definition_zh: (動) 放棄；拋棄
example_sentence: The team abandoned the project due to a lack of funds.
sentence_zh: 該團隊因資金不足而放棄了這個計畫。

definition_zh: (形) 被遺棄的；廢棄的
example_sentence: The stray dog looked frightened because it had been abandoned by its owner.
sentence_zh: 那隻流浪狗看起來很害怕，因為牠被主人遺棄了。

definition_zh: (動) 貶低；使丟臉
example_sentence: Abasing himself before the crowd, the athlete apologized sincerely for cheating.
sentence_zh: 那位運動員在群眾面前貶低自己，誠心為作弊道歉。

definition_zh: (動) 減弱；減輕
example_sentence: The heavy rain, which finally abated after midnight, let students sleep.
sentence_zh: 那場大雨在午夜後終於減弱，讓學生們得以入睡。

definition_zh: (名) 修道院；大教堂
example_sentence: If the tour group visits London, the abbey will be their first stop.
sentence_zh: 如果旅行團參觀倫敦，那座修道院將會是他們的第一站。

definition_zh: (動) 縮寫；縮短
example_sentence: Teachers often abbreviate long chapter titles on the board.
sentence_zh: 老師常在黑板上將冗長的章節標題縮寫。

definition_zh: (名) 縮寫；縮略詞
example_sentence: Students use the abbreviation "govt" to save time when taking notes.
sentence_zh: 學生使用縮寫「govt」來節省做筆記的時間。

definition_zh: (名) 腹部；腹腔
example_sentence: The doctor pressed the abdomen, and the patient felt sharp pain.
sentence_zh: 醫生按壓腹部，病人感到劇烈疼痛。

definition_zh: (動) 綁架；誘拐
example_sentence: The police acted quickly after the child was abducted near the school.
sentence_zh: 那名孩童在學校附近遭到綁架後，警方迅速採取行動。

definition_zh: (名) 綁架；誘拐
example_sentence: Having survived the abduction, the student shared her story with police.
sentence_zh: 那名學生在綁架事件中倖存後，向警方講述了自己的遭遇。

definition_zh: (動) 煽動；協助（犯罪）
example_sentence: The classmate who abetted the bully faced serious school punishment.
sentence_zh: 那位協助霸凌者的同學面臨嚴重的校規處分。

definition_zh: (動) 憎惡；厭惡
example_sentence: Most students abhor cheating, but exam pressure can be overwhelming.
sentence_zh: 大多數學生憎惡作弊，但考試壓力有時會讓人難以承受。

definition_zh: (形) 令人厭惡的；可憎的
example_sentence: If the school found bullying abhorrent, stricter rules would protect every student.
sentence_zh: 如果學校認為霸凌行為令人厭惡，更嚴格的規定將保護每位學生。

definition_zh: (片) 遵守；遵從
example_sentence: All students must abide by the school rules every day.
sentence_zh: 所有學生每天都必須遵守校規。

definition_zh: (動) 遵守；忍受
example_sentence: Abiding by the school rules, students avoided many unnecessary conflicts.
sentence_zh: 遵守校規，學生們避免了許多不必要的衝突。

definition_zh: (形) 持久的；永久的
example_sentence: Students gain an abiding love for reading because great books change their lives.
sentence_zh: 學生們培養出對閱讀持久的熱愛，因為好書改變了他們的生命。

definition_zh: (名) 能力；才能
example_sentence: Never has the ability to work well with others been more important than today.
sentence_zh: 與他人良好合作的能力從未像今天這樣重要。

definition_zh: (形) 非生物的；無生命環境的
example_sentence: Sunlight and water are abiotic factors that all living things depend on.
sentence_zh: 陽光和水是所有生物都依賴的非生物因子。

definition_zh: (形) 極度悲慘的；卑劣的
example_sentence: The charity raised funds to rescue families from abject poverty.
sentence_zh: 該慈善機構募集資金，以拯救生活在赤貧中的家庭。

definition_zh: (形) 燃燒的；光輝燦爛的
example_sentence: The old barn was ablaze, and thick smoke filled the night sky.
sentence_zh: 那座舊穀倉燃起大火，濃煙瀰漫了整個夜空。

definition_zh: (形) 能夠的；有能力的
example_sentence: Most students are able to finish the test on time.
sentence_zh: 大多數學生能夠準時完成考試。

definition_zh: (形) 異常的；不正常的
example_sentence: The doctor ran more tests because the blood results looked abnormal.
sentence_zh: 因為血液檢查結果看起來異常，醫生進行了更多檢驗。

definition_zh: (副) 在船（車、飛機）上　(介) 上（船、車、飛機）
example_sentence: Stepping aboard the plane, the students felt excitement for their first overseas trip.
sentence_zh: 踏上飛機時，這些學生對他們的第一次海外旅行感到興奮。

definition_zh: (名) 住所；居所
example_sentence: The old cottage that the artist chose as an abode looked peaceful.
sentence_zh: 那位藝術家選擇作為住所的老農舍看起來十分寧靜。

definition_zh: (動) 廢除；廢止
example_sentence: If the school abolishes the uniform policy, students can dress more freely.
sentence_zh: 如果學校廢除制服規定，學生就能穿著更自由。

definition_zh: (形) 原住民的；土著的　(名) 原住民；土著
example_sentence: Aboriginal cultures in Taiwan are rich and diverse.
sentence_zh: 台灣的原住民文化豐富而多元。

definition_zh: (名) 原住民；土著
example_sentence: The museum opened a special exhibit to honor Taiwan's aborigines.
sentence_zh: 博物館開設了一個特別展覽，以表彰台灣的原住民。

definition_zh: (動) 中止；放棄　(名) 中止行動
example_sentence: The rocket launch failed, so the team had to abort the mission.
sentence_zh: 火箭發射失敗，所以團隊不得不中止任務。

definition_zh: (名) 墮胎；流產
example_sentence: The debate over abortion continues because people hold very different values.
sentence_zh: 關於墮胎的辯論持續不斷，因為人們持有非常不同的價值觀。

definition_zh: (動) 大量存在；充滿
example_sentence: Having abounded in fresh seafood for centuries, this coastal town attracts many food lovers.
sentence_zh: 這座沿海小鎮數百年來盛產新鮮海鮮，吸引了許多美食愛好者。

definition_zh: (介) 關於；大約　(副) 到處；附近
example_sentence: The book about animals that the teacher recommended is very interesting.
sentence_zh: 老師推薦的那本關於動物的書非常有趣。

definition_zh: (介) 在…上方；高於　(副) 在上面；以上
example_sentence: The score is above 90, so the class can have a free period.
sentence_zh: 分數高於90分，所以這堂課可以自由活動。

definition_zh: (名) 磨損；擦傷
example_sentence: If the climber wore proper gloves, the rope would cause less abrasion on the hands.
sentence_zh: 如果那位登山者戴了適當的手套，繩子對手部造成的磨損就會少一些。

definition_zh: (副) 並排地；跟上地　(形) 並列的；不落後的
example_sentence: Daily reading keeps students abreast of current events.
sentence_zh: 每天閱讀讓學生跟上時事。

definition_zh: (副) 在國外；到國外
example_sentence: Studying abroad, many students discover new cultures and gain confidence.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在國外求學時，發現了新文化並建立了自信。

definition_zh: (形) 突然的；唐突的
example_sentence: The music stopped abruptly because the speaker lost power suddenly.
sentence_zh: 音樂突然停止，因為喇叭突然沒電了。

definition_zh: (副) 突然地；唐突地
example_sentence: Hardly had the music started when the power went out abruptly.
sentence_zh: 音樂幾乎才剛開始，電力就突然中斷了。

definition_zh: (名) 缺席；不在
example_sentence: The absence that worried the teacher most was Tom's.
sentence_zh: 最讓老師擔心的缺席是湯姆的。

definition_zh: (形) 心不在焉的；健忘的
example_sentence: The professor set a daily alarm to avoid being absent-minded during class.
sentence_zh: 那位教授設定每日鬧鐘，以避免上課時心不在焉。

definition_zh: (形) 缺席的；不在的
example_sentence: Mark was absent from class, so the teacher called his parents.
sentence_zh: Mark缺課，所以老師打電話給他的父母。

definition_zh: (名) 缺席者；曠課者　(形) 缺席的；不在場的
example_sentence: The teacher marked three absentee students in the morning roll call.
sentence_zh: 老師在早上點名時記錄了三位缺席的學生。

definition_zh: (形) 絕對的；完全的　(副) 絕對地；完全地
example_sentence: The classroom stayed silent because the teacher required absolute concentration.
sentence_zh: 因為老師要求絕對的專注，教室裡保持安靜。

definition_zh: (副) 絕對地；完全地
example_sentence: Trained hard every day, the student felt absolutely ready for the exam.
sentence_zh: 每天努力練習，這位學生感到自己已完全準備好迎接考試。

definition_zh: (動) 赦免；免除責任
example_sentence: The judge absolved the student who had told the full truth.
sentence_zh: 法官赦免了那位說出全部實情的學生。

definition_zh: (動) 吸收；全神貫注
example_sentence: If students read every day, their brains will absorb new words more easily.
sentence_zh: 如果學生每天閱讀，他們的大腦將更容易吸收新單字。

definition_zh: (動) 戒除；棄權
example_sentence: Athletes should abstain from junk food before a big competition.
sentence_zh: 運動員在大型比賽前應該戒除垃圾食物。

definition_zh: (形) ['æbstrækt] 抽象的；深奧的　(名) ['æbstrækt] 摘要；概要　(動) [æb'strækt] 摘錄；提取
example_sentence: Artists use abstract shapes to express emotions beyond words.
sentence_zh: 藝術家使用抽象的形狀來表達超越言語的情感。

definition_zh: (名) 抽象概念；抽象化
example_sentence: Math uses abstraction, so students must think beyond concrete numbers.
sentence_zh: 數學運用抽象概念，因此學生必須超越具體數字來思考。

definition_zh: (形) 深奧的；難解的
example_sentence: The philosophy text seemed abstruse because the concepts were too complex.
sentence_zh: 這本哲學課本看起來深奧難懂，因為其中的概念太複雜了。

definition_zh: (形) 荒謬的；可笑的
example_sentence: Having heard the absurd excuse, the teacher shook her head in disbelief.
sentence_zh: 聽了那個荒謬的藉口後，老師難以置信地搖了搖頭。

definition_zh: (名) 豐富；大量
example_sentence: The market sells fresh fruit that is available in great abundance.
sentence_zh: 那個市場販售大量新鮮水果。

definition_zh: (形) 豐富的；大量的
example_sentence: Taiwan's mountains receive abundant rainfall, so rivers rarely run dry.
sentence_zh: 台灣山區雨量充沛，因此河流很少乾涸。

definition_zh: (副) 充裕地；大量地
example_sentence: If the school garden received more sunlight, vegetables would grow abundantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學校菜園得到更多陽光，蔬菜就會大量生長。

definition_zh: (名) [ə'bjus] 濫用；虐待　(動) [ə'bjuz] 濫用；虐待
example_sentence: Drug abuse causes serious damage to a person's health.
sentence_zh: 藥物濫用會對一個人的健康造成嚴重傷害。

definition_zh: (形) 辱罵的；虐待的
example_sentence: Feeling threatened, the player began using abusive language toward teammates.
sentence_zh: 感到受威脅時，那名球員開始對隊友使用辱罵性的語言。

definition_zh: (形) 學術的；學業的　(名) 學者；大學教師
example_sentence: Students perform better academically when their parents show strong support.
sentence_zh: 當父母給予大力支持時，學生的學業表現會更好。

definition_zh: (名) 學院；學術團體
example_sentence: Only after joining the academy did young artists gain true recognition.
sentence_zh: 唯有加入學院之後，年輕藝術家才獲得真正的肯定。

definition_zh: (動) 加速；促進
example_sentence: The new train line accelerates the progress that students make on daily commutes.
sentence_zh: 新的火車路線加速了學生每日通勤的進步效率。

definition_zh: (形) 加速的；加快的　(動) 加速；促進
example_sentence: The school offers an accelerated program to help gifted students graduate early.
sentence_zh: 這所學校提供加速課程，幫助資優生提早畢業。

definition_zh: (名) 加速；加速度
example_sentence: The car's acceleration was impressive, and the passengers felt a strong push.
sentence_zh: 這輛車的加速表現令人印象深刻，乘客感受到強烈的推力。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈæksɛnt] 口音；腔調　(動) [ækˈsɛnt] 強調；使突出
example_sentence: The foreign teacher's accent sounds very natural and clear.
sentence_zh: 那位外籍老師的口音聽起來非常自然且清晰。

definition_zh: (動) 強調；使突出
example_sentence: Dark colors accentuate the design because they create strong contrast.
sentence_zh: 深色能使設計更突出，因為它們製造強烈對比。

definition_zh: (動) 接受；承認
example_sentence: Accepted into the top university, Lisa felt proud of her hard work.
sentence_zh: 被頂尖大學錄取後，Lisa 對自己的努力感到驕傲。

definition_zh: (形) 可接受的；令人滿意的
example_sentence: The score that most teachers find acceptable is above sixty.
sentence_zh: 大多數老師認為可接受的分數是六十分以上。

definition_zh: (名) 接受；認可
example_sentence: If the school sends an acceptance letter, the student should reply quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果學校寄來錄取通知，該學生應該盡快回覆。

definition_zh: (形) 被接受的；公認的
example_sentence: Hard work is the accepted key to success in school.
sentence_zh: 努力是學校中公認的成功關鍵。

definition_zh: (名) 入口；使用權　(動) 存取；進入
example_sentence: Students need a library card to access the online database.
sentence_zh: 學生需要圖書館借書證才能使用線上資料庫。

definition_zh: (形) 可進入的；易獲得的
example_sentence: The new library is accessible, and all students can borrow books freely.
sentence_zh: 新圖書館方便進入，所有學生都可以自由借書。

definition_zh: (名) 配件；附屬品　(形) 附加的；輔助的
example_sentence: The bag looks more stylish because the accessories match the outfit perfectly.
sentence_zh: 這個包看起來更時尚，因為配件與整套服裝完美搭配。

definition_zh: (名) 意外；事故
example_sentence: Having witnessed a serious accident, the driver called for help immediately.
sentence_zh: 目睹了一場嚴重事故後，那位駕駛立刻呼救。

definition_zh: (形) 意外的；偶然的
example_sentence: The fire that broke out in the lab was completely accidental.
sentence_zh: 實驗室發生的火災完全是意外。

definition_zh: (名) 喝采；讚揚　(動) 歡呼；稱讚
example_sentence: The young pianist performed brilliantly, and the audience responded with loud acclaim.
sentence_zh: 這位年輕鋼琴家表現出色，觀眾以熱烈的喝采回應。

definition_zh: (形) 廣受好評的；備受讚譽的
example_sentence: If this novel were more widely read, it would become an acclaimed classic.
sentence_zh: 如果這本小說被更廣泛閱讀，它將會成為一部廣受好評的經典。

definition_zh: (名) 榮譽；獎讚
example_sentence: The young pianist received a great accolade at the national competition.
sentence_zh: 這位年輕鋼琴家在全國比賽中獲得極高榮譽。

definition_zh: (動) 容納；提供住宿
example_sentence: Designed to accommodate large crowds, the new stadium hosts major sports events.
sentence_zh: 這座新體育場設計可容納大批人群，舉辦重要體育賽事。

definition_zh: (形) 樂於助人的；隨和的
example_sentence: The hotel staff were so accommodating that every guest felt welcome.
sentence_zh: 飯店員工非常樂於助人，以至於每位客人都感到受歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 住宿；accommodation
example_sentence: Only after booking accommodation did the travel club announce the trip dates.
sentence_zh: 旅遊社在訂好住宿之後，才公布行程日期。

definition_zh: (名) 住宿；膳宿
example_sentence: The hotel accommodations that the school booked were clean and comfortable.
sentence_zh: 學校預訂的飯店住宿既乾淨又舒適。

definition_zh: (動) 陪同；伴隨
example_sentence: A school nurse accompanied the students to visit the hospital.
sentence_zh: 一位學校護士陪同學生們去參觀醫院。

definition_zh: (動) 完成；達成
example_sentence: The team worked hard all week, and they accomplished every goal.
sentence_zh: 這個團隊整週努力工作，並完成了每一個目標。

definition_zh: (形) 熟練的；有才藝的
example_sentence: The accomplished pianist won first place at the national competition.
sentence_zh: 那位技藝精湛的鋼琴家在全國比賽中獲得第一名。

definition_zh: (名) 成就；成績
example_sentence: Winning the science fair felt like a great accomplishment because the project took months.
sentence_zh: 贏得科學展覽感覺像是一項巨大成就，因為這個專題花了好幾個月。

definition_zh: (名) 協議；一致　(動) 給予；符合
example_sentence: Reached in accord with both sides, the peace agreement ended years of conflict.
sentence_zh: 這份和平協議在雙方一致同意下達成，結束了多年的衝突。

definition_zh: (名) 一致；符合
example_sentence: The rules that students follow must be in accordance with school policy.
sentence_zh: 學生遵守的規定必須符合學校政策。

definition_zh: (副) 因此；照著辦
example_sentence: If the weather turns bad, the outdoor event will be canceled accordingly.
sentence_zh: 如果天氣變差，戶外活動將因此取消。

definition_zh: (名) 手風琴
example_sentence: The old musician plays the accordion at the night market every weekend.
sentence_zh: 那位老音樂家每個週末在夜市演奏手風琴。

definition_zh: (名) 帳戶；帳號　(動) 說明；解釋
example_sentence: Students need a school email account to access online learning materials.
sentence_zh: 學生需要一個學校電子郵件帳號來使用線上學習資料。

definition_zh: (形) 負有責任的；應負責的
example_sentence: The class leader made a mistake, so the class leader must be accountable for it.
sentence_zh: 班長犯了錯，因此班長必須為此負責。

definition_zh: (名) 會計師；會計人員
example_sentence: The accountant checked every number twice because the report was due tomorrow.
sentence_zh: 那位會計師把每個數字都核對了兩遍，因為報告明天就要交了。

definition_zh: (名) 會計；帳務處理
example_sentence: Having studied accounting for two years, the student handled the club's budget with ease.
sentence_zh: 在學習了兩年會計之後，那名學生輕鬆地處理了社團的預算。

definition_zh: (動) 認可；授權
example_sentence: The university that the school board accredits offers strong science programs.
sentence_zh: 校董會認可的那所大學提供優秀的理科課程。

definition_zh: (名) 逐漸增長；積聚
example_sentence: Coral reefs grow slowly, and their accretion takes thousands of years.
sentence_zh: 珊瑚礁生長緩慢，其積聚需要數千年的時間。

definition_zh: (副) 正確地；精確地
example_sentence: If the lab equipment were calibrated, the results would be recorded more accurately.
sentence_zh: 如果實驗設備經過校準，結果就會被更精確地記錄下來。

definition_zh: (動) 積累；累積
example_sentence: Dust accumulates on the shelves without regular cleaning.
sentence_zh: 沒有定期清潔，灰塵就會積在架子上。

definition_zh: (名) 積累；堆積
example_sentence: Accumulated over years, the student's notes filled three thick binders.
sentence_zh: 這位學生的筆記累積多年，裝滿了三個厚厚的活頁夾。

definition_zh: (名) 準確性；精確度
example_sentence: Only after years of practice did the archer achieve such accuracy.
sentence_zh: 唯有經過多年練習，那位弓箭手才達到如此高的準確度。

definition_zh: (形) 準確的；精確的
example_sentence: The weather report that the scientist made was completely accurate.
sentence_zh: 那位科學家所做的天氣預報完全準確。

definition_zh: (副) 準確地；精確地
example_sentence: Students must practice reading maps accurately to pass the geography test.
sentence_zh: 學生必須練習準確地讀地圖，以通過地理測驗。

definition_zh: (形) 被詛咒的；令人厭惡的
example_sentence: The old map marked the accursed forest, and no villager dared enter it.
sentence_zh: 古老的地圖標記了那片被詛咒的森林，沒有村民敢進入。

definition_zh: (名) 指控；控告　(名) 被控告的事；罪名
example_sentence: The accusation against the manager turned out to be false and unfair.
sentence_zh: 對經理的控告結果證明是虛假且不公正的。

definition_zh: (動) 指控；控告　非難；譴責
example_sentence: Although the witness accused the suspect of theft, the judge found insufficient evidence to convict him.
sentence_zh: 雖然證人指控嫌疑人偷竊，但法官發現證據不足而判其無罪。

definition_zh: (動) 使習慣；使適應　(形) 習慣的；通常的
example_sentence: Having accustomed ourselves to online learning, students adapted well to hybrid classes.
sentence_zh: 已經習慣了線上學習，學生們很好地適應了混合式課程。

definition_zh: (形) 習慣的；適應的　(動) 使習慣；使適應
example_sentence: Students accustomed to studying alone often struggle with group projects that require collaboration.
sentence_zh: 習慣於獨自讀書的學生常常在需要合作的小組專案中感到困難。

definition_zh: (名) 王牌；高手　(動) 成功地完成；獲得優異成績　(形) 優秀的；一流的
example_sentence: If you ace the CSAT exam, universities will offer you better scholarships.
sentence_zh: 如果你在學測中表現優異，大學將會提供更好的獎學金。

definition_zh: (名) 乙醯膽鹼；神經傳遞物質
example_sentence: Acetylcholine is a chemical messenger that helps nerve cells communicate with muscles.
sentence_zh: 乙醯膽鹼是一種化學信使，幫助神經細胞與肌肉溝通。

definition_zh: (動) 渴望；想念　(片) ache for 渴望得到；迫不及待想要
example_sentence: After months abroad, the exchange student ached for returning home to see family.
sentence_zh: 在國外待了幾個月後，這位交換學生渴望回家看望家人。

definition_zh: (名) 疼痛；酸痛　(動) 疼痛；酸痛
example_sentence: After playing basketball for two hours, my legs and back ache from the intense exercise.
sentence_zh: 打了兩小時籃球後，我的腿和背部因為激烈運動而酸痛。

definition_zh: (動) 達成；完成　(動) 獲得；取得
example_sentence: Although the project was difficult, the team achieved its goal by working together consistently.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個專案很困難，但團隊透過持續合作達成了目標。

definition_zh: (名) 成就；成就感　(名) 達成；完成
example_sentence: Having completed the challenging project, the team's achievement was recognized by the entire school.
sentence_zh: 完成了具有挑戰性的專案後，該團隊的成就獲得了整所學校的認可。

definition_zh: (片) 打噴嚏的擬聲詞
example_sentence: The student who went achoo during the exam had to leave the classroom quickly.
sentence_zh: 在考試中打噴嚏(achoo)的那位學生必須快速離開教室。

definition_zh: (名) 酸；酸性物質　(形) 酸的；尖刻的
example_sentence: Lemon juice contains citric acid, which gives it a sour and tangy flavor.
sentence_zh: 檸檬汁含有檸檬酸，使其具有酸酸的刺激味道。

definition_zh: (形) 略帶酸味的；尖酸刻薄的
example_sentence: If the professor's acidulous remarks were less biting, students would feel more comfortable asking questions during class.
sentence_zh: 如果教授那些尖酸刻薄的評論沒有那麼傷人，學生在課堂上會更願意提問。

definition_zh: (動) 承認；認可　(動) 表示感謝；致謝
example_sentence: The principal acknowledged the students' hard work at the school assembly.
sentence_zh: 校長在學校集會上表示感謝學生們的努力。

definition_zh: (名) 承認；認可　(名) 感謝；致謝
example_sentence: Receiving acknowledgment from the teacher, the student felt proud of her hard work.
sentence_zh: 收到老師的認可，那個學生為她的辛勤工作感到驕傲。

definition_zh: (名) 頂點；高峰　(名) 最高成就；極致
example_sentence: When the athlete reached the acme of her career, she won three Olympic gold medals in succession.
sentence_zh: 當這位運動員達到她職業生涯的高峰時，她連續獲得三枚奧運金牌。

definition_zh: (名) 青春痘；粉刺
example_sentence: Seldom does acne disappear overnight without proper skincare and treatment.
sentence_zh: 沒有適當的護膚和治療，青春痘很少會在一夜之間消失。

definition_zh: (名) 助手；門徒　(名) 追隨者；信徒
example_sentence: The politician surrounded himself with loyal acolytes who followed his every decision without question.
sentence_zh: 那位政治人物身邊圍繞著忠誠的追隨者，他們毫無疑問地跟隨他的每一個決定。

definition_zh: (形) 聲學的；與聲音有關的　(名) 音響效果；聲學特性
example_sentence: The concert hall was designed with special acoustic materials to improve sound quality.
sentence_zh: 音樂廳採用特殊的聲學材料來改善音響效果。

definition_zh: (動) 使認識；介紹　(動) 了解；熟悉
example_sentence: The tour guide acquainted all visitors with the history and culture of this ancient temple.
sentence_zh: 導遊使所有遊客認識了這座古廟的歷史和文化。

definition_zh: (名) 認識的人；泛泛之交　(名) 認識；熟悉
example_sentence: Making new acquaintances at school helps students build a wider social network.
sentence_zh: 在學校結交新認識的人有助於學生建立更廣泛的社交圈。

definition_zh: (形) 認識的；熟悉的　(動) 了解；使認識
example_sentence: Before joining the debate club, Sarah became acquainted with the team members through online meetings.
sentence_zh: 在加入辯論社之前，莎拉透過線上會議與隊員變得熟悉。

definition_zh: (動) 默認；同意　(動) 順從；妥協
example_sentence: Acquiescing to the school's new uniform policy, students gradually accepted the change without further complaint.
sentence_zh: 默認學校的新制服政策，學生逐漸接受了這項改變而不再抱怨。

definition_zh: (形) 默許的；順從的　(形) 不反對的；被動接受的
example_sentence: The manager's acquiescent attitude toward unfair policies disappointed many employees who expected leadership.
sentence_zh: 經理對不公平政策的默許態度讓許多期待領導力的員工感到失望。

definition_zh: (動) 獲得；取得　(動) 學到；習得
example_sentence: If students acquire strong English skills now, they will succeed in future university entrance exams.
sentence_zh: 如果學生現在獲得強大的英語技能，他們將在未來的大學入學考試中成功。

definition_zh: (形) 獲得的；後天習得的　(動) 獲得；取得
example_sentence: Learning a new language is an acquired skill that requires consistent practice.
sentence_zh: 學習新語言是一項後天習得的技能，需要持續練習。

definition_zh: (名) 取得；獲得　(名) 獲得的事物；所得
example_sentence: Studying hard is essential to acquire the knowledge and skills needed for university entrance.
sentence_zh: 努力學習是為了取得大學入學所需的知識和技能。

definition_zh: (名) 獲得；習得　(名) 所得物；收購品
example_sentence: The company's acquisition of a smaller competitor helped expand market share and strengthen business position.
sentence_zh: 這家公司對一家較小競爭對手的收購幫助了市場占有率的擴大和商業地位的加強。

definition_zh: (動) 宣判無罪；證明清白
example_sentence: Although the defendant was accused of theft, the jury acquitted him because the evidence was insufficient.
sentence_zh: 雖然被告被指控竊盜，但由於證據不足，陪審團宣判他無罪。

definition_zh: (名) 英畝（面積單位）；田地
example_sentence: Having purchased ten acres, the farmer began planning the crop rotation schedule.
sentence_zh: 買下十英畝的土地後，農夫開始規劃輪作計畫。

definition_zh: (形) 刺鼻的；辛辣的　(形) 尖刻的；刻薄的
example_sentence: The acrid smoke that filled the chemistry lab made students cough and leave quickly.
sentence_zh: 充滿化學實驗室的刺鼻煙霧使學生咳嗽並快速離開。

definition_zh: (名) 特技表演者；雜技演員
example_sentence: The skilled acrobat performed amazing flips and handstands on the circus stage.
sentence_zh: 技藝精湛的特技表演者在馬戲團舞台上表演令人驚嘆的翻騰和倒立動作。

definition_zh: (名) 縮寫詞；首字母縮略詞
example_sentence: If students learned common acronyms, understanding English texts would become much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果學生學會常見的縮寫詞，理解英文文章就會變得容易得多。

definition_zh: (名) 懼高症；害怕高處的恐懼症
example_sentence: Many people suffer from acrophobia and avoid climbing tall buildings or mountains.
sentence_zh: 許多人患有懼高症，因此避免爬高樓或山峰。

definition_zh: (介) 穿過；橫過　(副) 橫過；對面地　(形) 橫跨的；對面的
example_sentence: Running across the busy street, the student nearly got hit by a car.
sentence_zh: 跑過繁忙街道的學生差點被車撞到。

definition_zh: (動) 根據...行動；按照...做　(動) 對...起作用；影響
example_sentence: After receiving the test results, the principal acted on the feedback and improved the school's teaching methods.
sentence_zh: 收到測試結果後，校長根據反饋意見行動，改進了學校的教學方法。

definition_zh: (動) 表演；演出　(動) 發洩；表現出來
example_sentence: Seldom does a shy student act out emotions so freely on stage.
sentence_zh: 一個害羞的學生很少在舞台上如此自由地表演情感。

definition_zh: (動) 故障；出毛病　(動) 調皮；惹麻煩
example_sentence: The old printer that acts up every Monday frustrates our office staff.
sentence_zh: 那臺每週一都會故障的舊印表機讓辦公室員工很沮喪。

definition_zh: (動) 行動；做；表演　(名) 行為；法案；段落
example_sentence: Students study hard to act out their dreams in the future.
sentence_zh: 學生們努力讀書以實現未來的夢想。

definition_zh: (名) 表演；演出　(動) 扮演；擔任角色　(形) 代理的；臨時的
example_sentence: Studying acting and performing in school plays help students build confidence.
sentence_zh: 學習表演和在校園戲劇中演出能幫助學生建立信心。

definition_zh: (名) 行動；動作　(名) 行為；作用
example_sentence: Taking action to protect the environment is important for all students.
sentence_zh: 採取行動保護環境對所有學生來說都很重要。

definition_zh: (動) 啟動；激活　(動) 使活躍；激勵
example_sentence: Once the alarm system is activated, security guards immediately respond to any unusual movement detected.
sentence_zh: 一旦警報系統被啟動，保安人員就會立即對任何偵測到的異常活動做出反應。

definition_zh: (形) 積極的；主動的　(動) 啟動；激活
example_sentence: The students actively participating in the science club gained valuable experience preparing for university.
sentence_zh: 積極參與科學社團的學生獲得了為大學做準備的寶貴經驗。

definition_zh: (副) 積極地；主動地　(副) 活躍地；精力充沛地
example_sentence: Students who actively participate in class discussions tend to improve their English skills.
sentence_zh: 積極參與課堂討論的學生往往會進步得更快。

definition_zh: (名) 行動主義者；積極分子　(形) 行動主義的；積極分子的
example_sentence: If environmental activists raise awareness now, many species could be protected from extinction.
sentence_zh: 如果環保人士現在提高公眾意識，許多物種就能免於滅絕。

definition_zh: (名) 活動；事物　(名) 積極性；活躍
example_sentence: School activities help students develop new skills and make friends.
sentence_zh: 學校活動幫助學生發展新技能並交新朋友。

definition_zh: (名) 演員；男演員　(名) 行動者；參與者
example_sentence: Many students join drama clubs to become a professional actor in the future.
sentence_zh: 許多學生加入戲劇社是為了將來成為專業演員。

definition_zh: (名) 女演員；女優
example_sentence: The famous actress won the Best Actress award at the film festival last night.
sentence_zh: 那位著名女演員在昨晚的電影節上獲得最佳女演員獎。

definition_zh: (形) 實際的；真實的　(副) 實際上；其實
example_sentence: Although the movie looked exciting in the trailer, the actual plot turned out to be quite boring.
sentence_zh: 雖然電影預告看起來很刺激，但實際上的劇情卻相當無聊。

definition_zh: (副) 實際上；其實　(副) 竟然；居然
example_sentence: Having studied hard for months, the student actually failed the exam, shocking everyone in the class.
sentence_zh: 經過數月的努力學習，這名學生竟然考試不及格，令班上所有人感到震驚。

definition_zh: (動) 驅動；激勵　(動) 促使；推動
example_sentence: The desire to succeed, which actuates ambitious students, often leads to academic excellence.
sentence_zh: 促使野心勃勃的學生向前的成功欲望，往往導致學業成就。

definition_zh: (名) 執行器；驅動裝置　(名) 致動器；操動裝置
example_sentence: The robot's actuator system controls all movements and responses automatically.
sentence_zh: 機器人的執行器系統自動控制所有的動作和反應。

definition_zh: (形) 有刺的；尖銳的
example_sentence: If the cactus were not aculeate, desert animals would consume it without difficulty.
sentence_zh: 如果仙人掌不是有刺的，沙漠動物就能毫無困難地吃掉它。

definition_zh: (名) 敏銳的眼光；聰慧；商業頭腦
example_sentence: Business acumen helped the young entrepreneur succeed in the competitive market.
sentence_zh: 敏銳的商業眼光幫助這位年輕創業家在競爭激烈的市場中取得成功。

definition_zh: (名) 穴位；穴道
example_sentence: Stimulating the acupoint located on the wrist, the acupuncturist relieved the patient's headache.
sentence_zh: 針灸師刺激位於手腕上的穴位，緩解了患者的頭痛。

definition_zh: (名) 穴位按壓療法；按壓穴位
example_sentence: Since acupressure can relieve headaches without medication, many students use it during exam preparation.
sentence_zh: 由於穴位按壓療法可以不用藥物就緩解頭痛，許多學生在準備考試時會使用它。

definition_zh: (名) 針灸；穴位針刺療法
example_sentence: Not only does acupuncture relieve pain, but it also improves overall health significantly.
sentence_zh: 針灸不僅能緩解疼痛，而且還能顯著改善整體健康。

definition_zh: (形) 嚴重的；急性的　(形) 敏銳的；尖銳的
example_sentence: The patient who had an acute illness needed immediate hospital care.
sentence_zh: 患有急性疾病的患者需要立即住院治療。

definition_zh: (副) 敏銳地；尖銳地　(副) 急迫地；嚴重地
example_sentence: The nurse noticed acutely that patients needed better support to recover quickly.
sentence_zh: 護士敏銳地意識到病患需要更好的支持才能迅速康復。

definition_zh: (名) 廣告；廣告文案　(動) 登廣告；刊登廣告
example_sentence: The company posted an ad on social media to attract young customers.
sentence_zh: 這家公司在社群媒體上刊登廣告以吸引年輕顧客。

definition_zh: (形) 堅定的；不動搖的　(形) 堅決的；拒不改變的
example_sentence: Despite his parents' objections, Marcus remained adamant about pursuing a music career.
sentence_zh: 儘管父母反對，馬克仍然堅定地追求音樂事業。

definition_zh: (動) 適應；調整　(動) 改編；改製
example_sentence: As students move to a new school, adapting to different teaching styles requires patience and effort.
sentence_zh: 當學生轉到新學校時，適應不同的教學方式需要耐心和努力。

definition_zh: (動) 適應；改編　(動) 調整；改造
example_sentence: Adapting to a new school environment, many students gradually build confidence and friendships.
sentence_zh: 適應新的學校環境，許多學生逐漸建立信心和友誼。

definition_zh: (形) 能適應的；適應力強的　能調整的；靈活的
example_sentence: Students who are adaptable to different learning methods succeed in the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 能夠適應不同學習方法的學生在學測考試中會成功。

definition_zh: (名) 適應；改編　(動) 適應；改編
example_sentence: If students make an effort to understand different cultures, adaptation to new environments would become much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果學生努力了解不同的文化，適應新環境就會變得容易得多。

definition_zh: (名) 適應；改編　(動) 改編；調整
example_sentence: The film's adaption of the popular novel attracted many young viewers.
sentence_zh: 這部小說改編電影吸引了許多年輕觀眾。

definition_zh: (形) 適應的；能適應的　(形) 調整的；改進的
example_sentence: Students use adaptive learning strategies to improve their test scores.
sentence_zh: 學生運用適應性學習策略來提高考試成績。

definition_zh: (動) 增加；附加　(動) 加入；添加
example_sentence: The restaurant offers a dessert add-on for five dollars extra.
sentence_zh: 這家餐廳提供甜點附加餐點，需另付五美元。

definition_zh: (動) 加起來等於；總計
example_sentence: Although the test scores seemed low individually, they added up to a passing grade when combined.
sentence_zh: 雖然個別測驗分數看起來很低，但加起來總共達到及格分數。

definition_zh: (動) 加；增加　(動) 補充說；繼續說
example_sentence: Having added all the numbers correctly, Maria submitted her math homework without worry.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞正確地加上所有的數字後，毫無擔憂地交了數學作業。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈædɪkt] 成癮者；上癮的人　(動) [əˈdɪkt] 使成癮；沉溺於　(形) 成癮的；上癮的
example_sentence: Students who become addicts to social media often struggle with academic focus and sleep.
sentence_zh: 沉溺於社群媒體的學生經常難以專注於課業和睡眠。

definition_zh: (形) 沉溺於…的；成癮的　(動) 使…成癮；使…沉溺
example_sentence: Playing mobile games becomes addicted, so many students struggle with their homework.
sentence_zh: 玩手遊變得成癮，所以許多學生為功課而苦惱。

definition_zh: (名) 成癮；上癮　(名) 沉溺；癡迷
example_sentence: If social media addiction did not consume so much study time, many students would achieve better exam scores.
sentence_zh: 如果社群媒體成癮不會佔用那麼多讀書時間，許多學生就能考得更好的成績。

definition_zh: (名) 加法；加運算　(名) 附加物；增加
example_sentence: Learning addition is the first step in elementary mathematics.
sentence_zh: 學習加法是小學數學的第一步。

definition_zh: (形) 額外的；另外的　(形) 補充的；增加的
example_sentence: Having completed the main project, students received additional assignments requiring extra research and writing skills.
sentence_zh: 完成主要專案後，學生收到需要額外研究和寫作技能的額外作業。

definition_zh: (副) 另外；此外　(副) 而且；加上
example_sentence: The university requires a high test score; additionally, students must submit a strong essay.
sentence_zh: 這所大學要求高的考試成績；此外，學生還必須提交一篇優秀的文章。

definition_zh: (形) 添加的；附加的　(名) 添加劑；加法的
example_sentence: Not only does artificial color improve appearance, but artificial additives also preserve food freshly.
sentence_zh: 人工色素不僅改善外觀，人工添加劑也能保持食物新鮮。

definition_zh: (名) 地址；住址　(動) 向…說話；處理
example_sentence: The letter was sent to the address that the customer provided during checkout.
sentence_zh: 這封信被寄到顧客結帳時提供的地址。

definition_zh: (名) 收件人；收信人
example_sentence: The envelope must be marked clearly to help the postal worker deliver mail to the correct addressee.
sentence_zh: 信封必須清楚標記，以幫助郵遞員把郵件送給正確的收件人。

definition_zh: (形) 熟練的；精通的　(動) 使適應；調整
example_sentence: Being adept at time management and organization helped many students pass the CSAT exam successfully.
sentence_zh: 精通時間管理和組織的學生許多都成功通過了學測。

definition_zh: (形) 足夠的；充分的　(形) 令人滿意的；適當的
example_sentence: Two hours of sleep is not adequate for preparing for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 兩小時的睡眠對於準備學測考試來說不夠充分。

definition_zh: (動) 遵守；信守　粘附；黏著
example_sentence: As long as students adhere to school rules, they can graduate successfully.
sentence_zh: 只要學生遵守校規，他們就能順利畢業。

definition_zh: (形) 忠實的；堅定支持的　(名) 支持者；信徒
example_sentence: Adhering to environmental principles, the organization attracts many devoted adherents worldwide.
sentence_zh: 堅持環保原則，該組織吸引了世界各地許多忠實的支持者。

definition_zh: (形) 黏著的；粘合的　(名) 黏合劑；膠水
example_sentence: The adhesive tape that holds the package together must be strong enough to survive shipping.
sentence_zh: 黏住包裝的黏著膠帶必須足夠牢固才能承受運送過程。

definition_zh: (形) 相鄰的；毗鄰的　(形) 靠近的；鄰接的
example_sentence: If the two adjacent classrooms were combined, the school could hold larger activities.
sentence_zh: 如果這兩間相鄰的教室合併，學校就能舉辦更大型的活動。

definition_zh: (名) 形容詞　(形) 描述性的；修飾性的
example_sentence: The word 'beautiful' is an adjective that describes the noun 'flower'.
sentence_zh: 'Beautiful'這個詞是描述名詞'flower'的形容詞。

definition_zh: (動) 與...相鄰；毗鄰　(動) 靠近；接近
example_sentence: The new shopping mall was built to adjoin the existing train station.
sentence_zh: 新購物中心的建造目的是與現有火車站相鄰。

definition_zh: (形) 相鄰的；毗鄰的　(形) 接著的；相連的
example_sentence: The two adjoining classrooms share a common wall, making it hard to concentrate during tests.
sentence_zh: 這兩間相鄰的教室共用一面牆，考試時很難集中注意力。

definition_zh: (動) 暫停；休會　散會；延期
example_sentence: After the heated debate ended, the committee adjourned until the following week.
sentence_zh: 激烈的辯論結束後，委員會暫停會議到下週。

definition_zh: (名) 附加物；兼職教師　(形) 附加的；兼職的
example_sentence: Having completed her master's degree, Professor Chen worked as an adjunct instructor teaching literature courses.
sentence_zh: 完成碩士學位後，陳教授以兼職講師身分教授文學課程。

definition_zh: (動) 調整；適應　(動) 調節；改變
example_sentence: The brightness of the screen, which students adjusted throughout the exam, affected their focus.
sentence_zh: 學生在考試期間調整的螢幕亮度影響了他們的專注力。

definition_zh: (形) 可調整的；可調節的
example_sentence: The desk lamp has an adjustable arm, so students can direct light exactly where needed.
sentence_zh: 這盞書桌燈有可調整的燈臂，學生可以把光線導向需要的地方。

definition_zh: (名) 調整；適應　(名) 調節；改正
example_sentence: If the camera adjustment were made properly, the photo quality would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果相機調整做得恰當，照片品質就會明顯改善。

definition_zh: (動) 管理；執行　(動) 施予；供給
example_sentence: The principal administers school rules fairly to all students.
sentence_zh: 校長公平地對所有學生執行學校規則。

definition_zh: (名) 管理；行政　(名) 政府部門；內閣
example_sentence: Managing school affairs, the administration worked hard to improve student facilities.
sentence_zh: 通過管理校務，學校行政部門努力改善學生設施。

definition_zh: (形) 行政的；管理的　(形) 與政府部門有關的
example_sentence: Although the administrative process seemed complicated, the school staff explained each step clearly.
sentence_zh: 儘管行政程序看起來很複雜，學校職員清楚地解釋了每一步驟。

definition_zh: (名) 管理者；行政人員　(名) 遺產管理人
example_sentence: Not only does the school administrator manage budgets, but also resolves student conflicts daily.
sentence_zh: 不僅學校管理者管理預算，而且每天解決學生衝突。

definition_zh: (形) 值得欽佩的；令人敬佩的
example_sentence: The athlete's dedication to training, which was admirable in every way, inspired countless young students.
sentence_zh: 這位運動員對訓練的投入，在各方面都令人敬佩，激勵了無數年輕學生。

definition_zh: (名) 海軍上將；旗艦司令官
example_sentence: The admiral commanded the entire fleet to protect the island against invasion.
sentence_zh: 那位海軍上將指揮整支艦隊以保護該島免受入侵。

definition_zh: (名) 欽佩；敬佩　(名) 讚美；崇拜
example_sentence: Winning the gold medal earned the athlete admiration and respect from people worldwide.
sentence_zh: 贏得金牌使這位運動員獲得來自世界各地人民的欽佩和尊重。

definition_zh: (動) 欣賞；讚美　(動) 仰慕；崇拜
example_sentence: Many students admire their teachers for patience and dedication.
sentence_zh: 許多學生欣賞老師的耐心和奉獻精神。

definition_zh: (名) 錄取；入學　(名) 承認；招認
example_sentence: Because admission to top universities is highly competitive, many students study hard throughout high school.
sentence_zh: 因為進入頂尖大學的入學競爭很激烈，許多學生在高中時期努力讀書。

definition_zh: (動) 承認；坦白　(動) 允許進入；放行
example_sentence: Admitting his mistake to the teacher, the student felt relieved and ready to improve.
sentence_zh: 向老師承認自己的錯誤，這個學生感到釋然，準備好改進。

definition_zh: (副) 誠然；確實　公認地；不可否認地
example_sentence: The exam was difficult, admittedly, but students who studied hard passed.
sentence_zh: 那場考試誠然很難，但認真準備的學生都及格了。

definition_zh: (名) 麻煩；費力　(動) 製造麻煩；折騰
example_sentence: If preparing for the CSAT exam without much ado, students would improve their vocabulary faster.
sentence_zh: 如果學生準備學測考試不費力，他們會更快地提高詞彙量。

definition_zh: (名) 青春期；青少年時期　(名) 青春期特有的行為或特徵
example_sentence: Adolescence is a time when teenagers experience physical and emotional changes.
sentence_zh: 青春期是青少年經歷身體和情緒變化的時期。

definition_zh: (名) 青少年；十幾歲的人　(形) 青春期的；少年的
example_sentence: Many adolescents attend summer camps to develop social skills and independence.
sentence_zh: 許多青少年參加暑期營隊以培養社交技能和獨立性。

definition_zh: (動) 採納；接受　(動) 收養；領養
example_sentence: Many families adopt children from orphanages to give them a loving home.
sentence_zh: 許多家庭從孤兒院領養孩子，給他們一個充滿愛的家。

definition_zh: (形) 被領養的；經改編的　(動) 採納；收養
example_sentence: Although the adopted child didn't share the family's genes, love made them truly one.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個被領養的孩子與家人沒有血緣關係，但愛使他們成為真正的一家人。

definition_zh: (名) 領養；採納
example_sentence: Having adopted three children from foster care, the family found their home filled with joy and laughter.
sentence_zh: 已經從寄養家庭領養了三個孩子，這個家庭發現他們的家充滿了歡樂和笑聲。

definition_zh: (形) 收養的；領養的　(形) 適應的；有適應能力的
example_sentence: The adoptive parents, who had waited years for a child, finally brought their son home.
sentence_zh: 那對領養父母等了多年才有孩子，終於把他們的兒子帶回家。

definition_zh: (形) 可愛的；令人喜愛的
example_sentence: The adorable puppy with soft fur and big eyes made everyone smile.
sentence_zh: 那隻毛茸茸、眼睛很大的可愛小狗讓每個人都笑了。

definition_zh: (名) 崇拜；愛慕　(名) 深深的敬愛；尊敬
example_sentence: If the famous singer did not receive constant adoration from fans, she would lose motivation to perform.
sentence_zh: 如果這位著名歌手沒有不斷獲得粉絲的崇拜，她就會失去表演的動力。

definition_zh: (動) 喜愛；愛慕　(動) 非常喜歡；崇拜
example_sentence: Many fans adore the famous singer for her beautiful voice.
sentence_zh: 許多粉絲因為那位著名歌手美妙的嗓音而崇拜她。

definition_zh: (動) 裝飾；點綴　(動) 佩戴；穿戴
example_sentence: Adorning the school hall with colorful banners, volunteers prepared for the annual celebration.
sentence_zh: 志願者用彩色橫幅裝飾學校大廳，為年度慶典做準備。

definition_zh: (名) 裝飾品；裝飾　(動) 裝飾；點綴
example_sentence: Although jewelry serves as adornment, many students prefer simple styles for daily wear.
sentence_zh: 雖然珠寶用作裝飾品，許多學生日常穿著時偏好簡單的風格。

definition_zh: (名) 腎上腺素；腎上腺激素
example_sentence: Only when facing the final exam does adrenalin surge through students' bodies.
sentence_zh: 只有在面對期末考時，腎上腺素才會在學生體內急速上升。

definition_zh: (名) 過度讚美；奉承
example_sentence: The celebrity received constant adulation from fans who treated him like a god.
sentence_zh: 那位名人從將他視為神般對待的粉絲那裡不斷獲得過度讚美。

definition_zh: (名) 成人；大人　(形) 成人的；成熟的
example_sentence: Many students work part-time to earn money and become financially independent adults.
sentence_zh: 許多學生兼職工作以賺錢和成為經濟獨立的成年人。

definition_zh: (名) 成年期；成人階段　(名) 成熟；長大成人
example_sentence: Reaching adulthood brings both exciting opportunities and significant responsibilities for young people.
sentence_zh: 進入成年期為年輕人帶來既興奮的機會，也帶來重大責任。

definition_zh: (動) 前進；推進　(名) 進步；預付款
example_sentence: The technology company advanced its new product release by two months.
sentence_zh: 這家科技公司將新產品發布日期提前了兩個月。

definition_zh: (形) 先進的；高級的　(動) 促進；推動
example_sentence: As technology advanced, students found online learning tools increasingly helpful for exam preparation.
sentence_zh: 隨著科技進步，學生發現線上學習工具對考試準備越來越有幫助。

definition_zh: (名) 進步；晉升　(名) 推進；促進
example_sentence: Having completed the training program, Maria's advancement to team leader became certain.
sentence_zh: 完成培訓課程後，瑪麗亞晉升為團隊領導者已成定局。

definition_zh: (名) 優勢；好處　(動) 有利於；對某人有利
example_sentence: Learning computer skills is an advantage that students who prepare early will definitely gain.
sentence_zh: 學習電腦技能是那些提早準備的學生一定能獲得的優勢。

definition_zh: (形) 有利的；優於他人的　有好處的；對...有益的
example_sentence: If studying abroad provides an advantageous environment for language learning, many students will choose this path.
sentence_zh: 如果出國留學提供有利的語言學習環境，許多學生將選擇這條道路。

definition_zh: (名) 到來；來臨　(名) 聖誕節前的四週
example_sentence: The advent of smartphones changed how teenagers communicate with friends.
sentence_zh: 智慧型手機的出現改變了青少年與朋友溝通的方式。

definition_zh: (名) 冒險；冒險經歷　(動) 冒險；大膽嘗試
example_sentence: Traveling abroad during summer vacation is a great way to adventure into unfamiliar cultures.
sentence_zh: 暑假出國旅遊是冒險進入陌生文化的絕佳方式。

definition_zh: (名) 冒險家；探險家
example_sentence: The famous adventurer explored uncharted islands searching for hidden treasures.
sentence_zh: 那位著名的冒險家探索未知島嶼，尋找隱藏的寶藏。

definition_zh: (形) 冒險的；膽大的　愛尋求刺激的
example_sentence: Although the mountain climb was dangerous, many adventurous hikers attempted it despite the risk.
sentence_zh: 雖然登山很危險，但許多膽大的登山者不顧風險仍然嘗試了。

definition_zh: (名) 副詞；修飾詞
example_sentence: Having studied grammar rules carefully, students recognized the adverb modifying the verb in the sentence.
sentence_zh: 仔細學習文法規則後，學生認出句子中修飾動詞的副詞。

definition_zh: (形) 不利的；有害的　(形) 對立的；敵對的
example_sentence: The weather conditions that delayed the flight were adverse, so passengers had to wait several hours.
sentence_zh: 延誤班機的惡劣天氣條件是不利的，所以乘客必須等待好幾個小時。

definition_zh: (副) 有害地；不利地　負面地；反對地
example_sentence: Pollution and climate change adversely affect the health and future of young people worldwide.
sentence_zh: 污染和氣候變遷有害地影響全世界年輕人的健康和未來。

definition_zh: (名) 廣告；宣傳　(動) 登廣告；宣傳
example_sentence: If the company placed more adverts on social media, sales would increase significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果公司在社群媒體上刊登更多廣告，銷售額會大幅增加。

definition_zh: (動) 登廣告；宣傳　刊登廣告
example_sentence: The new smartphone will be advertised on television next week.
sentence_zh: 這部新智慧型手機將在下週於電視上刊登廣告。

definition_zh: (名) 廣告；宣傳　(動) 刊登廣告
example_sentence: Attracting millions of viewers, the advertisement successfully promoted the new smartphone to teenage consumers.
sentence_zh: 這則廣告吸引了數百萬觀眾，成功向青少年消費者推廣了新款智慧型手機。

definition_zh: (名) 廣告商；廣告主
example_sentence: Because advertisers pay high fees, television networks broadcast popular shows during prime time.
sentence_zh: 由於廣告商支付高額費用，電視台在黃金時段播放熱門節目。

definition_zh: (名) 廣告；廣告業　(動) 宣傳；刊登廣告
example_sentence: Not only does advertising inform consumers about products, but it also shapes cultural trends.
sentence_zh: 廣告不僅向消費者介紹產品，而且還塑造文化趨勢。

definition_zh: (動) 宣傳；廣告宣傳　(動) 公告；通知
example_sentence: Companies advertise products that attract young consumers in social media.
sentence_zh: 公司在社群媒體上宣傳能吸引年輕消費者的產品。

definition_zh: (名) 建議；勸告　(動) 建議；勸告
example_sentence: Students should ask teachers for advice to improve their test scores.
sentence_zh: 學生應該向老師尋求建議以提高考試成績。

definition_zh: (形) 明智的；適當的　值得建議的；可取的
example_sentence: Studying regularly and consulting teachers before exams is highly advisable for exam success.
sentence_zh: 定期讀書並在考試前請教老師是獲得考試成功的明智做法。

definition_zh: (動) 建議；勸告　(動) 通知；告知
example_sentence: The doctor advised patients to exercise regularly and eat healthy food.
sentence_zh: 醫生建議患者要定期運動並吃健康的食物。

definition_zh: (名) 顧問；建議人　(名) 指導老師；輔導員
example_sentence: As the school adviser explained the college application process, many students took careful notes.
sentence_zh: 當學校顧問解釋大學申請程序時，許多學生仔細地做筆記。

definition_zh: (名) 顧問；建議者　(名) 指導老師；輔導員
example_sentence: Having consulted the career advisor, many students feel more confident planning their future.
sentence_zh: 在諮詢了生涯顧問之後，許多學生對規劃未來更有信心。

definition_zh: (形) 諮詢的；顧問的　(名) 忠告；公告
example_sentence: The safety advisory that the government issued warned citizens about the flood risk.
sentence_zh: 政府發布的安全忠告警告市民注意洪水風險。

definition_zh: (動) 提倡；主張　(名) 提倡者；律師
example_sentence: If students advocate for better school meal quality, the administration would listen to their concerns.
sentence_zh: 如果學生提倡改善學校餐點品質，校方就會聽取他們的顧慮。

definition_zh: (動) 使通風；充氣
example_sentence: Opening windows helps aerate the classroom and improves air quality.
sentence_zh: 打開窗戶有助於教室通風，改善空氣品質。

definition_zh: (形) 空中的；從空中的　(名) 天線；空中的東西
example_sentence: Drones use aerial cameras to capture high-quality images for mapping.
sentence_zh: 無人機使用空中攝影機來拍攝高品質影像以製作地圖。

definition_zh: (名) 有氧運動；有氧健身操
example_sentence: Regular aerobics classes help students build strength and improve cardiovascular health.
sentence_zh: 定期的有氧運動課程幫助學生增強體力並改善心血管健康。

definition_zh: (名) 空氣動力學；流體力學
example_sentence: As engineers design faster cars, aerodynamics becomes increasingly important so that fuel consumption decreases significantly.
sentence_zh: 當工程師設計更快的汽車時，空氣動力學變得越來越重要，以便燃油消耗大幅降低。

definition_zh: (名) 懼高症；害怕飛行
example_sentence: Having suffered from aerophobia for years, the traveler finally booked a flight to study abroad.
sentence_zh: 多年來患有懼高症，這位旅行者終於預訂了一班飛往國外留學的班機。

definition_zh: (名) 航太；航空航天　(形) 航太的；航空航天的
example_sentence: The aerospace industry develops aircraft and spacecraft for modern transportation.
sentence_zh: 航太產業開發現代運輸用的飛機和太空船。

definition_zh: (形) 美學的；審美的　(名) 美感；審美觀點
example_sentence: Although the building's aesthetic appeal is undeniable, its practical functionality remains questionable for daily use.
sentence_zh: 雖然這棟建築物的審美吸引力毫無疑問，但它的實用功能對於日常使用仍然值得懷疑。

definition_zh: (名) 美學；審美標準　(名) 審美觀；美感
example_sentence: Appreciating aesthetics in modern art, students discover how design shapes visual communication.
sentence_zh: 欣賞現代藝術的美學，學生發現設計如何塑造視覺溝通。

definition_zh: (副) 遠處；遠方　(介) 距離...遠
example_sentence: The mountains that rise afar from the coastal city attract many hikers every weekend.
sentence_zh: 從沿海城市遠處升起的那些山吸引許多登山者每個週末前往。

definition_zh: (形) 親切的；友善的　(形) 和藹的；容易相處的
example_sentence: If the manager were more affable, employees would feel more comfortable sharing their ideas.
sentence_zh: 如果經理更友善一些，員工就會更自在地分享他們的想法。

definition_zh: (名) 事情；事務　(名) 婚外情；風流韻事
example_sentence: The scandal damaged the politician's reputation, and many people discussed the affair at work.
sentence_zh: 這樁醜聞損害了政治人物的聲譽，許多人在工作時討論此事件。

definition_zh: (動) 影響；影響到　(名) 情感；感受
example_sentence: The teacher used videos to affect students' interest in learning English.
sentence_zh: 老師使用影片來影響學生對學英文的興趣。

definition_zh: (名) 喜愛；疼愛　(名) 感情；情感
example_sentence: Showing affection toward parents and siblings strengthens family bonds.
sentence_zh: 對父母和兄弟姐妹表現出喜愛能夠加強家庭紐帶。

definition_zh: (形) 感情的；情感的　(形) 充滿感情的；親切的
example_sentence: Although the gift was inexpensive, its affectional value meant everything to her heart.
sentence_zh: 雖然禮物不貴，但它的感情價值對她來說意義重大。

definition_zh: (形) 充滿愛心的；親切的　(動) 表現關愛；示好
example_sentence: Having grown up in a loving family, Maria became an affectionate teacher who genuinely cared about each student's progress.
sentence_zh: 在充滿愛的家庭中長大後，瑪麗亞成為了一位親切的教師，真心關懷每位學生的進步。

definition_zh: (副) 親切地；溫柔地　(副) 深情地；充滿愛意地
example_sentence: The grandmother hugged her grandchild affectionately, who immediately smiled at her warmth.
sentence_zh: 祖母親切地擁抱她的孫子，他立刻對她的溫暖報以微笑。

definition_zh: (動) 使隸屬於；關聯　(名) 附屬公司；分公司
example_sentence: The small bookstore affiliated with the major publishing house expanded its inventory significantly.
sentence_zh: 與大型出版社有關聯的小書店大幅擴展了其存貨。

definition_zh: (名) 隸屬；關係　(名) 附屬機構；分支
example_sentence: If the student's school affiliation were with a top university, career opportunities would increase significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果該學生的學校隸屬於頂尖大學，職業機會會大幅增加。

definition_zh: (動) 肯定；確認　(動) 聲明；宣稱
example_sentence: The principal affirmed that the new school policy would benefit all students.
sentence_zh: 校長肯定新的學校政策將造福所有學生。

definition_zh: (名) 肯定；確認　(名) 證實；申明
example_sentence: Receiving affirmation from teachers, students felt more confident pursuing their academic goals.
sentence_zh: 從老師那裡獲得肯定，學生們在追求學業目標時感到更有信心。

definition_zh: (形) 肯定的；正面的　(副) 肯定地；贊成地
example_sentence: Although the teacher's feedback was critical, students responded affirmatively because they understood improvement was possible.
sentence_zh: 雖然老師的反饋是批評性的，但學生給予肯定的回應，因為他們理解進步是可能的。

definition_zh: (名) ['æfɪks] 詞綴；附加物　(動) [ə'fɪks] 貼上；附加
example_sentence: Only by affixing the correct suffix to the root word can students form proper English words.
sentence_zh: 只有將正確的字尾附加到詞根上，學生才能構成適當的英文單字。

definition_zh: (動) 使痛苦；折磨　(動) 使患病；侵襲
example_sentence: The drought that afflicts the region has destroyed many farmers' crops.
sentence_zh: 困擾該地區的乾旱摧毀了許多農民的莊稼。

definition_zh: (名) 痛苦；折磨　(名) 疾病；不幸
example_sentence: Many volunteers work at the hospital to comfort patients suffering from serious affliction.
sentence_zh: 許多志工在醫院工作來安慰遭受嚴重痛苦的患者。

definition_zh: (形) 令人痛苦的；造成苦惱的
example_sentence: The afflictive memories of failure haunted the student throughout exam season.
sentence_zh: 失敗令人痛苦的記憶在考試季節困擾著這名學生。

definition_zh: (名) 財富；富裕　(名) 充足；豐富
example_sentence: Growing up in affluence, Marcus never worried about money or basic needs.
sentence_zh: 馬庫斯在富裕的環境中長大，從不為金錢或基本需求擔心。

definition_zh: (形) 富裕的；富有的　(形) 充足的；豐富的
example_sentence: Although living in an affluent neighborhood, many students still work part-time jobs.
sentence_zh: 雖然住在富裕的社區，許多學生仍然做兼職工作。

definition_zh: (形) 富有的；有錢的　(形) 影響力大的；有勢力的
example_sentence: Affluential families donating millions to the school, the gymnasium renovation project finally began construction.
sentence_zh: 富有的家族捐獻了數百萬元給學校，體育館翻新項目終於開始施工。

definition_zh: (動) 負擔得起；買得起　(動) 提供；給予
example_sentence: Students who can afford extra tutoring classes often achieve better exam scores.
sentence_zh: 能夠負擔得起額外補習課程的學生通常考試成績更好。

definition_zh: (形) 負擔得起的；價格合理的
example_sentence: If housing prices become more affordable, more young couples will buy their own homes.
sentence_zh: 如果房價變得更加負擔得起，更多年輕夫婦將會買自己的房子。

definition_zh: (動) 造林；植林
example_sentence: The government plans to afforest the barren hillside with native trees.
sentence_zh: 政府計畫用原生樹種在荒山上造林。

definition_zh: (名) 造林；植林
example_sentence: Environmental organizations plant millions of trees annually to afforest degraded areas.
sentence_zh: 環保組織每年種植數百萬棵樹木以造林退化地區。

definition_zh: (形) 害怕的；恐懼的　(形) 擔心的；憂慮的
example_sentence: Many students feel afraid and nervous before taking the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在參加學測前感到害怕和緊張。

definition_zh: (副) 畢竟；終究　(連) 既然；因為
example_sentence: After all, studying hard every day will help you pass the CSAT exam successfully.
sentence_zh: 畢竟，每天認真讀書會幫助你順利通過學測。

definition_zh: (名) 下班後；下班時間　(介) 在...之後
example_sentence: Having finished their homework after work, the students went to the convenience store together.
sentence_zh: 下班後完成功課，學生們一起去便利商店。

definition_zh: (介) 在…之後；追求　(連) 在…之後　(形) 後面的；以後的
example_sentence: The student who studied after midnight passed the difficult CSAT exam successfully.
sentence_zh: 在午夜之後讀書的學生成功通過了難的學測考試。

definition_zh: (名) 後果；後遺症　(名) 餘波；影響
example_sentence: The aftermath of the natural disaster left the community struggling for months.
sentence_zh: 這場天災的後果讓社區掙扎了好幾個月。

definition_zh: (名) 下午；午後
example_sentence: If Sarah finished her morning classes early, she would spend the afternoon studying at the library.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉早上的課早點結束，她下午就會在圖書館讀書。

definition_zh: (副) 之後；後來　(連) 隨後；然後
example_sentence: The concert ended at nine o'clock, and afterward the band members went to celebrate together.
sentence_zh: 演唱會在九點結束，之後樂隊成員一起去慶祝。

definition_zh: (副) 之後；後來　(連) 然後；隨後
example_sentence: Having finished the exam, students walked out of the classroom, chatting and laughing afterwards.
sentence_zh: 考試結束後，學生們走出教室，隨後邊聊天邊笑。

definition_zh: (副) 再；又　(副) 再一次；重複
example_sentence: After the first test failed, the student studied harder and tried again, hoping for a better result.
sentence_zh: 第一次考試失敗後，這位學生更努力讀書，再試一次，希望獲得更好的成績。

definition_zh: (介) 反對；違反　(介) 靠著；對著
example_sentence: Never should students argue against their teachers without proper evidence and respect.
sentence_zh: 學生絕不應該在沒有適當證據和尊重的情況下反對他們的老師。

definition_zh: (名) 瑪瑙；縞瑪瑙　(形) 瑪瑙製的；堅硬的
example_sentence: The ancient agate stone that decorates the museum's entrance attracts many visitors daily.
sentence_zh: 裝飾博物館入口的古代瑪瑙石頭每天吸引許多遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 年齡；時代　(動) 變老；老化
example_sentence: Many students study hard to age gracefully and build a successful career.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力讀書以便年長時能建立成功的事業。

definition_zh: (形) 年老的；老年的　(形) 陳年的；有年份的
example_sentence: The aged wine in the cellar tastes much better than the new bottles.
sentence_zh: 地窖裡陳年的葡萄酒比新瓶子裡的酒味道好得多。

definition_zh: (名) 代理機構；仲介公司　(名) 行動；作用；力量
example_sentence: A travel agency can help you book flights and hotels for your summer vacation.
sentence_zh: 一家旅行社可以幫你預訂暑假的班機和飯店。

definition_zh: (名) 議程；日程　(名) 目標；計畫
example_sentence: As the meeting agenda becomes clear, the committee decides which topics deserve the most discussion time.
sentence_zh: 當會議議程變得明確時，委員會決定哪些議題值得最多討論時間。

definition_zh: (名) 代理人；經紀人　(名) 代理物；媒介
example_sentence: Acting as a travel agent, Maria helped students booking their graduation trip smoothly.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞擔任旅遊代理人，幫助學生順利預訂畢業旅行。

definition_zh: (動) 使惡化；加重　(動) 激怒；使生氣
example_sentence: The traffic jam, which aggravated the situation during rush hour, caused many workers to arrive late.
sentence_zh: 那場交通堵塞在尖峰時段加重了情況，導致許多工人遲到。

definition_zh: (形) 令人惱火的；使人煩躁的　(形) 使情況更糟的；加重的
example_sentence: If the noise from construction becomes aggravating, residents can contact the building management office.
sentence_zh: 如果建築工地的噪音變得令人煩躁，住戶可以聯絡大樓管理處。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈægrəgɪt] 總和；合計　(動) [ˈægrəˌget] 合併；聚集　(形) 合成的；集合的
example_sentence: The school's test scores aggregate to show overall student performance improvements.
sentence_zh: 學校的測驗成績合併後顯示學生整體表現的進步。

definition_zh: (名) 聚合；集合　(名) 總數；彙總
example_sentence: The company uses data aggregation to analyze consumer behavior patterns effectively.
sentence_zh: 該公司使用數據聚合來有效分析消費者行為模式。

definition_zh: (名) 侵略；攻擊　(名) 好鬥；挑釁
example_sentence: Military aggression and trade disputes between neighboring countries created serious tension.
sentence_zh: 鄰近國家間的軍事侵略和貿易糾紛造成了嚴重的緊張局勢。

definition_zh: (形) 好鬥的；富有進攻性的　(形) 積極進取的；主動的
example_sentence: Although the team played aggressively, their opponents' defense proved too strong to break.
sentence_zh: 雖然球隊踢得很積極進取，但對手的防線仍然堅不可摧。

definition_zh: (名) 侵略者；挑釁者　(形) 具侵略性的；好鬥的
example_sentence: Having attacked neighboring countries without provocation, the aggressor nation faced international sanctions and widespread condemnation.
sentence_zh: 在沒有挑釁的情況下攻擊鄰國後，這個侵略國家面臨國際制裁和廣泛譴責。

definition_zh: (形) 靈活的；敏捷的　(形) 反應迅速的；機動的
example_sentence: The agile team that responded quickly to the market change gained a competitive advantage.
sentence_zh: 那個對市場變化反應迅速的敏捷團隊獲得了競爭優勢。

definition_zh: (名) 靈活性；敏捷性　(名) 身體的靈活和快速反應
example_sentence: The basketball player's quick feet and rapid direction changes demonstrated impressive agility on the court.
sentence_zh: 這位籃球選手快速的腳步和快速改變方向展現出球場上令人印象深刻的靈活性。

definition_zh: (名) 衰老；老化　(動) 變老；使老化　(形) 老的；衰退的
example_sentence: If the population continued aging rapidly, Taiwan would face serious healthcare and pension challenges.
sentence_zh: 如果人口持續快速老化，台灣將面臨嚴重的醫療和退休金挑戰。

definition_zh: (動) 煽動；激怒　(動) 攪動；搖晃
example_sentence: False news on social media agitates public opinion easily.
sentence_zh: 社群媒體上的假新聞容易激怒公眾輿論。

definition_zh: (形) 激動的；不安的　(動) 使激動；使不安
example_sentence: Feeling agitated by the exam results, Sarah couldn't focus on her studies that evening.
sentence_zh: 因為對考試成績感到不安，莎拉那晚無法專心讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 激動；騷動　(名) 攪動；振動
example_sentence: Although public agitation over the new policy grew, the government remained firm in its decision.
sentence_zh: 雖然對新政策的公眾騷動日益增長，政府仍堅守其決定。

definition_zh: (副) 以前；前...時間　(介) 在...之前
example_sentence: Only two years ago did the school build this new library for students.
sentence_zh: 只有在兩年前，學校才為學生建造了這座新圖書館。

definition_zh: (動) 為...感到痛苦；折磨；使極度擔憂
example_sentence: The student who agonizes over exam results often loses sleep and confidence.
sentence_zh: 那位為考試成績感到極度擔憂的學生經常失眠並喪失信心。

definition_zh: (形) 令人極度痛苦的；使人苦惱的
example_sentence: Students study hard every day to avoid the agonizing feeling of exam failure.
sentence_zh: 學生每天認真讀書是為了避免考試失敗的痛苦感受。

definition_zh: (副) 痛苦地；極其難受地　令人難以忍受的方式
example_sentence: Waiting for exam results felt agonizingly slow and unbearable for many students.
sentence_zh: 等待考試成績對許多學生來說痛苦地漫長且難以忍受。

definition_zh: (名) 極度的痛苦；劇烈的痛楚
example_sentence: The athlete's agony after losing the championship was clear to everyone watching.
sentence_zh: 那位運動員在失去冠軍後的極度痛苦對每個觀看者都很明顯。

definition_zh: (形) 農業的；農民的　(名) 農民；農業工作者
example_sentence: As agrarian regions develop modern farming techniques, crop yields increase significantly every season.
sentence_zh: 當農業地區採用現代農業技術時，農作物產量每季都顯著增加。

definition_zh: (動) 同意；答應　(動) 贊成；認可
example_sentence: Agreeing to the new study schedule, the students began preparing for the CSAT immediately.
sentence_zh: 同意新的讀書計畫後，學生們立即開始準備學測。

definition_zh: (動) 同意；贊成　(動) 與某人看法相同
example_sentence: Students who agree with the teacher's opinion tend to perform better academically.
sentence_zh: 同意老師意見的學生往往學業表現更好。

definition_zh: (動) 同意；贊成　(動) 一致；相符
example_sentence: If students agree to follow the new school rules, the campus environment will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生同意遵守新的校規，校園環境將會顯著改善。

definition_zh: (形) 令人愉快的；討人喜歡的　(形) 同意的；樂意的
example_sentence: The weather forecast predicts an agreeable sunny day for the outdoor picnic tomorrow.
sentence_zh: 天氣預報預測明天戶外野餐會有令人愉快的晴朗天氣。

definition_zh: (名) 協議；同意　(動) 同意；達成共識
example_sentence: Both companies signed an agreement to work together and build the new project.
sentence_zh: 兩家公司簽署了一項協議以便合作並建設新的專案。

definition_zh: (形) 農業的；與農業有關的　農村的；農業社會的
example_sentence: Taiwan's agricultural products and exports depend heavily on seasonal weather patterns.
sentence_zh: 臺灣的農業產品和出口在很大程度上取決於季節性的天氣模式。

definition_zh: (名) 農業；農耕　(形) 農業的；農村的
example_sentence: Although agriculture remains important to Taiwan's economy, many young people prefer working in cities rather than farming.
sentence_zh: 雖然農業對臺灣經濟仍然很重要，但許多年輕人寧願在城市工作而不是務農。

definition_zh: (介) 領先；超越　(副) 在...前面；提前
example_sentence: Having completed her project ahead of the deadline, Maria felt relieved and confident.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞在截止日期前完成了她的專案，感到放心和自信。

definition_zh: (副) 在前面；向前　(形) 領先的；在…前面的
example_sentence: The student who studies ahead of the class schedule makes faster progress.
sentence_zh: 那位提前學習課程的學生進度更快。

definition_zh: (名) 人工智慧；AI
example_sentence: AI technology is changing how students learn and teachers teach in classrooms.
sentence_zh: 人工智慧技術正在改變學生和老師在教室裡的學習和教學方式。

definition_zh: (名) 援助；幫助　(動) 幫助；協助
example_sentence: If the government provided more financial aid, struggling students would attend university more easily.
sentence_zh: 如果政府提供更多財務援助，經濟困難的學生會更容易上大學。

definition_zh: (名) 助手；助理　(名) 援助；幫助
example_sentence: The teacher's aide helped students with their homework after school.
sentence_zh: 老師的助理放學後幫助學生做功課。

definition_zh: (名) 幫助；助手　(動) 幫助；協助
example_sentence: Using online resources as aids, students preparing for the exam study more effectively.
sentence_zh: 將線上資源作為幫助工具，準備考試的學生能更有效地學習。

definition_zh: (名) 副翼；飛機機翼上控制傾斜的活動面
example_sentence: As the pilot adjusted the ailerons, the aircraft banked smoothly toward the runway.
sentence_zh: 當飛行員調整副翼時，飛機平穩地向跑道傾斜。

definition_zh: (形) 生病的；衰退的　(動) 患病；衰落
example_sentence: Never before had the company's ailing finances forced management into such difficult decisions.
sentence_zh: 公司衰退的財務狀況從未像現在這樣迫使管理層做出如此艱難的決定。

definition_zh: (名) 疾病；小病　(名) 問題；缺陷
example_sentence: The chronic ailment that affected Maria's daily life required ongoing medical treatment.
sentence_zh: 影響瑪麗亞日常生活的慢性疾病需要持續的醫學治療。

definition_zh: (動) 瞄準；針對　設立目標；努力達成
example_sentence: The training program aims at improving students' English speaking skills.
sentence_zh: 這個培訓課程的目的是提高學生的英語口語能力。

definition_zh: (名) 目標；目的　(動) 瞄準；以...為目標
example_sentence: Students aiming for top universities must study hard and achieve excellent grades.
sentence_zh: 立志進入頂尖大學的學生必須努力讀書並取得優異成績。

definition_zh: (形) 有空調的；裝有冷氣的
example_sentence: The air-conditioned classroom feels much more comfortable during hot summer days.
sentence_zh: 有冷氣的教室在炎熱的夏日感覺舒服多了。

definition_zh: (名) 空氣；大氣　(動) 播放；廣播　(形) 空中的；航空的
example_sentence: As the window opened, fresh air rushed into the stuffy classroom.
sentence_zh: 當窗戶打開時，新鮮空氣衝進了悶熱的教室。

definition_zh: (形) 在空中的；由飛機運送的　(形) 傳播中的；流行的
example_sentence: Airborne particles spread quickly through classrooms without good ventilation.
sentence_zh: 在通風不良的教室裡，飄浮在空中的粒子迅速傳播。

definition_zh: (名) 空軍；空中力量
example_sentence: If a country strengthens its airforce, it will gain greater security in regional conflicts.
sentence_zh: 如果一個國家加強其空軍，它將在地區衝突中獲得更大的安全保障。

definition_zh: (名) 空中運輸；空運　(動) 用飛機運送；空運
example_sentence: The military used helicopters to airlift supplies to the flooded village.
sentence_zh: 軍隊用直升機把物資空運到洪水淹沒的村莊。

definition_zh: (名) 航空公司；航線
example_sentence: Many students book airline tickets in advance to save money for summer travel.
sentence_zh: 許多學生提前預訂航班票券以節省暑假旅遊的費用。

definition_zh: (名) 客運飛機；大型客機
example_sentence: The airliner departed from Taipei Taoyuan Airport at 10 AM this morning.
sentence_zh: 這架客運飛機今早上午10點從台北桃園機場起飛。

definition_zh: (名) 航空郵件；航空信　(動) 用航空郵件寄送
example_sentence: Although airmail costs more than regular mail, many students send important documents this way when time is limited.
sentence_zh: 雖然航空郵件比普通郵件貴，但當時間緊張時，許多學生用這種方式寄送重要文件。

definition_zh: (名) 飛機；航空器
example_sentence: Having boarded the airplane, passengers settled into their seats and prepared for takeoff.
sentence_zh: 登上飛機後，乘客們坐進座位並為起飛做準備。

definition_zh: (名) 機場；航空站
example_sentence: The airport that we arrived at yesterday was very crowded.
sentence_zh: 我們昨天抵達的那個機場人很多。

definition_zh: (形) 密閉的；不透氣的　(形) 無懈可擊的；完全的
example_sentence: The container's airtight seal keeps the cookies fresh for weeks without any moisture entering.
sentence_zh: 那個容器的密閉封條能讓餅乾保持新鮮數週，不會有任何水分進入。

definition_zh: (名) 氣道；呼吸道
example_sentence: If the patient's airway were blocked, doctors would need to perform an emergency procedure immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果病人的氣道被阻塞，醫生就會需要立即進行緊急處置。

definition_zh: (名) 走廊；通道　(名) 飛機座位之間的通路
example_sentence: Passengers walk down the aisle to find their airplane seats.
sentence_zh: 乘客沿著走廊尋找他們的飛機座位。

definition_zh: (名) 警報；鬧鐘　(動) 使驚恐；警告　(形) 警報的；報警的
example_sentence: Hearing the fire alarm ringing loudly, students evacuated the building immediately.
sentence_zh: 聽到火警報警大聲響起，學生們立刻疏散建築物。

definition_zh: (形) 令人擔憂的；令人警覺的
example_sentence: As the number of students skipping class continues rising, teachers find the trend increasingly alarming.
sentence_zh: 隨著學生逃課人數不斷增加，教師們發現這個趨勢越來越令人擔憂。

definition_zh: (連) 雖然；儘管　(副) 雖然；然而
example_sentence: Not only is the job demanding, but the salary is low, albeit competitive in the market.
sentence_zh: 不僅這份工作要求高，薪資也很低，雖然在市場上頗具競爭力。

definition_zh: (名) 相冊；集錄　(名) 專輯；唱片
example_sentence: The photo album that my grandmother treasures contains precious family memories.
sentence_zh: 我祖母珍愛的相冊裡裝著珍貴的家庭回憶。

definition_zh: (名) 酒精；酒　(形) 含酒精的；酒精的
example_sentence: Doctors recommend limiting alcohol consumption to prevent serious health problems.
sentence_zh: 醫生建議限制酒精攝取以預防嚴重的健康問題。

definition_zh: (形) 含酒精的；酒精性的　(名) 酗酒者；酒精中毒患者
example_sentence: Excessive alcoholic beverage consumption during adolescence can damage brain development and health.
sentence_zh: 青少年時期過度飲用含酒精飲料會損害大腦發育和身體健康。

definition_zh: (名) 麥芽酒；淡啤酒
example_sentence: At the pub, friends enjoy drinking ale and chatting about their weekend plans.
sentence_zh: 在酒吧裡，朋友們享受喝麥芽酒並談論週末計畫。

definition_zh: (形) 警覺的；機敏的　(動) 警告；提醒　(名) 警報；警告
example_sentence: As the storm approached, the weather service issued an alert so that residents could prepare for danger.
sentence_zh: 當暴風雨逼近時，氣象局發佈警報，以便居民能夠為危險做好準備。

definition_zh: (名) 藻類；水藻
example_sentence: Growing rapidly in the polluted lake, algae blocked sunlight and killed many fish.
sentence_zh: 在受污染的湖中快速生長，藻類阻擋陽光並導致許多魚類死亡。

definition_zh: (名) 代數；用字母代表數字的數學方法
example_sentence: Algebra, which requires logical thinking and problem-solving skills, is essential for students preparing for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 代數是需要邏輯思維和解決問題能力的學科，對準備學測的學生來說至關重要。

definition_zh: (名) 不在場證明；藉口
example_sentence: If the suspect provides a solid alibi, the police will have to release him immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果嫌疑人提供確實的不在場證明，警察就必須立即釋放他。

definition_zh: (名) 外星人；陌生人　(形) 外星的；陌生的
example_sentence: Scientists wonder if alien life exists on distant planets.
sentence_zh: 科學家想知道遙遠行星上是否存在外星生命。

definition_zh: (動) 使疏遠；使孤立　使失去支持
example_sentence: Posting controversial opinions online may alienate potential friends and damage social relationships.
sentence_zh: 在網路上發表爭議性意見可能會使潛在朋友疏遠，並損害社交關係。

definition_zh: (動) 排成一直線；使一致　(動) 支持；站在…一邊
example_sentence: The company aligned its business strategy with environmental protection goals to attract young consumers.
sentence_zh: 該公司將商業策略與環保目標相一致，以吸引年輕消費者。

definition_zh: (名) 對齊；排列　(名) 聯盟；結盟
example_sentence: Although the team members had different opinions, alignment of their goals was achieved when everyone focused on winning the championship.
sentence_zh: 雖然隊員意見不同，但當每個人都專注於贏得冠軍時，目標的對齊就實現了。

definition_zh: (形) 相似的；一樣的　(副) 同樣地；都一樣地
example_sentence: Having studied the two paintings carefully, art critics found them remarkably alike in style and composition.
sentence_zh: 經過仔細研究這兩幅畫，藝術評論家發現它們在風格和構圖上驚人地相似。

definition_zh: (名) 贍養費；離婚後一方支付給另一方的生活費
example_sentence: The divorced father pays monthly alimony to his ex-wife, who relies on the money she receives to cover living expenses.
sentence_zh: 那位離婚的父親每月支付贍養費給前妻，她依靠所收到的錢來支付生活開銷。

definition_zh: (動) 排列整齊；對齊　(動) 使成一直線
example_sentence: The architect asked workers to aline the building's windows in perfect symmetry.
sentence_zh: 建築師要求工人們將建築的窗戶對齐排列，達到完美的對稱。

definition_zh: (形) 活著的；有生命的　(形) 精力充沛的；生氣勃勃的
example_sentence: If the endangered species remained alive, conservation efforts would continue protecting their natural habitat.
sentence_zh: 如果瀕危物種保持活著，保育工作就會繼續保護牠們的自然棲息地。

definition_zh: (形) 鹼性的；含鹼的
example_sentence: Alkaline batteries last longer than regular ones in most devices.
sentence_zh: 鹼性電池在大多數設備中比普通電池更耐用。

definition_zh: (副) 一直；始終　(副) 從一開始就
example_sentence: Having suspected the truth all along, Sarah finally confronted her best friend about the stolen notebook.
sentence_zh: 莎拉一直懷疑事實的真相，最後終於向她最好的朋友對質那本被盜的筆記本。

definition_zh: (副) 突然；一下子　同時；一起
example_sentence: All at once, the lights went out, and the entire theater fell into darkness.
sentence_zh: 突然間，燈全部熄滅了，整個劇院陷入黑暗。

definition_zh: (片) 整天；全天　(片) 一整天
example_sentence: Not only did Sarah study hard, but she also practiced English all day long.
sentence_zh: 莎拉不僅用功讀書，而且整天都在練習英文。

definition_zh: (片) 完全無法理解；聽不懂　(形) 難以理解的；令人困惑的
example_sentence: The physics lecture was all Greek to Sarah, who hadn't studied the prerequisite course yet.
sentence_zh: 那堂物理課對莎拉來說完全聽不懂，因為她還沒有修過先修課程。

definition_zh: (片) 各種各樣的；形形色色的
example_sentence: The university offers all manner of clubs and activities to help students develop their interests.
sentence_zh: 這所大學提供各種各樣的俱樂部和活動，以幫助學生開發他們的興趣。

definition_zh: (副) 突然；忽然　(片) 猛然間；霎時
example_sentence: The power went out all of a sudden during the online class yesterday.
sentence_zh: 昨天線上課程中電力突然中斷了。

definition_zh: (片) 終究；說到底；總的來說
example_sentence: All said and done, studying hard is the best way to pass the exam.
sentence_zh: 說到底，用功讀書是通過考試的最好辦法。

definition_zh: (片) 各式各樣的；形形色色的
example_sentence: When preparing for the CSAT, students encounter all sorts of difficult reading materials, which really challenges their comprehension skills.
sentence_zh: 準備學測時，學生會遇到各式各樣的困難閱讀材料，這真的挑戰他們的理解能力。

definition_zh: (名) 風靡；流行　(動) 猛烈進行；發怒
example_sentence: Becoming wildly popular among teenagers, the new fashion trend was all the rage last summer.
sentence_zh: 那種新時尚在去年夏天變得非常風靡，在青少年間引起了熱烈討論。

definition_zh: (副) 一直；從頭到尾　(副) 完全地；徹底地
example_sentence: The marathon runner who trained for six months finished the race all the way without stopping.
sentence_zh: 那位訓練了六個月的馬拉松選手從頭到尾完成了比賽，沒有中途停止。

definition_zh: (代) 全部；所有　(形) 全部的；整個的　(副) 完全地；非常
example_sentence: If all students study hard, the class exam results will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果所有學生都努力讀書，班級的考試成績將會大幅進步。

definition_zh: (動) 減輕；緩解　(動) 平撫；安慰
example_sentence: The teacher's kind words allayed the student's anxiety about the exam.
sentence_zh: 老師親切的話語減輕了學生對考試的焦慮。

definition_zh: (名) 指控；聲稱　(名) 未經證實的說法
example_sentence: The journalist investigated the allegation to verify its accuracy before publishing.
sentence_zh: 記者調查該項指控以核實其準確性後再發表。

definition_zh: (動) 聲稱；宣稱　(動) 指控；控告
example_sentence: The witness alleged that the defendant had stolen the expensive jewelry from the museum.
sentence_zh: 證人聲稱被告從博物館偷走了昂貴的珠寶。

definition_zh: (形) 聲稱的；據說的　(動) 聲稱；宣稱
example_sentence: Although the alleged thief denied the crime, police found evidence at the scene.
sentence_zh: 雖然據說是那個小偷的人否認犯罪，但警察在現場發現了證據。

definition_zh: (副) 據稱；據說　據受指控
example_sentence: Having allegedly stolen company funds, the manager faced immediate dismissal and legal investigation.
sentence_zh: 據稱挪用公司資金後，該經理遭到立即解僱和法律調查。

definition_zh: (名) 忠誠；效忠　(名) 效忠的對象
example_sentence: Citizens who pledge allegiance to their country demonstrate loyalty that defines national unity.
sentence_zh: 宣誓效忠國家的公民展現了定義國家團結的忠誠。

definition_zh: (名) 過敏原；致敏物質
example_sentence: Pollen and dust mites are common indoor allergens affecting many students.
sentence_zh: 花粉和塵蟎是影響許多學生的常見室內過敏原。

definition_zh: (形) 過敏的；對…過敏的
example_sentence: If Maria were not allergic to peanuts, she would enjoy eating the school cafeteria's peanut butter cookies.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪麗亞不對花生過敏，她就會享受吃學校食堂的花生醬餅乾。

definition_zh: (名) 過敏；過敏症　(形) 易過敏的；有過敏症的
example_sentence: Many students suffer from food allergies and must avoid certain foods at school.
sentence_zh: 許多學生患有食物過敏症，必須在學校避免吃某些食物。

definition_zh: (動) 減輕；緩解　(動) 舒緩；改善
example_sentence: Alleviating students' stress through outdoor activities, the school organized weekend camping trips.
sentence_zh: 通過戶外活動減輕學生的壓力，學校組織了週末露營旅行。

definition_zh: (名) 減輕；緩解　(名) 救濟；補救
example_sentence: As the medicine took effect, alleviation of the patient's pain became noticeable within hours.
sentence_zh: 當藥物開始發揮作用時，患者疼痛的緩解在數小時內變得明顯。

definition_zh: (名) 小巷；巷道　(名) 後街；後巷
example_sentence: Only after walking through the narrow alley did the lost tourists find the famous night market.
sentence_zh: 只有在走過那條狹窄的小巷後，迷路的遊客才找到了那個著名的夜市。

definition_zh: (名) 聯盟；同盟　(動) 結成聯盟；聯合
example_sentence: The two countries formed an alliance that would strengthen their economic ties.
sentence_zh: 這兩個國家形成了一個將加強其經濟聯繫的聯盟。

definition_zh: (形) 聯合的；結盟的　(動) 聯合；結盟
example_sentence: Several countries formed an allied coalition to address the regional conflict.
sentence_zh: 幾個國家形成了一個聯合陣線來解決區域衝突。

definition_zh: (名) 短吻鱷；美洲鱷
example_sentence: The alligator's powerful jaw can snap branches in the swamp.
sentence_zh: 短吻鱷強有力的顎可以在沼澤中咬斷樹枝。

definition_zh: (動) 分配；分派　(動) 撥款；撥給
example_sentence: The school allocated funds to improve classroom technology and student resources.
sentence_zh: 學校分配經費來改善教室科技和學生資源。

definition_zh: (動) 分配；分派　(動) 撥給；預留
example_sentence: As time was allotted for each presentation, students finished their speeches without rushing.
sentence_zh: 既然每場發表都分配了時間，學生們就能不慌不忙地完成演講。

definition_zh: (名) 分配；配額　(名) 小塊土地；菜園
example_sentence: Having received an allotment of garden space, the students grew vegetables for the school cafeteria.
sentence_zh: 獲得了一塊菜園的學生們為學校食堂種植了蔬菜。

definition_zh: (動) 為...做準備；考慮到　(動) 留出空間；預留
example_sentence: The budget allows for unexpected expenses that may occur during the project.
sentence_zh: 這份預算為可能在專案中出現的意外開支做了準備。

definition_zh: (動) 允許；容許　允許發生；不妨礙
example_sentence: If the new schedule allows of flexible working hours, many employees would feel more satisfied.
sentence_zh: 如果新時間表允許靈活工作時間，許多員工會感到更滿意。

definition_zh: (動) 允許；讓　(動) 准許；同意
example_sentence: Teachers allow students to use dictionaries during the vocabulary test.
sentence_zh: 老師在詞彙考試中允許學生使用字典。

definition_zh: (名) 零用錢；津貼　(名) 容許量；寬容
example_sentence: Parents save money to provide a monthly allowance to help teenagers learn financial responsibility.
sentence_zh: 父母存錢以便提供月津貼幫助青少年學習財務責任。

definition_zh: (名) 合金；混合物　(動) 混合；參合
example_sentence: Steel is an alloy made by mixing iron with carbon and other elements.
sentence_zh: 鋼是由鐵與碳及其他元素混合而成的合金。

definition_zh: (動) 暗示；間接提及　(動) 拐彎抹角地談到
example_sentence: Having alluded to financial problems in the meeting, the manager refused to discuss details further.
sentence_zh: 經理在會議中暗示了財務問題後，拒絕進一步討論細節。

definition_zh: (動) 誘惑；吸引　(名) 魅力；吸引力
example_sentence: The luxury lifestyle that allures young people often leads to financial problems.
sentence_zh: 誘惑年輕人的奢侈生活方式往往導致財務問題。

definition_zh: (形) 迷人的；吸引人的　(形) 誘人的；引人注目的
example_sentence: The alluring display of luxury watches attracted many customers to the high-end jewelry store.
sentence_zh: 那個誘人的名錶展示吸引了許多顧客來到這家高端珠寶店。

definition_zh: (名) 暗示；典故　(動) 暗指；提及
example_sentence: If the author had not made that classical allusion, readers would miss the deeper meaning of the novel.
sentence_zh: 如果作者沒有做出那個古典典故的暗示，讀者就會錯過這部小說更深層的意義。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈælaɪ] 盟友；同盟國　(動) [əˈlaɪ] 與…結盟；聯合
example_sentence: During World War II, Britain and France became close allies against Nazi Germany.
sentence_zh: 在第二次世界大戰期間，英國和法國成為對抗納粹德國的親密盟友。

definition_zh: (名) 杏仁；杏仁樹
example_sentence: Containing almonds, the cookies tasted sweet and crunchy during snack time.
sentence_zh: 含有杏仁的餅乾在點心時間嚐起來又甜又脆。

definition_zh: (副) 幾乎；差不多　(副) 快要；即將
example_sentence: Almost every student in the class passed the exam, so the teacher felt proud.
sentence_zh: 班上幾乎每個學生都通過了考試，所以老師感到驕傲。

definition_zh: (副) 高空中；在空中　(形) 在上面的；升起的
example_sentence: Only when the airplane lifted off the ground did the passengers see the city aloft.
sentence_zh: 只有當飛機離地升起，乘客們才能看到高空中的城市。

definition_zh: (形) 單獨的；孤獨的　(副) 單獨地；獨自地
example_sentence: Students who study alone before the exam often feel anxious and stressed.
sentence_zh: 在考試前單獨讀書的學生常常感到焦慮和有壓力。

definition_zh: (介) 和...一起；連同　(連) 除了...之外還
example_sentence: Sarah studied hard along with her classmates to prepare for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 莎拉和她的同學一起努力讀書，以準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (介) 沿著；順著　(副) 一起；一同
example_sentence: Walking along the riverside park, students enjoy fresh air and nature.
sentence_zh: 沿著河邊公園散步，學生享受新鮮空氣和大自然。

definition_zh: (介) 沿著；在...旁邊　(副) 一起；並肩
example_sentence: Walking alongside the river, students discovered historical temples from the Qing dynasty.
sentence_zh: 沿著河邊散步，學生們發現了清朝時期的歷史廟宇。

definition_zh: (形) 冷漠的；疏遠的　(副) 冷漠地；遠遠地
example_sentence: Although Mark remained aloof during the group discussion, his classmates still respected his intelligence.
sentence_zh: 雖然Mark在小組討論中保持冷漠，他的同學仍然尊重他的聰慧。

definition_zh: (名) 禿頭症；掉髮症　(形) 禿頭的；掉髮的
example_sentence: Experiencing progressive hair loss, the patient consulted a dermatologist about treating alopecia.
sentence_zh: 經歷漸進性掉髮，病人諮詢皮膚科醫生關於治療禿頭症的方法。

definition_zh: (副) 大聲地；出聲地　(形) 大聲的；出聲的
example_sentence: The student who read the passage aloud impressed the teacher with clear pronunciation.
sentence_zh: 那位大聲朗讀課文的學生以清楚的發音給老師留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 字母表；字母　(名) 基本知識；入門
example_sentence: If students master the English alphabet, learning new vocabulary becomes much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果學生掌握英文字母，學習新單字就會變得容易得多。

definition_zh: (副) 已經；已經做完
example_sentence: The exam has already finished, so students left the classroom.
sentence_zh: 考試已經結束了，所以學生們離開了教室。

definition_zh: (副) 也；同樣　(連) 而且；另外
example_sentence: Many students study hard to pass the exam and also to improve their English skills.
sentence_zh: 許多學生用功讀書以通過考試，同時也為了提高英文技能。

definition_zh: (名) 極右派人士；另類右翼支持者
example_sentence: The alt-righter's controversial social media posts sparked heated debates among university students.
sentence_zh: 那位極右派人士在社群媒體上的爭議性貼文引發了大學生之間的激烈辯論。

definition_zh: (名) 祭壇；聖壇　(動) 改變；修改
example_sentence: Before the priest placed offerings on the altar, worshippers gathered in silent prayer.
sentence_zh: 在神父將祭品放在祭壇上之前，信徒聚集在一起默默祈禱。

definition_zh: (動) 改變；修改　(動) 改小；改大
example_sentence: Having altered the dress to fit perfectly, the tailor delivered it to the happy customer.
sentence_zh: 裁縫師改好洋裝使其完全合身後，交付給了滿意的顧客。

definition_zh: (名) 改變；修改　(名) 改動；裁縫改衣
example_sentence: The alteration that the tailor made to the school uniform fit perfectly.
sentence_zh: 裁縫師所做的校服改衣完全合身。

definition_zh: (動) [ˋɔltɚˏnet] 輪流；交替　(形) [ˋɔltɚnɪt] 輪流的；交替的
example_sentence: Students alternate between classroom learning and hands-on laboratory experiments throughout the semester.
sentence_zh: 學生在整個學期中輪流進行課堂學習和實際動手實驗。

definition_zh: (副) 交替地；輪流地　(副) 另一方面；相反地
example_sentence: If students studied alternately between math and English, concentration and motivation would improve noticeably.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在數學和英文之間交替學習，專注力和學習動力就會明顯提高。

definition_zh: (形) 替代的；另外的　(名) 替代品；另一選擇
example_sentence: When the main road closed, drivers found an alternative route to reach school.
sentence_zh: 當主要道路關閉時，駕駛人找到另一條路線到達學校。

definition_zh: (副) 另一方面；或者　(副) 作為替代；反之
example_sentence: Alternatively, choosing a different major might lead to better career prospects for future graduates.
sentence_zh: 或者，選擇不同的科系可能為未來的畢業生帶來更好的職業前景。

definition_zh: (連) 雖然；縱然　(副) 儘管；雖說
example_sentence: Although the exam was difficult, most students passed it successfully.
sentence_zh: 雖然考試很難，但大多數學生還是成功通過了。

definition_zh: (名) 海拔；高度　(名) 高度角；仰角
example_sentence: Only at such high altitude can mountain climbers experience extreme cold and thin air.
sentence_zh: 只有在如此高的海拔，登山者才能經歷極端寒冷和稀薄空氣。

definition_zh: (副) 總共；一共　(副) 完全地；根本上
example_sentence: The total cost, which adds up altogether, exceeds the budget that was originally planned.
sentence_zh: 總成本加起來完全超過了最初計畫的預算。

definition_zh: (名) 鋁；鋁製品
example_sentence: Engineers use aluminum to build aircraft frames in order to reduce weight.
sentence_zh: 工程師使用鋁來製造飛機框架，以便降低重量。

definition_zh: (名) 校友；畢業生
example_sentence: The school invited many successful alumni to share their career experiences with current students.
sentence_zh: 學校邀請許多成功的校友與在校學生分享他們的職業經驗。

definition_zh: (名) 校友；校友會成員
example_sentence: The alumnus donated a large sum of money to his high school.
sentence_zh: 那位校友捐贈了一大筆金錢給他的高中。

definition_zh: (副) 總是；始終　(副) 永遠；一直
example_sentence: Although the exam is difficult, students always prepare carefully before the test.
sentence_zh: 雖然考試很難，學生總是在測驗前仔細準備。

definition_zh: (動) 合併；合並　(動) 混合；融合
example_sentence: Amalgamating the two companies, the CEO created a stronger business.
sentence_zh: 通過合併這兩家公司，執行長創造了一個更強大的企業。

definition_zh: (名) 合併；融合　(名) 混合物；合成體
example_sentence: The amalgamation of the two companies, which produced better products, attracted many new customers.
sentence_zh: 這兩家公司的合併，生產出更好的產品，吸引了許多新客戶。

definition_zh: (動) 積累；累積　(動) 聚集；集合
example_sentence: If students amass enough knowledge through consistent study, they will pass the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 如果學生通過持續學習積累足夠的知識，他們就會通過學測。

definition_zh: (名) 業餘愛好者；非職業人士　(形) 業餘的；非專業的
example_sentence: The amateur photographer won first prize at the local art competition.
sentence_zh: 那位業餘攝影師在當地藝術比賽中贏得了第一名。

definition_zh: (動) 使驚訝；使驚奇
example_sentence: Sarah studied hard all year to amaze her parents with excellent exam results.
sentence_zh: 莎拉整年努力讀書，想用優異的考試成績使父母感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (形) 感到吃驚；驚訝　(動) 使...感到驚奇
example_sentence: Sarah was amazed and delighted by the surprise birthday party her friends planned.
sentence_zh: 莎拉對朋友們籌劃的驚喜生日派對感到既吃驚又高興。

definition_zh: (名) 驚訝；驚奇　(名) 令人驚奇的事物
example_sentence: As the magician pulled a rabbit from the hat, amazement filled everyone's faces in the audience.
sentence_zh: 當魔術師從帽子裡拉出兔子時，驚訝之情寫滿了觀眾的臉上。

definition_zh: (形) 令人驚奇的；非凡的　(形) 令人印象深刻的；了不起的
example_sentence: Having won the competition, the amazing student received a scholarship from the university.
sentence_zh: 贏得比賽後，這位令人驚奇的學生獲得了大學獎學金。

definition_zh: (副) 令人驚訝地；非常地
example_sentence: The student who scored amazingly high on the CSAT got into a top university.
sentence_zh: 在學測中成績驚人地高的學生進入了頂尖大學。

definition_zh: (名) 大使；外交官　(名) 代表；使者
example_sentence: The U.S. ambassador to Taiwan promotes cultural exchange and strengthens diplomatic relations between the two countries.
sentence_zh: 美國駐台大使推動文化交流，並加強兩國間的外交關係。

definition_zh: (名) 模糊；歧義　(名) 不明確；含混
example_sentence: If contract language lacked ambiguity, disputes between business partners would decrease significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果合約語言沒有歧義，商業夥伴之間的爭議就會大幅減少。

definition_zh: (形) 模糊的；含混的　(形) 不明確的；令人困惑的
example_sentence: The teacher's ambiguous instructions left many students confused about the homework.
sentence_zh: 老師模糊的指示讓許多學生對功課感到困惑。

definition_zh: (副) 模糊地；含混地　(副) 曖昧地；不明確地
example_sentence: Speaking ambiguously about future plans, the principal avoided making concrete promises to students.
sentence_zh: 校長模糊地談論未來計畫，迴避對學生做出具體承諾。

definition_zh: (名) 野心；抱負　(名) 強烈的欲望；雄心
example_sentence: Although Sarah has great ambition to become a doctor, she must study hard every day.
sentence_zh: 雖然莎拉有成為醫生的遠大抱負，但她必須每天努力讀書。

definition_zh: (形) 有抱負的；野心勃勃的　(形) 需要付出努力的；艱難的
example_sentence: Not only does ambitious goal-setting drive success, but it also builds lasting confidence.
sentence_zh: 不僅設定雄心勃勃的目標能夠推動成功，而且還能建立持久的自信。

definition_zh: (名) 矛盾的感情；模稜兩可的態度
example_sentence: Students who feel ambivalence about their career choices should discuss options with counselors.
sentence_zh: 對職業選擇感到矛盾的學生應該與諮詢師討論選項。

definition_zh: (形) 矛盾的；態度不明確的　(形) 搖擺不定的；猶豫的
example_sentence: Sarah felt ambivalent about the job offer to balance career and family time.
sentence_zh: 莎拉對這份工作機會感到矛盾，想要平衡事業和家庭時間。

definition_zh: (名) 兼具內向和外向特質的人；雙向性格者
example_sentence: An ambivert student can enjoy both solo study sessions and group project work equally well.
sentence_zh: 一位雙向性格的學生可以同樣享受獨自讀書和小組專案工作。

definition_zh: (名) 救護車；急救車
example_sentence: The ambulance arrived quickly and took the injured patient to the hospital.
sentence_zh: 救護車迅速趕到，並將受傷的患者送往醫院。

definition_zh: (名) 埋伏；伏擊　(動) 埋伏攻擊；突然襲擊
example_sentence: As the enemy soldiers marched through the forest, rebels launched an ambush from behind the trees.
sentence_zh: 當敵軍士兵穿過森林行進時，反抗軍從樹後發動埋伏攻擊。

definition_zh: (形) 易接受的；願意同意的　(形) 順從的；聽話的
example_sentence: Being reasonable and open-minded, the principal remained amenable to students' suggestions for improving school facilities.
sentence_zh: 校長為人理性且思想開放，對於學生改善校園設施的建議保持願意接納的態度。

definition_zh: (動) 修改；改正　(動) 修訂法律；改進
example_sentence: The constitution that was amended last year has improved citizen rights significantly.
sentence_zh: 去年修訂的憲法已大幅改善了公民權利。
