definition_zh: (名) 修正案；改正　(動) 修改；改正
example_sentence: If the government proposes an amendment to the Constitution, citizens will vote on it carefully.
sentence_zh: 如果政府提出憲法修正案，公民將會仔細投票表決。

definition_zh: (名) 賠償；補償　(動) 彌補；改正
example_sentence: Making amends for past mistakes requires sincere effort and consistent action.
sentence_zh: 為過去的錯誤彌補需要誠懇的努力和持續的行動。

definition_zh: (名) 便利設施；舒適設備　(名) 便利；舒適
example_sentence: The dormitory offers various amenities to help students live comfortably.
sentence_zh: 宿舍提供各種便利設施以幫助學生舒適地生活。

definition_zh: (名) 美國；美洲
example_sentence: Many Taiwanese students dream of studying at universities in America after high school.
sentence_zh: 許多台灣學生高中畢業後夢想在美國大學讀書。

definition_zh: (形) 美國的；美國人的　(名) 美國人
example_sentence: Because American students study hard, many universities worldwide recruit them.
sentence_zh: 因為美國學生用功讀書，世界各地許多大學都招募他們。

definition_zh: (形) 和藹可親的；親切友善的
example_sentence: Having prepared thoroughly for the interview, the amiable director greeted each candidate with genuine warmth and encouragement.
sentence_zh: 經過充分準備後，這位和藹可親的主任以真誠的溫暖和鼓勵迎接每位候選人。

definition_zh: (形) 友善的；和睦的　(形) 和平的；友好的
example_sentence: The two countries reached an amicable agreement that satisfied both sides.
sentence_zh: 這兩個國家達成了一項令雙方都滿意的友善協議。

definition_zh: (介) 在...之中；在...之間　(介) 被...所包圍
example_sentence: Amid the noise and chaos of the crowded market, the young girl found peace.
sentence_zh: 在擁擠市場的喧囂和混亂之中，那位年輕女孩找到了寧靜。

definition_zh: (介) 在...之中；在...當中　(副) 在中間；在當中
example_sentence: If students studied amidst constant distractions, their exam results would suffer significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在不斷的干擾中讀書，考試成績會明顯下降。

definition_zh: (名) 氨；阿摩尼亞
example_sentence: Ammonia is a colorless gas with a pungent smell used in cleaning products.
sentence_zh: 氨是一種無色氣體，具有刺激性氣味，用於清潔產品中。

definition_zh: (名) 銨；銨鹽
example_sentence: Containing ammonium nitrate, the fertilizer helps crops grow faster and stronger.
sentence_zh: 含有硝酸銨的肥料使農作物生長得更快更強壯。

definition_zh: (名) 彈藥；武器
example_sentence: Because the soldiers ran out of ammunition, they had to retreat from the battle.
sentence_zh: 因為士兵彈藥用盡，他們不得不從戰鬥中撤退。

definition_zh: (名) 赦免；特赦　(動) 赦免；特赦
example_sentence: Only after the government announced amnesty did many refugees dare return home.
sentence_zh: 只有在政府宣布特赦後，許多難民才敢回家。

definition_zh: (介) 在...之中；在...之間　(介) 由...分享
example_sentence: Among the students who studied hard, many achieved excellent scores on the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 在認真讀書的學生當中，許多人在學測中取得優異成績。

definition_zh: (名) 數量；金額　(動) 共計；達到
example_sentence: Saving a small amount of money every month helps students build good financial habits.
sentence_zh: 每個月存一點錢有助於學生養成良好的理財習慣。

definition_zh: (名) 符號(&)；並且符號
example_sentence: In formal writing, use "and" instead of the ampersand symbol in titles.
sentence_zh: 在正式寫作中，標題裡應該用「and」而不是並且符號。

definition_zh: (名) 兩棲動物　(形) 兩棲的；水陸兩用的
example_sentence: Frogs are amphibians that live in water and on land.
sentence_zh: 青蛙是既能在水中又能在陸地上生活的兩棲動物。

definition_zh: (形) 充足的；豐富的　(形) 寬敞的；寬闊的
example_sentence: As the campus provides ample resources for students, many can pursue their dreams without financial worry.
sentence_zh: 由於校園提供充足的資源給學生，許多學生可以不用為經濟擔憂而追求夢想。

definition_zh: (動) 放大；擴大　(動) 增強；加強
example_sentence: Amplifying the main character's struggles, the director created a powerful and moving film.
sentence_zh: 導演透過放大主角的困境，創作出一部強大而感人的電影。

definition_zh: (副) 充分地；足夠地　(副) 慷慨地；大量地
example_sentence: The scholarship provides amply for students whose families lack financial resources.
sentence_zh: 這項獎學金為家庭缺乏經濟資源的學生充分提供了支助。

definition_zh: (動) 截肢；切除肢體
example_sentence: If the infection spreads further, doctors will amputate the patient's leg.
sentence_zh: 如果感染繼續擴散，醫生將必須為病患進行截肢手術。

definition_zh: (名) 截肢；切除肢體
example_sentence: After the serious car accident, the patient underwent amputation of the left leg.
sentence_zh: 在那場嚴重車禍後，病人接受了左腿截肢手術。

definition_zh: (名) 截肢者；被截肢的人
example_sentence: The rehabilitation center provided prosthetics to help amputees regain mobility.
sentence_zh: 復健中心提供義肢幫助截肢者恢復行動能力。

definition_zh: (動) 逗樂；使高興　(動) 消遣；娛樂
example_sentence: The comedian's funny jokes amused the audience, making everyone laugh throughout the show.
sentence_zh: 這位喜劇演員的笑話逗樂了觀眾，讓大家在整場表演中都笑得很開心。

definition_zh: (形) 感到好笑的；被逗樂的　(動) 逗樂；使娛樂
example_sentence: Although the movie was supposed to be serious, the audience remained amused throughout the entire film.
sentence_zh: 雖然這部電影本應是嚴肅的，但觀眾在整部影片中始終感到有趣。

definition_zh: (名) 遊樂園；主題樂園
example_sentence: Having saved money for months, the students visited the amusement park during summer vacation.
sentence_zh: 經過幾個月的存錢，學生們在暑假期間參觀了遊樂園。

definition_zh: (名) 娛樂；消遣　(名) 愉快；樂趣
example_sentence: The theme park, which offers various rides and attractions, provides endless amusement for visiting families.
sentence_zh: 那個主題樂園提供各種遊樂設施和景點，為訪問的家庭提供無盡的娛樂。

definition_zh: (形) 有趣的；令人發笑的　(形) 娛樂性的；使人愉快的
example_sentence: The comedian told amusing jokes that made the whole audience laugh loudly.
sentence_zh: 那位喜劇演員講了有趣的笑話，讓全場觀眾大聲笑出來。

definition_zh: (名) 數量；量　(片) 大約；左右
example_sentence: If the company received a large amount of customer feedback, management would improve the product design.
sentence_zh: 如果公司收到大量的顧客意見，管理層就會改進產品設計。

definition_zh: (名) 冰原；冰盤　(名) 冰床；冰層
example_sentence: An ice sheet covering Antarctica holds most of the world's fresh water.
sentence_zh: 覆蓋南極洲的冰原蘊含世界上大部分的淡水。

definition_zh: (形) 類似的；相似的　(形) 對應的；平行的
example_sentence: Showing similar patterns in structure, the two mathematical systems are analogous to each other.
sentence_zh: 這兩個數學系統呈現出相似的結構模式，彼此類似。

definition_zh: (名) 類比；比喻　(名) 類似之處；相似點
example_sentence: Just as a computer needs a program to function, the human brain requires education to develop, making this analogy quite useful for understanding learning.
sentence_zh: 就像電腦需要程式才能運作一樣，人腦需要教育才能發展，這個類比對於理解學習很有用。

definition_zh: (名) 分析；解析　(動) 分析；檢驗
example_sentence: Only after careful analysis of the data did the researcher discover the hidden pattern.
sentence_zh: 只有在仔細分析數據之後，研究人員才發現了隱藏的規律。

definition_zh: (名) 分析師；分析人員
example_sentence: The financial analyst who examined the company's data predicted strong growth.
sentence_zh: 檢查公司數據的財務分析師預測強勁的增長。

definition_zh: (形) 分析的；善於分析的　(形) 邏輯的；有條理的
example_sentence: Students need to develop analytical skills to solve complex math problems effectively.
sentence_zh: 學生需要培養分析能力以便有效解決複雜的數學問題。

definition_zh: (動) 分析；解析　(動) 研究；檢查
example_sentence: Studying data and analyzing trends help students understand market changes better.
sentence_zh: 研究數據和分析趨勢幫助學生更好地理解市場變化。

definition_zh: (名) 解剖學；身體結構　(名) 詳細分析；構成
example_sentence: Medical students study human anatomy to understand how bodies work.
sentence_zh: 醫學生研究人體解剖學以了解身體如何運作。

definition_zh: (名) 祖先；祖宗　(名) 前人；前代的人
example_sentence: As our ancestors settled in this valley generations ago, the village has preserved their traditions carefully.
sentence_zh: 由於我們的祖先數代前就在這個山谷定居，這個村莊仔細保護了他們的傳統。

definition_zh: (名) 祖先；家族來源　(名) 血統；家世背景
example_sentence: Tracing back generations, families discover their ancestry connecting to different countries.
sentence_zh: 追溯幾代人的祖先，家族發現他們的血統與不同國家相連。

definition_zh: (名) 錨；支柱　(動) 拋錨；固定　(形) 主要的；關鍵的
example_sentence: The news anchor who reported the scandal became a trusted figure that audiences relied on.
sentence_zh: 報導醜聞的新聞主播成為觀眾所信賴的受信任人物。

definition_zh: (形) 古代的；古老的　(形) 年代久遠的；遠古的
example_sentence: If ancient civilizations had not developed writing systems, modern society would not exist today.
sentence_zh: 如果古代文明沒有發展出文字系統，現代社會就不會存在。

definition_zh: (形) 軼事的；基於個人故事的　(形) 不夠科學的；缺乏證據的
example_sentence: The doctor's anecdotal evidence about the medicine was interesting but not scientifically proven.
sentence_zh: 醫生關於這種藥物的軼事證據很有趣，但在科學上未被證實。

definition_zh: (名) 趣事；軼事　(名) 簡短故事；小故事
example_sentence: The professor told amusing anecdotes to illustrate historical events.
sentence_zh: 教授講述有趣的軼事來說明歷史事件。

definition_zh: (名) 貧血；紅血球不足
example_sentence: Patients suffering from severe anemia often feel tired and weak during daily activities.
sentence_zh: 患有嚴重貧血的病人在日常活動中經常感到疲勞和虛弱。

definition_zh: (名) 麻醉；麻醉藥　(名) 感覺喪失；無感覺
example_sentence: Before the surgery starts, the patient receives anesthesia so that pain during the operation can be completely avoided.
sentence_zh: 在手術開始之前，病人接受麻醉，這樣手術中的疼痛就能完全避免。

definition_zh: (名) 動脈瘤；血管瘤
example_sentence: Having suffered a ruptured aneurysm, the patient required emergency brain surgery.
sentence_zh: 患者因動脈瘤破裂，需要緊急腦部手術。

definition_zh: (名) 天使；神的信使　(名) 善良的人；好心人
example_sentence: The nurse who cared for the patient was an angel that everyone respected deeply.
sentence_zh: 照顧病人的護士是一位大家都深深尊敬的天使。

definition_zh: (形) 天使般的；純潔的　(形) 溫柔善良的；天真的
example_sentence: The angelic voice of the choir singer moved everyone in the concert hall to tears.
sentence_zh: 唱詩班歌手那天使般的嗓音讓音樂廳裡的每個人都感動得流淚。

definition_zh: (名) 憤怒；生氣　(動) 使生氣；激怒
example_sentence: If Mark did not apologize sincerely, his girlfriend's anger would grow stronger.
sentence_zh: 如果馬克沒有真摯道歉，他女友的憤怒會變得更強烈。

definition_zh: (動) 想方設法爭取；暗示想要
example_sentence: The politician angled for support from local business leaders.
sentence_zh: 那位政治人物想方設法爭取當地商界領袖的支持。

definition_zh: (名) 角度；角　(動) 轉向；傾斜　(名) 觀點；立場
example_sentence: Adjusting the camera angle, the photographer captured the sunset beautifully.
sentence_zh: 調整相機角度，攝影師漂亮地捕捉到日落景象。

definition_zh: (名) 釣魚者；釣手
example_sentence: As the angler cast his line into the river, fish began to gather beneath the surface.
sentence_zh: 當釣魚者把釣線投入河中時，魚開始聚集在水面下。

definition_zh: (形) 生氣的；憤怒的　(形) 兇狠的；猛烈的
example_sentence: Never has Mark been so angry at his younger brother as he was that day.
sentence_zh: 馬克從未像那天一樣對他弟弟生過那麼大的氣。

definition_zh: (形) 有稜角的；瘦削的　(形) 笨拙的；不靈活的
example_sentence: The angular building, which stands at the corner of the street, attracts many tourists every year.
sentence_zh: 那棟有稜角的建築物矗立在街角，每年吸引許多遊客前往。

definition_zh: (名) 動物；獸類　(形) 動物的；獸性的
example_sentence: Many students visit the zoo to learn about different animals and their habitats.
sentence_zh: 許多學生參觀動物園是為了了解不同的動物及其棲息地。

definition_zh: (動) [ˋænəmet] 使有生氣；使活躍　(形) [ˋænəmɪt] 生動的；活潑的
example_sentence: The animated discussion between students and teachers made the class more engaging and interesting.
sentence_zh: 學生和老師之間生動的討論使課堂更有趣且吸引人。

definition_zh: (形) 生動的；充滿活力的　(形) 動畫的；用動畫製作的
example_sentence: The animated movie about the lost dog touched many viewers' hearts.
sentence_zh: 那部關於走失小狗的動畫電影感動了許多觀眾。

definition_zh: (名) 動畫；動畫製作　(名) 活力；生氣
example_sentence: As the animator drew each frame carefully, the animation came alive on the screen.
sentence_zh: 當動畫師仔細繪製每一幀時，動畫在螢幕上生動起來。

definition_zh: (名) 仇恨；敵意　(名) 深深的厭惡
example_sentence: Holding deep animosity toward each other, the two rival teams refused to shake hands after the match.
sentence_zh: 互相抱著深深的仇恨，這兩支對立球隊在比賽後拒絕握手。

definition_zh: (名) 腳踝；踝關節
example_sentence: The runner who twisted her ankle during the marathon had to stop.
sentence_zh: 在馬拉松比賽中扭傷腳踝的跑者不得不停下來。

definition_zh: (動) [ə`nɛks] 併吞；兼併　(名) [`ænɛks] 附件；附屬建築
example_sentence: If the government annexes that territory, the local residents will lose their independence.
sentence_zh: 如果政府併吞那個領土，當地居民將失去獨立性。

definition_zh: (動) 徹底摧毀；完全消滅
example_sentence: The powerful explosion annihilated the entire building in seconds.
sentence_zh: 那場強大的爆炸在幾秒內徹底摧毀了整棟建築物。

definition_zh: (名) 完全摧毀；殲滅　(名) 湮滅；消亡
example_sentence: The military deployed advanced weapons to prevent the annihilation of civilian populations.
sentence_zh: 軍隊部署先進武器以防止平民遭到殲滅。

definition_zh: (形) 滅絕的；摧毀性的
example_sentence: The annihilative power of nuclear weapons remains a serious global concern.
sentence_zh: 核武器的毀滅性力量仍然是全球的一個嚴重關注點。

definition_zh: (名) 週年紀念；周年紀念日
example_sentence: Although the company celebrated its tenth anniversary last month, employees continued working on new projects.
sentence_zh: 儘管公司上個月慶祝了十週年紀念，員工們仍繼續進行新專案。

definition_zh: (動) 宣佈；公告　(動) 播報；報告
example_sentence: Having announced the new scholarship program, the principal answered questions from excited students.
sentence_zh: 校長宣佈了新的獎學金計畫後，回答了興奮學生的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 公告；通知　(名) 宣布；宣傳
example_sentence: The announcement that the school made surprised all students who were waiting for exam results.
sentence_zh: 學校所做的公告讓所有等待考試成績的學生都感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (名) 播音員；主持人　(名) 宣布者；公告人
example_sentence: The radio announcer's clear voice made every listener feel welcome and informed.
sentence_zh: 廣播播音員清晰的聲音讓每位聽眾都感到受歡迎且受到訊息告知。

definition_zh: (動) 惹惱；使煩擾　(動) 騷擾；打擾
example_sentence: If constant noise from neighbors annoyed studying students, they would complain to the landlord immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果來自鄰居的持續噪音惹惱了讀書的學生，他們會立即向房東投訴。

definition_zh: (名) 煩惱；惱怒　(動) 使煩惱；惹人厭
example_sentence: The constant noise from construction is a major annoyance to nearby residents.
sentence_zh: 持續的施工噪音對附近居民是一大煩惱。

definition_zh: (形) 惱怒的；煩躁的　(動) 使生氣；使煩惱
example_sentence: Annoyed by constant notifications, the student turned off the phone during study time.
sentence_zh: 被持續的通知惱怒，學生在讀書時間關掉了手機。

definition_zh: (形) 惱人的；令人厭煩的　(動) 惱人；使厭煩
example_sentence: Although the noise outside was annoying, the students managed to concentrate on their exam preparation.
sentence_zh: 雖然外面的噪音令人厭煩，學生們還是設法專注於備考。

definition_zh: (形) 每年的；年度的　(名) 年刊；年鑑
example_sentence: Only after the annual school festival ends do students finally relax.
sentence_zh: 只有在年度校慶結束後，學生才終於放鬆。

definition_zh: (副) 每年；按年度
example_sentence: The school holds an awards ceremony annually, which recognizes students who excel in academics and sports.
sentence_zh: 學校每年舉辦一次頒獎典禮，表揚在學業和運動上表現優異的學生。

definition_zh: (動) 廢除；宣佈無效　(動) 取消；撤銷
example_sentence: The court decided to annul the marriage to protect both parties' legal rights.
sentence_zh: 法院決定廢除婚姻以保護雙方的法律權益。

definition_zh: (名) 陽極；正極
example_sentence: In a battery, the anode is the positive terminal where chemical reactions release electrons.
sentence_zh: 在電池中，陽極是正極端，化學反應在此釋放電子。

definition_zh: (動) 塗油；膏抹　(動) 任命；授予權力
example_sentence: The priest anointed the baby's forehead with holy oil during the ceremony.
sentence_zh: 在儀式中，神父用聖油塗抹嬰兒的額頭。

definition_zh: (名) 異常；反常現象　(名) 不規則；偏差
example_sentence: Although the test results showed an anomaly, doctors continued monitoring the patient carefully.
sentence_zh: 雖然檢查結果顯示異常，醫生仍然仔細監測患者的狀況。

definition_zh: (形) 匿名的；無名的　(形) 身份不明的；來源不詳的
example_sentence: Posting anonymous comments online, many students avoid taking responsibility for their words.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在網上發匿名評論，藉此避免對自己的言論負責。

definition_zh: (形) 另一個；其他的　(代) 另一個；別的
example_sentence: The students who finished early were able to start another project.
sentence_zh: 提早完成的學生能夠開始另一個專案。

definition_zh: (動) 頂嘴；回嘴　(動) 反駁；頂嘴回應
example_sentence: If your parents scold you, you should not answer back, or they will be more angry.
sentence_zh: 如果你的父母責罵你，你不應該頂嘴，否則他們會更生氣。

definition_zh: (動) 為...負責；對...承擔後果　(動) 對...作出解釋或回應
example_sentence: The company must answer for the product's safety defects.
sentence_zh: 這家公司必須為產品的安全缺陷負責。

definition_zh: (名) 答題卷；答案紙
example_sentence: Students need to fill in their names on the answer sheet to submit their test responses.
sentence_zh: 學生需要在答題卷上填入姓名以提交測驗答案。

definition_zh: (名) 答案；回答　(動) 回答；解答
example_sentence: The teacher asked a difficult question, and only one student could answer it correctly.
sentence_zh: 老師問了一個困難的問題，只有一個學生能正確回答它。

definition_zh: (名) 螞蟻；蟻
example_sentence: As ants work together to build their nest, students should cooperate to complete group projects.
sentence_zh: 就像螞蟻一起合作建造巢穴一樣，學生應該合作完成小組專案。

definition_zh: (形) 對立的；敵對的　(形) 相反的；不相容的
example_sentence: Having experienced repeated conflicts, the two nations adopted increasingly antagonistic policies toward each other.
sentence_zh: 經歷了多次衝突後，這兩個國家對彼此採取越來越敵對的政策。

definition_zh: (動) 激怒；惹惱　(動) 對抗；使成為敵人
example_sentence: Comments that antagonize readers will damage your online reputation, which many students overlook.
sentence_zh: 激怒讀者的評論會損害你的網路名聲，這是許多學生忽視的問題。

definition_zh: (形) 南極的；南極地區的　(名) 南極；南極地區
example_sentence: The Antarctic continent is covered by thick ice and experiences extreme cold temperatures year-round.
sentence_zh: 南極大陸被厚厚的冰層覆蓋，全年經歷極端寒冷的溫度。

definition_zh: (名) 南極洲；南極
example_sentence: If Antarctica were not covered in ice, the world's climate would change dramatically.
sentence_zh: 如果南極洲沒有被冰覆蓋，世界氣候會發生劇烈變化。

definition_zh: (名) 前因；先行詞　(形) 在前的；先發生的
example_sentence: Understanding the antecedent events helps explain why the accident happened.
sentence_zh: 理解先前發生的事件有助於解釋為什麼會發生事故。

definition_zh: (名) 羚羊；跳羚
example_sentence: Running swiftly across the grassland, the antelope escaped the lion's attack.
sentence_zh: 羚羊迅速地跑過草地，逃脫了獅子的攻擊。

definition_zh: (名) 天線；觸角
example_sentence: As the radio antenna picked up signals, the host began broadcasting the evening news to thousands of listeners.
sentence_zh: 當廣播天線接收到信號時，主持人開始向數千名聽眾播放晚間新聞。

definition_zh: (名) 國歌；聖歌　(名) 象徵；代表作
example_sentence: Never has a national anthem stirred the hearts of citizens more powerfully than in times of crisis.
sentence_zh: 從未有國歌在危機時刻比現在更深深觸動人民的心靈。

definition_zh: (名) 人類學家；研究人類文化和社會的學者
example_sentence: The anthropologist who studied tribal customs discovered fascinating cultural traditions unknown to modern society.
sentence_zh: 研究部落習俗的人類學家發現了現代社會不知道的迷人文化傳統。

definition_zh: (名) 人類學；人類文化和社會的研究
example_sentence: Students study anthropology to understand how different cultures develop and change over time.
sentence_zh: 學生學習人類學來了解不同文化如何發展和改變。

definition_zh: (形) 擬人化的；賦予人格特徵的
example_sentence: The animated film features anthropomorphic animals wearing clothes and speaking human languages.
sentence_zh: 這部動畫電影以擬人化的動物為主角，牠們穿著衣服並說著人類語言。

definition_zh: (名) 抗生素　(形) 抗生素的；殺菌的
example_sentence: Doctors prescribe antibiotics to treat bacterial infections and help patients recover.
sentence_zh: 醫生開抗生素處方來治療細菌感染並幫助患者康復。

definition_zh: (名) 抗體；對抗病原體的蛋白質
example_sentence: Because the body produces antibodies when fighting infection, the immune system becomes stronger over time.
sentence_zh: 因為身體在對抗感染時會產生抗體，所以免疫系統會隨著時間逐漸增強。

definition_zh: (動) 預期；期待　(動) 先於...之前做；預先準備
example_sentence: Anticipating the exam questions, students reviewed the textbook thoroughly.
sentence_zh: 預期考試題目，學生們徹底複習了課本。

definition_zh: (名) 期待；預期　(名) 興奮的期盼感
example_sentence: The anticipation that students felt before the exam results were announced was almost unbearable.
sentence_zh: 學生在考試成績公布前感受到的期待幾乎是難以忍受的。

definition_zh: (名) 解毒劑；對抗毒物的藥物　(名) 解決問題的方法；補救措施
example_sentence: If a student takes the antidote of regular practice, exam anxiety will decrease significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生服用定期練習的解藥，考試焦慮將會大幅降低。

definition_zh: (名) 抗氧化物；防止氧化的物質
example_sentence: Eating fruits rich in antioxidants helps protect your body from damage.
sentence_zh: 吃富含抗氧化物的水果有助於保護身體免受傷害。

definition_zh: (名) 厭惡；反感　(動) 厭惡；討厭
example_sentence: Some students feel antipathy toward math to avoid challenging their thinking abilities.
sentence_zh: 有些學生對數學感到反感，以避免挑戰自己的思維能力。

definition_zh: (形) 古董的；古書籍的　(名) 古董收藏家；古書籍研究者
example_sentence: The antiquarian book collector spent decades hunting rare first editions at auctions.
sentence_zh: 這位古書籍收藏家花了數十年在拍賣會上尋找珍貴的初版書。

definition_zh: (形) 過時的；陳舊的　(形) 古老的；年代久遠的
example_sentence: Although the factory still uses antiquated machinery, it manages to produce quality goods year after year.
sentence_zh: 雖然這家工廠仍然使用過時的機器，它卻年復一年地生產優質產品。

definition_zh: (形) 古老的；古董的　(名) 古董；古物
example_sentence: Having been passed down through generations, the antique furniture now decorates grandmother's living room beautifully.
sentence_zh: 經過世代相傳，那件古董家具現在裝飾著奶奶的客廳，看起來非常漂亮。

definition_zh: (名) 對立；對比　(名) 相反的事物
example_sentence: Happiness and sadness are antithesis, which makes life truly meaningful.
sentence_zh: 快樂和悲傷是對立的事物，這使人生真正有意義。

definition_zh: (名) 防毒軟體；反病毒程式
example_sentence: Installing reliable antivirus software protects your computer from malicious attacks.
sentence_zh: 安裝可靠的防毒軟體可以保護你的電腦免受惡意攻擊。

definition_zh: (名) 反義詞；對立詞
example_sentence: If students memorized antonyms systematically, vocabulary retention would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生有系統地背誦反義詞，字彙記憶力會大幅提升。

definition_zh: (名) 焦慮；不安　(名) 擔心；憂慮
example_sentence: Test anxiety often affects students during major exams.
sentence_zh: 考試焦慮常常影響學生在重要考試中的表現。

definition_zh: (形) 焦慮的；不安的　(形) 渴望的；急切的
example_sentence: Feeling anxious about the upcoming CSAT exam, many students studied extra hours daily.
sentence_zh: 由於對即將到來的學測感到焦慮，許多學生每天都花額外時間讀書。

definition_zh: (副) 焦急地；不安地
example_sentence: Anxiously waiting for the exam results, Sarah checked her email every few minutes.
sentence_zh: 莎拉焦急地等待考試成績，每隔幾分鐘就檢查一次電子郵件。

definition_zh: (形) 任何的；任意一個　(代) 任何人；任何事物
example_sentence: Hardly any student in our class failed the math test last month.
sentence_zh: 上個月幾乎我們班沒有任何學生在數學測驗中不及格。

definition_zh: (代) 任何人；誰　(代) 重要人物
example_sentence: Anyone who studies hard will pass the exam that determines college entrance.
sentence_zh: 任何認真讀書的人都會通過決定大學入學的考試。

definition_zh: (副) 無論如何；反正　(連) 然而；不過
example_sentence: The exam is difficult, but students must study hard anyhow to improve their test scores.
sentence_zh: 考試很難，但學生必須無論如何努力讀書以改進他們的考試成績。

definition_zh: (副) 再；已不；不再
example_sentence: Sarah doesn't want to study English anymore, so she switched to a different subject.
sentence_zh: 莎拉不想再學英文了，所以她改選了不同的科目。

definition_zh: (代) 任何人；任何一個人
example_sentence: Does anyone in this class want to join the volleyball team?
sentence_zh: 這班上有人想加入排球隊嗎？

definition_zh: (片) 除了...之外什麼都不是；絕非
example_sentence: Winning the game was anything but easy, requiring months of hard training and teamwork.
sentence_zh: 贏得比賽絕非容易，需要幾個月的艱苦訓練和團隊合作。

definition_zh: (代) 任何東西；任何事物　(名) 重要的事；值得注意的事
example_sentence: Anything happening in the classroom was carefully observed by the strict teacher.
sentence_zh: 教室裡發生的任何事物都被那位嚴格的老師仔細觀察。

definition_zh: (副) 任何時候；隨時　(名) 任意時刻
example_sentence: Students can submit assignments anytime before the deadline arrives.
sentence_zh: 學生可以在截止日期到來之前的任何時候提交作業。

definition_zh: (副) 無論如何；不管怎樣　(連) 不過；然而
example_sentence: If studying seems difficult, remember that passing the exam is possible anyway.
sentence_zh: 如果讀書看起來很困難，無論如何要記得通過考試是可能的。

definition_zh: (介) 從...到...；大約在...範圍內
example_sentence: The concert ticket price ranges anywhere from five hundred to two thousand dollars.
sentence_zh: 演唱會門票價格大約在五百到兩千元之間。

definition_zh: (副) 任何地方；到處　(代) 任何地點
example_sentence: Students need to prepare textbooks anywhere to review lessons effectively.
sentence_zh: 學生需要在任何地方準備課本以便有效複習功課。

definition_zh: (介) 除了...之外；除去
example_sentence: Apart from studying English, the student also practices music every weekend.
sentence_zh: 除了學英文之外，那名學生每個週末還練習音樂。

definition_zh: (副) 分開；分散　(介) 除了…之外
example_sentence: Apart from studying for exams, many students find it hard to maintain friendships during the busy school year.
sentence_zh: 除了準備考試之外，許多學生在繁忙的學年中很難維持友誼。

definition_zh: (名) 種族隔離制度；種族分離　(形) 被隔離的；被分離的
example_sentence: Having experienced apartheid, South Africa transformed into a democratic nation embracing equality.
sentence_zh: 經歷過種族隔離制度後，南非轉變為擁抱平等的民主國家。

definition_zh: (名) 公寓；住宅　(名) 套房；房間
example_sentence: The apartment that my family rents is located near the convenient MRT station.
sentence_zh: 我家租住的公寓位於靠近便利的捷運站附近。

definition_zh: (形) 冷漠的；無感的　(形) 懶散的；不關心的
example_sentence: The apathetic student showed no interest in learning or participating in class discussions.
sentence_zh: 那個冷漠的學生對學習和課堂討論毫不感興趣。

definition_zh: (副) 冷漠地；漠不關心地　缺乏熱情地
example_sentence: If the government responded apathetically to climate change, future generations would suffer serious consequences.
sentence_zh: 如果政府對氣候變遷漠不關心地回應，未來世代將遭受嚴重後果。

definition_zh: (名) 冷漠；無動於衷　(形) 冷淡的；無感的
example_sentence: Many students showed apathy toward the school's volunteer program.
sentence_zh: 許多學生對學校志願服務計畫表現出冷漠。

definition_zh: (名) 猿；類人猿　(動) 模仿；模擬
example_sentence: Aping the famous actor's gestures, the student made everyone in class laugh.
sentence_zh: 那位學生模仿著那位著名演員的姿態，逗得全班同學都笑了。

definition_zh: (名) 頂點；最高峰　(名) 高潮；巔峰時期
example_sentence: As the athlete reached the apex of her career, winning multiple gold medals became her ultimate goal.
sentence_zh: 當運動員達到職業生涯的巔峰時，贏得多面金牌成為了她的終極目標。

definition_zh: (名) 呼吸暫停；睡眠呼吸中止
example_sentence: Only after a patient experiences repeated apnea episodes does a doctor recommend sleep study testing.
sentence_zh: 只有在患者經歷多次呼吸暫停發作之後，醫生才會建議進行睡眠檢查。

definition_zh: (名) 為某人或某事辯護者；道歉者
example_sentence: The politician, who was an apologist for the controversial policy, faced strong criticism.
sentence_zh: 那位為有爭議政策辯護的政治人物面臨強烈批評。

definition_zh: (動) 道歉；認錯　為某事表示遺憾
example_sentence: Maria called her best friend to apologize for missing the important birthday party.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞打電話給她的好友，為缺席重要的生日派對而道歉。

definition_zh: (名) 道歉；為...表示歉意　(動) 為...道歉；向...認錯
example_sentence: Making a sincere apology and admitting your mistake shows real maturity.
sentence_zh: 真誠道歉並承認錯誤展現真正的成熟度。

definition_zh: (動) 使震驚；使驚愕　使感到厭惡
example_sentence: The terrible news about the accident appalled everyone in the school.
sentence_zh: 關於那場事故的可怕消息讓學校裡的每個人都感到震驚。

definition_zh: (形) 令人震驚的；極其糟糕的　(形) 可怕的；駭人的
example_sentence: Although the weather was appalling, the students completed the outdoor field trip successfully.
sentence_zh: 雖然天氣令人震驚地糟糕，學生們仍成功完成了戶外實地考察。

definition_zh: (名) 儀器；裝置　(名) 器材；設備
example_sentence: Using sophisticated laboratory apparatus, students conducted experiments to analyze chemical reactions.
sentence_zh: 學生使用精密的實驗室儀器進行實驗，以分析化學反應。

definition_zh: (名) 衣服；服裝　(動) 穿著；打扮
example_sentence: The formal apparel that students wear for graduation ceremonies impresses families and friends.
sentence_zh: 學生在畢業典禮上穿著的正式服裝給家人和朋友留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (形) 明顯的；似乎的　(副) 明顯地；表面上
example_sentence: If the apparent reason for the accident is human error, authorities will launch a strict investigation.
sentence_zh: 如果事故的明顯原因是人為失誤，當局將啟動嚴格調查。

definition_zh: (副) 似乎；看起來　明顯地；據說
example_sentence: The exam was apparently harder than last year according to most students.
sentence_zh: 據大多數學生所說，這次考試似乎比去年更難。

definition_zh: (動) 吸引；符合　(動) 上訴；懇求
example_sentence: Companies design colorful packaging to appeal to teenage customers and increase sales.
sentence_zh: 公司設計色彩繽紛的包裝以吸引青少年顧客並增加銷售。

definition_zh: (名) 上訴；呼籲　(動) 吸引；打動；上訴
example_sentence: The advertisement's colorful design and catchy music appeal to young audiences effectively.
sentence_zh: 這則廣告的繽紛設計和朗朗上口的音樂能有效吸引年輕觀眾。

definition_zh: (形) 有吸引力的；迷人的　(動) 呼籲；懇求
example_sentence: Although the job offers low pay, the appealing work environment attracts many applicants annually.
sentence_zh: 雖然這份工作薪水低，但吸引人的工作環境每年都吸引許多申請者。

definition_zh: (動) 出現；顯得　(動) 似乎；看起來
example_sentence: Having appeared on stage nervously, the student gradually gained confidence.
sentence_zh: 那位學生在舞台上緊張地出現後，逐漸獲得信心。

definition_zh: (名) 外表；樣子　(名) 出現；現身
example_sentence: The student whose appearance was neat and tidy made a good impression on the interviewer.
sentence_zh: 外表整潔的那位學生給面試官留下了很好的印象。

definition_zh: (動) 安撫；平息　緩和；減輕
example_sentence: The government offered tax cuts to appease angry voters before the election.
sentence_zh: 政府在選舉前提供減稅來安撫憤怒的選民。

definition_zh: (名) 綏靖；妥協　(動) 綏靖；安撫
example_sentence: If the government chose appeasement instead of standing firm, the aggressor would demand even more territory.
sentence_zh: 若政府選擇綏靖而非堅定立場，侵略者會要求更多領土。

definition_zh: (動) 附加；添加　(動) 附上；附在...後面
example_sentence: The teacher asked students to append their names to the assignment.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生在作業上附上他們的名字。

definition_zh: (名) 附肢；附加物　(名) 闌尾
example_sentence: Having a specialized appendage, the gecko clings effortlessly to walls.
sentence_zh: 壁虎具有特化的附肢，輕易地黏在牆上。

definition_zh: (名) 附錄；附件　(名) 闌尾
example_sentence: Before submitting the research report, students should check the appendix so that all supporting data are included.
sentence_zh: 在提交研究報告之前，學生應該檢查附錄，以便所有的支持數據都被包含在內。

definition_zh: (名) 食慾；胃口　(名) 慾望；渴望
example_sentence: Only after eating a large breakfast did Sarah lose her appetite for lunch.
sentence_zh: 只有在吃過豐盛的早餐後，莎拉才對午餐沒有食慾。

definition_zh: (名) 開胃菜；前菜
example_sentence: The appetizer that the restaurant served before dinner tasted delicious.
sentence_zh: 餐廳在晚餐前端上的開胃菜嚐起來很美味。

definition_zh: (形) 引起食慾的；誘人的　(形) 吸引人的；有吸引力的
example_sentence: The chef prepared an appetizing meal to welcome the distinguished guests.
sentence_zh: 廚師準備了一頓誘人的餐點來歡迎尊貴的客人。

definition_zh: (動) 鼓掌；喝彩　(動) 讚同；贊成
example_sentence: The audience applauded and cheered loudly after the student's excellent musical performance.
sentence_zh: 觀眾在那位學生精彩的音樂表演後，熱烈地鼓掌和歡呼。

definition_zh: (名) 掌聲；喝彩　(動) 為…鼓掌；喝彩
example_sentence: The audience gave loud applause after the concert finished.
sentence_zh: 音樂會結束後，觀眾給予熱烈的掌聲。

definition_zh: (名) 蘋果；蘋果樹
example_sentence: As soon as Sarah picked an apple from the tree, she took a bite.
sentence_zh: 莎拉一從樹上摘下蘋果，就咬了一口。

definition_zh: (名) 電器用品；家電　(名) 裝置；器具
example_sentence: Having purchased a new washing machine, the family could finally wash clothes more efficiently using the modern appliance.
sentence_zh: 購買了一臺新洗衣機後，這個家庭終於能用現代電器用品更有效率地洗衣服。

definition_zh: (形) 適用的；可應用的　(形) 相關的；適用於
example_sentence: The new traffic rules applicable to all drivers require immediate attention and compliance.
sentence_zh: 適用於所有駕駛人的新交通規則需要立即關注和遵守。

definition_zh: (名) 申請人；求職者　(名) 應試者；考生
example_sentence: If the applicant submits all required documents before the deadline, the university will review the application promptly.
sentence_zh: 如果申請人在截止日期前提交所有必需文件，大學將迅速審查申請。

definition_zh: (名) 申請；應用　(名) 應用程式；軟體
example_sentence: Submit your university application before the deadline in February.
sentence_zh: 在二月截止日期之前提交你的大學申請。

definition_zh: (動) 申請；應徵　提出申請　(動) 使用；運用　(動) 涂抹；敷
example_sentence: Many students apply to universities every year to pursue higher education.
sentence_zh: 許多學生每年申請大學以追求高等教育。

definition_zh: (動) 任命；委派　(動) 約定；安排
example_sentence: The principal appointed three new teachers and assigned them to different departments.
sentence_zh: 校長任命了三位新老師，並將他們分配到不同的部門。

definition_zh: (名) 預約；約定　(名) 職位；任命
example_sentence: Although the doctor's appointment was scheduled for next week, the patient decided to reschedule it.
sentence_zh: 雖然醫生的預約安排在下週，但患者決定改期。

definition_zh: (動) 分配；按比例分配
example_sentence: Having apportioned the project budget fairly among all departments, the manager earned widespread respect.
sentence_zh: 經理公平地將項目預算分配給所有部門後，贏得了廣泛的尊重。

definition_zh: (名) 分配；配置　(名) 分派；分配比例
example_sentence: The apportionment of seats in Congress, which affects how many representatives each state receives, changes after every ten-year census.
sentence_zh: 眾議院議席的分配是一種每十年進行一次普查後就會改變的制度，它決定了每個州獲得多少名代表。

definition_zh: (名) 評估；評價　(名) 績效考核；考績
example_sentence: The manager's annual appraisal of employee performance determines salary increases and career development.
sentence_zh: 經理對員工績效的年度評估決定薪資調整和職業發展。

definition_zh: (動) 評估；估價　(動) 評判；鑑定
example_sentence: If the antique furniture were appraised by a professional expert, its true value would be revealed to the family.
sentence_zh: 如果這件古董家具由專業鑑定師評估，它真正的價值就會被家族發現。

definition_zh: (形) 明顯的；可察覺的　相當大的；值得注意的
example_sentence: The appreciable increase in exam scores motivated all the students to study harder.
sentence_zh: 考試成績明顯提高激勵所有學生更努力讀書。

definition_zh: (動) 感謝；欣賞　(動) 理解；認識到
example_sentence: Appreciating her parents' hard work, Sarah decided to help more at home.
sentence_zh: 莎拉欣賞父母的辛勤工作，決定在家幫忙更多。

definition_zh: (名) 感謝；讚賞　(名) 增值；升值
example_sentence: As the students completed the volunteer project, their appreciation for community service grew noticeably.
sentence_zh: 隨著學生完成志願服務項目，他們對社區服務的感謝與讚賞明顯增加。

definition_zh: (形) 感謝的；欣賞的　(形) 領會的；理解的
example_sentence: Seldom have teachers received such appreciative comments from their students about the engaging lessons.
sentence_zh: 老師很少從學生那裡收到對這些引人入勝的課程如此感謝的評論。

definition_zh: (動) 逮捕；抓捕　(動) 理解；領悟
example_sentence: The criminal whom police apprehended yesterday was wanted for theft.
sentence_zh: 警察昨天逮捕的那個罪犯因盜竊罪而被通緝。

definition_zh: (名) 擔憂；害怕　(名) 理解；領悟
example_sentence: Students studied hard to reduce their apprehension about the CSAT entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們努力讀書以減少對學測的擔憂。

definition_zh: (名) 學徒；實習生　(動) 使當學徒；訓練
example_sentence: Starting as an apprentice in a bakery shop, Sarah learned valuable skills from the experienced master baker.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在麵包店當學徒開始，從經驗豐富的師傅那裡學到寶貴的技能。

definition_zh: (動) 接近；靠近　(名) 方法；途徑
example_sentence: The exam is approaching, so students must study harder every day.
sentence_zh: 考試即將到來，所以學生每天必須更努力地讀書。

definition_zh: (形) 容易接近的；親切友善的
example_sentence: Because Ms. Chen is approachable, students feel comfortable asking her questions during class.
sentence_zh: 因為陳老師很容易親近，學生在課堂上很樂意向她提問。

definition_zh: (形) 合適的；恰當的　(動) 挪用；佔用
example_sentence: Choosing appropriate clothes for the job interview, Sarah felt confident walking into the office.
sentence_zh: 莎拉選擇了適合工作面試的衣服，信心滿滿地走進辦公室。

definition_zh: (名) 撥款；撥給　(名) 挪用；不當佔用
example_sentence: The government's appropriation of funds, which was approved by Congress, will support education reform.
sentence_zh: 國會批准的政府撥款將支持教育改革。

definition_zh: (名) 贊成；同意　(名) 批准；認可
example_sentence: If the principal gives approval, the student club can organize the event next month.
sentence_zh: 如果校長給予批准，學生社團就能在下個月舉辦這個活動。

definition_zh: (動) 贊成；同意　(動) 核准；批准
example_sentence: The principal approved our plan to organize a school sports day.
sentence_zh: 校長批准了我們舉辦校運會的計畫。

definition_zh: (動) 接近；估算　(形) 近似的；大約的
example_sentence: Scientists use computer models to approximate the Earth's climate in order to predict future weather patterns.
sentence_zh: 科學家使用電腦模型來估算地球氣候，以便預測未來的天氣模式。

definition_zh: (副) 大約；近似地　大概；左右
example_sentence: The project will cost approximately 500,000 dollars and take roughly six months to complete.
sentence_zh: 該專案將耗費大約50萬美元，並且大概需要6個月才能完成。

definition_zh: (名) 杏；杏子　(形) 杏色的；淡橙色的
example_sentence: Although apricots are sweet and juicy, many students avoid eating them during exam season.
sentence_zh: 雖然杏子甜多汁，但許多學生在考試季節避免食用它們。

definition_zh: (名) 四月
example_sentence: Having arrived in April, the cherry blossoms decorated the entire campus beautifully.
sentence_zh: 四月抵達後，櫻花裝飾了整個校園。

definition_zh: (名) 圍裙；圍兜
example_sentence: The chef wore a white apron that protected his clothes from food stains.
sentence_zh: 廚師穿著一件白色圍裙，用來保護衣服不被食物污漬弄髒。

definition_zh: (形) 恰當的；適合的　(形) 傾向於；易於
example_sentence: Careful planning and quick thinking are apt qualities for solving complex math problems efficiently.
sentence_zh: 仔細規劃和迅速思考是有效解決複雜數學問題的恰當特質。

definition_zh: (名) 天賦；才能　(名) 傾向；素質
example_sentence: If Maria had greater aptitude for mathematics, she would pursue engineering at university.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪麗亞在數學上天賦更強，她就會在大學裡攻讀工程。

definition_zh: (副) 恰當地；恰好地　恰当地表达或形容
example_sentence: The movie title aptly captures the main character's inner struggle throughout the story.
sentence_zh: 這部電影的標題恰當地捕捉了主角貫穿故事的內心掙扎。

definition_zh: (名) 海藍寶石；青綠色　(形) 海藍色的；水藍色的
example_sentence: Sparkling in the sunlight, the aquamarine gemstone caught every student's eye during the museum exhibition.
sentence_zh: 在陽光下閃閃發光的海藍寶石在博物館展覽中吸引了每位學生的目光。

definition_zh: (名) 水族館；魚缸
example_sentence: While we were visiting the aquarium, colorful fish swam gracefully through the large glass tanks.
sentence_zh: 當我們參觀水族館時，五彩繽紛的魚在大玻璃缸中優雅地游動。

definition_zh: (名) 水瓶座；水瓶座的人
example_sentence: Never has Aquarius been more popular among young people than in recent years.
sentence_zh: 水瓶座在年輕人中的人氣從未像近年來那樣高。

definition_zh: (形) 水生的；與水有關的
example_sentence: The swimming competition features aquatic sports that athletes train for throughout the year.
sentence_zh: 游泳比賽包含運動員全年訓練的水生運動項目。

definition_zh: (名) 輸水渠道；水道橋
example_sentence: The Roman engineers built aqueducts to transport fresh water to supply distant cities.
sentence_zh: 羅馬工程師建造輸水渠道來運送淡水供應遠方城市。

definition_zh: (形) 可耕種的；適合農業的
example_sentence: Farmers prefer arable land near rivers for growing crops and vegetables.
sentence_zh: 農民偏好在河邊的可耕種土地上種植穀物和蔬菜。

definition_zh: (副) 任意地；武斷地　隨意地；專斷地
example_sentence: The teacher arbitrarily chose five students to present their projects first.
sentence_zh: 老師任意選擇了五位學生先上台報告他們的專題。

definition_zh: (形) 武斷的；任意的　(形) 專斷的；隨意的
example_sentence: Although the teacher's decision seemed arbitrary, students accepted it without complaint.
sentence_zh: 雖然老師的決定看似武斷，學生還是默默接受了。

definition_zh: (動) 仲裁；調解　(動) 判決；決定
example_sentence: Arbitrating the dispute between the two companies, the lawyer found a fair solution.
sentence_zh: 仲裁兩家公司之間的爭議，律師找到了公平的解決方案。

definition_zh: (名) 弧；弧線　(動) 形成弧形；彎曲
example_sentence: The rainbow, which formed a beautiful arc across the sky, appeared after the heavy rain.
sentence_zh: 那道彩虹在大雨後形成了一個美麗的弧線，橫跨在天空上。

definition_zh: (名) 拱；拱形結構　(動) 弓起；呈拱形　(形) 主要的；狡猾的
example_sentence: If the arch of the bridge breaks, the entire structure will collapse immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果橋的拱形結構破裂，整個結構會立刻倒塌。

definition_zh: (形) 考古的；與考古學有關的
example_sentence: The archaeological dig uncovered ancient pottery and tools from thousands of years ago.
sentence_zh: 這次考古挖掘發現了來自數千年前的古代陶器和工具。

definition_zh: (名) 考古學家；從事考古工作的人
example_sentence: Archaeologists excavate ancient ruins to uncover lost civilizations and understand human history.
sentence_zh: 考古學家挖掘古代遺跡以發現失落的文明並了解人類歷史。

definition_zh: (名) 考古學；古代遺物的研究
example_sentence: Archaeology helps historians uncover ancient civilizations buried thousands of years ago.
sentence_zh: 考古學幫助歷史學家發掘埋藏數千年的古代文明。

definition_zh: (名) 考古學；考古
example_sentence: As archaeologists dig deeper into ancient sites, archaeology reveals secrets that civilizations buried thousands of years ago.
sentence_zh: 當考古學家深入挖掘古代遺址時，考古學揭示了文明在數千年前埋藏的秘密。

definition_zh: (名) 弓箭手；射手　(名) 射手座
example_sentence: Having practiced for months, the archer hit the target perfectly during the competition.
sentence_zh: 經過數月的練習，這位弓箭手在比賽中完美地擊中了靶心。

definition_zh: (名) 建築師；設計者　(動) 設計；規劃
example_sentence: The architect who designed this museum won an international award last year.
sentence_zh: 設計這間博物館的建築師去年贏得國際獎項。

definition_zh: (形) 建築的；建築學的　(形) 結構的；設計的
example_sentence: The architectural design of the new school building impressed both teachers and students.
sentence_zh: 新校舍的建築設計給老師和學生都留下了深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 建築；建築風格　(名) 建築師；設計者
example_sentence: If the architect had considered sustainable materials, the building's architecture would reflect modern environmental values.
sentence_zh: 如果建築師曾考慮永續材料，這棟建築物的建築風格就會反映現代環保價值。

definition_zh: (名) 檔案室；檔案　(動) 將...存檔；歸檔
example_sentence: The school archive stores important documents and historical records carefully.
sentence_zh: 學校檔案室仔細保存重要文件和歷史紀錄。

definition_zh: (名) 建築學；建築風格　(名) 建築師；建築設計
example_sentence: Studying ancient Greek architecture, students discovered the mathematical principles behind those magnificent temples.
sentence_zh: 學生在研究古希臘建築時，發現了那些宏偉廟宇背後的數學原理。

definition_zh: (形) 北極的；寒冷的
example_sentence: As the Arctic wind blew across the frozen lake, penguins huddled together for warmth.
sentence_zh: 當北極寒風吹過結冰的湖面時，企鵝們擠在一起以保暖。

definition_zh: (形) 熱情的；熱烈的　(形) 熱切的；渴望的
example_sentence: Only when the competition began did the team's ardent desire to win become truly apparent.
sentence_zh: 只有當比賽開始時，這支隊伍贏得比賽的熱烈願望才真正顯露出來。

definition_zh: (名) 熱情；熱心　(名) 熱烈的渴望；愛慕
example_sentence: The young activists, whose ardor for social justice inspired many classmates, organized a community volunteer project.
sentence_zh: 那些對社會正義懷抱熱情的年輕活動分子激勵了許多同學，並組織了一個社區志工項目。

definition_zh: (形) 艱難的；費力的　(形) 陡峭的；險峻的
example_sentence: Mountain climbers need strong determination to complete arduous treks up high peaks.
sentence_zh: 登山者需要堅定的決心來完成艱難的高山跋涉。

definition_zh: (名) 地區；區域　(名) 面積；範圍
example_sentence: The mountainous area in central Taiwan attracts many hikers every weekend.
sentence_zh: 臺灣中部的山區每個週末都吸引許多登山者。

definition_zh: (名) 競技場；舞台　(名) 領域；範疇
example_sentence: The Olympic Games take place in a modern arena every four years.
sentence_zh: 奧運會每四年在現代競技場舉行。

definition_zh: (形) 可議論的；有爭議的　(形) 可能的；有根據的
example_sentence: Although the director's decision is arguable, most team members support the new project plan.
sentence_zh: 儘管主任的決定有爭議，大多數團隊成員支持新計畫。

definition_zh: (動) 通過論證說服；駁倒
example_sentence: Arguing down the opponent's weak points, the debate team won the competition convincingly.
sentence_zh: 通過駁倒對手的薄弱論點，辯論隊令人信服地贏得了比賽。

definition_zh: (動) 充分討論以解決；辯論清楚
example_sentence: The two friends argued out their disagreement, which lasted for hours.
sentence_zh: 那兩個朋友充分討論了他們的分歧，這花了好幾個小時。

definition_zh: (動) 爭論；辯論　(動) 主張；論證
example_sentence: If students argue respectfully during class discussions, teachers will encourage more participation.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在課堂討論中能尊重地爭論，老師就會鼓勵更多人參與。

definition_zh: (名) 爭論；辯論　(名) 理由；論點
example_sentence: The two students had a heated argument about climate change policy.
sentence_zh: 這兩名學生關於氣候變遷政策進行了激烈的爭論。

definition_zh: (形) 乾旱的；缺水的　(形) 枯燥的；無趣的
example_sentence: Scientists study arid regions to develop water-saving crops for future farming.
sentence_zh: 科學家研究乾旱地區，是為了開發未來農業用的節水作物。

definition_zh: (動) 由...產生；源於　(動) 來自；從
example_sentence: Many environmental problems arise from industrial pollution and excessive resource consumption.
sentence_zh: 許多環境問題源於工業污染和過度資源消耗。

definition_zh: (動) 出現；產生　發生；起身
example_sentence: As new challenges arise during the exam preparation, students must adapt their study strategies quickly.
sentence_zh: 當考試準備過程中出現新的挑戰時，學生必須迅速調整學習策略。

definition_zh: (名) 算術；四則運算　(形) 算術的；數字的
example_sentence: Having mastered arithmetic operations, the student confidently solved complex problems.
sentence_zh: 掌握了算術運算後，這位學生信心十足地解決了複雜問題。

definition_zh: (片) 臂挽臂地；手臂挽著手臂　(形) 親密的；親切的
example_sentence: The elderly couple walked arm in arm through the park that they visited every weekend.
sentence_zh: 那對老夫婦臂挽臂地走過他們每個週末都會造訪的公園。

definition_zh: (名) 手臂；武器　(動) 配備；武裝
example_sentence: The soldier armed with a rifle stood guard at the entrance.
sentence_zh: 那名士兵拿著步槍，手臂挺直地站在入口處守衛。

definition_zh: (名) 武裝；軍備　(名) 武器；裝備
example_sentence: If military armament were reduced significantly, regional conflicts would become less destructive.
sentence_zh: 如果軍事武裝被大幅削減，區域衝突將變得破壞性較低。

definition_zh: (名) 扶手椅；舒適的椅子
example_sentence: Sitting in the armchair after school, Tom enjoyed reading his favorite book.
sentence_zh: 放學後坐在扶手椅上，湯姆享受著閱讀他最喜歡的書。

definition_zh: (形) 武裝的；帶武器的　(動) 裝備；武裝
example_sentence: Armed with confidence and preparation, the students walked into the exam room feeling ready.
sentence_zh: 帶著信心和充分準備，學生們走進考試室，感到準備就緒。

definition_zh: (名) 盔甲；防具　(名) 裝甲；盔甲
example_sentence: Although the knight wore heavy armor, he moved swiftly across the battlefield.
sentence_zh: 雖然騎士穿著沉重的盔甲，但他在戰場上移動迅速。

definition_zh: (形) 有裝甲的；武裝的　(形) 受保護的；防禦的
example_sentence: Not only armored vehicles but also tanks patrol the military base regularly.
sentence_zh: 不僅裝甲車，坦克也定期在軍事基地巡邏。

definition_zh: (名) 腋窩；腋下
example_sentence: The deodorant that prevents sweat in the armpit is popular among students.
sentence_zh: 能防止腋窩出汗的除臭劑在學生中很受歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 武器；槍砲　(名) 手臂；臂膀
example_sentence: The government passed new laws to control the sale of arms to prevent violence.
sentence_zh: 政府通過新法律來管制武器銷售以防止暴力事件。

definition_zh: (名) 軍隊；陸軍　(名) 大量；眾多
example_sentence: The army officer trained soldiers with discipline and patience.
sentence_zh: 那位軍隊官員以紀律和耐心訓練士兵。

definition_zh: (名) 香氣；芳香　(形) 有香味的；芬芳的
example_sentence: The aroma of fresh coffee in the morning makes everyone feel awake.
sentence_zh: 早晨新鮮咖啡的香氣讓每個人都感到清醒。

definition_zh: (形) 芳香的；有香味的　(形) 香氣四溢的
example_sentence: Because the tea was aromatic, customers enjoyed drinking it every morning.
sentence_zh: 因為這茶很芳香，顧客每天早上都喜歡喝它。

definition_zh: (副) 世界各地；環繞世界　(片) 全球；世界范圍內
example_sentence: Traveling around the world, many students discovered new cultures and perspectives.
sentence_zh: 環遊世界各地，許多學生發現了新的文化和視野。

definition_zh: (介) 在…周圍；圍繞　(副) 大約；周圍
example_sentence: The students who gathered around the teacher listened to every word carefully.
sentence_zh: 聚集在老師周圍的學生仔細聽著每一句話。

definition_zh: (動) 喚起；引發　激怒；惹惱
example_sentence: If the unfair exam policy arouses student protest, the school will reconsider the new rules.
sentence_zh: 如果不公平的考試政策引發學生抗議，學校將重新考慮新規則。

definition_zh: (動) 安排；計劃　(動) 整理；布置
example_sentence: The teacher arranged the classroom desks in a circle for group discussion.
sentence_zh: 老師把教室的課桌椅排成圓形以便進行小組討論。

definition_zh: (名) 安排；整理　(名) 協議；約定
example_sentence: The school made careful arrangements to help students prepare for the exam.
sentence_zh: 學校做了仔細的安排來幫助學生準備考試。

definition_zh: (名) 排列；陣列　(動) 排列；整理
example_sentence: The soldiers stood in a military array, ready for the important ceremony.
sentence_zh: 士兵們排成一個軍事陣列，準備參加重要的典禮。

definition_zh: (動) 逮捕；拘捕　(動) 停止；阻止　(名) 逮捕；拘留
example_sentence: After the suspect was arrested, the police discovered evidence while searching the house.
sentence_zh: 在嫌疑人被逮捕後，警察在搜索房屋時發現了證據。

definition_zh: (名) 到達；抵達　(名) 到達的人或物
example_sentence: Having arrived early, the team prepared thoroughly for the important competition.
sentence_zh: 球隊早到，已為重要比賽做好充分準備。

definition_zh: (動) 抵達；到達　(動) 成功；實現
example_sentence: The train that arrives at noon carries many passengers heading to Taipei.
sentence_zh: 在中午抵達的列車載著許多前往台北的乘客。

definition_zh: (形) 傲慢的；自大的　(形) 驕傲自滿的；目中無人的
example_sentence: The arrogant student refused to listen to his classmates' suggestions during the group project.
sentence_zh: 那個傲慢的學生在小組專案中拒絕聽取同學的建議。

definition_zh: (名) 箭；箭頭　(動) 快速移動；指向
example_sentence: If the archer released the arrow with more force, it would travel much farther.
sentence_zh: 如果弓箭手用更大的力量射出這支箭，它會飛得遠得多。

definition_zh: (名) 軍火庫；武器庫　(名) 大量的資源或工具
example_sentence: The country's military arsenal includes many advanced weapons and defense systems.
sentence_zh: 該國的軍事武器庫包括許多先進的武器和防禦系統。

definition_zh: (名) 縱火；放火罪　(動) 縱火；放火
example_sentence: Having committed arson, the suspect fled the scene immediately.
sentence_zh: 犯了縱火罪後，嫌疑人立即逃離現場。

definition_zh: (名) 縱火犯；放火者
example_sentence: Because the arsonist deliberately set fires in residential areas, the police launched an urgent investigation.
sentence_zh: 因為縱火犯刻意在住宅區放火，警方展開緊急調查。

definition_zh: (名) 藝術；美術　(名) 技藝；手藝
example_sentence: Not only does painting require skill, but so does the study of art history.
sentence_zh: 不僅繪畫需要技藝，對藝術史的研究也是如此。

definition_zh: (名) 動脈；幹線
example_sentence: The main artery that supplies blood to the brain requires careful surgical attention.
sentence_zh: 供應血液到大腦的主動脈需要謹慎的手術處理。

definition_zh: (形) 狡猾的；巧妙的　(形) 聰明靈巧的；有技巧的
example_sentence: The magician used artful tricks to deceive the audience and create wonder.
sentence_zh: 魔術師使用巧妙的技巧來欺騙觀眾並製造奇蹟。

definition_zh: (名) 文章；論文　(名) 條款；條文　(名) 物品；東西
example_sentence: Reading newspaper articles about current events helps students prepare for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 閱讀關於時事的報紙文章有助於學生準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (動) 清楚表達；明確說出　(形) 表達清晰的；清楚明白的
example_sentence: The student articulated her ideas clearly during the class presentation.
sentence_zh: 這名學生在課堂報告中清楚地表達了她的想法。

definition_zh: (名) 人造物品；手工製品　(名) 考古遺物；古器物
example_sentence: Although the pottery artifact was buried for centuries, archaeologists carefully cleaned it to reveal beautiful patterns.
sentence_zh: 雖然那個陶製手工製品被埋了幾個世紀，考古學家仍然小心翼翼地清潔它來展露美麗的圖案。

definition_zh: (形) 人造的；人工的　(形) 不自然的；虛假的
example_sentence: Artificial flowers decorating the school hall require no watering or maintenance.
sentence_zh: 裝飾學校禮堂的人造花不需要澆水或維護。

definition_zh: (副) 人工地；人為地　(副) 虛假地；做作地
example_sentence: The flavors in this drink, which are artificially created, taste nothing like real fruit.
sentence_zh: 這飲料中的味道是人工製造的，嘗起來一點都不像真正的水果。

definition_zh: (名) 砲兵；火砲
example_sentence: If the military deploys artillery to the border, regional tensions would increase significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果軍隊在邊境部署砲兵，地區緊張局勢將會大幅升高。

definition_zh: (名) 工匠；手工藝人　(形) 手工的；工匠製作的
example_sentence: The local artisan crafted beautiful wooden furniture using traditional methods.
sentence_zh: 當地工匠用傳統方法製作出精美的木製家具。

definition_zh: (名) 藝術家；畫家　(名) 藝人；表演者
example_sentence: Many young people study art to become a successful artist in the future.
sentence_zh: 許多年輕人學習藝術是為了將來成為成功的藝術家。

definition_zh: (形) 藝術的；富有藝術性的　(形) 有美感的；精緻的
example_sentence: The artistic design of the museum's entrance attracts thousands of visitors every year.
sentence_zh: 博物館入口的藝術設計每年吸引數千名訪客。

definition_zh: (名) 藝術性；藝術手法　(名) 精湛的技藝；創意才能
example_sentence: Although the painting lacked perfect technique, its artistry shone brilliantly throughout the composition.
sentence_zh: 雖然這幅畫的技法不完美，但其藝術性在整個構圖中閃閃發光。

definition_zh: (形) 藝術氣質的；富有藝術感的　(形) 喜愛藝術的；崇尚藝術的
example_sentence: Having studied painting for years, Maria became increasingly artsy, decorating her room with handmade sketches and vintage posters.
sentence_zh: 經過多年繪畫學習後，瑪莉亞變得越來越富有藝術感，用手繪素描和復古海報裝飾房間。

definition_zh: (名) 藝術作品；美術作品
example_sentence: The museum displayed ancient artwork that attracted thousands of visitors.
sentence_zh: 這個博物館展出了吸引數千名遊客的古代藝術作品。

definition_zh: (片) 實際上；其實
example_sentence: As a matter of fact, studying vocabulary every day helps students pass the exam more easily.
sentence_zh: 實際上，每天學習詞彙能幫助學生更容易通過考試。

definition_zh: (介) 因此；所以　(副) 結果；最後
example_sentence: If students didn't study regularly, poor exam performance would result as a consequence.
sentence_zh: 如果學生沒有定期複習，考試成績不佳就會隨之而來。

definition_zh: (片) 總體上；整體而言
example_sentence: The school's test scores improved as a whole this year.
sentence_zh: 整體而言，學校今年的考試成績有所提高。

definition_zh: (副) 像往常一樣；一如既往
example_sentence: Being extremely focused on studying, Sarah completed her homework as always before dinner.
sentence_zh: 莎拉像往常一樣專注於讀書，在晚餐前完成了功課。

definition_zh: (副) 盡可能地；盡量
example_sentence: Please finish your homework as soon as possible before dinner.
sentence_zh: 請在晚餐前盡快完成你的功課。

definition_zh: (片) 就...而言；在...方面
example_sentence: Seldom as far as technology goes has progress been so rapid in Taiwan's semiconductor industry.
sentence_zh: 就科技而言，台灣半導體產業的進展很少像現在一樣快速。

word: as far as the eye can see
definition_zh: (片) 目光所及之處；盡眼所見
example_sentence: The endless desert stretches across the landscape, golden sand visible as far as the eye can see.
sentence_zh: 無垠的沙漠綿延景觀，金黃色的沙粒盡眼所見。

definition_zh: (介) 就...而言；到...的程度
example_sentence: As far as I can tell, the exam schedule is not finalized yet.
sentence_zh: 就我所知，考試時間表還沒有最終確定。

definition_zh: (連) 至於；就…而言；談到
example_sentence: As for the math homework, most students found the last three problems quite challenging.
sentence_zh: 至於數學作業，大多數學生覺得最後三題相當有挑戰性。

definition_zh: (片) 根據傳說；民間傳說說法是
example_sentence: As legend has it, the old temple was built by a magical monk centuries ago.
sentence_zh: 根據傳說，這座古老的寺廟是幾百年前由一位神奇的和尚建造的。

definition_zh: (連) 只要；倘若　(副) 在…期間內；只要
example_sentence: As long as students submit their homework on time, they will receive full marks.
sentence_zh: 只要學生按時提交作業，他們就會獲得滿分。

definition_zh: (連) 一...就...; 儘快地
example_sentence: Finishing the homework, Sarah submitted it to her teacher as soon as possible.
sentence_zh: 莎拉一完成作業，就立刻提交給老師。

definition_zh: (片) 如預期；正如所料
example_sentence: The exam was difficult, as suspected, so many students found it challenging.
sentence_zh: 如預期一般，考試很難，所以許多學生覺得很有挑戰性。

definition_zh: (副) 像往常一樣；照例
example_sentence: If Mark arrives late as usual, the meeting will start without him.
sentence_zh: 如果馬克像往常一樣遲到，會議將不等他就開始。

definition_zh: (連) 當...時；如同　(介) 作為；以...身份　(副) 同樣地；一樣
example_sentence: As the sun rose over the mountains, students began their morning classes.
sentence_zh: 當太陽升起越過山丘時，學生們開始上早晨的課。

definition_zh: (動) 上升；攀登　(動) 晉升；提高
example_sentence: Mountain climbers train hard to ascend the highest peaks safely.
sentence_zh: 登山者努力訓練以安全地攀登最高的山峰。

definition_zh: (形) 上升的；遞增的　(動) 上升；攀登
example_sentence: The ascending order of test scores helped teachers identify students needing extra support.
sentence_zh: 測驗成績的遞增順序幫助老師辨識需要額外協助的學生。

definition_zh: (動) 確定；查明　(動) 確認；弄清楚
example_sentence: After the doctor examined the patient carefully, she ascertained that the illness was not serious.
sentence_zh: 醫生仔細檢查病人後，她確定那個病不嚴重。

definition_zh: (動) 歸因於；把…歸功於
example_sentence: Having ascribed the painting's success to careful brushwork, critics praised the artist's dedication.
sentence_zh: 把這幅畫的成功歸功於精細的筆法後，評論家稱讚了藝術家的奉獻精神。

definition_zh: (名) 灰燼；灰　(名) 骨灰　(形) 灰色的；蒼白的
example_sentence: The volcano left ash that covered the entire city, which took months to clean.
sentence_zh: 那座火山留下的灰燼覆蓋了整個城市，花了好幾個月才清理乾淨。

definition_zh: (形) 羞愧的；感到慚愧的　(形) 尷尬的；害臊的
example_sentence: Feeling ashamed of his poor grades, the student decided to study harder for the next exam.
sentence_zh: 因為對自己不良的成績感到羞愧，這位學生決定為下次考試更努力讀書。

definition_zh: (副) 靠岸；登陸　(形) 在岸上的；陸上的
example_sentence: If the ship had run into a storm, the sailors would have swum ashore to safety.
sentence_zh: 如果那艘船遇到了風暴，船員們就會游到岸上尋求安全。

definition_zh: (名) 亞洲；亞洲大陸
example_sentence: Asia is the world's largest and most populous continent.
sentence_zh: 亞洲是世界上最大且人口最多的大陸。

definition_zh: (形) 亞洲的；亞洲人的　(名) 亞洲人
example_sentence: Featuring traditional Asian cuisines, the new restaurant attracts many food lovers.
sentence_zh: 這家新餐廳以傳統亞洲菜餚為特色，吸引許多美食愛好者。

definition_zh: (介) 除了...之外；不計
example_sentence: Aside from studying for the CSAT, many students also work part-time jobs.
sentence_zh: 除了準備學測外，許多學生也打工兼職。

definition_zh: (副) 在旁邊；另外　(介) 除了...之外　(名) 旁白；題外話
example_sentence: Aside from studying, hardly does any student ignore the importance of physical health.
sentence_zh: 除了讀書之外，幾乎沒有學生會忽視身體健康的重要性。

definition_zh: (動) 詢問…的近況；關切　(動) 詢問…的健康狀況
example_sentence: Maria asked after her grandmother who had been ill for weeks.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞詢問了生病數週的祖母的近況。

definition_zh: (動) 四處詢問；到處打聽
example_sentence: Maria asked around to find the best coffee shop near her school.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞到處打聽以找到學校附近最好的咖啡館。

definition_zh: (動) 要求；請求　詢問；問
example_sentence: Asking for help from teachers when confused is a smart study habit.
sentence_zh: 當困惑時向老師請求幫助是一個聰明的讀書習慣。

definition_zh: (動) 邀請進入；請進來
example_sentence: The receptionist asked in the next visitor waiting outside the office.
sentence_zh: 接待員邀請在辦公室外等候的下一位訪客進來。

definition_zh: (動) 邀請約會；約某人出去
example_sentence: Before asking out Sarah, Marcus practiced what he would say for days.
sentence_zh: 在邀請莎拉約會之前，馬克斯練習了好幾天要說什麼。

definition_zh: (動) 邀請來家裡；邀約過來
example_sentence: Inviting friends over for dinner, Sarah prepared delicious homemade pasta and fresh salad.
sentence_zh: 邀請朋友來家裡吃飯，莎拉準備了美味的自製義大利麵和新鮮沙拉。

definition_zh: (動) 詢問；問　(動) 要求；請求
example_sentence: The teacher asked the student who forgot the homework to submit it tomorrow.
sentence_zh: 老師要求忘記做功課的學生明天提交。

definition_zh: (形) 睡著的；入睡的　(副) 熟睡地
example_sentence: If the baby falls asleep during the car ride, the parents will drive home quietly.
sentence_zh: 如果嬰兒在車程中入睡，父母就會安靜地開車回家。

definition_zh: (名) 方面；層面　(名) 外觀；樣子
example_sentence: Learning a language involves many aspects, including listening and speaking skills.
sentence_zh: 學習語言涉及許多方面，包括聽力和口語技能。

definition_zh: (名) 抱負；志向　(名) 渴望；願望
example_sentence: Many students work hard every day to achieve their career aspirations.
sentence_zh: 許多學生每天努力用功以實現他們的職業抱負。

definition_zh: (動) 渴望；追求　(動) 有志於；立志
example_sentence: Many students aspire to become doctors and contribute to society through medicine.
sentence_zh: 許多學生渴望成為醫生，並通過醫學對社會做出貢獻。

definition_zh: (名) 阿斯匹靈；常用的止痛退燒藥
example_sentence: Before the exam, take an aspirin if your head aches too much.
sentence_zh: 在考試前，如果頭痛太厲害，就吃一片阿斯匹靈。

definition_zh: (形) 有抱負的；渴望成功的　(動) 渴望；有志於
example_sentence: Having worked part-time for three years, the aspiring nurse finally enrolled in medical school.
sentence_zh: 在兼職工作三年後，這位有志成為護士的學生終於進入了醫學院。

definition_zh: (名) 驢；笨蛋　(名) 臀部；屁股
example_sentence: The student who failed the exam felt like an ass for not studying the material.
sentence_zh: 那位沒讀書而考試不及格的學生覺得自己像個笨蛋。

definition_zh: (動) 猛烈攻擊；嚴厲批評
example_sentence: Negative comments assailed the actor's reputation, forcing him to issue a public statement.
sentence_zh: 負面評論猛烈攻擊該演員的聲譽，迫使他發表公開聲明。

definition_zh: (動) 暗殺；刺殺　謀殺
example_sentence: If a leader were assassinated, the entire nation would face serious political crisis and instability.
sentence_zh: 如果一位領導人被暗殺，整個國家將面臨嚴重的政治危機和不穩定。

definition_zh: (名) 攻擊；襲擊　(動) 攻擊；襲擊
example_sentence: The police arrested the man for assaulting a passenger on the train.
sentence_zh: 警方逮捕了那名在火車上襲擊乘客的男子。

definition_zh: (動) 組裝；集合　(動) 聚集；聚合
example_sentence: Assembling the furniture carefully, the team completed the task ahead of schedule.
sentence_zh: 認真地組裝傢俱，團隊提前完成了任務。

definition_zh: (名) 生產線；裝配線
example_sentence: As products move along the assembly line, workers add different parts until the final product is complete.
sentence_zh: 當產品沿著生產線移動時，工人會添加不同的零件，直到最終產品完成。

definition_zh: (名) 集會；大會　(動) 組裝；聚集
example_sentence: Only after the morning assembly does the principal announce important school news.
sentence_zh: 只有在早會之後，校長才宣布重要的學校新聞。

definition_zh: (動) 主張；聲稱　(動) 堅持；維護
example_sentence: The student asserted that hard work, which is essential to success, cannot be ignored.
sentence_zh: 這名學生主張說勤奮工作（這是成功必不可少的）不能被忽視。

definition_zh: (名) 聲稱；主張　(動) 堅定主張；申明
example_sentence: The lawyer made a strong assertion to prove his client's innocence.
sentence_zh: 律師提出有力的聲稱來證明他的委託人無罪。

definition_zh: (形) 堅定自信的；自信果斷的
example_sentence: An assertive student speaking up in class discussion earns respect from teachers and classmates alike.
sentence_zh: 一個在課堂討論中堅定發言的學生會獲得老師和同學的尊重。

definition_zh: (名) 果斷；自信地表達意見　(名) 主張自己權利的能力
example_sentence: Assertiveness helps students speak up confidently during class discussions.
sentence_zh: 果斷有助於學生在課堂討論中自信地發表意見。

definition_zh: (動) 評估；評價　(動) 估計；判斷
example_sentence: Before deciding on a university major, students should assess their interests as they consider their future careers.
sentence_zh: 在決定大學主修之前，學生應該評估自己的興趣，因為他們考慮未來的職業。

definition_zh: (名) 評估；評量　(名) 評量結果；成績
example_sentence: Submitting the final project on time, students completing the assessment demonstrated strong time management and responsibility.
sentence_zh: 按時提交期末專題報告，完成評量的學生展現了良好的時間管理和責任感。

definition_zh: (名) 資產；有利條件　(名) 優勢；長處
example_sentence: The language skills that Maria possesses are valuable assets which will help her succeed in international business.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞所具備的語言技能是寶貴的資產，這些資產將幫助她在國際商務中成功。

definition_zh: (形) 勤奮的；執著的　(形) 認真的；不懈的
example_sentence: If students are assiduous in their studies, they will achieve excellent results on the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在學習中勤奮不懈，他們就會在學測中取得優異成績。

definition_zh: (動) 分配；指派　(動) 布置（作業）；交代
example_sentence: The teacher assigned each student a different research project to complete.
sentence_zh: 老師給每位學生分配了不同的研究專題要完成。

definition_zh: (名) 作業；功課　(名) 任務；指派
example_sentence: Students need to complete the assignment to improve their writing skills.
sentence_zh: 學生需要完成作業以提高他們的寫作能力。

definition_zh: (動) 吸收；同化　(動) 融入；適應
example_sentence: International students assimilate into campus life by joining clubs and making local friends.
sentence_zh: 國際學生透過參加社團和交當地朋友來融入校園生活。

definition_zh: (動) 幫助；協助　(名) 助手；輔助
example_sentence: As the project manager assists with planning, the team can focus on execution more effectively.
sentence_zh: 當專案經理協助規劃時，團隊可以更有效地專注於執行工作。

definition_zh: (名) 幫助；協助　(名) 援助；救濟
example_sentence: Having received financial assistance from the government, the startup company expanded its operations successfully.
sentence_zh: 獲得政府財務援助後，這家新創公司成功擴展了營運。

definition_zh: (名) 助手；助理　(形) 輔助的；幫助的
example_sentence: The assistant who helped organize the school event impressed everyone with dedication.
sentence_zh: 幫助籌劃校園活動的助理用她的投入精神給所有人留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (動) 聯想；將...連結在一起　(名) 同事；夥伴
example_sentence: Many people associate the color red with love and passion in relationships.
sentence_zh: 許多人將紅色與愛情和熱情聯想在一起。

definition_zh: (形) 相關的；有關聯的　(動) 聯想；關聯
example_sentence: If smoking were not associated with serious health risks, fewer people would avoid the habit.
sentence_zh: 如果吸菸不與嚴重的健康風險有關，較少人會避免這個習慣。

definition_zh: (名) 協會；聯誼會　(名) 聯想；關聯
example_sentence: Joining a sports association helps students develop teamwork and make new friends.
sentence_zh: 加入運動協會幫助學生培養團隊合作能力並交新朋友。

definition_zh: (動) 分類；整理　(動) 搭配；配合
example_sentence: Assorted by color and size, the books were neatly arranged on the library shelf.
sentence_zh: 按顏色和尺寸分類後，這些書整齊地排列在圖書館的架子上。

definition_zh: (形) 各種各樣的；混合的　(形) 分類的；配套的
example_sentence: Although the gift box contained assorted chocolates, every flavor tasted equally delicious.
sentence_zh: 雖然禮盒裡裝著各種各樣的巧克力，但每種口味都一樣好吃。

definition_zh: (名) 混合物；各種各樣　(名) 分類；配搭
example_sentence: Seldom does a convenience store offer such a wide assortment of international snacks.
sentence_zh: 便利商店很少提供如此多樣的國際零食組合。

definition_zh: (動) 假設；假定　(動) 承擔；擔任
example_sentence: The marketing strategy that the team assumes will succeed requires careful planning.
sentence_zh: 團隊假定會成功的行銷策略需要仔細規劃。

definition_zh: (動) 假設；假如　(連) 假如；倘若
example_sentence: Assuming the exam starts at nine, students should arrive by eight-thirty.
sentence_zh: 假如考試九點開始，學生應該八點半前到達。

definition_zh: (名) 假設；假定　(名) 假想；認定
example_sentence: Making assumptions without evidence often leads to misunderstandings between people.
sentence_zh: 在沒有證據的情況下做出假設，往往會導致人與人之間的誤解。

definition_zh: (名) 保證；確保　(名) 自信；確信
example_sentence: The company's assurance of product quality gave customers complete peace of mind.
sentence_zh: 該公司對產品品質的保證讓顧客完全放心。

definition_zh: (動) 保證；確保　(動) 使確信；讓放心
example_sentence: Although the teacher assured students that the exam would be fair, many still felt nervous about the results.
sentence_zh: 雖然老師向學生保證考試會公平，但許多學生仍對成績感到緊張。

definition_zh: (形) 確定的；有把握的　(動) 使確信；保證
example_sentence: Feeling assured about the exam results, students celebrated their hard work with confidence.
sentence_zh: 對考試成績感到有把握，學生們自信地慶祝他們的努力。

definition_zh: (副) 確定地；無疑地　(副) 肯定地；當然地
example_sentence: The doctor assured us that the patient, who would assuredly recover, needed only rest and time.
sentence_zh: 醫生向我們保證，那位患者肯定會康復，只需要休息和時間。

definition_zh: (名) 氣喘；哮喘
example_sentence: If regular exercise becomes part of daily routine, asthma symptoms will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果規律運動成為日常習慣，氣喘症狀將會明顯改善。

definition_zh: (動) 使驚訝；使震驚　(動) 使吃驚；讓人感到意外
example_sentence: The magician's incredible tricks astonish the audience every single time.
sentence_zh: 魔術師的不可思議魔法每次都讓觀眾感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (形) 驚訝的；吃驚的　(動) 使驚訝；使吃驚
example_sentence: The students were astonished to discover the exam results were posted early online.
sentence_zh: 學生們驚訝地發現考試成績提早在網上公布了。

definition_zh: (形) 令人驚訝的；驚人的　令人吃驚的；出人意料的
example_sentence: The astonishing speed of the new technology amazed scientists and engineers worldwide.
sentence_zh: 這項新科技令人驚訝的速度令全球科學家和工程師感到驚嘆。

definition_zh: (動) 使驚訝；使震驚　(動) 使大吃一驚；使目瞪口呆
example_sentence: When the exam results were announced, the teacher's comments astounded the entire class, leaving everyone speechless and shocked.
sentence_zh: 當考試成績公布時，老師的評論使整個班級都感到震驚，讓每個人都目瞪口呆。

definition_zh: (動) 誤入歧途；走偏　(形) 偏離正道的；迷失的
example_sentence: Having gone astray in the mountains, the hikers finally found their way back to the village.
sentence_zh: 登山者在山中迷路後，終於找到回村莊的路。

definition_zh: (名) 太空人；宇航員
example_sentence: The astronaut who landed on the moon became a hero admired by millions worldwide.
sentence_zh: 登陸月球的太空人成為受到全世界數百萬人欽佩的英雄。

definition_zh: (名) 天文學家；天文學者
example_sentence: The astronomer discovered a new planet using the telescope.
sentence_zh: 這位天文學家用望遠鏡發現了一顆新行星。

definition_zh: (形) 天文的；極其巨大的　(形) 極高的；天文數字的
example_sentence: If university tuition fees were not astronomical, more students would apply to top schools.
sentence_zh: 如果大學學費不是天文數字，更多學生會申請頂尖大學。

definition_zh: (名) 天文學；星象學
example_sentence: Astronomy helps us understand the universe and distant stars.
sentence_zh: 天文學幫助我們了解宇宙和遠方的星星。

definition_zh: (形) 敏銳的；精明的　(形) 聰慧的；狡猾的
example_sentence: Recognizing the market trend early, the astute investor made a profitable decision.
sentence_zh: 早早察覺到市場趨勢，那位精明的投資者做出了獲利的決定。

definition_zh: (名) 庇護；避難所　(名) 精神病院；收容所
example_sentence: Because the country was at war, thousands of refugees sought asylum in neighboring nations.
sentence_zh: 因為該國正在交戰，數千名難民在相鄰國家尋求庇護。

definition_zh: (連) 在…的時候；當…時　(介) 在…時期
example_sentence: Only at a time when the economy was strong did many companies invest in new technology.
sentence_zh: 只有在經濟強勁的時期，許多公司才會投資新技術。

definition_zh: (介片) 一次；逐一　(副) 每次；單獨地
example_sentence: The teacher checked one student's homework at a time so that feedback was thorough.
sentence_zh: 老師一次檢查一位學生的功課，這樣反饋才能詳盡。

definition_zh: (片) 放鬆；自在
example_sentence: Taking deep breaths helps students relax to feel at ease during exams.
sentence_zh: 深呼吸幫助學生放鬆以便在考試中感到自在。

definition_zh: (片) 乍看之下；初次印象
example_sentence: At first sight, the job looked easy, but it required much patience and skill.
sentence_zh: 乍看之下，這份工作看起來很簡單，但它需要很多耐心和技能。

definition_zh: (副) 起初；最初　(副) 一開始；剛開始
example_sentence: At first, the math problem seemed difficult, but practice made it easy.
sentence_zh: 起初，這道數學題看起來很難，但練習使它變得容易。

definition_zh: (片) 在手邊；即將發生；可得到的
example_sentence: With the college entrance exam at hand, many students study late into the night every day.
sentence_zh: 大學入學考試即將到來，許多學生每天都熬夜讀書。

definition_zh: (副) 最後；終於　(介片) 終於；最後
example_sentence: Having studied for three months, students finally passed the difficult exam at last.
sentence_zh: 經過三個月的學習，學生們終於通過了這場困難的考試。

definition_zh: (副) 立刻；馬上　(副) 同時；一起
example_sentence: The fire alarm that rang at once alarmed all students studying in the library.
sentence_zh: 立刻響起的火警警報嚇到了在圖書館唸書的所有學生。

definition_zh: (介) 在…歲時；在…年紀時
example_sentence: If students graduate at the age of eighteen, many will pursue university education or vocational training.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在十八歲時畢業，許多人將追求大學教育或職業訓練。

definition_zh: (介) 在...開始時；最初　(副) 起初；一開始
example_sentence: At the beginning of high school, many students feel nervous and excited about their new classes.
sentence_zh: 高中開始時，許多學生對新課程感到緊張和興奮。

definition_zh: (副) 同時；一邊一邊　(連) 然而；但是
example_sentence: Studying chemistry and reviewing history at the same time helps students prepare thoroughly for exams.
sentence_zh: 同時念化學和複習歷史有助於學生為考試做充分準備。

definition_zh: (介片) 那時；當時　(連) 在…時候
example_sentence: At the time, many students didn't understand the importance of preparing for the CSAT exam carefully.
sentence_zh: 那時，許多學生不明白認真準備學測考試的重要性。

word: at the top of one’s lungs
definition_zh: (片) 用最大音量；放聲大喊
example_sentence: The fans cheered at the top of their lungs when the home team scored the winning goal.
sentence_zh: 當主隊進球得分時，球迷們放聲大喊歡呼。

definition_zh: (片) 隨意地；任意地　(片) 自由地；想怎樣就怎樣
example_sentence: Students cannot leave the classroom at will without the teacher's permission.
sentence_zh: 學生未經老師允許，不能隨意離開教室。

definition_zh: (形) 放鬆的；自在的　(片) 舒適地；輕鬆地
example_sentence: After finishing the difficult exam, students felt at ease and chatted happily in the hallway.
sentence_zh: 完成困難的考試後，學生們感到放鬆自在，在走廊裡開心地聊天。

definition_zh: (名) 運動員；選手
example_sentence: If a young athlete trained harder every day, winning an Olympic medal would become much more possible.
sentence_zh: 如果年輕運動員每天練習更努力，贏得奧運獎牌就會變得更有可能。

definition_zh: (形) 運動的；體育的　(形) 強健的；擅長運動的
example_sentence: The athletic team trained hard for the national competition.
sentence_zh: 那支運動隊為全國比賽刻苦訓練。

definition_zh: (名) 田徑運動；競技運動　(名) 運動員的素質；體育能力
example_sentence: Competing in athletics, many students develop discipline and teamwork skills.
sentence_zh: 參加田徑運動的許多學生養成了紀律和團隊合作的能力。

definition_zh: (副) 至少；起碼
example_sentence: At least you finished the homework, even though the quality could improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 至少你完成了功課，儘管品質還有很大進步空間。

definition_zh: (名) 自動提款機；ATM
example_sentence: Only after withdrawing cash from the ATM did Sarah realize her card balance was low.
sentence_zh: 直到從自動提款機提出現金後，莎拉才意識到她的卡片餘額不足。

definition_zh: (名) 大氣；氛圍　(名) 氣氛；環境
example_sentence: The festival atmosphere, which attracted thousands of visitors, created unforgettable memories for everyone.
sentence_zh: 那個節慶氛圍吸引了數千名遊客，為每個人創造了難忘的回憶。

definition_zh: (名) 原子；微粒
example_sentence: Scientists study atoms to understand how matter behaves and changes.
sentence_zh: 科學家研究原子以了解物質如何表現和變化。

definition_zh: (形) 原子的；極小的　(形) 核能的；原子能的
example_sentence: The development of atomic energy has changed modern science and industry forever.
sentence_zh: 原子能的發展永遠改變了現代科學與工業。

definition_zh: (介) 在…頂部；在…上面　(副) 在頂部；在上面
example_sentence: A golden statue stood atop the tall mountain, visible from miles away.
sentence_zh: 一座金色雕像矗立在高山頂部，從遠處都能看見。

definition_zh: (名) 中庭；天井　(名) 心房
example_sentence: As sunlight flooded through the glass roof, the shopping mall's atrium became the perfect gathering spot.
sentence_zh: 當陽光從玻璃天花板灑下時，購物中心的中庭成了完美的聚集地點。

definition_zh: (形) 極其惡劣的；駭人聽聞的　(形) 非常糟糕的；令人厭惡的
example_sentence: Having committed atrocious crimes, the criminal faced a life sentence in prison.
sentence_zh: 因為犯下駭人聽聞的罪行，那名罪犯面臨終身監禁的判決。

definition_zh: (名) 暴行；殘暴行為　(名) 令人厭惡的事物
example_sentence: The war crimes that shocked the world were atrocities which violated basic human rights.
sentence_zh: 震驚世界的戰爭罪行是違反基本人權的暴行。

definition_zh: (感嘆詞) 好的；好極了　(名) 鼓勵；讚許
example_sentence: If you study hard for the CSAT, you'll get an atta from your teachers and parents.
sentence_zh: 如果你為學測努力讀書，老師和父母會給你鼓勵和讚許。

definition_zh: (動) 附加；連接　(動) 依附；喜愛
example_sentence: Please attach your resume to the email before sending it.
sentence_zh: 寄送前，請把履歷表附加到電子郵件中。

definition_zh: (形) 附著的；貼著的　(動) 附著；連接
example_sentence: Students need to attach their ID cards to entrance forms to enter the exam hall.
sentence_zh: 學生需要把身分證附在報名表上才能進入考場。

definition_zh: (名) 附件；依戀　(動) 重視；喜愛
example_sentence: Students sending college applications often include document attachments with their personal statements.
sentence_zh: 學生寄送大學申請時，經常附上個人自述的文件附件。

definition_zh: (動) 攻擊；襲擊　(名) 攻擊；發作
example_sentence: When the enemy attacked the city, all residents fled to safety.
sentence_zh: 當敵人攻擊城市時，所有居民都逃到安全的地方。

definition_zh: (動) 達到；獲得　(動) 實現；完成
example_sentence: Having attained high scores on the mock exam, the students felt confident about the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 在模擬考中達到高分後，學生對學測充滿信心。

definition_zh: (名) 成就；達成　獲得；成績
example_sentence: Educational attainment, which determines future career opportunities, requires consistent effort throughout high school.
sentence_zh: 教育成就決定了未來的職業機會，它需要整個高中時期的持續努力。

definition_zh: (動) 嘗試；試圖　(名) 嘗試；企圖
example_sentence: Making an attempt to finish homework before midnight requires focus and determination.
sentence_zh: 在午夜前完成作業的嘗試需要專注力和決心。

definition_zh: (動) 嘗試；企圖　(形) 被嘗試的；未遂的
example_sentence: If the student had attempted the difficult math problem, she would have scored higher on the exam.
sentence_zh: 如果那位學生曾經嘗試過那道困難的數學題，她在考試中會得到更高的分數。

definition_zh: (動) 參加；出席　(動) 照顧；服侍
example_sentence: All students must attend the morning assembly every Monday.
sentence_zh: 所有學生每星期一都必須參加早會。

definition_zh: (名) 出席；出勤　(名) 出席人數；到場人數
example_sentence: Having perfect attendance throughout the semester, Maria earned a special certificate from the school.
sentence_zh: 整個學期出勤完美無缺，瑪麗亞獲得學校頒發的特殊證書。

definition_zh: (名) 服務員；隨從　(形) 伴隨的；相關的
example_sentence: As the flight attendant walked through the cabin, passengers raised their hands to request assistance.
sentence_zh: 當空服員走過客艙時，乘客舉手要求協助。

definition_zh: (名) 參加者；出席者
example_sentence: Seldom do conference attendees leave without making valuable business connections.
sentence_zh: 很少有會議參加者不結交寶貴的商業人脈就離開。

definition_zh: (名) 注意；關注　(動) 留意；注視
example_sentence: The teacher appreciated students whose attention never wavered during the difficult lecture.
sentence_zh: 老師欣賞那些在困難的講課中注意力始終不動搖的學生。

definition_zh: (形) 專注的；細心的　(形) 留意的；留神的
example_sentence: The nurse stayed attentive to monitor every patient's vital signs carefully.
sentence_zh: 這位護士保持專注以便仔細監測每位病人的生命徵象。

definition_zh: (副) 專心地；仔細地　注意力集中地
example_sentence: Listening attentively to the teacher's explanation helps students understand the difficult grammar concepts.
sentence_zh: 專心聽老師的解說有助於學生理解困難的文法概念。

definition_zh: (名) 注意力；專心；留心
example_sentence: The teacher's attentiveness to student questions helped everyone learn better.
sentence_zh: 老師對學生提問的注意力幫助大家學得更好。

definition_zh: (動) 證明；証實　(動) 作証；出庭作証
example_sentence: The witness's detailed testimony attested that the defendant was present at the scene when the crime occurred.
sentence_zh: 因為證人的詳細證詞証實了被告在犯罪發生時在現場，所以法院相信了這個説法。

definition_zh: (名) 閣樓；頂樓　(形) 古代雅典的；雅典風格的
example_sentence: Storing old furniture in the attic, the family discovered many forgotten memories.
sentence_zh: 把舊傢俱存放在閣樓裡，這個家庭發現了許多被遺忘的回憶。

definition_zh: (名) 服裝；衣著　(動) 穿著；打扮
example_sentence: The students whose attire met the dress code requirements were allowed to enter the formal ceremony.
sentence_zh: 衣著符合著裝規則的學生被允許進入正式典禮。

definition_zh: (名) 態度；姿態　(名) 看法；想法
example_sentence: If students adopt a positive attitude toward studying, their exam scores will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生對於讀書採取積極的態度，他們的考試成績將會大幅進步。

definition_zh: (名) 律師；檢察官
example_sentence: The attorney argued the case before the high court yesterday.
sentence_zh: 那位律師昨天在高等法院為這個案件進行辯論。

definition_zh: (動) 吸引；引起　(動) 招引；使喜歡
example_sentence: The new shopping mall uses colorful decorations to attract more customers every weekend.
sentence_zh: 這間新購物中心利用彩色裝飾來吸引更多顧客每個週末。

definition_zh: (名) 吸引力；引力　(名) 吸引人的事物；景點
example_sentence: The theme park's main attraction is the roller coaster that thrills thousands of visitors daily.
sentence_zh: 主題樂園的主要景點是每天吸引數千遊客的雲霄飛車。

definition_zh: (形) 吸引人的；迷人的　(形) 有吸引力的；漂亮的
example_sentence: Although the job offer seemed attractive, many graduates rejected it because the salary was too low.
sentence_zh: 雖然這份工作機會很吸引人，但許多畢業生因為薪水太低而拒絕了。

definition_zh: (動) 歸因於；將...歸咎於
example_sentence: Having attributed the project's failure to poor planning, the team leader proposed better strategies.
sentence_zh: 將項目失敗歸咎於計劃不周後，團隊領導提出了更好的策略。

definition_zh: (名) ['ætrəˌbjut] 特徵；屬性　(動) [ə'trɪbˌjut] 把...歸因於；認為...是由於
example_sentence: The success that the company achieved was attributed to the teamwork of employees who worked hard.
sentence_zh: 公司取得的成功歸因於辛勤工作的員工們的團隊合作。

definition_zh: (形) 修飾名詞的；定語的　(名) 定語；修飾詞
example_sentence: In the phrase 'a red car,' the word 'red' functions as an attributive adjective modifying the noun 'car.'
sentence_zh: 在片語「一輛紅色汽車」中，單詞「紅色」作為定語形容詞修飾名詞「汽車」。

definition_zh: (名) 磨損；消耗　(名) 人員流失；人員損耗
example_sentence: If the company did not address employee attrition, losing experienced workers would seriously damage long-term competitiveness.
sentence_zh: 如果公司不解決員工流失問題，失去經驗豐富的員工將會嚴重損害長期競爭力。

definition_zh: (動) 拍賣；競拍出售
example_sentence: The art museum will auction off rare paintings to raise funds for renovation.
sentence_zh: 美術館將拍賣稀有畫作以籌集翻修資金。

definition_zh: (名) 拍賣；拍賣會　(動) 拍賣
example_sentence: Attracting hundreds of bidders, the famous painting's auction broke the gallery's sales record.
sentence_zh: 吸引數百位出價者，這幅名畫的拍賣打破了畫廊的銷售紀錄。

definition_zh: (形) 大膽的；冒險的　(形) 魯莽的；放肆的
example_sentence: Although the plan was audacious, the team decided to pursue it with determination.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個計畫很大膽，但團隊決定堅定地追求它。

definition_zh: (名) 膽量；大膽　(名) 冒失；無禮
example_sentence: Never before had such audacity been displayed by a student challenging the school's strict uniform policy.
sentence_zh: 學生挑戰學校嚴格服儀規定的膽量從未如此顯現過。

definition_zh: (形) 能聽到的；可聽見的
example_sentence: The announcement that was barely audible across the crowded stadium frustrated many fans.
sentence_zh: 那則在擁擠體育館裡幾乎聽不清楚的公告讓許多球迷感到沮喪。

definition_zh: (名) 觀眾；聽眾　(名) 謁見；接見
example_sentence: The theater company hired professional actors to perform and entertain the audience effectively.
sentence_zh: 這家劇院公司雇用專業演員來表演並有效地娛樂觀眾。

definition_zh: (名) 音頻；音訊　(形) 音聲的；音頻的
example_sentence: The audio quality of this podcast makes listening to educational content more enjoyable.
sentence_zh: 這個播客的音頻品質讓聆聽教育內容變得更愉快。

definition_zh: (名) 審計；稽核　(動) 審計；旁聽
example_sentence: The company hired an independent auditor to audit its financial records carefully.
sentence_zh: 這家公司聘請獨立審計人員仔細審計其財務記錄。

definition_zh: (名) 試鏡；試音　(動) 參加試鏡；試音
example_sentence: Before the school play audition takes place, students must prepare a short monologue.
sentence_zh: 在學校戲劇試鏡舉行之前，學生必須準備一段簡短的獨白。

definition_zh: (名) 禮堂；演講廳　(名) 觀眾席；講堂
example_sentence: Seated in the auditorium, thousands of students listened attentively to the inspiring speech.
sentence_zh: 坐在禮堂裡，數千名學生專注地聽著這場激勵人心的演講。

definition_zh: (形) 聽覺的；與聽力有關的
example_sentence: The auditory system, which processes sound waves in the inner ear, is crucial for human communication.
sentence_zh: 聽覺系統是處理內耳中聲波的，對人類溝通至關重要。

definition_zh: (名) 阿姨；姑媽　(名) 螞蟻
example_sentence: If my aunt visits next month, we will prepare a special dinner for her.
sentence_zh: 如果我的阿姨下個月來訪，我們將為她準備一頓特別的晚餐。

definition_zh: (名) 極光；曙光
example_sentence: The aurora borealis painted the Arctic sky with stunning green and purple lights.
sentence_zh: 北極光用令人驚嘆的綠色和紫色光線點綴了北極的天空。

definition_zh: (形) 吉利的；幸運的　(形) 有利的；預示良好的
example_sentence: The couple chose that date to get married in order to receive auspicious blessings.
sentence_zh: 這對夫婦選擇那個日期結婚，目的是為了獲得吉利的祝福。

definition_zh: (名) 緊縮；節約　(形) 嚴格的；樸素的
example_sentence: The government's austerity measures reduced public spending and caused widespread economic hardship.
sentence_zh: 政府的緊縮措施減少了公共開支，造成廣泛的經濟困難。

definition_zh: (名) 澳洲；澳大利亞
example_sentence: Although Australia is far from Taiwan, many students study there for higher education.
sentence_zh: 雖然澳洲離臺灣很遠，但許多學生到那裡去接受高等教育。

definition_zh: (形) 澳洲的；澳洲人的　(名) 澳洲人；澳洲居民
example_sentence: Having visited several Australian cities, Maria found Sydney's beaches the most impressive.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞參訪了幾個澳洲城市後，發現雪梨的海灘最令人印象深刻。

definition_zh: (形) 真正的；道地的　(形) 可信的；可靠的
example_sentence: The restaurant serves authentic Taiwanese cuisine that customers who visit regularly truly appreciate.
sentence_zh: 這家餐廳提供道地的台灣菜，是常客們真正喜愛的。

definition_zh: (副) 真實地；真誠地　(副) 可靠地；有根據地
example_sentence: The documentary authentically portrayed the daily struggles and dreams of rural Taiwanese farmers.
sentence_zh: 這部紀錄片真實地呈現了台灣鄉村農民的日常困難與夢想。

definition_zh: (動) 驗證；認證　(動) 證明…真實
example_sentence: If the museum authenticated the painting, visitors would trust the exhibition.
sentence_zh: 如果博物館驗證了那幅畫，參觀者就會信任這個展覽。

definition_zh: (名) 真實性；真品　(名) 可信度；可靠性
example_sentence: The museum displays ancient artifacts and certifies their authenticity with detailed documentation.
sentence_zh: 這間博物館展示古代文物，並用詳細文件證明它們的真實性。

definition_zh: (名) 作者；作家　(動) 創作；著述
example_sentence: Having written three bestselling novels, the author gained fame among teenagers across Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 這位作者寫了三部暢銷小說，在台灣青少年中獲得了名氣。

definition_zh: (形) 獨裁的；專制的　(名) 獨裁者；專制統治者
example_sentence: Although the government claimed to be democratic, its authoritarian policies restricted citizens' freedom of speech.
sentence_zh: 雖然政府聲稱民主，但其專制政策限制了公民的言論自由。

definition_zh: (形) 權威的；有權勢的　(形) 確定的；有信服力的
example_sentence: Not only does the government official speak with authoritative knowledge, but also inspires public confidence.
sentence_zh: 不僅那位政府官員說話帶有權威性知識，而且能激發大眾的信心。

definition_zh: (名) 當局；政府部門　(名) 權威人士；專家
example_sentence: The health authorities, which announced new safety guidelines yesterday, urged all restaurants to follow them strictly.
sentence_zh: 昨天宣布新安全準則的衛生當局敦促所有餐廳嚴格遵守。

definition_zh: (名) 權力；權威　(名) 專家；權威人士
example_sentence: Students need to consult their parents to gain permission before joining the club.
sentence_zh: 學生需要徵求父母的同意才能加入俱樂部。

definition_zh: (動) 授權；批准　(動) 允許；核准
example_sentence: The principal authorized the student council to organize the school festival independently.
sentence_zh: 校長授權學生會獨立籌辦校慶活動。

definition_zh: (名) 自閉症；孤獨症
example_sentence: Autism is a developmental disorder affecting communication and social interaction.
sentence_zh: 自閉症是一種影響溝通和社交互動的發展障礙。

definition_zh: (名) 汽車；自動車　(形) 自動的；汽車的　(副) 自動地；無意識地
example_sentence: As the auto industry develops rapidly, electric vehicles become increasingly popular among consumers.
sentence_zh: 隨著汽車產業快速發展，電動車在消費者中越來越受歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 自傳；自述
example_sentence: Writing an autobiography, the famous director revealed many untold stories from his childhood.
sentence_zh: 那位著名導演在撰寫自傳時，揭露了許多童年的未曾公開故事。

definition_zh: (名) 自動更正；自動修正　(名) 備份；備用副本　(名) 文件；文檔
example_sentence: The AutoCorrect Backup Document, which prevents typing errors from being saved, is essential for online assignments.
sentence_zh: 自動更正備份文件（可防止輸入錯誤被儲存）對線上作業至關重要。

definition_zh: (形) 獨裁的；專制的　(形) 專斷的；不容許異議的
example_sentence: The autocratic leader made all decisions without consulting the people.
sentence_zh: 這位獨裁領導人不徵詢人民意見就做出所有決定。

definition_zh: (名) 親筆簽名；手簽　(動) 簽名；在...上簽名
example_sentence: The famous singer asked the photographer to take a photo in order to get her autograph.
sentence_zh: 這位著名歌手請攝影師拍照以便能夠得到她的親筆簽名。

definition_zh: (動) 自動化；使自動運作　(名) 自動化系統
