example_sentence: Factories automate repetitive tasks to increase production efficiency and reduce labor costs.
sentence_zh: 工廠將重複性工作自動化以提高生產效率並降低勞動成本。

definition_zh: (形) 自動的；無意識的　(副) 自動地；必然地
example_sentence: As the door opened automatically, the security guard rushed in to check the building.
sentence_zh: 當門自動打開時，保安衝進去檢查那棟建築物。

definition_zh: (副) 自動地；無需人工操作地　(副) 習慣性地；不假思索地
example_sentence: Having set the timer, the oven automatically adjusted its temperature throughout cooking.
sentence_zh: 設置好計時器後，烤箱在整個烹飪過程中自動調整溫度。

definition_zh: (名) 自動化；自動控制
example_sentence: Factory automation, which increases production efficiency, reduces manual labor costs significantly.
sentence_zh: 工廠自動化能提高生產效率，大幅降低人工成本。

definition_zh: (名) 汽車；自動車
example_sentence: Modern automobiles are equipped with advanced safety features to protect drivers.
sentence_zh: 現代汽車配備先進的安全功能來保護駕駛人。

definition_zh: (形) 自主的；自治的　(形) 獨立的；自動的
example_sentence: If the government created truly autonomous schools, teachers would have more freedom designing curriculum.
sentence_zh: 如果政府創設真正自主的學校，教師在課程設計上就會有更多自由。

definition_zh: (副) 自動地；獨立地　(副) 自主地；不受控制地
example_sentence: Modern robots can complete factory tasks autonomously without human intervention.
sentence_zh: 現代機器人可以在沒有人工干預的情況下自主完成工廠任務。

definition_zh: (名) 自主權；自治　(名) 自主性；獨立
example_sentence: Having gained autonomy, the student organization successfully planned its own activities.
sentence_zh: 獲得自主權後，該學生組織成功地規劃了自己的活動。

definition_zh: (名) 自噬；細胞自我分解
example_sentence: Although autophagy removes damaged cells, excessive autophagy can harm healthy tissue.
sentence_zh: 雖然自噬能清除受損細胞，但過度自噬可能傷害健康組織。

definition_zh: (名) 自動駕駛系統；自動導航裝置
example_sentence: Only after engaging the autopilot system can the pilot take a brief rest.
sentence_zh: 只有在啟動自動駕駛系統之後，飛行員才能短暫休息。

definition_zh: (形) 常染色體的；常染色體相關的
example_sentence: Genetic diseases that follow autosomal patterns are inherited from both parents equally.
sentence_zh: 遵循常染色體模式的遺傳疾病是由雙親平等地遺傳下來的。

definition_zh: (名) 秋季；秋天　(形) 秋天的；秋季的
example_sentence: Many students visit Jiufen Old Street in autumn to enjoy the cool weather and night markets.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在秋季造訪九份老街，目的是享受涼爽天氣和夜市。

definition_zh: (形) 輔助的；副的　(名) 輔助人員；輔助裝置
example_sentence: The auxiliary power system helps the main engine when the plane climbs.
sentence_zh: 輔助動力系統在飛機爬升時幫助主引擎。

definition_zh: (動) 有用；幫助　(名) 利益；幫助
example_sentence: Working hard will avail you nothing without a clear study plan.
sentence_zh: 沒有明確的讀書計畫，再努力也沒有用。

definition_zh: (名) 可得性；可用性　(名) 有空；有時間
example_sentence: Since availability of online learning platforms has improved, students can study whenever convenient.
sentence_zh: 由於線上學習平台的可用性已經提高，學生可以隨時方便地學習。

definition_zh: (形) 可得到的；可利用的　(形) 有空的；未被占用的
example_sentence: Having limited time available, the student finished the homework quickly and efficiently.
sentence_zh: 由於可用時間有限，這位學生迅速而有效地完成了功課。

definition_zh: (名) 雪崩；山洪　(動) 崩落；大量滑落
example_sentence: The massive avalanche that buried the mountain village claimed many lives.
sentence_zh: 那場埋沒山村的大雪崩奪走了許多生命。

definition_zh: (動) 報仇；復仇　(動) 為...報仇；替...復仇
example_sentence: If the hero avenges his father's death, justice will finally be served.
sentence_zh: 如果英雄為他父親的死亡復仇，正義最終將獲得伸張。

definition_zh: (名) 大街；林蔭道　(名) 途徑；方法
example_sentence: The coffee shop is located on Fifth Avenue, a popular shopping street downtown.
sentence_zh: 這家咖啡館位在第五大街上，那是市區一條受歡迎的購物街。

definition_zh: (動) 聲稱；主張　(動) 確認；斷言
example_sentence: The witness appeared in court to aver that the defendant was innocent.
sentence_zh: 證人出庭是為了聲稱被告是無辜的。

definition_zh: (名) 平均數；平均值　(形) 普通的；中等的　(動) 平均為；達到平均
example_sentence: The average temperature in Taiwan during summer is around thirty degrees Celsius.
sentence_zh: 臺灣夏季的平均溫度大約是攝氏三十度。

definition_zh: (形) 厭惡的；不樂意的　(形) 反對的；敵對的
example_sentence: Although Maria is averse to public speaking, she delivered an excellent presentation at the school assembly.
sentence_zh: 雖然瑪麗亞厭惡公開演講，但她在學校集會上發表了精彩的演講。

definition_zh: (副) 不利地；逆地　(副) 反對地；敵意地
example_sentence: Having been aversely affected by the economic downturn, many small businesses struggled to survive.
sentence_zh: 受到經濟衰退的不利影響，許多小企業努力求生。

definition_zh: (名) 厭惡；反感　(形) 厭惡的；反感的
example_sentence: Many students have a strong aversion to homework that requires excessive memorization.
sentence_zh: 許多學生對需要過度背誦的功課有強烈的厭惡感。

definition_zh: (動) 轉移；避開　(動) 防止；阻止
example_sentence: Quick thinking and decisive action averted a serious accident on the highway.
sentence_zh: 迅速的思考和果斷的行動轉移了高速公路上一場嚴重事故。

definition_zh: (形) 鳥類的；與鳥有關的
example_sentence: If bird flu were not an avian disease, poultry farmers would not worry about infection during breeding season.
sentence_zh: 如果禽流感不是鳥類疾病，家禽農民在繁殖季節就不用擔心感染。

definition_zh: (名) 鳥舍；飼鳥籠
example_sentence: The zoo's aviary houses hundreds of colorful birds from around the world.
sentence_zh: 動物園的鳥舍飼養著來自世界各地數百隻色彩繽紛的鳥類。

definition_zh: (名) 航空；航空業　(形) 航空的；與飛行有關的
example_sentence: Growing rapidly in recent decades, aviation industry provides thousands of jobs for skilled workers.
sentence_zh: 在過去幾十年中快速成長，航空業為熟練工人提供了數千個工作機會。

definition_zh: (形) 熱情的；熱切的　(形) 熱愛的；著迷的
example_sentence: Because Maria is an avid reader, she finishes three novels every month.
sentence_zh: 因為瑪麗亞是一位熱情的讀者，她每月完成三部小說。

definition_zh: (動) 避免；迴避　(動) 躲開；避開
example_sentence: Only by studying hard can students avoid failing the entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 唯有努力讀書，學生才能避免考試不及格。

definition_zh: (形) 可以避免的；可以迴避的
example_sentence: Many traffic accidents are avoidable mistakes that careful drivers can prevent easily.
sentence_zh: 許多交通事故是細心駕駛人可以輕易預防的可避免錯誤。

definition_zh: (副) 可以避免地；本可避免地
example_sentence: The accident happened because the driver failed to brake in time to avoidably prevent the collision.
sentence_zh: 那場事故發生是因為駕駛未能及時煞車來可避免地防止碰撞。

definition_zh: (動) 等待；期待　(動) 留待；等著被
example_sentence: Many students await the announcement of exam results with great anxiety and hope.
sentence_zh: 許多學生懷著焦慮和希望等待考試成績的公布。

definition_zh: (動) 醒來；喚醒　(形) 清醒的；醒著的
example_sentence: The alarm clock woke Maria up at six o'clock every morning.
sentence_zh: 鬧鐘每天早上六點叫瑪麗亞起床。

definition_zh: (動) 喚醒；甦醒　(動) 使…覺悟；喚起
example_sentence: As dawn broke over the mountains, birds awoke and sang their morning songs loudly.
sentence_zh: 當黎明破曉照亮山巒時，鳥兒們甦醒並大聲唱起晨歌。

definition_zh: (名) 獎項；獎品　(動) 頒發；授予
example_sentence: Winning the science competition, the student received an award recognizing years of hard work.
sentence_zh: 贏得科學競賽，該學生獲得了表彰多年辛勤工作的獎項。

definition_zh: (形) 意識到的；察覺的　(動) 認識到；了解
example_sentence: Students who are aware of the exam schedule should start preparing early.
sentence_zh: 那些意識到考試時間表的學生應該儘早開始準備。

definition_zh: (名) 意識；認識　(名) 警覺；注意
example_sentence: If students develop awareness of environmental issues, they will make better choices.
sentence_zh: 如果學生培養對環境問題的認識，他們將做出更好的選擇。

definition_zh: (副) 離開；遠離　(副) 不在；缺席
example_sentence: The soccer player kicked the ball away from the goal.
sentence_zh: 足球運動員把球踢遠離球門。

definition_zh: (名) 敬畏；驚嘆　(動) 對...感到敬畏
example_sentence: Visitors climbed the mountain to experience awe at its breathtaking natural beauty.
sentence_zh: 遊客爬山是為了對其令人驚嘆的自然美景感到敬畏。

definition_zh: (形) 令人驚歎的；極好的　(形) 令人敬畏的；了不起的
example_sentence: The concert was absolutely awesome, with amazing performances and awesome sound effects throughout.
sentence_zh: 這場演唱會令人驚歎，有著精彩的表演和絕佳的音效效果。

definition_zh: (形) 非常糟糕的；令人厭惡的　(副) 非常地；極其
example_sentence: Although the weather was awful yesterday, the school sports day proceeded as planned.
sentence_zh: 雖然昨天的天氣非常糟糕，學校運動會仍然按計畫進行。

definition_zh: (副) 一陣子；暫時　(名) 一段時間；一會兒
example_sentence: Having studied awhile, the students felt more confident about the upcoming CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 複習了一陣子後，學生們對即將到來的學測更有信心了。

definition_zh: (形) 尷尬的；不自在的　(形) 笨拙的；不靈巧的
example_sentence: The situation that made everyone feel uncomfortable was truly awkward for the entire class.
sentence_zh: 讓每個人都感到不舒服的那個情況對整個班級來說真的很尷尬。

definition_zh: (名) 尷尬；不自在　(名) 笨拙；動作不靈活
example_sentence: The awkwardness between the two former friends made the reunion dinner feel uncomfortable.
sentence_zh: 這兩位前友人之間的尷尬氣氛讓同學會晚餐顯得不舒服。

definition_zh: (名) 遮陽篷；頂篷
example_sentence: If the café had installed an awning, customers would enjoy their coffee without worrying about sun damage.
sentence_zh: 如果咖啡館安裝了遮陽篷，顧客就能在不擔心日曬傷害的情況下享受咖啡。

definition_zh: (形) 出錯的；不順利的　(副) 歪斜地；出錯地
example_sentence: The project went awry when the main server crashed unexpectedly.
sentence_zh: 當主伺服器意外當機時，這個專案就出錯了。

definition_zh: (名) 斧頭；斧子　(動) 用斧頭砍；解僱
example_sentence: Chopping wood with an ax, the farmer prepared firewood for winter.
sentence_zh: 農民用斧頭砍柴，為冬天準備木柴。

definition_zh: (名) 軸；軸線　(名) 中心線；對稱軸
example_sentence: As the Earth rotates around its axis, different regions experience day and night.
sentence_zh: 當地球繞著它的軸自轉時，不同地區經歷白天和夜晚。

definition_zh: (動) 喋喋不休地說；含糊地說　(名) 含糊的聲音；喋喋不休
example_sentence: Hardly had the baby started babbling when proud parents recorded every sound.
sentence_zh: 嬰兒才開始咿呀學語，父母就急不可待地錄下每一個聲音。

definition_zh: (名) 嬰兒；寶寶　(動) 把…當寶寶對待
example_sentence: The baby who was sleeping peacefully in the cradle suddenly woke up.
sentence_zh: 那個在搖籃裡安靜睡著的嬰兒突然醒了。

definition_zh: (動) 臨時照顧小孩；代人看小孩
example_sentence: Maria earns pocket money to babysit her neighbor's children on weekends.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞在週末臨時照顧鄰居的小孩來賺取零用錢。

definition_zh: (名) 臨時保姆；嬰幼兒照顧者
example_sentence: The babysitter arrived early to help care for the two young children tonight.
sentence_zh: 那位臨時保姆今晚提早到達，幫忙照顧兩個年幼的孩子。

definition_zh: (名) 學士；未婚男子　(名) 單身漢；獨身者
example_sentence: After graduating from college, Tom became a bachelor living in Taipei.
sentence_zh: 從大學畢業後，Tom 成為住在台北的單身漢。

definition_zh: (動) 退出；食言　(動) 放棄承諾；反悔
example_sentence: After signing the contract, the company backed out when market conditions changed suddenly.
sentence_zh: 在簽署合約後，當市場狀況突然改變時，該公司食言了。

definition_zh: (動) 備份；支持　(動) 倒車；後退
example_sentence: Backing up important files regularly, students protect their assignments from unexpected data loss.
sentence_zh: 定期備份重要檔案，學生保護自己的作業免於突然的資料遺失。

definition_zh: (名) 背；後面　(動) 支持；往後退　(形) 後面的；背後的
example_sentence: The student who sat in the back of the classroom couldn't hear the teacher's explanation clearly.
sentence_zh: 坐在教室後面的那位學生無法清楚聽到老師的解說。

definition_zh: (名) 脊骨；骨幹　(名) 骨氣；決心
example_sentence: If a student lacks backbone, perseverance in studying difficult subjects would become nearly impossible.
sentence_zh: 如果學生缺乏骨氣，堅持學習難科目就幾乎不可能了。

definition_zh: (名) 學士；單身漢
example_sentence: After graduating from university, Tom became a bachelor and lived alone in the city.
sentence_zh: 大學畢業後，湯姆成為學士學位持有者，獨自在城市裡生活。

definition_zh: (動) [bæk`faɪr] 適得其反；事與願違　(名) [`bæk.faɪr] 反效果；失敗的計畫
example_sentence: The company raised prices to increase profits, only to backfire and lose many customers.
sentence_zh: 這家公司提高價格以增加利潤，結果適得其反，失去了許多客戶。

definition_zh: (名) 背景；背景資訊　(名) 教育背景；家庭背景
example_sentence: Understanding students' educational and family backgrounds helps teachers provide better support.
sentence_zh: 了解學生的教育和家庭背景能幫助老師提供更好的協助。

definition_zh: (名) 支持；後援　(名) 背面；襯裡　(動) 支持；贊助
example_sentence: Backing the school's environmental project, many students volunteered to clean up the campus.
sentence_zh: 因為支持學校的環保專案，許多學生自願參與校園清潔工作。

definition_zh: (名) 積壓的工作；待辦事項　(動) 積壓；堆積
example_sentence: Having accumulated a massive backlog of orders, the factory extended working hours to meet deadlines.
sentence_zh: 由於積壓了大量訂單，工廠延長工作時間以趕上截止期限。

definition_zh: (名) 背包；背囊
example_sentence: The backpack that Maria carries to school every day contains textbooks and snacks.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞每天帶到學校的背包裡裝著課本和零食。

definition_zh: (名) 背包客；自助旅行者
example_sentence: Many backpackers travel across Southeast Asia with limited budgets during summer vacation.
sentence_zh: 許多背包客在暑假期間以有限預算在東南亞旅行。

definition_zh: (動) 改變立場；食言　(動) 原路返回；回溯
example_sentence: If the government backtracked on its education reform promise, students would lose trust in policymakers.
sentence_zh: 如果政府改變其教育改革的承諾，學生就會對政策制定者失去信任。

definition_zh: (名) [`bækˌʌp] 備份；後援　(動) [bæk`ʌp] 備份；支持
example_sentence: Always keep a backup of your important files on an external hard drive.
sentence_zh: 一定要在外接硬碟上保存重要檔案的備份。

definition_zh: (形) 向後的；落後的　(副) 向後；倒退
example_sentence: Walking backward carefully, the student avoided stepping on the wet paint.
sentence_zh: 那名學生小心地向後走，避免踩到溼漆。

definition_zh: (副) 向後；反向　(形) 落後的；不進步的
example_sentence: As the dancer moved backwards across the stage, the audience applauded her impressive balance and control.
sentence_zh: 當舞者向後穿過舞台時，觀眾為她令人印象深刻的平衡和控制力鼓掌。

definition_zh: (名) 培根；煙肉　(名) 弗蘭西斯·培根（英國哲學家）
example_sentence: Seldom does crispy bacon fail to make breakfast truly delicious and satisfying.
sentence_zh: 酥脆的培根很少無法讓早餐變得真正美味又令人滿足。

definition_zh: (名) 細菌；菌類
example_sentence: The bacteria that live in soil help plants absorb nutrients from the ground.
sentence_zh: 生活在土壤中的細菌幫助植物從地面吸收養分。

definition_zh: (形) 壞的；不好的　(形) 有害的；不健康的　(形) 嚴重的；令人不快的
example_sentence: Eating too much junk food is bad for your health and study performance.
sentence_zh: 吃太多垃圾食物對你的健康和學習表現不好。

definition_zh: (名) 徽章；證章　(名) 標誌；象徵
example_sentence: Students wearing a school badge feel proud of their achievement.
sentence_zh: 穿著校徽的學生為他們的成就感到驕傲。

definition_zh: (副) 嚴重地；很糟糕地　(副) 非常地；極度地
example_sentence: Although the storm damaged the town badly, residents worked together to rebuild it.
sentence_zh: 儘管暴風雨嚴重毀壞了這個鎮，居民們齊心協力重建它。

definition_zh: (名) 羽毛球；羽毛球運動
example_sentence: Playing badminton regularly, students improve hand-eye coordination and build strength effectively.
sentence_zh: 定期打羽毛球，學生能改善手眼協調並有效增強體力。

definition_zh: (動) 使困惑；難倒　(形) 令人困惑的；費解的
example_sentence: The math problem that baffled most students turned out to be surprisingly simple.
sentence_zh: 令大多數學生困惑的這道數學題結果出奇地簡單。

definition_zh: (形) 令人困惑的；難以理解的　(形) 令人費解的；莫名其妙的
example_sentence: If the math problem remains baffling after studying the textbook, asking the teacher would help clarify it.
sentence_zh: 如果數學題目在讀完課本後仍然令人困惑，詢問老師會有幫助釐清它。

definition_zh: (名) 袋子；背包　(動) 裝進袋子；獲得
example_sentence: Maria put her books and notebook into her school bag every morning.
sentence_zh: 瑪莉亞每天早上都把她的書和筆記本放進書包裡。

definition_zh: (名) 行李；包袱　(名) 累贅；包袱
example_sentence: Travelers pack light baggage to avoid extra fees at the airport.
sentence_zh: 旅客打包輕便的行李以避免在機場產生額外費用。

definition_zh: (形) 寬鬆的；肥大的　(形) 鬆垮的；下垂的
example_sentence: Wearing baggy clothes and comfortable shoes makes studying for long hours much easier.
sentence_zh: 穿著寬鬆的衣服和舒適的鞋子讓長時間讀書變得容易得多。

definition_zh: (名) 保釋金；保釋　(動) 保釋；釋放　(名) 水舀；舀子
example_sentence: The defendant was released on bail after posting a large sum of money.
sentence_zh: 被告在交付一大筆保釋金後被釋放。

definition_zh: (名) 餌；誘餌　(動) 用餌引誘；激怒
example_sentence: Having baited the trap with cheese, the farmer waited patiently for the mouse to appear.
sentence_zh: 農夫用起司設置好誘餌陷阱後，耐心地等待老鼠出現。

definition_zh: (動) 烘烤；烤　(名) 烘烤；烤製
example_sentence: The cookies that Mom baked yesterday were crispy and delicious.
sentence_zh: 媽媽昨天烤的餅乾又酥又好吃。

definition_zh: (名) 烘焙食品；麵包糕點
example_sentence: The bakery sells fresh baked goods every morning for customers.
sentence_zh: 那家麵包店每天早上為顧客銷售新鮮的烘焙食品。

definition_zh: (名) 麵包師；麵包店老闆
example_sentence: If the baker had used fresher flour, the bread would have tasted better yesterday.
sentence_zh: 如果麵包師昨天用了更新鮮的麵粉，麵包的味道會更好。

definition_zh: (名) 麵包店；烘焙坊
example_sentence: Every morning, Sarah buys fresh bread from the bakery near school.
sentence_zh: 每天早上，莎拉都從學校附近的麵包店買新鮮麵包。

definition_zh: (名) 平衡；均衡　(動) 平衡；使保持平衡
example_sentence: Balancing work and study, many students find success in their CSAT preparation.
sentence_zh: 在平衡工作和讀書的同時，許多學生在學測準備中取得成功。

definition_zh: (形) 平衡的；均衡的　(動) 平衡；使均衡
example_sentence: Because the diet was balanced with vegetables and protein, the athlete maintained excellent health throughout the season.
sentence_zh: 因為飲食中蔬菜和蛋白質均衡，這位運動員在整個賽季中保持了優異的健康狀態。

definition_zh: (名) 陽台；露台
example_sentence: Only from the balcony could the guests enjoy the stunning night view of Taipei.
sentence_zh: 只有從陽台上，客人們才能欣賞到台北令人驚嘆的夜景。

definition_zh: (形) 禿頭的；光禿的
example_sentence: The man who is bald wears a hat to cover his head.
sentence_zh: 那位禿頭的男人戴著帽子來遮住他的頭。

definition_zh: (名) 球；舞會
example_sentence: Students practice throwing the ball to improve their hand-eye coordination.
sentence_zh: 學生練習投球以改善他們的手眼協調能力。

definition_zh: (名) 芭蕾舞；芭蕾舞劇
example_sentence: Learning ballet requires dedication, discipline, and years of rigorous training.
sentence_zh: 學習芭蕾舞需要奉獻精神、紀律和多年的嚴格訓練。

definition_zh: (名) 氣球；汽球
example_sentence: The children released colorful balloons into the sky during the celebration.
sentence_zh: 慶祝活動中，孩子們將五彩繽紛的氣球放入空中。

definition_zh: (名) 選票；投票　(動) 投票；表決
example_sentence: Although the ballot was anonymous, many students felt nervous before casting their votes in the school election.
sentence_zh: 雖然選票是匿名的，但許多學生在學校選舉投票前感到緊張。

definition_zh: (名) 舞廳；舞場
example_sentence: Couples dancing in the ballroom looked elegant and graceful.
sentence_zh: 在舞廳裡跳舞的情侶們看起來優雅而優美。

definition_zh: (形) 溫暖宜人的；晴朗溫和的
example_sentence: The balmy weather that greeted us in spring made outdoor activities enjoyable.
sentence_zh: 春天迎接我們那溫暖宜人的天氣使戶外活動變得令人愉快。

definition_zh: (名) 竹子；竹　(名) 竹製品
example_sentence: If bamboo is planted in rich soil, it will grow very tall and strong.
sentence_zh: 如果竹子種在肥沃的土壤中，它將長得非常高大強壯。

definition_zh: (動) 禁止；禁用　(名) 禁令；禁止
example_sentence: The school banned students from using mobile phones during class.
sentence_zh: 學校禁止學生在課堂上使用手機。

definition_zh: (名) 香蕉；芭蕉
example_sentence: Students bring bananas to school to provide quick energy during study breaks.
sentence_zh: 學生帶香蕉到學校以在讀書休息時提供快速能量。

definition_zh: (名) 繃帶；創可貼　(動) 用繃帶包紮
example_sentence: After soccer practice, Tom applied a band-aid to his scraped knee.
sentence_zh: 足球練習後，湯姆在擦傷的膝蓋上貼了一張創可貼。

definition_zh: (名) 樂隊；樂團　(名) 帶子；條紋　(動) 把...綁在一起
example_sentence: As the band played their final song, the crowd cheered loudly and applauded.
sentence_zh: 當樂隊演奏他們的最後一首歌時，觀眾大聲歡呼並鼓掌。

definition_zh: (名) 繃帶；藥布　(動) 用繃帶包紮；包紮傷口
example_sentence: Having bandaged the wound carefully, the nurse checked the patient's vital signs.
sentence_zh: 護士小心地用繃帶包紮了傷口後，檢查了患者的生命徵象。

definition_zh: (名) 強盜；土匪　(名) 惡棍；不誠實的人
example_sentence: The police arrested the bandits who had robbed the convenience store last week.
sentence_zh: 警察逮捕了上週搶劫便利商店的強盜。

definition_zh: (名) 爆炸聲；砰聲　(動) 砰地關閉；猛烈撞擊　(副) 砰地一聲；正好
example_sentence: The door slammed with a loud bang, startling everyone in the quiet classroom.
sentence_zh: 門砰地一聲大響關上，嚇了安靜教室裡的每個人一跳。

definition_zh: (名) 瀏海；齊頭短髮
example_sentence: If Maria didn't cut her bangs so short, she would look much older.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪麗亞沒有把瀏海剪得那麼短，她看起來會老很多。

definition_zh: (動) 放逐；驅趕　(動) 消除；驅散
example_sentence: The king banished the traitor from the kingdom forever.
sentence_zh: 國王將背叛者永遠從王國中放逐。

definition_zh: (名) 放逐；驅逐　(名) 流放；被驅逐出境
example_sentence: Facing banishment from the kingdom, the rebel leader fled across the border.
sentence_zh: 面臨被放逐出王國，那位叛亂領袖逃過邊境。

definition_zh: (動) 依靠；指望　相信會成功
example_sentence: Although the team hadn't practiced much, the coach banked on winning the championship.
sentence_zh: 雖然球隊練習不足，但教練依靠贏得冠軍。

definition_zh: (名) 銀行；金融機構　(名) 河岸；堤岸　(動) 把錢存入銀行；將飛機傾斜
example_sentence: Rarely does a student open a savings account without first consulting parents.
sentence_zh: 學生很少在沒有先詢問父母的情況下就開設儲蓄帳戶。

definition_zh: (名) 銀行家；銀行人員
example_sentence: The banker who manages our school's fund is experienced in financial planning.
sentence_zh: 管理我們學校基金的銀行家在財務規劃方面很有經驗。

definition_zh: (名) 銀行業；銀行工作　(動) 存款；使用銀行服務
example_sentence: Many students learn basic accounting to prepare for banking careers after graduation.
sentence_zh: 許多學生學習基礎會計以準備畢業後從事銀行業的職業。

definition_zh: (名) 紙幣；鈔票
example_sentence: The tourist exchanged foreign currency for local banknotes at the airport.
sentence_zh: 遊客在機場用外幣兌換當地紙幣。

definition_zh: (形) 破產的；無法償還債務的　(動) 使破產；導致經濟失敗
example_sentence: The company went bankrupt after losing millions in bad investments.
sentence_zh: 這家公司因為投資失利損失數百萬後而破產了。

definition_zh: (名) 破產；倒閉　(形) 破產的；完全缺乏的
example_sentence: Because the company faced bankruptcy, many workers lost their jobs immediately.
sentence_zh: 因為該公司面臨破產，許多員工立即失去工作。

definition_zh: (名) 旗幟；橫幅　(名) 標語；口號
example_sentence: Flying proudly above the stadium, the school banner inspired all athletes competing in the annual sports festival.
sentence_zh: 高高飄揚在體育館上方的校旗激勵了所有在年度運動會中競爭的運動員。

definition_zh: (名) 宴會；盛宴　(動) 設宴款待；享受盛宴
example_sentence: The awards banquet, which celebrates outstanding student achievements, attracts hundreds of guests annually.
sentence_zh: 這場慶祝傑出學生成就的頒獎宴會每年吸引數百位嘉賓參加。

definition_zh: (名) 友善的玩笑；打趣　(動) 開玩笑；互相打趣
example_sentence: If teammates engage in friendly banter, the team's morale will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果隊友之間進行友善的打趣，球隊的士氣就會大幅提升。

definition_zh: (名) 酒吧；酒館　(名) 條狀物；棒　(動) 阻止；禁止
example_sentence: The beach bar serves cold drinks and snacks every afternoon.
sentence_zh: 那家海灘酒吧每天下午供應冰飲和點心。

definition_zh: (名) 野蠻人；未開化的人　(形) 野蠻的；殘暴的
example_sentence: Ancient Romans built walls to protect their civilization from barbarian invasions.
sentence_zh: 古羅馬人建造城牆以保護他們的文明免受野蠻人入侵。

definition_zh: (名) 烤肉；燒烤架　(動) 烤肉；用燒烤架烹飪
example_sentence: My family loves having a barbecue in the backyard on summer weekends.
sentence_zh: 我的家人喜歡在夏天週末在後院烤肉。

definition_zh: (名) 理髮師；男理髮店
example_sentence: Although the barber was busy, he still greeted every customer with a warm smile.
sentence_zh: 雖然理髮師很忙，他仍然用溫暖的笑容問候每位顧客。

definition_zh: (名) 理髮店；男子理容院
example_sentence: Having visited the barbershop near his home, Tom got a fresh haircut before the school ceremony.
sentence_zh: 在去過家附近的理髮店後，湯姆在校典禮前剪了頭新髮型。

definition_zh: (形) 赤裸的；光禿的　(動) 露出；暴露
example_sentence: The bare truth, which nobody wanted to hear, finally came out.
sentence_zh: 沒人想聽到的赤裸真相，最後終於說出來了。

definition_zh: (形) 赤腳的；光腳的
example_sentence: Running barefoot on the beach sand feels refreshing and natural.
sentence_zh: 赤腳在沙灘上奔跑感覺清爽又自然。

definition_zh: (副) 勉強；幾乎不　(副) 剛剛；僅僅
example_sentence: If Mark barely studied before the exam, he would not pass the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 如果馬克考試前勉強唸書，他就不會通過學測。

definition_zh: (動) 談判爭取；預料會發生
example_sentence: When buying a used car, customers often bargain for a lower price.
sentence_zh: 購買二手車時，顧客經常會談判爭取更低的價格。

definition_zh: (名) 便宜貨；交易　(動) 討價還價；議價　(形) 便宜的；划算的
example_sentence: Bargaining at the night market, smart shoppers can find excellent deals on clothes and snacks.
sentence_zh: 在夜市討價還價的聰明購物者可以找到服飾和零食的優惠。

definition_zh: (動) 粗魯地闖入；突然打斷
example_sentence: While the meeting was in progress, Tom barged in without knocking on the door.
sentence_zh: 當會議正在進行時，湯姆沒有敲門就粗魯地闖了進來。

definition_zh: (動) 冒然闖入；粗魯地打斷
example_sentence: Hardly had the meeting started when the angry customer barged into the office.
sentence_zh: 會議才剛開始，那位生氣的客人就冒然闖進辦公室。

definition_zh: (名) 駁船；平底貨船　(動) 粗魯地推進；闖入
example_sentence: The cargo barge, which was loaded with construction materials, slowly moved down the river.
sentence_zh: 那艘裝滿建築材料的駁船在河上緩緩移動。

definition_zh: (名) 咖啡師；咖啡館員工
example_sentence: Many people visit the café daily to learn about specialty coffee from the skilled barista.
sentence_zh: 許多人每天到咖啡館拜訪技術高超的咖啡師，以了解精品咖啡。

definition_zh: (名) 男中音；男中音歌手
example_sentence: The baritone singer performed a beautiful aria at the school concert.
sentence_zh: 那位男中音歌手在校園音樂會上表演了一首優美的詠嘆調。

definition_zh: (名) 樹皮　(動) 吠叫；大聲喊叫
example_sentence: The dog barks loudly whenever someone walks past the house.
sentence_zh: 每當有人經過房子時，那隻狗就大聲吠叫。

definition_zh: (名) 大麥；麥類穀物
example_sentence: Although barley is less common than rice in Taiwan, it has become increasingly popular as a health food.
sentence_zh: 雖然大麥在台灣不如米類常見，但它作為健康食品變得越來越受歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 穀倉；農舍
example_sentence: Storing grain in the barn, the farmer protected the harvest from heavy rain.
sentence_zh: 農民將穀物儲存在穀倉裡，保護收成免受豪雨侵襲。

definition_zh: (名) 男爵；貴族　(名) 大亨；商業巨頭
example_sentence: The baron who owned vast estates across Europe was respected by the local villagers.
sentence_zh: 擁有遍佈歐洲廣大莊園的那位男爵受到當地村民的尊敬。

definition_zh: (名) 營房；軍營　(動) 在營房中駐紮；把...安置在營房
example_sentence: If soldiers were assigned to that barrack, they would receive strict military training.
sentence_zh: 如果士兵被分配到那個營房，他們將會接受嚴格的軍事訓練。

definition_zh: (名) 桶；木桶　(名) 槍管；砲管
example_sentence: The wine was stored in wooden barrels for three years.
sentence_zh: 葡萄酒在木桶中儲存了三年。

definition_zh: (形) 貧瘠的；不毛的　(形) 空虛的；無結果的
example_sentence: Farmers cleared the barren land to grow crops and improve soil quality.
sentence_zh: 農民開墾貧瘠的土地以種植作物並改善土壤品質。

definition_zh: (名) 路障；柵欄　(動) 用路障阻擋；封鎖
example_sentence: Police officers set up barricades and blocked the street to prevent traffic from entering the dangerous area.
sentence_zh: 警察設置路障並封鎖街道，防止車輛進入危險區域。

definition_zh: (名) 障礙；屏障　(名) 柵欄；圍欄
example_sentence: Although language barrier exists between the two students, their friendship grows stronger every day.
sentence_zh: 雖然語言障礙存在於這兩個學生之間，但他們的友誼每天都在加強。

definition_zh: (介) 除了...以外；除非　(動) 阻擋；封鎖
example_sentence: Barring any unexpected weather changes, the outdoor concert will proceed as scheduled tomorrow evening.
sentence_zh: 除非天氣出現意外變化，否則戶外演唱會將按計畫於明天晚上進行。

definition_zh: (動) 根據；以...為基礎　(片) 基於；根據
example_sentence: The decision that the company based on market research turned out to be very successful.
sentence_zh: 公司根據市場研究而做出的決定被證明非常成功。

definition_zh: (名) 基地；根據地　(名) 基礎；基本　(動) 以...為基礎
example_sentence: The military base located near the coast serves as an important strategic point.
sentence_zh: 位於海岸附近的軍事基地是一個重要的戰略據點。

definition_zh: (名) 棒球；棒球運動
example_sentence: If more students played baseball regularly, school athletic programs would become much stronger.
sentence_zh: 如果更多學生經常打棒球，學校運動項目就會變得更強。

definition_zh: (介) 根據；按照　(片) 以...為基礎
example_sentence: Based on the survey results, most students prefer online learning.
sentence_zh: 根據調查結果，大多數學生更偏好線上學習。

definition_zh: (形) 以…為基礎的；基於…的　(動) 以…為基礎；把…設在
example_sentence: Based on recent survey results, the school decided to improve its cafeteria menu significantly.
sentence_zh: 根據最近的調查結果，學校決定大幅改善其食堂菜單。

definition_zh: (名) 地下室；地窖
example_sentence: As the earthquake shook the building, the family rushed to the basement for safety.
sentence_zh: 當地震搖撼建築物時，家人衝向地下室尋求安全。

definition_zh: (動) 亂打；胡亂擺弄
example_sentence: Hardly ever does someone bash about the old guitar without breaking its strings.
sentence_zh: 很少有人會胡亂擺弄那把舊吉他而不弄斷琴弦。

definition_zh: (動) 打入；砸進　(動) 猛烈批評
example_sentence: The door that thieves bashed in was immediately repaired by the homeowner.
sentence_zh: 小偷砸進的那扇門立即被屋主修好了。

definition_zh: (動) 急速完成；倉促製作　匆忙寫出
example_sentence: The journalist had to bash out a quick article to meet the newspaper's deadline.
sentence_zh: 那位記者必須匆忙寫出一篇快速報導以趕上報紙的截稿期限。

definition_zh: (動) 痛打；毆打　(動) 損壞；破壞
example_sentence: The car was bashed up after the accident, so repairs cost a lot of money.
sentence_zh: 那輛車在事故後被撞得很破，所以修理費很貴。

definition_zh: (動) 狠狠打；猛烈攻擊　(名) 盛大聚會；派對
example_sentence: The critics bashed the new movie for its weak plot and poor acting.
sentence_zh: 評論家因為電影情節薄弱和演技不佳而狠狠批評它。

definition_zh: (形) 害羞的；靦腆的　(形) 缺乏自信的；羞怯的
example_sentence: Although Ming-hui felt bashful when presenting in class, consistent practice gradually built his confidence.
sentence_zh: 雖然明輝在班級報告時感到害羞，但持續練習逐漸增強了他的自信心。

definition_zh: (形) 基本的；基礎的　(名) 基本要素；基礎
example_sentence: Starting with basic vocabulary, students build confidence in English conversation.
sentence_zh: 從基本詞彙開始著手，學生在英語對話中逐漸建立信心。

definition_zh: (副) 基本上；本質上　(副) 說穿了；簡而言之
example_sentence: The exam, which basically tests reading comprehension and grammar, requires consistent preparation.
sentence_zh: 這場考試基本上考查閱讀理解和文法，需要持續的準備。

definition_zh: (名) 基礎；基本原理　(名) 基本要素；必需品
example_sentence: If students master the basics of English grammar, they will find advanced reading much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果學生掌握英文文法的基礎，他們就會發現進階閱讀容易得多。

definition_zh: (名) 盆；盆地　(名) 河流的流域；集水區
example_sentence: Farmers in the river basin depend on regular rainfall for irrigation.
sentence_zh: 河流流域的農民依賴定期降雨進行灌溉。

definition_zh: (名) 基礎；根據　(名) 基準；依據
example_sentence: Students study chemistry fundamentals to establish a strong basis for advanced courses.
sentence_zh: 學生研究化學基礎是為了為高級課程奠定堅實的基礎。

definition_zh: (動) 曬太陽；享受溫暖　(動) 沉浸在；陶醉於
example_sentence: Students basking in the warm sunshine felt relaxed and happy during lunch break.
sentence_zh: 在溫暖陽光下曬太陽的學生在午餐時間感到放鬆和快樂。

definition_zh: (名) 籃子；籃　(名) 籃球隊；得分
example_sentence: As the teacher distributed art supplies, each student received a basket containing colored pencils and paper.
sentence_zh: 當老師分配美術用品時，每位學生都收到一個裝著彩色鉛筆和紙的籃子。

definition_zh: (名) 籃球；籃球運動
example_sentence: Having practiced basketball for years, the team won the national championship.
sentence_zh: 經過多年的籃球訓練，這支隊伍贏得了全國冠軍。

definition_zh: (名) 低音；貝斯　(名) 鱸魚；海鱸　(形) 低音的；低沉的
example_sentence: The bass player, whose skillful fingers moved across the strings, created a melody that captivated the entire audience.
sentence_zh: 那位低音貝斯手，他的靈巧手指在琴弦上移動，創造出了吸引整個觀眾的旋律。

definition_zh: (名) 私生子；雜種　(名) 討厭的人；混蛋
example_sentence: The bastard son inherited nothing from his wealthy father's estate.
sentence_zh: 那個私生子從他富有父親的遺產中什麼都沒有繼承。

definition_zh: (名) 堡壘；要塞　(名) 中心；陣地
example_sentence: If democracy were not this nation's last bastion, freedom would disappear from society.
sentence_zh: 如果民主不是這個國家最後的堡壘，自由將從社會中消失。

definition_zh: (名) 蝙蝠；球棒　(動) 用球棒打；輪流上場打擊
example_sentence: The baseball player swung the bat and hit a home run.
sentence_zh: 那位棒球選手揮動球棒打出全壘打。

definition_zh: (名) 一批；一組　(動) 分批；成批處理
example_sentence: Having finished sorting the batch of applications, the admissions team sent out acceptance letters.
sentence_zh: 在完成分類申請書的一批材料後，招生團隊寄出了錄取通知書。

definition_zh: (名) 洗澡；浴室　(動) 洗澡；沐浴
example_sentence: After finishing homework, taking a bath helps students relax and sleep better.
sentence_zh: 完成功課後，洗澡可以幫助學生放鬆並睡得更好。

definition_zh: (動) 洗澡；沐浴　(動) 浸泡；浸入
example_sentence: Only after bathing in the warm ocean water does the tired swimmer feel completely relaxed.
sentence_zh: 只有在溫暖的海水中沐浴後，疲憊的游泳者才感到完全放鬆。

definition_zh: (名) 浴室；衛生間　(名) 廁所；洗手間
example_sentence: The bathroom that we renovated last summer is now very comfortable.
sentence_zh: 我們去年夏天翻新的浴室現在非常舒適。

definition_zh: (名) 接力棒；指揮棒
example_sentence: The relay team passed the baton to complete the race successfully.
sentence_zh: 接力隊傳遞接力棒以成功完成比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 營；（軍隊的）一營　(名) 一大群；大批
example_sentence: The infantry battalion marched through the city streets during the military parade.
sentence_zh: 步兵營在軍事遊行中穿過城市街道。

definition_zh: (名) 麵糊；打者　(動) 連續猛擊；傷害
example_sentence: The baseball batter stepped up to the plate with confidence and hit a home run.
sentence_zh: 棒球打者充滿信心地踏上打擊區，並打出了全壘打。

definition_zh: (形) 破舊的；受傷的　(動) 反覆敲打；毆打
example_sentence: Although the old book was battered from years of reading, it remained a treasure to the collector.
sentence_zh: 雖然這本舊書因為多年閱讀而破舊，但它對收藏者來說仍是珍寶。

definition_zh: (名) 電池；電池組　(名) 一連串；連續
example_sentence: Having run out of batteries, the remote control stopped working during the movie.
sentence_zh: 電池用完後，遙控器在電影播放中停止運作。

definition_zh: (名) 戰鬥；戰役　(動) 奮力對抗；搏鬥
example_sentence: The soldiers who fought in the battle showed incredible courage and determination.
sentence_zh: 在那場戰鬥中奮力作戰的士兵展現了令人難以置信的勇氣和決心。

definition_zh: (名) 戰場；戰地
example_sentence: If soldiers prepare well before entering the battlefield, they will have a better chance of winning the battle.
sentence_zh: 如果士兵在進入戰場前準備充分，他們將有更好的機會贏得這場戰役。

definition_zh: (動) 大聲責罵；狠狠訓斥
example_sentence: The coach bawled out the team for their careless mistakes during the game.
sentence_zh: 教練因為球隊在比賽中的粗心錯誤而狠狠訓斥他們。

definition_zh: (名) 海灣；灣　(動) 包圍；圍住
example_sentence: Sailors used the bay to anchor boats and protect them from storms.
sentence_zh: 水手們利用海灣來停泊船隻並保護它們免受風暴侵襲。

definition_zh: (名) 刺刀；槍刀　(動) 用刺刀刺；用刀戳
example_sentence: Soldiers attached bayonets to their rifles before charging into battle.
sentence_zh: 士兵在衝鋒前將刺刀裝在步槍上。

definition_zh: (名) 市集；巴紮　(名) 慈善販賣會
example_sentence: While shopping at the bazaar, many students found affordable clothes and vintage books.
sentence_zh: 當在市集購物時，許多學生找到了平價衣服和二手書。

definition_zh: (片) 為…增光；使…感到光榮
example_sentence: Having won the national science competition, Maria was a credit to her school and family.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞贏得全國科學競賽，為她的學校和家庭增光。

definition_zh: (片) 暗示；致敬于　(動) 向...致敬；暗指
example_sentence: The museum's new exhibition, which is a nod to classic cinema, attracts many film enthusiasts.
sentence_zh: 這個博物館的新展覽向經典電影致敬，吸引了許多電影愛好者。

definition_zh: (助動) 能夠；能；可以
example_sentence: After practicing for months, the students were able to pass the difficult exam.
sentence_zh: 經過幾個月的練習，學生們能夠通過這場困難的考試。

definition_zh: (動) 全神貫注於；沉浸在
example_sentence: If Maria were not absorbed in her smartphone, she would notice the beautiful sunset.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪麗亞沒有全神貫注於手機，她就會注意到美麗的日落。

definition_zh: (動) 被改編成；被調整以適應　(形) 適應的；改編的
example_sentence: The novel was adapted for television and became very popular.
sentence_zh: 這部小說被改編成電視劇，變得非常受歡迎。

definition_zh: (動) 受…影響；受…患病
example_sentence: Affected by heavy rain, the outdoor concert was postponed to next weekend.
sentence_zh: 受到大雨的影響，戶外演唱會被推遲到下週末。

definition_zh: (動) 追求；想要　(動) 在...之後；接著發生
example_sentence: After the company announced the new product, competitors were quick to be after the same technology.
sentence_zh: 在公司發布新產品後，競爭者立即想要獲得相同的技術。

definition_zh: (動) 即將到達；馬上來
example_sentence: Hardly had the meeting started when the director was along with important news.
sentence_zh: 會議才剛開始，主任便隨即帶著重要消息到來。

definition_zh: (動) 在附近；存在　(動) 陪伴；隨侍
example_sentence: The teacher who is around the classroom helps students understand difficult grammar concepts.
sentence_zh: 在教室附近的老師幫助學生理解困難的文法概念。

definition_zh: (動) 為...感到羞愧；為...感到害臊
example_sentence: Failing the exam made Sarah study harder to be ashamed of nothing.
sentence_zh: 考試不及格讓莎拉更加用功，目的是不再為任何事感到羞愧。

definition_zh: (動) 與…有關聯；與…有連繫
example_sentence: Smoking is strongly associated with serious health problems and early death.
sentence_zh: 吸菸與嚴重的健康問題和早逝有很強的關聯。

definition_zh: (片) 不在家；外出　(片) 缺席；不在
example_sentence: My parents will be away for two weeks on vacation next month.
sentence_zh: 我的父母下個月將外出度假兩週。

definition_zh: (片) 恢復健康；重新站起來；恢復正常生活
example_sentence: After recovering from surgery, Maria was finally back on her feet, returning to work and enjoying her daily activities.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞從手術中恢復後，終於重新站起來，回到工作崗位並享受日常活動。

definition_zh: (動) 以…為基礎；根據　(動) 建立在…之上
example_sentence: Based on recent survey data, the school's new curriculum redesigns student learning paths more effectively.
sentence_zh: 根據最近的調查數據，學校的新課程重新設計了學生的學習路徑，效果更好。

definition_zh: (動片) 被祝福；擁有幸運
example_sentence: Students blessed with supportive families often achieve greater academic success than those without such encouragement.
sentence_zh: 被擁有支持家庭祝福的學生通常比沒有這種鼓勵的學生取得更大的學業成功。

definition_zh: (片語) 充滿；洋溢著
example_sentence: If the festival were held next month, the entire stadium would be bursting with excited fans.
sentence_zh: 如果節慶在下個月舉辦，整個體育館將會充滿興奮的粉絲。

definition_zh: (動) 能夠；有能力　(形) 有才能的；勝任的
example_sentence: A good student is capable of finishing homework independently without help.
sentence_zh: 一個好學生能夠獨立完成功課而不需要幫助。

definition_zh: (動) 分類；歸類
example_sentence: New students take placement tests to be classified as advanced or intermediate English learners.
sentence_zh: 新生參加分班考試以便被歸類為進階或中級英語學習者。

definition_zh: (動) 由…組成；由…構成
example_sentence: The human body is composed of water, protein, and minerals in different amounts.
sentence_zh: 人體由水、蛋白質和礦物質以不同的比例組成。

definition_zh: (動) 由…組成；包含
example_sentence: Because the school orchestra is comprised of talented musicians from different grades, it performs at many competitions throughout the year.
sentence_zh: 因為學校管弦樂隊是由來自不同年級的天才音樂家組成的，所以它全年在許多比賽中表演。

definition_zh: (動) 被判有罪；被定罪
example_sentence: Convicted of fraud, the businessman lost his job and reputation.
sentence_zh: 因欺詐被定罪，這位商人失去了工作和聲譽。

definition_zh: (片語) 非常喜歡；對...著迷
example_sentence: Soccer fans who are crazy about the sport attend every match and collect player cards.
sentence_zh: 那些對足球著迷的球迷參加每場比賽，並收集選手卡。

definition_zh: (片語) 適合；勝任　天生適合做某事
example_sentence: Working with children requires patience, and Sarah is cut out for teaching.
sentence_zh: 與孩子一起工作需要耐心，莎拉天生適合教書。

definition_zh: (動) 傷心；難過　被切割；被粉碎
example_sentence: If parents criticized their children harshly, the children would be cut up for weeks.
sentence_zh: 如果父母嚴厲批評孩子，孩子就會難過好幾個星期。

definition_zh: (動) 依靠；取決於　(片) 依賴；依存
example_sentence: Student success depends on consistent study habits and teacher support.
sentence_zh: 學生的成功取決於持續的讀書習慣和老師的支持。

definition_zh: (片) 致力於；獻身於
example_sentence: Devoted to improving her English skills, Maria studied hard every evening after school.
sentence_zh: 瑪莉亞致力於提升英文能力，每晚放學後都認真讀書。

definition_zh: (片) 患病；支持；贊同
example_sentence: Because Mark was down with the flu, he stayed home and rested for a week.
sentence_zh: 因為馬克患了流感，他待在家裡休息了一週。

definition_zh: (動) 心情低落；沮喪　(動) 減少；下降
example_sentence: Never before has morale been down as much as it was after the exam results were announced.
sentence_zh: 從未像公布考試成績後那樣，士氣下降得如此之多。

definition_zh: (片) 渴望；急於
example_sentence: Students who are eager to improve their English often practice speaking every day.
sentence_zh: 渴望進步的學生經常每天練習說英文。

definition_zh: (動) 背叛；欺騙　(動) 違背；不忠於
example_sentence: The politician promised to protect workers' rights but chose to be false to his campaign pledge in order to gain corporate support.
sentence_zh: 那位政治人物承諾保護勞工權益，但為了獲得企業支持，選擇背叛他的競選承諾。

definition_zh: (動) 熟悉；認識　(形容詞片語) 熟悉的；親近的
example_sentence: After working at the library for three months, Maria became familiar with the catalog system and helped new volunteers efficiently.
sentence_zh: 在圖書館工作三個月後，瑪麗亞熟悉了編目系統，並有效地幫助新志工。

definition_zh: (動) 厭倦；受夠　(動) 對…感到不耐煩
example_sentence: After waiting two hours for the delayed bus, most passengers were fed up with the poor service.
sentence_zh: 在公車延誤兩小時後，大多數乘客對糟糕的服務感到厭倦。

definition_zh: (動) 充滿；裝滿
example_sentence: As the concert began, the stadium was filled with excited fans cheering loudly.
sentence_zh: 當演唱會開始時，體育館充滿了興奮的粉絲大聲歡呼。

definition_zh: (片) 緊盯不放；目不轉睛
example_sentence: Students who are glued to their phones during class miss important lessons.
sentence_zh: 在課堂上緊盯手機不放的學生會錯過重要的課程。

definition_zh: (片) 長期存在；持久不衰
example_sentence: If artificial intelligence continues advancing, smart robots will be here to stay in factories.
sentence_zh: 如果人工智慧持續進步，智慧機器人將會長期存在於工廠中。

definition_zh: (片) 是…的所在地；是…的棲息地
example_sentence: Taiwan is home to many unique species of birds and insects.
sentence_zh: 台灣是許多獨特鳥類和昆蟲的棲息地。

definition_zh: (動) 沉浸；全神貫注
example_sentence: Students read novels to be immersed in different cultures and worlds.
sentence_zh: 學生閱讀小說是為了沉浸在不同的文化和世界中。

definition_zh: (動) 在...裡面；參與　(動) 流行；時髦
example_sentence: Online shopping is in, and many teenagers enjoy buying clothes through mobile apps.
sentence_zh: 網路購物很流行，許多青少年喜歡通過手機應用程式購買衣服。

definition_zh: (動片) 被稱為；被認為
example_sentence: As one of the most important philosophers in history, Confucius is known as the founder of Confucianism.
sentence_zh: 身為歷史上最重要的哲學家之一，孔子被稱為儒家思想的創始人。

definition_zh: (動) 因…而聞名；以…著稱
example_sentence: Known for its delicious night market food, Taipei attracts millions of tourists every year.
sentence_zh: 因以美味夜市小吃聞名，台北每年吸引數百萬遊客。

definition_zh: (片語) 毫無疑問；確信無疑
example_sentence: The evidence presented in court left the jury with no doubt about the defendant's guilt.
sentence_zh: 法庭上呈現的證據讓陪審團毫無疑問地相信被告有罪。

definition_zh: (片) 很可能會；容易會
example_sentence: Students who study hard are likely to pass the CSAT exam successfully.
sentence_zh: 認真讀書的學生很可能會成功通過學測考試。

definition_zh: (動) 位於；坐落於
example_sentence: If the library were located closer to campus, students would study there more often.
sentence_zh: 如果圖書館位於靠近校園的地方，學生就會更常在那裡讀書。

definition_zh: (片) 尋求；打算　(片) 想要；尋找
example_sentence: Many companies are looking to hire new graduates this summer.
sentence_zh: 許多公司今年夏天打算錄用應屆畢業生。

definition_zh: (片) 非常喜歡；著迷於
example_sentence: Being mad about photography, Sarah spent hours editing her photos after school.
sentence_zh: 因為對攝影著迷，莎拉放學後花了好幾小時編輯她的照片。

definition_zh: (片) 由…組成；由…構成
example_sentence: Because the human body is made up of water, staying hydrated remains essential for students studying late.
sentence_zh: 因為人體由水組成，所以熬夜讀書的學生補充水分很重要。

definition_zh: (動) 由...組成；構成　(動) 編造；虛構
example_sentence: Not only oxygen but also nitrogen make up most of Earth's atmosphere.
sentence_zh: 不僅氧氣，還有氮氣構成了地球大氣的大部分。

definition_zh: (動) 由...製成；用...製作
example_sentence: The chocolate cake that is made with dark chocolate tastes really delicious.
sentence_zh: 用黑巧克力製作的巧克力蛋糕嚐起來真的很美味。

definition_zh: (片語) 注定要；應該；被用來做
example_sentence: This textbook is meant to help students prepare for the CSAT exam thoroughly.
sentence_zh: 這本教科書的目的是幫助學生充分準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (動片) 幾乎不可能；差不多是不可能的
example_sentence: Finishing the project by tomorrow is next to impossible without extra help from the team.
sentence_zh: 沒有團隊的額外幫助，明天完成這個專案幾乎是不可能的。

definition_zh: (片) 對...不陌生；很熟悉...　(片) 經常接觸或經歷...
example_sentence: Sarah is no stranger to hard work, having studied for hours every day.
sentence_zh: 莎拉對辛苦工作不陌生，她每天都花好幾小時念書。

definition_zh: (片) 不進行；未開始　(片) 沒有約定；未成立
example_sentence: The concert is not on because the singer fell ill, so the tickets will be refunded.
sentence_zh: 因為歌手生病了，演唱會沒有舉辦，所以門票將被退款。

definition_zh: (動) 沉迷於；著迷於　(形) 被迷住的；執著的
example_sentence: Obsessed with improving grades, many students study late into the night before exams.
sentence_zh: 沉迷於提高成績，許多學生在考試前深夜仍在讀書。

definition_zh: (動) 是；成為　(介) 的；關於
example_sentence: The new science fiction novel, which is of great interest to teenagers, won several awards.
sentence_zh: 這部新科幻小說對青少年很有吸引力，贏得了好幾個獎項。

word: be off to a good start
definition_zh: (片) 開始得很好；有良好的開局
example_sentence: If the new marketing campaign is off to a good start, the company will invest more in advertising next quarter.
sentence_zh: 如果新的行銷活動開局良好，公司將在下一季度投入更多廣告費用。

definition_zh: (片) 出發；離開　(片) 停止；關閉　(片) 不舒服；生病
example_sentence: The school trip is off because of heavy rain tomorrow.
sentence_zh: 因為明天下大雨，校外教學取消了。

definition_zh: (動片) 談論；說起　(動片) 想要表達；暗示
example_sentence: Sarah kept talking about climate change to raise awareness among her classmates.
sentence_zh: 莎拉一直談論氣候變遷，目的是要提高同學們的環保意識。

definition_zh: (片) 站起來；恢復健康　(片) 準備好；有能力
example_sentence: After resting for a week, the injured athlete was back on her feet and ready to compete.
sentence_zh: 休息一週後，受傷的運動員恢復了健康，準備好參賽。

definition_zh: (動) 進行中；開始　(動) 穿著；戴著
example_sentence: Once the concert is on, thousands of fans will gather at the stadium.
sentence_zh: 一旦音樂會開始進行，數千名粉絲就會聚集在體育館。

definition_zh: (動) 被...所困擾；飽受...折磨
example_sentence: Plagued with constant injuries throughout the season, the basketball team struggled to maintain their winning record.
sentence_zh: 在整個賽季中飽受傷痛困擾，籃球隊努力維持他們的勝績紀錄。

definition_zh: (動) 對…感到滿意；為…高興
example_sentence: The teacher was pleased with the student's essay, which showed clear improvement.
sentence_zh: 老師對這位學生的作文感到滿意，那篇作文顯示出明顯的進步。

definition_zh: (動) 對…負責；為…承擔責任
example_sentence: The marketing team is responsible for creating the new advertising campaign.
sentence_zh: 行銷團隊負責創作新的廣告活動。

definition_zh: (形) 富有的；豐富的　(動) 使富有；充滿
example_sentence: If Taiwan's agricultural products were rich in organic nutrients, farmers would sell them at premium prices.
sentence_zh: 如果臺灣的農產品富含有機營養，農民就會以溢價出售。

definition_zh: (動) 根植於；源自於
example_sentence: Many environmental problems are rooted in industrialization and overconsumption.
sentence_zh: 許多環境問題根植於工業化和過度消費。

definition_zh: (動) 被…打動；被…吸引　(動) 被…擊中；被…碰撞
example_sentence: Struck by the film's powerful message, the audience sat in silence for minutes.
sentence_zh: 被這部電影強有力的信息打動，觀眾沉默地坐了幾分鐘。

definition_zh: (助動) 應該；被期望；據說
example_sentence: Since the exam is next Monday, all students are supposed to review their notes every evening.
sentence_zh: 由於考試在下週一，所有學生應該每天晚上複習他們的筆記。

definition_zh: (片) 務必；一定要
example_sentence: Not only should students be sure to review grammar before the CSAT, but they must also practice reading comprehension daily.
sentence_zh: 學生不僅務必在學測前複習文法，更應該每天練習閱讀理解。

definition_zh: (動) 忠於；保持一致　(動) 信守；遵守
example_sentence: The athlete who was true to her training plan achieved excellent results at the Olympics.
sentence_zh: 那位忠於訓練計畫的運動員在奧運會上取得優異成績。

definition_zh: (片) 表示能力或責任：勝任；應該　(片) 取決於；由...決定
example_sentence: Studying hard is necessary to be up to the CSAT challenge this year.
sentence_zh: 努力讀書是為了能應付今年學測的挑戰。

definition_zh: (片) 非常喜歡；熱衷於
example_sentence: My younger brother is wild about playing basketball after school every day.
sentence_zh: 我弟弟放學後每天都熱衷於打籃球。

definition_zh: (片) 擔心得要命；急得不得了
example_sentence: Her parents were worried sick when she didn't come home after midnight.
sentence_zh: 當她午夜後還沒回家時，她的父母擔心得要命。

definition_zh: (名) 海灘；沙灘
example_sentence: When summer arrives, many students go to the beach to swim and relax.
sentence_zh: 當夏天來臨時，許多學生去海灘游泳和放鬆。

definition_zh: (名) 海灘前景；濱海區　(形) 面向海灘的；靠近海邊的
example_sentence: Located on the beachfront, the resort offers guests stunning ocean views and direct access to pristine sand.
sentence_zh: 坐落在濱海區的度假村為遊客提供了令人驚豔的海景，以及直接通往原始沙灘的通道。

definition_zh: (名) 珠子；珠粒　(動) 形成珠粒；用珠子裝飾
example_sentence: The necklace, which features colorful beads that sparkle in sunlight, was a gift.
sentence_zh: 那條項鍊具有在陽光下閃閃發光的彩色珠子，是一份禮物。

definition_zh: (名) 獵犬；小獵犬
example_sentence: If the beagle were not so energetic, training it to obey commands would become much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果這隻獵犬不那麼精力充沛，訓練它服從命令會變得容易得多。

definition_zh: (名) 鳥嘴；喙
example_sentence: The parrot's colorful beak helps it crack hard nuts easily.
sentence_zh: 鸚鵡彩色的鳥嘴幫助牠輕易地啃破堅果。

definition_zh: (名) 光線；光束　(動) 發光；照射　(名) 梁；橫樑
example_sentence: The lighthouse uses a powerful beam to guide ships safely into the harbor at night.
sentence_zh: 燈塔使用強力光束在夜間引導船隻安全進入港口。

definition_zh: (名) 豆；豆類　(名) 豆莢
example_sentence: Coffee beans from South America taste rich and smooth to many people.
sentence_zh: 來自南美洲的咖啡豆對許多人來說嚐起來濃郁而順滑。

definition_zh: (片) 逼近；施加壓力　(片) 全力衝刺；竭力推進
example_sentence: As the deadline approached, the project manager bore down on the team to finish the report on time.
sentence_zh: 隨著截止日期臨近，專案經理施加壓力要求團隊按時完成報告。

definition_zh: (動) 對...有影響；與...相關　(動) 承受；承擔
example_sentence: Having gathered solid evidence, the new research bore on climate change policy for years to come.
sentence_zh: 已蒐集到確鑿證據，這項新研究對未來多年的氣候變遷政策產生了影響。

definition_zh: (動) 證實；證明　支持；確認
example_sentence: The evidence that the detective found bore out the victim's testimony during the trial.
sentence_zh: 偵探找到的證據證實了受害者在審判中的證詞。

definition_zh: (動) 在困難中堅持；忍耐度過
example_sentence: Despite facing financial difficulties, the family managed to bear up under the pressure and stayed together.
sentence_zh: 儘管面臨經濟困難，這個家庭設法在壓力下堅持下去，並保持團結。

definition_zh: (動) 撐住；堅持　(動) 忍耐；承受
example_sentence: If the team bore up under pressure, they would win the championship.
sentence_zh: 如果球隊在壓力下能夠堅持，他們就會贏得冠軍。

definition_zh: (動) 忍耐；耐心等待
example_sentence: Please bear with me while I fix this computer problem.
sentence_zh: 請耐心等待我修好這個電腦問題。

definition_zh: (動) 作證；見證　(片) 證明；表明
example_sentence: Having witnessed the accident firsthand, the reporter could bear witness to what actually happened that day.
sentence_zh: 親眼目睹這場意外，這位記者能夠為當天實際發生的事作證。

definition_zh: (動) 承受；忍受　(動) 攜帶；運送　(名) 熊
example_sentence: Although the project was difficult, the team bore the challenges until completion.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個專案很困難，但團隊一直承受著挑戰直到完成。

definition_zh: (形) 可忍受的；可以承受的
example_sentence: Seldom bearable are the summer temperatures in Taipei without air conditioning.
sentence_zh: 沒有冷氣，台北的夏季溫度很少是可以忍受的。

definition_zh: (名) 鬍子；鬚髮　(動) 留鬍子
example_sentence: The old man whose beard was long and grey looked like a wise philosopher.
sentence_zh: 那位鬍子又長又灰白的老人看起來像一位睿智的哲學家。

definition_zh: (形) 有鬍鬚的；長鬍子的
example_sentence: The old man grew a bearded face to look more authoritative.
sentence_zh: 那位老人留鬍鬚以顯得更有權威感。

definition_zh: (名) 舉止；態度　(名) 關係；影響　(名) 方向；方位
example_sentence: The student's confident bearing and honest attitude impressed the college admission officers.
sentence_zh: 那位學生自信的舉止和誠實的態度給大學招生官留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 野獸；凶惡的人　(形) 野蠻的；殘忍的
example_sentence: The wild beast emerged from the forest and frightened the hikers.
sentence_zh: 那隻野獸從森林裡出現，嚇到了登山者。

definition_zh: (動) 打敗；擊敗　(動) 炎熱逼人；驕陽似火
example_sentence: As the summer sun beat down relentlessly, students sought shelter under the school's covered walkway.
sentence_zh: 當夏日驕陽似火地炙烤著大地時，學生們在校園走廊下尋求遮蔽。

definition_zh: (動) 打敗；擊敗　(動) 超越；勝過
example_sentence: Beating out her competitors in the science fair, Sarah won first prize and a full scholarship.
sentence_zh: 在科學展覽中擊敗對手後，莎拉贏得了一等獎和全額獎學金。

definition_zh: (動) 痛打；毆打　(動) 擊敗；打敗
example_sentence: The bully who beat up the freshman was finally caught by school security.
sentence_zh: 那個毆打新生的惡霸最後被校警抓住了。

definition_zh: (動) 打敗；擊敗　(動) 敲打；打　(名) 節拍；拍子
example_sentence: If the team practices harder, they will beat their rivals in the championship match.
sentence_zh: 如果球隊練習更努力，他們將在錦標賽中擊敗對手。

definition_zh: (動) 打敗；擊敗　(形) 筋疲力盡的；疲憊不堪的
example_sentence: The basketball team beaten by their rivals played with great determination next season.
sentence_zh: 那支被對手擊敗的籃球隊在下一季比賽時展現了堅定的決心。

definition_zh: (名) 打；擊打　(動) 打敗；超越
example_sentence: Professional athletes train hard every day to improve beating their competitors in competitions.
sentence_zh: 職業運動員每天努力訓練是為了在比賽中擊敗對手。

definition_zh: (名) 美容師；化妝師
example_sentence: The beautician at the salon gave Emma a fresh haircut and makeup before her graduation party.
sentence_zh: 沙龍的美容師在艾瑪畢業派對前幫她做了新髮型和化妝。

definition_zh: (形) 美麗的；漂亮的　(形) 極好的；令人愉快的
example_sentence: Although the weather was cold, the sunset looked beautiful as we watched from the hilltop.
sentence_zh: 雖然天氣很冷，但當我們從山頂觀看時，日落看起來很美麗。

definition_zh: (動) 美化；裝飾　(動) 改善外觀；點綴
example_sentence: Having beautified the old classroom with colorful posters and plants, students felt proud of their workspace.
sentence_zh: 經過美化老教室，貼上彩色海報和擺放植物後，學生們為自己的學習空間感到自豪。

definition_zh: (名) 美麗；美　(形) 美麗的；漂亮的
example_sentence: The beauty that attracts many tourists is found in Taiwan's natural mountains.
sentence_zh: 吸引許多遊客的美麗風景位於台灣的天然山脈中。

definition_zh: (片) 努力工作；持續不懈地工作
example_sentence: Despite facing setbacks, the research team beavered away until they discovered a breakthrough.
sentence_zh: 儘管遭遇挫折，研究團隊仍然努力不懈地工作，直到他們發現了一項突破。

definition_zh: (動) 以…為基礎；建立在…之上
example_sentence: If the research were based on more reliable data, the conclusion would be more trustworthy.
sentence_zh: 如果這項研究是以更可靠的數據為基礎，結論就會更值得信賴。

definition_zh: (介) 因為；由於
example_sentence: The school cancelled classes because of the heavy rain yesterday.
sentence_zh: 因為昨天下大雨，學校取消了課程。

definition_zh: (連) 因為；由於　(介) 因為；由於
example_sentence: Being tired because of the exam, the student fell asleep immediately after arriving home.
sentence_zh: 由於考試疲勞，這名學生一回到家就立刻睡著了。

definition_zh: (動) 招手；召喚　(動) 吸引；誘惑
example_sentence: As the teacher beckoned students to come forward, everyone stood up and moved toward the front.
sentence_zh: 當老師招手叫學生往前走時，每個人都站起來走向前面。

definition_zh: (動) 變成；成為　(動) 適合；相配
example_sentence: Never before has technology become such an important part of student life.
sentence_zh: 從未有過科技像現在這樣成為學生生活如此重要的一部分。

definition_zh: (動) 躺下睡覺；在某處安頓下來
example_sentence: The soldiers who bed down in the camp must wake up early tomorrow.
sentence_zh: 在營地裡躺下睡覺的士兵們必須明天早起。

definition_zh: (動) 移植幼苗；定植　(動) 排列展示
example_sentence: The gardener planted seedlings in rows to bed out the flowers for spring blooming.
sentence_zh: 園丁將幼苗排成一行來定植這些春天開花的花朵。

definition_zh: (名) 床；床位　(動) 種植；放置
example_sentence: Every morning, Sarah gets out of bed and opens the bedroom window to let fresh air in.
sentence_zh: 每天早上，莎拉起床並打開臥室的窗戶讓新鮮空氣進來。

definition_zh: (名) 臭蟲；床蝨
example_sentence: Hotels must clean rooms carefully to prevent bedbugs from spreading to guests.
sentence_zh: 飯店必須仔細清潔房間，防止臭蟲傳播給客人。

definition_zh: (名) 床上用品；被褥　(名) 鋪底物；墊層
example_sentence: After the heavy rain flooded the basement, the family replaced all the bedding and furniture that got damaged.
sentence_zh: 在大雨淹沒地下室後，全家更換了所有受損的床上用品和傢俱。

definition_zh: (名) 基岩；基礎　(形) 根本的；基本的
example_sentence: Forming the foundation of modern democracy, bedrock principles protect citizens' basic rights.
sentence_zh: 構成現代民主基礎的基本原則保護公民的基本權利。

definition_zh: (名) 臥室；寢室
example_sentence: The bedroom that my parents decorated last month is very comfortable and spacious.
sentence_zh: 我父母上個月裝飾的臥室非常舒適寬敞。

definition_zh: (名) 睡眠時間；就寢時間
example_sentence: If children follow a regular bedtime routine, their sleep quality will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果孩子遵循規律的就寢時間安排，他們的睡眠品質將會顯著改善。

definition_zh: (名) 蜜蜂；蜂
example_sentence: A bee collects nectar from flowers to make honey.
sentence_zh: 蜜蜂從花朵採集花蜜來製造蜂蜜。

definition_zh: (動) 加強；增強　(動) 改善；改進
example_sentence: The company hired more engineers to beef up its technology team.
sentence_zh: 公司雇用更多工程師來加強技術團隊。

definition_zh: (名) 牛肉　(名) 牢騷；怨言
example_sentence: Grilled beef and fresh vegetables make a delicious dinner for the whole family.
sentence_zh: 烤牛肉和新鮮蔬菜為全家人準備了一頓美味的晚餐。

definition_zh: (名) 嗶聲；警告聲　(動) 發出嗶聲；鳴笛
example_sentence: As the alarm clock beeped loudly, students woke up startled from their afternoon nap.
sentence_zh: 當鬧鐘發出大聲嗶聲時，學生們從午睡中被驚醒。

definition_zh: (名) 啤酒；酒
example_sentence: Having finished his homework, Tom enjoyed a cold beer with friends at the weekend.
sentence_zh: 完成功課後，湯姆在週末與朋友享受冰涼的啤酒。

definition_zh: (名) 甜菜；甜菜根
example_sentence: The beet salad that my mother prepared for dinner was both nutritious and delicious.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽為晚餐準備的甜菜沙拉既營養又美味。

definition_zh: (名) 甲蟲；金龜子
example_sentence: The colorful beetle crawled slowly across the garden path this morning.
sentence_zh: 那隻色彩繽紛的甲蟲今早在花園小徑上慢慢爬行。

definition_zh: (動) 發生；降臨　(動) 遭遇；碰上
example_sentence: If a typhoon were to befall the island, thousands of residents would evacuate immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果颱風降臨這座島嶼，數千位居民會立即撤離。

definition_zh: (片語) 轉眼間；不知不覺中
example_sentence: Before we knew it, the summer vacation was already over.
sentence_zh: 不知不覺中，暑假就已經結束了。

definition_zh: (片) 還沒意識到就已經；轉眼間就
example_sentence: Before knowing it, the summer vacation passed, leaving students unprepared for the new school term.
sentence_zh: 還沒意識到就已經，暑假就過去了，使學生對新學期毫無準備。

definition_zh: (副) 不久；很快；在不遠的將來
example_sentence: Before long, the new shopping mall will open near Taipei Station, attracting many visitors.
sentence_zh: 不久之後，新的購物中心將在台北車站附近開幕，吸引許多遊客。

definition_zh: (介) 在…之前；尚未　(連) 在…之前；還沒有
example_sentence: Never before had the school won such an important national competition.
sentence_zh: 學校從未在此之前贏得過如此重要的全國比賽。

definition_zh: (副) 提前；事先　(形) 預先的；事前的
example_sentence: The students who prepared their notes beforehand performed better on the exam.
sentence_zh: 那些事先準備好筆記的學生在考試中表現得更好。

definition_zh: (動) 與...交朋友；和...成為朋友
example_sentence: Marcus joined the debate club to befriend students interested in public speaking.
sentence_zh: 馬庫斯加入辯論社來與對公開演講感興趣的學生交朋友。

definition_zh: (片) 循環論證；用待證的論點來證明結論
example_sentence: Saying that smoking is harmful because it damages health begs the question without providing scientific evidence.
sentence_zh: 說吸菸有害因為它傷害健康，這是循環論證，沒有提供科學證據。

definition_zh: (動) 懇求；乞求　(動) 討飯；乞討
example_sentence: The homeless man begged for food and spare change on the street.
sentence_zh: 那名無家可歸的男子在街上懇求食物和零錢。

definition_zh: (名) 乞丐；乞討者　(動) 乞討；懇求
example_sentence: As the beggar sat on the street corner, passersby occasionally dropped coins into his cup.
sentence_zh: 當乞丐坐在街角時，路人偶爾會把硬幣投入他的杯子。

definition_zh: (動) 開始；著手　(名) 開始；起始
example_sentence: Beginning the project early, the students completed it ahead of schedule.
sentence_zh: 學生們及早開始這個專案，因此提前完成了它。

definition_zh: (名) 初學者；新手　(形) 初級的；適合初學者的
example_sentence: Students who are beginners in English should practice speaking every day.
sentence_zh: 初學英文的學生應該每天練習說英語。

definition_zh: (名) 開始；初期　(動) 開始；著手
example_sentence: If students start studying early, they will improve their English before the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 如果學生早點開始唸書，他們會在學測前進步。

definition_zh: (介) 代表；為了　(名) 利益；好處
example_sentence: The lawyer spoke on behalf of his client during the trial.
sentence_zh: 律師在審判中代表他的委託人發言。

definition_zh: (動) 表現；舉止　(動) 守規矩；表現良好
example_sentence: Students attend classes on time to behave well and earn teacher respect.
sentence_zh: 學生按時上課是為了表現良好並獲得老師的尊重。

definition_zh: (名) 行為；舉止　(動) 表現；舉止得當
example_sentence: Good behavior in class and respectful attitude toward teachers help students succeed academically.
sentence_zh: 課堂上的良好行為與對老師的尊重態度有助於學生的學業成功。

definition_zh: (形) 行為的；舉止的　(形) 與行為有關的
example_sentence: Because behavioral problems often appear early, parents should address them before school begins.
sentence_zh: 因為行為問題通常在早期就會出現，家長應該在上學前處理這些問題。

definition_zh: (名) 行為；舉止　(動) 表現；舉止
example_sentence: Having behaved badly in class, the student was required to write a reflection letter.
sentence_zh: 在課堂上表現不佳後，這名學生被要求寫反思信。

definition_zh: (名) 龐然大物；巨獸
example_sentence: The corporation, which operates as a behemoth in the tech industry, controls millions of users worldwide.
sentence_zh: 這家公司是科技產業中的龐然大物，它控制著全球數百萬的使用者。

definition_zh: (名) 吩咐；命令　(動) 吩咐；要求
example_sentence: At the principal's behest, the student council organized a charity event.
sentence_zh: 在校長的吩咐下，學生會組織了一場慈善活動。

definition_zh: (介) 在…後面；背後　(副) 在後面；落後
example_sentence: If the project were not behind schedule, the team would finish before summer vacation.
sentence_zh: 如果這項專案沒有落後進度，團隊就會在暑假前完成。

definition_zh: (動) 看見；注視　觀看；眼見
example_sentence: Behold the beautiful sunset over the Pacific Ocean.
sentence_zh: 看啊，太平洋上那美麗的夕陽。

definition_zh: (名) 存在；生命　(動) 是；存在　(片) 作為；當作
example_sentence: Being a high school student, Sarah must balance studying with extracurricular activities every day.
sentence_zh: 作為一名高中生，莎拉每天必須在讀書和課外活動之間取得平衡。

definition_zh: (名) 信念；信仰　(動) 相信；認為
example_sentence: Although many students doubt their abilities, belief in hard work often leads to success.
sentence_zh: 雖然許多學生懷疑自己的能力，但對努力的信念往往會帶來成功。

definition_zh: (形) 可信的；令人信服的　(形) 能接受的；合理的
example_sentence: Hardly believable was the news that the student won the national science competition.
sentence_zh: 那名學生贏得全國科學競賽的消息幾乎令人難以置信。

definition_zh: (動) 相信；信任　(動) 信仰；支持
example_sentence: Students who believe in their own abilities can overcome academic challenges more easily.
sentence_zh: 相信自己能力的學生能夠更容易地克服學術挑戰。

definition_zh: (片) 信不信由你；不管怎樣　相信與否
example_sentence: To pass the CSAT, students study hard every day believe it or not.
sentence_zh: 為了通過學測，學生們每天努力讀書，信不信由你。

definition_zh: (動) 相信；認為　(動) 信任；接受
example_sentence: Many students believe that studying hard and practicing regularly leads to exam success.
sentence_zh: 許多學生相信努力讀書和定期練習會導致考試成功。

definition_zh: (名) 信徒；信仰者　(名) 信任者；相信的人
example_sentence: Religious believers gather at the temple every Sunday morning.
sentence_zh: 信徒們每個星期天上午聚集在廟裡。

definition_zh: (動) 貶低；輕視　(動) 縮小；減少
example_sentence: Although the coach praised the team's effort, he belittled their poor defensive skills during the post-game review.
sentence_zh: 雖然教練稱讚球隊的努力，但他在賽後檢討時貶低了他們糟糕的防守能力。

definition_zh: (名) 鈴；鐘　(動) 敲鈴；發出鈴聲
example_sentence: Ringing loudly, the school bell announced the end of class.
sentence_zh: 發出響亮聲音的學校鐘聲宣布下課了。

definition_zh: (形) 好戰的；好鬥的　(名) 交戰國；好鬥的人
example_sentence: The belligerent nations that refused to negotiate prolonged the devastating conflict for years.
sentence_zh: 拒絕談判的好戰國家使這場災難性的衝突延長了多年。

definition_zh: (名) 腹部；肚子　(形) 腹部的；前面的
example_sentence: If eating too much candy, your belly will become round and uncomfortable.
sentence_zh: 如果吃太多糖果，你的肚子會變圓而且感到不舒服。

definition_zh: (動) 屬於；是...的成員　(動) 放在；存放
example_sentence: This book belongs to the school library.
sentence_zh: 這本書屬於學校圖書館。

definition_zh: (動) 屬於；是…的成員　(動) 應該在；適合
example_sentence: To belong to a sports club helps high school students build friendship and develop teamwork skills.
sentence_zh: 加入運動社團有助於高中學生建立友誼並培養團隊合作能力。

definition_zh: (名) 個人物品；行李　(名) 財產；所有物
example_sentence: Before leaving the dormitory, students must pack all their belongings into suitcases carefully.
sentence_zh: 離開宿舍前，學生必須小心地將所有個人物品打包進行李箱。

definition_zh: (形) 心愛的；摯愛的　(名) 心愛的人；摯愛
example_sentence: Although the beloved teacher retired last year, students still visit and remember him fondly.
sentence_zh: 雖然摯愛的老師去年退休了，學生們仍然經常去拜訪並懷念他。

definition_zh: (介) 在...下方；低於　(副) 在下面；往下
example_sentence: Having fallen below the passing grade, the student decided to study harder for the next exam.
sentence_zh: 成績跌至及格線以下後，這名學生決定為下次考試更加用功。

definition_zh: (動) 大聲唱出；放聲歌唱
example_sentence: The singer who belted out the national anthem received thunderous applause from the audience.
sentence_zh: 那位放聲唱國歌的歌手從觀眾那裡獲得了雷鳴般的掌聲。

definition_zh: (動) 繫上安全帶；做好準備　(片) 做好心理準備；準備迎接困難
example_sentence: Before driving to school, students must belt up to stay safe on the road.
sentence_zh: 開車上學前，學生必須繫上安全帶以保持道路安全。

definition_zh: (名) 腰帶；皮帶　(動) 用帶子束；打擊
example_sentence: If Mark didn't wear his safety belt, he would get seriously injured in car accidents.
sentence_zh: 如果Mark沒有繫上安全帶，他會在車禍中受到嚴重傷害。

definition_zh: (名) 長凳；板凳　(名) 運動隊的替補席
example_sentence: The players sat on the bench waiting for their turn to play.
sentence_zh: 球員坐在替補席上等待上場的機會。

definition_zh: (名) 基準；標準　(動) 以…為基準；比較
example_sentence: Setting a clear benchmark, the company measured its quarterly sales against competitors' performance.
sentence_zh: 公司設定明確的基準，將季度銷售與競爭對手的表現進行比較。

definition_zh: (動) 彎下；俯身　(動片) 彎腰的；俯身的
example_sentence: As the teacher bent down to pick up the chalk, the student whispered to his classmate.
sentence_zh: 當老師彎下身撿粉筆時，學生向他的同學低聲說話。

definition_zh: (動) 彎腰；俯身　(動) 弄彎；使屈曲
example_sentence: Not only did the old teacher bend over to help the fallen student, but also stayed with him until help arrived.
sentence_zh: 老師不僅彎腰幫助跌倒的學生，還一直陪著他直到救援人員到達。

definition_zh: (動) 彎曲；折彎　(名) 彎曲；轉彎
example_sentence: The road that bends sharply ahead is dangerous during heavy rain.
sentence_zh: 前方急速彎曲的這條道路在大雨時很危險。

definition_zh: (形) 可彎曲的；易彎的
example_sentence: The yoga instructor chose bendable mats to accommodate students of different flexibility levels.
sentence_zh: 瑜伽老師選擇可彎曲的墊子以適應不同柔軟度學生的需求。

definition_zh: (形) 易彎曲的；柔軟的　(形) 有許多彎道的；蜿蜒的
example_sentence: The bendy ruler and flexible plastic tube made the science experiment easier for students.
sentence_zh: 易彎曲的尺子和柔軟的塑膠管讓學生的科學實驗變得更簡單。

definition_zh: (介) 在…下面；低於　(動) 在…之下
example_sentence: The treasure was buried beneath the old oak tree in the garden.
sentence_zh: 寶藏被埋在花園裡那棵老橡樹的下面。

definition_zh: (形) 有益的；有利的　(形) 受惠的；受益的
example_sentence: Since exercise is beneficial to health, many students start jogging regularly.
sentence_zh: 既然運動對健康有益，許多學生開始定期慢跑。

definition_zh: (名) 受益人；受惠者　(形) 獲得利益的；受益的
example_sentence: Receiving the scholarship, the beneficiary student felt grateful and motivated.
sentence_zh: 獲得獎學金，這位受益學生感到感激且受到激勵。

definition_zh: (名) 好處；益處　(動) 使獲益；使受益
example_sentence: The new gym facility, which provides many benefits to students who exercise regularly, opens next month.
sentence_zh: 這個新健身房設施為定期運動的學生提供許多好處，下個月開幕。

definition_zh: (形) 慈善的；仁慈的　(形) 友善的；善良的
example_sentence: If a wealthy businesswoman were more benevolent, her company could help many struggling communities.
sentence_zh: 如果一位富有的女商人更仁慈的話，她的公司就能幫助許多困苦的社區。

definition_zh: (形) 良性的；無害的　(形) 溫和的；親切的
example_sentence: The doctor said the tumor was benign and not dangerous.
sentence_zh: 醫生說那個腫瘤是良性的，不危險。

definition_zh: (動) 使失去；奪走　(動) 使喪失親人
example_sentence: The accident bereaved the family to lose their beloved father forever.
sentence_zh: 那場意外使這個家庭失去了心愛的父親，永遠無法挽回。

definition_zh: (形) 被剝奪的；喪失的　(動) 奪去；剝奪
example_sentence: Losing his job left him bereft of confidence and hope for the future.
sentence_zh: 失去工作使他喪失了信心和對未來的希望。

definition_zh: (名) 貝雷帽；軍帽
example_sentence: Although the soldier wore a beret proudly, the summer heat made him uncomfortable.
sentence_zh: 雖然士兵驕傲地戴著貝雷帽，但夏日炎熱讓他感到不適。

definition_zh: (名) 漿果；莓果
example_sentence: Having picked fresh berries from the garden, Sarah made a delicious jam for her family.
sentence_zh: 莎拉從花園採摘新鮮漿果後，為家人製作了美味的果醬。

definition_zh: (介) 在…旁邊；靠近　(副) 在旁邊；另外
example_sentence: The girl who sits beside me in class always shares her notes.
sentence_zh: 在課堂上坐在我旁邊的女孩總是分享她的筆記。

definition_zh: (介) 除了...之外；此外　(副) 而且；另外
example_sentence: Besides studying hard, joining clubs helps students develop skills and confidence.
sentence_zh: 除了努力讀書之外，參加社團還能幫助學生發展技能和自信。

definition_zh: (動) 圍攻；包圍　(動) 持續困擾；纏擾
example_sentence: If enemy forces besieged the city, residents would need emergency supplies immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果敵軍圍攻該城市，居民將需要立即的緊急物資。

definition_zh: (片) 最重要的是；最好的是
example_sentence: The vacation was fun, but best of all, we made new friends.
sentence_zh: 這個假期很有趣，但最重要的是，我們交到了新朋友。

definition_zh: (形) 最好的；最優秀的　(副) 最；最好地　(名) 最好的人或事
example_sentence: Having studied hard all semester, Maria achieved the best score in her chemistry class.
sentence_zh: 整個學期認真讀書後，瑪莉亞在化學課獲得全班最高分。

definition_zh: (動) 賦予；授予　(動) 贈送；給予
example_sentence: As the principal bestows the scholarship, every student recognizes the importance of academic excellence.
sentence_zh: 當校長頒發獎學金時，每位學生都認識到學業成績的重要性。

definition_zh: (名) 賭注；打賭　(動) 打賭；賭錢　(動) 確信；預料
example_sentence: Never bet money on something without understanding the risks involved.
sentence_zh: 絕不要在沒有了解風險的情況下就賭錢。

definition_zh: (動) 背叛；洩露　(動) 暴露；顯露
example_sentence: The spy who betrayed his country was sentenced to life imprisonment.
sentence_zh: 那位背叛國家的間諜被判終身監禁。

definition_zh: (名) 背叛；違背　(動) 背叛；出賣
example_sentence: His friend's betrayal forced him to reconsider who to trust.
sentence_zh: 他朋友的背叛迫使他重新考慮相信誰。

definition_zh: (副) 更好的是；更進一步說
example_sentence: Studying abroad helps improve English skills; better still, students gain valuable cultural experience.
sentence_zh: 出國留學有助於提高英語能力；更好的是，學生還能獲得寶貴的文化經驗。

definition_zh: (形) 更好的；較佳的　(副) 更好地；更佳地　(動) 改善；使變好
example_sentence: Studying with friends is better than studying alone for the exam.
sentence_zh: 和朋友一起讀書比獨自讀書更適合準備考試。

definition_zh: (介) 在…之間；在（兩者）之中　(副) 在中間；相隔地
example_sentence: Between studying for the exam and working part-time, Maria barely has time to rest.
sentence_zh: 在準備考試和兼職工作之間，瑪麗亞幾乎沒有時間休息。

definition_zh: (名) 飲料；飲品
example_sentence: Containing high sugar levels, the beverage attracted many young customers at the school cafeteria.
sentence_zh: 含有高糖分的飲料在學校食堂吸引了許多年輕顧客。

definition_zh: (動) 當心；提防　(片) 小心；留意
example_sentence: Beware of websites that ask for personal information, which can lead to identity theft.
sentence_zh: 當心那些要求個人資訊的網站，這些網站可能導致身分被盜。

definition_zh: (動) 使困惑；使迷茫　(動) 使無所適從；難住
example_sentence: If the confusing instructions bewilder the students, the teacher will explain again clearly.
sentence_zh: 如果令人困惑的指示使學生感到困惑，老師將會清楚地再次解釋。

definition_zh: (形) 困惑的；不知所措的　(形) 迷茫的；茫然的
example_sentence: The bewildered student stared at the difficult math problem without any idea.
sentence_zh: 那位困惑的學生呆呆地盯著這道難題，毫無頭緒。

definition_zh: (形) 令人困惑的；使人不知所措的
example_sentence: The math teacher assigned a bewildering homework problem to challenge advanced students.
sentence_zh: 數學老師出了一道令人困惑的作業題來挑戰進階學生。

definition_zh: (介) 超過；超越　(形) 無法達到的；遠處的
example_sentence: Her talent for painting goes far beyond what most students achieve in high school.
sentence_zh: 她的繪畫天賦遠超過大多數高中學生所能達到的程度。

definition_zh: (形) 一年兩次的；每半年一次的　(副) 一年兩次；每半年一次
example_sentence: The company holds biannual meetings so that employees receive updates on progress twice yearly.
sentence_zh: 該公司舉辦一年兩次的會議，以便員工每年能兩次收到進展更新。

definition_zh: (副) 一年兩次；每半年一次
example_sentence: Having published the magazine biannually for five years, the company decided to increase frequency to monthly.
sentence_zh: 該公司一年出版兩次雜誌已有五年，之後決定改為每月出版。

definition_zh: (名) 偏見；偏差　(動) 使有偏見；影響　(形) 偏頗的；有偏差的
example_sentence: The judge dismissed the case because he recognized a bias that could influence his fair judgment.
sentence_zh: 這位法官駁回了案件，因為他認識到一種可能影響他公正判決的偏見。

definition_zh: (形) 有偏見的；不公平的　(動) 使產生偏見；影響判斷
example_sentence: The judge's personal opinions made the court decision biased against the defendant.
sentence_zh: 法官的個人意見使法庭判決對被告有偏見。

definition_zh: (名) 聖經；聖書
example_sentence: If students read the Bible regularly, they would understand Western culture more deeply.
sentence_zh: 如果學生定期閱讀聖經，他們會更深入地理解西方文化。

definition_zh: (名) 參考書目；書籍目錄　(名) 著作清單；出版資料
example_sentence: The research paper includes a detailed bibliography listing all sources.
sentence_zh: 這篇研究論文包含詳細的參考書目，列出所有來源。

definition_zh: (名) 自行車；腳踏車
example_sentence: Riding a bicycle to school every morning, Sarah stays fit and saves money on transportation.
sentence_zh: 莎拉每天早上騎自行車上學，既保持健康又節省交通費用。

definition_zh: (名) 出價；投標　(動) 出價；投標
example_sentence: As the auction progressed, competing collectors bid higher prices whenever the painting's value increased.
sentence_zh: 隨著拍賣進行，每當畫作價值上升時，競爭的收藏家就出更高的價。

definition_zh: (形) 大的；巨大的　(形) 重要的；著名的
example_sentence: Not only does this project require big effort, but it also demands careful planning.
sentence_zh: 這個專案不僅需要大量的努力，而且還需要仔細的規劃。

definition_zh: (名) 固執己見；偏見　(名) 狹隘的思想
example_sentence: The discrimination that stems from religious bigotry has caused countless conflicts throughout history.
sentence_zh: 源於宗教偏見的歧視在歷史上引發了無數衝突。

definition_zh: (名) 自行車；腳踏車　(動) 騎自行車
example_sentence: Many students ride bikes to school to save money and stay healthy.
sentence_zh: 許多學生騎自行車上學以省錢並保持健康。

definition_zh: (形) 雙邊的；涉及兩方的　(形) 相互的；互惠的
example_sentence: The two countries signed a bilateral trade agreement to boost economic cooperation.
sentence_zh: 這兩個國家簽署了一項雙邊貿易協議以促進經濟合作。

definition_zh: (名) 膽汁；膽液　(名) 憤怒；怨恨
example_sentence: The doctor explained that bile helps digest fatty foods in the stomach.
sentence_zh: 醫生解釋膽汁幫助胃部消化脂肪食物。

definition_zh: (名) 帳單；帳款　(名) 鈔票；紙幣　(名) 法案；議案
example_sentence: As soon as the waiter brought the bill, the customer realized the restaurant charged too much.
sentence_zh: 當服務員拿來帳單時，顧客意識到這家餐廳收費過高。

definition_zh: (名) 廣告牌；看板
example_sentence: Standing tall above the highway, the billboard displayed a colorful advertisement for a new smartphone.
sentence_zh: 聳立在高速公路上方的廣告牌展示了一則新智慧型手機的彩色廣告。

definition_zh: (名) 台球；撞球　(形) 台球的；撞球用的
example_sentence: The billiard table that sits in our school's recreation room attracts many students after class.
sentence_zh: 放在我們學校娛樂室裡的台球桌吸引了許多下課後的學生。

definition_zh: (名) 十億；十億個
example_sentence: If the company earns a billion dollars next year, it will become the market leader.
sentence_zh: 如果公司明年賺了十億美元，它將成為市場領導者。

definition_zh: (名) 波浪；浪濤　(動) 翻滾；膨脹
example_sentence: Thick smoke billowed from the burning building during the fire.
sentence_zh: 火災中，濃煙從燃燒的建築物翻滾而出。

definition_zh: (名) 垃圾桶；廢棄物桶　(動) 將...放入垃圾桶；丟棄
example_sentence: Remember to bin your plastic bottles to keep the classroom clean and tidy.
sentence_zh: 記得把塑膠瓶丟進垃圾桶，以保持教室乾��淨整潔。

definition_zh: (動) 綁；束縛　(動) 裝訂；釘成冊
example_sentence: The teacher asked students to bind their research papers with colorful covers before submission.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生在繳交前將研究報告用彩色封面綁好。

definition_zh: (形) 有約束力的；必須遵守的　(名) 裝訂；束縛
example_sentence: Binding as the contract is, both companies must follow its terms carefully.
sentence_zh: 雖然合約具有約束力，但兩家公司必須仔細遵守其條款。

definition_zh: (動) 暴飲暴食；狂歡　(名) 一陣狂歡；暴食期
example_sentence: Having binged on junk food all weekend, Sarah felt too guilty to eat dessert Monday.
sentence_zh: 在週末狂吃了垃圾食物後，莎拉週一感到太內疚而不敢吃甜點。

definition_zh: (名) 賓果遊戲；中獎　(感) 太好了；成功了
example_sentence: The lottery result, which was announced yesterday, turned out to be bingo for many lucky winners.
sentence_zh: 昨天公布的彩票結果對許多幸運的贏家來說結果是中獎。

definition_zh: (名) 雙筒望遠鏡；雙眼鏡
example_sentence: The biology students used binoculars to observe birds in the forest during their field trip.
sentence_zh: 生物課學生在戶外教學時用雙筒望遠鏡觀察森林裡的鳥類。

definition_zh: (名) 生物化學；生化
example_sentence: If students studied biochemistry more thoroughly, understanding how enzymes work would become much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果學生更徹底地研究生物化學，理解酶如何運作就會變得容易得多。

definition_zh: (形) 可生物分解的；可自然分解的
example_sentence: Biodegradable plastic bags break down naturally in the environment.
sentence_zh: 可生物分解的塑膠袋在環境中會自然分解。

definition_zh: (名) 生物氣體；沼氣
example_sentence: Produced from decomposing organic waste, biogas provides renewable energy for rural communities across Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 由分解的有機廢物產生，生物氣體為台灣各地農村社區提供再生能源。

definition_zh: (名) 傳記；自傳　(名) 傳記文學；生平記錄
example_sentence: Although the biography was long and detailed, students found it inspiring because the author described the subject's challenges honestly.
sentence_zh: 雖然這部傳記既冗長又詳細，但學生們發現它很激勵人心，因為作者誠實地描述了主角的挑戰。

definition_zh: (形) 生物的；生物學的　(形) 生理的；有機的
example_sentence: Only after biological research advanced could scientists understand human genetics better.
sentence_zh: 只有在生物研究進步之後，科學家才能更好地了解人類遺傳學。

definition_zh: (名) 生物學家；從事生物學研究的科學家
example_sentence: The biologist who discovered this new species spent ten years studying rainforest ecosystems.
sentence_zh: 發現這個新物種的生物學家花了十年時間研究雨林生態系統。

definition_zh: (名) 生物學；生物　(形) 生物的；生物學的
example_sentence: Students study biology to understand how living organisms function and interact.
sentence_zh: 學生們學習生物學是為了理解生物如何運作和相互作用。

definition_zh: (名) 活體組織檢查；生檢
example_sentence: The doctor performed a skin biopsy to check for cancer cells.
sentence_zh: 醫生進行皮膚活體組織檢查以檢測癌細胞。

definition_zh: (名) 生物素；維生素B7
example_sentence: Biotin helps strengthen hair and nails naturally.
sentence_zh: 生物素能幫助自然強化頭髮和指甲。

definition_zh: (名) 鳥；鳥類
example_sentence: As the bird flew across the sky, students watched it through the classroom window.
sentence_zh: 當那隻鳥飛過天空時，學生們透過教室窗戶觀看它。

definition_zh: (名) 鳥浴盆；鳥類沐浴池
example_sentence: Sitting in the garden, the birdbath filled with fresh water attracts many colorful birds.
sentence_zh: 放在花園裡、盛著清水的鳥浴盆吸引了許多五彩繽紛的鳥類。

definition_zh: (名) 高爾夫球少於標準桿一桿的成績；小鳥　(動) 在高爾夫球中以少於標準桿一桿的成績完成一洞
example_sentence: The golfer who scored a birdie on the difficult hole felt extremely proud of the achievement.
sentence_zh: 在那個困難球洞上打出小鳥球的高爾夫球手對這個成績感到非常驕傲。

definition_zh: (名) 賞鳥者；觀察鳥類的人
example_sentence: If a birdwatcher observes rare species in the forest, the discovery will contribute to environmental research.
sentence_zh: 如果賞鳥者在森林裡發現稀有鳥類，這項發現將有助於環境研究。

definition_zh: (名) 出生；誕生　(名) 血統；出身
example_sentence: The baby's birth was celebrated by the entire family with joy.
sentence_zh: 這個嬰兒的出生讓整個家族欣喜若狂地慶祝。

definition_zh: (名) 生日；誕生日
example_sentence: Students often plan parties to celebrate their birthday with classmates.
sentence_zh: 學生經常計畫派對來和同學慶祝他們的生日。

definition_zh: (名) 餅乾；小餅
example_sentence: Having a cup of tea with chocolate biscuits is a perfect afternoon treat.
sentence_zh: 喝茶配巧克力餅乾是完美的下午茶享受。

definition_zh: (動) 平分；二等分　(動) 切成兩部分
example_sentence: When the architect bisected the building's floor plan, the two halves became perfectly symmetrical.
sentence_zh: 當建築師平分建築物的平面圖時，兩個部分變得完全對稱。

definition_zh: (名) 一點；少量　(動) 咬；叮咬
example_sentence: Bitten by mosquitoes during the camping trip, the students applied medicine immediately.
sentence_zh: 在露營旅行中被蚊子叮咬後，學生們立即塗抹藥物。

definition_zh: (動) 搞砸；弄糟
example_sentence: The project that the team bitched up last month delayed the entire company's launch schedule.
sentence_zh: 團隊上個月搞砸的那個專案延誤了整個公司的上市時程。

definition_zh: (名) 母狗；粗魯的女人　(動) 抱怨；發牢騷
example_sentence: The neighbor's bitch gave birth to six puppies last week.
sentence_zh: 鄰居的母狗上週生了六隻小狗。

definition_zh: (動) 咬；叮　(名) 咬；一口
example_sentence: If the dog bit the mailman, the owner would face serious consequences.
sentence_zh: 如果那隻狗咬了郵差，狗主人會面臨嚴重後果。

definition_zh: (形) 刺痛的；尖銳的　(動) 咬；叮咬
example_sentence: The biting cold wind made everyone rush indoors quickly.
sentence_zh: 刺痛的寒風讓每個人都急忙跑進室內。

definition_zh: (形) 苦的；痛苦的　(副) 極其；非常
example_sentence: Tasting the bitter medicine, the patient finally felt better after days of suffering.
sentence_zh: 嚐著苦藥，那名患者在數天的痛苦後終於感到好轉。

definition_zh: (形) 奇怪的；古怪的　(形) 離奇的；荒誕的
example_sentence: Although the movie's bizarre plot confused many viewers, critics praised its originality and creative storytelling.
sentence_zh: 雖然這部電影古怪的情節讓許多觀眾困惑，但評論家稱讚它的原創性和創意故事。

definition_zh: (動) 昏迷；停電　(動) 審查刪除；遮蔽
example_sentence: Not only did the city's power fail, but the entire region blacked out during the storm.
sentence_zh: 不僅城市停電，整個地區在暴風雨期間都陷入了停電狀態。

definition_zh: (形) 黑色的；黑暗的　(名) 黑色；黑人
example_sentence: The student wore a black uniform that matched the school's dress code.
sentence_zh: 那名學生穿著符合校服規定的黑色制服。

definition_zh: (名) 黑板；粉筆板
example_sentence: Teachers use blackboards to write lessons and help students learn new concepts.
sentence_zh: 老師用黑板寫課程內容以幫助學生學習新概念。

definition_zh: (名) 停電；斷電　(名) 昏迷；失意識
example_sentence: The sudden blackout left the entire neighborhood without electricity for three hours.
sentence_zh: 突如其來的停電讓整個社區三小時沒有電力供應。

definition_zh: (名) 鐵匠；打鐵工人
example_sentence: The blacksmith forged a strong iron gate for the old temple.
sentence_zh: 鐵匠為那座古廟鍛造了一扇堅固的鐵門。

definition_zh: (名) 膀胱；儲存器
example_sentence: Before drinking too much water during the exam, students should empty their bladder so they can concentrate.
sentence_zh: 在考試中喝太多水之前，學生應該先排空膀胱，這樣才能專心應考。

definition_zh: (名) 刀片；葉片　(動) 用刀片切割
example_sentence: Sharpening the blade regularly, the chef prepared vegetables for tonight's dinner.
sentence_zh: 主廚經常磨利刀片，為今晚的晚餐準備蔬菜。

definition_zh: (動) 責備；指責　(名) 責任；過錯
example_sentence: The coach blamed the players who made careless mistakes in the game.
sentence_zh: 教練責備了在比賽中犯了粗心錯誤的球員。

definition_zh: (形) 應受責備的；值得責罪的
example_sentence: If the manager had checked the safety rules, the accident would not have been blameworthy.
sentence_zh: 如果經理當時檢查了安全規則，這起事故就不會是應受責備的了。

definition_zh: (動) 焯；用沸水快速煮　(動) 變蒼白；退色
example_sentence: Blanching vegetables briefly in boiling water helps preserve their bright color.
sentence_zh: 將蔬菜在沸水中快速焯一下有助於保持其鮮豔的顏色。

definition_zh: (形) 乏味的；單調的　(形) 溫和的；淡的
example_sentence: Adding spices to bland dishes helps to make meals more delicious.
sentence_zh: 在乏味的菜餚中加入香料有助於讓食物更好吃。

definition_zh: (動) 暫時忘記；記憶空白　(動) 昏迷；失去意識
example_sentence: During the final exam, Sarah suddenly blanked out and couldn't remember any formulas.
sentence_zh: 在期末考試中，莎拉突然記憶空白，想不起任何公式。

definition_zh: (形) 空白的；無字跡的　(名) 空白；空白處　(動) 忘記；(記憶)一片空白
example_sentence: As the exam time ran out, the student's mind went blank while trying to answer the final question.
sentence_zh: 當考試時間用完時，學生在試著回答最後一題時，腦中一片空白。

definition_zh: (名) 毛毯；毛巾　(動) 覆蓋；包裹　(形) 全面的；籠統的
example_sentence: Covered by a thick blanket, the sleeping child looked warm and peaceful throughout the cold winter night.
sentence_zh: 被厚毛毯覆蓋著，這個睡著的孩子在寒冷的冬夜看起來溫暖而安詳。

definition_zh: (副) 茫然地；無表情地　呆滯地；空洞地
example_sentence: The student stared blankly at the exam paper, which contained questions far beyond comprehension.
sentence_zh: 這名學生茫然地盯著考卷，那份考卷包含遠超理解範圍的題目。

definition_zh: (動) 大聲播放；刺耳地發出　out 發出
example_sentence: The loudspeaker blared out an emergency announcement during the school assembly.
sentence_zh: 學校集會時，擴音器大聲播放緊急通告。

definition_zh: (動) 發出刺耳的聲音；大聲鳴響　(名) 刺耳的噪音；響亮的聲音
example_sentence: If the alarm clock blared every morning, the entire dormitory would wake up immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果鬧鐘每天早上都發出刺耳的聲音，整個宿舍會立即醒來。

definition_zh: (動) 發射升空；爆炸飛出
example_sentence: The rocket will blast off at dawn tomorrow morning.
sentence_zh: 火箭將在明天早晨發射升空。

definition_zh: (名) 爆炸；氣流　(動) 炸毀；破壞　(片) 太棒了
example_sentence: Blasting through the tunnel, the construction team completed the project ahead of schedule.
sentence_zh: 通過炸毀隧道，施工隊提前完成了該項目。

definition_zh: (形) 明目張膽的；公然的　(形) 露骨的；刺眼的
example_sentence: Although the student's cheating was blatant, the teacher decided to give him one more chance.
sentence_zh: 雖然學生的作弊行為十分明目張膽，但老師決定再給他一次機會。

definition_zh: (副) 公然地；明目張膽地　毫不隱瞞地
example_sentence: Seldom have students cheated so blatantly during the CSAT exam without facing consequences.
sentence_zh: 學生很少在學測中如此公然作弊而不用面對後果。

definition_zh: (動) 猛烈射擊；快速開槍　(動) 熱情地做某事
example_sentence: The soldiers, who blazed away at the target that was moving rapidly across the field, finally hit their mark.
sentence_zh: 士兵們猛烈射擊那快速穿過田野的目標，最後終於擊中了。

definition_zh: (動) 燃燒；熊熊燃燒　(名) 火焰；烈火
example_sentence: Firefighters worked through the night to blaze a safe path for residents.
sentence_zh: 消防隊員整夜工作，為居民開闢一條安全路徑。

definition_zh: (名) 漂白劑；漂白水　(動) 漂白；使褪色　(形) 蒼白的；淡白的
example_sentence: The laundry room's bleach smell mixed with soap and detergent filled the air.
sentence_zh: 洗衣房的漂白劑味道與肥皂和洗衣粉混合的氣味充滿了空氣。

definition_zh: (形) 荒涼的；冷清的　(形) 黯淡的；無希望的
example_sentence: The bleak winter landscape made students feel sad and lonely.
sentence_zh: 荒涼的冬季景色讓學生們感到難過和寂寞。

definition_zh: (動) 流血；出血　(動) 滲出；洩漏
example_sentence: As the wound bleeds, the nurse applied pressure to stop the bleeding immediately.
sentence_zh: 當傷口流血時，護士立即按壓以止血。
