definition_zh: (名) 瑕疵；污點　(動) 損害；使有瑕疵　(形) 有瑕疵的；不完美的
example_sentence: Blemishing the mirror's surface, the dust particles reduced its clarity and shine.
sentence_zh: 灰塵顆粒損害了鏡子表面，降低了它的清晰度和光澤。

definition_zh: (動) 混合；融合　(名) 混合物；混合品
example_sentence: The coffee blend that baristas prefer is one combining beans from different regions.
sentence_zh: 咖啡師偏好的咖啡混合品是一種結合來自不同地區豆子的產品。

definition_zh: (名) 果汁機；攪拌機
example_sentence: If fresh fruit and yogurt are placed in the blender, a healthy smoothie will be made quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果將新鮮水果和優格放入果汁機，健康的冰沙很快就會製成。

definition_zh: (片) 祝你健康；保佑你
example_sentence: When someone sneezes, people often say 'bless you' to show kindness.
sentence_zh: 當有人打噴嚏時，人們經常說「祝你健康」來表示友善。

definition_zh: (動) 祝福；祝願　(動) 讚美；頌揚
example_sentence: Parents hope to bless their children with good health and success.
sentence_zh: 父母希望祝福他們的孩子擁有健康和成功。

definition_zh: (形) 幸福的；蒙福的　(形) 受祝福的；神聖的
example_sentence: Feeling blessed and grateful, the student thanked everyone who helped accomplish the dream.
sentence_zh: 感到幸福和感謝，這名學生感謝所有幫助他實現夢想的人。

definition_zh: (名) 祝福；恩惠　(動) 祝福；保佑
example_sentence: Although studying is difficult, having supportive parents is truly a blessing that many students appreciate.
sentence_zh: 雖然讀書很困難，但擁有支持的父母確實是許多學生珍視的祝福。

definition_zh: (名) 枯萎病；病害　(動) 使枯萎；摧毀　(形) 枯萎的；被摧毀的
example_sentence: Blighted by severe drought, the wheat crops failed to produce enough grain for harvest.
sentence_zh: 因嚴重乾旱而枯萎，小麥作物未能生產足夠的穀物供收割。

definition_zh: (形) 盲的；看不見的　(動) 使看不見；蒙住眼睛
example_sentence: The student who was blind in one eye still achieved excellent grades on the exam.
sentence_zh: 那位一隻眼睛看不見的學生仍在考試中取得優異成績。

definition_zh: (動) 蒙住眼睛；遮蔽視線　(名) 眼罩；蒙眼布
example_sentence: Playing the blindfold game at the party, students had to guess who was touching them.
sentence_zh: 在派對上玩蒙眼遊戲時，學生們必須猜測誰在碰他們。

definition_zh: (名) 百葉窗；窗簾　(動) 使失明；蒙蔽
example_sentence: If Maria closed the blinds, the afternoon sunlight would not disturb her study.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪麗亞關上百葉窗，午後的陽光就不會打擾她讀書。

definition_zh: (動) 眨眼；閃爍　(名) 眨眼；一瞬間
example_sentence: The neon sign blinks on and off throughout the night.
sentence_zh: 霓虹燈招牌整夜閃爍著開和關。

definition_zh: (動) 陶醉；沉浸在快樂中
example_sentence: Relaxing on the beach and blissing out, Maya forgot all her exam stress completely.
sentence_zh: 瑪雅在沙灘上放鬆並沉浸在快樂中，完全忘記了所有考試壓力。

definition_zh: (名) 極樂；幸福　(形) 極樂的；幸福的
example_sentence: Although studying for the CSAT is stressful, passing the exam brings bliss to many students.
sentence_zh: 雖然為學測讀書很有壓力，但通過考試為許多學生帶來極樂。

definition_zh: (形) 幸福的；極樂的　(形) 喜樂的；快樂的
example_sentence: Never has a vacation felt more blissful than our trip to Kenting last summer.
sentence_zh: 沒有任何假期比去年夏天去墾丁的旅行更令人感到幸福。

definition_zh: (副) 幸福地；快樂地　(副) 毫不在乎地；不知不覺地
example_sentence: The couple walked through the garden blissfully unaware of the storm approaching behind them.
sentence_zh: 這對情侶漫步於花園中，幸福地毫不知覺身後逼近的暴風雨。

definition_zh: (名) 極端的幸福；完全的喜悅
example_sentence: Many students study hard to achieve blissfulness after passing the entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力讀書以便在通過大學入學考試後獲得極端的幸福。

definition_zh: (名) 水泡；泡沫　(動) 起泡；長水泡
example_sentence: Wearing new shoes without socks caused a painful blister on his heel.
sentence_zh: 穿著新鞋而沒穿襪子導致他的腳跟長出一個疼痛的水泡。

definition_zh: (名) 暴風雪；猛烈的風雪
example_sentence: The blizzard made driving on the mountain road extremely dangerous yesterday.
sentence_zh: 昨天的暴風雪使得在山路上開車變得極其危險。

definition_zh: (動) 腫脹；膨脹　(名) 腫脹；脹氣
example_sentence: As the bread rose in the oven, the dough began to bloat significantly.
sentence_zh: 當麵包在烤箱裡發酵時，麵團開始明顯膨脹。

definition_zh: (形) 臃腫的；腫脹的　(形) 浮誇的；冗長的
example_sentence: Feeling bloated after eating too much dessert, the student struggled to focus during the afternoon class.
sentence_zh: 吃了太多甜點後感到臃腫，這位學生在下午課程中難以集中注意力。

definition_zh: (形) 腹脹的；浮腫的　(名) 腹脹；脹滿
example_sentence: The bloating that occurs after eating too much salt is a common digestive problem.
sentence_zh: 吃太多鹽之後發生的腹脹是常見的消化問題。

definition_zh: (名) 集團；聯盟　(名) 板塊；區域
example_sentence: If the Eastern bloc were to dissolve, international politics would change dramatically.
sentence_zh: 如果東方集團瓦解，國際政治將會劇烈改變。

definition_zh: (動) 用東西擋住；阻擋　(動) 粗略勾畫；初步設計
example_sentence: A large truck blocked in the narrow street, preventing cars from passing through.
sentence_zh: 一輛大卡車擋住了狹窄的街道，阻止汽車通過。

definition_zh: (動) 封鎖；阻擋　(動) 隔離；分隔
example_sentence: The government blocked off the entire street to prevent traffic accidents during the parade.
sentence_zh: 政府封鎖整條街道以防止遊行期間發生交通事故。

definition_zh: (動) 擋住；遮蔽　隔離音聲；忽視
example_sentence: Heavy curtains block out the sunlight, helping students sleep better before important exams.
sentence_zh: 厚重的窗簾擋住陽光，幫助學生在重要考試前睡得更好。

definition_zh: (動) 堵塞；阻塞　(動) 擋住；遮住
example_sentence: Because heavy snow blocked up the mountain road, the rescue team had to wait until spring.
sentence_zh: 因為大雪堵塞了山路，救援隊必須等到春天才能前進。

definition_zh: (名) 街區；塊　(動) 阻擋；妨礙　(形) 堵住的；被阻擋的
example_sentence: Blocked by heavy traffic, the delivery truck arrived at the store two hours late.
sentence_zh: 被大量車流阻擋，那輛送貨車晚了兩小時才到達商店。

definition_zh: (名) 封鎖；圍困　(動) 封鎖；阻斷
example_sentence: The naval blockade that prevented supplies from entering the port lasted for several months.
sentence_zh: 阻止補給品進入港口的海上封鎖持續了好幾個月。

definition_zh: (名) 大片電影；暢銷書　(形) 極受歡迎的；票房大賣的
example_sentence: The superhero movie became a blockbuster hit, earning millions at the box office.
sentence_zh: 這部超級英雄電影成為票房大賣的熱門電影，在票房上賺取數百萬美元。

definition_zh: (名) 阻擋；阻止　(動) 阻擋；妨礙
example_sentence: If blocking the entrance were not so difficult, the security guard would prevent more unauthorized visitors.
sentence_zh: 如果阻擋入口不是那麼困難，保安人員就會阻止更多未經授權的訪客。

definition_zh: (名) 部落格；網誌　(動) 在部落格上寫文章
example_sentence: Many students write about their daily life on their personal blog.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在個人部落格上寫關於他們日常生活的文章。

definition_zh: (名) 部落格寫手；網誌作者
example_sentence: Writing engaging posts daily, the blogger built a loyal audience interested in sustainable fashion.
sentence_zh: 每日撰寫有趣的貼文，這位部落格寫手建立了一群忠實的永續時尚愛好者。

definition_zh: (名) 男人；傢伙
example_sentence: Although the bloke seemed quiet at first, he turned out to be quite funny.
sentence_zh: 雖然那個傢伙起初看起來很安靜，但他後來被證明相當有趣。

definition_zh: (形) 金色的；淺色的　(名) 金髮人；淺色
example_sentence: Not only does Sarah have blonde hair, but also her natural charm impresses everyone.
sentence_zh: 莎拉不僅有金色頭髮，而且她的自然魅力給每個人留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 血液；血　(名) 暴力；流血
example_sentence: The donation center needs blood that comes from healthy donors.
sentence_zh: 捐血中心需要來自健康捐獻者的血液。

definition_zh: (名) 獻血車；流動獻血車
example_sentence: The Red Cross operates a bloodmobile to collect donations from local communities.
sentence_zh: 紅十字會運營獻血車以從當地社區收集捐獻。

definition_zh: (名) 流血；死傷　(名) 暴力衝突；殺戮
example_sentence: The two countries signed a peace treaty to prevent further bloodshed and suffering.
sentence_zh: 這兩個國家簽署和平條約以防止進一步的流血和痛苦。

definition_zh: (名) 純種馬；優良血統的動物
example_sentence: The racing farm invested heavily in bloodstock to improve its breeding program.
sentence_zh: 這個賽馬農場投入大筆資金購買純種馬以改進其育種計畫。

definition_zh: (形) 嗜血的；渴望暴力的　(形) 殘忍的；兇狠的
example_sentence: Because the dictator was bloodthirsty, the nation suffered tremendous loss and pain.
sentence_zh: 因為這位獨裁者嗜血成性，國家遭受了巨大的損失和痛苦。

definition_zh: (形) 流血的；血淋淋的　(副) 非常地；很
example_sentence: The bleeding wound required immediate medical attention from doctors.
sentence_zh: 那個流血的傷口需要醫生立即處理。

definition_zh: (動) 開花；盛開　(名) 花朵；花期
example_sentence: The cherry blossoms that bloom in spring are a sight that many Taiwanese tourists travel far to see.
sentence_zh: 在春天盛開的櫻花是許多台灣遊客遠道前往觀賞的景象。

definition_zh: (名) 原始煉鐵爐；古代冶鐵裝置
example_sentence: If ancient metalworkers had constructed a bloomery efficiently, iron production in early societies would have advanced faster.
sentence_zh: 如果古代金屬工人有效地建造了原始煉鐵爐，早期社會的鐵生產就會進展得更快。

definition_zh: (名) 失誤；錯誤　(名) 不小心說出的愚蠢話
example_sentence: The actor made a funny blooper during the live performance yesterday.
sentence_zh: 那位演員昨天在現場演出中犯了一個有趣的失誤。

definition_zh: (名) 花；花朵　(動) 開花；繁榮
example_sentence: Students study hard during winter to watch cherry blossoms blossom in spring.
sentence_zh: 學生們在冬天努力讀書，以便在春天欣賞櫻花盛開。

definition_zh: (形) 開滿花朵的；花朵繁茂的
example_sentence: The blossomy cherry trees along the riverside attracted thousands of visitors during spring festival season.
sentence_zh: 河畔開滿花朵的櫻花樹在春季祭典期間吸引了數千名遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 污點；墨跡　(動) 弄髒；玷污　(動) 吸乾；擦乾
example_sentence: As the ink blot spread across the paper, the student's careful handwriting became completely ruined.
sentence_zh: 當墨跡在紙上擴散時，學生仔細的字跡完全被毀了。

definition_zh: (形) 爛醉的；酩酊大醉的
example_sentence: Having consumed too many beers at the party, Marcus ended up completely blotto and unable to remember anything.
sentence_zh: 在派對上喝了太多啤酒後，馬克思最後完全爛醉，什麼都記不得了。

definition_zh: (名) 女性上衣；襯衫
example_sentence: The white blouse that Sarah wore to the job interview impressed the hiring managers.
sentence_zh: 莎拉穿去工作面試的白色襯衫給聘僱主管留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (動) 吹走；吹散　(動) 給...留下深刻印象；令...驚嘆
example_sentence: The strong wind blew away our tent during the camping trip.
sentence_zh: 露營時，強風吹走了我們的帳篷。

definition_zh: (動) 吹倒；吹倒下　(動) daun 打倒；摧毀
example_sentence: If the typhoon were stronger, it would blow down the old trees in the park.
sentence_zh: 如果颱風更強，它就會吹倒公園裡的老樹。

definition_zh: (動) 突然到達；吹進
example_sentence: A strong wind blew in from the ocean during the storm yesterday.
sentence_zh: 昨天暴風雨期間，一陣強風從海洋吹進來。

definition_zh: (片) 吹散蒸汽；發洩情緒；釋放壓力
example_sentence: Feeling stressed after the exam, many students blow off steam by playing basketball with friends.
sentence_zh: 考試後感到有壓力，許多學生通過和朋友打籃球來發洩情緒。

definition_zh: (動) 取消；放棄　(動) 草率對待；輕視
example_sentence: Because Mark blew off his study plan, he failed the midterm exam badly.
sentence_zh: 因為馬克放棄了他的讀書計畫，他期中考表現得很差。

definition_zh: (動) 吹滅；熄滅　(動) 爆胎；爆裂
example_sentence: Hardly had the birthday candles been lit when the wind blew them out completely.
sentence_zh: 生日蠟燭才點燃，風就幾乎立刻把它們全吹滅了。

definition_zh: (動) 吹過；消散　(動) (爭議等)平息；化解
example_sentence: The scandal that blew over last month barely affected the company's reputation.
sentence_zh: 上月平息的那個醜聞幾乎沒有影響公司的聲譽。

definition_zh: (動) 引爆；炸毀　(動) 充氣；膨脹
example_sentence: The construction crew used explosives to blow up the old building to make space for a new shopping mall.
sentence_zh: 建築工人使用炸藥來炸毀舊建築物，以便為新購物商場騰出空間。

definition_zh: (動) 吹；吹動　(動) 打；打擊　(名) 一擊；打擊
example_sentence: The strong wind blew the fallen leaves across the playground.
sentence_zh: 強風吹著落葉飄過操場。

definition_zh: (名) 鯨脂；脂肪　(動) 哭喊；哭著說話
example_sentence: The whale's thick blubber keeps it warm in cold ocean water.
sentence_zh: 鯨魚厚厚的鯨脂讓它在冷海水中保持溫暖。

definition_zh: (形) 藍色的；藍色　(形) 憂鬱的；沮喪的
example_sentence: Although the sky turned blue after the rain stopped, many students felt sad because the exam results were disappointing.
sentence_zh: 雖然雨停後天空變成藍色，但許多學生因為考試成績令人失望而感到沮喪。

definition_zh: (名) 藍圖；設計圖　(動) 規劃；製定計畫
example_sentence: Following the architect's detailed blueprint, construction workers began assembling the new school building.
sentence_zh: 按照建築師詳細的藍圖，施工人員開始組裝新校舍。

definition_zh: (名) 藍調音樂；憂鬱；悲傷
example_sentence: The blues music, which originated in Africa, deeply influences modern pop songs.
sentence_zh: 起源於非洲的藍調音樂深深影響了現代流行歌曲。

definition_zh: (名) 重大錯誤；失策　(動) 犯大錯；笨拙地行動
example_sentence: If the manager had not corrected that marketing blunder, the company would have lost many customers.
sentence_zh: 如果經理沒有改正那個行銷上的重大失誤，公司就會失去許多客戶。

definition_zh: (形) 鈍的；不尖銳的　(動) 使變鈍；削弱
example_sentence: A blunt knife is less useful for cutting vegetables than a sharp one.
sentence_zh: 鈍刀子不如銳利刀子適合切蔬菜。

definition_zh: (動) 模糊；使不清楚　(名) 模糊的東西；污點
example_sentence: Students often wear sunglasses to blur their vision and avoid the glare.
sentence_zh: 學生常常戴太陽眼鏡來模糊視線，避免眩光。

definition_zh: (形) 模糊的；不清楚的　(動) 使模糊；弄不清
example_sentence: Rain-covered windows and blurred vision made driving dangerous for commuters.
sentence_zh: 被雨覆蓋的窗戶和模糊的視線使通勤者開車危險。

definition_zh: (形) 模糊的；不清楚的　(形) 視線不清的；眼花的
example_sentence: Although the photo was blurry, we could still recognize our friends in it.
sentence_zh: 雖然照片很模糊，我們仍然能認出裡面的朋友。

definition_zh: (動) 脫口而出；突然說出　(動) 衝口說出；未經思考就說
example_sentence: Having blurted out the secret during the meeting, Tom regretted his careless words immediately.
sentence_zh: 湯姆在會議上脫口說出了秘密，他立即為自己的不謹慎感到後悔。

definition_zh: (動) 臉紅；羞紅　(名) 臉紅；羞愧
example_sentence: The student who blushes easily often feels embarrassed during class presentations.
sentence_zh: 那位容易臉紅的學生在課堂報告時經常感到尷尬。

definition_zh: (名) 野豬；公豬
example_sentence: The wild boar herd wandered through the forest searching for food.
sentence_zh: 野豬群在森林裡遊蕩，尋找食物。

definition_zh: (動) 寄宿；將...送去寄宿
example_sentence: If Sarah's parents board out their dog while traveling, the pet would stay at a professional kennel.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉的父母在旅行時將他們的狗送去寄宿，寵物會留在專業的狗舍。

definition_zh: (動) 用木板釘住；封閉　(動) 準備停業；暫停營業
example_sentence: The store owners decided to board up their windows before the typhoon arrived.
sentence_zh: 店主們決定在颱風來臨前用木板釘住窗戶。

definition_zh: (動) 與…同住；搭乘並留宿
example_sentence: Boarding with a local family, the exchange student quickly adapted to Taiwanese culture and made many friends.
sentence_zh: 與當地家庭同住的交換學生很快適應了台灣文化，並交了許多朋友。

definition_zh: (名) 木板；董事會　(動) 登上；上車
example_sentence: As soon as students board the school bus, they must wear seatbelts for safety.
sentence_zh: 當學生登上校車時，他們必須繫安全帶以確保安全。

definition_zh: (動) 吹牛；自誇　(名) 吹牛的話；自誇
example_sentence: Never does Mark boast about his academic achievements, though he ranks first in class.
sentence_zh: 儘管馬克在班上排名第一，但他從不自誇自己的學業成就。

definition_zh: (形) 愛吹牛的；自誇的
example_sentence: The student who made boastful claims about winning first place lost the competition.
sentence_zh: 那位做出自誇聲稱要贏得第一名的學生最後輸了比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 船；小船　(動) 划船；乘船
example_sentence: Many tourists rent a boat to explore the beautiful coastal scenery.
sentence_zh: 許多遊客租一艘船來探索美麗的海岸風景。

definition_zh: (名) 小船；船　(名) 划船；乘船
example_sentence: Sailing a small boat along the river became my favorite weekend hobby.
sentence_zh: 沿著河流划一艘小船成為我最喜歡的週末愛好。

definition_zh: (動) 上下擺動；點頭　(名) 短髮；浮子
example_sentence: The fishing float bobs gently on the water's surface.
sentence_zh: 釣魚的浮子在水面上輕輕上下擺動。

definition_zh: (形) 大膽的；令人印象深刻的　(形) 性感的；誘人的
example_sentence: Although the fashion designer's collection was bodacious, many traditional customers found it too bold for their taste.
sentence_zh: 雖然這位時尚設計師的服裝系列大膽奪目，但許多傳統顧客認為它太前衛了。

definition_zh: (動) 預示；顯示　(名) 預兆；徵兆
example_sentence: Boding trouble ahead, the dark clouds gathered quickly over the city.
sentence_zh: 預示著前方有麻煩，烏雲快速聚集在城市上空。

definition_zh: (形) 身體的；軀體的　(副) 以身體方式；實際上
example_sentence: The athlete, whose bodily strength amazed everyone at the competition, trained for months.
sentence_zh: 那位運動員身體力量驚人，在比賽中令所有人嘆服，他為此訓練了數個月。

definition_zh: (名) 身體；軀體　(名) 屍體；遺體　(名) 團體；組織
example_sentence: If students exercise regularly, their bodies will become much stronger and healthier.
sentence_zh: 如果學生定期運動，他們的身體會變得更強壯和更健康。

definition_zh: (名) 保鏢；護衛
example_sentence: The famous actor hired a bodyguard to protect him from crowds.
sentence_zh: 那位著名演員雇用保鏢來保護他免受人群騷擾。

definition_zh: (動) 使陷入困境；使進度緩慢　(動) 使...停滯不前
example_sentence: Too many assignments bog down students' progress to prepare for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 太多作業會使學生的學測準備進度停滯不前。

definition_zh: (動) 認真投入；埋頭苦幹
example_sentence: After receiving the project deadline, the entire marketing team bogged in to complete the presentation.
sentence_zh: 收到專案截止日期後，整個行銷團隊埋頭苦幹完成簡報。

definition_zh: (動) 陷入；深陷　沉溺於；埋頭做
example_sentence: As soon as the exam finished, students bogged into their summer projects with enthusiasm.
sentence_zh: 考試一結束，學生們就熱情地埋頭做起暑期專案。

definition_zh: (片) 滾開；走開　(片) 已經離開；走掉了
example_sentence: Having bogged off without finishing his homework, Tom faced angry parents at dinner.
sentence_zh: 湯姆已經滾開而沒有完成功課，在晚餐時面臨憤怒的父母。

definition_zh: (名) 沼澤；泥炭地　(動) 陷入；困住
example_sentence: The hiking trail that cuts through the bog becomes dangerous during heavy rainfall.
sentence_zh: 穿過沼澤的登山步道在大雨時變得很危險。

definition_zh: (動) 使困惑；使茫然　(名) 困惑；遊戲
example_sentence: The difficult math problem and its confusing explanation boggled the student's mind completely.
sentence_zh: 那道難的數學題和它令人困惑的解釋完全使學生感到茫然。

definition_zh: (形) 假的；偽造的　(形) 欺騙的；不真實的
example_sentence: If that diploma were bogus, the university would immediately cancel the graduate's degree.
sentence_zh: 如果那張文憑是假的，大學就會立即撤銷該畢業生的學位。

definition_zh: (動) 歸結為；簡化　(動) 濃縮；提取
example_sentence: The main problem boils down to a lack of communication between teams.
sentence_zh: 主要問題歸結為團隊之間缺乏溝通。

definition_zh: (動) 沸騰溢出；失去控制　(動) 情緒爆發；變得憤怒
example_sentence: Boiling over with frustration, the student finally complained about the unfair exam.
sentence_zh: 因沸騰的挫折感而失去控制，那名學生終於抱怨了不公平的考試。

definition_zh: (動) 沸騰；煮沸　(動) 積累；逐漸加重
example_sentence: As tension boiled up between the two classmates, the teacher decided to intervene before things got worse.
sentence_zh: 當兩位同學之間的緊張關係逐漸加重時，老師決定在事情惡化前介入。

definition_zh: (動) 煮沸；沸騰　(名) 沸騰；煮沸
example_sentence: Not only does water boil at different temperatures, but salt also raises the boiling point.
sentence_zh: 水不僅在不同溫度下沸騰，鹽也會提高沸點。

definition_zh: (形) 沸騰的；煮沸的　(名) 煮沸；沸騰
example_sentence: The boiling water that filled the pot was too hot to touch carefully.
sentence_zh: 裝滿鍋子的沸騰水太燙，無法小心觸碰。

definition_zh: (形) 勇敢的；大膽的　(動) 大膽嘗試；冒險
example_sentence: Many students study abroad to gain experience and be bold in facing new challenges.
sentence_zh: 許多學生出國留學為了獲得經驗並勇敢面對新的挑戰。

definition_zh: (動) 支持；鼓勵　增強；提高
example_sentence: Winning the championship match really bolstered up the team's confidence for next season.
sentence_zh: 贏得冠軍賽確實提高了隊伍對下一季的信心。

definition_zh: (動) 支持；鞏固　(名) 長枕；靠墊
example_sentence: The government's new policy bolstered public confidence in the economy.
sentence_zh: 政府的新政策鞏固了公眾對經濟的信心。

definition_zh: (動) 衝出；逃跑　(名) 門栓；閃電
example_sentence: As soon as the door opened, the frightened dog bolted from the house.
sentence_zh: 一打開門，那隻害怕的狗就從房子裡衝了出來。

definition_zh: (名) 炸彈；爆彈　(動) 轟炸；投擲炸彈　(動) 砸；失敗
example_sentence: Bombing the city during wartime caused massive destruction and countless casualties.
sentence_zh: 戰時轟炸該城市造成大規模破壞和無數傷亡。

definition_zh: (動) 轟炸；砲轟　(動) 不斷攻擊；連續提問
example_sentence: Students who are bombarded with excessive homework often struggle to maintain their mental health.
sentence_zh: 被過度功課轟炸的學生往往難以維持心理健康。

definition_zh: (名) 浮誇的言辭；誇大其詞　(形) 浮誇的；誇大的
example_sentence: If the politician's speech contains too much bombast, voters will doubt his sincerity and reject his proposals.
sentence_zh: 如果政治人物的演講包含太多浮誇言辭，選民將懷疑他的真誠並拒絕他的提案。

definition_zh: (名) 轟炸機；轟炸手　(名) 棒球投手
example_sentence: The military bomber dropped supplies to the remote village.
sentence_zh: 那架軍用轟炸機向偏遠村莊投放補給品。

definition_zh: (名) 紐帶；連結　(動) 粘合；結合
example_sentence: Students need to build strong bonds to create a supportive classroom community.
sentence_zh: 學生需要建立牢固的紐帶來創造一個互相支持的班級社群。

definition_zh: (名) 束縛；奴役　(動) 束縛；囚禁
example_sentence: The historical novel describes how slavery and bondage destroyed families across generations.
sentence_zh: 這部歷史小說描述奴役和束縛如何在幾代人中摧毀了家庭。

definition_zh: (名) 建立關係；連結　(動) 結合；黏合
example_sentence: As teenagers spend more time together, bonding between friends becomes stronger and more meaningful.
sentence_zh: 當青少年花費更多時間在一起時，朋友之間的關係變得更強和更有意義。

definition_zh: (動) 趕快學習；集中準備　(動) 複習強化
example_sentence: Having boned up on chemistry formulas, Maria felt confident before the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞集中複習了化學公式後，在學測考試前感到信心滿滿。

definition_zh: (名) 骨頭；骨骼　(動) 剔除骨頭
example_sentence: The chicken bone that the dog buried in the yard was discovered yesterday.
sentence_zh: 狗埋在院子裡的雞骨頭昨天被發現了。

definition_zh: (名) 獎金；紅利　(名) 額外好處；附加利益
example_sentence: Finishing the project ahead of schedule earned the team a performance bonus.
sentence_zh: 提前完成專案讓團隊獲得績效獎金。

definition_zh: (形) 骨瘦如柴的；瘦骨嶙峋的　(形) 含骨頭的；多骨的
example_sentence: If the chicken were not so bony, more students would enjoy eating it at lunch.
sentence_zh: 如果這隻雞肉不是那麼多骨頭，更多學生就會在午餐時享受吃它。

definition_zh: (動) 跳舞；搖擺　(名) 布吉舞；搖滾樂
example_sentence: The students boogie at the school dance every Friday night.
sentence_zh: 學生們每個星期五晚上在學校舞會上跳布吉舞。

definition_zh: (動) 預訂；登記
example_sentence: Having booked in at the hotel, the tired students finally rested after their long journey.
sentence_zh: 在旅館辦理入住後，疲憊的學生們在長途旅行後終於得以休息。

definition_zh: (動) 預訂；登記入住
example_sentence: After arriving at the hotel, guests book into their rooms before exploring the city.
sentence_zh: 客人抵達飯店後，在探索城市之前先辦理入住手續。

definition_zh: (動) 預訂；約定　(動) 登記；記錄
example_sentence: Hardly ever does a popular restaurant book out its tables weeks in advance without taking reservations.
sentence_zh: 一家熱門餐廳幾乎不可能在數週前就預訂滿座而不接受預約。

definition_zh: (動) 預訂；訂滿　(形) 已被預訂的；客滿的
example_sentence: The restaurant that we wanted to visit was completely booked up for the entire month.
sentence_zh: 我們想去的那家餐廳整個月都客滿了。

definition_zh: (名) 書；書籍　(動) 預訂；預約
example_sentence: Students read books to improve their English vocabulary for the exam.
sentence_zh: 學生閱讀書籍以提高他們的英文詞彙應付考試。

definition_zh: (名) 書櫃；書架
example_sentence: The wooden bookcase in the library holds thousands of novels and reference books.
sentence_zh: 圖書館裡的木製書櫃放著數千本小說和參考書。

definition_zh: (名) 預訂；訂位　(動) 預訂；登記
example_sentence: Making a hotel booking online is quick and convenient for travelers.
sentence_zh: 為旅客在線上進行飯店預訂既快速又方便。

definition_zh: (名) 簿記；帳目管理　(動) 進行簿記；記帳
example_sentence: As the business expanded, accurate bookkeeping became essential for tracking all financial transactions.
sentence_zh: 隨著生意擴大，精確的簿記對追蹤所有財務交易變得很重要。

definition_zh: (名) 小冊子；小手冊
example_sentence: Containing useful tips for exam preparation, the booklet distributed by the school helps students review efficiently.
sentence_zh: 這本由學校發放、包含實用應考訣竅的小冊子幫助學生有效複習。

definition_zh: (名) 書架；放書的架子
example_sentence: The bookshelf that stands in the corner of my bedroom holds all my favorite novels.
sentence_zh: 放在我臥室角落的書架上擺放著我所有最喜歡的小說。

definition_zh: (名) 書店；書籍販售店
example_sentence: If students visit the bookstore after school, they will find many useful exam preparation books.
sentence_zh: 如果學生放學後去書店，他們會找到許多有用的考試準備書籍。

definition_zh: (名) 繁榮；景氣　(動) 發出低沉聲音；急速增長
example_sentence: The real estate market experienced a boom after the government announced new development plans.
sentence_zh: 政府宣布新的開發計畫後，房地產市場經歷了一次繁榮。

definition_zh: (動) 促進；增強　(名) 推動；提升
example_sentence: Students study hard to boost their test scores and university admission chances.
sentence_zh: 學生們努力讀書是為了提高考試成績和大學錄取機會。

definition_zh: (名) 助推器；促進劑　(名) 加強注射；強化針
example_sentence: Getting a booster shot before traveling abroad helps protect students from serious diseases.
sentence_zh: 出國前打強化針有助於保護學生免受嚴重疾病侵害。

definition_zh: (動) 啟動；開機　(片) 開啟；起動
example_sentence: Before the exam starts, students must boot up their computers to access the online test platform.
sentence_zh: 在考試開始之前，學生必須啟動電腦才能進入線上測驗平台。

definition_zh: (名) 靴子；長靴　(動) 啟動；開機　(動) 踢；踹
example_sentence: Having booted up the computer, the student waited for the exam system to load completely.
sentence_zh: 學生啟動了電腦後，等待考試系統完全加載。

definition_zh: (名) 攤位；售票亭　(名) 電話亭；投票間
example_sentence: The information booth that stands near the entrance provides maps for tourists.
sentence_zh: 靠近入口的資訊攤位為遊客提供地圖。

definition_zh: (動) 接近；瀕臨　(動) 與...相鄰
example_sentence: The student's behavior borders on being disrespectful to the teacher.
sentence_zh: 這位學生的行為接近不尊重老師的程度。

definition_zh: (名) 邊界；國境　(動) 與...接壤；圍住
example_sentence: If Taiwan's border were more protected, the country would face fewer security challenges.
sentence_zh: 如果台灣的邊界受到更好的保護，該國將面臨較少的安全挑戰。

definition_zh: (動) 使厭煩；讓人感到乏味　(名) 令人厭煩的人或事；鑽孔
example_sentence: Watching the same TV show every day bores most teenagers after a while.
sentence_zh: 每天看同一部電視節目會讓大多數青少年在一段時間後感到厭煩。

definition_zh: (形) 感到厭倦的；感到無聊的
example_sentence: Feeling bored after finishing homework, the student decided to watch a movie online.
sentence_zh: 做完功課後感到無聊，這個學生決定在線上看電影。

definition_zh: (名) 無聊；厭倦　(動) 使感到無聊
example_sentence: Although the lecture was informative, boredom crept in as the teacher spoke monotonously for two hours.
sentence_zh: 雖然那場講座很有資訊，但當老師單調地講了兩小時，無聊感漸漸襲來。

definition_zh: (形) 無聊的；令人厭倦的　(動) 使厭倦；鑽孔
example_sentence: Hardly ever does a movie bore the audience more than this one did.
sentence_zh: 幾乎沒有電影像這部一樣令觀眾感到如此無聊。

definition_zh: (形) 天生的；出生的　(動) 出生；誕生
example_sentence: A child born into a wealthy family doesn't always understand the value of hard work.
sentence_zh: 出生在富裕家庭的孩子不一定能理解努力工作的價值。

definition_zh: (名) 區；自治市鎮
example_sentence: Students visit the historic borough to learn about local government and community development.
sentence_zh: 學生參訪這個歷史悠久的自治市鎮，以了解地方政府和社區發展。

definition_zh: (動) 借用；借入　(動) 向…借錢
example_sentence: Can I borrow your notebook and pen for the history exam?
sentence_zh: 我可以借你的筆記本和筆來準備歷史考試嗎？

definition_zh: (名) 借用；借進　(動) 借；借入
example_sentence: Borrowing books from the library helps students prepare for exams.
sentence_zh: 從圖書館借書有助於學生準備考試。

definition_zh: (名) 胸部；懷抱　(形) 親密的；知心的
example_sentence: As the grandmother held her granddaughter in her bosom, tears of joy streamed down her wrinkled face.
sentence_zh: 當祖母把孫女緊抱在懷裡時，淚水從她滿是皺紋的臉頰滑落。

definition_zh: (動) 專斷地指揮；傲慢地命令
example_sentence: Being bossed about by the team captain, the new players felt frustrated and unmotivated.
sentence_zh: 被隊長專斷地指揮，新隊員感到沮喪和沒有幹勁。

definition_zh: (名) 老闆；上司　(動) 指揮；領導
example_sentence: The boss who hired me last year is very strict about deadlines.
sentence_zh: 去年聘僱我的老闆對截止日期要求很嚴格。

definition_zh: (形) 專制的；愛指揮人的　(形) 傲慢的；跋扈的
example_sentence: If the team leader becomes bossy, the group members will lose motivation and stop cooperating.
sentence_zh: 如果團隊領導者變得專制，組員就會失去動力並停止合作。

definition_zh: (形) 植物的；植物學的
example_sentence: The botanical garden displays rare plants from around the world.
sentence_zh: 這個植物園展示來自世界各地的稀有植物。

definition_zh: (名) 植物學；植物研究
example_sentence: Maria studies botany to understand how plants grow and survive in nature.
sentence_zh: 瑪莉亞學習植物學以了解植物如何在自然界中生長和生存。

definition_zh: (動) 搞砸；弄糟　(動) 失敗；台灣學生常說的 NG
example_sentence: The student botched up the final exam by forgetting to study the last three chapters.
sentence_zh: 那名學生因為忘記讀最後三章而把期末考搞砸了。

definition_zh: (代) 兩者；雙方　(形) 兩個的；雙方的
example_sentence: Both students studied hard, so they both passed the exam.
sentence_zh: 兩個學生都努力讀書，所以他們都考上了。

definition_zh: (動) 煩擾；打擾　(名) 麻煩事；討厭的人
example_sentence: Bothered by the loud noise, Maria couldn't focus on her CSAT preparation.
sentence_zh: 被吵雜的聲音煩擾，瑪麗亞無法專注於學測準備。

definition_zh: (形) 令人厭煩的；麻煩的
example_sentence: The constant notifications on social media are bothersome, which makes studying difficult.
sentence_zh: 社群媒體上不斷的通知令人厭煩，這使得讀書變得困難。

definition_zh: (動) 臨陣退縮；害怕而退出
example_sentence: The soccer player bottled out at the last moment, refusing to take the winning penalty kick.
sentence_zh: 那位足球選手在最後一刻臨陣退縮，拒絕踢出致勝的十二碼球。

definition_zh: (動) 壓抑；隱瞞　(動) 封存；藏匿
example_sentence: If Mark bottled up his stress about the university exam, he would develop serious health problems.
sentence_zh: 如果馬克壓抑他對大學入試的壓力，他會產生嚴重的健康問題。

definition_zh: (名) 瓶子；玻璃瓶　(動) 裝瓶；把…裝入瓶中
example_sentence: Please drink water from a bottle every day to stay healthy.
sentence_zh: 請每天從瓶子裡喝水以保持健康。

definition_zh: (名) 最低限度；基本原則　(名) 純利潤；淨利潤
example_sentence: Considering the budget constraints, the bottom line remains that we must reduce expenses by twenty percent.
sentence_zh: 考慮到預算限制，底線仍然是我們必須減少百分之二十的支出。

definition_zh: (動) 跌到谷底；降到最低點
example_sentence: After the stock market crashed, investor confidence bottomed out before gradually recovering.
sentence_zh: 股市崩盤後，投資人信心跌到谷底，然後逐漸恢復。

definition_zh: (名) 底部；最下面　(形) 最低的；底部的
example_sentence: Only at the bottom of the ocean do strange creatures live in complete darkness.
sentence_zh: 只有在海洋的最深處，奇異的生物才能在完全黑暗中生存。

definition_zh: (名) 巨石；大圓石
example_sentence: The massive boulder that blocked the mountain path was eventually removed by construction workers.
sentence_zh: 那塊阻擋山路的巨大圓石最後被建築工人移除了。

definition_zh: (名) 林蔭大道；寬闊街道
example_sentence: Many families visit the boulevard to enjoy the fresh air and exercise together.
sentence_zh: 許多家庭會到林蔭大道上散步以享受新鮮空氣和一起運動。

definition_zh: (動) 恢復；重新振作　(動) 反彈；彈回
example_sentence: After failing the first exam, Maria studied harder and bounced back with a higher score.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞在第一次考試失敗後，更加努力讀書，最後以更高的分數東山再起。

definition_zh: (動) 活躍地進入；興高采烈地走進
example_sentence: After winning the competition, the excited student bounced into the classroom to share the good news.
sentence_zh: 贏得比賽後，興高采烈的學生活躍地走進教室分享好消息。

definition_zh: (動) 反彈；彈開　(動) 被拒絕；未被接納
example_sentence: When the email bounced off the server, the IT staff investigated the network problem immediately.
sentence_zh: 當電子郵件從伺服器反彈時，IT人員立即調查網路問題。

definition_zh: (動) 反彈；彈回　(名) 反彈；彈力
example_sentence: Bouncing off the gym floor, the basketball rolled toward the sideline.
sentence_zh: 籃球從體育館地板反彈，滾向邊線。

definition_zh: (名) 保鏢；夜店保安　(名) 彈跳的東西；反彈物
example_sentence: The bouncer who stood at the club entrance checked everyone's ID carefully.
sentence_zh: 站在夜店入口的保鏢仔細檢查了每個人的身分證。

definition_zh: (形) 受束縛的；受限制的　(動) 跳躍；彈起　(名) 界限；邊界
example_sentence: If students are bound by strict school rules, they will find creative ways to express themselves.
sentence_zh: 如果學生被嚴格的校規所束縛，他們將會找到創意的方式來表達自己。

definition_zh: (名) 邊界；界線　(名) 界限；範圍
example_sentence: The river forms a natural boundary between the two countries.
sentence_zh: 這條河流形成兩國之間的天然邊界。

definition_zh: (形) 跳躍的；快速移動的　(動) 跳躍；彈起
example_sentence: The athlete trained hard to improve bounding ability for better jump performance.
sentence_zh: 這位運動員努力訓練以改善跳躍能力，獲得更好的跳高表現。

definition_zh: (名) 花束；香氣
example_sentence: As the bride walked down the aisle, she held a beautiful bouquet of red roses tightly.
sentence_zh: 當新娘沿著走道行進時，她緊緊握著一束美麗的紅玫瑰花束。

definition_zh: (名) 一段時間；輪次　(名) 比賽；對決
example_sentence: Having completed three training bouts, the boxer felt confident facing the championship match.
sentence_zh: 完成了三場訓練賽後，這位拳擊手對於面對冠軍賽感到有信心。

definition_zh: (名) 精品店；精品屋　(形) 精品的；小型專門的
example_sentence: The boutique hotel that offers personalized service attracts many travelers.
sentence_zh: 提供個人化服務的精品飯店吸引了許多旅客。

definition_zh: (動) 鞠躬進入；彎腰走進　(動) 屈服；投降
example_sentence: The actor bowed in through the stage door and greeted the audience with a respectful gesture.
sentence_zh: 那位演員彎腰走進舞台門，並用恭敬的姿態向觀眾致敬。

definition_zh: (動) 退出；放棄　退縮；認輸
example_sentence: If the star athlete bowed out of the competition, the team would lose its best player.
sentence_zh: 如果這位明星運動員退出比賽，球隊就會失去最好的選手。

definition_zh: (動) bo zu 鞠躬；屈服　(動) bo zu 投降；認輸
example_sentence: After losing the game, the team had to bow to their rivals' superior skills.
sentence_zh: 比賽失敗後，這支隊伍不得不承認對手的技術優越。

definition_zh: (名) [bo] 弓；鞠躬　(動) [baʊ] 鞠躬；彎曲
example_sentence: Bowing respectfully before the teacher, the student handed in the assignment.
sentence_zh: 那位學生鞠躬尊敬地向老師遞交作業。

definition_zh: (名) 腸；腸道
example_sentence: When the patient's bowel movements became irregular, the doctor recommended dietary changes immediately.
sentence_zh: 當患者的腸道排便變得不規律時，醫生立即建議改變飲食。

definition_zh: (動) 使…感到驚訝或印象深刻；使…震驚
example_sentence: Not only did the unexpected plot twist bowl over the audience, but it also changed their view of cinema.
sentence_zh: 不僅意外的情節轉折讓觀眾大為驚訝，而且改變了他們對電影的看法。

definition_zh: (名) 碗；盤　(動) 滾球；投球
example_sentence: The bowl that holds soup sits on the table next to plates.
sentence_zh: 盛湯的碗放在桌子上，靠近盤子的地方。

definition_zh: (名) 保齡球運動員；保齡球　(動) 投出保齡球
example_sentence: Sarah practiced every weekend to become a professional bowler in the national competition.
sentence_zh: 莎拉每個週末練習，目的是要成為全國比賽中的專業保齡球運動員。

definition_zh: (名) 保齡球；保齡球運動
example_sentence: Bowling is a fun weekend activity that brings friends and family together.
sentence_zh: 打保齡球是一項有趣的週末活動，可以讓朋友和家人聚在一起。

definition_zh: (動) 困住；限制；把…圍住
example_sentence: The narrow street boxes in the old marketplace from all sides.
sentence_zh: 這條狹窄的街道把舊市場從四面八方圍住。

definition_zh: (動) 把...裝進盒子；整理打包　(動) 限制；困住
example_sentence: After the concert ended, the crew boxed up all the equipment so they could move it to the next venue.
sentence_zh: 音樂會結束後，工作人員把所有設備打包裝箱，以便運往下一個場地。

definition_zh: (名) 盒子；箱子　(動) 把…裝入盒子；打拳
example_sentence: Packing books into boxes, students prepared their dorms for the new semester.
sentence_zh: 學生們把書裝進盒子裡，為新學期的宿舍做準備。

definition_zh: (名) 拳擊手；拳擊運動員　(名) 拳擊犬（一種狗的品種）
example_sentence: The boxer who trained for months finally won the championship match.
sentence_zh: 那位訓練了數個月的拳擊手終於贏得了冠軍賽。

definition_zh: (名) 拳擊；拳擊運動　(動) 進行拳擊
example_sentence: If professional boxers train discipline daily, boxing performance would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果職業拳擊手每天訓練紀律，拳擊表現會顯著提高。

definition_zh: (名) 男孩；少年　(名) 男人；傢伙
example_sentence: The boy plays soccer with his friends every afternoon.
sentence_zh: 那個男孩每天下午都和朋友們踢足球。

definition_zh: (動) 抵制；拒買　(名) 抵制行動；拒買運動
example_sentence: Environmental groups organized a boycott to pressure the company into using sustainable materials.
sentence_zh: 環保團體組織抵制行動，目的是促使該公司使用永續材料。

definition_zh: (名) 男朋友；交往的男性朋友
example_sentence: Sarah's boyfriend gave her flowers on her birthday.
sentence_zh: 莎拉的男朋友在她生日時送她花。

definition_zh: (名) 男孩時期；童年
example_sentence: Although boyhood was filled with carefree moments, Jason learned valuable lessons about responsibility.
sentence_zh: 雖然男孩時期充滿無憂無慮的時光，傑森卻學到了關於責任的寶貴功課。

definition_zh: (名) 胸罩；內衣
example_sentence: Having worn the same bra for years, Maria finally decided to buy a new one.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞穿了多年同一件胸罩後，終於決定買新的。

definition_zh: (名) 牙套；支架　(動) 做好準備；加強
example_sentence: Students who brace themselves for the CSAT exam often review past papers that appear in mock tests.
sentence_zh: 那些為學測做好準備的學生經常複習出現在模擬考中的往年試題。

definition_zh: (名) 手鐲；手環
example_sentence: Sarah wore a silver bracelet with colorful beads to the school dance.
sentence_zh: 莎拉戴著一條有彩色珠子的銀手鐲去參加學校舞會。

definition_zh: (形) 令人振奮的；振作人心的　(形) 清新的；涼爽的
example_sentence: If the morning air were not so bracing, students would find it harder to stay awake during early classes.
sentence_zh: 如果早晨的空氣不是那麼令人振奮，學生們會發現在早自習時更難保持清醒。

definition_zh: (名) 括號；方括號　(名) 支架；架子　(動) 用括號括住；歸類
example_sentence: The teacher asked students to put the math formula inside square brackets on the exam.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生在考試中將數學公式放在方括號內。

definition_zh: (形) 半鹹的；略帶鹹味的　(形) 令人不快的；令人厭惡的
example_sentence: Containing dissolved salt from ocean water, the brackish lake near the coast attracted few swimmers.
sentence_zh: 含有來自海水的溶解鹽分，靠近海岸的半鹹湖吸引很少游泳者。

definition_zh: (動) 吹牛；自誇　(名) 吹牛；誇耀
example_sentence: Although Tom bragged about winning the contest, nobody believed his story.
sentence_zh: 雖然湯姆吹牛說他贏了比賽，但沒人相信他的故事。

definition_zh: (名) 辮子；編織物　(動) 編；編成辮子
example_sentence: Only after her mother braided her long hair did Sarah feel ready for the school competition.
sentence_zh: 只有在她媽媽為她編好長頭髮之後，莎拉才感到為學校比賽做好準備。

definition_zh: (名) 大腦；腦部　(名) 智力；聰慧
example_sentence: The brain, which controls all body functions, is the most complex organ.
sentence_zh: 大腦是控制所有身體功能的器官，也是最複雜的器官。

definition_zh: (名) 創意產物；傑作
example_sentence: The social media platform was created to serve as the company's brainchild for connecting young people worldwide.
sentence_zh: 這個社交媒體平台是該公司為了連接世界各地年輕人而創造的傑作。

definition_zh: (名) 腦力激盪；集體討論　(動) 進行腦力激盪；集思廣益
example_sentence: The marketing team held a brainstorm session to develop new product ideas for next quarter.
sentence_zh: 行銷團隊舉辦了一場腦力激盪會議，為下一季開發新產品創意。

definition_zh: (動) 用小火和液體燉煮；紅燒
example_sentence: Braising beef with soy sauce and ginger creates a delicious home-cooked dish.
sentence_zh: 用醬油和生薑紅燒牛肉可以製作出美味的家常菜。

definition_zh: (動) 燜；用小火長時間燉煮　(形) 經過燜煮的；用小火燉的
example_sentence: Braised beef ribs being cooked slowly in soy sauce, the dish became tender and flavorful.
sentence_zh: 牛肋排在醬油中慢慢燜煮，這道菜變得軟嫩且美味。

definition_zh: (名) 煞車；制動器　(動) 煞車；減速
example_sentence: Braking suddenly on the wet road, the driver managed to avoid hitting the pedestrian.
sentence_zh: 駕駛員在濕潤的道路上突然煞車，設法避免撞到行人。

definition_zh: (名) 麸皮；穀物外殼
example_sentence: Whole wheat bread, which contains bran that provides fiber, is healthier than white bread.
sentence_zh: 含有提供纖維的麸皮的全麥麵包比白麵包更健康。

definition_zh: (動) 拓展到；涉足　(動) 分支出去；發展
example_sentence: If the coffee shop owner expanded the menu, the business would branch out into the bakery market.
sentence_zh: 如果咖啡店老闆擴大菜單，這項事業就會拓展到烘焙市場。

definition_zh: (動) 擴展業務；涉足新領域　(動) 多元發展；嘗試新事物
example_sentence: After success in the restaurant business, the company decided to branch out into retail.
sentence_zh: 在餐飲業成功後，該公司決定擴展業務進入零售業。

definition_zh: (名) 樹枝；分支　(動) 分開；分岔
example_sentence: The company opened a new branch to serve more customers in Taipei.
sentence_zh: 該公司開設一家新分店，以便在台北為更多顧客服務。

definition_zh: (形) 全新的；嶄新的　(形) 未使用過的；剛買的
example_sentence: My parents gave me a brand-new laptop as a graduation gift last month.
sentence_zh: 上個月我父母送給我一台嶄新的筆記型電腦作為畢業禮物。

definition_zh: (名) 品牌；商標　(動) 給...打上烙印；標記
example_sentence: Although the brand is expensive, many students choose it because the quality is reliable.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個品牌很貴，但許多學生選擇它，因為品質可靠。

definition_zh: (名) 白蘭地；葡萄烈酒
example_sentence: Having tasted the smooth brandy served at the fancy restaurant, the wine lover felt completely satisfied.
sentence_zh: 品嚐過高檔餐廳供應的順滑白蘭地後，這位葡萄酒愛好者感到完全滿足。

definition_zh: (名) 黃銅；銅製品　(形) 黃銅製的；厚顏無恥的
example_sentence: The old trumpet, which was made of brass and polished regularly, produced a brilliant sound.
sentence_zh: 那支舊喇叭是由黃銅製成的，經常被擦亮，發出了燦爛的聲音。

definition_zh: (形) 勇敢的；英勇的　(動) 勇敢面對；挺身抵抗
example_sentence: If students were braver, they would speak English more often in class.
sentence_zh: 如果學生更勇敢一些，他們就會在課堂上更常說英文。

definition_zh: (副) 勇敢地；大膽地
example_sentence: The firefighter bravely ran into the burning building to save people.
sentence_zh: 那位消防員勇敢地衝進燃燒的建築物救人。

definition_zh: (名) 勇氣；勇敢
example_sentence: Facing difficulties with determination, soldiers displayed remarkable bravery during the rescue mission.
sentence_zh: 這些士兵在救援任務中展現出非凡的勇氣，以堅定的決心面對困難。

definition_zh: (名) 打鬥；爭執　(動) 打架；爭吵
example_sentence: When fans started arguing loudly, a brawl broke out in the stadium.
sentence_zh: 當球迷開始大聲爭論時，體育館內爆發了一場打鬥。

definition_zh: (形) 厚顏無恥的；大膽魯莽的
example_sentence: Seldom has such brazen dishonesty been tolerated in our school community.
sentence_zh: 我們學校社群很少容忍如此厚顏無恥的不誠實行為。

definition_zh: (名) 違反；破壞　(動) 違反；破壞
example_sentence: The security breach that exposed student data was a serious problem that concerned many parents.
sentence_zh: 那起洩露學生資料的安全漏洞是許多家長都擔心的嚴重問題。

definition_zh: (名) 麵包；面包
example_sentence: Many students buy fresh bread to eat for breakfast before school.
sentence_zh: 許多學生買新鮮麵包在上學前當早餐吃。

definition_zh: (名) 寬度；範圍　(名) 廣度；涵蓋面
example_sentence: The breadth and depth of knowledge required for the CSAT exam demand careful planning and study.
sentence_zh: 學測考試所需的知識廣度和深度需要仔細的計畫和學習。

definition_zh: (動) 違反；打破　(動) 規則；統治
example_sentence: Breaking a rule in class can result in serious punishment from teachers.
sentence_zh: 在課堂上違反規則可能會導致老師的嚴厲懲罰。

definition_zh: (動) 逃脫；擺脫　(動) 脫離；獨立
example_sentence: As the runner broke away from the crowd, spectators cheered loudly along the entire street.
sentence_zh: 當跑者從人群中脫穎而出時，沿著整條街的觀眾都大聲歡呼。

definition_zh: (動) 分解；崩潰　(名) 故障；崩潰
example_sentence: Breaking down the complicated math problem into smaller steps, students found the solution more manageable.
sentence_zh: 將複雜的數學問題分解成更小的步驟，學生們發現解題變得更容易掌握。

definition_zh: (動) 為了…而停下；休息以便
example_sentence: The hikers took a break for water, which was essential in the hot weather.
sentence_zh: 登山者停下來喝水，這在炎熱的天氣中是必要的。

definition_zh: (動) 磨合；訓練　(動) 闖入；破門而入
example_sentence: If employees break in new equipment properly, the machines will last much longer.
sentence_zh: 如果員工正確地磨合新設備，機器將使用更久。

definition_zh: (動) 破門而入；闖入　(動) 開始從事；進入（新領域）
example_sentence: The burglar broke into the convenience store and stole money from the cash register.
sentence_zh: 那個竊賊破門而入便利商店，從收銀機裡偷走了錢。

definition_zh: (動) 中斷；終止　(動) 分裂；分離
example_sentence: The two countries decided to break off diplomatic relations to express their strong disagreement.
sentence_zh: 為了表達強烈的不同意，兩個國家決定中斷外交關係。

definition_zh: (動) 突然爆發；突然出現
example_sentence: A terrible disease broke out in the crowded hospital last winter.
sentence_zh: 去年冬天一種可怕的疾病在擁擠的醫院裡突然爆發。

definition_zh: (動) 逃脫；突破　(動) 打破；擺脫
example_sentence: After months of study, the student broke out of bad habits when preparing for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 經過幾個月的學習，這名學生在準備學測時擺脫了壞習慣。

definition_zh: (動) 爆發；突然發生　(動) 逃脫；逃獄
example_sentence: Having broken out in a cold sweat, the student nervously waited for exam results.
sentence_zh: 那位學生已經冷汗直流，緊張地等待考試成績。

definition_zh: (動) 打破傳統；突破常規
example_sentence: Artists who break the mold often create works that inspire future generations.
sentence_zh: 打破傳統的藝術家經常創作能啟發後代的作品。

definition_zh: (動) 突破；打破　(動) 克服困難；取得進展
example_sentence: After months of research, the scientist finally broke through and discovered a new vaccine.
sentence_zh: 經過數月的研究，這位科學家終於突破難關，發現了一種新疫苗。

definition_zh: (動) 分手；結束　(動) 打破；拆散
example_sentence: If a couple broke up over small arguments, they would regret their hasty decision.
sentence_zh: 如果一對情侶因為小爭執而分手，他們會後悔匆促的決定。

definition_zh: (名) 非法侵入；闖入　(動) 闖入；非法進入
example_sentence: The break-in at the jewelry store happened last night without any alarm.
sentence_zh: 珠寶店的闖入事件發生在昨晚，沒有任何警報。

definition_zh: (動) 打破；弄裂　(動) 休息；暫停　(名) 休息時間；假期
example_sentence: Breaking the glass accidentally, the student apologized to the teacher immediately.
sentence_zh: 那個學生不小心打破玻璃，立即向老師道歉了。

definition_zh: (形) 易破碎的；易損壞的
example_sentence: Because the vase is breakable, we must handle it with care during transport.
sentence_zh: 因為花瓶易碎，我們在運輸時必須小心處理。

definition_zh: (名) 破損；損壞　(名) 破損的東西；碎片
example_sentence: Seldom does breakage occur during shipping if packages are wrapped carefully.
sentence_zh: 如果包裹包裝得仔細，運送期間破損很少發生。

definition_zh: (名) 故障；崩潰　(動) 分解；發生故障
example_sentence: The car's breakdown, which occurred during the highway trip, caused significant delays for the family.
sentence_zh: 那輛車在高速公路上的故障，延誤了全家的行程。

definition_zh: (名) 早餐；早飯
example_sentence: Eating a healthy breakfast helps students focus on morning classes.
sentence_zh: 吃營養早餐幫助學生在早上課堂集中注意力。

definition_zh: (名) 突破；重大進展　(動) 突破；取得突破性進展
example_sentence: After years of research, the scientist's breakthrough discovery changed medical treatment forever.
sentence_zh: 經過多年研究後，這位科學家的突破性發現永遠改變了醫療方式。

definition_zh: (名) 胸部；乳房　(動) 勇敢面對；克服
example_sentence: The swimmer took a deep breath and breaststroked across the pool with confidence.
sentence_zh: 游泳選手深呼一口氣，自信地用蛙泳姿勢橫越游泳池。

definition_zh: (名) 呼吸；氣息　(動) 呼吸；吐氣
example_sentence: As the runner took a deep breath before the race, her nervousness gradually disappeared.
sentence_zh: 當跑步選手在比賽前深呼吸時，她的緊張感逐漸消散。

definition_zh: (片語) 鬆一口氣；感到寬慰
example_sentence: Finishing the difficult math exam, students breathed a sigh of relief in the hallway.
sentence_zh: 完成了困難的數學考試後，學生們在走廊裡鬆了一口氣。

definition_zh: (片語動) 緊緊跟蹤；對某人施加壓力
example_sentence: The manager who was breathing down the employee's neck made the entire office feel tense.
sentence_zh: 那位緊緊監視員工的經理使整個辦公室氣氛緊張。

definition_zh: (動) 呼吸；吸氣　(動) 輕聲說出；低聲講話
example_sentence: If students breathe deeply before the exam, their nervousness will decrease significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試前深呼吸，他們的緊張感會顯著降低。

definition_zh: (名) 呼吸；呼吸作用
example_sentence: Deep breathing helps reduce stress before the exam.
sentence_zh: 考試前深呼吸有助於減少壓力。

definition_zh: (形) 喘不過氣的；氣喘吁吁的　(形) 令人驚嘆的；驚人的
example_sentence: Marathon runners train hard to build stamina and avoid becoming breathless during the race.
sentence_zh: 馬拉松選手努力訓練以增強耐力，避免在比賽中喘不過氣。

definition_zh: (形) 令人屏息的；壯觀的　(形) 驚人的；驚奇的
example_sentence: The breathtaking view from the mountain top left all hikers speechless and amazed.
sentence_zh: 從山頂上令人屏息的景色讓所有登山者都驚嘆不已。

definition_zh: (副) 令人屏息地；驚人地
example_sentence: The mountain landscape was breathtakingly beautiful, which made every student stop and stare in wonder.
sentence_zh: 那座山景美得令人屏息，這使得每位學生都停下腳步驚嘆不已。

definition_zh: (動) 培育出；繁殖出　(動) 消除；清除
example_sentence: Having bred out the weaker traits over generations, farmers successfully developed a stronger cattle population.
sentence_zh: 經過多代培育出較弱的特徵後，農民成功開發出更強壯的牛群。

definition_zh: (名) 品種；種類　(動) 繁殖；飼養　(動) 引起；導致
example_sentence: The dog breed that requires the most exercise is one many families choose for outdoor activities.
sentence_zh: 需要最多運動的狗品種是許多家庭為了戶外活動而選擇的品種。

definition_zh: (名) 飼養者；繁殖者　(名) 製造者；引發者
example_sentence: Dog breeders must register their animals with the local government office.
sentence_zh: 狗隻飼養者必須向當地政府機構登記他們的動物。

definition_zh: (名) 繁殖；飼養　(動) 繁殖；培養
example_sentence: If farmers improved breeding conditions, livestock would grow healthier and stronger.
sentence_zh: 如果農民改善飼養條件，牲畜會長得更健康強壯。

definition_zh: (動) 輕鬆地進行；順利進展；快速通過
example_sentence: After finishing homework early, Maria breezed along to the café with her friends.
sentence_zh: 瑪莉亞很早完成功課後，輕鬆地和朋友們一起去了咖啡館。

definition_zh: (動) 輕鬆地進入；毫不費力地通過
example_sentence: Breeze in through the main entrance, Sarah easily found her seat in the crowded auditorium.
sentence_zh: 莎拉輕鬆地從主入口進入，在擁擠的禮堂中輕易地找到了座位。

definition_zh: (片) 輕鬆地進入；毫不費力地通過
example_sentence: Because Sarah studied hard all year, she breezed into the university entrance exam with confidence.
sentence_zh: 因為莎拉整年用功讀書，她滿懷信心地輕鬆通過大學入學考試。

definition_zh: (動) 輕鬆通過；毫不費力地完成
example_sentence: Not only did Maria breeze through the math exam, but she also scored the highest in class.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞不僅輕鬆通過數學考試，而且她還考得全班最高分。

definition_zh: (名) 微風；輕風　(動) 輕輕吹過；輕鬆行動
example_sentence: The cool breeze that swept across the beach made everyone feel refreshed and comfortable.
sentence_zh: 掃過沙灘的涼風讓每個人都感到精神爽朗和舒適。

definition_zh: (名) 簡潔；言簡意賅
example_sentence: Teachers often use brevity to communicate key points clearly without confusing students.
sentence_zh: 老師經常使用簡潔的表達方式來清楚地傳達重點，而不會讓學生感到困惑。

definition_zh: (動) 釀造；沖泡　(名) 釀造物；一杯飲料
example_sentence: Brewing strong coffee and reading the news every morning is my favorite routine.
sentence_zh: 每天早上釀造濃咖啡並閱讀新聞是我最喜歡的習慣。

definition_zh: (名) 釀造者；啤酒製造商
example_sentence: The local brewer produces craft beer using traditional methods and natural ingredients.
sentence_zh: 這家當地的啤酒釀造商用傳統方法和天然材料生產手工啤酒。

definition_zh: (名) 啤酒廠；釀造廠
example_sentence: Because the brewery produces craft beer locally, many tourists visit Taiwan's northern region every weekend.
sentence_zh: 因為啤酒廠在地生產精釀啤酒，許多遊客每個週末都造訪台灣北部。

definition_zh: (名) 英國脫歐；英國退出歐盟
example_sentence: Having caused major political debate, Brexit fundamentally changed Britain's relationship with European nations.
sentence_zh: 英國脫歐引發了重大政治辯論，從根本上改變了英國與歐洲國家的關係。

definition_zh: (名) 賄賂；贿金　(動) 贿赂；用賄賂收買
example_sentence: The official who accepted bribes that could influence his decisions was eventually arrested.
sentence_zh: 接受可以影響其決定的賄賂的那位官員最終被逮捕。

definition_zh: (名) 賄賂；贿赂行为
example_sentence: If a government official accepts bribery, he will face serious legal punishment.
sentence_zh: 如果政府官員接受賄賂，他將面臨嚴重的法律懲罰。

definition_zh: (動) 用磚砌；砌磚　(動) 堵住；用磚封閉
example_sentence: The construction workers brick in the old windows to make the room darker.
sentence_zh: 建築工人用磚砌堵住舊窗戶，使房間更暗。

definition_zh: (動) 用磚砌封住；隔絕
example_sentence: The construction workers need to brick up the old doorway to create more wall space.
sentence_zh: 建築工人需要用磚砌封住舊門道以便創造更多牆面空間。

definition_zh: (名) 磚；磚塊　(名) 磚紅色
example_sentence: The old brick building stood proudly in the center of town.
sentence_zh: 那棟老磚造建築物自豪地矗立在城鎮中心。

definition_zh: (名) 砌磚工；砌磚師傅
example_sentence: As the bricklayer carefully applied mortar between each brick, the wall gradually took its final shape.
sentence_zh: 當砌磚工仔細地在每塊磚之間抹灰泥時，牆壁逐漸成形。

definition_zh: (形) 新娘的；婚禮的
example_sentence: Having chosen the perfect dress, the bride felt confident wearing her bridal gown down the aisle.
sentence_zh: 挑選好完美的禮服後，新娘穿著她的婚紗有信心地走過禮堂走廊。

definition_zh: (名) 新娘；新婚妻子
example_sentence: The bride who wore her grandmother's dress looked absolutely radiant.
sentence_zh: 穿著祖母禮服的新娘看起來絕對光彩照人。

definition_zh: (名) 新郎；迎娶者
example_sentence: The bridegroom waited nervously at the altar for his bride to arrive.
sentence_zh: 新郎在祭壇前緊張地等待新娘的到來。

definition_zh: (名) 伴娘；新娘的女性伴禮
example_sentence: If Sarah were not working abroad, she would serve as the bridesmaid at her sister's wedding.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉沒有在國外工作，她就會在姐姐的婚禮上擔任伴娘。

definition_zh: (動) 縮小分歧；彌合差距　(動) 連接兩個不同的事物或想法
example_sentence: Better communication can bridge the gap between parents and teenagers.
sentence_zh: 更好的溝通可以縮小父母和青少年之間的分歧。

definition_zh: (名) 橋；橋樑　(動) 架橋；連接
example_sentence: The engineer, having designed the bridge, watched proudly as workers completed construction.
sentence_zh: 那位工程師設計好了這座橋後，自豪地觀看工人完成施工。

definition_zh: (名) 馬籠頭；韁繩　(動) 控制；約束
example_sentence: Before the horse could run freely, the trainer fitted the bridle so that the animal could be guided safely.
sentence_zh: 在馬能夠自由奔跑之前，訓練員套上馬籠頭，以便動物能被安全地引導。

definition_zh: (形) 短暫的；簡短的　(動) 簡述；說明
example_sentence: Only after the coach gave a brief talk did the team members understand the game plan.
sentence_zh: 只有在教練做了簡短的說明後，隊員們才理解了比賽計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 公事包；手提箱
example_sentence: The executive carried the briefcase which contained important documents to the meeting.
sentence_zh: 這位主管拿著裡面裝著重要文件的公事包去開會。

definition_zh: (名) 簡報；說明會　(動) 向...作簡報；向...說明
example_sentence: The manager held a briefing to inform staff about the new company policy.
sentence_zh: 經理舉行簡報會，向員工說明新的公司政策。

definition_zh: (副) 簡短地；簡要地　(副) 短暫地；一會兒
example_sentence: The teacher briefly explained the math problem, then asked students to solve it independently.
sentence_zh: 老師簡要地解釋了這道數學題，然後要求學生獨立解題。

definition_zh: (名) 旅；部隊；團隊
example_sentence: The fire brigade arrived quickly to rescue people from the burning building.
sentence_zh: 消防旅很快趕到，從燃燒的建築物中救出人們。

definition_zh: (形) 明亮的；聰慧的　(副) 明亮地；聰慧地
example_sentence: Because the classroom is bright, students can focus better on their studies and feel more motivated.
sentence_zh: 因為教室很明亮，學生能更專注於功課，也會感到更有動力。

definition_zh: (動) 使變亮；使明亮　(動) 使高興；使振奮
example_sentence: Painting the walls white brightened up the dark apartment, making the living room feel more spacious.
sentence_zh: 把牆壁漆成白色使昏暗的公寓變得明亮，讓客廳感覺更寬敞。

definition_zh: (名) 亮度；明亮　(名) 聰慧；機智
example_sentence: The brightness that makes the morning sky shine is what attracted many photographers.
sentence_zh: 使清晨天空閃耀的亮度就是吸引許多攝影師的原因。

definition_zh: (名) 才華；聰慧　(名) 光彩；光亮
example_sentence: If the student studied harder, the brilliance of her ideas would shine through in every exam.
sentence_zh: 如果那位學生更努力讀書，她想法的才華就會在每次考試中閃閃發光。

definition_zh: (形) 聰慧的；傑出的　(形) 耀眼的；光彩的
example_sentence: The brilliant student's invention won first place at the national science competition.
sentence_zh: 那位聰慧的學生的發明在全國科學競賽中獲得第一名。

definition_zh: (名) 邊緣；邊沿　(動) 盛滿；充滿
example_sentence: Students filled their water bottles to the brim to stay hydrated during the exam.
sentence_zh: 學生把水瓶裝滿水來在考試期間保持水分充足。

definition_zh: (動) 引起；造成　(動) 導致；促成
example_sentence: Social media campaigns have brought about significant changes in environmental awareness among teenagers.
sentence_zh: 社群媒體活動在青少年中引起了環境意識的重大改變。

definition_zh: (動) 帶著；攜帶　隨身攜帶某物
example_sentence: As long as you bring along your student ID, you can enter the museum for free.
sentence_zh: 只要你帶著學生證，你就可以免費進入博物館。

definition_zh: (動) 說服；使改變主意　(動) 使恢復知覺；使蘇醒
example_sentence: Having brought around his skeptical parents with solid evidence, the student finally gained permission to study abroad.
sentence_zh: 這位學生用確鑿的證據說服了懷疑的父母，終於獲得了出國留學的許可。

definition_zh: (動) 帶回；恢復　(動) 使回想起；重新流行
example_sentence: The museum exhibition that brought back memories of childhood attracted thousands of visitors.
sentence_zh: 那場喚起童年回憶的博物館展覽吸引了數千名遊客。

definition_zh: (動) 帶來；拿來　daʊn 向下；打倒；推翻
example_sentence: The scandal brought down the government, forcing the president to resign.
sentence_zh: 這個醜聞推翻了政府，迫使總統辭職。

definition_zh: (動) 帶來；生出　fɔrθ 產生；提出
example_sentence: If the new research project brought forth concrete evidence, the scientific community would reconsider its previous assumptions.
sentence_zh: 如果新研究計畫產生了具體證據，科學界就會重新考慮其先前的假設。

definition_zh: (動) 帶來；提出　fɔrwɚd 向前；提前
example_sentence: The company decided to bring forward the product launch from May to March.
sentence_zh: 這家公司決定把產品發布會從五月提前到三月。

definition_zh: (動) 引進；帶來　(動) 賺取；獲得
example_sentence: Bringing in new ideas and fresh perspectives, the young entrepreneur transformed the struggling company into a thriving business.
sentence_zh: 帶進新想法和新視角，這位年輕企業家把這個陷入困境的公司轉變成一個蓬勃發展的企業。

definition_zh: (動) 帶來；完成　(動) 離開；脫掉
example_sentence: Although the project seemed impossible at first, the team brought off a successful product launch by working together.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個專案起初看起來不可能，但該團隊透過一起努力完成了成功的產品發佈。

definition_zh: (動) 引起；導致　(動) 上場；推出
example_sentence: Only after the team's best player returned did the winning streak bring on a championship dream.
sentence_zh: 只有在隊伍最佳球員回歸後，勝利連勝才帶來了奪冠夢想。

definition_zh: (動) 引出；激發　展現；表現
example_sentence: The coach brings out in players the confidence that helps them win games.
sentence_zh: 教練激發出球員的信心，這種信心幫助他們贏得比賽。

definition_zh: (動) 帶出；推出　展現；突顯
example_sentence: The company designed a new product to bring out innovation in the technology market.
sentence_zh: 該公司設計新產品以在科技市場帶出創新。

definition_zh: (動) 帶來；說服　(動) 轉身；迴轉
example_sentence: After the coach explained the new strategy, many skeptical players were brought round to support the plan.
sentence_zh: 教練解釋了新戰略後，許多懷疑的球員被說服支持這個計畫。

definition_zh: (動) 將...繩之以法；懲罰犯人
example_sentence: The police worked hard to bring the criminal to justice after the robbery.
sentence_zh: 搶劫案發生後，警察努力工作將罪犯繩之以法。

definition_zh: (動) 帶來；使發生　(動) tu 向著；朝向　(動) 使活躍；使生動
example_sentence: By using colorful illustrations and vivid descriptions, the author brought the fantasy world to life so that young readers could easily imagine it.
sentence_zh: 透過使用彩色插圖和生動的描述，作者使奇幻世界栩栩如生，使年輕讀者能夠輕易地想像它。

definition_zh: (動) 帶來；引起　(動) tu 到；導致
example_sentence: Having studied the evidence carefully, the lawyer brought to light a critical contradiction in the witness's story.
sentence_zh: 仔細研究證據後，律師揭露了證人故事中的一個關鍵矛盾。

definition_zh: (動) 撫養；養育　(動) 提出；引起
example_sentence: Parents who bring up children with patience and love create confident individuals prepared for life's challenges.
sentence_zh: 以耐心和愛心撫養孩子的父母，會培養出準備好面對人生挑戰的自信個體。

definition_zh: (動) 帶來；拿來　(動) 造成；引起
example_sentence: If students bring their textbooks to class, the teacher will explain the difficult grammar more clearly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生把課本帶到課堂，老師會更清楚地解釋難的文法。

definition_zh: (名) 邊緣；懸崖邊　(形) 瀕臨的；即將發生的
example_sentence: The company stood on the brink of bankruptcy after losing major contracts.
sentence_zh: 失去大型合約後，該公司瀕臨破產。

definition_zh: (形) 輕快的；爽快的　(副) 快速地；敏捷地
example_sentence: The morning jog helped students to take a brisk walk before classes.
sentence_zh: 早晨慢跑幫助學生在上課前進行輕快的散步。

definition_zh: (名) 英國；不列顛
example_sentence: Britain is an island nation located off the coast of northwest Europe.
sentence_zh: 英國是位於歐洲西北海岸外的島國。

definition_zh: (形) 英國的；英國人的　(名) 英國人
example_sentence: Although the school teaches American English, many students find British pronunciation interesting when they watch British films.
sentence_zh: 雖然學校教授美式英語，但許多學生在看英國電影時發現英式發音有趣。

definition_zh: (形) 易碎的；脆弱的　(形) 冷淡的；生硬的
example_sentence: Broken into pieces by the fall, the brittle ceramic vase could not be repaired.
sentence_zh: 那個易碎的陶瓷花瓶經過跌落後碎成碎片，無法修復。

definition_zh: (形) 寬的；寬廣的　(形) 廣泛的；涵蓋面大的
example_sentence: The broad knowledge that the history teacher possesses helps students understand complex events.
sentence_zh: 歷史老師擁有的廣泛知識幫助學生理解複雜的歷史事件。

definition_zh: (名) 廣播；播送　(動) 廣播；播放
example_sentence: The live broadcast of the football match attracted millions of viewers nationwide.
sentence_zh: 足球比賽的直播吸引了全國數百萬的觀眾。

definition_zh: (名) 播送者；廣播公司　(名) 播放裝置；轉播設備
example_sentence: If the broadcaster were not careful about news accuracy, the audience would lose trust immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果播送者不謹慎對待新聞準確性，觀眾會立即失去信任。

definition_zh: (名) 廣播；播放　(動) 廣播的；播放的
example_sentence: The TV station is broadcasting the live concert to millions of viewers.
sentence_zh: 電視台正在向數百萬觀眾廣播這場現場演唱會。

definition_zh: (動) 拓寬；擴大　(動) 使變寬；加寬
example_sentence: Broadening his knowledge through reading, the student discovered new interests in science.
sentence_zh: 透過閱讀來拓寬知識，這名學生在科學中發現了新的興趣。

definition_zh: (副) 廣泛地；大致上　(副) 粗略地；概括地
example_sentence: Broadly speaking, most students find chemistry difficult, though some enjoy the lab work.
sentence_zh: 廣泛來說，大多數學生覺得化學很難，儘管有些人喜歡實驗工作。

definition_zh: (名) 側面砲火；猛烈批評　(動) 用側面砲火攻擊；猛烈批評
example_sentence: Hardly had the politician finished speaking before critics launched a broadside against his controversial proposal.
sentence_zh: 那位政治人物的演講才剛結束，批評者就猛烈抨擊他的爭議性提案。

definition_zh: (名) 宣傳冊；小冊子
example_sentence: The travel brochure that the tourism office distributed featured beautiful photos of Taiwan's national parks.
sentence_zh: 觀光局發放的旅遊宣傳冊刊登了台灣國家公園的美麗照片。

definition_zh: (動) 用高溫烤；炙烤　(動) 受到嚴厲批評
example_sentence: The chef uses a broiler to broil salmon fillets to perfection for dinner service.
sentence_zh: 主廚用烤爐炙烤鮭魚排，以達到晚餐服務的完美效果。

definition_zh: (形) 破的；損壞的　(形) 沒錢的；貧窮的　(動) 打破；中止
example_sentence: The broken window in the classroom needs to be fixed before the winter season.
sentence_zh: 教室裡那扇破損的窗戶需要在冬季前修好。

definition_zh: (形) 破碎的；損壞的　(形) 中斷的；破裂的
example_sentence: The broken phone screen made it impossible to see the display clearly.
sentence_zh: 破裂的手機螢幕使得螢幕顯示變得完全看不清楚。

definition_zh: (名) 仲介人；經紀人　(動) 充當仲介；協調
example_sentence: Although the real estate broker negotiated carefully, both parties struggled to reach an agreement on the final price.
sentence_zh: 雖然房地產仲介人仔細協商，但雙方在最終價格上仍難以達成共識。

definition_zh: (名) 經紀業；仲介費　(名) 經紀人的工作或佣金
example_sentence: Operating a stock brokerage, the financial advisor helping clients invest wisely earns commission.
sentence_zh: 經營股票經紀業，這位財務顧問透過協助客戶明智投資而賺取佣金。

definition_zh: (名) 青銅；銅牌　(形) 青銅色的；古銅色的
example_sentence: The ancient statue, which was made of bronze that had turned green with age, stood majestically in the museum.
sentence_zh: 這座古代雕像由已隨著時間變綠的青銅製成，莊嚴地矗立在博物館裡。

definition_zh: (名) 胸針；別針
example_sentence: If a student wears a vintage brooch to the school ceremony, teachers will surely notice her elegant style.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在校慶典禮上戴著古董胸針，老師一定會注意到她優雅的風格。

definition_zh: (動) 孵蛋；沉思　(名) 一窩蛋；一群幼鳥
example_sentence: The hen broods over her eggs in the warm nest every day.
sentence_zh: 母雞每天在溫暖的巢裡孵她的蛋。

definition_zh: (名) 孵蛋器；愛生悶氣的人
example_sentence: Farmers use a brooder to keep chicks warm and healthy during their early weeks.
sentence_zh: 農民使用孵蛋器在小雞的早期週數保持牠們溫暖和健康。

definition_zh: (名) 小溪；溪流　(動) 容忍；忍受
example_sentence: A small brook running through the forest provides fresh water for nearby villages.
sentence_zh: 流經森林的小溪為附近村莊提供新鮮的水源。

definition_zh: (名) 掃帚；掃把　(動) 掃；清掃
example_sentence: As soon as the morning assembly ends, the cleaning team sweeps the hallway with a broom.
sentence_zh: 早會一結束，清潔隊就用掃帚掃走廊。

definition_zh: (名) 肉湯；清湯
example_sentence: Having simmered for hours, the broth became rich and flavorful.
sentence_zh: 經過數小時的燉煮，肉湯變得濃郁又美味。

definition_zh: (名) 哥哥；弟弟　(名) 同志；同伴
example_sentence: My brother who studies at National Taiwan University is helping me prepare for the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 我那位在國立臺灣大學讀書的哥哥正在幫我準備學測。

definition_zh: (名) 兄弟情誼；兄弟會　(名) 同志精神；團結
example_sentence: The soldiers' brotherhood and mutual trust helped them survive the difficult mission together.
sentence_zh: 士兵們的兄弟情誼和相互信任幫助他們一起完成了艱難的任務。

definition_zh: (名) 眉毛；眉　(名) 山坡頂；山頂
example_sentence: If Sarah didn't furrow her brow so much, she would look less worried about the exam.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉不那麼皺眉的話，她看起來就不會那麼擔心考試了。

definition_zh: (形) 棕色的；褐色的　(名) 棕色；褐色
example_sentence: The old wooden table has a dark brown color that looks very traditional.
sentence_zh: 那張舊木桌有著深棕色，看起來非常傳統。

definition_zh: (名) 巧克力布朗尼蛋糕；女童軍　(形) 褐色的；棕色的
example_sentence: Baking brownies for the school bake sale, Sarah carefully measured the chocolate and sugar.
sentence_zh: 莎拉為學校烘焙義賣製作巧克力布朗尼蛋糕，仔細量測巧克力和糖的份量。

definition_zh: (動) 瀏覽；翻閱　(動) 在網路上搜尋資訊
example_sentence: While browsing through social media during lunch break, students often lose track of time.
sentence_zh: 當學生在午餐時間瀏覽社群媒體時，他們經常會失去時間概念。

definition_zh: (名) 瀏覽器；網頁瀏覽軟體　(名) 瀏覽者；閱覽者
example_sentence: Hardly does a student complete homework without opening a web browser on their computer.
sentence_zh: 很少有學生不打開電腦上的網頁瀏覽器就完成功課。

definition_zh: (名) 瘀傷；淤青　(動) 使受傷；碰傷　(形) 受傷的；有瘀傷的
example_sentence: The athlete's arm, which had a dark bruise from yesterday's game, required ice treatment.
sentence_zh: 那位運動員的手臂上有一處昨天比賽留下的深色瘀傷，需要冰敷治療。

definition_zh: (形) 瘀傷的；被撞傷的　(動) 撞傷；傷害
example_sentence: Athletes apply ice to bruised areas to reduce swelling and pain.
sentence_zh: 運動員在瘀傷的部位敷冰以減少腫脹和疼痛。

definition_zh: (形) 瘀傷的；受傷的　(名) 瘀傷；傷痕
example_sentence: After falling off his bicycle, the bruising on his knee made walking painful for a week.
sentence_zh: 從自行車上摔下來後，他膝蓋上的瘀傷讓他一週內走路都很疼痛。

definition_zh: (名) 早午餐；早午餐時間
example_sentence: On Sunday mornings, many students enjoy meeting friends for brunch at a café.
sentence_zh: 在星期天早上，許多學生喜歡在咖啡館和朋友一起享用早午餐。

definition_zh: (動) 不理睬；打發掉　(動) 輕率地拒絕；敷衍
example_sentence: Although Mark tried to explain his absence, his boss brushed off his excuse without listening carefully.
sentence_zh: 雖然馬克試圖解釋他的缺席，但他的老闆卻不聽他的解釋而敷衍了事。

definition_zh: (動) 複習；溫習　(動) 改進；提升
example_sentence: Brushing up on grammar rules before the exam, many students felt more confident answering difficult questions.
sentence_zh: 在考試前複習文法規則，許多學生回答難題時感到更有信心。

definition_zh: (名) 刷子；筆刷　(動) 刷；掃　(形) 灌木叢生的
example_sentence: The artist used a brush that had soft bristles to paint the canvas carefully.
sentence_zh: 這位藝術家用一支柔軟刷毛的筆刷小心地繪製畫布。

definition_zh: (形) 粗魯的；唐突的　(形) 生硬的；不客氣的
example_sentence: If the manager had not been so brusque during the meeting, the team would have felt more comfortable sharing ideas.
sentence_zh: 如果經理在會議中沒有那麼粗魯，團隊成員會感到更自在地分享想法。

definition_zh: (形) 殘忍的；野蠻的　(形) 嚴酷的；無情的
example_sentence: The brutal weather conditions made the mountain rescue mission extremely dangerous.
sentence_zh: 殘酷的天氣狀況使得山區救援任務變得極其危險。

definition_zh: (副) 殘忍地；冷酷地　無情地；粗暴地
example_sentence: The coach criticized the team brutally to improve their performance.
sentence_zh: 教練殘忍地批評球隊以改進他們的表現。

definition_zh: (形) 野蠻的；殘暴的　(名) 野蠻人；畜生
example_sentence: The brute force of the storm destroyed many houses in the village.
sentence_zh: 這場風暴的蠻橫力量摧毀了村子裡許多房屋。

definition_zh: (動) 興高采烈地說話；表達熱情　(動) 溢出；充滿情感而無法控制
example_sentence: As excitement built during the concert, fans bubbled over with joy when their favorite singer appeared on stage.
sentence_zh: 當演唱會的興奮氣氛逐漸高漲時，粉絲們在最喜愛的歌手出場時興高采烈地歡呼。

definition_zh: (名) 泡泡；氣泡　(動) 起泡；冒泡
example_sentence: Having bubbled up from the ocean floor, the gas escaped into the atmosphere.
sentence_zh: 從海底冒上來的氣泡逸入大氣中。

definition_zh: (動) 振作起來；打起精神　(動) 鼓勵；支持
example_sentence: Students who buck up their spirits before the exam will perform better than those who feel discouraged.
sentence_zh: 在考試前振作精神的學生表現會比感到沮喪的學生更好。

definition_zh: (名) 美元；金錢　(動) 違抗；反抗
example_sentence: Earning a few extra bucks during summer vacation helps pay for school supplies.
sentence_zh: 暑假期間賺取額外的幾塊美元有助於支付學用品。

definition_zh: (片) 傾盆大雨；下大雨
example_sentence: If it buckets down during the outdoor sports day, the school would postpone all events.
sentence_zh: 如果運動會當天傾盆大雨，學校就會延期所有比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 桶；水桶　(名) 桶的容量
example_sentence: The gardener filled a bucket with water to water the plants.
sentence_zh: 園丁用桶裝滿水來澆灌植物。

definition_zh: (動) 認真努力；集中精力　(動) 開始認真對待
example_sentence: Buckles down to study, Maria finally achieved top grades on the midterm exam.
sentence_zh: 認真努力讀書後，瑪麗亞終於在期中考取得優異成績。

definition_zh: (動) 屈服；讓步　在壓力下放棄立場
example_sentence: Although the company initially resisted the new regulations, management buckled under when facing massive public pressure.
sentence_zh: 雖然公司最初抵抗新規定，但在面臨龐大輿論壓力時，管理層屈服了。

definition_zh: (片) 繫好安全帶；扣緊
example_sentence: Hardly had the airplane door closed when the flight attendant reminded passengers to buckle up immediately.
sentence_zh: 飛機艙門才剛關上，空服員就提醒乘客立即繫好安全帶。

definition_zh: (名) 扣環；皮帶扣　(動) 扣上；彎曲　(形) 彎曲的；扭曲的
example_sentence: The seatbelt buckle, which keeps passengers safe, must be fastened before driving.
sentence_zh: 安全帶的扣環（能保護乘客）在開車前必須扣上。

definition_zh: (名) 蕎麥；蕎麥粉
example_sentence: Farmers plant buckwheat to improve soil quality and provide nutritious grain.
sentence_zh: 農民種植蕎麥來改善土壤品質並提供營養穀物。

definition_zh: (名) 花蕾；芽　(動) 發芽；萌發
example_sentence: Cherry blossoms budding in spring are a beautiful sight for students walking to school.
sentence_zh: 春天盛開的櫻花花蕾對走路上學的學生來說是美麗的景象。

definition_zh: (名) 佛陀；佛祖　(名) 佛像；佛的雕像
example_sentence: Many people visit Buddhist temples to see ancient Buddha statues and learn about Buddhism.
sentence_zh: 許多人參訪佛教寺廟，欣賞古老的佛像並學習佛教教義。

definition_zh: (名) 佛教；佛教信仰
example_sentence: As Buddhism emphasizes inner peace and meditation, many students find it helpful for managing exam stress.
sentence_zh: 由於佛教強調內在平靜和冥想，許多學生發現它有助於紓解考試壓力。

definition_zh: (名) 佛教徒；信仰佛教的人　(形) 佛教的；與佛教有關的
example_sentence: Following Buddhist teachings, the monk meditated in the quiet temple every morning.
sentence_zh: 遵循佛教教義，這位和尚每天早上都在寧靜的寺廟裡冥想。

definition_zh: (動) 挪動位置讓出空間；往旁邊靠
example_sentence: The passengers who budge up make room for everyone on the crowded bus.
sentence_zh: 願意往旁邊靠的乘客為擁擠公車上的每個人騰出空間。

definition_zh: (動) 移動；改變立場
example_sentence: If the heavy box doesn't budge after pushing hard, asking for help would be smart.
sentence_zh: 如果用力推那個重箱子還是不動，請求幫助就會是聰明的做法。

definition_zh: (名) 預算；預算案　(動) 編列預算；規劃開支
example_sentence: The school's annual budget covers textbooks, supplies, and facility maintenance.
sentence_zh: 學校的年度預算涵蓋教科書、用品和設施維護。

definition_zh: (動) 加強；提升　溫習；復習
example_sentence: Students study hard to buff up on English before the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們努力讀書是為了在學測前加強英文。

definition_zh: (動) 增強肌肉；變得強壯　(動) 改進；加強
example_sentence: Many high school athletes buff up their muscles by lifting weights regularly.
sentence_zh: 許多高中運動員通過定期舉重來增強肌肉。

definition_zh: (形) 強壯的；肌肉發達的　(動) 擦亮；磨光
example_sentence: Although the athlete was naturally thin, he became buff after training hard for six months.
sentence_zh: 雖然這位運動員天生瘦弱，但經過六個月的刻苦訓練後，他變得肌肉發達了。

definition_zh: (名) 水牛；美洲野牛
example_sentence: Having migrated across the plains, the buffalo herds faced increasing threats from hunters.
sentence_zh: 水牛群遷移到平原後，面臨越來越多獵人的威脅。

definition_zh: (名) 緩衝物；緩衝區　(動) 緩衝；保護
example_sentence: The airbag, which acts as a buffer that protects passengers during accidents, saves many lives.
sentence_zh: 安全氣囊是一種緩衝裝置，在事故中保護乘客，拯救許多生命。

definition_zh: (名) 自助餐；自助餐廳　(動) 用拳頭連打；打擊
example_sentence: The all-you-can-eat buffet at the hotel offers Chinese, Japanese, and Western dishes.
sentence_zh: 飯店的自助餐提供中式、日式和西餐。

definition_zh: (名) 小丑；愚蠢的人　(形) 愚蠢的；可笑的
example_sentence: If the class clown didn't act like such a buffoon during exams, his grades would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果班上的搗蛋鬼在考試時不表現得那麼愚蠢，他的成績會大幅進步。

definition_zh: (動) 滾開；走開；別煩我
example_sentence: Stop asking me annoying questions—just bug off and leave me alone!
sentence_zh: 別問我這些討厭的問題了——滾開，讓我一個人待著！

definition_zh: (動) 驚慌失措地逃跑；恐慌　(動) 眼睛突出；瞪大眼睛
example_sentence: Bugging out over the surprise exam, many students rushed to the library seeking help.
sentence_zh: 因為突然考試而驚慌失措，許多學生匆匆趕往圖書館尋求幫助。

definition_zh: (名) 蟲；臭蟲　(名) 程式錯誤；缺陷　(動) 煩擾；打擾
example_sentence: Because the software bug affected the system, the IT team worked overtime to fix it.
sentence_zh: 由於軟體程式錯誤影響了系統，資訊技術團隊加班修復它。

definition_zh: (形) 有故障的；出毛病的　(名) 嬰兒車；手推車
example_sentence: Seldom does a smartphone work properly once its system becomes buggy after multiple updates.
sentence_zh: 一支智慧型手機的系統經過多次更新後變得有故障，它很少能正常運作。

definition_zh: (動) 圍繞…建造；以…為中心發展
example_sentence: The new shopping center, built around a modern fountain, attracts thousands of visitors daily.
sentence_zh: 這座新購物中心以一個現代噴泉為中心建造，每天吸引數千名遊客。

definition_zh: (動) 內裝；嵌入　(動) 為了...而設計；為了...而製造
example_sentence: Engineers designed the safety feature to build in protection against equipment failure.
sentence_zh: 工程師設計了這項安全功能，以便內裝保護裝置來防止設備故障。

definition_zh: (動) 建造進去；內置於　組合進去；融合進去
example_sentence: Modern smartphone designs build advanced security features into every device.
sentence_zh: 現代智慧型手機設計將先進的安全功能內置於每個裝置中。

definition_zh: (動) 以…為基礎；在…之上發展
example_sentence: The company built on its past success to launch new products.
sentence_zh: 那家公司以過去的成功為基礎推出新產品。

definition_zh: (動) 逐漸增加；積累　加強；增進
example_sentence: As the exam approaches, students build up their confidence through consistent practice and review.
sentence_zh: 隨著考試逼近，學生透過持續練習和複習而逐漸增強信心。

definition_zh: (動) 建造；建設　(動) 發展；增強
example_sentence: Building a strong foundation in English, many students improve their CSAT scores significantly.
sentence_zh: 通過建立扎實的英文基礎，許多學生的學測成績顯著提高。

definition_zh: (名) 建築物；大樓　(動) 建造；搭建
example_sentence: The building that stands downtown is where my uncle works as an engineer.
sentence_zh: 那座矗立在市中心的建築物是我叔叔工作的地方，他是工程師。

definition_zh: (名) 累積；增加　(動) 逐漸增加；堆積
example_sentence: If pollution continues to buildup in the atmosphere, environmental damage would become irreversible.
sentence_zh: 如果污染持續在大氣中累積，環境破壞將變得不可逆轉。

definition_zh: (形) 內置的；嵌入的　(形) 固有的；天生的
example_sentence: Modern laptops have built-in cameras for video calls and online classes.
sentence_zh: 現代筆記型電腦有內置的攝像頭，可用於視訊通話和線上課程。

definition_zh: (名) 燈泡；球莖
example_sentence: Students buy LED bulbs to save energy and reduce electricity costs at home.
sentence_zh: 學生購買LED燈泡以節省能源並降低家中的電費。

definition_zh: (名) 鼓起；凸起　(動) 鼓起；膨脹
example_sentence: Muscles bulging from exercise and heavy lifting impressed the gym coach.
sentence_zh: 因運動和舉重而隆起的肌肉給健身房教練留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (動) 增加體積；變壯；膨脹
example_sentence: As athletes bulk out by eating more protein, their muscles grow stronger and more defined.
sentence_zh: 當運動員透過攝取更多蛋白質而增加體積時，他們的肌肉會變得更強壯、更明顯。

definition_zh: (動) 增加肌肉；變壯　(片) 加強；擴大
example_sentence: Having bulked up significantly over six months, the athlete felt confident competing in the weightlifting championship.
sentence_zh: 經過六個月大幅增加肌肉後，這位運動員對參加舉重錦標賽充滿信心。

definition_zh: (名) 大量；主體　(形) 大宗的；散裝的
example_sentence: The company sells products in bulk, which reduces costs for retailers who purchase large quantities.
sentence_zh: 該公司以大宗方式銷售產品，這對購買大量產品的零售商降低了成本。

definition_zh: (形) 體積大的；笨重的　(形) 龐大的；容易佔空間的
example_sentence: Moving to a new apartment requires packing bulky furniture and heavy boxes carefully.
sentence_zh: 搬到新公寓需要小心打包笨重的家具和沉重的箱子。

definition_zh: (名) 公牛；牡牛　(名) 股市上升；樂觀投資者　(動) 蠻力推進；橫衝直撞
example_sentence: If the market were not so volatile, investors would buy stocks with bull confidence.
sentence_zh: 如果市場不是這麼波動，投資者會以看漲的信心買進股票。

definition_zh: (名) 子彈；槍彈　(名) 要點；項目符號
example_sentence: The security guard found a bullet on the ground near the bank.
sentence_zh: 保安人員在銀行附近的地面上發現了一顆子彈。

definition_zh: (名) 公告；簡訊　(名) 期刊；通訊
example_sentence: Posted on the school website, the weekly bulletin informs students about upcoming activities and important deadlines.
sentence_zh: 貼在學校網站上的週刊公告會通知學生即將舉行的活動和重要截止日期。

definition_zh: (形) 防彈的；不易被擊敗的
example_sentence: Although the new product design seems bulletproof on paper, market testing revealed several unexpected problems.
sentence_zh: 雖然新產品設計在紙面上看起來無懈可擊，但市場測試卻暴露了幾個意想不到的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 牛棚；後備投手區　(名) 後備隊員；替補選手
example_sentence: Not only does the team need a strong pitcher, but also a reliable bullpen to win the championship.
sentence_zh: 球隊不僅需要強大的先發投手，也需要可靠的後備投手區才能贏得冠軍。

definition_zh: (動) 欺凌；霸凌　(名) 霸凌者；惡棍
example_sentence: Students who bully their classmates often face serious consequences at school.
sentence_zh: 在學校欺凌同學的學生經常面臨嚴重後果。

definition_zh: (名) 令人失望的事；掃興的事　(感) 真糟糕；真倒霉
example_sentence: Missing the concert is such a bummer, but I saved money to buy the album instead.
sentence_zh: 錯過演唱會真是令人失望，不過我省錢買了專輯來代替。

definition_zh: (動) 意外遇見；偶然碰到　(動) 撞上；碰撞
example_sentence: Running late for class, Ming bumped into his best friend outside the school library.
sentence_zh: 趕著去上課的明意外在學校圖書館外面遇到了他最好的朋友。

definition_zh: (動) 殺死；除掉
example_sentence: The detective discovered that the gangster planned to bump off his rival.
sentence_zh: 偵探發現那名黑幫份子計畫殺死他的對手。

definition_zh: (動) 提高；增加　增長；上升
example_sentence: As sales bumped up significantly, the company decided to hire more employees this summer.
sentence_zh: 隨著銷售大幅增加，該公司決定在今年夏天招聘更多員工。

definition_zh: (名) 碰撞；腫塊　(動) 碰撞；撞擊　(形) 崎嶇不平的
example_sentence: Bumping into an old friend at the mall, Sarah felt delighted to reconnect after years.
sentence_zh: 在商場裡撞見一位老朋友，莎拉很高興能在多年後重新聯繫。

definition_zh: (名) 保險桿；緩衝器　(形) 很大的；豐收的
example_sentence: The new car has a bumper that absorbs impact, which protects passengers during collisions.
sentence_zh: 這台新車有一個能吸收衝擊的保險桿，它在碰撞時保護乘客的安全。

definition_zh: (形) 崎嶇不平的；顛簸的
example_sentence: If the mountain road remains bumpy, the bus ride to school will be very uncomfortable.
sentence_zh: 如果山路仍然崎嶇不平，搭公車上學的車程將會很不舒服。

definition_zh: (名) 麵包；小圓麵包　(名) 髮髻；髮束
example_sentence: Sarah bought a chocolate bun at the bakery after school.
sentence_zh: 莎拉放學後在麵包店買了一個巧克力小圓麵包。

definition_zh: (名) 束；群；一堆　(動) 聚集；束在一起
example_sentence: Students brought a bunch of flowers to thank their teacher for her kindness.
sentence_zh: 學生帶來一束花來感謝老師的親切。

definition_zh: (名) 堤岸；防波堤　(名) 上海外灘
example_sentence: The city built a strong bund along the river to prevent flooding during heavy rain.
sentence_zh: 這座城市沿著河邊建造了一道堅固的堤岸，以防止暴雨期間的洪水。

definition_zh: (動) 匆忙送走；趕緊打發走
example_sentence: After the party ended, the parents bundled the children off to bed so they could clean up.
sentence_zh: 派對結束後，父母匆忙把孩子們送上床睡覺，這樣他們就可以收拾房間。

definition_zh: (動) 急忙趕出；匆匆驅趕出去
example_sentence: Having bundled out the unruly guests, the security staff finally restored order to the venue.
sentence_zh: 保安人員急忙趕出那些不守規矩的客人後，終於恢復了場地的秩序。

definition_zh: (動) 穿上厚重衣物；裹緊　(動) 把東西捆紮；打包
example_sentence: Students who bundle up warmly before waiting for the school bus avoid catching cold.
sentence_zh: 在等校車前穿上厚重衣物的學生能避免感冒。

definition_zh: (名) 束；包裹　(動) 捆紮；匆匆推動
example_sentence: The store offers a special bundle deal combining laptop, mouse, and keyboard together.
sentence_zh: 這家店提供筆記型電腦、滑鼠和鍵盤捆綁販售的特別優惠。

definition_zh: (動) 搞砸；弄糟　(名) 失敗；笨拙的行為
example_sentence: If the project manager had not bungled the plan, the team would have completed the assignment on time.
sentence_zh: 如果專案經理沒有搞砸這個計畫，團隊就會準時完成任務。

definition_zh: (動) 逃課；翹課
example_sentence: Students who bunk off class risk facing serious consequences from teachers.
sentence_zh: 翹課的學生可能面臨老師的嚴厲後果。

definition_zh: (名) 鋪位；床　(動) 翹課；逃避　(形) 假的；不真實的
example_sentence: Bunking off class repeatedly, the student faced serious consequences from the school.
sentence_zh: 那個學生因為反覆翹課，面臨了學校的嚴重處分。

definition_zh: (名) 掩體；地下防禦工事　(名) 沙坑（高爾夫球）
example_sentence: When the soldiers took shelter in the bunker, they felt safer from enemy fire.
sentence_zh: 當士兵躲進掩體時，他們感到更安全，不怕敵人的砲火。

definition_zh: (動) 使...振作起来；鼓舞
example_sentence: Seldom does a failure buoy up someone's confidence, yet persistence always wins.
sentence_zh: 失敗很少能使人信心大增，但堅持總能贏得勝利。

definition_zh: (名) 浮標；浮筒　(動) 使浮起；支撑
example_sentence: The lifeboat, which was kept afloat by buoys attached to its sides, drifted safely toward shore.
sentence_zh: 那艘救生艇由附在兩側的浮標支撑著，安全地漂向岸邊。

definition_zh: (形) 樂觀的；充滿希望的　(形) 能浮起的；輕飄飄的
example_sentence: Marathon runners maintain a buoyant attitude to overcome physical challenges during the race.
sentence_zh: 馬拉松選手保持樂觀的態度以克服比賽中的身體挑戰。

definition_zh: (名) 負擔；重擔　(動) 使負擔；使承受
example_sentence: Heavy schoolwork and part-time jobs burden many high school students with stress.
sentence_zh: 繁重的功課和兼職工作使許多高中學生承受壓力。

definition_zh: (形) 沉重的；令人厭煩的　(形) 困擾的；麻煩的
example_sentence: Preparing for the CSAT exam can be burdensome for many students.
sentence_zh: 為學測考試做準備對許多學生來說可能很令人厭煩。

definition_zh: (動) 埋葬；掩埋　(名) 埋葬；墓地
example_sentence: The ancient king was buried in the tomb when his reign ended.
sentence_zh: 當這位古代國王的統治結束時，他被埋葬在陵墓中。

definition_zh: (名) 局；部門；辦公室
example_sentence: Operating the weather bureau, meteorologists predict typhoons affecting Taiwan each season.
sentence_zh: 運作氣象局的氣象學家每個季節都預測影響台灣的颱風。

definition_zh: (名) 官僚體制；官樣文章　(名) 繁瑣的行政程序
example_sentence: The bureaucracy that slows down government decisions frustrates citizens waiting for permits.
sentence_zh: 拖延政府決策的官僚體制讓等待許可證的市民感到沮喪。

definition_zh: (名) 官僚；公務員　(形) 官僚的；繁瑣的
example_sentence: If the bureaucrat processed applications more efficiently, students would receive their documents faster.
sentence_zh: 如果那位官僚能更有效率地處理申請，學生將會更快收到文件。

definition_zh: (形) 官僚的；充滿繁文縟禮的
example_sentence: The bureaucratic process made applying for a visa extremely time-consuming.
sentence_zh: 官僚的申請程序使得簽證申請變得非常耗時。

definition_zh: (動) 迅速成長；蓬勃發展　(名) 新芽；幼苗
example_sentence: Social media platforms invest in new features to burgeon their user base and market share.
sentence_zh: 社群媒體平台投資新功能以促進其用戶基數和市場份額的蓬勃發展。

definition_zh: (名) 漢堡；漢堡包
example_sentence: Eating a cheese burger and drinking cola is a popular lunch choice for students.
sentence_zh: 吃起司漢堡和喝可樂是學生們流行的午餐選擇。

definition_zh: (名) 竊賊；夜間入室盜竊的人　(名) 盜匪；小偷
example_sentence: Although the burglar escaped through the window, police caught him when he returned home.
sentence_zh: 雖然竊賊從窗戶逃脫，但當他回家時警察抓住了他。

definition_zh: (名) 竊盜罪；入室盜竊
example_sentence: Having committed burglary at three houses last month, the criminal was finally arrested by police.
sentence_zh: 由於上個月在三間房子犯下入室盜竊罪，該犯人最終被警察逮捕。

definition_zh: (名) 埋葬；葬禮　(動) 埋葬；掩埋
example_sentence: The ancient tomb, whose burial ceremony lasted three days, revealed precious artifacts that archaeologists studied carefully.
sentence_zh: 那座古墓的埋葬儀式持續了三天，其中出土的珍貴文物被考古學家們仔細研究。

definition_zh: (動) 燒毀；燒倒　(動) 失敗；衰落
example_sentence: The old wooden house burned down in the massive fire last winter.
sentence_zh: 那棟老木屋在去年冬天的大火中燒毀了。

definition_zh: (動) 消耗；燃燒掉　(動) 通過運動消耗（卡路里）
example_sentence: If athletes didn't burn off excess energy through daily training, their performance would decline significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果運動員沒有透過每日訓練消耗多餘能量，他們的表現會明顯下降。

definition_zh: (動) 筋疲力盡；精力耗盡　(名) 過度疲勞；耗盡
example_sentence: Working seventy hours every week made the nurse burn out quickly.
sentence_zh: 每週工作七十小時使那位護士很快筋疲力盡。

definition_zh: (片語) 熬夜工作；辛苦用功
example_sentence: Burning the midnight oil before the exam, many students sacrifice sleep to prepare thoroughly.
sentence_zh: 在考試前熬夜用功，許多學生犧牲睡眠以充分準備。

definition_zh: (動) 燃燒殆盡；耗盡　(動) 非常生氣；憤怒
example_sentence: As the rocket burns up while re-entering Earth's atmosphere, scientists monitor its descent carefully.
sentence_zh: 當火箭在重新進入地球大氣層時燃燒殆盡，科學家仔細監測其下降過程。

definition_zh: (動) 燃燒；燒毀　(動) 灼傷；燙傷　(名) 燒傷；灼傷
example_sentence: Hardly ever does a careless student burn their hand in chemistry class.
sentence_zh: 一個粗心的學生在化學課上很少會燙傷他們的手。

definition_zh: (形) 灼熱的；燃燒的　(動) 燃燒；灼傷
example_sentence: The burning desire that motivates students is often their dream of entering a top university.
sentence_zh: 驅使學生的灼熱渴望——經常是進入頂尖大學的夢想——激勵著許多考生。

definition_zh: (動) 打嗝；嗝氣　(名) 嗝音；打嗝聲
example_sentence: The baby drank milk too fast and needed to burp to feel comfortable.
sentence_zh: 嬰兒喝奶太快，需要打嗝才能感到舒服。

definition_zh: (名) 毛刺；刺痛的聲音　(動) 發出粗糙聲音；去毛刺
example_sentence: The rough burr on the metal edge made my finger hurt when I touched it.
sentence_zh: 金屬邊緣上粗糙的毛刺在我碰到時刺痛了我的手指。

definition_zh: (名) 洞穴；地洞　(動) 挖洞；鑽進
example_sentence: Rabbits dig burrows underground to build their homes safely.
sentence_zh: 兔子在地下挖洞來安全地建造牠們的家。

definition_zh: (動) 突然開始；爆發　(動) 衝進；闖入
example_sentence: When the exam results were announced, the students burst into cheers as their hard work paid off.
sentence_zh: 當考試成績公布時，學生們突然歡呼起來，因為他們的辛苦付出得到了回報。

definition_zh: (動) 突然破裂；爆炸　(名) 突然的爆發；一陣
example_sentence: Bursting with excitement, the students rushed into the concert hall.
sentence_zh: 因為興奮而爆發，學生們衝進了演唱會大廳。

definition_zh: (形) 爆裂的；充滿的　(動) 爆裂；破裂
example_sentence: The stadium filled with bursting fans cheering loudly for the home team.
sentence_zh: 充滿的粉絲在體育館裡為主隊歡呼雀躍。

definition_zh: (動) 埋藏；埋葬　(動) 隱藏；掩蓋
example_sentence: If students bury their textbooks without reviewing them, their exam scores will drop significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生不複習就把課本埋藏起來，他們的考試成績會大幅下降。

definition_zh: (名) 公車；巴士　(動) 用公車運送
example_sentence: The bus to Taipei leaves at 8:00 AM every day.
sentence_zh: 往台北的公車每天上午8點出發。

definition_zh: (名) 灌木；灌木叢　(名) 灌木地；荒野
example_sentence: Hikers climbed the mountain to explore the thick bush in the forest.
sentence_zh: 登山者爬上山去探索森林裡茂密的灌木叢。

definition_zh: (名) 野生動物肉；灌木叢動物肉
example_sentence: Hunting bushmeat in protected forests threatens endangered species and local ecosystems.
sentence_zh: 在受保護森林中獵捕野生動物肉威脅瀕危物種和當地生態系統。

definition_zh: (形) 濃密的；茂密的　(形) 蓬亂的；毛茸茸的
