example_sentence: As the forest became bushy with thick vegetation, hikers found the trail increasingly difficult to navigate.
sentence_zh: 當森林因濃密的植被而變得灌木叢生時，登山者發現越來越難以通過這條小徑。

definition_zh: (名) 商業；生意　(名) 公司；企業
example_sentence: Having completed the MBA program, Sarah launched her own business in Taipei last year.
sentence_zh: 完成MBA課程後，莎拉去年在台北創辦了自己的公司。

definition_zh: (名) 商人；企業家　(名) 生意人；商務人士
example_sentence: The businessman who founded the tech company became very successful in Taiwan's market.
sentence_zh: 創辦科技公司的那位商人在台灣市場變得非常成功。

definition_zh: (動) 吵架；關係破裂　(動) 打破；摔壞
example_sentence: After constant disagreements about university plans, the couple bust up last month.
sentence_zh: 由於對大學計畫有持續分歧，這對情侶上個月分手了。

definition_zh: (動) 破裂；爆炸　(名) 胸像；半身像
example_sentence: If the water pipe burst, the basement would flood completely.
sentence_zh: 如果水管破裂，地下室就會完全淹水。

definition_zh: (名) 破壞者；克星　(名) 暢銷商品；大片電影
example_sentence: The action movie was a real blockbuster that broke all box office records.
sentence_zh: 那部動作電影是真正的暢銷大片，打破了所有票房紀錄。

definition_zh: (動) 忙碌地活動；熱鬧　(名) 熱鬧；繁忙
example_sentence: Bustling with energy, the night market attracted thousands of customers every weekend.
sentence_zh: 熱鬧非凡的夜市每個週末都吸引數千名顧客。

definition_zh: (形) 熙攘的；繁忙的　(副) 熙攘地；忙碌地
example_sentence: As the night market grew bustling with shoppers, vendors called out their specials loudly.
sentence_zh: 當夜市變得熙攘擁擠，小販大聲叫賣他們的特價商品。

definition_zh: (形) 忙碌的；忙著做某事　(動) 使忙碌；占據
example_sentence: Seldom are students as busy as during exam week.
sentence_zh: 學生很少像考試週一樣那麼忙碌。

definition_zh: (連) 而是；反而　(片) 倒是；卻是
example_sentence: The problem is not that students lack effort, but rather that they need better study strategies.
sentence_zh: 問題不在於學生缺乏努力，而是他們需要更好的讀書方法。

definition_zh: (連) 但是；可是　(介) 除了；只有
example_sentence: The exam is difficult, but studying hard helps students pass it.
sentence_zh: 這次考試很難，但認真讀書可以幫助學生通過考試。

definition_zh: (名) 屠夫；肉販　(動) 宰殺；粗暴對待
example_sentence: The local butcher shop sells fresh meat and prepared dishes every morning.
sentence_zh: 當地的肉鋪每天早上都販售新鮮肉類和熟食。

definition_zh: (動) 插嘴；打斷別人說話
example_sentence: During the class discussion, Tom butted in without raising his hand first.
sentence_zh: 在課堂討論中，湯姆沒舉手就插嘴發言。

definition_zh: (動) 不要插手；別管閒事　停止干涉
example_sentence: When the argument started between them, I decided to butt out before making things worse.
sentence_zh: 當他們之間的爭執開始時，我決定不插手以免讓情況變糟。

definition_zh: (動) 奉承；討好　(動) 用黃油塗抹
example_sentence: Buttering up the teacher with compliments, Mark hoped to improve his grade.
sentence_zh: 馬克用讚美奉承老師，希望能提高他的成績。

definition_zh: (名) 奶油；黃油　(動) 塗奶油；潤滑
example_sentence: The toast that the chef prepared had a generous layer of butter spread across it.
sentence_zh: 廚師準備的吐司上塗了一層厚奶油。

definition_zh: (名) 蝴蝶；蛺蝶
example_sentence: If a butterfly lands on your hand, you should stay still and watch carefully.
sentence_zh: 如果蝴蝶落在你的手上，你應該保持不動並仔細觀察。

definition_zh: (形) 含奶油的；黃油般的　(形) 光滑的；柔軟的
example_sentence: The buttery croissants from the bakery melted in my mouth during breakfast.
sentence_zh: 麵包店的奶油羊角麵包在早餐時在我嘴裡融化了。

definition_zh: (名) 按鈕；按扣　(動) 扣上；按下
example_sentence: Press the red button to start the machine.
sentence_zh: 按下紅色按鈕來啟動機器。

definition_zh: (動) 同意；購買；接受某個想法或計畫
example_sentence: The team needs to buy in to the new training strategy for success.
sentence_zh: 球隊需要同意這個新的訓練策略才能成功。

definition_zh: (動) 相信；接受　贊成；同意
example_sentence: Although many students buy into the idea that studying late improves grades, scientific research suggests otherwise.
sentence_zh: 雖然許多學生相信熬夜讀書能提高成績，但科學研究卻表明事實並非如此。

definition_zh: (動) 用金錢收買；賄賂　(動) 用利益收買某人使其不反對
example_sentence: Having bought off the local officials with bribes, the construction company completed the illegal project without opposition.
sentence_zh: 用賄賂收買了當地官員後，這家建築公司在沒有反對聲浪下完成了非法項目。

definition_zh: (動) 買斷；收購　購買某人的股份或企業
example_sentence: The larger company bought out the smaller competitor, which had been struggling financially.
sentence_zh: 那家較大的公司收購了陷入財務困難的較小競爭對手。

definition_zh: (動) 大量收購；全部買下
example_sentence: The investment company bought up all the available shares before the price increased.
sentence_zh: 那家投資公司在股價上漲前大量收購了所有可得的股份。

definition_zh: (動) 購買；買　(動) 說服；贏得
example_sentence: If students bought their textbooks early, they would save money before the semester starts.
sentence_zh: 如果學生們早點購買課本，他們在學期開始前就能省錢。

definition_zh: (動) 在附近忙碌地活動；嗡嗡地飛來飛去
example_sentence: Bees buzz around the garden looking for flowers every spring.
sentence_zh: 每個春天，蜜蜂都在花園周圍嗡嗡地飛來飛去尋找花朵。

definition_zh: (動) 滾開；別煩我；離開
example_sentence: Annoyed by constant interruptions, the student told the classmate to buzz off during the exam.
sentence_zh: 因為不斷被打擾而惱怒，那位學生在考試期間叫同學滾開。

definition_zh: (名) 嗡嗡聲；熱議話題　(動) 發出嗡嗡聲；引起熱烈討論
example_sentence: As the bee buzzed around the flower, students nearby felt both curious and nervous.
sentence_zh: 當蜜蜂在花朵周圍嗡嗡叫時，附近的學生既感到好奇又有些緊張。

definition_zh: (片) 突飛猛進；飛速增長
example_sentence: Not only has the company's revenue increased by leaps and bounds, but its market share has doubled.
sentence_zh: 這家公司的營收不僅突飛猛進，市場份額也翻倍了。

definition_zh: (介) 藉由；通過　(連) 以…方式；靠著
example_sentence: The scientist discovered a new medicine by means of careful experiments that took five years.
sentence_zh: 這位科學家藉由花了五年時間進行的仔細實驗發現了一種新藥。

definition_zh: (片) 絕對不；決不
example_sentence: Studying hard is essential to pass the CSAT by no means without effort and dedication.
sentence_zh: 要通過學測，絕對不能沒有努力和決心去認真讀書。

definition_zh: (介片) 在...身邊；靠近...　在...旁邊；與...在一起
example_sentence: Having a loyal friend by one's side makes life's difficult moments much easier to bear.
sentence_zh: 身邊有一位忠實的朋友會使人生中困難的時刻更容易度過。

definition_zh: (連) 到...時候；等到...的時候
example_sentence: By the time Sarah finished her homework, it was already midnight.
sentence_zh: 到莎拉完成功課的時候，已經是午夜了。

definition_zh: (副) 順便說一下；對了
example_sentence: By the way, don't forget to submit your homework before Friday.
sentence_zh: 順便說一下，別忘了在星期五前繳交你的功課。

definition_zh: (名) 副產品；附帶產物
example_sentence: Producing electricity from coal, pollution becomes an unavoidable by-product affecting air quality nationwide.
sentence_zh: 從煤炭發電，污染成為不可避免的副產品，影響全國空氣品質。

definition_zh: (介) 被；由　(介) 在...旁邊；靠近
example_sentence: The homework by students who study hard is always completed on time.
sentence_zh: 由認真讀書的學生所做的功課總是按時完成。

definition_zh: (動) 繞過；迂迴；規避　(名) 旁道；迂迴路線
example_sentence: If the main road is congested, drivers will bypass the traffic jam by taking the side streets.
sentence_zh: 如果主要道路擁塞，駕駛人員將透過走小街道來繞過交通堵塞。

definition_zh: (名) 位元組；字節
example_sentence: A byte consists of eight bits and can represent 256 different values.
sentence_zh: 一個位元組由八個位元組成，可以表示256種不同的數值。

definition_zh: (名) 諺語；俗語　(名) 代表人物；典型例子
example_sentence: The company became a byword to demonstrate the importance of ethical business practices.
sentence_zh: 這家公司成為一個典型例子，用來說明誠實商業行為的重要性。

definition_zh: (名) 高麗菜；包心菜
example_sentence: Fresh cabbage and other green vegetables are good for your health.
sentence_zh: 新鮮的高麗菜和其他綠色蔬菜對你的健康很有益。

definition_zh: (名) 小屋；船艙
example_sentence: As the storm grew worse, passengers retreated to the cabin where they felt safer.
sentence_zh: 當暴風雨變得更糟時，乘客們撤退到小屋，在那裡他們感到更安全。

definition_zh: (名) 內閣；政府部門　(名) 儲藏櫃；櫥櫃
example_sentence: Having served in the cabinet for five years, the minister resigned from politics.
sentence_zh: 在內閣中服務了五年後，部長從政治中辭職。

definition_zh: (名) 電纜；電線　(名) 船用粗繩
example_sentence: The internet cable that connects to your router is something you should not damage carelessly.
sentence_zh: 連接到你路由器的網路電纜是你不應該隨意損壞的東西。

definition_zh: (名) 仙人掌（複數）；仙人掌類植物
example_sentence: The garden's colorful cacti require very little water and thrive in dry climates.
sentence_zh: 花園裡五顏六色的仙人掌需要很少的水，在乾燥氣候中生長良好。

definition_zh: (名) 仙人掌；沙漠植物
example_sentence: If the desert region received more rainfall, the cactus would not need such thick, waxy leaves.
sentence_zh: 如果沙漠地區降雨量增多，仙人掌就不需要那麼厚的蠟質葉片。

definition_zh: (名) 屍體；遺體
example_sentence: Medical students study the cadaver to learn human anatomy.
sentence_zh: 醫學生透過研究屍體來學習人體解剖學。

definition_zh: (名) 咖啡館；咖啡廳　(名) 咖啡
example_sentence: Sitting in the quiet cafe, students studied for their CSAT exam together.
sentence_zh: 坐在安靜的咖啡館裡，學生們一起為學測做準備。

definition_zh: (名) 自助餐廳；食堂
example_sentence: Although the cafeteria serves affordable meals, many students prefer eating lunch outside.
sentence_zh: 儘管自助餐廳提供便宜的餐點，許多學生仍然偏好在外面吃午餐。

definition_zh: (名) 咖啡因；興奮劑
example_sentence: Not only does caffeine increase alertness, but it also raises heart rate.
sentence_zh: 咖啡因不僅能提高警覺性，而且還會升高心率。

definition_zh: (名) 籠子；鳥籠　(動) 將…關進籠子；限制
example_sentence: The bird that escaped from its cage flew freely through the sky.
sentence_zh: 那隻從籠子逃脫的鳥在天空中自由飛翔。

definition_zh: (名) 蛋糕；cake　(動) 結成塊；凝結
example_sentence: Baking a cake to celebrate birthdays is a popular tradition in Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 烤蛋糕來慶祝生日是台灣的流行傳統。

definition_zh: (名) 花燭；彩葉芋
example_sentence: The caladium plant with colorful leaves brightens up the shaded corner of the garden.
sentence_zh: 這株葉子色彩鮮豔的花燭植物為花園陰暗的角落增添亮色。

definition_zh: (名) 災難；浩劫　(名) 不幸的事件
example_sentence: The earthquake was a terrible calamity that affected thousands of families.
sentence_zh: 這場地震是影響數千個家庭的可怕災難。

definition_zh: (名) 鈣；鈣質
example_sentence: Since milk contains abundant calcium, drinking it daily helps strengthen bones and teeth.
sentence_zh: 由於牛奶含有豐富的鈣質，每天喝牛奶有助於強化骨骼和牙齒。

definition_zh: (動) 計算；推算　(動) 估計；判斷
example_sentence: Calculating the total cost carefully, the accountant discovered a significant error in the budget.
sentence_zh: 會計仔細計算總成本，發現預算中有重大錯誤。

definition_zh: (形) 計畫好的；預謀的　(形) 精心設計的；有意的
example_sentence: The calculated move that surprised everyone earned the team a victory.
sentence_zh: 那個令所有人吃驚的精心策劃的舉動使隊伍贏得了勝利。

definition_zh: (形) 精於計算的；狡猾的；有目的的
example_sentence: If students use calculating methods to solve math problems, they will save time during exams.
sentence_zh: 如果學生使用精於計算的方法來解數學題，他們在考試期間會節省時間。

definition_zh: (名) 計算；計算結果　(名) 估計；推測
example_sentence: The engineer's careful calculation ensured the building's safety.
sentence_zh: 工程師仔細的計算確保了建築物的安全。

definition_zh: (名) 計算機；計算器
example_sentence: Students use calculators to solve complex math problems during exams.
sentence_zh: 學生在考試中使用計算機來解決複雜的數學問題。

definition_zh: (名) 日曆；月曆　(名) 行事曆；日程表
example_sentence: Marking important exam dates on the wall calendar helps students stay organized.
sentence_zh: 在牆上的月曆標記重要考試日期能幫助學生保持井然有序。

definition_zh: (名) 小牛；腓腸肌
example_sentence: When the farmer's calf was born, the entire herd welcomed the newborn with gentle sounds.
sentence_zh: 當農民的小牛出生時，整個牛群用溫柔的叫聲歡迎新生兒。

definition_zh: (名) 口徑；能力　(名) 素質；水準
example_sentence: Having calibrated the equipment carefully, the engineer confirmed the instrument's high caliber for precision work.
sentence_zh: 工程師仔細地校準了設備後，確認了該儀器在精密工作中的高素質。

definition_zh: (動) 校準；調整
example_sentence: The scientific instrument that was carefully calibrated by the technician produced accurate results.
sentence_zh: 被技術員仔細校準的科學儀器產生了準確的結果。

definition_zh: (動) 以…命名；用…的名字給…取名
example_sentence: The baby was called after her grandmother, honoring the family tradition.
sentence_zh: 這個嬰兒以她祖母的名字命名，以此尊重家族傳統。

definition_zh: (動) 回電；打電話給　(動) 召回；要求歸還
example_sentence: If the store manager called back the defective product, customers would receive a full refund immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果店經理召回有缺陷的產品，顧客就會立即獲得全額退款。

definition_zh: (動) 責罵；斥責　(動) 召喚；呼叫下來
example_sentence: The coach called down the player for making careless mistakes during the match.
sentence_zh: 教練因為那位選手在比賽中犯了粗心的錯誤而責罵他。

definition_zh: (動) 要求；呼籲　(動) 需要；必需
example_sentence: Calling for immediate action, the environmental group demanded stronger pollution controls.
sentence_zh: 環保團體呼籲立即採取行動，要求更嚴格的污染管制措施。

definition_zh: (動) 喚起；引起　激發；召喚
example_sentence: Because the coach called forth the team's determination, the players performed at their highest level during the finals.
sentence_zh: 因為教練激發了球隊的決心，球員在決賽中表現出最高水準。

definition_zh: (動) 召喚；打電話　(動) 請假；缺席
example_sentence: Hardly ever does a nurse call in sick without advance notice.
sentence_zh: 護士幾乎不會在沒有提前通知的情況下請病假。

definition_zh: (片) 結束；放棄　停止做某事
example_sentence: After months of arguing about the project, the two partners decided to call it quits, which made everyone feel relieved.
sentence_zh: 經過數月爭論這個專案後，那兩位合夥人決定結束合作，這讓每個人都感到寬慰。

definition_zh: (動) 取消；停止　(動) 叫走；召回
example_sentence: The coach decided to call off practice to give players time to rest.
sentence_zh: 教練決定取消練習以便讓選手有時間休息。

definition_zh: (動) 呼籲；要求　(動) 拜訪；造訪
example_sentence: The principal called on all students to respect school rules and maintain discipline.
sentence_zh: 校長呼籲所有學生尊重校規並維持紀律。

definition_zh: (動) 辱罵；叫某人難聽的名字
example_sentence: When kids call names, other students feel hurt and sad.
sentence_zh: 當孩子們辱罵他人時，其他學生會感到受傷和難過。

definition_zh: (動) 召集；徵召　打電話給某人
example_sentence: When the army called up all available soldiers, thousands of young men reported to the base immediately.
sentence_zh: 當軍隊召集所有可用的士兵時，數千名年輕人立即向基地報到。

definition_zh: (動) 叫喊；呼喚　(動) 打電話；致電　(名) 呼喊；電話
example_sentence: Calling his name loudly, the coach gathered all the players for the final meeting.
sentence_zh: 教練大聲呼喚他的名字，聚集所有球員進行最後一次會議。

definition_zh: (名) 書法； 筆跡
example_sentence: The ancient Chinese calligraphy, which requires years of dedicated practice, remains a treasured art form in Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 那古代中文書法需要多年的專心練習，在台灣仍是一門珍貴的藝術形式。

definition_zh: (形) 冷漠的；無情的　(形) 麻木的；不敏感的
example_sentence: If students adopt a callous attitude toward others' struggles, they will lose important friendships.
sentence_zh: 如果學生對他人的困難採取冷漠的態度，他們將失去重要的友誼。

definition_zh: (名) 老繭；硬皮　(動) 形成老繭
example_sentence: The guitarist's fingers developed thick calluses from practicing every day.
sentence_zh: 吉他手因為每天練習而手指上形成了厚厚的老繭。

definition_zh: (動) 冷靜下來；平復心情　(動) 使某人平靜；使減弱
example_sentence: Taking deep breaths helps students calm down before major exams.
sentence_zh: 深呼吸有助於學生在大考前平復心情。

definition_zh: (形) 平靜的；冷靜的　(動) 使平靜；使冷靜
example_sentence: Taking deep breaths helps keep your mind calm and focused during difficult exams.
sentence_zh: 深呼吸有助於在困難的考試中保持心態平靜和集中。

definition_zh: (副) 平靜地；沉著地
example_sentence: Although the earthquake shocked everyone, the principal calmly guided students to safety.
sentence_zh: 雖然地震令每個人都感到震驚，但校長沉著地引導學生安全撤離。

definition_zh: (名) 卡路里；熱量
example_sentence: Having consumed excessive calories, the athlete modified her diet to improve performance.
sentence_zh: 運動員攝取過多卡路里後，修改了飲食以提高運動表現。

definition_zh: (名) 同志的友誼；戰友情誼　(名) 親密的友好關係；同伴精神
example_sentence: The camaraderie that the team members shared during training made them unstoppable competitors.
sentence_zh: 隊員在訓練期間所共享的同志友誼使他們成為不可戰勝的競爭者。

definition_zh: (名) 駱駝；駱駝型的人或物
example_sentence: The camel can store water and survive in the desert for weeks.
sentence_zh: 駱駝能夠儲存水分，在沙漠中存活數週。

definition_zh: (名) 相機；攝影機
example_sentence: If the camera had better resolution, the photo would look much sharper.
sentence_zh: 如果相機的解析度更高，照片看起來會清晰得多。

definition_zh: (名) 偽裝；迷彩　(動) 偽裝；隱藏
example_sentence: Soldiers wear camouflage uniforms to hide in the forest.
sentence_zh: 士兵穿著迷彩制服在森林中隱藏。

definition_zh: (名) 營地；夏令營　(動) 露營；紮營　(形) 誇張的；刻意做作的
example_sentence: Camping in the mountains, students discovered new plants and made lasting friendships.
sentence_zh: 在山裡露營，學生們發現了新的植物並建立了持久的友誼。

definition_zh: (名) 活動；運動　(動) 參加活動；宣傳
example_sentence: As the presidential campaign progresses, voters learn more about each candidate's policy positions.
sentence_zh: 隨著總統競選活動的進行，選民更了解每位候選人的政策立場。

definition_zh: (名) 運動倡導者；宣傳者
example_sentence: Seldom does a young campaigner abandon the fight for environmental justice.
sentence_zh: 一位年輕的倡導者很少放棄爭取環境正義的鬥爭。

definition_zh: (名) 露營；野營　(動) 露營；在戶外紮營
example_sentence: The camping trip that our school organized last month was absolutely amazing.
sentence_zh: 我們學校上個月舉辦的露營活動真的棒極了。

definition_zh: (名) 校園；校區
example_sentence: Many students visit the campus to attend clubs and meet friends after class.
sentence_zh: 許多學生放學後到校園參加社團並認識朋友。

definition_zh: (形) 誇張做作的；刻意營造戲劇效果的
example_sentence: The musical's campy costumes and over-the-top acting made the audience laugh throughout the show.
sentence_zh: 這齣音樂劇誇張做作的服裝和浮誇的表演讓觀眾全程大笑。

definition_zh: (動) 無法忘記；難以接受
example_sentence: Sarah can't get over her ex-boyfriend after their breakup last month.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在上個月分手後一直無法忘記她的前男友。

definition_zh: (片) 無法移開視線；被吸引住　(動) 目不轉睛地看著；被迷住
example_sentence: As the magician performed his final trick, the audience couldn't take their eyes off the stage.
sentence_zh: 當魔術師表演最後一個把戲時，觀眾無法移開他們的視線離開舞台。

definition_zh: (形) 不可錯過的；必看的
example_sentence: Featuring award-winning actors and stunning cinematography, this film is a can't-miss summer blockbuster.
sentence_zh: 這部電影以得獎演員和令人驚艷的攝影為特色，是不可錯過的暑期大片。

definition_zh: (動) 能夠；可以　(助動) 可能；能
example_sentence: Students who can speak English fluently have more opportunities for future careers.
sentence_zh: 能流利說英語的學生在未來職業上有更多機會。

definition_zh: (名) 加拿大（北美洲國家）
example_sentence: If students study hard, Canada's universities will offer them excellent scholarship opportunities.
sentence_zh: 如果學生努力讀書，加拿大的大學將為他們提供優異的獎學金機會。

definition_zh: (形) 加拿大的；加拿大人的　(名) 加拿大人
example_sentence: My friend's family moved to Canada, and now she speaks with a Canadian accent.
sentence_zh: 我朋友的家人搬到加拿大，現在她說話帶有加拿大口音。

definition_zh: (名) 運河；水道　(動) 引導；疏導
example_sentence: Engineers built a canal to transport fresh water and reduce flooding in the region.
sentence_zh: 工程師建造了一條運河，目的是運輸淡水並減少該地區的洪水災害。

definition_zh: (動) 相互抵消；互相抵銷　(動) 使無效；取消效果
example_sentence: The two opposite forces cancel out, leaving the object in equilibrium.
sentence_zh: 兩股相反的力相互抵消，使物體達到平衡。

definition_zh: (動) 取消；廢除　(動) 抵消；互相抵銷
example_sentence: Because the typhoon cancelled the outdoor concert, thousands of fans had to reschedule their plans.
sentence_zh: 因為颱風取消了戶外音樂會，數千名粉絲不得不重新安排他們的計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 取消；廢止　(名) 抵銷；相互抵消
example_sentence: Having received the cancellation notice, the student rescheduled the exam appointment immediately.
sentence_zh: 收到取消通知後，該學生立即重新安排考試時間。

definition_zh: (名) 癌症；癌　(名) 巨蟹座
example_sentence: The disease, which affected millions of people worldwide, required early detection and treatment to improve survival rates.
sentence_zh: 這種疾病，在全世界影響了數百萬人，需要早期發現和治療以改善存活率。

definition_zh: (形) 坦白的；率直的　(形) 真實的；未經修飾的
example_sentence: The teacher gave candid feedback about each student's essay during the writing conference.
sentence_zh: 老師在寫作會議中對每位學生的文章提出坦白的意見。

definition_zh: (名) 候選人；應徵者　(名) 考生；申請人
example_sentence: If the presidential candidate studied local issues more carefully, voters would trust him with important decisions.
sentence_zh: 如果總統候選人更仔細地研究地方問題，選民就會相信他能處理重要決策。

definition_zh: (名) 蠟燭；燭光
example_sentence: The candle on the birthday cake burns brightly in the dark room.
sentence_zh: 生日蛋糕上的蠟燭在黑暗的房間裡明亮地燃燒。

definition_zh: (名) 糖果；甜蜜的東西　(動) 糖漬；蜜餞
example_sentence: Watching the fireworks display, children eagerly collected colorful candy from the festival ground.
sentence_zh: 看著煙火表演，孩子們在節慶會場上急切地收集五彩繽紛的糖果。

definition_zh: (名) 手杖；拐杖　(動) 用手杖支撑；打
example_sentence: As the elderly man walked slowly with his cane, passersby offered help.
sentence_zh: 當那位老先生拿著手杖緩慢行走時，路人紛紛主動幫忙。

definition_zh: (形) 犬的；狗的　(名) 犬科動物；狗
example_sentence: Seldom does a canine companion show more loyalty than a faithful dog.
sentence_zh: 忠實的狗很少展現出比犬科寵物更多的忠誠。

definition_zh: (名) 食人族；食人者　(形) 食人的；同類相食的
example_sentence: The documentary explored the island where ancient tribes, which anthropologists believed were cannibals, developed unique survival strategies.
sentence_zh: 那部紀錄片探討了這座島嶼，人類學家認為島上古代部落是食人族，他們發展出獨特的生存策略。

definition_zh: (名) 大砲；砲　(動) 用砲轟擊；砲擊
example_sentence: The army used cannons to destroy the enemy's fortress and win the battle.
sentence_zh: 軍隊用大砲來摧毀敵人的堡壘並贏得戰爭。

definition_zh: (名) 獨木舟；輕舟
example_sentence: Paddling the canoe across the quiet lake requires both balance and strength.
sentence_zh: 用槳划著獨木舟穿過平靜的湖面需要平衡感和力量。

definition_zh: (動) 封為聖人；推崇為偉人
example_sentence: The Catholic Church canonized Mother Teresa for her selfless work with the poor.
sentence_zh: 天主教會因為德蕾莎修女為窮人的無私奉獻而將她封為聖人。

definition_zh: (名) 餐廳；食堂　(名) 水壺；水瓶
example_sentence: Whenever students feel hungry during breaks, the school canteen offers affordable meals and snacks.
sentence_zh: 每當學生在下課時感到飢餓，學校食堂提供價格合理的飯菜和零食。

definition_zh: (名) 懸臂；懸臂梁　(動) 用懸臂支撐
example_sentence: Extending out from the cliff, the cantilever bridge provided stunning views of the valley below.
sentence_zh: 從懸崖延伸出去的懸臂橋，提供了下方山谷的壯麗景色。

definition_zh: (名) 帆布；畫布　(動) 徵求意見；遊說
example_sentence: The painting, which was created on canvas by a famous artist, sold for millions at auction.
sentence_zh: 這幅由著名藝術家在畫布上創作的繪畫在拍賣會上以數百萬元成交。

definition_zh: (名) 峽谷；險峽
example_sentence: If hikers explore the Grand Canyon, they will discover breathtaking views and fascinating geological formations along the trail.
sentence_zh: 如果登山者探索大峽谷，他們將在步道沿途發現令人驚嘆的景色和迷人的地質構造。

definition_zh: (名) 帽子；蓋子　(動) 蓋住；限制
example_sentence: Remember to wear a cap when playing sports outside in summer.
sentence_zh: 在夏天戶外運動時，記得戴上帽子。

definition_zh: (名) 能力；能耐　(名) 才能；本領
example_sentence: Learning programming skills can enhance students' capability to solve real-world problems.
sentence_zh: 學習程式設計能力可以增強學生解決現實問題的能力。

definition_zh: (形) 有能力的；勝任的　(形) 能夠做某事的；有才能的
example_sentence: A capable student who studies hard can definitely pass the CSAT exam with flying colors.
sentence_zh: 一位肯努力的有能力學生絕對能以優異的成績通過學測。

definition_zh: (形) 寬敞的；容量大的；廣闊的
example_sentence: Although the museum's capacious gallery seemed endless, visitors still couldn't see all the paintings in one day.
sentence_zh: 雖然博物館寬敞的畫廊似乎無止盡，訪客仍然無法在一天內看完所有的畫作。

definition_zh: (名) 電容器；蓄電器
example_sentence: Having stored electrical energy, the capacitor released it gradually into the circuit.
sentence_zh: 電容器儲存了電能後，逐漸將其釋放到電路中。

definition_zh: (名) 容量；能力　(名) 職位；身分
example_sentence: The stadium's capacity, which exceeded fifty thousand seats, made it perfect for hosting the concert.
sentence_zh: 這個體育館的容量超過五萬個座位，這使它非常適合舉辦音樂會。

definition_zh: (名) 海角；岬角　(名) 斗篷；披肩
example_sentence: The lighthouse stands on a rocky cape overlooking the Atlantic Ocean.
sentence_zh: 燈塔矗立在俯瞰大西洋的岩石海角上。

definition_zh: (名) 首都；資本　(形) 主要的；大寫的
example_sentence: If Taiwan's capital were moved to the south, the government would need to invest huge amounts of money.
sentence_zh: 如果臺灣的首都遷往南方，政府將需要投入龐大的資金。

definition_zh: (名) 資本主義；資本制度
example_sentence: Capitalism encourages business competition and individual profit in modern economies.
sentence_zh: 資本主義在現代經濟中鼓勵商業競爭和個人利潤。

definition_zh: (名) 資本家；從事資本主義的人
example_sentence: Believing in free markets, the capitalist invested heavily in new technology companies.
sentence_zh: 那位資本家相信自由市場，因此在新科技公司中投入大量資金。

definition_zh: (名) 囚禁；被關押　(名) 被監禁的狀態；束縛
example_sentence: Although the bird had lived in captivity for many years, it still dreamed of flying free in nature.
sentence_zh: 雖然那隻鳥在囚禁中生活了多年，但它仍然夢想在大自然中自由飛翔。

definition_zh: (名) 小型膠囊錠劑；藥片
example_sentence: Only after taking the caplet with water does the medicine work effectively.
sentence_zh: 只有在用水吞下藥片後，藥物才能有效發揮作用。

definition_zh: (形) 善變的；任意的　(形) 反覆無常的；難以預測的
example_sentence: The fashion designer, whose capricious taste often changed overnight, frustrated many clothing manufacturers.
sentence_zh: 那位時尚設計師善變的品味經常在一夜之間改變，令許多服裝製造商感到沮喪。

definition_zh: (名) 膠囊；太空艙　(動) 把...裝入膠囊
example_sentence: Astronauts trained hard to operate the spacecraft capsule safely.
sentence_zh: 太空人努力訓練以便安全操作太空艙。

definition_zh: (名) 船長；隊長　(動) 擔任…的隊長；領導
example_sentence: The team captain led the players to victory in the final match.
sentence_zh: 隊長帶領選手在決賽中取得勝利。

definition_zh: (名) 標題；字幕　(動) 為…加標題；加字幕
example_sentence: The caption below the photo explains what the building is.
sentence_zh: 照片下方的標題解釋了這棟建築物是什麼。

definition_zh: (動) 吸引；迷住　(動) 俘虜；逮捕
example_sentence: As the magician performed his tricks, the audience became captivated by his amazing skills.
sentence_zh: 當魔術師表演他的魔術技巧時，觀眾被他驚人的技能所吸引。

definition_zh: (形) 迷人的；吸引人的　(動) 吸引；迷住
example_sentence: Captivating the audience with her storytelling skills, the teacher made history lessons unforgettable.
sentence_zh: 用說故事的技巧吸引觀眾，這位老師讓歷史課變得難忘。

definition_zh: (形) 被囚禁的；被俘虜的　(名) 俘虜；囚犯
example_sentence: The wild animal, which remained captive in the zoo for years, finally regained its freedom.
sentence_zh: 這隻野生動物在動物園裡被囚禁多年後，終於恢復了自由。

definition_zh: (名) 囚禁；被捕　(名) 被圈養的狀態；失去自由
example_sentence: If the endangered species remains in captivity, breeding programs will help ensure its survival for future generations.
sentence_zh: 如果這種瀕危物種保持在囚禁狀態，繁殖計畫將有助於確保其為後代存活。

definition_zh: (動) 捕捉；抓住　(動) 拍攝；記錄　(名) 俘虜；捕獲
example_sentence: The photographer managed to capture the sunset's beautiful colors in one amazing shot.
sentence_zh: 這位攝影師設法在一張精彩的照片中捕捉到日落的美麗色彩。

definition_zh: (名) 汽車；車子
example_sentence: Many students take the bus instead of driving a car to school.
sentence_zh: 許多學生搭公車而不是開車去上學。

definition_zh: (名) 鉤環；快速扣
example_sentence: Rock climbers use a carabiner to secure the rope safely during challenging ascents.
sentence_zh: 登山者在困難的攀登過程中使用鉤環來安全地固定繩索。

definition_zh: (名) 焦糖；太妃糖　(形) 焦糖色的；淡褐色的
example_sentence: While the butter melted slowly, the sugar turned into golden caramel that smelled wonderful.
sentence_zh: 當黃油慢慢融化時，糖變成了聞起來很香的金色焦糖。

definition_zh: (名) 旅行隊；車隊　(名) 露營車；活動住宅
example_sentence: Having traveled across three countries, the caravan finally arrived at its destination.
sentence_zh: 經過穿越三個國家，這支旅行隊終於到達了目的地。

definition_zh: (名) 碳水化合物；澱粉類食物
example_sentence: Students who eat carbs before exams often feel more energetic and focused.
sentence_zh: 在考試前吃碳水化合物的學生通常感到更有精力和專注。

definition_zh: (名) 碳水化合物；醣類
example_sentence: Eating whole grain carbohydrates provides energy and fiber for athletic performance.
sentence_zh: 食用全穀碳水化合物能為運動表現提供能量和纖維。

definition_zh: (名) 二氧化碳；碳酸氣
example_sentence: If factories reduced carbon dioxide emissions, air pollution would decrease significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果工廠減少二氧化碳排放，空氣汙染就會明顯減少。

definition_zh: (名) 碳；碳元素　(形) 含碳的；碳質的
example_sentence: Burning fossil fuels releases carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.
sentence_zh: 燃燒化石燃料會將二氧化碳釋放到大氣中。

definition_zh: (名) 卡片；卡　(動) 出示證件；刷卡
example_sentence: Having received a birthday card from her grandmother, Maria felt deeply moved and grateful.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞收到奶奶寄來的生日卡片後，感到非常感動和感謝。

definition_zh: (名) 硬紙板；紙板　(形) 硬紙板製的；平板的
example_sentence: Although the moving box was made of cardboard, it held heavy books without collapsing.
sentence_zh: 雖然搬家紙箱是用硬紙板製造的，但它能裝著沉重的書籍而不塌陷。

definition_zh: (名) 持卡人；信用卡持有人
example_sentence: Only after cardholders report fraudulent charges can banks immediately cancel the card.
sentence_zh: 只有在持卡人回報詐欺交易後，銀行才能立即取消該卡。

definition_zh: (形) 最重要的；基本的　(名) 樞機主教；紅衣主教
example_sentence: Time management, which is a cardinal skill that students need to develop, requires consistent practice and discipline.
sentence_zh: 時間管理是學生需要培養的最重要技能，它需要持續的練習和紀律。

definition_zh: (名) 心臟病醫生；心臟科醫生
example_sentence: My uncle visited a cardiologist to check his heart health.
sentence_zh: 我叔叔去看心臟科醫生檢查心臟健康。

definition_zh: (形) 心臟和血管的；心血管的
example_sentence: Regular exercise strengthens the cardiovascular system and improves overall health.
sentence_zh: 規律運動強化心血管系統並改善整體健康。

definition_zh: (動) 在乎；關心　(動) 介意；計較
example_sentence: Sarah doesn't care about what other people think of her appearance.
sentence_zh: 莎拉不在乎別人怎麼看她的外表。

definition_zh: (動) 照顧；關心　(動) 喜歡；想要
example_sentence: Because Maria cares for her elderly grandmother, she visits every weekend without fail.
sentence_zh: 因為瑪麗亞照顧她年邁的祖母，她每個週末都不間斷地去拜訪。

definition_zh: (動) 關心；照顧　(名) 關心；照顧
example_sentence: Caring for elderly parents, many students balance schoolwork and family duties.
sentence_zh: 照顧年長的父母，許多學生在功課和家庭責任之間取得平衡。

definition_zh: (動) 傾斜；搖晃　(動) 急速移動；衝向
example_sentence: The ship that careened through the storm endangered all passengers aboard.
sentence_zh: 那艘在暴風雨中搖晃傾斜的船隻危及船上所有乘客。

definition_zh: (名) 職業；生涯　(動) 快速移動；疾馳
example_sentence: If students choose their career path carefully, they will achieve greater success in the future.
sentence_zh: 如果學生仔細選擇職業道路，他們將在未來獲得更大的成功。

definition_zh: (形) 無憂無慮的；輕鬆自在的
example_sentence: During summer vacation, students enjoy carefree days without homework or exams.
sentence_zh: 在暑假期間，學生們享受沒有功課或考試的輕鬆自在的日子。

definition_zh: (形) 仔細的；小心的　(副) 仔細地；小心地
example_sentence: Students need to read the test questions carefully to avoid making careless mistakes.
sentence_zh: 學生需要仔細閱讀測驗題目以避免粗心犯錯。

definition_zh: (副) 仔細地；小心地
example_sentence: Preparing for the CSAT requires reading materials carefully and taking detailed notes.
sentence_zh: 準備學測需要仔細閱讀教材並做詳細筆記。

definition_zh: (名) 謹慎；小心　(名) 注意力；細心
example_sentence: Because carefulness is essential in chemistry experiments, students must follow safety procedures carefully.
sentence_zh: 因為在化學實驗中謹慎很重要，學生必須仔細遵循安全程序。

definition_zh: (形) 粗心的；不小心的　(形) 不關心的；漠不關心的
example_sentence: Having made several careless mistakes on the exam, Tom regretted not reviewing his notes more carefully.
sentence_zh: 在考試上犯了幾個粗心的錯誤後，湯姆後悔沒有更仔細地複習筆記。

definition_zh: (動) 輕撫；愛撫　(名) 撫摸；溫柔的接觸
example_sentence: The soft touch that caresses your skin feels incredibly soothing and peaceful.
sentence_zh: 輕輕撫摸你皮膚的柔和觸感感覺令人非常放鬆和平靜。

definition_zh: (名) 照顧者；管理員　(名) 臨時代理人；代理負責人
example_sentence: The school's caretaker maintains the building and ensures student safety daily.
sentence_zh: 學校的管理員每天維護校舍並確保學生安全。

definition_zh: (名) 貨物；貨運　(名) 船貨；運送的物品
example_sentence: If the cargo were not delayed by the storm, the delivery would arrive on schedule.
sentence_zh: 如果貨物沒有被暴風雨延遲，運送就會按時抵達。

definition_zh: (名) 誇張漫畫；漫畫像　(動) 畫…的誇張漫畫；諷刺描寫
example_sentence: The artist drew a funny caricature of the famous politician with an oversized head.
sentence_zh: 那位藝術家畫了一幅有趣的誇張漫畫，描繪那位著名政治家的頭特別大。

definition_zh: (形) 關心的；照顧的　(動) 關心；照顧
example_sentence: Caring for elderly relatives, many Taiwanese students balance homework and family duties.
sentence_zh: 許多台灣學生在照顧年長親戚的同時，還要兼顧功課和家庭責任。

definition_zh: (名) 汽車製造商；汽車製造廠
example_sentence: As carmakers develop electric vehicles, traditional fuel engines become less important in the market.
sentence_zh: 當汽車製造商開發電動車時，傳統燃油引擎在市場上變得不那麼重要。

definition_zh: (名) 康乃馨；肉色花
example_sentence: Not only does the florist arrange red roses, but also pink carnations fill the wedding bouquet.
sentence_zh: 不僅花店裡有紅玫瑰，粉紅康乃馨也填滿了婚禮花束。

definition_zh: (名) 嘉年華；狂歡節　(名) 遊樂園；娛樂活動
example_sentence: The carnival that attracts thousands of visitors every summer offers exciting rides and games.
sentence_zh: 那個每年夏天吸引數千名遊客的嘉年華提供令人興奮的遊樂設施和遊戲。

definition_zh: (名) 肉食動物；食肉者
example_sentence: Lions hunt zebras to survive as carnivores in the African savanna.
sentence_zh: 獅子獵斑馬是為了在非洲草原作為肉食動物而生存。

definition_zh: (形) 肉食的；食肉的
example_sentence: Lions and tigers are carnivorous animals that hunt other creatures for food.
sentence_zh: 獅子和老虎是肉食動物，靠獵殺其他生物來獲得食物。

definition_zh: (名) 聖誕歌曲；讚美詩　(動) 唱聖誕歌曲；歡樂地唱歌
example_sentence: Every December, families gather to sing Christmas carols together at home.
sentence_zh: 每年十二月，家人們聚在一起在家裡唱聖誕歌曲。

definition_zh: (名) 類胡蘿蔔素；胡蘿蔔素
example_sentence: Since carotenoid provides orange pigment in carrots, eating more orange vegetables benefits our vision.
sentence_zh: 由於類胡蘿蔔素提供胡蘿蔔的橙色色素，多吃橙色蔬菜對我們的視力有益。

definition_zh: (名) 旋轉木馬；圓形轉盤
example_sentence: Spinning slowly, the carousel delighted children waiting for their turn.
sentence_zh: 緩緩旋轉的旋轉木馬讓等待的小孩們感到開心。

definition_zh: (名) 鯉魚　(動) 抱怨；嘮叨
example_sentence: The carp that swims in the pond behind our school is larger than most fish we see.
sentence_zh: 在我們學校後面池塘裡游泳的那條鯉魚比我們看到的大多數魚都大。

definition_zh: (名) 木匠；木工
example_sentence: If the carpenter carefully measures the wood, the furniture will fit perfectly in the living room.
sentence_zh: 如果木匠仔細測量木頭，家具就會完美地放入客廳。

definition_zh: (名) 地毯；地板覆蓋物　(動) 用地毯覆蓋
example_sentence: The living room carpet needs cleaning after the party last weekend.
sentence_zh: 上周末派對後，客廳的地毯需要清潔。

definition_zh: (名) 地毯鋪設；地毯材料　(動) 鋪地毯；用地毯覆蓋
example_sentence: The construction company chose expensive carpeting to protect the new hardwood floors.
sentence_zh: 建築公司選擇昂貴的地毯鋪設來保護新的硬木地板。

definition_zh: (名) 馬車；車廂　(名) 運送；運輸
example_sentence: The royal carriage, drawn by four white horses, slowly moved through the palace gates.
sentence_zh: 皇家馬車由四匹白馬牽引，緩緩通過宮殿大門。

definition_zh: (名) 運輸者；載體　(名) 航空公司；運輸公司
example_sentence: As the airline carrier expanded its routes, more passengers chose to fly with them.
sentence_zh: 當該航空公司擴展航線時，更多乘客選擇搭乘他們的班機。

definition_zh: (名) 胡蘿蔔；紅蘿蔔
example_sentence: Having peeled the carrots, Mom added them to the vegetable soup.
sentence_zh: 媽媽削完胡蘿蔔後，把它們加進蔬菜湯裡。

definition_zh: (動) 沖昏頭；使激動不已　(動) 帶走；搬走
example_sentence: The concert's energy, which carried away the excited audience, became a memorable moment.
sentence_zh: 這場音樂會的能量沖昏了興奮的觀眾，成為難忘的時刻。

definition_zh: (動) 繼續進行；推進　承上期結轉；轉移
example_sentence: The company decided to carry forward its expansion plan into the new fiscal year.
sentence_zh: 該公司決定將其擴張計畫承上期結轉到新財政年度。

definition_zh: (動) 贏得；奪得　(動) 成功完成；順利執行
example_sentence: If the team practiced harder, they would carry off the championship trophy next month.
sentence_zh: 如果那支隊伍練習更努力的話，下個月他們就會贏得冠軍獎盃。

definition_zh: (動) 不停地抱怨；嘮叨不已
example_sentence: Mom keeps carrying on about the messy kitchen every single day.
sentence_zh: 媽媽每天都在不停地抱怨廚房凌亂。

definition_zh: (動) 繼續進行；繼續做　(動) 堅持；維持
example_sentence: Carrying on with their studies despite the challenges, the students gradually improved their test scores.
sentence_zh: 儘管面臨挑戰，這些學生繼續進行他們的學習，逐漸提高了他們的考試成績。

definition_zh: (動) 繼續；持續　(動) 進行；維持
example_sentence: Although the project faced many difficulties, the team carried on with determination until completion.
sentence_zh: 雖然專案面臨許多困難，該團隊仍然堅定地繼續進行，直到完成為止。

definition_zh: (動) 執行；進行　進行；實施
example_sentence: Only after completing the survey did the research team carry out the final analysis.
sentence_zh: 只有在完成調查之後，研究團隊才執行最後的分析。

definition_zh: (動) 延續；保留　(動) 結轉；轉移
example_sentence: The skills that students carry over from middle school will help them succeed in high school.
sentence_zh: 學生從國中帶過來的技能將幫助他們在高中取得成功。

definition_zh: (動) 完成；實行　堅持到底；貫徹
example_sentence: The student studied hard every day to carry through her dream of entering a top university.
sentence_zh: 那位學生每天都努力讀書，為了要實現她進入頂尖大學的夢想。

definition_zh: (名) 隨身行李；手提行李　(形) 隨身的；可帶上飛機的　(動) 繼續進行；堅持下去
example_sentence: Passengers must keep their carry-on luggage under the airplane's size restrictions.
sentence_zh: 乘客必須確保隨身行李符合飛機的尺寸限制。

definition_zh: (動) 攜帶；運送　(動) 承載；支持
example_sentence: Students must carry their student ID cards to school every day.
sentence_zh: 學生每天必須帶著學生證去學校。

definition_zh: (動) 運走；拖走　(動) 帶走；逮捕
example_sentence: As soon as the police arrived, they carted off the suspect before anyone could help him.
sentence_zh: 警察一到達，他們就立即把嫌疑人運走，沒有人能幫助他。

definition_zh: (名) 購物車；手推車　(動) 運送；推動
example_sentence: Pushing the shopping cart through crowded aisles, students found great discounts on snacks.
sentence_zh: 推著購物車走過擁擠的通道，學生們找到了零食的大優惠。

definition_zh: (名) 卡特爾；企業聯合；壟斷組織
example_sentence: The drug cartel, which controlled major trafficking routes, was finally dismantled by authorities.
sentence_zh: 那個控制主要販運路線的毒品卡特爾最終被當局瓦解了。

definition_zh: (名) 紙箱；紙盒　(名) 牛奶盒；飲料盒
example_sentence: If the carton of juice falls off the table, the sticky mess will ruin your homework.
sentence_zh: 如果果汁紙盒從桌子上掉下來，黏稠的液體會毀掉你的功課。

definition_zh: (名) 卡通；動畫　(名) 漫畫；卡通畫
example_sentence: My younger brother watches cartoons every Saturday morning before breakfast.
sentence_zh: 我弟弟每個星期六早上吃早餐前看卡通。

definition_zh: (動) 開創；創造　(動) 從...中挖出；雕刻
example_sentence: Many students work hard during high school to carve out a successful future for themselves.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在高中時期努力工作，以便為自己開創成功的未來。

definition_zh: (動) 分割；瓜分
example_sentence: The powerful nations carved up the weak country into separate territories after the war.
sentence_zh: 戰爭後，強大的國家將弱小國家分割成各個領土。

definition_zh: (動) 雕刻；刻畫　(動) 切割；分割
example_sentence: As the artist carved the stone carefully, onlookers watched in amazement at the emerging sculpture.
sentence_zh: 當藝術家仔細地雕刻石頭時，旁觀者對浮現的雕像感到驚嘆。

definition_zh: (動) 傾瀉；級聯　(名) 瀑布；層疊
example_sentence: Having cascaded down the mountain, the waterfall created a spectacular mist that attracted countless tourists.
sentence_zh: 瀑布傾瀉而下後，產生了壯觀的水霧，吸引了無數遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 情況；案件　(名) 外殼；容器　(名) 病例；患者
example_sentence: The detective solved the mystery case that puzzled the entire town for months.
sentence_zh: 那位偵探破解了困擾整個城鎮數月的神祕案件。

definition_zh: (動) 利用某事獲利；從中得利
example_sentence: Many companies are cashing in on the growing demand for eco-friendly products.
sentence_zh: 許多公司正在利用對環保產品日益增長的需求來獲利。

definition_zh: (動) 兌現；套現　利用某事物獲利
example_sentence: If winning lottery tickets were allowed to be cashed in immediately, many people would claim their prizes right away.
sentence_zh: 如果中獎彩券可以立即兌現，許多人就會馬上領取獎金。

definition_zh: (動) 提取現金；兌現　(動) 結束參與；退出
example_sentence: After winning the lottery, Maria decided to cash out and start a small business.
sentence_zh: 贏得樂透後，瑪麗亞決定提取現金並開創小事業。

definition_zh: (動) 清點現金；結帳　(動) 結束營業時清點收益
example_sentence: Cashing up the register after closing, the manager discovered a fifty-dollar discrepancy.
sentence_zh: 經理在打烊後清點收銀機時，發現少了五十塊。

definition_zh: (名) 現金；現款　(動) 兌現；支取現金
example_sentence: As long as customers pay in cash, the store offers a ten percent discount.
sentence_zh: 只要顧客以現金付款，這家店就提供百分之十的折扣。

definition_zh: (名) 收銀員；出納員
example_sentence: Seldom does the cashier make a mistake when counting the money at the end of the day.
sentence_zh: 收銀員在一天結束時數錢時很少出錯。

definition_zh: (名) 外殼；套管　(動) 用套管包裝；勘察
example_sentence: The protective casing that surrounds the phone prevents damage from drops.
sentence_zh: 圍繞手機的保護套管可以防止摔落造成的損傷。

definition_zh: (名) 賭場；娛樂場
example_sentence: Many tourists visit Macau's casinos to try their luck at gambling.
sentence_zh: 許多遊客到澳門的賭場去碰運氣賭博。

definition_zh: (名) 棺材；靈柩　(名) 小箱子；寶盒
example_sentence: The funeral director carefully placed flowers on the wooden casket before the ceremony began.
sentence_zh: 葬禮主任在儀式開始前小心地將鮮花放在木製棺材上。

definition_zh: (名) 錄音帶；卡帶
example_sentence: Many students enjoyed listening to music cassettes during the 1990s.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在1990年代喜歡聽錄音帶音樂。

definition_zh: (動) 尋找；搜索　(動) 試圖想出；計劃
example_sentence: As the company cast about for new marketing strategies, the team brainstormed creative ideas during weekly meetings.
sentence_zh: 當公司尋找新的行銷策略時，團隊在每週會議中進行創意腦力激盪。

definition_zh: (動) 拋棄；丟棄　(動) 放棄；摒棄
example_sentence: Having cast aside her childhood fears, Maya finally performed on stage with confidence.
sentence_zh: 摒棄了童年的恐懼後，瑪雅終於能自信地在舞台上表演。

definition_zh: (動) 脫掉；拋棄　(動) 解開；鬆開
example_sentence: The old sailor cast off the rope that had held the boat in place for years.
sentence_zh: 那位年邁的船長鬆開了多年來固定小船的繩子。

definition_zh: (動) 看上；注意到　(動) 將目光投向；盯著
example_sentence: If Chen Ming casts his eyes on that university, he will study harder to pass the entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 如果陳明看上那所大學，他就會更加努力以通過入學考試。

definition_zh: (動) 趕出；驅逐　(動) 拋棄；排斥
example_sentence: The village cast out the criminal for stealing from the community.
sentence_zh: 村莊因為那個罪犯偷竊社區財物而將他趕出去。

definition_zh: (動) 嘔吐；吐出　(動) 計算；加總
example_sentence: After eating too quickly, the student felt sick and had to cast up in the bathroom.
sentence_zh: 那位學生吃太快後感到不適，必須跑到廁所去嘔吐。

definition_zh: (動) 投擲；拋　(動) 選舉；投票　(名) 演員陣容；角色安排
example_sentence: The director cast the lead role in the new drama series after holding auditions.
sentence_zh: 導演在試鏡後，在新戲劇系列中指定了主角。

definition_zh: (名) 響板；響木棒
example_sentence: As the dancer moved gracefully across the stage, castanets clicked rhythmically in her hands.
sentence_zh: 當舞者優雅地在舞台上移動時，她手中的響板有節奏地發出點擊聲。

definition_zh: (名) 種姓制度；社會階級　(名) 演員陣容；投擲
example_sentence: Having studied the caste system in India, the students gained insight into historical social hierarchies.
sentence_zh: 在研究了印度的種姓制度後，學生們對歷史上的社會階級制度有了更深的了解。

definition_zh: (名) 城堡；堡壘
example_sentence: The ancient castle that stood on the hilltop attracted thousands of tourists every year.
sentence_zh: 矗立在山頂上的古老城堡每年吸引數千名遊客。

definition_zh: (形) 隨意的；不正式的　(形) 偶然的；無計畫的
example_sentence: Wearing casual clothes to the beach party makes everyone feel more relaxed and comfortable.
sentence_zh: 穿著隨意的衣服參加海灘派對，讓每個人都感到更放鬆和舒適。

definition_zh: (副) 隨意地；不正式地　漫不經心地；輕率地
example_sentence: If Mark dressed casually for the job interview, the hiring manager would probably question his seriousness.
sentence_zh: 如果馬克為面試穿著隨意，招聘經理可能會質疑他的認真態度。

definition_zh: (名) 傷亡者；傷亡　(名) 損失；受害者
example_sentence: The earthquake caused many casualties in the coastal region.
sentence_zh: 那場地震在沿海地區造成許多傷亡。

definition_zh: (名) 目錄；商品目錄　(動) 編目；分類記錄
example_sentence: Organizing books by genre, the librarian created a detailed catalog for students researching essay topics.
sentence_zh: 圖書館員按類型組織書籍，為研究論文主題的學生創建了詳細的目錄。

definition_zh: (名) 催化劑；促進因素
example_sentence: Because social media became a catalyst for change, many young people organized community projects.
sentence_zh: 由於社群媒體成為改變的催化劑，許多年輕人組織了社區項目。

definition_zh: (名) 彈射裝置；投石機　(動) 突然彈射；迅速推進
example_sentence: Only after the spring released its force did the stone catapult through the air.
sentence_zh: 只有在彈簧釋放力量之後，石頭才通過空氣彈射出去。

definition_zh: (名) 白內障；瀑布
example_sentence: The elderly patient who developed a cataract in his left eye needed surgery.
sentence_zh: 那位在左眼患上白內障的年長患者需要手術。

definition_zh: (名) 大災難；災難　(名) 慘敗；失敗
example_sentence: The government implemented new safety measures to prevent catastrophe from occurring in coastal areas.
sentence_zh: 政府實施新的安全措施以防止沿海地區發生大災難。

definition_zh: (形) 災難性的；毀滅性的　(形) 極為嚴重的；致命的
example_sentence: The earthquake's catastrophic damage to infrastructure required years of rebuilding and international aid.
sentence_zh: 地震對基礎設施造成的災難性破壞需要多年的重建和國際援助。

definition_zh: (動) 急切地試圖獲得；抓住
example_sentence: A drowning swimmer catches at floating debris hoping for rescue.
sentence_zh: 溺水的游泳者急切地抓住漂浮的碎片，希望能獲救。

definition_zh: (動) 流行起來；變得受歡迎　明白；理解
example_sentence: As social media trends spread quickly, new dance moves catch on among teenagers before parents even notice.
sentence_zh: 當社群媒體趨勢快速傳播時，新的舞蹈動作在父母注意到之前就在青少年中流行起來。

definition_zh: (動) 吸引；引起某人的注意
example_sentence: Featuring bright colors and bold designs, the poster caught everyone's attention in the crowded hallway.
sentence_zh: 那張海報以鮮豔的色彩和大膽的設計特色，吸引了走廊裡每個人的注意。

definition_zh: (動) 發現；揭露　抓住；逮捕
example_sentence: The student who was caught out cheating on the exam faced serious consequences.
sentence_zh: 那位在考試中被抓到作弊的學生面臨了嚴重的後果。

definition_zh: (動) 看到；瞥見
example_sentence: If Maria catches sight of her favorite author at the bookstore, she will ask for an autograph immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪麗亞在書店瞥見她最喜歡的作者，她會立即要求簽名。

definition_zh: (片) 當場逮捕；抓住現行犯
example_sentence: The security camera caught the thief red-handed stealing from the store last night.
sentence_zh: 安全監視器昨晚當場拍到那名小偷在商店裡偷東西。

definition_zh: (動) 趕上；追上　追上進度；補上落後的部分
example_sentence: Maria studied hard during summer break to catch up in mathematics before the new semester.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞在暑假期間努力讀書，以便在新學期開始前趕上數學進度。

definition_zh: (動) 趕上；跟上　補充；瞭解最新情況

definition_zh: (動) 磨擦；擦傷　(名) 擦傷；磨損
example_sentence: Because the tight shoes chafed her heels, Maria decided to buy a new pair immediately.
sentence_zh: 因為緊鞋子磨擦了瑪麗亞的腳跟，她決定立刻買新鞋。

definition_zh: (名) 穀殼；糠　(動) 篩選；去除雜質
example_sentence: Having chaff separated from the grain, the farmer stored the harvest in large containers.
sentence_zh: 農民將穀殼從穀粒中分離後，將收穫物儲存在大容器中。

definition_zh: (名) 連鎖店；連鎖商店
example_sentence: The chain store that opened near the station offers competitive prices every day.
sentence_zh: 在車站附近開張的那間連鎖店每天都提供有競爭力的價格。

definition_zh: (名) 鏈條；連鎖　(動) 用鏈條束縛；連接
example_sentence: The bicycle chain needs cleaning and regular maintenance to work smoothly.
sentence_zh: 自行車的鏈條需要清潔和定期維護才能順利運作。

definition_zh: (名) 椅子；座位
example_sentence: If the classroom had more comfortable chairs, students would focus better during long lectures.
sentence_zh: 如果教室有更舒適的椅子，學生在長時間講座中會專注力更好。

definition_zh: (名) 主席；董事長　(名) 會議主持人；領導者
example_sentence: The chairman of the board announced the new company policy to all employees.
sentence_zh: 董事長向全體員工宣布了公司的新政策。

definition_zh: (名) 主席；會議主持人　(名) 董事長；負責人
example_sentence: Presiding over the meeting, the chairperson announced the new school policy to all students.
sentence_zh: 主持會議的主席向所有學生宣布了新的學校政策。

definition_zh: (動) 草擬；概述　(動) 用粉筆畫出；標記
example_sentence: After the teacher chalked out the main points on the blackboard, students took notes carefully in their notebooks.
sentence_zh: 老師在黑板上草擬出重點後，學生們仔細地在筆記本裡記下來。

definition_zh: (動) 記錄；取得　(動) 歸功於；將...記在帳上
example_sentence: Not only did the team chalk up three victories this season, but they also broke the school record.
sentence_zh: 不僅該隊本賽季獲得三場勝利，而且還打破了學校紀錄。

definition_zh: (名) 粉筆；白堊　(動) 用粉筆寫；標記
example_sentence: The teacher used chalk that was easy to erase from the blackboard.
sentence_zh: 老師使用容易從黑板擦掉的粉筆。

definition_zh: (名) 挑戰；難題　(動) 挑戰；質疑
example_sentence: Students take the CSAT to challenge themselves and prove their academic ability.
sentence_zh: 學生參加學測是為了挑戰自己並證明他們的學術能力。

definition_zh: (形) 受挑戰的；被質疑的　(動) 挑戰；質疑
example_sentence: The challenged student worked hard and finally passed the difficult exam.
sentence_zh: 那位受挑戰的學生努力學習，最後終於通過了困難的考試。

definition_zh: (名) 挑戰者；競爭對手　(名) 質疑者；提出異議的人
example_sentence: The young challenger defeated the champion in yesterday's tennis match.
sentence_zh: 年輕的挑戰者在昨天的網球比賽中擊敗了冠軍。

definition_zh: (形) 富有挑戰性的；困難的　(動) 質疑；對...提出異議
example_sentence: Although the math competition is challenging, many students participate because they enjoy solving difficult problems.
sentence_zh: 雖然數學競賽很有挑戰性，但許多學生參加，因為他們喜歡解決困難的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 房間；議院　(名) 腔室；密閉空間
example_sentence: Entering the chamber filled with ancient artifacts, the archaeologist carefully examined each display.
sentence_zh: 進入充滿古代文物的議院，考古學家仔細檢查每件展品。

definition_zh: (名) 變色龍；善於變通的人
example_sentence: The chameleon, which changes color to match its surroundings, is a fascinating reptile that adapts easily.
sentence_zh: 變色龍會改變顏色以適應周圍環境，這是一種能夠輕易適應的迷人爬蟲類動物。

definition_zh: (名) 香檳酒；香檳　(形) 香檳色的；淡金黃色的
example_sentence: If the team wins the championship, champagne will flow throughout the celebration.
sentence_zh: 如果球隊贏得冠軍，香檳酒將在慶祝活動中盡情流淌。

definition_zh: (名) 冠軍；優勝者　(動) 擁護；支持
example_sentence: The tennis champion won three gold medals at the international competition.
sentence_zh: 這位網球冠軍在國際比賽中贏得三枚金牌。

definition_zh: (名) 冠軍身份；冠軍地位　(名) 錦標賽；冠軍賽
example_sentence: Many athletes train hard every day to win the national championship.
sentence_zh: 許多運動員每天刻苦訓練以贏得全國冠軍。

definition_zh: (動) 偶然發現；碰巧遇到；意外發現
example_sentence: While walking through the night market, Sarah chanced on a vintage bookstore she had never seen before.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在逛夜市時，偶然發現了一家她從未見過的舊書店。

definition_zh: (名) 機會；可能性　(動) 冒險；試試看
example_sentence: As long as students study hard, they have a chance to pass the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 只要學生認真讀書，他們就有機會通過學測。

definition_zh: (名) 聖壇；聖殿的東端部分　(動) 取消；廢止
example_sentence: Having been renovated, the chancel now displays beautiful stained glass windows that attract many visitors.
sentence_zh: 經過翻新後，聖壇現在展示著美麗的彩色玻璃窗，吸引許多遊客參觀。

definition_zh: (名) 總理府；大臣官邸　(名) 外交部門；使館
example_sentence: The chancellery, which handles diplomatic affairs, released an official statement about the trade agreement.
sentence_zh: 處理外交事務的總理府發布了一份關於貿易協議的官方聲明。

definition_zh: (名) 大學校長；總理
example_sentence: The university chancellor announced new scholarship programs for talented students.
sentence_zh: 大學校長宣布了為優秀學生設立的新獎學金計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 總理職位；校長職位
example_sentence: If the prime minister resigned tomorrow, the chancellorship would pass to the deputy leader.
sentence_zh: 如果總理明天辭職，總理職位將會傳給副領導人。

definition_zh: (片) 很可能；大概
example_sentence: Chances are the movie will be sold out by tonight.
sentence_zh: 這部電影今晚很可能會售罄。

definition_zh: (動) 轉換到；改用
example_sentence: Having decided to reduce plastic waste, the company changed over to reusable packaging materials.
sentence_zh: 該公司決定減少塑膠廢棄物後，改用可重複使用的包裝材料。

definition_zh: (名) 變化；改變　(動) 改變；更換　(名) 零錢；找錢
example_sentence: As the seasons change, the leaves turn red and gold.
sentence_zh: 當季節改變時，樹葉變成紅色和金色。

definition_zh: (形) 易變的；多變的　(形) 可改變的；易改變的
example_sentence: Seldom does the changeable weather in spring prevent students from enjoying outdoor activities.
sentence_zh: 春天難得有穩定的天氣，學生很少因為多變的氣候而無法享受戶外活動。

definition_zh: (名) 轉換；交接　(動) 轉換；更換
example_sentence: The changeover from coal to renewable energy, which many countries are pursuing, requires significant investment.
sentence_zh: 許多國家正在追求的從煤炭到再生能源的轉換，需要巨額投資。

definition_zh: (名) 頻道；頻率　(動) 引導；傳送　(名) 管道；途徑
example_sentence: Many students use social media channels to share study notes with classmates.
sentence_zh: 許多學生使用社群媒體頻道來與同學分享讀書筆記。

definition_zh: (動) 反覆吟唱；領唱　(名) 聖歌；領唱
example_sentence: The soccer fans chanted the team's name loudly throughout the entire match.
sentence_zh: 足球迷在整場比賽中大聲反覆吟唱隊名。

definition_zh: (名) 混亂；混沌　(名) 極度混亂的狀態；無序
example_sentence: The classroom descended into chaos when the teacher left the room.
sentence_zh: 老師離開教室後，教室陷入了混亂。

definition_zh: (名) 傢伙；小伙子　(動) 使皮膚龜裂；裂開
example_sentence: Although the winter wind chapped his lips badly, the rugby player continued training outdoors without complaint.
sentence_zh: 雖然冬風使他的嘴唇嚴重龜裂，但這位橄欖球選手仍繼續在戶外訓練而不抱怨。

definition_zh: (名) 禮拜堂；小教堂
example_sentence: Sitting in the quiet chapel, students found themselves reflecting on life's important questions.
sentence_zh: 坐在寧靜的禮拜堂裡，學生們發現自己在思考人生的重要問題。

definition_zh: (名) 牧師；隨軍牧師
example_sentence: The hospital chaplain, who provides spiritual support to patients, visits rooms every morning.
sentence_zh: 那位為病人提供精神寄託的醫院牧師每天早上都會探訪病房。

definition_zh: (形) 乾裂的；皸裂的　(動) 使乾裂；皸裂
example_sentence: If the winter air becomes too dry, your lips would become chapped without proper moisturizer.
sentence_zh: 如果冬天空氣太乾燥，沒有適當的保溼品，你的嘴唇就會皸裂。

definition_zh: (名) 章；章節　(名) (書籍或歷史的)部分；時期
example_sentence: Read chapter five before the next class and take some notes.
sentence_zh: 下次上課前讀第五章，並記一些筆記。

definition_zh: (名) 性格；個性　(名) 人物；角色　(名) 品德；道德
example_sentence: Reading novels helps students develop imagination to understand different characters better.
sentence_zh: 閱讀小說幫助學生培養想像力以更好地理解不同的人物。

definition_zh: (名) 特徵；特色　(形) 典型的；特有的
example_sentence: One characteristic of successful students is their ability to manage time effectively.
sentence_zh: 成功學生的一個特徵是他們能夠有效地管理時間。

definition_zh: (副) 以…特有的方式；典型地　有…特徵地
example_sentence: Characteristically, the student organized her notes before the exam, showing her usual careful approach.
sentence_zh: 這名學生在考試前典型地整理了她的筆記，展現出她一貫謹慎的作風。

definition_zh: (動) 描述；刻畫　(動) 區別；表現特性
example_sentence: Characterized by rapid urbanization, Taiwan's economy has transformed significantly over the past decades.
sentence_zh: 由於城市化迅速發展的特點，台灣的經濟在過去幾十年中發生了重大轉變。

definition_zh: (名) 木炭；炭　(形) 炭的；深灰色的
example_sentence: The artist used charcoal, which produces dark marks easily, to sketch the portrait.
sentence_zh: 藝術家使用木炭（容易產生深色筆跡）來素描肖像。

definition_zh: (動) 充電；加油　(動) 興奮；激動
example_sentence: Before the final exam, students need to charge up their energy and confidence for success.
sentence_zh: 期末考前，學生需要充足精力和信心來準備考試。

definition_zh: (動) 指控；控告　(動) 收費；要價
example_sentence: If the company charged users with breaking the contract, many people would lose their accounts immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果公司指控使用者違反合約，許多人會立即失去他們的帳號。

definition_zh: (動) 收費；要價　(動) 指控；控告　(名) 費用；價格
example_sentence: The coffee shop charges five dollars for a large cappuccino every morning.
sentence_zh: 這家咖啡店每天對一杯大杯卡布奇諾收費五元。

definition_zh: (名) 充電器；充電裝置　(名) 衝鋒者；騎兵
example_sentence: Plugging in the charger, the phone gradually regained its battery power.
sentence_zh: 插上充電器後，手機的電池電量逐漸恢復。

definition_zh: (名) 戰車；馬車
example_sentence: As the chariot raced across the desert, ancient warriors prepared their weapons for battle.
sentence_zh: 當戰車在沙漠中疾馳時，古代戰士準備好武器迎戰。

definition_zh: (名) 魅力；感召力　(名) 個人魅力；領導風采
example_sentence: Not only does the young politician possess intelligence, but also the charisma to inspire millions of supporters.
sentence_zh: 這位年輕政治人物不僅擁有聰慧才智，更具有激勵數百萬支持者的個人魅力。

definition_zh: (形) 慈善的；樂善好施的　(形) 寬容的；仁慈的
example_sentence: The charitable organization that supports homeless people has helped thousands of families find shelter.
sentence_zh: 那個幫助無家可歸者的慈善機構已經協助數千個家庭找到安身之所。

definition_zh: (名) 慈善；慈善機構　(名) 仁慈；寬容
example_sentence: Many students volunteer at charity organizations to help people in need.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在慈善機構擔任志工以幫助有需要的人。

definition_zh: (名) 魅力；吸引力　(動) 迷住；吸引　(形) 迷人的；有魅力的
example_sentence: The charm of traditional Taiwanese culture attracts many international visitors every year.
sentence_zh: 傳統臺灣文化的魅力每年都吸引許多國際遊客。

definition_zh: (形) 迷人的；有魅力的　(形) 令人愉快的；討人喜歡的
example_sentence: The charming old town attracts thousands of tourists every summer.
sentence_zh: 那個迷人的古鎮每年夏天吸引數千名遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 圖表；圖形　(動) 製作圖表；記錄
example_sentence: As the sales chart showed an upward trend, the manager decided to expand the marketing budget.
sentence_zh: 當銷售圖表顯示上升趨勢時，經理決定擴大行銷預算。

definition_zh: (名) 租用；包租　(動) 租用；包租；特許
example_sentence: Chartering a boat for the weekend trip, our class explored the beautiful coastal areas near Keelung.
sentence_zh: 為了周末旅行而租用一艘船，我們班探索了基隆附近美麗的沿海地區。

definition_zh: (形) 包租的；租用的　(形) 特許的；獲得特許的
example_sentence: The chartered flight, which departed early morning, arrived in Taipei ahead of schedule.
sentence_zh: 那班包租的班機在清晨起飛，比預定時間提早抵達台北。

definition_zh: (動) 趕走；驅趕　(動) 消除；排除
example_sentence: If the dog chases away the cat, the garden will be peaceful again.
sentence_zh: 如果狗把貓趕走，花園又會恢復平靜。

definition_zh: (動) 追趕；追捕　daʊn 追上；逮捕
example_sentence: The police officers chased down the suspect through the busy streets.
sentence_zh: 警察在繁忙的街道上追捕了嫌疑人。

definition_zh: (動) 趕走；驅趕　(動) 追離；趕出
example_sentence: The farmer used a loud noise to chase off the birds from the cornfield.
sentence_zh: 農夫用大聲音來趕走玉米田裡的鳥。

definition_zh: (動) 追趕；催促　(動) 跟進；催要
example_sentence: The manager will chase up the clients about their overdue payment next week.
sentence_zh: 經理下週將催促客戶支付逾期款項。

definition_zh: (動) 追趕；追捕　(動) 追求；追逐
example_sentence: As the thief ran down the street, police officers chased him until he stumbled and fell.
sentence_zh: 當小偷在街上奔跑時，警察追捕他，直到他絆倒跌倒。

definition_zh: (名) 底盤；車架
example_sentence: Having reinforced the chassis, engineers tested the car's stability on challenging mountain roads.
sentence_zh: 在加固了底盤之後，工程師們在崎嶇的山路上測試了汽車的穩定性。

definition_zh: (動) 不停地聊天；滔滔不絕地談話
example_sentence: The students who chatted away during the study session missed important review materials.
sentence_zh: 那些在溫習時間不停聊天的學生錯過了重要的複習資料。

definition_zh: (動) 搭訕；主動與陌生人聊天　flɝt wɪð 調情；示好
example_sentence: He tried to chat up the girl at the coffee shop, but she didn't seem interested.
sentence_zh: 他試著在咖啡店搭訕那個女孩，但她似乎沒有興趣。

definition_zh: (動) 聊天；閒談　(名) 聊天；談話
example_sentence: If students chatted with friends during class, the teacher would give them a warning.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在課堂中和朋友聊天，老師就會給他們一個警告。

definition_zh: (動) 喋喋不休地說話；閒聊　(名) 閒聊；喧鬧聲
example_sentence: The students chattered excitedly about the upcoming school trip to Jiufen.
sentence_zh: 學生們興奮地閒聊著即將到來的九份校外教學。

definition_zh: (名) 專業司機；駕駛員
example_sentence: Driving the luxury car smoothly, the chauffeur arrived at the hotel exactly on time.
sentence_zh: 那位司機平穩地駕駛著豪華轎車，恰好準時抵達飯店。

definition_zh: (形) 便宜的；低價的　(形) 廉價的；不值錢的
example_sentence: Although the tickets were cheap, the concert quality was surprisingly excellent.
sentence_zh: 雖然票價便宜，但演唱會的品質卻意外地很好。

definition_zh: (動) 背叛伴侶；欺騙　(動) 在考試中作弊
example_sentence: Hardly ever does a relationship recover after one partner cheats on the other.
sentence_zh: 一方在感情中背叛另一方後，這段關係幾乎無法修復。

definition_zh: (動) 欺騙；作弊　(動) 奪取；騙取
example_sentence: The company cheated customers out of their savings, which caused serious financial loss.
sentence_zh: 那間公司欺騙顧客奪取他們的存款，這造成了嚴重的財務損失。

definition_zh: (動) 作弊；欺騙　(名) 欺騙；作弊行為
example_sentence: Students use smartphones to cheat in order to get high exam scores.
sentence_zh: 學生使用智慧型手機作弊以便獲得高分。

definition_zh: (動) 檢查；驗證　(動) 經過；靠近
example_sentence: The security guard will check by the main gate before closing the building.
sentence_zh: 保安人員在關閉建築物前會檢查主要入口處。

definition_zh: (動) 辦理登記；報到　(動) 登入；簽到
example_sentence: Guests checking in at the hotel must show their IDs.
sentence_zh: 在飯店辦理登記的客人必須出示身分證。

definition_zh: (動) 辦理入住；登記入住
example_sentence: Before the family settled into their hotel room, they checked into the resort's front desk.
sentence_zh: 在家人進入飯店房間之前，他們先在度假村前台辦理了入住。

definition_zh: (動) 檢查完成；打勾確認
example_sentence: Checking off each item on the shopping list, Maria felt organized and ready.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞逐一在購物清單上打勾，感到井然有序且做好準備。

definition_zh: (動) 查看；檢查　(動) 確認；關心
example_sentence: The teacher checked on the students who were working on the group project.
sentence_zh: 老師查看了正在做小組專案的學生。

definition_zh: (片) 從飯店退房；結束逗留
example_sentence: If guests check out of the hotel by noon, they will receive a ten percent discount on their next booking.
sentence_zh: 如果房客在中午前從飯店退房，他們下次預訂時將獲得百分之十的折扣。

definition_zh: (動) 結帳；付款　查看；檢查
example_sentence: Before leaving the hotel, guests must check out at the front desk.
sentence_zh: 離開飯店前，客人必須在前台結帳。

definition_zh: (動) 檢查；查看　(動) 審視；檢視
example_sentence: Before submitting the report, the manager asked employees to check over all the calculations carefully.
sentence_zh: 在提交報告之前，經理要求員工仔細檢查所有的計算。

definition_zh: (動) 檢查；查看　照顧；關心
example_sentence: The doctor will check up on patients recovering from surgery next week.
sentence_zh: 醫生下禮拜將檢查從手術中恢復的患者。

definition_zh: (名) 辦理入住；報到　(動) 辦理入住；登記報到
example_sentence: Before passengers board the flight, check-in must be completed at the airport counter.
sentence_zh: 在乘客登機之前，必須在機場櫃檯完成報到。

definition_zh: (名) 檢查；體檢
example_sentence: Having completed the annual check-up, the doctor confirmed everything was healthy.
sentence_zh: 完成年度檢查後，醫生確認一切都很健康。

definition_zh: (動) 檢查；查看　(名) 檢查；支票
example_sentence: The homework that the teacher checked yesterday contained many mistakes.
sentence_zh: 老師昨天檢查的功課裡有許多錯誤。

definition_zh: (名) 支票簿；支票本
example_sentence: My mother keeps her checkbook in the desk drawer to pay monthly bills.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽把支票簿放在書桌抽屜裡用來支付每月帳單。

definition_zh: (動) 檢查；核實　(形) 有格子的；格紋的
example_sentence: If the homework had been checked more carefully, many mistakes would have been found.
sentence_zh: 如果功課當初檢查得更仔細，許多錯誤都會被發現。

definition_zh: (名) 結帳處；檢查出門　(動) 結帳；查看
example_sentence: Please go to checkout counter three to pay for your groceries.
sentence_zh: 請到第三號結帳處為你的雜貨付款。

definition_zh: (名) 檢查；檢查身體　(動) 檢查；診察
example_sentence: Having completed the annual checkup, the doctor confirmed that everything was healthy.
sentence_zh: 完成年度檢查後，醫生確認一切都很健康。

definition_zh: (名) 切達起司；切達乳酪
example_sentence: Because cheddar cheese melts smoothly, many restaurants use it for their hamburgers.
sentence_zh: 因為切達起司融化得很順利，許多餐廳用它來做漢堡。

definition_zh: (名) 臉頰；面頰　(動) 厚臉皮；無禮
example_sentence: Hardly would anyone show such cheek in formal situations without facing serious consequences.
sentence_zh: 幾乎沒有人會在正式場合表現出如此無禮的態度而不面臨嚴重後果。

definition_zh: (動) 為...加油；為...喝彩
example_sentence: The students who cheered on their basketball team showed great school spirit.
sentence_zh: 為籃球隊加油的學生們展現了很強的校隊精神。

definition_zh: (動) 使高興；鼓勵　(動) 歡呼；喝彩
example_sentence: Sarah visited her sick friend to cheer up and encourage her during recovery.
sentence_zh: 莎拉去看望生病的朋友，目的是讓她高興並在康復期間鼓勵她。

definition_zh: (動) 歡呼；鼓掌　(名) 歡呼聲；掌聲
example_sentence: The soccer fans cheered loudly when their team scored the winning goal.
sentence_zh: 當足球隊進球得分時，球迷們歡呼雀躍。

definition_zh: (形) 快樂的；高興的　(形) 樂觀的；積極的
example_sentence: A cheerful smile and positive attitude help students succeed in school.
sentence_zh: 愉快的笑容和積極的態度幫助學生在學校成功。

definition_zh: (副) 愉快地；開心地　樂觀地；積極地
example_sentence: Cheerfully accepting the challenge, the team prepared their presentation for the competition.
sentence_zh: 該隊愉快地接受挑戰，為競賽準備他們的報告。

definition_zh: (名) 起司；乾酪　(動) 笑得露齒；發出笑聲
example_sentence: Making cheese in the kitchen, the chef carefully mixed milk and salt together.
sentence_zh: 在廚房製作起司時，廚師小心地混合牛奶和鹽。

definition_zh: (名) 主廚；廚師
example_sentence: The chef who won the cooking competition last year now owns a famous restaurant downtown.
sentence_zh: 去年贏得烹飪比賽的主廚現在在市中心開設一間知名餐廳。

definition_zh: (形) 化學的；由化學物質組成的　(名) 化學物質；化學製品
example_sentence: If students understand how chemical reactions work, they will better appreciate environmental science.
sentence_zh: 如果學生了解化學反應的原理，他們會更欣賞環境科學。

definition_zh: (名) 藥劑師；化學家
example_sentence: The chemist at the pharmacy prepared my prescription carefully.
sentence_zh: 藥局的藥劑師仔細為我準備了處方藥。

definition_zh: (名) 化學；化學變化
example_sentence: Students study chemistry to understand how substances react together.
sentence_zh: 學生學習化學以了解物質如何相互反應。

definition_zh: (名) 化學療法；化療
example_sentence: Cancer patients receiving chemotherapy often experience side effects like hair loss and nausea.
sentence_zh: 接受化療的癌症患者經常會經歷掉髮和噁心等副作用。

definition_zh: (動) 珍惜；重視　(動) 懷念；深深喜愛
example_sentence: Although time passes quickly, students cherish the memories they made with friends during high school.
sentence_zh: 雖然時間流逝迅速，學生們珍惜他們在高中時與朋友一起創造的回憶。

definition_zh: (名) 櫻桃；櫻桃樹　(形) 櫻桃紅的；鮮紅的
example_sentence: Having picked fresh cherries from the orchard, the farmer brought them to the market early.
sentence_zh: 從果園採完新鮮櫻桃後，農民一早就把它們帶到市場。

definition_zh: (名) 西洋棋；象棋
example_sentence: Chess is a strategic game that requires careful thinking and planning.
sentence_zh: 西洋棋是一種需要謹慎思考和規劃的策略遊戲。

definition_zh: (名) 胸部；胸腔　(名) 箱子；櫃子
example_sentence: The swimmer took a deep breath and expanded his chest before diving into the pool.
sentence_zh: 游泳選手潛水前深吸一口氣並擴張胸部。

definition_zh: (名) 栗子；栗色
example_sentence: If roasted chestnuts were cheaper, street vendors would sell far more during autumn festivals.
sentence_zh: 如果烤栗子便宜一些，秋季慶典時路邊攤販會賣得多得多。

definition_zh: (動) 咬斷；啃掉
example_sentence: The puppy chewed off the corner of the cushion while playing.
sentence_zh: 小狗玩耍時咬斷了靠墊的一角。

definition_zh: (動) 咀嚼；深思　(動) 思考；琢磨
example_sentence: Chewing on the difficult math problem for hours, Maria finally found the solution.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞深思了好幾個小時的難數學題，最後終於找到了答案。

definition_zh: (動) 嚴厲責罵；狠狠批評
example_sentence: Because the team lost the important game, the coach chewed out the players during halftime.
sentence_zh: 因為球隊輸掉了重要比賽，教練在中場休息時狠狠責罵了球員。

definition_zh: (動) 咀嚼；思考　(動) 在...上方；反覆
example_sentence: Hardly ever does Maria chew over her decisions without consulting trusted friends first.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞幾乎從不在未諮詢信任的朋友之前就反覆思考她的決定。

definition_zh: (動) 動詞 ʌp 咀嚼；毀壞　(動) 嚴厲批評；責罵
example_sentence: The old washing machine, which chewed up our clothes, finally broke down last week.
sentence_zh: 那台舊洗衣機把我們的衣服都磨壞了，上週終於故障了。

definition_zh: (動) 咀嚼；咬　(動) 反復思考；琢磨
example_sentence: Students chew gum to stay focused during long study sessions.
sentence_zh: 學生咀嚼口香糖以在長時間的讀書期間保持專注。

definition_zh: (形) 需要費力咀嚼的；有嚼勁的
example_sentence: Caramel candy is chewy and sticks to your teeth easily.
sentence_zh: 太妃糖有嚼勁，容易黏在牙齒上。

definition_zh: (形) 時髦的；優雅的　(名) 時尚；風格
example_sentence: That designer's new collection is incredibly chic and popular with young people.
sentence_zh: 那位設計師的新系列非常時髦，深受年輕人喜愛。

definition_zh: (名) 小雞；年輕女性
example_sentence: Before the chick hatches, the farmer prepares a warm space for it.
sentence_zh: 在小雞孵化之前，農夫為牠準備了一個溫暖的空間。

definition_zh: (動) 因害怕而退縮；臨陣脫逃
example_sentence: The student who chickened out of the debate competition later regretted the decision.
sentence_zh: 那位臨陣脫逃而沒有參加辯論比賽的學生後來感到後悔。

definition_zh: (名) 雞；雞肉　(形) 膽小的；懦弱的
example_sentence: If the restaurant runs out of chicken, many customers would choose fish instead.
sentence_zh: 如果餐廳的雞肉賣完了，許多顧客就會改點魚。

definition_zh: (名) 首長；領導人　(形) 主要的；最重要的
example_sentence: The chief of police announced new safety rules for the city.
sentence_zh: 警察局長宣布了城市的新安全規則。

definition_zh: (副) 主要地；大部分地
example_sentence: Students study literature chiefly to improve their reading comprehension and critical thinking skills.
sentence_zh: 學生主要是為了提高閱讀理解力和批判性思維能力而學習文學。

definition_zh: (名) 小孩；兒童　(名) 孩子；兒子或女兒
example_sentence: Every child in the classroom enjoyed the fun English game yesterday afternoon.
sentence_zh: 昨天下午教室裡的每個小孩都很享受那個有趣的英文遊戲。

definition_zh: (名) 分娩；生產
example_sentence: Although childbirth is physically demanding, many women find the experience deeply meaningful and transformative.
sentence_zh: 雖然分娩在身體上很耗費體力，但許多女性發現這段經歷深具意義且具有轉變性。

definition_zh: (名) 童年；幼年
example_sentence: Having spent childhood playing in the countryside, Maria still cherishes those simple, happy memories.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞在鄉村度過童年後，仍然珍視那些簡單而快樂的回憶。

definition_zh: (形) 幼稚的；孩子氣的　(形) 不成熟的；愚蠢的
example_sentence: The behavior that annoyed everyone was childish, showing no respect for others.
sentence_zh: 那種惹惱大家的行為很幼稚，對他人毫無尊重。

definition_zh: (形) 幼稚的；天真的　(形) 像小孩的；純真的
example_sentence: Her childlike wonder at the science museum made everyone smile warmly.
sentence_zh: 她在科學館純真的好奇心讓每個人都溫暖地微笑。

definition_zh: (名) 辣椒；辣椒粉　(形) 寒冷的；冷颼颼的
example_sentence: If the cook added less chili to the soup, the dish would taste milder for sensitive stomachs.
sentence_zh: 如果廚師在湯裡加入較少的辣椒，這道菜對敏感的胃來說會嚐起來更溫和。

definition_zh: (動) 放鬆；冷靜下來　(動) 停止生氣；平復情緒
example_sentence: After the stressful exam, Jake decided to chill out with friends at the cafe.
sentence_zh: 在壓力很大的考試之後，傑克決定和朋友一起在咖啡館放鬆。

definition_zh: (動) 冷卻；放鬆　(形) 涼爽的；酷的
example_sentence: Chilling in the library after school, many students feel more relaxed studying together.
sentence_zh: 放學後在圖書館放鬆，許多學生一起唸書時感到更加放鬆。

definition_zh: (名) 辣椒；辛辣　(形) 辣的；寒冷的
example_sentence: Although the chilli sauce tastes extremely spicy, many students enjoy eating it with their lunch.
sentence_zh: 儘管辣椒醬嚐起來非常辛辣，許多學生仍喜歡在午餐時吃它。

definition_zh: (名) 辣椒；辣椒粉
example_sentence: Only after tasting the extremely hot chilli did the students realize how spicy Thai food truly is.
sentence_zh: 只有在嘗到極辣的辣椒之後，學生們才意識到泰國食物有多麼辛辣。

definition_zh: (形) 寒冷的；冷颼颼的　(形) 不友善的；冷淡的
example_sentence: The autumn morning, which was chilly and misty, made students hurry to school.
sentence_zh: 那個寒冷且霧濛濛的秋日早晨，使學生匆匆趕往學校。

definition_zh: (動) 插嘴；加入談話　打斷別人說話並表達意見
example_sentence: During the meeting, Sarah decided to chime in to share her important ideas with the team.
sentence_zh: 會議中，莎拉決定插嘴向團隊分享她的重要想法。

definition_zh: (名) 鐘聲；鈴聲　(動) 發出鐘聲；協調一致
example_sentence: The clock tower chimed midnight, and the school bell chimed in agreement with perfect timing.
sentence_zh: 鐘樓在午夜時分鳴鐘，校鐘也隨之協調地鳴響。

definition_zh: (名) 煙囪；烟道
example_sentence: Smoke rose from the chimney of the old house into the cold winter air.
sentence_zh: 煙霧從舊房子的煙囪升起，進入寒冷的冬日空氣中。

definition_zh: (名) 黑猩猩；大猿
example_sentence: Because chimpanzees share ninety-eight percent of human DNA, scientists study their behavior closely.
sentence_zh: 因為黑猩猩與人類共享百分之九十八的DNA，科學家密切研究牠們的行為。

definition_zh: (名) 下巴；頦　(動) 用力抬起下巴
example_sentence: Lifting his chin proudly, the athlete walked toward the podium to receive the medal.
sentence_zh: 那位運動員驕傲地抬起下巴，走向領獎台領取獎牌。

definition_zh: (名) 中國；瓷器　(形) 中國的；瓷製的
example_sentence: The delicate porcelain dishes, which came from China, decorated the living room beautifully.
sentence_zh: 那些來自中國的精緻瓷盤為客廳增添了美麗的裝飾。

definition_zh: (形) 中國的；中文的　(名) 中文；漢語
example_sentence: If students study Chinese regularly, their understanding of traditional culture will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生定期學習中文，他們對傳統文化的理解將會顯著進步。

definition_zh: (動) 逐漸削弱；慢慢減少
example_sentence: Regular exercise chips away at stress and improves mental health.
sentence_zh: 規律運動能逐漸削弱壓力並改善心理健康。

definition_zh: (動) 湊錢；出錢　捐獻；貢獻
example_sentence: Everyone decided to chip in to buy flowers for the teacher's retirement gift.
sentence_zh: 大家決定湊錢買花作為老師退休禮物。

definition_zh: (名) 晶片；芯片　(名) 洋芋片；薄片　(動) 削減；砍掉
example_sentence: The computer chip in your smartphone processes millions of calculations every second.
sentence_zh: 你智慧型手機裡的電腦晶片每秒處理數百萬次計算。

definition_zh: (名) 削片；碎片　(動) 削減；剝落
example_sentence: Chipping away at the stone, the sculptor gradually revealed the hidden figure inside.
sentence_zh: 雕刻家不斷削減石頭時，逐漸揭露了裡面隱藏的人物形象。

definition_zh: (動) 啾啾叫；發出尖銳短聲　(名) 啾啾聲；鳥鳴聲
example_sentence: Having chirped loudly at dawn, the birds settled quietly in the trees.
sentence_zh: 小鳥在黎明時啾啾大叫後，靜靜地棲息在樹上。

definition_zh: (形) 啾啾叫的；鳥鳴的　(名) 啾啾聲；鳥鳴聲
example_sentence: The chirping birds that filled the garden every morning made studying difficult for students.
sentence_zh: 每天早晨充滿花園的啾啾鳥鳴聲讓學生很難專心讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 鑿子；鑿　(動) 用鑿子雕刻；鑿進
example_sentence: The sculptor used a sharp chisel and hammer to carve the marble statue carefully.
sentence_zh: 雕塑家用一把尖銳的鑿子和鎚子，小心地雕刻大理石雕像。

definition_zh: (形) 騎士精神的；高尚的　(形) 彬彬有禮的；有禮貌的
example_sentence: If the knight were more chivalrous, he would protect the villagers from harm.
sentence_zh: 如果那位騎士更具騎士精神，他就會保護村民免受傷害。

definition_zh: (名) 騎士精神；紳士風度　(名) 禮貌且尊重他人的行為
example_sentence: Opening the door for others shows chivalry and respect in daily life.
sentence_zh: 為他人開門展現了騎士精神和日常生活中的尊重。

definition_zh: (名) 細香蔥；韭菜
example_sentence: Chopped finely, chives add a mild onion flavor to the egg fried rice.
sentence_zh: 細香蔥切碎後，為炒飯增添溫和的洋蔥風味。

definition_zh: (名) 巧克力成癮者；愛吃巧克力的人　(形) 沉溺於巧克力的；巧克力成癮的
example_sentence: Because Sarah is a chocaholic, she always keeps chocolate bars in her school bag.
sentence_zh: 因為莎拉是個巧克力成癮者，她總是在書包裡放著巧克力棒。

definition_zh: (名) 巧克力愛好者；嗜吃巧克力的人　(形) 嗜吃巧克力的；對巧克力著迷的
example_sentence: Seldom does a true chocoholic refuse a slice of chocolate cake at birthday parties.
sentence_zh: 在生日派對上，真正的巧克力愛好者很少會拒絕一塊巧克力蛋糕。

definition_zh: (名) 巧克力；巧克力色　(形) 巧克力色的；用巧克力做的
example_sentence: The chocolate cake that my mother baked yesterday was absolutely delicious.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽昨天烤的巧克力蛋糕絕對好吃極了。

definition_zh: (名) 選擇；抉擇　(動) 選擇；挑選
example_sentence: Students study hard to make the best choice for their future.
sentence_zh: 學生努力讀書以做出對未來最好的選擇。

definition_zh: (名) 合唱團；唱詩班
example_sentence: The school choir performed a beautiful song at the winter concert.
sentence_zh: 學校合唱團在冬季音樂會上表演了一首美妙的歌曲。

definition_zh: (動) 抑制；忍住　(動) 強忍住（淚水、笑聲等）
example_sentence: Sarah choked back her tears when receiving the sad news about her grandmother.
sentence_zh: 莎拉收到關於她祖母的難過消息時，強忍住了眼淚。

definition_zh: (動) 勉強吞下；硬吞　(動) 壓抑；抑制
example_sentence: Although the medicine tasted bitter, the patient choked down the tablet to recover quickly.
sentence_zh: 雖然藥嚐起來很苦，病人還是勉強吞下藥片以便快速康復。

definition_zh: (動) 阻止；切斷　(動) 使窒息；令人感到窘迫
example_sentence: Choking off funding to the program, the government forced its closure within months.
sentence_zh: 政府切斷該計畫的經費，迫使它在數個月內關閉。

definition_zh: (動) 哽咽；哭不出聲　(動) 因緊張而說不出話
example_sentence: The student who choked up during the speech felt embarrassed afterward.
sentence_zh: 在演講中哽咽的那位學生之後感到尷尬。

definition_zh: (動) 窒息；哽咽　(動) 使無法呼吸
example_sentence: If students choke during a presentation, taking deep breaths will help calm their nerves.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在簡報時感到緊張而無法好好表達，深呼吸將有助於緩解焦慮。

definition_zh: (名) 膽固醇；一種脂肪物質
example_sentence: Eating too much fried food increases cholesterol levels in the blood.
sentence_zh: 吃太多炸食物會增加血液中的膽固醇含量。

definition_zh: (動) 用力咬；咀嚼　(動) 咬碎；嚙齧
example_sentence: The hungry dog chomped down on the bone to satisfy its appetite.
sentence_zh: 飢餓的狗用力咬著骨頭來滿足它的食慾。

definition_zh: (動) 選邊隊；分隊挑選
example_sentence: Before the basketball game started, the team captains chose up players for their sides.
sentence_zh: 籃球比賽開始前，隊長們選邊隊，各自挑選隊員。

definition_zh: (動) 選擇；挑選　(動) 決定；願意
example_sentence: Before choosing a university major, students should research job market trends carefully.
sentence_zh: 在選擇大學科系之前，學生應該仔細研究就業市場趨勢。

definition_zh: (動) 砍；劈　(動) 砍倒；砍下
example_sentence: Having chopped down the old oak tree, the construction crew cleared the land for the new school building.
sentence_zh: 砍倒那棵老橡樹之後，施工隊清理了土地以建造新的學校大樓。

definition_zh: (動) 切碎；剁碎　砍成小塊
example_sentence: The vegetables that the chef chopped up were used in the soup.
sentence_zh: 廚師切碎的那些蔬菜被用在湯裡。

definition_zh: (動) 砍；劈　(名) 砍刀；肉排

sentence_zh: 廚師用銳利的刀快速切菜做沙拉。

definition_zh: (名) 砧板；處決台　(名) 受批評的對象；代罪羔羊
example_sentence: If the manager were not on the chopping block, the company would not implement such strict cost-cutting measures.
sentence_zh: 如果經理不是處在被批評的位置，公司就不會實施這麼嚴格的成本削減措施。

definition_zh: (名) 筷子；夾取食物的工具
example_sentence: Using chopsticks to eat rice is a common tradition in Asian countries.
sentence_zh: 用筷子吃飯是亞洲國家的常見傳統。

definition_zh: (名) 筷子；夾取食物的工具
example_sentence: Using chopsticks to pick up rice, many students find the skill challenging at first.
sentence_zh: 用筷子夾飯，許多學生一開始覺得這項技能很有挑戰。

sentence_zh: 由於鋼琴家彈錯了和弦，整首歌聽起來相當不同。

definition_zh: (名) 家務；雜務　(動) 分配家務；派遣
example_sentence: Seldom does doing household chores seem enjoyable to busy teenagers.
sentence_zh: 繁忙的青少年很少會覺得做家務很有趣。

definition_zh: (名) 舞蹈編排；舞蹈設計　(動) 編排舞蹈；設計舞蹈
example_sentence: The choreography that the dance team performed was so creative that it won first prize.
sentence_zh: 舞蹈隊表演的舞蹈編排非常有創意，因此贏得了第一名。

definition_zh: (名) 合唱團；副歌　(動) 齊聲說；合唱
example_sentence: The students joined the school chorus to improve their vocal skills.
sentence_zh: 學生們加入校合唱團以改進他們的歌唱技巧。

definition_zh: (動) 狼吞虎嚥地吃；大口吃東西

sentence_zh: 足球比賽後，飢餓的球員們狼吞虎嚥地吃披薩和喝飲料。

definition_zh: (名) 基督教徒；信奉基督教的人　(形) 基督教的；信奉基督教的

sentence_zh: 台灣許多基督教家庭把聖誕節當作假日來慶祝。

definition_zh: (名) 基督教；基督信仰
example_sentence: Although Christianity spread widely across Europe, many people still held different religious beliefs in medieval times.
sentence_zh: 雖然基督教在歐洲廣泛傳播，但許多人在中世紀時仍然持有不同的宗教信仰。

definition_zh: (名) 聖誕節；耶誕節
example_sentence: Celebrating Christmas with family and friends brings joy to everyone's heart.
sentence_zh: 與家人和朋友一起慶祝聖誕節為每個人帶來歡樂。

definition_zh: (形) 慢性的；長期的　(形) 持續的；根深蒂固的
example_sentence: Patients with chronic diseases that persist for years require consistent medical care.
sentence_zh: 患有多年持續不斷的慢性病的患者需要持續的醫療照護。

definition_zh: (副) 長期地；持續地　慢性地；經常性地

sentence_zh: 如果莎拉持續長期抽菸，她的肺隨著時間會遭受嚴重傷害。

definition_zh: (名) 編年史；歷史記錄　(動) 記錄；詳細記述
example_sentence: The documentary chronicles the history of Taiwan's independence movement.
sentence_zh: 這部紀錄片詳細記述了台灣獨立運動的歷史。

definition_zh: (副) 按時間順序地；按先後順序地
example_sentence: The historian arranged primary sources chronologically to better understand the war's progression.
sentence_zh: 那位歷史學家按時間順序整理原始資料，以便更好地理解戰爭的進展。

definition_zh: (名) 年代順序；時間順序　(名) 按時間順序排列的歷史事件記錄
example_sentence: Understanding the chronology of World War II helps students grasp historical cause and effect clearly.
sentence_zh: 理解第二次世界大戰的年代順序幫助學生清楚地掌握歷史因果關係。

definition_zh: (名) 蛹；chrysalis的複數形
example_sentence: As butterflies emerge from chrysalises, they display their colorful wings to the world.
sentence_zh: 當蝴蝶從蛹中羽化時，牠們向世界展示彩色的翅膀。

definition_zh: (形) 胖的；圓胖的
example_sentence: Having gained weight over the winter, the puppy looked noticeably chubby and adorable.
sentence_zh: 經過冬天增重後，這隻小狗看起來明顯地胖嘟嘟的，非常可愛。

definition_zh: (動) 丟棄；拋棄
example_sentence: Old textbooks that are no longer useful should be chucked away properly.
sentence_zh: 不再有用的舊課本應該被妥善丟棄。

definition_zh: (動) 扔進去；丟棄　加入；參與

sentence_zh: 當專案失敗時，團隊決定放棄並重新開始。

sentence_zh: 如果舊家具完全壞掉，家人會把所有東西丟掉並買新的。

definition_zh: (動) 嘔吐；吐出　(動) 放棄；拋棄
example_sentence: After eating spoiled food, Maria had to chuck up her entire lunch.
sentence_zh: 吃了腐敗的食物後，瑪麗亞不得不把整頓午餐都吐出來。

definition_zh: (動) 扔；丟　投擲　(動) 放棄；拋棄
example_sentence: Chucking the old textbook aside, Maria started reviewing new materials for her exam.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞把舊課本扔到一邊，開始複習考試的新教材。

definition_zh: (動) 輕聲笑；咯咯笑　(名) 輕笑；咯咯笑聲
example_sentence: As the comedian told jokes on stage, the audience chuckled throughout the entire show.
sentence_zh: 當喜劇演員在舞台上講笑話時，觀眾始終發出輕聲笑。

definition_zh: (名) 厚塊；大塊　(動) 分成塊；投擲
example_sentence: Only after breaking the chocolate into chunks did Sarah finally enjoy her dessert.
sentence_zh: 只有在將巧克力分成一塊塊之後，莎拉才終於享受她的甜點。

definition_zh: (名) 教堂；教會
example_sentence: The church where my grandmother worships every Sunday is located near the school.
sentence_zh: 我祖母每個星期天做禮拜的教堂就在學校附近。

definition_zh: (動) 大量生產；快速製造　迅速推出

sentence_zh: 這家工廠努力工作以每個月大量生產數千件產品。

definition_zh: (動) 攪動；翻滾　(動) 製造；生產　(名) 攪乳機；乳桶

sentence_zh: 海浪翻滾並將沙子攪動成海灘上的細粉末。

definition_zh: (名) 雪茄；古巴雪茄
example_sentence: My uncle enjoys smoking a cigar after dinner every weekend.
sentence_zh: 我叔叔每個週末晚餐後喜歡抽雪茄。

definition_zh: (名) 香菸；菸草製品
example_sentence: Although smoking cigarettes is harmful to health, many teenagers still try them at parties.
sentence_zh: 雖然抽菸對健康有害，許多青少年在派對上仍然嘗試抽菸。

definition_zh: (名) 香菜；芫荽
example_sentence: Using fresh cilantro picked from the garden, the chef created an aromatic Vietnamese soup.
sentence_zh: 廚師用從花園摘採的新鮮香菜，製作了一道香氣撲鼻的越南湯。

definition_zh: (名) 電影院；電影

sentence_zh: 去年在市中心開幕的那家電影院已經成為學生喜歡去的地方。

definition_zh: (名) 電影攝影；攝影技術
example_sentence: If the cinematography were more creative, the film would definitely attract more international audiences.
sentence_zh: 如果電影攝影更具創意，這部電影肯定會吸引更多國際觀眾。

definition_zh: (名) 肉桂；肉桂粉
example_sentence: Cinnamon adds a warm, sweet flavor to many desserts and hot drinks.
sentence_zh: 肉桂為許多甜點和熱飲增添溫暖、甜美的風味。

definition_zh: (名) 圓形；圓圈　(動) 環繞；圍繞
example_sentence: Students draw a circle to mark the correct answer on the test paper.
sentence_zh: 學生畫一個圓圈來標記測驗卷上的正確答案。

definition_zh: (名) 電路；迴路　(名) 巡迴；路線

sentence_zh: 損壞的電路板阻止電流通過該裝置。

definition_zh: (形) 圓形的；循環的　(副) 以迂迴的方式

sentence_zh: 雖然這個論證是迂迴論證，但老師一直解釋直到學生完全理解為止。

definition_zh: (副) 循環地；圓形地　(副) 迂迴地；兜圈子地

sentence_zh: 組織者已將椅子圓形排列在桌子周圍，確保每位客人都能彼此看清楚。

sentence_zh: 學生在線上傳播的請願書獲得了數千人的支持。

sentence_zh: 規律運動改善血液循環並保持心臟健康。

example_sentence: If the water system were circulative, pollutants would spread throughout the entire network quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果水系統是循環的，污染物會迅速在整個網絡中傳播。

definition_zh: (形) 循環的；循環系統的

sentence_zh: 循環系統將血液輸送到人體各處。

sentence_zh: 因為學校預算受到有限資源的限制，體育部門必須減少隊伍開支。

definition_zh: (名) 環境；情況　(名) 條件；因素

sentence_zh: 只有在如此困難的環境下，這支隊伍才能展現真正的勇氣和團結。

definition_zh: (動) 規避；迴避　繞過；克服

sentence_zh: 這家公司找到了迴避政府所制定之嚴格規定的方法。

definition_zh: (名) 馬戲團；馬戲表演

sentence_zh: 許多學生去馬戲團觀看特技演員表演驚人的把戲。

sentence_zh: 這位研究人員引用了三項重要研究，並清楚地解釋了它們的主要發現。

definition_zh: (動) 引用；舉例　(名) 引用；引述

sentence_zh: 引用可靠的資料來源能增強你研究論文的可信度。

definition_zh: (名) 公民；市民　(名) 國民；公民身份

sentence_zh: 雖然瑪麗亞去年成為公民，但她仍然深深懷念她的故鄉。

definition_zh: (名) 公民身份；公民權　(名) 公民資格；公民義務

sentence_zh: 許多移民通過歸化測試而獲得公民身份後，終於獲得了投票權。

definition_zh: (名) 城市；都市
example_sentence: The city where my grandparents live has many old temples and traditional markets.
sentence_zh: 我祖父母住的那座城市有許多古廟和傳統市場。

definition_zh: (形) 公民的；市民的　(形) 市政的；城市的
example_sentence: If students participate in civic activities, their sense of social responsibility will strengthen significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生參與公民活動，他們的社會責任感會顯著增強。

definition_zh: (形) 公民的；民間的　(形) 有禮貌的；溫文儒雅的

sentence_zh: 政府啟動了一項公民項目以改善城市的大眾運輸。

definition_zh: (名) 平民；民眾　(形) 民間的；非軍事的
example_sentence: The government established shelters to protect civilians during the natural disaster.
sentence_zh: 政府建立避難所以在自然災害期間保護平民。

definition_zh: (名) 文明；文化　(名) 開化；教化
