sentence_zh: 古埃及文明發展出先進的文字系統和令人印象深刻的建築成就。

definition_zh: (動) 使文明；開化　使進步；使有禮貌
example_sentence: As society modernizes, efforts to civilize remote communities bring both progress and cultural change.
sentence_zh: 隨著社會現代化，文明化偏遠社區的努力帶來進步和文化轉變。

definition_zh: (動) 聲稱；宣稱　(名) 要求；聲明
example_sentence: Having claimed victory in the debate, the student felt confident about the upcoming competition.
sentence_zh: 在辯論中聲稱獲勝後，那位學生對即將到來的比賽感到有信心。

definition_zh: (片) 閉口不言；拒絕說話
example_sentence: When the police asked about the accident, the witness clammed up, which made the investigation more difficult.
sentence_zh: 當警察詢問事故時，該證人閉口不言，這使調查變得更加困難。

definition_zh: (名) 蛤蜊；蚌　(動) 緊握；死死抓住
example_sentence: Fresh clams from the ocean taste delicious when cooked with garlic and white wine.
sentence_zh: 從海洋採集的新鮮蛤蜊，用大蒜和白酒烹飪時嚐起來很美味。

definition_zh: (名) 蛤蜊烤肉會；海邊烤貝類聚餐
example_sentence: If the weather were nicer this weekend, the school would organize a clambake for all students at the beach.
sentence_zh: 如果這個週末天氣好一些，學校就會為所有學生在海邊舉辦蛤蜊烤肉會。

definition_zh: (動) 爬；費力地攀登
example_sentence: The hikers clambered up the rocky mountain path to reach the summit.
sentence_zh: 登山者費力地攀登岩石山路以到達山頂。

definition_zh: (名) 喧嘩；嘈雜聲　(動) 大聲喧嚷；吵鬧
example_sentence: Clamoring for better school lunch quality, students organized a petition last week.
sentence_zh: 學生們為爭取更好的學校午餐品質而大聲疾呼，上週發動了連署。

definition_zh: (名) 喧鬧；吵鬧聲　(動) 大聲吵鬧；喧嚷
example_sentence: As the concert ended, fans clamoured outside the venue while security tried to maintain order.
sentence_zh: 當演唱會結束時，粉絲們在場館外大聲吵鬧，而保安試圖維持秩序。

definition_zh: (動) 嚴厲打擊；取締　(動) 壓制；制止
example_sentence: Only after the scandal broke did the government clamp down on illegal gambling operations.
sentence_zh: 只有在醜聞爆發後，政府才對非法賭博活動進行嚴厲打擊。

definition_zh: (名) 夾具；夾鉗　(動) 夾緊；固定

sentence_zh: 那個牢牢固定管子的金屬夾具可以防止任何洩漏。

definition_zh: (名) 氏族；家族　(名) 幫派；團體
example_sentence: Members of the martial arts clan trained together to preserve their ancient fighting techniques.
sentence_zh: 武術氏族的成員聚在一起訓練，目的是保護他們古老的格鬥技巧。

definition_zh: (名) 金屬碰撞聲；當啷聲　(動) 發出金屬碰撞聲；當啷地響
example_sentence: The metal gate and chain clang loudly whenever the wind blows hard.
sentence_zh: 每當風吹得很猛時，金屬大門和鐵鍊就會發出很大的當啷聲。

definition_zh: (動) 拍手；鼓掌　(名) 掌聲；拍擊聲
example_sentence: The audience clapped loudly after the school concert ended.
sentence_zh: 校園音樂會結束後，觀眾大聲鼓掌。

definition_zh: (名) 無稽之談；胡言亂語　(形) 荒唐的；虛偽的

sentence_zh: 雖然這位政治人物的演說聽起來很令人印象深刻，但那只是欺騙許多選民的無稽之談。

definition_zh: (動) 澄清；說明　(動) 使清楚；闡明
example_sentence: Clarifying the confusing instructions, the teacher helped all students understand the exam requirements.
sentence_zh: 澄清了令人困惑的說明後，老師幫助所有學生理解了考試要求。

definition_zh: (名) 清晰；明確　(名) 透明；清澈
example_sentence: The clarity with which the teacher explained the concept helped many students understand the difficult topic.
sentence_zh: 老師用極清晰的方式解釋這個概念，這種清晰度幫助許多學生理解這個困難的主題。

definition_zh: (動) 衝突；碰撞　(名) 衝突；碰撞聲
example_sentence: If the exam schedule clashes with the sports festival, students will need to apply for postponement.
sentence_zh: 如果考試時間與運動會衝突，學生將需要申請延期。

definition_zh: (名) 扣子；夾子　(動) 緊握；扣住
example_sentence: Sarah clasped her hands together nervously before the exam.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在考試前緊張地把雙手緊握在一起。

definition_zh: (名) 班級；課堂　(動) 分類；歸類

sentence_zh: 學生每天上課以學習新的文法和單字。

definition_zh: (形) 經典的；古典的　(名) 經典著作；古典文學
example_sentence: Shakespeare's plays are classic works of English literature studied in schools.
sentence_zh: 莎士比亞的戲劇是在學校裡研究的英文文學經典著作。

definition_zh: (形) 古典的；經典的　(形) 傳統的；標準的
example_sentence: Although classical music requires patience to understand, many students discover its beauty when listening to famous symphonies.
sentence_zh: 雖然古典音樂需要耐心去理解，但許多學生在聆聽著名交響樂時發現了它的美妙。

definition_zh: (名) 分類；分類法　(名) 分類結果；等級
example_sentence: Having completed the classification of plant species, the biology students presented their detailed findings to the class.
sentence_zh: 完成植物物種的分類後，生物學生向班級展示了他們的詳細發現。

definition_zh: (形) 機密的；保密的　(形) 分類的；分級的

sentence_zh: 被保密數十年的政府文件最終被公開了。

definition_zh: (動) 分類；歸類　(動) 列為機密的

sentence_zh: 圖書館員仔細地按類型和作者對書籍進行分類，以幫助學生輕鬆找到資料。

sentence_zh: 如果學生穿著不舒適的衣服上學，他們會很難專心。

definition_zh: (名) 衣服；服裝　(名) 布料；衣料
example_sentence: Many students wear comfortable clothing to school every day.
sentence_zh: 許多學生每天穿著舒適的衣服上學。

definition_zh: (動) 變陰暗；烏雲密佈
example_sentence: Clouds gathering overhead, the sky clouded over within minutes before the storm arrived.
sentence_zh: 烏雲在頭頂聚集，天空在暴風雨來臨前幾分鐘內迅速變得陰暗。

definition_zh: (名) 雲；烏雲　(動) 使模糊；變陰暗
example_sentence: As dark clouds gathered overhead, the outdoor sports day was postponed to next week.
sentence_zh: 當烏雲聚集在頭頂時，戶外運動會被延期到下週。

definition_zh: (名) 多雲；陰沉　(形) 模糊；不清楚
example_sentence: Only after the cloudiness lifted did the hikers see the mountain peak clearly.
sentence_zh: 只有在陰沉散去之後，登山者才清楚看到山峰。

definition_zh: (形) 多雲的；陰天的　(形) 不清楚的；模糊的
example_sentence: The sky that appears cloudy in the morning often clears by afternoon.
sentence_zh: 早上看起來多雲的天空，到了下午通常就會放晴。

definition_zh: (名) 三葉草；幸運草
example_sentence: Many students pick four-leaf clovers to bring good luck before the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在學測前採集四葉幸運草以帶來好運。

definition_zh: (動) 搗亂；胡鬧　(動) 開玩笑；耍寶
example_sentence: Stop clowning about in class; the teacher is getting angry with the noise.
sentence_zh: 停止在課堂上胡鬧；老師對這些噪音越來越生氣。

definition_zh: (名) 小丑；丑角　(動) 扮演小丑；搞笑
example_sentence: The clown made funny faces and silly jokes to entertain the children.
sentence_zh: 小丑做出有趣的臉部表情和愚蠢的笑話來娛樂孩子們。

definition_zh: (動) 使厭膩；使膩煩　(動) 使因過甜而不適
example_sentence: Although the dessert looked delicious, its overly sweet taste began to cloy after a few bites.
sentence_zh: 雖然甜點看起來很美味，但它過度甜膩的味道在吃了幾口後開始讓人感到厭膩。

definition_zh: (形) 過度甜膩的；令人厭煩的
example_sentence: Tasting overly sweet desserts, the judges found the cake's cloying flavor disappointing.
sentence_zh: 品嚐過度甜膩的甜點，評審發現這個蛋糕的令人厭煩的味道令人失望。

definition_zh: (名) 俱樂部；社團　(名) 棍棒；球棒　(動) 用棍棒打
example_sentence: The music club that my friend founded last year has grown very popular.
sentence_zh: 我朋友去年創辦的音樂俱樂部已經變得很受歡迎。

definition_zh: (動) 咯咯叫；發出咯咯聲　(名) 咯咯聲；母雞叫聲
example_sentence: If the hen clucks loudly in the morning, the farmer will wake up early.
sentence_zh: 如果母雞在早上咯咯叫得很大聲，農夫就會很早醒來。

definition_zh: (名) 線索；提示　(動) 提供線索；給予提示
example_sentence: The detective found an important clue at the crime scene.
sentence_zh: 偵探在犯罪現場發現了一條重要的線索。

definition_zh: (形) 茫然的；不知所措的　(形) 無知的；沒有線索的
example_sentence: Sarah studied all night to avoid looking clueless during the important exam.
sentence_zh: 莎拉整晚讀書以避免在重要考試中顯得茫然無措。

definition_zh: (形) 笨拙的；動作不靈活的　(形) 粗魯的；不優雅的
example_sentence: The clumsy waiter dropped three dishes during the busy dinner rush.
sentence_zh: 那位笨拙的服務生在忙碌的晚餐時段打破了三盤盤子。

definition_zh: (名) 群；簇；一群　(動) 聚集；群集
example_sentence: As stars cluster together in the night sky, students gathered around the teacher's desk.
sentence_zh: 當星星在夜空中聚集在一起時，學生聚集在老師的桌子周圍。

definition_zh: (動) 緊緊抓住；握住　(名) 離合器；關鍵時刻
example_sentence: Having clutched the exam results tightly, the student finally smiled with relief.
sentence_zh: 緊緊握住考試成績後，這位學生終於鬆了一口氣地笑了。

definition_zh: (名) 合著者；共同作者　(動) 與他人共同創作；合著
example_sentence: The research paper, which was co-authored by two professors from different universities, won an international award.
sentence_zh: 這篇研究論文由來自不同大學的兩位教授共同撰寫，獲得了國際獎項。

definition_zh: (動) 合作；協力　(動) 配合；互相配合
example_sentence: School clubs and community groups co-operate to organize the annual charity event successfully.
sentence_zh: 學校社團和社區組織合作組織年度慈善活動。

definition_zh: (形) 合作的；樂於合作的　(名) 合作社；合作組織
example_sentence: If the team members were more co-operative, the project would finish on schedule.
sentence_zh: 如果團隊成員更樂於合作，這個專案就會按時完成。

definition_zh: (動) 協調；配合　(名) 座標；坐標
example_sentence: The team members coordinated their efforts to finish the project on time.
sentence_zh: 團隊成員協調努力以按時完成專案。

definition_zh: (名) 教練；指導者　(動) 訓練；指導
example_sentence: Working with a professional coach preparing for the competition, the athlete improved her performance significantly.
sentence_zh: 這位運動員與專業教練合作準備比賽，她的表現顯著進步。

definition_zh: (動) 凝結；凝聚　(名) 凝結物；凝聚體
example_sentence: As the temperature dropped, the blood began to coagulate, forming a protective clot over the wound.
sentence_zh: 當溫度下降時，血液開始凝結，在傷口上形成保護性的血塊。

definition_zh: (名) 煤炭；煤　(名) 餘燼；木炭
example_sentence: Seldom do power plants rely on coal as their primary energy source anymore.
sentence_zh: 很少有發電廠仍然將煤炭作為主要能源。

definition_zh: (動) 合併；聯合　(動) 逐漸結合；匯聚
example_sentence: The small protests, which coalesced into a massive movement, surprised the government.
sentence_zh: 那些小型抗議活動，逐漸匯聚成一場大規模運動，令政府感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (名) 結合；聚合　(動) 結合；凝聚
example_sentence: Different political parties need to coalescence to form a stronger unified government.
sentence_zh: 不同的政黨需要結合來形成一個更強大的統一政府。

definition_zh: (形) 聚合的；融合的　(動) 合併；聯合
example_sentence: The small water droplets, coalescent after the rain, formed a larger stream flowing downhill.
sentence_zh: 雨後小水滴聚合在一起，形成了一股較大的溪流向下流去。

definition_zh: (名) 聯盟；聯合　(名) 結合；聯合體
example_sentence: The two political parties formed a coalition to win the election.
sentence_zh: 這兩個政黨結成聯盟來贏得選舉。

definition_zh: (形) 粗糙的；粗纖維的　(形) 粗魯的；不禮貌的
example_sentence: Although the sandpaper felt coarse, it effectively removed the old paint from the wooden door.
sentence_zh: 雖然砂紙摸起來很粗糙，但它有效地去除了木門上的舊油漆。

definition_zh: (動) 輕鬆通過；不費力地完成
example_sentence: Coasting through the exam without studying, many students failed to achieve their target scores.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在沒有準備的情況下輕鬆應付考試，結果未能達到目標成績。

definition_zh: (名) 海岸；沿海地區　(動) 沿著海岸航行
example_sentence: The coastal town, which attracts many tourists every summer, offers beautiful beaches and fresh seafood.
sentence_zh: 這個沿海小鎮吸引許多遊客每年夏天造訪，提供美麗的海灘和新鮮海產。

definition_zh: (形) 沿海的；海岸的
example_sentence: If coastal cities implement better flood defenses, they will protect thousands of residents.
sentence_zh: 如果沿海城市建立更好的防洪防禦，它們將保護數千名居民。

definition_zh: (名) 海岸線；海岸邊界
example_sentence: The rocky coastline of Taiwan attracts many tourists every year.
sentence_zh: 台灣的岩石海岸線每年吸引許多遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 外套；大衣　(動) 覆蓋；涂層
example_sentence: Students wear warm coats to protect themselves from cold winter weather.
sentence_zh: 學生穿著溫暖的外套來保護自己免受寒冷冬天的影響。

definition_zh: (名) 塗層；涂料　(動) 涂上；覆蓋
example_sentence: A protective coating on the metal surface prevents rust and corrosion.
sentence_zh: 金屬表面上的保護涂層可以防止生銹和腐蝕。

definition_zh: (動) 哄騙；勸誘　(動) 耐心引導
example_sentence: As long as the teacher coaxes the shy student to speak up, confidence will gradually build.
sentence_zh: 只要老師耐心引導那位害羞的學生發言，信心就會逐漸建立。

definition_zh: (動) 臨時拼湊；倉促組合
example_sentence: Having cobbled together a costume from old clothes, the student finally looked ready for the drama competition.
sentence_zh: 那名學生用舊衣服臨時拼湊了一套服裝後，終於為戲劇比賽做好了準備。

definition_zh: (名) 古柯鹼；可卡因
example_sentence: Cocaine, which is an illegal drug that damages the brain, remains a serious problem worldwide.
sentence_zh: 古柯鹼是一種會損害大腦的非法毒品，它在全球仍然是一個嚴重的問題。

definition_zh: (動) 搞砸；弄糟　(名) 失誤；錯誤
example_sentence: The student cocked up the chemistry exam by mixing the wrong chemicals together.
sentence_zh: 那名學生把化學考試搞砸了，因為混合了錯誤的化學物質。

definition_zh: (名) 公雞；雞鳴　(名) 龍頭；水龍頭開關
example_sentence: If the rooster did not crow at dawn, farmers would not wake up early to work.
sentence_zh: 如果公雞不在黎明時鳴叫，農民就不會早起工作。

definition_zh: (名) 鳳頭鸚鵡；一種大型白色鸚鵡
example_sentence: The cockatoo at the zoo has bright yellow feathers on its head.
sentence_zh: 動物園裡的鳳頭鸚鵡頭上有鮮黃色的羽毛。

definition_zh: (名) 蛤蜊；貝類　(動) 皺縮；收縮
example_sentence: Cockles being abundant in the coastal waters, fishermen harvested them daily for local markets.
sentence_zh: 由於蛤蜊在沿海水域數量豐富，漁民每日為當地市場捕撈牠們。

definition_zh: (名) 駕駛艙；座艙
example_sentence: As the plane prepared for takeoff, the pilot checked all instruments in the cockpit before communicating with air traffic control.
sentence_zh: 當飛機準備起飛時，飛行員在與空中交通管制通話前檢查駕駛艙內的所有儀器。

definition_zh: (名) 蟑螂；小強
example_sentence: Seldom does a cockroach appear in a clean kitchen during the day.
sentence_zh: 在白天，蟑螂很少出現在乾淨的廚房裡。

definition_zh: (名) 雞尾酒；混合飲料
example_sentence: The cocktail that the bartender prepared for the party was extremely popular.
sentence_zh: 酒保為派對準備的那杯雞尾酒極受歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 可可；可可粉　(名) 可可飲料；熱巧克力
example_sentence: Students drink hot cocoa to stay warm during cold winter mornings.
sentence_zh: 學生喝熱可可飲料來在寒冷的冬季早晨保持溫暖。

definition_zh: (名) 椰子；椰子果　(名) 椰肉；椰子肉
example_sentence: Coconut water is a popular drink in tropical countries and refreshing for athletes.
sentence_zh: 椰子水在熱帶國家是很受歡迎的飲料，對運動員來說很清涼。

definition_zh: (名) 繭；蛹衣　(動) 繭住；包裹
example_sentence: The silkworm builds a cocoon before becoming a beautiful butterfly.
sentence_zh: 蠶在變成美麗的蝴蝶之前會先結繭。

definition_zh: (動) 溺愛；嬌慣　(動) 輕輕煮；悶煮
example_sentence: Although parents coddle their children out of love, excessive spoiling may hinder personal growth.
sentence_zh: 雖然父母出於愛心而溺愛孩子，但過度嬌慣可能阻礙個人成長。

definition_zh: (動) 過度溺愛；嬌縱　(名) 溺愛；寵溺
example_sentence: Coddling children too much prevents them from learning independence and responsibility.
sentence_zh: 過度溺愛孩子會阻止他們學習獨立和承擔責任。

definition_zh: (名) 密碼；代碼　(動) 編碼；寫程式
example_sentence: Students must enter the access code that the teacher provides before they can submit the online exam.
sentence_zh: 學生必須輸入老師提供的存取密碼才能提交線上考試。

definition_zh: (動) 編纂成法典；制定法律　將…編成成文法
example_sentence: If the government codifies these unwritten rules into formal laws, citizens will understand their rights more clearly.
sentence_zh: 如果政府把這些不成文的規則編纂成正式法律，公民將更清楚地了解他們的權利。

definition_zh: (名) 係數；因數　(形) 共同起作用的；協助的
example_sentence: In the equation 3x + 5 = 20, the number 3 is the coefficient of x.
sentence_zh: 在方程式 3x + 5 = 20 中，數字 3 是 x 的係數。

definition_zh: (動) 強迫；脅迫　(動) 用強制手段使人服從
example_sentence: The government used new laws to coerce citizens into paying higher taxes.
sentence_zh: 政府使用新法律強迫市民繳納更高的稅金。

definition_zh: (名) 咖啡；咖啡色
example_sentence: Every morning before school, my mother drinks a cup of hot coffee.
sentence_zh: 每天上學前，我媽媽喝一杯熱咖啡。

definition_zh: (名) 棺材；靈柩
example_sentence: Although the funeral director explained the coffin's craftsmanship, many mourners remained emotionally overwhelmed.
sentence_zh: 雖然禮儀師解釋了棺材的工藝，許多致哀者仍然感到情緒激動。

definition_zh: (名) 共同創辦人；共同創辦者
example_sentence: Having established the startup together, the two cofounders worked tirelessly to expand their business across Asia.
sentence_zh: 已經共同創辦這家新創公司，這兩位共同創辦人不懈地致力於在亞洲擴展事業。

definition_zh: (動) 深思；思考　(動) 冥想；沉思
example_sentence: The problem that students cogitate during exam preparation often becomes clearer over time.
sentence_zh: 學生在考試準備期間深思的問題通常會隨著時間變得更清楚。

definition_zh: (名) 干邑白蘭地；高級葡萄酒
example_sentence: The luxury hotel served expensive cognac at the reception after the formal dinner.
sentence_zh: 這家豪華飯店在正式晚宴後的招待會上提供昂貴的干邑白蘭地。

definition_zh: (名) 認知；認識　(名) 認知能力；思維過程
example_sentence: If students developed stronger cognition skills, their exam performance would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生培養更強的認知能力，他們的考試成績會大幅提升。

definition_zh: (形) 認知的；涉及思考的　(名) 認知能力
example_sentence: Cognitive skills like memory and attention help students learn effectively.
sentence_zh: 像記憶力和專注力這樣的認知能力幫助學生有效學習。

definition_zh: (形) 意識到的；察覺的　了解的；認知的
example_sentence: Becoming cognizant of environmental issues, many students now support sustainable practices at school.
sentence_zh: 意識到環境問題，許多學生現在在學校支持永續實踐。

definition_zh: (形) 連貫的；條理清楚的　(形) 一致的；協調的
example_sentence: Although the presentation lasted two hours, the speaker maintained a coherent argument throughout the entire discussion.
sentence_zh: 儘管簡報持續了兩小時，演講者在整個討論過程中始終保持條理清楚的論點。

definition_zh: (形) 有凝聚力的；黏著的　(形) 緊密結合的；連貫的
example_sentence: Only through cohesive teamwork could the debate club win the national championship.
sentence_zh: 只有通過有凝聚力的團隊合作，辯論社才能贏得全國冠軍。

definition_zh: (名) 線圈；圈　(動) 盤繞；蜷縮
example_sentence: The copper coil that generates electricity in the generator must be regularly maintained.
sentence_zh: 發電機中產生電力的銅線圈必須定期維護。

definition_zh: (名) 硬幣；錢幣　(動) 創造；鑄造
example_sentence: Students save coins to buy lunch at the school cafeteria every day.
sentence_zh: 學生們存硬幣以便每天在學校餐廳買午餐。

definition_zh: (動) 巧合；一致　(動) 同時發生；相符
example_sentence: The school's opening ceremony and the national holiday coincide with each other every year.
sentence_zh: 學校開幕典禮和國定假日每年都巧合地同時進行。

definition_zh: (名) 巧合；同時發生
example_sentence: Meeting my old friend at the airport was a remarkable coincidence.
sentence_zh: 在機場遇見我的老朋友是個驚人的巧合。

definition_zh: (形) 同時發生的；巧合的　(形) 一致的；相符的
example_sentence: Coincident with the exam schedule change, the school announced a new tutoring program.
sentence_zh: 正好與考試時間表的改變同時發生，學校宣布了一項新的輔導計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 可口可樂；콜라　(名) 焦炭；煤炭
example_sentence: Drinking Coke containing lots of sugar, many teenagers gain weight quickly.
sentence_zh: 喝含有大量糖分的可樂，許多青少年迅速增重。

definition_zh: (名) 可樂；汽水
example_sentence: The cola that my friend bought at the convenience store tastes sweeter than before.
sentence_zh: 我朋友在便利商店買的可樂嚐起來比以前更甜。

definition_zh: (名) 漏勺；濾盆
example_sentence: If you rinse pasta with a colander, the water will drain quickly through its holes.
sentence_zh: 如果你用漏勺沖義大利麵，水會快速從孔洞中瀝出。

definition_zh: (形) 冷的；寒冷的　(名) 寒冷；感冒
example_sentence: The weather is very cold in winter, so students wear thick jackets.
sentence_zh: 冬天天氣很冷，所以學生穿著厚夾克。

definition_zh: (動) 合作；協力　(動) 共同完成
example_sentence: Students collaborate with classmates to complete the science project successfully.
sentence_zh: 學生與同學合作以順利完成科學專題。

definition_zh: (名) 合作；協力　(名) 合作的作品；協力成果
example_sentence: The successful film resulted from collaboration between the director and screenwriter working together.
sentence_zh: 這部成功的電影是導演和編劇合作的結果。

definition_zh: (形) 合作的；協作的　(名) 協作項目；共同作品
example_sentence: Since the project requires collaborative effort, all team members must contribute ideas and work together responsibly.
sentence_zh: 由於該項目需要協作努力，所有團隊成員必須貢獻想法並負責任地共同工作。

definition_zh: (副) 協力地；合作地　共同努力地；團隊合作地
example_sentence: Having collaborated on the project for months, the team members worked collaboratively to deliver excellent results.
sentence_zh: 經過幾個月的合作，團隊成員協力合作以交付優秀的成果。

definition_zh: (名) 合作者；協力者　(名) 叛徒；通敵者
example_sentence: The scientist who worked as a collaborator on this project earned international recognition.
sentence_zh: 在這個專案中擔任合作者的科學家獲得了國際認可。

definition_zh: (動) 倒塌；崩潰　(名) 倒塌；崩潰
example_sentence: The old bridge collapsed during the heavy storm, causing traffic chaos throughout the city.
sentence_zh: 老橋在暴風雨中倒塌，造成整個城市的交通混亂。

definition_zh: (名) 衣領；領子　(名) 項圈；頸圈
example_sentence: If the shirt collar were looser, wearing it all day would feel much more comfortable.
sentence_zh: 如果襯衫領子寬鬆一些，整天穿著會感覺舒服得多。

definition_zh: (形) 附帶的；並行的　(名) 擔保品；抵押品
example_sentence: The bank requires collateral such as property before approving the loan.
sentence_zh: 銀行在核准貸款前，需要房產等擔保品。

definition_zh: (名) 同事；同僚　(名) 工作夥伴；職場夥伴
example_sentence: Working on the project together, my colleagues and I discovered an innovative solution.
sentence_zh: 在一起做這個專案時，我和我的同事發現了一個創新的解決方案。

definition_zh: (動) 收集；蒐集　(動) 領取；取得
example_sentence: As soon as the teacher finishes the test, students collect their papers from the desk.
sentence_zh: 當老師一完成測驗，學生就從桌上收集他們的試卷。

definition_zh: (形) 冷靜的；鎮定的　(動) 收集；蒐集
example_sentence: Only after the teacher's calm words were collected thoughts finally restored to the anxious students.
sentence_zh: 只有在老師平靜的話語之後，焦慮的學生們才終於恢復了冷靜的思緒。

definition_zh: (形) 值得收集的；可收藏的
example_sentence: Vintage comic books that are rare and valuable become collectible items which attract serious collectors.
sentence_zh: 稀有且珍貴的老漫畫書成為值得收集的物品，吸引認真的收藏家。

definition_zh: (名) 收集；蒐集　(名) 收藏品；作品集
example_sentence: Museums display valuable artifacts to preserve historical collections for future generations.
sentence_zh: 博物館展出珍貴文物以保存歷史收藏供後代研究。

definition_zh: (形) 集體的；共同的　(名) 集體；團體
example_sentence: Collective effort from all team members made the school project a huge success.
sentence_zh: 來自所有隊員的集體努力使學校專案取得巨大成功。

definition_zh: (副) 集體地；全體地　共同地；一起地
example_sentence: The students collectively decided to organize a school fundraiser for the community.
sentence_zh: 學生們集體決定為社區組織一場學校募款活動。

definition_zh: (名) 收集者；收藏家　(名) 收稅員；稽徵官
example_sentence: Because the art collector wanted to expand the museum's holdings, many famous paintings were acquired last year.
sentence_zh: 因為這位藝術收藏家想要擴大博物館的收藏，許多名畫在去年被收購了。

definition_zh: (名) 大學文憑；學位證書
example_sentence: Having completed four years of study, graduates receiving a college diploma feel proud of their achievement.
sentence_zh: 完成四年的學習後，獲得大學文憑的畢業生為自己的成就感到驕傲。

definition_zh: (名) 大學；學院　(名) 大學部；專科學校
example_sentence: The college that Maria attends is located in central Taiwan and offers excellent engineering programs.
sentence_zh: 瑪莉亞就讀的大學位於中台灣，提供優秀的工程課程。

definition_zh: (形) 大學的；與大學有關的　(名) 大學生；同事
example_sentence: If students join collegiate clubs and activities, they will develop leadership skills for their future careers.
sentence_zh: 如果學生參加大學俱樂部和活動，他們將為未來職業發展領導技能。

definition_zh: (動) 碰撞；相撞　(動) 衝突；不相容
example_sentence: The two cars collided at the busy intersection during rush hour.
sentence_zh: 兩輛車在繁忙的十字路口尖峰時段相撞。

definition_zh: (名) 碰撞；衝突　(名) 抵觸；矛盾
example_sentence: Engineers designed safety features to prevent car collisions on busy highways.
sentence_zh: 工程師設計安全功能以防止在繁忙高速公路上發生汽車碰撞。

definition_zh: (形) 日常會話的；非正式的　(形) 口語的；通俗的
example_sentence: Using colloquial language in formal essays often results in lower grades.
sentence_zh: 在正式論文中使用日常會話語言往往會導致成績下降。

definition_zh: (副) 口語上；日常用語中
example_sentence: Although the term is formally 'photosynthesis,' students colloquially call it 'making food from sunlight.'
sentence_zh: 雖然這個詞在正式用語中是「光合作用」，但學生口語上稱它為「從陽光製造食物」。

definition_zh: (名) 勾結；串通　(名) 共謀；陰謀
example_sentence: Having engaged in collusion with competitors, the company was fined heavily by the government.
sentence_zh: 因與競爭對手串通，該公司被政府處以巨額罰款。

definition_zh: (名) 冒號；結腸
example_sentence: The recipe lists ingredients that follow the colon at the beginning of each section.
sentence_zh: 這份食譜在每個段落開頭的冒號後面列出了材料。

definition_zh: (名) 陸軍上校；空軍上校
example_sentence: The colonel ordered his soldiers to prepare for the morning drill.
sentence_zh: 那位上校命令他的士兵為早上的操練做準備。

definition_zh: (形) 殖民的；殖民地的　(名) 殖民地人；殖民地居民
example_sentence: If the colonial powers had not exploited resources so heavily, the economy of these regions would have developed more independently.
sentence_zh: 如果殖民列強當時沒有如此大量開採資源，這些地區的經濟本來會更獨立地發展。

definition_zh: (名) 殖民主義；帝國主義　(名) 殖民統治制度
example_sentence: Colonialism brought European culture to Asia but caused great suffering to local people.
sentence_zh: 殖民主義將歐洲文化帶到亞洲，但對當地人民造成了巨大痛苦。

definition_zh: (動) 殖民；開拓
example_sentence: Colonizing new territories, European powers expanded their influence across the globe.
sentence_zh: 殖民新領土，歐洲列強將其勢力擴展到全球各地。

definition_zh: (名) 殖民地；領地　(名) 群體；聚落
example_sentence: As the British colony expanded its territory, many indigenous people were displaced from their ancestral lands.
sentence_zh: 當英國殖民地擴大其領土時，許多原住民被迫離開祖先的土地。

definition_zh: (動) 給…著色；填色　(動) 使…變色；影響
example_sentence: Only after the artist colored in the entire background did the painting truly come alive.
sentence_zh: 只有在藝術家給整個背景著色之後，這幅畫才真正栩栩如生。

definition_zh: (動) 臉紅；變紅　漸漸顯現；逐漸呈現
example_sentence: The student who colored up during the presentation clearly felt embarrassed about forgetting the important facts.
sentence_zh: 在簡報中臉紅的那位學生顯然對忘記重要事實感到尷尬。

definition_zh: (名) 顏色；色彩　(動) 給...著色；使變色　(形) 有顏色的；彩色的
example_sentence: Artists mix paints to color their canvas and express creative ideas.
sentence_zh: 藝術家混合顏料給畫布著色並表達創意想法。

definition_zh: (名) 著色；著色方式　(名) 顏色搭配；色彩組合
example_sentence: The bird's bright coloration helps it attract mates during breeding season.
sentence_zh: 這隻鳥明亮的著色在繁殖季節幫助牠吸引配偶。

definition_zh: (形) 結腸和直腸的；大腸的
example_sentence: Colorectal cancer screening helps detect tumors early and save lives.
sentence_zh: 結腸直腸癌篩檢有助於早期發現腫瘤並拯救生命。

definition_zh: (形) 有色的；著色的　(形) (人種) 有色人種的
example_sentence: Colored pencils being carefully arranged on the desk made the art project look more professional.
sentence_zh: 當彩色鉛筆被小心地排列在桌子上時，美術專案看起來更專業。

definition_zh: (形) 色彩繽紛的；五彩斑斕的　(形) 生動的；有趣的
example_sentence: Decorated with colorful balloons and ribbons, the classroom looked festive and welcoming.
sentence_zh: 教室用五彩繽紛的氣球和彩帶裝飾，看起來既節慶又溫暖。

definition_zh: (名) 著色；上色　(形) 用來著色的
example_sentence: The coloring book that my younger sister enjoys contains many animals waiting to be colored.
sentence_zh: 我妹妹喜歡的著色本裡面有很多等著被著色的動物。

definition_zh: (形) 巨大的；龐大的　(形) 驚人的；極其重大的
example_sentence: If the construction project were not colossal in scale, it would not require such extensive planning.
sentence_zh: 如果這項建築工程不是如此龐大，就不會需要這麼詳細的規劃。

definition_zh: (名) 巨人；龐然大物　(名) 傑出人物；偉人
example_sentence: The tech giant Apple became a colossus in the global market.
sentence_zh: 科技巨頭蘋果公司成為全球市場上的龐然大物。

definition_zh: (名) 欄；柱子　(名) 專欄；版面
example_sentence: Students read the advice column to understand different perspectives on life.
sentence_zh: 學生閱讀建議專欄以瞭解對生活的不同看法。

definition_zh: (名) 專欄作家；評論員
example_sentence: The newspaper columnist writes thought-provoking articles about social issues every week.
sentence_zh: 這位報紙專欄作家每週撰寫關於社會議題的發人深省的文章。

definition_zh: (名) 昏迷；深度睡眠狀態
example_sentence: Although the patient fell into a coma after the accident, the doctors remained hopeful about recovery.
sentence_zh: 雖然患者在事故後陷入昏迷，但醫生對康復仍持樂觀態度。

definition_zh: (名) 梳子；梳状物　(動) 梳理；仔細搜索
example_sentence: Having combed through all the research papers, the student finally found the perfect source for the essay.
sentence_zh: 經過仔細搜索所有研究論文後，這名學生終於找到了論文的完美資料來源。

definition_zh: (動) [kəmˈbæt] 對抗；戰鬥　(名) [ˈkɑmbæt] 戰鬥；格鬥
example_sentence: The organization that combats climate change has launched several initiatives which address environmental issues.
sentence_zh: 對抗氣候變遷的組織推出了幾項解決環境問題的計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 戰鬥者；參戰者　(形) 參加戰鬥的；交戰的
example_sentence: The two combatant nations signed a peace treaty after months of conflict.
sentence_zh: 這兩個交戰國家在數月衝突後簽署了和平條約。

definition_zh: (形) 好鬥的；好戰的　(形) 具有戰鬥精神的；侵略性的
example_sentence: If the opposing team weren't so combative, the game would be more enjoyable for everyone.
sentence_zh: 如果對方隊伍不那麼好鬥，比賽對每個人來說會更有趣。

definition_zh: (名) 組合；結合　(名) 密碼組合
example_sentence: The winning lottery combination included six numbers selected randomly.
sentence_zh: 中獎的彩券組合包括六個隨機選出的號碼。

definition_zh: (動) [kəmˋbaɪn] 結合；合併　(名) [ˋkɑmbaɪn] 聯合收割機
example_sentence: Combining different study methods, students can improve their test scores more effectively.
sentence_zh: 結合不同的讀書方法，學生能更有效地提高考試成績。

definition_zh: (形) 結合的；聯合的　(動) 結合；混合
example_sentence: Combined with hard work, talent becomes the key to academic success.
sentence_zh: 結合勤奮的努力，天賦成為學業成功的關鍵。

definition_zh: (動) 發生；產生　(動) 轉向；改變方向
example_sentence: Only after the accident did the policy change come about in our school.
sentence_zh: 只有在那場意外發生後，我們學校的政策改變才得以實現。

definition_zh: (片) 給人......的印象；看起來像是......
example_sentence: Although Marcus studied hard, his poor test scores came across as a sign that he lacked focus.
sentence_zh: 雖然馬克思努力讀書，但他糟糕的考試成績看起來像是他缺乏專注力的徵兆。

definition_zh: (動) 偶然遇到；碰巧發現　(動) 留下好/壞的印象
example_sentence: Reading English novels helps students come across new vocabulary and improve comprehension skills.
sentence_zh: 閱讀英文小說幫助學生偶然發現新單字並提升理解能力。

definition_zh: (動) 活躍起來；變得生動　(動) 甦醒；展現活力
example_sentence: When the music started playing, the entire classroom came alive with energy and excitement.
sentence_zh: 當音樂開始播放時，整個教室充滿了能量和興奮的氣氛。

definition_zh: (動) 和…一起去；陪同　(動) 進展；有進展
example_sentence: My parents will come along with me to the university orientation next week.
sentence_zh: 我的父母下週會陪我一起去大學新生說明會。

definition_zh: (動) 一起來；跟著來　(動) 進展；有進展
example_sentence: As more students come along to join the club, the team becomes stronger and more active.
sentence_zh: 當更多學生加入俱樂部時，這個團隊變得更強大、更活躍。

definition_zh: (動) 散開；破裂
example_sentence: Coming apart at the seams, the old backpack finally broke during the hiking trip.
sentence_zh: 背包的接縫散開了，這次登山旅行中它終於破裂了。

definition_zh: (動) 改變主意；同意　(動) 恢復知覺；蘇醒
example_sentence: The manager, whose initial plan was rejected by the team, eventually came around to the employees' proposal, which improved productivity significantly.
sentence_zh: 經理最初的計畫被團隊拒絕，他最終同意了員工的提案，該提案大幅提高了生產力。

definition_zh: (動) 優先於；先於　(動) 在...之前出現
example_sentence: If family responsibilities come before career ambitions, students must balance both carefully.
sentence_zh: 如果家庭責任優先於職業抱負，學生必須小心平衡兩者。

definition_zh: (動) 獲得；得到　(動) 經過；靠近
example_sentence: Finding a good apartment in Taipei is difficult, but luck helped me come by one last month.
sentence_zh: 在台北找到好公寓很困難，但運氣幫助我上個月獲得了一間。

definition_zh: (片) 嚴厲處罰；對…進行懲罰
example_sentence: The principal came down on cheating students to maintain school standards.
sentence_zh: 校長嚴厲處罰作弊的學生以維持學校的標準。

definition_zh: (動) 患上；感染　(動) 開始生病；罹患
example_sentence: Many students come down with the flu during winter exam season.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在冬季考試季節患上流感。

definition_zh: (動) 下降；降低　(動) 下來；落下
example_sentence: As the temperature comes down, students feel more comfortable studying in the library.
sentence_zh: 當溫度下降時，學生在圖書館讀書感到更舒適。

definition_zh: (動) 首先到達；排名第一　(動) 優先；最重要
example_sentence: Having come first in the science competition, Maria received a scholarship for university.
sentence_zh: 在科學競賽中排名第一後，瑪麗亞獲得了大學獎學金。

definition_zh: (動) 來自；出身於
example_sentence: The student who comes from a small village in Taitung works very hard at school.
sentence_zh: 那個來自台東小鎮的學生在學校非常用功。

definition_zh: (動) 受到；遭受　(動) 被批評；被指責
example_sentence: The government came in for heavy criticism after raising taxes without public consultation.
sentence_zh: 政府在沒有徵詢民眾意見的情況下調高稅金，因此遭到嚴厲批評。

definition_zh: (片) 派得上用場；很有用
example_sentence: If students kept old notes organized, they would come in handy during exam preparation.
sentence_zh: 如果學生把舊筆記整理好，在準備考試時就會派得上用場。

definition_zh: (動) 進來；進入　(動) 到達；抵達
example_sentence: Please come in and sit down at the conference table.
sentence_zh: 請進來並坐在會議桌前。

definition_zh: (片) 開始發揮作用；開始有影響力
example_sentence: As the competition progressed, strategy and teamwork came into play, determining the final outcome.
sentence_zh: 隨著比賽進行，策略和團隊合作開始發揮作用，決定了最終結果。

definition_zh: (片) 進入視線；出現在視野中
example_sentence: As the hikers climbed higher, the mountain village came into sight beyond the misty valley.
sentence_zh: 當登山者爬得更高時，山村在霧霭山谷的另一邊進入視線。

definition_zh: (動) 開始被使用；投入使用
example_sentence: Only after the new technology came into use did the factory increase its production efficiency.
sentence_zh: 只有在新科技投入使用之後，工廠的生產效率才得以提高。

definition_zh: (片) 進入視野；出現在眼前
example_sentence: As the mountain climbers reached the summit, the valley that stretched below come into view.
sentence_zh: 當登山者到達山頂時，下方延伸的山谷進入了他們的視野。

definition_zh: (動) 繼承；獲得　(動) 進入；開始
example_sentence: Studying hard now helps students come into possession of better university opportunities.
sentence_zh: 現在努力讀書有助於學生獲得更好的大學機會。

definition_zh: (片) 別胡說；別騙人　(片) 停止假裝
example_sentence: Come off it! Nobody believes your excuse about missing the test because of a broken alarm clock.
sentence_zh: 別胡說了！沒有人相信你因為鬧鐘壞了而缺席考試的藉口。

definition_zh: (動) 成功；奏效　(動) 脫落；掉下來
example_sentence: The plan came off without any problems, making everyone happy.
sentence_zh: 這個計畫順利成功，讓大家都很開心。

definition_zh: (片) 加油；來吧　(片) 別開玩笑；真的假的
example_sentence: Come on, you can finish the exam if you stay focused and don't give up now.
sentence_zh: 加油，如果你保持專注且現在不放棄，你可以完成這場考試。

definition_zh: (動) 出現在；長出在　(動) 推出；發行
example_sentence: New spots coming out in spring require careful skin care and sun protection.
sentence_zh: 春天長出的新斑點需要仔細的皮膚護理和防曬保護。

definition_zh: (動) 推出；發布　(動) 承認；坦白
example_sentence: The smartphone company came out with a new model that features advanced camera technology.
sentence_zh: 這家智慧型手機公司推出了一款具有先進相機技術的新機型。

definition_zh: (動) 出現；發表　(動) 結果是；原來是
example_sentence: If the truth comes out, the company's reputation would be seriously damaged.
sentence_zh: 如果真相曝光，這家公司的聲譽將會受到嚴重損害。

definition_zh: (動) 過來；來訪　(動) 恢復；好轉
example_sentence: Why don't my friends come over to my house this weekend?
sentence_zh: 為什麼我的朋友們這個週末不來我家呢？

definition_zh: (動) 結束；終止
example_sentence: The winter concert will come to an end next Friday to make room for exam preparation.
sentence_zh: 冬季音樂會將在下週五結束，為考試準備騰出時間。

definition_zh: (動) 變成；成為
example_sentence: After years of hard work, Maria's dream came to be a successful engineer in a tech company.
sentence_zh: 經過多年的努力，瑪莉亞的夢想變成了在科技公司擔任成功工程師。

definition_zh: (動) 想到；浮現在心中
example_sentence: When studying for the exam, several important grammar rules came to mind immediately.
sentence_zh: 當準備考試時，幾條重要的文法規則立刻浮現在心中。

definition_zh: (動) 甦醒；恢復知覺　(動) 達到；共計
example_sentence: Having come to after the accident, the cyclist checked his bike for damage.
sentence_zh: 在事故後甦醒過來，這位騎自行車的人檢查了他的自行車是否損壞。

definition_zh: (動) 實現；成真
example_sentence: The dream that Sarah worked hard for finally came true after years of effort.
sentence_zh: 莎拉辛苦努力的夢想終於在多年後成真了。

definition_zh: (動) 遇到困難；面臨障礙；對抗；與…衝突
example_sentence: Many students come up against serious difficulties when preparing for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在準備學測時遇到了嚴重的困難。

definition_zh: (動) 達到；符合　(動) 接近；走近
example_sentence: If Mark's test score came up to the school's standard, he would receive a scholarship.
sentence_zh: 如果馬克的考試成績達到學校的標準，他就會獲得獎學金。

definition_zh: (片) 達到某人的水平；與某人相當
example_sentence: Sarah's piano skills come up to her older sister's level after years of practice.
sentence_zh: 經過多年練習，莎拉的鋼琴技巧已經達到她姐姐的水平。

definition_zh: (動) 達到；符合　(動) 接近；走到
example_sentence: Having come up to the entrance, the students waited for the teacher to unlock the door.
sentence_zh: 學生們走到入口處後，等待老師開門。

definition_zh: (片) 想出；提出　(片) 拿出；籌措
example_sentence: After brainstorming for hours, the marketing team came up with a creative campaign that impressed all the clients.
sentence_zh: 經過數小時的腦力激盪後，行銷團隊想出了一個讓所有客戶都印象深刻的創意活動。

definition_zh: (動) 出現；發生　(動) 浮現；被提出
example_sentence: Never does an unexpected problem come up during the final exam without proper preparation.
sentence_zh: 沒有適當準備，考前不會沒有突如其來的問題浮現。

definition_zh: (動) 偶然發現；碰巧遇到
example_sentence: While hiking in the mountain, the students came upon an ancient temple that few visitors knew about.
sentence_zh: 學生在山中登山時，碰巧發現了一座很少遊客知道的古廟。

definition_zh: (動) 一起去；跟著來　陪同；伴隨
example_sentence: Sarah invited her best friend to come with her to the concert next weekend.
sentence_zh: 莎拉邀請她最好的朋友下週末跟她一起去演唱會。

definition_zh: (動) 來；到達　(動) 發生；出現
example_sentence: When summer comes, many students come to the beach to swim and relax.
sentence_zh: 當夏天來臨時，許多學生來到海灘游泳和放鬆。

definition_zh: (名) 回歸；東山再起　(動) 恢復；重新流行
example_sentence: Although the singer's career seemed finished, a successful comeback happened when she released a new album.
sentence_zh: 雖然這位歌手的事業似乎已經結束，但當她發行新專輯時，成功的東山再起發生了。
subject_type: noun (the singer's career / a successful comeback)

definition_zh: (名) 喜劇演員；搞笑藝人
example_sentence: Making audiences laugh every night, the comedian performed his best material at the university auditorium.
sentence_zh: 那位喜劇演員每晚逗觀眾發笑，在大學禮堂表演了他最精彩的段子。

definition_zh: (名) 喜劇；喜劇片　(名) 滑稽；幽默
example_sentence: The comedy movie, which made audiences laugh throughout the entire screening, won several awards.
sentence_zh: 那部讓觀眾全程大笑的喜劇電影贏得了多個獎項。

definition_zh: (形) 可食用的；能吃的　(名) 食物；食用品
example_sentence: If the mushrooms are comestible, the chef will prepare them for tonight's dinner.
sentence_zh: 如果這些蘑菇是可食用的，廚師就會為今晚的晚餐準備它們。

definition_zh: (名) 彗星；彗虹
example_sentence: Astronomers observed a bright comet passing Earth last night.
sentence_zh: 天文學家昨晚觀測到一顆明亮的彗星經過地球。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈkʌmfɚt] 舒適；安慰　(動) [kəmˈfɚt] 安慰；使舒適　(形) 舒適的；安逸的
example_sentence: Students study hard to comfort their parents' worries about their future success.
sentence_zh: 學生努力讀書是為了安慰父母對他們未來成功的擔憂。

definition_zh: (形) 舒適的；舒服的　(形) 自在的；放鬆的
example_sentence: Wearing soft cotton clothes makes studying for exams feel more comfortable and less stressful.
sentence_zh: 穿著柔軟的棉質衣服讓準備考試的時間感覺更舒適，壓力也更少。

definition_zh: (副) 舒適地；安適地　自在地；輕鬆地
example_sentence: Although the exam was difficult, students who studied hard finished comfortably within the time limit.
sentence_zh: 雖然考試很難，但認真讀書的學生舒適地在時間限制內完成了。

definition_zh: (名) 被子；舒適的東西　(動) 安慰；撫慰
example_sentence: Having comforted by warm blankets, the tired student finally fell asleep peacefully.
sentence_zh: 被溫暖被子安撫後，疲倦的學生終於能安穩入睡。

definition_zh: (形) 滑稽的；好笑的　(名) 漫畫；喜劇演員
example_sentence: The comic movie that we watched last weekend made everyone in the theater laugh out loud.
sentence_zh: 我們上週末看的那部滑稽電影讓電影院裡的每個人都大聲笑了。

definition_zh: (形) 滑稽的；好笑的　(形) 令人發笑的；幽默的
example_sentence: The comical actor made the whole audience laugh and cheer loudly.
sentence_zh: 那位滑稽的演員讓整個觀眾群大笑並歡呼。

definition_zh: (形) 即將到來的；未來的　(名) 到來；來臨
example_sentence: If the coming exam were not so difficult, students would feel less stressed about preparation.
sentence_zh: 如果即將到來的考試不那麼困難，學生就不會對準備感到那麼大的壓力。

definition_zh: (名) 來往；進出；人員的流動
example_sentence: The security guard monitored all the comings and goings at the building entrance.
sentence_zh: 保安人員監控了大樓入口處的所有進出情況。

definition_zh: (名) 逗號；逗點
example_sentence: Separating items in a list using commas, the student wrote the address correctly on the form.
sentence_zh: 學生用逗號分隔清單中的項目，在表格上正確地寫下地址。

definition_zh: (動) 命令；指揮　(名) 命令；掌控
example_sentence: As the captain commanded the team to focus, players listened carefully and prepared for the final match.
sentence_zh: 當隊長命令球隊專注時，選手們仔細聆聽並為決賽做準備。

definition_zh: (名) 指揮官；司令　(動) 指揮；統領
example_sentence: Not only did the commander lead the troops with wisdom, but also earned deep respect from soldiers.
sentence_zh: 這位指揮官不僅以智慧領導部隊，而且獲得士兵的深切敬重。

definition_zh: (形) 威嚴的；令人印象深刻的　(形) 指揮的；控制的
example_sentence: The commanding officer who led the rescue mission earned great respect from soldiers.
sentence_zh: 領導救援任務的指揮官贏得了士兵們的高度尊敬。

definition_zh: (動) 紀念；慶祝　(動) 為...立紀念碑
example_sentence: The school organized a ceremony to commemorate the founding of the institution fifty years ago.
sentence_zh: 學校組織了一場典禮來紀念該校五十年前的創立。

definition_zh: (形) 紀念的；為了紀念而設計的
example_sentence: The museum displayed commemorative coins marking the country's centennial anniversary.
sentence_zh: 博物館展示了紀念該國百年紀念日的紀念幣。

definition_zh: (動) 開始；著手　(名) 開始；開幕式
example_sentence: The graduation ceremony will commence at ten o'clock tomorrow morning.
sentence_zh: 畢業典禮明天上午十點開始。

definition_zh: (名) 開始；開端　(名) 畢業典禮；學位授予式
example_sentence: As the commencement ceremony began, graduates walked across the stage to receive their diplomas.
sentence_zh: 當畢業典禮開始時，畢業生走上舞台領取文憑。

definition_zh: (動) 表揚；稱讚　(動) 推薦；委託
example_sentence: Commending the students for their hard work, the principal presented certificates to the top performers.
sentence_zh: 校長表揚學生們的努力，將證書頒給表現優異的學生。

definition_zh: (形) 相稱的；相當的　(動) 與…相稱；相當於
example_sentence: The salary offered should be commensurate with the experience that the candidate brings to the position.
sentence_zh: 所提供的薪水應該與應徵者帶來的經驗相稱。

definition_zh: (名) 評論；意見　(動) 評論；發表意見
example_sentence: If students comment on the film thoughtfully, the teacher will give them extra credit.
sentence_zh: 如果學生認真評論這部電影，老師會給他們加分。

definition_zh: (名) 評論；評述　(名) 講解；說明
example_sentence: The sports commentary during the basketball game kept audiences excited throughout.
sentence_zh: 籃球比賽期間的體育評論讓觀眾全程興奮不已。

definition_zh: (名) 評論員；解說員　(名) 時評家；評論者
example_sentence: Sports commentators use detailed analysis to help audiences understand the game better.
sentence_zh: 運動評論員利用詳細的分析來幫助觀眾更了解比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 商業；貿易　(名) 商務；商品買賣
example_sentence: International commerce between Taiwan and other countries grows stronger every year.
sentence_zh: 台灣與其他國家之間的國際商業每年都在增長。

definition_zh: (形) 商業的；商用的　(名) 廣告；商業廣告
example_sentence: Although the movie received critical acclaim, its commercial success depended heavily on opening weekend box office numbers.
sentence_zh: 雖然這部電影獲得評論好評，但它的商業成功主要取決於首週末的票房數字。

definition_zh: (副) 商業上地；為了商業目的地　(副) 以營利方式地；商用地
example_sentence: Having been produced commercially for decades, smartphones have become essential tools for modern teenagers.
sentence_zh: 智慧型手機被商業化生產了幾十年，已成為現代青少年的必需工具。

definition_zh: (名) 佣金；手續費　(動) 委託；授權　(名) 委員會；機構
example_sentence: The sales representative who earned a commission for each product sold exceeded this month's target.
sentence_zh: 這位因每件售出商品而獲得佣金的銷售代表超額完成本月目標。

definition_zh: (名) 專員；委員　(名) 局長；處長
example_sentence: The sports commissioner announced new rules for fair competition among all teams.
sentence_zh: 體育委員會的委員宣布了對所有隊伍的新公平競爭規則。

definition_zh: (動) 承諾；保證　實行；犯下
example_sentence: If students committed to studying hard, they would achieve better scores on the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 如果學生承諾認真念書，他們在學測上會取得更好的成績。

definition_zh: (名) 承諾；誓約　(名) 承擔；投入
example_sentence: Making a commitment to study English requires time and effort.
sentence_zh: 對英文學習做出承諾需要時間和努力。

definition_zh: (名) 委員會；小組　(名) 全體委員
example_sentence: Representing the school at the meeting, the committee discussed the new campus policy.
sentence_zh: 代表學校參加會議，委員會討論了新的校園政策。

definition_zh: (名) 商品；物品　(名) 日用品；農產品
example_sentence: As global demand for oil increases, the commodity price rises sharply every year.
sentence_zh: 隨著全球對石油的需求增加，該商品的價格每年急劇上升。

definition_zh: (形) 普通的；常見的　(形) 平凡的；一般的
example_sentence: Seldom do common mistakes in grammar go unnoticed during the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 在學測考試中，普通的文法錯誤很少被忽視。

definition_zh: (副) 通常；經常　普遍地；廣泛地
example_sentence: Students who study commonly before exams tend to perform better in tests.
sentence_zh: 在考試前經常讀書的學生在測驗中往往表現得更好。

definition_zh: (形) 普通的；平凡的　(名) 平凡的事；老生常談
example_sentence: Reading classic novels helps students avoid commonplace thinking to develop deeper critical perspectives.
sentence_zh: 閱讀經典小說幫助學生避免平凡的思維以發展更深入的批判觀點。

definition_zh: (名) 英聯邦；共和體　(名) 共同福祉；公共利益
example_sentence: Australia is a Commonwealth nation that maintains strong ties with Britain and other member states.
sentence_zh: 澳洲是英聯邦國家，與英國及其他成員國保持密切關係。

definition_zh: (名) 鸕鶿；潛水鳥　(形) 貪婪的；貪心的
example_sentence: The cormorant dove deep into the ocean to catch fish for dinner.
sentence_zh: 這隻鸕鶿潛入深海捕捉魚類作為晚餐。

definition_zh: (形) 共有的；公共的　(形) 集體的；社區的
example_sentence: Although the apartment building has communal spaces, residents rarely gather there together.
sentence_zh: 雖然這棟公寓樓有公共空間，但住戶很少一起在那裡聚集。

definition_zh: (形) 可傳染的；易傳播的
example_sentence: Being highly communicable, the flu virus spreads quickly through crowded schools during winter months.
sentence_zh: 由於傳染性強，流感病毒在冬季通過擁擠的學校快速傳播。

definition_zh: (動) 溝通；交流　(動) 傳達；表達
example_sentence: Students who communicate effectively with teachers achieve better academic results.
sentence_zh: 那些與老師有效溝通的學生取得更好的學業成績。

definition_zh: (名) 溝通；交流　(名) 通訊；信息
example_sentence: If clear communication happens between teachers and students, misunderstandings will decrease significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果老師和學生之間發生清楚的溝通，誤會將會大幅減少。

definition_zh: (形) 善於溝通的；易於交流的
example_sentence: Effective teachers use communicative methods to help students learn English naturally.
sentence_zh: 有效的教師使用溝通型教學方法幫助學生自然地學習英文。

definition_zh: (名) 共產主義；共產制度
example_sentence: Some historians study communism to understand twentieth-century political conflicts.
sentence_zh: 一些歷史學家研究共產主義以瞭解二十世紀的政治衝突。

definition_zh: (名) 共產主義者；共產黨人　(形) 共產主義的；共產黨的
example_sentence: The history teacher explained how communist governments controlled many countries during the Cold War.
sentence_zh: 歷史老師解釋了在冷戰期間共產黨政府如何控制許多國家。

definition_zh: (名) 社區；社群　(名) 共同體；團體
example_sentence: As the community becomes more aware of environmental issues, local recycling programs have expanded significantly.
sentence_zh: 當社區對環境問題的認識增加時，當地的回收計畫已大幅擴展。

definition_zh: (動) 通勤；往返　(名) 通勤路程；通勤時間
example_sentence: Having commuted by train for three years, Maria finally decided to work from home.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞搭火車通勤了三年後，終於決定在家工作。

definition_zh: (名) 通勤者；往返於住家和工作地點的人　(名) 通勤車
example_sentence: The commuter who takes the early train avoids traffic congestion every morning.
sentence_zh: 搭早班列車的通勤者每天早上都避免了交通堵塞。

definition_zh: (形) 緊湊的；小巧的　(動) 壓緊；壓縮
example_sentence: The compact design of this smartphone makes it easy to carry in your pocket.
sentence_zh: 這支智慧手機的緊湊設計使得它易於放在你的口袋裡。

definition_zh: (名) 同伴；夥伴　(名) 陪伴者；伴侶
example_sentence: If Sarah had a travel companion, the solo trip would be much less lonely and more enjoyable.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉有一位旅遊同伴，這次獨自旅行會少一些孤獨，也會更愉快。

definition_zh: (名) 陪伴；友誼　同伴關係
example_sentence: Traveling with friends provides wonderful companionship during the journey.
sentence_zh: 與朋友一起旅遊在旅程中提供美妙的陪伴。

definition_zh: (名) 公司；企業　(名) 陪伴；同伴
example_sentence: Working in a multinational company, Sarah gains valuable experience in international business management.
sentence_zh: 在一家跨國公司工作，莎拉在國際商業管理中獲得寶貴經驗。

definition_zh: (形) 可比較的；相當的　(形) 相似的；同等的
example_sentence: As the two smartphones are comparable in price, choosing between them becomes difficult for consumers.
sentence_zh: 由於這兩支智慧型手機在價格上相當，消費者在選擇時變得困難。

definition_zh: (形) 比較的；相對的　(名) 比較級
example_sentence: Only by making comparative studies of different cultures can students truly understand global diversity.
sentence_zh: 唯有進行不同文化的比較研究，學生才能真正理解全球多樣性。

definition_zh: (副) 相對地；比較地　相當地；較為
example_sentence: Although both universities are excellent, National Taiwan University is comparatively more competitive in terms of entrance requirements.
sentence_zh: 雖然兩所大學都很優秀，但國立台灣大學在入學要求方面相對來說更具競爭力。

definition_zh: (動) 比較；對比　(動) 相比
example_sentence: Students study different countries to compare their economic systems and cultures.
sentence_zh: 學生研究不同國家以比較它們的經濟制度和文化。

definition_zh: (動) 比較；對比　(形) 相比的；被比較的
example_sentence: Compared with last year's results, this year's exam scores improved significantly.
sentence_zh: 與去年的成績相比，今年的考試分數明顯進步。

definition_zh: (名) 比較；對比　(名) 比較級
example_sentence: In comparison with last year, sales increased by twenty percent this quarter.
sentence_zh: 與去年相比，本季銷售額增長了百分之二十。

definition_zh: (名) 隔間；車廂　(名) 部分；領域
example_sentence: As the train pulled into the station, passengers gathered their luggage from the luggage compartment overhead.
sentence_zh: 當列車駛入車站時，乘客從頭頂的行李隔間取出他們的行李。

definition_zh: (名) 指南針；羅盤　(名) 圓規；範圍
example_sentence: Using a compass pointing northward, the hikers navigated through the dense forest confidently.
sentence_zh: 登山者使用指向北方的指南針，自信地在密林中導航。

definition_zh: (名) 同情心；憐憫　(動) 同情；憐憫
example_sentence: The doctor showed genuine compassion for patients who were suffering from serious illnesses.
sentence_zh: 那位醫生對患有重病的病患表現出真誠的同情心。

definition_zh: (形) 同情的；有同情心的　(形) 溫情的；仁慈的
example_sentence: If doctors were more compassionate toward patients, hospital care would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果醫生對患者更具同情心，醫院的照護就會大幅改善。

definition_zh: (名) 相容性；兼容性　(名) 匹配度；協調性
example_sentence: The software's compatibility with older computers makes it popular among users.
sentence_zh: 該軟體與舊電腦的相容性使其在使用者中很受歡迎。

definition_zh: (形) 相容的；兼容的　(形) 能並存的；相合的
example_sentence: Installing new software requires choosing a compatible system to ensure smooth operation.
sentence_zh: 安裝新軟體需要選擇相容的系統以確保順利運作。

definition_zh: (名) 同胞；同鄉人
example_sentence: During the international competition, the athlete felt proud supporting fellow compatriots from Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 在國際比賽中，這位運動員為支持來自台灣的同胞感到驕傲。

definition_zh: (動) 強迫；迫使　(動) 促使；驅使
example_sentence: Because heavy rain compelled the outdoor concert to be postponed, disappointed fans received refund tickets.
sentence_zh: 由於大雨迫使戶外音樂會延期，失望的樂迷收到了退款票券。

definition_zh: (形) 令人信服的；有說服力的　(形) 引人入勝的；吸引人的
example_sentence: Compelled by the documentary's powerful message, many teenagers decided to volunteer for environmental protection.
sentence_zh: 被這部紀錄片強有力的訊息所吸引，許多青少年決定為環境保護做志願服務。

definition_zh: (動) 補償；賠償　(動) 彌補；抵消
example_sentence: The company offered a raise to employees whose efforts had increased sales significantly.
sentence_zh: 公司對那些努力提高銷售額的員工提供加薪作為補償。

definition_zh: (名) 補償；賠償　(名) 報酬；薪資
example_sentence: The company offered fair compensation to workers injured during the factory accident.
sentence_zh: 該公司對工廠事故中受傷的工人提供了公平的賠償。

definition_zh: (名) 補償器；平衡裝置　(名) 彌補者；賠償者
example_sentence: If the building lacked a compensator, structural damage would occur during earthquakes.
sentence_zh: 如果建築物缺少補償器，地震時結構損傷就會發生。

definition_zh: (形) 補償的；賠償的　(形) 代償的；彌補的
example_sentence: The company offered compensatory pay to employees affected by the factory shutdown.
sentence_zh: 該公司向受工廠關閉影響的員工提供補償薪酬。

definition_zh: (動) 競爭；比賽　(動) 參加比賽；參與競賽
example_sentence: Competing in the science fair, students showcased their creative projects and research findings.
sentence_zh: 在科學展覽會中競爭，學生展示了他們的創意項目和研究發現。

definition_zh: (名) 能力；勝任　(名) 專業知識；技能
example_sentence: Although the new employee lacked experience, her technical competence impressed the supervisor immediately.
sentence_zh: 雖然新員工缺乏經驗，但她的技術能力立即給主管留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 能力；勝任力　(名) 專業知識；技能
example_sentence: Only after mastering both English and math does true academic competency emerge for success.
sentence_zh: 唯有同時精通英文和數學，真正的學業能力才會展現出來以獲得成功。

definition_zh: (形) 勝任的；能幹的　(形) 足夠的；充分的
example_sentence: The doctor who treated the patient was competent and experienced in surgery.
sentence_zh: 治療病人的醫生是個勝任的且具有外科手術經驗的醫生。

definition_zh: (動) 競爭；比賽　(形) 有競爭力的；互相競爭的
example_sentence: Many students study hard to prepare for competing in the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力讀書以準備參加學測競爭。

definition_zh: (名) 競爭；比賽　(名) 競爭者；對手
example_sentence: Winning the speech competition requires careful preparation and confident delivery.
sentence_zh: 贏得演講比賽需要仔細的準備和自信的表現。

definition_zh: (名) 競爭優勢；領先優勢
example_sentence: Having strong English skills gives students a competitive edge in university entrance exams.
sentence_zh: 擁有強大的英文能力讓學生在大學入學考試中具有競爭優勢。

definition_zh: (形) 競爭的；好競爭的　(形) 有競爭力的；相當好的
example_sentence: Although the job market is highly competitive, many graduates still pursue their dream careers.
sentence_zh: 雖然就業市場競爭非常激烈，許多畢業生仍然追求他們的夢想職業。

definition_zh: (名) 競爭者；對手　(名) 參賽者；選手
example_sentence: Competing fiercely in the tournament, the young athletes impressed judges with their skill.
sentence_zh: 在比賽中激烈競爭的年輕運動員用他們的技術給評委留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (動) 編譯；彙編　(動) 編寫；整理
example_sentence: The research team compiled data from multiple sources, which provided valuable insights.
sentence_zh: 研究團隊從多個來源彙編數據，這些數據提供了寶貴的見解。

definition_zh: (形) 自滿的；得意洋洋的　(形) 滿足的；不思進步的
example_sentence: If athletes become complacent after winning one championship, they will lose motivation.
sentence_zh: 如果運動員在贏得一次冠軍後變得自滿，他們就會失去動力。

definition_zh: (動) 抱怨；不滿　(名) 抱怨；訴苦
example_sentence: Students often complain about too much homework after school.
sentence_zh: 學生經常抱怨放學後功課太多。

definition_zh: (名) 抱怨；投訴　(動) 抱怨；申訴
example_sentence: Students filed a complaint to request better cafeteria food quality.
sentence_zh: 學生們提出投訴以要求改善學食品質。

definition_zh: (名) 補足物；搭配物　(動) 補充；襯托
example_sentence: The chef's creative sauce and perfectly cooked vegetables complement each other wonderfully.
sentence_zh: 廚師創意醬汁與烹飪完美的蔬菜彼此搭配得很棒。

definition_zh: (形) 互補的；相輔相成的　(形) 免費贈送的；附送的
example_sentence: Since the two colors are complementary, designers often use them together to create striking visual contrasts.
sentence_zh: 由於這兩種顏色互補，設計師經常將它們搭配使用以創造引人注目的視覺對比。

definition_zh: (動) 完成；結束　(形) 完整的；圓滿的
example_sentence: Having completed the final exam, students finally felt relieved and excited.
sentence_zh: 完成了期末考試後，學生們終於感到輕鬆和興奮。

definition_zh: (副) 完全地；徹底地　(副) 全部地；整個地
example_sentence: The building that was completely destroyed in the earthquake has now been rebuilt.
sentence_zh: 那棟在地震中完全被摧毀的建築物現在已經重建了。

definition_zh: (名) 完成；完末　(名) 竣工；結束
example_sentence: The completion of the high-speed rail project brought great convenience to many commuters.
sentence_zh: 高鐵專案的完成為許多通勤者帶來了極大的便利。

definition_zh: (形) 複雜的；難懂的　(名) 複合體；情結
example_sentence: If the math problem were not so complex, students would finish the exam more quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果數學題不是那麼複雜，學生就能更快完成考試。

definition_zh: (名) 膚色；臉色　(名) 情況；狀況
example_sentence: A healthy complexion requires regular skincare and sufficient sleep every day.
sentence_zh: 健康的膚色需要定期護膚和每天充足的睡眠。

definition_zh: (名) 複雜性；複雜的事物　(名) 複雜的部分；難點
example_sentence: Facing increasing complexity, software engineers must design systems carefully and thoughtfully.
sentence_zh: 面對日益增加的複雜性，軟體工程師必須謹慎且深思熟慮地設計系統。

definition_zh: (名) 遵守；服從　(名) 順應；配合
example_sentence: Although the factory promised to improve safety measures, its compliance with environmental regulations remains questionable.
sentence_zh: 雖然該工廠承諾改善安全措施，但其對環保法規的遵守情況仍令人懷疑。

definition_zh: (形) 服從的；配合的　(形) 符合規定的；達到要求的
example_sentence: Only when machinery becomes compliant with safety standards can factories operate legally.
sentence_zh: 只有當機器符合安全標準時，工廠才能合法運營。

definition_zh: (動) 使複雜；使難以理解　(形) 複雜的；難懂的
example_sentence: The new tax rules, which complicate financial planning for small businesses, took effect last month.
sentence_zh: 新的稅務規則使小型企業的財務規劃變得更複雜，該規則上個月開始生效。

definition_zh: (形) 複雜的；難懂的
example_sentence: Learning English grammar requires studying hard to understand complicated sentence structures.
sentence_zh: 學習英文文法需要用功讀書以理解複雜的句子結構。

definition_zh: (名) 併發症；複雜情況　(名) 麻煩；困難
example_sentence: Infection and complications following surgery require careful monitoring and prompt medical attention.
sentence_zh: 手術後的感染和併發症需要仔細監測和及時的醫療護理。

definition_zh: (名) 複雜情況；並發症
example_sentence: The surgery went well, but serious complications developed after two weeks.
sentence_zh: 手術進行順利，但兩週後出現了嚴重的並發症。

definition_zh: (形) 共謀的；同謀的　(形) 被牽連的；有份的
example_sentence: Although the manager claimed innocence, evidence showed that management was complicit in the accounting fraud scheme.
sentence_zh: 雖然經理聲稱無辜，但證據顯示管理層在會計欺詐計畫中有份。

definition_zh: (名) 共謀；串通　(名) 包庇；共犯
example_sentence: Having discovered evidence of corruption, the auditor exposed the manager's complicity in the embezzlement scheme.
sentence_zh: 稽核員發現貪污證據後，揭露了經理在挪用公款計畫中的共謀行為。

definition_zh: (名) 讚美；稱讚　(動) 稱讚；恭維
example_sentence: The teacher gave Maria a compliment that made her feel confident about her presentation.
sentence_zh: 老師給了瑪麗亞一句讚美，使她對自己的簡報感到有信心。

definition_zh: (形) 讚美的；恭維的　(形) 免費的；附贈的
example_sentence: If the restaurant provides complimentary dessert, customers would feel more satisfied.
sentence_zh: 如果餐廳提供免費甜點，顧客會感到更滿意。

definition_zh: (動) 遵守；服從　(動) 同意；配合
example_sentence: All students must comply with the school's dress code policy.
sentence_zh: 所有學生必須遵守學校的服裝儀容規定。

definition_zh: (名) 零件；組成部分　(形) 組成的；構成的
example_sentence: Engineers use various components to build a reliable automobile engine.
sentence_zh: 工程師使用各種零件來製造可靠的汽車引擎。

definition_zh: (動) 創作；譜曲　撰寫；編寫　(形) 鎮定的；沉著的
example_sentence: The musician composed a beautiful symphony, and the audience applauded loudly.
sentence_zh: 這位音樂家創作了一首優美的交響樂，觀眾熱烈鼓掌。

definition_zh: (形) 鎮靜的；沉著的　(動) 組成；創作
example_sentence: Composed as the pianist was, nerves still affected her performance during the final competition.
sentence_zh: 雖然鋼琴家保持沉著，但緊張情緒仍然影響了她在決賽中的表現。

definition_zh: (名) 作曲家；譜曲者
example_sentence: Having studied music theory for years, the composer finally completed his first symphony.
sentence_zh: 經過多年的音樂理論研究，這位作曲家終於完成了他的第一部交響曲。

definition_zh: (形) 複合的；組合的　(名) 複合物；混合體
example_sentence: The bridge, which is made of composite materials that are both strong and light, can withstand earthquakes.
sentence_zh: 這座橋由既堅固又輕盈的複合材料製成，能夠抵禦地震。

definition_zh: (名) 作文；構圖　(名) 成分；組成
example_sentence: Writing a good composition requires careful planning and clear organization of ideas.
sentence_zh: 寫好一篇作文需要仔細計畫和清晰的思想組織。

definition_zh: (名) 沉著；鎮定　(名) 組成；成分
example_sentence: If the athlete lost composure during the final match, the team would have failed to win the championship.
sentence_zh: 如果運動員在決賽中失去沉著，球隊就不會贏得冠軍。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈkɑmpaʊnd] 化合物；混合物　(形) [ˈkɑmpaʊnd] 複合的；混合的　(動) [kəmˈpaʊnd] 加重；惡化
example_sentence: Water is a compound made of hydrogen and oxygen atoms.
sentence_zh: 水是由氫原子和氧原子組成的化合物。

definition_zh: (動) 理解；明白　(動) 包含；涵蓋
example_sentence: Comprehending the complex physics concept, the student finally solved the difficult exam question.
sentence_zh: 理解了複雜的物理概念後，這位學生終於解決了這道困難的考試題目。

definition_zh: (形) 可理解的；易懂的
example_sentence: Because the teacher explained the grammar rules clearly, the lesson became comprehensible to most students.
sentence_zh: 因為老師清楚地解釋了文法規則，這堂課對大多數學生來說變得容易理解。

definition_zh: (名) 理解；領悟　(名) 理解力；認知能力
example_sentence: Only through consistent reading practice does comprehension of complex texts improve gradually.
sentence_zh: 只有透過持續的閱讀練習，才能逐漸提高對複雜文本的理解能力。

definition_zh: (形) 全面的；廣泛的　(形) 綜合性的；包含一切的
example_sentence: The comprehensive study that researchers conducted revealed important trends in student learning.
sentence_zh: 研究人員所進行的全面研究揭示了學生學習的重要趨勢。

definition_zh: (動) [kəmˋprɛs] 壓縮；壓扁　(名) [ˋkɑmprɛs] 冷敷布；藥布
example_sentence: Athletes use ice compress to reduce swelling and ease pain.
sentence_zh: 運動員使用冷敷布來減少腫脹和緩解疼痛。

definition_zh: (動) 組成；構成　包含；包括
example_sentence: The school team comprises students from different grades and classes working together toward victory.
sentence_zh: 該校隊由來自不同年級和班級的學生組成，共同為勝利而努力。

definition_zh: (動) 妥協；折衷　(名) 妥協；讓步
example_sentence: The two countries reached a compromise after weeks of difficult negotiations.
sentence_zh: 經過數週艱難談判後，兩國達成了妥協。

definition_zh: (形) 強迫性的；無法自制的　(副) 強迫地；無法抗拒地
example_sentence: Because shopping becomes compulsive, many teenagers find themselves in debt.
sentence_zh: 因為購物變成了強迫性的行為，許多青少年發現自己陷入了債務。

definition_zh: (形) 強制的；必修的　(形) 義務性的；必須的
example_sentence: Requiring all students to complete compulsory English courses, the school aims to improve language proficiency.
sentence_zh: 學校要求所有學生完成強制英文課程，目的是提高語言能力。

definition_zh: (名) 計算；運算　(名) 計算過程；計算結果
example_sentence: The computation that scientists performed revealed unexpected patterns in the data.
sentence_zh: 科學家進行的計算揭示了數據中出乎意料的規律。

definition_zh: (動) 計算；運算　(動) 用電腦處理
example_sentence: If students compute the data correctly, the research results will be more reliable.
sentence_zh: 如果學生正確計算數據，研究結果將更加可靠。

definition_zh: (名) 電腦；計算機
example_sentence: Students use computers to complete homework and research online.
sentence_zh: 學生用電腦完成功課和線上研究。

definition_zh: (動) 使用電腦；電腦化　(動) 將…輸入電腦；數位化
example_sentence: The hospital decided to computerize its patient records to improve efficiency and reduce errors.
sentence_zh: 這家醫院決定將病患紀錄電腦化，以提高效率並減少錯誤。

definition_zh: (名) 計算；運算　(形) 計算的；運算的
example_sentence: Computing skills and digital literacy have become essential for modern students entering universities and workplaces.
sentence_zh: 計算技能和數位素養已成為現代學生進入大學和職場的必備條件。

definition_zh: (名) 同志；同伴　(名) 戰友；夥伴
example_sentence: Although the two soldiers had different backgrounds, they became true comrades as they fought together in the war.
sentence_zh: 雖然這兩名士兵出身背景不同，但他們在戰爭中並肩作戰而成為真正的戰友。

definition_zh: (名) 騙局；詐騙　(動) 欺騙；詐騙
example_sentence: Having conned many investors out of their savings, the fraud artist was finally arrested by police.
sentence_zh: 那位詐騙藝術家騙了許多投資者的積蓄後，最終被警察逮捕。

definition_zh: (動) 隱藏；隱瞞　(動) 遮掩；掩蓋
example_sentence: The student who concealed the truth about the exam faced serious consequences.
sentence_zh: 隱瞞考試真相的那位學生面臨嚴重後果。

definition_zh: (動) 承認；讓步　(動) 認輸；退縮
example_sentence: After losing the final match, the champion conceded victory to the younger opponent with grace.
sentence_zh: 在輸掉決賽後，冠軍優雅地向年輕對手承認敗北。

definition_zh: (名) 自負；驕傲　(動) 自以為是；沾沾自喜
example_sentence: If the student didn't harbor such conceit about his abilities, he would study harder for the exam.
sentence_zh: 如果那名學生對自己的能力不那麼自負，他就會為考試更努力準備。

definition_zh: (形) 可以想像的；可能的
example_sentence: Every conceivable problem with the new software system needs fixing before launch.
sentence_zh: 新軟體系統的每一個可以想像得到的問題都需要在推出前修正。

definition_zh: (動) 想出；構想　懷孕；受孕
example_sentence: Conceiving a brilliant business plan, the young entrepreneur immediately pitched it to investors.
sentence_zh: 那位年輕企業家構想出一個絕妙的商業計畫，立刻向投資者提案。

definition_zh: (動) 集中；專注　(動) 濃縮；提煉
example_sentence: As the exam approaches, students must concentrate on reviewing key grammar rules daily.
sentence_zh: 隨著考試逼近，學生必須集中精力每天複習重要文法規則。

definition_zh: (形) 濃縮的；集中的　(動) 專注；集中
example_sentence: Only after drinking concentrated orange juice did the athlete regain energy quickly.
sentence_zh: 只有喝了濃縮柳橙汁後，運動員才快速恢復體力。

definition_zh: (名) 專注；集中　(名) 濃度；含量
example_sentence: The intense concentration that marathon runners maintain throughout the race is what separates champions.
sentence_zh: 馬拉松選手在整場比賽中保持的強烈專注力是冠軍的區別所在。

definition_zh: (名) 概念；想法　(名) 概括；觀念
example_sentence: Scientists use models to test the concept in order to verify their hypothesis.
sentence_zh: 科學家使用模型來測試這個概念，以驗證他們的假說。

definition_zh: (名) 概念；想法　(名) 懷孕；受孕
example_sentence: The conception of artificial intelligence has changed how we think about technology.
sentence_zh: 人工智慧的概念改變了我們對科技的想法。

definition_zh: (形) 概念的；理論的　(形) 抽象的；思想上的
example_sentence: The teacher explained the conceptual framework behind the scientific theory.
sentence_zh: 老師解釋了這個科學理論背後的概念框架。

definition_zh: (動) 形成概念；使具體化　(動) 想像；設想
example_sentence: As students conceptualize the main idea, they gradually understand the entire passage better.
sentence_zh: 當學生形成主要概念時，他們逐漸更好地理解整篇文章。

definition_zh: (名) 關心；擔憂　(動) 涉及；使擔心　(形) 感到擔憂的；有關的
example_sentence: Concerning rising tuition fees, many students and parents voiced their worries at the meeting.
sentence_zh: 關於學費上漲的問題，許多學生和家長在會議上表達了他們的擔憂。

definition_zh: (形) 擔心的；關切的　(形) 有關的；涉及的
example_sentence: Parents concerned about their children's exam scores often attend school meetings.
sentence_zh: 擔心孩子考試成績的家長經常參加學校會議。

definition_zh: (形) 令人擔憂的；令人關切的　(介) 關於；涉及
example_sentence: If rising sea levels become more concerning, coastal cities must prepare stronger flood defenses immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果海平面上升變得更令人擔憂，沿海城市必須立即準備更強的防洪防禦。

definition_zh: (名) [kɑnsɚt] 音樂會；演奏會　(動) [kənˋsɚt] 共同策劃；協力
example_sentence: Thousands of fans attended the rock concert last Saturday night.
sentence_zh: 數千名粉絲上周六晚上參加了搖滾音樂會。

definition_zh: (名) 協奏曲；樂隊與獨奏者的樂曲
example_sentence: Musicians practice the difficult concerto to perform it perfectly at the concert.
sentence_zh: 音樂家練習這首困難的協奏曲，以便在音樂會上完美演出。

definition_zh: (名) 讓步；妥協　(名) 特許權；優惠
example_sentence: The government made a major concession to environmental groups by banning single-use plastics nationwide.
sentence_zh: 政府向環保團體做出重大讓步，在全國禁止使用一次性塑膠製品。

definition_zh: (名) 螺貝；海螺　(名) 螺貝殼
example_sentence: As the diver explored the ocean floor, conches lay scattered among the rocks and seaweed.
sentence_zh: 當潛水員探索海床時，螺貝散落在岩石和海草之間。

definition_zh: (名) 門房；禮賓員　(動) 提供禮賓服務
example_sentence: Having worked as a concierge for five years, Maria knew every restaurant in the city.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞曾擔任禮賓員五年，對城裡的每家餐廳都瞭如指掌。

definition_zh: (動) 安撫；調和　(動) 使和解；平息
example_sentence: The manager offered conciliatory gestures that conciliated the angry employees who demanded better working conditions.
sentence_zh: 經理提出和解姿態，安撫了那些要求改善工作條件的憤怒員工。

definition_zh: (名) 調解人；和解者　(名) 調停者；仲裁人
example_sentence: The experienced conciliator helped both parties reach a fair agreement without going to court.
sentence_zh: 那位經驗豐富的調解人幫助雙方達成公平協議，而無需上法庭。

definition_zh: (形) 調和的；和解的　(形) 溫和的；討好的
example_sentence: If the company adopted a more conciliatory approach, angry customers would likely return and rebuild trust.
sentence_zh: 如果公司採取更和解的態度，憤怒的顧客可能會回頭並重建信任。

definition_zh: (形) 簡潔的；簡明的
example_sentence: A concise summary helps students understand the main points quickly.
sentence_zh: 簡潔的摘要幫助學生快速理解要點。

definition_zh: (副) 簡潔地；簡明地
example_sentence: Speaking concisely during the presentation, the student impressed all judges with clear ideas.
sentence_zh: 在演講中簡潔地表達，這位學生以清晰的想法給所有評審留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (動) 結束；完成　推斷；得出結論
example_sentence: Not only did the research conclude that sleep is essential, but it also revealed surprising benefits for memory.
sentence_zh: 這項研究不但得出睡眠至關重要的結論，而且還揭示了睡眠對記憶的驚人好處。

definition_zh: (名) 結論；結束　(動) 推斷；結束
example_sentence: The conclusion that the students reached after the debate was surprising to everyone.
sentence_zh: 學生們在辯論後得出的結論令所有人感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (動) 調製；混合　(動) 編造；策劃
example_sentence: The chef concocted a special dessert to impress the competition judges.
sentence_zh: 這位廚師調製了一道特殊甜點來打動比賽評委。

definition_zh: (動) 捏造；策劃　(形) 虛假的；編造的
example_sentence: The fake news story, concocted by dishonest reporters, spread quickly online.
sentence_zh: 由不誠實的記者捏造的假新聞故事在網路上迅速傳播。

definition_zh: (形) 伴隨的；同時發生的　(名) 伴隨事物；附帶現象
example_sentence: Economic growth and increased pollution are concomitant problems facing Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 經濟成長和污染增加是台灣所面臨的伴隨問題。

definition_zh: (名) 協議；和諧　(動) 一致；相符
example_sentence: Although the two countries reached concord on trade, disagreements remained on environmental issues.
sentence_zh: 雖然兩國在貿易上達成協議，但在環境問題上仍有分歧。

definition_zh: (形) 具體的；實際的　(名) 混凝土；水泥
example_sentence: Facing concrete evidence of climate change, scientists worldwide are pushing for immediate action.
sentence_zh: 面對氣候變化的具體證據，全球科學家正在推動立即採取行動。

definition_zh: (動) 同意；贊同　(動) 一致；相符
example_sentence: The two judges concurred on a verdict that satisfied most observers.
sentence_zh: 這兩位法官在一項令大多數旁觀者滿意的判決上達成共識。

definition_zh: (名) 同意；贊同　(名) 同時發生；一致
example_sentence: If the committee reaches concurrence on the budget plan, the project will proceed immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果委員會對預算計畫達成一致意見，專案將立即進行。

definition_zh: (副) 同時地；並行地　(副) 一起；同步地
example_sentence: The student studied math and English concurrently to prepare for the entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 這位學生同時學習數學和英文以準備入學考試。

definition_zh: (名) 腦震盪；震動
example_sentence: Athletes wear helmets to prevent concussion during contact sports.
sentence_zh: 運動員在接觸性運動中戴頭盔以防止腦震盪。

definition_zh: (動) 譴責；批評　(動) 判刑；定罪
example_sentence: The judge condemned the criminal to life imprisonment for the serious crime.
sentence_zh: 法官因重罪而判該罪犯終身監禁。

definition_zh: (名) 譴責；強烈批評　(名) 定罪；判刑
example_sentence: Although the government issued a strong condemnation of the illegal activity, many citizens still demanded further action.
sentence_zh: 雖然政府對這項非法活動進行了強烈譴責，但許多公民仍然要求採取進一步行動。

definition_zh: (動) 濃縮；凝結　(形) 濃縮的；簡潔的
example_sentence: Having condensed the report into three pages, the manager submitted it to the director.
sentence_zh: 經過濃縮報告至三頁，經理將其提交給董事。

definition_zh: (動) 俯視；居高臨下對待　(動) 屈尊；勉強同意
example_sentence: The manager who condescended to junior employees always made them feel uncomfortable and undervalued.
sentence_zh: 那位對下屬員工居高臨下的經理總是讓他們感到不舒服和不被重視。

definition_zh: (名) 居高臨下的態度；傲慢　(名) 屈尊；俯就
example_sentence: The professor's condescendence toward students made everyone feel uncomfortable and disrespected.
sentence_zh: 那位教授對學生居高臨下的態度讓每個人都感到不舒服和被不尊重。

definition_zh: (名) 傲慢態度；居高臨下　(動) 以傲慢態度對待
example_sentence: If the manager showed condescension toward junior staff, employees would lose motivation and respect.
sentence_zh: 如果經理對初級員工表現傲慢態度，員工就會失去動力和尊重。

definition_zh: (名) 條件；狀況　(動) 使習慣；訓練
example_sentence: Getting into a good university requires hard work and excellent grades.
sentence_zh: 進入一所好大學需要努力學習和優異的成績。

definition_zh: (形) 有條件的；附帶條件的　(名) 條件句；條件語法
example_sentence: Passing the entrance exam, students gain admission conditional on meeting the required score threshold.
sentence_zh: 通過入學考試，學生在達到要求的分數門檻時，有條件地獲得入學資格。

definition_zh: (名) 護髮素；調理劑　(動) 調理；使適應
example_sentence: Although hair conditioner is expensive, many students use it regularly to keep their hair healthy.
sentence_zh: 雖然護髮素很貴，許多學生仍定期使用它來保持頭髮健康。

definition_zh: (名) 公寓大廈；共有公寓
example_sentence: Only after buying a condo did Sarah realize the maintenance fees were quite high.
sentence_zh: 只有在買了公寓大廈後，莎拉才意識到管理費相當高。

definition_zh: (名) 慰問；同情　(名) 弔唁；悼詞
example_sentence: The letters of condolence that arrived after the accident deeply comforted the grieving family.
sentence_zh: 事故後收到的慰問信深深安慰了這個悲傷的家庭。

definition_zh: (名) 保險套；避孕套
example_sentence: Using a condom to prevent sexually transmitted infections is an important health practice.
sentence_zh: 使用保險套來預防性傳染病是重要的健康習慣。

definition_zh: (名) 公寓大廈；分戶所有權住宅
example_sentence: Many young professionals buy condominiums in downtown Taipei for convenient city living.
sentence_zh: 許多年輕上班族在台北市中心購買公寓大廈以方便城市生活。

definition_zh: (形) 有利的；促進的　有助於...的
example_sentence: A quiet study environment is conducive to better concentration and academic success.
sentence_zh: 安靜的讀書環境有利於更好的專注力和學業成功。

definition_zh: (名) ['kɑndʌkt] 行為；舉止　(動) [kən'dʌkt] 進行；指揮
example_sentence: As the orchestra conductor leads the musicians, the audience listens intently to the beautiful music.
sentence_zh: 當樂隊指揮帶領樂手時，聽眾專注地聆聽優美的音樂。

definition_zh: (名) 指揮家；樂隊指揮　(名) 導體；電導體
example_sentence: Leading the orchestra with passion, the conductor inspired every musician to perform beautifully.
sentence_zh: 樂隊指揮以熱情指揮樂團，激勵每位音樂家精美地表演。

definition_zh: (動) 用錐形路障圍起；封閉
example_sentence: The construction area that workers coned off yesterday remained inaccessible to pedestrians.
sentence_zh: 工人昨天用路障圍起的施工區域仍然行人無法進入。

definition_zh: (名) 圓錐體；圓錐形物體　(動) 使成圓錐形
example_sentence: If the ice cream cone melts, we will need to eat it more quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果冰淇淋甜筒融化，我們將需要更快地吃掉它。

definition_zh: (名) 糖果；甜食　(名) 製作；配製
example_sentence: The bakery sells beautiful confections decorated with colorful frosting.
sentence_zh: 這家烘焙店出售用彩色糖霜裝飾的漂亮糖果。

definition_zh: (名) 糖果；甜點　(形) 糖果的；甜食的
example_sentence: The bakery sells confectionery to attract customers and increase monthly sales.
sentence_zh: 這家麵包店銷售糖果來吸引顧客並增加月銷售額。

definition_zh: (名) 邦聯；聯盟　(名) 同盟國；聯合體
example_sentence: The Southern states formed a confederacy to resist Northern authority during the American Civil War.
sentence_zh: 美國南方各州在內戰期間組成邦聯來抵抗北方的權力。

definition_zh: (動) 聯合；結盟　(形) 同盟的；聯合的
example_sentence: As the small states confederated to form a stronger alliance, their combined military power increased significantly.
sentence_zh: 當小國家聯合起來形成更強大的同盟時，它們的軍事力量顯著增加。

definition_zh: (名) 聯邦；邦聯　(名) 聯合；結合
example_sentence: Having united their efforts through formal agreements, the member states formed a confederation to strengthen their collective influence.
sentence_zh: 各成員州通過正式協議團結努力，組成一個聯邦以加強其集體影響力。

definition_zh: (動) 商談；協商　(動) 授予；頒發
example_sentence: The principal will confer with teachers about the new curriculum policy that affects all students.
sentence_zh: 校長將與教師商談那項影響全體學生的新課程政策。

definition_zh: (名) 會議；討論會
example_sentence: The international trade conference brought together business leaders from many countries to discuss economic cooperation.
sentence_zh: 這場國際貿易會議聚集了來自許多國家的商業領袖，討論經濟合作。

definition_zh: (動) 承認；坦白　(動) 向神父認罪
example_sentence: If the student confessed the cheating incident earlier, the teacher would have shown more leniency.
sentence_zh: 如果那位學生早點坦白作弊的事，老師會表現得更寬容。

definition_zh: (名) 認罪；供認　(名) 告白；承認
example_sentence: The criminal's confession to the police led to his arrest.
sentence_zh: 那名罪犯向警方的認罪導致他被逮捕。

definition_zh: (名) 知己；親信　(形) 確信的；自信的
example_sentence: Sharing her deepest secrets with her trusted confidant, Sarah felt relieved and understood.
sentence_zh: 莎拉與她信任的知己分享最深的秘密，感到輕鬆和被理解。

definition_zh: (名) 知心朋友；親信
example_sentence: Because Maria trusted her confidante completely, she shared her deepest secrets without any hesitation.
sentence_zh: 因為瑪麗亞完全信任她的知心朋友，她毫不猶豫地分享了她最深的秘密。

definition_zh: (動) 吐露；傾訴　(動) 信任；託付
example_sentence: Only after gaining trust did Emma confide her deepest fears to her closest friend.
sentence_zh: 只有在獲得信任之後，艾瑪才向最親近的朋友傾訴她最深層的恐懼。

definition_zh: (名) 信心；自信　(名) 信任；信賴
example_sentence: The student who had built confidence through consistent practice performed excellently in the exam.
sentence_zh: 通過持續練習而建立信心的學生在考試中表現出色。

definition_zh: (形) 有信心的；自信的　(形) 確信的；肯定的
example_sentence: Maria studied hard all semester to feel confident taking the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞整個學期努力讀書，為的是在學測考試時感到有信心。

definition_zh: (形) 機密的；保密的　(形) 信任的；親密的
example_sentence: The company's confidential business plans must be kept secret from competitors.
sentence_zh: 公司的機密商業計畫必須對競爭對手保密。

definition_zh: (副) 機密地；秘密地　以保密的方式
example_sentence: The doctor spoke confidentially with the patient about treatment options.
sentence_zh: 醫生以保密的方式與患者討論治療方案。

definition_zh: (名) 配置；組態　(名) 結構；構造
example_sentence: Because the system configuration changed unexpectedly, the software stopped working properly yesterday.
sentence_zh: 因為系統的配置突然改變，軟體昨天停止正常運作。

definition_zh: (動) 設定；調整　(動) 組態；配置
example_sentence: Configuring the computer system properly, the technician ensured all devices worked smoothly.
sentence_zh: 技術人員妥善設定電腦系統，確保所有設備運作順暢。

definition_zh: (動) 限制；侷限　(動) 監禁；關押
example_sentence: The strict rules that confine students to campus during lunch break frustrate many teenagers.
sentence_zh: 那些限制學生午餐時間不能離開校園的嚴格規則讓許多青少年感到沮喪。

definition_zh: (形) 被限制的；受限的　(動) 限制；關閉
example_sentence: If students were confined to the classroom during lunch, many would feel unhappy.
sentence_zh: 如果學生們在午餐時間被限制在教室裡，許多人會感到不開心。

definition_zh: (動) 確認；證實　(動) 批准；確定
example_sentence: Please confirm your attendance at tomorrow's meeting by email.
sentence_zh: 請透過電子郵件確認你明天是否參加會議。

definition_zh: (名) 確認；證實　(名) 確認信；確認函
example_sentence: Students need to send confirmation to register for the summer camp.
sentence_zh: 學生需要寄出確認信以登記參加暑期夏令營。

definition_zh: (動) 沒收；充公　(動) 奪取；沒收
example_sentence: The teacher confiscated mobile phones and other electronic devices from cheating students.
sentence_zh: 老師從作弊的學生沒收了手機和其他電子設備。

definition_zh: (名) 沒收；充公　(動) 沒收的行為
example_sentence: Because the student brought a phone to school, confiscation of the device was unavoidable.
sentence_zh: 因為學生帶手機到學校，沒收該裝置是不可避免的。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈkɑnflɪkt] 衝突；爭執　(動) [kənˈflɪkt] 衝突；不一致
example_sentence: Having conflicted with his parents over career choices, the student finally pursued engineering as planned.
sentence_zh: 與父母在職業選擇上發生衝突後，這名學生最終按計畫攻讀工程學。

definition_zh: (形) 相互矛盾的；衝突的　(形) 不一致的；相反的
example_sentence: The two witnesses gave conflicting statements that made the investigation difficult.
sentence_zh: 這兩名證人提供了相互矛盾的證詞，使調查變得困難。

definition_zh: (動) 遵守；順應　符合；一致
example_sentence: All students must conform to school rules and maintain discipline.
sentence_zh: 所有學生必須遵守校規並保持紀律。

definition_zh: (動) 使困惑；使混亂　(動) 混淆；搞混
example_sentence: If the confusing instructions confounded the students, they would ask the teacher for clarification.
sentence_zh: 如果令人困惑的指示使學生們感到困亂，他們就會請老師說明。

definition_zh: (形) 困惑的；混亂的　(形) 該死的；討厭的
example_sentence: The confounded computer kept deleting her essay every time.
sentence_zh: 那台該死的電腦每次都刪除她的論文。

definition_zh: (副) 令人困惑地；惱人地　(副) 該死地；非常地
example_sentence: Confoundedly difficult math problems appearing on last year's exam confused even top students.
sentence_zh: 令人困惑的數學難題出現在去年的考試上，甚至困惑了優秀學生。

definition_zh: (動) 面對；對抗　勇敢面對（困難、問題等）
example_sentence: As students confront the challenge of college entrance exams, many discover their true potential.
sentence_zh: 當學生面對大學入學考試的挑戰時，許多人發現了他們真正的潛力。

definition_zh: (名) 對抗；衝突　(名) 面對；對質
example_sentence: Seldom does a peaceful dialogue avoid direct confrontation between opposing viewpoints.
sentence_zh: 對立觀點之間很少能通過和平對話來避免直接的衝突。

definition_zh: (名) 孔子；儒家思想的創始人
example_sentence: Confucius, whose teachings emphasize respect and virtue, remains influential in East Asian culture.
sentence_zh: 孔子，其教導強調尊重與品德，至今仍對東亞文化有重大影響。

definition_zh: (動) 使困惑；使混淆　(動) 弄混；搞混
example_sentence: The teacher used simple examples to confuse the difficult grammar concept.
sentence_zh: 老師用簡單的例子來澄清這個困難的文法概念。

definition_zh: (形) 困惑的；混淆的　(動) 使困惑；混淆
example_sentence: After reading the confusing instructions, Tom felt confused and asked his classmate for help.
sentence_zh: 讀完令人困惑的說明後，湯姆感到困惑，向同學尋求幫助。

definition_zh: (副) 困惑地；迷亂地　(副) 混亂地；不清楚地
example_sentence: The student confusedly looked at the exam question and didn't know where to start.
sentence_zh: 那位學生困惑地看著考試題目，不知道從何開始。

definition_zh: (形) 令人困惑的；難以理解的　(形) 混亂的；混淆的
example_sentence: Although the teacher explained the grammar rule carefully, the confusing examples still made many students uncertain about the correct answer.
sentence_zh: 雖然老師仔細解釋了文法規則，但那些令人困惑的例句仍然讓許多學生對正確答案感到不確定。

definition_zh: (名) 困惑；混亂　(名) 混淆；誤解
example_sentence: Feeling confused about the exam rules, many students asked the teacher for clarification.
sentence_zh: 對考試規則感到困惑，許多學生向老師請求說明。

definition_zh: (形) 性格相投的；友善的　(形) 令人愉快的；舒適的
example_sentence: The congenial atmosphere that filled the classroom made studying together enjoyable.
sentence_zh: 充滿親切友善氣氛的教室讓大家一起讀書很愉快。

definition_zh: (形) 先天的；與生俱來的　(形) 先天性的；遺傳的
example_sentence: If a baby is born with a congenital heart disease, doctors must monitor the condition carefully throughout childhood.
sentence_zh: 如果嬰兒生來就患有先天性心臟病，醫生必須在整個童年期間仔細監測該病情。

definition_zh: (形) 擁擠的；堵塞的　(形) 充滿的；擠滿的
example_sentence: The subway during rush hour becomes so congested that passengers struggle to move.
sentence_zh: 尖峰時段的地鐵變得非常擁擠，乘客很難移動。

definition_zh: (名) 擁擠；堵塞　(名) 充血；鼻塞
example_sentence: The city built a new metro line to reduce traffic congestion during rush hour.
sentence_zh: 這座城市建造了一條新地鐵線以減少尖峰時段的交通擁擠。

definition_zh: (名) 大企業集團；混合體　(動) 合併；聚集　(形) 由許多部分組成的
example_sentence: The media conglomerate owns multiple television stations and publishing companies worldwide.
sentence_zh: 這個媒體集團在世界各地擁有多家電視台和出版公司。

definition_zh: (動) 祝賀；恭喜　(動) 稱讚；褒揚
example_sentence: As soon as the exam results were announced, classmates congratulated Maria on her excellent score.
sentence_zh: 考試成績公布後，同學們立刻祝賀瑪麗亞取得優異成績。

definition_zh: (名) 祝賀；恭喜　(名) 祝賀的話語
example_sentence: Having won the championship, the team received congratulations from fans and media across the country.
sentence_zh: 贏得冠軍後，該隊獲得了全國粉絲和媒體的祝賀。

definition_zh: (動) 聚集；聚合　(動) 集結；群集
example_sentence: Students who congregate in the library during lunch hour often form study groups together.
sentence_zh: 在午餐時間聚集在圖書館的學生經常一起組成讀書小組。

definition_zh: (名) 會眾；集會　(名) 聚集；聚合
example_sentence: The church congregation gathered together to celebrate the important religious holiday.
sentence_zh: 教堂的會眾聚集在一起慶祝重要的宗教假日。

definition_zh: (形) 會眾的；教堂的　(形) 集體的；群體的
example_sentence: If the church building were more congregational in design, worshippers would feel more connected during services.
sentence_zh: 如果教堂的設計更注重會眾參與，信徒們在禮拜時會感到更加親密相連。

definition_zh: (名) 國會；議會　(名) 會議；集會
example_sentence: The congress meets every year to discuss important national laws and policies.
sentence_zh: 國會每年召開會議，討論重要的國家法律和政策。

definition_zh: (形) 國會的；議會的
example_sentence: Passing the congressional vote, the new education policy will take effect next semester.
sentence_zh: 通過國會投票的新教育政策將在下個學期生效。

definition_zh: (名) 國會議員；下議院議員
example_sentence: Because the congressman supported education reform, many students voted for him in the election.
sentence_zh: 由於該國會議員支持教育改革，許多學生在選舉中投票給他。

definition_zh: (形) 推測的；猜測的　(形) 基於推理的；非事實的
example_sentence: Only after careful investigation did the detective abandon his conjectural theory about the crime.
sentence_zh: 只有經過仔細調查後，偵探才放棄了他關於該犯罪的推測性理論。

definition_zh: (名) 猜測；推測　(動) 猜測；推想
example_sentence: The scientist made a conjecture that explained the results observed in the experiment.
sentence_zh: 科學家提出了一個解釋實驗中所觀察到結果的猜測。

definition_zh: (動) 使結合；配對　(動) 列舉動詞的各種時態變化
example_sentence: Language learners use flashcards to conjugate irregular verbs and master verb tenses.
sentence_zh: 語言學習者使用抽認卡來變化不規則動詞並掌握動詞時態。

definition_zh: (名) 動詞變位法；詞形變化
example_sentence: Learning Spanish verb conjugation requires memorizing patterns and practicing regularly with various tenses.
sentence_zh: 學習西班牙文動詞變位法需要記住規律並定期練習各種時態。

definition_zh: (名) 連接詞；結合
example_sentence: The conjunction 'and' connects two simple sentences into one compound sentence.
sentence_zh: 連接詞「and」將兩個簡單句連接成一個複合句。

definition_zh: (動) 想像；憑空產生　變出；製造出
example_sentence: When the magician waved his wand, he conjured up a white dove as the audience watched in amazement.
sentence_zh: 當魔術師揮動魔杖時，他變出了一隻白鴿，觀眾驚嘆不已。

definition_zh: (動) 變魔法；施展魔法　(動) 變出；召喚
example_sentence: Conjuring a rabbit from an empty hat, the magician amazed the entire audience.
sentence_zh: 魔術師從空帽子裡變出兔子，讓全場觀眾驚嘆不已。

definition_zh: (動) 故障停止；累垮；昏迷
example_sentence: The old car, which conked out on the highway, needed expensive repairs.
sentence_zh: 那輛在高速公路上故障的老車需要昂貴的維修。

definition_zh: (動) 連接；接上　連結；聯繫
example_sentence: If students connect their laptops to the school WiFi, they can access online learning materials easily.
sentence_zh: 如果學生把筆電連接到校園無線網路，他們就能輕易地取得線上學習資料。

definition_zh: (形) 連接的；相通的　(動) 連接；接通
example_sentence: The two cities are connected by a high-speed train.
sentence_zh: 這兩座城市由高鐵連接。

definition_zh: (名) 連接；連繫　(名) 關係；聯繫
example_sentence: Learning English is important to build strong connections with people worldwide.
sentence_zh: 學英文很重要，目的是與世界各地的人建立牢固的關係。

definition_zh: (動) 暗中同謀；狼狽為奸　(動) 默許；縱容
example_sentence: The manager and the accountant connived to hide the missing funds from the company.
