sentence_zh: 經理和會計師暗中同謀隱瞞公司失蹤的資金。

definition_zh: (形) 縱容的；默許的；共謀的
example_sentence: Although the manager claimed ignorance, his connivent attitude toward employee theft suggested deeper complicity.
sentence_zh: 雖然經理聲稱不知情，但他對員工竊盜的縱容態度暗示了更深層的共謀。

definition_zh: (名) 鑑賞家；品酒師
example_sentence: Having studied French wines for years, the connoisseur could distinguish subtle flavors others missed.
sentence_zh: 那位品酒師多年來研究法國葡萄酒，能辨別他人察覺不到的細微風味。

definition_zh: (名) 隱含意義；言外之意　隱喻；聯想
example_sentence: The word 'home' carries connotations that extend beyond its literal dictionary meaning.
sentence_zh: 「家」這個詞所帶有的隱含意義遠超出其字典上的字面意思。

definition_zh: (動) 征服；攻佔　(動) 克服；戰勝
example_sentence: The successful athlete conquered fear and self-doubt through years of hard training.
sentence_zh: 這位成功的運動員通過多年的艱苦訓練征服了恐懼和自我懷疑。

definition_zh: (名) 征服；征兆　(動) 征服；攻佔
example_sentence: If the ancient Romans had not achieved military conquest, their vast empire would not have dominated the Mediterranean region for centuries.
sentence_zh: 如果古羅馬人沒有取得軍事征服，他們龐大的帝國就不會在地中海地區統治數個世紀。

definition_zh: (名) 征服者；西班牙征服者
example_sentence: Spanish conquistadors explored and conquered much of South America during the 1500s.
sentence_zh: 西班牙征服者在1500年代探索並征服了南美洲的大部分地區。

definition_zh: (名) 良心；道德感　(名) 道德意識；自我約束
example_sentence: Feeling guilty about the lie, the student finally confessed to the teacher.
sentence_zh: 感到為謊言內疚，那位學生最後向老師坦白了。

definition_zh: (形) 認真的；謹慎的　(形) 有良心的；誠實的
example_sentence: Because the student was conscientious about her studies, she earned top grades consistently.
sentence_zh: 因為這名學生對課業認真謹慎，她持續獲得優異成績。

definition_zh: (形) 有意識的；清醒的　(形) 意識到的；察覺到的
example_sentence: Hardly conscious of the time passing, students focused entirely on their exam.
sentence_zh: 學生幾乎沒有意識到時間的流逝，完全專注於考試。

definition_zh: (副) 有意識地；自覺地　(副) 刻意地；故意地
example_sentence: The student consciously avoided distractions while studying for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 這位學生在準備學測考試時，有意識地避免分心。

definition_zh: (名) 意識；覺悟　(名) 清醒；清楚
example_sentence: Studying hard helps students develop consciousness to improve academic performance.
sentence_zh: 努力讀書能幫助學生培養意識來提高學業表現。

definition_zh: (形) 連續的；相鄰的　(名) 連續發生的事物
example_sentence: The basketball team won five consecutive games and advanced to the finals.
sentence_zh: 籃球隊連贏五場比賽並晉級決賽。

definition_zh: (副) 連續地；依序地
example_sentence: The basketball player scored points consecutively in the fourth quarter.
sentence_zh: 那位籃球選手在第四節連續得分。

definition_zh: (名) 共識；一致意見　(名) 普遍同意；共同看法
example_sentence: Although the committee members had different opinions, consensus was reached after careful discussion.
sentence_zh: 雖然委員會成員意見不同，但經過仔細討論後達成了共識。

definition_zh: (名) 同意；許可　(動) 同意；贊成
example_sentence: Having obtained parental consent, the student proceeded with the field trip registration.
sentence_zh: 獲得父母的同意後，該學生繼續進行校外教學的註冊。

definition_zh: (名) 結果；後果　(名) 重要性；影響力
example_sentence: The mistake that the engineer made had serious consequences for the entire project.
sentence_zh: 那位工程師所犯的錯誤對整個專案造成了嚴重的後果。

definition_zh: (形) 隨之而來的；由此產生的　(名) 結果；後果
example_sentence: If students study consistently, consequent improvements in exam scores will follow naturally.
sentence_zh: 如果學生持續唸書，隨之而來的考試成績進步將自然而然地出現。

definition_zh: (形) 重要的；有重大影響的　(形) 自負的；矯揉造作的
example_sentence: The decision to study abroad had consequential effects on Maria's entire future.
sentence_zh: 出國留學的決定對瑪麗亞的整個未來產生了重大影響。

definition_zh: (副) 因此；所以　(副) 隨之而來地；相應地
example_sentence: The student studied hard consequently to improve test scores.
sentence_zh: 這位學生努力讀書，因此為了提高考試成績。

definition_zh: (名) 自然保護區；保護組織　(名) 保護；保存
example_sentence: The local conservancy has protected the coastal wetlands from industrial development for nearly two decades.
sentence_zh: 當地保護組織近二十年來一直保護沿海濕地免受工業開發。

definition_zh: (名) 保護；保存　(名) 節約；節省
example_sentence: As wildlife conservation becomes increasingly urgent, more organizations dedicate resources to protecting endangered species.
sentence_zh: 當野生動物保護變得越來越迫切時，更多組織投入資源保護瀕危物種。

definition_zh: (名) 環保人士；保護主義者　(形) 致力於保護的；環保的
example_sentence: Having studied endangered species for years, the conservationist worked to protect the threatened wetland habitat.
sentence_zh: 這位環保人士多年來研究瀕危物種，致力於保護受威脅的濕地棲息地。

definition_zh: (形) 保守的；傳統的　(名) 保守派人士
example_sentence: Students who hold conservative views often prefer traditional teaching methods that have proven effective.
sentence_zh: 持有保守觀點的學生通常偏好已證實有效的傳統教學方法。

definition_zh: (名) 溫室；溫暖房　(名) 音樂學院；藝術學校
example_sentence: The botanical conservatory near Taipei displays rare tropical plants from around the world.
sentence_zh: 台北附近的植物溫室展示來自世界各地的稀有熱帶植物。

definition_zh: (動) 保護；保存　節約；節省
example_sentence: If students conserved electricity at home, their families would save money on utility bills.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在家節約用電，他們的家人就能省電費。

definition_zh: (動) 考慮；認為　(動) 仔細思考；打量
example_sentence: Before choosing a university, students should consider their interests and abilities.
sentence_zh: 在選擇大學之前，學生應該考慮他們的興趣和能力。

definition_zh: (形) 相當大的；可觀的　(形) 值得考慮的；重要的
example_sentence: Considering the considerable expenses involved, the school decided to postpone the project.
sentence_zh: 考慮到涉及的可觀開支，學校決定推遲該項目。

definition_zh: (副) 相當地；非常　明顯地；大幅地
example_sentence: Since the new teacher arrived, student engagement in class has improved considerably.
sentence_zh: 自從新老師到任以來，學生的課堂參與度已大幅提高。

definition_zh: (形) 體貼的；周到的　(動) 考慮；顧及
example_sentence: Not only does Sarah listen carefully, but also does she offer considerate advice to struggling classmates.
sentence_zh: 莎拉不僅仔細聆聽，而且也對困頓的同學提供體貼的建議。

definition_zh: (副) 體貼地；周到地　(副) 善良地；體諒地
example_sentence: The nurse, who spoke considerately to worried patients, earned their deep trust.
sentence_zh: 那位護士體貼地和擔憂的病患交談，贏得了他們深深的信任。

definition_zh: (名) 考慮；思考　(名) 體貼；關心
example_sentence: Students study hard to gain consideration from universities and secure admission.
sentence_zh: 學生努力讀書以獲得大學的重視並確保入學。

definition_zh: (介) 鑑於；考慮到　(動) 考慮；思考
example_sentence: Considering the high cost of tuition, many students choose to attend public universities.
sentence_zh: 鑑於學費高昂，許多學生選擇就讀公立大學。

definition_zh: (名) 寄售；委託銷售　(名) 寄出的貨物；發貨
example_sentence: The store received a consignment of winter coats from the manufacturer last week.
sentence_zh: 那家店上週收到製造商寄來的一批冬季外套。

definition_zh: (動) 由...組成；構成　包含；包括
example_sentence: Because the team consists of experienced players, winning the championship seemed inevitable.
sentence_zh: 因為這支隊伍由經驗豐富的選手組成，贏得冠軍似乎是必然的。

definition_zh: (名) 一致性；貫徹性　(名) 濃稠度；黏稠度
example_sentence: Maintaining consistency in studying every day, successful students build strong foundations.
sentence_zh: 每天都保持學習的一致性，成功的學生建立了堅實的基礎。

definition_zh: (形) 一致的；前後相符的　(形) 持續的；堅持不懈的
example_sentence: The teacher praised students whose homework was consistent with classroom lessons.
sentence_zh: 老師稱讚那些功課與課堂內容相符的學生。

definition_zh: (副) 一貫地；始終如一地　堅持不懈地；持續地
example_sentence: If students study consistently, they will definitely improve their test scores.
sentence_zh: 如果學生一貫地用功讀書，他們的考試成績一定會進步。

definition_zh: (名) 安慰；慰藉　(名) 令人感到安慰的人或事物
example_sentence: Winning the second prize was a consolation after losing the championship.
sentence_zh: 在失去冠軍後，贏得第二名是一種安慰。

definition_zh: (動) [kənˈsol] 安慰；撫慰　(名) [ˈkɑnˌsol] 控制台；遊戲機
example_sentence: Sarah wrote a heartfelt letter to console her grieving friend after the loss.
sentence_zh: 莎拉寫了一封真摯的信來安慰她喪親的朋友。

definition_zh: (動) 鞏固；加強　(動) 合併；整合
example_sentence: The company consolidated its three branches into one office and improved efficiency significantly.
sentence_zh: 該公司將三個分公司合併為一個辦公室，大幅提高了效率。

definition_zh: (名) 鞏固；加強　(名) 合併；整合
example_sentence: As the company consolidates its departments, employees must adapt to new reporting structures.
sentence_zh: 當公司鞏固各部門時，員工必須適應新的回報結構。

definition_zh: (名) 輔音；子音
example_sentence: Having studied the consonant sounds carefully, students found pronunciation practice much easier.
sentence_zh: 仔細研究過輔音音素後，學生們發現發音練習變得容易得多。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈkɑnsɔrt] 配偶；伴侶　(動) [kənˈsɔrt] 與...交往；陪伴
example_sentence: The queen's consort, whose diplomatic skills were widely praised, played a key role in strengthening international relations.
sentence_zh: 那位外交能力廣受讚揚的王后配偶在加強國際關係方面發揮了關鍵作用。

definition_zh: (名) 聯盟；協會　(名) 企業集團；財團
example_sentence: Several major tech companies formed a consortium to develop new environmental technologies together.
sentence_zh: 幾家大型科技公司組成聯盟，共同開發新的環保技術。

definition_zh: (形) 顯眼的；引人注目的　(形) 明顯的；突出的
example_sentence: If the graffiti on the wall were less conspicuous, the principal would not have noticed it immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果牆上的塗鴉沒那麼顯眼，校長就不會立刻發現它。

definition_zh: (副) 明顯地；引人注目地　清楚地；明白地
example_sentence: The bright red scarf hung conspicuously on the classroom wall during the school festival.
sentence_zh: 在校慶期間，那條鮮紅色的圍巾明顯地掛在教室牆壁上。

definition_zh: (名) 陰謀；密謀　(名) 共謀者的集合
example_sentence: Involving multiple government officials, the conspiracy to manipulate election results shocked the entire nation.
sentence_zh: 涉及多名政府官員的陰謀操縱選舉結果震撼了整個國家。

definition_zh: (動) 密謀；共謀　(動) 合力促成；促成
example_sentence: Although the two companies publicly denied involvement, evidence revealed that they conspired to fix prices and cheat consumers.
sentence_zh: 儘管這兩家公司公開否認參與，證據卻顯示它們密謀操縱價格並欺騙消費者。

definition_zh: (名) 警察；警官　(名) 城堡司令官
example_sentence: Hardly ever does a constable patrol this quiet neighborhood on foot anymore.
sentence_zh: 幾乎沒有警察再徒步巡邏這個安靜的鄰近地區了。

definition_zh: (形) 持續的；不變的　(名) 常數；常量
example_sentence: The teacher praised students whose constant effort and dedication improved their test scores.
sentence_zh: 老師稱讚那些努力不懈且專注的學生，他們的考試成績有所進步。

definition_zh: (副) 持續地；不斷地　經常；總是
example_sentence: Students study constantly to pass the CSAT and achieve their academic goals.
sentence_zh: 學生持續不斷地讀書，目的是要通過學測並達成學業目標。

definition_zh: (動) 使驚愕；使不安
example_sentence: The sudden news of the earthquake consternated the entire city and disrupted all daily activities.
sentence_zh: 地震的突然消息使整個城市驚愕，打亂了所有日常活動。

definition_zh: (名) 驚愕；震驚　(名) 不安；困惑
example_sentence: The sudden announcement caused great consternation among the exam-taking students.
sentence_zh: 突然的公告在考試的學生中引起了很大的驚愕。

definition_zh: (名) 便秘；排便困難
example_sentence: Since the patient suffered from constipation, the doctor recommended drinking more water and eating fiber.
sentence_zh: 由於病人患有便秘，醫生建議他多喝水並多吃纖維食物。

definition_zh: (名) 選區；選民區　(名) 構成成分；組成部分
example_sentence: Representing the constituency, the newly elected official worked tirelessly to improve local infrastructure.
sentence_zh: 代表該選區的新當選官員不懈地努力改善地方基礎設施。

definition_zh: (名) 組成部分；成分　(形) 組成的；構成的
example_sentence: The various elements that constitute the proposal are detailed in the report.
sentence_zh: 構成該提案的各種要素已在報告中詳細說明。

definition_zh: (動) 組成；構成　(動) 建立；制定
example_sentence: If citizens do not participate in community activities, they cannot constitute a strong society.
sentence_zh: 如果公民不參與社區活動，就無法組成一個強大的社會。

definition_zh: (名) 憲法；憲章　(名) 體質；身體狀況
example_sentence: The constitution of a country defines the rights and duties of citizens.
sentence_zh: 一個國家的憲法定義了公民的權利和義務。

definition_zh: (形) 憲法的；符合憲法的　(形) 體質的；身體的
example_sentence: The government amended the law to ensure constitutional rights protecting all citizens.
sentence_zh: 政府修改法律以確保保護所有公民的憲法權利。

definition_zh: (動) 限制；約束　(動) 強制；迫使
example_sentence: Budget limits and tight deadlines constrain the project team's ability to deliver quality work.
sentence_zh: 預算限制和緊迫的截止日期限制了專案團隊提供優質工作的能力。

definition_zh: (名) 限制；束縛　(動) 限制；約束
example_sentence: Although budget constraints limit the school's resources, teachers find creative ways to engage students.
sentence_zh: 雖然預算限制限制了學校的資源，但老師們找到了創意方式來吸引學生。

definition_zh: (動) 收縮；束緊　(動) 限制；妨礙
example_sentence: Constricted by tight clothing, the athlete felt uncomfortable during the long training session.
sentence_zh: 被緊身衣物束縛，這位運動員在長時間訓練中感到不適。

definition_zh: (名) 收縮；狹窄　(名) 束縛；限制
example_sentence: The constriction that tightens around the snake's body helps it move through narrow spaces.
sentence_zh: 纏繞在蛇身體周圍的收縮幫助牠通過狹窄的空間。

definition_zh: (形) 限制性的；束縛的　(形) 收縮的；壓縮的
example_sentence: Wearing overly tight clothes can create a constrictive feeling that limits your comfort and movement throughout the day.
sentence_zh: 穿著過於緊身的衣服會產生限制性的感受，限制你整天的舒適度和活動範圍。

definition_zh: (名) ['kɑnstrʌkt] 概念；構想　(動) [kən'strʌkt] 建造；構造
example_sentence: If the city government constructed a new metro line, commuting to school would become much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果市政府興建一條新地鐵線，上學通勤就會容易得多。

definition_zh: (名) 建築；建設　(名) 構造；結構
example_sentence: The construction of the new school building will take two years.
sentence_zh: 新學校大樓的建築將花費兩年時間。

definition_zh: (形) 建設性的；有幫助的　(形) 積極的；具創意的
example_sentence: Offering constructive feedback, the teacher helped students improve their writing skills significantly.
sentence_zh: 老師提供建設性的反饋，幫助學生大幅提升寫作能力。

definition_zh: (名) 建築師；承包商　(名) 構造者；設計者
example_sentence: Because the constructor finished the project ahead of schedule, the company received a bonus payment.
sentence_zh: 因為承包商提前完成了這個專案，公司獲得了獎金。

definition_zh: (動) 解釋；理解　(動) 構造；建造
example_sentence: Seldom can ambiguous remarks be construed in only one way.
sentence_zh: 模稜兩可的言論很少只能用一種方式來解釋。

definition_zh: (名) 領事館；總領事館
example_sentence: The consulate, which is located in Taipei, helps citizens who need passport renewal.
sentence_zh: 位於台北的領事館協助需要換護照的公民。

definition_zh: (動) 諮詢；請教　(動) 參考；查閱
example_sentence: Students should consult their teachers to understand difficult grammar concepts better.
sentence_zh: 學生應該向老師諮詢以便更好地理解困難的文法概念。

definition_zh: (名) 顧問；諮詢專家　(名) 顧問醫生；專業顧問
example_sentence: The management consultant helped the company improve its business strategy and increase sales.
sentence_zh: 那位管理顧問幫助公司改善業務策略並增加銷售額。

definition_zh: (名) 諮詢；諮商　(名) 磋商；討論
example_sentence: The doctor's consultation helped the patient understand the treatment plan.
sentence_zh: 醫生的諮詢幫助病患了解治療計畫。

definition_zh: (動) 徵詢；請教　(名) 諮詢；顧問工作
example_sentence: Before making the final decision, the company consulted with market experts, analyzing consumer trends carefully.
sentence_zh: 在做出最終決定之前，該公司諮詢了市場專家，仔細分析消費者趨勢。

definition_zh: (動) 消耗；消費　(動) 吃掉；喝掉
example_sentence: Consuming too much fast food daily, many students struggle with their health.
sentence_zh: 每天消耗太多速食，許多學生為健康苦惱。

definition_zh: (名) 消費者；消費人　(形) 消費的；用於消費的
example_sentence: Companies that ignore consumer feedback from social media often lose market share quickly.
sentence_zh: 忽視來自社群媒體消費者回饋的公司通常會迅速喪失市場占有率。

definition_zh: (形) 耗費時間的；消耗的　(動) 消費；消耗
example_sentence: If studying for the CSAT becomes too consuming, students should take regular breaks.
sentence_zh: 如果準備學測變得太耗費時間，學生應該定期休息。

definition_zh: (動) [ˋkɑnsə͵met] 完成；實現　(形) [kənˋsʌmɪt] 完美的；圓滿的
example_sentence: After years of hard work, the athlete finally consummated her dream of winning an Olympic gold medal.
sentence_zh: 經過多年的努力，這位運動員終於實現了贏得奧運金牌的夢想。

definition_zh: (名) 消費；消耗　(名) 肺結核
example_sentence: Reducing plastic consumption helps protect our environment for future generations.
sentence_zh: 減少塑膠消費有助於保護我們未來世代的環境。

definition_zh: (名) 隱形眼鏡；接觸鏡片
example_sentence: Many students wear contact lenses instead of glasses for sports and daily activities.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在運動和日常活動中戴隱形眼鏡而不是眼鏡。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈkɑntækt] 接觸；聯繫　(動) [kənˈtækt] 聯絡；接觸
example_sentence: Before attending the university, prospective students should contact the admissions office so that they understand the application requirements.
sentence_zh: 申請大學前，準大學生應該聯絡招生辦公室，以便他們瞭解申請要求。

definition_zh: (形) 易傳染的；有傳染性的　(形) 易蔓延的；容易傳播的
example_sentence: Having caught the flu, the student remained contagious for several days despite feeling better.
sentence_zh: 那位學生染上流感後，儘管感覺好多了，仍在數天內具有傳染性。

definition_zh: (動) 包含；含有　(動) 控制；抑制
example_sentence: The document that the teacher distributed contains important information about the exam.
sentence_zh: 老師發下來的那份文件包含了關於考試的重要資訊。

definition_zh: (名) 容器；盛器　(名) 貨櫃；集裝箱
example_sentence: The plastic food container keeps leftovers fresh in the refrigerator for days.
sentence_zh: 塑膠食物容器能讓剩菜在冰箱裡保持新鮮好幾天。

definition_zh: (名) 圍堵；防止擴散　(名) 遏制；限制
example_sentence: If strict containment measures were not implemented, the virus would spread rapidly throughout the community.
sentence_zh: 如果沒有實施嚴格的防堵措施，病毒會迅速在社區內傳播。

definition_zh: (名) 污染物；污染源
example_sentence: Heavy metals are dangerous contaminants that harm drinking water quality.
sentence_zh: 重金屬是危害飲用水品質的危險污染物。

definition_zh: (動) 污染；使受污染　(動) 弄髒；使不潔淨
example_sentence: Contaminating the water supply with chemicals, the factory faced serious legal consequences.
sentence_zh: 用化學物質污染供水系統，該工廠面臨嚴重的法律後果。

definition_zh: (名) 污染；受污染　(名) 汙染物；污穢
example_sentence: As water contamination spreads rapidly, local residents must find alternative drinking sources immediately.
sentence_zh: 當水污染迅速擴散時，當地居民必須立即尋找替代飲用水源。

definition_zh: (動) 冥想；思考　沉思；考慮
example_sentence: Only after contemplating the offer for weeks did Maria finally accept the scholarship.
sentence_zh: 只有在思考了幾週的這項獎學金機會後，瑪莉亞才最終接受了它。

definition_zh: (名) 深思；沉思　(名) 冥想；靜慮
example_sentence: After hours of contemplation about his future, the student decided to study engineering.
sentence_zh: 在經過數小時深思關於他的未來後，這名學生決定學習工程。

definition_zh: (形) 當代的；現代的　(名) 同時代的人；當代人物
example_sentence: Museums display contemporary art to educate visitors about modern artistic trends.
sentence_zh: 博物館展示當代藝術以教育遊客了解現代藝術趨勢。

definition_zh: (名) 輕蔑；蔑視　(動) 輕蔑；鄙視
example_sentence: Treating others with contempt and disrespect will only damage your own reputation.
sentence_zh: 用輕蔑和不尊重的態度對待他人只會損害你自己的名聲。

definition_zh: (形) 輕蔑的；鄙視的　(形) 傲慢的；不屑的
example_sentence: The wealthy businessman's contemptuous attitude toward poor workers shocked everyone in the office.
sentence_zh: 那位富有商人對窮工人的輕蔑態度震驚了辦公室裡的每個人。

definition_zh: (動) 主張；聲稱　(動) 競爭；爭奪
example_sentence: Although the two teams contended fiercely for the championship, both earned respect from fans.
sentence_zh: 雖然兩隊為了冠軍激烈競爭，但兩隊都贏得了球迷的尊敬。

definition_zh: (名) 競爭者；參賽者　(名) 有希望的候選人
example_sentence: Competing fiercely in the final round, the young contender impressed all judges with remarkable skill.
sentence_zh: 在決賽中激烈競爭，這位年輕的參賽者以卓越的技能給所有評委留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 內容；容量　(形) 滿足的；滿意的
example_sentence: Students who are content with their study results often stop making progress.
sentence_zh: 對學習成績感到滿意的學生往往停止進步。

definition_zh: (形) 滿足的；滿意的　(形) 心滿意足的；安心的
example_sentence: If students feel contented with their study progress, they will maintain consistent effort throughout the year.
sentence_zh: 如果學生對自己的學習進度感到滿足，他們將在整年保持穩定的努力。

definition_zh: (名) 爭論；主張　(名) 競爭；衝突
example_sentence: The main contention between the two companies concerns pricing and product quality.
sentence_zh: 這兩家公司之間的主要爭論涉及價格和產品品質。

definition_zh: (名) 滿足；知足　(形) 滿足的；心滿意足的
example_sentence: Many people work hard to earn money in order to achieve contentment and peace.
sentence_zh: 許多人努力工作賺錢，為的是獲得滿足感和內心平靜。

definition_zh: (名) 內容；內裝物　(名) 目錄；篇章
example_sentence: The table of contents helps readers find chapters and sections quickly.
sentence_zh: 目錄幫助讀者快速找到章節和段落。

definition_zh: (動) [kənˈtɛst] 反對；質疑　(名) [ˈkɑntɛst] 競賽；比賽
example_sentence: Although many students contested the exam results, the school refused to change the scores.
sentence_zh: 雖然許多學生質疑考試成績，但學校拒絕改分。

definition_zh: (名) 參賽者；競爭者
example_sentence: Having trained for months, the contestant delivered a flawless performance at the national competition.
sentence_zh: 經過數月的訓練，這位參賽者在全國比賽中呈現出完美的表現。

definition_zh: (名) 上下文；背景　(名) 環境；情況
example_sentence: The meaning of the word depends on the context in which it appears.
sentence_zh: 這個單字的意思取決於它出現的上下文。

definition_zh: (形) 相鄰的；毗鄰的　(形) 連續的；相接的
example_sentence: The contiguous states of Taiwan and China are separated only by the Taiwan Strait.
sentence_zh: 台灣和中國相鄰的地區只被台灣海峽分開。

definition_zh: (副) 連續地；相鄰地　毫無間斷地
example_sentence: If the apartment buildings were arranged contiguously along the street, residents would easily access nearby shops and services.
sentence_zh: 如果公寓大樓沿著街道連續排列，居民就能輕鬆接近附近的商店和服務。

definition_zh: (名) 大陸；洲
example_sentence: Asia is the largest continent in the world by population.
sentence_zh: 亞洲是世界上人口最多的大陸。

definition_zh: (形) 大陸的；洲際的　(形) 連續的；持續的
example_sentence: Covering vast territories, continental climate zones experience extreme temperature variations throughout the year.
sentence_zh: 覆蓋廣大地區的大陸氣候區在全年經歷極端的溫度變化。

definition_zh: (形) 視情況而定的；取決於...的　(名) 應急隊；臨時代表團
example_sentence: The student's scholarship is contingent on maintaining a high GPA throughout the academic year.
sentence_zh: 這名學生的獎學金取決於整個學年維持高GPA的表現。

definition_zh: (形) 持續的；連續的　(形) 不斷的；頻繁的
example_sentence: Not only do continual complaints disrupt classroom order, but also harm student focus.
sentence_zh: 不僅持續的投訴擾亂課堂秩序，而且損害學生專注力。

definition_zh: (副) 持續地；不斷地　不停地；反覆地
example_sentence: The student who studies continually will achieve better test scores than others.
sentence_zh: 持續不斷讀書的學生會比別人取得更好的考試成績。

definition_zh: (名) 延續；持續　繼續
example_sentence: The company extended the project continuation to achieve long-term goals.
sentence_zh: 公司延長了專案的延續期以達成長期目標。

definition_zh: (動) 繼續；持續　(動) 延續；保持
example_sentence: The students continued studying hard and passed the difficult exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們繼續努力讀書，並通過了困難的考試。

definition_zh: (名) 連續性；延續性　(名) 持續；不間斷
example_sentence: The TV show maintained good continuity between seasons, keeping the storyline consistent.
sentence_zh: 這部電視劇在各季之間保持良好的連續性，劇情保持一致。

definition_zh: (形) 連續的；不間斷的　(形) 持續的；不停的
example_sentence: As the rain continued falling continuously, the student decided to stay home and study.
sentence_zh: 隨著雨持續不斷地下著，這名學生決定待在家裡念書。

definition_zh: (副) 不斷地；持續地　(副) 連續不停地
example_sentence: Working continuously on difficult math problems, students gradually improve their problem-solving skills.
sentence_zh: 學生不斷地做困難的數學題目，逐漸提高了解題能力。

definition_zh: (名) 輪廓；邊界　(動) 沿著邊界走；畫輪廓　(形) 有輪廓的；輪廓分明的
example_sentence: The mountain's contour, which rises sharply against the sunset sky, attracts many hikers.
sentence_zh: 那座輪廓在夕陽天空中清晰聳立的山峰吸引了許多登山者。

definition_zh: (動) 簽約承諾；縮小範圍
example_sentence: If the company contracts in its operations, many workers will lose their jobs.
sentence_zh: 如果公司縮小營運範圍，許多員工將失去工作。

definition_zh: (動) 退出；不再參與
example_sentence: Many companies contract out of long-term pension plans to reduce costs.
sentence_zh: 許多公司退出長期養老金計劃以降低成本。

definition_zh: (動) 將工作外包；簽約委託給他人
example_sentence: The construction company decided to contract out electrical work to reduce costs.
sentence_zh: 這家建築公司決定將電氣工程外包以降低成本。

definition_zh: (名) ['kɑntrækt] 合約；契約　(動) [kən'trækt] 簽訂合約；縮小
example_sentence: The employment contract between the company and the worker clearly states all rights and responsibilities.
sentence_zh: 公司與員工之間的僱用合約清楚說明了所有的權利與責任。

definition_zh: (名) 承包商；簽約人　(名) 承攬業者；約定人
example_sentence: Since the contractor failed to complete the project on time, the company decided to hire another team.
sentence_zh: 由於承包商未能按時完成專案，公司決定僱用另一個團隊。

definition_zh: (動) 與...相矛盾；反駁　(動) 否認；否定
example_sentence: Having contradicted the official report, the witness's credibility came under serious question.
sentence_zh: 在與官方報告相矛盾後，該證人的可信度受到嚴重質疑。

definition_zh: (名) 矛盾；相互衝突　(名) 否認；反駁
example_sentence: The statement that contradicts the earlier evidence creates a logical problem.
sentence_zh: 與先前證據相矛盾的陳述造成了邏輯問題。

definition_zh: (形) 相互矛盾的；自相矛盾的　(形) 對立的；相反的
example_sentence: The witness gave contradictory statements about what happened that night.
sentence_zh: 該證人對那晚發生的事提供了相互矛盾的說法。

definition_zh: (副) 相反地；反之　(連) 反之；否則
example_sentence: If the company failed to invest in technology, contrariwise, rivals would capture the entire market share.
sentence_zh: 如果公司沒有投資於技術，相反地，競爭對手將會奪取整個市場佔有率。

definition_zh: (形) 相反的；相對的　(副) 相反地；恰恰相反
example_sentence: Contrary to popular belief, spending time alone can boost creativity.
sentence_zh: 與普遍看法相反，獨處的時間可以提高創造力。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈkɑntræst] 對比；差異　(動) [kənˈtræst] 與…形成對比；對照　(形) 對比的；相反的
example_sentence: Contrasting two paintings, the artist highlighted different styles and techniques.
sentence_zh: 對比兩幅畫作，這位藝術家突顯了不同的風格和技巧。

definition_zh: (動) 違反；違抗　(動) 與…相衝突；相悖
example_sentence: Although the new policy contravenes existing regulations, the government believes it serves the public interest better.
sentence_zh: 雖然新政策違反現有規定，但政府認為它更符合公共利益。

definition_zh: (動) 貢獻；捐獻　(動) 促成；有助於
example_sentence: Not only did the volunteers contribute their time, but also their expertise to the community project.
sentence_zh: 志工們不僅貢獻了時間，更貢獻了他們的專業知識給社區項目。

definition_zh: (名) 貢獻；捐獻　(名) 投稿；稿件
example_sentence: The scientist's contribution, which revolutionized modern medicine, earned worldwide recognition.
sentence_zh: 那位科學家的貢獻改變了現代醫學，因此獲得全球認可。

definition_zh: (名) 貢獻者；捐獻者　(名) 促成因素；原因
example_sentence: Many contributors volunteered to help organize the school fundraiser to support earthquake relief efforts.
sentence_zh: 許多貢獻者自願幫助組織學校募款活動，以支持震災救援工作。

definition_zh: (動) 設法完成；策劃　(動) 巧妙地安排；想出
example_sentence: The director contrived to finish the film on schedule despite numerous obstacles and budget cuts.
sentence_zh: 儘管有許多障礙和預算削減，導演還是設法按時完成這部電影。

definition_zh: (動) 控制；管理　(名) 控制；掌控
example_sentence: The government controls the price of electricity to help citizens.
sentence_zh: 政府控制電費以幫助市民。

definition_zh: (名) 控制器；操縱桿　(名) 管制者；控制人
example_sentence: Because the game controller was broken, players had to find another way to enjoy the video game together.
sentence_zh: 因為遊戲控制器壞了，玩家們不得不用另一種方式一起享受電玩。

definition_zh: (形) 引起爭議的；有爭議的　(形) 引人不適的；容易招致批評的
example_sentence: Adopting controversial policies, the government faced strong criticism from various groups.
sentence_zh: 採取引起爭議的政策，政府面臨來自各界的強烈批評。

definition_zh: (名) 爭議；爭論　(形) 有爭議的；引起爭論的
example_sentence: The new school policy, which sparked considerable controversy among parents and teachers, was eventually revised.
sentence_zh: 那項引起家長和老師之間相當爭議的新校政策最終被修改了。

definition_zh: (動) 召集；聚集　(動) 集會；開會
example_sentence: If the principal convenes an emergency meeting, all teachers will attend immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果校長召集緊急會議，所有老師會立即出席。

definition_zh: (名) 便利；方便　(名) 便利設施；便利商店
example_sentence: The convenience of online shopping makes it popular among busy students.
sentence_zh: 線上購物的便利性使其在忙碌的學生中很受歡迎。

definition_zh: (形) 方便的；便利的　(形) 近便的；容易到達的
example_sentence: Shopping online is convenient to save time and avoid crowds.
sentence_zh: 網上購物很方便，可以節省時間並避免人群擁擠。

definition_zh: (副) 便利地；方便地　(副) 恰好地；巧合地
example_sentence: The convenience store is conveniently located near the school and train station.
sentence_zh: 這家便利超商便利地位於學校和火車站附近。

definition_zh: (名) 修道院；女修道院
example_sentence: Although the convent sits quietly on the hillside, many tourists visit it every year.
sentence_zh: 雖然修道院靜靜地坐落在山坡上，但每年仍有許多遊客造訪。

definition_zh: (名) 習俗；慣例　(名) 會議；大會
example_sentence: Having attended the international convention, the delegates shared innovative ideas about environmental protection.
sentence_zh: 參加過國際會議後，代表們分享了關於環境保護的創新想法。

definition_zh: (形) 傳統的；習慣的　(形) 常見的；普通的
example_sentence: The teaching methods that schools use are often conventional, which students find familiar and easy to follow.
sentence_zh: 學校使用的教學方法通常是傳統的，學生們發現這些方法很熟悉且容易跟上。

definition_zh: (副) 按照慣例；傳統上　通常地；一般而言
example_sentence: Conventionally, Taiwanese students wear uniforms and follow strict school rules.
sentence_zh: 按照慣例，台灣學生穿著制服並遵守嚴格的校規。

definition_zh: (動) 匯聚；聚集　(動) 趨同；一致
example_sentence: If multiple traffic routes converged at the intersection, accidents would happen more frequently.
sentence_zh: 如果多條交通路線在十字路口匯聚，事故會更頻繁地發生。

definition_zh: (名) 聚合；匯聚　(名) 趨同；一致
example_sentence: The convergence of different cultures in the city creates unique food traditions.
sentence_zh: 城市中不同文化的匯聚創造了獨特的飲食傳統。

definition_zh: (形) 匯聚的；聚合的　(形) 趨同的；相交的
example_sentence: Converging toward the same goal, the two research teams finally discovered the vaccine together.
sentence_zh: 匯聚於相同目標，這兩個研究團隊最終一起發現了疫苗。

definition_zh: (形) 熟悉的；通曉的
example_sentence: Although Maria is conversant with three languages, she still practices daily to maintain fluency.
sentence_zh: 雖然瑪麗亞通曉三種語言，但她仍然每天練習以保持流利。

definition_zh: (名) 交談；談話　(名) 對話；閒聊
example_sentence: Seldom does a casual conversation between classmates develop into a lifelong friendship.
sentence_zh: 同學之間的閒聊很少會發展成終身友誼。

definition_zh: (名) 善於談話的人；健談者
example_sentence: A conversationalist who enjoys discussing current events makes friends easily at parties.
sentence_zh: 一位喜歡討論時事的健談者在派對上容易交到朋友。

definition_zh: (動) [kənˋvɝs] 交談；談話　(名) [ˋkɑnvɝs] 相反的事物；反面
example_sentence: Students join the English club to converse with native speakers and improve fluency.
sentence_zh: 學生加入英文社團是為了與母語使用者交談並提高流暢度。

definition_zh: (副) 相反地；反之
example_sentence: Some students prefer studying alone; conversely, others work better in groups.
sentence_zh: 有些學生喜歡獨自讀書；反之，有些學生在小組裡效果更好。

definition_zh: (名) 轉換；改變　(名) 信仰的改宗；宗教信仰的改變
example_sentence: The conversion of solar energy into electricity helps reduce pollution.
sentence_zh: 太陽能轉換為電力有助於減少污染。

definition_zh: (名) ['kɑnvɝt] 改宗者；轉換者　(動) [kən'vɝt] 轉換；改變；使信教
example_sentence: As the factory converted its production line, workers learned to operate new machinery efficiently.
sentence_zh: 當工廠轉換生產線時，工人們學會了有效地操作新機器。

definition_zh: (形) 可轉換的；可改變的　(名) 敞篷車；可轉換公司債
example_sentence: Converting the old warehouse into a modern office, the convertible space attracted many young companies.
sentence_zh: 將舊倉庫改造成現代辦公室，這個可轉換的空間吸引了許多年輕公司。

definition_zh: (動) 傳達；表達　(動) 運送；傳遞
example_sentence: The movie conveys a message that friendship is precious, which touches audiences' hearts.
sentence_zh: 這部電影傳達了友誼很珍貴的訊息，這觸動了觀眾的心。

definition_zh: (名) 運輸；傳達　(名) 運輸工具；交通工具
example_sentence: If improved public conveyance were available, commuting to school would become much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果有改善的大眾運輸工具，上學通勤就會容易得多。

definition_zh: (動) [kənˈvɪkt] 判決有罪；定罪　(名) [ˈkɑnvɪkt] 已定罪的人；囚犯
example_sentence: The court convicted the suspect of stealing after reviewing all the evidence.
sentence_zh: 法庭在檢視所有證據後，判決該嫌疑人有盜竊罪。

definition_zh: (名) 信念；確信　(名) 定罪；有罪判決
example_sentence: Environmental activists gathered to demonstrate their deep conviction to protect the ocean.
sentence_zh: 環保人士聚集起來，以展示他們保護海洋的堅定信念。

definition_zh: (動) 說服；使信服　(動) 使確信；使承認
example_sentence: Strong evidence and logical arguments convinced the jury of the defendant's innocence.
sentence_zh: 強有力的證據和邏輯論證使陪審團相信被告是無辜的。

definition_zh: (形) 確信的；被說服的　(動) 說服；使相信
example_sentence: Convinced that studying hard leads to success, many students prepare intensively for the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 確信努力學習會帶來成功，許多學生為學測做密集準備。

definition_zh: (副) 令人信服地；有說服力地
example_sentence: The lawyer argued her case so convincingly that the jury believed every word she said.
sentence_zh: 律師辯護得如此令人信服，陪審團相信了她所說的每一個字。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈkɑnvɔɪ] 護送隊伍；車隊　(動) [kənˈvɔɪ] 護送；陪同
example_sentence: The military convoy carrying supplies traveled safely through the mountain pass.
sentence_zh: 運送物資的軍事護送隊伍安全地穿過山口。

definition_zh: (動) 烹飪；煮　(名) 廚師；做飯的人
example_sentence: If students cooked their own meals, they would save a lot of money.
sentence_zh: 如果學生自己煮飯，他們會省很多錢。

definition_zh: (名) 爐灶；烹飪器　(名) 廚師
example_sentence: My mother uses an electric cooker to prepare dinner for the family.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽用電爐灶為家人準備晚餐。

definition_zh: (名) 餅乾；曲奇　(名) (電腦) cookies (追蹤用戶資訊的檔案)
example_sentence: Eating cookies while studying, Mark felt more focused and energized.
sentence_zh: 標記邊吃餅乾邊念書，感到更加專注和有精力。

definition_zh: (名) 烹飪；料理　(動) 煮；烹調
example_sentence: While cooking dinner, Maria discovered that fresh ingredients make the dish taste much better.
sentence_zh: 在煮晚餐的時候，瑪麗亞發現新鮮食材能讓菜餚的味道好得多。

definition_zh: (動) 冷靜下來；平復；降溫
example_sentence: Only after the argument did tempers cool down and both sides listen carefully.
sentence_zh: 直到爭執結束後，雙方的情緒才平復下來，並認真聆聽彼此的意見。

definition_zh: (動) 冷靜下來；平復情緒　(動) 降溫；冷卻
example_sentence: After the argument, Sarah took a walk to cool off, which helped her think more clearly.
sentence_zh: 爭執後，莎拉去散步來冷靜下來，這幫助她思考得更清楚。

definition_zh: (形) 涼的；酷的　(動) 冷卻；變涼
example_sentence: Students study hard to keep their minds cool and focused during exam season.
sentence_zh: 學生努力唸書以保持頭腦清爽和專注，渡過考試季節。

definition_zh: (名) 獵浣熊犬；獵犬
example_sentence: Hunters in rural areas often train coonhounds to track animals through the forest.
sentence_zh: 鄉村地區的獵人經常訓練獵浣熊犬在森林中追蹤動物。

definition_zh: (動) 把...關起來；限制自由　(動) 禁閉；囚禁
example_sentence: Being cooped up in the classroom all day makes students feel tired and stressed.
sentence_zh: 整天被關在教室裡讓學生感到疲倦和有壓力。

definition_zh: (名) 籠子；狹小空間　(動) 把…關在籠子裡；限制
example_sentence: Although the chickens were cooped up in a small cage, the farmer still fed them every day.
sentence_zh: 雖然雞被關在小籠子裡，農民還是每天餵食牠們。

definition_zh: (動) 合作；協力　(動) 配合；協助
example_sentence: Cooperating with classmates on the science project, students learned teamwork skills effectively.
sentence_zh: 與同學合作進行科學項目，學生們有效地學到了團隊合作技能。

definition_zh: (名) 合作；協力　(名) 運作；操作
example_sentence: The project succeeded because of the cooperation that existed among team members who shared common goals.
sentence_zh: 這個專案成功是因為團隊成員之間存在的合作，他們都共享相同的目標。

definition_zh: (形) 願意合作的；配合的　(名) 合作社；協力組織
example_sentence: If the community members are more cooperative, the neighborhood cleanup project will succeed.
sentence_zh: 如果社區成員更願意合作，這個鄰里清潔計畫就會成功。

definition_zh: (動) 協調；調配　(名) 坐標；座標
example_sentence: The teacher asked students to coordinate their efforts for the class project.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生為班級專題協調他們的努力。

definition_zh: (名) 協調者；協調員　(動) 協調；配合
example_sentence: The event coordinator works hard to organize all details and ensure success.
sentence_zh: 活動協調員努力工作以組織所有細節並確保成功。

definition_zh: (動) 受到懲罰；遭受後果　挨罵；被批評
example_sentence: If students cheat on the exam, they will definitely cop it from their parents and teachers.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試中作弊，他們肯定會因此遭到父母和老師的批評。

definition_zh: (片) 逃脱；逃跑　(片) 接吻；調情
example_sentence: Before the police arrived, the suspect copped off through the back alley.
sentence_zh: 在警察到達之前，嫌疑人通過後巷逃脱了。

definition_zh: (片動) 逃避責任；找藉口推脫
example_sentence: Having copped out of the difficult project, the team leader faced criticism from management.
sentence_zh: 逃避了這個困難專案後，該團隊負責人面臨了管理層的批評。

definition_zh: (名) 警察；警官　(動) 逮捕；抓住
example_sentence: The cop who arrested the thief was praised by the local community.
sentence_zh: 逮捕小偷的那位警察受到當地社區的表揚。

definition_zh: (動) 應對；處理　(動) 克服；忍受
example_sentence: Learning to cope with stress and manage emotions is essential for exam success.
sentence_zh: 學會應對壓力和管理情緒對考試成功至關重要。

definition_zh: (名) 影印機；複印機
example_sentence: If the office copier were working properly, printing documents would be much faster.
sentence_zh: 如果辦公室的影印機正常運作，列印文件會快得多。

definition_zh: (形) 豐富的；大量的　(形) 充足的；充分的
example_sentence: The library has a copious collection of books for students to explore.
sentence_zh: 這間圖書館為學生準備了豐富的書籍收藏供其探索。

definition_zh: (名) 銅；銅幣　(形) 銅色的；紅銅色的
example_sentence: Polishing the copper coins found in the old box, Maria discovered ancient markings underneath.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞擦拭在舊盒子裡找到的銅幣，發現了底下的古老標記。

definition_zh: (名) 複製品；副本　(動) 複製；抄寫　(動) 模仿；抄襲
example_sentence: As the student copied the homework from his friend, the teacher caught him cheating.
sentence_zh: 當這名學生從朋友那裡抄襲功課時，老師抓到他作弊。

definition_zh: (名) 著作權；版權　(動) 對...擁有著作權
example_sentence: Not only does the author own copyright, but the publisher also holds certain rights.
sentence_zh: 這位作者不僅擁有著作權，出版社也擁有某些權利。

definition_zh: (名) 珊瑚　(形) 珊瑚色的；珊瑚製的
example_sentence: The coral reef, which stretches for miles along the coast, supports thousands of marine species.
sentence_zh: 這片珊瑚礁沿著海岸綿延數英里，為數千種海洋生物提供棲息地。

definition_zh: (名) 繩子；線　(動) 用繩子綑綁
example_sentence: Students need to use a cord to tie the rolling papers together.
sentence_zh: 學生需要用繩子把捲尺綁在一起。

definition_zh: (形) 親切友善的；溫暖的　(名) 甜酒；果汁飲料
example_sentence: The principal's cordial greeting and warm smile made new students feel welcome and comfortable.
sentence_zh: 校長親切的問候和溫暖的笑容讓新生感到受歡迎和舒適。

definition_zh: (副) 熱情地；親切地　(副) 誠摯地；友善地
example_sentence: The principal cordially invited all parents to attend the school's annual celebration.
sentence_zh: 校長熱情地邀請所有家長參加學校的年度慶祝活動。

definition_zh: (形) 無線的；沒有電線的
example_sentence: Since the cordless phone became popular, families no longer needed to stay near the wall socket.
sentence_zh: 由於無線電話變得流行，家庭成員不再需要待在牆邊的插座附近。

definition_zh: (名) 核心；中心　(動) 去除果核
example_sentence: Focusing on the core values of environmental protection, many students organized a campus recycling campaign.
sentence_zh: 專注於環境保護的核心價值，許多學生組織了一項校園回收活動。

definition_zh: (名) 軟木；瓶塞　(動) 用軟木塞封住
example_sentence: If the winemaker doesn't cork the bottle properly, the wine will oxidize and taste bitter.
sentence_zh: 如果釀酒師沒有正確地用軟木塞封瓶，葡萄酒就會氧化並嘗起來很苦。

definition_zh: (名) 鸕鶿；一種潛水捕魚的海鳥
example_sentence: The fisherman trained cormorants to dive and catch fish in the river.
sentence_zh: 漁夫訓練鸕鶿在河裡潛水捕魚。

definition_zh: (名) 玉米糖漿；玉米糖液
example_sentence: Many food manufacturers use corn syrup to sweeten soft drinks and processed snacks.
sentence_zh: 許多食品製造商使用玉米糖漿來增甜汽水和加工零食。

definition_zh: (名) 玉米；穀物　(名) 雞眼；老繭
example_sentence: The farmer grows corn and wheat in large fields every summer.
sentence_zh: 那位農民每年夏天在大田地裡種植玉米和小麥。

definition_zh: (名) 玉米芯；玉米穗軸
example_sentence: As the farmer removed the kernels, the corncob remained on the table after processing.
sentence_zh: 當農民去除玉米粒後，玉米芯在加工後留在了桌上。

definition_zh: (名) 角落；角度　(動) 逼入困境；轉彎
example_sentence: Cornered by tough questions, the politician struggled to explain the controversial policy clearly.
sentence_zh: 被尖銳的問題逼入困境，這位政治家難以清楚解釋這項爭議性政策。

definition_zh: (名) 基石；奠基石　(名) 基礎；根本
example_sentence: Honesty is the cornerstone that builds a strong relationship between friends.
sentence_zh: 誠實是建立朋友之間牢固關係的基石。

definition_zh: (形) 老套的；陳腐的　(形) 玉米的；含玉米的
example_sentence: That corny joke about homework made the whole class groan loudly.
sentence_zh: 那個關於功課的老套笑話讓全班都呻吟出聲。

definition_zh: (名) 冠狀病毒
example_sentence: If the coronavirus had not spread rapidly, the world would have avoided such a serious crisis.
sentence_zh: 如果冠狀病毒沒有迅速傳播，世界就會避免如此嚴重的危機。

definition_zh: (形) 身體的；肉體的　(名) 下士；軍曹
example_sentence: Physical education teaches students about corporal health and fitness.
sentence_zh: 體育課教導學生關於身體健康和體能的知識。

definition_zh: (形) 公司的；企業的　(名) 公司；企業
example_sentence: Facing increasing competition, the corporate management decided to restructure its operations.
sentence_zh: 面對日益激烈的競爭，企業管理層決定重組其業務。

definition_zh: (名) 公司；企業　(名) 法人；團體
example_sentence: Because the corporation invested heavily in technology, its products became more competitive in the global market.
sentence_zh: 因為該公司大量投資科技，其產品在全球市場上變得更具競爭力。

definition_zh: (名) 軍團；兵團　(名) 團體；集團
example_sentence: Not only did the military corps defend the border, but also trained new soldiers.
sentence_zh: 軍團不僅防守邊界，而且還訓練新兵。

definition_zh: (名) 屍體；死屍
example_sentence: The corpse that the detective found in the abandoned house revealed important clues about the crime.
sentence_zh: 偵探在廢棄房屋中發現的屍體揭露了關於該犯罪的重要線索。

definition_zh: (名) 語料庫；文獻集合　(名) 屍體；遺體
example_sentence: Linguists analyze large text corpora to understand language patterns and usage.
sentence_zh: 語言學家分析大型文本語料庫以理解語言模式和用法。

definition_zh: (動) 改正；糾正　(形) 正確的；正對的
example_sentence: The teacher corrected our mistakes and gave us better ways to solve the problem.
sentence_zh: 老師改正了我們的錯誤，並給了我們更好的解決方法。

definition_zh: (名) 改正；修改　(名) 改正的地方；更正
example_sentence: The teacher marked several corrections on my English essay yesterday.
sentence_zh: 老師昨天在我的英文作文上標記了幾處改正。

definition_zh: (動) 相關聯；有關係　(名) 相關的人或事物
example_sentence: As test scores correlate with study hours, diligent students often perform better.
sentence_zh: 當測驗成績與讀書時數相關時，勤奮的學生通常表現更好。

definition_zh: (動) 符合；相應　(動) 通信；交流
example_sentence: Corresponding with pen pals from around the world, Maria discovered fascinating cultures and made lifelong friendships.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞與世界各地的筆友通信，發現了迷人的文化並建立了終身友誼。

definition_zh: (名) 通信；信件　(名) 相似；對應
example_sentence: The correspondence that revealed the company's hidden dealings shocked the public.
sentence_zh: 揭露公司隱瞞行為的信件震驚了大眾。

definition_zh: (名) 通訊記者；通信者　(形) 相應的；相符的
example_sentence: If the journalist were a foreign correspondent, she would report on international news from overseas.
sentence_zh: 如果那位記者是駐外通訊記者，她就會從海外報導國際新聞。

definition_zh: (形) 相應的；對應的　(形) 相符的；一致的
example_sentence: The corresponding answers to these math problems are listed at the back.
sentence_zh: 這些數學題的相應答案列在後面。

definition_zh: (副) 相應地；照應地　(副) 因此；所以
example_sentence: The company raised salaries correspondingly to retain talented employees and improve morale.
sentence_zh: 公司相應地提高薪資以留住人才並提升士氣。

definition_zh: (名) 走廊；過道　(名) 狹長的地帶
example_sentence: Students rushing through the school corridor often bump into each other between classes.
sentence_zh: 學生在下課時常在校內走廊衝撞彼此。

definition_zh: (動) 證實；確認　(動) 支持；驗證
example_sentence: Because the witness corroborated the victim's story, the judge believed the evidence was reliable.
sentence_zh: 因為證人證實了受害者的說法，法官相信證據是可靠的。

definition_zh: (名) 證實；確認　(名) 證據；佐證
example_sentence: Having gathered corroboration from multiple witnesses, the detective confidently presented the case to the prosecutor.
sentence_zh: 從多位證人那裡蒐集到確認證據後，偵探自信地將案件呈交給檢察官。

definition_zh: (形) 證實的；確認的　(形) 支持的；佐證的
example_sentence: The witness's testimony, which was corroborative evidence supporting the defendant's alibi, proved crucial to the trial.
sentence_zh: 證人的證詞是支持被告不在場證明的確認證據，在審判中扮演了關鍵角色。

definition_zh: (動) 腐蝕；侵蝕　(名) 腐蝕作用
example_sentence: Salt water and oxygen gradually corrode metal pipes, making regular maintenance necessary.
sentence_zh: 鹽水和氧氣逐漸腐蝕金屬管道，使得定期維護成為必要。

definition_zh: (形) 腐敗的；貪汙的　(動) 使腐敗；使墮落
example_sentence: If government officials were not corrupt, public trust in institutions would increase significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果政府官員不貪汙，對政府機構的公眾信任就會大幅提高。

definition_zh: (名) 腐敗；貪污　(名) 道德敗壞；墮落
example_sentence: Government corruption damages public trust and slows economic development.
sentence_zh: 政府腐敗會損害公眾信任並阻礙經濟發展。

definition_zh: (名) 大腦皮層；皮質
example_sentence: Covering the entire brain, the cortex enables complex thinking and memory storage in students.
sentence_zh: 覆蓋整個大腦的大腦皮層使學生能夠進行複雜思考和記憶儲存。

definition_zh: (名) 一致性；連貫性　(名) 濃稠度；黏稠度
example_sentence: Although the coach emphasized training consistency, many athletes struggled to maintain their effort throughout the season.
sentence_zh: 雖然教練強調訓練的一致性，但許多運動員在整個賽季中難以保持他們的努力。

definition_zh: (形) 化妝的；美容的　(名) 化妝品；護膚品
example_sentence: Not only do cosmetic products improve appearance, but also boost confidence in teenagers.
sentence_zh: 化妝品不僅改善外觀，也能增強青少年的自信心。

definition_zh: (形) 宇宙的；來自宇宙的　(形) 龐大的；無限的
example_sentence: The cosmic rays that bombard Earth's atmosphere originate from distant stars and supernovas.
sentence_zh: 轟擊地球大氣層的宇宙射線來自遙遠的恆星和超新星。

definition_zh: (形) 宇宙學的；宇宙的
example_sentence: Astronomers use powerful telescopes to observe cosmological phenomena in order to understand the universe's origin.
sentence_zh: 天文學家使用強大的望遠鏡觀察宇宙學現象，以便了解宇宙的起源。

definition_zh: (名) 宇宙學；宇宙的起源和結構
example_sentence: Modern cosmology reveals that the universe expanded from a single point billions of years ago.
sentence_zh: 現代宇宙學揭示宇宙是從數十億年前的單一點膨脹而來的。

definition_zh: (名) 宇宙人；太空人
example_sentence: The Russian cosmonaut spent six months aboard the international space station.
sentence_zh: 那位俄羅斯太空人在國際太空站上停留了六個月。

definition_zh: (形) 世界性的；國際化的　(名) 世界公民；國際人士
example_sentence: Although the city is cosmopolitan, traditional culture remains deeply rooted in local communities.
sentence_zh: 儘管這座城市具有國際化特色，傳統文化仍然深深扎根於當地社區。

word: cost an arm and a leg
definition_zh: (片語) 花費很大；非常昂貴
example_sentence: Costing an arm and a leg, the new iPhone model makes many students hesitate before buying.
sentence_zh: 新款iPhone手機花費很大，讓許多學生在購買前猶豫不決。

definition_zh: (動) 成本上升；費用增加
example_sentence: The construction materials whose prices keep rising have cost up the entire building project significantly.
sentence_zh: 那些價格不斷上漲的建築材料使得整個建築計畫的成本大幅增加。

definition_zh: (名) 費用；成本　(動) 花費；值
example_sentence: If studying abroad costs too much money, many students will choose domestic universities.
sentence_zh: 如果出國留學花費太多錢，許多學生就會選擇國內大學。

definition_zh: (名) 成本計算；造價　(動) 花費；成本為
example_sentence: The project's costing exceeded our budget by twenty percent.
sentence_zh: 這個專案的成本計算超過了我們預算百分之二十。

definition_zh: (形) 昂貴的；費錢的　(形) 造成重大損失的；代價高的
example_sentence: Studying abroad is costly, so many students work part-time to pay tuition.
sentence_zh: 出國留學很昂貴，所以許多學生兼職工作以支付學費。

definition_zh: (名) 服裝；戲服　(名) 習俗；傳統
example_sentence: The actress wore an elaborate Victorian costume for the historical drama production.
sentence_zh: 這位女演員為歷史劇製作穿上了精心設計的維多利亞時代服裝。

definition_zh: (名) 小屋；鄉村別墅　(名) 農舍；度假小屋
example_sentence: Although the cottage was small, it provided a perfect retreat for the family during summer vacation.
sentence_zh: 儘管小屋很小，但它為這家人的暑假提供了完美的休閒去處。

definition_zh: (動) 終於明白；恍然大悟
example_sentence: Having cottoned on to the teacher's hints, students finally understood the exam strategy.
sentence_zh: 學生們恍然大悟老師的暗示後，終於理解了考試策略。

definition_zh: (名) 棉花；棉布　(形) 棉製的；棉質的
example_sentence: The soft cotton shirts that students wear during summer are comfortable and breathable.
sentence_zh: 學生在夏天穿著的柔軟棉質襯衫既舒適又透氣。

definition_zh: (名) 沙發；長椅　(動) 用言語表達；蹲伏
example_sentence: After finishing homework, Tom relaxed on the comfortable couch watching his favorite TV show.
sentence_zh: 完成功課後，湯姆舒服地躺在沙發上看他最喜歡的電視節目。

definition_zh: (動) 咳出；吐出　(動) 勉強交出；支付
example_sentence: If the witness coughed up the truth, the criminal case would be solved quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果證人吐露真相，這樁犯罪案件就會很快破案。

definition_zh: (名) 咳嗽；咳嗽聲　(動) 咳嗽；咳
example_sentence: A bad cough kept Sarah awake all night.
sentence_zh: 嚴重的咳嗽讓莎拉整晚都睡不著。

definition_zh: (動) 需要；想要　(片) 可以用得著；需要
example_sentence: Having finished the long exam, Sarah could do with some rest and relaxation this weekend.
sentence_zh: 完成了長考試後，莎拉這個週末可以用得著一些休息和放鬆。

definition_zh: (名) 對小丑的恐懼；小丑恐懼症
example_sentence: Although coulrophobia seems unusual to many people, some individuals experience intense anxiety whenever they encounter clowns at circuses or parties.
sentence_zh: 雖然小丑恐懼症對許多人來說似乎很不尋常，但有些人在馬戲團或派對上遇到小丑時會感到極度焦慮。

definition_zh: (名) 議會；委員會　(動) 勸告；建議
example_sentence: Seldom does a school council make decisions without listening to student voices.
sentence_zh: 學校議會很少在不聽取學生意見的情況下做決定。

definition_zh: (名) 議員；委員
example_sentence: The councilor who represented our district proposed a new policy for improving public transportation.
sentence_zh: 代表我們地區的議員提出了一項改善公共運輸的新政策。

definition_zh: (名) 律師；顧問　(動) 勸告；提供意見
example_sentence: Many students consult a school counselor to plan their university applications.
sentence_zh: 許多學生諮詢學校輔導老師以規劃他們的大學申請。

definition_zh: (名) 諮詢；輔導　(動) 提供建議；進行心理諮詢
example_sentence: Student counseling services help teenagers overcome academic stress and personal challenges.
sentence_zh: 學生諮詢服務幫助青少年克服課業壓力和個人問題。

definition_zh: (名) 顧問；諮詢師　(名) 輔導老師；校園輔導員
example_sentence: The school counselor helps students choose the right university major.
sentence_zh: 學校輔導老師幫助學生選擇合適的大學科系。

definition_zh: (動) 對…不利；不利於
example_sentence: Although Maria studied hard, her late arrival to class counted against her final grade.
sentence_zh: 雖然瑪麗亞用功讀書，但她上課遲到對她的最終成績不利。

definition_zh: (動) 被列為；算作
example_sentence: Being recognized as one of the top students, Maria counted among the scholarship recipients for the overseas exchange program.
sentence_zh: 瑪莉亞因為被認可為頂尖學生之一，被列為海外交換計畫的獎學金得主。

definition_zh: (動) 倒數計時；倒計數
example_sentence: The final exam, which students counted down to for months, finally arrived yesterday.
sentence_zh: 學生們倒數了好幾個月的期末考，終於在昨天到來。

definition_zh: (動) 算數；有價值　(動) 被認為是；視為
example_sentence: If good grades count for university admission, students will study harder than ever before.
sentence_zh: 如果好成績對大學入學有價值，學生會比以往更加努力讀書。

definition_zh: (片) 被計算；被考慮　(片) 算數；重要
example_sentence: Your test scores count in the final grade, so study hard.
sentence_zh: 你的測驗成績被計算在最終成績裡，所以要認真讀書。

definition_zh: (動) 依靠；信任　(動) 計算；算入
example_sentence: Students need to count on their teachers to provide clear explanations for difficult concepts.
sentence_zh: 學生需要依靠老師來提供困難概念的清楚解釋。

definition_zh: (動) 排除；不計算　(動) 數出；點數
example_sentence: The teacher counted out twenty test papers and distributed them to the students in the classroom.
sentence_zh: 老師數出二十份試卷，並分發給教室裡的學生。

definition_zh: (動) 有助於；計入　(動) 被列為；被計算
example_sentence: Because your final project counts towards your total grade, finishing it early will improve your overall score.
sentence_zh: 因為期末專題計入你的總成績，所以提早完成它會改善你的整體分數。

definition_zh: (動) 數起來；加起來　(動) 變得重要；很重要
example_sentence: Having counted up all the test scores, the teacher announced the class average to students.
sentence_zh: 老師數完所有的測驗成績後，向學生宣布班級平均分數。

definition_zh: (動) 計數；數數　(動) 算作；被認為　(名) 伯爵；計數
example_sentence: The votes that the election committee counted yesterday determined the final result.
sentence_zh: 選舉委員會昨天計算的票數決定了最終結果。

definition_zh: (形) 可數的；可計算的　(形) 重要的；值得注意的
example_sentence: Nouns in English are either countable nouns or uncountable nouns, and students must learn the difference.
sentence_zh: 英文中的名詞要麼是可數名詞，要麼是不可數名詞，學生必須學會區分。

definition_zh: (名) 櫃檯；計數器　(動) 反駁；對抗　(形) 相反的；對立的
example_sentence: If the store manager didn't counter the customer's complaint immediately, the situation would become much worse.
sentence_zh: 如果店經理沒有立即反駁顧客的抱怨，情況會變得更糟。

definition_zh: (動) 抵消；對抗　(動) 減弱；阻止
example_sentence: Exercise counteracts the negative effects of a sedentary lifestyle.
sentence_zh: 運動可以抵消久坐不動生活方式的負面影響。

definition_zh: (副) 逆時針方向；反時針方向　(形) 逆時針的；反時針方向的
example_sentence: Rotating the dial counterclockwise, students discovered the safe's combination quickly.
sentence_zh: 學生逆時針旋轉撥號盤，很快就發現了保險箱的密碼。

definition_zh: (形) 偽造的；假的　(動) 偽造；仿冒　(名) 贗品；假貨
example_sentence: Although the designer bag looked expensive, it turned out to be counterfeit when experts examined it carefully.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個設計師包包看起來很昂貴，但專家仔細檢查後發現它是偽造的。

definition_zh: (名) 對應的人；對等物　(名) 相似的東西；同類人物
example_sentence: Not only does the US president hold significant power, but so does his Chinese counterpart in international affairs.
sentence_zh: 不僅美國總統在國際事務中握有重大權力，其中國對應官員也是如此。

definition_zh: (名) 對位法；對比　(名) 對立的論點；相反的觀點
example_sentence: The composer's counterpoint, which blended two independent melodies together, impressed all the music students.
sentence_zh: 作曲家的對位法——將兩個獨立的旋律混合在一起——給所有音樂學生留下了深刻的印象。

definition_zh: (名) 平衡物；制衡力量　(動) 平衡；抵消
example_sentence: The government created new policies to counterpoise the influence of large corporations in the market.
sentence_zh: 政府制定新政策以平衡大型企業在市場上的影響力。

definition_zh: (名) 解毒劑；對抗毒藥的物質
example_sentence: The doctor administered a counterpoison to neutralize the snake venom in the patient's bloodstream.
sentence_zh: 醫生給病人注射解毒劑以中和血液中的蛇毒。

definition_zh: (形) 適得其反的；效果相反的　(形) 有害的；無效的
example_sentence: Studying while watching videos is counterproductive for exam preparation.
sentence_zh: 邊看影片邊唸書對考試準備來說適得其反。

definition_zh: (名) 反抗議者；對抗示威者
example_sentence: Although counterprotesters gathered outside the venue, the original demonstration proceeded peacefully throughout the day.
sentence_zh: 雖然反抗議者聚集在會場外，原始示威活動整天都進行得很和平。

definition_zh: (名) 國家；國土　(形) 鄉村的；農村的
example_sentence: The country that produces the most tea has a long agricultural history.
sentence_zh: 生產最多茶葉的國家有著悠久的農業歷史。

definition_zh: (名) 鄉村；鄉下　(形) 鄉村的；農村的
example_sentence: If students visit the countryside, they will discover how farmers grow crops and raise animals.
sentence_zh: 如果學生訪問鄉村，他們將會發現農民如何種植作物和飼養動物。

definition_zh: (名) 縣；郡
example_sentence: My grandparents live in a small county in the countryside.
sentence_zh: 我的祖父母住在鄉村的一個小縣裡。

definition_zh: (名) 政變；突然奪取政權　(動) 發動政變；突然奪取
example_sentence: The military planned a coup to overthrow the corrupt government.
sentence_zh: 軍隊計畫發動政變以推翻腐敗的政府。

definition_zh: (名) 一對；夫妻　(動) 連接；結合
example_sentence: A young couple walked hand in hand through the night market.
sentence_zh: 一對年輕夫妻手牽手漫步在夜市裡。

definition_zh: (名) 折價券；優惠券
example_sentence: Since online shopping has become popular, many students use coupons whenever they purchase clothes or snacks.
sentence_zh: 由於線上購物變得普遍，許多學生在購買衣服或零食時會使用折價券。

definition_zh: (名) 勇氣；膽量　(動) 鼓勵；激勵
example_sentence: Having faced many challenges, the student found courage to speak up in class.
sentence_zh: 經歷了許多挑戰後，那位學生找到勇氣在課堂上發言。

definition_zh: (形) 勇敢的；無畏的　(形) 大膽的；有膽量的
example_sentence: The courageous firefighters who rescued the trapped family received a medal from the city.
sentence_zh: 那些救出困住家庭的勇敢消防員獲得了城市頒發的獎章。

definition_zh: (名) 快遞員；信差　(名) 快遞服務；傳遞
example_sentence: The courier delivered the urgent package to the office before noon.
sentence_zh: 快遞員在中午前把緊急包裹送到辦公室。

definition_zh: (名) 課程；課程內容　(名) 過程；進程　(名) 一道菜；菜餚
example_sentence: If students took the online course seriously, they would improve their English skills significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生認真上網路課程，他們的英文能力就會顯著提升。

definition_zh: (名) 法庭；法院　(名) 運動場；球場
example_sentence: The judge ruled in favor of the defendant in court.
sentence_zh: 法官在法庭判決被告勝訴。

definition_zh: (形) 有禮貌的；恭敬的　(形) 周到的；殷勤的
example_sentence: Being courteous to customers, the shop assistant created a pleasant shopping experience.
sentence_zh: 對顧客表現得很有禮貌，那位店員創造了令人愉快的購物經驗。

definition_zh: (名) 禮貌；親切　(形) 恭敬的；有禼的
example_sentence: Since showing courtesy toward classmates builds stronger friendships, treating others respectfully matters greatly.
sentence_zh: 因為對同學表現禮貌能建立更堅固的友誼，所以尊重他人是很重要的。

definition_zh: (名) 法院；法庭
example_sentence: Only after the trial ended did the journalists leave the courthouse.
sentence_zh: 只有在審判結束後，記者們才離開法院。

definition_zh: (名) 法庭；審判室
example_sentence: The lawyer presented evidence in the courtroom where the judge carefully listened to both sides.
sentence_zh: 律師在法庭上提出證據，該法庭中法官仔細聆聽雙方的陳述。

definition_zh: (名) 求愛；談戀愛　(動) 向...求愛
example_sentence: Young couples spend months in courtship to understand each other better.
sentence_zh: 年輕情侶花數月時間談戀愛，以便更了解彼此。

definition_zh: (名) 院子；庭院　(名) 校園內的空地
example_sentence: The ancient courtyard of the temple attracts many visitors during festivals.
sentence_zh: 這座寺廟古老的院子在節慶期間吸引許多遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 堂表親；表親
example_sentence: My cousin lives in Taipei and studies engineering at university.
sentence_zh: 我的表親住在台北，在大學裡念工程。

definition_zh: (動) 為某人隱瞞；替某人掩飾　(動) 代替某人值班；代班
example_sentence: When the manager discovered the mistake, Tom's coworker covered for him so he wouldn't get fired.
sentence_zh: 當經理發現那個錯誤時，湯姆的同事替他隱瞞，所以他沒有被解僱。

definition_zh: (動) 隱瞞；掩蓋　(動) 遮掩；覆蓋
example_sentence: Covering up the scandal, the company issued a false statement to the media.
sentence_zh: 該公司為了隱瞞醜聞，向媒體發布了虛假聲明。

definition_zh: (動) 覆蓋；遮蓋　(名) 封面；蓋子
example_sentence: The textbook cover that displays the school logo is designed by students.
sentence_zh: 展示學校標誌的課本封面是由學生設計的。

definition_zh: (名) 報導；新聞報導　涵蓋範圍；保險範圍
example_sentence: If the news media provides comprehensive coverage of local environmental issues, more citizens will understand climate change.
sentence_zh: 如果新聞媒體對當地環境議題提供全面報導，更多市民將了解氣候變遷。

definition_zh: (名) 覆蓋物；蓋子　(動) 覆蓋；遮住
example_sentence: The snow covering the mountain made the view absolutely beautiful.
sentence_zh: 覆蓋山峰的雪景看起來絕對很美麗。

definition_zh: (形) 祕密的；隱蔽的　(名) 祕密行動；隱蔽場所
example_sentence: Intelligence agents conducted covert operations to gather classified information.
sentence_zh: 情報員進行祕密行動以蒐集機密資訊。

definition_zh: (動) 渴望；貪圖　(形) 貪心的；渴望的
example_sentence: Many students covet admission to top universities and work hard to achieve their dreams.
sentence_zh: 許多學生渴望進入頂尖大學，並努力實現他們的夢想。

definition_zh: (名) 母牛；牛
example_sentence: While the farmer milked the cow, it remained calm and still.
sentence_zh: 當農夫擠牛奶時，那頭牛保持平靜不動。

definition_zh: (名) 懦夫；膽小鬼　(形) 膽小的；懦弱的
example_sentence: Having been criticized by his friends, the coward finally admitted his mistake in avoiding the difficult challenge.
sentence_zh: 被朋友們批評後，那個懦夫終於承認了自己逃避困難挑戰的錯誤。

definition_zh: (形) 膽小的；怯懦的　(副) 怯懦地；膽小地
example_sentence: The student who answered cowardly during the debate lost the respect of classmates.
sentence_zh: 在辯論中膽小作答的那位學生失去了同學的尊重。

definition_zh: (名) 牛仔；牧牛人　(名) 西部電影或小說中的角色
example_sentence: The cowboy rode his horse across the desert looking for cattle.
sentence_zh: 牛仔騎著馬穿過沙漠尋找牛群。

definition_zh: (名) 同事；共事者
example_sentence: If Sarah communicated better with her coworkers, the project would finish on time.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉與同事溝通得更好，這個專案就會按時完成。

definition_zh: (名) 郊狼；土狼
example_sentence: A coyote howled in the desert under the moonlight.
sentence_zh: 一隻郊狼在月光下的沙漠中嚎叫。

definition_zh: (動) 討好；親近　親密相待
example_sentence: Cozying up to the teacher before the exam, Mark hoped for extra credit.
sentence_zh: 馬克在考試前討好老師，希望能獲得加分。

definition_zh: (形) 舒適的；溫暖舒適的　(形) 親切的；親密的
example_sentence: As the winter wind blew outside, the living room felt cozy because the fireplace warmed everyone.
sentence_zh: 當冬風在外面吹著時，因為壁爐溫暖了每個人，客廳感到舒適溫暖。

definition_zh: (名) 螃蟹　(動) 抱怨；發牢騷
example_sentence: Seldom do beachgoers find crabs walking freely along the sandy shore.
sentence_zh: 海灘遊客很少看到螃蟹在沙灘上自由行走。

definition_zh: (形) 易怒的；脾氣壞的　(形) 不友善的；容易被激怒的
example_sentence: The customer who was crabby about the long wait complained to the manager loudly.
sentence_zh: 那位因等待時間長而脾氣壞的顧客大聲向經理投訴。

definition_zh: (動) 嚴厲打擊；取締　(動) 對...採取強硬措施
example_sentence: The government implemented new policies to crack down on illegal online gambling.
sentence_zh: 政府實施新政策以嚴厲打擊非法網路賭博。

definition_zh: (動) 繼續努力；加緊工作
example_sentence: The team cracked on with their project despite the tight deadline.
sentence_zh: 儘管截止期限很緊，該團隊仍繼續努力推進他們的項目。

definition_zh: (動) 大笑；裂開　(動) 精神崩潰；情緒失控
example_sentence: The entire class cracked up when the teacher slipped on the floor.
sentence_zh: 當老師在地板上滑倒時，全班都大笑起來。

definition_zh: (動) 裂開；破裂　(名) 裂縫；裂痕
example_sentence: As the temperature dropped suddenly, the ice cracked into pieces overnight.
sentence_zh: 當溫度突然下降時，冰在一夜之間裂成了碎片。

definition_zh: (名) 鎮壓；打擊　(動) 鎮壓；嚴厲打擊
example_sentence: Facing mounting protests, the government launched a crackdown targeting illegal demonstrations across major cities.
sentence_zh: 面對日益增加的抗議活動，政府在主要城市發起了鎮壓非法示威的行動。

definition_zh: (名) 餅乾；薄脆餅　(名) 鞭炮；爆竹
example_sentence: The crackers that my grandmother baked taste delicious and crunchy.
sentence_zh: 我祖母烤的餅乾嚐起來很好吃，而且脆脆的。

definition_zh: (名) 搖籃；發源地　(動) 輕輕搖動；懷抱
example_sentence: If parents cradle newborns gently, the babies will feel safe and secure.
sentence_zh: 如果父母輕輕搖動搖籃，嬰兒會感到安全和舒適。

definition_zh: (名) 工藝；手工藝　(動) 精心製作；手工製造
example_sentence: Learning traditional woodcraft helps preserve cultural heritage and develop practical skills.
sentence_zh: 學習傳統木工藝有助於保護文化遺產並發展實用技能。

definition_zh: (名) 工匠；手工藝人　(名) 技藝高超的工人
example_sentence: The experienced craftsman learned traditional woodworking techniques to preserve cultural heritage.
sentence_zh: 這位經驗豐富的工匠學習傳統木工技術以保存文化遺產。

definition_zh: (名) 工藝技巧；精湛手藝　(名) 精良製作；工藝品質
example_sentence: The furniture maker's craftsmanship is evident in every careful detail and perfect joint.
sentence_zh: 家具製作師的工藝技巧在每個細心的細節和完美的接合處都明顯可見。

definition_zh: (形) 狡詐的；詭計多端的　(形) 靈巧的；精巧的
example_sentence: Although the magician appeared friendly, his crafty tricks fooled the entire audience.
sentence_zh: 雖然魔術師看起來很友善，但他狡詐的魔術騙過了全場觀眾。

definition_zh: (動) 死記硬背；填塞　(名) 臨時抱佛腳
example_sentence: Having crammed all night before the exam, the student felt exhausted and unprepared.
sentence_zh: 在考試前徹夜死記硬背，那名學生感到疲憊且準備不足。

definition_zh: (名) 抽筋；痛楚　(動) 使抽筋；限制
example_sentence: The muscle cramp that struck during the marathon was so painful that the runner had to stop.
sentence_zh: 馬拉松比賽中襲擊選手的肌肉抽筋痛得很厲害，以至於跑者不得不停下來。

definition_zh: (名) 起重機；吊車　(名) 鶴（鳥類）
example_sentence: The construction crew used a tall crane to lift heavy steel beams onto the building site.
sentence_zh: 施工隊用一台高起重機將沉重的鋼樑吊到建築工地上。

definition_zh: (動) 迅速生產；大量製造　(動) 匆匆完成；倉促寫出
example_sentence: If the factory workers had better equipment, the company would crank out twice as many products each month.
sentence_zh: 如果工廠工人有更好的設備，公司每個月能生產出兩倍多的產品。

definition_zh: (動) 提高音量；增加音量　(動) 加快速度；加強力度
example_sentence: The music producer cranked up the volume so the whole studio could hear the new song.
sentence_zh: 音樂製作人提高了音量，讓整個錄音室都能聽到這首新歌。

definition_zh: (名) 曲柄；手搖把　(動) 轉動；搖動　(形) 古怪的；脾氣怪
example_sentence: Cranking the handle repeatedly, the boy slowly lowered the bucket into the deep well.
sentence_zh: 男孩反覆轉動曲柄，慢慢地將水桶放入深井裡。

definition_zh: (形) 易怒的；脾氣壞的　(形) 古怪的；容易出毛病的
example_sentence: Although the old machine was cranky, the factory workers managed to repair it before the deadline.
sentence_zh: 雖然那台舊機器容易出毛病，工廠工人還是在截止日期前設法修好了它。

definition_zh: (名) 廢話；垃圾　(動) 排便；製造廢話
example_sentence: Hardly ever does Tom talk such crap during serious class discussions.
sentence_zh: 湯姆在嚴肅的課堂討論中幾乎從不說這種廢話。

definition_zh: (動) 昏睡；入睡　(動) 突然停止運作；崩潰
example_sentence: The exhausted student crashed out on the sofa, which was piled with textbooks.
sentence_zh: 那位疲憊的學生在堆滿課本的沙發上昏睡，這張沙發正好位於客廳角落。

definition_zh: (動) 撞擊；碰撞　(名) 撞車；碰撞聲
example_sentence: The driver swerved quickly to avoid crashing into the stopped vehicle ahead.
sentence_zh: 駕駛員迅速轉向以避免撞上前面停下的車輛。

definition_zh: (形) 粗俗的；無禮的　(形) 粗魯的；不敏感的
example_sentence: Making crass jokes about others' appearance shows a lack of respect and maturity.
sentence_zh: 對他人外貌開粗俗玩笑顯示出缺乏尊重與成熟度。

definition_zh: (名) 木箱；板條箱　(動) 把...裝入箱子
example_sentence: The farmer loaded apples into a wooden crate for transport.
sentence_zh: 農民把蘋果裝進木箱以便運輸。

definition_zh: (名) 隕石坑；火山口　(名) 凹陷；坑洞
example_sentence: As the meteor struck Earth, a massive crater formed where the impact occurred.
sentence_zh: 當隕石撞擊地球時，撞擊發生的地方形成了一個巨大的隕石坑。

definition_zh: (動) 渴望；極想要　(名) 強烈的慾望；渴求
example_sentence: Craving delicious food after school, many students rush to the night market.
sentence_zh: 放學後渴望美食，許多學生匆忙趕往夜市。

definition_zh: (名) 強烈渴望；極想要的東西　(動) 渴望；想要
example_sentence: The intense craving that students experience during exam season often leads to unhealthy eating habits.
sentence_zh: 學生在考試季節經歷的強烈渴望常常導致不健康的飲食習慣。

definition_zh: (動) 爬行；緩慢移動　(名) 爬行；緩慢速度
example_sentence: If babies crawl regularly on clean floors, their muscles will develop more quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果嬰兒經常在乾淨的地板上爬行，他們的肌肉會發育得更快。

definition_zh: (名) 爬蟲；爬行動物　(名) 網路爬蟲；搜索程式
example_sentence: The spider crawler moved slowly across the garden wall.
sentence_zh: 蜘蛛爬蟲緩慢地爬過花園的牆壁。

definition_zh: (名) 蠟筆；彩色筆
example_sentence: Children use crayons to color pictures and express their creativity.
sentence_zh: 小孩使用蠟筆給圖畫著色並表達他們的創意。

definition_zh: (形) 瘋狂的；發瘋的　(形) 古怪的；不理性的
example_sentence: Going skydiving for the first time sounds crazy, but Maria thinks it will be an amazing experience.
sentence_zh: 第一次去跳傘聽起來很瘋狂，但瑪麗亞認為這會是一次很棒的經歷。

definition_zh: (動) 吱吱聲；發出刺耳聲　(名) 吱吱的聲音
example_sentence: As the old wooden door creaked, the student realized the house was not as quiet as expected.
sentence_zh: 當老舊木門吱吱作響時，學生意識到這間房子並不如預期那麼安靜。

definition_zh: (動) 把…中最好的部分取走；榨取　(動) 將浮在表面的東西撇去
example_sentence: Having creamed off the top students for the advanced program, the school focused on supporting the remaining learners.
sentence_zh: 學校把最優秀的學生篩選進入進階班後，開始專注於協助其他學生的學習。

definition_zh: (名) 奶油；乳霜
example_sentence: The cream on this cake tastes very sweet and rich.
sentence_zh: 這個蛋糕上的奶油嚐起來非常甜且濃郁。

definition_zh: (形) 奶油般的；滑潤的
example_sentence: If this creamy sauce contains too much butter, the chef will adjust the recipe.
sentence_zh: 如果這種奶油醬含有太多奶油，廚師會調整食譜。

definition_zh: (名) 皺摺；摺痕　(動) 使皺摺；摺疊
example_sentence: Creasing the paper carefully, Maya prepared her origami project for the competition.
sentence_zh: 瑪雅仔細地摺紙，為比賽準備她的摺紙作品。

definition_zh: (動) 創造；創作　(動) 製造；建立
example_sentence: The artist created a beautiful painting that won many international awards.
sentence_zh: 這位藝術家創作了一幅美麗的畫，贏得了許多國際獎項。

definition_zh: (名) 創造；創作　(名) 被創造的事物；作品
example_sentence: If the artist had more time, the creation of this painting would be even more impressive.
sentence_zh: 如果藝術家有更多時間，這幅畫的創作會更令人印象深刻。

definition_zh: (形) 有創意的；富創造力的　(形) 創新的；想像力豐富的
example_sentence: Creative thinking helps students solve difficult problems in new ways.
sentence_zh: 具有創意的思考能幫助學生用新方法解決困難的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 創造力；創意　(形) 創意的；有創意的
example_sentence: Many students join art clubs to develop creativity and express themselves.
sentence_zh: 許多學生參加藝術社團來培養創造力並表達自己。

definition_zh: (名) 創作者；製作者
example_sentence: The content creator produces videos that help students prepare for the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 這位內容創作者製作了幫助學生準備學測的影片。

definition_zh: (名) 生物；動物　(名) 人；傢伙
example_sentence: Although the creature lived deep in the forest, scientists finally discovered it last year.
sentence_zh: 雖然這隻生物住在森林深處，科學家去年終於發現了它。

definition_zh: (名) 可信度；信譽　(名) 說服力；公信力
example_sentence: Having published numerous peer-reviewed studies, the researcher's credibility remained strong throughout the scandal.
sentence_zh: 這位研究人員已發表過許多經過同行評審的研究，他的信譽在整個醜聞期間仍然很強。

definition_zh: (形) 可信的；可靠的　(形) 令人相信的；合理的
example_sentence: The witness provided credible evidence that convinced the judge of the defendant's guilt.
sentence_zh: 該證人提供了令人信服的證據，使法官確信被告有罪。

definition_zh: (名) 學分；信用　(動) 把...歸於；相信　(名) 貸款；信貸
example_sentence: Completing this course will give students four credits toward graduation.
sentence_zh: 完成這門課程將為學生提供四個畢業學分。

definition_zh: (動) 認可；承認　(動) 記入帳戶；存入
example_sentence: If the professor credited your essay to the correct student, your grade would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果教授將你的文章歸功於正確的學生，你的成績會大幅提高。

definition_zh: (名) 債權人；貸方
example_sentence: The bank acted as a creditor when lending money to the company.
sentence_zh: 當銀行借錢給公司時，銀行扮演債權人的角色。

definition_zh: (形) 信用良好的；值得信賴的
example_sentence: Having a stable job and good savings, the young couple became creditworthy enough to apply for a mortgage.
sentence_zh: 擁有穩定工作和良好儲蓄，這對年輕夫婦變得信用良好，足以申請房貸。

definition_zh: (名) 小溪；溪流
example_sentence: As the hikers walked through the forest, they heard the sound of a creek flowing nearby.
sentence_zh: 當登山者穿過森林時，他們聽到附近小溪流動的聲音。

definition_zh: (動) 慢慢進入；悄悄滲入　(動) 逐漸出現；悄悄靠近
example_sentence: Only after midnight did doubt creep in, making the student reconsider the entire plan.
sentence_zh: 只有午夜過後，疑慮才悄悄滲入，讓學生重新考慮整個計畫。

definition_zh: (動) 逐漸滲入；慢慢進入
example_sentence: Doubt that creeps into the mind during exam preparation often undermines student confidence.
sentence_zh: 在考試準備期間逐漸滲入心中的懷疑，常常會削弱學生的信心。

definition_zh: (片) 使人感到害怕或不舒服；嚇人
example_sentence: Watching that horror movie alone at midnight is likely to creep out on anyone without courage.
sentence_zh: 午夜獨自看恐怖電影很可能會嚇到任何沒有勇氣的人。

definition_zh: (動) 使人感到毛骨悚然；令人不安
example_sentence: The old abandoned house creeps out everyone who walks past it at night.
sentence_zh: 那棟老舊的廢棄房子在夜間讓所有經過的人都感到毛骨悚然。

definition_zh: (動) 緩慢地蔓延；逐漸接近
example_sentence: Darkness creeps over the mountain as evening approaches slowly.
sentence_zh: 當傍晚緩緩到來時，黑暗逐漸籠罩山頂。

definition_zh: (動) 逐漸接近；悄悄靠近
example_sentence: As winter crept up on the city, temperatures dropped significantly every week.
sentence_zh: 當冬天逐漸降臨這座城市時，氣溫每週都明顯下降。

definition_zh: (動) 爬行；緩慢移動　(名) 令人不快的人
example_sentence: Creeping slowly across the dark room, the burglar avoided the alarm system.
sentence_zh: 竊賊緩慢地爬過黑暗的房間，避開了警報系統。

definition_zh: (形) 令人毛骨悚然的；恐怖的　(形) 令人不安的；詭異的
example_sentence: The abandoned house that stands on the dark hill is creepy and attracts few visitors.
sentence_zh: 那棟坐落在黑暗山丘上、已廢棄的房子令人毛骨悚然，很少有人前往。

definition_zh: (動) 火化；火葬
example_sentence: If the family chooses to cremate the deceased, the ashes will be scattered at sea.
sentence_zh: 如果家人選擇火化逝者，骨灰將被撒入海中。

definition_zh: (名) 火葬；火化
example_sentence: Cremation is a common practice for disposing of the dead in many countries.
sentence_zh: 火葬是許多國家處理遺體的普遍做法。

definition_zh: (名) 火葬場；焚化爐
example_sentence: The city built a new crematorium to handle the growing need for respectful funeral services.
sentence_zh: 這座城市興建了一間新的火葬場，以滿足越來越多人對於尊重喪葬服務的需求。

definition_zh: (名) 可麗餅；薄煎餅
example_sentence: The French crepe restaurant near our school serves delicious sweet and savory crepes.
sentence_zh: 我們學校附近的法式可麗餅餐廳提供美味的甜味和鹹味可麗餅。

definition_zh: (名) 新月；月牙　(形) 彎曲的；逐漸增加的
example_sentence: As the crescent moon appeared in the night sky, students finished their evening study sessions.
sentence_zh: 當新月出現在夜空中時，學生們完成了他們的晚間讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 山頂；頂峰　(動) 到達頂點；登上
example_sentence: Having crested the mountain after hours of climbing, the hikers finally enjoyed the breathtaking view.
sentence_zh: 登山者在攀登數小時後到達山頂，終於享受到了令人驚嘆的景色。

definition_zh: (名) 智障者；低能兒　(形) 愚蠢的；低能的
example_sentence: The employee whose incompetence was a cretin made countless mistakes at work.
sentence_zh: 那位無能的員工是個低能者，在工作中犯了無數錯誤。

definition_zh: (名) 裂縫；細縫　(名) 狹窄的空隙
example_sentence: The tiny crevice between the rocks provided shelter for small insects.
sentence_zh: 岩石之間的細小裂縫為小昆蟲提供了庇護所。

definition_zh: (名) 船員；工作人員　(動) 划船；當船員
example_sentence: If the film crew had arrived earlier, the movie production would have started on schedule.
sentence_zh: 如果電影工作團隊早一點到達，電影製作就會按時開始。

definition_zh: (名) 嬰兒床；小床　(動) 抄襲；舞弊
example_sentence: The baby sleeps soundly in the wooden crib every night.
sentence_zh: 嬰兒每晚在木製嬰兒床裡睡得很熟。

definition_zh: (名) 頸部的痛性肌肉扭傷；脖子酸痛　(動) 使頸部扭傷；弄傷脖子
example_sentence: Waking up with a stiff neck, Sarah suffered from a painful crick that lasted all morning.
sentence_zh: 莎拉醒來時脖子僵硬，整個上午都因為頸部扭傷而感到疼痛。

definition_zh: (名) 蟋蟀；板球
example_sentence: As the cricket chirped loudly throughout the night, many students found it hard to concentrate on their study.
sentence_zh: 當蟋蟀整晚大聲鳴叫時，許多學生發現很難專心讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 犯罪；罪行　(名) 犯罪行為；嚴重違法
example_sentence: Seldom does a single witness solve major crimes without additional evidence.
sentence_zh: 很少有單一證人在沒有額外證據的情況下破獲重大犯罪。

definition_zh: (形) 犯罪的；刑事的　(名) 罪犯；犯人
example_sentence: The criminal who robbed the convenience store was arrested by police yesterday.
sentence_zh: 搶劫便利商店的罪犯昨天被警察逮捕。

definition_zh: (名) 犯罪學；刑事學
example_sentence: Police officers study criminology to understand criminal behavior patterns better.
sentence_zh: 警察研究犯罪學以便更好地理解犯罪行為的模式。

definition_zh: (動) 感到尷尬；退縮　(名) 尷尬；令人不適的感覺
example_sentence: Watching embarrassing videos online makes many students cringe with discomfort.
sentence_zh: 看線上的尷尬影片讓許多學生感到不舒服而退縮。

definition_zh: (形) 令人尷尬的；令人不舒服的
example_sentence: The awkward dancing in that music video was totally cringeworthy.
sentence_zh: 那部音樂影片中尷尬的舞蹈動作真的令人感到不舒服。

definition_zh: (動) 使跛腳；傷殘　(動) 削弱；癱瘓
example_sentence: Although the accident crippled his left leg, John never gave up pursuing his dream of becoming an athlete.
sentence_zh: 雖然那場意外使他左腿傷殘，約翰從未放棄成為運動員的夢想。

definition_zh: (形) 殘廢的；受傷的　(動) 使殘廢；削弱
example_sentence: Crippled by injury, the athlete could not compete in the national championship.
sentence_zh: 因傷致殘，這位運動員無法參加全國錦標賽。

definition_zh: (名) 危機；困境　(名) 關鍵時刻；轉折點
example_sentence: The financial crisis that hit the country in 2008 caused widespread economic hardship.
sentence_zh: 2008年襲擊該國的金融危機造成了廣泛的經濟困難。

definition_zh: (形) 酥脆的；新鮮的　(形) 清爽的；清晰的
example_sentence: If the apple remains crisp and fresh, eating it immediately will taste much better.
sentence_zh: 如果蘋果保持酥脆新鮮，立即吃它會好吃得多。

definition_zh: (形) 酥脆的；脆的　(形) 新鮮的；清爽的
example_sentence: The fried chicken skin was golden and crispy on the outside.
sentence_zh: 炸雞的皮金黃酥脆。

definition_zh: (動) 交叉；縱橫交錯　(形) 交叉的；縱橫交錯的
example_sentence: The hiking trail crisscrosses the mountain to provide hikers with multiple scenic viewpoints.
sentence_zh: 登山步道縱橫交錯地穿過山區，以便提供登山者多個風景優美的觀景點。

definition_zh: (名) 標準；準則　(名) 評判基準；衡量尺度
example_sentence: Academic performance and teacher evaluation are two important criteria for college admission.
sentence_zh: 學業成績和教師評價是大學入學的兩項重要標準。

definition_zh: (名) 評論家；批評家　(名) 批評者；挑剔者
example_sentence: Because the film critic praised the movie highly, many students went to see it during the holiday.
sentence_zh: 由於電影評論家高度讚揚這部電影，許多學生在假期間去看了它。

definition_zh: (形) 批判性的；關鍵的　(形) 危急的；嚴重的
example_sentence: Having received critical feedback from teachers, the student revised the essay thoroughly.
sentence_zh: 在收到老師的批判性意見後，這名學生徹底修改了論文。

definition_zh: (副) 批判性地；用批評的態度　(副) 危急地；極度地
example_sentence: The research findings, which were critically examined by experts, proved the new theory was flawed.
sentence_zh: 這項研究發現經專家嚴格批評性審視後，證明新理論有缺陷。

definition_zh: (名) 批評；評論　(名) 批評意見；挑剔
example_sentence: Receiving constructive criticism from teachers helps students improve their writing skills effectively.
sentence_zh: 從老師那裡獲得建設性的批評，能幫助學生有效地改進寫作技巧。

definition_zh: (動) 批評；指責　(動) 評論；評估
example_sentence: If the teacher criticized the student's essay more carefully, the student would improve his writing skills significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果老師更仔細地批評學生的作文，學生就會大幅提高寫作能力。

definition_zh: (動) 批評；評論　(名) 批評；評論
example_sentence: Criticizing the film's weak plot, the reviewer suggested better character development.
sentence_zh: 評論家批評該電影情節薄弱，並建議加強人物發展。

definition_zh: (名) 小動物；昆蟲
example_sentence: When the campers heard strange noises outside their tent, they worried that critters might be nearby.
sentence_zh: 當露營者聽到帳篷外傳來奇怪的聲音時，他們擔心小動物可能就在附近。

definition_zh: (名) 鉤針編織；鉤針工藝　(動) 用鉤針編織；鉤編
example_sentence: Only after mastering basic stitches does crochet become an enjoyable hobby for beginners.
sentence_zh: 只有在掌握基本針法之後，鉤針編織才能成為初學者享受的嗜好。

definition_zh: (名) 鱷魚；鱷魚皮
example_sentence: The crocodile that lives in the river is a dangerous predator hunters must avoid.
sentence_zh: 住在河裡的鱷魚是獵人必須避開的危險捕食者。

definition_zh: (名) 可頌甜甜圈；可頌和甜甜圈的混合甜點
example_sentence: Many bakeries create cronuts to attract customers who enjoy both flaky pastries and fried dough.
sentence_zh: 許多麵包店製作可頌甜甜圈以吸引喜歡酥脆麵包和炸麵包的顧客。

definition_zh: (名) 密友；親信　(形) 與親信相關的
example_sentence: The politician was accused of giving government contracts to crony business partners for personal gain.
sentence_zh: 該政治人物被控把政府合約發給親信商業夥伴以謀取私利。

definition_zh: (名) 騙子；壞人　(名) 彎曲的東西；彎柄　(動) 彎曲；彎起
example_sentence: The crook stole money from the bank and ran away quickly.
sentence_zh: 那個騙子從銀行偷了錢，然後迅速逃跑。

definition_zh: (形) 彎曲的；不直的　(形) 不誠實的；腐敗的
example_sentence: Although the road was crooked, the taxi driver navigated it skillfully without slowing down.
sentence_zh: 雖然這條路彎曲不平，計程車司機卻靈巧地駕駛，沒有減速。

definition_zh: (動) 突然出現；意外發生
example_sentence: Having studied the old documents, unexpected problems cropped up during the project.
sentence_zh: 在檢查舊文件後，專案進行中突然出現了預料之外的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 農作物；莊稼　(動) 剪短；裁剪　(形) 短的；修剪過的
example_sentence: The farmer harvested the rice crop, which had grown well despite the drought.
sentence_zh: 那位農民收割了水稻，儘管遭遇乾旱，它仍然長得很好。

definition_zh: (名) 農田；耕地
example_sentence: If cropland is not properly maintained, soil quality will gradually decrease over time.
sentence_zh: 如果農田沒有得到適當維護，土壤品質會逐漸下降。

definition_zh: (名) 炸丸子；可樂餅
example_sentence: The cafeteria serves crispy croquettes with mashed potatoes every Friday.
sentence_zh: 學食堂每週五都提供炸丸子配馬鈴薯泥。

definition_zh: (動) 刪除；劃掉　(動) 取消；排除
example_sentence: Students cross off completed tasks to track their study progress effectively.
sentence_zh: 學生劃掉已完成的任務以便有效追蹤他們的學習進度。

definition_zh: (動) 劃掉；刪除　(動) 塗黑；消除
example_sentence: The teacher asked students to cross out the incorrect answers before submitting the exam.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生在交卷前劃掉不正確的答案。

definition_zh: (動) 背叛；出賣　欺騙；捉弄
example_sentence: When Mark promised to keep the secret but told everyone at school, he really crossed up his best friend.
sentence_zh: 當馬克答應保守秘密，卻在學校告訴所有人時，他真的背叛了他最好的朋友。

definition_zh: (形) 越野的；跨越多個地區的　(名) 越野運動；越野賽跑
example_sentence: Having completed the cross-country race, the exhausted runners celebrated their achievement with their teammates.
sentence_zh: 完成越野賽跑後，精疲力竭的跑步者與隊友一起慶祝他們的成就。

definition_zh: (動) 穿著異性服裝；跨性別穿衣　(名) 異性服裝穿著；跨性別裝扮
example_sentence: The performer who cross-dresses for the theatrical production challenges traditional gender norms effectively.
sentence_zh: 為戲劇製作而穿著異性服裝的表演者有效地挑戰了傳統性別規範。

definition_zh: (動) 盤問；詰問　(名) 盤問；交叉詢問
example_sentence: The lawyer will cross-examine the witness about the events of that night.
sentence_zh: 律師將盤問證人關於那晚發生的事件。

definition_zh: (形) 跨越多個產業的；跨產業的
example_sentence: If companies adopted cross-industry collaboration, innovation would accelerate across technology, healthcare, and finance sectors.
sentence_zh: 如果公司採納跨產業合作，創新將會在科技、醫療和金融部門加速發展。

definition_zh: (動) 穿過；通過　(形) 生氣的；不悅的　(名) 十字；交叉
example_sentence: Students cross the busy street carefully every morning.
sentence_zh: 學生每天早上小心地穿過繁忙的街道。

definition_zh: (名) 十字路口；穿越　(動) 穿過；越過　(形) 相交的；橫過的
example_sentence: Crossing the busy street, the elderly woman held onto the railing tightly.
sentence_zh: 穿越繁忙的街道時，這位老婦人緊緊握住欄杆。

definition_zh: (名) 十字路口；岔路　(名) 關鍵時刻；轉折點
example_sentence: When the company reached a crossroad, the CEO had to make a difficult decision about the company's future direction.
sentence_zh: 當公司到達十字路口時，執行長必須做出關於公司未來方向的困難決定。

definition_zh: (名) 行人穿越道；斑馬線
example_sentence: Only at the crosswalk can pedestrians safely cross the busy street.
sentence_zh: 只有在行人穿越道，行人才能安全地穿過繁忙的街道。

definition_zh: (動) 蹲；彎腰　(名) 蹲的姿勢
example_sentence: The athlete crouched behind the wall, waiting for the signal that would start the race.
sentence_zh: 運動員蹲在牆後面，等待開始比賽的信號。

definition_zh: (名) 烏鴉；烏鴉色　(動) 發出烏鴉聲；吹牛
example_sentence: The farmer installed a scarecrow in the field to prevent crows from eating the crops.
sentence_zh: 農夫在田裡裝設稻草人以防止烏鴉吃掉農作物。

definition_zh: (名) 人群；群眾　(動) 擁擠；聚集
example_sentence: A large crowd of students gathered outside the school gate waiting for the concert to begin.
sentence_zh: 一大群學生聚集在校門口外，等待音樂會開始。

definition_zh: (形) 擁擠的；人多的　(形) 充滿的；滿是的
example_sentence: The subway during rush hour is always very crowded with commuters.
sentence_zh: 尖峰時段的捷運總是擠滿通勤者，非常擁擠。

definition_zh: (名) 皇冠；王冠　(動) 為…加冕；居首
example_sentence: As the athlete crossed the finish line, the gold medal crowned their years of hard training.
sentence_zh: 當運動員衝過終點線時，金牌為他們多年的艱苦訓練畫上句號。

definition_zh: (形) 關鍵的；決定性的　(形) 極其重要的；至關緊要的
example_sentence: Facing the crucial exam, students studied hard every night without complaining.
sentence_zh: 面對關鍵的考試，學生們每晚都認真唸書，毫無怨言。

definition_zh: (形) 粗糙的；未加工的　(形) 粗魯的；無禮的
example_sentence: The crude oil that comes from underground needs to be refined before it becomes gasoline.
sentence_zh: 來自地下的原油在變成汽油之前需要經過提煉。

definition_zh: (形) 殘忍的；無情的　(形) 令人痛苦的；嚴酷的
example_sentence: If the experiment involves cruel treatment of animals, the research committee will reject the proposal immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果實驗涉及對動物的殘忍對待，研究委員會將立即拒絕該提案。

definition_zh: (名) 殘忍；殘酷　(名) 虐待；傷害行為
example_sentence: The treatment of animals in that factory shows terrible cruelty toward innocent creatures.
sentence_zh: 那家工廠對待動物的方式顯示出對無辜生物的可怕殘忍。

definition_zh: (動) 輕鬆通過；順利經過
example_sentence: Students study hard all semester to cruise through the final exam.
sentence_zh: 學生整個學期努力讀書，為的是要輕鬆通過期末考。

definition_zh: (動) 航海旅遊；巡航　(名) 遊輪旅程；巡航
example_sentence: Many families enjoy taking a cruise ship vacation during summer holidays.
sentence_zh: 許多家庭喜歡在暑假期間搭乘遊輪度假。

definition_zh: (名) 巡洋艦；遊艇　(名) 巡邏車；警車
example_sentence: When the naval cruiser patrolled the harbor, local fishermen felt safer from pirate attacks.
sentence_zh: 當海軍巡洋艦在港口巡邏時，當地漁民感到更安全，免受海盜襲擊。

definition_zh: (動) 弄碎；撕碎　(動) 往下；放下
example_sentence: Having crumbed down the stale bread, the baker mixed it into the new dough for texture.
sentence_zh: 麵包師傅把陳舊的麵包弄碎後，混入新麵團中以增加口感。

definition_zh: (名) 麵包屑；碎片　(動) 撒麵包屑；弄碎
example_sentence: The cake crumbs that fell on the table were quickly swept away by Mother.
sentence_zh: 掉在桌子上的蛋糕麵包屑被媽媽迅速掃掉了。

definition_zh: (動) 碎裂；崩潰　(名) 碎片；崩潰
example_sentence: The old wall crumbles into dust after years of rain and wind.
sentence_zh: 這堵老牆經過多年的雨風侵襲而碎裂成灰塵。

definition_zh: (形) 易碎的；酥脆的　(形) 粉狀的；鬆散的
example_sentence: If the cookie were less crumbly, it would hold together better during transport.
sentence_zh: 如果餅乾較不易碎，它在運輸過程中會保持得更好。

definition_zh: (名) 英式鬆餅；烤餅
example_sentence: Eating warm crumpets with butter and jam is a British tea tradition.
sentence_zh: 吃塗著奶油和果醬的溫熱英式鬆餅是英國下午茶的傳統。

definition_zh: (動) 嘎吱嘎吱地嚼；發出脆響聲　(名) 脆響聲；緊急關頭
example_sentence: Crunching loudly on potato chips, the student distracted everyone during the quiet reading session.
sentence_zh: 那個學生嘎吱嘎吱地咬著薯片，在安靜閱讀課時分散了大家的注意力。

definition_zh: (形) 脆的；發出嘎吱聲的　(副) 發出脆響地；嘎吱嘎吱地
example_sentence: Although the apple tastes crunchy when bitten fresh, it becomes soft after sitting out.
sentence_zh: 雖然新鮮的蘋果咬下去時很脆，但放一會兒後就會變軟。

definition_zh: (動) 壓碎；粉碎　(名) 迷戀；暗戀的人
example_sentence: Only after the heavy machinery crushed the old building did the construction crew clear the site.
sentence_zh: 直到重型機械壓碎舊建築物後，建築工人才清理了該場地。

definition_zh: (名) 地殼；硬皮　(名) 麵包皮；外層
example_sentence: The pizza crust, which was baked until golden brown, impressed all the students at the cafeteria.
sentence_zh: 那個烤到金黃色的披薩外皮給學食堂的所有學生留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 拐杖；支撑物　(動) 依靠；支撑
