example_sentence: After breaking her leg, Maria used crutches to walk around school.
sentence_zh: 瑪莉亞腿骨折後，使用拐杖在學校裡走動。

definition_zh: (動) 取消；退出　(動) 放棄；不參加
example_sentence: After injuring his ankle, the runner cried off the marathon competition.
sentence_zh: 跑步者腳踝受傷後，取消了馬拉松比賽的參賽資格。

definition_zh: (動) 大聲喊叫；呼救
example_sentence: When the child got lost, crying out for help brought immediate attention from nearby shoppers.
sentence_zh: 當孩子走失時，大聲呼救立刻引起附近購物者的注意。

definition_zh: (動) 哭；哭泣　(名) 哭聲；叫喊
example_sentence: Although the movie was sad, many audience members tried not to cry during the emotional scene.
sentence_zh: 雖然電影很傷感，但許多觀眾在那個感人的場景中試著不哭。

definition_zh: (名) 晶體；水晶　(形) 清澈的；透明的
example_sentence: Sparkling crystal glasses, displayed on the shelf, caught the afternoon sunlight beautifully.
sentence_zh: 閃閃發光的水晶玻璃杯陳列在架子上，漂亮地捕捉了午後的陽光。

definition_zh: (名) 幼獸；小熊　(名) 年輕缺乏經驗的人
example_sentence: The bear cub, which was separated from its mother, was rescued by wildlife experts.
sentence_zh: 那隻與母熊分離的小熊被野生動物專家救了下來。

definition_zh: (名) 立方體；正方形　(動) 切成立方體；立方
example_sentence: If students understand the cube formula, calculating the volume of a box becomes much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果學生理解立方體公式，計算盒子的體積就會變得簡單得多。

definition_zh: (形) 立方的；立方體的　(形) 三次方的
example_sentence: The cubic box contains exactly one thousand small cubes inside.
sentence_zh: 這個立方體盒子裡面恰好裝著一千個小立方體。

definition_zh: (名) 立體主義；立體派
example_sentence: Artists developed cubism to break down objects into geometric shapes.
sentence_zh: 藝術家發展立體主義以便將物體分解成幾何形狀。

definition_zh: (名) 布穀鳥；杜鵑鳥　(形) 瘋狂的；古怪的
example_sentence: The cuckoo bird lays its eggs in other birds' nests without caring for them.
sentence_zh: 布穀鳥在其他鳥類的巢中產卵，而不照顧牠們。

definition_zh: (名) 小黃瓜；黃瓜
example_sentence: As long as fresh cucumbers are available at the market, Mother will make a delicious salad.
sentence_zh: 只要市場有新鮮的小黃瓜，媽媽就會做一道美味的沙拉。

definition_zh: (動) 擁抱；依偎　(名) 擁抱；親密接觸
example_sentence: Having cuddled with her puppy, Sarah felt warm and comforted after a difficult day.
sentence_zh: 莎拉與她的小狗依偎在一起後，在困難的一天後感到溫暖和安慰。

definition_zh: (形) 令人想擁抱的；可愛的　(形) 溫暖舒適的
example_sentence: The teddy bear, which looks cuddly and soft, has been my favorite toy since childhood.
sentence_zh: 那隻看起來令人想擁抱且柔軟的泰迪熊，自童年以來一直是我最喜歡的玩具。

definition_zh: (名) 提示；暗示　(動) 給予提示；提醒
example_sentence: The actor waited for his cue to enter the stage and deliver his opening lines.
sentence_zh: 這位演員等待舞台進場的提示，好念出他的開場台詞。

definition_zh: (名) 袖口；褲腳　(動) 掌摑；拍打
example_sentence: If the shirt cuff were not so tight, the student would wear it more comfortably during the school day.
sentence_zh: 如果襯衫的袖口不那麼緊，這名學生在上課日會穿得更舒服。

definition_zh: (名) 菜系；烹飪風格　(名) 食物；料理
example_sentence: Italian cuisine is famous for its pasta and fresh tomatoes worldwide.
sentence_zh: 義大利菜系以其義大利麵和新鮮番茄聞名全球。

definition_zh: (副) 在烹飪上；從料理的角度
example_sentence: Combining fresh herbs and quality ingredients, the chef created a culinarily impressive dish that impressed all the judges.
sentence_zh: 主廚結合新鮮香草和優質食材，創造出一道在烹飪上令人印象深刻的菜餚，給所有評審留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (形) 烹飪的；廚藝的　(形) 烹飪有關的；食物的
example_sentence: Because culinary skills require constant practice, many chefs spend years perfecting their craft.
sentence_zh: 由於烹飪技能需要持續練習，許多廚師花費多年來完善他們的手藝。

definition_zh: (動) 篩選；淘汰　(動) 挑選；採集
example_sentence: Seldom does a farm cull weak animals from its herd without careful planning.
sentence_zh: 農場很少不經過仔細規劃就從畜群中淘汰弱小的動物。

definition_zh: (動) 達到頂點；終於發生　(動) 以…作為結束
example_sentence: The graduation ceremony, which culminated in the principal's speech, moved every student present.
sentence_zh: 畢業典禮以校長的演講作為結束，這個典禮感動了在場的每一位學生。

definition_zh: (名) 犯人；罪魁禍首　(名) 責任人；肇事者
example_sentence: The police worked hard to find the culprit in order to bring justice to the victim.
sentence_zh: 警察努力工作以找到犯人，目的是為受害者伸張正義。

definition_zh: (名) 邪教；異端宗教　(名) 狂熱追隨者；膜拜團體
example_sentence: The dangerous cult demanded that members give up all their money and family connections.
sentence_zh: 這個危險的邪教要求成員交出所有金錢並斷絕家庭關係。

definition_zh: (形) 可耕種的；適合種植的
example_sentence: The farmer discovered that the rocky land near the river was cultivatable after clearing away stones.
sentence_zh: 農民清除石頭後，發現河邊那塊多石的土地是可耕種的。

definition_zh: (動) 培養；栽培　(動) 種植；耕種
example_sentence: As students cultivate good study habits, their academic performance improves significantly over time.
sentence_zh: 當學生培養良好的讀書習慣時，他們的學業成績會隨著時間顯著進步。

definition_zh: (形) 文化的；文化相關的　(形) 傳統的；習俗的
example_sentence: Participating in cultural festivals, students learn traditional customs and values.
sentence_zh: 參與文化節慶活動，學生們學習傳統習俗和價值觀。

definition_zh: (名) 文化；文明　(名) 修養；素質
example_sentence: The traditional culture that Taiwan has preserved for centuries inspires young artists today.
sentence_zh: 台灣保存了數百年的傳統文化鼓舞了今天的年輕藝術家。

definition_zh: (形) 笨重的；難處理的　(形) 繁雜的；複雜的
example_sentence: If the computer system were less cumbersome, office work would become much more efficient.
sentence_zh: 如果電腦系統不那麼笨重，辦公室工作會變得更有效率。

definition_zh: (形) 累積的；逐漸增加的
example_sentence: Regular exercise combined with healthy eating produces cumulative effects on body fitness.
sentence_zh: 規律運動結合健康飲食對身體健康產生累積效果。

definition_zh: (形) 狡猾的；精明的　(名) 狡詐；詭計
example_sentence: The fox used cunning tricks to escape from the hunter's trap.
sentence_zh: 那隻狐狸用狡猾的詭計逃脫了獵人的陷阱。

definition_zh: (名) 杯子；杯狀物　(動) 用手掌形成杯狀；握住
example_sentence: Coffee cup and tea cup are common household items in Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 咖啡杯和茶杯是台灣常見的日用品。

definition_zh: (名) 碗櫃；食物櫃
example_sentence: Whenever Sarah opens the cupboard before breakfast, she finds her favorite cereal inside.
sentence_zh: 每當莎拉在早餐前打開碗櫃時，她都會發現她最喜歡的麥片在裡面。

definition_zh: (名) 丘比特（羅馬愛神）；愛情的象徵
example_sentence: Aided by Cupid's arrow, the two strangers fell madly in love at first sight.
sentence_zh: 受到丘比特之箭的幫助，這兩個陌生人一見鐘情地瘋狂墜入愛河。

definition_zh: (形) 可治癒的；可治療的
example_sentence: Many diseases that were once fatal are now curable with modern medical treatment.
sentence_zh: 許多曾經致命的疾病現在用現代醫療方法是可以治癒的。

definition_zh: (動) 精心挑選；策劃　(名) 策展人；館長
example_sentence: The museum director carefully curates each exhibition to tell meaningful stories about Taiwanese history.
sentence_zh: 博物館主任精心策劃每一場展覽，講述關於臺灣歷史的有意義故事。

definition_zh: (名) 策展人；館長　(動) 策劃；組織展覽
example_sentence: If the museum curator had selected different artworks, the exhibition would have attracted more international visitors.
sentence_zh: 如果博物館策展人選擇了不同的藝術作品，這個展覽本來會吸引更多國際遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 路緣；馬路邊　(動) 抑制；控制
example_sentence: The government is trying to curb pollution by encouraging electric vehicles.
sentence_zh: 政府試圖透過鼓勵電動車來抑制污染。

definition_zh: (名) 凝乳；乳酪　(動) 凝結；結塊
example_sentence: Heating milk and adding bacteria, curds form gradually during cheese production.
sentence_zh: 加熱牛奶並加入細菌，乳酪生產過程中凝乳逐漸形成。

definition_zh: (動) 凝結；變酸　(動) 使…凝結
example_sentence: As the milk curdled in the heat, the entire batch of yogurt was ruined.
sentence_zh: 當牛奶在高溫中凝結時，整批優格都報廢了。

definition_zh: (名) 萬靈丹；包治百病的良藥　(形) 萬能的；能解決所有問題的
example_sentence: Seldom does any single medicine serve as a cure-all for serious diseases.
sentence_zh: 很少有單一藥物能成為嚴重疾病的萬靈丹。

definition_zh: (動) 治癒；治療　(名) 療法；治療方法
example_sentence: The new medicine, which doctors believe can cure the disease, offers hope to patients.
sentence_zh: 醫生相信能治癒該疾病的新藥，為患者帶來希望。

definition_zh: (名) 宵禁；夜間禁令　(動) 對…實施宵禁
example_sentence: The government imposed a curfew to prevent teenagers from staying out late.
sentence_zh: 政府實施宵禁以防止青少年在外逗留太晚。

definition_zh: (名) 好奇心；求知欲　(名) 奇異的東西；珍奇物品
example_sentence: A strong curiosity about science and nature drives many students to explore new discoveries.
sentence_zh: 對科學和自然的強烈好奇心驅使許多學生探索新發現。

definition_zh: (形) 好奇的；想知道的　(形) 奇怪的；特別的
example_sentence: Sarah felt curious about the new science experiment and asked many questions.
sentence_zh: 莎拉對新的科學實驗感到好奇，並提出許多問題。

definition_zh: (副) 好奇地；奇怪地
example_sentence: Curiously, the student discovered a hidden note while cleaning the classroom after school.
sentence_zh: 奇怪的是，那個學生在放學後打掃教室時發現了一張隱藏的紙條。

definition_zh: (動) 捲；使彎曲　(名) 捲髮；彎曲物
example_sentence: Curling her hair with a straightener, Sarah prepared for the school dance.
sentence_zh: 莎拉用直髮器捲她的頭髮，為校舞做準備。

definition_zh: (形) 捲曲的；卷的　(形) 彎曲的；螺旋狀的
example_sentence: The girl whose curly hair bounced when she walked always stood out.
sentence_zh: 那位走路時捲髮彈跳的女孩總是很引人注目。

definition_zh: (名) 貨幣；通貨　(名) 流通；現行
example_sentence: If the local currency becomes unstable, many businesses would struggle to plan their budgets.
sentence_zh: 如果當地貨幣變得不穩定，許多企業將難以規劃他們的預算。

definition_zh: (形) 現在的；當前的　(名) 電流；水流；趨勢
example_sentence: The current situation requires us to study harder for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 當前的情況要求我們為學測考試更努力地學習。

definition_zh: (副) 目前；現在　(副) 當前；現階段
example_sentence: Many students study English currently to prepare for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生目前正在學習英文以準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (名) 課程；教學大綱　(名) 全部課程安排；教育課程
example_sentence: The new curriculum includes both traditional subjects and modern technology courses.
sentence_zh: 新的課程包括傳統科目和現代科技課程。

definition_zh: (名) 咖哩；咖哩菜　(動) 梳理；用咖哩調理
example_sentence: As the chef prepared curry for the dinner party, the aroma filled the entire kitchen.
sentence_zh: 當廚師為晚宴準備咖哩時，香氣充滿了整個廚房。

definition_zh: (動) 詛咒；咒罵　(名) 詛咒；髒話
example_sentence: Cursed by bad luck, the team lost every match throughout the season.
sentence_zh: 受到厄運詛咒，該隊在整個賽季中每場比賽都輸了。

definition_zh: (形) 粗略的；匆匆的　(形) 膚淺的；不仔細的
example_sentence: The manager gave the report only a cursory glance before approving the budget.
sentence_zh: 經理在批准預算前，只是粗略地瀏覽了一遍報告。

definition_zh: (動) 削減；縮短　(動) 限制；阻止
example_sentence: Budget cuts forced the school to curtail sports programs and reduce equipment spending.
sentence_zh: 預算削減迫使學校縮短運動項目並減少設備開支。

definition_zh: (名) 窗簾；布幕　(動) 用窗簾遮住；隔開
example_sentence: If the curtain were thicker, morning sunlight wouldn't wake students so early.
sentence_zh: 如果窗簾更厚，早晨的陽光就不會讓學生那麼早醒來。

definition_zh: (名) 曲線；彎曲　(動) 彎曲；轉彎
example_sentence: The road curves gently through the mountain valley.
sentence_zh: 這條道路在山谷中緩緩彎曲。

definition_zh: (形) 彎曲的；有曲線的　(形) 豐滿的；曲線美的
example_sentence: Having a curvy body shape, the model confidently walked down the fashion runway.
sentence_zh: 身材曲線優美，那位模特兒自信地走過時裝秀的跑道。

definition_zh: (名) 靠墊；坐墊　(動) 緩衝；減輕
example_sentence: Although the shock was severe, the airbag cushioned the impact so passengers escaped injury.
sentence_zh: 雖然撞擊很嚴重，但安全氣囊緩衝了衝力，所以乘客逃過一劫。

definition_zh: (名) 監護；照護　(名) 拘留；羈押
example_sentence: Only after the court hearing did the mother gain full custody of her children.
sentence_zh: 只有在法庭聽證會後，母親才獲得孩子的完全監護權。

definition_zh: (形) 按客戶要求製造的；量身訂做的
example_sentence: The wedding dress that the bride wore was custom-made according to her specific measurements.
sentence_zh: 新娘穿著的婚紗是按照她的具體尺寸量身訂做的。

definition_zh: (名) 風俗；習慣　(形) 訂做的；習慣性的
example_sentence: Many families follow traditional customs to celebrate the Lunar New Year festival.
sentence_zh: 許多家庭遵循傳統風俗來慶祝農曆新年。

definition_zh: (副) 通常；慣例上　按照習慣
example_sentence: Taiwanese families customarily gather for dinner on Lunar New Year's Eve.
sentence_zh: 台灣家庭在農曆除夕通常會聚在一起吃晚餐。

definition_zh: (形) 習慣的；按照慣例的　(形) 傳統的；慣常的
example_sentence: It is customary for Taiwanese families to gather together during Lunar New Year.
sentence_zh: 台灣家庭在農曆新年聚在一起是習慣做法。

definition_zh: (名) 顧客；客戶　(名) 消費者；購買者
example_sentence: Although the store was crowded, every customer received polite and helpful service from the staff.
sentence_zh: 雖然商店很擁擠，但每位顧客都從員工那裡得到有禮貌且有幫助的服務。

definition_zh: (動) 客製化；依需要改造　(動) 調整；修改
example_sentence: Customizing the phone's settings, Anna made it perfect for her daily life.
sentence_zh: 安娜透過客製化手機設定，讓它完全符合她的日常需求。

definition_zh: (名) 海關；關稅　(名) 風俗；習慣
example_sentence: The customs officer checked the luggage that the traveler brought into the country.
sentence_zh: 海關官員檢查了旅客帶入該國的行李。

definition_zh: (動) 穿過；抄近路　(動) 打斷；中斷
example_sentence: If students cut across the school garden, they will save ten minutes walking to class.
sentence_zh: 如果學生穿過校園花園，他們就能省下十分鐘的路程到教室。

definition_zh: (片語) 減少；縮減
example_sentence: The government decided to cut back on spending for next year's budget.
sentence_zh: 政府決定縮減明年預算的支出。

definition_zh: (動) 減少；削減　(動) 戒除；停止
example_sentence: Many students cut back on social media to study for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生減少使用社群媒體以準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (動) 減少；削減　(片) 減少使用或消費
example_sentence: To stay healthy, many teenagers need to cut down on sugary drinks and fast food.
sentence_zh: 為了保持健康，許多青少年需要減少喝含糖飲料和吃速食。

definition_zh: (動) 砍倒；減少　(動) 降低；限制
example_sentence: After the company cut down expenses, its profit increased significantly.
sentence_zh: 在公司削減開支之後，利潤顯著增加。

definition_zh: (動) 插入；打斷　(動) 插隊；加入
example_sentence: Having cut in on the conversation, the manager announced the new project timeline.
sentence_zh: 在插入談話之後，經理宣布了新的專案時程。

definition_zh: (動) 插隊；打斷　(動) 突然轉向；切入
example_sentence: The rude passenger who cut in line at the ticket counter annoyed everyone waiting.
sentence_zh: 那個在售票處插隊的無禮乘客惹惱了所有排隊等候的人。

definition_zh: (動) 停止；住手　(動) 別胡鬧；別搗亂
example_sentence: Stop arguing about the homework—just cut it out before the teacher hears you.
sentence_zh: 別再為功課爭執了——別胡鬧，要不老師會聽到。

definition_zh: (動) 切斷；割掉　(動) 中斷；停止供應
example_sentence: If the water supply were cut off, the whole neighborhood would face a serious problem.
sentence_zh: 如果水源被切斷，整個社區將面臨嚴重的問題。

definition_zh: (動) 裁剪；剪下　(動) 停止；戒除
example_sentence: The tailor cut out a new dress pattern from the fabric carefully.
sentence_zh: 裁縫仔細地從布料上裁剪出新的洋裝樣式。

definition_zh: (動) 穿過；貫穿　(動) 抄近路；走捷徑
example_sentence: Cutting through the forest, the hikers found a shortcut to the mountain peak.
sentence_zh: 穿過森林的登山者發現了到達山頂的捷徑。

definition_zh: (動) 切碎；剁碎　(動) 逗笑；惹人發笑
example_sentence: Cut up the vegetables before cooking dinner, so the meal prepares faster.
sentence_zh: 在做晚餐前先把蔬菜切碎，這樣餐點準備得更快。

definition_zh: (動) 切割；剪　(動) 減少；降低　(名) 傷口；切口
example_sentence: Not only did the government cut taxes, but also improved public services.
sentence_zh: 政府不僅削減稅收，還改善了公共服務。

definition_zh: (名) 削減；縮減　(動) 削減；減少
example_sentence: The government announced budget cutbacks that affected many public services.
sentence_zh: 政府宣布了影響許多公共服務的預算削減。

definition_zh: (形) 可愛的；漂亮的　(形) 聰慧的；伶俐的
example_sentence: Many students buy cute stationery to make studying more enjoyable.
sentence_zh: 許多學生購買可愛的文具以使讀書更愉快。

definition_zh: (名) 角質層；表皮　(名) 指甲周圍的皮膚
example_sentence: Regular nail care, including trimming cuticles and moisturizing the nail bed, keeps fingernails healthy and strong.
sentence_zh: 定期的指甲護理，包括修剪角質層和潤澤甲床，能保持指甲健康強壯。

definition_zh: (名) 切割；剪裁　(形) 尖銳的；刺痛的
example_sentence: The cutting of the cake was the best part of the birthday party.
sentence_zh: 蛋糕的切割是生日派對最精彩的部分。

definition_zh: (名) 網路霸凌者；線上欺凌者　(動) 在網路上霸凌；網路騷擾
example_sentence: As cyber-bullies post mean comments online, many students feel anxious about their social media presence.
sentence_zh: 當網路霸凌者在網上發表惡毒評論時，許多學生對自己的社群媒體形象感到焦慮。

definition_zh: (形) 沉迷網路的；網路成癮的　(名) 網路成癮者；網路沉迷者
example_sentence: Spending hours gaming online, cyberholic teenagers often neglect their schoolwork and sleep.
sentence_zh: 沉迷線上遊戲的網路成癮青少年經常忽視功課和睡眠。

definition_zh: (名) 網路暴民；線上集體騷擾
example_sentence: The cybermob that attacked the celebrity's social media account spread harmful rumors.
sentence_zh: 攻擊這位明星社群媒體帳號的網路暴民散播了有害謠言。

definition_zh: (名) 循環；週期　(動) 騎自行車；循環
example_sentence: If students cycle to school regularly, they will improve their physical fitness and reduce carbon emissions.
sentence_zh: 如果學生定期騎自行車上學，他們將會改善體能並減少碳排放。

definition_zh: (名) 騎自行車的人；單車騎士
example_sentence: The cyclist rode along the scenic coastal road every weekend.
sentence_zh: 那位單車騎士每個週末都沿著風景優美的海濱道路騎車。

definition_zh: (名) 圓筒；圓柱　(名) 汽缸；鋼瓶
example_sentence: Engineers designed a metal cylinder to store compressed gas safely.
sentence_zh: 工程師設計了一個金屬圓筒來安全地儲存壓縮氣體。

definition_zh: (形) 圓筒形的；圓柱形的
example_sentence: The cylindrical shape of the water bottle makes it easy to hold and carry.
sentence_zh: 水瓶的圓筒形設計使其易於握持和攜帶。

definition_zh: (形) 憤世嫉俗的；懷疑的　(形) 冷嘲熱諷的；不信任的
example_sentence: Although the campaign promised positive change, cynical voters dismissed the promises as empty rhetoric.
sentence_zh: 雖然這場運動承諾帶來正面改變，但憤世嫉俗的投票者將承諾視為空洞的言辭。

definition_zh: (名) 臘腸犬；短腿獵犬
example_sentence: Having adopted a dachshund from the shelter, Maria now takes daily walks with her energetic new companion.
sentence_zh: 瑪莉亞從收容所領養了一隻臘腸犬後，現在每天都和這隻充滿活力的新伴侶一起散步。

definition_zh: (名) 爸爸；父親
example_sentence: My dad, who works as an engineer, always helps me with my math homework.
sentence_zh: 我的爸爸是工程師，他經常幫我做數學功課。

definition_zh: (名) 水仙花；黃水仙
example_sentence: Golden daffodils bloom in spring gardens across Taiwan every March.
sentence_zh: 金黃色的水仙花每年三月在台灣各地的春季花園裡綻放。

definition_zh: (形) 每天的；日常的　(副) 每天；日常地
example_sentence: If students reviewed their notes daily, their test scores would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生每天複習筆記，他們的考試成績會大幅進步。

definition_zh: (形) 精緻的；優雅的　(形) 嬌小的；纖細的
example_sentence: The dainty teacups displayed in the museum impressed many visitors.
sentence_zh: 博物館展示的精緻茶杯給許多遊客留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 乳製品；牛奶製品　(形) 含乳製品的；與乳製品有關的
example_sentence: Containing dairy products, the breakfast menu offers milk, cheese, and yogurt choices.
sentence_zh: 包含乳製品，早餐菜單提供牛奶、起司和優格的選擇。

definition_zh: (名) 水壩；大壩　(動) 築壩；堵住
example_sentence: Although the dam was built to prevent flooding, it actually changed the river's ecosystem.
sentence_zh: 雖然水壩是為了防止洪水而建造的，但它實際上改變了河流的生態系統。

definition_zh: (名) 損害；損傷　(動) 損害；毀損
example_sentence: Seldom does careless driving cause less damage to vehicles and lives.
sentence_zh: 粗心駕駛很少不對車輛和生命造成傷害。

definition_zh: (形) 受損的；破損的　(形) 受傷的；有缺陷的
example_sentence: The smartphone that fell on the floor was so damaged that nobody wanted to buy it.
sentence_zh: 掉到地板上的智慧型手機損傷得非常嚴重，沒有人想購買。

definition_zh: (形) 有害的；造成損害的　(動) 損害；破壞
example_sentence: Smoking is damaging to reduce lung disease risk in teenagers.
sentence_zh: 抽菸是有害的，會降低青少年減少肺病風險的機會。

definition_zh: (名) 夫人；女士　(名) 棋盤上的王后
example_sentence: The elderly dame managed the historic mansion with remarkable grace and dignity.
sentence_zh: 這位年長的夫人以非凡的優雅和尊嚴管理著這座歷史悠久的莊園。

definition_zh: (動) 詛咒；該死　(形) 該死的；討厭的
example_sentence: Damn! I forgot my phone at home this morning.
sentence_zh: 該死！我今早把手機忘在家裡了。

definition_zh: (形) 該死的；討厭的　(副) 非常地；極其地
example_sentence: Damned as the homework was, students completed it before the deadline.
sentence_zh: 儘管作業令人厭煩，學生們仍在截止日期前完成了它。

definition_zh: (動) 降低；減弱　(動) 抑制；阻止
example_sentence: Dampening the team's initial excitement, the coach warned them about overconfidence before the finals.
sentence_zh: 教練在決賽前抑制了隊伍的初期興奮，警告他們不要過度自信。

definition_zh: (動) 使植物腐爛；使種子枯死
example_sentence: Seedlings that damp off because of excessive moisture require immediate drainage.
sentence_zh: 因過多水分而腐爛的幼苗需要立即排水。

definition_zh: (形) 潮濕的；微溼的　(動) 使潮濕；抑制
example_sentence: If the basement remains damp, mold will grow and damage the stored books.
sentence_zh: 如果地下室保持潮濕，黴菌就會生長並損壞存放的書籍。

definition_zh: (動) 減弱；抑制　(動) 弄濕；潮濕
example_sentence: Heavy rain dampened the students' enthusiasm for the outdoor sports day.
sentence_zh: 大雨澆熄了學生對戶外運動會的熱情。

definition_zh: (名) 減振器；阻尼器　(名) 使氣氛冷淡的人或事
example_sentence: The car's suspension uses a damper to reduce vibration and improve ride comfort.
sentence_zh: 汽車的懸吊系統使用減振器來減少震動並改善乘坐舒適度。

definition_zh: (名) 潮濕；濕度　(名) 潮濕的狀態；受潮
example_sentence: The dampness in the basement caused mold and an unpleasant smell to develop.
sentence_zh: 地下室的潮濕導致黴菌生長和令人不快的氣味產生。

definition_zh: (動) 跳舞；舞動　(名) 舞蹈；舞會
example_sentence: While the music played loudly, students danced together at the school festival happily.
sentence_zh: 當音樂大聲播放時，學生們在校慶活動上開心地一起跳舞。

definition_zh: (名) 舞者；舞蹈家　(名) 跳舞的人
example_sentence: Having trained for years, the dancer performed a stunning solo at the national competition.
sentence_zh: 經過多年訓練，這位舞者在全國比賽中表演了一場精彩的獨舞。

definition_zh: (名) 舞蹈；跳舞　(形) 跳舞的；搖晃的
example_sentence: The dancing performance that the students prepared for the school festival impressed everyone greatly.
sentence_zh: 學生們為校慶準備的舞蹈表演給所有人留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 頭皮屑；頭皮脫屑
example_sentence: Regular shampooing helps remove dandruff and keeps the scalp healthy.
sentence_zh: 定期洗頭有助於去除頭皮屑並保持頭皮健康。

definition_zh: (名) 危險；危害　(動) 使處於危險中
example_sentence: If students ignored traffic rules, they would face serious danger on their way to school.
sentence_zh: 如果學生忽視交通規則，他們上學途中就會面臨嚴重的危險。

definition_zh: (形) 危險的；有危害的　(形) 易出事故的；不安全的
example_sentence: Swimming in rough ocean waters during a typhoon is very dangerous.
sentence_zh: 在颱風期間在洶湧的海水中游泳非常危險。

definition_zh: (形) 潮濕陰冷的；悶濕的
example_sentence: Finding the basement damp and dank, the students decided to hold their club meeting elsewhere.
sentence_zh: 發現地下室潮濕陰冷，學生們決定在別處舉行俱樂部會議。

definition_zh: (動) 敢；膽敢　(名) 挑戰；賭注
example_sentence: Although the exam was difficult, many students dared to attempt the challenging questions.
sentence_zh: 雖然考試很難，許多學生仍敢嘗試那些有挑戰性的題目。

definition_zh: (形) 勇敢的；大膽的　(名) 膽量；大膽行為
example_sentence: Never before has such daring innovation transformed the entire technology industry.
sentence_zh: 從未有過如此大膽的創新改變了整個科技產業。

definition_zh: (形) 黑暗的；暗的　(形) 深色的；深沉的
example_sentence: The abandoned building that stands in the dark corner frightens many local residents.
sentence_zh: 那棟位在黑暗角落的廢棄建築嚇到許多當地居民。

definition_zh: (動) 變暗；使變黑　(動) 加深；變沉重
example_sentence: Maya closed the curtains to darken the bedroom before taking a nap.
sentence_zh: Maya 關上窗簾來使臥室變暗，然後午睡。

definition_zh: (名) 親愛的人；寶貝　(形) 親愛的；心愛的
example_sentence: My darling sister surprised me with a handmade birthday cake yesterday afternoon.
sentence_zh: 我親愛的姐姐昨天下午用自製蛋糕給我驚喜。

definition_zh: (名) 飛鏢；箭　(動) 快速移動；衝向
example_sentence: The athlete threw the dart at the board with great precision.
sentence_zh: 運動員非常精準地將飛鏢投向靶板。

definition_zh: (動) 匆匆完成；趕快寫/做　(動) 迅速離開；衝出去
example_sentence: Before the exam started, Maria dashed off a quick email to her friend about the study plan.
sentence_zh: 考試開始前，瑪麗亞匆匆寫了一封電子郵件給朋友，說明讀書計畫。

definition_zh: (動) 衝刺；急跑　(名) 短跑；衝刺
example_sentence: Dashing across the field, the soccer player scored an amazing goal.
sentence_zh: 那位足球選手衝過球場，進了一個令人驚嘆的球。

definition_zh: (名) 儀表板；控制面板
example_sentence: The car's dashboard, which displays speed and fuel information, helps drivers monitor vehicle performance.
sentence_zh: 汽車的儀表板會顯示速度和燃油資訊，可以幫助駕駛監控車輛狀況。

definition_zh: (名) 數據；資料　(名) 信息；數字
example_sentence: If students collect accurate data from their experiments, the research project will produce reliable conclusions.
sentence_zh: 如果學生從實驗中收集準確的數據，這個研究項目就會得出可靠的結論。

definition_zh: (名) 資料庫；數據庫
example_sentence: The school database stores all student records and grades.
sentence_zh: 學校的資料庫儲存所有學生的紀錄和成績。

definition_zh: (動) 追溯到；起源於
example_sentence: Historians use ancient coins to date back the city's founding to 2000 years ago.
sentence_zh: 歷史學家利用古代硬幣來追溯這座城市的建立時間至2000年前。

definition_zh: (名) 約會；日期　(動) 與…約會；標明日期
example_sentence: My older sister has a dinner date with her boyfriend next Friday evening.
sentence_zh: 我姐姐下個星期五晚上要和男朋友一起吃晚餐約會。

definition_zh: (名) 女兒；千金
example_sentence: Although her daughter was nervous, she performed beautifully at the school concert.
sentence_zh: 雖然她的女兒很緊張，但她在校園音樂會上表現得很漂亮。

definition_zh: (動) 使害怕；使氣餒　(名) 令人害怕的事
example_sentence: Daunted by the difficult math problem, the student asked the teacher for help.
sentence_zh: 被那道難的數學題嚇到，這個學生向老師求助。

definition_zh: (形) 令人畏懼的；艱鉅的
example_sentence: The entrance exam, which seems daunting to many students, requires months of preparation.
sentence_zh: 這場入學考試看起來令人畏懼，需要許多學生準備好幾個月。

definition_zh: (形) 無畏的；勇敢的　(形) 不懼怕的；膽大的
example_sentence: The dauntless firefighters rushed into the burning building to rescue trapped residents.
sentence_zh: 這些無畏的消防隊員衝進燃燒的建築物中救出被困的居民。

definition_zh: (副) 勇敢地；無畏地　(副) 堅定地；毫不畏懼地
example_sentence: If the team faced that powerful opponent dauntlessly, winning the championship would become possible.
sentence_zh: 如果隊伍勇敢地面對那個強大的對手，贏得冠軍就會成為可能。

definition_zh: (動) 突然想起；豁然開朗
example_sentence: After the teacher's explanation, understanding finally dawned on the confused students.
sentence_zh: 在老師的解釋後，理解最終豁然開朗了那些困惑的學生。

definition_zh: (名) 黎明；清晨　(動) 開始；破曉
example_sentence: Waking at dawn, the hikers began their journey up the mountain.
sentence_zh: 登山者在黎明時分醒來，開始攀登山頂的旅程。

definition_zh: (形) 日常的；每日的　(副) 每天地；日常地
example_sentence: As students manage day-to-day homework and exams, balancing sleep becomes increasingly important.
sentence_zh: 當學生處理日常功課和考試時，保持充足睡眠變得越來越重要。

definition_zh: (名) 日子；天　(名) 白天；日間
example_sentence: Only after that day did the students realize the importance of hard work.
sentence_zh: 只有在那一天之後，學生們才意識到努力工作的重要性。

definition_zh: (名) 黎明；破曉　(名) 開始；起點
example_sentence: The hikers reached the mountain peak at daybreak, which was when the sun first appeared.
sentence_zh: 登山者在黎明時到達山頂，那是太陽首次出現的時刻。

definition_zh: (名) 日光；白天的光線　(名) 白天；日間
example_sentence: Students wake up early to catch daylight and study before school.
sentence_zh: 學生早起為了趕上日光，在上學前讀書。

definition_zh: (動) 使目眩；使昏迷　(名) 昏迷；目眩狀態
example_sentence: The bright flash of light left him in a daze, stumbling forward without clear direction.
sentence_zh: 那道明亮的閃光使他目眩，他踉蹌地向前走，沒有清晰的方向感。

definition_zh: (副) 茫然地；困惑地　(副) 無神地；恍惚地
example_sentence: After the long exam, students walked out of the classroom dazedly, barely remembering what they had written.
sentence_zh: 長考試結束後，學生們茫然地走出教室，幾乎記不得自己寫了什麼。

definition_zh: (動) 使眼花繚亂；使驚豔　(名) 耀眼的光芒；令人驚豔的表現
example_sentence: As the stage lights dazzled the audience, the dancer performed with such grace that everyone held their breath.
sentence_zh: 當舞台燈光使觀眾眼花繚亂時，舞者以優雅的姿態表演，令所有人屏住呼吸。

definition_zh: (形) 耀眼的；令人目眩的　(形) 傑出的；非凡的
example_sentence: Shining brightly under the stage lights, the performer's dazzling costume captured everyone's attention.
sentence_zh: 在舞台燈光下閃閃發光，表演者那套耀眼的服裝吸引了所有人的注意。

definition_zh: (形) 死的；無生命的　(形) 完全的；徹底的
example_sentence: The old tree that stood in the school garden for decades finally became dead last winter.
sentence_zh: 那棵在校園裡屹立數十年的老樹，終於在去年冬天完全枯死了。

definition_zh: (名) 截止日期；期限　(名) 最後期限；最後通牒
example_sentence: If students miss the deadline for the project, they will receive a lower grade.
sentence_zh: 如果學生錯過專案的截止日期，他們將獲得較低的分數。

definition_zh: (名) 僵局；停滯　(動) 使陷入僵局
example_sentence: The two companies reached a deadlock in their salary negotiations.
sentence_zh: 這兩家公司在薪資談判上陷入了僵局。

definition_zh: (形) 致命的；極度危險的　(副) 極其；非常
example_sentence: Doctors use antibiotics to treat deadly infections before they become serious.
sentence_zh: 醫生使用抗生素來治療致命感染，以防其變得嚴重。

definition_zh: (形) 面無表情的；毫無感情的　(副) 用毫無表情的方式
example_sentence: The comedian told jokes with a deadpan expression, making the audience unsure whether to laugh.
sentence_zh: 那位喜劇演員面無表情地講笑話，讓觀眾不確定是否應該笑。

definition_zh: (形) 聾的；耳聾的　(形) 不願聽的；漠視的
example_sentence: Although the old musician was deaf, he could still feel the vibrations of the piano.
sentence_zh: 雖然那位老音樂家已經聾了，他仍然能感受到鋼琴的振動。

definition_zh: (動) 使聾；震得耳聾　(動) 使聽不見；淹沒聲音
example_sentence: Deafened by the roaring engine, the mechanic struggled to hear his coworker's warning.
sentence_zh: 被引擎怒吼聲震得耳聾，那位機械師很難聽到同事的警告。

definition_zh: (動) 經營；買賣　(動) 涉及；參與
example_sentence: The company that deals in electronics has expanded its online sales significantly this year.
sentence_zh: 那家經營電子產品的公司今年大幅擴展了線上銷售。

definition_zh: (動) 處理；應付　(動) 與…相處；應對
example_sentence: Learning to deal with stress and pressure is essential for exam success.
sentence_zh: 學會處理壓力對考試成功至關重要。

definition_zh: (名) 交易；協議　(動) 處理；分配　(名) 待遇；對待
example_sentence: If students made a deal with their parents about homework time, conflicts would decrease significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生與父母達成關於做功課時間的協議，衝突會大幅減少。

definition_zh: (名) 經銷商；販賣者　(名) 發牌人
example_sentence: The car dealer offered a special discount to attract more customers.
sentence_zh: 汽車經銷商提供特別折扣來吸引更多顧客。

definition_zh: (名) 經銷商；代理商　(名) 代理店；銷售點
example_sentence: Visiting the car dealership to check out new models, Sarah found a vehicle matching her budget perfectly.
sentence_zh: 莎拉到汽車經銷商展間查看新車型，找到了一輛完全符合她預算的車。

definition_zh: (名) 交易；買賣　(動) 處理；對付　(名) 分配；發牌
example_sentence: While dealing with exam stress, many students find that regular exercise helps them stay focused.
sentence_zh: 當學生在處理考試壓力時，許多人發現定期運動有助於他們保持專注。

definition_zh: (名) 學院院長；系主任
example_sentence: Only after the dean approved the new curriculum did the school implement the changes.
sentence_zh: 只有在院長批准新課程後，學校才實施了這些改變。

definition_zh: (形) 親愛的；寶貴的　(名) 親愛的人；親人
example_sentence: The teacher, dear to every student's heart, retired after forty years.
sentence_zh: 那位受到每個學生深愛的老師在教了四十年後退休了。

definition_zh: (名) 缺乏；短缺　(名) 不足量
example_sentence: Universities need more funding to address the dearth of science teachers in rural schools.
sentence_zh: 大學需要更多資金來解決鄉村地區科學教師短缺的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 死亡；死　(名) 死者；死的狀態
example_sentence: The death of a loved one brings deep sorrow and lasting memories to the family.
sentence_zh: 摯愛的人的死亡為家人帶來深深的哀傷和永久的回憶。

definition_zh: (名) 慘敗；災難　(名) 混亂；失敗
example_sentence: The team's debacle in the championship game disappointed fans across the country.
sentence_zh: 該隊在錦標賽中的慘敗令全國球迷失望。

definition_zh: (名) 貶低；降低身份　(名) 貨幣貶值
example_sentence: As the politician continued spreading false information, the debasement of public trust became increasingly evident to voters.
sentence_zh: 當政客持續散布虛假訊息時，公眾信任的貶低對選民變得愈來愈明顯。

definition_zh: (形) 可辯論的；有爭議的　(形) 值得討論的；未決定的
example_sentence: Debatable as the claim may be, many students question its scientific accuracy.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個說法有爭議，但許多學生質疑其科學準確性。

definition_zh: (名) 辯論；討論　(動) 辯論；爭論
example_sentence: The environmental issue that students debated in class raised important questions.
sentence_zh: 學生在課堂上辯論的環境議題引發了重要的問題。

definition_zh: (動) 縱慾；放蕩　(名) 縱慾；狂歡
example_sentence: If students debauch themselves with excessive partying, their academic performance will suffer greatly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生沉溺於過度派對狂歡，他們的學業表現會大幅下滑。

definition_zh: (動) 削弱；使虛弱　(形) 虛弱的；衰弱的
example_sentence: Lack of exercise and poor nutrition debilitate the body over time.
sentence_zh: 缺乏運動和營養不良會逐漸削弱身體。

definition_zh: (名) 碎片；殘骸　(名) 廢墟；瓦礫
example_sentence: Rescue teams cleared debris to find survivors after the earthquake.
sentence_zh: 救援隊清除碎片以便在地震後尋找倖存者。

definition_zh: (名) 債務；欠債　(動) 欠債；負債
example_sentence: Paying off student loans and credit card debt requires careful budget planning.
sentence_zh: 償還學生貸款和信用卡債務需要仔細的預算規劃。

definition_zh: (動) 揭露謊言；駁斥　(動) 證明...為假；拆穿
example_sentence: After scientists debunked the false claim, the public finally understood the truth about climate change.
sentence_zh: 在科學家駁斥了那個錯誤的說法之後，大眾終於理解了氣候變遷的真相。

definition_zh: (名) 首次演出；初次登場　(動) 首次出現；初次表演
example_sentence: Having debuted on the music stage last year, the young singer performed at three major concerts.
sentence_zh: 去年首次登台後，這位年輕歌手在三場重要演唱會上表演。

definition_zh: (名) 十年；十個
example_sentence: The 1990s was a decade during which technology rapidly changed society.
sentence_zh: 1990年代是一個科技快速改變社會的十年。

definition_zh: (形) 去咖啡因的；無咖啡因的
example_sentence: Many coffee lovers choose decaffeinated coffee in the evening to avoid sleep problems.
sentence_zh: 許多咖啡愛好者在晚上選擇無咖啡因咖啡以避免睡眠問題。

definition_zh: (動) 腐爛；腐蝕；衰退　(名) 腐爛；衰退
example_sentence: If dental hygiene were ignored, teeth would decay and cause serious health problems.
sentence_zh: 如果忽視牙齒衛生，牙齒就會腐爛並造成嚴重的健康問題。

definition_zh: (形) 腐爛的；已衰退的　(動) 腐爛；衰退
example_sentence: The decayed building stood abandoned for many years.
sentence_zh: 那棟腐爛破損的建築物已廢棄多年。

definition_zh: (動) 去世；死亡　(名) 死亡；死亡事件
example_sentence: Having deceased last month, the elderly professor left behind numerous published works and devoted students.
sentence_zh: 已於上月去世的年邁教授留下了許多已發表的著作和忠誠的學生。

definition_zh: (形) 已故的；死亡的　(名) 已故者；死者
example_sentence: Although the deceased grandfather had passed away ten years ago, his family still remembered his kindness.
sentence_zh: 雖然已故的祖父已於十年前去世，他的家人仍然記得他的善良。

definition_zh: (形) 欺騙的；不誠實的　(形) 狡詐的；虛偽的
example_sentence: The deceitful politician who promised lower taxes lost the election.
sentence_zh: 那位承諾降低稅收的欺騙性政治人物在選舉中落選了。

definition_zh: (副) 欺騙地；不誠實地
example_sentence: The salesman spoke deceitfully to persuade customers to buy the product.
sentence_zh: 那名銷售員不誠實地說話，目的是說服顧客購買該產品。

definition_zh: (動) 欺騙；迷惑　(名) 欺騙；詐騙
example_sentence: Dishonest salespeople often deceive customers by hiding product defects.
sentence_zh: 不誠實的業務員常藉由隱瞞產品缺陷來欺騙顧客。

definition_zh: (名) 十二月；冬季最後一個月
example_sentence: December is the coldest month in Taiwan for most students.
sentence_zh: 十二月是台灣大多數學生最冷的月份。

definition_zh: (形) 令人滿意的；不錯的　(形) 得體的；適當的
example_sentence: Although the restaurant's service was decent, the food quality didn't quite meet expectations.
sentence_zh: 雖然餐廳的服務還不錯，但食物品質沒有達到預期。

definition_zh: (副) 適當地；得體地　(副) 相當地；還不錯地
example_sentence: Having prepared thoroughly for the interview, the candidate answered questions decently and impressed the hiring manager.
sentence_zh: 經過充分準備面試，那位候選人回答問題得體，給招聘經理留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (形) 欺騙的；具有迷惑性的　(形) 外表騙人的；容易誤導的
example_sentence: The advertisement that promised quick weight loss proved deceptive, misleading many consumers.
sentence_zh: 那則承諾快速減肥的廣告被證實具有欺騙性，誤導了許多消費者。

definition_zh: (動) 決定；確定　選擇；決意
example_sentence: If students decide on a university major early, they will have more time to prepare.
sentence_zh: 如果學生早早決定大學主修科系，他們會有更多時間準備。

definition_zh: (動) 決定；決心　(動) 判決；裁定
example_sentence: Sarah decided to study medicine after discussing her future with her parents.
sentence_zh: 莎拉與父母談論未來後，決定要讀醫學系。

definition_zh: (副) 明確地；堅定地　決然地；毫無疑問地
example_sentence: The company decided to hire more engineers to improve its product quality decidedly.
sentence_zh: 該公司決定僱用更多工程師以明確改善其產品品質。

definition_zh: (名) 小數；十進制　(形) 小數的；十進位的
example_sentence: Converting a fraction to a decimal form makes calculation easier for most students.
sentence_zh: 將分數轉換成小數形式讓大多數學生更容易進行計算。

definition_zh: (動) 大幅減少；摧毀；使損失慘重
example_sentence: Because the hurricane decimated the coastal villages, aid organizations rushed to provide emergency supplies.
sentence_zh: 因為颶風使沿海村莊遭受巨大破壞，援助機構緊急提供救濟物資。

definition_zh: (形) 可以破譯的；可以理解的
example_sentence: Having studied the ancient manuscript for months, the linguist finally found the text decipherable and revealed its hidden meaning.
sentence_zh: 經過數月研究古代手稿，這位語言學家終於發現文本可以破譯，並揭露了隱藏的含義。

definition_zh: (名) 決策；做決定　(名) 判斷力；決斷力
example_sentence: The decision-making process that affects student futures requires careful thought.
sentence_zh: 影響學生未來的決策過程需要謹慎思考。

definition_zh: (名) 決定；決策　(名) 判決；裁定
example_sentence: Making a final decision about which university to attend requires careful consideration.
sentence_zh: 對於要進哪所大學做出最終決定需要仔細考慮。

definition_zh: (形) 決定性的；果斷的　(形) 明確的；決定結果的
example_sentence: If the team captain were more decisive, winning the championship would become possible.
sentence_zh: 如果隊長更果斷，贏得冠軍就會成為可能。

definition_zh: (動) 裝飾；打扮；布置
example_sentence: The students decked out the classroom with colorful balloons for the graduation party.
sentence_zh: 學生們用五彩氣球裝飾教室，為畢業派對做準備。

definition_zh: (名) 甲板；層板　(動) 裝飾；整理
example_sentence: Decking the cruise ship with colorful flags, the crew prepared for the international festival celebration.
sentence_zh: 船員用彩旗裝飾遊輪甲板，為國際節慶慶祝做準備。

definition_zh: (形) 聲調浮誇的；言辭激昂的
example_sentence: Although the politician delivered a declamatory speech that excited the crowd, many voters questioned whether his promises were realistic.
sentence_zh: 儘管那位政治人物發表了言辭激昂的演講讓群眾興奮，許多選民仍質疑他的承諾是否現實。

definition_zh: (名) 宣言；宣布　(名) 聲明；申報
example_sentence: Not only did the president make a formal declaration, but also promised immediate action.
sentence_zh: 不僅總統發表了正式宣言，而且承諾立即採取行動。

definition_zh: (動) 宣布；聲明　(動) 申報；說明
example_sentence: The president declared a new policy that would benefit all citizens.
sentence_zh: 總統宣布了一項將造福全民的新政策。

definition_zh: (動) 拒絕；婉言謝絕　(動) 下降；衰退　(名) 衰落；下降
example_sentence: The company decided to decline the offer to preserve its independence and avoid unnecessary risk.
sentence_zh: 這家公司決定拒絕該提議，以保護自身的獨立性並避免不必要的風險。

definition_zh: (動) 下降；衰退　(形) 衰落的；遞減的
example_sentence: The declining population in rural areas has become a serious problem for local governments.
sentence_zh: 農村地區人口衰退已成為地方政府的嚴重問題。

definition_zh: (名) 下坡；向下傾斜
example_sentence: The mountain's declivity made hiking down quite challenging for inexperienced climbers.
sentence_zh: 那座山的下坡地形對於沒有經驗的登山者來說相當具有挑戰性。

definition_zh: (動) 解碼；破譯　(動) 理解；領會
example_sentence: As the archaeologist decoded the ancient inscriptions, students listened intently to understand the historical meaning.
sentence_zh: 當考古學家解碼古代銘文時，學生專心聆聽以理解歷史意義。

definition_zh: (動) 停止使用；退役　(名) 停止使用；廢棄
example_sentence: Decommissioning the old nuclear power plant, the government invested heavily in renewable energy sources.
sentence_zh: 停止使用老舊核電廠，政府在再生能源上投入了大量資金。

definition_zh: (形) 停用的；退役的　(動過去分詞) 已停用；已退役
example_sentence: The decommissioned nuclear power plant, which operated for forty years, was finally closed last summer.
sentence_zh: 那座已停用的核電廠在運作了四十年後，終於在去年夏天關閉。

definition_zh: (動) 分解；腐爛　(動) 使分裂；使瓦解
example_sentence: If organic waste were left in the landfill, it would decompose into harmful methane gas.
sentence_zh: 如果有機廢棄物留在垃圾掩埋場，它就會分解成有害的甲烷氣體。

definition_zh: (名) 裝飾；布置
example_sentence: The colorful decor in the restaurant makes customers feel happy and relaxed.
sentence_zh: 餐廳色彩繽紛的裝飾讓顧客感到開心且放鬆。

definition_zh: (動) 裝飾；布置　(動) 授予勳章；表彰
example_sentence: The students painted the classroom walls to decorate the space for graduation.
sentence_zh: 學生粉刷教室的牆壁以裝飾空間迎接畢業典禮。

definition_zh: (名) 裝飾；裝飾品　(動) 裝飾；美化
example_sentence: The colorful balloons and paper chains served as beautiful decorations for the school festival.
sentence_zh: 五彩繽紛的氣球和紙鏈成為學校慶典的美麗裝飾。

definition_zh: (形) 裝飾的；裝飾用的　(名) 裝飾品；裝飾物
example_sentence: Although the vase is decorative, it adds elegance to the living room.
sentence_zh: 雖然花瓶是裝飾性的，但它為客廳增添了優雅。

definition_zh: (動) 分離；脫鉤　解除關聯
example_sentence: Having decoupled the two systems, engineers discovered improved efficiency across both platforms.
sentence_zh: 在分離這兩個系統後，工程師發現兩個平台的效率都提高了。

definition_zh: (動) [dɪˈkris] 減少；降低　(名) [ˈdikris] 減少；下降
example_sentence: The pollution that decreases air quality requires immediate government action.
sentence_zh: 那個降低空氣品質的污染需要政府立即採取行動。

definition_zh: (名) 法令；政令　(動) 下令；頒布
example_sentence: The government issued a new decree banning single-use plastic bags in all stores.
sentence_zh: 政府頒布新法令，禁止所有商店使用一次性塑膠袋。

definition_zh: (動) 致力於；奉獻　(動) 獻身；專注
example_sentence: If athletes dedicated themselves to training daily, they would achieve their Olympic dreams.
sentence_zh: 如果運動員每天致力於訓練，他們就能實現奧運夢想。

definition_zh: (形) 專注的；全心投入的　(形) 獻身的；忠誠的
example_sentence: A dedicated student spends hours studying for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 一位專注的學生花許多小時準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (名) 奉獻；獻身　(名) 專注；投入
example_sentence: Dedicating herself to environmental protection, Maria established a community garden inspiring thousands of teenagers.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞獻身於環境保護，創辦了一個社區花園，激勵了數千名青少年。

definition_zh: (名) 去美元化；減少對美元的依賴
example_sentence: As geopolitical tensions increase, many countries pursue dedollarization so that they reduce their economic dependence on the United States.
sentence_zh: 隨著地緣政治緊張局勢加劇，許多國家推行去美元化，以便減少對美國的經濟依賴。

definition_zh: (動) 減少對美元的依賴；去美元化
example_sentence: Only after several countries began to dedollarize their reserves did global financial systems start to shift.
sentence_zh: 只有在幾個國家開始去美元化他們的外匯儲備之後，全球金融體系才開始轉變。

definition_zh: (動) 推斷；推理　(動) 演繹；推導
example_sentence: Based on the clues that the detective found at the crime scene, he could deduce the suspect's identity.
sentence_zh: 根據偵探在犯罪現場找到的線索，他能推斷出嫌疑人的身份。

definition_zh: (動) 扣除；減去　(動) 推斷；推導
example_sentence: The company will deduct a portion of your salary to pay for health insurance.
sentence_zh: 公司將從你的薪水中扣除一部分來支付健康保險。

definition_zh: (形) 可扣除的；可抵扣的　(名) 免賠額；自付額
example_sentence: With a high deductible health insurance plan, patients pay more out-of-pocket costs before coverage begins.
sentence_zh: 在高自付額的健康保險計畫中，患者在保險開始理賠前需要自己支付更多費用。

definition_zh: (名) 扣除；減少　(名) 推理；推斷
example_sentence: The company made a tax deduction for business expenses this year.
sentence_zh: 今年公司對商業開支進行了稅務扣除。

definition_zh: (名) 行為；事蹟　(動) 做；行動
example_sentence: Although the deed was small, it made a real difference to the community.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個行為很小，但它對社區產生了真實的影響。

definition_zh: (動) 認為；視為　(動) 判定；評定
example_sentence: Deeming the proposal impractical, the committee rejected it without further discussion.
sentence_zh: 委員會認為該提案不切實際，因此未加討論就否決了它。

definition_zh: (片語) 心裡深處；內心深層
example_sentence: The worry that exists deep in one's mind often surfaces when facing major decisions.
sentence_zh: 心裡深處存在的擔憂，往往在面臨重大決定時浮現出來。

definition_zh: (形) 油炸的；炸過的
example_sentence: If the oil temperature is not hot enough, the deep-fried chicken will absorb too much oil.
sentence_zh: 如果油溫不夠熱，油炸雞肉會吸收太多油脂。

definition_zh: (形) 深的；深度大的　(形) 深層的；深入的
example_sentence: The ocean has many deep places where sunlight cannot reach.
sentence_zh: 海洋有許多陽光無法到達的深處。

definition_zh: (動) 加深；深化　(動) 加強；增強
example_sentence: Students read classic literature to deepen their understanding of human nature.
sentence_zh: 學生閱讀經典文學作品來加深對人性的理解。

definition_zh: (副) 深深地；深入地　(副) 認真地；誠摯地
example_sentence: The pollution problem deeply affects air quality and public health in many cities.
sentence_zh: 污染問題深深地影響許多城市的空氣品質和公眾健康。

definition_zh: (名) 鹿；梅花鹿
example_sentence: When hikers enter the forest where deer live, they must move quietly so as not to startle the animals.
sentence_zh: 當登山者進入鹿棲息的森林時，他們必須安靜行動以免嚇到動物。

definition_zh: (名) 誹謗；名譽損害　(動) 誹謗；傷害...的名譽
example_sentence: Having spread false rumors about the celebrity, the blogger was sued for defamation and ordered to pay damages.
sentence_zh: 在散播關於這位名人的虛假謠言後，該部落客因誹謗罪被起訴並被判賠償損失。

definition_zh: (形) 誹謗的；損害名譽的
example_sentence: The newspaper published defamatory statements that harmed the politician's reputation.
sentence_zh: 這家報紙刊登了損害該政治人物名譽的誹謗言論。

definition_zh: (名) 違約；不履行　(動) 未履行義務；違約　(名) 預設值；默認設定
example_sentence: Failing to submit the project on time will result in a default on the assignment.
sentence_zh: 未能按時提交專案將導致該作業被記為違約。

definition_zh: (動) 擊敗；戰勝　(名) 失敗；敗北
example_sentence: If our team practiced harder, we would defeat the champions in next month's final.
sentence_zh: 如果我們隊伍練習更努力，我們將在下個月的決賽中擊敗冠軍隊。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈdifɛkt] 缺陷；瑕疵　(動) [dɪˈfɛkt] 背棄；叛逃
example_sentence: The phone manufacturer recalled all units because a serious defect made the battery overheat.
sentence_zh: 手機製造商召回所有單位，因為一個嚴重缺陷導致電池過熱。

definition_zh: (形) 有缺陷的；不完美的　(形) 故障的；不能正常工作的
example_sentence: Having discovered a defective battery, the technician replaced it immediately.
sentence_zh: 技術員發現電池有缺陷後，立即更換了它。

definition_zh: (名) 防守；防禦　(名) 辯護；抗辯
example_sentence: Although the team's defence improved significantly, they still lost the championship match last weekend.
sentence_zh: 雖然球隊的防守明顯進步，但他們上週末仍然在冠軍賽中落敗。

definition_zh: (動) 保護；防守　(動) 為...辯護；維護
example_sentence: Not only soldiers but also citizens defend their nation against invaders.
sentence_zh: 不僅士兵，市民也保護他們的國家抵禦入侵者。

definition_zh: (名) 被告；被指控的人
example_sentence: The defendant who was accused of theft denied all charges in court.
sentence_zh: 被指控偷竊的被告在法庭上否認了所有指控。

definition_zh: (名) 防守者；後衛　(名) 保護者；辯護人
example_sentence: The defender worked hard to prevent the opponent from scoring goals.
sentence_zh: 防守者努力工作以防止對手進球。

definition_zh: (名) 防守；防衛　(名) 辯護；答辯
example_sentence: The basketball team's strong defense and quick counterattacks helped them win the championship.
sentence_zh: 籃球隊的強力防守和迅速的反擊幫助他們贏得冠軍。

definition_zh: (形) 可防守的；站得住腳的
example_sentence: The government's decision to raise education funding is defensible based on student achievement data.
sentence_zh: 根據學生成績數據，政府提高教育經費的決定是站得住腳的。

definition_zh: (形) 防守的；防禦的　(形) 易怒的；猜疑的
example_sentence: Although the team played defensively throughout the match, they managed to secure a crucial victory.
sentence_zh: 雖然球隊整場比賽採取防守策略，但他們還是設法贏得了關鍵的勝利。

definition_zh: (動) 延遲；推遲　(動) 尊重；服從
example_sentence: Deferring the important decision to next month, the committee members decided to gather more information first.
sentence_zh: 將這個重要決定推遲到下個月，委員會成員決定先蒐集更多資訊。

definition_zh: (名) 尊重；敬意　(名) 讓步；順從
example_sentence: The student showed deference to the teacher who had guided him through difficult problems.
sentence_zh: 這位學生對曾幫助他解決困難問題的老師表示了尊重。

definition_zh: (形) 恭敬的；謙恭的　(形) 尊重他人的；禮貌的
example_sentence: If the student shows deferential respect toward teachers, better relationships will develop naturally.
sentence_zh: 如果學生對老師表現出恭敬的態度，會自然而然地發展出更好的關係。

definition_zh: (名) 違抗；反抗　(動) 公然違抗；蔑視
example_sentence: The student's refusal to follow the unfair rule showed clear defiance of authority.
sentence_zh: 這名學生拒絕遵守不公平的規則，顯示對權威的明確違抗。

definition_zh: (形) 挑戰性的；違抗的　(名) 挑戰者；反抗者
example_sentence: The students organized a protest to defy the unfair school policy.
sentence_zh: 學生們組織了一場抗議活動來違抗這項不公平的校園政策。

definition_zh: (名) 缺乏；不足　(名) 缺陷；缺點
example_sentence: Vitamin C deficiency can weaken the immune system and cause health problems.
sentence_zh: 維生素C缺乏會削弱免疫系統並造成健康問題。

definition_zh: (形) 不足的；缺乏的　(形) 不及格的；不合格的
example_sentence: Because the student's nutrition was deficient, the doctor recommended taking vitamins daily.
sentence_zh: 因為這名學生的營養不足，醫生建議每天服用維生素。

definition_zh: (名) 赤字；虧損　(名) 不足；缺乏
example_sentence: Having accumulated a massive budget deficit over decades, the government finally implemented spending cuts.
sentence_zh: 由於累積了數十年龐大的預算赤字，政府終於實施支出削減。

definition_zh: (動) 污辱；玷污　(動) 破壞；損害
example_sentence: The ancient temple, which soldiers defiled during the war, now stands restored.
sentence_zh: 那座在戰爭中被士兵污辱的古老寺廟，現在已經被修復。

definition_zh: (動) 定義；解釋　(動) 確定；說明
example_sentence: The teacher asked students to define the word "culture" using simple English.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生用簡單的英文定義「文化」這個詞。

definition_zh: (形) 明確的；肯定的　(形) 清楚的；確定的
example_sentence: If the exam date were definite, students would begin preparing their study schedule immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果考試日期是確定的，學生就會立刻開始準備讀書計畫。

definition_zh: (副) 肯定地；確定地　一定；必然
example_sentence: Studying hard will definitely help your CSAT scores improve.
sentence_zh: 認真讀書肯定會幫助你的學測成績進步。

definition_zh: (名) 定義；解釋　(名) 清晰度；鮮明度
example_sentence: Defining difficult words carefully, the teacher helped students understand complex concepts.
sentence_zh: 老師仔細地定義難詞，幫助學生理解複雜的概念。

definition_zh: (形) 最終的；確定的　(形) 權威性的；決定性的
example_sentence: The research findings provided definitive evidence, so the debate about climate change ended.
sentence_zh: 因為研究發現提供了確定的證據，所以關於氣候變遷的辯論就結束了。

definition_zh: (動) 洩氣；使氣球放氣　(動) 打擊士氣；使沮喪
example_sentence: Only after the coach deflated their overconfidence did the team truly improve their performance.
sentence_zh: 只有在教練打擊了球隊的過度自信之後，球隊的表現才真正進步。

definition_zh: (名) 通貨緊縮；物價下跌
example_sentence: Deflation, which reduces consumer spending power, poses serious challenges to economic growth.
sentence_zh: 通貨緊縮會降低消費者的購買力，這對經濟成長造成嚴重挑戰。

definition_zh: (動) 偏轉；轉向　(動) 轉移(注意力)
example_sentence: The goalkeeper jumped to deflect the ball away from the goal.
sentence_zh: 守門員跳起來轉向球以遠離球門。

definition_zh: (動) 砍伐森林；進行森林砍伐
example_sentence: Cutting down trees to deforest large areas threatens endangered animals and their habitats.
sentence_zh: 砍樹以砍伐大片森林威脅到瀕危動物及其棲息地。

definition_zh: (名) 森林砍伐；森林破壞
example_sentence: Deforestation in tropical regions destroys animal habitats and increases carbon dioxide.
sentence_zh: 熱帶地區的森林砍伐破壞了動物棲息地並增加了二氧化碳。

definition_zh: (動) 取消好友關係；刪除朋友
example_sentence: After their argument escalated, Maria defriended him, which made him feel quite hurt.
sentence_zh: 在他們的爭執惡化之後，瑪麗亞取消了他的好友關係，這讓他感到相當受傷。

definition_zh: (動) 解凍；除霜
example_sentence: Defrosting the frozen chicken in the refrigerator, Maria prepared dinner for her family.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞在冰箱裡解凍冷凍雞肉，為家人準備晚餐。

definition_zh: (形) 靈巧的；熟練的　(形) 敏捷的；聰慧的
example_sentence: The surgeon's deft hands, which had performed thousands of operations, moved with precision.
sentence_zh: 那位外科醫生靈巧的雙手（已進行過數千次手術）精確地移動著。

definition_zh: (動) 緩解；化解　消除危險或緊張局面
example_sentence: If the negotiator defuses the tense situation, both sides will reach a peaceful agreement.
sentence_zh: 如果談判代表化解了這個緊張局面，雙方就會達成和平協議。

definition_zh: (動) 違抗；反抗　(動) 挑戰；不畏懼
example_sentence: The young activist defied the unfair school rules and inspired many students.
sentence_zh: 這位年輕的社運人士違抗不公平的校規，激勵了許多學生。

definition_zh: (動) 退化；墮落　(形) 墮落的；頹廢的
example_sentence: Regular exercise helps prevent muscles from degenerating due to age and inactivity.
sentence_zh: 定期運動有助於預防肌肉因年齡和缺乏活動而退化。

definition_zh: (動) 貶低；降低　(動) 使變壞；惡化
example_sentence: Using plastic bags degrades our environment and harms marine animals in the ocean.
sentence_zh: 使用塑膠袋會貶低我們的環境品質並傷害海洋中的動物。
subject_type: gerund + noun (Using plastic bags; our environment)

definition_zh: (名) 學位；程度　(名) 角度；度數
example_sentence: As the temperature rises to 40 degrees, many students struggle to concentrate during summer exams.
sentence_zh: 當溫度上升到40度時，許多學生在夏季考試期間難以集中注意力。

definition_zh: (動) 使脫水；使缺水
example_sentence: Having dehydrated after the marathon, the runner drank water immediately.
sentence_zh: 在馬拉松賽跑後因脫水，這位跑者立即喝了水。

definition_zh: (形) 脫水的；缺水的
example_sentence: Athletes who feel dehydrated during practice should drink water immediately.
sentence_zh: 在練習中感到脫水的運動員應該立即喝水。

definition_zh: (名) 脫水；身體缺水
example_sentence: Drinking enough water prevents dehydration during long sports training.
sentence_zh: 在長時間的運動訓練中喝足夠的水可以防止脫水。

definition_zh: (名) 神祇；神靈　(名) 神；上帝
example_sentence: If ancient Greeks worshipped different deities, their entire civilization would have developed completely differently.
sentence_zh: 如果古代希臘人信仰不同的神祇，他們的整個文明發展方式就會完全不同。

definition_zh: (名) 似曾相識；既視感
example_sentence: Experiencing déjà vu while entering the classroom, Sarah felt oddly familiar with everything.
sentence_zh: 莎拉進入教室時經歷既視感，覺得一切都奇異地熟悉。

definition_zh: (動) 延遲；耽擱　(名) 延遲；遲延
example_sentence: Because the train was delayed by an hour, many passengers missed their connecting flights.
sentence_zh: 因為火車延遲了一小時，許多乘客錯過了他們的轉接班機。

definition_zh: (形) 美味的；令人愉快的　(形) 可口的；誘人的
example_sentence: Seldom have diners encountered such delectable dishes at this price.
sentence_zh: 食客們很少在這個價格下吃到如此美味的菜餚。

definition_zh: (動) [ˈdɛləˌget] 委派；授權　(名) [ˈdɛləgɪt] 代表；代理人
example_sentence: The manager will delegate tasks to team members who demonstrate strong leadership skills.
sentence_zh: 經理會將工作委派給能展現出強大領導能力的團隊成員。

definition_zh: (名) 代表團；授權　(動) 委派；委託
example_sentence: The manager sent a delegation to negotiate with the supplier to reach a fair agreement.
sentence_zh: 經理派遣一個代表團去與供應商談判以達成公平的協議。

definition_zh: (動) 刪除；刪去　(動) 消除；清除
example_sentence: Pressing the delete button will remove the saved file from the computer.
sentence_zh: 按下刪除鍵會將儲存的檔案從電腦中移除。

definition_zh: (形) 有害的；對健康不利的　造成傷害的；有害的
example_sentence: Smoking has deleterious effects on lung health and overall fitness.
sentence_zh: 吸菸對肺部健康和整體體能有害。

definition_zh: (副) 有害地；傷害性地
example_sentence: Although the new policy aims to help students, it deleteriously affects those from low-income families.
sentence_zh: 雖然新政策的目的是幫助學生，但它對低收入家庭學生卻產生了有害的影響。

definition_zh: (動) 仔細考慮；深思熟慮　(形) 故意的；蓄意的；深思熟慮的
example_sentence: Deliberately choosing each word, the student crafted a persuasive essay for the entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 該學生仔細選擇每個詞彙，為入學考試撰寫了有說服力的文章。

definition_zh: (副) 故意地；蓄意地　刻意地；有意地
example_sentence: The student who deliberately copied homework from classmates faced serious consequences.
sentence_zh: 故意從同學抄襲功課的學生面臨嚴重的後果。

definition_zh: (名) 深思熟慮；仔細考慮　(名) 討論；商議
example_sentence: If careful deliberation about college choices happens early, students will avoid regret later.
sentence_zh: 如果學生早期對大學選擇進行仔細考慮，就會避免日後的遺憾。

definition_zh: (名) 精美的食物；佳餚　(名) 優雅；精巧
example_sentence: Shark fin soup is considered a delicacy in some Asian cultures.
sentence_zh: 魚翅湯在某些亞洲文化中被認為是一道佳餚。

definition_zh: (形) 細緻的；精緻的　(形) 虛弱的；脆弱的
example_sentence: Museums use special glass cases to protect delicate artifacts from damage.
sentence_zh: 博物館使用特殊玻璃櫃以保護精緻的古物免受損壞。

definition_zh: (副) 輕輕地；溫柔地　精細地；巧妙地
example_sentence: The violinist's fingers moved delicately across the strings, producing beautiful melodies.
sentence_zh: 小提琴家的手指輕輕地在琴弦上移動，演奏出優美的旋律。

definition_zh: (名) 熟食店；熟食商店
example_sentence: Since the delicatessen near campus opens early, students can grab breakfast there before classes.
sentence_zh: 因為校園附近的熟食店開得早，學生可以在上課前在那裡買早餐。

definition_zh: (形) 美味的；好吃的　(形) 令人愉快的；令人滿意的
example_sentence: Having tasted the homemade pizza, the students found it absolutely delicious and asked for the recipe.
sentence_zh: 嚐過自製披薩後，學生們發現它絕對美味，並索要食譜。

definition_zh: (名) 美味；好吃的特質
example_sentence: The deliciousness that made the dessert so popular was its perfect balance of sweetness.
sentence_zh: 讓甜點如此受歡迎的美味，在於它完美的甜度平衡。

definition_zh: (名) 喜悅；高興　(動) 使…高興；令…愉快　(形) 很高興的；樂意的
example_sentence: The delighted students celebrated winning the school debate competition with joy and pride.
sentence_zh: 那些高興的學生以喜悅和驕傲慶祝贏得校辯論比賽。

definition_zh: (形) 高興的；欣喜的　(動) 使...高興；使...欣喜
example_sentence: If Sarah received an acceptance letter from her dream university, she would be absolutely delighted.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉收到她理想大學的錄取通知書，她會欣喜若狂。

definition_zh: (形) 令人愉快的；使人高兴的　(形) 充满喜悦的；极好的
example_sentence: The delightful dessert made everyone at the dinner party smile happily.
sentence_zh: 那道令人愉快的甜点让晚宴上的每个人都开心地笑了。

definition_zh: (副) 令人愉快地；欣喜地
example_sentence: Discovering a hidden café in Taipei, tourists delightfully enjoyed fresh coffee and traditional snacks.
sentence_zh: 在台北發現一間隱藏的咖啡館，遊客們欣喜地享受新鮮咖啡和傳統小吃。

definition_zh: (動) 描繪；勾勒　(動) 清楚說明；界定
example_sentence: As the artist delineated the mountain's outline, the landscape gradually became clear and recognizable.
sentence_zh: 當藝術家勾勒山的輪廓時，風景逐漸變得清楚可辨。

definition_zh: (形) 違反法律的；不履行義務的　(名) 違法者；逃學者
example_sentence: Seldom do delinquent teenagers realize the serious consequences of their actions.
sentence_zh: 違法的青少年很少意識到他們行為的嚴重後果。

definition_zh: (動) 遞送；運送　傳達；發表
example_sentence: The package that the delivery company delivered yesterday arrived in perfect condition.
sentence_zh: 那個快遞公司昨天遞送的包裹完好無損地送達了。

definition_zh: (名) 遞送；運送　(名) 演說；發表方式
example_sentence: The company hired more drivers to deliver packages on time.
sentence_zh: 那家公司雇用更多司機以準時遞送包裹。

definition_zh: (名) 大洪水；淹沒　(動) 淹沒；大量湧入
example_sentence: Heavy rainfall caused a deluge of water to flood the entire downtown area.
sentence_zh: 豪雨造成大量水流淹沒整個市中心區域。

definition_zh: (動) 要求；需要　(名) 需求；要求
example_sentence: The job demands excellent communication skills and strong teamwork abilities.
sentence_zh: 這份工作需要優秀的溝通技巧和強大的團隊合作能力。

definition_zh: (形) 苛刻的；要求嚴格的　(形) 費時的；耗力的
example_sentence: Although the job is demanding, many students apply for it because the salary is excellent.
sentence_zh: 雖然這份工作要求嚴格，但許多學生仍然申請，因為薪水很優厚。

definition_zh: (動) 貶低；侮辱　(動) 降低身分；自貶
example_sentence: Demeaning others by spreading rumors online damages both their reputation and your character.
sentence_zh: 通過在網上散布謠言來貶低他人，既傷害了他們的聲譽，也傷害了你的品格。

definition_zh: (名) 舉止；風度　(形) 舉止的；儀態的
example_sentence: The student whose calm demeanor impressed the teacher remained focused during the difficult exam.
sentence_zh: 那位舉止沉著令老師印象深刻的學生在困難的考試中保持專注。

definition_zh: (名) 失智症；癡呆
example_sentence: If an elderly person develops dementia, family members must provide constant care and support.
sentence_zh: 如果年長者罹患失智症，家人必須提供持續的照顧和支持。

definition_zh: (動) 使非軍事化；解除武裝
example_sentence: The two countries agreed to demilitarize the border region after signing the peace treaty.
sentence_zh: 這兩個國家在簽署和平條約後同意將邊界地區非軍事化。

definition_zh: (形) 非軍事化的；去軍事化的
example_sentence: The two countries signed a treaty to create a demilitarized zone in order to reduce military tensions.
sentence_zh: 兩國簽署條約以建立非軍事化區域來減少軍事緊張局勢。

definition_zh: (名) 死亡；終結　(動) 導致死亡；終止
example_sentence: The sudden demise of the popular restaurant shocked the local community and disappointed loyal customers.
sentence_zh: 這家受歡迎餐廳的突然倒閉震驚了當地社區，也令忠實客戶感到失望。

definition_zh: (名) 民主制度；民主政體　(名) 民主；民主原則
example_sentence: Because democracy requires citizen participation, voting in elections remains a crucial civic duty.
sentence_zh: 因為民主制度需要公民參與，在選舉中投票仍然是重要的公民責任。

definition_zh: (名) 民主主義者；民主黨人　(形) 民主的；民主主義的
example_sentence: Having championed voting rights for decades, the democrat finally saw meaningful electoral reform passed.
sentence_zh: 那位民主主義者倡導投票權數十年後，終於看到有意義的選舉改革通過。

definition_zh: (形) 民主的；民主制度的　(形) 民主性的；平等的
example_sentence: Students who attend schools with democratic decision-making processes develop stronger leadership skills.
sentence_zh: 參與具有民主決策過程的學校的學生會培養更強的領導能力。

definition_zh: (形) 過時的；不流行的
example_sentence: The demode fashion style from the 1980s rarely appears in modern clothing stores.
sentence_zh: 來自1980年代過時的時尚風格在現代服裝店裡很少出現。

definition_zh: (名) 人口統計學；人口統計資料
example_sentence: If Taiwan's demography continued aging, the government would need to adjust pension policies significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果台灣的人口統計持續老化，政府就必須大幅調整退休金政策。

definition_zh: (動) 拆除；毀壞　(動) 推翻；破壞
example_sentence: The old factory will be demolished to build a new shopping center.
sentence_zh: 舊工廠將被拆除以興建新的購物中心。

definition_zh: (名) 拆除；破壞　(名) 拆毀工程；拆除過程
example_sentence: Demolishing the old factory, workers carefully removed valuable equipment before final destruction.
sentence_zh: 拆除舊工廠時，工人們在最終破壞前小心地移除了貴重設備。

definition_zh: (名) 惡魔；魔鬼　(名) 非常壞的人
example_sentence: Although the villain appeared kind in public, demons of greed controlled his every decision.
sentence_zh: 雖然那個惡棍在公眾面前顯得友善，但貪婪的惡魔控制了他的每一個決定。

definition_zh: (動) 妖魔化；將...描繪成邪惡的
example_sentence: Seldom do politicians avoid demonizing their opponents during election campaigns.
sentence_zh: 政治人物在競選期間很少不妖魔化對手。

definition_zh: (動) 示範；演示　(動) 證明；表明
example_sentence: The science teacher demonstrated an experiment that amazed all students.
sentence_zh: 這位科學老師演示了一個令所有學生驚嘆的實驗。

definition_zh: (名) 示威；抗議　(名) 示範；演示
example_sentence: Students organized a demonstration to raise awareness about climate change.
sentence_zh: 學生組織了一場示威活動來提高人們對氣候變遷的認識。

definition_zh: (形) 表現出來的；容易表達感情的　(名) 指示詞
example_sentence: Sarah's demonstrative behavior and warm hugs made everyone feel welcomed at the party.
sentence_zh: 莎拉表現出來的熱情行為和溫暖的擁抱讓派對上的每個人都感到受歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 示威者；遊行者　(名) 示範者；演示者
example_sentence: The demonstrators marched through the city streets protesting the new education policy.
sentence_zh: 示威者在城市街道上遊行，抗議新的教育政策。

definition_zh: (動) 使氣餒；打擊士氣　打擊信心；使喪失鬥志
example_sentence: Losing the first game demoralizing the team, the players struggled to recover confidence.
sentence_zh: 輸掉首場比賽打擊球隊士氣，球員們很難恢復信心。

definition_zh: (動) 降職；貶低　(名) 降職；貶低
example_sentence: The manager who demoted the hardworking employee faced strong criticism from the team.
sentence_zh: 那位降職了這名勤奮員工的經理遭到團隊的強烈批評。

definition_zh: (名) 降職；貶低　(動) 使降職；貶低
example_sentence: If the manager fails to meet sales targets, demotion to a junior position would follow.
sentence_zh: 如果經理未能達到銷售目標，就會被降職到初級職位。

definition_zh: (名) 登革熱；登革病
example_sentence: Dengue fever spreads quickly in tropical areas during the rainy season.
sentence_zh: 登革熱在雨季期間在熱帶地區迅速傳播。

definition_zh: (形) 可否認的；可推卸責任的
example_sentence: The company used vague language to make its misleading claims deniable in court.
sentence_zh: 該公司使用模糊的語言來使其誤導性聲明在法庭上可以被否認。

definition_zh: (名) 否認；拒絕　(名) 否定；駁斥
example_sentence: The government's denial of the pollution problem angered many environmentally concerned citizens.
sentence_zh: 政府對污染問題的否認激怒了許多環保人士。

definition_zh: (名) 否認；否定　(名) 丹寧布；牛仔布
example_sentence: Although the suspect's denier of involvement seemed convincing, the evidence proved otherwise.
sentence_zh: 雖然嫌疑人的否認看似有說服力，但證據證明並非如此。

definition_zh: (動) 表示；代表　(動) 標示；象徵
example_sentence: The red light that denotes danger warns drivers to stop immediately.
sentence_zh: 表示危險的紅燈警告駕駛人立即停止。

definition_zh: (動) 公開指責；譴責　(動) 舉報；告發
example_sentence: The principal denounced cheating on exams as a serious violation of school rules.
sentence_zh: 校長公開指責在考試中作弊是對校規的嚴重違反。

definition_zh: (形) 密集的；稠密的　(形) 濃厚的；難以理解的
example_sentence: If the forest were less dense, hikers would find it easier to navigate through the trees.
sentence_zh: 如果森林不那麼密集，登山者就會更容易穿過樹林行進。

definition_zh: (副) 密集地；稠密地　(副) 濃厚地；厚重地
example_sentence: The forest grows densely with tall trees blocking out most sunlight.
sentence_zh: 森林密集生長，高大的樹木遮擋了大部分陽光。

definition_zh: (名) 密度；濃度　(名) 人口密度；物質密度
example_sentence: Increasing rapidly in urban areas, population density affects housing prices and public transportation systems.
sentence_zh: 在都市地區迅速增加的人口密度會影響房屋價格和大眾運輸系統。

definition_zh: (名) 凹痕；凹陷　(動) 使凹陷；損害
example_sentence: Although the car hit a pole, the dent on the door was not serious.
sentence_zh: 雖然車子撞到了電線桿，門上的凹痕並不嚴重。

definition_zh: (形) 牙齒的；牙科的
example_sentence: Only after regular dental checkups does tooth decay become preventable.
sentence_zh: 只有在定期牙科檢查之後，蛀牙才變得可以預防。

definition_zh: (名) 牙醫；牙科醫生
example_sentence: The dentist who treats my teeth is very skilled and patient with nervous patients.
sentence_zh: 那位治療我牙齒的牙醫非常熟練，對緊張的患者也很有耐心。

definition_zh: (名) 譴責；指控　公開的批評或控告
example_sentence: The public denunciation of corruption by news reporters encouraged many citizens to report illegal activities.
sentence_zh: 新聞記者對貪污的公開譴責鼓勵許多市民舉報非法活動。

definition_zh: (形) 譴責的；控訴的
example_sentence: The witness gave a denunciative statement against the corrupt official.
sentence_zh: 證人對貪污官員提出了譴責性的陳述。

definition_zh: (動) 否認；拒絕　(動) 否定；不承認
example_sentence: Although Maria denied stealing the money, the evidence proved her guilt.
sentence_zh: 雖然瑪麗亞否認偷錢，但證據證明她有罪。

definition_zh: (動) 出發；離開　(動) 背離；偏離
example_sentence: Departing from the station at dawn, the tour bus headed toward the mountain resort.
sentence_zh: 旅遊巴士在黎明時從車站出發，前往山區度假村。

definition_zh: (形) 已離開的；已出發的　(動) 離開；出發
example_sentence: The departed guests left thank-you notes on the table.
sentence_zh: 那些已離開的客人在桌上留下了感謝信。

definition_zh: (名) 部門；科系　(名) 部分；領域
example_sentence: If students choose the engineering department, they will study mathematics and physics.
sentence_zh: 如果學生選擇工程系，他們將學習數學和物理。

definition_zh: (名) 出發；離開　(名) 偏離；出發時間
example_sentence: The departure of the morning flight was delayed by two hours.
sentence_zh: 早班飛機的出發時間延遲了兩小時。

definition_zh: (動) 依賴；信任　(動) 取決於；由…決定
example_sentence: To pass the CSAT, students must depend on consistent study and teacher guidance.
sentence_zh: 為了通過學測，學生必須依賴持續的學習和教師的指導。

definition_zh: (動) 依靠；取決於　(動) 相信；信賴
example_sentence: The success of the school trip depends on good weather and careful planning.
sentence_zh: 學校旅行的成功取決於好天氣和仔細的計劃。

definition_zh: (名) 可靠性；信賴度　(名) 值得依賴的品質
example_sentence: Since the software demonstrates high dependability, many companies choose to use it for their business operations.
sentence_zh: 因為該軟體展現出高度的可靠性，許多公司選擇將其用於商業運營。

definition_zh: (形) 可信任的；可靠的　(形) 值得依賴的；堅實的
example_sentence: Having proven reliable over many years, this dependable teacher earned students' deep respect and lasting trust.
sentence_zh: 經過多年證實為可靠，這位值得信賴的老師獲得了學生的深深尊敬和持久信任。

definition_zh: (名) 依賴；依存　(名) 成癮；上癮
example_sentence: Students whose dependence on smartphones grows daily often struggle with concentration during class.
sentence_zh: 對智慧型手機的依賴日益增加的學生，常常在課堂上難以集中注意力。

definition_zh: (形) 依賴的；依附的　(名) 受撫養人；家屬
example_sentence: Many families with dependent children struggle with rising education costs and living expenses.
sentence_zh: 許多有受撫養孩子的家庭都在為教育費用和生活開支而掙扎。

definition_zh: (動) 描繪；表現　(動) 刻畫；描述
example_sentence: If the artist depict the historical event accurately, the museum would attract many visitors.
sentence_zh: 如果藝術家能準確描繪這個歷史事件，博物館將吸引許多遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 描繪；描寫　(名) 描繪方式；表現手法
example_sentence: The movie's depiction of ancient Rome impressed many history teachers and students.
sentence_zh: 這部電影對古羅馬的描繪給許多歷史老師和學生留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (動) 下飛機；離開飛機
example_sentence: Passengers deplaning from the international flight collected their luggage at the carousel.
sentence_zh: 從國際班機下飛機的乘客在行李轉盤領取行李。

definition_zh: (動) 耗盡；用完　枯竭；減少
example_sentence: As natural resources are depleted, nations must develop alternative energy sources.
sentence_zh: 當天然資源被耗盡時，各國必須開發替代能源。

definition_zh: (形) 令人遺憾的；可悲的　(形) 極壞的；惡劣的
example_sentence: Hardly ever does such deplorable behavior occur in our school community.
sentence_zh: 在我們的學校社區中，這樣令人遺憾的行為幾乎不會發生。

definition_zh: (動) 強烈反對；譴責　(動) 對…感到遺憾；哀嘆
example_sentence: Environmental activists deplore the policies that destroy forests without adequate protection measures.
sentence_zh: 環保運動人士譴責那些在沒有適當保護措施下摧毀森林的政策。

definition_zh: (動) 部署；配置　(動) 使用；採取
example_sentence: The military deployed troops to maintain peace in the region.
sentence_zh: 軍隊部署了士兵以維持該地區的和平。

definition_zh: (名) 部署；配置　(名) 派遣；調派
example_sentence: The military deployment of troops to the border required careful planning and coordination.
sentence_zh: 軍隊向邊境的部署需要仔細的計畫和協調。

definition_zh: (動) 驅逐出境；遣返
example_sentence: The government deported the illegal immigrant back to his home country.
sentence_zh: 政府將那名非法移民遣返回他的母國。

definition_zh: (名) 驅逐出境；遣返
example_sentence: Although the government announced deportation procedures, many families protested against the unfair immigration policy.
sentence_zh: 雖然政府宣布了驅逐出境的程序，但許多家庭抗議這項不公平的移民政策。

definition_zh: (動) 廢黜；使下臺　(動) 作證；說明
example_sentence: Deposed from power by the parliament, the former president faced investigation for corruption.
sentence_zh: 被國會廢黜下臺的前總統面臨貪汙調查。

definition_zh: (名) 保證金；定金　(動) 存放；沉澱　(形) 沉積的
example_sentence: The deposit that customers made will be returned after the contract expires.
sentence_zh: 顧客所支付的保證金將在合約到期後退還。

definition_zh: (名) 倉庫；儲存站　(名) 公車站；集散地
example_sentence: If the supply depot were located closer to the factory, shipping costs would decrease significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果補給倉庫位置更靠近工廠，運輸成本將會大幅下降。

definition_zh: (動) 表示不贊成；反對　不鼓勵；勸阻
example_sentence: Teachers deprecate cheating on exams because it harms learning.
sentence_zh: 老師反對在考試中作弊，因為這傷害學習。

definition_zh: (形) 貶低的；反對的　(動) 反對；不贊成
example_sentence: The teacher used a deprecating tone to discourage students from copying homework.
sentence_zh: 老師用貶低的語氣來阻止學生抄作業。

definition_zh: (名) 貶值；折舊　(名) 貶低；輕視
example_sentence: The depreciation of your car happens quickly during the first year of ownership.
sentence_zh: 汽車在購買的第一年會迅速貶值。

definition_zh: (動) 使沮喪；使憂鬱　(動) 降低；壓低
example_sentence: Although the rainy weather depressed many students, the hiking club still organized the mountain trip.
sentence_zh: 雖然雨天使許多學生感到沮喪，登山社仍然組織了這次登山旅行。

definition_zh: (名) 中樞神經抑制劑；鎮靜劑　(形) 抑制中樞神經的；令人沮喪的
example_sentence: Having consumed alcohol, a known depressant, the driver's reaction time slowed considerably.
sentence_zh: 由於酒精是已知的中樞神經抑制劑，司機的反應時間明顯變慢了。

definition_zh: (形) 沮喪的；悲傷的　(形) 經濟衰退的；不景氣的
example_sentence: Students who feel depressed about exam results should talk to a counselor.
sentence_zh: 對考試成績感到沮喪的學生應該與輔導老師談話。

definition_zh: (形) 令人沮喪的；令人失望的　(形) 陰沉的；沉悶的
example_sentence: The rainy weather and gloomy sky made the whole day feel depressing and unbearable.
sentence_zh: 雨天和陰沉的天空使整個一天感到令人沮喪且難以忍受。

definition_zh: (名) 憂鬱症；沮喪　(名) 經濟衰退；蕭條
example_sentence: If Sarah suffered from depression, cognitive therapy would help her manage negative thoughts.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉患有憂鬱症，認知治療將有助她管理負面想法。

definition_zh: (形) 令人沮喪的；抑鬱的　(形) 沉悶的；陰沉的
example_sentence: Rainy weather often makes people feel depressive and unmotivated about studying.
sentence_zh: 雨天常常讓人感到沮喪，對讀書沒有動力。

definition_zh: (動) 剝奪；使失去　(動) 使處於貧困
example_sentence: Deprived of internet access during the exam, students must focus entirely on their test papers.
sentence_zh: 在考試期間被剝奪網際網路使用權，學生必須完全專注於試卷。

definition_zh: (名) 深度；深處　(名) 深入；深刻
example_sentence: As the divers descended into the ocean depth, the water pressure increased significantly.
sentence_zh: 當潛水員下潛到海洋深處時，水壓明顯增加。

definition_zh: (名) 副手；代理人　(形) 代理的；副的
example_sentence: Not only does the manager lead the team, but the deputy also handles daily operations.
sentence_zh: 不僅經理領導團隊，副經理也處理日常業務。

definition_zh: (動) 使出軌；脫離軌道　(動) 破壞；使失敗
example_sentence: The scandal that derailed the politician's career shocked the entire nation.
sentence_zh: 那個使政治人物職業生涯脫軌的醜聞震驚了整個國家。

definition_zh: (名) 脫軌；出軌
example_sentence: The train operator took emergency measures to prevent derailment and protect passenger safety.
sentence_zh: 火車駕駛員採取緊急措施來防止脫軌並保護乘客安全。

definition_zh: (動) 使混亂；擾亂　(動) 使精神失常；使發瘋
example_sentence: The sudden loud noise deranged the cat's calm mood completely.
sentence_zh: 突然的巨大聲音完全擾亂了貓平靜的情緒。

definition_zh: (形) 瘋狂的；精神錯亂的　(形) 混亂的；失控的
example_sentence: The deranged criminal's actions confused everyone at the police station.
sentence_zh: 那個精神錯亂的罪犯的行為讓警察局的每個人都感到困惑。

definition_zh: (動) 解除管制；放寬法規
example_sentence: As the government deregulates the telecom industry, competition increases and service fees drop significantly.
sentence_zh: 當政府放寬電信產業的法規限制時，競爭加劇且服務費用大幅下降。

definition_zh: (名) 放鬆管制；解除管制
example_sentence: Deregulation removing strict government controls encouraged more airlines to enter the market.
sentence_zh: 放鬆管制移除政府的嚴格控制，鼓勵更多航空公司進入市場。

definition_zh: (動) 嘲笑；嘲弄　(動) 輕視；貶低
example_sentence: The students who derided their classmate's dream ultimately regretted their cruel words.
sentence_zh: 那些嘲笑同學夢想的學生最後為他們殘酷的言語感到後悔。

definition_zh: (形) 衍生的；非原創的　(名) 衍生物；導數
example_sentence: If students copy ideas without attribution, the work becomes derivative and loses academic value.
sentence_zh: 如果學生未註明出處而抄襲想法，作品就會變成衍生的，並失去學術價值。

definition_zh: (動) 推導；得出　獲得；來自
example_sentence: Scientists derive new medicine formulas from natural plant sources.
sentence_zh: 科學家從天然植物來源推導出新的藥物配方。

definition_zh: (名) 皮膚科醫生；皮膚專科醫生
example_sentence: Many teenagers visit a dermatologist to treat acne and improve their skin health.
sentence_zh: 許多青少年去看皮膚科醫生以治療痤瘡並改善皮膚健康。

definition_zh: (名) 皮膚病學；皮膚科
example_sentence: Many teenagers visit dermatology clinics for treatment of acne and skin conditions.
sentence_zh: 許多青少年到皮膚科診所治療青春痘和皮膚問題。

definition_zh: (形) 貶低的；侮辱性的　(形) 不利的；有損的
example_sentence: Although the comment seemed derogatory, Maria chose to ignore it and focus on her work.
sentence_zh: 雖然那個評論看起來很貶低人，瑪莉亞還是選擇忽視它，專注於她的工作。

definition_zh: (動) 除鹽；淡化
example_sentence: Having desalinated the seawater through advanced technology, the coastal city solved its freshwater shortage problem.
sentence_zh: 通過先進技術除鹽後，這個沿海城市解決了其淡水短缺的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 淡化；海水淡化
example_sentence: The coastal city built a desalination plant that removes salt from seawater, which supplies fresh water to residents.
sentence_zh: 這個沿海城市建造了一座海水淡化廠，它從海水中去除鹽分，為居民提供淡水。

definition_zh: (動) 下降；下來　(動) 祖先是；源自
example_sentence: The airplane began to descend slowly toward the runway as passengers prepared for landing.
sentence_zh: 當乘客為著陸做準備時，飛機開始緩慢下降朝向跑道。

definition_zh: (名) 後代；子孫　(形) 下降的；遞減的
example_sentence: If the ancient royal family had not migrated to Taiwan, their descendants would not live on this island today.
sentence_zh: 如果古老王室沒有遷移到台灣，他們的後代就不會住在這個島上。

definition_zh: (名) 下降；下坡　(名) 血統；祖先　(動) 下降；下去
example_sentence: The steep descent down the mountain required careful footsteps and patience.
sentence_zh: 陡峭的山坡下降需要謹慎的步伐和耐心。

definition_zh: (動) 描述；說明　(動) 描繪；刻劃
example_sentence: Describing the accident to the police, the witness provided many important details.
sentence_zh: 目擊者向警察描述那場事故，提供了許多重要細節。

definition_zh: (名) 描述；說明　(名) 敘述；描寫
example_sentence: As the tour guide provided a detailed description, tourists listened attentively to learn about local history.
sentence_zh: 當導遊提供詳細的描述時，遊客專心聆聽以了解當地歷史。

definition_zh: (形) 描述性的；敘述的　具有詳細描寫特徵的
example_sentence: Only through descriptive language can writers truly transport readers into vivid imaginary worlds.
sentence_zh: 唯有透過描述性的語言，作家才能真正將讀者帶入生動的想像世界。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈdɛzɚt] 沙漠；荒漠　(動) [dɪˈzɝt] 遺棄；拋棄　(形) 荒蕪的；人煙稀少的
example_sentence: The desert that covers much of Africa is home to many unique animal species.
sentence_zh: 覆蓋非洲大部分的沙漠是許多獨特動物物種的家園。

definition_zh: (動) 應該得到；值得　(動) 應得；應受
example_sentence: Working hard every day helps students deserve to enter their dream university.
sentence_zh: 每天努力工作幫助學生值得進入他們夢想的大學。

definition_zh: (名) 設計；圖案　(動) 設計；計畫
example_sentence: The graphic design team created a modern logo for the new product launch.
sentence_zh: 平面設計團隊為新產品發布會創作了一個現代標誌。

definition_zh: (動) 指定；任命　(動) 標明；表示
example_sentence: The principal designated three teachers to organize the school sports day.
sentence_zh: 校長指定三位老師組織學校運動會。

definition_zh: (名) 指定；名稱　(名) 職位；身份
example_sentence: Because the team's designation as champions was announced yesterday, all players celebrated their hard-won victory.
sentence_zh: 由於該隊被指定為冠軍的身份在昨天宣布，所有選手慶祝他們來之不易的勝利。

definition_zh: (名) 設計者；設計師　(動) 設計；規劃
example_sentence: The designer creating the new smartphone spent months researching user preferences carefully.
sentence_zh: 那位正在創造新智慧手機的設計師花了幾個月仔細研究使用者的偏好。

definition_zh: (形) 值得想要的；令人嚮往的　(形) 受歡迎的；令人滿意的
example_sentence: A career in medicine is desirable for students who enjoy helping others.
sentence_zh: 對於喜歡幫助他人的學生來說，醫學職業是值得嚮往的。

definition_zh: (名) 渴望；慾望　(動) 渴望；想要
example_sentence: If students desire academic success, they would study harder every day.
sentence_zh: 如果學生渴望學業成功，他們每天會更努力讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 桌子；書桌　(名) 辦公室；服務台
example_sentence: My desk is near the window in the classroom.
sentence_zh: 我的書桌在教室靠窗的地方。

definition_zh: (名) 桌面；桌上型電腦
example_sentence: Many students use a desktop computer to organize their study notes efficiently.
sentence_zh: 許多學生使用桌上型電腦來有效整理他們的讀書筆記。

definition_zh: (形) [ˋdɛsəlɪt] 荒涼的；孤獨的　(動) [ˋdɛsəˌlet] 使荒涼；使孤獨
example_sentence: The old, abandoned house stood desolate and empty on the lonely hillside.
sentence_zh: 那棟老舊、被遺棄的房子在孤獨的山坡上顯得荒涼而空蕩。

definition_zh: (名) 絕望；失望　(動) 失去希望；感到絕望
example_sentence: As the rescue team searched the mountain without finding survivors, the families began to despair.
sentence_zh: 當救援隊在山上搜尋卻找不到生還者時，家屬們開始感到絕望。

definition_zh: (形) 絕望的；孤注一擲的　(動) 使絕望
example_sentence: Having lost all hope, the desperate refugees searched the crowded streets for missing family members.
sentence_zh: 失去了所有希望，這些絕望的難民在擁擠的街道上尋找失散的家人。

definition_zh: (副) 絕望地；不顧一切地　拼命地；急切地
example_sentence: The rescue team searched desperately for survivors in the ruins after the earthquake.
sentence_zh: 這支救援隊在地震後的廢墟中不顧一切地搜索倖存者。

definition_zh: (名) 絕望；窮困　(名) 不顧一切的努力
example_sentence: Facing bankruptcy and homelessness, the struggling family's desperation drove them to seek help.
sentence_zh: 面對破產和無家可歸，這個陷入困境的家庭的絕望促使他們尋求幫助。

definition_zh: (形) 可恨的；令人厭惡的　(形) 低劣的；卑鄙的
example_sentence: If bullying classmates were despicable, more students would stand up against it.
sentence_zh: 如果欺負同學是可恨的行為，更多學生就會反對它。

definition_zh: (副) 令人厭惡地；可鄙地
example_sentence: The dictator treated prisoners despicably, causing international outrage and condemnation.
sentence_zh: 那位獨裁者以可鄙的方式對待囚犯，引起國際憤怒與譴責。

definition_zh: (動) 鄙視；輕視　(動) 厭惡；看不起
example_sentence: Despising hard work, the lazy student failed most of his exams.
sentence_zh: 那個懶惰的學生鄙視努力工作，結果大多數考試都不及格。

definition_zh: (介) 儘管；雖然　(名) 怨恨；惡意
example_sentence: Despite working late every night, many students still struggle with the exam.
sentence_zh: 儘管每晚工作到很晚，許多學生仍然在考試中掙扎。

definition_zh: (形) 沮喪的；失望的　(形) 灰心的；悲觀的
example_sentence: Seldom have students felt so despondent after receiving their exam results.
sentence_zh: 學生們在收到考試成績後，很少感到如此沮喪。

definition_zh: (形) 專制的；獨裁的　(形) 暴虐的；專斷的
example_sentence: The despotic ruler who ignored citizens' rights faced widespread protests across the nation.
sentence_zh: 那位忽視公民權利的專制統治者在全國面臨廣泛抗議。

definition_zh: (名) 甜點；甜食　(動) 遺棄；拋棄
example_sentence: Many students study hard to earn money for buying dessert after exams.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力讀書以便在考試後能買甜點。

definition_zh: (名) 目的地；目標　(名) 旅遊勝地；終點
example_sentence: Paris is a popular travel destination attracting millions of tourists every year.
sentence_zh: 巴黎是一個熱門的旅遊目的地，每年吸引數百萬遊客。

definition_zh: (動) 注定；命中注定
example_sentence: Hard work and persistence destine successful people to achieve their dreams.
sentence_zh: 努力工作和堅持注定成功的人會實現他們的夢想。

definition_zh: (形) 註定的；命中註定的　(形) 預定的；預期的
example_sentence: Though born into poverty, the young entrepreneur was destined to become a successful business leader.
sentence_zh: 雖然出生貧困，但這位年輕企業家註定會成為成功的商業領袖。

definition_zh: (名) 命運；宿命　(名) 前途；發展方向
example_sentence: Facing many challenges, students pursuing their dreams shape their own destiny.
sentence_zh: 面對許多挑戰，追求夢想的學生塑造了自己的命運。

definition_zh: (形) 貧困的；一無所有的　(形) 缺乏的；不具備的
example_sentence: Families that are destitute of basic resources struggle to survive.
sentence_zh: 缺乏基本資源的家庭難以生存。

definition_zh: (名) 赤貧；窮困　(名) 缺乏；匱乏
example_sentence: If families fall into destitution, government assistance programs should provide immediate help.
sentence_zh: 如果家庭陷入赤貧，政府救助計畫應該立即提供幫助。

definition_zh: (動) 摧毀；破壞　(動) 殺死；消滅
example_sentence: The earthquake destroyed many buildings in the city.
sentence_zh: 地震摧毀了城市裡許多建築物。

definition_zh: (動) 破壞；摧毀　(動) 自毀；爆炸
example_sentence: The spy activated the device to destruct all secret files immediately.
sentence_zh: 那名特務啟動裝置以摧毀所有機密文件。

definition_zh: (名) 破壞；毀滅　(名) 被破壞的狀態；廢墟
example_sentence: The destruction of the old building made room for a modern shopping center.
sentence_zh: 舊建築的破壞為現代購物中心騰出了空間。

definition_zh: (形) 破壞性的；毀滅性的　(形) 有害的；具傷害性的
example_sentence: Because the earthquake was destructive, many buildings collapsed and thousands of people lost their homes.
sentence_zh: 因為地震是破壞性的，許多建築物倒塌，數千人失去了家園。

definition_zh: (動) 分離；卸下　(動) 超然以待；置身事外
example_sentence: Having detached the broken wheel from the bicycle, the mechanic inspected the frame carefully.
sentence_zh: 機械師卸下了自行車的壞輪子後，仔細檢查了車架。

definition_zh: (形) 超然的；不參與的　(形) 分離的；單獨的
example_sentence: The teacher, detached from classroom drama, focused only on her lesson plan.
sentence_zh: 那位不參與課堂風波的老師只專注於她的教學計劃。

definition_zh: (名) 超然；冷漠　(名) 分遣隊；派遣單位
example_sentence: The journalist's emotional detachment from the story allowed her to report facts objectively and fairly.
sentence_zh: 這位記者對故事的情感超然，使她能夠客觀公正地報導事實。

definition_zh: (名) 細節；詳情　(動) 詳述；說明細節
example_sentence: If students paid more attention to every detail, their essays would receive higher scores.
sentence_zh: 如果學生更注意每個細節，他們的作文會獲得更高分數。

definition_zh: (形) 詳細的；仔細的　(動) 詳述；列舉
example_sentence: The detailed report helped the team understand the problem completely.
sentence_zh: 那份詳細的報告幫助團隊完全理解了這個問題。

definition_zh: (動) 拘留；扣留　(動) 耽擱；延誤
example_sentence: Detaining the suspect at the police station, officers questioned him about the theft.
sentence_zh: 警察在警察局拘留嫌疑人，並詢問他關於盜竊案的事。

definition_zh: (動) 偵測；發現　(動) 察覺；檢測出
example_sentence: Before the security guard detected the thief, the stolen phone had already disappeared.
sentence_zh: 在保全人員偵測到小偷之前，被盜的手機已經消失了。

definition_zh: (形) 可發現的；可偵測的
example_sentence: Only after careful analysis was the error detectable in the laboratory results.
sentence_zh: 只有經過仔細分析，實驗室結果中的錯誤才能被發現。

definition_zh: (名) 偵測；發現　(名) 檢測；察覺
example_sentence: The security system's early detection of the fire prevented a serious disaster.
sentence_zh: 安全系統對火災的早期偵測預防了一場嚴重災難。

definition_zh: (名) 偵探；警探　(形) 偵查的；推理的
example_sentence: The detective studied the crime scene carefully to find the hidden clues.
sentence_zh: 偵探仔細研究犯罪現場以找到隱藏的線索。

definition_zh: (名) 探測器；偵測器　(名) 檢測裝置；感應器
example_sentence: The smoke detector in our kitchen goes off whenever someone cooks.
sentence_zh: 我們廚房裡的煙霧探測器每當有人煮飯時就會響起。

definition_zh: (名) 拘禁；留置　(名) 課後留校
example_sentence: Students who break school rules may receive detention after classes end.
sentence_zh: 違反校規的學生可能在課後留校。

definition_zh: (動) 阻止；制止　遏阻；勸阻
example_sentence: Although strict penalties deter many criminals, some still commit serious crimes.
sentence_zh: 雖然嚴厲的懲罰能阻止許多罪犯，但有些人仍然犯下嚴重罪行。

definition_zh: (名) 洗滌劑；清潔劑　(形) 去污的；清潔的
example_sentence: Using detergent containing enzymes, the washing machine removes tough stains more effectively.
sentence_zh: 洗衣機使用含有酵素的洗滌劑，能更有效地去除頑固污漬。

definition_zh: (動) 惡化；變糟　(動) 衰退；退化
example_sentence: The patient's health condition, which has deteriorated rapidly since last month, requires immediate hospital care.
sentence_zh: 患者的健康狀況，自上月以來急速惡化，需要立即住院治療。

definition_zh: (動) 惡化；衰退　(形) 惡化的；衰退的
example_sentence: If air quality deteriorated further, many students would struggle with respiratory problems during exam season.
sentence_zh: 如果空氣品質進一步惡化，許多學生在考試季節會呼吸困難。

definition_zh: (名) 惡化；衰退　(名) 品質下降；損壞
example_sentence: The deterioration of air quality in winter months affects many students' health.
sentence_zh: 冬季空氣品質的惡化影響了許多學生的健康。

definition_zh: (名) 決心；毅力　(名) 決定；判定
example_sentence: The student studied hard every day to build determination for the entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 這名學生每天努力讀書以培養參加入學考試所需的決心。

definition_zh: (形) 堅定的；決心的　(動) 決定；確定
example_sentence: Determined to pass the CSAT exam, many students study hard every day.
