sentence_zh: 決心通過學測考試，許多學生每天都努力讀書。

definition_zh: (動) 決定；確定　(動) 查明；判定
example_sentence: Because the teacher determined that cheating occurred during the exam, all involved students received failing grades.
sentence_zh: 因為老師確定考試中發生了作弊行為，所有涉及的學生都得到了不及格的成績。

definition_zh: (形) 堅定的；有決心的　(動) 決定；確定
example_sentence: Determined to improve her English, Sarah studied grammar rules every single day.
sentence_zh: 莎拉下定決心要進步，她每天都在研習文法規則。

definition_zh: (名) 宿命論者；相信一切由因果決定的人
example_sentence: A determinist, who believes that all events are inevitable results of prior causes, often debates free will with philosophers.
sentence_zh: 一位相信所有事件都是先前原因必然結果的宿命論者，經常與哲學家討論自由意志的問題。

definition_zh: (動) 厭惡；討厭　(動) 極度反感；憎恨
example_sentence: Many students detest early morning classes and difficult homework assignments.
sentence_zh: 許多學生厭惡早晨課程和困難的家庭作業。

definition_zh: (動) 推翻；廢黜　(動) 使失去權力；打敗
example_sentence: If the corrupt king continued abusing power, angry citizens would dethrone him.
sentence_zh: 如果這位腐敗的國王繼續濫用權力，憤怒的人民會推翻他。

definition_zh: (名) 繞路；迂迴路線　(動) 繞路；迂迴行進
example_sentence: Construction on the highway forced drivers to take a long detour around the city.
sentence_zh: 高速公路施工迫使駕駛人繞過城市走很長的迂迴路線。

definition_zh: (動) [diˈtɑks] 排毒；解毒　(名) [ˈdiˌtɑks] 排毒療程；解毒過程
example_sentence: Detoxifying their bodies through exercise and healthy eating, students felt more energized at school.
sentence_zh: 學生們透過運動和健康飲食排毒，在學校感到更有精力。

definition_zh: (動) 解毒；排毒　(動) 使…不含毒素
example_sentence: After eating too much junk food, the body needs time to detoxify itself before the person feels healthy again.
sentence_zh: 在吃了太多垃圾食物之後，身體需要時間排毒，這樣人才能感到健康。

definition_zh: (動) 減損；貶低　(動) 分散注意力；轉移焦點
example_sentence: Not only does excessive phone use harm health, but it also detracts from academic focus.
sentence_zh: 不僅過度使用手機有害健康，而且會減損學習專注力。

definition_zh: (形) 有害的；不利的　造成傷害的；損害性的
example_sentence: Excessive social media use, which is detrimental to mental health, should be limited by teenagers.
sentence_zh: 過度使用社群媒體（這對心理健康有害），應該受到青少年的限制。

definition_zh: (名) 平手；打成平手　(名) 網球中的四十比四十
example_sentence: Playing tennis regularly helps students improve their skills to avoid deuce situations.
sentence_zh: 定期打網球幫助學生改進技巧，以避免打成平手的局面。

definition_zh: (動) 貶低；降低價值　(動) 使貶值；減少重要性
example_sentence: Constant criticism can devalue a student's confidence and academic performance significantly.
sentence_zh: 持續的批評會貶低學生的信心和學業表現。

definition_zh: (動) 嚴重破壞；摧毀　(動) 使極度傷心；打擊
example_sentence: The earthquake devastated the entire coastal city and left thousands homeless.
sentence_zh: 那場地震摧毀了整個沿海城市，使數千人無家可歸。

definition_zh: (形) 被毀滅的；極度沮喪的
example_sentence: Although Maria studied hard, she felt devastated when she failed the entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 雖然瑪麗亞很用功讀書，但她沒考上大學時感到極度沮喪。

definition_zh: (形) 毀滅性的；破壞性的　(形) 令人震驚的；極其傷人的
example_sentence: Devastating floods sweeping across the region forced thousands of residents to evacuate immediately.
sentence_zh: 席捲該地區的毀滅性洪水迫使數千名居民立即撤離。

definition_zh: (名) 毀滅；破壞　(名) 荒廢；殘破
example_sentence: The earthquake caused widespread devastation that affected thousands of families throughout the region.
sentence_zh: 這場地震造成了廣泛的毀滅，影響了整個地區數千個家庭。

definition_zh: (動) 發展；開發　(動) 沖洗（相片）；製作
example_sentence: If students develop good study habits now, they will succeed in the university entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 如果學生現在養成良好的讀書習慣，他們將在大學入學考試中成功。

definition_zh: (形) 發達的；先進的　(動) 發展；開發
example_sentence: Taiwan's developed technology industry attracts engineers from around the world.
sentence_zh: 台灣發達的科技產業吸引了世界各地的工程師。

definition_zh: (名) 開發者；開發人員　(名) 房地產開發商
example_sentence: Software developers learn programming languages to build useful applications for users.
sentence_zh: 軟體開發者學習程式語言來為使用者建立有用的應用程式。

definition_zh: (動) 發展；開發　(形) 發展中的；成長中的
example_sentence: Developing countries in Asia are building more schools and factories every year.
sentence_zh: 亞洲發展中國家每年都在興建更多學校和工廠。

definition_zh: (名) 發展；進展　(名) 開發；發育
example_sentence: As technology advances rapidly, urban development becomes increasingly important to meet growing city needs.
sentence_zh: 隨著科技快速進步，城市發展對滿足日益增長的城市需求變得越來越重要。

definition_zh: (形) 發展的；成長的　(形) 發育的；進步的
example_sentence: Having completed the developmental stage, the child entered primary school with confidence.
sentence_zh: 完成了發展階段後，這個孩子充滿信心地進入了小學。

definition_zh: (形) 偏離的；異常的　(名) 偏差；異常行為
example_sentence: Students who exhibit deviant behavior that violates school rules face serious consequences.
sentence_zh: 表現出違反校規的異常行為的學生會面臨嚴重後果。

definition_zh: (動) 偏離；背離　(動) 轉向；改變方向
example_sentence: The airplane had to deviate from its original flight path due to severe weather conditions.
sentence_zh: 由於惡劣的天氣狀況，飛機必須偏離其原定的飛行路線。

definition_zh: (名) 偏差；背離　(名) 轉向；轉移
example_sentence: If the airplane's deviation from the planned route were greater, the pilot would have noticed the problem immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果飛機與計劃路線的偏差更大，飛行員本來會立即發現這個問題。

definition_zh: (名) 裝置；設備　(名) 方法；手段
example_sentence: Modern smartphones are useful devices for communication and work.
sentence_zh: 現代智慧型手機是溝通和工作的實用裝置。

definition_zh: (形) 不顧後果的；輕率冒險的
example_sentence: Having a devil-may-care attitude, the young entrepreneur launched her startup without detailed planning.
sentence_zh: 抱著不顧後果的態度，這位年輕企業家在沒有詳細計畫的情況下創辦了新公司。

definition_zh: (名) 魔鬼；惡魔　(名) 壞人；調皮鬼
example_sentence: Although the devil tempted him constantly, the monk remained faithful to his religious beliefs.
sentence_zh: 雖然魔鬼不斷引誘他，但那位僧侶始終保持對信仰的忠誠。

definition_zh: (動) 設計；想出　創造；發明
example_sentence: Only after careful planning did the engineering team devise a solution to the water shortage problem.
sentence_zh: 只有在仔細計畫之後，工程團隊才想出了解決缺水問題的方案。

definition_zh: (形) 完全缺乏的；沒有的　(動) 使空出；清空
example_sentence: The desert, which is devoid of water and vegetation, presents a harsh environment for survival.
sentence_zh: 那片沙漠完全缺乏水和植被，對生存來說是個惡劣的環境。

definition_zh: (動) 奉獻；致力於　(動) 將…專用於
example_sentence: Many students devote their spare time to prepare for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生奉獻他們的空閒時間來準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (形) 忠誠的；專心的　(動) 獻身；致力於
example_sentence: The devoted teacher spent countless hours preparing lessons for struggling students.
sentence_zh: 那位忠誠的老師花費無數小時為學習困難的學生準備課程。

definition_zh: (形) 忠誠的；專心的　(形) 獻身的；投入的
example_sentence: The devoted teacher spent hours preparing lessons for struggling students.
sentence_zh: 那位忠誠的老師花了好幾個小時為學習困難的學生準備課程。

definition_zh: (名) 狂熱者；虔誠信徒　(名) 愛好者；迷
example_sentence: Because the devoted fan attended every concert whenever the band came to Taiwan, she earned the nickname of the true devotee.
sentence_zh: 因為這位忠實粉絲每當樂隊來台灣時就參加每場演唱會，她贏得了真正狂熱者的綽號。

definition_zh: (名) 奉獻；忠誠　(名) 專注；熱情
example_sentence: Showing great devotion to her studies, Maria achieved top grades in every subject.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞對她的課業表現出極大的奉獻精神，在每個科目都取得優異成績。

definition_zh: (動) 狼吞虎嚥；貪婪地吃　(動) 貪婪地閱讀或觀看
example_sentence: The hungry lion devoured the meat that hunters left behind in the savanna.
sentence_zh: 飢餓的獅子狼吞虎嚥地吃掉獵人在草原上留下的肉。

definition_zh: (名) 露水；露　(動) 凝結成露
example_sentence: If morning dew covers the grass, the garden will look fresh and beautiful.
sentence_zh: 如果晨露覆蓋草地，花園會看起來清新美麗。

definition_zh: (名) 糖尿病；糖尿病患者
example_sentence: Regular exercise and a healthy diet help prevent diabetes and other serious diseases.
sentence_zh: 規律運動和健康飲食有助於預防糖尿病和其他嚴重疾病。

definition_zh: (名) 皇冠；王冠　(名) 光榮；尊嚴
example_sentence: The queen wore an ornate diadem to symbolize her power and authority.
sentence_zh: 皇后戴著精緻的王冠來象徵她的權力與權威。

definition_zh: (動) 診斷；判斷　(名) 診斷
example_sentence: The doctor diagnosed the patient's illness and prescribed medicine to treat it.
sentence_zh: 醫生診斷了病人的疾病，並開了藥物來治療。

definition_zh: (動) 診斷；確診　(形) 被診斷的；確診的
example_sentence: After the doctor diagnosed the patient with diabetes, the family adjusted their diet carefully.
sentence_zh: 在醫生診斷患者患有糖尿病之後，家人小心地調整了他們的飲食。

definition_zh: (名) 診斷；判斷　(動) 診斷；判斷
example_sentence: Having received a careful diagnosis from the specialist, the patient finally understood the cause of the illness.
sentence_zh: 從專家那裡獲得仔細的診斷後，患者終於明白了病因。

definition_zh: (形) 對角線的；斜的　(名) 對角線
example_sentence: The diagonal line that divides the rectangle creates two equal triangles.
sentence_zh: 分割矩形的對角線創造了兩個相等的三角形。

definition_zh: (副) 對角線地；斜著
example_sentence: The teacher drew a line diagonally across the whiteboard to divide the two sections.
sentence_zh: 老師在白板上斜著畫了一條線，把兩個部分分開。

definition_zh: (名) 圖表；圖解　(動) 用圖表表示；繪製圖表
example_sentence: If the teacher drew a clear diagram on the board, students would understand the process much better.
sentence_zh: 如果老師在黑板上畫一個清楚的圖表，學生就會更容易理解這個過程。

definition_zh: (動) 撥號連接；用電話號碼撥接網際網路
example_sentence: Before broadband internet became common, students had to dial up to access online resources.
sentence_zh: 在寬頻網際網路普遍之前，學生必須撥號連接才能上網。

definition_zh: (動) 撥打；轉動　(名) 錶盤；刻度盤
example_sentence: Dialing the customer service number, Sarah waited patiently for a representative to answer her question.
sentence_zh: 莎拉撥打客服電話，耐心等待代表回答她的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 方言；地方語言　(名) 某一群體的語言變體
example_sentence: Although the dialect differs greatly from standard Mandarin, elderly villagers still speak it fluently.
sentence_zh: 雖然這種方言與標準普通話差異很大，但村裡的老人仍然能流利地說它。

definition_zh: (名) 對話；對白　(動) 進行對話；交換意見
example_sentence: Only through honest dialog can misunderstandings between friends be resolved completely.
sentence_zh: 唯有通過誠實的對話，朋友之間的誤解才能被完全解決。

definition_zh: (名) 直徑；直經
example_sentence: The wheel, whose diameter measures exactly one meter, rolls smoothly.
sentence_zh: 這個直徑恰好為一公尺的輪子滾動得很平順。

definition_zh: (名) 鑽石；鑽石戒指　(名) 菱形；棒球場
example_sentence: Many couples save money for years to buy a diamond ring to propose with.
sentence_zh: 許多夫妻存錢多年，為了買鑽石戒指來求婚。

definition_zh: (名) 尿布；紙尿褲
example_sentence: Parents need to change baby diapers frequently throughout the day.
sentence_zh: 父母需要整天頻繁更換嬰兒的尿布。

definition_zh: (名) 腹瀉；痢疾
example_sentence: Eating contaminated food caused Sarah to suffer from diarrhea for days.
sentence_zh: 食用受污染的食物導致莎拉腹瀉了好幾天。

definition_zh: (名) 日記；日誌　(名) 行程簿；記事本
example_sentence: As Sarah wrote in her diary every evening, she reflected on what happened during the day.
sentence_zh: 當莎拉每天晚上在日記裡寫字時，她反思了當天發生的事情。

definition_zh: (動) 口述；聽寫　(動) 規定；命令
example_sentence: Dictating the essay to her secretary, the manager ensured every detail was recorded accurately.
sentence_zh: 經理向秘書口述這篇文章，確保每一個細節都被準確記錄。

definition_zh: (名) 聽寫；口述　(名) 命令；專制統治
example_sentence: The dictation that the teacher assigned last week tested students' listening comprehension skills effectively.
sentence_zh: 老師上週指派的聽寫測驗有效地測試了學生的聽力理解能力。

definition_zh: (名) 獨裁者；專制統治者
example_sentence: If a dictator refuses to hold free elections, the country will face international isolation.
sentence_zh: 如果獨裁者拒絕舉行自由選舉，該國將面臨國際孤立。

definition_zh: (形) 獨裁的；專制的　(形) 傲慢的；專斷的
example_sentence: The dictatorial leader refused to listen to any opposing opinions from citizens.
sentence_zh: 那位獨裁的領導人拒絕傾聽來自人民的任何反對意見。

definition_zh: (名) 獨裁統治；獨裁政體
example_sentence: Citizens organized protests to overthrow the dictatorship and establish democratic governance.
sentence_zh: 公民組織抗議活動以推翻獨裁統治並建立民主制度。

definition_zh: (名) 字典；辭典　(名) 詞彙；字彙
example_sentence: Looking up unfamiliar words in a dictionary helps improve vocabulary for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 在字典中查找陌生單字有助於提升學測的詞彙能力。

definition_zh: (動) 完成；做到　(助) 過去式助動詞
example_sentence: After the team practiced for weeks, they finally did it and won the championship.
sentence_zh: 在球隊練習了數週之後，他們終於做到了並贏得了冠軍。

definition_zh: (形) 教導的；有教育意義的　(形) 生硬說教的；枯燥乏味的
example_sentence: Having studied the didactic methods used by experienced teachers, the new instructor redesigned the entire curriculum.
sentence_zh: 經過研究資深教師所採用的教學方法，新講師重新設計了整個課程。

definition_zh: (動) 死亡；去世　(動) 一個；某個
example_sentence: The soldiers who died an early death in the war were remembered by their families forever.
sentence_zh: 在戰爭中英年早逝的士兵被他們的家人永遠銘記在心。

definition_zh: (動) 逐漸減弱；消失　(動) 漸漸衰退；淡去
example_sentence: The sound of the ambulance died away as it turned the corner downtown.
sentence_zh: 當救護車在市中心轉過街角時，警笛聲逐漸消失了。

definition_zh: (動) 枯死；凋謝　(動) 逐漸消失；衰退
example_sentence: If the rose garden did not receive enough water, the flowers would die back before summer arrived.
sentence_zh: 如果玫瑰花園沒有獲得足夠的水，花朵會在夏天來臨前就枯死。

definition_zh: (動) 逐漸減弱；漸漸消退　(動) 平息；緩和
example_sentence: After the heavy rain died down, children played outside happily.
sentence_zh: 大雨漸漸停止後，孩子們開心地在外面玩耍。

definition_zh: (動) 為...犧牲；為...死去　(動) 極其渴望；拼命想要
example_sentence: Dying for a chance to perform on stage, the young musician practiced every single day.
sentence_zh: 極其渴望有機會在舞台上表演，這位年輕音樂家每天都在練習。

definition_zh: (動) 死亡；死掉　(動) 來自；由於
example_sentence: Because many patients died from the flu last winter, hospitals prepared more beds this year.
sentence_zh: 因為許多病患去年冬天死於流感，醫院今年準備了更多床位。

definition_zh: (動) 逐漸消亡；相繼死去　(動) 逐漸消失；衰退
example_sentence: Hardly did the old trees die off before new species began to flourish in the forest.
sentence_zh: 老樹還沒完全消亡，新物種就開始在森林中繁衍。

definition_zh: (動) 逐漸消失；滅絕
example_sentence: Many species that lived in rainforests are dying out because their habitats are being destroyed.
sentence_zh: 許多曾經住在雨林裡的物種正在逐漸滅絕，因為牠們的棲息地被破壞了。

definition_zh: (動) 死亡；去世　(動) 熄滅；停止運作
example_sentence: Many soldiers sacrificed their lives to die for their country's freedom.
sentence_zh: 許多士兵犧牲生命為了為國家的自由而死。

definition_zh: (名) 死忠粉絲；頑固分子　(形) 死心塌地的；忠實不渝的
example_sentence: Taylor Swift's diehard fans waited overnight outside the concert venue.
sentence_zh: 泰勒絲的死忠粉絲在演唱會場外徹夜排隊。

definition_zh: (名) 柴油；柴油引擎　(形) 柴油的
example_sentence: Diesel engines are commonly used in trucks and buses throughout Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 柴油引擎在台灣的卡車和公車上很常見。

definition_zh: (名) 飲食；節食　(動) 節食；限制飲食
example_sentence: Although Maria followed a strict diet, she still couldn't lose weight as quickly as expected.
sentence_zh: 雖然瑪麗亞遵循嚴格的節食計畫，但她的體重下降速度仍未如預期那麼快。

definition_zh: (形) 飲食的；與飲食有關的　(形) 飲食習慣的；飲食方式的
example_sentence: Following a dietary plan that limits sugar, many students find their energy and focus improving throughout the school day.
sentence_zh: 遵循限制糖分的飲食計畫，許多學生發現他們在上課期間的精力和專注力都有所提高。

definition_zh: (名) 營養師；飲食營養專家
example_sentence: The dietitian who works at our school hospital helps students plan balanced meals.
sentence_zh: 在我們學校醫院工作的營養師幫助學生規劃均衡飲食。

definition_zh: (動) 不同；相異　(動) 意見不合；有分歧
example_sentence: If the two study methods differ in effectiveness, students should choose the more efficient one.
sentence_zh: 如果這兩種讀書方法的效果不同，學生應該選擇較有效率的方法。

definition_zh: (名) 差異；不同　(名) 差額；差數
example_sentence: The main difference between the two plans is the cost.
sentence_zh: 這兩個計畫之間的主要差異是成本。

definition_zh: (形) 不同的；有區別的　(形) 各式各樣的；多種的
example_sentence: Students learn different subjects to prepare for the entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 學生學習不同的科目以準備大學入學考試。

definition_zh: (動) 區分；辨別　(動) 使不同；區別對待
example_sentence: Learning to differentiate between fact and opinion helps students evaluate information more critically.
sentence_zh: 學習區分事實和觀點，有助於學生更批判性地評估資訊。

definition_zh: (形) 困難的；難的　(形) 難相處的；不容易的
example_sentence: Although the math problem is difficult, students must solve it carefully during the exam.
sentence_zh: 雖然數學題目很困難，但學生必須在考試中仔細解答。

definition_zh: (名) 困難；難度　(名) 難事；麻煩
example_sentence: Having faced numerous difficulties, the student finally passed the challenging exam.
sentence_zh: 經歷了許多困難後，這名學生終於通過了這場具有挑戰性的考試。

definition_zh: (形) [dɪˋfjus] 散開的；分散的　(動) [dɪˋfjuz] 散開；傳播
example_sentence: The diffuse light that filtered through the frosted glass created a soft, calming atmosphere in the study room.
sentence_zh: 透過磨砂玻璃散射進來的柔和光線在書房營造出寧靜的氛圍。

definition_zh: (動) 開始認真做；埋頭工作　(動) 狼吞虎嚥；大口吃
example_sentence: After reviewing the test format, students dug in and studied hard for the exam.
sentence_zh: 在查看了考試形式後，學生們埋頭苦讀，為考試做準備。

definition_zh: (動) 深入研究；仔細調查
example_sentence: If students dug into historical documents, they would discover fascinating truths about Taiwan's past.
sentence_zh: 如果學生深入研究歷史文獻，他們會發現關於臺灣過去的迷人真相。

definition_zh: (動) 挖出；發掘　(動) 找出；搜尋
example_sentence: The archaeologist dug out ancient pottery from the underground site.
sentence_zh: 考古學家從地下遺址挖出了古代陶器。

definition_zh: (動) 挖出；挖掘　(動) 揭露；查出
example_sentence: Digging up old photos from the attic, the family discovered forgotten memories and laughed together.
sentence_zh: 從閣樓挖出舊照片，這個家庭發現了被遺忘的回憶，一起笑了起來。

definition_zh: (動) 挖；掘　(動) 挖掘；尋找
example_sentence: As the archaeologist dug deeper into the site, she discovered ancient pottery fragments.
sentence_zh: 當考古學家更深入地挖掘遺址時，她發現了古代陶器碎片。

definition_zh: (動) [dəˋdʒɛst] 消化；吸收　(名) [ˋdaɪdʒɛst] 文摘；摘要
example_sentence: Only after the body digests the food properly can energy be released for daily activities.
sentence_zh: 唯有在身體適當消化食物後，才能釋放能量供日常活動使用。

definition_zh: (形) 容易消化的；易於吸收的
example_sentence: Food that is digestible provides nutrients our body can absorb efficiently.
sentence_zh: 容易消化的食物提供身體能有效吸收的營養。

definition_zh: (名) 消化；消化作用　(名) 理解；吸收
example_sentence: Eating slowly helps digestion to work more efficiently during meals.
sentence_zh: 進食緩慢有助於消化在進餐時更有效地運作。

definition_zh: (形) 消化的；幫助消化的　(名) 消化劑；助消化的物質
example_sentence: Eating digestive biscuits after meals helps your stomach feel more comfortable.
sentence_zh: 飯後吃消化餅乾有助於讓你的胃感到更舒服。

definition_zh: (名) 數字；手指
example_sentence: Each digit in the password must be different from the others.
sentence_zh: 密碼中的每個數字必須彼此不同。

definition_zh: (形) 數位的；數字的　(形) 手指的
example_sentence: As digital technology continues to develop, more students prefer studying online rather than attending classes in person.
sentence_zh: 隨著數位科技持續發展，愈來愈多學生傾向於線上學習，而不是親自到教室上課。

definition_zh: (形) 莊嚴的；端莊的　(動) 使...顯得莊重
example_sentence: Standing dignified in formal attire, the ambassador greeted each guest with respect.
sentence_zh: 大使身穿正式服裝，姿態莊嚴地迎接每位來賓，表現出尊重。

definition_zh: (動) 使...尊貴；使...莊嚴　(動) 賦予...尊嚴；增添...價值
example_sentence: The ceremony that dignified the award recipients reflected the school's commitment to excellence.
sentence_zh: 那場典禮為獲獎學生增添了莊嚴感，反映了學校對卓越的執著。

definition_zh: (名) 高級官員；政要　(名) 貴人；名流
example_sentence: If the visiting dignitary arrives on time, the ceremony would proceed smoothly without delay.
sentence_zh: 如果訪問的高級官員按時抵達，典禮將會順利進行，不會有延誤。

definition_zh: (名) 尊嚴；尊貴　(名) 莊重；體面
example_sentence: The athlete maintained dignity despite losing the important championship game.
sentence_zh: 儘管輸掉了重要的冠軍賽，該運動員仍保持了尊嚴。

definition_zh: (動) 使破敗；使荒廢　(形) 破敗的；年久失修的
example_sentence: The old mansion was left to dilapidate for decades to avoid paying property taxes.
sentence_zh: 這座老宅被任其破敗數十年以避免繳納房產稅。

definition_zh: (形) 破舊的；殘破的　(形) 衰敗的；廢棄的
example_sentence: The old dilapidated house stood empty on the hill for many years.
sentence_zh: 那棟老舊破損的房子在山上空置了許多年。

definition_zh: (動) 擴張；膨脹　(動) 詳述；闡述
example_sentence: As the doctor examined the patient's eyes, the pupils dilated when exposed to bright light.
sentence_zh: 當醫生檢查病人的眼睛時，瞳孔在受到強光照射下擴張了。

definition_zh: (名) 進退兩難的局面；困境　(名) 兩難的選擇；難題
example_sentence: Having faced multiple job offers from competing companies, Sarah found herself caught in a difficult dilemma.
sentence_zh: 在收到來自競爭公司的多份工作邀約後，莎拉發現自己陷入了困難的兩難局面。

definition_zh: (名) 勤奮；努力　(形) 勤奮的；認真的
example_sentence: Students who demonstrate diligence in their studies achieve better results on the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 在學習中表現出勤奮的學生在學測中取得更好的成績。

definition_zh: (形) 勤勉的；認真的　(形) 盡心盡力的；努力的
example_sentence: Diligent students who study hard every day achieve better grades.
sentence_zh: 每天認真讀書的勤勉學生會取得更好的成績。

definition_zh: (副) 勤奮地；認真地　(副) 孜孜不倦地；努力地
example_sentence: If students studied diligently every day, they would achieve excellent results on the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 如果學生每天都勤奮地讀書，他們就會在學測上取得優異成績。

definition_zh: (動) 稀釋；沖淡　(形) 稀釋的；淡的
example_sentence: Adding water to juice dilutes its strong flavor and makes it taste sweeter.
sentence_zh: 在果汁中加水會稀釋其濃烈的味道，使其嚐起來更甜。

definition_zh: (形) 昏暗的；模糊的　(動) 使變暗；調暗
example_sentence: Dimming the classroom lights before the movie, the teacher created a relaxed atmosphere for students.
sentence_zh: 老師調暗教室燈光放映電影，為學生營造輕鬆的氛圍。

definition_zh: (名) 十分硬幣；少量金錢
example_sentence: Although saving just a dime each day seems small, it gradually builds into real savings.
sentence_zh: 雖然每天只存一枚十分硬幣看起來很少，但它會逐漸累積成真正的儲蓄。

definition_zh: (名) 尺寸；維度　(名) 規模；範圍
example_sentence: Only after considering the social dimension did the project gain full support.
sentence_zh: 直到考慮到社會層面，這個專案才獲得完全的支持。

definition_zh: (動) 減少；降低　(動) 縮小；衰退
example_sentence: The student's confidence, which diminished after failing the exam, gradually returned through consistent study.
sentence_zh: 那位學生的信心在考試失敗後減少了，但透過持續念書逐漸恢復。

definition_zh: (形) 很小的；微小的　(名) 小型詞；昵稱詞
example_sentence: The author used diminutive names to make the characters seem more endearing to readers.
sentence_zh: 作者使用小型詞來讓角色對讀者顯得更討人喜歡。

definition_zh: (名) 調光器；亮度調節裝置　(動) 調暗；使變暗
example_sentence: Installing a dimmer switch in the bedroom lets students adjust lighting for studying or relaxation.
sentence_zh: 在臥室安裝調光開關可以讓學生根據需要調整燈光來讀書或放鬆。

definition_zh: (名) 酒窩；凹陷　(動) 形成酒窩；出現凹陷
example_sentence: When Sarah smiles, two dimples appear on her cheeks.
sentence_zh: 當莎拉微笑時，她的臉頰上出現兩個酒窩。

definition_zh: (動片) 以…自豪；反覆談論…　(動片) 靠…招搖；藉…炫耀
example_sentence: Because Maria dined out on her internship at a tech company, everyone knew about her summer experience.
sentence_zh: 因為瑪麗亞經常炫耀她在科技公司的實習經歷，所以大家都知道她的暑期經驗。

definition_zh: (動) 在外面餐廳吃飯；外食
example_sentence: Dining out at a fancy restaurant, the family celebrated their daughter's graduation with joy.
sentence_zh: 在高級餐廳外食慶祝女兒畢業，這個家庭充滿喜悅。

definition_zh: (動) 用餐；進餐　(動) 吃飯
example_sentence: The restaurant where families dine together on weekends is always crowded.
sentence_zh: 家人在週末一起用餐的那家餐廳總是很擁擠。

definition_zh: (名) 用餐者；食客　(名) 小餐館；餐廳
example_sentence: If a diner requests extra sauce, the restaurant staff will prepare it immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果用餐者要求額外的醬料，餐廳員工會立即準備。

definition_zh: (名) 用餐；進餐　(形) 用餐的；餐飲的
example_sentence: The dining hall serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner every day.
sentence_zh: 餐廳每天供應早餐、午餐和晚餐。

definition_zh: (名) 晚餐；正餐
example_sentence: Parents prepare dinner to feed their children nutritious meals.
sentence_zh: 父母準備晚餐是為了讓孩子吃營養的飯菜。

definition_zh: (名) 晚餐時間；吃晚飯的時刻
example_sentence: Dinnertime at my house is usually around six o'clock in the evening.
sentence_zh: 我家的晚餐時間通常在傍晚六點左右。

definition_zh: (名) 餐具；盤子和碗等用餐用具
example_sentence: Because dinnerware made of ceramic breaks easily, many families prefer stainless steel options.
sentence_zh: 因為陶瓷製的餐具很容易破碎，許多家庭更喜歡不鏽鋼的選擇。

definition_zh: (名) 恐龍；史前巨大爬蟲類
example_sentence: Having disappeared millions of years ago, dinosaurs remain one of science's greatest mysteries.
sentence_zh: 恐龍已在數百萬年前滅絕，但仍然是科學中最大的謎團之一。

definition_zh: (名) 二極體；二極管
example_sentence: The diode, which conducts electricity in only one direction, is essential for converting AC to DC current.
sentence_zh: 二極體是只能單向導電的元件，對於將交流電轉換為直流電至關重要。

definition_zh: (動) 浸入；沾一下　(動) 快速查閱；涉獵
example_sentence: Before painting the walls, dipping the brush in water helps make the work easier.
sentence_zh: 粉刷牆壁前，把刷子浸入水裡有助於讓工作更輕鬆。

definition_zh: (動) 浸入；涉獵　(動) 動用；支取
example_sentence: If saving accounts offered better interest, many students would dip into their emergency funds.
sentence_zh: 如果儲蓄帳戶提供更好的利息，許多學生會動用他們的應急基金。

definition_zh: (動) 退出；放棄　(動) 快速浸入後立即取出
example_sentence: When the project became too difficult, several team members decided to dip out.
sentence_zh: 當專案變得太困難時，幾位團隊成員決定退出。

definition_zh: (動) 浸；沾　(名) 醬料；下降
example_sentence: Dipping the bread into the olive oil, Sarah enjoyed the simple Italian appetizer.
sentence_zh: 莎拉把麵包浸入橄欖油中，享受簡單的義大利前菜。

definition_zh: (名) 文憑；畢業證書　(名) 外交文件；國家證書
example_sentence: Although earning a diploma requires four years of hard work, many students consider it essential for their future careers.
sentence_zh: 雖然獲得文憑需要四年的辛苦工作，但許多學生認為它對未來職業至關重要。

definition_zh: (名) 外交；外交手段　(名) 手腕；策略
example_sentence: Only through careful diplomacy can conflicts between nations be resolved peacefully.
sentence_zh: 只有透過謹慎的外交，國家間的衝突才能和平解決。

definition_zh: (名) 外交官；外交家　(形) 圓滑的；策略性的
example_sentence: The diplomat who negotiated the trade agreement earned respect from both countries.
sentence_zh: 那位協商貿易協定的外交官贏得了兩國的尊重。

definition_zh: (形) 外交的；經外交途徑的　(形) 圓滑的；得體的
example_sentence: The ambassador adopted a diplomatic approach to resolve the trade dispute between nations.
sentence_zh: 大使採取外交手段來解決國家間的貿易爭議。

definition_zh: (名) 油尺；量油棒　(名) 愚蠢的人；笨蛋
example_sentence: The mechanic used a dipstick to check the engine oil level before the long road trip.
sentence_zh: 那位技工在長途旅行前用油尺檢查引擎機油的油位。

definition_zh: (形) 極度的；危急的　(形) 嚴重的；絕望的
example_sentence: The hospital faced dire financial problems and needed immediate government support.
sentence_zh: 這家醫院面臨極度的財務問題，需要政府立即支持。

definition_zh: (動) 指導；導演　(形) 直接的；直達的　(副) 直接地；徑直
example_sentence: The teacher directed students how to solve the problem, so everyone understood it better.
sentence_zh: 老師直接指導學生如何解決問題，所以大家都更了解了。

definition_zh: (名) 方向；指示　(動) 指導；引導
example_sentence: Following the teacher's directions carefully, the students found the correct answer quickly.
sentence_zh: 仔細遵循老師的指示，學生們很快找到了正確答案。

definition_zh: (形) 指導性的；命令式的　(名) 指示；指令
example_sentence: The safety regulations, which were directive in nature, required all employees to wear helmets.
sentence_zh: 那些本質上具有指導性的安全規定要求所有員工配戴安全帽。

definition_zh: (副) 直接地；正直地　(副) 立即；馬上
example_sentence: If students study the material directly before the exam, their test scores will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試前直接研讀教材，他們的考試成績將會顯著提高。

definition_zh: (名) 導演；主任　(名) 董事；理事
example_sentence: The film director decided to shoot the movie in Taiwan last summer.
sentence_zh: 那位電影導演決定去年夏天在台灣拍攝這部電影。

definition_zh: (名) 目錄；名冊　(名) 目錄夾；資料夾
example_sentence: Students need to consult the school directory to find their teachers' office phone numbers.
sentence_zh: 學生需要查閱學校名冊來找到老師辦公室的電話號碼。

definition_zh: (名) 泥土；塵埃　(名) 骯髒的物質；污垢
example_sentence: After playing soccer in the park, the players' uniforms were covered with dirt and grass stains.
sentence_zh: 在公園踢足球後，球員的球衣被泥土和草漬覆蓋。

definition_zh: (形) 髒的；骯髒的　(動) 弄髒；使骯髒
example_sentence: Because the playground was dirty after heavy rain, students had to clean it before playing sports.
sentence_zh: 因為大雨後操場很髒，學生們在運動前必須先清潔它。

definition_zh: (名) 殘疾；身心障礙　(名) 無能力；缺陷
example_sentence: Having experienced a serious accident, the athlete overcame disability to achieve Olympic gold.
sentence_zh: 經歷了一場嚴重事故，這位運動員克服身心障礙而獲得奧運金牌。

definition_zh: (動) 使失去能力；使無法工作　(形) 殘疾的；無法行動的
example_sentence: The accident disabled the machine that the factory had relied on for years.
sentence_zh: 那場意外使工廠多年依賴的機器無法工作。

definition_zh: (形) 殘疾的；身心障礙的　(動) 使失去能力；使殘疾
example_sentence: The disabled athlete competed in the Paralympics and won three gold medals.
sentence_zh: 那位身心障礙的運動員參加了殘障奧運會，並贏得三枚金牌。

definition_zh: (名) 劣勢；不利條件　(動) 使處於不利地位
example_sentence: If starting school later in the year would disadvantage students, the education ministry should reconsider that policy.
sentence_zh: 如果在一年較晚時開始上學會使學生處於不利地位，教育部應該重新考慮該政策。

definition_zh: (形) 處於不利地位的；缺乏機會的
example_sentence: Disadvantaged students often face more challenges in their education.
sentence_zh: 處於不利地位的學生在教育上經常面臨更多挑戰。

definition_zh: (動) 不同意；持不同意見　(動) 與…意見相左
example_sentence: Disagreeing with the teacher's explanation, many students raised their hands to ask questions.
sentence_zh: 不同意老師解釋的許多學生舉手提出問題。

definition_zh: (動) 不同意；反對　(動) 意見不合；爭執
example_sentence: Although the two scientists disagree about the research results, they respect each other's opinions.
sentence_zh: 雖然這兩位科學家對研究結果意見不合，但他們互相尊重彼此的看法。

definition_zh: (名) 異議；分歧　(名) 爭執；不同意
example_sentence: Not only did the two friends have a disagreement about the project, but they also stopped talking for weeks.
sentence_zh: 那兩位朋友不僅對這個專案有異議，而且幾週都沒有交談。

definition_zh: (動) 消失；不見　(動) 失蹤；消滅
example_sentence: The ancient civilization that disappeared thousands of years ago remains a mystery to modern archaeologists.
sentence_zh: 那個數千年前消失的古代文明至今仍是現代考古學家的謎團。

definition_zh: (名) 消失；失蹤　(名) 不見；消亡
example_sentence: The police investigated the mysterious disappearance to find the missing person quickly.
sentence_zh: 警察調查了這起神祕失蹤事件，以便迅速尋找失蹤者。

definition_zh: (動) 使失望；令人沮喪　(動) 破壞；挫折
example_sentence: Failing the exam disappointed many students and their parents alike.
sentence_zh: 考試不及格讓許多學生和他們的父母都感到失望。

definition_zh: (形) 失望的；沮喪的
example_sentence: The students felt disappointed when the school cancelled the field trip.
sentence_zh: 當學校取消校外教學時，學生們感到失望。

definition_zh: (形) 令人失望的；使人沮喪的
example_sentence: Although the concert was disappointing, the band's energy still impressed many fans.
sentence_zh: 雖然音樂會令人失望，樂團的熱情仍然打動了許多粉絲。

definition_zh: (名) 失望；讓人失望的事物　(動) 使失望；辜負
example_sentence: Failing the exam despite studying hard, Sarah felt deep disappointment about her test results.
sentence_zh: 儘管努力讀書，莎拉考試不及格，對她的考試成績感到深深的失望。

definition_zh: (名) 不贊成；反對　(動) 不同意；不認可
example_sentence: The teacher's disapproval of cheating made students study harder.
sentence_zh: 老師對作弊的反對使學生更加努力讀書。

definition_zh: (動) 不贊成；反對　不同意；不滿意
example_sentence: If parents disapprove of their children's career choice, open communication becomes essential.
sentence_zh: 如果父母不贊成孩子的職業選擇，坦誠溝通就變得很重要。

definition_zh: (動) 解除武裝；放下武器　(動) 消除敵意；使溫和
example_sentence: The peace agreement required both countries to disarm their nuclear weapons completely.
sentence_zh: 和平協議要求兩國完全解除核武裝備。

definition_zh: (名) 裁軍；軍備縮減
example_sentence: Many nations signed treaties to promote disarmament and reduce global military tensions.
sentence_zh: 許多國家簽署條約以促進裁軍並減少全球軍事緊張局勢。

definition_zh: (名) 混亂；亂七八糟　(動) 使混亂；弄得亂糟糟
example_sentence: The students' messy desks and scattered papers created a complete disarray in the classroom.
sentence_zh: 學生們凌亂的書桌和散落的紙張在教室裡造成了完全的混亂。

definition_zh: (名) 災難；災害　(名) 慘敗；失敗
example_sentence: As the earthquake struck the city, disaster spread rapidly before rescue teams could arrive.
sentence_zh: 當地震襲擊城市時，災難在救援隊到達之前迅速蔓延。

definition_zh: (形) 災難性的；毀滅性的　(形) 極糟糕的；非常失敗的
example_sentence: Having made a disastrous decision, the company lost millions of dollars within weeks.
sentence_zh: 做出了災難性的決定後，該公司在數週內損失了數百萬美元。

definition_zh: (動) 解散；散開　(動) 遣散；解除
example_sentence: The rock band, which disbanded after ten years of touring, recently reunited for a special concert.
sentence_zh: 這支搖滾樂團在巡演十年後解散，最近重新聚合舉辦特別演唱會。

definition_zh: (名) 不相信；懷疑　(動) 不相信；懷疑
example_sentence: The witness's shocking testimony left the jury in a state of complete disbelief and confusion.
sentence_zh: 證人的驚人證詞使陪審團陷入完全懷疑和困惑的狀態。

definition_zh: (名) 支付；撥款　(名) 支出金額；分配資金
example_sentence: If the government approved the budget, disbursement of funds to schools would begin immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果政府批准了預算，資金撥給學校的工作就會立即開始。

definition_zh: (動) [dɪsˋkɑrd] 丟棄；拋棄　(名) [ˋdɪsˌkɑrd] 被丟棄的東西；廢品
example_sentence: After cleaning the closet, Sarah decided to discard old clothes she no longer wore.
sentence_zh: 整理衣櫥後，莎拉決定丟棄她不再穿的舊衣服。

definition_zh: (動) 辨別；看出　(動) 領悟；理解
example_sentence: Carefully examining the painting, art experts discerned hidden symbols beneath the surface layers.
sentence_zh: 藝術專家仔細檢視這幅畫，在表面下看出了隱藏的符號。

definition_zh: (形) 可辨別的；明顯的
example_sentence: Although the differences between the two paintings are subtle, a clear pattern becomes discernible when you examine them closely.
sentence_zh: 儘管這兩幅畫之間的差異很細微，但當你仔細檢查時，一個明顯的模式就變得可辨別了。

definition_zh: (形) 有眼光的；善於判斷的　(形) 敏銳的；有分辨力的
example_sentence: Seldom does a discerning student overlook the subtle differences between these two theories.
sentence_zh: 很少有眼光的學生會忽略這兩個理論之間細微的差異。

definition_zh: (名) ['dɪstʃɑrdʒ] 釋放；流出物　(動) [dɪs'tʃɑrdʒ] 釋放；排放
example_sentence: The factory that discharged toxic waste into the river faced serious environmental fines.
sentence_zh: 那間向河流排放有毒廢物的工廠面臨嚴厲的環境罰款。

definition_zh: (名) 門徒；弟子　(名) 追隨者；信徒
example_sentence: Many students studied under the master teacher to become dedicated disciples of his teaching method.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在這位大師老師門下學習，目的是成為他教學方法的忠實門徒。

definition_zh: (形) 紀律的；處罰性的　(名) 紀律委員會；懲罰措施
example_sentence: The school's disciplinary committee decided to hold a serious meeting about student conduct violations.
sentence_zh: 學校的紀律委員會決定舉行一次關於學生違規行為的嚴肅會議。

definition_zh: (名) 紀律；訓練　(動) 懲罰；訓練
example_sentence: Strict discipline in the classroom helps students focus on their studies.
sentence_zh: 教室裡的嚴格紀律幫助學生專注於功課。

definition_zh: (名) 免責聲明；否認
example_sentence: Although the product comes with a disclaimer, customers should still read the safety instructions carefully.
sentence_zh: 雖然產品附有免責聲明，顧客仍應該仔細閱讀安全說明。

definition_zh: (動) 揭露；披露　透露；洩露
example_sentence: Disclosing financial records to investors, the company demonstrated transparency and accountability.
sentence_zh: 向投資者披露財務紀錄，該公司展示了透明度和問責制。

definition_zh: (名) 揭露；披露　公開；曝光
example_sentence: The disclosure of company secrets, which shocked investors worldwide, led to immediate investigation.
sentence_zh: 公司機密的揭露引起了全球投資者的震驚，導致了立即調查。

definition_zh: (名) 迪斯可舞廳；迪斯可音樂
example_sentence: If the disco near the shopping mall opens tomorrow, many students would want to go dancing there.
sentence_zh: 如果購物中心附近的迪斯可舞廳明天開業，許多學生會想去那裡跳舞。

definition_zh: (名) 不適；不舒服　(動) 使不安；使不適
example_sentence: Sitting in an uncomfortable chair for hours caused physical discomfort during the exam.
sentence_zh: 坐在不舒服的椅子上好幾個小時在考試時造成身體上的不適。

definition_zh: (動) 使不安；打亂；使困惑
example_sentence: The unexpected question during the interview served to disconcert the nervous candidate.
sentence_zh: 面試中那個意外的問題打亂了那位緊張的考生。

definition_zh: (副) 令人不安地；令人困惑地
example_sentence: The teacher's disconcertingly silent response to the student's question created an awkward moment.
sentence_zh: 老師對學生的提問給予的令人不安的沉默回應造成了尷尬的時刻。

definition_zh: (動) 斷開；切斷　(動) 斷絕；停止聯繫
example_sentence: Although the technician disconnected the old server, the company's data remained safe in the cloud.
sentence_zh: 雖然技術人員斷開了舊伺服器，但公司的資料仍安全保存在雲端。

definition_zh: (名) 不滿；不滿足　(形) 不滿的；不高興的
example_sentence: Dissatisfied with the unfair grades, many students expressed their discontent in the class meeting.
sentence_zh: 許多學生對不公平的成績感到不滿，在班會上表達了他們的不滿。

definition_zh: (形) 不滿的；不悅的　(形) 不開心的；失望的
example_sentence: Students who felt discontented with their exam results decided to retake the test.
sentence_zh: 對考試成績感到不滿的學生決定重新參加考試。

definition_zh: (動) 停止；中斷　(動) 終止；不再繼續
example_sentence: The company decided to discontinue the product line due to low sales and changing market demands.
sentence_zh: 由於銷售不佳和市場需求改變，該公司決定停止生產該產品線。

definition_zh: (名) 不和；爭執　(動) 不一致；相衝突
example_sentence: If the band members resolved their discord, their music would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果樂隊成員解決他們的不和，他們的音樂會大幅進步。

definition_zh: (形) 不和諧的；衝突的　(形) 不一致的；相矛盾的
example_sentence: The discordant sounds from the construction site disturbed neighbors throughout the afternoon.
sentence_zh: 來自建築工地不和諧的聲音整個下午都在擾亂鄰居。

definition_zh: (名) 迪斯可舞廳；夜總會
example_sentence: Dancing at the discotheque until midnight, the students enjoyed their graduation celebration.
sentence_zh: 在迪斯可舞廳跳舞到午夜，學生們享受他們的畢業慶祝。

definition_zh: (名) ['dɪskaʊnt] 折扣；優惠　(動) [dɪs'kaʊnt] 打折；減價
example_sentence: Since the store offered a big discount, many customers rushed to buy winter coats.
sentence_zh: 由於商店提供大折扣，許多顧客蜂擁購買冬季外套。

definition_zh: (動) 使失去勇氣；打擊信心　(動) 阻止；勸阻
example_sentence: Never should harsh criticism discourage students from pursuing their dreams.
sentence_zh: 嚴厲的批評絕不應該打擊學生追尋夢想的勇氣。

definition_zh: (形) 灰心的；沮喪的　(動) 使灰心；打消…的念頭
example_sentence: Students who feel discouraged by difficult exam questions should ask their teachers for help.
sentence_zh: 感到被難題打擊而灰心的學生應該向老師求助。

definition_zh: (名) [dɪsˈkors] 談話；論述　(動) [dɪˈskors] 討論；論述
example_sentence: Students joined the classroom discourse to understand different perspectives on climate change.
sentence_zh: 學生參與課堂論述，以了解對氣候變遷的不同看法。

definition_zh: (動) 發現；發掘　(動) 探索；揭露
example_sentence: Researchers discovered a new species of butterfly in the rainforest last year.
sentence_zh: 研究人員去年在雨林中發現了一種新的蝴蝶物種。

definition_zh: (名) 發現；發現物　(動) 發現；探索
example_sentence: The discovery of penicillin changed medicine forever.
sentence_zh: 青黴素的發現永遠改變了醫學。

definition_zh: (動) 使失去信譽；詆毀　(名) 恥辱；損失信任
example_sentence: Although the athlete denied the accusations, the scandal discredited his reputation among fans.
sentence_zh: 雖然這位運動員否認了指控，但這場醜聞使他在粉絲心中失去信譽。

definition_zh: (形) 謹慎的；小心的　(形) 不張揚的；低調的
example_sentence: Being discreet about her friend's secret, Maya avoided mentioning it during lunch.
sentence_zh: 由於謹慎對待朋友的秘密，瑪亞在午餐時避免提及此事。

definition_zh: (名) 差異；不符　(名) 矛盾；出入
example_sentence: The discrepancy that exists between the two reports confuses the accountant.
sentence_zh: 存在於兩份報告之間的差異使會計師感到困惑。

definition_zh: (形) 分開的；各別的　(形) 謹慎的；不張揚的
example_sentence: If the teacher provides discrete groups for the project, students can work more efficiently together.
sentence_zh: 如果老師為專題提供分開的小組，學生可以更有效率地一起工作。

definition_zh: (名) 判斷力；分寸　(名) 自由裁量權；決定權
example_sentence: The teacher used discretion when deciding the student's final grade.
sentence_zh: 老師在決定學生最後成績時運用了判斷力。

definition_zh: (形) 可自由決定的；可裁量的
example_sentence: The principal has discretionary power to decide student discipline cases fairly.
sentence_zh: 校長擁有可自由裁量的權力，以公平地決定學生懲處案件。

definition_zh: (動) 歧視；區別對待　(動) 區分；辨別
example_sentence: Employers who discriminate against job applicants based on age or gender face serious legal consequences.
sentence_zh: 根據年齡或性別歧視求職者的雇主會面臨嚴重的法律後果。

definition_zh: (名) 歧視；差別對待　(名) 辨別；區分
example_sentence: Although discrimination against minorities remains a serious problem, many organizations are working to create more equal workplaces.
sentence_zh: 儘管針對少數族裔的歧視仍是嚴重問題，許多機構正致力於創造更平等的工作環境。

definition_zh: (動) 討論；商量　(動) 談論；講述
example_sentence: Having discussed the project plan thoroughly, the team felt confident moving forward.
sentence_zh: 詳細討論過專案計畫後，團隊對繼續推進感到有信心。

definition_zh: (名) 討論；討論會　(動) 討論；商討
example_sentence: The discussion that our class held yesterday helped us understand the social issues better.
sentence_zh: 我們班昨天舉辦的討論會幫助我們更好地理解了社會議題。

definition_zh: (名) 輕蔑；不屑　(動) 輕視；鄙視　(形) 充滿輕蔑的；不屑一顧的
example_sentence: The wealthy businessman showed disdain toward people from lower social classes and refused to speak with them.
sentence_zh: 那位富有的商人對來自較低社會階層的人表現出輕蔑，拒絕與他們交談。

definition_zh: (形) 輕蔑的；傲慢的　(副) 以輕蔑的方式
example_sentence: If Mark studied harder, he would not treat his classmates' ideas so disdainfully.
sentence_zh: 如果馬克更努力讀書，他就不會以如此輕蔑的態度對待同學的想法。

definition_zh: (名) 疾病；病　(動) 使患病；使衰退
example_sentence: Regular exercise and healthy eating help prevent serious disease.
sentence_zh: 規律運動和健康飲食有助於預防嚴重疾病。

definition_zh: (動) 下船；下飛機　登陸；離開
example_sentence: Disembarking from the cruise ship, passengers eagerly walked toward the tropical beach.
sentence_zh: 從郵輪下船，乘客們急不可待地走向熱帶海灘。

definition_zh: (動) 毀損...的容貌；破壞...的外觀
example_sentence: Although the accident disfigured his face, his determination to pursue his dreams remained unchanged.
sentence_zh: 雖然那場意外毀損了他的容貌，但他追求夢想的決心依然未變。

definition_zh: (形) 毀容的；面目全非的　(動) 毀損；使變醜
example_sentence: Seldom has a burn victim's face been so severely disfigured by the accident.
sentence_zh: 很少有燒傷患者的臉因為意外而受到如此嚴重的毀容。

definition_zh: (名) 恥辱；羞辱　(動) 使蒙羞；玷污　(形) 可恥的；丟臉的
example_sentence: The athlete's cheating scandal was a disgrace that damaged the reputation which his team had built for decades.
sentence_zh: 那位運動員的作弊醜聞是一場恥辱，損害了他的隊伍數十年來建立的聲譽。

definition_zh: (形) 可恥的；不名譽的　(形) 令人羞愧的；醜陋的
example_sentence: The athlete trained hard to avoid disgraceful performance at the national competition.
sentence_zh: 那位運動員努力訓練以避免在全國比賽中表現可恥。

definition_zh: (名) 偽裝；化妝　(動) 偽裝；隱瞞
example_sentence: The spy wore a disguise and went undercover to collect secret information.
sentence_zh: 那名間諜穿著偽裝並臥底以蒐集祕密情報。

definition_zh: (名) 厭惡；反感　(動) 使厭惡；使反感　(形) 感到厭惡的
example_sentence: The rotten smell from the garbage filled everyone with disgust and made them leave.
sentence_zh: 垃圾散發的腐臭味讓每個人都感到厭惡，他們因此離開了。

definition_zh: (形) 感到厭惡的；反感的
example_sentence: Disgusted by the moldy food in the refrigerator, Maria decided to clean it thoroughly.
sentence_zh: 由於對冰箱裡發霉的食物感到厭惡，瑪麗亞決定徹底清潔它。

definition_zh: (形) 令人厭惡的；令人討厭的
example_sentence: Seeing garbage scattered on the beach, students found the pollution absolutely disgusting.
sentence_zh: 看到垃圾散落在海灘上，學生們發現污染令人感到非常厭惡。

definition_zh: (動) 分配；發放　(動) 提供；施加
example_sentence: The restaurant dished out free samples that attracted many hungry customers.
sentence_zh: 那家餐廳分配了免費試吃品，吸引了許多飢餓的顧客。

definition_zh: (動) 盛菜到盤子上；提供　(動) 展示；呈現
example_sentence: If the restaurant dishes up fresh seafood every day, customers will keep coming back for more.
sentence_zh: 如果這家餐廳每天都提供新鮮海鮮，顧客就會一直回來光顧。

definition_zh: (名) 盤子；菜餚　(動) 盛放；端上
example_sentence: My mother prepared a delicious dish for our family dinner last night.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽昨晚為家人準備了一道美味的菜餚。

definition_zh: (名) 不和諧；失調　(名) 不一致；衝突
example_sentence: The two countries signed a peace agreement to resolve disharmony and build mutual trust.
sentence_zh: 這兩個國家簽署和平協議以解決不和諧並建立相互信任。

definition_zh: (動) 使沮喪；使失去勇氣　(動) 使氣餒；使灰心
example_sentence: Failing the midterm exam disheartened many students and reduced their motivation for studying.
sentence_zh: 期中考不及格使許多學生感到沮喪，並降低了他們的讀書動力。

definition_zh: (形) 灰心的；沮喪的　(動) 使灰心；使沮喪
example_sentence: Although the basketball team lost the championship, the players didn't feel disheartened because they had tried their best.
sentence_zh: 雖然籃球隊失去了冠軍，但球員們並沒有感到灰心，因為他們已經盡力了。

definition_zh: (形) 不誠實的；欺騙的　(名) 不誠實的人；騙子
example_sentence: Having been caught cheating on the exam, the dishonest student faced serious consequences from the school.
sentence_zh: 因為在考試中作弊被抓到，那個不誠實的學生面臨了學校的嚴重處罰。

definition_zh: (名) 不誠實；欺騙　(形) 不誠實的；欺騙的
example_sentence: The student who submitted work containing dishonesty was suspended from school.
sentence_zh: 提交包含不誠實內容作業的學生被學校停學。

definition_zh: (名) 洗碗機；自動洗碗機
example_sentence: After dinner, my family loads the dishwasher with dirty plates and bowls.
sentence_zh: 晚餐後，我的家人把髒盤子和碗放進洗碗機。

definition_zh: (名) 幻滅；失望　(動) 使幻滅；使失望
example_sentence: If students didn't work hard, disillusionment with their future dreams would come quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生不努力，對未來夢想的幻滅感就會很快到來。

definition_zh: (形) 不願意的；不樂意的
example_sentence: Many students feel disinclined to wake up early for morning classes.
sentence_zh: 許多學生不願意為了早上的課程早起。

definition_zh: (動) 消毒；殺菌
example_sentence: Disinfecting the classroom surfaces daily helps prevent the spread of illness.
sentence_zh: 每天消毒教室表面有助於預防疾病傳播。

definition_zh: (名) 消毒劑；滅菌劑
example_sentence: Because the hospital uses strong disinfectant regularly, patients feel safer receiving treatment there.
sentence_zh: 因為醫院定期使用強力消毒劑，患者在那裡接受治療時感到更安心。

definition_zh: (名) 消毒；除菌
example_sentence: Only after thorough disinfection can the hospital safely admit new patients.
sentence_zh: 只有在徹底消毒之後，醫院才能安全地收治新病人。

definition_zh: (動) 分解；瓦解　(動) 崩潰；破裂
example_sentence: The old wooden bridge, which had disintegrated over decades, finally collapsed during the storm.
sentence_zh: 那座老木橋因為數十年來逐漸瓦解，最後在暴風雨中終於倒塌了。

definition_zh: (名) 不偏私；公正　(動) 使失去興趣；使冷淡
example_sentence: The judge recused himself to disinterest from the case and ensure fairness.
sentence_zh: 法官迴避該案件以保持公正，確保公平性。

definition_zh: (形) 不偏私的；公正的　(形) 缺乏興趣的；冷漠的
example_sentence: A disinterested judge and impartial referee ensured the competition was fair.
sentence_zh: 一位公正的法官和中立的裁判確保了比賽的公平性。

definition_zh: (名) 磁碟；光碟　(名) 圓盤；盤狀物
example_sentence: The computer stores all files on a hard disk for long-term backup.
sentence_zh: 電腦將所有檔案儲存在硬碟上作為長期備份。

definition_zh: (動) 不喜歡；厭惡　(名) 厭惡；不滿
example_sentence: Although many students dislike early morning classes, they must attend them regularly.
sentence_zh: 雖然許多學生不喜歡早上的課程，但他們必須定期出席。

definition_zh: (動) 使脫臼；使移位　(動) 擾亂；破壞
example_sentence: Falling heavily during basketball practice, the player dislocated his shoulder and had to leave the game.
sentence_zh: 在籃球練習中重摔，該球員肩膀脫臼，不得不退出比賽。

definition_zh: (動) 使移位；驅趕　(動) 推開；移動
example_sentence: The boulder that blocked the mountain road was too heavy for workers to dislodge.
sentence_zh: 那塊阻擋山路的巨石對工人來說太重了，無法移動。

definition_zh: (形) 陰鬱的；悲慘的　(形) 令人沮喪的；糟糕的
example_sentence: If the weather remains dismal next weekend, the outdoor sports festival will be postponed indefinitely.
sentence_zh: 如果下週末的天氣持續陰鬱，戶外運動節將被無限期推遲。

definition_zh: (動) 拆卸；拆除　(動) 廢除；廢棄
example_sentence: Workers dismantled the old factory equipment piece by piece.
sentence_zh: 工人們一片一片地拆卸那些舊的工廠設備。

definition_zh: (動) 使沮喪；使失望　(名) 沮喪；失望
example_sentence: The exam results were surprising enough to dismay even the most confident students in our class.
sentence_zh: 考試成績令人驚訝，足以使班上最有自信的學生感到沮喪。

definition_zh: (動) 解僱；開除　(動) 駁回；不理會
example_sentence: The principal dismissed the unfounded complaints and decided to support the teacher's decision.
sentence_zh: 校長駁回了毫無根據的投訴，並決定支持那位老師的決定。

definition_zh: (名) 解雇；開除　(名) 駁回；不受理
example_sentence: Since the company announced the dismissal of hundreds of workers, many families lost their income.
sentence_zh: 由於公司宣布解雇數百名員工，許多家庭失去了收入。

definition_zh: (名) 混亂；紊亂　(動) 使混亂；擾亂　(名) 疾病；失調
example_sentence: Having disordered the files, the intern quickly reorganized them before the manager arrived.
sentence_zh: 那位實習生把文件弄亂後，在經理到達前迅速重新整理。

definition_zh: (形) 雜亂的；混亂的　(副) 雜亂地；混亂地
example_sentence: The classroom, which had become disorderly after the exam, required immediate cleanup.
sentence_zh: 教室變得雜亂不堪，需要立即打掃，這間教室已成為需要清理的地方。

definition_zh: (動) 使失去方向感；使困惑　(動) 使不知所措；使混亂
example_sentence: The confusing road signs and sudden weather changes disoriented the hiking group during their mountain adventure.
sentence_zh: 令人困惑的路標和突然的天氣變化使登山隊在他們的山地冒險中失去了方向感。

definition_zh: (動) 貶低；輕視　(動) 詆毀；貶抑
example_sentence: If people disparaged Maria's cooking skills, she would lose confidence in the kitchen.
sentence_zh: 如果人們貶低瑪麗亞的烹飪技能，她在廚房裡就會失去信心。

definition_zh: (形) 差異很大的；各不相同的　(形) 互不相關的；不相稱的
example_sentence: The two students had disparate abilities, so they studied differently.
sentence_zh: 這兩名學生的能力差異很大，所以他們用不同的方法讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 差異；不平等　(名) 差距；懸殊
example_sentence: Facing widening income disparities, many students struggle to afford quality education.
sentence_zh: 面對日益擴大的收入差距，許多學生難以負擔優質教育。

definition_zh: (形) 冷靜的；不帶感情的　(副) 冷靜地；客觀地
example_sentence: Although the judge felt sympathy for the defendant, remaining dispassionate was necessary to deliver a fair verdict.
sentence_zh: 雖然法官對被告感到同情，但保持冷靜客觀對做出公正判決是必要的。

definition_zh: (動) 派遣；發送　(名) 公文；急件
example_sentence: Only after the emergency call arrived did the police dispatch officers to the scene.
sentence_zh: 只有在緊急電話到達後，警察才派遣警官趕往現場。

definition_zh: (動) 消除；驅散　(動) 消除疑慮；澄清
example_sentence: The teacher's clear explanation dispelled the confusion that students had about the grammar rule.
sentence_zh: 老師清楚的解釋消除了學生對文法規則的疑惑。

definition_zh: (形) 可有可無的；不必要的　(形) 可拋棄的；可替代的
example_sentence: Some employees were considered dispensable to reduce operating costs during the recession.
sentence_zh: 在經濟衰退期間，一些員工被認為是可有可無的，以降低營運成本。

definition_zh: (名) 藥房；配藥室　(名) 診療所；醫療站
example_sentence: The school health center and medicine dispensary provide free medical services to all students.
sentence_zh: 學校衛生中心和藥房為所有學生提供免費醫療服務。

definition_zh: (動) 分配；發放　(動) 免除；豁免
example_sentence: The pharmacist dispenses medications according to the doctor's prescription.
sentence_zh: 藥劑師根據醫生處方配藥。

definition_zh: (名) 分配器；販賣機　(名) 藥劑師；配藥者
example_sentence: Whenever students need tissues, the tissue dispenser in the hallway provides them conveniently.
sentence_zh: 每當學生需要面紙時，走廊裡的面紙分配器就能方便地提供。

definition_zh: (名) 散佈；傳播　(名) 分散；分佈
example_sentence: Dispersing seeds widely, the dandelion ensures its species' survival across different regions.
sentence_zh: 蒲公英廣泛散佈種子，確保物種在不同地區的生存。

definition_zh: (動) 驅散；分散　(動) 消散；散開
example_sentence: The police dispersed the crowd that had gathered outside the stadium.
sentence_zh: 警察驅散了在體育館外聚集的人群。

definition_zh: (動) 移位；驅逐　(動) 取代；替換
example_sentence: If the earthquake displaces thousands of families, the government will provide temporary shelter.
sentence_zh: 如果地震使數千戶家庭流離失所，政府將提供臨時住所。

definition_zh: (形) 流離失所的；被迫遷移的　(動) 流離失所；迫遷
example_sentence: Thousands of families became displaced after the earthquake destroyed their homes.
sentence_zh: 地震摧毀房屋後，數千戶家庭流離失所。

definition_zh: (動) 展示；陳列　(名) 展覽；表現
example_sentence: The museum arranged ancient pottery to display the cultural heritage of Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 博物館陳列古代陶器以展示台灣的文化遺產。

definition_zh: (動) 使不高興；惹惱　(動) 冒犯；引起不滿
example_sentence: Arriving late to the family dinner displeased her parents, who waited patiently.
sentence_zh: 遲到到家庭晚餐使她的父母不高興，他們耐心地等待著。

definition_zh: (形) 可拋棄的；一次性的　(形) 可處置的；可用的
example_sentence: Since disposable masks became widely available, many people use them daily for convenience and hygiene.
sentence_zh: 由於一次性口罩變得廣泛可得，許多人為了方便和衛生每天都使用它們。

definition_zh: (名) 處理；處置　(名) 可用性；處於某人掌握中
example_sentence: Having disposed of the hazardous waste properly, the factory obtained environmental certification from the government.
sentence_zh: 妥善處理了危險廢棄物後，這家工廠獲得了政府的環保認證。

definition_zh: (動) 處理；丟棄
example_sentence: The factory must properly dispose of waste materials that contain harmful chemicals.
sentence_zh: 那家工廠必須適當處理含有有害化學物質的廢棄物。

definition_zh: (動) 處理；丟棄　(動) 使傾向；使有意願
example_sentence: The school must dispose of old textbooks and equipment properly every year.
sentence_zh: 學校必須每年妥善處理舊教科書和設備。

definition_zh: (名) 性格；氣質　(名) 傾向；趨勢
example_sentence: If Maria had a more positive disposition, she would enjoy school life much more.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪麗亞的性格更樂觀一些，她會更享受學校生活。

definition_zh: (副) 不成比例地；過度地
example_sentence: Low-income families spend disproportionately more money on housing costs.
sentence_zh: 低收入家庭在住房成本上花費不成比例地更多的金錢。

definition_zh: (動) 證明...是錯誤的；駁斥
example_sentence: Disproving the old theory, the scientist presented new experimental data to the academic conference.
sentence_zh: 這位科學家通過呈現新的實驗數據駁斥了舊理論，在學術會議上發表了演講。

definition_zh: (形) 可爭議的；有爭論的　(形) 可質疑的；可商榷的
example_sentence: Although the coach's decision was disputable, the team accepted it and moved forward.
sentence_zh: 雖然教練的決定有爭議，但球隊還是接受並繼續前進。

definition_zh: (名) 爭議；爭執　(動) 爭論；質疑
example_sentence: Seldom do business partners dispute contract terms without seeking legal advice first.
sentence_zh: 商業夥伴很少在未尋求法律建議的情況下爭論合約條款。

definition_zh: (動) 取消資格；不合格　(動) 排除；使不適合
example_sentence: Athletes who test positive for banned substances are disqualified from competing in the Olympic Games.
sentence_zh: 檢測出禁用物質的運動員會被取消奧運會參賽資格。

definition_zh: (動) 使不安；使擾亂　(名) 不安；焦慮
example_sentence: The teacher spoke calmly to disquiet the students about exam results.
sentence_zh: 老師平靜地說話是為了消除學生對考試成績的不安。

definition_zh: (動) 忽視；不顧　(名) 漠視；忽略
example_sentence: Disregarding the teacher's warning, many students skipped the review session before the exam.
sentence_zh: 不顧老師的警告，許多學生在考試前跳過了複習課程。

definition_zh: (形) 名聲不好的；聲譽不佳的
example_sentence: The disreputable company was shut down after cheating many customers.
sentence_zh: 那家名聲不好的公司在欺騙許多顧客後被關閉了。

definition_zh: (動) 破壞；中斷　(動) 擾亂；打擾
example_sentence: As the fire alarm sounded, the entire exam was disrupted, forcing all students to evacuate.
sentence_zh: 當火警警報響起時，整場考試被打擾，迫使所有學生撤離。

definition_zh: (名) 中斷；打亂　(名) 破壞；混亂
example_sentence: Causing major disruption to traffic, the accident forced commuters to find alternate routes home.
sentence_zh: 這場意外造成交通大亂，迫使通勤者尋找替代回家路線。

definition_zh: (形) 破壞性的；擾亂的　(形) 造成中斷的；令人分心的
example_sentence: The disruptive student who talked constantly during class received a warning from the teacher.
sentence_zh: 那個在課堂上不斷說話、造成干擾的學生收到了老師的警告。

definition_zh: (名) 不滿；不滿意　(名) 失望；遺憾
example_sentence: If students express dissatisfaction with the school lunch quality, the cafeteria will improve the menu.
sentence_zh: 如果學生對學校午餐品質表達不滿，食堂將會改善菜單。

definition_zh: (形) 不滿意的；不滿足的
example_sentence: Many students felt dissatisfied with their exam scores and wanted to try again.
sentence_zh: 許多學生對自己的考試成績感到不滿意，想再試一次。

definition_zh: (動) 解剖；分析
example_sentence: Biology students dissect frogs to understand their internal organ structures.
sentence_zh: 生物學學生解剖青蛙以了解其內部器官結構。

definition_zh: (形) 可以解剖的；可以分解的
example_sentence: The dissectible frog specimen allowed biology students to study internal organs carefully.
sentence_zh: 這個可解剖的青蛙標本讓生物學生能夠仔細研究內部器官。

definition_zh: (名) 解剖；分析
example_sentence: Although dissection requires careful observation, many biology students find it educational and interesting.
sentence_zh: 雖然解剖需要仔細觀察，但許多生物學學生認為它既有教育意義又有趣。

definition_zh: (動) 散布；傳播　(動) 廣泛流傳；宣傳
example_sentence: Having disseminated the research findings through social media, the scientist gained widespread recognition from the academic community.
sentence_zh: 那位科學家通過社群媒體散布研究結果後，在學術界獲得了廣泛的認可。

definition_zh: (名) 傳播；散布　(名) 傳播資訊
example_sentence: The dissemination of accurate health information, which hospitals actively support, helps students make better choices.
sentence_zh: 醫院積極支持的準確健康資訊傳播，幫助學生做出更好的選擇。

definition_zh: (名) 不和；意見分歧　(名) 爭執；異議
example_sentence: Disagreement and dissension among team members created serious problems during the project.
sentence_zh: 隊員之間的分歧和不和在專案期間造成了嚴重的問題。

definition_zh: (動) 不同意；反對　(名) 異議；反對意見
example_sentence: If the government ignored public dissent, serious social conflict would arise throughout the nation.
sentence_zh: 若政府忽視公眾的異議，整個國家將會出現嚴重的社會衝突。

definition_zh: (形) 不同意的；持不同意見的　(名) 異議；反對意見
example_sentence: The dissenting opinion raised important questions about the government's new policy.
sentence_zh: 那份異議意見對政府的新政策提出了重要的質疑。

definition_zh: (名) 論文；學位論文　(名) 長篇演講；冗長的論述
example_sentence: Writing a dissertation requires months of research, careful planning, and dedicated effort.
sentence_zh: 撰寫論文需要數個月的研究、仔細的規劃和專注的努力。

definition_zh: (名) 異議人士；持不同政見者　(形) 持不同意見的；反對的
example_sentence: Although the government tried to silence dissidents, their voices grew louder each day.
sentence_zh: 儘管政府試圖壓制異議人士，他們的聲音每天都變得更大聲。

definition_zh: (動) 消散；驅散　浪費；揮霍
example_sentence: Hardly had the morning fog dissipated before students rushed onto the playground.
sentence_zh: 晨霧才剛散去，學生們就衝向了操場。

definition_zh: (名) 解散；消解　(名) 溶解；分解
example_sentence: The dissolution of the old company, which had failed to adapt to market changes, surprised no one.
sentence_zh: 那家未能適應市場變化的老公司的解散並不令人驚訝。

definition_zh: (動) 溶解；分解　(動) 結束；解散
example_sentence: Heating the sugar solution will dissolve the crystals completely and evenly.
sentence_zh: 加熱糖溶液會將晶體完全均勻地溶解。

definition_zh: (動) 勸阻；勸退　打消某人的念頭
example_sentence: Her parents tried hard to dissuade her from dropping out of school.
sentence_zh: 她的父母盡力勸阻她不要從學校退學。

definition_zh: (名) 距離；遠近　(動) 拉開距離
example_sentence: The distance between Taipei and Kaohsiung is about four hundred kilometers.
sentence_zh: 台北和高雄之間的距離大約四百公里。

definition_zh: (形) 遠的；遠處的　(形) 冷淡的；疏遠的
example_sentence: Although the mountain looks distant from our school, hiking enthusiasts reach it every weekend.
sentence_zh: 雖然那座山從我們學校看起來很遠，登山愛好者每個週末都能到達它。

definition_zh: (形) 令人厭惡的；不愉快的　(形) 粗俗的；低級的

definition_zh: (形) 家庭的；國內的　(形) 馴養的；家畜的
example_sentence: Having finished domestic chores, Sarah finally started her homework assignment.
sentence_zh: 完成了家務後，莎拉終於開始做功課。

definition_zh: (名) 住所；住地　(名) 法定住所；戶籍地
example_sentence: The apartment domicile, which the company rented for executives, offered convenient access to downtown offices.
sentence_zh: 公司為主管租用的那間公寓住所，提供了進入市中心辦公室的便利通道。

definition_zh: (名) 優勢；統治　(動) 佔優勢；統治
example_sentence: If a team maintains dominance in defense, winning the championship becomes much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果一支隊伍在防守上保持優勢，贏得冠軍就會容易得多。

definition_zh: (形) 佔優勢的；主要的　(形) 支配的；統治的
example_sentence: The dominant team won the championship after a season of hard work.
sentence_zh: 那支佔優勢的隊伍經過一季的努力後贏得了冠軍。

definition_zh: (副) 佔優勢地；主要地　(副) 明顯地；顯著地
example_sentence: Students study grammar dominantly to master English sentence structure for the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 學生主要研習文法以掌握英文句子結構來應對學測。

definition_zh: (動) 控制；主宰　(動) 佔優勢；居於首位
example_sentence: Strong teamwork and strategic planning dominate successful business competition.
sentence_zh: 強大的團隊合作和戰略規畫在成功的商業競爭中佔優勢。

definition_zh: (動) 專制統治；欺壓　(動) 傲慢地對待；控制
example_sentence: Although the manager tried to domineer over the team, employees soon demanded better working conditions.
sentence_zh: 雖然經理試圖專制統治團隊，員工們很快就要求更好的工作條件。

definition_zh: (形) 專制的；蠻橫的　(動) 控制；統治
example_sentence: Having dominated the team for years, the domineering captain finally lost control after breaking team rules.
sentence_zh: 那位專制的隊長多年來一直控制著球隊，但在違反隊規後終於失去了控制權。

definition_zh: (動) 穿上；戴上　(名) 大學老師的學位服
example_sentence: The professor who donned his academic gown looked dignified and serious.
sentence_zh: 穿上學位服的那位教授看起來莊嚴而認真。

definition_zh: (動) 捐獻；捐贈　(名) 捐獻物；捐款
example_sentence: Many students donate money and school supplies to help poor communities.
sentence_zh: 許多學生捐款和捐贈學用品來幫助貧困社區。

definition_zh: (名) 捐款；捐贈　(動) 捐獻；捐助
example_sentence: If more students made charitable donations, schools would have better resources for extracurricular programs.
sentence_zh: 如果更多學生進行慈善捐款，學校就會有更好的課外活動資源。

definition_zh: (名) 驢；驢子
example_sentence: The farmer used a donkey to carry heavy goods up the mountain.
sentence_zh: 農夫用驢子把重物運上山。

definition_zh: (名) 捐贈者；施予者　(名) 器官捐贈者
example_sentence: Donating blood regularly, donors help save countless lives in hospitals.
sentence_zh: 定期捐血的捐贈者在醫院中幫助拯救無數生命。

definition_zh: (名) 厄運；滅亡　(動) 注定；判決　(形) 不幸的；被詛咒的
example_sentence: As the final exam approaches, students feel doomed unless they study harder every single day.
sentence_zh: 隨著期末考逼近，除非學生每天更加努力讀書，否則他們感到命中註定要失敗。

definition_zh: (形) 注定失敗的；必然滅亡的
example_sentence: Never before had the explorers felt so doomed facing the endless desert.
sentence_zh: 探險家們面對無盡沙漠時，從未感到如此必然滅亡。

definition_zh: (名) 門；門戶　(名) 門道；入口
example_sentence: The door that leads to the classroom is usually open in the morning.
sentence_zh: 通往教室的那扇門在早上通常是開著的。

definition_zh: (名) 門階；門前臺階　(名) 非常接近的地方；眼前
example_sentence: The charity left donation boxes on every doorstep to collect money for homeless people.
sentence_zh: 慈善機構在每戶門前放置捐款箱，目的是為無家可歸者募集資金。

definition_zh: (名) 門口；門道　(名) 進入的機會；途徑
example_sentence: Standing in the doorway of the library, Sarah hesitated before entering the crowded reading room.
sentence_zh: 莎拉站在圖書館的門口，進入擁擠的閱讀室前猶豫了。

definition_zh: (名) 多巴胺；神經傳導物質
example_sentence: Dopamine released during exercise makes people feel happy and energized.
sentence_zh: 運動時釋放的多巴胺使人感到快樂和充滿活力。

definition_zh: (形) 呆板的；不酷的；古怪的
example_sentence: Although Marcus wore dorky glasses, he became popular because his sense of humor was genuinely funny.
sentence_zh: 雖然馬庫斯戴著不酷的眼鏡，但因為他的幽默感很真誠，所以他變得受歡迎。

definition_zh: (形) 休眠的；暫時不活動的　(形) 潛伏的；未被激發的
example_sentence: Lying dormant beneath the soil, seeds wait for spring warmth to trigger growth.
sentence_zh: 種子休眠在土壤下方，等待春天的溫暖來促發生長。

definition_zh: (名) 宿舍；學生宿舍　(名) 集體宿舍；宿舍樓
example_sentence: The dormitory where many students live together requires residents to follow strict rules.
sentence_zh: 許多學生一起居住的宿舍要求住戶遵守嚴格的規則。

definition_zh: (名) 應該做的事和不應該做的事；注意事項
example_sentence: If students follow the dos and don'ts of exam preparation, their test scores will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生遵循考試準備的注意事項，他們的測驗成績會大幅提高。

definition_zh: (名) 劑量；用量　(動) 給予劑量；分配藥量
example_sentence: The doctor prescribed a daily dosage of medicine for the patient's illness.
sentence_zh: 醫生為病人的疾病開了每日的藥物劑量。

definition_zh: (名) 劑量；一份　(動) 給予劑量；給藥
example_sentence: The doctor prescribed a higher dose to help reduce the patient's fever.
sentence_zh: 醫生開了更高的劑量來幫助降低患者的發燒。

definition_zh: (動) 閒散度日；無所事事
example_sentence: Instead of studying for the exam, Tom dossed about in the park all afternoon.
sentence_zh: 與其為考試而讀書，湯姆整個下午都在公園裡閒散度日。

definition_zh: (動) 臨時睡覺；隨便躺下睡覺
example_sentence: When the concert ended late, tired fans dossed down in the parking lot before driving home.
sentence_zh: 當演唱會很晚才結束時，疲憊的歌迷在停車場臨時躺下睡覺，之後才開車回家。

definition_zh: (名) 點；圓點　(動) 點；標點　(形) 點狀的；零星的
example_sentence: Having dotted the map with red marks, the geographer explained the distribution of cities.
sentence_zh: 地理學家在地圖上標滿紅點後，解釋了城市的分布情況。

definition_zh: (動) 兼任；同時充當　(動) 同時用途；一物多用
example_sentence: The living room, which doubles as a study space, helps students focus on homework.
sentence_zh: 客廳兼作書房，幫助學生專心做功課。

definition_zh: (動) 折返；原路返回　(動) 突然改變主意；背棄承諾
example_sentence: Realizing he forgot his student ID, Tom doubled back to retrieve it from home.
sentence_zh: 湯姆意識到忘記學生證後，折返家裡去拿。

definition_zh: (動) 彎腰；雙折　(動) 笑得彎腰；因疼痛而彎身
example_sentence: If the comedian's joke were any funnier, the audience would double over with laughter and tears.
sentence_zh: 如果那位喜劇演員的笑話更好笑，觀眾就會笑得彎腰，淚流滿面。

definition_zh: (動) 兼任；同時充當　(動) 折疊；加倍
example_sentence: The school library doubles up as a study hall during exam season.
sentence_zh: 考試季節期間，學校圖書館兼做自習室。

definition_zh: (動) 加倍；翻倍　(動) 彎腰；蜷縮
example_sentence: Doubling up on studying after school, many students improved their test scores significantly.
sentence_zh: 放學後加倍用功讀書，許多學生的考試成績顯著進步。

definition_zh: (動) 加倍；翻倍　(形) 雙重的；成對的　(名) 雙份；雙人房
example_sentence: As the company's profit doubled, expenses increased as well, making growth harder to maintain.
sentence_zh: 當公司的利潤加倍時，支出也隨之增加，使得成長更加困難。

definition_zh: (動) 懷疑；不確定　(名) 疑惑；不信任
example_sentence: Seldom do students doubt the importance of consistent study for the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 學生很少懷疑持續讀書對學測的重要性。

definition_zh: (形) 懷疑的；不確定的　(形) 可疑的；靠不住的
example_sentence: The test results, which seem doubtful to many experts, require further investigation.
sentence_zh: 這些測試結果，許多專家認為令人懷疑，需要進一步調查。

definition_zh: (副) 懷疑地；不確定地　(副) 猶豫地；遲疑地
example_sentence: The student answered the difficult math question doubtfully to avoid making a careless mistake.
sentence_zh: 那名學生懷疑地回答這道難題，目的是為了避免犯粗心的錯誤。

definition_zh: (形) 無疑的；肯定的　(副) 無疑地；肯定地
example_sentence: Doubtless, regular exercise and a balanced diet improve overall health significantly.
sentence_zh: 無疑地，定期運動和均衡飲食能顯著改善整體健康。

definition_zh: (副) 無疑地；毫無疑問地
example_sentence: The new shopping mall will doubtlessly become a popular destination for teenagers.
sentence_zh: 這間新購物中心無疑將成為青少年喜愛的地點。

definition_zh: (名) 麵糰；金錢　(動) 搓揉；製作麵糰
example_sentence: As the baker kneaded the dough until it became smooth, customers waited eagerly outside.
sentence_zh: 當麵包師傅搓揉麵糰直到光滑時，顧客在外面急切地等待。

definition_zh: (名) 甜甜圈；油炸圈餅
example_sentence: Sitting in the coffee shop, Sarah enjoyed a glazed doughnut with her friends.
sentence_zh: 坐在咖啡館裡，莎拉和朋友享受一個淋上糖衣的甜甜圈。

definition_zh: (形) 勇敢的；無畏的　(形) 堅毅的；頑強的
example_sentence: The doughty explorer who crossed the frozen mountain range inspired countless adventurers.
sentence_zh: 那位穿越冰凍山脈的勇敢探險家激勵了無數冒險者。

definition_zh: (名) 鴿子；和平的象徵　(動) 迅速下潛；俯衝
example_sentence: If the white dove flies across the stage, the audience would know peace is coming.
sentence_zh: 如果白鴿飛過舞台，觀眾就會知道和平即將到來。

definition_zh: (名) 木釘；木銷　(動) 用木釘連接；固定
example_sentence: The carpenter used wooden dowels to join the furniture pieces together securely.
sentence_zh: 木匠用木釘將家具零件牢固地連接在一起。

definition_zh: (片) 心情沮喪；情緒低落
example_sentence: After failing the midterm exam, Sarah felt down in the dumps and needed encouragement to study harder.
sentence_zh: 期中考不及格後，莎拉感到心情沮喪，需要鼓勵才能更努力讀書。

definition_zh: (片) 運氣不好；處於困難時期
example_sentence: After losing his job, Tom felt down on his luck and needed support.
sentence_zh: 湯姆失業後，感到運氣不好，需要他人的幫助。

definition_zh: (名) 頭期款；定金
example_sentence: Before the bank approves the mortgage, the buyer must pay a down payment to secure the property.
sentence_zh: 在銀行核准貸款之前，買家必須支付頭期款來確保房產。

definition_zh: (副) 向下；下去　(形) 向下的；下降的　(動) 喝完；吞下
example_sentence: Knocked down by the strong wind, the old tree fell across the road.
sentence_zh: 被強風吹倒後，這棵老樹倒在了馬路上。

definition_zh: (形) [daʊnˌkæst] 沮喪的；失望的　(動) [daʊnˈkæst] 投下；低垂
example_sentence: The student whose test results were downcast decided to study harder for the next exam.
sentence_zh: 那位測驗成績令人沮喪的學生決定為下次考試更努力讀書。

definition_zh: (動) [daʊnˈlod] 下載；下傳　(名) [ˈdaʊnˌlod] 下載；下載檔案
example_sentence: Students can download practice materials from the school's online platform.
sentence_zh: 學生可以從學校的線上平台下載練習題。

definition_zh: (動) 淡化；輕視　(動) 貶低；縮小
example_sentence: If the government downplayed the health risks, citizens would lose trust completely.
sentence_zh: 如果政府淡化健康風險，市民會完全失去信任。

definition_zh: (名) 傾盆大雨；暴雨
example_sentence: A sudden downpour caught us without umbrellas during the school trip.
sentence_zh: 一場突然的傾盆大雨在校外教學時淋到我們，我們卻沒帶傘。

definition_zh: (副) 完全地；絕對地　(形) 徹底的；絕對的
example_sentence: Feeling disappointed by the grade, Sarah found the exam downright unfair and frustrating.
sentence_zh: 因為對成績感到失望，莎拉發現這次考試絕對不公平且令人沮喪。

definition_zh: (動) 縮小；降低規模　(形) 低檔的；簡約的
example_sentence: As the company faced budget cuts, management decided to downscale operations before laying off employees.
sentence_zh: 當公司面臨預算削減時，管理層決定在裁員前先縮小營運規模。

definition_zh: (動) 降檔；減速　(名) 降檔；速度下降
example_sentence: Only after the driver downshifted did the car slow down on the steep mountain road.
sentence_zh: 只有在駕駛人降檔之後，汽車才在陡峭的山路上減速。

definition_zh: (名) 缺點；不利之處　(形) 向下的；下方的
example_sentence: The downside that concerns most students is the heavy homework load.
sentence_zh: 令大多數學生擔憂的缺點是沉重的家庭作業負擔。

definition_zh: (動) 裁員；縮小規模　(動) 降低；減少
example_sentence: The company decided to downsize to reduce operating costs during the economic crisis.
sentence_zh: 該公司決定裁員以降低經濟危機期間的營運成本。

definition_zh: (副) 在樓下；向樓下　(名) 樓下；下層
example_sentence: The kitchen and living room are located downstairs in this apartment.
sentence_zh: 在這間公寓裡，廚房和客廳位於樓下。

definition_zh: (名) 市中心；商業區　(形) 往市中心的；市中心的
example_sentence: Many teenagers like to go shopping downtown on weekends.
sentence_zh: 許多青少年喜歡在週末到市中心逛街。

definition_zh: (名) 經濟衰退；下降　(動) 下降；衰退
example_sentence: As the economy experienced a sharp downturn, many companies reduced their workforce significantly.
sentence_zh: 當經濟經歷急劇衰退時，許多公司大幅裁員。

definition_zh: (形) 向下的；下降的　(副) 向下；朝下
example_sentence: Facing the downward trend in test scores, the school decided to strengthen its tutoring program.
sentence_zh: 面對考試成績下降的趨勢，學校決定加強輔導計畫。

definition_zh: (副) 向下；往下　(形) 向下的；下降的
example_sentence: The water flowing downwards into the valley creates a beautiful waterfall that attracts many tourists.
sentence_zh: 向下流入山谷的水形成了一道美麗的瀑布，吸引許多遊客。

definition_zh: (動) 打瞌睡；不小心睡著
example_sentence: If the lecture becomes boring, students will doze off in class.
sentence_zh: 如果講課變得無聊，學生就會在課堂上打瞌睡。

definition_zh: (動) 打瞌睡；小睡　(名) 小睡；瞌睡
example_sentence: After studying for hours, the student dozed off during the afternoon lecture.
sentence_zh: 經過數小時的讀書後，那位學生在午後講座中打起了瞌睡。

definition_zh: (名) 一打（12個）；許多
example_sentence: The bakery bakes a dozen cookies every morning to satisfy customer demand.
sentence_zh: 那家烘焙店每天早上烤一打餅乾以滿足顧客的需求。

definition_zh: (名) 推土機；剷土機　(動) 用推土機推平；開挖
example_sentence: The heavy dozer cleared the construction site in just one week.
sentence_zh: 這台重型推土機在短短一週內就清空了建築工地。

definition_zh: (形) 單調的；乏味的　(形) 灰褐色的；暗淡的
example_sentence: Although the museum's drab walls needed fresh paint, the ancient artifacts displayed there fascinated thousands of visitors.
sentence_zh: 儘管博物館的單調牆壁需要重新粉刷，但那裡展出的古代文物吸引了數千名遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 草稿；初稿　(動) 起草；擬定　(名) 氣流；通風
example_sentence: Having drafted the essay twice, the student finally submitted a polished version to the teacher.
sentence_zh: 那位學生草擬了兩次論文後，最終向老師提交了一份精良的版本。

definition_zh: (動) 拖延；冗長進行；緩慢持續
example_sentence: The meeting that dragged on for three hours bored all the students.
sentence_zh: 那場拖延了三小時的會議讓所有學生感到厭倦。

definition_zh: (動) 拖；拉　(動) 緩慢移動；拖曳　(名) 阻力；妨礙
example_sentence: Finishing the long homework assignment felt like dragging through mud without any motivation.
sentence_zh: 完成長長的功課感覺像在泥濘中無力地拖曳一樣。

definition_zh: (名) 龍；龍形生物　(名) 兇悍的人；火龍
example_sentence: If ancient dragons existed, medieval castles would have needed much stronger defenses.
sentence_zh: 如果古代的龍真的存在，中世紀的城堡就會需要更強大的防禦。

definition_zh: (名) 蜻蜓
example_sentence: A dragonfly landed on the pond near our school.
sentence_zh: 一隻蜻蜓停落在我們學校附近的池塘上。

definition_zh: (動) 排水；消耗　(名) 排水管；流失
example_sentence: Draining the pool before winter, the maintenance team prevented pipe damage.
sentence_zh: 在冬天之前排乾游泳池，維修團隊防止了管道損壞。

definition_zh: (名) 排水；排水系統　(動) 排水；流出
example_sentence: As the heavy rain fell, the drainage system worked hard to prevent flooding in the city.
sentence_zh: 當大雨落下時，排水系統努力工作以防止城市淹水。

definition_zh: (名) 公鴨；雄鴨
example_sentence: Seldom does a drake swim alone in the pond during breeding season.
sentence_zh: 在繁殖季節，公鴨很少獨自在池塘裡游泳。

definition_zh: (名) 戲劇；劇本　(名) 衝突；紛爭
example_sentence: The school play was a drama that attracted many students who wanted to perform on stage.
sentence_zh: 這場校園戲劇吸引了許多想在舞台上表演的學生。

definition_zh: (形) 戲劇性的；引人注目的　(形) 急劇的；顯著的
example_sentence: The company used dramatic price cuts to attract more customers and increase sales.
sentence_zh: 該公司採取戲劇性的價格下降來吸引更多顧客並增加銷售。

definition_zh: (動) 披；掛　(名) 布簾；窗簾
example_sentence: The designer draped elegant fabric over the model's shoulders for the fashion show.
sentence_zh: 設計師為時裝秀在模特兒肩膀上披上優雅的布料。

definition_zh: (形) 劇烈的；激進的　(形) 嚴厲的；極端的
example_sentence: The government took drastic measures to control pollution in major cities.
sentence_zh: 政府採取了激進的措施來控制主要城市的污染。

definition_zh: (副) 急劇地；大幅度地　激烈地；極端地
example_sentence: When the company's sales dropped drastically, management had to reduce staff immediately.
sentence_zh: 當公司銷售額急劇下降時，管理層不得不立即裁員。

sentence_zh: 教練不斷向學生灌輸安全規則，確保每個人都理解戴安全帽的重要性。

definition_zh: (動) 趕出；開除　(動) 逐漸消除；淘汰
example_sentence: The coach drummed out players who didn't follow team rules, creating a discipline that others respected.
sentence_zh: 教練開除了不遵守隊規的球員，建立了其他人尊重的紀律。

definition_zh: (動) 募集；爭取　(動) 激發；鼓動
example_sentence: If the student council drums up enough support, the school dance will definitely happen.
sentence_zh: 如果學生會能募集到足夠的支持，校舞會肯定會舉辦。

definition_zh: (名) 鼓；鼓狀物　(動) 敲鼓；反覆敲打
example_sentence: The drummer played the drum loudly during the school concert.
sentence_zh: 鼓手在校園音樂會上大聲敲鼓。

definition_zh: (形) 醉的；喝醉的　(名) 醉漢；酗酒者
example_sentence: Drinking too much alcohol will make you drunk and unable to drive home safely.
sentence_zh: 喝太多酒會讓你喝醉，無法安全開車回家。

definition_zh: (名) 酗酒者；醉漢
example_sentence: The chronic drunkard lost his job and family due to his alcohol addiction.
sentence_zh: 這位長期酗酒的醉漢因為酒精成癮而失去了工作和家人。

definition_zh: (動) 擦乾；晾乾
example_sentence: After swimming, the athlete dried off with a towel before heading to the locker room.
sentence_zh: 游泳後，運動員用毛巾擦乾身體後才前往更衣室。

definition_zh: (動) 乾掉；變乾　(動) 枯萎；凋謝
example_sentence: Having dried out completely, the plant in the corner could no longer be saved.
sentence_zh: 那盆放在角落的植物已完全乾枯，無法再被救活。

definition_zh: (動) 乾涸；枯竭　(動) 逐漸消失；耗盡
example_sentence: The river that once flowed through the village dried up during the severe drought.
sentence_zh: 曾經流經村莊的河流在嚴重乾旱期間枯竭了。

definition_zh: (形) 乾的；乾燥的　(動) 使乾；擦乾
example_sentence: Wet clothes hanging on the clothesline dry quickly under the strong summer sun.
sentence_zh: 濕衣服掛在曬衣繩上，在炎熱的夏日陽光下很快就乾了。

definition_zh: (名) 烘乾機；乾衣機　(名) 乾燥劑；除濕劑
example_sentence: If laundry stayed wet longer, using a dryer would save much drying time.
sentence_zh: 如果洗好的衣服保持濕潤更久，使用烘乾機會節省很多乾燥時間。

definition_zh: (動) 下降；下來　(動) 下坡；傳下來
example_sentence: The hikers descended the mountain carefully during the afternoon.
sentence_zh: 登山者在下午小心地從山上下來。

definition_zh: (形) 雙重的；二元的　(名) 雙打；雙人賽
example_sentence: Having mastered both piano and violin, the musician excelled in dual performances at international competitions.
sentence_zh: 那位音樂家精通鋼琴和小提琴，在國際比賽中表現出色的雙重表演。

definition_zh: (動) 配音；為...配上聲軌　(動) 給...起綽號
example_sentence: Since the film was originally made in French, the studio dubbed it into English so that more audiences could enjoy the movie.
sentence_zh: 因為這部電影原本是用法語拍攝的，所以電影公司為它配上英文配音，好讓更多觀眾能欣賞這部電影。

definition_zh: (形) 可疑的；有疑問的　(形) 令人懷疑的；不可信的
example_sentence: Dubious as the politician's promises were, many voters still believed them.
sentence_zh: 儘管那位政治人物的承諾令人懷疑，許多選民仍然相信了。

definition_zh: (名) 公爵夫人；女公爵
example_sentence: The duchess who attended the royal ball wore an elegant diamond tiara.
sentence_zh: 出席皇家舞會的公爵夫人戴著優雅的鑽石王冠。

definition_zh: (動) 逃避；躲避　(動) 迴避責任；臨陣脫逃
example_sentence: Some students try to duck out of attending the school assembly to avoid standing in the sun.
sentence_zh: 有些學生試圖逃避參加學校集會，以躲避在太陽下站立。

definition_zh: (名) 鴨；鴨肉　(動) 躲避；低頭閃避
example_sentence: The duck pond near our school attracts many visitors every weekend.
sentence_zh: 我們學校附近的鴨池每個週末都吸引許多遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 小鴨；鴨子的幼鳥
example_sentence: The duckling followed its mother into the pond every morning.
sentence_zh: 那隻小鴨每天早上都跟著媽媽游進池塘。

definition_zh: (名) 老兄；朋友　(感) 天哪；厲害
example_sentence: Dude, as soon as the exam finished, everyone rushed out of the classroom like crazy.
sentence_zh: 老兄，考試一結束，大家就像瘋了一樣衝出教室。

definition_zh: (介) 由於；因為　(連) 因為；所以
example_sentence: Due to heavy rain falling overnight, the school sports day was postponed to next week.
sentence_zh: 由於整夜下著大雨，學校運動會被延期到下週舉行。

definition_zh: (形) 應該；預期的　(形) 到期的；應繳納的　(名) 應得的；應付款
example_sentence: The homework assignment that is due next Monday requires careful research and planning.
sentence_zh: 下週一到期的功課需要仔細的研究和計劃。

definition_zh: (名) 決鬥；對決　(動) 決鬥；對抗
example_sentence: If the two champions duel tomorrow, thousands of fans will watch the intense match.
sentence_zh: 如果這兩位冠軍明天決鬥，數千名粉絲將觀看這場激烈的比賽。

definition_zh: (介) 由於；因為　(連) 因為；既然
example_sentence: Due to heavy rain, the outdoor sports day was postponed until next week.
sentence_zh: 由於下大雨，戶外運動會被延期到下週。

definition_zh: (動) 毆打；痛打　(動) 傷害；損傷
example_sentence: The gang members duffed up innocent people to steal their wallets.
sentence_zh: 幫派成員毆打無辜民眾以竊取他們的錢包。

definition_zh: (名) 棒球隊員的休息室；地下掩體
example_sentence: The baseball players waited in the dugout, cheering loudly for their teammates on the field.
sentence_zh: 棒球隊員在休息室裡等待，為場上的隊友大聲加油。

definition_zh: (名) 公爵；貴族　(名) 拳擊中的揮拳動作
example_sentence: Since the duke governed the region fairly, local people respected him and supported his policies.
sentence_zh: 因為公爵公平地統治該地區，當地人民尊敬他並支持他的政策。

definition_zh: (形) 遲鈍的；無聊的　(動) 使變遲鈍；使變無聊
example_sentence: Bored by the dull lecture, many students fell asleep in class.
sentence_zh: 被無聊的講座弄得厭倦，許多學生在課堂上睡著了。

definition_zh: (副) 適當地；按時地　(副) 妥善地；恰當地
example_sentence: The assignment, which was duly submitted before the deadline, received full marks from the teacher.
sentence_zh: 這份作業按時提交，符合截止日期的要求，從老師那裡獲得滿分。

definition_zh: (動) 將某事簡化或降低難度；使變得更簡單
example_sentence: The publisher asked the author to dumb down the scientific content for younger readers.
sentence_zh: 出版商要求作者簡化科學內容以吸引年輕讀者。

definition_zh: (形) 啞的；不能說話　(形) 愚蠢的；傻的
example_sentence: If the student hadn't skipped classes, failing the test would not have seemed so dumb.
sentence_zh: 如果這名學生沒有翹課，不及格考試就不會顯得那麼愚蠢。

definition_zh: (動) 向某人傾倒(不滿、問題等)；對某人發洩
example_sentence: After a bad test, Sarah dumped all her frustration on her best friend.
sentence_zh: 考試不好後，莎拉向她的好友傾倒了所有的挫折感。

definition_zh: (動) 傾倒；倒垃圾　(名) 垃圾場；廢棄物堆放地
example_sentence: Dumping waste into the river harms aquatic ecosystems and pollutes our water supply.
sentence_zh: 將廢棄物倒入河裡會破壞水生生態系統，並污染我們的水源。

definition_zh: (名) 傾倒；傾銷　(動) 傾倒；倒垃圾
example_sentence: Because dumping industrial waste into rivers damages the ecosystem, the government imposed strict penalties.
sentence_zh: 由於將工業廢料傾倒入河流會破壞生態系統，政府實施了嚴厲的罰款。

definition_zh: (名) 餃子；水餃　(名) 湯圓；甜點
example_sentence: Only after grandmother finished cooking dumplings did the family gather around the dinner table happily.
sentence_zh: 只有在奶奶做完餃子後，家人才歡樂地聚在餐桌周圍。

definition_zh: (名) 垃圾箱；廢棄物箱
example_sentence: The dumpster that sits behind the restaurant overflows with trash every evening.
sentence_zh: 位於餐廳後面的那個垃圾箱每晚都溢滿垃圾。

definition_zh: (名) 沙丘；沙堆
example_sentence: Tourists climb the tall sand dune to enjoy the beautiful desert sunset.
sentence_zh: 遊客爬上高沙丘以享受美麗的沙漠日落。

definition_zh: (動) [`djup lə ket] 複製；重複　(名) [`djup lə kət] 複本；副本　(形) [`djup lə kət] 相同的；重複的
example_sentence: The software can duplicate files instantly without losing any important data.
sentence_zh: 該軟體可以瞬間複製檔案，而不會遺失任何重要資料。

definition_zh: (名) 欺詐；雙面性　(名) 虛偽；背信
example_sentence: The politician's duplicity was exposed when his secret meetings with rivals became public.
sentence_zh: 當政治人物與對手的秘密會面曝光時，他的欺詐行為被揭露了。

definition_zh: (名) 耐久性；耐用程度　(名) 持久力；持續性
example_sentence: Although the phone's durability was tested extensively, many users complained about its fragile screen.
sentence_zh: 雖然手機的耐久性經過廣泛測試，但許多用戶抱怨其螢幕易碎。

definition_zh: (形) 耐用的；持久的　(形) 能承受使用或磨損的
example_sentence: Made from durable materials, the hiking boots lasted for years without significant wear.
sentence_zh: 由耐用材料製成的登山靴數年來沒有明顯磨損。

definition_zh: (名) 持續時間；時間長度　(名) 期間；時期
example_sentence: The concert, whose duration lasted three hours, satisfied all the excited fans.
sentence_zh: 那場音樂會持續了三小時，讓所有興奮的粉絲都很滿意。

definition_zh: (介) 在...期間；在...過程中　(介) 整個...間
example_sentence: If students study hard during the exam preparation period, they will pass the CSAT easily.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在準備考試的期間用功讀書，他們就能輕易通過學測。

definition_zh: (名) 黃昏；薄暮　(形) 昏暗的；陰暗的
example_sentence: The sky turns orange and pink during dusk every evening.
sentence_zh: 每天傍晚，天空在黃昏時變成橙色和粉紅色。

definition_zh: (動) 掸掉灰塵；清除
example_sentence: Before the school ceremony, students dusted down the old trophy to make it shine brightly.
sentence_zh: 在學校典禮前，學生掸掉舊獎杯上的灰塵，使其閃閃發光。

definition_zh: (名) 灰塵；塵埃　(動) 擦去灰塵；撣去灰塵
example_sentence: Dust particles floating in sunlight made the classroom look magical and mysterious.
sentence_zh: 陽光中漂浮的灰塵微粒使教室看起來神奇而神秘。

definition_zh: (形) 佈滿灰塵的；灰塵般的
example_sentence: Because the old library room was dusty, students had to wear masks while studying there.
sentence_zh: 因為那間舊圖書館房間佈滿灰塵，學生們在那裡讀書時必須戴口罩。

definition_zh: (形) 荷蘭的；荷蘭人的　(名) 荷蘭語；荷蘭人
example_sentence: Having studied Dutch culture for months, the exchange student finally understood the local customs.
sentence_zh: 交換學生研習荷蘭文化數月後，終於理解了當地風俗。

definition_zh: (形) 盡責的；忠誠的　(形) 認真的；勤奮的
example_sentence: The dutiful son who cares for elderly parents deserves our respect.
sentence_zh: 那位照顧年邁父母的盡責兒子值得我們尊敬。

definition_zh: (副) 忠誠地；盡責地　認真且負責任地完成工作或責任
example_sentence: Every morning, the student dutifully completed homework and prepared for the upcoming CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 每天早上，這位學生忠誠地完成功課並為即將到來的學測做準備。

definition_zh: (名) 責任；義務　(名) 稅金；關稅　(動) 應該做；必須做
example_sentence: If students took their study duty seriously, better grades would follow naturally.
sentence_zh: 如果學生認真對待功課責任，更好的成績就會自然而然地隨之而來。

definition_zh: (名) 羽絨被；厚棉被
example_sentence: On cold winter nights, sleeping under a warm duvet feels wonderful.
sentence_zh: 在寒冷的冬夜，蓋著溫暖的羽絨被睡覺感覺很舒服。

definition_zh: (名) 侏儒；矮子　(動) 使顯得矮小；阻礙成長　(形) 矮小的；發育不全的
example_sentence: Dwarfed by towering skyscrapers, the old temple still attracted countless visitors yearly.
sentence_zh: 被高聳的摩天大樓襯托得更顯渺小，這座古廟每年仍吸引無數遊客造訪。

definition_zh: (動) 反覆思考；老是想著
example_sentence: Although failing the exam was disappointing, dwelling on past mistakes won't help improve future performance.
sentence_zh: 雖然考試不及格令人失望，但反覆思考過去的錯誤不會幫助改善未來的表現。

definition_zh: (動) 居住；住在　(動) 深思；細想
example_sentence: Only after moving to the countryside did the family dwell in true peace and contentment.
sentence_zh: 直到搬到鄉村後，這個家庭才在真正的平靜和滿足中居住。

definition_zh: (名) 居住者；住民
example_sentence: City dwellers who live in crowded apartments often dream of peaceful rural life.
sentence_zh: 住在擁擠公寓裡的城市居民常夢想著寧靜的鄉村生活。

definition_zh: (名) 住宅；居住處　(動) 居住；住在
example_sentence: Many families build new dwellings in the suburbs to enjoy a peaceful lifestyle.
sentence_zh: 許多家庭在郊區建造新住宅以享受寧靜的生活方式。

definition_zh: (動) 逐漸減少；逐漸消失
example_sentence: As the school year progressed, student attendance dwindled down to almost nothing.
sentence_zh: 隨著學年進行，學生出席率逐漸減少到幾乎沒有。

definition_zh: (動) 染色；將某物浸入顏料　(名) 染料；顏料
example_sentence: The factory uses natural materials to dye fabric different colors.
sentence_zh: 這家工廠用天然材料將布料染成不同的顏色。

definition_zh: (形) 垂死的；奄奄一息的　(動) 死亡；漸漸消失
example_sentence: Dying from lack of water, the plant finally wilted and turned brown.
sentence_zh: 由於缺水而奄奄一息，這株植物最終枯萎並變成了褐色。

definition_zh: (形) 充滿活力的；有力的　(名) 動力；驅動力
example_sentence: Developing dynamic problem-solving skills, successful students adapt quickly to challenging exam questions.
sentence_zh: 成功的學生藉著培養充滿活力的解題能力，能迅速適應具挑戰性的考試題目。

definition_zh: (名) 活力；動力　(名) 積極進取的精神
example_sentence: The startup company, which displays remarkable dynamism in innovation, attracts many young investors.
sentence_zh: 那家展現出色活力的新創公司吸引許多年輕投資者。

definition_zh: (名) 炸藥；極具威力的東西　(動) 用炸藥炸；摧毀
example_sentence: If the construction crew uses dynamite to blast through the mountain, the tunnel will be completed much faster.
sentence_zh: 如果建築工人用炸藥炸穿山脈，隧道會完成得快得多。

definition_zh: (名) 朝代；王朝　(名) 家族統治；世家
