example_sentence: The Tang Dynasty was one of the most powerful and wealthy periods in Chinese history.
sentence_zh: 唐朝是中國歷史上最強大和最富有的時期之一。

definition_zh: (名) 功能障礙；失常　(名) 不和；不協調
example_sentence: The doctor examined the patient to diagnose the heart dysfunction causing shortness of breath.
sentence_zh: 醫生檢查患者是為了診斷造成呼吸急促的心臟功能障礙。

definition_zh: (名) 電子郵件；電郵
example_sentence: Sending an e-mail to your teacher requires a polite greeting and clear subject line.
sentence_zh: 寄電子郵件給老師需要禮貌的問候語和清楚的主旨欄。

definition_zh: (名) 電子詞彙；網路用語
example_sentence: As social media becomes more popular, e-words spread quickly among teenagers worldwide.
sentence_zh: 隨著社群媒體越來越受歡迎，網路用語在全球青少年之間迅速傳播。

definition_zh: (代) 每一個；各個　(形) 各自的；每一個的
example_sentence: Having completed their assignments, each student received a certificate of achievement.
sentence_zh: 完成作業後，每個學生都獲得了成就證書。

definition_zh: (形) 渴望的；急切的　(動) 渴望；期盼
example_sentence: Students eager to improve their test scores often study late into the night.
sentence_zh: 渴望提高考試成績的學生經常熬夜念書。

definition_zh: (副) 急切地；熱切地　熱情地；迫不及待地
example_sentence: Students eagerly waited for the exam results, hoping to get into their dream universities.
sentence_zh: 學生們急切地等待考試成績，希望能進入夢想中的大學。

definition_zh: (名) 鷹；鷲
example_sentence: If golden eagles had smaller wings, they would not fly so gracefully over the mountains.
sentence_zh: 如果金鷹的翅膀更小，牠們就不會在山脈上空飛得那麼優雅。

definition_zh: (名) 耳朵；耳　(動) 聽見；傾聽
example_sentence: The dog's ear moved when it heard a strange sound.
sentence_zh: 狗聽到奇怪的聲音時，它的耳朵動了。

definition_zh: (名) 耳膜；鼓膜
example_sentence: Vibrating rapidly when struck by sound waves, the eardrum transmits vibrations to the middle ear.
sentence_zh: 耳膜受到聲波撞擊時迅速振動，將振動傳送到中耳。

definition_zh: (形) 早的；提早的　(副) 早地；提早
example_sentence: Early as the sun rose, students were already waiting outside the classroom for the exam.
sentence_zh: 太陽剛升起，學生們已經在教室外等著考試了。

definition_zh: (動) 賺；掙　獲得；贏得
example_sentence: Only by studying hard can students earn good grades and future success.
sentence_zh: 只有努力讀書，學生才能獲得好成績和未來的成功。

definition_zh: (形) 認真的；誠摯的　(名) 認真；誠摯
example_sentence: The student's earnest effort, which impressed all the teachers, led to admission to a top university.
sentence_zh: 這名學生認真的努力，令所有老師印象深刻，最後進入了頂尖大學。

definition_zh: (副) 誠懇地；認真地　(副) 懇切地；坦誠地
example_sentence: Many students study earnestly to prepare for the CSAT examination.
sentence_zh: 許多學生認真讀書以準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (名) 收入；所得　(名) 利潤；收益
example_sentence: The company's quarterly earnings exceeded investor expectations by a significant margin.
sentence_zh: 該公司的季度收入大幅超出投資者的預期。

definition_zh: (名) 耳機；耳塞
example_sentence: Students often wear earphones while studying online at home.
sentence_zh: 學生經常在家線上學習時戴著耳機。

definition_zh: (名) 耳環；耳飾
example_sentence: Although Sarah wore diamond earrings, she felt nervous before her first job interview.
sentence_zh: 雖然莎拉戴著鑽石耳環，但在第一次工作面試前感到緊張。

definition_zh: (名) 地球；地面　(名) 土壤；泥土
example_sentence: Turning over the earth in spring, farmers prepare the soil for planting crops.
sentence_zh: 農民在春天翻動土壤，為種植作物做準備。

definition_zh: (名) 地震；地動
example_sentence: The earthquake that struck Taiwan last month caused significant damage to several buildings.
sentence_zh: 上個月襲擊台灣的地震對許多建築物造成重大損害。

definition_zh: (名) 耳朵裡揮之不去的歌曲；腦中反覆播放的音樂
example_sentence: If a catchy pop song becomes an earworm, you will find yourself humming it all day long.
sentence_zh: 如果一首容易上癮的流行歌曲成為耳朵蟲，你會發現自己整天都在哼唱它。

definition_zh: (動) 減輕；放松　(動) 逐漸停止；減少
example_sentence: After finishing the exam, pressure eased off and students finally smiled.
sentence_zh: 考試結束後，壓力逐漸減輕，學生們終於笑了。

definition_zh: (動) 放鬆；減少；緩解　(動) 停止；結束
example_sentence: The coach told the team to ease up on practice to avoid injury before the final game.
sentence_zh: 教練告訴球隊減少練習強度以避免在決賽前受傷。

definition_zh: (動) 減輕；舒緩　(名) 輕鬆；舒適
example_sentence: Taking deep breaths and listening to music can ease stress and tension for students.
sentence_zh: 深呼吸和聽音樂可以減輕學生的壓力和緊張。

definition_zh: (副) 容易地；輕易地　輕鬆地；毫不費力地
example_sentence: Since the exam questions were clearly explained, students answered them easily without much difficulty.
sentence_zh: 由於考試題目解釋得很清楚，學生輕易地回答了，沒有遇到太多困難。

definition_zh: (名) 東方；東邊　(形) 東方的；向東的　(副) 向東地
example_sentence: Having traveled east from Taipei, the hikers reached the coastal mountains by afternoon.
sentence_zh: 從台北向東旅行後，登山者在下午抵達了沿海山脈。

definition_zh: (名) 復活節；耶穌復活紀念日
example_sentence: Easter, which falls in spring every year, is a Christian holiday that many families celebrate together.
sentence_zh: 復活節是每年春天到來的基督教節日，許多家庭都一起慶祝。

definition_zh: (形) 東方的；東邊的　(形) 來自東方的
example_sentence: The eastern coast of Taiwan attracts many tourists visiting beaches and coastal parks.
sentence_zh: 台灣的東海岸吸引許多遊客前往參觀海灘和沿海公園。

definition_zh: (形) 容易的；簡單的　(副) 容易地；輕鬆地
example_sentence: If studying vocabulary were easy, preparing for the CSAT would not require so much effort.
sentence_zh: 如果背單字很容易，準備學測就不會需要花費這麼多努力。

definition_zh: (形) 隨和的；好相處的　(形) 放鬆的；不嚴格的
example_sentence: My easygoing math teacher never gets angry with late homework submissions.
sentence_zh: 我那位隨和的數學老師從不會因為功課遲交而生氣。

definition_zh: (動) 逐漸侵蝕；慢慢消耗
example_sentence: Constant waves eating away the rocky shore gradually transformed the landscape.
sentence_zh: 不斷的波浪逐漸侵蝕岩石海岸，慢慢改變了地貌。

definition_zh: (動) 在餐廳內用餐；堂食
example_sentence: Since the restaurant just reopened after renovation, many families chose to eat in rather than order takeout.
sentence_zh: 由於餐廳剛翻新重新開業，許多家庭選擇在餐廳內用餐而不是外帶。

definition_zh: (動) 侵蝕；逐漸消耗　(動) 減少；吃掉一部分
example_sentence: Hardly did unexpected medical bills eat into the family's savings before they faced another crisis.
sentence_zh: 突如其來的醫療帳單幾乎沒有侵蝕家庭儲蓄，他們就又面臨另一場危機。

definition_zh: (動) 在外面吃飯；外食
example_sentence: The restaurant that Maria chose for dinner last weekend was expensive but delicious.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞上週末選來吃飯的那家餐廳很貴但很好吃。

definition_zh: (動) 吃完；吃光　(動) 快速吃掉；狼吞虎嚥
example_sentence: Students bring lunch boxes to school to eat up their meals during break time.
sentence_zh: 學生帶便當到學校是為了在休息時間吃完他們的餐食。

definition_zh: (動) 吃；進食　(動) 用餐；享用食物
example_sentence: Eating a healthy breakfast and exercising regularly help students stay focused during class.
sentence_zh: 吃健康的早餐和定期運動幫助學生在課堂上保持專注。

definition_zh: (動) 偷聽；竊聽　(名) 偷聽；竊聽行為
example_sentence: The student was caught eavesdropping on teachers' private conversation in the office.
sentence_zh: 那個學生被抓到在辦公室偷聽老師的私人談話。

definition_zh: (動) 逐漸消退；逐漸減弱
example_sentence: As the sun set, the sound of traffic ebbed away into silence.
sentence_zh: 當太陽下山時，交通聲音逐漸消退成寂靜。

definition_zh: (名) 退潮；衰退
example_sentence: Experiencing an ebb tide in sales, the struggling company decided to launch new marketing strategies.
sentence_zh: 經歷銷售退潮，這家苦苦掙扎的公司決定推出新的行銷策略。

definition_zh: (動) 退潮；衰退　(名) 退潮；衰弱
example_sentence: The tide, which ebb and flow daily, shapes the coastal landscape that fishermen know well.
sentence_zh: 潮汐每天退漲，這是塑造漁民熟知的海岸地貌的自然現象。

definition_zh: (形) 古怪的；怪異的　(名) 古怪的人；怪人
example_sentence: If the artist's eccentric style were more widely understood, audiences would appreciate her innovative paintings.
sentence_zh: 如果這位藝術家古怪的風格能被更廣泛地理解，觀眾就會欣賞她的創新繪畫。

definition_zh: (名) 古怪；離奇　(名) 偏心；不規則
example_sentence: The artist's eccentricity made people remember his unusual creative style.
sentence_zh: 那位藝術家的古怪風格讓人們記住了他不尋常的創意風格。

definition_zh: (名) 回聲；迴音　(動) 發出回聲；重複
example_sentence: Hiking enthusiasts climb mountains to echo their voices off canyon walls.
sentence_zh: 登山愛好者爬山是為了在峽谷壁上製造回聲。

definition_zh: (名) 日食；月食　(動) 遮蔽；使黯然失色
example_sentence: The moon's shadow crossing Earth causes a lunar eclipse during night.
sentence_zh: 月球的影子穿過地球會在夜間造成月食。

definition_zh: (形) 生態的；與生態有關的　(形) 環境的；生態學的
example_sentence: As ecological balance becomes increasingly fragile, protecting forests is essential for our survival.
sentence_zh: 當生態平衡變得越來越脆弱時，保護森林對我們的生存至關重要。

definition_zh: (副) 從生態學角度；在生態上　(副) 對環境有利地；環保地
example_sentence: Having been damaged by pollution, the wetland was restored ecologically by planting native species.
sentence_zh: 那片濕地因污染而受損，透過種植原生物種在生態上得到了恢復。

definition_zh: (名) 生態學；生態　(形) 生態的；環保的
example_sentence: The ecology that supports diverse species requires protection from human pollution.
sentence_zh: 支持多種物種的生態需要受保護，不受人類污染的影響。

definition_zh: (形) 經濟的；節省的　(形) 划算的；便宜的
example_sentence: Economic growth and environmental protection are both important for Taiwan's future development.
sentence_zh: 經濟成長和環境保護對台灣的未來發展都很重要。

definition_zh: (形) 經濟的；節省的　(形) 省錢的；便宜的
example_sentence: If families chose economical cars, monthly fuel costs would decrease significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果家庭選擇經濟型汽車，月度燃料成本會大幅下降。

definition_zh: (副) 經濟上地；節省地；划算地
example_sentence: Building public transportation is economically beneficial for the entire city.
sentence_zh: 建設公共運輸系統在經濟上對整個城市有益。

definition_zh: (名) 經濟學；經濟學科　(名) 經濟效益；成本效益
example_sentence: Studying economics, students understand how markets determine prices and allocate resources efficiently.
sentence_zh: 研究經濟學，學生們了解市場如何決定價格並有效配置資源。

definition_zh: (名) 經濟學家；經濟學者
example_sentence: As the economist analyzed the market trends, policymakers listened carefully to his insights.
sentence_zh: 當經濟學家分析市場趨勢時，政策制定者認真聽取了他的見解。

definition_zh: (動) 節省；節約　(動) 減少開支；精打細算
example_sentence: Only by economizing on daily expenses can students save enough for their future education.
sentence_zh: 只有透過節省日常開支，學生才能為未來教育存夠錢。

definition_zh: (名) 經濟；節約　(形) 經濟的；省錢的
example_sentence: The economy that Taiwan relies on depends heavily on exports, which drive national growth.
sentence_zh: 臺灣所依靠的經濟取決於出口，這些出口推動了國家的成長。

definition_zh: (名) 經濟；經濟制度　(動) 節省；節約
example_sentence: Many countries reduce spending to strengthen their economy and provide better services.
sentence_zh: 許多國家減少支出以加強經濟並提供更好的服務。

definition_zh: (名) 生態系統；生態系
example_sentence: Protecting forest ecosystems helps maintain biodiversity and supports countless plant and animal species.
sentence_zh: 保護森林生態系統有助於維持生物多樣性，並支持無數的植物和動物物種。

definition_zh: (名) 極度的喜悅；狂喜　(名) 搖頭丸（毒品）
example_sentence: Winning the championship brought the team into a state of pure ecstasy.
sentence_zh: 贏得冠軍使球隊進入極度狂喜的狀態。

definition_zh: (形) 狂喜的；欣喜若狂的　(副) 狂喜地；欣喜若狂地
example_sentence: Because the team won the championship, fans were ecstatic, cheering loudly in the streets.
sentence_zh: 因為球隊贏得冠軍，粉絲們欣喜若狂，在街上大聲歡呼。

definition_zh: (名) 濕疹；皮膚炎
example_sentence: Suffering from severe eczema, the student applied moisturizer regularly.
sentence_zh: 患有嚴重濕疹的那位學生定期擦保濕乳液。

definition_zh: (名) 伊甸園；樂園　(形) 如伊甸園的；理想的
example_sentence: The resort offers an eden-like experience where guests can escape daily stress.
sentence_zh: 這個度假村提供如伊甸園般的體驗，讓客人能逃離日常壓力。

definition_zh: (動) 勉強領先；險勝　(動) 逐漸超越；慢慢超過
example_sentence: If the local team practices harder, they will edge out their rivals in the championship game.
sentence_zh: 如果本地隊加強練習，他們將在冠軍賽中險勝對手。

definition_zh: (動) 逐漸上升；慢慢增加
example_sentence: The temperature edged up by two degrees over the past week.
sentence_zh: 過去一週溫度逐漸上升了兩度。

definition_zh: (名) 邊緣；邊界　(動) 慢慢移動；靠近　(形) 銳利的；尖銳的
example_sentence: Students sharpened their pencils to edge closer to perfection on the exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們磨尖鉛筆是為了在考試中更接近完美。

definition_zh: (形) 有邊緣的；銳利的　(動) 緩慢移動；漸進
example_sentence: The sharp-edged knife is dangerous for children to use in the kitchen.
sentence_zh: 那把銳利的刀對廚房裡的小孩來說很危險。

definition_zh: (形) 可食用的；可吃的
example_sentence: Although many mushrooms grow in forests, only certain species are edible.
sentence_zh: 雖然許多蘑菇生長在森林裡，但只有某些品種是可食用的。

definition_zh: (名) 建築物；宏偉的建築
example_sentence: Having been constructed over twenty years, the historic edifice now stands as a symbol of national pride.
sentence_zh: 經過二十年的建造，這座歷史建築物現在成為國家驕傲的象徵。

definition_zh: (動) 編輯；修改　(名) 編輯版本；版本
example_sentence: The documentary that the director edited won several international awards.
sentence_zh: 那位導演編輯的紀錄片贏得了幾項國際獎項。

definition_zh: (名) 版本；版次　(名) 印刷品；出版物
example_sentence: The latest edition of the science textbook includes new chapters on climate change.
sentence_zh: 這本科學教科書的最新版本包含了關於氣候變化的新章節。

definition_zh: (名) 編輯；編者　(動) 編輯；修改
example_sentence: If the editor had checked the article more carefully, many errors would not have appeared in the magazine.
sentence_zh: 如果編輯當時檢查文章更仔細的話，雜誌上就不會出現許多錯誤。

definition_zh: (形) 社論的；編輯的　(名) 社論；評論文章
example_sentence: The newspaper's editorial about climate change sparked widespread public debate.
sentence_zh: 報紙關於氣候變遷的社論引發了廣泛的公眾辯論。

definition_zh: (動) 教育；培養　(名) 教育
example_sentence: Educated by excellent teachers, many students discover their passion for learning.
sentence_zh: 受到優秀教師的教育，許多學生發現他們對學習的熱情。

definition_zh: (形) 受過教育的；有文化修養的　(形) 明智的；有根據的
example_sentence: Because Maria is educated in science, she can explain the climate change problem clearly to everyone.
sentence_zh: 因為瑪麗亞受過科學教育，她能清楚地向大家解釋氣候變遷的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 教育；受教育　(名) 教育制度；教學
example_sentence: Only after completing secondary education can students apply for university entrance exams.
sentence_zh: 只有在完成中等教育之後，學生才能申請大學入學考試。

definition_zh: (形) 教育的；與教育有關的　(形) 有教育意義的；啟發性的
example_sentence: The educational programs that schools offer help students develop critical thinking skills.
sentence_zh: 學校提供的教育課程幫助學生培養批判性思維能力。

definition_zh: (形) 教育的；教育性的　(形) 有助於學習的；具教育意義的
example_sentence: The museum offers educational programs to help students learn about history.
sentence_zh: 這間博物館提供教育課程以幫助學生學習歷史。

definition_zh: (名) 教育工作者；教師
example_sentence: Experienced educators shape students' futures through inspiring teaching methods.
sentence_zh: 經驗豐富的教育工作者透過啟發性的教學方法塑造學生的未來。

definition_zh: (名) 鰻魚；鱔魚
example_sentence: The chef grilled fresh eel with special sauce for dinner.
sentence_zh: 主廚用特製醬料烤新鮮鰻魚作為晚餐。

definition_zh: (形) 詭異的；令人毛骨悚然的
example_sentence: As the fog grew thicker, the old mansion looked increasingly eerie, making visitors feel uneasy.
sentence_zh: 當霧氣變得更濃厚時，那棟老宅看起來越來越詭異，讓訪客感到不安。

definition_zh: (副) 詭異地；令人不安地　以令人毛骨悚然的方式
example_sentence: The abandoned house, standing eerily quiet on the hill, frightened the young explorers approaching it.
sentence_zh: 那棟空屋詭異地矗立在山丘上，沉寂得令人不安，嚇到了靠近它的年輕探險家。

definition_zh: (名) 效果；影響　(動) 實現；達成
example_sentence: If students study hard every day, their test scores will have a positive effect on their future.
sentence_zh: 如果學生每天努力讀書，他們的考試成績將對未來產生正面的影響。

definition_zh: (形) 有效的；有效果的　(形) 實際的；實在的
example_sentence: Regular exercise is an effective way to improve physical health.
sentence_zh: 規律運動是改善身體健康的有效方法。

definition_zh: (副) 有效地；有成效地　(副) 實際上；事實上
example_sentence: Regular exercise helps students sleep better to improve study performance effectively.
sentence_zh: 規律運動可以幫助學生睡得更好，以有效地提升讀書表現。

definition_zh: (名) 效果；效能　有效性；成效
example_sentence: The effectiveness of this study method depends on consistent practice and regular review.
sentence_zh: 這種讀書方法的效果取決於持續練習和定期複習。

definition_zh: (形) 起泡的；冒泡的　(形) 活潑的；興高采烈的
example_sentence: Although the champagne became less effervescent as it sat on the table, guests still enjoyed its refreshing taste.
sentence_zh: 雖然香檳放在桌子上時變得較不起泡，客人們仍然享受它清爽的味道。

definition_zh: (名) 效率；功效　(形) 高效的；有效率的
example_sentence: Having improved the production process, the factory achieved greater efficiency and reduced waste significantly.
sentence_zh: 改進了生產流程之後，工廠實現了更高的效率並大幅減少了浪費。

definition_zh: (形) 有效率的；高效的　(形) 節省的；省力的
example_sentence: The study method that helps students pass exams is efficient and worth adopting.
sentence_zh: 幫助學生通過考試的讀書方法是有效率的，值得採用。

definition_zh: (副) 有效率地；效率高地　(副) 迅速而經濟地；節省地
example_sentence: Working efficiently on group projects requires clear communication and good time management.
sentence_zh: 在小組專案中有效率地工作需要清楚的溝通和良好的時間管理。

definition_zh: (名) 努力；用力　(動) 努力；盡力
example_sentence: If students made more effort in studying, their test scores would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在讀書上花更多努力，他們的考試成績會有顯著提高。

definition_zh: (形) 輕鬆的；不費力的　(形) 自然的；流暢的
example_sentence: Mastering piano requires practice, but professional pianists make it look effortless.
sentence_zh: 精通鋼琴需要練習，但專業鋼琴家看起來毫不費力。

definition_zh: (副) 毫不費力地；輕而易舉地
example_sentence: Moving through the crowded hallway effortlessly, the student found his classroom without asking for directions.
sentence_zh: 那位學生毫不費力地穿過擁擠的走廊，不用問路就找到了他的教室。

definition_zh: (形) 平等主義的；平等的　(名) 平等主義者；主張平等的人
example_sentence: Because the school promotes egalitarian values, all students receive equal opportunities regardless of family background.
sentence_zh: 因為學校推動平等主義的價值觀，所有學生不管家庭背景如何都獲得平等的機會。

definition_zh: (動) 煽動；鼓動　(動) 慫恿；激怒
example_sentence: Not only did his friends egg him on, but also his family encouraged him to try.
sentence_zh: 不只他的朋友煽動他，連他的家人也鼓勵他嘗試。

definition_zh: (名) 蛋；卵
example_sentence: The egg that hatched yesterday is now a healthy chick.
sentence_zh: 昨天孵化的那顆蛋現在是隻健康的小雞。

definition_zh: (名) 蛋殼；蛋殼色
example_sentence: Pottery artisans carefully paint eggshell porcelain to create delicate decorative pieces.
sentence_zh: 陶藝工匠仔細繪製蛋殼瓷以製作精緻的裝飾品。

definition_zh: (名) 自我；自尊心　(名) 傲慢；虛榮心
example_sentence: Winning the debate competition boosted Sarah's ego, making her feel confident and proud.
sentence_zh: 贏得辯論比賽提升了莎拉的自尊心，使她感到自信和驕傲。

definition_zh: (形) 極其嚴重的；令人震驚的
example_sentence: The student's egregious cheating on the final exam shocked the entire school.
sentence_zh: 那位學生在期末考試中極其嚴重的作弊行為震驚了整所學校。

definition_zh: (數) 八；八個
example_sentence: Although there are eight students in the group, only five attended the meeting yesterday.
sentence_zh: 雖然小組裡有八個學生，但昨天只有五個參加會議。

definition_zh: (名) 十八；十八歲
example_sentence: Having turned eighteen, many Taiwanese students began preparing for the university entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 滿十八歲後，許多台灣學生開始準備大學入學考試。

definition_zh: (形) 第八的；八個中的一個　(名) 第八；八分之一
example_sentence: The eighth contestant, who trained for six months, won the national singing competition.
sentence_zh: 訓練了六個月的第八位參賽者贏得了全國唱歌比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 八十；eighty歲　(形) 八十的
example_sentence: If a person reaches eighty years old, they will have lived through many historical changes.
sentence_zh: 如果一個人活到八十歲，他將經歷許多歷史變化。

definition_zh: (連) 要麼…要麼；二者之一　(片) 任一個；無論哪一個
example_sentence: Either studying hard or practicing sports regularly helps students stay healthy and focused.
sentence_zh: 要麼認真讀書，要麼定期運動，這兩者都能幫助學生保持健康和專注。

definition_zh: (片) 無論如何；不管怎樣　(連) 兩者都不；要麼...要麼...
example_sentence: Either way, studying hard is necessary to pass the CSAT exam successfully.
sentence_zh: 無論如何，努力讀書都是為了成功通過學測考試。

definition_zh: (連) 或者；也不　(代) 兩者之一；任何一個
example_sentence: Either coffee or tea works fine for the morning meeting.
sentence_zh: 早上會議喝咖啡或茶都可以。

definition_zh: (動) 彈出；排出　(動) 趕出；驅逐
example_sentence: When the software detects a virus, the system ejects the infected file before damage occurs.
sentence_zh: 當軟體偵測到病毒時，系統會在損害發生前彈出受感染的檔案。

definition_zh: (動) 勉強維持；艱難地謀生
example_sentence: Having eked out a living as a part-time tutor, Maria finally saved enough money for university.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞靠兼職家教勉強謀生後，終於存夠了大學學費。

definition_zh: (形) 詳細的；精心製作的　(動) 詳細說明；精心設計
example_sentence: The research project, which required elaborate planning and careful data collection, took two years to complete.
sentence_zh: 這個研究計畫（需要詳細的規劃和仔細的數據收集）花了兩年時間才完成。

definition_zh: (副) 精緻地；詳細地　複雜地；精心地
example_sentence: The wedding cake was elaborately decorated with handmade sugar flowers and gold leaf.
sentence_zh: 這個婚禮蛋糕精心裝飾著手工製作的糖花和金箔。

definition_zh: (名) 詳細說明；闡述　(名) 精細的製作；精心設計
example_sentence: If the student provided more elaboration on the essay topic, the teacher would give a higher score.
sentence_zh: 如果學生對論文主題提供更多詳細說明，老師就會給予更高的分數。

definition_zh: (動) 時間流逝；經過　(名) 時間的流逝；間隔
example_sentence: Three years elapsed before the missing student finally returned home.
sentence_zh: 三年時間流逝後，失蹤的學生終於回家了。

definition_zh: (形) 有彈性的；易伸縮的　(名) 橡皮筋；彈性物料
example_sentence: Stretching the elastic band before exercise, athletes prepare their muscles for intense training.
sentence_zh: 運動員在運動前伸展橡皮筋，為肌肉做好劇烈訓練的準備。

definition_zh: (名) 手肘；肘部　(動) 用肘推；擠開
example_sentence: As the crowd pushed forward, Maria had to elbow her way through the concert entrance.
sentence_zh: 當人群向前推擠時，瑪麗亞必須用手肘擠過演唱會入口。

definition_zh: (名) 年長者；長輩　(形) 年長的；較年長的
example_sentence: Seldom does an elder refuse to share wisdom with curious young students.
sentence_zh: 年長者很少拒絕與好奇的年輕學生分享智慧。

definition_zh: (形) 年老的；上了年紀的　(名) 老年人；年長者
example_sentence: My grandparents, who are elderly, enjoy spending time with their grandchildren on weekends.
sentence_zh: 我的祖父母親戚雖然年邁，但週末喜歡和孫子孫女共度時光。

definition_zh: (動) 選舉；當選　(動) 選擇；決定
example_sentence: Students organized a debate to elect the best candidate for class president.
sentence_zh: 學生組織了一場辯論會來選舉最佳的班長候選人。

definition_zh: (名) 選舉；選舉活動　(名) 選擇；抉擇
example_sentence: The presidential election will be held next month, and many young voters are preparing to cast their ballots.
sentence_zh: 總統選舉將在下個月舉行，許多年輕選民正在準備投票。

definition_zh: (形) 選舉的；與選舉有關的
example_sentence: The electoral process in Taiwan involves many important voting procedures.
sentence_zh: 台灣的選舉過程涉及許多重要的投票程序。

definition_zh: (名) 選民；全體投票者　(名) 選舉人團
example_sentence: Although the electorate voted overwhelmingly for reform, politicians delayed implementing the changes.
sentence_zh: 雖然全體選民以壓倒性多數投票贊成改革，但政治人物延遲了實施這些改變。

definition_zh: (形) 電的；用電的　(名) 電氣產品；電力
example_sentence: Running on electric power, the new train reduces pollution significantly.
sentence_zh: 以電力運行，新列車大幅減少了污染。

definition_zh: (形) 電的；電氣的　(形) 與電相關的
example_sentence: The electrical wiring that runs through the walls requires regular inspection by professionals.
sentence_zh: 穿過牆壁的電氣配線需要由專業人員定期檢查。

definition_zh: (名) 電工；電氣技師
example_sentence: If the electrician arrives early, the power problem will be solved before tomorrow's exam.
sentence_zh: 如果電工早到的話，停電問題將在明天考試前解決。

definition_zh: (名) 電；電力　(名) 電能；電流
example_sentence: Modern cities depend on electricity to power homes, hospitals, and schools.
sentence_zh: 現代城市依賴電力來為家庭、醫院和學校供電。

definition_zh: (形) 電化學的；與電和化學反應有關的
example_sentence: Scientists use electrochemical cells to convert chemical energy into electrical energy for batteries.
sentence_zh: 科學家使用電化學電池將化學能轉換為電能來製造電池。

definition_zh: (名) 電極；導電體
example_sentence: The battery's positive and negative electrodes conduct electricity through the circuit efficiently.
sentence_zh: 電池的正負電極透過電路有效地傳導電力。

definition_zh: (名) 電子；電子粒子
example_sentence: Because electrons move through the wire, electric current flows and powers our devices.
sentence_zh: 因為電子在電線中移動，電流才會流動並為我們的裝置供電。

definition_zh: (形) 電子的；電子設備的　(名) 電子產品；電子設備
example_sentence: Having studied electronics for two years, Maria designed an electronic device that impressed her teachers.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞在學習電子學兩年後，設計了一個讓老師印象深刻的電子設備。

definition_zh: (名) 電子學；電子產品　(名) 電子設備；電子零件
example_sentence: The electronics that power modern smartphones require advanced technology and careful design.
sentence_zh: 驅動現代智慧型手機的電子產品需要先進的技術和精心的設計。

definition_zh: (形) 優雅的；高雅的　(形) 精緻的；簡潔的
example_sentence: The elegant design and simple structure of this building impressed all the visitors.
sentence_zh: 這棟建築物優雅的設計和簡潔的結構給所有訪客留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 元素；成分　(名) 要素；因素
example_sentence: If oxygen were not a crucial element in the atmosphere, human survival would be impossible.
sentence_zh: 如果氧氣不是大氣中的關鍵元素，人類的生存將成為不可能。

definition_zh: (形) 基本的；初級的　(形) 小學的；初等的
example_sentence: Learning basic math is an elementary skill for all students.
sentence_zh: 學習基本數學是所有學生的初級技能。

definition_zh: (名) 象；大象
example_sentence: Walking through the safari, tourists spotted a massive elephant spraying water across its wrinkled skin.
sentence_zh: 遊客走過野生動物園，發現一隻巨大的象用象鼻噴水潑灑牠布滿皺紋的皮膚。

definition_zh: (動) 提升；抬高　(動) 提高；改善
example_sentence: As the new manager elevated the company's standards, employee morale improved significantly.
sentence_zh: 當新經理提高公司的標準時，員工的士氣顯著改善。

definition_zh: (形) 升高的；提升的　(形) 崇高的；高尚的
example_sentence: Not only was the bridge elevated above the river, but also beautifully designed.
sentence_zh: 不僅這座橋高高聳立在河流之上，而且設計也很優美。

definition_zh: (名) 海拔；高度　(名) 提升；晉升
example_sentence: The mountain resort, which has an elevation of two thousand meters, attracts many hikers every summer.
sentence_zh: 那個海拔兩千公尺的山間度假村每年夏天都吸引許多登山者。

definition_zh: (名) 電梯；升降機
example_sentence: Taking the elevator to reach the office saves time and energy.
sentence_zh: 搭乘電梯到達辦公室可以節省時間和體力。

definition_zh: (名) 十一；11　(形) 十一的；十一個的
example_sentence: There are eleven players on each soccer team taking the field.
sentence_zh: 每支足球隊場上都有十一名球員。

definition_zh: (序) 第十一的；第十一個
example_sentence: My eleventh birthday was the best day of my entire childhood.
sentence_zh: 我的第十一個生日是我整個童年中最美好的一天。

definition_zh: (名) 小精靈；妖精
example_sentence: As the Christmas elf decorated the workshop, children watched the magical holiday preparations unfold.
sentence_zh: 當聖誕小精靈裝飾工作室時，孩子們看著魔法的假期準備展開。

definition_zh: (動) 引出；誘出　(動) 獲得；取得
example_sentence: Asking open-ended questions, the teacher elicited thoughtful responses from her curious students.
sentence_zh: 透過提出開放式問題，老師從好奇的學生身上引出深思熟慮的回答。

definition_zh: (名) 符合資格；合格資格　(形) 有資格的；合格的
example_sentence: Students whose grades meet the school's standards have the eligibility to apply for the scholarship program.
sentence_zh: 成績符合學校標準的學生具有申請獎學金計畫的資格。

definition_zh: (形) 有資格的；符合條件的　(形) 合適的；可取的
example_sentence: If applicants meet all requirements, they will become eligible for the scholarship program.
sentence_zh: 如果申請者符合所有條件，將有資格獲得獎學金計畫。

definition_zh: (副) 符合資格地；合格地
example_sentence: Students who pass the entrance exam can be eligible for university admission.
sentence_zh: 通過入學考試的學生可以符合資格地申請大學入學。

definition_zh: (動) 消除；排除　(動) 淘汰；刪除
example_sentence: Regular exercise helps eliminate fatty deposits and improve overall health.
sentence_zh: 定期運動有助於消除脂肪堆積並改善整體健康。

definition_zh: (名) 消除；排除　(名) 淘汰；剔除
example_sentence: The elimination of plastic bags from supermarkets helps protect our environment.
sentence_zh: 超市消除塑膠袋有助於保護我們的環境。

definition_zh: (名) 菁英；精英　(形) 精英的；頂尖的
example_sentence: Although the university accepts many students, only elite athletes receive full scholarships for their outstanding performance.
sentence_zh: 儘管該大學錄取許多學生，只有精英運動員因其傑出表現而獲得全額獎學金。

definition_zh: (名) 精英主義；菁英統治
example_sentence: Having criticized by many educators, elitism in school admissions continues to disadvantage talented students from lower-income families.
sentence_zh: 儘管受到許多教育工作者的批評，學校招生中的精英主義持續使來自低收入家庭的優秀學生處於劣勢。

definition_zh: (名) 菁英主義者；精英分子　(形) 菁英主義的；精英主義思想的
example_sentence: The policy that only wealthy students can attend prestigious universities is an elitist system which many people criticize.
sentence_zh: 只有富有學生才能進入名校的政策是一個許多人批評的菁英主義制度。

definition_zh: (名) 萬靈丹；靈丹妙藥　(名) 長生不老藥；仙丹
example_sentence: Many ancient alchemists searched for the elixir of life, hoping to achieve immortality through magical potions.
sentence_zh: 許多古代的煉金術士尋找長生不老藥，希望透過魔法藥水獲得永生。

definition_zh: (名) 楕圓形；橢圓　(形) 楕圓的；橢圓形的
example_sentence: If the planet's orbit were a perfect circle instead of an ellipse, gravitational calculations would become much simpler.
sentence_zh: 如果行星的軌道是完美圓形而不是橢圓形，重力計算就會變得簡單得多。

definition_zh: (名) 省略號；省略
example_sentence: The three dots used in writing represent an ellipsis, showing omitted words.
sentence_zh: 寫作中使用的三個點代表省略號，表示省略的文字。

definition_zh: (名) 雄辯；口才　(形) 雄辯的；能言善辯的
example_sentence: Speaking with eloquence, the debate champion impressed the judges with logical arguments.
sentence_zh: 那位辯論冠軍以雄辯的口才發言，用邏輯論證給評審留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (形) 雄辯的；言辭有力的　(形) 表達清楚有說服力的
example_sentence: Because the speaker was eloquent, the audience listened intently to every word.
sentence_zh: 因為演講者言辭有力，聽眾認真聆聽每一句話。

definition_zh: (副) 否則；要不然　(連) 否則；或者
example_sentence: Seldom else will the exam questions be this straightforward next year.
sentence_zh: 明年考試題目不太可能再這麼直接了。

definition_zh: (副) 別處；其他地方　(形) 在別處的；其他的
example_sentence: Students who study elsewhere must submit their transfer documents before the deadline.
sentence_zh: 在別處讀書的學生必須在期限前提交轉學文件。

definition_zh: (動) 說明；闡述　(動) 澄清；解釋
example_sentence: The teacher used diagrams to elucidate the complex scientific concept for students.
sentence_zh: 老師用圖表來闡述這個複雜的科學概念供學生理解。

definition_zh: (動) 逃脫；躲避　(動) 使困惑；難以理解
example_sentence: The clever suspect managed to elude police detection by changing his appearance and moving frequently.
sentence_zh: 那位聰明的嫌疑人藉由改變外貌和頻繁移動來逃脫警方追捕。

definition_zh: (形) 難以捉摸的；難以找到的
example_sentence: The answer to that difficult math problem proved elusive for many students.
sentence_zh: 那道難數學題的答案對許多學生來說難以捉摸。

definition_zh: (動) 解放；使自由　(動) 使獲得平等權利
example_sentence: As women became educated, they gradually emancipated themselves from traditional constraints.
sentence_zh: 當婦女受到教育時，她們逐漸從傳統束縛中解放自己。

definition_zh: (形) 獲得解放的；自由的　(形) 不受約束的；獨立的
example_sentence: Emancipated from parental control, the teenager finally pursued music as a serious career.
sentence_zh: 獲得解放，不再受父母控制，這位青少年終於能認真追求音樂事業。

definition_zh: (名) 解放；獲得自由　(名) 廢除奴隸制度
example_sentence: The abolition of slavery, which led to emancipation, fundamentally changed American history.
sentence_zh: 廢除奴隸制度（導致解放）從根本上改變了美國歷史。

definition_zh: (名) 禁運；貿易禁令　(動) 對...實施禁運；禁止出口
example_sentence: If the government imposes an embargo on imports, local businesses will face serious economic challenges.
sentence_zh: 如果政府對進口品實施禁運，本地企業將面臨嚴重的經濟挑戰。

definition_zh: (動) 開始；著手　踏上；從事
example_sentence: After graduating, many students embark on their first job journey.
sentence_zh: 畢業後，許多學生開始他們的第一份工作之旅。

definition_zh: (動) 開始；著手　(動) 上船；登船
example_sentence: Many students embark on summer internships to gain valuable work experience.
sentence_zh: 許多學生開始參與暑期實習以獲得寶貴的工作經驗。

definition_zh: (動) 使尷尬；使不安　(動) 阻礙；妨礙
example_sentence: Forgetting lines on stage embarrassed the nervous actor during the school play.
sentence_zh: 在校園劇中忘了台詞使那位緊張的演員感到尷尬。

definition_zh: (形) 尷尬的；窘迫的　(動) 使尷尬；使窘迫
example_sentence: When the teacher called on him during class, the student felt embarrassed because he hadn't prepared.
sentence_zh: 當老師在課堂上點他的名字時，因為他沒有準備，那個學生感到很尷尬。

definition_zh: (形) 令人尷尬的；使人難堪的
example_sentence: Having forgotten my lines on stage, the embarrassing moment haunted me for weeks.
sentence_zh: 在舞台上忘記台詞後，那個令人尷尬的時刻困擾我好幾週。

definition_zh: (名) 尷尬；窘迫　(名) 使人感到困難的事物
example_sentence: The awkward silence that followed his mistake caused embarrassment to everyone in the room.
sentence_zh: 隨之而來的尷尬沉默使房間裡的每個人都感到窘迫。

definition_zh: (名) 大使館；使館
example_sentence: The student visited the American embassy in Taipei to apply for a visa.
sentence_zh: 那名學生到台北的美國大使館申請簽證。

definition_zh: (動) 嵌入；埋入　(動) 使深深植入
example_sentence: If the company embedded security features properly, hackers would find the system much harder to breach.
sentence_zh: 如果公司正確地嵌入安全功能，駭客就會發現該系統更難入侵。

definition_zh: (動) 裝飾；美化　(動) 誇大；渲染
example_sentence: The artist embellished the simple frame with gold and jewels.
sentence_zh: 這位藝術家用金色和寶石裝飾了簡單的相框。

definition_zh: (動) 侵佔；盜用　挪用公款
example_sentence: The manager, embezzling company funds for years, finally faced arrest.
sentence_zh: 那位經理多年來侵佔公司資金，最終面臨逮捕。

definition_zh: (名) 侵占；挪用公款
example_sentence: Although the accountant denied the embezzlement, evidence clearly showed money disappeared from company accounts.
sentence_zh: 雖然會計否認侵占公款，但證據清楚顯示公司帳戶的錢消失了。

definition_zh: (名) 化身；象徵　(名) 體現；具體表現
example_sentence: Hardly ever has a leader been the embodiment of both courage and compassion.
sentence_zh: 一位領導人很少同時具有勇氣和同情心的化身。

definition_zh: (動) 體現；具體表現　(動) 包含；包括
example_sentence: The new school building, which embodies modern design and sustainability, has become a landmark in our city.
sentence_zh: 那棟體現現代設計與永續性的新校舍已成為本市的地標。

definition_zh: (動) 擁抱；接受　(名) 擁抱；懷抱
example_sentence: Many students embrace online learning to improve their English skills effectively.
sentence_zh: 許多學生擁抱線上學習來有效地提升他們的英文能力。

definition_zh: (名) 胚胎；初期形態
example_sentence: The embryo develops rapidly during the first few weeks of pregnancy.
sentence_zh: 胚胎在懷孕的前幾週發育迅速。

definition_zh: (動) 出現；浮現　(動) 從…中出來；浮出
example_sentence: New leaders emerged from the student council election last month.
sentence_zh: 新的領導者在上個月的學生會選舉中出現了。

definition_zh: (名) 出現；浮現　(名) 緊急情況；突發事件
example_sentence: As the emergence of new technology became clear, many students began learning coding skills.
sentence_zh: 隨著新科技的出現變得明顯，許多學生開始學習程式設計技能。

definition_zh: (名) 緊急情況；緊急事件　(形) 緊急的；應急的
example_sentence: Facing an approaching typhoon, the school issued an emergency alert urging students to return home immediately.
sentence_zh: 面對逼近的颱風，學校發布了緊急警報，敦促學生立即返家。

definition_zh: (形) 新興的；出現的　(動) 浮現；發展
example_sentence: Emerging technologies that transform daily life require careful regulation and public understanding.
sentence_zh: 改變日常生活的新興科技需要謹慎的監管和大眾的理解。

definition_zh: (名) 移民；移居他國的人　(形) 移民的；移居的
example_sentence: If more emigrants were to leave the countryside, rural communities would face serious labor shortages.
sentence_zh: 假如更多移民離開鄉村，農村社區將面臨嚴重的勞動力短缺。

definition_zh: (動) 移居國外；遷移到別國
example_sentence: Many young professionals emigrate to Canada seeking better job opportunities.
sentence_zh: 許多年輕專業人士移居到加拿大尋求更好的工作機會。

definition_zh: (名) 移民；出國移居　(名) 移民人口；移民潮
example_sentence: Many people choose emigration to pursue better career opportunities abroad.
sentence_zh: 許多人選擇移民以便在國外追求更好的職業機會。

definition_zh: (名) 傑出；卓越　(名) 高地；突出部分
example_sentence: Her eminence in medical research earned her international recognition and respect.
sentence_zh: 她在醫學研究上的傑出表現為她贏得國際認可與尊敬。

definition_zh: (形) 著名的；傑出的　(形) 傑出；卓越
example_sentence: Although the eminent professor had retired, students still sought his advice on research.
sentence_zh: 雖然這位著名教授已經退休，學生仍然尋求他在研究上的建議。

definition_zh: (名) 使者；特使　(名) 代表；信差
example_sentence: Having served as the ambassador's emissary for five years, the diplomat understood the complex negotiations between the two nations.
sentence_zh: 在擔任大使特使五年後，這位外交官理解了兩國之間複雜的談判。

definition_zh: (名) 排放；散發　(名) 放射物；排放物
example_sentence: The factory's emissions, which contain harmful chemicals, pollute the air.
sentence_zh: 工廠的排放物，含有有害化學物質，污染空氣。

definition_zh: (動) 發出；散發　(動) 排放；放射
example_sentence: The factory emits harmful gases into the air every day.
sentence_zh: 那間工廠每天向空氣中排放有害氣體。

definition_zh: (名) 表情符號；繪文字
example_sentence: If students used emojis in formal essays, teachers would mark them as inappropriate.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在正式作文中使用表情符號，老師會認為它們不恰當。

definition_zh: (名) 情感；感情　(名) 情緒；激動
example_sentence: Strong emotions like happiness and sadness shape how we interact with others.
sentence_zh: 像快樂和悲傷這樣的強烈情感影響著我們如何與他人互動。

definition_zh: (形) 情緒的；感情的　(形) 容易激動的；易受感動的
example_sentence: Feeling overwhelmed by the sad movie, the emotional audience left the theater in tears.
sentence_zh: 因為悲傷的電影而感到不知所措，這群容易激動的觀眾流著淚水離開了電影院。

definition_zh: (副) 情緒上地；感情用事地
example_sentence: Although the movie ended sadly, audiences remained emotionally moved by the characters' struggle.
sentence_zh: 雖然電影以悲傷結局告終，觀眾對於角色的奮鬥在感情上仍感到深深的觸動。

definition_zh: (形) 有同情心的；能體諒他人的
example_sentence: Not only does Maria understand her friend's pain, but empathetic responses also help build trust.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞不僅理解朋友的痛苦，而且富有同情心的回應也能幫助建立信任。

definition_zh: (名) 同理心；換位思考　(動) 感同身受；體諒
example_sentence: Teachers who show empathy toward students create a classroom environment that encourages learning.
sentence_zh: 對學生展現同理心的老師會營造一個鼓勵學習的教室環境。

definition_zh: (名) 皇帝；帝王
example_sentence: The emperor built a great wall to protect his empire from invaders.
sentence_zh: 皇帝建造了一道偉大的城牆以保護他的帝國免受入侵者侵害。

definition_zh: (名) 強調；重點　(動) 強調；著重
example_sentence: The teacher placed great emphasis on reading comprehension and writing skills.
sentence_zh: 老師特別強調閱讀理解和寫作技能的重要性。

definition_zh: (動) 強調；重視　(動) 突出；使突出
example_sentence: The teacher emphasized the importance of studying hard for the exam.
sentence_zh: 老師強調努力讀書對考試的重要性。

definition_zh: (形) 強調的；有力的　(副) 強調地；有力地
example_sentence: Although the professor spoke quietly, his emphatic tone made every student listen carefully.
sentence_zh: 雖然教授說話很輕聲，但他強調的語氣讓每位學生都認真聽講。

definition_zh: (名) 帝國；帝制　(名) 權力大的企業或組織
example_sentence: Expanding rapidly across Asia, the Roman Empire dominated trade routes for centuries.
sentence_zh: 快速擴張穿越亞洲，羅馬帝國統治了數個世紀的貿易路線。

definition_zh: (形) 以實驗或觀察為基礎的；經驗的　(形) 實證的；實際的
example_sentence: The research findings, which were empirical and based on careful observation, convinced many skeptical scientists.
sentence_zh: 那些以實驗為基礎且基於仔細觀察的研究成果說服了許多懷疑的科學家。

definition_zh: (動) 僱用；雇用　(動) 利用；運用
example_sentence: If the company employs experienced workers, production efficiency will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果公司僱用有經驗的員工，生產效率將會大幅提高。

definition_zh: (名) 員工；雇員　(動) 雇用；僱傭
example_sentence: The company hired fifty new employees to work in the office.
sentence_zh: 這家公司雇用了五十名新員工在辦公室工作。

definition_zh: (名) 僱主；老闆　(名) 雇用者
example_sentence: Many students work part-time to gain experience and impress potential employers.
sentence_zh: 許多學生打工是為了獲得經驗並讓潛在僱主印象深刻。

definition_zh: (名) 工作；就業　(名) 僱用；聘僱
example_sentence: Finding stable employment after graduation is a major goal for many students.
sentence_zh: 畢業後找到穩定的工作是許多學生的主要目標。

definition_zh: (名) 大商場；商業中心　(名) 百貨公司；購物場所
example_sentence: Since the new shopping emporium opened downtown, many students visit there after school to browse the latest fashion and gadgets.
sentence_zh: 由於新的大商場在市中心開幕，許多學生放學後會到那裡瀏覽最新的服裝和電子產品。

definition_zh: (動) 賦予力量；使有力量　(動) 授權；委以權力
example_sentence: Empowered by new skills, students confidently pursued their dreams after graduation.
sentence_zh: 獲得新技能所賦予的力量，學生們在畢業後有信心地追求自己的夢想。

definition_zh: (名) 權力；授權　(名) 增進；改善
example_sentence: The program that provides job training is an empowerment for young people who lack experience.
sentence_zh: 提供工作訓練的計畫對缺乏經驗的年輕人是一種增進。

definition_zh: (名) 女皇；皇后
example_sentence: The empress ruled the empire with wisdom and strength for many decades.
sentence_zh: 這位女皇以智慧和力量統治帝國長達數十年。

definition_zh: (名) 空虛；空洞　(名) 空白；虛無
example_sentence: If modern life continued without meaningful connections, emptiness would gradually consume one's heart.
sentence_zh: 如果現代生活持續缺乏真誠的人際連結，空虛感會逐漸侵蝕一個人的內心。

definition_zh: (動) 倒空；清空　(動) 清除內容物；排空
example_sentence: Before moving house, the family emptied out all drawers and packed everything into boxes.
sentence_zh: 搬家前，家人把所有抽屜都倒空了，並把東西裝進紙箱。

definition_zh: (形) 空的；空著的　(動) 倒空；清空
example_sentence: Emptying the trash can before leaving, Sarah locked the classroom door.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在離開前倒空垃圾桶，隨後鎖上教室門。

definition_zh: (動) 模仿；效法　(動) 競爭；比較
example_sentence: As the coach emulated professional athletes' training methods, the team's performance improved significantly.
sentence_zh: 當教練模仿職業運動員的訓練方法時，球隊的表現明顯改善。

definition_zh: (名) 模擬器；仿真程式　(動) 模仿；仿效
example_sentence: Only by using an emulator can mobile game developers test their apps efficiently.
sentence_zh: 只有藉由使用模擬器，行動遊戲開發者才能有效率地測試他們的應用程式。

definition_zh: (前綴) 使；使…成為；放入
example_sentence: The teacher's encouraging words enabled students who felt discouraged to regain confidence.
sentence_zh: 老師那令人鼓舞的話語使感到沮喪的學生重新獲得信心。

definition_zh: (動) 使；使得　(介) 在…裡面；進入
example_sentence: Students study hard to enable themselves to pass the entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 學生努力讀書以便自己能通過入學考試。

definition_zh: (動) 使能夠；使可能　(動) 提供便利；方便
example_sentence: Learning to code enables students to create amazing software applications.
sentence_zh: 學習編程使學生能夠創建令人驚嘆的軟體應用程式。

definition_zh: (動) 制定；頒布　(動) 表演；上演
example_sentence: The government enacted a new law to protect the environment.
sentence_zh: 政府頒布了一項新法律來保護環境。

definition_zh: (名) 制定；頒布　(名) 法律；法令
example_sentence: After the government passed the new environmental protection enactment, factories had to reduce their pollution emissions.
sentence_zh: 政府通過新的環境保護法令後，工廠必須減少污染排放。

definition_zh: (名) 琺瑯；牙釉質　(動) 用琺瑯覆蓋；上釉
example_sentence: Covering the metal surface with enamel, the artist created a beautiful decorative piece.
sentence_zh: 藝術家用琺瑯覆蓋金屬表面，創作了一件美麗的裝飾品。

definition_zh: (動) 包裹；封裝　(動) 用外殼包住；密封
example_sentence: The artifact, which experts encase in a protective glass display, attracts millions of visitors annually.
sentence_zh: 專家用防護玻璃展示櫃包裹的古物每年吸引數百萬遊客參觀。

definition_zh: (動) 迷住；使著迷　(動) 施魔法；下咒語
example_sentence: If the magical story enchants young readers, they will surely request more books from the library.
sentence_zh: 如果這個魔幻故事迷住年輕讀者，他們肯定會從圖書館要求更多書籍。

definition_zh: (副) 迷人地；令人著迷地　(副) 魅力十足地；吸引人地
example_sentence: The old castle stood enchantingly on the hilltop, drawing tourists from all over.
sentence_zh: 那座古老的城堡迷人地矗立在山頂上，吸引來自四面八方的遊客。

definition_zh: (動) 包圍；環繞　(動) 圍住；封鎖
example_sentence: The police surrounded the building to encircle the suspects.
sentence_zh: 警察包圍了建築物以圍住嫌疑人。

definition_zh: (名) 飛地；被包圍的領土　(名) 孤立的社群；隔離區
example_sentence: The ethnic enclave in the downtown area preserves traditional customs and attracts many visitors.
sentence_zh: 市中心的這個民族飛地保留了傳統習俗，吸引了許多遊客。

definition_zh: (動) 圍住；封閉　(動) 附上；隨信附寄
example_sentence: As the fence encloses the garden, birds cannot easily enter the vegetable area.
sentence_zh: 當圍籬圍住花園時，鳥類無法輕易進入蔬菜區。

definition_zh: (形) 被圍住的；密閉的　(形) 隨信附上的；同函附寄的
example_sentence: Enclosed in the package, the handwritten letter made the birthday gift even more special.
sentence_zh: 隨著禮物一起附上的手寫信，使這份生日禮物更加特別。

definition_zh: (名) 圍欄；圍起的空間　(名) 附件；隨附物
example_sentence: The animal shelter has a large enclosure where rescued dogs can play safely.
sentence_zh: 那間動物收容所有一個寬敞的圍欄，被救的狗可以在裡面安全地玩耍。

definition_zh: (動) 編碼；加密　(動) 將信息轉換成代碼形式
example_sentence: The software engineers encode sensitive banking data using advanced encryption technology.
sentence_zh: 軟體工程師使用先進的加密技術對敏感的銀行數據進行編碼。

definition_zh: (動) 遇見；碰面　(名) 相遇；邂逅
example_sentence: If students encountered a native speaker on the street, they would practice English conversation immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在街上遇到英語使用者，他們會立刻練習英文會話。

definition_zh: (動) 鼓勵；促進　(動) 支持；推動
example_sentence: Teachers encourage students to read more books outside class.
sentence_zh: 老師鼓勵學生在課外閱讀更多書籍。

definition_zh: (動) 鼓勵；支持　(形) 受鼓勵的；被激勵的
example_sentence: Encouraged by her teacher's praise, Sarah worked harder on her English homework.
sentence_zh: 受到老師讚美的鼓勵，莎拉更認真做英文功課。

definition_zh: (名) 鼓勵；激勵　(動) 鼓勵；促進
example_sentence: As the coach provided constant encouragement, the athletes trained harder to achieve their goals.
sentence_zh: 當教練不斷地給予鼓勵時，運動員更努力地訓練以達成他們的目標。

definition_zh: (形) 鼓勵的；令人振奮的　(動) 鼓勵；促進
example_sentence: Not only does the teacher's encouraging words inspire confidence, but also motivate students to work harder.
sentence_zh: 不僅老師鼓勵的話語激發信心，而且促使學生更加努力學習。

definition_zh: (動) 侵佔；侵略　(動) 漸漸侵蝕
example_sentence: The shopping mall that encroaches on the forest where endangered birds live has faced strong community opposition.
sentence_zh: 侵佔了瀕危鳥類棲息森林的購物中心面臨了強烈的社區反對。

definition_zh: (名) 侵占；蠶食　(動) 侵犯；逐漸佔領
example_sentence: Environmental groups work to prevent corporate encroachment on protected forest areas.
sentence_zh: 環保組織致力於防止企業對受保護森林地區的蠶食。

definition_zh: (名) 百科全書；百科辭典
example_sentence: Consulting an encyclopedia helped students research ancient civilizations efficiently.
sentence_zh: 查閱百科全書幫助學生有效地研究古代文明。

definition_zh: (動) 以...結束；以...告終
example_sentence: The movie ends in a surprising twist that shocks the audience.
sentence_zh: 這部電影以令人驚訝的轉折結束，震撼了觀眾。

definition_zh: (片) 最後得到；以…結束　(片) 陷入；處於
example_sentence: Although the film started well, it ended up with a disappointing ending that confused the audience.
sentence_zh: 雖然這部電影開始得很好，但它最後以令人失望的結局結束，讓觀眾感到困惑。

definition_zh: (動) 最後結局；結束　(動) 最後成為；最終變成
example_sentence: Working hard every day, many students end up getting into their dream universities.
sentence_zh: 每天努力讀書，許多學生最後進入他們夢想的大學。

definition_zh: (動) 以…結束；終止於　(動) 用…作為結尾
example_sentence: The movie, which ended with a surprising plot twist, left the audience speechless.
sentence_zh: 這部電影以令人驚訝的劇情轉折結束，讓觀眾啞口無言。

definition_zh: (名) 末尾；結束　(動) 結束；終止　(名) 目的；目標
example_sentence: If students end their homework before midnight, they will have time to rest.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在午夜前完成功課，他們將有時間休息。

definition_zh: (動) 危害；使...處於危險中　(動) 威脅；危及
example_sentence: Pollution from factories endangers the health of people living nearby.
sentence_zh: 工廠污染危害住在附近人們的健康。

definition_zh: (形) 瀕臨滅絕的；處於危險中的
example_sentence: Many zoos work to protect endangered animals to prevent their extinction.
sentence_zh: 許多動物園努力保護瀕臨滅絕的動物以防止牠們滅絕。

definition_zh: (名) 努力；嘗試　(動) 努力；試圖
example_sentence: Making every endeavor to succeed and improve academic performance benefits students preparing for college entrance exams.
sentence_zh: 為了成功並改進學業表現而做出每一次努力，對準備大學入學考試的學生很有幫助。

definition_zh: (動) 努力；盡力　(名) 努力；嘗試
example_sentence: Although the project was difficult, the team endeavoured to complete it before the deadline.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個專案很困難，但團隊努力在截止日期前完成它。

definition_zh: (形) 地方特有的；當地的　(形) 地域流行的；地方性的
example_sentence: Having spread widely across Taiwan, the endemic disease required urgent public health intervention.
sentence_zh: 在台灣廣泛傳播的地方性疾病需要緊急的公共衛生措施。

definition_zh: (名) 結局；結尾　(形) 結束的；最後的
example_sentence: The movie's ending, which surprised many viewers, changed how audiences felt about the entire story.
sentence_zh: 這部電影的結局，令許多觀眾感到驚訝，改變了觀眾對整個故事的看法。

definition_zh: (形) 無盡的；永無止境的　(形) 冗長的；似乎沒有盡頭的
example_sentence: Scrolling through social media often feels like an endless cycle of notifications and updates.
sentence_zh: 滑動社交媒體經常感覺像是無盡的通知和更新循環。

definition_zh: (動) 贊同；支持　(動) 背書；簽名
example_sentence: If the principal endorsed the new scholarship program, more students would apply for financial aid.
sentence_zh: 如果校長贊同這項新獎學金計畫，更多學生就會申請助學金。

definition_zh: (名) 認可；贊同　(名) 簽名；背書
example_sentence: The celebrity's endorsement of the new product increased sales significantly.
sentence_zh: 那位名人對新產品的認可大幅增加了銷售額。

definition_zh: (名) 內視鏡；檢視鏡
example_sentence: Using an endoscope inserted through the mouth, doctors can examine the patient's stomach lining.
sentence_zh: 醫生使用通過嘴巴插入的內視鏡，可以檢查病人的胃黏膜。

definition_zh: (動) 賦予；給予　(動) 捐贈；資助
example_sentence: Because the university was endowed with a large donation, many students received financial aid.
sentence_zh: 因為這所大學獲得了一筆大額捐贈，許多學生獲得了財務援助。

definition_zh: (名) 捐贈；基金　(名) 天賦；才能
example_sentence: Not only does the university's endowment support scholarships, but it also funds research programs.
sentence_zh: 這所大學的捐贈基金不僅支持獎學金，而且還資助研究計畫。

definition_zh: (形) 可忍受的；可耐受的
example_sentence: The pain from the injury was endurable, though difficult for the athlete to manage during training.
sentence_zh: 那個傷痛是可以忍受的，雖然對運動員在訓練期間很難控制。

definition_zh: (名) 耐力；忍耐力　(名) 持久力；耐受力
example_sentence: Athletes train hard to build endurance for long-distance competitions.
sentence_zh: 運動員努力訓練以增強耐力來參加長距離比賽。

definition_zh: (動) 忍受；承受　(動) 持續；維持
example_sentence: Marathon runners must endure physical pain and mental fatigue throughout the long race.
sentence_zh: 馬拉松選手必須在長距離比賽中忍受身體疼痛和精神疲勞。

definition_zh: (形) 持久的；耐久的　(形) 忍耐的；堅毅的
example_sentence: The enduring friendship between the two students lasted through high school.
sentence_zh: 這兩個學生之間持久的友誼在高中時期一直存在。

definition_zh: (名) 敵人；對手　(形) 敵對的；有敵意的
example_sentence: Although the two countries were enemies for decades, they finally signed a peace treaty last year.
sentence_zh: 雖然這兩個國家數十年來一直是敵人，但他們終於在去年簽署了和平協議。

definition_zh: (形) 精力充沛的；充滿能量的　(形) 活潑的；積極的
example_sentence: Feeling energetic after morning exercise, Sarah finished her homework quickly.
sentence_zh: 早上運動後精力充沛，莎拉很快地完成了功課。

definition_zh: (形) 精力充沛的；充滿活力的　(形) 積極有力的；有效率的
example_sentence: The energetical approach that the coach adopted proved highly effective for athlete training.
sentence_zh: 教練採取的充滿活力的方法被證明對運動員訓練非常有效。

definition_zh: (副) 精力充沛地；充滿活力地　(副) 熱烈地；積極地
example_sentence: If students study energetically before the exam, they will achieve better results and feel more confident.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試前精力充沛地讀書，他們將會取得更好的成績並感到更有自信。

definition_zh: (動) 使充滿能量；使興奮　使活躍；振奮
example_sentence: A good breakfast energizes students for a productive school day.
sentence_zh: 一頓豐盛的早餐能讓學生在學校有精力度過有成效的一天。

definition_zh: (名) 能量；精力　(動) 給予活力；激勵
example_sentence: Students need to eat healthy food to gain energy for studying hard.
sentence_zh: 學生需要吃健康食物以獲得精力認真讀書。

definition_zh: (動) 執行；實施　(動) 強制；強迫
example_sentence: The school enforces strict rules to maintain discipline and ensure student safety.
sentence_zh: 學校執行嚴格的規則以維持紀律和確保學生安全。

definition_zh: (名) 執行；實施　(名) 強制；驅使
example_sentence: Although the government announced strict rules, enforcement of the traffic law remained weak until police increased patrols.
sentence_zh: 雖然政府宣布了嚴格的規則，但在警察增加巡邏之前，交通法的執行仍然很薄弱。

definition_zh: (動) 吸引；使參與　(動) 從事；參加
example_sentence: Having engaged in several volunteer projects, Sarah felt more confident about her future career path.
sentence_zh: 參與過多個志願服務項目後，莎拉對自己的未來職業道路更有信心。

definition_zh: (形) 忙碌的；投入的　(形) 訂婚的；約定的
example_sentence: The students engaged in the challenging project showed great enthusiasm and teamwork.
sentence_zh: 那些投入於這個具有挑戰性專題的學生展現了很大的熱情和團隊合作精神。

definition_zh: (名) 婚約；訂婚　(名) 承諾；參與　(名) 約會；預定
example_sentence: The couple announced their engagement at a family dinner last weekend.
sentence_zh: 這對夫婦在上週末的家庭聚餐上宣布了他們的婚約。

definition_zh: (名) 引擎；發動機　(名) 動力；推動力
example_sentence: If the car's engine were more powerful, the vehicle would reach higher speeds on the highway.
sentence_zh: 如果汽車的引擎更強大，該車輛在高速公路上會達到更高的速度。

definition_zh: (名) 工程師；設計者　(動) 設計；規劃
example_sentence: My older brother works as a civil engineer for a construction company.
sentence_zh: 我的哥哥在一家建築公司擔任土木工程師。

definition_zh: (名) 工程；工程學　(動) 設計；策劃
example_sentence: Engineering bridges and highways, civil engineers solve complex problems daily.
sentence_zh: 通過設計橋樑和高速公路，土木工程師每天解決複雜的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 英格蘭；英國
example_sentence: Before graduating from high school, many students dream of studying in England, where they can improve their English skills significantly.
sentence_zh: 在高中畢業前，許多學生夢想在英格蘭讀書，在那裡他們能夠顯著提高英語能力。

definition_zh: (名) 英語；英文　(形) 英國的；英語的
example_sentence: Only after mastering English grammar can students tackle complex academic texts with confidence.
sentence_zh: 只有掌握英文文法後，學生才能自信地應對複雜的學術文章。

definition_zh: (名) 英國人；英格蘭人
example_sentence: The Englishman who studied at our school became a famous scientist.
sentence_zh: 在我們學校唸書的那位英國人後來成為著名科學家。

definition_zh: (動) 雕刻；刻畫　(動) 銘記；深深印在心中
example_sentence: The jeweler carved the couple's initials to engrave their love on the ring forever.
sentence_zh: 珠寶商在戒指上雕刻這對情侶的首字母，以此銘記他們永恆的愛。

definition_zh: (名) 雕刻；版畫　(動) 雕刻；銘刻
example_sentence: The artist's detailed engraving on the metal plate took several weeks to complete.
sentence_zh: 這位藝術家在金屬板上的細緻雕刻花了好幾週才完成。

definition_zh: (形) 全神貫注的；專心致志的
example_sentence: Sarah was engrossed in her novel and didn't hear the phone ring.
sentence_zh: 莎拉全神貫注地看著她的小說，沒有聽到電話鈴聲。

definition_zh: (動) 吞沒；淹沒　(動) 包圍；籠罩
example_sentence: As the tsunami approached the coast, enormous waves engulfed the entire village within minutes.
sentence_zh: 當海嘯接近海岸時，巨大的海浪在幾分鐘內吞沒了整個村莊。

definition_zh: (動) 提高；增強　(動) 改善；增進
example_sentence: Enhancing her English skills through daily reading, Sarah scored higher on the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 莎拉通過每日閱讀來提高英語技能，在學測中得分更高。

definition_zh: (名) 謎；神秘的人或事
example_sentence: The ancient artifact, which remained an enigma to archaeologists for decades, was finally decoded last year.
sentence_zh: 這件古代文物對考古學家來說數十年來一直是個謎，去年終於被破解了。

definition_zh: (形) 神祕的；難以理解的　(形) 謎樣的；高深莫測的
example_sentence: If the mysterious painting were less enigmatic, art students could interpret its meaning more easily.
sentence_zh: 如果這幅神祕的畫作沒有那麼難以理解，美術學生就能更容易地詮釋它的意義。

definition_zh: (形) 神祕的；謎樣的　難以理解的；費解的
example_sentence: The professor's enigmatical smile left students wondering what he meant.
sentence_zh: 教授那神祕的笑容讓學生不知道他的意思。

definition_zh: (副) 神祕地；謎樣地　隱晦地；含糊地
example_sentence: The detective spoke enigmatically to confuse the suspects during questioning.
sentence_zh: 那位偵探說話神祕兮兮，目的是在詢問時迷惑嫌疑人。

definition_zh: (動) 享受；喜歡　(動) 擁有；享用
example_sentence: Enjoying good food and spending time with friends makes life meaningful.
sentence_zh: 享受美食和與朋友相處使生活變得有意義。

definition_zh: (形) 令人愉快的；有趣的　(形) 使人快樂的；使人享受的
example_sentence: Although the weather was rainy, the camping trip remained enjoyable because friends shared laughter and stories together.
sentence_zh: 雖然天氣下雨，露營之旅仍然令人愉快，因為朋友們一起分享歡笑和故事。

definition_zh: (副) 令人愉快地；使人開心地
example_sentence: Having finished the difficult exam, students walked out enjoyably, chatting and laughing together.
sentence_zh: 完成了困難的考試後，學生們開心地走出來，邊聊天邊笑。

definition_zh: (名) 享受；快樂　(名) 樂趣；娛樂
example_sentence: The enjoyment that students experience during school trips makes learning more memorable.
sentence_zh: 學生在校外教學中體驗到的享受讓學習更加難忘。

definition_zh: (動) 擴大；放大　(動) 增加；加大
example_sentence: The photo editing software allows users to enlarge images without losing quality.
sentence_zh: 這個修圖軟體讓使用者能夠放大影像而不失去品質。

definition_zh: (名) 擴大；放大　(名) 增大後的東西；放大版本
example_sentence: If the doctor recommended enlargement surgery, the patient would need to discuss all risks carefully.
sentence_zh: 如果醫生建議進行擴大手術，患者就必須仔細討論所有風險。

definition_zh: (動) 啟發；開導　(動) 照亮；使明亮
example_sentence: The teacher's explanation enlightened students about the complex history of Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 老師的解釋啟發了學生對台灣複雜歷史的理解。

definition_zh: (形) 啟發的；有啟發性的　(動) 使開悟；照亮
example_sentence: Reading that enlightening book about climate change, Maria gained a deeper understanding of environmental issues.
sentence_zh: 閱讀那本有啟發性的氣候變遷書籍，瑪麗亞對環境議題有了更深入的了解。

definition_zh: (動) 參軍；徵募　(動) 爭取；尋求幫助
example_sentence: Before graduating from high school, many students enlist in the military because they want to serve their country.
sentence_zh: 高中畢業前，許多學生參軍，因為他們想為國家服務。

definition_zh: (動) 使生動；使活躍　(動) 使有趣；使愉快
example_sentence: Only after the music started did the boring party enliven everyone's mood.
sentence_zh: 只有在音樂開始後，無聊的派對才使每個人的心情活躍起來。

definition_zh: (名) 活躍；生氣勃勃　(名) 使變生動的事物；振奮劑
example_sentence: The surprise party, which brought enlivenment to the birthday girl's celebration, became the highlight of her year.
sentence_zh: 那個驚喜派對為生日女孩的慶祝活動帶來了生氣，成為她這一年的亮點。

definition_zh: (名) 敵意；仇恨
example_sentence: The two rival schools worked together to reduce enmity and build mutual respect.
sentence_zh: 這兩所競爭的學校一起努力減少敵意並建立相互尊重。

definition_zh: (形) 巨大的；龐大的　(形) 極多的；大量的
example_sentence: The enormous skyscraper in Taipei attracts millions of visitors every year.
sentence_zh: 台北那棟巨大的摩天大樓每年吸引數百萬遊客造訪。

definition_zh: (副) 極其；非常　巨大地；很大程度上
example_sentence: The new shopping mall is enormously popular with teenagers on weekends.
sentence_zh: 這家新商場在週末對青少年極其受歡迎。

definition_zh: (形) 足夠的；充分的　(副) 足夠地；充分地
example_sentence: As long as students study enough before the exam, they can pass the test.
sentence_zh: 只要學生在考試前讀書足夠，他們就能通過測驗。

definition_zh: (動) 詢問；打聽　(動) 調查；查詢
example_sentence: Enquiring about the exam date, the student visited the school office.
sentence_zh: 學生詢問考試日期，造訪了學校辦公室。

definition_zh: (動) 激怒；使憤怒　(動) 惹惱；觸怒
example_sentence: The unfair punishment that enraged the students led to a school protest.
sentence_zh: 那個激怒學生的不公平懲罰導致了一場校園抗議。

definition_zh: (形) 憤怒的；狂怒的　(動) 激怒；使憤怒
example_sentence: If the manager treats employees unfairly, workers would become enraged and demand better working conditions.
sentence_zh: 如果經理對員工待遇不公平，工人會變得憤怒並要求更好的工作條件。

definition_zh: (動) 豐富；充實　(動) 改善；提高
example_sentence: Reading widely can enrich a student's knowledge and perspective about the world.
sentence_zh: 廣泛閱讀可以豐富學生對世界的知識和見解。

definition_zh: (動) 入學；報名　參加；登記
example_sentence: Many students enroll in summer courses to improve their English skills.
sentence_zh: 許多學生報名參加暑期課程以提高他們的英文能力。

definition_zh: (名) 入學；註冊　(名) 入學人數；招生
example_sentence: The university announced record enrollment numbers for the fall semester.
sentence_zh: 那所大學宣布秋季學期創歷史新高的入學人數。

definition_zh: (名) 整體；全體　(名) 樂團；合奏隊　(動) 聚集；組合
example_sentence: As the orchestra members assembled on stage, the ensemble began to play with remarkable precision and harmony.
sentence_zh: 當樂隊成員聚集在舞台上時，這個樂團開始以非凡的精準度和協調性演奏。

definition_zh: (動) 將…列入憲法；正式確立　(動) 將…供奉；奉為神聖
example_sentence: Having enshrined the right to free speech in the constitution, the government protects all citizens' voices fairly.
sentence_zh: 將言論自由權正式列入憲法後，政府公正地保護所有公民的聲音。

definition_zh: (動) 隨之發生；接著發生
example_sentence: After the announcement, chaos ensued that affected the entire school.
sentence_zh: 宣布後，隨之發生了影響整所學校的混亂。

definition_zh: (形) 隨後的；接著發生的　(動) 跟著出現；隨即發生
example_sentence: The accident caused serious injuries, and the ensuing chaos made rescue efforts extremely difficult.
sentence_zh: 這起意外造成嚴重傷勢，隨後的混亂使救援工作變得極為困難。

definition_zh: (動) 確保；保證　(動) 使...確定；確認
example_sentence: If students reviewed class notes daily, they would ensure better exam performance.
sentence_zh: 如果學生每天複習課堂筆記，他們就會確保更好的考試成績。

definition_zh: (動) 需要；必然導致　(動) 涉及；牽涉
example_sentence: Buying a house entails saving money for years.
sentence_zh: 買房子必然需要多年的儲蓄。

definition_zh: (動) 報名參加；進入參與
example_sentence: Entering for the national English competition, many students prepared speeches for weeks.
sentence_zh: 報名參加全國英文競賽，許多學生花了好幾週時間準備演講。

definition_zh: (動) 開始從事；著手進行　開始訂立或簽訂
example_sentence: After graduating, many students enter into job training programs to gain practical experience before starting their careers.
sentence_zh: 畢業後，許多學生著手進行工作訓練課程，在開始職業生涯前獲得實務經驗。

definition_zh: (動) 進入；進去　(動) 參加；報名
example_sentence: Only after the teacher enters the classroom do the students begin their exam.
sentence_zh: 只有在老師進入教室後，學生們才開始考試。

definition_zh: (名) 企業；事業　(動) 從事；承辦
example_sentence: The startup enterprise that focuses on renewable energy has attracted many young investors interested in sustainability.
sentence_zh: 專注於再生能源的新創企業吸引了許多對永續發展感興趣的年輕投資者。

definition_zh: (形) 有進取心的；有魄力的　(形) 勇於冒險的；積極主動的
example_sentence: The young entrepreneur started a business to pursue her enterprising vision for the future.
sentence_zh: 這位年輕企業家創辦企業以追求她對未來有進取心的願景。

definition_zh: (動) 娛樂；招待　(動) 使高興；逗樂
example_sentence: Hosting a party and entertaining guests with music and games requires good planning.
sentence_zh: 舉辦派對並用音樂和遊戲招待客人需要良好的計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 表演者；藝人　(名) 招待者；主持人
example_sentence: The famous entertainer performed magic tricks and made the audience laugh.
sentence_zh: 這位著名的表演者表演魔術，讓觀眾笑聲不斷。

definition_zh: (形) 有趣的；令人愉快的　(動) 招待；款待
example_sentence: Although the movie was entertaining, many students found the plot predictable and unrealistic.
sentence_zh: 雖然這部電影很有趣，但許多學生覺得情節可預測且不現實。

definition_zh: (名) 娛樂；消遣　(名) 表演；節目
example_sentence: Providing exciting entertainment, the concert attracted thousands of enthusiastic fans.
sentence_zh: 提供令人興奮的娛樂，這場音樂會吸引了數千名熱情的粉絲。

definition_zh: (動) 迷住；吸引　(動) 深深吸引；使著迷
example_sentence: The magic show that enthralled thousands of spectators became the talk of the school.
sentence_zh: 那場迷住了數千名觀眾的魔術表演成為學校裡的熱門話題。

definition_zh: (名) 熱情；熱忱　(名) 熱心；積極的態度
example_sentence: If students show enthusiasm for learning English, their grades will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生對學習英文展現熱情，他們的成績將會大幅進步。

definition_zh: (名) 熱情；熱忱　(名) 興趣；愛好
example_sentence: Maria's enthusiasm for learning English inspires her classmates every day.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞對學英文的熱情每天都激勵著她的同學。

definition_zh: (形) 熱情的；充滿熱忱的　(形) 熱心的；積極的
example_sentence: Many students join the debate club to develop enthusiastic speaking skills and confidence.
sentence_zh: 許多學生加入辯論社是為了培養熱情的演講技巧和信心。

definition_zh: (副) 熱情地；熱心地　充滿熱忱地；積極地
example_sentence: The students enthusiastically joined the volunteer project to help the local community.
sentence_zh: 學生們熱情地參加了志願項目，幫助當地社區。

definition_zh: (動) 引誘；吸引　(動) 誘惑；勾引
example_sentence: Although the advertisement enticed customers with attractive discounts, many remained skeptical about product quality.
sentence_zh: 雖然廣告以吸引人的折扣誘惑顧客，但許多人仍懷疑產品品質。

definition_zh: (形) 整個的；全部的　(形) 完整的；未損傷的
example_sentence: Having finished the entire project on time, the team celebrated their success together.
sentence_zh: 完成了整個專案後，團隊一起慶祝他們的成功。

definition_zh: (副) 完全地；徹底地　(副) 全部地；絕對地
example_sentence: The old building, which was entirely destroyed by the fire, will be rebuilt next year.
sentence_zh: 那棟完全被火災摧毀的舊建築物將在明年重建。

definition_zh: (名) 全部；整體　完整；完全
example_sentence: The museum's entire collection, viewed in its entirety, tells the story of Taiwan's cultural history.
sentence_zh: 博物館的整個收藏品，以其完整性來看，講述了臺灣的文化歷史故事。

definition_zh: (動) 給予權利；使有資格　使享有
example_sentence: If graduates earned top grades, their university degrees would entitle them to better job opportunities.
sentence_zh: 如果畢業生取得優異成績，他們的大學學位將使他們獲得更好的工作機會。

definition_zh: (形) 有權利的；被命名為　(動) 給…命名；使有權得到
example_sentence: Students entitled to scholarships must submit their applications before the deadline.
sentence_zh: 有資格獲得獎學金的學生必須在截止日期前提交申請。

definition_zh: (名) 實體；個體　(名) 法人；團體
example_sentence: Each company, operating independently, maintains its own legal entity.
sentence_zh: 每間公司獨立營運，都維持自己的法人身份。

definition_zh: (名) [`ɛntrəns] 入口；進入　(動) [ɪn`træns] 進入；錄取
example_sentence: As soon as students pass the entrance exam, they feel relieved and excited.
sentence_zh: 學生一通過入學考試，他們就感到放鬆和興奮。

definition_zh: (動) 懇求；懇請　(動) 熱情勸告；懇懇為難
example_sentence: Never did the students entreat their teacher more earnestly for extra study time.
sentence_zh: 學生們從未如此懇切地為額外的讀書時間而懇求老師。

definition_zh: (名) 企業家；創業者　(形) 創業的；企業家的
example_sentence: The entrepreneur who founded this tech company started from a small garage.
sentence_zh: 創立這家科技公司的企業家從一個小車庫開始起步。

definition_zh: (動) 委託；託付　(動) 信任；相信
example_sentence: Parents entrust their children to teachers to receive quality education.
sentence_zh: 父母把孩子託付給老師以獲得優質教育。

definition_zh: (名) 進入；入口　(名) 參賽作品；報名
example_sentence: Winning the art competition required submitting an original entry before the deadline.
sentence_zh: 贏得藝術競賽需要在截止日期前提交一份原創參賽作品。

definition_zh: (動) 包圍；籠罩　(動) 用信封裝
example_sentence: Heavy fog enveloped the entire mountain during the hike.
sentence_zh: 登山時，濃霧籠罩了整座山。

definition_zh: (名) 信封；封套
example_sentence: As soon as Maria opened the envelope, she discovered a handwritten letter inside.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞一打開信封，就發現裡面有一封手寫信。

definition_zh: (形) 嫉妒的；羨慕的　(形) 引人嫉妒的；令人羨慕的
example_sentence: Feeling envious of her classmate's test score, Sarah studied harder for the next exam.
sentence_zh: 莎拉嫉妒同學的考試成績，為下次考試更加努力讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 環境；周圍的情況　(名) 自然環境；生態環境
example_sentence: Students who study in a quiet environment tend to concentrate better on their homework.
sentence_zh: 在安靜環境中讀書的學生往往能更專注於功課。

definition_zh: (形) 環境的；與環境有關的　(形) 生態的；環保的
example_sentence: If schools provide more environmental education, students will better understand climate change.
sentence_zh: 如果學校提供更多環境教育，學生將更了解氣候變遷。

definition_zh: (名) 環保人士；環境保護者
example_sentence: The environmentalist works hard to protect endangered animals and forests.
sentence_zh: 這位環保人士努力工作以保護瀕危動物和森林。

definition_zh: (副) 環保地；從環境的角度來看
example_sentence: Many companies use renewable energy to operate environmentally and reduce carbon emissions.
sentence_zh: 許多公司使用再生能源來環保地運營並減少碳排放。

definition_zh: (動) 想象；設想　(動) 預見；預料
example_sentence: Scientists envisage that renewable energy will replace fossil fuels within twenty years.
sentence_zh: 科學家設想可再生能源將在二十年內取代化石燃料。

definition_zh: (動) 想像；設想　(動) 展望；預見
example_sentence: As technology advances rapidly, engineers envision a future where artificial intelligence transforms daily life.
sentence_zh: 隨著科技快速進步，工程師們想像人工智慧將改變日常生活的未來。

definition_zh: (名) 使節；特使　(動) 派遣；委派
example_sentence: Having served as a special envoy for five years, the diplomat successfully negotiated the trade agreement between the two nations.
sentence_zh: 在擔任特使五年後，這位外交官成功協商了兩國間的貿易協議。

definition_zh: (動) 妒忌；羨慕　(名) 妒忌；嫉妒
example_sentence: Sarah envies her classmate who won the scholarship that Sarah had hoped to receive.
sentence_zh: 莎拉妒忌她的同學獲得了莎拉本來希望得到的獎學金。

definition_zh: (名) 酵素；酶
example_sentence: Digestive enzymes in the stomach break down food into smaller molecules.
sentence_zh: 胃裡的消化酵素將食物分解成更小的分子。

definition_zh: (形) 史詩般的；壯大的　(名) 史詩；偉大的事蹟
example_sentence: If the sports team had trained harder, their victory in the championship would have been truly epic.
sentence_zh: 如果這支運動隊訓練得更刻苦，他們在錦標賽中的勝利就會真正壯觀。

definition_zh: (名) 流行病；傳染病　(形) 流行的；大流行的
example_sentence: The spread of disease during an epidemic requires immediate government action and public cooperation.
sentence_zh: 流行病期間疾病的傳播需要政府立即採取行動和公眾配合。

definition_zh: (名) 表皮；上表皮
example_sentence: The epidermis, forming the skin's outer layer, protects underlying tissues from harmful bacteria and environmental damage.
sentence_zh: 表皮構成皮膚的外層，保護下層組織免受有害細菌和環境損害。

definition_zh: (名) 豁然開悟；恍然大悟　(名) 頓悟時刻；靈光乍現
example_sentence: As Maria struggled with the math problem for hours, an epiphany suddenly struck when she changed her approach completely.
sentence_zh: 當瑪麗亞為這道數學題苦苦思考了好幾個小時後，當她徹底改變解題方法時，一個頓悟瞬間襲來。

definition_zh: (名) 劇集；單集　(名) 事件；插曲
example_sentence: Only after watching the final episode did the mystery of the crime become clear.
sentence_zh: 只有在看了最後一集之後，犯罪的謎團才變得清晰。

definition_zh: (名) 綽號；別稱　(名) 修飾語；形容詞
example_sentence: The term 'coward,' which is an epithet that the bully used to describe others, actually revealed his own insecurity.
sentence_zh: 「膽小鬼」這個綽號是那個惡霸用來形容他人的詞彙，卻實際上暴露了他自己的不安全感。

definition_zh: (名) 典型；縮影　(動) 成為…的典型
example_sentence: Studying hard every day is the epitome to achieve your dream of entering a top university.
sentence_zh: 每天努力讀書是為了達成進入頂尖大學夢想的典型方式。

definition_zh: (名) 時代；時期　(名) 重要時期；歷史轉折點
example_sentence: The invention of the internet marked a new epoch in human communication and information sharing.
sentence_zh: 網際網路的發明標誌著人類通訊和信息分享的新時代。

definition_zh: (名) 人名地名；同名人物
example_sentence: The sandwich gets its name from the Earl of Sandwich, making him an eponym.
sentence_zh: 三明治因桑威治伯爵而得名，他是這個食物的同名人物。

definition_zh: (形) 相等的；平等的　(動) 等於；相當
example_sentence: As long as both students work equally hard, they will achieve equal results in the exam.
sentence_zh: 只要兩名學生同樣努力，他們在考試中就會取得相等的成績。

definition_zh: (名) 平等；相等　(名) 品質；特性
example_sentence: Recognizing equality among all students, the school created programs supporting disadvantaged learners.
sentence_zh: 認識到所有學生的平等，該校創立了支持弱勢學習者的計畫。

definition_zh: (動) 等同；視為相同　(動) 相等；成正比
example_sentence: Many students equate success, which society measures by test scores, with personal happiness.
sentence_zh: 許多學生把成功（社會以考試分數衡量）等同於個人幸福。

definition_zh: (名) 方程式；等式　(名) 問題；情況
example_sentence: If students understand the basic rules of algebra, solving this equation will become much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果學生理解代數的基本規則，解這個方程式就會變得容易得多。

definition_zh: (名) 赤道；地球中心的想像圓線
example_sentence: The equator divides Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres.
sentence_zh: 赤道將地球分為北半球和南半球。

definition_zh: (形) 馬術的；騎馬的　(名) 馬術選手；騎馬者
example_sentence: Many students join the equestrian club to learn proper riding techniques.
sentence_zh: 許多學生加入馬術俱樂部以學習正確的騎馬技巧。

definition_zh: (名) 平衡；均衡　(名) 穩定狀態；平衡狀態
example_sentence: The chemistry experiment requires maintaining equilibrium between acid and base solutions.
sentence_zh: 這個化學實驗需要維持酸性和鹼性溶液之間的平衡。

definition_zh: (動) 裝備；配備　(動) 使具有能力；準備
example_sentence: As students equip themselves with strong study skills, they can tackle challenging exams more confidently.
sentence_zh: 當學生裝備自己堅強的讀書技巧時，他們能更有信心地應對困難的考試。

definition_zh: (名) 設備；裝備　(名) 器材；工具
example_sentence: Having purchased new equipment, the school's science lab became much more modern and functional.
sentence_zh: 購置了新設備後，學校的科學實驗室變得現代化且功能更完善。

definition_zh: (形) 公平的；公正的　(形) 合理的；均等的
example_sentence: The new grading system, which is equitable to all students, considers both effort and achievement.
sentence_zh: 這個新的評分制度對所有學生都是公平的，它既考慮努力也考慮成績。

definition_zh: (名) 公平；公正　(名) 股權；股本
example_sentence: Fair salary distribution and equity among employees create a stronger workplace culture.
sentence_zh: 公平的薪資分配和員工之間的公正性創造了更強大的職場文化。

definition_zh: (形) 相等的；等量的　(名) 相等物；等價物
example_sentence: If the two test scores were equivalent, the university would accept both as proof of English ability.
sentence_zh: 如果這兩個考試成績相等，大學就會接受兩者作為英語能力的證明。

definition_zh: (副) 含糊地；模稜兩可地　(副) 言辭曖昧地
example_sentence: The politician answered the reporter's question equivocally, avoiding a clear yes or no.
sentence_zh: 那位政治人物含糊地回答記者的問題，避免給出明確的是或否。

definition_zh: (名) 時代；年代　(名) 時期；紀元
example_sentence: Entering the digital era, students now rely on technology for learning and communication.
sentence_zh: 進入數位時代，學生現在依靠科技來學習和溝通。

definition_zh: (動) 根除；消滅　(動) 徹底清除；摧毀
example_sentence: Because malaria has been eradicated in many countries, fewer children suffer from this deadly disease.
sentence_zh: 因為許多國家已經根除瘧疾，較少兒童遭受這種致命疾病的折磨。

definition_zh: (動) 擦掉；刪除　(動) 消除；清除
example_sentence: Only after the student erased the incorrect answer did the teacher accept the revised solution.
sentence_zh: 只有在學生擦掉錯誤答案之後，老師才接受修正後的解答。

definition_zh: (名) 橡皮擦；擦除物
example_sentence: The eraser that removes pencil marks easily is very popular with students.
sentence_zh: 那支容易擦掉鉛筆痕跡的橡皮擦很受學生歡迎。

definition_zh: (動) 豎立；建造　(形) 直立的；挺直的
example_sentence: The construction company built a tall building to erect a modern shopping center downtown.
sentence_zh: 這家建築公司建造了一棟高樓，目的是在市中心豎立一個現代購物中心。

definition_zh: (動) 侵蝕；磨損　(動) 逐漸破壞；削弱
example_sentence: Heavy rainfall and strong winds erode the hillside, causing serious landslides threatening nearby villages.
sentence_zh: 強降雨和強風侵蝕山坡，造成嚴重山崩威脅附近村莊。

definition_zh: (名) 侵蝕；腐蝕　(動) 侵蝕；逐漸破壞
example_sentence: Heavy rainfall causes serious erosion of the mountainside every year.
sentence_zh: 每年大雨都會導致山坡嚴重的侵蝕。

definition_zh: (形) 色情的；情慾的　(形) 挑逗性慾的；性感的
example_sentence: Although the museum displayed erotic art from ancient civilizations, many parents complained about its appropriateness for young visitors.
sentence_zh: 儘管博物館展出了古代文明的色情藝術作品，許多家長仍對其對年輕訪客的適切性提出抱怨。

definition_zh: (名) 差事；跑腿　(動) 跑腿；辦差
example_sentence: Running errands for elderly neighbors, Sarah delivered groceries and paid bills.
sentence_zh: 莎拉為年長鄰居跑腿，遞送雜貨並繳付帳單。

definition_zh: (形) 不規則的；反覆無常的　(形) 不穩定的；難以預測的
example_sentence: The student's erratic study habits, which changed every week, made exam preparation difficult.
sentence_zh: 這個學生反覆無常的讀書習慣，每週都在改變，使得準備考試很困難。

definition_zh: (形) 錯誤的；不正確的　(形) 謬誤的；荒謬的
example_sentence: If the student submits erroneous data, the experiment's results will be completely unreliable.
sentence_zh: 如果學生提交錯誤的數據，實驗的結果將完全不可靠。

definition_zh: (副) 錯誤地；誤地
example_sentence: The scientist erroneously believed the old experimental data without further verification.
sentence_zh: 那位科學家錯誤地相信舊的實驗數據，沒有進一步驗證。

definition_zh: (名) 錯誤；過失　(動) 犯錯；出錯
example_sentence: Students must study hard to avoid making errors on the final exam.
sentence_zh: 學生必須努力讀書以避免在期末考試中犯錯。

definition_zh: (動) 爆發；噴發　(動) 突然發生；突然出現
example_sentence: The volcano erupted suddenly, and hot lava flowed down the mountain rapidly.
sentence_zh: 火山突然噴發，熔岩迅速流下山坡。

definition_zh: (名) 爆發；噴發　(名) 皮膚病；皮疹
example_sentence: When the volcano erupted, ash spread across the island because lava burst violently.
sentence_zh: 當火山噴發時，因為岩漿猛烈爆裂，灰燼散布在整個島嶼上。

definition_zh: (動) 升級；加劇　(名) 升級；加劇
example_sentence: Having escalated the conflict, both sides found themselves unable to reach a peaceful agreement.
sentence_zh: 衝突升級後，雙方發現自己無法達成和平協議。

definition_zh: (名) 扶梯；電扶梯　(動) 逐漸增加；上升
example_sentence: The escalator that connects the two floors is always crowded during rush hour.
sentence_zh: 連接兩層樓的那部扶梯在尖峰時段總是很擁擠。

definition_zh: (動) 逃脫；逃離　(名) 逃脫；逃生
example_sentence: The prisoner's daring escape from the maximum-security prison shocked the whole country.
sentence_zh: 那名囚犯從最高安全監獄的大膽逃脫震驚了整個國家。

definition_zh: (動) [ɪˈskɔrt] 護送；陪同　(名) [ˈɛskɔrt] 護衛者；同伴
example_sentence: If the security guard did not escort the famous singer through the airport, fans would surround her immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果保安人員沒有護送這位著名歌手通過機場，粉絲會立即包圍她。

definition_zh: (形) 深奧的；只有少數人能理解的　(形) 秘傳的；神祕的
example_sentence: The professor's esoteric theories about ancient philosophy confuse most students.
sentence_zh: 那位教授關於古代哲學的深奧理論讓大多數學生感到困惑。

definition_zh: (副) 尤其；特別　(副) 格外；特殊地
example_sentence: Having finished the math test early, students felt especially proud of their effort.
sentence_zh: 有提前完成數學考試，學生們對自己的努力感到特別驕傲。

definition_zh: (名) 間諜活動；諜報
example_sentence: Because espionage threatened national security, the government increased intelligence agency funding significantly.
sentence_zh: 因為間諜活動威脅國家安全，政府大幅增加情報機構的經費。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈɛse] 短文；論文　(動) [ɛˈse] 嘗試；試驗
example_sentence: Only after completing the essay did the student realize how much research was needed.
sentence_zh: 只有在完成這篇論文之後，學生才意識到需要多少研究。

definition_zh: (名) 本質；精髓　(名) 精油；香精
example_sentence: The essence of learning a language is consistent practice, which many students often overlook.
sentence_zh: 學習語言的本質是持續練習，這是許多學生經常忽視的。

definition_zh: (形) 必須的；基本的　(名) 必需品；要素
example_sentence: Learning essential grammar rules is necessary to pass the CSAT English exam.
sentence_zh: 學習必要的文法規則是通過學測英文考試的必要條件。

definition_zh: (副) 本質上；根本上　基本上；大致上
example_sentence: Learning vocabulary and practicing grammar are essentially the most important steps for CSAT preparation.
sentence_zh: 學習詞彙和練習文法本質上是準備學測最重要的步驟。

definition_zh: (動) 建立；設立　(動) 確定；證實
example_sentence: The school established a new scholarship program to support talented students.
sentence_zh: 該校設立了一項新的獎學金計畫，以支持有才華的學生。

definition_zh: (形) 已確立的；公認的　(動) 建立；設立
example_sentence: Although the company was established fifty years ago, it remains innovative and competitive in the market.
sentence_zh: 雖然這家公司是五十年前成立的，但它在市場上仍然保持創新和競爭力。

definition_zh: (名) 機構；組織　(名) 建立；設立
example_sentence: Having established a reputation for quality, the fashion brand's new establishment quickly attracted loyal customers.
sentence_zh: 該時尚品牌建立了優質的聲譽後，其新開設的機構迅速吸引了忠實顧客。

definition_zh: (名) 莊園；房產　(名) 遺產；財產
example_sentence: The mansion, which stood on an estate covering hundreds of acres, attracted many wealthy buyers.
sentence_zh: 那座豪宅坐落在一個佔地數百英畝的莊園上，吸引了許多富有的買家。

definition_zh: (動) 尊重；敬重　(名) 尊敬；評價
example_sentence: If your teacher esteems your hard work, you will gain confidence and motivation.
sentence_zh: 如果你的老師尊重你的努力，你將獲得信心和動力。

definition_zh: (動) [ˈɛstəˌmet] 估計；評估　(名) [ˈɛstəmɪt] 估計；評估
example_sentence: The engineer estimated the project cost at two million dollars.
sentence_zh: 工程師估計該項目成本為兩百萬美元。

definition_zh: (名) 估計；評估　(名) 估價；報價
example_sentence: Engineers need accurate estimation to plan the bridge construction project successfully.
sentence_zh: 工程師需要準確的估計來成功規劃橋樑建設專案。

definition_zh: (動) 使疏遠；使關係破裂　(動) 使陌生；使分離
example_sentence: Years of misunderstanding and poor communication gradually estranged the once-close siblings from each other.
sentence_zh: 多年的誤解和溝通不良逐漸使這對曾經親近的兄妹彼此疏遠。
subject_type: noun (years of misunderstanding and poor communication)

definition_zh: (名) 河口；河的下游
example_sentence: As the river flows toward the estuary, the water becomes salty due to the mixing of freshwater and ocean water.
sentence_zh: 當河流流向河口時，由於淡水與海水混合，水變鹹了。

definition_zh: (縮) 等等；及其他　(片) 諸如此類
example_sentence: Having listed all required documents, including passport, visa, tickets, etc., the traveler felt prepared for departure.
sentence_zh: 旅客列舉了所有必需文件（包括護照、簽證、機票等），感到已為出發做好準備。

definition_zh: (形) 永恆的；永遠的　(形) 終身的；不朽的
example_sentence: The love that parents show their children is an eternal bond which grows stronger over time.
sentence_zh: 父母對孩子展現的愛是一種永恆的紐帶，這種紐帶會隨著時間而加強。

definition_zh: (副) 永遠地；無止境地　(副) 始終；一直
example_sentence: Love and friendship, eternally valued by humanity, bring meaning to our lives.
sentence_zh: 愛與友誼，被人類永遠珍視，為我們的生活帶來意義。

definition_zh: (名) 永恆；永遠　(名) 來世；永生
example_sentence: If humans could live forever, eternity would lose its precious meaning.
sentence_zh: 如果人類能永遠活著，永恆將失去其珍貴的意義。

definition_zh: (名) 乙醇；酒精
example_sentence: Ethanol is commonly used as fuel in many countries around the world.
sentence_zh: 乙醇在世界許多國家中常被用作燃料。

definition_zh: (名) 倫理；道德　(形) 符合倫理的；道德的
example_sentence: Following strict ethical guidelines, the researcher ensured all study participants gave informed consent.
sentence_zh: 遵循嚴格的倫理準則，研究人員確保所有參與者都給予知情同意。

definition_zh: (形) 倫理的；道德的　(形) 符合道德的；誠實的
example_sentence: Although the company was profitable, its unethical practices made many customers avoid buying their products.
sentence_zh: 雖然這家公司獲利，但其不道德的做法讓許多顧客避免購買他們的產品。

definition_zh: (名) 倫理學家；道德專家
example_sentence: Only after careful study of moral philosophy does an ethicist develop a clear position on controversial issues.
sentence_zh: 只有在仔細研究道德哲學之後，倫理學家才能對爭議性問題形成清晰立場。

definition_zh: (名) 倫理；道德　(名) 倫理學；道德標準
example_sentence: The company's ethics, which prioritize customer safety and fair treatment, have earned widespread public trust.
sentence_zh: 該公司的倫理標準（優先考慮顧客安全和公平對待），贏得了廣泛的公眾信任。

definition_zh: (形) 民族的；種族的　(形) 具有民族特色的
example_sentence: The museum hosts cultural festivals to celebrate ethnic diversity among different communities.
sentence_zh: 這家博物館舉辦文化節慶來慶祝不同社區之間的民族多樣性。

definition_zh: (名) 禮儀；禮節　(名) 餐桌禮儀；社交禮儀
example_sentence: Learning proper dining etiquette helps students succeed at formal business dinners.
sentence_zh: 學習正確的餐桌禮儀幫助學生在正式商務晚餐中取得成功。

definition_zh: (名) 宦官；被閹割的男性
example_sentence: In ancient Chinese courts, a eunuch often served the emperor with great loyalty.
sentence_zh: 在古代中國宮廷中，宦官常常以極大的忠誠侍奉皇帝。

definition_zh: (名) 極度的幸福感；欣喜若狂
example_sentence: Although winning the lottery brought euphoria, the team discovered that financial success required careful planning.
sentence_zh: 雖然中樂透帶來了極度的幸福感，但這支隊伍發現財務成功需要謹慎的規劃。

definition_zh: (名) 歐元；歐洲聯盟貨幣
example_sentence: Using euros when traveling across Europe, students can purchase goods without exchanging currency repeatedly.
sentence_zh: 學生在歐洲旅遊時使用歐元購買商品，無須反覆兌換貨幣。

definition_zh: (名) 歐洲；歐洲大陸
example_sentence: Europe, which is a continent with diverse cultures and languages, attracts millions of tourists annually.
sentence_zh: 歐洲是一個文化和語言多樣化的大陸，每年吸引數百萬遊客。

definition_zh: (形) 歐洲的；歐洲人的　(名) 歐洲人
example_sentence: If students study European history, they will understand modern politics better.
sentence_zh: 如果學生們研究歐洲歷史，他們會更好地理解現代政治。

definition_zh: (動) 撤離；逃離　(動) 疏散；清空
example_sentence: When the earthquake alarm sounded, students evacuated the building quickly.
sentence_zh: 地震警報響起時，學生迅速撤離大樓。

definition_zh: (名) 疏散；撤離　(動) 疏散；撤出
example_sentence: The school organized an evacuation drill to prepare students for emergencies.
sentence_zh: 學校組織了一次疏散演習，為學生做好應對緊急情況的準備。

definition_zh: (動) 逃避；躲避　(動) 規避；迴避
example_sentence: The suspect evaded police by hiding in the abandoned warehouse downtown.
sentence_zh: 那名嫌疑人藏在市中心的廢棄倉庫裡來躲避警察。

definition_zh: (動) 評估；評價　(動) 計算；求值
example_sentence: As the teacher evaluated each student's project, she noted the creative ideas and technical skills shown.
sentence_zh: 當老師評估每位學生的專題時，她記下了展現的創意想法和技術能力。

definition_zh: (名) 評估；評價　(名) 評定；鑑定
example_sentence: Having completed the project evaluation, the team identified several areas for improvement.
sentence_zh: 完成項目評估後，該團隊確認了幾個需要改進的地方。

definition_zh: (形) 福音派的；熱心傳教的
example_sentence: The evangelical church, which emphasizes personal conversion, attracts many young believers.
sentence_zh: 那間福音派教堂強調個人信仰的轉變，吸引了許多年輕信徒。

definition_zh: (名) 傳播福音；宗教佈道
example_sentence: Christian evangelism aims to share religious beliefs with people seeking spiritual truth.
sentence_zh: 基督教傳播福音旨在與尋求精神真理的人分享宗教信仰。

definition_zh: (動) 傳教；宣揚信仰
example_sentence: If religious groups evangelized more actively in schools, student awareness of faith would certainly increase.
sentence_zh: 如果宗教團體在學校更積極地傳教，學生對信仰的認識肯定會增加。

definition_zh: (動) 蒸發；消失
example_sentence: Water evaporates quickly when exposed to hot sunlight.
sentence_zh: 水在暴露於炎熱陽光下時會迅速蒸發。

definition_zh: (名) 蒸發；蒸散
example_sentence: Evaporation occurring during summer increases atmospheric water vapor significantly.
sentence_zh: 夏天發生的蒸發現象明顯增加大氣中的水蒸氣。

definition_zh: (名) 前夜；前一天晚上　(名) 邊緣；前夕
example_sentence: As the eve of the college entrance exam approached, students studied harder than ever before.
sentence_zh: 隨著大學入學考試前夜的到來，學生們比以往更加努力地讀書。

definition_zh: (連) 雖然；儘管　(副) 甚至；即使
example_sentence: Never in her life had Sarah studied hard, even though her parents constantly encouraged her.
sentence_zh: 莎拉從未努力讀書，儘管父母不斷鼓勵她。

definition_zh: (副) 更糟；甚至更差
example_sentence: The exam was difficult, and even worse, the results were posted online immediately.
sentence_zh: 考試很難，更糟的是，成績立刻被發布到網路上。

definition_zh: (形) 甚至；連...都　(副) 甚至；連...都　(動) 使...平坦
example_sentence: Students study hard every day even to pass the university entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 學生每天努力讀書，甚至為了通過大學入學考試而學習。

definition_zh: (連) 即使；縱然　(連) 就算；哪怕
example_sentence: Even if the weather is bad tomorrow, the school sports day will still proceed as planned.
sentence_zh: 即使明天天氣不好，學校運動會仍將按計畫進行。

definition_zh: (名) 傍晚；夜間　(名) 晚會；晚間活動
example_sentence: Many students study hard in the evening to prepare for exams.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在傍晚用功讀書以準備考試。

definition_zh: (副) 均勻地；平均地　(副) 平靜地；冷靜地
