example_sentence: The teacher divided the snacks evenly among all students so that everyone received the same amount.
sentence_zh: 老師均勻地將零食分配給所有學生，以便每個人都得到相同的份量。

definition_zh: (名) 事件；活動　(名) 比賽項目；運動會
example_sentence: Winning the championship, the student athletes celebrated their hard work and dedication.
sentence_zh: 贏得冠軍，學生運動員慶祝他們的辛勤工作和奉獻。

definition_zh: (副) 最終地；終於　(形) 最後的；終極的
example_sentence: The investment strategy, which showed poor results initially, eventually proved successful for long-term investors.
sentence_zh: 這項投資策略雖然初期表現不佳，但對長期投資者來說最終證明是成功的。

definition_zh: (副) 最終；終於　(副) 迅速解決；漸漸地
example_sentence: If students study hard consistently, they will eventually pass the CSAT with flying colors.
sentence_zh: 如果學生持續努力讀書，他們最終會以優異成績通過學測。

definition_zh: (連) 自從；打從…以來
example_sentence: Ever since moving to Taipei, Maya has loved trying new restaurants every weekend.
sentence_zh: 自從搬到台北以來，瑪亞每個週末都喜歡嘗試新餐廳。

definition_zh: (副) 曾經；從來　(副) 到底；究竟
example_sentence: Students study hard every day to ever improve their test scores.
sentence_zh: 學生每天努力讀書以便不斷進步他們的考試成績。

definition_zh: (形) 四季常綠的；永不凋謝的　(名) 常綠樹；常青樹
example_sentence: Evergreen trees in the schoolyard provide shade and oxygen throughout the entire year.
sentence_zh: 學校操場裡的常綠樹全年都能提供陰涼和氧氣。

definition_zh: (形) 永恆的；永久的　(形) 持久的；不衰退的
example_sentence: As long as love remains everlasting, couples can overcome any difficulty together.
sentence_zh: 只要愛永恆不變，情侶就能一起克服任何困難。

definition_zh: (副) 不時地；時不時地　(副) 偶爾；間或
example_sentence: Having finished the project ahead of schedule, the team would meet up every now and then to share updates.
sentence_zh: 在提前完成項目後，團隊會不時地聚在一起分享進展。

definition_zh: (形) 每隔一個的；每次都隔一個的
example_sentence: Students who attend every other class meeting often fall behind in the material covered.
sentence_zh: 每隔一堂課才出席的學生經常會跟不上教材進度。

definition_zh: (形) 每一個；每一　(副) 每次；每隔
example_sentence: Every student in the class must complete homework and submit it by Friday.
sentence_zh: 班級裡的每一個學生都必須完成功課，並在星期五前繳交。

definition_zh: (代) 每個人；人人
example_sentence: If everybody studied hard for the exam, the class average would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果每個人都為考試認真讀書，班級平均成績就會大幅提高。

definition_zh: (形) 每天的；日常的　(副) 每天；天天
example_sentence: Drinking enough water is an important everyday habit for good health.
sentence_zh: 喝足夠的水是保持健康的重要日常習慣。

definition_zh: (代) 每個人；人人　(名) 各個人；所有的人
example_sentence: Everyone attending the school festival enjoyed watching the traditional music performance held on the playground.
sentence_zh: 參加校園祭典的每個人都享受了在操場舉辦的傳統音樂表演。

definition_zh: (代) 每件事；一切　(名) 全部；所有事物
example_sentence: Everything went wrong when the exam started, so many students felt stressed.
sentence_zh: 當考試開始時一切都出錯了，所以許多學生感到有壓力。

definition_zh: (副) 到處；各地　(副) 任何地方
example_sentence: Hardly anywhere in Taipei can you find a quieter park than this one.
sentence_zh: 在台北幾乎找不到比這裡更安靜的公園。

definition_zh: (動) 驅逐；趕出　(動) 逐出租住所
example_sentence: The landlord evicted tenants who failed to pay rent on time.
sentence_zh: 房東驅逐了那些未按時繳租的房客。

definition_zh: (名) 驅逐；逐出　(名) 房客被趕出租屋
example_sentence: The landlord filed papers to evict the tenant for nonpayment of rent.
sentence_zh: 房東為了追討租金而提交文件來驅逐房客。

definition_zh: (名) 證據；證物　(名) 跡象；跡象
example_sentence: Police collected physical evidence from the crime scene and the suspect's apartment.
sentence_zh: 警察從犯罪現場和嫌疑人的公寓蒐集了物證。

definition_zh: (動) 表明；證明　(形) 有證據的；明顯的
example_sentence: The students' excellent test scores evidenced their hard work throughout the semester.
sentence_zh: 學生優異的考試成績證明了他們整個學期的努力。

definition_zh: (形) 明顯的；清楚的　(形) 顯而易見的；無庸置疑的
example_sentence: Because the test results are evident, the student's improvement in English is undeniable.
sentence_zh: 因為測試結果很明顯，這位學生在英文上的進步是無可否認的。

definition_zh: (副) 明顯地；顯然地　顯而易見地
example_sentence: Having studied all night, the student evidently struggled to focus during the exam.
sentence_zh: 徹夜讀書的那個學生在考試中顯然很難集中注意力。

definition_zh: (形) 邪惡的；惡劣的　(名) 邪惡；壞事
example_sentence: The villain's evil plan, which aimed to destroy the city, was finally stopped by the hero.
sentence_zh: 那個反派的邪惡計畫試圖摧毀城市，最後終於被英雄阻止了。

definition_zh: (形) 可避免的；可逃避的
example_sentence: If students prepare well, many exam mistakes would be evitable and easily prevented.
sentence_zh: 如果學生準備充分，許多考試錯誤就會是可避免的，容易被預防。

definition_zh: (動) 喚起；引起　激發；回想起
example_sentence: The old photograph evoked memories of childhood adventures in the countryside.
sentence_zh: 那張舊照片喚起了在鄉間的童年冒險回憶。

definition_zh: (名) 進化；演變　(名) 發展；變化
example_sentence: Scientists study fossil records to understand the evolution of ancient species.
sentence_zh: 科學家研究化石紀錄以了解古代物種的進化。

definition_zh: (形) 進化的；演化的　(形) 逐步發展的；漸進的
example_sentence: Darwin's theory of evolutionary change explains how species adapt to their environment over millions of years.
sentence_zh: 達爾文的進化論解釋了物種如何在數百萬年間適應環境而逐步改變。

definition_zh: (動) 進化；演變　(動) 發展；逐漸形成
example_sentence: As technology evolves, students must adapt their learning methods to stay competitive.
sentence_zh: 隨著科技的進化，學生必須調整學習方法以保持競爭力。

definition_zh: (名) 前任伴侶；前男友或前女友
example_sentence: Having broken up last year, Sarah's ex still messages her on social media.
sentence_zh: 去年分手後，莎拉的前男友仍在社群媒體上傳訊息給她。

definition_zh: (動) 惡化；加重　(動) 使情況更糟
example_sentence: The lack of sleep, which exacerbated his stress, made studying for the exam much harder.
sentence_zh: 缺乏睡眠加重了他的壓力，使得準備考試變得更加困難。

definition_zh: (形) 精確的；準確的　(動) 強求；索取
example_sentence: The exact time of the exam is important for all test-takers to know.
sentence_zh: 考試的精確時間對所有考生來說都很重要。

definition_zh: (形) 嚴格的；苛刻的　(形) 費力的；耗時的
example_sentence: If the professor were less exacting about details, students would submit their reports more confidently.
sentence_zh: 如果教授對細節沒有那麼苛刻，學生們會更有信心地提交報告。

definition_zh: (副) 確實；恰好　(副) 精確地；准確地
example_sentence: The exam starts at 2 p.m. exactly, so arrive on time.
sentence_zh: 考試確實在下午2點開始，所以要準時到達。

definition_zh: (動) 誇大；誇張　(名) 誇大；夸張的說法
example_sentence: Exaggerating the problem's severity, the report warned of serious consequences.
sentence_zh: 那份報告誇大了問題的嚴重性，警告會有嚴重後果。

definition_zh: (形) 誇大的；過度渲染的　(動) 誇大；言過其實
example_sentence: Although the movie's action scenes were exaggerated, audiences still enjoyed the thrilling entertainment.
sentence_zh: 雖然電影的動作場景被誇大了，觀眾仍然享受刺激的娛樂效果。

definition_zh: (名) 誇大；過度渲染　(名) 誇張的說法
example_sentence: Seldom does such exaggeration help build trust between friends.
sentence_zh: 很少有誇大其詞的做法能幫助朋友之間建立信任。

definition_zh: (動) 高舉；讚美　(動) 使興高采烈；使欣喜若狂
example_sentence: The coach exalted the players who displayed exceptional teamwork throughout the season.
sentence_zh: 教練讚美了在整個賽季中表現出卓越團隊合作的球員。

definition_zh: (形) 高尚的；崇高的　(形) 興高采烈的；得意洋洋的
example_sentence: Many students study hard to achieve an exalted position in society.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力讀書，目的是在社會上達到崇高的地位。

definition_zh: (名) 考試；試卷　(動) 檢查；審視
example_sentence: Preparing for the entrance exam requires months of hard work and dedication.
sentence_zh: 為大學入學考試做準備需要數個月的努力和決心。

definition_zh: (名) 考試；檢驗　(名) 詳細檢查；審視
example_sentence: The final examination covers all chapters from the textbook we studied.
sentence_zh: 期末考試涵蓋我們所學教科書的所有章節。

definition_zh: (動) 檢查；檢驗　(動) 審視；研究
example_sentence: As the doctor examined the patient's injury, she explained the treatment plan carefully.
sentence_zh: 當醫生檢查病人的傷口時，她仔細說明了治療方案。

definition_zh: (名) 考生；應試者
example_sentence: Sitting nervously in the examination hall, examinees checked their admission tickets one last time.
sentence_zh: 坐在考場裡緊張地等待，考生們最後檢查了一次准考證。

definition_zh: (名) 考官；主考者　(名) 審查員；檢查官
example_sentence: The examiner who evaluated our performance was fair and gave detailed feedback.
sentence_zh: 評估我們表現的考官很公平，並給了詳細的回饋。

definition_zh: (名) 例子；示範　(動) 舉例；示範
example_sentence: If students study the example carefully, they will understand the grammar rule better.
sentence_zh: 如果學生仔細研究這個例子，他們會更好地理解文法規則。

definition_zh: (動) 激怒；惹惱　(動) 使...更加惡化
example_sentence: Constant interruptions during class exasperate even the most patient teachers.
sentence_zh: 課堂上不斷的打斷會激怒即使是最耐心的老師。

definition_zh: (形) 非常惱怒的；極其不耐煩的
example_sentence: The teacher spoke in an exasperated tone to make students understand the importance of homework.
sentence_zh: 老師用非常不耐煩的語氣說話，目的是讓學生理解功課的重要性。

definition_zh: (動) 超過；勝過　(動) 超出限制；過量
example_sentence: The number of online shoppers this year has exceeded last year's total by millions.
sentence_zh: 今年線上購物者的人數已經超過去年的總數數百萬人。

definition_zh: (副) 非常；極其　極度；過度
example_sentence: Although the math problems were exceedingly difficult, many students solved them through careful thinking.
sentence_zh: 雖然數學題目極其困難，但許多學生透過仔細思考解決了它們。

definition_zh: (動) 擅長；傑出　(動) 超越；勝過
example_sentence: Having excelled in mathematics competitions, the student earned a scholarship to study engineering.
sentence_zh: 在數學競賽中表現傑出後，這名學生獲得工程系獎學金。

definition_zh: (名) 卓越；優秀　(名) 傑出的品質
example_sentence: The teacher praised students whose work demonstrated excellence in both creativity and accuracy.
sentence_zh: 老師讚賞那些在創意和準確性上都表現出卓越的學生。

definition_zh: (形) 優秀的；傑出的　(形) 極好的；卓越的
example_sentence: The excellent performance by the school orchestra impressed every audience member in the auditorium.
sentence_zh: 學校管弦樂隊的優秀表演給禮堂裡的每一位觀眾留下了深刻印象。

definition_zh: (介) 除了…之外；除…以外
example_sentence: If everyone except for Maria had studied harder, the team would have won the competition.
sentence_zh: 如果除了瑪莉亞之外的每個人都更努力念書，那支隊伍就會贏得比賽。

definition_zh: (連) 除了...之外；只是
example_sentence: The plan sounds perfect, except that we need more funding to start.
sentence_zh: 這個計畫聽起來很完美，只是我們需要更多資金才能開始。

definition_zh: (動) 除外；排除　(介) 除了；除…外
example_sentence: Everyone attending the meeting except those on vacation must submit their reports by Friday.
sentence_zh: 除了在休假的人以外，參加會議的每個人都必須在星期五前提交報告。

definition_zh: (名) 例外；特殊情況　(名) 異議；反對
example_sentence: Although most students follow the school rules, John remains an exception whenever his parents give him permission.
sentence_zh: 雖然大多數學生遵守校規，但只要他父母給予許可，約翰就成為例外。

definition_zh: (形) 卓越的；非凡的　(形) 特殊的；罕見的
example_sentence: Seldom does a student show such exceptional talent in both music and mathematics.
sentence_zh: 很少有學生在音樂和數學上展現出如此卓越的才能。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈɛksɝpt] 摘錄；節錄　(動) [ɪkˈsɝpt] 摘取；引用
example_sentence: The excerpt that the teacher assigned reveals the author's main argument about climate change.
sentence_zh: 老師指派的那段節錄揭示了作者關於氣候變遷的主要論點。

definition_zh: (名) [ɪkˋsɛs] 過量；超額　(形) [ˋɛksɛs] 過多的；超出的　(動) 超過；超出
example_sentence: Eating excess sugar daily causes weight gain and health problems.
sentence_zh: 每天攝取過量的糖會導致體重增加和健康問題。

definition_zh: (形) 過度的；超過的　(形) 過量的；過分的
example_sentence: Excessive screen time and lack of exercise harm teenagers' physical and mental health.
sentence_zh: 過度的螢幕時間和缺乏運動傷害青少年的身心健康。

definition_zh: (動) 交換；互換　(名) 交換；兌換
example_sentence: Students can exchange textbooks with classmates during the study session.
sentence_zh: 學生可以在讀書時間與同學交換課本。

definition_zh: (動) 使興奮；使激動　(動) 引起；激發
example_sentence: As the concert began, the live music excited the audience so much that everyone stood up and cheered.
sentence_zh: 當演唱會開始時，現場音樂使觀眾如此興奮，以至於每個人都站起來歡呼。

definition_zh: (形) 興奮的；激動的　(動) 使興奮；激發
example_sentence: Excited about the upcoming school festival, students decorated the classroom with colorful posters.
sentence_zh: 對即將到來的校慶感到興奮，學生們用彩色海報裝飾教室。

definition_zh: (副) 興奮地；激動地
example_sentence: The students who finished the exam excitedly shared their answers with classmates.
sentence_zh: 完成考試的學生興奮地與同學分享他們的答案。

definition_zh: (名) 興奮；激動　(名) 令人興奮的事物
example_sentence: If the concert tickets sell out, the excitement among fans will reach its peak.
sentence_zh: 如果演唱會門票售完，粉絲之間的興奮程度將達到最高點。

definition_zh: (形) 令人興奮的；刺激的　(形) 令人激動的；吸引人的
example_sentence: Winning the basketball championship was an exciting moment for our school.
sentence_zh: 贏得籃球冠軍對我們學校來說是一個令人興奮的時刻。

definition_zh: (動) 驚呼；大聲說出　(名) 驚呼；感歎詞
example_sentence: The student exclaimed in surprise to share her joy with classmates.
sentence_zh: 那位學生驚呼出聲，想和同學們分享她的喜悅。

definition_zh: (動) 排除；不包括　(動) 把...拒之門外；不讓進入
example_sentence: The school's new policy excludes students with poor attendance from attending the graduation ceremony.
sentence_zh: 學校的新政策把出席率不佳的學生排除在畢業典禮之外。

definition_zh: (介) 不包括；除了...以外　(連) 除了...以外；要不是
example_sentence: Excluding weekends, the library opens eight hours every day.
sentence_zh: 除了週末以外，圖書館每天開放八小時。

definition_zh: (名) 排除；除外　(名) 被排斥的人或事物
example_sentence: Having been excluded from the team, the athlete faced social isolation and struggled with self-doubt.
sentence_zh: 被排除出隊伍後，這位運動員面臨社交孤立並與自我懷疑搏鬥。

definition_zh: (形) 獨家的；專有的　(形) 高級的；限制性的
example_sentence: The luxury hotel offers exclusive benefits that only members can enjoy.
sentence_zh: 這家豪華飯店提供只有會員才能享受的專有優惠。

definition_zh: (副) 專門地；獨有地　僅僅；只有
example_sentence: This luxury brand sells exclusively through high-end department stores nationwide.
sentence_zh: 這個奢侈品牌專門透過全國高級百貨公司販售。

definition_zh: (形) 極度痛苦的；令人難以忍受的
example_sentence: If the dentist used no anesthesia, the tooth extraction would be excruciating for the patient.
sentence_zh: 如果牙醫不使用麻醉藥，拔牙對患者來說會是極度痛苦的。

definition_zh: (副) 極其痛苦地；令人難以忍受地
example_sentence: The dental procedure was excruciatingly painful, making every second feel like an eternity.
sentence_zh: 這個牙科手術極其疼痛，每一秒都感覺像永恆一樣。

definition_zh: (名) 短途旅行；郊遊　(名) 偏離；背離
example_sentence: Taking a guided excursion to Jiufen Old Street, the students discovered many traditional snacks and crafts.
sentence_zh: 參加九份老街的導遊短途旅行，學生們發現了許多傳統小食和手工藝品。

definition_zh: (動) 原諒；寬恕　(動) 藉口；理由
example_sentence: Because Sarah was late for class, the teacher excused her absence without any questions.
sentence_zh: 因為莎拉上課遲到，老師沒有任何疑問就原諒了她的缺席。

definition_zh: (動) 執行；實施　(動) 處死；被處死
example_sentence: Only after the director approved the plan did the team execute the marketing strategy flawlessly.
sentence_zh: 只有在主任批准計畫之後，團隊才完美地執行了行銷策略。

definition_zh: (名) 執行；實行　(動) 執行；進行　(動) 處死；槍斃
example_sentence: The project execution, which required careful planning and teamwork, succeeded beyond everyone's expectations.
sentence_zh: 該項目的執行過程需要仔細規劃和團隊合作，最終超出了所有人的預期。

definition_zh: (名) 行政主管；執行官　(形) 行政的；執行的
example_sentence: The company hired a new executive to manage daily operations and achieve growth targets.
sentence_zh: 該公司聘僱一位新的行政主管來管理日常營運並達成成長目標。

definition_zh: (動) 舉例說明；典範
example_sentence: The story of Steve Jobs exemplifies how determination and creativity can transform the world.
sentence_zh: 史蒂夫‧賈伯斯的故事舉例說明決心和創意如何能改變世界。

definition_zh: (動) 豁免；免除　(形) 被豁免的；不受約束的
example_sentence: Students with excellent grades are exempt from taking the final exam.
sentence_zh: 成績優異的學生可以免除參加期末考試。

definition_zh: (名) 免除；豁免　(名) 被豁免的人或物
example_sentence: Because students received an exemption from the exam, they celebrated with their classmates.
sentence_zh: 因為學生獲得考試豁免，他們和同學一起慶祝。

definition_zh: (名) 運動；練習　(動) 運動；鍛鍊
example_sentence: Exercising regularly, students improve their physical fitness and mental health.
sentence_zh: 規律地運動，學生改善了他們的體能和心理健康。

definition_zh: (動) 施展；發揮　(動) 用力；費力
example_sentence: The student who exerts constant effort in studying will achieve excellent results.
sentence_zh: 那位在課業上持續用力的學生將獲得優異成績。

definition_zh: (名) 努力；費力　(名) 用力；發力
example_sentence: If intense physical exertion during sports practice causes dizziness, students should rest immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果運動訓練期間的激烈用力導致頭暈，學生應該立即休息。

definition_zh: (動) 呼氣；吐氣
example_sentence: After finishing the long run, athletes exhale deeply and slowly.
sentence_zh: 完成長跑後，運動員深深地慢慢呼氣。

definition_zh: (動) 用盡；耗盡　(動) 排放；排出　(名) 廢氣；排氣
example_sentence: The factory installed new filters to exhaust harmful gases safely into the atmosphere.
sentence_zh: 該工廠安裝了新的過濾器，以便將有害氣體安全地排放到大氣中。

definition_zh: (形) 筋疲力盡的；疲憊的　(動) 用盡；耗盡
example_sentence: After the exhausting basketball game, all the players felt completely exhausted and needed rest.
sentence_zh: 在令人疲憊的籃球賽之後，所有球員都感到筋疲力盡，需要休息。

definition_zh: (形) 令人疲憊的；令人筋疲力盡的
example_sentence: Because the final exam is exhausting, many students need to rest well afterward.
sentence_zh: 因為期末考很令人疲憊，許多學生之後需要好好休息。

definition_zh: (名) 精疲力盡；耗盡　(名) 廢氣；排氣
example_sentence: Having completed the marathon, runners suffered from complete exhaustion and needed rest.
sentence_zh: 完成馬拉松後，跑者們因完全精疲力盡而需要休息。

definition_zh: (形) 詳盡的；徹底的　(形) 令人疲憊的；消耗人的
example_sentence: The exhaustive research that the team conducted revealed every detail of the problem.
sentence_zh: 團隊進行的詳盡研究揭示了問題的每一個細節。

definition_zh: (副) 徹底地；詳盡地　彻分地；完全地
example_sentence: The research team examined all available data exhaustively before reaching their final conclusion.
sentence_zh: 研究小組在得出最終結論前，徹底檢查了所有可得的數據。

definition_zh: (動) 展出；展覽　陳列；表現　(名) 展品；展覽物
example_sentence: If the museum exhibited more modern artworks, young visitors would find the gallery more interesting.
sentence_zh: 如果博物館展出更多現代藝術作品，年輕遊客會發現畫廊更有趣。

definition_zh: (名) 展覽；展示　(名) 展出品
example_sentence: The art exhibition at the museum attracted thousands of visitors last week.
sentence_zh: 博物館的藝術展覽上週吸引了數千名遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 參展者；展覽者　(名) 參展公司；參展機構
example_sentence: Displaying innovative products at the trade show, exhibitors attract buyers from around the world.
sentence_zh: 在貿易展上展示創新產品的參展者吸引了來自世界各地的買家。

definition_zh: (動) 使興奮；使高興　(形) 興高采烈的；欣喜若狂的
example_sentence: As the roller coaster descended rapidly, passengers felt exhilarated, screaming with pure joy.
sentence_zh: 當雲霄飛車迅速下降時，乘客們感到興高采烈，尖叫著發出純粹的快樂。

definition_zh: (形) 令人興奮的；使人愉快的　(動) 使興奮；使高興
example_sentence: So exhilarating was the mountain climb that the students forgot their fatigue completely.
sentence_zh: 登山之旅是如此令人興奮，以至於學生們完全忘記了疲勞。

definition_zh: (名) 流放；放逐　(動) 放逐；驅逐　(形) 被流放的；被驅逐的
example_sentence: The political leader who was exiled from his country spent years in a foreign land.
sentence_zh: 那位被放逐出國的政治領袖在異國度過了多年。

definition_zh: (動) 存在；生存　(動) 存活；維持生命
example_sentence: Many ancient species no longer exist to survive in today's changing climate.
sentence_zh: 許多古代物種不再存在以適應今日變化的氣候。

definition_zh: (名) 存在；存在的事物　(名) 生存；生活
example_sentence: The existence of life on other planets remains a mystery scientists continue exploring.
sentence_zh: 其他星球上生命的存在仍然是科學家持續探索的謎團。

definition_zh: (形) 現存的；存在的　(動) 存在；生存
example_sentence: Protecting existing forests is important for environmental conservation.
sentence_zh: 保護現存的森林對環境保護很重要。

definition_zh: (名) 出口；出去　(動) 離開；退出
example_sentence: As soon as students exit the classroom, they rush to the cafeteria for lunch.
sentence_zh: 學生一離開教室，就衝到食堂吃午餐。

definition_zh: (名) 圍繞行星運轉的衛星；系外衛星
example_sentence: Orbiting a distant exoplanet, the newly discovered exomoon may hold clues to extraterrestrial life.
sentence_zh: 圍繞遠方系外行星運轉的新發現系外衛星，可能蘊含著地外生命的線索。

definition_zh: (形) 過高的；不合理的　(形) 貪心的；掠奪性的
example_sentence: The hotel's exorbitant prices, which shocked many tourists, made budget travel impossible.
sentence_zh: 這家飯店那些令許多遊客震驚的過高價格，使經濟型旅遊變得不可能。

definition_zh: (形) 異國的；來自外國的　奇特的；不尋常的
example_sentence: If tropical fruits were not so exotic, fewer students would develop interest in international cuisine.
sentence_zh: 如果熱帶水果不是那麼具異國風情，較少學生會對國際美食產生興趣。

definition_zh: (動) 擴大；擴展　(動) 膨脹；展開
example_sentence: The company plans to expand its business into three new markets next year.
sentence_zh: 這家公司計畫明年將業務擴展到三個新市場。

definition_zh: (名) 廣大的區域；遼闊地帶　(動) 擴大；延伸
example_sentence: Astronomers study distant stars to explore the vast expanse of the universe.
sentence_zh: 天文學家研究遠處的星星以探索宇宙的遼闊區域。

definition_zh: (名) 擴展；擴大　(名) 膨脹；延伸
example_sentence: The company's expansion into Asian markets required significant investment and careful planning.
sentence_zh: 該公司向亞洲市場的擴展需要大量投資和仔細規劃。

definition_zh: (名) 外僑；駐外人士
example_sentence: Although Sarah moved to Taiwan as an expat, she has quickly adapted to local life and culture.
sentence_zh: 雖然莎拉以外僑身份移居台灣，但她已迅速適應當地生活和文化。

definition_zh: (名) 僑居人士；移居國外的人　(動) 放逐；驅逐出國　(形) 僑居的；在國外的
example_sentence: Having expatriated to Singapore for work, the engineer now manages a regional office there.
sentence_zh: 那位工程師已移居新加坡工作，現在在當地管理一個地區辦公室。

definition_zh: (名) 放棄國籍；移居國外
example_sentence: The politician's expatriation, which shocked many voters, marked the end of his domestic career.
sentence_zh: 那位政治人物的放棄國籍決定，令許多選民震驚，標誌著他國內生涯的結束。

definition_zh: (動) 期待；期望　(動) 預期；預料
example_sentence: Students expect good results after studying hard for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 學生在為學測努力讀書後期待取得好成績。

definition_zh: (名) 期望；預期　(名) 期待；盼望
example_sentence: If students lowered their expectations about exam results, they would feel less stressed during preparation.
sentence_zh: 如果學生降低對考試成績的期望，他們在準備期間會感到較少的壓力。

definition_zh: (形) 預期的；預想的　(動) 期望；預料
example_sentence: The expected arrival time of the train is 3 p.m. today.
sentence_zh: 火車的預期到達時間是今天下午3點。

definition_zh: (名) 祛痰藥；排痰劑　(形) 祛痰的；幫助排痰的
example_sentence: Taking an expectorant, the patient coughed up mucus more easily during recovery.
sentence_zh: 服用祛痰藥後，患者在復原期間更容易咳出痰液。

definition_zh: (動) 加快；促進　(動) 迅速處理；加速
example_sentence: Because the manager expedited the approval process, the project started two weeks earlier than planned.
sentence_zh: 因為經理加快了批准流程，該專案比計劃提前兩週開始。

definition_zh: (名) 探險隊；遠征　(名) 探險之旅；考察活動
example_sentence: Only after months of careful planning did the Arctic expedition finally set out.
sentence_zh: 直到經過數月的仔細籌劃後，北極探險隊才終於出發。

definition_zh: (形) 迅速的；快速的　(形) 高效率的；敏捷的
example_sentence: The expeditious manner in which the emergency team responded saved many lives.
sentence_zh: 急救隊以迅速的方式做出反應，拯救了許多生命。

definition_zh: (動) 開除；驅逐　(動) 趕出；排出
example_sentence: The school decided to expel the student to maintain campus safety.
sentence_zh: 學校決定開除該學生以維持校園安全。

definition_zh: (動) 花費；支出　(動) 消耗；耗盡
example_sentence: The government expended significant budget and resources on improving rural infrastructure.
sentence_zh: 政府在改善鄉村基礎設施上花費了大量預算和資源。

definition_zh: (形) 可消耗的；可丟棄的　(形) 不重要的；可犧牲的
example_sentence: Plastic bags are considered expendable materials in most supermarkets today.
sentence_zh: 在今天大多數超市裡，塑膠袋被認為是可丟棄的材料。

definition_zh: (名) 支出；開支　(名) 花費；經費
example_sentence: Although government expenditure on education increased significantly, many schools still lack modern teaching equipment.
sentence_zh: 雖然政府在教育上的支出大幅增加，但許多學校仍然缺乏現代教學設備。

definition_zh: (名) 費用；開支　(動) 花費；使耗費
example_sentence: Having reduced unnecessary expenses, the company improved its profit margin significantly.
sentence_zh: 減少了不必要的開支後，該公司的利潤率明顯提高。

definition_zh: (形) 昂貴的；費錢的　(形) 高價的
example_sentence: The smartphone that costs over fifty thousand dollars is expensive for most students.
sentence_zh: 那支要價五萬多元的智慧型手機對大多數學生來說很昂貴。

definition_zh: (名) 經驗；體驗　(動) 經歷；體驗
example_sentence: If you experience failure in studying, you will learn valuable lessons.
sentence_zh: 如果你在學習中經歷失敗，你將學到寶貴的教訓。

definition_zh: (形) 有經驗的；熟練的　(動) 經歷；體驗
example_sentence: An experienced teacher knows how to help struggling students improve their grades.
sentence_zh: 一位有經驗的老師知道如何幫助學習困難的學生提高成績。

definition_zh: (名) 實驗；試驗　(動) 做實驗；進行試驗
example_sentence: Scientists conduct experiments to understand how plants grow in space.
sentence_zh: 科學家進行實驗以了解植物如何在太空中生長。

definition_zh: (形) 實驗的；試驗性的　(形) 基於實驗的；經驗性的
example_sentence: The chemistry teacher introduced an experimental method for testing the purity of water samples.
sentence_zh: 化學老師介紹了一種用於檢驗水樣純度的實驗性方法。

definition_zh: (名) 專家；行家　(形) 熟練的；專業的
example_sentence: Because the engineer is an expert in bridge design, the company trusts his judgment completely.
sentence_zh: 因為那位工程師是橋樑設計的專家，公司完全信任他的判斷。

definition_zh: (名) 專業知識；專門技能　(名) 專家的意見；專業判斷
example_sentence: Having developed expertise in software engineering over ten years, the team leader mentored junior programmers effectively.
sentence_zh: 在軟體工程領域累積了十年專業知識後，這位團隊領導者有效地指導了資深程式設計師。

definition_zh: (名) 過期；終止　(名) 呼氣；最後期限
example_sentence: Food products that have passed their expiration date should not be consumed.
sentence_zh: 已經過了過期日期的食品不應該被食用。

definition_zh: (動) 期滿；終止　失效；到期　(動) 呼氣；斷氣
example_sentence: The student's library card will expire next month, so renewal is necessary.
sentence_zh: 這名學生的圖書證將在下個月失效，所以需要更新。

definition_zh: (名) 到期日；有效期限　(形) 已過期的；即將到期的
example_sentence: If the medicine's expiry date passed, patients would not take it safely.
sentence_zh: 如果藥物的有效期限已過，患者就不會安全地服用它。

definition_zh: (動) 說明；解釋　(動) 闡述；說清楚
example_sentence: The science teacher explained how plants grow from seeds.
sentence_zh: 這位科學老師說明了植物如何從種子長大。

definition_zh: (名) 說明；解釋　(名) 理由；原因
example_sentence: The teacher's explanation clarifying the difficult concept helped students understand better.
sentence_zh: 老師澄清困難概念的說明幫助學生更好地理解。

definition_zh: (形) 可解釋的；可說明的
example_sentence: Although the strange noise seemed scary, the scientist explained that it was explicable by the wind blowing through the old building.
sentence_zh: 雖然奇怪的聲音聽起來令人害怕，但科學家解釋說，這是可以用風吹過老建築來解釋的。

definition_zh: (形) 明確的；清楚的　(形) 露骨的；直率的
example_sentence: Explicit in the contract are the responsibilities and obligations of both parties.
sentence_zh: 合約中明確規定的是雙方的責任和義務。

definition_zh: (副) 明確地；清楚地　(副) 直言地；坦率地
example_sentence: The teacher explained the exam rules explicitly, which helped students understand the requirements.
sentence_zh: 老師明確地解釋了考試規則，這幫助學生理解了要求。

definition_zh: (動) 爆炸；爆發　(名) 爆炸
example_sentence: The science teacher used dry ice to explode the balloon and demonstrate chemical reactions.
sentence_zh: 這位科學老師用乾冰讓氣球爆炸，以便展示化學反應。

definition_zh: (動) [ɪkˈsplɔɪt] 剝削；利用　(名) [ˈɛksplɔɪt] 功績；壯舉
example_sentence: Large companies often exploit workers in developing countries for cheap labor and maximum profits.
sentence_zh: 大公司經常剝削開發中國家的工人，以獲得廉價勞動力和最大利潤。

definition_zh: (名) 剝削；不公平的利用　(名) 開採；資源的利用
example_sentence: Child labor exploitation remains a serious problem in many developing countries.
sentence_zh: 童工剝削在許多開發中國家仍然是嚴重問題。

definition_zh: (名) 探險；探索　(名) 調查；研究
example_sentence: As exploration of outer space continues, scientists discover new planets and gather valuable data.
sentence_zh: 當外太空的探險持續進行時，科學家發現新行星並蒐集寶貴的數據。

definition_zh: (動) 探索；探險　(動) 調查；檢查
example_sentence: Exploring the night market, the students discovered many delicious local snacks.
sentence_zh: 探索夜市時，學生們發現了許多美味的在地小吃。

definition_zh: (名) 探險家；探索者　(名) 調查員；研究人員
example_sentence: The explorer who discovered the ancient temple became famous throughout the world.
sentence_zh: 發現古廟的探險家在世界各地變得聞名。

definition_zh: (名) 爆炸；爆發　(名) 突然的增加；激增
example_sentence: If a gas leak occurs in the building, an explosion would cause serious damage to nearby residents.
sentence_zh: 如果建築物發生瓦斯洩漏，爆炸將對附近居民造成嚴重傷害。

definition_zh: (形) 爆炸性的；易爆炸的　(名) 炸藥；爆炸物
example_sentence: The factory stores explosive materials in a secure underground vault.
sentence_zh: 這家工廠將爆炸物儲存在安全的地下金庫裡。

definition_zh: (形) 指數的；快速增長的　(名) 指數函數；指數值
example_sentence: Scientists studied the virus's exponential growth to predict future infection rates.
sentence_zh: 科學家研究病毒的指數增長以預測未來感染率。

definition_zh: (副) 以指數方式地；快速增長地
example_sentence: The number of smartphone users has grown exponentially over the past decade.
sentence_zh: 過去十年，智慧型手機使用者的數量呈指數方式快速增長。

definition_zh: (動) [ɪkˈspɔrt] 出口；輸出　(名) [ˈɛkspɔrt] 出口商品；出口貿易
example_sentence: As the company exports more products to international markets, its revenue continues to grow significantly.
sentence_zh: 當該公司向國際市場出口更多產品時，其收入持續顯著成長。

definition_zh: (動) 揭露；曝光　(動) 使暴露；使接觸
example_sentence: Exposed to harsh sunlight for years, the old painting gradually faded and lost its original colors.
sentence_zh: 那幅古畫多年來暴露在烈日下，逐漸褪色並失去了原有的色彩。

definition_zh: (形) 暴露的；無遮蔽的　(動) 揭露；暴露
example_sentence: The scandal exposed by the newspaper left many officials in trouble.
sentence_zh: 報紙揭露的醜聞讓許多官員陷入困境。

definition_zh: (名) 展覽；博覽會　(名) 詳細說明；解釋
example_sentence: The art exposition in Taipei showcased works from emerging contemporary artists across East Asia.
sentence_zh: 台北的藝術展覽展出了來自東亞新興當代藝術家的作品。

definition_zh: (形) 說明的；闡述的　(形) 解釋性的；敍述的
example_sentence: If the textbook were more expository, students would understand the difficult concepts more easily.
sentence_zh: 如果教科書更具說明性，學生就會更容易理解難懂的概念。

definition_zh: (名) 暴露；揭露　(名) 接觸；接受（陽光、寒冷等）
example_sentence: Long exposure to the sun can damage your skin.
sentence_zh: 長時間暴露在陽光下會傷害皮膚。

definition_zh: (動) 表達；表現　(形) 快速的；特快的
example_sentence: Expressing her feelings clearly, Sarah won the debate competition easily.
sentence_zh: 清楚地表達自己的想法，莎拉輕鬆贏得了辯論比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 表情；表現　(名) 表達；措辭
example_sentence: As the student's facial expression changed, the teacher realized the math problem was too difficult.
sentence_zh: 當那位學生的臉部表情改變時，老師意識到這道數學題太難了。

definition_zh: (形) 富有表現力的；能表達感情的　(形) 生動的；有意義的
example_sentence: Not only did the actor's expressive face convey emotion, but his voice also moved the audience deeply.
sentence_zh: 不僅那位演員富有表現力的臉部傳達了情感，他的聲音也深深打動了觀眾。

definition_zh: (副) 富於表情地；表達力強地　(副) 生動地；充分地
example_sentence: The actor spoke expressively, using gestures that made the audience feel every emotion.
sentence_zh: 那位演員表達力豐富地說話，用手勢讓觀眾感受到每一種情感。

definition_zh: (副) 明確地；清楚地　(副) 特意地；專門地
example_sentence: The principal made this rule expressly to prevent students from using phones during class.
sentence_zh: 校長明確地制定這條規則是為了防止學生在課堂上使用手機。

definition_zh: (名) 開除；驅逐　(名) 逐出；趕出
example_sentence: The student's expulsion from school resulted from serious misconduct and repeated rule violations.
sentence_zh: 這名學生因為嚴重的不當行為和多次違反校規而被學校開除。

definition_zh: (形) 精緻的；優美的　(形) 極度的；劇烈的
example_sentence: The exquisite design of the traditional Chinese vase impressed all museum visitors.
sentence_zh: 那個傳統中國花瓶的精緻設計令所有博物館訪客印象深刻。

definition_zh: (名) 提取器；萃取裝置　(名) 提取者；提煉者
example_sentence: After the dentist used an extractor to remove the tooth, the patient felt immediate relief from pain.
sentence_zh: 牙醫師用提取器移除牙齒後，患者的疼痛立即減輕。

definition_zh: (動) 延伸；擴大　延長；伸出
example_sentence: Extending the deadline by two weeks, the teacher gave students more time to complete the project.
sentence_zh: 延長截止日期兩週，老師給學生更多時間完成專案。

definition_zh: (形) 可延伸的；可擴展的
example_sentence: The table, which is extendable, fits small apartments and large dining rooms.
sentence_zh: 這張餐桌可延伸，適合小公寓和大餐廳使用。

definition_zh: (形) 延長的；擴大的　(動) 延伸；伸出
example_sentence: If the project deadline were extended by two weeks, the team would complete all tasks successfully.
sentence_zh: 如果專案截止日期延長兩週，團隊就會成功完成所有任務。

definition_zh: (名) 延伸；延長　(名) 延期；展期
example_sentence: The teacher granted the student a one-week extension on the homework deadline.
sentence_zh: 老師給了這名學生一星期的作業延期。

definition_zh: (形) 廣泛的；大規模的　(形) 詳細的；內容豐富的
example_sentence: The company conducted extensive research to better understand customer needs.
sentence_zh: 該公司進行了廣泛的研究以更好地瞭解顧客需求。

definition_zh: (副) 廣泛地；大規模地　詳盡地；充分地
example_sentence: The research team studied climate change extensively, collecting data from five continents.
sentence_zh: 研究團隊廣泛研究氣候變化，從五個大陸收集數據。

definition_zh: (名) 程度；範圍　(名) 長度；面積
example_sentence: To the extent that students study consistently, their test scores improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 學生們在持續用功的程度上，他們的考試成績會明顯進步。

definition_zh: (形) 外部的；外面的　(名) 外部；外觀
example_sentence: Damaged by the storm, the building's exterior required immediate repairs and renovation.
sentence_zh: 遭風暴破壞的建築物外牆需要立即修繕和翻新。

definition_zh: (動) 滅絕；消滅　(動) 根除；杜絕
example_sentence: The pesticide that farmers spray kills insects which exterminate crops in the fields.
sentence_zh: 農民噴灑的殺蟲劑殺死了那些摧毀田地作物的昆蟲。

definition_zh: (形) 外部的；外面的　(形) 外在的；表面的
example_sentence: The external appearance of the building looks modern, but its internal structure needs repair.
sentence_zh: 這棟建築的外部外觀看起來現代，但它的內部結構需要修繕。

definition_zh: (名) 外部事物；外在因素　(名) 外表；外觀
example_sentence: If students focused only on externals like uniforms and grades, their true character would never develop properly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生只關注制服和成績這些外在因素，他們真正的品格就永遠無法發展。

definition_zh: (形) 滅絕的；絕種的　(形) 熄滅的；消失的
example_sentence: The dodo bird became extinct hundreds of years ago due to hunting.
sentence_zh: 渡渡鳥因狩獵而在幾百年前滅絕。

definition_zh: (名) 滅絕；消失　(名) 熄滅；消亡
example_sentence: Facing habitat loss, many species risk extinction, prompting scientists to develop conservation strategies.
sentence_zh: 面臨棲息地喪失，許多物種面臨滅絕的危險，促使科學家們開發保育策略。

definition_zh: (動) 熄滅；撲滅　(動) 消除；結束
example_sentence: Before the firefighters extinguished the forest fire, many trees had already burned down.
sentence_zh: 在消防隊員撲滅森林大火之前，許多樹木已經燒毀了。

definition_zh: (動) 讚揚；稱讚　(動) 歌頌；高度讚美
example_sentence: Never has a student's dedication to environmental protection been extolled more passionately.
sentence_zh: 學生對環境保護的奉獻精神從未被如此熱情地讚揚過。

definition_zh: (形) 額外的；多餘的　(副) 特別地；非常
example_sentence: Students who need extra help can attend the tutoring sessions offered after school.
sentence_zh: 需要額外幫助的學生可以參加放學後提供的輔導課程。

definition_zh: (動) [ɪkˈstrækt] 提取；萃取　(名) [ˈɛkstrækt] 精華；萃取物
example_sentence: Scientists extract DNA from plant cells to study genetic information.
sentence_zh: 科學家從植物細胞中提取DNA以研究遺傳信息。

definition_zh: (名) 萃取；提取　(名) 摘錄；選段
example_sentence: The extraction of natural resources from the ocean requires advanced technology and careful environmental protection.
sentence_zh: 從海洋中萃取天然資源需要先進的科技和謹慎的環境保護。

definition_zh: (形) 開採的；提取的　(名) 提取物；萃取液
example_sentence: Mining companies use extractive methods to obtain valuable minerals from the earth.
sentence_zh: 採礦公司使用開採方法從地球上獲得有價值的礦物。

definition_zh: (名) 提取器；抽取裝置　(名) 提取人；提煉者
example_sentence: As the juice extractor filters the pulp, fresh orange juice flows into the container.
sentence_zh: 當榨汁機過濾果肉時，新鮮柳橙汁流入容器中。

definition_zh: (形) 課外的；課程外的　(名) 課外活動
example_sentence: Participating in extracurricular activities, many students develop leadership skills and lasting friendships.
sentence_zh: 參加課外活動，許多學生培養領導能力和長久的友誼。

definition_zh: (動) 引渡；遣返　(動) 將犯人送回原地受審
example_sentence: The fugitive who fled to another country was extradited to face trial.
sentence_zh: 逃到他國的逃犯被引渡回國接受審判。

definition_zh: (形) 無關的；不相干的　(形) 外來的；多餘的
example_sentence: If extraneous information were removed from the essay, the argument would become much clearer.
sentence_zh: 如果把無關的資訊從這篇文章中去除，論點就會變得更清楚。

definition_zh: (副) 非常地；極其　格外地；異常地
example_sentence: The CSAT math questions this year were extraordinarily difficult and challenging.
sentence_zh: 今年學測數學題目非常困難且有挑戰性。

definition_zh: (形) 非凡的；特別的　(形) 異常的；極其的
example_sentence: Studying extraordinary science discoveries helps students prepare for advanced exams.
sentence_zh: 研究非凡的科學發現有助於學生準備進階考試。

definition_zh: (名) 推斷；延伸推論　(名) 外推法；推算法
example_sentence: The company's extrapolation of market trends based on past sales data proved accurate for next quarter.
sentence_zh: 這家公司根據過去銷售數據對市場趨勢的推論對下季度證明是準確的。

definition_zh: (形) 奢侈的；浪費的　(形) 過度的；誇張的
example_sentence: Although the shopping mall offers extravagant discounts during holiday sales, many students still spend money wisely.
sentence_zh: 雖然購物中心在假日銷售期間提供奢侈的折扣，但許多學生仍然謹慎消費。

definition_zh: (形) 極端的；非常的　(名) 極端；極限
example_sentence: Having experienced extreme weather conditions, the farmers decided to change their planting strategy.
sentence_zh: 經歷過極端天氣後，農民決定改變他們的種植策略。

definition_zh: (副) 極其；非常　(副) 極端地；最高程度地
example_sentence: The exam questions that students found extremely difficult required months of preparation.
sentence_zh: 學生們認為極其困難的那些考試題目需要數月的準備。

definition_zh: (名) 極端主義者；激進份子
example_sentence: Political extremists on both sides rejected the compromise agreement proposed by moderates.
sentence_zh: 兩派政治極端主義者都拒絕了溫和派提出的妥協協議。

definition_zh: (形) 可解救的；可擺脫的　(形) 可逃脫的；可排除的
example_sentence: If the situation were extricable, the trapped miners would have escaped hours ago.
sentence_zh: 如果那個局面是可以擺脫的，被困的礦工早就逃脫了。

definition_zh: (動) 使擺脫；解救　使脫離；救出
example_sentence: The rescue team worked hard to extricate the trapped miners from the collapsed tunnel.
sentence_zh: 救援隊努力從倒塌的隧道中救出被困的礦工。

definition_zh: (名) 解救；救出　(名) 逃脫；脫離
example_sentence: Extricating himself from the complicated situation, the businessman finally regained his peace of mind.
sentence_zh: 那位商人從複雜的局面中脫身，終於恢復了內心的平靜。

definition_zh: (名) 外向的人；善於社交的人　(形) 外向的；愛社交的
example_sentence: Although Marcus is naturally shy at first, he gradually becomes an extrovert when he joins the school debate club.
sentence_zh: 雖然馬可斯最初天生害羞，但當他加入學校辯論社後，他逐漸變成外向的人。

definition_zh: (形) 外向的；好交際的　(形) 性格開朗的；善於社交的
example_sentence: Not only does an extroverted student enjoy public speaking, but also thrive in group projects.
sentence_zh: 外向的學生不僅喜歡公開演講，而且在團隊項目中也表現突出。

definition_zh: (動) 擠出；擠壓　推出；製造
example_sentence: The plastic material extruded from the machine, which hardened into a long pipe, was cut into smaller sections.
sentence_zh: 從機器擠出的塑膠材料（已硬化成長管子）被切成更小的段落。

definition_zh: (名) 擠出機；擠出機械
example_sentence: Factories use an extruder to shape plastic into long thin tubes.
sentence_zh: 工廠使用擠出機將塑膠塑形成長細管。

definition_zh: (形) 興高采烈的；充滿熱情的　(形) 茂盛的；繁茂的
example_sentence: Winning the debate competition filled the team with exuberant joy and endless celebration.
sentence_zh: 贏得辯論比賽讓隊伍充滿了興高采烈的喜悅和無盡的慶祝。

definition_zh: (動) 散發；流露　(動) 自然表現；顯露
example_sentence: The confident actor exuded charm and charisma on stage.
sentence_zh: 那位自信的演員在舞台上散發出魅力和個人風采。

definition_zh: (形) 欣喜若狂的；洋洋得意的
example_sentence: Exultant because the team won the championship, the coach couldn't stop smiling.
sentence_zh: 由於球隊贏得冠軍而欣喜若狂，教練無法停止微笑。

definition_zh: (動) 看中；想要得到　(動) 打量；評估
example_sentence: Eying up the scholarship opportunity, the student began preparing for the exam seriously.
sentence_zh: 看中那個獎學金機會，這個學生開始認真準備考試。

definition_zh: (名) 令人大開眼界的事物；驚人的發現
example_sentence: The documentary about ocean conservation was an eye-opener that changed how students viewed environmental protection.
sentence_zh: 這部關於海洋保護的紀錄片是一個令人大開眼界的發現，改變了學生對環境保護的看法。

definition_zh: (名) 眼睛；眼　(動) 注視；觀察
example_sentence: If you keep your eyes on the road, accidents can be prevented.
sentence_zh: 如果你保持眼睛注視路面，就能預防車禍。

definition_zh: (名) 眉毛；眉
example_sentence: Dark eyebrows can make your face look more expressive and attractive.
sentence_zh: 深色的眉毛能讓你的臉看起來更有表情和吸引力。

definition_zh: (名) 睫毛；眼睫毛
example_sentence: Many people use mascara to darken their eyelashes to make eyes look more attractive.
sentence_zh: 許多人使用睫毛膏來加深睫毛，以使眼睛看起來更有吸引力。

definition_zh: (名) 眼皮；眼瞼
example_sentence: When Alison felt very tired, her eyelids became heavy and began to close slowly.
sentence_zh: 當艾莉森感到非常疲倦時，她的眼皮變得沉重，開始慢慢閉合。

definition_zh: (名) 視力；看見的能力　(名) 景象；看法
example_sentence: Although Maria's eyesight has weakened as she ages, she still reads classical literature without glasses.
sentence_zh: 儘管瑪麗亞的視力隨著年齡增長而減弱，她仍然能不戴眼鏡閱讀古典文學。

definition_zh: (名) 寓言；寓言故事　(名) 謊言；虛構的故事
example_sentence: Having read the famous Aesop's fable about the tortoise and hare, students understood the value of persistence.
sentence_zh: 學生讀過了那部著名的伊索寓言《烏龜和兔子》後，理解了堅持的價值。

definition_zh: (名) 布料；織物　(名) 結構；構成
example_sentence: The silk fabric that my mother bought for the dress festival looks elegant and smooth.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽為舞蹈節目買的那件絲綢布料看起來優雅柔順。

definition_zh: (動) 製造；編造　(動) 捏造；虛構
example_sentence: The company fabricated evidence and false reports to hide the safety problems.
sentence_zh: 該公司編造證據和虛假報告以隱藏安全問題。

definition_zh: (形) 製造的；偽造的　(動) 製造；編造
example_sentence: If the evidence were not fabricated, the defendant would have lost the case immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果證據不是偽造的，被告會立即敗訴。

definition_zh: (形) 極好的；了不起的　(形) 難以置信的；傳說中的
example_sentence: The fabulous concert last night impressed every student in the audience.
sentence_zh: 昨晚那場極好的演唱會給觀眾中的每位學生留下了深刻印象。

definition_zh: (動) 對峙；面對面對抗　(動) 直接面對；勇敢面對
example_sentence: Facing off against their rivals on the basketball court, both teams displayed remarkable skill and determination.
sentence_zh: 在籃球場上面對面對抗對手時，兩隊都展現了卓越的技巧和決心。

definition_zh: (動) 勇敢面對；正視　(片) 面對；對付
example_sentence: Although feeling nervous, students must face up to the challenges of the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 雖然感到緊張，學生必須勇敢面對學測考試的挑戰。

definition_zh: (名) 臉；面孔　(動) 面對；勇敢承受
example_sentence: Not only did the student face the exam with confidence, but also helped classmates prepare.
sentence_zh: 這位學生不僅自信地面對考試，還幫助同學準備。

definition_zh: (名) 面向；側面　(名) (寶石的)面；切面
example_sentence: The economic facet, which affects student part-time job opportunities, remains a major concern.
sentence_zh: 經濟面向（影響學生打工機會）仍然是主要關切。

definition_zh: (形) 臉部的；面部的　(名) 臉部護理；美容療程
example_sentence: Many teenagers use facial masks to improve their skin condition.
sentence_zh: 許多青少年使用面膜來改善皮膚狀況。

definition_zh: (動) 促進；便利　(動) 協助進行；提供便利條件
example_sentence: Good study habits and a quiet environment facilitate effective learning and exam preparation.
sentence_zh: 良好的讀書習慣和安靜的環境能促進有效的學習和考試準備。

definition_zh: (名) 促進；便利　協助；輔助
example_sentence: The teacher's facilitation of group discussions helped students learn better.
sentence_zh: 老師促進小組討論的方式幫助學生學得更好。

definition_zh: (名) 設施；便利　(動) 促進；便利
example_sentence: Because the school provides excellent sports facilities, many students participate in after-school athletic programs.
sentence_zh: 因為學校提供優良的運動設施，許多學生參加課後運動計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 設施；便利　(名) 才能；技能
example_sentence: Having excellent sports facilities available, the school attracts many talented athletes competing nationally.
sentence_zh: 由於擁有優秀的運動設施，這所學校吸引了許多在全國比賽的天才運動員。

definition_zh: (名) 傳真；複製品　(動) 傳真；複製
example_sentence: The museum displayed a facsimile that was identical to the original manuscript which scholars had studied for centuries.
sentence_zh: 博物館展出了一份傳真複製品，它與學者們研究了數個世紀的原始手稿完全相同。

definition_zh: (名) 事實；真相　(名) 實際
example_sentence: If students study the facts carefully, they will understand the history lesson better.
sentence_zh: 如果學生仔細研究這些事實，他們會更了解這堂歷史課。

definition_zh: (名) 派系；政治小集團　(名) 黨派；分裂的群體
example_sentence: Political factions within the party disagreed strongly about education policy.
sentence_zh: 黨內的派系對教育政策意見不一致。

definition_zh: (名) 因素；要素　(動) 是...的因素；影響
example_sentence: Students study hard to factor in all important concepts before the exam.
sentence_zh: 學生努力讀書以納入所有重要概念，為考試做準備。

definition_zh: (名) 工廠；製造廠　(名) 製造業
example_sentence: The car factory produces thousands of vehicles every month.
sentence_zh: 這家汽車工廠每個月生產數千輛汽車。

definition_zh: (形) 以事實為基礎的；符合事實的　(形) 真實的；確實的
example_sentence: Since the report is factual, the company must respond to all the criticisms.
sentence_zh: 既然這份報告是以事實為基礎，公司必須回應所有批評。

definition_zh: (名) 事實性；真實性
example_sentence: Having verified all sources carefully, the journalist confirmed the factuality of the reported news story.
sentence_zh: 記者仔細驗證所有資料後，確認了報導新聞的事實性。

definition_zh: (副) 事實上；實際上　按事實；確實地
example_sentence: The report, which states factually what happened during the accident, helped solve the case.
sentence_zh: 該報告準確陳述事故發生過程，這份報告幫助破獲了案件。

definition_zh: (名) 能力；才能　(名) 教職員；系所
example_sentence: The faculty of memory helps students retain information from their studies.
sentence_zh: 記憶的能力幫助學生保留他們研究的資訊。

definition_zh: (名) 一時風尚；短暫流行的事物　(動) 逐漸消退；褪色
example_sentence: If social media trends were not so powerful, the latest fashion fad would not disappear so quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果社群媒體趨勢不是那麼強大，最新的時尚風潮就不會消失得那麼快。

definition_zh: (形) 流行一時的；容易跟風的
example_sentence: Faddish fashion trends come and go quickly among teenagers.
sentence_zh: 青少年中流行一時的時尚趨勢來得快去得也快。

definition_zh: (副) 盲目跟風地；一時流行地
example_sentence: Following faddishly the latest social media trends, many teenagers neglected their study schedules and mental health.
sentence_zh: 許多青少年盲目跟風最新的社群媒體趨勢，忽視了他們的學習計畫和心理健康。

definition_zh: (動) 褪色；消退　(動) 逐漸消失；減弱
example_sentence: As the sun faded below the horizon, the sky turned from orange to deep purple.
sentence_zh: 當太陽消失在地平線下方時，天空從橙色變成深紫色。

definition_zh: (動) 閒晃；浪費時間
example_sentence: Seldom does Tom faff about when an important project deadline approaches.
sentence_zh: 當重要專案截止日期臨近時，湯姆很少閒晃浪費時間。

definition_zh: (名) 華氏溫標；華氏度數
example_sentence: The weather forecast shows a high of 95 degrees Fahrenheit, which is extremely hot for this season.
sentence_zh: 天氣預報顯示最高溫度為華氏95度，這對這個季節來說異常炎熱。

definition_zh: (動) 未能；失敗　不能；沒有
example_sentence: The student failed to submit the homework on time and received a lower grade.
sentence_zh: 那名學生未能按時繳交作業，因此獲得較低的成績。

definition_zh: (動) 失敗；不及格　(名) 失敗
example_sentence: Studying hard every day helps prevent failing the final exam.
sentence_zh: 每天努力讀書有助於避免期末考不及格。

definition_zh: (名) 失敗；失敗的事　(動) 失敗；不及格
example_sentence: Learning from failure helps students improve their exam performance.
sentence_zh: 從失敗中學習能幫助學生改善考試成績。

definition_zh: (形) 微弱的；昏迷的　(動) 昏倒；暈厥
example_sentence: Although the music was faint, the audience remained completely silent throughout the concert.
sentence_zh: 雖然音樂很微弱，但觀眾在整場演唱會中始終保持完全安靜。

definition_zh: (副) 微弱地；隱約地　(副) 略微；稍微
example_sentence: Hearing the faintly glowing stars above, the hikers felt peaceful during their night climb.
sentence_zh: 登山者聽著上方微弱發光的星星，在夜間登山時感到平靜。

definition_zh: (形) 公平的；公正的　(形) 晴朗的；不錯的
example_sentence: The teacher gave all students a fair test that measured what they had actually learned.
sentence_zh: 老師給所有學生一場公平的考試，測驗他們實際學到的內容。

definition_zh: (副) 相當；還算　(副) 公平地；公正地
example_sentence: If students study fairly hard before the exam, they will likely pass the test.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試前相當用功讀書，他們可能會通過考試。

definition_zh: (名) 仙女；精靈　(形) 仙女般的；神奇的
example_sentence: The fairy in the story gave the poor girl three magic wishes.
sentence_zh: 故事中的仙女給了貧窮女孩三個魔法願望。

definition_zh: (名) 信念；信仰　(名) 信心；信任
example_sentence: Many students study hard every day to build faith in their ability to pass the exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生每天努力讀書，目的是建立對自己通過考試的信心。

definition_zh: (形) 忠實的；可靠的　(形) 準確的；逼真的
example_sentence: A faithful friend always supports you through difficult times without complaint.
sentence_zh: 一個忠實的朋友在困難時期總是毫無怨言地支持你。

definition_zh: (副) 忠實地；誠懇地　(副) 堅定地；盡責地
example_sentence: As Maria faithfully followed the study plan, her English grades improved significantly.
sentence_zh: 當瑪莉亞忠實地遵循讀書計畫時，她的英文成績大幅進步。

definition_zh: (名) 忠誠；誠實　(形) 忠實的；可靠的
example_sentence: Having proven his faithfulness through years of dedicated service, the employee received a promotion and bonus.
sentence_zh: 那名員工透過多年盡心盡力的服務證明了他的忠誠，因而獲得晉升和獎金。

definition_zh: (形) 假的；偽造的　(動) 偽造；冒充
example_sentence: The designer bag that Sarah bought online turned out to be fake, which disappointed her greatly.
sentence_zh: Sarah在網上買的設計師包包原來是假的，這讓她感到很失望。

definition_zh: (動) 大笑；哈哈大笑
example_sentence: When the comedy show started, the entire audience fell about laughing at the funny jokes.
sentence_zh: 當喜劇節目開始時，整個觀眾席因為搞笑的笑話而哈哈大笑。

definition_zh: (片) 依靠；退而求其次　(動) 退縮；依賴
example_sentence: If the job market became difficult, many graduates would fall back on their parents' financial support.
sentence_zh: 如果就業市場變得困難，許多畢業生就會依靠父母的經濟支持。

definition_zh: (動) 退縮；後退　(動) 依靠；依賴
example_sentence: When the first plan failed, the team fell back on their backup strategy.
sentence_zh: 當第一個計畫失敗時，團隊依靠他們的備用策略。

definition_zh: (動) 在...方面落後；進度跟不上
example_sentence: Falling behind in math, Sarah decided to attend extra tutoring sessions after school.
sentence_zh: 在數學方面落後，莎拉決定在放學後參加額外的補習課程。

definition_zh: (動片) 落後；跟不上
example_sentence: Because Sarah fell behind in math class, she attended extra tutoring sessions after school.
sentence_zh: 因為莎拉在數學課上落後，她在放學後參加了額外的補習課程。

definition_zh: (動) 跌倒；落下　(動) 衰退；減少
example_sentence: Hardly had the old man left the house when he fell down on the icy street.
sentence_zh: 那位老先生才剛離開房子，他就在冰滑的街道上跌倒了。

definition_zh: (片) 失敗；不受歡迎　(動) 失敗；效果不佳
example_sentence: The comedian's joke, which fell flat in front of the audience, made him reconsider his material.
sentence_zh: 那位喜劇演員的笑話在觀眾面前失敗了，這使他重新考慮他的表演內容。

definition_zh: (動) 愛上；被迷住　(動) 上當；受騙
example_sentence: Marcus used fake compliments to fall for Sarah's trust and steal her personal information.
sentence_zh: 馬克斯用假讚美來贏得莎拉的信任並竊取她的個人資訊。

definition_zh: (動) 愛上；喜歡上　(動) 跌倒；摔下
example_sentence: After meeting the exchange student from Japan, Marcus fell in love with her charming personality.
sentence_zh: 在遇到來自日本的交換學生後，馬庫斯愛上了她迷人的個性。

definition_zh: (動) 陷入；落入　(動) 被騙；上當
example_sentence: Many students fall into the trap of studying only the night before the exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生陷入只在考試前一晚才讀書的陷阱。

definition_zh: (動) 掉落；脫落　(動) 減少；下降
example_sentence: As the old paint fell off the wall, workers prepared to repaint the entire building.
sentence_zh: 當舊油漆從牆上掉落時，工人們準備重新粉刷整棟建築。

definition_zh: (動) 與某人吵架；和某人絕交
example_sentence: Having fallen out with his best friend over a misunderstanding, Marcus spent weeks feeling regretful and lonely.
sentence_zh: 因為誤會與最好的朋友吵架，馬可斯花了好幾週感到後悔和孤獨。

definition_zh: (動) 吵架；起爭執　(動) 脫落；掉落
example_sentence: The two friends, who fell out over a misunderstanding, finally reconciled after months.
sentence_zh: 那兩個朋友因為誤會而吵架，經過幾個月後終於和解了。

definition_zh: (動) 摔倒；跌落　(動) 傾倒；倒塌
example_sentence: If the ladder is not stable, the worker will fall over and get injured.
sentence_zh: 如果梯子不穩定，工人會摔倒並受傷。

definition_zh: (動) 失敗；落空　(動) 掉下去；穿過
example_sentence: The company's plan to expand overseas fell through due to funding problems.
sentence_zh: 由於資金問題，公司的海外擴張計劃落空了。

definition_zh: (動) 屬於；受…管轄；歸類為
example_sentence: These online courses fall under the education category to help students prepare for exams.
sentence_zh: 這些線上課程屬於教育類別，用來幫助學生準備考試。

definition_zh: (動) 落入；淪為　(片) 受害者；犧牲品
example_sentence: Many online shoppers fall victim to fraud schemes every year without realizing it.
sentence_zh: 許多線上購物者每年都在不知不覺中淪為詐騙的受害者。

definition_zh: (動) 掉下；跌落　(名) 秋天；跌倒
example_sentence: As the leaves fall from the trees, autumn arrives and temperatures drop significantly.
sentence_zh: 當樹葉從樹上掉下來時，秋天就到了，氣溫也顯著下降。

definition_zh: (形) 虛假的；不真實的　(形) 錯誤的；不正確的
example_sentence: Having been caught in a false claim, the politician apologized to the public immediately.
sentence_zh: 由於被抓到虛假主張，那位政治人物立即向大眾道歉。

definition_zh: (名) 謊言；虛假　(名) 虛偽；不誠實
example_sentence: The politician's speech contained obvious falsehood that voters immediately recognized and rejected.
sentence_zh: 這位政治人物的演講包含了選民立即認出並拒絕的明顯謊言。

definition_zh: (動) 竄改；偽造　(動) 作假；捏造
example_sentence: Falsifying test results and submitting fake documents are serious academic crimes.
sentence_zh: 竄改測驗成績和提交偽造文件是嚴重的學術犯罪。

definition_zh: (動) 搖晃；動搖　(動) 猶豫；畏縮
example_sentence: If the team's confidence faltered, their chances of winning the championship would disappear completely.
sentence_zh: 如果球隊的信心動搖，贏得冠軍的機會就會完全消失。

definition_zh: (名) 名聲；名氣　(名) 聲譽；成名
example_sentence: The young musician achieved fame after winning the international piano competition.
sentence_zh: 這位年輕音樂家在贏得國際鋼琴大賽後成名。

definition_zh: (形) 著名的；聞名的
example_sentence: Famed for its beautiful mountains, Taiwan attracts tourists from around the world.
sentence_zh: 以美麗山脈聞名的台灣吸引來自世界各地的遊客。

definition_zh: (形) 熟悉的；常見的　(形) 親密的；不陌生的
example_sentence: Because the neighborhood felt familiar to her, Sarah walked through the old streets without checking her map.
sentence_zh: 因為這個社區對莎拉來說很熟悉，她不用看地圖就在老街道上行走。

definition_zh: (名) 熟悉；親切感　(名) 親密；親近
example_sentence: Only after long-term practice does familiarity with English grammar truly emerge.
sentence_zh: 只有經過長期練習，對英文文法的熟悉感才會真正浮現。

definition_zh: (名) 家庭；家族　(名) 家人；家務
example_sentence: The family that lives next door has three children who study hard.
sentence_zh: 住在隔壁的家庭有三個認真讀書的孩子。

definition_zh: (名) 飢荒；飢餓　(形) 饑饉的；極度缺乏的
example_sentence: The government organized food distribution programs to prevent famine from affecting rural villages.
sentence_zh: 政府組織食物配送計畫以防止飢荒影響鄉村地區。

definition_zh: (動) 使飢餓；餓死　(形) 極餓的；飢餓的
example_sentence: After being famished from skipping breakfast and lunch, the student eagerly devoured the cafeteria meal.
sentence_zh: 由於跳過早餐和午餐而極度飢餓，那名學生急不可耐地吃完了食堂的飯菜。

definition_zh: (形) 極餓的；飢餓的
example_sentence: After studying for six hours without food, the student felt famished and rushed to the cafeteria.
sentence_zh: 那名學生讀了六個小時的書而沒有進食，感到極餓，便衝到食堂。

definition_zh: (形) 極餓的；飢餓的　(形) 渴望的；急需的
example_sentence: Because the hikers were famished after walking for hours, they quickly devoured the packed lunch.
sentence_zh: 因為登山者走了數小時後極度飢餓，他們迅速吃完了便當。

definition_zh: (形) 著名的；有名的　(形) 出名的；聞名的
example_sentence: Being famous for her scientific discoveries, the researcher inspired many students.
sentence_zh: 因為在科學發現上很有名，這位研究者激勵了許多學生。

definition_zh: (副) 著名地；因...而聞名
example_sentence: The restaurant, famously known for its traditional Taiwanese soup, attracts thousands of visitors every week.
sentence_zh: 這家餐廳因其傳統台灣湯品而著名，每週吸引數千名訪客。

definition_zh: (名) 風扇；電扇　(名) 粉絲；愛好者　(動) 煽動；吹散
example_sentence: If the fan breaks down, we will have to buy a new one for summer.
sentence_zh: 如果電扇壞了，我們夏天就必須買一個新的。

definition_zh: (名) 狂熱者；癡迷者　(形) 狂熱的；過度執著的
example_sentence: Sports fanatics often watch every game and collect player memorabilia.
sentence_zh: 運動狂熱者經常觀看每一場比賽並收集球員紀念品。

definition_zh: (形) 充滿想像的；異想天開的　(形) 虛構的；不切實際的
example_sentence: The artist created fanciful paintings to inspire young viewers to dream.
sentence_zh: 這位藝術家創作了充滿想像的畫作，目的是激勵年輕觀眾去做夢。

definition_zh: (形) 花俏的；精美的　(動) 想要；喜歡
example_sentence: Many students fancy wearing fancy school uniforms with unique designs and colors.
sentence_zh: 許多學生喜歡穿著設計獨特、色彩鮮豔的花俏校服。

definition_zh: (名) 盛大的歡迎；熱烈的歡呼
example_sentence: Although the pop star arrived with great fanfare, the concert was canceled due to heavy rain.
sentence_zh: 雖然這位流行歌手以盛大的歡迎儀式到達，但演唱會因大雨而被取消。

definition_zh: (形) 極好的；非常棒的　(形) 奇異的；想像的
example_sentence: Having completed the challenging project, the team felt fantastic about their achievement.
sentence_zh: 完成了這個具挑戰性的專案後，團隊對他們的成就感到非常滿意。

definition_zh: (名) 幻想；奇想　(形) 幻想的；想像的
example_sentence: The fantasy world that the author created captivated millions of readers worldwide.
sentence_zh: 作者創作的那個幻想世界吸引了全球數百萬讀者。

definition_zh: (形) 遠的；遠方的　(副) 遠地；很；迄今為止
example_sentence: Living far from school and working part-time makes studying for the CSAT challenging.
sentence_zh: 住得離學校遠且打工，使得準備學測變得很困難。

definition_zh: (形) 遠方的；遙遠的　(副) 在遠方；到遠方
example_sentence: If Maria had enough money, she would visit that faraway island in Southeast Asia.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪麗亞有足夠的錢，她就會去那個東南亞的遙遠島嶼旅遊。

definition_zh: (形) 荒唐可笑的；滑稽荒誕的
example_sentence: The farcical plot of that comedy movie made the entire audience laugh uncontrollably.
sentence_zh: 那部喜劇電影荒唐可笑的情節讓全場觀眾笑得停不下來。

definition_zh: (名) 車費；票價　(名) 食物；飯菜　(動) 進展；過活
example_sentence: Faring well in the entrance exam, the student boarded the subway without paying the fare.
sentence_zh: 在入學考試中表現良好，這個學生上地鐵時沒有付車費。

definition_zh: (名) 告別；再見　(動) 向…道別；告別　(感) 再見；再會
example_sentence: As the ship sailed away, passengers waved farewell to their families waiting on the shore.
sentence_zh: 當船駛離時，乘客們向在岸邊等候的家人揮手告別。

definition_zh: (動) 把工作分包給他人；外包工作
example_sentence: Only when the company farmed out its delivery service did costs decrease significantly.
sentence_zh: 只有當公司把運送工作外包出去，成本才明顯下降。

definition_zh: (名) 農場；農地　(動) 務農；種植
example_sentence: The farm where my grandfather grows rice supplies vegetables to the local market every week.
sentence_zh: 我祖父種植稻米的農場每週供應蔬菜給當地市場。

definition_zh: (名) 農夫；農民　(名) 務農者；種田的人
example_sentence: The farmer works hard every day to grow crops and feed the family.
sentence_zh: 那位農民每天努力工作以種植農作物並養活家人。

definition_zh: (名) 農業；耕作　(動) 從事農業；經營農場
example_sentence: Farming in Taiwan requires advanced techniques to grow rice and vegetables efficiently.
sentence_zh: 台灣的農業需要先進的技術來高效地種植稻米和蔬菜。

definition_zh: (形) 遠見的；目光遠大的　(形) 遠視的
example_sentence: Farsighted leaders plan for the future with wisdom and care.
sentence_zh: 有遠見的領導者用智慧和關懷為未來做計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 遠視；目光長遠
example_sentence: Although the business leader's farsightedness helped the company survive the crisis, many employees initially doubted the strategy.
sentence_zh: 雖然這位商業領袖的遠見幫助公司度過危機，但許多員工最初對該策略表示懷疑。

definition_zh: (動) 浪費時間做無關緊要的事；閒晃
example_sentence: Instead of farting about on social media, students should focus on preparing for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 學生應該專注於準備學測，而不是浪費時間在社群媒體上閒晃。

definition_zh: (形) 更遠的；較遠的　(副) 更遠地；到更遠處
example_sentence: The mountain village that lies farther from the city requires more travel time.
sentence_zh: 位於離城市更遠的那個山村需要更多的旅行時間。

definition_zh: (名) 筋膜；包裹肌肉的薄膜　(名) 建築物的外牆面
example_sentence: If athletes stretch their fascia regularly, their muscles will recover faster after intense training.
sentence_zh: 如果運動員定期伸展筋膜，他們的肌肉在激烈訓練後會恢復得更快。

definition_zh: (動) 使著迷；吸引　(動) 迷住；使感興趣
example_sentence: The mystery of ancient Egypt fascinates many history students around the world.
sentence_zh: 古埃及的神祕之處令世界各地許多歷史學生著迷。

definition_zh: (形) 著迷的；被吸引的　(動) 使著迷；吸引
example_sentence: Many students visit the science museum to learn and feel fascinated by interesting discoveries.
sentence_zh: 許多學生參觀科學博物館，想要學習並被有趣的發現所吸引。

definition_zh: (形) 迷人的；引人入勝的　(形) 令人著迷的；有趣的
example_sentence: The museum's ancient artifacts and interactive exhibits make learning about history absolutely fascinating.
sentence_zh: 博物館的古代文物和互動展覽使得學習歷史變得絕對引人入勝。

definition_zh: (名) 著迷；魅力　(動) 使著迷；吸引
example_sentence: Although the magic show lasted only one hour, its fascination kept the audience entertained throughout.
sentence_zh: 雖然魔術表演只持續一小時，但它的魅力讓觀眾始終保持娛樂狀態。

definition_zh: (名) 法西斯主義；極權統治
example_sentence: Having studied fascism in history class, students understood the dangers of authoritarian governments.
sentence_zh: 在歷史課中學習過法西斯主義後，學生們理解了專制政府的危害。

definition_zh: (名) 法西斯主義者；獨裁者　(形) 法西斯的；專制的
example_sentence: The dictator, who was a fascist that banned all opposing political parties, controlled the nation with an iron fist.
sentence_zh: 那位獨裁者是個法西斯主義者，他禁止所有反對黨派，用鐵血手段統治國家。

definition_zh: (名) 時尚；流行　(動) 設計；製作
example_sentence: Following the latest fashion trends helps many teenagers express their unique personal style.
sentence_zh: 追隨最新的時尚潮流幫助許多青少年表達他們獨特的個人風格。

definition_zh: (形) 時尚的；流行的　(形) 受歡迎的；合潮流的
example_sentence: If wearing fashionable clothes were not so expensive, more students would buy them.
sentence_zh: 如果穿著時尚的衣服不那麼昂貴，更多學生會購買。

definition_zh: (形) 快的；迅速的　(副) 快地；迅速地
example_sentence: Running fast helps athletes finish the race in record time.
sentence_zh: 快速奔跑幫助運動員以紀錄時間完成比賽。

definition_zh: (動) 牢牢固定；緊緊繫住
example_sentence: Fastening down the loose rope with strong knots, the sailors secured the cargo safely.
sentence_zh: 水手們用強力繩結牢牢固定鬆散的繩子，安全地固定了貨物。

definition_zh: (動) 集中於；緊盯著
example_sentence: As the coach fastened on the team's weaknesses, players began improving their defense.
sentence_zh: 當教練集中於球隊的弱點時，選手們開始改進他們的防守。

definition_zh: (動) 緊緊抓住；死死盯著
example_sentence: Only after the scandal broke did reporters fasten onto every detail of the politician's past.
sentence_zh: 只有在醜聞爆發之後，記者們才死死盯著這位政治人物過去的每一個細節。

definition_zh: (動) 扣緊；系牢　(動) 關閉；鎖上
example_sentence: The seatbelt, which passengers must fasten up before departure, ensures their safety during the flight.
sentence_zh: 乘客在出發前必須扣緊的安全帶確保了飛行期間的安全。

definition_zh: (動) 扣牢；繫緊　(動) 固定；栓住
example_sentence: Students must fasten their seatbelts to ensure safety during the school trip.
sentence_zh: 學生必須繫好安全帶以確保校外教學期間的安全。

definition_zh: (形) 挑剔的；講究衛生的　(形) 難以滿足的；苛求的
example_sentence: Fastidious about cleanliness and good manners, Maria always organized her desk perfectly before studying.
sentence_zh: 瑪莉亞對清潔和禮儀很挑剔，總是在讀書前把書桌整理得很完美。

definition_zh: (名) 脂肪；肥肉　(形) 肥的；胖的　(動) 使發胖
example_sentence: Eating too much fat and sugar can make people gain weight easily.
sentence_zh: 吃太多脂肪和糖容易使人發胖。

definition_zh: (形) 致命的；導致死亡的　(形) 致命性的；毀滅性的
example_sentence: Although the accident was serious, it was not fatal because emergency services arrived quickly.
sentence_zh: 雖然那場車禍很嚴重，但因為急救人員及時趕到，所以並未造成死亡。

definition_zh: (名) 死亡；致命的結果　(名) 致命事故；喪生
example_sentence: Resulting from the serious car accident, the fatality shocked the entire community deeply.
sentence_zh: 由於嚴重的車禍造成的死亡事故，深深震撼了整個社區。

definition_zh: (名) 命運；宿命　(名) 結局；下場
example_sentence: The accident that changed her fate happened on a rainy night.
sentence_zh: 改變她命運的那場車禍發生在一個雨夜。

definition_zh: (形) 決定性的；重要的　(形) 命運性的；不幸的
example_sentence: If the team had made a different decision that day, their fateful journey to the championship would have ended differently.
sentence_zh: 如果那支球隊當天做了不同的決定，他們命運性的奪冠之旅就會以不同的方式結束。

definition_zh: (名) 父親；爸爸　(動) 當父親；生育
example_sentence: My father teaches English at the high school near my home.
sentence_zh: 我的父親在我家附近的高中教英文。

definition_zh: (名) 父親的身份；做父親
example_sentence: Many young men aspire to experience fatherhood to build a meaningful family.
sentence_zh: 許多年輕男性渴望經歷父親身份來建立有意義的家庭。

definition_zh: (動) 理解；弄懂　(動) 測量深度
example_sentence: After reading the article three times, Maya finally fathomed out the author's main argument about climate change.
sentence_zh: 讀了三次文章後，Maya 終於弄懂了作者關於氣候變化的主要論點。

definition_zh: (動) 理解；領悟　(名) 英尋（長度單位）
example_sentence: Although the professor explained the concept clearly, students still couldn't fathom why quantum physics challenged their understanding.
sentence_zh: 雖然教授清楚地解釋了這個概念，但學生們仍然無法理解為什麼量子物理挑戰了他們的認知。

definition_zh: (名) 疲勞；疲倦　(動) 使疲倦；使厭倦　(形) 疲倦的；疲勞的
example_sentence: Exhausted by the long exam, many students felt fatigue settling into their minds.
sentence_zh: 經過長時間的考試而筋疲力盡後，許多學生感到疲勞逐漸籠罩他們的心靈。

definition_zh: (動) 使變胖；增重
example_sentence: The farmer feeds the cattle extra grain to fatten them up before the market sale.
sentence_zh: 農民在市場銷售前餵牛額外的穀物使其增重。

definition_zh: (形) 含脂肪的；肥膩的　(名) 肥胖的人；胖子
example_sentence: Eating too much fatty food and junk food leads to serious health problems.
sentence_zh: 吃太多含脂肪的食物和垃圾食物會導致嚴重的健康問題。

definition_zh: (名) 水龍頭；旋塞
example_sentence: If the kitchen faucet were not leaking, water bills would not increase every month.
sentence_zh: 如果廚房水龍頭沒有漏水，每月的水費就不會增加。

definition_zh: (名) 過錯；缺點　(動) 挑剔；批評
example_sentence: Forgetting homework is not a serious fault for most students.
sentence_zh: 忘記功課對大多數學生來說不是嚴重的過錯。

definition_zh: (形) 有缺陷的；故障的　(形) 不完美的；有問題的
example_sentence: The engineer, finding faulty wiring in the building, immediately reported the safety hazard.
sentence_zh: 工程師發現建築物內的電線有故障，立即報告了安全隱患。

definition_zh: (名) 動物群；野生動物
example_sentence: Because the island's fauna includes many endangered species, the government protects its natural habitats strictly.
sentence_zh: 因為該島嶼的動物群包括許多瀕危物種，政府嚴格保護其自然棲息地。

definition_zh: (名) 野獸派；野獸派藝術運動
example_sentence: Not only did Fauvism reject realistic color, but also it transformed modern painting forever.
sentence_zh: 野獸派不僅拒絕寫實色彩，而且它永遠改變了現代繪畫。

definition_zh: (名) 偏好；喜愛　(動) 傾向於；偏袒　(名) 恩惠；幫忙
example_sentence: The teacher showed favor to students who completed the homework that was assigned last week.
sentence_zh: 那位老師偏愛完成上週指定作業的學生。

definition_zh: (形) 有利的；贊成的　(形) 良好的；正面的
example_sentence: The company offered a favorable contract to attract talented engineers to join the team.
sentence_zh: 該公司提供有利的合約條件以吸引優秀工程師加入團隊。

definition_zh: (副) 有利地；贊成地　(副) 積極地；順利地
example_sentence: The teacher commented favorably on Maria's detailed essay, praising her clear arguments and strong supporting evidence.
sentence_zh: 老師對瑪麗亞的詳細論文給予好評，稱讚她的論點清晰和證據有力。

definition_zh: (形) 最喜歡的；最受歡迎的　(名) 最喜歡的人或物；最受歡迎者
example_sentence: Basketball is my favorite sport to play after school every day.
sentence_zh: 籃球是我最喜歡在放學後每天進行的運動。

definition_zh: (動) 討好；奉承　(動) 巴結；拍馬屁
example_sentence: Because the manager always fawns on the company president, many colleagues view him with suspicion and distrust.
sentence_zh: 因為那位經理總是巴結公司董事長，所以許多同事都對他持懷疑態度。

definition_zh: (名) 傳真；傳真機　(動) 傳真；用傳真機發送
example_sentence: Sending the document by fax, the office worker ensured quick delivery to the branch.
sentence_zh: 辦公室職員透過傳真發送文件，確保迅速送達分公司。

definition_zh: (名) 害怕；恐懼　(動) 害怕；擔心　(形) 害怕的；恐懼的
example_sentence: Students who fear failing the CSAT exam often study harder than others.
sentence_zh: 害怕學測不及格的學生通常比別人讀書更用功。

definition_zh: (形) 害怕的；恐懼的　(形) 令人害怕的；可怕的
example_sentence: If the exam is difficult, students will feel fearful about failing the test.
sentence_zh: 如果考試很難，學生會害怕考試不及格。

definition_zh: (形) 無畏的；勇敢的　(形) 大膽的；無所懼怕的
example_sentence: The fearless athlete competed in the dangerous mountain climbing competition.
sentence_zh: 那位無畏的運動員參加了危險的登山比賽。

definition_zh: (形) 可怕的；令人畏懼的　(形) 兇悍的；凶惡的
example_sentence: Ancient warriors wore fearsome armor to intimidate enemies in battle.
sentence_zh: 古代戰士穿著可怕的盔甲來嚇阻戰場上的敵人。

definition_zh: (名) 可行性；實行的可能性
example_sentence: The feasibility of building a new stadium depends on sufficient funding and community support.
sentence_zh: 建設新體育館的可行性取決於充足的資金和社區支持。

definition_zh: (形) 可行的；切實可行的　(形) 合理的；可能的
example_sentence: As long as the budget is feasible, the school will proceed with the new library construction project.
sentence_zh: 只要預算可行，學校就會推進新圖書館建設項目。

definition_zh: (動) 飽覽；盡情欣賞　(片) 用眼睛享受；視覺盛宴
example_sentence: Having feasted their eyes on the cherry blossoms at Yangmingshan, the students felt completely satisfied and happy.
sentence_zh: 在陽明山飽覽櫻花美景後，學生們感到完全滿足和快樂。

definition_zh: (名) 盛宴；豐盛的餐飲　(動) 大吃；享受豐富的食物
example_sentence: The family feast, which included traditional dishes prepared for hours, brought everyone together on Lunar New Year.
sentence_zh: 那場家庭盛宴包含許多傳統菜餚，費時數小時準備，在農曆新年時讓全家人聚在一起。

definition_zh: (名) 功績；壯舉　(動) 完成；達成
example_sentence: Winning the national science competition was an impressive feat that required months of hard work.
sentence_zh: 贏得全國科學競賽是項令人印象深刻的壯舉，需要好幾個月的辛苦工作。

definition_zh: (名) 羽毛；羽毛狀物　(動) 用羽毛裝飾；輕輕放下
example_sentence: If the bird lost a feather, it would need weeks to grow a new one.
sentence_zh: 如果那隻鳥掉了一根羽毛，牠需要好幾週才能長出新的。

definition_zh: (名) 特徵；特色　(動) 以…為主要內容；刊登
example_sentence: The new smartphone features an excellent camera and long battery life.
sentence_zh: 這款新智慧型手機的特色是有優秀的相機和長久的電池壽命。

definition_zh: (名) 二月
example_sentence: Being February, the weather turned colder, prompting students to wear heavier coats daily.
sentence_zh: 二月到來，天氣變冷，促使學生每天穿著更厚重的外套。

definition_zh: (形) 糞便的；大腸的
example_sentence: Because fecal contamination was detected in the water supply, the health department immediately issued a public warning.
sentence_zh: 由於在供水系統中發現糞便污染，衛生部門立即發布了公開警告。

definition_zh: (名) 糞便；排泄物
example_sentence: Hardly ever do medical students examine feces without proper protective equipment.
sentence_zh: 醫學生幾乎從不在沒有適當防護設備的情況下檢查糞便。

definition_zh: (形) 肥沃的；豐饒的　(形) 多產的；富有創意的
example_sentence: The fecund soil that farmers cultivated produced abundant crops year after year.
sentence_zh: 農民耕作的肥沃土壤年復一年產出豐富的農作物。

definition_zh: (形) 聯邦的；聯邦政府的
example_sentence: The federal government established new environmental standards to protect national forests.
sentence_zh: 聯邦政府制定了新的環境標準以保護國家森林。

definition_zh: (名) 聯邦；聯合體　(名) 聯盟；協會
example_sentence: The European Union is a political and economic federation of twenty-seven member states.
sentence_zh: 歐盟是由二十七個成員國組成的政治和經濟聯邦。

definition_zh: (名) 費用；服務費　(名) 學費；會費
example_sentence: The gym charges a monthly fee of five hundred dollars.
sentence_zh: 這家健身房每月收費五百元。

definition_zh: (形) 虛弱的；無力的　(形) 微弱的；淡薄的
example_sentence: Although the patient's feeble voice could barely be heard, the doctor listened carefully to every word.
sentence_zh: 雖然病患虛弱的聲音幾乎聽不見，醫生仍仔細聽每個字。

definition_zh: (動) 靠...維生；以...為食　(動) 藉由...成長；因...而興盛
example_sentence: Feeding off social media attention, the influencer posted provocative content daily.
sentence_zh: 藉由社群媒體的關注而成長，這位網紅每天發布挑釁性的內容。

definition_zh: (動) 以...為食；靠...維生　依賴；以...為主要來源
example_sentence: Mosquitoes that feed on human blood can transmit serious diseases to communities.
sentence_zh: 以人血為食的蚊子會將嚴重疾病傳播給社區。

definition_zh: (動) 厭煩；受夠　(動) 養肥；增重
example_sentence: If students feed up with endless homework, they would seek better study methods.
sentence_zh: 如果學生厭煩了無盡的功課，他們就會尋求更好的讀書方法。

definition_zh: (動) 餵食；供應食物　(名) 飼料；食物
example_sentence: Farmers feed their cows fresh grass every morning.
sentence_zh: 農民每天早上餵牛吃新鮮草料。

definition_zh: (名) 反饋；意見　(動) 提供反饋；回應
example_sentence: Teachers give feedback to students to help improve their writing skills.
sentence_zh: 老師給學生反饋，目的是幫助改進他們的寫作能力。

definition_zh: (名) 飼料；食物　(名) 支流；支線
example_sentence: The farmer spreads chicken feeder across the barn to keep all the birds well-fed.
sentence_zh: 農民在穀倉裡放置雞飼料器，以保持所有鳥類都能吃飽。

definition_zh: (動) 想要；好像　(動) 感覺；覺得
example_sentence: Although the exam is difficult, many students feel like they can pass it with hard work.
sentence_zh: 雖然考試很難，但許多學生感覺他們透過努力就能及格。

definition_zh: (動) 摸索；觸摸　(動) 感受；感覺
example_sentence: Having felt up the fabric carefully, the designer decided to use it for the new collection.
sentence_zh: 設計師仔細摸索過那塊布料後，決定用它來製作新系列。

definition_zh: (動) 感覺；感受　(名) 感覺；感受
example_sentence: The warm sunshine that touched her skin made her feel completely relaxed and happy.
sentence_zh: 碰觸她皮膚的溫暖陽光讓她感覺完全放鬆和快樂。

definition_zh: (名) 感覺；感受　(名) 情感；情緒　(動) 感到；感受
example_sentence: Many students have mixed feelings about taking the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生對參加學測考試有複雜的感受。

definition_zh: (名) 腳；足部　(名) 英尺（長度單位）
example_sentence: If runners did not stretch their feet before practice, injuries would occur more easily.
sentence_zh: 如果跑步者練習前不伸展腳部，傷害就會更容易發生。

definition_zh: (形) 好鬥的；充滿精力的；易生氣的
example_sentence: The feisty old coach never backed down from a challenge.
sentence_zh: 那位好鬥的老教練從未退縮於任何挑戰。

definition_zh: (形) 貓科的；貓一樣的　(名) 貓科動物；貓
example_sentence: Stretching lazily across the sunny windowsill, the feline creature seemed perfectly content.
sentence_zh: 那隻貓科動物懶洋洋地伸著身體，橫臥在陽光灑滿的窗台上，看起來很滿足。

definition_zh: (名) 同伴；夥伴　(形) 同類的；相同的
example_sentence: As fellow students preparing for the CSAT, we should support each other during exam season.
sentence_zh: 當同學們為了學測做準備時，我們應該互相支持。

definition_zh: (名) 友誼；同志情誼　(名) 獎學金；研究員職位
example_sentence: Seldom does a student find such genuine fellowship among classmates in competitive exam preparation.
sentence_zh: 在競爭激烈的考試準備中，學生很少能在同學間找到這樣真摯的友誼。

definition_zh: (名) 重罪；重刑犯罪
example_sentence: A felony, which carries a prison sentence of more than one year, is considered a serious crime.
sentence_zh: 重罪（即監禁超過一年的犯罪）被視為嚴重犯罪。

definition_zh: (形) 女性的；女的　(名) 女性；女人
example_sentence: The school hired more female teachers to inspire young girls.
sentence_zh: 這所學校聘請更多女性教師來激勵年輕女孩。

definition_zh: (形) 女性的；柔和的　(形) 陰性的；優雅的
example_sentence: The designer created a feminine collection featuring soft colors and elegant flowing fabrics.
sentence_zh: 該設計師創作了一系列女性風格的服裝，採用柔和色調和優雅飄逸的布料。

definition_zh: (名) 女性主義；男女平等主義
example_sentence: Feminism advocates for equal rights and opportunities for all genders.
sentence_zh: 女性主義提倡所有性別擁有平等的權利和機會。

definition_zh: (名) 女性主義者；爭取婦女權利的人　(形) 女性主義的；支持性別平等的
example_sentence: Although some people misunderstand feminism, many feminists work hard so that society treats men and women equally.
sentence_zh: 雖然有些人誤解女性主義，但許多女性主義者努力工作，使社會能平等對待男性和女性。

definition_zh: (動) 用圍欄圍住；限制行動
example_sentence: Fencing in the garden with wooden posts, the family finally protected their vegetables from wild animals.
sentence_zh: 用木樁圍住花園後，這個家庭終於保護了他們的蔬菜免受野生動物傷害。

definition_zh: (動) 用柵欄圍住；隔離
example_sentence: The construction site that was fenced off prevented students from entering the dangerous area.
sentence_zh: 被圍起來的建築工地防止了學生進入危險區域。

definition_zh: (名) 柵欄；圍籬　(動) 用柵欄圍住；限制
example_sentence: If the school builds a fence around the playground, students will feel safer during lunch break.
sentence_zh: 如果學校在操場周圍建造柵欄，學生在午餐時間會感到更安全。

definition_zh: (動) 自力更生；靠自己照顧自己
example_sentence: After moving to a new city for university, students must learn to fend for themselves.
sentence_zh: 搬到新城市上大學後，學生必須學會自力更生。

definition_zh: (動) 自力更生；獨立生活　照顧自己
example_sentence: After moving to the dormitory, students learned to fend for themselves in daily life.
sentence_zh: 搬進宿舍後，學生們學會自力更生來處理日常生活。

definition_zh: (動) 擊退；抵禦　(動) 躲避；避開
example_sentence: The goalkeeper fended off several dangerous attacks during the intense match.
sentence_zh: 守門員在激烈的比賽中擊退了幾次危險的進攻。

definition_zh: (動) 自衛；防守　(動) 照顧；養活
example_sentence: Fending off competition from larger companies, the startup invested heavily in innovation and customer service.
sentence_zh: 新創公司在抵禦來自大型企業的競爭之際，投入大量資金進行創新和提升客戶服務。

definition_zh: (名) 茴香；茴香植物
example_sentence: Having harvested the fennel from the garden, the chef prepared a fragrant Mediterranean dish.
sentence_zh: 從花園採收茴香後，廚師準備了一道香氣四溢的地中海菜餚。

definition_zh: (動) [fɚˈmɛnt] 發酵；騷動　(名) [ˈfɝmɛnt] 騷亂；不安
example_sentence: The social unrest that fermented in the city led to widespread protests demanding change.
sentence_zh: 在城市中醞釀的社會不安導致了廣泛的抗議活動，要求改革。

definition_zh: (名) 蕨類植物；蕨
example_sentence: The shaded forest floor was covered with green ferns and moss.
sentence_zh: 陰暗的森林地面上覆蓋著綠色的蕨類植物和苔蘚。

definition_zh: (形) 凶猛的；兇惡的　(形) 狂暴的；殘暴的
example_sentence: If the tiger were not ferocious, attacking it would be much easier and safer.
sentence_zh: 如果老虎不是那麼兇猛，攻擊它會容易且安全得多。

definition_zh: (副) 兇猛地；凶狠地　殘暴地；野蠻地
example_sentence: The injured dog barked ferociously at anyone approaching its food bowl.
sentence_zh: 那隻受傷的狗兇猛地對著靠近牠食碗的任何人吠叫。

definition_zh: (名) 兇猛；猛烈　(名) 野蠻；殘暴
example_sentence: Displaying ferocity in the final match, the volleyball team crushed their opponents decisively.
sentence_zh: 在決賽中展現兇猛氣勢，排球隊果斷擊敗對手。

definition_zh: (動) 到處翻找；四處搜尋
example_sentence: While waiting for the interview results, the student ferrets about online, searching for information about the company.
sentence_zh: 在等待面試結果期間，這位學生四處翻找線上資訊，搜尋有關該公司的資料。

definition_zh: (動) 搜查；偵查　發現；揭露
example_sentence: Only after careful investigation did the detective ferret out the hidden evidence.
sentence_zh: 只有經過仔細調查，偵探才發現了隱藏的證據。

definition_zh: (名) 渡輪；擺渡船　(動) 用渡輪運送；擺渡
example_sentence: The ferry that connects the island to the mainland operates daily throughout the year.
sentence_zh: 連接島嶼與本島的渡輪全年每天都在運行。

definition_zh: (形) 肥沃的；適合種植的　(形) 多產的；富有成果的
example_sentence: Farmers choose fertile soil to grow crops and increase their harvest.
sentence_zh: 農民選擇肥沃的土壤來種植作物並增加收成。

definition_zh: (名) 生育能力；肥沃　(形) 能生育的；肥沃的
example_sentence: Improving soil fertility through sustainable farming practices benefits future crop production.
sentence_zh: 通過永續農業做法提高土壤肥沃度有利於未來的作物產量。

definition_zh: (動) 施肥；使...肥沃　(動) 使...受孕；授粉
example_sentence: Farmers fertilize their fields every spring to grow better crops.
sentence_zh: 農民每年春天為田地施肥以種出更好的作物。

definition_zh: (名) 肥料；化肥　(動) 施肥；使肥沃
example_sentence: Because the soil lacked nutrients, farmers applied fertilizer to improve crop yield.
sentence_zh: 因為土壤缺乏養分，農民施肥以提高作物產量。

definition_zh: (名) 熱情；熱忱　(名) 熱烈；狂熱
example_sentence: Burning with fervor, the debate team prepared tirelessly for the national competition.
sentence_zh: 帶著熱忱準備，辯論隊為全國比賽不懈地做準備。

definition_zh: (動) 坦白承認；招認
example_sentence: If the student fesses up about cheating on the exam, the teacher might be more lenient with punishment.
sentence_zh: 如果學生坦白承認在考試中作弊，老師可能會從輕處罰。

definition_zh: (動) 化膿；惡化　(名) 膿瘡；潰爛處
example_sentence: Left untreated, the infected wound will fester and cause serious problems.
sentence_zh: 如果不治療，感染的傷口會化膿並造成嚴重問題。

definition_zh: (名) 節慶；慶典　(名) 藝術節；展覽會
example_sentence: Many students attend the music festival to enjoy live performances and make memories.
sentence_zh: 許多學生參加音樂節慶來享受現場表演並留下回憶。

definition_zh: (形) 歡樂的；節慶的　(形) 充滿喜慶氣氛的
example_sentence: The shopping mall decorated with colorful lights and festive music created a joyful atmosphere for holiday shoppers.
sentence_zh: 用彩色燈飾和歡樂音樂裝飾的購物中心為假日購物者營造了充滿喜慶的氣氛。

definition_zh: (名) 節慶氣氛；歡樂　(名) 慶典活動；節日
example_sentence: As the Christmas festivity approached, decorations filled every street and store in Taipei.
sentence_zh: 當聖誕節慶氣氛臨近時，台北的每條街道和商店都擺滿了裝飾品。

definition_zh: (動) 最終到達；停下來　(動) 嘔吐；吐出
example_sentence: Having fetched up at the train station after a long journey, the exhausted travelers finally rested.
sentence_zh: 經過長途旅行後，疲憊的旅客們最終到達火車站並休息了。

definition_zh: (動) 取回；拿來　(動) 賣得；換取
example_sentence: The antique vase that the museum wanted to fetch sold for a million dollars.
sentence_zh: 博物館想要取回的那個古董花瓶以一百萬元的價格售出。

definition_zh: (名) 長期仇恨；世仠　(動) 與...發生長期糾紛
example_sentence: The two families' long-standing feud prevented them from attending the same school events.
sentence_zh: 這兩個家族之間長期的仇恨使他們無法參加同一個學校活動。

definition_zh: (名) 發燒；發熱　(動) 發燒；患熱病
example_sentence: If a student had a high fever, missing the exam would be unavoidable.
sentence_zh: 如果一名學生發高燒，缺席考試就不可避免了。

definition_zh: (形) 少的；很少　(代) 少數人；少數的東西
example_sentence: Only a few students attended the club meeting yesterday.
sentence_zh: 昨天只有少數學生參加了社團會議。

definition_zh: (名) 未婚夫；未婚妻
example_sentence: Having accepted the proposal last month, Sarah's fiancé began planning their wedding with great enthusiasm.
sentence_zh: 上個月接受求婚後，莎拉的未婚夫開始充滿熱情地計畫他們的婚禮。
subject_type: noun (fiancé as object; Sarah as participial subject)

definition_zh: (名) 慘敗；失敗　(名) 糟糕的事件；災難
example_sentence: Although the school festival planning seemed careful, it turned into a fiasco when heavy rain flooded the gymnasium.
sentence_zh: 雖然學校慶典的規劃看起來很仔細，但大雨淹沒體育館時，整個活動變成了一場慘敗。

definition_zh: (名) 纖維；纖維素　(名) 光纖
example_sentence: Seldom does dietary fiber receive enough attention from teenagers ignoring their health.
sentence_zh: 青少年忽視自身健康，很少有人重視膳食纖維。

definition_zh: (名) 虛構的故事；小說　(名) 謊言；虛假的事物
example_sentence: Science fiction novels, which explore futuristic technology and space exploration, fascinate many teenage readers.
sentence_zh: 科幻小說探討未來科技和太空探險，吸引許多青少年讀者。

definition_zh: (形) 虛構的；小說的　(形) 假想的；虛假的
example_sentence: Students read fictional stories to improve their English vocabulary and comprehension skills.
sentence_zh: 學生閱讀虛構故事以提高英語詞彙和閱讀理解能力。

definition_zh: (形) 虛構的；假的　(形) 臆造的；捏造的
example_sentence: The detective discovered that the suspect's alibi was fictitious and completely made up.
sentence_zh: 偵探發現嫌疑人的不在場證明是虛構的，完全是捏造的。

definition_zh: (動) 隨意擺弄；瞎搗鼓
example_sentence: Tom fiddled about with his phone during class instead of taking notes.
sentence_zh: 湯姆在課堂上隨意玩弄手機，而不是做筆記。

definition_zh: (動) 浪費時間；虛度光陰　(動) 懶散地打發時間
example_sentence: Although Marcus had an important exam next week, he fiddled away the entire afternoon watching videos.
sentence_zh: 雖然馬克思下週有重要考試，他卻整個下午都在浪費時間看影片。

definition_zh: (動) 撥弄；胡亂轉動；欺騙　(名) 小提琴；騙局
example_sentence: Fiddling with his phone during class, the student missed the important announcement.
sentence_zh: 在課堂上撥弄手機的那個學生錯過了重要的公告。

definition_zh: (形) 需要細心處理的；複雜繁瑣的
example_sentence: Assembling the model airplane is a fiddly task that requires patience and steady hands.
sentence_zh: 組裝模型飛機是需要細心處理的工作，需要耐心和穩定的手。

definition_zh: (名) 忠誠；忠實　(名) 準確性；逼真度
example_sentence: If a student maintains fidelity to her studies, she will achieve excellent results on the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 如果學生對功課保持忠實，她將在學測取得優異成績。

definition_zh: (動) 坐立不安；亂動　(名) 坐立不安的人；小玩具
example_sentence: During the long exam, many students fidget with their pens nervously.
sentence_zh: 在漫長的考試中，許多學生緊張地用筆亂動。

definition_zh: (名) 實地考察；戶外教學
example_sentence: The biology class organized a field trip to observe insects in the local forest.
sentence_zh: 生物課組織了一次實地考察，目的是在當地森林觀察昆蟲。

definition_zh: (名) 田地；田野　(名) 領域；範疇　(動) 處理；應付
example_sentence: Working in the medical field requires both knowledge and compassion for patients.
sentence_zh: 在醫療領域工作需要知識和對患者的同情心。

definition_zh: (形) 兇猛的；激烈的　(形) 強烈的；熾熱的
example_sentence: Although the competition was fierce, the athletes remained calm and focused throughout the match.
sentence_zh: 雖然比賽很激烈，但運動員始終保持冷靜和專注。

definition_zh: (副) 猛烈地；兇狠地　激烈地；強烈地
example_sentence: Having fought fiercely for three hours, the two teams finally reached a draw in the championship match.
sentence_zh: 經過三小時的激烈對戰後，兩支隊伍在冠軍賽中最終打成平手。

definition_zh: (形) 熾熱的；炎熱的　(形) 激烈的；激情的
example_sentence: The fiery debate that erupted during the student council meeting left everyone stunned.
sentence_zh: 在學生會議中爆發的激烈辯論讓所有人都感到震驚。

definition_zh: (名) 慶祝活動；節慶　(名) 盛大派對；聚會
example_sentence: The Spanish fiesta celebrates local culture through music, dancing, and traditional food.
sentence_zh: 西班牙慶祝活動透過音樂、舞蹈和傳統食物來慶祝當地文化。

definition_zh: (名) 十五；15個
example_sentence: If the exam had only fifteen questions, students would finish it much faster.
sentence_zh: 如果考試只有十五題，學生們會完成得快得多。

definition_zh: (序) 第五的；第五個
example_sentence: My fifth time visiting Taipei was the most memorable summer.
sentence_zh: 我第五次造訪台北是最令人難忘的夏天。

definition_zh: (名) 五十；五十個　(形) 五十的
example_sentence: Having completed fifty math problems, the student felt confident about the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 完成了五十道數學題目後，這位學生對學測感到有信心。

definition_zh: (名) 無花果；牙籤　(動) 打扮；裝扮
example_sentence: Although the actor figured out the complex plot, he still couldn't grasp the hidden meaning.
sentence_zh: 雖然這位演員想出了複雜的劇情，他仍然無法掌握隱藏的含義。

definition_zh: (動) 反擊；還手　(動) 抵抗；反抗
example_sentence: Seldom does a victim fight back against their bully without support from friends.
sentence_zh: 沒有朋友的支持，受害者很少反擊霸凌者。

definition_zh: (動) 打鬥；決出勝負；激烈競爭
example_sentence: The two companies that fight it out in the market will determine which offers better service.
sentence_zh: 那兩家在市場上激烈競爭的公司將決定誰提供更好的服務。

definition_zh: (動) 抵抗；驅除　(動) 擊退；戰勝
example_sentence: Eating nutritious food helps the body fight off common colds and infections.
sentence_zh: 吃營養豐富的食物可以幫助身體抵抗感冒和感染。

definition_zh: (動) 打架；戰鬥　(名) 打鬥；爭執
