example_sentence: The two teams fought hard, and their determination to win impressed the crowd.
sentence_zh: 兩隊奮力對戰，他們贏得勝利的決心給觀眾留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 戰鬥機；飛行員　(名) 鬥士；格鬥家
example_sentence: The fighter pilot trained hard to master advanced flying skills.
sentence_zh: 那位戰鬥機飛行員努力訓練以掌握高級飛行技巧。

definition_zh: (動) 計畫；打算　(動) 預期；指望
example_sentence: Figure on spending two hours studying before the exam, and you'll be well prepared.
sentence_zh: 考試前打算花兩小時唸書，這樣你就會準備得很充分。

definition_zh: (動) 理解；弄明白　(動) 解決；想出辦法
example_sentence: Having figured out the math problem, Sarah confidently explained her solution to the class.
sentence_zh: 弄明白了這道數學題後，莎拉自信地向班級解釋了她的解法。

definition_zh: (動) 計算；算出　(動) 理解；弄明白
example_sentence: The accountant who figured up the monthly expenses discovered a significant accounting error.
sentence_zh: 計算出月度支出的會計師發現了一個重大會計錯誤。

definition_zh: (名) 數字；人物　(動) 計算；想出　(形) 明顯的；易見的
example_sentence: If students figure out the math problem correctly, they will gain confidence for the exam.
sentence_zh: 如果學生能正確算出這道數學題，他們就會對考試更有信心。

definition_zh: (名) 小雕像；小塑像
example_sentence: My little sister collects ceramic figurines of famous cartoon characters.
sentence_zh: 我妹妹收集有名卡通人物的陶製小雕像。

definition_zh: (名) 絲聚蛋白；角蛋白
example_sentence: Dermatologists study filaggrin to understand skin barrier function and prevent dryness.
sentence_zh: 皮膚科醫生研究絲聚蛋白以了解皮膚屏障功能並預防乾燥。

definition_zh: (名) 細絲；燈絲　(名) 花絲；細長部分
example_sentence: The light bulb's glowing filament converts electrical energy into bright light.
sentence_zh: 燈泡發光的燈絲將電能轉化為明亮的光。

definition_zh: (動) 提交；申請　(名) 文件；檔案
example_sentence: After the company ignored multiple complaints, the consumer decided to file a suit against them in court.
sentence_zh: 在公司忽視多次投訴後，消費者決定向法院對其提起訴訟。

definition_zh: (動) 將...歸檔；整理文件　(動) 妥善保存；記住
example_sentence: Having filed away all the important documents, the secretary organized the office filing system more efficiently.
sentence_zh: 秘書將所有重要文件歸檔後，更有效率地組織了辦公室的檔案系統。

definition_zh: (動) 提交；申請　(動) 歸檔；整理
example_sentence: Students who file for scholarship must submit all required documents before the deadline.
sentence_zh: 申請獎學金的學生必須在截止日期前提交所有必要文件。

definition_zh: (名) 檔案；文件　(動) 提出；歸檔
example_sentence: Students must file their application forms before the deadline passes.
sentence_zh: 學生必須在截止日期前提交申請表。

definition_zh: (形) 孝順的；孝敬父母的
example_sentence: If students showed more filial respect, family relationships would become much stronger and happier.
sentence_zh: 如果學生表現出更多孝心，家庭關係就會變得更堅固和幸福。

definition_zh: (動) 代替；暫時替代
example_sentence: When the manager got sick, Sarah filled in for him at the meeting.
sentence_zh: 當經理生病時，莎拉在會議中代替他。

definition_zh: (動) 代替；替換　(動) 通知；告知最新情況
example_sentence: Filling in on the weekend shift, Mark discovered several inventory errors in the warehouse.
sentence_zh: 馬克代替週末班次上班時，在倉庫裡發現了幾個庫存錯誤。

definition_zh: (動) 填寫；填充　(動) 代替；替補
example_sentence: Before submitting the application form, students must fill in all required information carefully.
sentence_zh: 在提交申請表之前，學生必須仔細填寫所有必要資訊。

definition_zh: (動) 填寫；完成表格
example_sentence: Only after carefully reading the instructions did students fill out the application form.
sentence_zh: 只有仔細閱讀說明後，學生才填寫了申請表。

definition_zh: (動) 加滿；裝滿　(動) 完成；填寫
example_sentence: The gas station, which is located near our school, fills up many cars every day.
sentence_zh: 那間位於我們學校附近的加油站每天為許多汽車加滿汽油。

definition_zh: (動) 裝滿；填滿　(動) 補充；供應
example_sentence: Sarah bought a large water bottle to fill it with fresh juice every morning.
sentence_zh: 莎拉買了一個大水瓶，目的是每天早上裝滿新鮮果汁。

definition_zh: (名) 填充物；補牙　(形) 飽足的；令人滿足的
example_sentence: The dental filling helped restore the decayed tooth to its original shape and function.
sentence_zh: 牙科補牙材料幫助將蛀牙恢復到原來的形狀和功能。

definition_zh: (名) 電影；影片　(動) 拍攝；製作電影
example_sentence: My favorite film is about a young teacher helping poor students in a small village.
sentence_zh: 我最喜歡的電影是關於一位年輕老師幫助小村莊貧困學生的故事。

definition_zh: (名) 電影製作人；導演
example_sentence: Because the filmmaker wanted to tell a meaningful story, she spent two years researching the historical events.
sentence_zh: 因為電影製作人想要講述一個有意義的故事，她花了兩年時間研究歷史事件。

definition_zh: (動) 逐漸滲入；慢慢傳入
example_sentence: Rumors filtering into the classroom gradually changed students' opinions about the new teacher.
sentence_zh: 逐漸滲入教室的謠言慢慢改變了學生對新老師的看法。

definition_zh: (動) 濾出；排除掉　(動) 過濾掉不需要的東西
example_sentence: The water purifier filters out harmful chemicals that may damage human health.
sentence_zh: 這台淨水器濾出可能損害人體健康的有害化學物質。

definition_zh: (動) 過濾掉；篩選去除　排除；剔除
example_sentence: If students filter out unreliable sources, their research papers will become much more credible.
sentence_zh: 如果學生篩選掉不可靠的資料來源，他們的研究報告將會更加可信。

definition_zh: (名) 過濾器；篩選　(動) 過濾；篩選
example_sentence: Using a water filter helps remove harmful substances from drinking water.
sentence_zh: 使用淨水器有助於去除飲用水中的有害物質。

definition_zh: (名) 污垢；髒東西　(名) 下流的言語或思想
example_sentence: The workers wore masks to protect themselves from breathing in filth.
sentence_zh: 工人戴著口罩是為了保護自己免於吸入污垢。

definition_zh: (形) 骯髒的；污穢的　(形) 令人厭惡的；下流的
example_sentence: The abandoned factory with broken windows and filthy floors shocked everyone during the field trip.
sentence_zh: 那間廢棄工廠有破碎的窗戶和骯髒的地板，在校外教學時讓大家都感到震驚。

definition_zh: (名) 魚鰭；翅膀　(動) 用鰭划水；結束
example_sentence: As the shark moved closer, its dorsal fin broke the ocean surface.
sentence_zh: 當鯊魚靠近時，它的背鰭破出海面。

definition_zh: (形) 最後的；決定性的　(名) 決賽；期末考
example_sentence: Having studied hard for months, the student felt confident facing the final exam.
sentence_zh: 經過好幾個月的努力讀書，這個學生對期末考感到有信心。

definition_zh: (動) 最終確定；定案　完成；締結
example_sentence: The contract that the company finalized last week will take effect next month.
sentence_zh: 公司上週最終確定的合約將在下個月生效。

definition_zh: (副) 最後；終於　(副) 最終地；決定性地
example_sentence: After studying hard for months, students finally passed the difficult CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 經過幾個月的努力讀書，學生們終於通過了困難的學測考試。

definition_zh: (名) 財務；金錢　(動) 提供資金；籌資
example_sentence: If a student understood personal finance well, managing a scholarship budget would become much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果學生很了解個人財務管理，管理獎學金預算就會變得容易得多。

definition_zh: (形) 財務的；金融的　(形) 經濟的；財政的
example_sentence: Good financial planning helps students manage their pocket money wisely.
sentence_zh: 良好的財務規劃幫助學生明智地管理零用錢。

definition_zh: (副) 在財務上；在經濟上　就金錢方面而言
example_sentence: Financially struggling, many students work part-time jobs to support their families.
sentence_zh: 在財務上捉襟見肘，許多學生打工以支持家庭。

definition_zh: (動) 發現；查出　(動) 了解；得知
example_sentence: After the teacher graded the exam, students found out their mistakes and improved their study methods.
sentence_zh: 在老師批改考試後，學生們發現了他們的錯誤並改進了學習方法。

definition_zh: (動) 發現；找到　(動) 認為；發現
example_sentence: Only after careful research did students find the answer to the difficult question.
sentence_zh: 只有在仔細研究之後，學生們才發現了那個難題的答案。

definition_zh: (名) 發現；調查結果　(形) 有發現性的；引人注目的
example_sentence: The research finding that students presented at the conference impressed many professors.
sentence_zh: 學生們在會議上呈現的研究發現給許多教授留下了深刻印象。

definition_zh: (動) 精調；微調　(動) 改進；完善
example_sentence: Engineers adjusted the engine settings to fine-tune its performance for better fuel efficiency.
sentence_zh: 工程師調整引擎設定以精調其性能，達到更好的燃油效率。

definition_zh: (形) 很好的；優秀的　(形) 細的；精細的　(動) 罰款；處以罰金
example_sentence: The fine weather and beautiful scenery made the hiking trip absolutely unforgettable.
sentence_zh: 晴朗的天氣和美麗的風景使得登山之旅絕對難以忘懷。

definition_zh: (副) 細緻地；精細地　(副) 很好；不錯
example_sentence: The artist painted the details finely on the canvas.
sentence_zh: 這位藝術家在畫布上細緻地繪製了細節。

definition_zh: (名) 手指；手指形的東西　(動) 用手指指；指出
example_sentence: As the teacher pointed at the board, students noticed her finger touching the important formula.
sentence_zh: 當老師指向黑板時，學生注意到她的手指接觸到那個重要的公式。

definition_zh: (名) 指紋；手指印　(動) 留下指紋；記錄指紋
example_sentence: Having left fingerprints at the crime scene, the suspect was quickly identified by police.
sentence_zh: 由於在犯罪現場留下指紋，嫌疑人很快被警察識別出來。

definition_zh: (動) 完成；結束　(動) 消滅；打敗
example_sentence: The boxer finished off his opponent with a powerful punch that left everyone amazed.
sentence_zh: 那位拳擊手用一記強力揮拳完成了對手的擊敗，讓所有人都驚嘆不已。

definition_zh: (動) 用某物結束；最後以某物作為結尾
example_sentence: If the restaurant finishes up with a free dessert, customers would feel very satisfied.
sentence_zh: 如果餐廳最後送免費甜點，顧客會感到非常滿意。

definition_zh: (動) 完成；結束　(動) 用完；吃完
example_sentence: After finishing up homework, students can enjoy free time and relax.
sentence_zh: 完成功課後，學生可以享受自由時間並放鬆。

definition_zh: (動) 結束與...的關係；與...斷絕　(動) 用完；耗盡
example_sentence: After the argument, Maria decided to finish with her unreliable friend to focus on her studies.
sentence_zh: 爭執後，瑪麗亞決定與不可靠的朋友斷絕關係，以專注於學業。

definition_zh: (動) 完成；做完　(名) 結束；最後的部分
example_sentence: Finishing homework and studying hard are necessary for passing the exam.
sentence_zh: 完成功課和努力讀書是通過考試必要的。

definition_zh: (形) 完成的；結束的　(動) 完成；做完
example_sentence: Finished with his homework, David finally relaxed and watched his favorite drama series.
sentence_zh: 完成了功課後，大衛終於放鬆身心，看他最喜歡的連續劇。

definition_zh: (形) 有限的；有限度的　(名) 有限的事物
example_sentence: Having completed the finite project within the deadline, the team celebrated their success.
sentence_zh: 在截止日期前完成了有限的專案，團隊為他們的成功歡慶。

definition_zh: (動) 告密；背叛　(片) 向…告密；檢舉
example_sentence: The student who finked on his classmates during the cheating scandal faced social isolation.
sentence_zh: 在作弊醜聞中向同學告密的那名學生遭到社交孤立。

definition_zh: (動) 臨陣退縮；放棄承諾
example_sentence: Tom promised to help with the project, but he finked out at the last moment.
sentence_zh: 湯姆答應幫助這個項目，但他在最後一刻臨陣退縮了。

definition_zh: (片) 開始說話；暢所欲言　(動) 開槍；發射
example_sentence: If the teacher asked for questions, students would fire away without hesitation.
sentence_zh: 如果老師要求提問，學生會毫不猶豫地暢所欲言。

definition_zh: (動) 迅速發射；快速提出　(動) 快速說出；連珠砲似地講
example_sentence: The reporter fired off several tough questions at the politician during the press conference.
sentence_zh: 記者在記者會上向政治人物連珠砲似地提出了幾個尖銳問題。

definition_zh: (動) 激發；點燃　使興奮；使活躍
example_sentence: Fired up by the coach's motivational speech, the basketball team dominated the second half.
sentence_zh: 受到教練激勵性演講的鼓舞，籃球隊在下半場表現得非常出色。

definition_zh: (名) 火；火災　(動) 開槍；射擊　(動) 解雇；開除
example_sentence: As the fire spread rapidly, families evacuated their homes before it was too late.
sentence_zh: 當火勢迅速蔓延時，家庭在為時已晚之前撤離了家園。

definition_zh: (名) 鞭炮；爆竹
example_sentence: Only after the clock strikes midnight do children eagerly light firecrackers outside.
sentence_zh: 只有在時鐘敲響午夜之後，孩子們才熱切地在外面點燃鞭炮。

definition_zh: (名) 消防員；火災救援人員
example_sentence: The firefighters who arrived quickly at the burning building rescued everyone inside.
sentence_zh: 及時趕到燃燒建築物的消防員救出了裡面的每一個人。

definition_zh: (名) 壁爐；火爐
example_sentence: The family gathered around the fireplace to stay warm during winter.
sentence_zh: 家人聚集在壁爐周圍以在冬天保持溫暖。

definition_zh: (形) 防火的；耐火的　(動) 使防火；防火處理
example_sentence: Modern office buildings require fireproof materials to protect workers from potential fire hazards.
sentence_zh: 現代辦公大樓需要防火材料來保護員工免受火災危險。

definition_zh: (名) 煙火；炮竹　(名) 焰火表演；烟花秀
example_sentence: Fireworks light up the night sky during the Lunar New Year celebration.
sentence_zh: 春節慶祝活動期間，煙火照亮了夜空。

definition_zh: (動) 使堅定；確認　鞏固；使穩固
example_sentence: As the exam approaches, many students firm up their study plans before they fall behind.
sentence_zh: 當考試臨近時，許多學生在落後之前確認他們的讀書計畫。

definition_zh: (形) 堅固的；結實的　(動) 使堅固；成立
example_sentence: Having firmly grasped the concept, students found the physics exam manageable and less intimidating.
sentence_zh: 學生已牢牢掌握該概念，發現物理考試易於應付且不那麼令人害怕。

definition_zh: (副) 堅定地；牢固地　(副) 堅決地；果斷地
example_sentence: The teacher firmly believes that students who study consistently will achieve excellent exam results.
sentence_zh: 這位老師堅定相信，那些持續用功唸書的學生會取得優異的考試成績。

definition_zh: (形) 一流的；頂級的　(名) 頭等艙；一等車廂
example_sentence: If students submit first-class work, teachers will recognize their effort and dedication.
sentence_zh: 如果學生繳交一流的作業，老師就會認可他們的努力和用心。

definition_zh: (形) 第一的；最初的　(副) 首先；最初
example_sentence: My first day at school was exciting and a little nervous.
sentence_zh: 我上學的第一天既興奮又有點緊張。

definition_zh: (副) 首先；第一　(副) 最初；起初
example_sentence: Firstly, students need to review their notes to prepare for the exam.
sentence_zh: 首先，學生需要複習筆記以準備考試。

definition_zh: (形) 財政的；稅收的　(形) 國庫的；政府預算的
example_sentence: The government's fiscal policy directly affects tax rates and public spending programs.
sentence_zh: 政府的財政政策直接影響稅率和公共支出計畫。

definition_zh: (動) 探聽；打探　尋求；試圖獲得
example_sentence: As the reporter fished for information, the witness became increasingly nervous and evasive.
sentence_zh: 當這位記者試圖打探資訊時，證人變得越來越緊張和閃爍其詞。

definition_zh: (動) 釣出；從水中取出　撈出；尋找並找到
example_sentence: Having fished out the lost keys from the drain, Maria felt relieved and grateful.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞從排水管中撈出丟失的鑰匙後，感到寬慰和感激。

definition_zh: (名) 魚　(動) 釣魚；捕魚
example_sentence: The fish that swim in the ocean are often larger than those in rivers.
sentence_zh: 在海洋中游動的魚通常比河裡的魚更大。

definition_zh: (名) 魚；魚肉　(動) 釣魚；捕魚
example_sentence: Every summer, fishing enthusiasts gather at the riverside to catch freshwater fish for dinner.
sentence_zh: 每個夏天，釣魚愛好者都在河邊聚集，捕捉淡水魚當晚餐。

definition_zh: (名) 漁夫；漁民
example_sentence: If the fisherman had checked the weather forecast, he would have avoided the storm.
sentence_zh: 如果漁夫當時有查看天氣預報，他就會避免遇到暴風雨。

definition_zh: (名) 漁業；魚類養殖
example_sentence: Japan's fishery industry produces high-quality seafood for global markets.
sentence_zh: 日本的漁業為全球市場生產高品質的海產品。

definition_zh: (名) 釣魚；捕魚　(動) 釣魚；捕魚
example_sentence: Fishing by the river every weekend, Mark catches many fish and enjoys the peaceful time.
sentence_zh: 每個週末在河邊釣魚，Mark 抓到很多魚，並且享受寧靜的時光。

definition_zh: (形) 可疑的；令人懷疑的　(形) 有魚腥味的；像魚的
example_sentence: Although the businessman's explanation sounded reasonable, something about his story seemed fishy to everyone.
sentence_zh: 雖然那位商人的解釋聽起來很合理，但他的故事對每個人來說都有些可疑。

definition_zh: (名) 核分裂；分裂
example_sentence: Only after scientists understood nuclear fission could energy production advance rapidly.
sentence_zh: 直到科學家了解核分裂之後，能源生產才能迅速進展。

definition_zh: (名) [`fɪʃɚ] 裂縫；裂隙　(動) [fɪ`ʃɚ] 裂開；分裂
example_sentence: The canyon wall, which contained a deep fissure, worried experienced climbers during their expedition.
sentence_zh: 那面峽谷岩壁含有一道深裂縫，令經驗豐富的登山者在遠足中感到擔憂。

definition_zh: (名) 拳頭；緊握的手　(動) 握拳；用拳頭打
example_sentence: Athletes clench their fists to build strength for boxing matches.
sentence_zh: 運動員握緊拳頭來為拳擊比賽增強力量。

definition_zh: (動) 適應；融入　ɪn 在…裡面　wɪð 與…一起 適應環境或融入群體
example_sentence: Moving to a new school, Sarah gradually fit in with her classmates through shared interests.
sentence_zh: 搬到新學校後，莎拉透過共同興趣逐漸融入同學群體。

definition_zh: (動) 融入；適應　(動) 擠出時間；安排
example_sentence: Moving to a new school, Sarah tried hard to fit in with her classmates.
sentence_zh: 搬到新學校後，莎拉努力地融入她的同學之中。

definition_zh: (動) 適應；融入　(動) 進入；陷入
example_sentence: As Sarah adjusted her fashion style, fitting into the new school community became much easier.
sentence_zh: 當莎拉調整了她的穿著風格後，融入新學校社群就變得容易得多。

definition_zh: (動) 配備；裝備
example_sentence: Being fitted out with modern equipment, the new laboratory attracted many talented researchers.
sentence_zh: 新實驗室配備了現代化設備，吸引了許多才華洋溢的研究人員。

definition_zh: (動) 裝備；配置　(動) 為…裝備
example_sentence: The new school library, which was fitted out with modern computers and comfortable seating, became a popular study space.
sentence_zh: 這間新學校圖書館配備了現代化電腦和舒適座椅，成為受歡迎的讀書場所。

definition_zh: (片) 符合要求；滿足需要
example_sentence: If the new smartphone fits the bill for your budget and features, purchasing it would be a smart choice.
sentence_zh: 如果這支新手機符合你的預算和功能需要，購買它將是個聰明的選擇。

definition_zh: (動) 裝備；布置　(動) 設置；準備
example_sentence: The company fitted up the new office with modern furniture and computers.
sentence_zh: 那家公司用現代家具和電腦裝備了新辦公室。

definition_zh: (動) 適合；符合　(形) 健康的；合適的　(名) 發作；適合度
example_sentence: Regular exercise helps students fit into university sports teams successfully.
sentence_zh: 規律運動幫助學生成功地適應大學運動隊。

definition_zh: (名) 健身；體適能　(名) 適合度；適應性
example_sentence: Regular exercise and a balanced diet improve your physical fitness and overall health.
sentence_zh: 定期運動和均衡飲食能提升你的身體健身和整體健康。

definition_zh: (形) 合身的；貼身的　(形) 裝有…的；配備…的
example_sentence: Fitted with advanced safety features, the new smartphone appeals to many teenagers concerned about data protection.
sentence_zh: 由於配備了先進的安全功能，這款新智慧手機吸引了許多關心資料保護的青少年。

definition_zh: (形) 合適的；恰當的　(名) 試穿；配件
example_sentence: Having tried on several dresses, Sarah finally found a fitting outfit for the school dance.
sentence_zh: 莎拉試穿了幾件洋裝後，終於找到一套適合學校舞會的衣服。

definition_zh: (名) 五；五個　(形) 五的；五個的
example_sentence: The five students who won the competition will receive scholarships next month.
sentence_zh: 那五名贏得比賽的學生下個月將獲得獎學金。

definition_zh: (動) 修理；整修　(動) 安排；準備
example_sentence: My brother is fixing up his old car to sell it next month.
sentence_zh: 我哥哥正在修理他的舊車，準備下個月賣掉。

definition_zh: (動) 修理；修復　(動) 安排；決定
example_sentence: If the broken laptop were fixed before the exam, studying for the test would become much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果這台壞掉的筆電在考試前被修好，為考試準備就會變得容易得多。

definition_zh: (形) 執著的；沉迷的　(動) 固定；集中
example_sentence: Many students become fixated on achieving perfect scores in the exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生沉迷於在考試中取得完美成績。

definition_zh: (名) 固著；執著　(名) 痴迷；過度關注
example_sentence: Becoming obsessed with social media, many teenagers develop an unhealthy fixation on likes and comments.
sentence_zh: 沉迷於社群媒體，許多青少年對按讚和留言產生了不健康的執著。

definition_zh: (形) 固定的；確定的　(動) 修理；解決
example_sentence: The meeting time is fixed, so all team members must arrive on time.
sentence_zh: 既然會議時間已確定，所有團隊成員必須準時到達。

definition_zh: (名) 固定裝置；燈具　(名) 經常參加的人或事物
example_sentence: Only after the new light fixtures were installed did the classroom become brighter.
sentence_zh: 只有在安裝了新燈具之後，教室才變得更亮。

definition_zh: (動) 逐漸消失；無疾而終
example_sentence: The team's initial enthusiasm fizzled out when they faced difficulties that seemed impossible to overcome.
sentence_zh: 當球隊面對似乎無法克服的困難時，他們最初的熱情逐漸消失了。

definition_zh: (形) 非常驚訝的；目瞪口呆的
example_sentence: The student was flabbergasted to discover winning first prize at the national science competition.
sentence_zh: 那位學生驚訝地發現自己贏得全國科學競賽第一名。

definition_zh: (動) 揮手示意停下；攔下
example_sentence: The police officer flagged down the speeding car on the highway.
sentence_zh: 警察在高速公路上揮手示意那輛超速汽車停下。

definition_zh: (動) 標記；指出　提醒注意
example_sentence: The teacher flagged up several grammar mistakes in the student's essay.
sentence_zh: 老師在學生的作文中標記出幾個文法錯誤。

definition_zh: (名) 旗幟；國旗　(動) 衰退；標記　(形) 疲乏的；無力的
example_sentence: As the runner's energy flagged during the race, coaches encouraged him to push harder.
sentence_zh: 當跑者在比賽中體力衰退時，教練鼓勵他更加努力。

definition_zh: (形) 明目張膽的；極其明顯的　(形) 嚴重的；惡劣的
example_sentence: Violating the school rules so openly, the student's flagrant disobedience shocked everyone.
sentence_zh: 公然違反校規，那位學生明目張膽的不服從令所有人都感到震驚。

definition_zh: (名) 旗艦；代表作　(形) 最重要的；首屈一指的
example_sentence: Apple's iPhone, which is the company's flagship product, continues to dominate the smartphone market worldwide.
sentence_zh: 蘋果公司的 iPhone 是該公司的旗艦產品，持續在全球智慧型手機市場佔據主導地位。

definition_zh: (動) 臨陣脫逃；放鴿子　(動) 疲勞而無法繼續
example_sentence: If the concert ticket sales flake out, the organizers will need to find another venue.
sentence_zh: 如果演唱會售票臨陣脫逃，主辦單位將需要找另一個場地。

definition_zh: (名) 薄片；碎片　(動) 剝落；脫落
example_sentence: Paint flakes off the old wooden door when exposed to heavy rain.
sentence_zh: 當舊木門暴露在大雨中時，油漆會剝落。

definition_zh: (動) 突然燃起；迅速蔓延　(動) 突然發怒；激烈爆發
example_sentence: The campfire began to flame up to keep everyone warm during the cold night.
sentence_zh: 營火開始熊熊燃燒以在寒冷的夜晚保持每個人的溫暖。

definition_zh: (名) 火焰；火苗　(動) 燃燒；發火　(形) 火紅的；激烈的
example_sentence: The candle flame danced gently in the dark room.
sentence_zh: 蠟燭的火焰在黑暗房間裡輕輕搖曳。

definition_zh: (形) 易燃的；可燃的
example_sentence: Because the material is highly flammable, workers must keep it away from heat sources.
sentence_zh: 因為這種材料易燃，工人必須將它遠離熱源。

definition_zh: (名) 側面；側翼　(動) 位於…的側面；迂迴攻擊
example_sentence: Flanked by two security guards, the president walked through the crowded airport terminal.
sentence_zh: 被兩名保安人員護衛著，總統走過擁擠的機場航廈。

definition_zh: (名) 拍打；襟翼　(動) 拍動；揮動　(形) 鬆垂的；搖晃的
example_sentence: The tent flap, which was damaged in the storm, needed immediate repair.
sentence_zh: 在暴風雨中受損的帳篷襟翼需要立即修理。

definition_zh: (動) 向外張開；擴張　(動) 逐漸加寬；喇叭口
example_sentence: The dancer's skirt flared out beautifully when she spun across the stage.
sentence_zh: 舞者在舞台上旋轉時，她的裙子優美地向外張開。

definition_zh: (動) 突然惡化；突然發作　(動) 突然爆發；激烈起來
example_sentence: If Sarah didn't take her allergy medicine, her symptoms would flare up during spring.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉沒有服用過敏藥物，她在春天的症狀就會突然惡化。

definition_zh: (名) 閃光；信號彈　(動) 閃耀；突然變亮　(形) 喇叭形的；展開的
example_sentence: The emergency flare lit up the dark sky and guided the rescue team to the ship.
sentence_zh: 緊急信號彈照亮了黑暗的天空，引導救援隊找到那艘船。

definition_zh: (名) 閃光；一瞬間　(動) 閃爍；迅速移動　(形) 華麗的；時髦的
example_sentence: Flashing across the night sky, the meteor caught everyone's attention instantly.
sentence_zh: 流星在夜空中閃爍而過，立刻吸引了所有人的注意。

definition_zh: (名) 手電筒；閃光燈
example_sentence: When the power went out, Sarah grabbed her flashlight so she could find her way downstairs safely.
sentence_zh: 當停電時，莎拉拿起手電筒，這樣她就能安全地找到下樓的路。

definition_zh: (形) 華麗的；炫耀的　(形) 閃亮的；耀眼的
example_sentence: Seldom does such flashy jewelry appeal to students who prefer simple style.
sentence_zh: 這樣華麗的珠寶很少吸引喜歡簡約風格的學生。

definition_zh: (形) 平坦的；扁平的　(形) 單調的；乏味的
example_sentence: The apartment that Sarah rented has a flat roof where neighbors often gather.
sentence_zh: 莎拉租的公寓有一個平坦的屋頂，鄰居經常在那裡聚集。

definition_zh: (動) 諂媚；奉承　(動) 使…顯得更好看
example_sentence: Politicians often flatter voters to win their support during elections.
sentence_zh: 政治人物經常奉承選民以贏得他們在選舉中的支持。

definition_zh: (動) 奉承；吹捧　(動) 使顯得更好看；使顯得漂亮
example_sentence: Flattering comments from classmates boosted Lisa's confidence before the presentation.
sentence_zh: 來自同學的奉承話語在簡報前提升了麗莎的信心。

definition_zh: (形) 奉承的；討好的　(動) 奉承；恭維
example_sentence: The flattering comments about her presentation made her feel proud and confident.
sentence_zh: 關於她報告的奉承言語讓她感到驕傲和自信。

definition_zh: (名) 風味；味道　(動) 調味；加香料
example_sentence: As the chocolate melted on my tongue, its rich flavor filled my mouth completely.
sentence_zh: 當巧克力在我舌頭上融化時，它濃郁的風味完全充滿了我的口腔。

definition_zh: (名) 調味料；香料　(動) 添加調味料；使有風味
example_sentence: Using natural flavoring, the baker created a delicious vanilla cake loved by customers.
sentence_zh: 麵包師傅用天然調味料製作蛋糕，創造出顧客喜愛的美味香草蛋糕。

definition_zh: (名) 缺點；瑕疵　(動) 使有缺陷
example_sentence: The phone design has a flaw that affects its durability, which disappointed many customers.
sentence_zh: 這支手機的設計有一個影響其耐用性的缺點，令許多顧客失望。

definition_zh: (形) 有缺陷的；不完美的　(形) 有漏洞的；有問題的
example_sentence: If the experiment's design were not flawed, the results would be more reliable.
sentence_zh: 如果實驗的設計沒有缺陷，結果會更可靠。

definition_zh: (形) 完美的；無缺陷的　(形) 無瑕疵的；完善的
example_sentence: The dancer's flawless performance earned a standing ovation from the audience.
sentence_zh: 那位舞者完美無缺的表演贏得了觀眾的起立鼓掌。

definition_zh: (名) 跳蚤　(動) 使跳躍；驅趕
example_sentence: Pet owners use special shampoo to remove fleas from their dogs and cats.
sentence_zh: 寵物主人使用特殊洗髮精來清除狗和貓身上的跳蚤。

definition_zh: (動) 逃跑；逃離　(動) 倉皇離去
example_sentence: Hearing the fire alarm, students fled the building quickly and safely.
sentence_zh: 聽到火警警報，學生們迅速安全地逃離了校舍。

definition_zh: (名) 艦隊；船隊　(形) 快速的；敏捷的　(動) 快速移動；掠過
example_sentence: As the warships sailed across the ocean, the entire fleet moved swiftly toward their destination.
sentence_zh: 當軍艦駛過大洋時，整個艦隊迅速朝著目的地前進。

definition_zh: (形) 短暫的；轉瞬即逝的　(動) 飛逝；匆匆掠過
example_sentence: Having cherished fleeting moments with old friends, Maria realized how precious their time together truly was.
sentence_zh: 瑪莉亞珍惜了與老友短暫相聚的時光後，才明白他們在一起的時間有多珍貴。

definition_zh: (副) 短暫地；轉瞬即逝地
example_sentence: A smile fleetingly crossed her face when the good news arrived.
sentence_zh: 當好消息傳來時，微笑在她臉上轉瞬即逝。

definition_zh: (動) 充實；豐富　發展；補充細節
example_sentence: The author fleshed out the character's background with many personal details and memories.
sentence_zh: 那位作者用許多個人細節和回憶充實了角色的背景故事。

definition_zh: (名) 肉；肉體　(動) 使豐滿；充實　(形) 肉色的；淡紅色的
example_sentence: If the author developed the character's background more, the story would gain much needed flesh and emotional depth.
sentence_zh: 如果作者更多地發展人物的背景，故事會增加急需的血肉和情感深度。

definition_zh: (動) 炫耀；展示　(動) 彎曲；伸縮
example_sentence: The athlete flexed his muscles after winning the championship.
sentence_zh: 那位運動員在贏得冠軍後炫耀了他的肌肉。

definition_zh: (形) 柔軟的；易彎曲的　(形) 靈活的；有適應力的
example_sentence: Having a flexible schedule, students can balance study and extracurricular activities more effectively.
sentence_zh: 擁有靈活的時間表，學生能更有效地平衡學習和課外活動。

definition_zh: (動) 快速翻動；輕撥 翻過；越過
example_sentence: As Sarah flicked over the pages of her notebook, she realized she had forgotten half the chemistry notes.
sentence_zh: 當莎拉快速翻動筆記本的頁面時，她意識到自己忘記了一半的化學筆記。

definition_zh: (動) 快速翻閱；匆匆瀏覽
example_sentence: Seldom does Maria flick through a magazine without finding an interesting article.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞很少翻閱雜誌卻找不到有趣的文章。

definition_zh: (動) 輕彈；快速翻動　(名) 輕快的動作；電影
example_sentence: The magician performed a card trick that delighted the audience watching the flick.
sentence_zh: 這位魔術師表演了一個讓觀看把戲的觀眾感到高興的翻牌魔術。

definition_zh: (動) 閃爍；抖動　(名) 閃爍；微弱的光
example_sentence: The candle flame began to flicker to warn us about the coming storm.
sentence_zh: 蠟燭火焰開始閃爍，警告我們暴風雨即將來臨。

definition_zh: (名) 飛行；航班　(名) 逃跑；逃離　(動) 飛；飛行
example_sentence: The morning flight to Taipei departed on time despite heavy rain.
sentence_zh: 儘管下著大雨，早上飛往台北的班機還是準時起飛。

definition_zh: (動) 用力拋；猛然投擲　(名) 短暫的戀愛關係；一段時間
example_sentence: Sarah flung her backpack onto the bed after a long school day.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在漫長的上課日後，把背包猛地扔到床上。

definition_zh: (動) 用手指彈開；快速翻動　(動) 無禮地對待；頂嘴
example_sentence: When the teacher gave him homework, the student flipped off the assignment as if it were worthless.
sentence_zh: 當老師給他作業時，這個學生無禮地翻掉作業，彷彿它毫無價值。

definition_zh: (動) 發瘋；失控　(動) 變得非常興奮
example_sentence: Failing the math test, Sarah flipped out and threw her pencil across the classroom.
sentence_zh: 數學考試不及格，莎拉失控了，把鉛筆扔過教室。

definition_zh: (動) 快速翻閱；翻動
example_sentence: The magazine that Sarah flipped through contained fashion trends she wanted to follow.
sentence_zh: 莎拉快速翻閱的那本雜誌包含了她想追隨的時尚趨勢。

definition_zh: (名) 夾腳拖鞋；人字拖　(動) 翻轉；搖擺　(名) 政策或意見的突然改變
example_sentence: If you wear flip-flops to the beach, your feet will stay comfortable and dry.
sentence_zh: 如果你穿著夾腳拖鞋到海灘，你的腳會保持舒適和乾燥。

definition_zh: (名) 言行不一致的人；改變立場的人
example_sentence: The politician became a flip-flopper after changing his position on tax policy.
sentence_zh: 那位政治人物在改變稅收政策立場後，成為言行不一致的人。

definition_zh: (動) 翻轉；翻動　(動) 快速切換；按動開關
example_sentence: Students flip through their textbooks to find the grammar section quickly.
sentence_zh: 學生翻閱課本以便快速找到文法段落。

definition_zh: (動) 漂浮；浮動　(名) 浮體；木筏
example_sentence: Leaves and small branches float downstream after heavy rain.
sentence_zh: 大雨後，樹葉和小樹枝沿著溪流漂浮而下。

definition_zh: (名) 羊群；一大群　(動) 聚集；成群結隊
example_sentence: As tourists flock to the beach during summer vacation, local shops become very busy.
sentence_zh: 當遊客在暑假期間蜂擁至海灘時，當地商店變得非常忙碌。

definition_zh: (動) 廉價出售；甩賣　(動) 售出；處理
example_sentence: Having flogged off the old furniture online, the shop owner finally opened up space for new inventory.
sentence_zh: 在網路上廉價出售舊家具後，店主終於為新商品騰出了空間。

definition_zh: (名) 洪水；大量　(動) 淹沒；湧入　(形) 泛濫的；溢出的
example_sentence: The village that experienced the terrible flood last summer has gradually recovered.
sentence_zh: 去年夏天經歷過可怕洪水的村莊已逐漸復甦。

definition_zh: (名) 洪水；淹水　(動) 泛濫；氾濫　(形) 大量的；過量的
example_sentence: Heavy rainfall caused severe flooding in the southern region last month.
sentence_zh: 上個月大雨導致南部地區發生嚴重的洪水氾濫。

definition_zh: (動) 踩足油門；全速前進
example_sentence: If the driver floored it on the highway, the sports car would reach one hundred kilometers per hour easily.
sentence_zh: 如果駕駛在高速公路上踩足油門，這輛跑車就能輕鬆達到時速一百公里。

definition_zh: (名) 地板；樓層　(動) 打倒；使困惑
example_sentence: Please take off your shoes before stepping on the clean floor.
sentence_zh: 踩上乾淨的地板前，請脫掉你的鞋子。

definition_zh: (動) 失敗；不成功　(名) 失敗作品；失敗
example_sentence: Flopping on the final exam, the student decided to study harder next semester.
sentence_zh: 在期末考試上失敗了，那個學生決定下學期更努力讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 植物群；花草　(名) 腸道菌群；菌叢
example_sentence: While the tropical rainforest's flora thrives in humid conditions, desert plants adapt differently.
sentence_zh: 當熱帶雨林的植物群在潮濕環境中繁茂時，沙漠植物的適應方式卻截然不同。

definition_zh: (形) 花的；花卉的　(形) 花紋的；花朵圖案的
example_sentence: Not only did the garden display beautiful roses, but also were the floral decorations throughout the wedding venue simply stunning.
sentence_zh: 不僅花園展示了美麗的玫瑰，而且整個婚禮會場的花卉裝飾也非常令人驚嘆。

definition_zh: (名) 花卉商人；花店老闆
example_sentence: The florist who arranges beautiful bouquets works near our school.
sentence_zh: 那位能夠安排美麗花束的花卉商人在我們學校附近工作。

definition_zh: (名) 花藝；插花藝術　(名) 花店業務
example_sentence: Many students learn floristry to create beautiful arrangements for weddings.
sentence_zh: 許多學生學習花藝以便為婚禮設計出美麗的花卉布置。

definition_zh: (動) 生氣地離開；憤然離去
example_sentence: After losing the debate, the angry student flounced off without saying goodbye.
sentence_zh: 辯論失敗後，那名生氣的學生生氣地離開，沒有說再見。

definition_zh: (動) 氣沖沖地走出去；生氣地離開
example_sentence: After the argument, Maria flounced out of the classroom without saying a word.
sentence_zh: 爭吵後，瑪麗亞氣沖沖地走出教室，一句話也沒說。

definition_zh: (動) 掙扎；踉蹌　(動) 困惑；不知所措
example_sentence: Although the swimmer floundered in the deep water, the lifeguard quickly rescued them.
sentence_zh: 雖然游泳者在深水中掙扎，救生員還是迅速救了他們。

definition_zh: (名) 麵粉；粉末
example_sentence: Using white flour mixed with water, the baker created a smooth dough for the cake.
sentence_zh: 烘焙師傅用白麵粉混合水，揉製出蛋糕光滑的麵糊。

definition_zh: (動) 繁榮；興旺　(名) 繁榮；華麗的動作
example_sentence: The small business that adopted new technology flourished in ways that competitors who refused change could never imagine.
sentence_zh: 採用新技術的小企業以拒絕改變的競爭對手無法想像的方式繁榮發展。

definition_zh: (形) 繁榮的；興盛的　(動) 蓬勃發展；茁壯成長
example_sentence: If the startup receives more investment, its flourishing business will create many job opportunities.
sentence_zh: 如果這家新創公司獲得更多投資，它繁榮的業務將創造許多工作機會。

definition_zh: (名) 流動；流量　(動) 流動；流過
example_sentence: Water flows down the mountain into the river every day.
sentence_zh: 水每天從山上流下來進入河裡。

definition_zh: (名) 流程圖；程序圖
example_sentence: Students use flowcharts to organize their essay ideas before writing.
sentence_zh: 學生使用流程圖來組織寫作前的論文想法。

definition_zh: (名) 花；花朵　(動) 開花；盛開
example_sentence: The sunflower in the garden blooms bright yellow every summer.
sentence_zh: 花園裡的向日葵每個夏天都綻放明亮的黃色。

definition_zh: (名) 流感；感冒
example_sentence: Since the flu spread quickly through the school, many students stayed home last week.
sentence_zh: 因為流感在學校快速傳播，許多學生上週待在家裡。

definition_zh: (動) 波動；變化　(名) 波動；變化
example_sentence: Having fluctuated sharply last month, the stock price now stabilizes gradually.
sentence_zh: 上個月股價劇烈波動後，現在逐漸趨於穩定。

definition_zh: (名) 波動；變化　(名) 漲跌；起伏
example_sentence: Stock prices, which experienced significant fluctuation last month, recovered gradually.
sentence_zh: 上月經歷顯著波動的股價逐漸恢復。

definition_zh: (名) 流暢；流利　(名) 說話或寫作的順暢度
example_sentence: Practicing English conversations daily improves fluency and builds confidence in speaking.
sentence_zh: 每天練習英文對話能夠提高流暢度並增強說話信心。

definition_zh: (形) 流利的；流暢的　(形) 說話自然流利的
example_sentence: If Maria practiced English conversation daily, she would become fluent in six months.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪麗亞每天練習英文會話，她六個月內就會變得流利。

definition_zh: (副) 流暢地；熟練地　(副) 清晰地；順暢地
example_sentence: Speaking English fluently requires consistent practice and daily conversation with native speakers.
sentence_zh: 要能流暢地說英文，需要持續練習和每天與母語人士交談。

definition_zh: (名) 蓬鬆物；絨毛　(動) 使蓬鬆；弄蓬鬆
example_sentence: Fluffing the pillow before bed, Sarah felt more comfortable sleeping.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在睡前把枕頭拍蓬鬆，感到睡眠更加舒適。

definition_zh: (形) 蓬鬆的；軟綿綿的　(形) 輕飄飄的；不實在的
example_sentence: The cake tasted delicious because the baker whisked the batter until it became fluffy and light.
sentence_zh: 因為烘焙師傅把麵糊打到蓬鬆輕盈，所以這個蛋糕吃起來很美味。

definition_zh: (形) 流動的；流暢的　(名) 流體；液體
example_sentence: Only after the engineer adjusted the pressure would the fluid flow smoothly through the pipeline.
sentence_zh: 只有在工程師調整了壓力之後，流體才會順暢地流過管道。

definition_zh: (動) 不及格；失敗　(名) 不及格；失敗者
example_sentence: Students who flunk the midterm exam must attend summer school.
sentence_zh: 不及格期中考的學生必須參加暑期輔導課。

definition_zh: (形) 螢光的；發螢光的　(形) 明亮的；容易引人注目的
example_sentence: Schools install fluorescent lights to brighten classrooms and reduce eye strain.
sentence_zh: 學校裝設螢光燈以照亮教室並減輕眼睛疲勞。

definition_zh: (名) 一陣；小陣風　(動) 匆匆地做；急速移動
example_sentence: A sudden flurry of snow and wind made the morning walk difficult.
sentence_zh: 突然一陣雪和風使早晨散步變得困難。

definition_zh: (動) 沖洗；沖水　(形) 臉紅的；充足的
example_sentence: Remember to flush the toilet after using the bathroom.
sentence_zh: 使用浴室後記得沖水。

definition_zh: (動) 使慌張；使困惑　(名) 慌張；混亂
example_sentence: Although the unexpected question flustered the student, she still managed to answer confidently.
sentence_zh: 雖然那個突如其來的問題使這位學生感到慌張，她仍然成功地自信地回答了。

definition_zh: (名) 長笛；豎笛　(動) 吹奏長笛
example_sentence: Playing the flute during the school concert, Sarah impressed everyone with her beautiful performance.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在校園音樂會上吹奏長笛，以優美的表現給大家留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (動) 飄動；振翅　(名) 顫動；興奮
example_sentence: The butterfly whose wings flutter gracefully in the garden attracts many visitors.
sentence_zh: 翅膀在花園裡優雅飄動的蝴蝶吸引了許多遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 流動；變化　(動) 流動；變化
example_sentence: If the magnetic flux in the coil increases, the induced current would flow in the opposite direction.
sentence_zh: 如果線圈中的磁通量增加，感應電流就會反向流動。

definition_zh: (動) 到處飛翔；飛來飛去
example_sentence: Butterflies fly about the garden, visiting colorful flowers every morning.
sentence_zh: 蝴蝶每天早上在花園裡飛來飛去，拜訪五顏六色的花朵。

definition_zh: (動) 撲向；攻擊　(動) 猛烈抨擊；厲聲責罵
example_sentence: The angry customer flew at the manager to complain about the poor service.
sentence_zh: 那位憤怒的顧客撲向經理以抱怨糟糕的服務。

definition_zh: (動) 快速飛過；匆匆經過　(動) (時間)飛快流逝
example_sentence: Time flies by when students study hard for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 當學生努力準備學測時，時間飛快流逝。

definition_zh: (動) 勃然大怒；突然發火　(動) 衝進；急速進入
example_sentence: When the teacher announced the surprise exam, students flew into a panic because they hadn't studied the new material.
sentence_zh: 當老師宣布臨時考試時，學生們勃然大怒，因為他們還沒有複習新課程。

definition_zh: (動) 飛；飛行　(名) 蒼蠅；飛行
example_sentence: Having flown across the Pacific Ocean, the airplane finally landed at Taipei International Airport.
sentence_zh: 飛越太平洋後，這架飛機終於降落在台北國際機場。

definition_zh: (名) 傳單；宣傳品　(名) 飛行員；飛鳥
example_sentence: The colorful flyer that was distributed at school announced the upcoming sports day.
sentence_zh: 在學校發放的那份彩色傳單宣布了即將到來的運動會。

definition_zh: (名) 泡沫；泡　(動) 產生泡沫；起泡
example_sentence: The coffee maker produces thick foam on top of each drink.
sentence_zh: 咖啡機在每杯飲料頂部產生濃密的泡沫。

definition_zh: (形) 多泡沫的；起泡的
example_sentence: If the coffee were foamy, the milk would have been beaten too long.
sentence_zh: 如果咖啡很多泡沫，那表示牛奶被打太久了。

definition_zh: (動) 把不好的東西推給別人；欺騙
example_sentence: The salesman tried to fob off defective products on unsuspecting customers.
sentence_zh: 那個銷售員試圖把有瑕疵的產品推銷給毫無戒心的顧客。

definition_zh: (動) 用借口搪塞；敷衍打發
example_sentence: Dismissing the student's concerns with vague promises, the principal fobbed off with empty reassurances about school safety.
sentence_zh: 校長用模糊的承諾打發學生的擔憂，敷衍了關於校園安全的空洞保證。

definition_zh: (動) 敷衍；搪塞　(動) 推卸責任；賴掉
example_sentence: Although the manager promised to solve the problem, he fobbed off the angry customer with vague excuses.
sentence_zh: 雖然經理承諾解決問題，但他用含糊的藉口敷衍那位生氣的顧客。

definition_zh: (動) 專注於；集中於
example_sentence: Only by focusing on their studies can students improve their test scores significantly.
sentence_zh: 只有專注於功課，學生才能顯著提高考試成績。

definition_zh: (名) 焦點；中心　(動) 集中；聚焦
example_sentence: The camera's focus, which the photographer adjusted carefully, captured the sunset in stunning detail.
sentence_zh: 攝影師仔細調整的相機焦點，清晰地捕捉了令人驚嘆的日落景象。

definition_zh: (名) 飼料；草料　(名) 粗劣內容；素材
example_sentence: The farm produces cheap grain to use as fodder for livestock.
sentence_zh: 這個農場生產廉價的穀物作為牲畜的飼料。

definition_zh: (名) 敵人；對手　(名) 反對者；仇敵
example_sentence: The hero faced his mortal foe in an epic final battle.
sentence_zh: 英雄在史詩般的最後戰役中面對他的死敵。

definition_zh: (名) 霧；霧氣　(動) 使模糊；籠罩
example_sentence: The fog made it difficult for drivers to see the road clearly.
sentence_zh: 霧使駕駛者很難清楚地看到道路。

definition_zh: (名) 噴霧機；製造霧氣的裝置　(名) 噴霧劑；防蚊液
example_sentence: As the fogger sprayed insecticide throughout the neighborhood, residents stayed indoors to avoid inhaling the chemicals.
sentence_zh: 當噴霧機在整個社區噴灑殺蟲劑時，居民待在室內以避免吸入化學物質。

definition_zh: (形) 霧茫茫的；能見度低的　(形) 模糊的；不清楚的
example_sentence: Obscured by thick fog, the mountain road became treacherous, causing drivers to slow down considerably.
sentence_zh: 被濃霧遮蔽的山路變得危險，導致駕駛人明顯放慢速度。

definition_zh: (名) 小缺點；弱點　(形) 輕微的；次要的
example_sentence: Everyone has minor foibles that make them unique individuals worth knowing.
sentence_zh: 每個人都有輕微的小缺點，這些缺點使他們成為值得認識的獨特個體。

definition_zh: (動) 阻止；挫敗　(名) 金屬薄片；箔紙
example_sentence: If the security team had not foiled the plan, the robbery would have succeeded easily.
sentence_zh: 如果保全團隊沒有挫敗這個計畫，搶劫早就得手了。

definition_zh: (動) 硬塞給；騙人接受
example_sentence: The salesman tried to foist a broken phone onto the unsuspecting customer.
sentence_zh: 那位銷售員試圖硬塞一支壞掉的手機給毫無戒心的顧客。

definition_zh: (動) 摺疊；收起　(動) 倒閉；停止營業
example_sentence: The camping tent needs to be folded up carefully to fit in the backpack.
sentence_zh: 露營帳篷需要小心摺疊才能放進背包裡。

definition_zh: (動) 摺疊；對摺　(名) 褶皺；摺痕
example_sentence: Folding clothes carefully and putting them in the drawer keeps your room organized.
sentence_zh: 仔細摺疊衣服並放入抽屜能保持房間整潔。

definition_zh: (形) 可摺疊的；能夠摺疊的
example_sentence: Because the phone is foldable, students can easily carry it in their backpacks.
sentence_zh: 因為手機是可摺疊的，學生可以輕鬆地把它放在背包裡。

definition_zh: (名) 文件夾；資料夾　(名) 摺疊物；折紙
example_sentence: Having organized the files into folders, the secretary completed her task efficiently.
sentence_zh: 秘書已把文件整理到資料夾裡，效率地完成了她的工作。

definition_zh: (名) 民俗；民間文化　(形) 民間的；民俗的
example_sentence: The folk songs that grandparents sang reflect the traditions of their generation.
sentence_zh: 祖父母唱的民謠反映了他們那一代的傳統。

definition_zh: (名) 民間故事；民俗傳說　(名) 民間文化；傳統知識
example_sentence: Many folklore stories passed down through generations reflect the values and beliefs of ancient societies.
sentence_zh: 許多代代相傳的民間故事反映了古代社會的價值觀和信仰。

definition_zh: (動) 接著發生；由...引起　(動) 繼續進行；承接而來
example_sentence: If the economic crisis worsened, unemployment would follow on from reduced consumer spending.
sentence_zh: 如果經濟危機惡化，失業將會接著因消費者支出減少而產生。

definition_zh: (動) 接著發生；隨後而來　(動) 繼續進行；保持聯繫
example_sentence: Heavy rain followed on from the typhoon warning yesterday.
sentence_zh: 颱風警報後隨之而來了大雨。

definition_zh: (動) 跟隨；效仿　(片) 採取相同行動；跟著做
example_sentence: Following suit after the top student's achievement, many classmates began studying harder for the entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 在頂尖學生的成就後跟著做，許多同學開始為升學考試更努力地讀書。

definition_zh: (動) 完成；堅持到底；貫徹始終
example_sentence: Although the project faced many obstacles, the team followed through with their original plan until completion.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個專案面臨許多障礙，但這支團隊堅持貫徹他們最初的計畫直到完成。

definition_zh: (動) 跟進；追蹤　(名) 後續行動；追蹤
example_sentence: Only after the meeting ended did the manager follow up with each client about their concerns.
sentence_zh: 只有在會議結束後，經理才與每位客戶跟進他們的疑慮。

definition_zh: (名) 後續行動；追蹤　(動) 進行後續；跟進　(形) 後續的；追蹤的
example_sentence: The doctor scheduled a follow-up appointment that would monitor the patient's recovery progress.
sentence_zh: 醫生安排了一個後續預約，該預約將監測患者的恢復進度。

definition_zh: (動) 跟隨；追隨　(動) 理解；明白
example_sentence: Students study hard every day to follow their teachers' instructions and succeed in the exam.
sentence_zh: 學生每天努力讀書是為了跟隨老師的指導並在考試中成功。

definition_zh: (名) 追隨者；粉絲　(名) 跟隨物；附屬物
example_sentence: Social media followers of popular celebrities often share their favorite posts online.
sentence_zh: 受歡迎名人的社群媒體粉絲常常在線上分享他們最愛的貼文。

definition_zh: (形) 接下來的；隨後的　(名) 支持者；粉絲
example_sentence: The following week, the school will hold its annual sports day.
sentence_zh: 接下來的一週，學校將舉辦年度運動會。

definition_zh: (形) 接下來的；隨後的　(介) 在...之後
example_sentence: Following the midterm exam, students need to review their mistakes carefully.
sentence_zh: 在期中考之後，學生需要仔細檢討他們的錯誤。

definition_zh: (形) 喜愛的；喜歡的　(動) 喜歡；愛好
example_sentence: Feeling fond of classical music, many students attend the school orchestra concert every semester.
sentence_zh: 因為喜歡古典音樂，許多學生每學期都參加學校管弦樂團音樂會。

definition_zh: (名) 喜愛；偏好　(名) 溫柔；親切
example_sentence: The grandmother's fondness for her grandchildren, which was obvious in every interaction, brought warmth to the entire family.
sentence_zh: 祖母對孫子女的喜愛（在每次互動中都很明顯）為整個家庭帶來了溫暖。

definition_zh: (名) 食物；食品　(名) 飲食；糧食
example_sentence: If students eat nutritious food regularly, their concentration in class will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生定期吃營養食物，他們在課堂上的專注力會明顯改善。

definition_zh: (動) 瞎混；浪費時間　閒晃；胡鬧
example_sentence: Instead of studying for the exam, Tom fooled about in the mall all afternoon.
sentence_zh: 湯姆沒有準備考試，反而整個下午在購物中心瞎混。

definition_zh: (名) 傻瓜；愚人　(動) 欺騙；愚弄
example_sentence: Don't be fooled by false advertising to buy unnecessary products.
sentence_zh: 不要被虛假廣告所欺騙而購買不必要的產品。

definition_zh: (名) 愚蠢的行為；傻事　(名) 無意義的玩笑；胡鬧
example_sentence: The student's foolery during the exam caused him to fail the difficult test.
sentence_zh: 那個學生在考試中的傻事導致他沒有通過那場困難的考試。
subject_type: noun (object of preposition in compound context)

definition_zh: (形) 愚蠢的；傻的　(動) 欺騙；愚弄
example_sentence: Although Mark felt foolish when he made that mistake, his classmates offered support instead of criticism.
sentence_zh: 雖然馬克犯那個錯誤時感到愚蠢，但他的同學們提供支持而不是批評。

definition_zh: (名) 腳；腳部　(名) 英尺（長度單位）
example_sentence: Having walked for hours, the tired hiker's foot began to hurt badly.
sentence_zh: 走了好幾個小時後，疲倦的登山者的腳開始非常疼痛。

definition_zh: (名) 影片；錄影　(名) 長度；碼數
example_sentence: The security footage that police discovered at the crime scene proved the suspect's guilt.
sentence_zh: 警察在犯罪現場發現的安全監視影片證明了嫌疑人的罪行。

definition_zh: (名) 美式足球；橄欖球　(名) 足球；曲棍球
example_sentence: Playing football every weekend helps students build strong teamwork and physical fitness.
sentence_zh: 每個週末踢足球幫助學生建立強大的團隊合作和身體體能。

definition_zh: (名) 人行天橋；行人橋
example_sentence: If the footbridge were not built across the highway, pedestrians would face serious danger.
sentence_zh: 如果沒有在高速公路上建造人行天橋，行人將面臨嚴重危險。
subject_type: noun (footbridge as subject of conditional clause)

definition_zh: (名) 足跡；腳印　(名) 影響；痕跡
example_sentence: The detective found footprints in the sand near the crime scene.
sentence_zh: 偵探在犯罪現場附近的沙地上發現了腳印。

definition_zh: (名) 腳步；步伐　(名) 腳步聲；足跡
example_sentence: Hearing approaching footsteps, the student hurried toward the classroom before the teacher arrived.
sentence_zh: 聽到接近的腳步聲，學生在老師到達前匆匆跑向教室。

definition_zh: (副) 例如；比如
example_sentence: Many students enjoy sports, for example, basketball and volleyball are popular at school.
sentence_zh: 許多學生喜歡運動，例如籃球和排球在學校很受歡迎。

definition_zh: (片) 暫時；目前　(片) 暫且；一時
example_sentence: Only for the time being can students postpone their university entrance exam preparation.
sentence_zh: 只有在暫時的情況下，學生才能推遲大學入學考試的準備。

definition_zh: (動) 尋找食物；覓食　(名) 飼料；草料
example_sentence: Squirrels that forage for nuts in autumn prepare for the cold winter ahead.
sentence_zh: 在秋天為堅果覓食的松鼠為即將到來的寒冬做準備。

definition_zh: (動) 禁止；不准　(動) 阻止；妨礙
example_sentence: The school forbids students to use mobile phones during class to improve focus.
sentence_zh: 學校禁止學生在課堂上使用手機以提高專注力。

definition_zh: (形) 禁止的；被禁止的　(動) 禁止；不允許
example_sentence: Smoking in the library is forbidden, so students must go outside.
sentence_zh: 在圖書館抽菸是被禁止的，所以學生必須到外面去。

definition_zh: (副) 以令人害怕的方式；嚇人地
example_sentence: The dark castle stood forbiddingly on the hilltop, its tall walls discouraging visitors.
sentence_zh: 那座黑暗的城堡令人生畏地聳立在山頂上，高牆阻止了訪客。

definition_zh: (名) 力量；力　(動) 強制；迫使　(形) 強有力的；有效的
example_sentence: Although the coach tried to force the team to practice harder, the players' motivation remained low.
sentence_zh: 雖然教練試圖強制隊伍更努力地練習，但球員的動力仍然很低。

definition_zh: (形) 強有力的；有力的　(形) 堅定的；堅決的
example_sentence: Having made a forceful argument in class, the student convinced everyone to support the environmental project.
sentence_zh: 在課堂上提出有力論點後，這名學生說服了所有人支持環境保護專案。

definition_zh: (動) 克制；忍耐　(動) 祖先；前輩
example_sentence: The teacher showed patience toward the student whose behavior was difficult, forbearing any harsh criticism.
sentence_zh: 那位老師對這個行為不佳的學生表現出耐心，克制了任何嚴厲的批評。

definition_zh: (動) [fɔrˈkæst] 預報；預測　(名) [ˈfɔrˌkæst] 預報；預測
example_sentence: If the weather forecast predicts heavy rain tomorrow, the outdoor sports day will be postponed.
sentence_zh: 如果天氣預報預測明天會下大雨，戶外運動會將會延期。

definition_zh: (名) 祖先；前人
example_sentence: Many forefathers of Taiwan fought hard for independence and democracy.
sentence_zh: 台灣的許多祖先為獨立和民主而努力奮鬥。

definition_zh: (名) 最前線；前沿　(名) 最重要的位置
example_sentence: Scientists work at the forefront to develop new vaccines protecting public health.
sentence_zh: 科學家在最前線工作，目的是開發保護公眾健康的新疫苗。

definition_zh: (名) 額頭；前額
example_sentence: Sweat dripped down Sarah's forehead as she nervously waited for exam results.
sentence_zh: 莎拉焦急地等待考試成績時，汗水滑過她的額頭。

definition_zh: (形) 外國的；國外的　(形) 陌生的；不熟悉的
example_sentence: Although studying in a foreign country seems challenging, many Taiwanese students pursue this opportunity to gain international experience.
sentence_zh: 雖然在外國讀書似乎很有挑戰性，但許多台灣學生追求這個機會來獲得國際經驗。

definition_zh: (名) 外國人；外邦人
example_sentence: Having learned Mandarin for years, the foreigner finally understood the local news broadcast.
sentence_zh: 學了多年的中文後，那位外國人終於聽懂了當地新聞播報。

definition_zh: (名) 工頭；領班　(名) 陪審團主席
example_sentence: The foreman who supervised the construction site ensured all workers followed safety regulations.
sentence_zh: 監督建築工地的工頭確保所有工人遵守安全規定。

definition_zh: (形) 最重要的；首要的　(副) 首先；最主要地
example_sentence: Safety and environmental protection are foremost concerns for modern car manufacturers.
sentence_zh: 安全和環保保護是現代汽車製造商最重要的考慮。

definition_zh: (名) 前爪；前腳
example_sentence: If the injured cat moved its forepaw carefully, it would feel less pain during recovery.
sentence_zh: 如果受傷的貓小心移動牠的前爪，復原期間會感到較少的疼痛。

definition_zh: (名) 先驅者；前驅者　(名) 預兆；徵兆
example_sentence: The smartphone was a forerunner of today's advanced technology.
sentence_zh: 智慧型手機是當今先進科技的先驅。

definition_zh: (動) 預見；預先看到　(動) 預測；預料
example_sentence: Foreseeing the heavy traffic during rush hour, commuters left home earlier than usual.
sentence_zh: 預先看到尖峰時段的交通堵塞，通勤者比平常更早離家。

definition_zh: (形) 可預見的；可預測的
example_sentence: As long as the weather remains foreseeable, the outdoor graduation ceremony will proceed as planned.
sentence_zh: 只要天氣仍然可預見，戶外畢業典禮就會按計劃進行。

definition_zh: (名) 森林；林地　(形) 森林的；林區的
example_sentence: Only after entering the dense forest did the hikers realize how easy it is to get lost.
sentence_zh: 只有進入茂密的森林後，登山者才意識到迷路是多麼容易的事。

definition_zh: (動) 預防；阻止　(動) 搶先採取行動
example_sentence: The security measures that the company forestalled prevented a serious data breach.
sentence_zh: 公司預防性的安全措施阻止了一場嚴重的資料洩露。

definition_zh: (動) 預言；預測　(動) 預知；預先說出
example_sentence: Ancient fortune tellers claim to foretell the future by reading tarot cards carefully.
sentence_zh: 古代的算命師聲稱可以透過仔細閱讀塔羅牌來預言未來。

definition_zh: (副) 永遠地；永久地　(名) 永遠；很長時間
example_sentence: Learning English requires patience and practice forever and ever.
sentence_zh: 學英文需要永久的耐心和練習。

definition_zh: (動) [fɚ`fɪt] 喪失；被沒收　(名) [`fɔrfɪt] 被沒收的東西；罰金
example_sentence: Players who arrive late forfeit their right to participate in the competition.
sentence_zh: 遲到的選手將喪失參加比賽的權利。

definition_zh: (動) 勇敢向前；奮力前進
example_sentence: Although the project faced many challenges, the team forged ahead with determination and enthusiasm.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個專案面臨許多挑戰，但該團隊以決心和熱情勇敢向前。

definition_zh: (動) 鍛造；偽造　(名) 鍛造廠；熔爐
example_sentence: Forging a strong friendship with classmates, many students find school life more enjoyable.
sentence_zh: 與同學鍛造堅強的友誼，許多學生發現學校生活更加愉快。

definition_zh: (動) 偽造；假造　(形) 偽造的；假的
example_sentence: The detective discovered that the signature on the document, which had been forged by a skilled criminal, was not authentic.
sentence_zh: 那位偵探發現文件上的簽名是由一位技術高超的罪犯偽造的，並不真實。

definition_zh: (動) 忘記；遺忘　(動) 忽略；不理會
example_sentence: If students forget to review regularly, their grades will drop significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生忘記定期複習，他們的成績將會明顯下降。

definition_zh: (形) 容易忘記的；健忘的　(形) 疏忽的；不留心的
example_sentence: My forgetful grandmother often loses her glasses in the house.
sentence_zh: 我健忘的祖母經常在家裡遺失她的眼鏡。

definition_zh: (動) 原諒；寬恕　(動) 免除（債務、罪責）
example_sentence: Parents often forgive their children to teach them the value of second chances.
sentence_zh: 父母經常原諒孩子以教導他們重新開始的價值。

definition_zh: (名) 原諒；寬恕　(名) 寬容；仁慈
example_sentence: Asking for forgiveness after hurting a friend requires courage and honesty.
sentence_zh: 在傷害朋友後請求原諒需要勇氣和誠實。

definition_zh: (形) 寬容的；樂於原諒的　(動) 原諒；寬恕
example_sentence: Although Mark made a serious mistake, his forgiving nature helped him rebuild trust with everyone.
sentence_zh: 雖然馬克犯了嚴重的錯誤，但他寬容的性格幫助他重新與大家建立信任。

definition_zh: (名) 叉子；餐叉　(動) 用叉子夾取；分叉
example_sentence: Having forked the salad onto her plate, Maria enjoyed her lunch quietly.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞用叉子把沙拉叉到盤子上後，安靜地享受午餐。

definition_zh: (名) 形式；表格　(動) 形成；組成　(形) 正式的；標準的
example_sentence: Students must complete the application form that the school provides before the deadline.
sentence_zh: 學生必須在截止日期前完成學校提供的申請表格。

definition_zh: (形) 正式的；莊重的　(形) 按規則的；官方的
example_sentence: Attending a formal dinner requires wearing a suit and dress shoes.
sentence_zh: 參加正式的晚宴需要穿著西裝和皮鞋。

definition_zh: (副) 正式地；隆重地　(副) 照形式上；表面上
example_sentence: If the company formally announced the merger, stock prices would rise immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果公司正式宣布合併，股價會立即上升。

definition_zh: (名) [`fɔrmæt] 格式；版式　(動) [fɔr`mæt] 格式化；安排版面
example_sentence: Students must format their essays according to the teacher's requirements.
sentence_zh: 學生必須根據老師的要求格式化他們的論文。

definition_zh: (名) 形成；構成　(名) 隊伍排列；陣形
example_sentence: Forming a strong team through constant practice, the rock band achieved international recognition.
sentence_zh: 透過不斷練習而形成堅強的團隊，這支搖滾樂隊獲得了國際認可。

definition_zh: (形) 有助於發展的；形成性的　(形) 構成的；塑造的
example_sentence: Although formative experiences during childhood shape personality development, adolescent friendships also play an important role.
sentence_zh: 雖然童年時期具有塑造性的經驗能形塑人格發展，但青少年的友誼也扮演重要角色。

definition_zh: (形) 以前的；從前的　(名) 前任者；前者
example_sentence: Never has a former president shown such strong support for education reform.
sentence_zh: 從未有過一位前任總統對教育改革表現出如此堅定的支持。

definition_zh: (副) 以前；曾經　從前；先前
example_sentence: The company, which formerly operated in Taipei, has now relocated to Taichung.
sentence_zh: 這家公司曾經在台北營運，現在已搬到台中。

definition_zh: (形) 令人敬畏的；強大的　(形) 難以克服的；艱鉅的
example_sentence: Elite athletes train rigorously to overcome formidable opponents in international competitions.
sentence_zh: 菁英運動員刻苦訓練以克服國際比賽中令人敬畏的對手。

definition_zh: (名) 公式；方程式　(名) 配方；成分
example_sentence: The teacher wrote a mathematical formula on the blackboard for students to solve.
sentence_zh: 老師在黑板上寫了一個數學公式供學生解題。

definition_zh: (動) 制定；組織　(動) 表達；闡述
example_sentence: The research team formulated a clear strategy to solve the pollution problem.
sentence_zh: 研究團隊制定了一個明確的策略來解決污染問題。

definition_zh: (名) 制定；公式　(名) 配方；成分
example_sentence: Since the company's product formulation includes natural ingredients, customers trust its quality and safety.
sentence_zh: 由於該公司的產品配方包含天然成分，顧客相信其品質和安全性。

definition_zh: (動) 通姦；婚外性行為
example_sentence: Fornicating with someone outside marriage, the character faced serious consequences in the traditional community.
sentence_zh: 與婚外人士通姦，這個角色在傳統社區中面臨嚴重後果。

definition_zh: (動) 拋棄；放棄　(動) 背棄；遺棄
example_sentence: The loyal friend whom nobody forsake will always stand by your side.
sentence_zh: 那位沒有人拋棄的忠實朋友將永遠站在你身邊。

definition_zh: (名) 堡壘；要塞　(動) 加強；防禦
example_sentence: If the army reinforces the fort with more supplies, the soldiers will defend it successfully against any attack.
sentence_zh: 如果軍隊用更多物資加強這個堡壘，士兵們將能成功抵禦任何攻擊。

definition_zh: (副) 向前；前進　(介) 向外；離開
example_sentence: The explorer set forth on a journey to discover new lands.
sentence_zh: 這位探險家啟程前往發現新大陸。

definition_zh: (形) 即將到來的；即將發生的　(形) 樂於提供的；坦誠的
example_sentence: Students prepared thoroughly to succeed in the forthcoming college entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們做了充分準備以便在即將到來的大學入學考試中成功。

definition_zh: (片) 暫時；目前；眼下
example_sentence: The new school rules will be adjusted for the time being until students adapt completely.
sentence_zh: 這些新的校規暫時會調整，直到學生完全適應為止。

definition_zh: (形) 坦率的；直言的　(副) 坦誠地；直言不諱地
example_sentence: Forthright in expressing her opinion, the student pointed out the problem with the project plan.
sentence_zh: 那位學生坦率地表達意見，指出了專案計畫的問題所在。

definition_zh: (形) 加強防禦的；堡壘化的　(動過) 加固；強化
example_sentence: Fortified with thick walls and armed guards, the ancient castle protected the town for centuries.
sentence_zh: 這座古堡因厚牆和武裝衛兵而得到加強防禦，數百年來一直保護著這個城鎮。

definition_zh: (動) 加強；鞏固　(動) 強化；增強
example_sentence: The city walls, which engineers fortified with stone and steel, protected residents during the invasion.
sentence_zh: 這座城牆經工程師用石頭和鋼鐵加強後，在入侵期間保護了居民。

definition_zh: (名) 堅毅；不畏艱難的勇氣　(名) 精神力量；毅力
example_sentence: Facing failure and hardship, the student's fortitude helped overcome every challenge.
sentence_zh: 面對失敗和困難，這位學生的堅毅精神幫助克服了每個挑戰。

definition_zh: (名) 十四天；兩週
example_sentence: If the summer vacation lasted a fortnight, students would have enough time to travel abroad.
sentence_zh: 如果暑假持續兩週，學生們就會有足夠的時間出國旅遊。

definition_zh: (形) 幸運的；運氣好的　(形) 幸福的；有利的
example_sentence: Winning the scholarship was fortunate for Maria's university dreams.
sentence_zh: 贏得獎學金對瑪麗亞的大學夢來說是幸運的。

definition_zh: (副) 幸運地；所幸　(副) 幸好；值得慶幸地
example_sentence: Fortunately having studied the textbook carefully, students passed the exam without difficulty.
sentence_zh: 幸運地認真研讀教科書，學生們輕鬆通過了考試。

definition_zh: (動) 幸運眷顧；命運垂青
example_sentence: As fortune smiled on the ambitious entrepreneur, the startup gained millions in investment within months.
sentence_zh: 當幸運眷顧這位雄心勃勃的企業家時，該新創公司在數月內獲得了數百萬元的投資。

definition_zh: (名) 財富；金錢　(名) 運氣；命運
example_sentence: Only after winning the lottery did the young man realize that fortune alone cannot guarantee happiness.
sentence_zh: 只有在中獎之後，那位年輕人才意識到僅有財富無法保證幸福。

definition_zh: (數) 四十　(形) 四十的；四十歲的
example_sentence: The marathon, which is forty kilometers long, challenges runners who train seriously.
sentence_zh: 這場馬拉松賽跑長達四十公里，對認真訓練的跑者來說是個挑戰。

definition_zh: (名) 論壇；討論會　(名) 廣場；公開討論的場所
example_sentence: Many students use online forums to ask questions and share study tips.
sentence_zh: 許多學生使用線上論壇來提問和分享讀書技巧。

definition_zh: (形) 向前的；前進的　(動) 轉寄；促進　(副) 向前；往前
example_sentence: Looking forward to the summer vacation, many students began planning their travel schedules.
sentence_zh: 期待暑假的到來，許多學生開始規畫他們的旅遊行程。

definition_zh: (副) 向前；前進　(動) 轉寄；運送
example_sentence: The soccer team moved forwards to attack the opponent's goal.
sentence_zh: 足球隊向前移動以進攻對手的球門。

definition_zh: (名) 化石；遺跡　(形) 陳舊的；過時的
example_sentence: As scientists study fossils, they discover how ancient creatures evolved millions of years ago.
sentence_zh: 當科學家研究化石時，他們發現了古代生物在數百萬年前如何演化的。

definition_zh: (動) 石化；變成化石　使變得僵化；使停止進展
example_sentence: Fossilized by outdated teaching methods, the education system failed to adapt to modern student needs.
sentence_zh: 被過時教學方法石化的教育系統，未能適應現代學生的需求。

definition_zh: (形) 僵化的；陳舊的　(形) 化石化的；固定不變的
example_sentence: The teaching methods that have remained unchanged for decades are fossilized approaches that students find boring.
sentence_zh: 幾十年來保持不變的教學方法是已僵化的做法，學生覺得無聊。

definition_zh: (動) 培養；促進　(動) 領養；撫養
example_sentence: If the school fosters a love of reading, students will develop better critical thinking skills.
sentence_zh: 如果學校培養閱讀的熱愛，學生將會發展更好的批判性思維能力。

definition_zh: (形) 骯髒的；污穢的　(形) 違規的；不正當的　(動) 犯規；弄髒
example_sentence: The foul smell from the garbage made everyone leave the area quickly.
sentence_zh: 垃圾發出的骯髒臭味讓每個人都快速離開了這個區域。

definition_zh: (動) 創辦；建立　(動) 發現；找到
example_sentence: Many successful entrepreneurs founded their companies to solve real problems.
sentence_zh: 許多成功的企業家創辦公司是為了解決真實的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 基礎；根基　(名) 基金會；慈善機構
example_sentence: A strong foundation in mathematics helps students excel in physics and engineering.
sentence_zh: 數學的堅實基礎幫助學生在物理和工程中表現優異。

definition_zh: (名) 創辦人；建立者　(動) 沉沒；失敗
example_sentence: Although the founder struggled financially, the startup eventually became successful.
sentence_zh: 雖然創辦人在財務上遇到困難，但這間新創公司最終還是成功了。

definition_zh: (名) 鑄造廠；鑄造工場
example_sentence: Having operated the foundry for decades, the company finally modernized its equipment.
sentence_zh: 經營這家鑄造廠數十年後，這家公司終於現代化了設備。

definition_zh: (名) 噴泉；水池
example_sentence: The fountain that stands in the city center attracts many tourists every day.
sentence_zh: 位於市中心的噴泉每天吸引許多遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 四；四個　(形) 四的；四個的
example_sentence: The four members of our study group met every Saturday afternoon.
sentence_zh: 我們讀書小組的四位成員每個星期六下午都會碰面。

definition_zh: (名) 十四；十四歲
example_sentence: If Maria had studied fourteen hours last week, she would have passed the exam.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪麗亞上週讀了十四小時，她就會通過考試。

definition_zh: (形) 第四的；第四　(名) 四分之一
example_sentence: Sarah finished fourth in the swimming competition last weekend.
sentence_zh: 上週末莎拉在游泳比賽中獲得第四名。

definition_zh: (名) 家禽；鳥　(動) 獵殺家禽；犯規
example_sentence: Flocking to the farm, wild geese and domestic fowl competed for grain scattered across the yard.
sentence_zh: 聚集到農場，野鵝和家禽爭奪散落在院子裡的穀物。

definition_zh: (名) 狐狸；狡猾的人
example_sentence: As the fox darted through the forest, hunters chased it desperately.
sentence_zh: 當狐狸衝過森林時，獵人們拼命追趕它。

definition_zh: (形) 狡猾的；伶俐的　(形) 迷人的；有魅力的
example_sentence: Seldom does a foxy politician reveal his true intentions during an election campaign.
sentence_zh: 狡猾的政客在選舉活動中很少會透露他真正的意圖。

definition_zh: (名) 門廳；大廳　(名) 飯店或劇院的入口大廳
example_sentence: The elegant foyer, which greeted visitors with marble columns, impressed everyone entering the concert hall.
sentence_zh: 那個用大理石柱迎接訪客的優雅門廳，給進音樂廳的每個人留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 分數；片段　(名) 小部分；微小的量
example_sentence: Students need to master fractions to solve complex math problems efficiently.
sentence_zh: 學生需要掌握分數以便有效地解決複雜的數學問題。

definition_zh: (名) 骨折；裂縫　(動) 使骨折；破裂
example_sentence: The skateboarding accident caused a serious fracture of the left arm bone.
sentence_zh: 滑板事故造成左臂骨頭嚴重骨折。

definition_zh: (形) 易碎的；脆弱的　(形) 虛弱的；柔弱的
example_sentence: Fragile items like glasses require careful packing during moving.
sentence_zh: 玻璃杯等易碎物品在搬家時需要小心包裝。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈfrægmənt] 碎片；片段　(動) [frægˈmɛnt] 分裂；破碎
example_sentence: Although the ancient pottery fragmented into dozens of pieces, archaeologists carefully reconstructed the entire vessel.
sentence_zh: 雖然古代陶器碎成了數十片，考古學家仍仔細重組了整個容器。

definition_zh: (形) 零碎的；片段的　(形) 不完整的；殘缺的
example_sentence: Gathering fragmentary evidence from various sources, the detective slowly pieced together the complete picture.
sentence_zh: 偵探從各種來源蒐集零碎的證據，慢慢拼湊出完整的圖像。

definition_zh: (名) 香氣；芳香　(名) 香水；香氛
example_sentence: The fragrance that filled the garden came from roses blooming in spring.
sentence_zh: 充滿花園的香氣來自春天盛開的玫瑰。

definition_zh: (形) 芬芳的；香的　(形) 香氣怡人的；馨香的
example_sentence: If flowers remain fragrant after being dried, many students would use them for decoration.
sentence_zh: 如果花朵烘乾後仍保持芬芳，許多學生就會用它們來裝飾。

definition_zh: (形) 虛弱的；瘦弱的　(形) 易碎的；脆弱的
example_sentence: The elderly patient's frail body required constant care and attention.
sentence_zh: 那位年長患者虛弱的身體需要持續的照顧和注意。

definition_zh: (名) 虛弱；脆弱　(形) 虛弱的；易損壞的
example_sentence: The elderly woman exercised regularly to combat the frailty that comes with age.
sentence_zh: 這位年長女性定期運動以對抗隨著年齡而來的虛弱。

definition_zh: (名) 框架；畫框　(動) 設計；構成；誣陷
example_sentence: The wooden frame around the old painting makes it look more valuable and attractive.
sentence_zh: 那幅古老繪畫周圍的木製框架使它看起來更珍貴且吸引人。

definition_zh: (名) 框架；結構　(名) 體系；架構
example_sentence: Because the company adopted a new management framework, productivity increased significantly throughout the organization.
sentence_zh: 因為公司採用了新的管理框架，整個組織的生產力大幅提高。

definition_zh: (名) 法郎（瑞士或法國的貨幣單位）
example_sentence: Having exchanged dollars for francs, the tourists explored the Swiss marketplace with confidence.
sentence_zh: 遊客將美元兌換成法郎後，自信地在瑞士市場探索購物。

definition_zh: (名) 法國；法蘭西
example_sentence: France, which is famous for its art and wine, attracts millions of tourists every year.
sentence_zh: 法國以其藝術和葡萄酒聞名，每年吸引數百萬遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 特許經營權；連鎖店　(動) 授予特許經營權；特許經營
example_sentence: McDonald's franchise opportunities attract many entrepreneurs seeking business expansion.
sentence_zh: 麥當勞的特許經營機會吸引許多尋求商業擴展的企業家。

definition_zh: (形) 坦白的；直率的　(動) 在郵件上簽名以示已付郵資
example_sentence: If the manager were more frank about project delays, team members would trust the company more.
sentence_zh: 如果經理對專案延誤更加坦白，團隊成員會更信任公司。

definition_zh: (副) 坦白地；老實說　(副) 說實話；坦誠地
example_sentence: Frankly, studying for the CSAT requires consistent effort and dedication every day.
sentence_zh: 老實說，為學測做準備需要每天持續努力和投入。

definition_zh: (形) 狂亂的；惶恐的　(形) 急促的；匆忙的
example_sentence: Frantically searching through her backpack, Maya finally found the admission ticket for the entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 瑪雅狂亂地翻著她的背包，最後終於找到了入學考試的准考證。

definition_zh: (名) 兄弟會；友愛精神　(名) 同志情誼；手足之情
example_sentence: Although joining a fraternity requires commitment, many students find lifelong friendships there.
sentence_zh: 雖然加入兄弟會需要投入，但許多學生在那裡找到終身的友誼。

definition_zh: (名) 詐騙；欺詐　(動) 詐騙；騙取
example_sentence: Only after the company discovered the hidden records did evidence of fraud emerge.
sentence_zh: 只有在公司發現隱藏的紀錄之後，詐騙的證據才顯露出來。

definition_zh: (形) 詐欺的；欺騙性的　(形) 不誠實的；虛假的
example_sentence: The company's fraudulent accounting practices, which were discovered by auditors, resulted in massive fines.
sentence_zh: 該公司的詐欺性會計實務（被審計人員發現）導致了巨額罰款。

definition_zh: (形) 充滿...的；令人擔憂的　(形) 緊張的；不安的
example_sentence: The project timeline is fraught with risks, so the team met to plan carefully.
sentence_zh: 這個專案時程充滿風險，所以團隊開會仔細規畫。

definition_zh: (動) 驚慌失措；失去冷靜　尖叫；發瘋
example_sentence: When the fire alarm suddenly went off during the exam, several students freaked out and couldn't focus.
sentence_zh: 當考試中火警警報突然響起時，幾名學生驚慌失措，無法專注。

definition_zh: (名) 怪人；古怪的人　(動) 使驚嚇；使不安　(形) 古怪的；異常的
example_sentence: The athlete's extreme training habits made him a freak among his teammates.
sentence_zh: 這位運動員的極端訓練習慣使他在隊友中顯得很古怪。

definition_zh: (動) 釋放；騰出　(動) 向上；完成
example_sentence: Before the exam, students need to free up time by finishing homework early so they can review.
sentence_zh: 考試前，學生需要藉由提早完成功課來騰出時間，這樣才能複習。

definition_zh: (形) 自由的；免費的　(動) 釋放；解放
example_sentence: Freed from homework pressure, students finally enjoyed their summer vacation relaxing at home.
sentence_zh: 擺脫功課壓力，學生終於在家輕鬆地享受暑假。

definition_zh: (名) 自由；自由權　(名) 自主；獨立
example_sentence: The right to vote is a freedom that citizens should cherish and protect.
sentence_zh: 投票權是公民應該珍視和保護的自由。

definition_zh: (名) 自由地主；永久業主
example_sentence: If a freeholder wants to sell the property, they must notify the local government first.
sentence_zh: 如果永久業主想出售該房產，必須先通知當地政府。

definition_zh: (名) 自由工作；兼職工作　(動) 從事自由工作；接兼職案件
example_sentence: Many graphic designers freelance to earn extra money during summer vacation.
sentence_zh: 許多平面設計師在暑假期間從事自由工作來賺取額外收入。

definition_zh: (名) 自由工作者；兼職工作者
example_sentence: Many designers become freelancers to have more flexibility in choosing projects.
sentence_zh: 許多設計師成為自由工作者以便在選擇專案時擁有更多彈性。

definition_zh: (副) 自由地；不受限制地　(副) 坦誠地；直率地
example_sentence: Students can freely choose elective courses that match their interests and future plans.
sentence_zh: 學生可以自由地選擇符合他們興趣和未來計畫的選修課程。

definition_zh: (名) 高速公路；快速道路
example_sentence: Since the freeway was under construction, commuters had to take local roads instead.
sentence_zh: 由於高速公路正在施工，通勤者不得不改走一般道路。

definition_zh: (動) 把...排斥在外；冷落　(動) 凍結；停止
example_sentence: Having been frozen out of the project, the junior designer felt discouraged and considered leaving the company.
sentence_zh: 那位初級設計師被排斥在專案之外，感到沮喪並考慮離開公司。

definition_zh: (動) 結冰；凍結　(動) 停滯；僵化
example_sentence: The lake, which froze over last winter, became a popular skating rink for local teenagers.
sentence_zh: 那個湖去年冬天結冰了，它成為當地青少年喜愛的溜冰場。

definition_zh: (動) 僵住；無法動作　(動) 結冰；凍結
example_sentence: During the important presentation, nervousness caused Mark to freeze up and forget his lines.
sentence_zh: 在重要的報告中，緊張導致馬克僵住而忘記他的台詞。

definition_zh: (動) 結冰；凍結　(動) 靜止不動；驚呆
example_sentence: If water temperature dropped below zero, it would freeze into solid ice.
sentence_zh: 如果水溫降至零度以下，它就會結冰成固體。

definition_zh: (名) 冷凍庫；冰箱冷凍室
example_sentence: Storing ice cream in the freezer keeps it from melting quickly.
sentence_zh: 把冰淇淋放在冷凍庫裡可以防止它快速融化。

definition_zh: (形) 極冷的；冰凍的　(動) 結冰；冷凍
example_sentence: Freezing rain made the roads dangerous for drivers yesterday morning.
sentence_zh: 昨天早上凍雨使得道路對駕駛來說很危險。

definition_zh: (名) 貨物；運費　(動) 裝貨；運送貨物
example_sentence: Because freight costs have increased significantly, many companies are raising product prices.
sentence_zh: 因為運費大幅上漲，許多公司正在提高產品價格。

definition_zh: (形) 法國的；法國人的　(名) 法語；法國人
example_sentence: Only after mastering French grammar can students fully appreciate Molière's classical plays.
sentence_zh: 只有掌握了法文文法，學生才能真正欣賞莫里哀的經典戲劇。

definition_zh: (名) 狂熱；瘋狂　(形) 瘋狂的；狂亂的
example_sentence: The shopping frenzy that occurs during sales season drives many customers into crowded stores.
sentence_zh: 在銷售季節發生的購物狂熱驅使許多顧客進入擁擠的商店。

definition_zh: (名) 頻率；出現次數　(名) 頻道；頻率
example_sentence: Teachers use quizzes frequently to check students' understanding and increase learning frequency.
sentence_zh: 老師經常使用小考來檢查學生的理解力，並增加學習的頻率。

definition_zh: (形) [ˈfrikwənt] 頻繁的；經常的　(動) [friˈkwɛnt] 經常造訪；常去
example_sentence: Taking frequent breaks while studying helps students maintain focus and improve memory retention.
sentence_zh: 讀書時經常休息可以幫助學生保持專注力並提高記憶力。

definition_zh: (副) 經常；頻繁地　(副) 往往；常常
example_sentence: Students frequently use smartphones to search for information during study time.
sentence_zh: 學生在讀書時經常使用智慧型手機來搜尋資訊。

definition_zh: (形) 新鮮的；剛製造的　(形) 精神爽朗的；充滿活力的
example_sentence: Since the bread was baked fresh this morning, it tasted delicious.
sentence_zh: 因為麵包是今早新鮮烤的，所以嚐起來很美味。

definition_zh: (動) 整理儀容；梳洗
example_sentence: Freshening up after the long flight, Sarah felt much more comfortable and ready to explore the city.
sentence_zh: 梳洗了一番以後，莎拉在長途飛行後感到舒適多了，準備好探索這座城市。

definition_zh: (副) 新近地；剛剛　(副) 新鮮地；生氣勃勃地
example_sentence: The freshly baked bread that came from the oven smelled wonderful and warm.
sentence_zh: 從烤箱出來的新鮮烤麵包聞起來又香又溫暖。

definition_zh: (名) 大一學生；新生
example_sentence: If a freshman works hard on studying, they will adapt to high school life more easily.
sentence_zh: 如果一名大一學生認真讀書，他們將更容易適應高中生活。

definition_zh: (動) 擔心；焦慮　(名) 煩惱；憂慮
example_sentence: Don't fret about the exam; you prepared well for it.
sentence_zh: 別為考試擔心；你為它做了充分的準備。

definition_zh: (名) 摩擦；摩擦力　(名) 衝突；不和
example_sentence: Engineers design special lubricants to reduce friction and improve machine efficiency.
sentence_zh: 工程師設計特殊潤滑劑以減少摩擦並提高機器效率。

definition_zh: (名) 星期五；週五
example_sentence: Every Friday afternoon, our school holds a special assembly in the gymnasium.
sentence_zh: 每個星期五下午，我們學校都在體育館舉辦特別集會。

definition_zh: (名) 冰箱；冷藏櫃
example_sentence: Before cooking dinner, Sarah took out chicken from the fridge and prepared the ingredients carefully.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在煮晚餐前從冰箱拿出雞肉，並小心地準備食材。

definition_zh: (名) 朋友；友人　(動) 與…交友；成為朋友
example_sentence: Having made friends in middle school, Tom now enjoys strong friendships throughout high school.
sentence_zh: 在國中交到朋友後，湯姆現在在高中享受著牢固的友誼。

definition_zh: (形) 友善的；親切的　(形) 友好的；好相處的
example_sentence: The teacher who is friendly always listens to students' problems carefully.
sentence_zh: 那位親切友善的老師總是仔細傾聽學生的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 友誼；友誼關係　(名) 朋友間的親密關係
example_sentence: True friendship between classmates requires honesty, trust, and mutual support.
sentence_zh: 同學之間真誠的友誼需要誠實、信任和相互支持。

definition_zh: (名) 驚嚇；恐懼　(動) 驚嚇；使害怕
example_sentence: If sudden loud noises did not give passengers such a fright, airplane travel would feel much more relaxing.
sentence_zh: 如果突如其來的巨大聲響不會給乘客這麼大的驚嚇，搭飛機旅行會感得輕鬆得多。

definition_zh: (動) 嚇跑；驚嚇而趕走
example_sentence: The sudden loud noise frightened away all the birds in the tree.
sentence_zh: 突然的巨大聲響嚇跑了樹上所有的鳥。

definition_zh: (動) 嚇唬；使害怕　(動) 驚嚇；令人恐懼
example_sentence: Frightened by the sudden noise, the cat jumped off the table immediately.
sentence_zh: 被突然的聲音嚇到，那隻貓立刻跳下桌子。

definition_zh: (形) 害怕的；驚嚇的
example_sentence: Frightened by the sudden loud noise, the cat ran under the bed immediately.
sentence_zh: 受到突然巨大噪音的驚嚇，貓立刻跑到床下。

definition_zh: (形) 令人害怕的；可怕的　(形) 極壞的；極端的
example_sentence: Seldom have students witnessed such a frightful accident during the school field trip.
sentence_zh: 學生們在校外教學中很少目睹過如此可怕的意外事故。

definition_zh: (形) 極冷的；寒冷的　(形) 冷淡的；不友善的
example_sentence: The frigid weather that swept across northern Taiwan forced schools to cancel outdoor activities.
sentence_zh: 席捲台灣北部的極冷天氣迫使學校取消戶外活動。

definition_zh: (名) 褶邊；裝飾邊　(動) 加褶邊；裝飾
example_sentence: Fashion designers use frills to decorate dresses and attract customers.
sentence_zh: 時尚設計師使用褶邊來裝飾洋裝並吸引顧客。

definition_zh: (名) 邊緣；邊界　(形) 邊緣的；非主流的
example_sentence: Independent films on the cultural fringe often attract dedicated young audiences.
sentence_zh: 文化邊緣的獨立電影常吸引忠實的年輕觀眾。

definition_zh: (名) 飛盤；塑膠圓盤玩具
example_sentence: Playing frisbee in the park is a fun weekend activity.
sentence_zh: 在公園玩飛盤是有趣的週末活動。

definition_zh: (動) 搜身；搜查　(形) 輕快的；活潑的
example_sentence: As the security guard frisked each visitor, he checked for prohibited items carefully.
sentence_zh: 當保安人員搜身每位訪客時，他仔細檢查禁止物品。

definition_zh: (形) 活潑好動的；愛嬉鬧的
example_sentence: Feeling energized after the weekend, the frisky puppies chased each other around the park.
sentence_zh: 週末後精力充沛，那些活潑好動的小狗在公園裡互相追逐。

definition_zh: (動) 浪費；揮霍　(動) 虛度光陰；浪擲
example_sentence: Students who fritter away their time playing games will regret not studying harder.
sentence_zh: 那些把時間浪費在玩遊戲上的學生，將會後悔沒有更努力讀書。

definition_zh: (形) 輕浮的；不認真的　(形) 瑣碎的；微不足道的
example_sentence: If students spend frivolous time on social media, they will fail the entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 如果學生把時間浪費在社群媒體的瑣碎事物上，他們將會在學測中失敗。

definition_zh: (形) 強有力的；有力的　(副) 強有力地；有力地
example_sentence: The coach's forceful speech motivated the team to win the championship.
sentence_zh: 教練強有力的演講激勵了球隊贏得冠軍。

definition_zh: (形) 強制的；用力的　(副) 強行地；用強力地
example_sentence: The government used forcible measures to enforce the new traffic safety law.
sentence_zh: 政府採取強制措施來執行新的交通安全法。

definition_zh: (名) 青蛙；蛙
example_sentence: The frog sat on a lily pad in the pond and croaked loudly.
sentence_zh: 那隻青蛙坐在池塘的荷葉上，大聲呱呱叫。

definition_zh: (動) 嬉戲；玩耍　(名) 嬉戲；玩樂
example_sentence: While the children frolicked in the park, their parents watched them play happily.
sentence_zh: 當孩子們在公園裡嬉戲時，他們的父母開心地看著他們玩耍。

definition_zh: (片) 來自各行各業的人；形形色色的人
example_sentence: Having gathered from all walks of life, the volunteers brought diverse skills to the community project.
sentence_zh: 聚集來自各行各業的志工為社區專案帶來了多元的技能。

definition_zh: (片) 來自四面八方；從遠近各地
example_sentence: The charity event attracted volunteers from far and wide, who helped organize activities for the whole day.
sentence_zh: 這場慈善活動吸引來自四面八方的志工，他們整天協助組織各項活動。

definition_zh: (片) 從零開始；白手起家
example_sentence: Building a successful business from scratch requires patience, hard work, and a clear vision.
sentence_zh: 從零開始建立一個成功的事業需要耐心、努力和清晰的願景。

definition_zh: (介) 來自；從　(介) 用來表示起點或來源
example_sentence: If a student studied seriously from the beginning, passing the CSAT would become much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果一個學生從一開始就認真讀書，通過學測會變得容易得多。

definition_zh: (名) 蕨類植物的葉子；羽狀葉
example_sentence: The tropical rainforest is full of large green ferns with beautiful fronds.
sentence_zh: 熱帶雨林裡充滿了長著美麗蕨葉的大型蕨類植物。

definition_zh: (片) 在最重要的位置；引人注目
example_sentence: Standing front and center on the stage, the winning student received the scholarship award.
sentence_zh: 那位獲獎學生站在舞台最前面的中心位置，接受獎學金表揚。

definition_zh: (片) 作為...的幌子；假扮...　(動) 冒充；充當掩護
example_sentence: Although the charity claims to help poor children, it actually serves as a front for illegal money laundering.
sentence_zh: 雖然該慈善機構聲稱要幫助貧困兒童，但實際上卻是非法洗錢的掩護。

definition_zh: (動) 冒充；假裝　(動) 充當掩護
example_sentence: Not only did the company front off as a legitimate business, but it also deceived many investors.
sentence_zh: 不僅那家公司假裝是合法企業，而且它還欺騙了許多投資者。

definition_zh: (動) 面向；朝向
example_sentence: The old mansion that fronts onto the main street attracts many visitors daily.
sentence_zh: 那棟面向主街的老宅邸每天吸引許多遊客。

definition_zh: (動) 坦白承認；大膽面對　(動) 拿出錢；支付
example_sentence: The student decided to front out the truth to avoid deeper trouble later.
sentence_zh: 這個學生決定坦白承認真相，以便避免日後更大的麻煩。

definition_zh: (動) 勇敢面對；挺身而出　(動) 承認錯誤；坦白認罪
example_sentence: When caught cheating on the exam, the student decided to front up and confess to the teacher immediately.
sentence_zh: 當被發現考試作弊時，這名學生決定勇敢承認錯誤並立即向老師坦白。

definition_zh: (形) 頭版的；重要新聞的　(名) 頭版；第一頁
example_sentence: The scandal became front-page news after the president resigned.
sentence_zh: 總統辭職後，這樁醜聞成為頭版新聞。

definition_zh: (名) 前面；前部　(形) 前面的；正面的
example_sentence: As students walked toward the school gate, the front entrance came into view.
sentence_zh: 當學生走向校門時，前門進入了視線。

definition_zh: (名) 邊界；邊疆　(名) 新領域；未開發地區
example_sentence: Facing new challenges in the digital frontier, many companies are developing innovative solutions to stay competitive.
sentence_zh: 面對數位邊疆中的新挑戰，許多公司正在開發創新解決方案以保持競爭力。

definition_zh: (名) 前線；最前方　(形) 最前面的；處於最前線的
example_sentence: Doctors working in frontline hospitals, which treat the most serious cases, often face tremendous pressure.
sentence_zh: 在最前線醫院工作的醫生們，也就是治療最嚴重病例的醫院，經常面臨巨大的壓力。

definition_zh: (名) 霜；寒霜　(動) 結霜；冷凍　(形) 結霜的；冷的
example_sentence: If temperatures drop below zero tonight, frost will cover the garden plants by morning.
sentence_zh: 如果今晚氣溫降至零度以下，霜就會在早上覆蓋花園植物。

definition_zh: (形) 寒冷的；結霜的　(形) 冷淡的；不友善的
example_sentence: The frosty morning air made students shiver while waiting for the school bus.
sentence_zh: 結霜的早晨空氣讓學生在等校車時發抖。

definition_zh: (形) 泡沫狀的；起泡的　(形) 浮誇的；空洞的
example_sentence: Students ordered frothy coffee to enjoy during their lunch break at the school café.
sentence_zh: 學生點了起泡咖啡，想在午餐時間在學校咖啡廳享用。

definition_zh: (動) 不贊成；表示反對
example_sentence: The principal frowns on students arriving late to class without a valid excuse.
sentence_zh: 校長不贊成學生沒有正當理由遲到上課。

definition_zh: (動) 皺眉；不悅　(名) 皺眉；不滿的表情
example_sentence: Although the teacher tried to explain clearly, students frowned as the math problem remained confusing.
sentence_zh: 雖然老師試圖清楚地解釋，但由於數學題目仍然令人困惑，學生們皺起了眉頭。

definition_zh: (形) 凍結的；冷凍的　(動過分) 被凍住；凍結
example_sentence: Frozen by fear, the student couldn't answer the teacher's difficult question.
sentence_zh: 被恐懼凍住的那位學生無法回答老師的難題。

definition_zh: (名) 果糖；水果糖
example_sentence: Fructose, which is found in fruits and honey, tastes sweeter than regular sugar.
sentence_zh: 果糖是存在於水果和蜂蜜中的物質，它的甜度比普通糖還高。

definition_zh: (形) 節儉的；省錢的　(形) 簡樸的；儉朴的
example_sentence: Living a frugal lifestyle by cooking meals at home saves money for college.
sentence_zh: 通過在家做飯過著節儉的生活方式為上大學省錢。

definition_zh: (副) 節儉地；省錢地
example_sentence: If Sarah shopped frugally every month, she would save enough money for a summer trip.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉每個月節儉購物，她就能存夠錢去暑期旅行。

definition_zh: (名) 水果；果實　(動) 結果實；產生結果
example_sentence: Eating fresh fruit every day helps keep your body healthy and strong.
sentence_zh: 每天吃新鮮水果有助於保持身體健康和強壯。

definition_zh: (形) 豐碩的；成果豐富的　(形) 有成效的；富有成果的
example_sentence: Having conducted thorough research, the team achieved fruitful results in their project.
sentence_zh: 進行過徹底研究後，團隊在專案中獲得了豐碩的成果。

definition_zh: (副) 豐碩地；有成果地　(副) 富有成效地；卓有成就地
example_sentence: By studying fruitfully throughout the semester, students can achieve excellent results on the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 透過整個學期豐碩的學習，學生能在學測考試中取得優異成績。

definition_zh: (名) 實現；成果　(動) 實現；達成
example_sentence: Only after years of hard work did the team's dream come to fruition.
sentence_zh: 只有經過多年的努力，這支隊伍的夢想才得以實現。

definition_zh: (形) 徒勞的；無成果的　(形) 無結果的；白費的
example_sentence: The team's fruitless efforts to win the championship disappointed all supporters.
sentence_zh: 球隊徒勞的奪冠努力讓所有支持者感到失望。

definition_zh: (動) 使感到沮喪；挫折　(動) 阻止；破壞
example_sentence: Students study hard to frustrate their parents' worries about exam results.
sentence_zh: 學生努力讀書以消除父母對考試成績的擔憂。

definition_zh: (形) 沮喪的；感到挫折的　(形) 失望的；灰心的
example_sentence: Frustrated by repeated test failures, many students sought help from tutors.
sentence_zh: 因為多次考試失敗而感到沮喪，許多學生尋求補習老師的幫助。

definition_zh: (形) 令人沮喪的；使人感到失望的
example_sentence: Waiting in long traffic jams every morning is frustrating for commuters.
sentence_zh: 每天早上在長長的車隊中等待對通勤者來說令人沮喪。

definition_zh: (名) 沮喪；挫折感　(動) 使沮喪；阻礙
example_sentence: Although studying hard for months, frustration overwhelmed Tom when he failed the entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 雖然湯姆努力讀書好幾個月，當他沒通過入學考試時，沮喪感還是淹沒了他。

definition_zh: (動) 油炸；煎　(名) 炸薯條；油炸食物
example_sentence: Frying vegetables in hot oil, the chef prepared a delicious dinner for the family.
sentence_zh: 在熱油中油炸蔬菜，這位廚師為家人準備了美味的晚餐。

definition_zh: (動) 加油；補充燃料　(動) 充滿精力；準備行動
example_sentence: Before the long road trip, drivers who fuel up at the gas station save time later.
sentence_zh: 在長途公路旅行前，在加油站加油的駕駛人後來節省時間。

definition_zh: (形) 燃料節省的；省油的　(形) 能源利用效率高的
example_sentence: If drivers choose fuel-efficient cars, they will save money on gas every month.
sentence_zh: 如果駕駛選擇省油汽車，他們每個月將節省汽油費用。

definition_zh: (名) 燃料；汽油　(動) 供給燃料；激起
example_sentence: Electric cars need to replace fossil fuels to protect our environment.
sentence_zh: 電動汽車需要取代化石燃料來保護我們的環境。

definition_zh: (名) 逃犯；逃亡者　(形) 逃亡的；短暫的
example_sentence: The police set up roadblocks to catch the fugitive before he could escape the city.
sentence_zh: 警察設置路障以抓住那名逃犯，防止他逃離城市。

definition_zh: (名) 支點；槓桿支撐點
example_sentence: The lever balanced on the fulcrum, allowing the student to lift the heavy stone easily.
sentence_zh: 槓桿平衡在支點上，讓學生能輕易地抬起沉重的石頭。

definition_zh: (動) 完成；滿足　(動) 實現；達成
example_sentence: As long as students fulfill their graduation requirements, they can receive their diplomas.
sentence_zh: 只要學生完成畢業要求，他們就能獲得文憑。

definition_zh: (形) 令人滿足的；有成就感的　(動) 實現；完成
example_sentence: Having completed the volunteer project, Maria felt fulfilling work gave her life real purpose.
sentence_zh: 完成了志願服務項目後，瑪麗亞覺得有成就感的工作給了她的人生真正的目標。

definition_zh: (名) 滿足；實現　(名) 訂單配送；履行
example_sentence: The sense of fulfillment that comes from helping others is rewarding.
sentence_zh: 來自幫助他人的滿足感是有意義的。

definition_zh: (名) 滿分；完全學分　(形) 獲得滿分的；取得全額學分的
example_sentence: Students earning full credit on the midterm exam received recognition at the school assembly.
sentence_zh: 在期中考獲得滿分的學生在校集會上受到表揚。

definition_zh: (形) 全職的；全時間的　(副) 全職地；全時間地
example_sentence: If Maria worked full-time at the bookstore, she would earn enough money for university tuition.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪麗亞在書店全職工作，她就能賺到足夠的大學學費。

definition_zh: (形) 滿的；充滿的　(形) 飽的；吃飽的
example_sentence: The water bottle is full of juice and ready for the picnic.
sentence_zh: 這個水瓶裝滿了果汁，已準備好野餐。

definition_zh: (副) 完全地；充分地　(副) 徹底地；全部地
example_sentence: Fully understanding the exam requirements, students reviewed all past papers carefully.
sentence_zh: 充分理解考試要求後，學生仔細複習了所有歷年試題。

definition_zh: (名) 煙霧；有毒氣體　(動) 冒煙；生氣
example_sentence: As toxic fumes escaped from the factory, residents evacuated the neighborhood immediately.
sentence_zh: 當有毒煙霧從工廠逸出時，居民立即撤離社區。

definition_zh: (名) 煙霧；有毒氣體　(動) 冒煙；散發氣味
example_sentence: Hardly had the factory released toxic fumes before residents complained of breathing problems.
sentence_zh: 工廠才剛釋放有毒氣體，居民隨即抱怨呼吸困難。

definition_zh: (名) 樂趣；玩樂　(形) 有趣的；好玩的
example_sentence: The summer camp, which offers many fun activities, attracts thousands of students every year.
sentence_zh: 那個暑期營隊提供許多有趣的活動，每年吸引數千名學生參加。

definition_zh: (名) 功能；作用　(動) 運作；發揮作用
example_sentence: Students use calculators to function efficiently when solving complex math problems.
sentence_zh: 學生使用計算機以便在解決複雜數學問題時有效地發揮作用。

definition_zh: (形) 實用的；有用的　(形) 功能性的；官能的
example_sentence: Designing functional furniture helps maximize limited dorm space efficiently.
sentence_zh: 設計實用的家具有助於有效地最大化有限的宿舍空間。

definition_zh: (名) 基金；資金　(動) 資助；提供資金
example_sentence: The school raised funds to build a new library for students.
sentence_zh: 學校募集資金為學生興建一座新圖書館。

definition_zh: (形) 基本的；根本的　(名) 基本要素；基礎
example_sentence: Since mathematics is fundamental to engineering, students must master calculus before taking advanced courses.
