sentence_zh: 由於數學是工程的基礎，學生在修習高級課程之前必須掌握微積分。

definition_zh: (名) 基本教義派；原教旨主義
example_sentence: Rejecting modern science, fundamentalism influenced many religious communities throughout history.
sentence_zh: 拒絕現代科學，基本教義派在歷史上影響了許多宗教社群。

definition_zh: (名) 基本教義派人士；原教旨主義者
example_sentence: Religious fundamentalists who strictly follow ancient teachings often reject modern scientific explanations.
sentence_zh: 嚴格遵循古老教義的宗教基本教義派人士經常拒絕現代科學解釋。

definition_zh: (副) 根本上；基本上　(副) 從根本上；本質上
example_sentence: If the education system does not improve fundamentally, students' learning outcomes will not change significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果教育制度不從根本上改進，學生的學習成果就不會有明顯改變。

definition_zh: (名) 資金；經費　(動) 提供資金；融資
example_sentence: The government provides funding for public schools every year.
sentence_zh: 政府每年為公立學校提供經費。

definition_zh: (名) 募款；募資　(動) 募款；籌錢
example_sentence: The school organized a charity event to raise money for fundraising purposes.
sentence_zh: 學校組織慈善活動以募集善款。

definition_zh: (名) 葬禮；喪禮　(形) 與葬禮有關的；哀悼的
example_sentence: Many relatives and friends attended the funeral ceremony to pay their final respects.
sentence_zh: 許多親戚和朋友參加了葬禮以表達最後的敬意。

definition_zh: (形) 可互換的；可替代的
example_sentence: Since money is fungible, one dollar bill can be exchanged for another without any difference in value.
sentence_zh: 由於金錢是可互換的，一張一美元紙鈔可以兌換成另一張而沒有任何價值差異。

definition_zh: (名) 真菌；黴菌　(名) 菌類植物
example_sentence: Infected with fungus, the athlete's foot required immediate medical treatment.
sentence_zh: 被真菌感染的運動員足部需要立即就醫治療。

definition_zh: (名) 恐懼；沮喪　(動) 逃避；害怕　(形) 沮喪的；消沉的
example_sentence: The player who suffered a losing streak fell into a funk that lasted several weeks.
sentence_zh: 那名經歷連敗的選手陷入了持續數週的沮喪情緒。

definition_zh: (形) 有趣的；好笑的　(形) 奇怪的；可疑的
example_sentence: That comedy movie was so funny that the whole audience laughed loudly.
sentence_zh: 那部喜劇電影非常有趣，整個觀眾都大聲笑了。

definition_zh: (名) 毛皮；毛髮　(動) 生毛皮；長毛
example_sentence: If that endangered animal lost its thick fur, it would struggle to survive in the Arctic winter.
sentence_zh: 如果那隻瀕危動物失去厚厚的毛皮，在北極冬天時就很難生存。

definition_zh: (形) 極其憤怒的；狂怒的　(形) 猛烈的；激烈的
example_sentence: The coach became furious when the team lost the championship game.
sentence_zh: 當隊伍輸掉冠軍賽時，教練變得極其憤怒。

definition_zh: (副) 猛烈地；憤怒地　(副) 激烈地；狂怒地
example_sentence: Furiously typing her essay, Sarah finished her homework before the midnight deadline.
sentence_zh: 莎拉憤怒地狂打鍵盤，在午夜截止前完成了功課。

definition_zh: (名) 暫時休假；無薪假　(動) 給予暫時休假；暫時裁員
example_sentence: Although the company granted workers a furlough during the pandemic, many employees worried about their financial situation.
sentence_zh: 雖然公司在疫情期間給員工無薪假，許多員工仍擔心自己的財務狀況。

definition_zh: (名) 熔爐；火爐　(名) 極熱的地方
example_sentence: Only in the intense heat of the industrial furnace could steel be properly shaped.
sentence_zh: 只有在工業熔爐的高溫中，鋼鐵才能被正確塑形。

definition_zh: (動) 供應；提供　(動) 裝置；配置
example_sentence: The hotel furnishes rooms that meet the needs of business travelers.
sentence_zh: 這家飯店提供滿足商務旅客需求的房間。

definition_zh: (形) 配備家具的；有傢俱的　(動) 提供；配備
example_sentence: The landlord rented out furnished apartments to provide tenants with immediate housing.
sentence_zh: 房東出租配備家具的公寓，以便為租客提供立即可住的房子。

definition_zh: (名) 家具；傢俱　(名) 房間或建築物內的可動物品
example_sentence: The new bedroom furniture includes a bed, desk, and wooden wardrobe.
sentence_zh: 新臥室家具包括床、書桌和木製衣櫃。

definition_zh: (名) 公眾的憤怒；強烈不滿
example_sentence: The scandal caused a public furor among voters across the nation.
sentence_zh: 這個醜聞在全國選民中引起了公眾的強烈憤怒。

definition_zh: (形) 毛茸茸的；長滿毛髮的　(形) 模糊的；不清楚的
example_sentence: Although the photograph looked furry because of the poor camera quality, we could still recognize the building in the background.
sentence_zh: 雖然照片因為相機品質不好而看起來模糊，但我們仍然能認出背景中的建築物。

definition_zh: (動) 促進；推進　(形) 更遠的；進一步的　(副) 而且；此外
example_sentence: Further improving our study methods, we can achieve better results on the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 進一步改進我們的讀書方法，我們可以在學測上取得更好的成績。

definition_zh: (連) 而且；此外　(副) 而且；進一步地
example_sentence: The exam covers grammar and vocabulary, furthermore, students must complete a writing section.
sentence_zh: 考試涵蓋文法和單字，而且學生必須完成寫作部分。

definition_zh: (名) 狂怒；盛怒　(名) 猛烈；激烈
example_sentence: If the coach's fury were known to the team, the players would immediately apologize for their poor performance.
sentence_zh: 如果教練的狂怒為球隊所知，球員們會立即為表現不佳而道歉。

definition_zh: (動) 熔合；融合　(名) 保險絲；導火線
example_sentence: The two companies decided to fuse their resources together to create a stronger business.
sentence_zh: 這兩家公司決定融合資源以創造更強大的企業。

definition_zh: (名) 飛機機身；機艙
example_sentence: Engineers designed a lightweight fuselage to reduce fuel consumption and improve aircraft efficiency.
sentence_zh: 工程師設計了輕量化的飛機機身，以降低燃料消耗並提高飛行效率。

definition_zh: (名) 融合；核融合　(動) 融合；合併
example_sentence: The fusion of traditional music and modern technology creates innovative pop songs.
sentence_zh: 傳統音樂和現代科技的融合創造了創新的流行歌曲。

definition_zh: (名) 小題大作；麻煩事　(動) 為小事煩惱；大驚小怪　(形) 愛挑剔的；講究的
example_sentence: Although the restaurant made a small mistake with the order, the customer made a big fuss over it.
sentence_zh: 雖然餐廳的訂單出了點小錯誤，但顧客卻為此大吵大鬧。

definition_zh: (形) 徒勞的；無效的　(形) 無用的；白費的
example_sentence: Having exhausted all possible solutions, the team realized their efforts were futile.
sentence_zh: 用盡了所有可能的解決方案後，該團隊意識到他們的努力是徒勞的。

definition_zh: (名) 未來；將來　(形) 未來的；將要發生的
example_sentence: The future that awaits students who study hard is bright and full of possibilities.
sentence_zh: 等待那些認真讀書學生的未來是光明的，充滿了無限可能。

definition_zh: (形) 未來的；科幻的　具有現代或先進特徵的
example_sentence: The architect designed a futuristic building with sleek glass walls and smart technology features.
sentence_zh: 建築師設計了一棟具有未來感的建築物，配備光滑的玻璃牆和智能科技功能。

definition_zh: (名) 絨毛；模糊　(動) 變得模糊；起毛球　(形) 模糊的；不清楚的
example_sentence: If the old camera lens didn't have so much fuzz on it, the photo quality would be much clearer.
sentence_zh: 如果舊相機鏡頭上沒有那麼多絨毛，照片品質會清晰得多。

definition_zh: (形) 模糊的；不清楚的　(形) 蓬鬆的；毛茸茸的
example_sentence: The old photograph looks fuzzy, making it difficult to recognize the people in it.
sentence_zh: 這張老照片看起來很模糊，很難認出照片中的人。

definition_zh: (動) 到處遊蕩；四處閒逛
example_sentence: Gadding about the shopping mall, teenagers often lose track of time and money.
sentence_zh: 青少年在購物中心四處閒逛時，常常忘記時間和金錢。

definition_zh: (名) 小工具；小裝置　(名) 電子產品；新奇用具
example_sentence: Although the smartphone is a useful gadget, students should limit screen time during study.
sentence_zh: 雖然智慧型手機是個實用的小工具，學生在讀書時應該限制使用螢幕的時間。

definition_zh: (名) 失言；失禮的言行　(動) 犯失言的錯誤
example_sentence: Rarely does a public figure commit such an embarrassing gaffe during a live broadcast.
sentence_zh: 一位公眾人物很少在現場直播中犯如此尷尬的失言。

definition_zh: (動) 渴望；急切想要
example_sentence: The marathon runner who was gagging for water finally reached the aid station.
sentence_zh: 那位渴望喝水的馬拉松選手終於到達了補給站。

definition_zh: (名) 一群；一堆　(動) 聚集；成群
example_sentence: A gaggle of students gathered in the cafeteria to discuss the upcoming school trip.
sentence_zh: 一群學生聚集在食堂裡討論即將到來的校外教學。

definition_zh: (動) 獲得；賺取　(名) 利益；收穫
example_sentence: Working part-time at the coffee shop helped Maya gain valuable experience and confidence.
sentence_zh: 在咖啡館打工幫助瑪雅獲得寶貴的經驗和信心。

definition_zh: (名) 銀河；星系
example_sentence: The Milky Way is our home galaxy containing billions of stars.
sentence_zh: 銀河系是我們的家園星系，包含數十億顆恆星。

definition_zh: (名) 強風；狂風
example_sentence: As the gale swept across the island, fishing boats returned to harbor for safety.
sentence_zh: 當強風掃過島嶼時，漁船為了安全返回港口。

definition_zh: (形) 勇敢的；英勇的　(形) 殷勤的；彬彬有禮的
example_sentence: Standing gallantly at the ceremony, the veteran soldier received heartfelt applause from the entire audience.
sentence_zh: 那位老兵在典禮上英勇地站著，獲得全場觀眾熱烈的掌聲。

definition_zh: (名) 美術館；畫廊　(名) 走廊；樓廊
example_sentence: The art gallery that opened last month displays paintings from famous Taiwanese artists.
sentence_zh: 上個月開幕的美術館展出來自著名台灣藝術家的畫作。

definition_zh: (名) 鎵（一種金屬元素）
example_sentence: If gallium were used more widely in semiconductor manufacturing, electronic devices would become more efficient.
sentence_zh: 如果鎵在半導體製造中被更廣泛地使用，電子設備將會變得更有效率。

definition_zh: (名) 加侖（液體容量單位）；桶
example_sentence: A car's gas tank typically holds fifteen gallons of fuel.
sentence_zh: 汽車的油箱通常可以裝載十五加侖的燃料。

definition_zh: (動) 疾馳；飛快奔跑　(名) 疾馳；飛奔
example_sentence: The cavalry officer urged the horse to gallop in order to reach the village before sunset.
sentence_zh: 騎兵軍官促使馬匹疾馳，以便在日落前抵達村莊。

definition_zh: (形) 電流的；引起行動的；刺激的
example_sentence: The galvanic response in the student's nervous system increased when facing the difficult exam.
sentence_zh: 面對困難考試時，學生神經系統中的電流反應增加了。

definition_zh: (名) 開局策略；開局著法　(名) 巧妙的開場手段；策略性的第一步
example_sentence: Although the chess player sacrificed a pawn as an opening gambit, the strategy eventually led to victory.
sentence_zh: 雖然棋手在開局時犧牲了一個兵作為開局策略，但這個策略最終導致了勝利。

definition_zh: (動) 賭博；冒險　(名) 賭博；冒險行為
example_sentence: Having gambled away his savings, Tom regretted his poor financial decisions.
sentence_zh: 湯姆賭光了他的積蓄後，為自己糟糕的財務決定感到後悔。

definition_zh: (名) 賭徒；賭客　(名) 冒險者；投機者
example_sentence: The gambler who lost all his money at the casino decided to seek help from a counselor.
sentence_zh: 那位在賭場輸掉所有錢的賭徒決定向心理諮詢師尋求幫助。

definition_zh: (名) 賭博；賭錢　(動) 賭博；冒險
example_sentence: Gambling addiction causes serious financial and family problems for teenagers.
sentence_zh: 賭博成癮對青少年造成嚴重的經濟和家庭問題。

definition_zh: (名) 遊戲；比賽　(動) 玩遊戲；參賽
example_sentence: If students played educational games regularly, their English vocabulary would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生定期玩教育遊戲，他們的英文單字會進步很多。

definition_zh: (名) 電玩遊戲者；玩家
example_sentence: A serious gamer spends hours practicing competitive video games.
sentence_zh: 認真的玩家花費數小時練習競爭性電玩遊戲。

definition_zh: (名) 遊戲；電玩遊戲　(動) 玩遊戲；參與遊戲
example_sentence: Playing video games regularly, many students find it hard to focus on homework.
sentence_zh: 定期玩電玩遊戲，許多學生發現很難專心做功課。

definition_zh: (片) 聯合起來反對；一起對付
example_sentence: When the unfair rule was announced, students ganged up against it, demanding the principal reconsider the policy.
sentence_zh: 當不公平的規則公布時，學生們聯合起來反對它，要求校長重新考慮這項政策。

definition_zh: (動) 聯合起來對付；集體欺負
example_sentence: Seldom do bullies gang up on a student who stands firm and seeks help from teachers.
sentence_zh: 霸凌者很少會集體欺負那些立場堅定且尋求老師幫助的學生。

definition_zh: (名) 幫派；黑幫　(動) 聚集；組隊
example_sentence: The gang members who were arrested last month received lengthy prison sentences.
sentence_zh: 上個月被逮捕的幫派成員獲判長期徒刑。

definition_zh: (名) 幫派成員；黑道分子
example_sentence: Police arrested the gangster to prevent him from committing more crimes.
sentence_zh: 警察逮捕了這個黑道分子，以防止他犯下更多罪行。

definition_zh: (名) 監獄；牢獄
example_sentence: The criminal spent ten years in gaol after committing a serious crime.
sentence_zh: 那名罪犯在犯下重罪後在監獄裡度過了十年。

definition_zh: (名) 空隙；間隔　(名) 差距；不足
example_sentence: There is a large gap between rich and poor students in Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 台灣富裕學生和貧困學生之間存在很大的差距。

definition_zh: (名) 車庫；修車廠　(動) 把車停放在車庫裡
example_sentence: Because the garage was full of boxes, Father couldn't park the car inside last night.
sentence_zh: 因為車庫裡堆滿了箱子，爸爸昨晚無法把車停進去。

definition_zh: (名) 垃圾；廢物　(形) 劣質的；無用的
example_sentence: The garbage that piles up in landfills is a problem which society must solve.
sentence_zh: 堆積在垃圾掩埋場的垃圾是社會必須解決的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 花園；菜園　(動) 種植花草；從事園藝
example_sentence: If students maintain the school garden regularly, it will become a beautiful space for everyone.
sentence_zh: 如果學生們定期維護校園花園，它將成為一個供大家享受的美麗場所。

definition_zh: (名) 園丁；花園工人
example_sentence: The gardener waters the flowers every morning in the park.
sentence_zh: 園丁每天早上在公園裡澆花。

definition_zh: (名) 園藝；種植花草　(動) 從事園藝；整理花園
example_sentence: Many students enjoy gardening to relax after studying for exams.
sentence_zh: 許多學生喜歡從事園藝來在準備考試後放鬆身心。

definition_zh: (名) 大蒜；蒜頭
example_sentence: Garlic bread tastes delicious with butter and fresh herbs.
sentence_zh: 大蒜麵包搭配奶油和新鮮香草嚐起來很美味。

definition_zh: (名) 衣服；服裝　(名) 衣著；外衣
example_sentence: Although the winter garment was expensive, Sarah bought it because it kept her warm throughout the cold season.
sentence_zh: 雖然這件冬季衣服很昂貴，莎拉還是買了，因為它在整個寒冷季節都能讓她保暖。

definition_zh: (動) 獲得；蒐集　(動) 贏得；獲取
example_sentence: Having garnered widespread support from local communities, the environmental project finally received government funding.
sentence_zh: 這項環保專案已獲得當地社區的廣泛支持，最終獲得政府資金。

definition_zh: (動) 裝飾；點綴　(名) 裝飾品；食物配菜
example_sentence: The chef added a parsley garnish that made the dish look more appealing.
sentence_zh: 廚師加上香芹裝飾，使這道菜看起來更吸引人。

definition_zh: (名) 氣體；汽油　(動) 加油；說話不停
example_sentence: Running out of gas before reaching the gas station made the driver very anxious.
sentence_zh: 在到達加油站前就沒汽油了，使得駕駛感到非常焦慮。

definition_zh: (形) 氣態的；氣體狀的
example_sentence: If water were heated to an extremely high temperature, it would become gaseous and rise into the atmosphere.
sentence_zh: 如果水被加熱到極高溫度，它會變成氣態並上升進入大氣中。

definition_zh: (名) 汽油；油氣
example_sentence: The price of gasoline has increased significantly this month.
sentence_zh: 汽油的價格這個月已經大幅上漲。

definition_zh: (動) 喘氣；倒吸一口氣　(名) 喘息聲；倒吸氣聲
example_sentence: Gasping for air, the runner crossed the finish line with determination and relief.
sentence_zh: 喘著氣，跑者帶著決心和放鬆感越過終點線。

definition_zh: (形) 胃的；與胃有關的
example_sentence: When gastric problems occur, students should eat light meals until digestion improves.
sentence_zh: 當胃部問題出現時，學生應該吃清淡的食物直到消化改善。

definition_zh: (名) 胃腸病學；消化道醫學
example_sentence: Only after studying gastroenterology for years does the doctor truly understand digestive disorders.
sentence_zh: 只有在研習胃腸病學多年後，這位醫生才真正理解消化道疾病。

definition_zh: (名) 大門；門　(名) 入口；通道
example_sentence: The security guard checked every visitor at the gate that leads to the school.
sentence_zh: 保安人員檢查了每位進入學校的大門訪客。

definition_zh: (動) 聚集；收集　(動) 聚合；集合
example_sentence: Students gathered in the classroom to discuss the upcoming exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們聚集在教室裡討論即將到來的考試。

definition_zh: (名) 聚會；集會　(名) 集合；聚集
example_sentence: The family gathering during the Lunar New Year holiday brings relatives together from different cities.
sentence_zh: 農曆新年假期的家庭聚會讓來自不同城市的親戚聚在一起。

definition_zh: (動) 估計；判斷　(名) 量表；標準
example_sentence: Teachers gauge student progress through regular quizzes and assignments.
sentence_zh: 老師透過定期小考和作業來評估學生的進度。

definition_zh: (動) 測量；評估；判斷
example_sentence: As the teacher gauged student understanding through questions, she adjusted her teaching speed accordingly.
sentence_zh: 當老師透過提問來評估學生的理解程度時，她相應調整了教學進度。

definition_zh: (名) 紗布；薄紗　(形) 薄的；透明的
example_sentence: Using sterile gauze covering the wound, the nurse prevented infection effectively.
sentence_zh: 護士用無菌紗布覆蓋傷口，有效地防止了感染。

definition_zh: (形) 快樂的；高興的　(形) 鮮豔的；色彩繽紛的
example_sentence: The parade, which attracted thousands of gay spectators in festive costumes, celebrated the city's cultural diversity.
sentence_zh: 這場遊行吸引了數千名穿著節慶服裝的快樂觀眾，慶祝這座城市的文化多樣性。

definition_zh: (動) 凝視；注視　(名) 凝視；目光
example_sentence: If the speaker gazes directly at the audience, listeners will feel more engaged and connected.
sentence_zh: 如果演講者直視觀眾，聽眾會感到更投入和被重視。

definition_zh: (名) 涼亭；六角亭
example_sentence: The gazebo in the park provides shade for visitors on hot summer days.
sentence_zh: 公園裡的涼亭在炎熱的夏日為遊客提供遮蔭。

definition_zh: (動) 針對；為了適應　(動) 調整；準備
example_sentence: The curriculum is geared to help students master essential skills for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 這份課程設計旨在幫助學生掌握學測必備的關鍵技能。

definition_zh: (動) 針對...調整；使適應於...　朝著...方向設計
example_sentence: The new curriculum is geared towards helping students develop critical thinking skills for university entrance.
sentence_zh: 新課程針對幫助學生培養大學入學所需的批判性思維能力而設計。

definition_zh: (片) 準備；裝備　(動) 準備好；穿上裝備
example_sentence: As the soccer tournament approaches, players gear up with new uniforms and intense training.
sentence_zh: 隨著足球錦標賽臨近，選手們穿上新球衣並進行密集訓練來準備。

definition_zh: (名) 齒輪；排檔　(動) 調整；準備
example_sentence: Having geared up for the math competition, the students felt confident entering the exam room.
sentence_zh: 已經為數學競賽做好準備的學生們滿信心地走進考場。

definition_zh: (名) 排檔桿；變速桿
example_sentence: The car's gearshift, which the driver adjusted smoothly, allowed faster acceleration on the highway.
sentence_zh: 汽車的排檔桿（駕駛員平順地調整）使其在高速公路上加速更快。

definition_zh: (名) 壁虎；守宫
example_sentence: The small gecko climbed slowly up the bedroom wall at night.
sentence_zh: 那隻小壁虎在夜間慢慢地爬上臥室的牆壁。

definition_zh: (片) 驅趕；加速（馬匹）；出發
example_sentence: If the jockey shouted 'gee up' louder, the horse would run faster toward the finish line.
sentence_zh: 如果騎師喊『駕』的聲音更大聲，馬匹會跑得更快衝向終點線。

definition_zh: (動) 熱情投入；興奮談論某事
example_sentence: My brother geeks out about video games every weekend with his friends.
sentence_zh: 我哥哥每個週末都和朋友熱情地討論電動遊戲。

definition_zh: (名) 日本藝妓；日本傳統女性表演者
example_sentence: Performing traditional dances, the geisha entertained guests throughout the evening.
sentence_zh: 藝妓表演著傳統舞蹈，整晚都在招待客人。

definition_zh: (名) 凝膠；膠狀物　(動) 變成凝膠；凝固
example_sentence: Before the gel sets, you should smooth out any wrinkles with your fingers.
sentence_zh: 在凝膠凝固之前，你應該用手指把任何皺紋撫平。

definition_zh: (名) 膠質；明膠　(名) 果凍；啫喱
example_sentence: Only after the gelatin had completely set could the dessert be served to guests.
sentence_zh: 只有在明膠完全凝固後，甜點才能上桌招待客人。

definition_zh: (形) 呈膠狀的；黏稠的
example_sentence: The jellyfish, which has a gelatinous body that floats in ocean currents, amazes marine biologists.
sentence_zh: 這種水母具有呈膠狀的身體在洋流中漂浮，令海洋生物學家感到驚嘆。

definition_zh: (名) 寶石；珍寶　(動) 塞滿；卡住
example_sentence: Museums display precious gems to help visitors understand ancient civilizations.
sentence_zh: 博物館展示珍貴的寶石，幫助遊客了解古代文明。

definition_zh: (名) 寶石；寶貴的東西
example_sentence: The diamond gemstone in her engagement ring sparkled brilliantly under the wedding hall lights.
sentence_zh: 她訂婚戒指上的鑽石寶石在婚禮大廳的燈光下閃閃發亮。

definition_zh: (名) 性別；性　(形) 性別的；關於性別的
example_sentence: The school's new policy treats students of all genders with equal respect and support.
sentence_zh: 學校的新政策以平等的尊重和支持對待所有性別的學生。

definition_zh: (名) 基因；遺傳因子
example_sentence: Because genes control our traits, understanding genetics helps doctors predict health risks early.
sentence_zh: 由於基因控制我們的特徵，瞭解遺傳學能幫助醫生提早預測健康風險。

definition_zh: (名) 普遍的憤怒；廣泛的憤怒　(形) 普遍憤怒的；廣泛憤怒的
example_sentence: Feeling general anger at the unfair exam results, students organized a peaceful protest meeting.
sentence_zh: 對不公平的考試成績感到普遍憤怒，學生們組織了一次和平抗議集會。

definition_zh: (形) 一般的；普通的　(名) 將軍；將領
example_sentence: The general knowledge that students learn in junior high is the foundation which supports advanced study.
sentence_zh: 學生在國中學習的一般知識是支撐進階學習的基礎。

definition_zh: (動) 概括；推廣　(動) 歸納；得出一般性結論
example_sentence: If students generalize from one example without checking more evidence, their conclusions will often be incorrect.
sentence_zh: 如果學生未經檢驗更多證據就從一個例子推廣，他們的結論通常會是錯誤的。

definition_zh: (副) 通常；一般來說　(副) 廣泛地；普遍地
example_sentence: Generally speaking, students find math more difficult than English classes.
sentence_zh: 一般來說，學生覺得數學比英文課更困難。

definition_zh: (動) 產生；發電　(動) 引起；造成
example_sentence: Solar panels generate electricity to power homes during daytime hours.
sentence_zh: 太陽能板發電為住家在白天供電。

definition_zh: (名) 一代人；世代　(名) 生成；產生
example_sentence: The younger generation values environmental protection and sustainable living practices.
sentence_zh: 年輕一代重視環境保護和永續生活方式。

definition_zh: (名) 發電機；生成器　(名) 發生器；製造者
example_sentence: Since the power plant generator broke down, the entire factory had to suspend production for three days.
sentence_zh: 因為發電廠的發電機故障，整個工廠必須停產三天。

definition_zh: (名) 慷慨；寬宏大量　(名) 慷慨的行為；慷慨捐獻
example_sentence: Having shown great generosity to the homeless shelter, the wealthy businessman earned widespread community respect.
sentence_zh: 那位富商對無家者收容所表現出極大的慷慨，因而贏得了廣泛的社區尊重。

definition_zh: (形) 慷慨的；大方的　(形) 豐富的；充足的
example_sentence: The teacher who is generous with praise encourages students to work harder.
sentence_zh: 那位慷慨地給予讚美的老師鼓勵學生更努力學習。

definition_zh: (副) 慷慨地；大方地　(副) 豐富地；充分地
example_sentence: The local business owner generously donated money and supplies to the community center.
sentence_zh: 當地商人慷慨地向社區中心捐獻金錢和物資。

definition_zh: (名) 起源；開始　(名) 創造；形成
example_sentence: If the project lacked proper planning from genesis, it would face serious problems later.
sentence_zh: 如果這個專案從起源就缺乏適當規劃，稍後就會面臨嚴重的問題。

definition_zh: (形) 遺傳的；基因的　(形) 與生俱來的；天生的
example_sentence: Genetic factors play an important role in determining human height and appearance.
sentence_zh: 遺傳因素在決定人類身高和外觀方面起著重要作用。

definition_zh: (副) 從遺傳上；基因上地
example_sentence: Genetically modified crops, designed to resist pests, now feed millions worldwide.
sentence_zh: 經過基因改造的農作物被設計來抵抗害蟲，現在養活世界各地的數百萬人。

definition_zh: (名) 遺傳學；基因學
example_sentence: Because genetics plays a crucial role in human development, scientists study DNA to understand inherited traits.
sentence_zh: 由於遺傳學在人類發展中扮演重要角色，科學家研究DNA以了解遺傳特徵。

definition_zh: (名) 天才；天賦　(形) 極具才華的；聰慧的
example_sentence: Only after years of practice does a musical genius truly master the instrument.
sentence_zh: 只有經過多年練習，音樂天才才能真正掌握樂器。

definition_zh: (名) 文類；類型　(名) 風格；流派
example_sentence: Science fiction is a genre that attracts many teenage readers who enjoy imaginative stories.
sentence_zh: 科幻小說是一種吸引許多喜歡想像故事的青少年讀者的文類。

definition_zh: (形) 溫柔的；和藹的　(形) 輕微的；不強烈的
example_sentence: Parents use gentle voice to comfort their crying baby at night.
sentence_zh: 父母用溫柔的聲音在晚上安撫哭泣的嬰兒。

definition_zh: (名) 紳士；有禮貌的男人　(名) 先生；男士
example_sentence: A true gentleman always shows respect and kindness to everyone around him.
sentence_zh: 真正的紳士總是對身邊的每個人表現出尊重和善良。

definition_zh: (副) 溫柔地；輕輕地　(副) 溫和地；緩慢地
example_sentence: The nurse gently placed a blanket over the sleeping patient.
sentence_zh: 護士輕輕地在睡著的患者身上蓋上毛毯。

definition_zh: (名) 城市老舊地區的改造和升級；士紳化
example_sentence: As gentrification transforms the old neighborhood, longtime residents struggle to afford rising rents.
sentence_zh: 當士紳化改造這個老舊社區時，長期居住的居民難以負擔上升的租金。

definition_zh: (動) 使社區高級化；改善舊社區環境　(動) 使原住居民遷出
example_sentence: Gentrifying the old neighborhood, developers built luxury apartments and trendy cafés.
sentence_zh: 開發商改善舊社區，建造豪華公寓和時髦咖啡館。

definition_zh: (形) 真正的；真實的　(形) 誠實的；坦誠的
example_sentence: The antique vase that the museum acquired is genuine and worth millions.
sentence_zh: 博物館購得的古董花瓶是真正的，價值數百萬。

definition_zh: (副) 真誠地；真實地　(副) 發自內心地；確實地
example_sentence: If students genuinely want to improve their English skills, consistent practice will help them succeed.
sentence_zh: 如果學生真誠地想要提升英文能力，持之以恆的練習將幫助他們成功。

definition_zh: (名) 地球動力學家；研究地球內部力量和運動的科學家
example_sentence: The geodynamicist studied how tectonic plates move and shape Earth's surface.
sentence_zh: 那位地球動力學家研究了板塊如何運動和塑造地球表面。

definition_zh: (形) 地理的；地理學的　與地形、氣候、人口分佈等相關的
example_sentence: Scientists study geographical data to understand climate change patterns worldwide.
sentence_zh: 科學家研究地理數據以瞭解全球氣候變化的規律。

definition_zh: (名) 地理；地理學　(名) 地形；地勢
example_sentence: Understanding world geography helps students appreciate cultural differences and natural resources across continents.
sentence_zh: 理解世界地理有助於學生欣賞各大洲的文化差異和自然資源。

definition_zh: (名) 地質學家；研究地球和岩石的科學家
example_sentence: Because geologists study rock formations carefully, they can predict where earthquakes might occur.
sentence_zh: 因為地質學家仔細研究岩石構造，他們可以預測地震可能發生的地點。

definition_zh: (名) 地質學；地質構造
example_sentence: Having studied geology for two years, Maria understood why earthquakes occurred so frequently in Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞學了兩年地質學後，就理解了台灣為什麼經常發生地震。

definition_zh: (形) 幾何的；幾何學的　(形) 由幾何圖形組成的
example_sentence: The architect designed a building whose geometric patterns reflected ancient mathematical principles.
sentence_zh: 建築師設計了一棟建築物，其幾何圖案反映了古代的數學原理。

definition_zh: (名) 幾何學；幾何圖形
example_sentence: Understanding basic geometry and spatial relationships helps students solve complex math problems more effectively.
sentence_zh: 理解基本幾何和空間關係能幫助學生更有效地解決複雜的數學問題。

definition_zh: (形) 地熱的；地熱能的
example_sentence: If geothermal energy were more affordable, many countries would reduce their dependence on fossil fuels significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果地熱能更便宜，許多國家就會大幅降低對化石燃料的依賴。

definition_zh: (名) 細菌；病菌　(名) 萌芽；種子
example_sentence: Washing hands regularly helps remove germs and prevent illness.
sentence_zh: 定期洗手有助於去除細菌並預防疾病。

definition_zh: (形) 德國的；德語的　(名) 德國人；德語
example_sentence: Speaking German fluently, Maria impressed all the university admissions officers during interviews.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞流利地說德語，在面試中給所有大學招生官員留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 德國；德意志
example_sentence: Although Germany is located in central Europe, it has become an economic powerhouse in the modern world.
sentence_zh: 雖然德國位於中歐，但它已成為現代世界的經濟強國。

definition_zh: (名) 殺菌劑；消毒劑
example_sentence: Hardly ever does a hospital disinfectant work without germicide as its active ingredient.
sentence_zh: 幾乎沒有醫院消毒劑能在沒有殺菌劑作為活性成分的情況下發揮作用。

definition_zh: (動) 發芽；開始生長　(動) 萌發；開始發展
example_sentence: Seeds that germinate in warm soil grow into healthy plants.
sentence_zh: 在溫暖土壤中發芽的種子會長成健康的植物。

definition_zh: (名) 發芽；萌發　(動) 發芽；開始生長
example_sentence: Farmers soak seeds in water to promote germination before planting crops.
sentence_zh: 農民在種植作物前將種子浸水以促進發芽。

definition_zh: (形) 萌發的；發芽的　(形) 初期的；開始性的
example_sentence: The germinative stage of seed development requires proper moisture and temperature conditions for successful growth.
sentence_zh: 種子發育的萌發階段需要適當的濕度和溫度條件才能成功生長。

definition_zh: (名) 對細菌的極度恐懼；潔癖
example_sentence: Maria's germophobia makes her wash her hands dozens of times daily.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞對細菌的極度恐懼使她每天洗手數十次。

definition_zh: (名) 蓋世太保（納粹德國的秘密警察）
example_sentence: Although the Gestapo terrorized citizens during World War II, many brave people resisted their oppression.
sentence_zh: 雖然蓋世太保在第二次世界大戰期間恐嚇人民，但許多勇敢的人仍然抵抗他們的壓迫。

definition_zh: (名) 妊娠期；懷孕期　(名) 發展；形成期
example_sentence: Lasting nine months, gestation allows the baby's organs to develop fully before birth.
sentence_zh: 持續九個月的妊娠期讓嬰兒的器官在出生前完全發育。

definition_zh: (名) 手勢；姿態　(動) 做手勢；示意
example_sentence: The coach made a gesture that encouraged the team to keep fighting.
sentence_zh: 教練做了一個鼓勵球隊繼續奮鬥的手勢。

definition_zh: (動) 四處走動；到處旅行　(動) 傳播；流傳
example_sentence: If students get about the campus regularly, they will discover many hidden study spots.
sentence_zh: 如果學生經常在校園裡走動，他們就會發現許多隱藏的讀書地點。

definition_zh: (動) 變得傲慢；自以為是　(動) 超越；升到…之上
example_sentence: Since winning the competition, Marcus has gotten above his former friends.
sentence_zh: 自從贏得比賽後，馬庫斯對他從前的朋友變得傲慢了。

definition_zh: (動) 向…傳達；使…理解
example_sentence: Teachers use different strategies to get across to students the importance of studying hard.
sentence_zh: 老師使用不同的策略向學生傳達努力讀書的重要性。

definition_zh: (動) 傳達；表達　(動) 成功溝通；使人理解
example_sentence: The teacher's message about studying hard got across to all students in class.
sentence_zh: 老師關於努力讀書的訊息已經傳達給班上所有同學。

definition_zh: (動) 催促；督促　(動) 追趕；追捕
example_sentence: After the teacher got after the students about homework, they finished their assignments more quickly.
sentence_zh: 老師催促學生做功課之後，他們更快完成了作業。

definition_zh: (動) 取得進展；領先　(動) 向前；領先
example_sentence: Having studied hard for months, Sarah got ahead of her classmates in the math competition.
sentence_zh: 莎拉經過數月的努力學習，在數學競賽中領先了她的同學。

definition_zh: (動) 相處；相安　(動) 進展；進行
example_sentence: Students who get along well with classmates tend to enjoy school more and succeed academically.
sentence_zh: 與同學相處融洽的學生往往更喜歡上學，學業上也更成功。

definition_zh: (動) 解決；處理　(動) 四處走動；繞過
example_sentence: Getting around the city without a car requires good planning and patience.
sentence_zh: 沒有汽車在城市裡四處走動需要好的計畫和耐心。

definition_zh: (動) 想要得到；試圖達到　(動) 暗示；意指
example_sentence: If students could get at the real meaning of the difficult passage, their reading comprehension would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生能夠理解那篇困難文章的真正含義，他們的閱讀理解能力就會大幅進步。

definition_zh: (動) 逃離；遠離　　(動) 擺脫；逃避
example_sentence: The hikers wanted to get away from the busy city for a relaxing weekend.
sentence_zh: 登山者們想要逃離繁忙的城市，享受放鬆的週末。

definition_zh: (動) 逃脫；成功隱瞞　(動) 僥倖逃過；不被懲罰
example_sentence: Cheating on the exam without getting caught, some students hoped to get away with their dishonesty.
sentence_zh: 有些學生沒被發現作弊，希望能逃脫他們的不誠實行為。

definition_zh: (動) 逃脫；逃跑　(動) 躲避；避免
example_sentence: Before the police arrived, the suspect managed to get away with stolen goods.
sentence_zh: 在警察到達之前，嫌疑人設法帶著贓物逃脫了。

definition_zh: (動) 報復；對...進行報復　(動) 向...復仇；抵償
example_sentence: Seldom does Michael get back at his classmates for their mean jokes without regret.
sentence_zh: 邁克爾很少因為同學的刻薄玩笑就對他們報復，而不感到後悔。

definition_zh: (動) 重新開始；恢復參與
example_sentence: After graduation, many students find it difficult to get back into a regular study routine that they had in high school.
sentence_zh: 畢業後，許多學生發現很難重新開始他們在高中時養成的規律讀書習慣。

definition_zh: (動) 回到；回覆　(片) 與...重新聯絡；回覆
example_sentence: The teacher promised to get back to students' questions after reviewing the materials.
sentence_zh: 老師承諾在複習資料後會回覆學生的問題。

definition_zh: (動) 重新在一起；破鏡重圓
example_sentence: After breaking up for six months, Sarah and Mark decided to get back together.
sentence_zh: 分手六個月後，莎拉和馬克決定重新在一起。

definition_zh: (動) 回來；取回　(動) 報復；反擊
example_sentence: After losing the first game, the team worked hard to get back into the competition.
sentence_zh: 在輸掉第一場比賽後，這支隊伍努力工作以重新回到比賽中。

definition_zh: (動片) 落後；跟不上　(動片) 欠下；積欠
example_sentence: Because Mark didn't study regularly, he got behind with his homework assignments.
sentence_zh: 因為馬克沒有定期讀書，他的家庭作業開始積欠。

definition_zh: (動) 支持；贊成　落後；跟不上
example_sentence: Getting behind the new school recycling program, many students organized collection points around campus.
sentence_zh: 支持學校新的資源回收計畫，許多學生在校園各處設置了收集點。

definition_zh: (動片) ɡɛt bɑɪ ɑn 勉強維持生活；用...艱難度日
example_sentence: Many students who work part-time jobs get by on savings that barely cover rent and food.
sentence_zh: 許多兼職打工的學生靠著勉強維持的儲蓄度日，幾乎無法支付房租和食物。

definition_zh: (動) 勉強應付；湊合著過　(動) 用有限的資源勉強維生
example_sentence: If the company reduces its budget, employees will have to get by with fewer resources next year.
sentence_zh: 如果公司削減預算，員工們明年將必須用更少的資源來勉強應付。

definition_zh: (動) 勉強維持；湊合著過日子　(動) 對付；應付
example_sentence: Working part-time helps students get by during expensive university years.
sentence_zh: 打工幫助學生在昂貴的大學時期勉強維持生活。

definition_zh: (動) 趴在…上面；伏在…上　(動) 開始認真做；投入
example_sentence: Athletes get down on their hands and knees to stretch their muscles before competition.
sentence_zh: 運動員在比賽前趴在地上用雙手雙膝伸展肌肉。

definition_zh: (動) 開始認真做；著手進行
example_sentence: After wasting two weeks, the students finally got down to studying for the midterm exam.
sentence_zh: 浪費了兩週後，學生們終於開始認真為期中考讀書。

definition_zh: (動) 下來；趴下　(動) 認真做；專心處理
example_sentence: After the teacher explained the rules, students got down to practicing the grammar exercises seriously.
sentence_zh: 老師說明規則之後，學生認真地著手練習文法題目。

definition_zh: (動) 參與；加入　(動) 分享；參加
example_sentence: Having gotten in on the school's new robotics club, many students discovered their passion for engineering.
sentence_zh: 已經參加了學校新創辦的機器人社團後，許多學生發現了他們對工程的熱情。

definition_zh: (動) 與…交好；開始與…來往　(動) 參與；涉入
example_sentence: Students who get in with the right crowd often find school more enjoyable and supportive.
sentence_zh: 與志同道合的人交好的學生往往會發現學校生活更加愉快且有幫助。

definition_zh: (動) 進入；上車　(動) 到達；進行
example_sentence: After waiting thirty minutes, passengers finally got in the crowded bus heading downtown.
sentence_zh: 等待三十分鐘後，乘客終於上了開往市中心的擁擠公車。

definition_zh: (動) 獲得；取得　(動) 洞察；深入理解
example_sentence: If students read that novel carefully, they would get insight into human nature and society.
sentence_zh: 如果學生仔細閱讀那部小說，他們就能深入理解人性和社會。

definition_zh: (動) 惹麻煩；引起問題　(動) 陷入；遭遇
example_sentence: Cheating on the exam got Tom into serious trouble with school authorities.
sentence_zh: 在考試中作弊讓湯姆與學校當局惹上了大麻煩。

definition_zh: (動) 進入；陷入　(動) 被...錄取；被...接納
example_sentence: Getting into a top university requires consistent study and strong test scores throughout high school.
sentence_zh: 進入頂尖大學需要在高中期間持續用功和取得優異的考試成績。

definition_zh: (動) 開始親吻或接吻；發生性行為
example_sentence: When the music started playing at the party, many couples got it on on the dance floor.
sentence_zh: 當派對上的音樂開始播放時，許多情侶在舞池裡開始親吻。

definition_zh: (動) 使某物豎起；鼓起勇氣
example_sentence: Only after several attempts could the team get it up the steep hill.
sentence_zh: 只有經過幾次嘗試後，這支隊伍才能將它搬上陡峭的山坡。

definition_zh: (動) 理解；明白　(動) 掌握；領會
example_sentence: The math concept that confuses many students is the one that requires careful thinking to get it.
sentence_zh: 讓許多學生感到困惑的數學概念是需要仔細思考才能理解的那個。

definition_zh: (片) 別胡說；停止吹牛　(片) 別烦我；住手
example_sentence: Stop exaggerating to impress everyone—get off it and tell us the truth.
sentence_zh: 別為了給人留下好印象而誇大其詞——別胡說了，告訴我們真相吧。

definition_zh: (動) 因某事而興奮；喜歡某事
example_sentence: Some people get off on extreme sports like skydiving and rock climbing.
sentence_zh: 有些人因為跳傘和攀岩等極限運動而感到興奮。

definition_zh: (動) 與…親密；和…有染；逃脫懲罰
example_sentence: The suspect got off with only a warning despite breaking several laws.
sentence_zh: 儘管違反了幾項法律，該嫌疑人僅因警告而逃脫懲罰。

definition_zh: (動片) 下班；放工
example_sentence: After finishing the project, Maria gets off work at six o'clock every weekday.
sentence_zh: 完成專案後，瑪麗亞每個工作日都在六點下班。

definition_zh: (動) 下車；離開　(動) 逃脫；免除懲罰
example_sentence: Getting off the bus at the correct stop, students avoided being late for class.
sentence_zh: 在正確的站牌下車，學生們避免了上課遲到。

definition_zh: (動) 在…處上車；與…相處融洽
example_sentence: The student who gets on at Taipei Main Station every morning sits near the window.
sentence_zh: 每天早上在台北車站上車的學生坐在窗邊。

definition_zh: (片) 接近；快要；相處融洽
example_sentence: If the project gets on for another month, the team will complete all required tasks.
sentence_zh: 如果這個專案再進行一個月，團隊將完成所有必要的工作。

definition_zh: (片) 開始處理；著手進行　(片) 聯繫；接觸
example_sentence: Once the project deadline approaches, the team needs to get on to planning the final presentation carefully.
sentence_zh: 一旦專案截止日期接近，團隊需要著手仔細規劃最終的展示。

definition_zh: (動) 與...相處；進展順利
example_sentence: Students study hard every day to get on with their classmates and improve their exam scores.
sentence_zh: 學生每天努力讀書是為了與同學相處融洽並提高考試成績。

definition_zh: (動) 上車；登上　(動) 進展；相處
example_sentence: After finishing homework, students get on the bus to head home.
sentence_zh: 完成功課後，學生上公車回家。

definition_zh: (片) 初次嘗試；開始涉入
example_sentence: After joining the debate club, Maria got her feet wet by participating in a practice round before the real competition.
sentence_zh: 加入辯論社後，瑪麗亞在真正的比賽前先參加練習賽以初次嘗試。

definition_zh: (動) 上車；登上　(動) 與…談話；開始談論
example_sentence: Having gotten onto the bus, the tired student finally found a seat and closed his eyes.
sentence_zh: 上了公車後，疲倦的學生終於找到座位並閉上眼睛。

definition_zh: (片) 逃脫；擺脫　(片) 逃避；避免
example_sentence: The student who got out of the difficult exam through dishonesty faced serious consequences.
sentence_zh: 透過不誠實逃避困難考試的學生面臨了嚴重的後果。

definition_zh: (動) 離開；出去　滾出去；離開某地
example_sentence: We need to get out of the house before the storm arrives.
sentence_zh: 暴風雨來臨前，我們需要離開房子。

definition_zh: (動) 快速完成；盡快結束
example_sentence: If students finished the difficult exam early, they would get over with the stress quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生們能早點完成這份困難的考試，他們會很快擺脫壓力。

definition_zh: (動) 克服；度過　(動) 原諒；不再生氣
example_sentence: After months of practice, Maria finally got over her fear of public speaking.
sentence_zh: 經過數個月的練習，瑪麗亞終於克服了她對公開演講的恐懼。

definition_zh: (動) 去掉；除去　(動) 擺脫；丟棄
example_sentence: Having gotten rid of old clothes, Sarah donated them to charity.
sentence_zh: 莎拉丟棄了舊衣服後，把它們捐給慈善機構。

definition_zh: (動片) 抽出時間做某事；終於去做
example_sentence: After finishing the project, Sarah finally got round to cleaning her messy bedroom.
sentence_zh: 完成專案後，莎拉終於抽出時間打掃她凌亂的房間。

definition_zh: (動) 繞過；迴避　(動) 走動；活動
example_sentence: Only by asking the principal directly could the students get round the strict school rules.
sentence_zh: 只有直接詢問校長，學生才能繞過嚴格的校規。

definition_zh: (片) 積極投入；認真從事
example_sentence: Students who get stuck in their study groups often improve their test scores.
sentence_zh: 認真投入讀書小組的學生常常提高他們的考試成績。

definition_zh: (動) 陷入困境；被卡住　(片) 遇到困難；無法繼續
example_sentence: Students study hard every day to get stuck less often on difficult exam questions.
sentence_zh: 學生每天努力讀書是為了在困難的考試題目上少陷入困境。

definition_zh: (動) 成功傳達；聯絡上　(動) 說服；使理解
example_sentence: The teacher finally got through to the student after explaining the math problem three times.
sentence_zh: 老師用三次解釋後，終於成功讓這位學生理解了數學題。

definition_zh: (動) 完成；度過　(動) 接通；聯絡
example_sentence: Studying hard every day helps students get through the difficult entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 每天用功讀書幫助學生度過困難的入學考試。

definition_zh: (動) 到達；開始　(動) 有機會；設法
example_sentence: Before the concert starts, fans queue early to get to their favorite seats.
sentence_zh: 演唱會開始前，粉絲早早排隊以便能到達他們喜歡的座位。

definition_zh: (動) 從事；參與　(動) 達到；進行到
example_sentence: Getting up to mischief in the cafeteria, the students forgot about their afternoon classes.
sentence_zh: 在餐廳搗亂的學生們忘記了下午的課程。

definition_zh: (動) 起床；起身　(動) 組織；籌辦
example_sentence: Students who get up early usually have better focus in morning classes.
sentence_zh: 早起的學生通常在早上課堂中專注力較好。

definition_zh: (動) 得到；獲得　(動) 變成；開始
example_sentence: If you study hard, you will get a high score on the exam.
sentence_zh: 如果你用功讀書，你就會在考試中得到高分。

definition_zh: (動) 除去；丟棄　擺脫；消除
example_sentence: We need to get rid of old furniture before moving to the new apartment.
sentence_zh: 我們搬到新公寓前需要丟棄舊傢俱。

definition_zh: (名) 貧民區；少數民族聚集區
example_sentence: Community volunteers organized programs to help young people in the ghetto escape poverty.
sentence_zh: 社區志工組織計畫來幫助貧民區的年輕人擺脫貧窮。

definition_zh: (名) 幽靈；鬼　(名) 幽靈般的人；淡淡的蹤跡
example_sentence: The old ghost story scared many students at the Halloween party.
sentence_zh: 那個老鬼故事在萬聖節派對上嚇到許多學生。

definition_zh: (名) 食屍鬼；怪物
example_sentence: Because ghouls haunt abandoned cemeteries at night, locals avoid the area after dark.
sentence_zh: 因為食屍鬼在夜間出沒於廢棄的墓地，當地人在天黑後避開該區域。

definition_zh: (名) 巨人；龐然大物　(形) 巨大的；偉大的
example_sentence: Having grown into a giant corporation, the tech company now employs thousands of workers worldwide.
sentence_zh: 這家科技公司已成長為一個巨大的企業，如今在世界各地僱用數千名員工。

definition_zh: (形) 暈眩的；頭昏眼花的　(形) 輕浮的；不認真的
example_sentence: The student who felt giddy after spinning around dizzily decided to sit down.
sentence_zh: 那個旋轉後感到暈眩的學生決定坐下來。

definition_zh: (名) 禮物；贈禮　(動) 贈送；給予
example_sentence: Receiving a birthday gift from close friends always makes students feel special and loved.
sentence_zh: 從親密朋友收到生日禮物總是讓學生感到特別且被愛。

definition_zh: (形) 有天賦的；才華出眾的　(形) 天生的；與生俱來的
example_sentence: If Maria were gifted in music, she would have become a professional pianist by now.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪麗亞在音樂方面有天賦，她現在早就成為專業鋼琴家了。

definition_zh: (名) 演唱會；音樂會　(名) 臨時工作；短期工作
example_sentence: The band performed at three gigs last weekend across different cities.
sentence_zh: 樂隊上週末在不同城市進行了三場演唱會。

definition_zh: (形) 巨大的；龐大的　(形) 非常大的；極其巨大的
example_sentence: Covering an entire city block, the gigantic shopping mall attracted millions of visitors annually.
sentence_zh: 這座巨大的購物中心佔據整個街區，每年吸引數百萬遊客。

definition_zh: (動) 咯咯笑；傻笑　(名) 咯咯笑；輕聲笑
example_sentence: Although the movie wasn't very funny, the audience giggled whenever the clumsy actor fell down.
sentence_zh: 雖然這部電影不太好笑，但每當那位笨拙的演員跌倒時，觀眾都會咯咯笑。

definition_zh: (名) 金箔；鍍金　(形) 金色的；鍍金的
example_sentence: Only after the artist applied gilt to the frame did its true beauty emerge.
sentence_zh: 只有在藝術家將金箔貼到框架上之後，它的真正美感才顯現出來。

definition_zh: (動) 製造；激發　(動) 捏造；虛構
example_sentence: The marketing campaign, which ginned up excitement among young consumers, successfully boosted sales.
sentence_zh: 這個行銷活動激發年輕消費者的興奮感，成功促進了銷售。

definition_zh: (動) 使...活躍；使...更有活力　(動) 加快步伐；促進
example_sentence: The coach added some exciting music to ginger up the team's energy during training.
sentence_zh: 教練加入一些令人興奮的音樂來振奮隊伍在訓練中的精力。

definition_zh: (名) 薑；生薑　(形) 薑色的；活潑的
example_sentence: Ginger root and honey tea helps soothe a sore throat during cold season.
sentence_zh: 薑根和蜂蜜茶在感冒季節有助於舒緩喉嚨痛。

definition_zh: (副) 小心翼翼地；謹慎地　(副) 輕輕地；溫和地
example_sentence: The nurse gingerly removed the bandage from the patient's wound.
sentence_zh: 護士小心翼翼地從病人的傷口上移除繃帶。

definition_zh: (名) 長頸鹿
example_sentence: Although giraffes have extremely long necks, they can only eat leaves from tall trees.
sentence_zh: 雖然長頸鹿有極長的脖子，但牠們只能吃高樹的葉子。

definition_zh: (名) 女孩；女孩子　(名) 女性；女人
example_sentence: Playing in the park, the girl found a small kitten under the tree.
sentence_zh: 在公園裡玩耍的那個女孩在樹下發現了一隻小貓。

definition_zh: (名) 女朋友；交往的女性
example_sentence: The girl whom Mark introduced is his new girlfriend from Australia.
sentence_zh: 馬克介紹的那個女孩是他來自澳洲的新女朋友。

definition_zh: (名) 要點；主旨　(名) 核心內容；梗概
example_sentence: If you understand the gist of the article, you will be able to answer most questions correctly.
sentence_zh: 如果你理解這篇文章的要點，你就能夠正確回答大部分的問題。

definition_zh: (動) 分發；送出　(動) 洩露；揭露
example_sentence: The school gave away free notebooks to all new students yesterday.
sentence_zh: 學校昨天把免費筆記本發給所有新生。

definition_zh: (動) 歸還；退回　(動) 回饋；貢獻
example_sentence: Many graduates volunteer at schools to give back to their communities.
sentence_zh: 許多畢業生在學校志願服務，目的是回饋社區。

definition_zh: (動) 屈服；讓步　(動) 沉溺於；沉迷於
example_sentence: After months of pressure from friends, Sarah finally gave in to peer pressure and joined the drama club.
sentence_zh: 經過朋友數月的壓力，莎拉最後屈服於同儕壓力，加入了戲劇社。

definition_zh: (動) 讓步；屈服　放棄；投降
example_sentence: Although Maria studied hard, she gave in to exhaustion and fell asleep before finishing the exam.
sentence_zh: 雖然瑪麗亞努力讀書，但她還是屈服於疲勞，在完成考試前就睡著了。

definition_zh: (動) 給予；交給　(片) 全力以赴；盡力
example_sentence: Having given it to the teacher, the student felt relieved and confident about the exam.
sentence_zh: 把作業交給老師後，學生對考試感到放心且有信心。

definition_zh: (動片) 為…鼓掌；為…喝彩
example_sentence: Let's give it up for the students who won the science competition.
sentence_zh: 讓我們為贏得科學競賽的學生們鼓掌。

definition_zh: (動) 為某人鼓掌；向某人喝彩
example_sentence: Let's give it up to our hardworking school band for winning the competition.
sentence_zh: 讓我們為贏得比賽的辛勤校樂隊鼓掌吧。

definition_zh: (動) 給予；提供　(動) 貢獻；奉獻
example_sentence: If volunteers gave of their time more often, the community center would serve twice as many families.
sentence_zh: 如果志工能更常奉獻時間，社區中心就能服務兩倍的家庭。

definition_zh: (動) 散發；放出　(動) 發出
example_sentence: The factory gives off harmful smoke into the air every day.
sentence_zh: 這家工廠每天向空氣中散發有害的煙霧。

definition_zh: (動) 給予；賦予　(動) 朝向；面對
example_sentence: Having given onto the stage, the nervous performer felt the audience's energy lifting spirits.
sentence_zh: 將舞台交給演員後，緊張的表演者感受到觀眾的能量振奮了精神。

definition_zh: (動) 放棄；停止　(動) 投降；認輸
example_sentence: Although the exam was difficult, Maria refused to give up and studied harder every day.
sentence_zh: 雖然考試很難，瑪莉亞拒絕放棄，每天更努力地讀書。

definition_zh: (動) 給予；給　(動) 提供；授予
example_sentence: Not only does Maria give money to charity, but also her time.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞不僅將金錢捐給慈善機構，也貢獻她的時間。

definition_zh: (名) 無意中洩露的線索；破綻　(形) 免費贈送的；廉價的
example_sentence: The nervous smile was a dead giveaway that revealed the secret hiding in plain sight.
sentence_zh: 那緊張的微笑是個明顯的破綻，洩露了隱藏在眼前的祕密。

definition_zh: (動) 給予；贈送　(名) 給予；捐獻
example_sentence: The charity organization worked hard at giving food and clothes to homeless families.
sentence_zh: 慈善機構努力工作，目的是向無家可歸的家庭提供食物和衣服。

definition_zh: (動) 屈服；讓步　(動) 向…投降；放棄抵抗
example_sentence: After arguing for hours, Maria finally gave in to her parents' wishes about her future career.
sentence_zh: 經過數小時的爭論後，瑪麗亞最終向父母關於她未來職業的願望讓步了。

definition_zh: (連) 既然；因為　(介) 考慮到；鑑於
example_sentence: Given that the exam is next week, students should start studying now.
sentence_zh: 既然考試下週進行，學生現在應該開始讀書。

definition_zh: (形) 已給定的；特定的　(介) 考慮到；鑒於
example_sentence: Given the tight exam schedule, many students study late into the night.
sentence_zh: 鑒於緊密的考試時程，許多學生熬夜念書。

definition_zh: (形) 冰川的；冰冷的　(形) 極其緩慢的；冷淡的
example_sentence: Melting rapidly due to climate change, glacial ice sheets threaten coastal cities worldwide.
sentence_zh: 由於氣候變遷而迅速融化，冰川冰層對世界各地沿海城市構成威脅。

definition_zh: (名) 冰川；冰河
example_sentence: The glacier that covers much of Greenland is melting rapidly due to climate change.
sentence_zh: 覆蓋格陵蘭大部分地區的冰川，由於氣候變遷正在快速融化。

definition_zh: (形) 高興的；快樂的　(形) 樂意的；願意的
example_sentence: If you study hard now, you will be glad to see your test scores improve.
sentence_zh: 如果你現在努力讀書，你會很高興看到考試成績進步。

definition_zh: (名) 空地；林間空地
example_sentence: The hiker discovered a sunny glade surrounded by tall trees.
sentence_zh: 登山者發現了一片被高大樹木環繞的晴朗空地。

definition_zh: (名) 魅力；光彩　(動) 使...具有魅力
example_sentence: Many celebrities use social media to glamor their public image.
sentence_zh: 許多名人利用社群媒體來增添自己的公眾形象魅力。

definition_zh: (形) 光彩奪目的；迷人的　(形) 華麗的；魅力十足的
example_sentence: The glamorous movie star and her elegant designer dress attracted everyone's attention at the awards ceremony.
sentence_zh: 那位光彩奪目的電影明星和她優雅的設計師禮服在頒獎典禮上吸引了所有人的目光。

definition_zh: (動) 匆匆看；瞥一眼　(名) 一瞥；匆匆一看
example_sentence: While reading the newspaper, Tom glanced at the headlines before going to school.
sentence_zh: 湯姆在讀報紙時，於上學前匆匆瞥了一眼標題。

definition_zh: (動) 匆匆一瞥；掃一眼　(名) 一瞥；眼神
example_sentence: Having glanced at the exam questions, Tom felt more confident about the test.
sentence_zh: 匆匆掃過考試題目後，湯姆對這次考試更有信心了。

definition_zh: (名) 腺體；腺
example_sentence: The sweat glands that produce moisture help cool the body during exercise.
sentence_zh: 在運動期間產生水分的汗腺有助於身體散熱。

definition_zh: (名) 刺眼的光；眩光　(動) 發出刺眼的光；瞪視
example_sentence: The sun's glare on the water made driving dangerous during afternoon.
sentence_zh: 水面上陽光的眩光使得下午開車很危險。

definition_zh: (名) 玻璃；玻璃杯　(動) 用玻璃覆蓋
example_sentence: If the glass window were not so thick, the noise from outside would bother us during study time.
sentence_zh: 如果玻璃窗不是那麼厚，外面的噪音在我們讀書時就會打擾我們。

definition_zh: (名) 眼鏡；玻璃杯
example_sentence: Sarah wears glasses to read books and study for exams.
sentence_zh: 莎拉戴著眼鏡讀書和準備考試。

definition_zh: (名) 玻璃器皿；玻璃製品
example_sentence: Broken glassware scattered across the kitchen floor needs careful cleaning.
sentence_zh: 散落在廚房地板上的破碎玻璃器皿需要仔細清理。

definition_zh: (形) 光滑透明的；玻璃般的　(形) 呆滯的；無神的
example_sentence: Although the lake appeared glassy on the surface, strong currents flowed beneath the water.
sentence_zh: 雖然湖面看起來光滑透明，但水下卻有強勁的水流。

definition_zh: (名) 微光；閃光　(動) 發出微光；閃爍
example_sentence: Seldom does such brilliant gleam appear in the night sky over Taipei.
sentence_zh: 台北夜空上很少出現這樣燦爛的微光。

definition_zh: (動) 收集；蒐集　(動) 獲取；取得
example_sentence: The researcher gleaned valuable data from interviews which she conducted carefully.
sentence_zh: 這位研究員從她仔細進行的訪談中收集到寶貴的數據。

definition_zh: (名) 歡樂；喜悅　(動) 欣喜；高興
example_sentence: Students sang songs to express glee at winning the debate competition.
sentence_zh: 學生唱歌來表達贏得辯論比賽的歡樂。

definition_zh: (動) 滑行；滑翔　(名) 滑行；滑翔動作
example_sentence: The ice skater glided smoothly across the frozen lake without making any mistakes.
sentence_zh: 那位滑冰選手在結冰的湖面上平穩滑行，沒有犯任何錯誤。

definition_zh: (名) 滑翔機；滑行者　(動) 滑翔；滑行
example_sentence: The pilot controlled the glider smoothly through the sky.
sentence_zh: 飛行員順利地控制滑翔機穿過天空。

definition_zh: (名) 微弱的光；閃爍　(動) 發出微弱的光；閃爍
example_sentence: As the candle flickered, a faint glimmer appeared in the darkness, giving us hope.
sentence_zh: 當蠟燭搖晃時，黑暗中出現微弱的光芒，給了我們希望。

definition_zh: (名) 一瞥；匆匆一看　(動) 瞥見；匆匆看到
example_sentence: Glimpsing the famous singer walking through the mall, excited fans rushed toward her immediately.
sentence_zh: 瞥見那位著名歌手走過購物中心，興奮的粉絲立即向她衝去。

definition_zh: (動) 閃閃發光；閃爍
example_sentence: The lake glistens in the sunlight, which creates a beautiful scene.
sentence_zh: 那個在陽光下閃閃發光的湖面，呈現出美麗的景象。

definition_zh: (名) 閃光；亮粉　(動) 閃閃發光；發出光澤　(形) 閃耀的；炫麗的
example_sentence: If the stage lighting reflects on the dancer's costume, glitter will shine brilliantly throughout the entire performance.
sentence_zh: 如果舞台燈光照射到舞者的服裝上，亮粉就會在整場表演中閃耀光彩。

definition_zh: (形) 閃閃發光的；華麗耀眼的
example_sentence: The glitzy casino in Las Vegas attracted millions of tourists every year.
sentence_zh: 拉斯維加斯那家華麗耀眼的賭場每年吸引數百萬遊客。

definition_zh: (形) 全球的；全世界的　(形) 整體的；全面的
example_sentence: Many companies use social media to reach global audiences and promote their products.
sentence_zh: 許多公司使用社群媒體來接觸全球客眾並推廣他們的產品。

definition_zh: (名) 全球化；世界一體化
example_sentence: Globalization has made international trade and cultural exchange increasingly common.
sentence_zh: 全球化使得國際貿易和文化交流變得越來越普遍。

definition_zh: (名) 地球；世界　(名) 地球儀；圓球
example_sentence: As the globe warms, many island nations face serious flooding threats.
sentence_zh: 隨著地球暖化，許多島國面臨嚴重的洪水威脅。

definition_zh: (名) 黑暗；陰沉　(形) 陰沉的；沮喪的
example_sentence: Having endured years of failure, the abandoned factory stood shrouded in gloom and silence.
sentence_zh: 經歷多年失敗後，被遺棄的工廠籠罩在陰沉與寂靜中。

definition_zh: (形) 陰沉的；憂鬱的　(形) 昏暗的；陰暗的
example_sentence: The rainy weather that made students feel gloomy lasted for three weeks.
sentence_zh: 那個讓學生感到憂鬱的雨天天氣持續了三週。

definition_zh: (動) 頌揚；讚美　(動) 美化；使顯得光榮
example_sentence: The documentary glorifies environmental heroes and inspires young people to protect nature.
sentence_zh: 這部紀錄片頌揚環保英雄，激勵年輕人保護自然。

definition_zh: (形) 光榮的；輝煌的　(形) 壯麗的；華麗的
example_sentence: If the team's performance were glorious, winning the championship would become their proudest moment.
sentence_zh: 如果該隊的表現光榮輝煌，贏得冠軍就會成為他們最驕傲的時刻。

definition_zh: (名) 榮耀；光榮　(名) 偉大的成就；讚譽
example_sentence: Winning the national basketball championship brought glory to the school.
sentence_zh: 贏得全國籃球冠軍為學校帶來了榮耀。

definition_zh: (名) 光澤；光彩　(動) 掩蓋；粉飾　(形) 有光澤的；光滑的
example_sentence: Glossing over the mistakes, the manager presented the project as completely successful.
sentence_zh: 經理掩飾那些錯誤，把專案呈現得完全成功。

definition_zh: (名) 詞彙表；術語解釋表　(名) 附錄；補充說明
example_sentence: Although the chemistry textbook included a glossary, students still found many difficult terms confusing.
sentence_zh: 雖然化學課本附有詞彙表，學生仍然對許多難詞感到困惑。

definition_zh: (名) 害怕在公眾場合說話的恐懼症；當眾演講恐懼症
example_sentence: Never has glossophobia prevented Maria from sharing her brilliant ideas in class presentations.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞的當眾演講恐懼症從未阻止她在課堂報告中分享她聰慧的想法。

definition_zh: (形) 光滑有光澤的；光亮的　(形) 表面光滑反光的
example_sentence: The glossy magazine that she bought at the bookstore featured famous celebrities on its cover.
sentence_zh: 她在書店買的那本光澤雜誌的封面上有著名明星。

definition_zh: (名) 手套　(動) 戴手套；用手套覆蓋
example_sentence: Athletes wear boxing gloves to protect their hands during training.
sentence_zh: 運動員在訓練時戴拳擊手套以保護他們的雙手。

definition_zh: (動) 發光；照亮　(名) 光輝；光芒
example_sentence: The neon signs glow brightly in the night market, attracting many teenagers shopping.
sentence_zh: 霓虹招牌在夜市裡明亮發光，吸引許多青少年購物。

definition_zh: (形) 發光的；明亮的　(形) 熱情的；充滿活力的
example_sentence: The glowing lanterns lit up the night sky during the festival.
sentence_zh: 節慶期間發光的燈籠照亮了夜空。

definition_zh: (名) 葡萄糖；血糖
example_sentence: Because glucose enters the bloodstream quickly, athletes drink it during competitions when their energy drops.
sentence_zh: 因為葡萄糖快速進入血液，運動員在比賽中能量下降時會飲用它。

definition_zh: (名) 膠水；黏著劑　(動) 用膠水黏；緊緊貼住
example_sentence: Gluing the broken pieces together, the student carefully repaired the ceramic vase.
sentence_zh: 學生仔細地用膠水黏合破碎的陶瓷花瓶。

definition_zh: (副) 悶悶不樂地；沮喪地
example_sentence: The student who failed the exam stared glumly at the failing grade displayed on screen.
sentence_zh: 考試不及格的學生悶悶不樂地盯著螢幕上顯示的不合格成績。

definition_zh: (名) 麵筋；麩質
example_sentence: If people consume gluten regularly, they may develop digestive problems over time.
sentence_zh: 如果人們經常食用麩質，他們可能會長期發展出消化問題。

definition_zh: (形) 黏性的；黏稠的
example_sentence: Glutinous rice is a popular ingredient in many Asian desserts and dishes.
sentence_zh: 糯米是許多亞洲甜點和菜餚中常見的材料。

definition_zh: (名) 貪吃的人；饕餮者　(形) 貪吃的；貪得無厭的
example_sentence: Mark exercises regularly to avoid becoming a glutton for unhealthy snacks and drinks.
sentence_zh: 馬克定期運動以避免變成貪吃不健康零食和飲料的人。

definition_zh: (名) 貪食；暴食　(名) 貪婪；過度放縱
example_sentence: Excessive eating and drinking without moderation represents gluttony that harms both body and wallet.
sentence_zh: 過度飲食且不知節制代表傷害身體和荷包的貪食行為。

definition_zh: (名) 符號；字形　(名) 雕刻；浮雕
example_sentence: As the designer studied each glyph carefully, the ancient symbols gradually revealed their hidden cultural meaning.
sentence_zh: 當設計師仔細研究每個符號時，這些古老的象形文字逐漸揭露了它們隱藏的文化意義。

definition_zh: (形) 雕刻的；刻畫的　(形) 象形文字的；圖形的
example_sentence: Having studied the glyphic symbols carved on ancient temple walls, the archaeology team uncovered remarkable historical evidence.
sentence_zh: 考古團隊研究了刻在古廟牆上的象形符號後，發現了非凡的歷史證據。

definition_zh: (名) 小飛蟲；蚋
example_sentence: The tiny gnat that buzzes around your face can be very annoying during summer.
sentence_zh: 在夏天嗡嗡飛繞著你臉部的小蚋蟲可能非常令人厭煩。

definition_zh: (動) 啃咬；咬　(動) 逐漸侵蝕；折磨
example_sentence: The worried student gnawed at his pencil while studying for the difficult exam.
sentence_zh: 那位擔心的學生在準備難考試時一直啃著他的鉛筆。

definition_zh: (片) 大有幫助；產生重遠的影響
example_sentence: If practicing English conversation every day would go a long way toward passing the CSAT listening test, many students would study harder.
sentence_zh: 如果每天練習英文對話對於通過學測聽力測驗大有幫助，許多學生就會更用功讀書。

definition_zh: (動) 著手進行；處理　(動) 四處走動；活動
example_sentence: Maria went about her homework carefully, finishing each problem step by step.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞認真著手做功課，逐步完成每一題。

definition_zh: (動) 出發；開始　(動) 爆炸；發出聲音
example_sentence: The alarm going off at midnight startled everyone sleeping in the dormitory.
sentence_zh: 午夜時鬧鐘響起，嚇到了宿舍裡所有睡覺的人。

definition_zh: (片語) 去約會；談戀愛
example_sentence: Before going on a date, Sarah practiced her conversation skills to feel more confident.
sentence_zh: 在去約會之前，莎拉練習了她的談話技巧以感到更自信。

definition_zh: (動) 罷工；罷課
example_sentence: Only after the company refused to raise wages did the workers go on strike.
sentence_zh: 只有在公司拒絕加薪之後，工人們才罷工。

definition_zh: (動) 過度；做得太過分
example_sentence: The party planner who went overboard with decorations spent twice the budget.
sentence_zh: 那位過度裝飾的派對策劃者花費了兩倍的預算。

definition_zh: (動) 經歷；經過　(動) 仔細檢查；審視
example_sentence: Students need to go through all the practice tests to prepare for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 學生需要仔細檢查所有的模擬考卷以準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (動) 進行順利；發展良好
example_sentence: The school project went well because everyone cooperated and worked hard together.
sentence_zh: 因為每個人都合作並努力工作，所以這個學校專案進行順利。

definition_zh: (名) 同意；許可　(形) 積極的；願意幫忙的
example_sentence: The principal gave the go-ahead for the school festival to proceed next month.
sentence_zh: 校長同意了學校節慶下個月繼續進行。

definition_zh: (動) 刺激；促使　(名) 刺棒；鞭子
example_sentence: As the coach goaded the team onto the field, players felt motivated to perform their best.
sentence_zh: 當教練刺激球隊上場時，選手們感到被激勵要表現最好。

definition_zh: (名) 目標；進球　(動) 進球；得分
example_sentence: Working toward their goal, the soccer team practiced every day after school.
sentence_zh: 朝著他們的目標努力，這支足球隊每天放學後都會練習。

definition_zh: (名) 守門員；門將
example_sentence: The goalkeeper who made that incredible save is the player that everyone admires.
sentence_zh: 那位做出不可思議撲救的守門員是大家都欽佩的球員。

definition_zh: (名) 山羊；羊
example_sentence: If the farmer raises goats on his farm, he will produce fresh milk for the village.
sentence_zh: 如果農夫在他的農場飼養山羊，他將為村莊生產新鮮牛奶。

definition_zh: (動) 狼吞虎嚥；快速吃　(動) 發出咯咯聲
example_sentence: The hungry dog gobbled down its food in seconds without chewing.
sentence_zh: 那隻餓狗狼吞虎嚥地在幾秒內吃完食物，根本沒咀嚼。

definition_zh: (名) 高腳杯；聖杯
example_sentence: The restaurant uses crystal goblets to serve expensive wine at formal dinners.
sentence_zh: 這家餐廳在正式晚餐時使用水晶高腳杯來盛裝昂貴的葡萄酒。

definition_zh: (名) 上帝；神　(名) 神像；偶像
example_sentence: Many people pray to God for help during difficult times in their lives.
sentence_zh: 許多人在人生困難時期向上帝祈禱求助。

definition_zh: (名) 女神；美女
example_sentence: As the goddess of love appears in Greek mythology, Aphrodite inspires artists and poets worldwide.
sentence_zh: 當愛情女神出現在古希臘神話中時，阿芙羅狄蒂激勵了世界各地的藝術家和詩人。

definition_zh: (動) 去；前往　(形) 進行中的；持續的
example_sentence: Having gone through three job interviews, Sarah finally received the offer she had been waiting for.
sentence_zh: 莎拉經歷了三次面試後，終於得到她一直在等待的工作機會。

definition_zh: (名) 黃金；金色　(形) 金的；金色的
example_sentence: The ancient necklace, which was made of pure gold, was discovered in the museum's basement.
sentence_zh: 那條古代項鍊是用純金製成的，在博物館地下室被發現。

definition_zh: (形) 金色的；金黃色的　(形) 珍貴的；美好的
example_sentence: The golden sunset over the Taiwan Strait created a beautiful moment for evening photographers.
sentence_zh: 台灣海峽上的金色夕陽為傍晚攝影師創造了美麗的時刻。

definition_zh: (名) 高爾夫球；高爾夫球運動　(動) 打高爾夫球
example_sentence: If Marcus practiced golf regularly, he would improve his swing and compete in school tournaments.
sentence_zh: 如果Marcus定期練習高爾夫球，他的揮桿就會進步，也能參加學校比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 耶穌受難日；聖週五
example_sentence: Good Friday is an important religious holiday when Christians remember Jesus's death.
sentence_zh: 耶穌受難日是一個重要的宗教節日，基督徒在這天紀念耶穌的死亡。

definition_zh: (片) 再見；珍重
example_sentence: Waving goodbye, the exchange student boarded the plane to return home.
sentence_zh: 揮手告別，交換生登上飛機回家。

definition_zh: (形) 外貌漂亮的；長得好看的
example_sentence: Since the new student is good-looking, many classmates want to be friends with him.
sentence_zh: 因為那位新同學長得好看，許多同學都想和他做朋友。

definition_zh: (形) 性情溫和的；脾氣好的　(形) 友善的；親切的
example_sentence: Seldom does a good-natured person hold grudges against others for long.
sentence_zh: 性情溫和的人很少對他人長期懷恨在心。

definition_zh: (形) 好的；優良的　(形) 善良的；品德好的
example_sentence: Students who study hard every day will achieve good grades in the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 每天認真讀書的學生將在學測考試中取得好成績。

definition_zh: (名) 善良；美德　(感) 天啊；天哪
example_sentence: Maria studied hard to demonstrate goodness and earn her parents' trust.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞努力讀書是為了展現善良並贏得父母的信任。

definition_zh: (名) 商品；貨物　(名) 物品；財產

sentence_zh: 這家店在架子和儲藏區展示各式各樣的家用商品。

definition_zh: (名) 善意；好感　(名) 商譽；企業信譽
example_sentence: The company's goodwill toward its customers helped build long-term loyalty.
sentence_zh: 該公司對顧客的善意幫助建立了長期的忠誠度。

definition_zh: (形) 愚蠢的；傻的　(形) 古怪的；滑稽的
example_sentence: Although Tom made goofy mistakes during the presentation, his classmates found his humor quite amusing.
sentence_zh: 雖然湯姆在簡報中犯了愚蠢的錯誤，但他的同學覺得他的幽默相當有趣。

definition_zh: (動) 用谷歌搜尋；搜索　(名) 谷歌搜尋
example_sentence: Googling the answer online, the student found helpful resources for the exam.
sentence_zh: 在網路上用谷歌搜尋答案，那位學生找到了考試的有用資源。

definition_zh: (名) 鵝；鵝肉
example_sentence: The goose that flew south for winter inspired many migration stories.
sentence_zh: 那隻往南飛過冬的鵝啟發了許多遷徙故事。

definition_zh: (名) 雞皮疙瘩；起雞皮疙瘩的現象
example_sentence: If watching that horror movie alone at night, goosebumps would cover your entire body.
sentence_zh: 如果在晚上獨自看那部恐怖電影，雞皮疙瘩會覆蓋你的整個身體。

definition_zh: (名) 血；流血　(動) 流血；傷害
example_sentence: The horror movie featured graphic gore that made many viewers uncomfortable.
sentence_zh: 那部恐怖電影含有逼真的暴力血腥畫面，讓許多觀眾感到不適。

definition_zh: (名) 峽谷；峽道　(動) 大吃；狼吞虎嚥

sentence_zh: 觀光客參訪大峽谷以體驗大自然的壯麗美景。

definition_zh: (形) 非常美麗的；華麗的　(形) 極好的；令人驚嘆的
example_sentence: The gorgeous sunset over the mountain filled everyone with wonder and joy.
sentence_zh: 山上那場華麗的落日景象讓每個人都充滿了驚嘆和喜悅。

definition_zh: (名) 大猩猩；gorilla
example_sentence: Although the gorilla appeared aggressive, researchers observed its gentle behavior toward infant members.
sentence_zh: 雖然大猩猩看起來很凶悍，但研究人員觀察到牠對幼小成員的溫和行為。

definition_zh: (名) 福音；基督教聖經的四部福音書　(名) 絕對真理；天經地義的事
example_sentence: Having studied the Gospel of Mark for months, the theology students presented their research findings with confidence.
sentence_zh: 經過數個月研習《馬可福音》後，這些神學系學生自信地發表了他們的研究成果。

definition_zh: (名) 閒言碎語；八卦　(動) 說閒話；八卦
example_sentence: The rumor that spread through school was gossip which nobody could verify.
sentence_zh: 在學校傳開的謠言是沒人能證實的八卦。

definition_zh: (名) 葫蘆；南瓜
