sentence_zh: 用作餐桌中心裝飾品的葫蘆給所有晚餐客人留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 美食家；讚賞美食的人　(形) 高級的；精選的
example_sentence: If refined taste and culinary skill were combined, gourmet dining experiences would delight every sophisticated palate.
sentence_zh: 如果精緻品味和烹飪技巧結合在一起，美食饗宴就會令每位講究的人滿足。

definition_zh: (名) 痛風；風濕病
example_sentence: My grandfather's gout makes it painful for him to walk.
sentence_zh: 我祖父的痛風讓他走路時感到疼痛。

definition_zh: (動) 統治；管理　(動) 控制；影響
example_sentence: Governing a country requires making difficult decisions affecting millions.
sentence_zh: 統治一個國家需要做出影響數百萬人的艱難決定。

definition_zh: (名) 治理；統治　(名) 管理制度；政策
example_sentence: As governance becomes more transparent, citizens trust the government more readily.
sentence_zh: 當治理變得更加透明時，公民更容易信任政府。

definition_zh: (名) 政府；政權　(名) 統治；管理
example_sentence: Only after the new government took office did citizens see real change in education policy.
sentence_zh: 只有在新政府上台後，公民才看到教育政策的真正改變。

definition_zh: (形) 政府的；政府機構的
example_sentence: The governmental policies that aim to reduce pollution have gained support from environmental groups.
sentence_zh: 旨在減少污染的政府政策已獲得環保團體的支持。

definition_zh: (名) 州長；省長　(名) 管理者；統治者
example_sentence: The governor implemented new policies to improve education and reduce unemployment.
sentence_zh: 州長實施新政策以改善教育並減少失業。

definition_zh: (名) 禮服；長袍　(名) 醫用袍；手術服
example_sentence: The bride wore an elegant white wedding gown down the aisle.
sentence_zh: 新娘穿著優雅的白色婚紗禮服走過走道。

definition_zh: (動) 抓住；搶奪　(動) 迅速拿取
example_sentence: The hungry dog grabbed the bone from the ground quickly.
sentence_zh: 飢餓的狗迅速從地上抓起那根骨頭。

definition_zh: (名) 優雅；恩典　(動) 使優雅；裝飾　(形) 優雅的；得體的
example_sentence: Although the dancer moved with grace, her nervousness still showed through in her facial expressions.
sentence_zh: 雖然舞者的動作優雅，但她的緊張感仍從臉部表情透露出來。

definition_zh: (形) 優雅的；姿態優美的　(形) 流暢的；柔和的
example_sentence: Moving gracefully across the stage, the dancer captivated the entire audience with her performance.
sentence_zh: 那位舞者優雅地在舞台上移動，以她的表演吸引了整個觀眾。

definition_zh: (形) 親切的；有禮貌的　(形) 優雅的；高貴的
example_sentence: The host, whose gracious manner made every guest feel welcome, remembered everyone's name.
sentence_zh: 那位主人親切的舉止讓每位客人都感到受歡迎，他記得每個人的名字。

definition_zh: (名) 成績；分數　(動) 給分；評分　(名) 年級；等級
example_sentence: If students study hard, they will receive better grades on the final exam.
sentence_zh: 如果學生努力讀書，他們在期末考試上會得到更好的成績。

definition_zh: (名) 評分者；批改老師　(名) 分級機；等級分類器
example_sentence: The English grader spent hours marking student essays before the exam.
sentence_zh: 英文批改老師在考試前花了好幾個小時批改學生的作文。

definition_zh: (形) 逐漸的；漸進的　(副) 逐漸地；慢慢地
example_sentence: Students should study every day to gradually improve their English skills.
sentence_zh: 學生應該每天讀書以逐漸提高英文能力。

definition_zh: (副) 逐漸地；慢慢地　(副) 逐步地；按部就班地
example_sentence: Practicing English gradually every day helps students build strong language skills for the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 每天逐漸練習英文有助於學生為學測培養強大的語言能力。

definition_zh: (名) 研究所；碩士班　(名) 研究生院
example_sentence: After completing her bachelor's degree, Maria applied to graduate school because she wanted advanced training in psychology.
sentence_zh: 完成學士學位後，瑪麗亞申請研究所，因為她想要在心理學領域接受進階培訓。

definition_zh: (動) [ˈgrædʒuˌet] 畢業；完成學業　(名) [ˈgrædʒuɪt] 畢業生；大學畢業生
example_sentence: Having graduated from high school last year, Maria now studies engineering at a top university.
sentence_zh: 在去年從高中畢業後，瑪麗亞現在在一所頂尖大學學習工程。

definition_zh: (名) 畢業；畢業典禮
example_sentence: The graduation ceremony, which takes place in June, celebrates students who complete their high school education.
sentence_zh: 在六月舉行的畢業典禮慶祝完成高中教育的學生。

definition_zh: (名) 塗鴉；壁畫
example_sentence: The colorful graffiti on the subway wall attracted many art lovers and photographers.
sentence_zh: 地鐵牆上五彩繽紛的塗鴉吸引了許多藝術愛好者和攝影師。

definition_zh: (名) 聖杯；夢寐以求的目標
example_sentence: If the startup had not lost funding, the holy grail of affordable housing would have become reality.
sentence_zh: 如果這家新創公司沒有失去資金，平價住宅的夢寐以求目標就會成為現實。

definition_zh: (名) 穀物；穀類　(名) 顆粒；細粒
example_sentence: Farmers grow grain in large fields to produce flour and food.
sentence_zh: 農民在大田裡種植穀物來生產麵粉和食物。

definition_zh: (名) 公克；克　(名) 克數；克
example_sentence: Weighing ingredients carefully, using exact grams ensures baking success.
sentence_zh: 精確稱量材料，使用精確的克數能確保烘焙成功。

definition_zh: (名) 文法；語法　(名) 語法規則
example_sentence: Although grammar rules seem complicated, practicing them daily helps students master English writing.
sentence_zh: 雖然文法規則似乎很複雜，但每天練習有助於學生精通英文寫作。

definition_zh: (形) 符合文法的；語法上正確的　(形) 依據文法規則的
example_sentence: Only after studying grammar rules carefully could the sentence structure become grammatical.
sentence_zh: 只有在仔細研究文法規則之後，句子結構才能變得符合文法。

definition_zh: (形) 宏偉的；壯麗的　(形) 重要的；盛大的
example_sentence: The grand palace, which tourists visit every year, stands majestically on the hill.
sentence_zh: 那座遊客每年造訪的宏偉宮殿莊嚴地矗立在山丘上。

definition_zh: (名) 孫子；孫女　(名) 孫兒；後代
example_sentence: Mr. Chen saves money every month to buy gifts for his grandchildren.
sentence_zh: 陳先生每個月存錢以便為孫兒購買禮物。

definition_zh: (名) 孫女；外孫女
example_sentence: My grandfather's granddaughter studies hard and wants to become a doctor.
sentence_zh: 我祖父的孫女用功讀書，想成為醫生。

definition_zh: (名) 宏偉；壯麗　(名) 偉大；卓越
example_sentence: The grandeur of the ancient palace impressed every visitor who walked through its massive gates.
sentence_zh: 這座古老宮殿的宏偉景象令每位進入其巨大城門的訪客印象深刻。

definition_zh: (名) 祖父；爺爺
example_sentence: Whenever grandfather visits us, he brings stories about the old days.
sentence_zh: 每當祖父來看我們時，他都會帶來關於往日的故事。

definition_zh: (名) 浮誇；自大　(形) 宏大的；雄偉的
example_sentence: Displaying grandiosity in his speech, the politician boasted about achievements never accomplished.
sentence_zh: 在演講中表現出浮誇態度，這位政治人物吹噓了從未完成的成就。

definition_zh: (名) 祖母；奶奶
example_sentence: The grandmother who lives next door often bakes cookies for neighborhood children.
sentence_zh: 住在隔壁的祖母常常為鄰居小孩烤餅乾。

definition_zh: (名) 祖父母；外公外婆
example_sentence: If students visit their grandparents regularly, family bonds will strengthen considerably.
sentence_zh: 如果學生經常拜訪祖父母，家庭關係就會明顯增進。

definition_zh: (名) 孫子；孫兒
example_sentence: My grandfather is very proud of his oldest grandson.
sentence_zh: 我的祖父對他最年長的孫子感到非常驕傲。

definition_zh: (動) 授予；同意　(名) 補助金；撥款
example_sentence: The government granted scholarship money to help low-income students attend university.
sentence_zh: 政府撥款補助金以幫助低收入學生上大學。

definition_zh: (名) 葡萄；葡萄果實
example_sentence: Fresh grapes and apples are my favorite fruits for school lunch.
sentence_zh: 新鮮的葡萄和蘋果是我最喜歡的學校午餐水果。

definition_zh: (名) 葡萄柚；柚子
example_sentence: Because grapefruit contains vitamin C, eating one daily boosts immune health significantly.
sentence_zh: 由於葡萄柚含有維生素C，每天吃一個能顯著增強免疫力。

definition_zh: (名) 葡萄藤；小道消息；謠言
example_sentence: Having heard the gossip through the grapevine, the manager investigated the rumor before taking action.
sentence_zh: 經由小道消息聽到謠言後，經理在採取行動前調查了這個傳言。

definition_zh: (名) 圖表；圖形　(動) 用圖表表示
example_sentence: The graph which shows sales data clearly indicates growing market demand this quarter.
sentence_zh: 那份顯示銷售數據的圖表清楚地表明本季市場需求在增長。

definition_zh: (形) 圖形的；視覺化的　(形) 生動的；逼真的
example_sentence: The graphic design of the poster caught every student's attention in the school hallway.
sentence_zh: 這張海報的圖形設計吸引了走廊裡每位學生的注意。

definition_zh: (動) 努力應對；與…搏鬥　(動) 握住；扭打
example_sentence: If students grappled with difficult math problems regularly, their problem-solving skills would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生定期努力應對困難的數學問題，他們的解題能力會顯著進步。

definition_zh: (動) 抓住；握住　(動) 理解；領會　(名) 掌握；理解
example_sentence: Students must grasp the main ideas before attempting difficult practice problems.
sentence_zh: 學生在嘗試困難的練習題之前，必須掌握主要概念。

definition_zh: (名) 草；草地　(動) 放牧；吃草
example_sentence: Growing wild in the garden, grass covered the entire lawn after the rain.
sentence_zh: 野生生長在花園裡，雨後草覆蓋了整片草坪。

definition_zh: (名) 蝗蟲；草蜢
example_sentence: As the grasshopper jumped across the field, the farmer watched it carefully.
sentence_zh: 當草蜢跳過田地時，農夫仔細地看著它。

definition_zh: (名) 草地；牧場
example_sentence: Seldom do grasslands receive enough rainfall to support large forests in this region.
sentence_zh: 在這個地區，草地很少獲得足夠的降雨來支持大型森林。

definition_zh: (形) 長滿草的；草地的
example_sentence: The hiking trail that winds through grassy meadows offers beautiful views of distant mountains.
sentence_zh: 蜿蜒穿過長滿草的草地的登山步道提供了遠方山脈的美麗景色。

definition_zh: (動) 磨碎；刮；發出刺耳聲音　(名) 柵欄；篩子
example_sentence: Maya uses a microplane grater to grate fresh lemon zest for her dessert recipe.
sentence_zh: 瑪雅用微型刨絲器磨碎新鮮檸檬皮來製作她的甜點食譜。

definition_zh: (形) 感謝的；感激的　(形) 令人欣慰的；令人愉快的
example_sentence: Grateful for their support and encouragement, the students worked harder than ever before.
sentence_zh: 感謝他們的支持和鼓勵，這些學生比以往任何時候都更加努力。

definition_zh: (副) 感謝地；感激地　(副) 懷著感謝之心地
example_sentence: Sarah gratefully accepted the scholarship offer from the university.
sentence_zh: 莎拉感激地接受了大學的獎學金。

definition_zh: (名) 刨絲器；磨碎器　(動) 用刨絲器刮；磨碎
example_sentence: As the cheese grater slipped from her hand, Mom quickly caught it before it fell.
sentence_zh: 當起司刨絲器從媽媽手中滑落時，她迅速接住了它。

definition_zh: (名) 滿足感；滿足　(名) 喜悅；快樂
example_sentence: Achieving academic goals brings gratification, motivating students to pursue further success.
sentence_zh: 達成學業目標帶來滿足感，促使學生追求更大的成功。

definition_zh: (動) 使滿足；令人高興　(動) 滿足願望；實現願望
example_sentence: The achievement that gratified the student most was winning the scholarship.
sentence_zh: 最讓這位學生感到滿足的成就是獲得獎學金。

definition_zh: (名) 感謝；感激　(形) 感謝的；感激的
example_sentence: If students show gratitude for their teachers' effort, classroom relationships will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生對老師的努力表示感謝，課堂關係會明顯改善。

definition_zh: (形) 無根據的；不必要的　(形) 無償的；免費的
example_sentence: Making such gratuitous comments about others' appearance is disrespectful and hurtful.
sentence_zh: 對他人外表做出無根據的評論既無禮又傷人。

definition_zh: (名) 小費；賞錢　(名) 恩惠；恩賜
example_sentence: The restaurant added a gratuity to the bill to reward excellent service.
sentence_zh: 餐廳在帳單上加了小費，以獎勵優質的服務。

definition_zh: (形) 嚴肅的；莊嚴的　(名) 墳墓；墓地　(動) 雕刻；銘刻
example_sentence: The funeral ceremony was held in a grave and solemn atmosphere.
sentence_zh: 葬禮在莊嚴肅穆的氣氛中舉行。

definition_zh: (名) 重力；引力　(名) 嚴肅；莊嚴
example_sentence: Having experienced the Moon's lower gravity, the astronaut realized how much Earth's pull affected daily movements.
sentence_zh: 經歷過月球較低的引力後，這位太空人意識到地球的引力對日常活動有多大的影響。

definition_zh: (名) 肉汁；肉湯　(形) 容易的；輕鬆的
example_sentence: The turkey, which comes with rich gravy that costs nothing extra, is a popular holiday dish.
sentence_zh: 那隻火雞附帶濃郁的肉汁，不需額外付費，是受歡迎的假日菜餚。

definition_zh: (形) 灰色的；灰色　(名) 灰色
example_sentence: The gray clouds and rainy weather made the morning feel gloomy.
sentence_zh: 灰色的雲和雨天讓早晨感覺陰沉沉的。

definition_zh: (動) 放牧；吃草　(動) 輕擦；擦傷
example_sentence: If cattle grazed in that polluted pasture, their health would suffer serious damage.
sentence_zh: 如果牛群在那片污染的牧場放牧，牠們的健康會受到嚴重傷害。

definition_zh: (動) 吃草；放牧　(名) 放牧；吃草
example_sentence: Cows spend most of their day grazing in the meadow.
sentence_zh: 牛整天大部分時間都在草地上吃草。

definition_zh: (名) [gris] 油脂；潤滑油　(動) [griz] 塗油；潤滑　(形) 油膩的；骯髒的
example_sentence: Greasing the bicycle chain regularly, the mechanic ensured smooth and quiet operation.
sentence_zh: 機械師定期塗油自行車鏈條，確保運轉順暢且安靜。

definition_zh: (形) 油膩的；多油脂的　(形) 骯髒的；令人厭惡的
example_sentence: Because the kitchen was greasy after cooking, the chef cleaned all surfaces thoroughly.
sentence_zh: 因為廚房在烹飪後變得油膩，廚師徹底清潔了所有表面。

definition_zh: (形) 偉大的；了不起的　(形) 很好的；極好的
example_sentence: Not only is Chiang Wei-shui a great doctor, but also a great social activist.
sentence_zh: 蔣渭水不僅是位偉大的醫生，也是位偉大的社會運動家。

definition_zh: (副) 很大地；極其　(副) 大幅地；顯著地
example_sentence: The student who studied greatly improved her test scores this semester.
sentence_zh: 那位學習非常認真的學生這學期考試成績大幅提高。

definition_zh: (形) 古希臘的；古希臘風格的
example_sentence: Museum curators studied ancient Grecian sculptures to understand classical Greek artistic techniques.
sentence_zh: 博物館策展人研究古希臘雕像以了解古典希臘藝術技巧。

definition_zh: (名) 貪心；貪欲　(形) 貪心的；貪婪的
example_sentence: Greed for money and power often leads to corruption and unhappy relationships.
sentence_zh: 對金錢和權力的貪心常常導致腐敗和不幸的關係。

definition_zh: (形) 貪心的；貪婪的　(形) 貪吃的；渴望的
example_sentence: The greedy businessman wanted more money and power than anyone else.
sentence_zh: 那個貪心的商人想要比任何人都更多的金錢和權力。

definition_zh: (形) 綠色的；環保的　(名) 綠色；草坪
example_sentence: As environmental issues become serious, more companies choose green products because consumers care about sustainability.
sentence_zh: 隨著環境問題變得嚴重，因為消費者關心永續發展，更多公司選擇綠色產品。

definition_zh: (名) 溫室；玻璃房　(形) 溫室的；會產生溫室效應的
example_sentence: Growing vegetables in a greenhouse, farmers can control temperature and humidity effectively.
sentence_zh: 在溫室中種植蔬菜，農民可以有效控制溫度和濕度。

definition_zh: (動) 問候；打招呼　(名) 問候；招呼
example_sentence: The teacher who greets every student warmly creates a comfortable classroom.
sentence_zh: 每位熱情問候學生的老師都能營造舒適的教室環境。

definition_zh: (名) 問候；招呼　(動) 向…打招呼；迎接
example_sentence: If you offer a warm greeting to classmates every morning, they will feel more welcomed.
sentence_zh: 如果你每天早上向同學們熱情問候，他們會感到更受歡迎。

definition_zh: (形) 喜歡群居的；社交性強的
example_sentence: Humans are gregarious animals who enjoy spending time with others.
sentence_zh: 人類是喜歡群居的動物，喜歡和他人相處。

definition_zh: (名) 悲傷；哀痛　(動) 為…感到悲傷
example_sentence: After losing her grandmother, Maria took time to grieve and process her deep sorrow.
sentence_zh: 在失去祖母後，瑪莉亞花時間去哀悼並處理她深深的悲傷。

definition_zh: (名) 不平；冤屈　(名) 抱怨；申訴
example_sentence: The student filed a formal grievance against the unfair grading with school administration.
sentence_zh: 該學生向學校行政部門提出了對不公平評分的正式申訴。

definition_zh: (動) 為...感到悲傷；哀悼　(動) 使...難過；使...傷心
example_sentence: As the family grieved the loss of their beloved grandmother, they gathered to share cherished memories.
sentence_zh: 當家人為失去心愛的祖母而傷心難過時，他們聚在一起分享珍貴的回憶。

definition_zh: (動) 感到悲傷；哀悼
example_sentence: Grieved by the loss of his best friend, Mark decided to volunteer at the community center to help others.
sentence_zh: 馬克因失去最好的朋友而感到悲傷，他決定到社區中心當志工幫助他人。

definition_zh: (名) 烤架；烤肉架　(動) 烤；燒烤
example_sentence: The restaurant, which uses a traditional charcoal grill that produces authentic flavor, attracts many customers.
sentence_zh: 那家餐廳使用傳統木炭烤架來產生真正風味的做法吸引了許多顧客。

definition_zh: (形) 用火烤的；燒烤的　(動) 烤；用火焰烹飪
example_sentence: The grilled fish and fresh vegetables made a delicious and healthy dinner.
sentence_zh: 烤魚和新鮮蔬菜組成了一頓美味又健康的晚餐。

definition_zh: (形) 陰沉的；令人沮喪的　(形) 嚴肅的；堅定的
example_sentence: If the economic situation were grimmer, many small businesses would close down permanently.
sentence_zh: 如果經濟形勢更加嚴峻，許多小型企業將會永久關閉。

definition_zh: (名) 污垢；黑垢　(動) 弄髒；沾污
example_sentence: Heavy rain washed the grime off the school building's windows.
sentence_zh: 大雨沖掉了校舍窗戶上的污垢。

definition_zh: (動) 露齒笑；咧嘴笑　(名) 燦爛的笑容；笑靨
example_sentence: Winning the basketball championship, the team members grinned widely at the trophy ceremony.
sentence_zh: 贏得籃球冠軍後，隊員們在頒獎典禮上開心地咧嘴笑。

definition_zh: (動) 磨；研磨　(動) 辛苦地工作；努力奮鬥
example_sentence: As the coffee beans grind into fine powder, the aroma fills the entire kitchen.
sentence_zh: 當咖啡豆磨成細粉時，香氣充滿整個廚房。

definition_zh: (名) 抓握；握力　(動) 緊握；吸引　(形) 引人入勝的；緊握的
example_sentence: Only with a firm grip on the steering wheel could the driver maintain control on the icy road.
sentence_zh: 只有緊握方向盤，駕駛才能在結冰的道路上保持控制。

definition_zh: (動) 抱怨；發牢騷；使不滿　(名) 不滿；怨言
example_sentence: Students who gripe about homework are often those who don't start early.
sentence_zh: 那些抱怨功課的學生往往是沒有早點開始的人。

definition_zh: (形) 令人毛骨悚然的；恐怖的　(形) 令人不安的；令人厭惡的
example_sentence: The detective examined the grisly crime scene to gather evidence for the investigation.
sentence_zh: 偵探檢查了那令人毛骨悚然的犯罪現場以蒐集調查證據。

definition_zh: (名) 決心；毅力　(名) 沙粒；砂礫
example_sentence: Overcoming exam anxiety requires grit and hard work from every student.
sentence_zh: 克服考試焦慮需要每位學生具備決心和辛苦努力。

definition_zh: (動) 呻吟；發出低沉聲音　(名) 呻吟聲；低沉的聲音
example_sentence: The injured player groaned in pain after falling during the basketball game.
sentence_zh: 那位受傷的籃球選手在比賽中跌倒後，痛苦地呻吟著。

definition_zh: (名) 雜貨商；食品店老闆
example_sentence: Since the grocer opened his shop in the neighborhood, many families have shopped there regularly.
sentence_zh: 由於雜貨商在社區開設店鋪，許多家庭一直定期在那裡購物。

definition_zh: (名) 雜貨店；食品雜貨　(名) 食品雜貨
example_sentence: Buying groceries while checking the shopping list, Maria saved money and time at the store.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞一邊檢查購物清單一邊買雜貨，在超市節省了金錢和時間。

definition_zh: (名) 新郎；馬夫　(動) 梳洗打扮；培養
example_sentence: The groom who wore a tailored suit looked handsome on his wedding day.
sentence_zh: 那位穿著裁製西裝的新郎在他的婚禮當天看起來很帥。

definition_zh: (名) 溝槽；節奏　(動) 隨著音樂擺動；進入狀態
example_sentence: If the musician finds the right groove, the whole band will play together perfectly.
sentence_zh: 如果音樂家找到正確的節奏，整個樂隊就會完美地合作演奏。

definition_zh: (動) 摸索；盲目尋找　(動) 撫摸；不禮貌地觸碰
example_sentence: Lost in the dark cave, the explorer groped along the wall for a safe exit.
sentence_zh: 在黑暗的洞穴中迷失，探險家沿著牆壁摸索尋找安全的出口。

definition_zh: (形) 令人厭惡的；粗俗的　(動) 賺取；淨賺
example_sentence: Students need to avoid gross language to maintain respect in classroom conversations.
sentence_zh: 學生需要避免使用令人厭惡的語言，以在課堂對話中保持尊重。

definition_zh: (名) 石窟；洞穴
example_sentence: The ancient grotto hidden beneath the mountain served as a shelter for travelers during storms.
sentence_zh: 隱藏在山下的古老石窟在暴風雨時為旅客提供了庇護所。

definition_zh: (名) 愛發牢騷的人；脾氣暴躁的人　(動) 發牢騷；抱怨
example_sentence: Although Mark is a grouch when he wakes up early, he becomes friendly after drinking coffee.
sentence_zh: 雖然馬克早起時愛發牢騷，但喝了咖啡後就變得友善了。

definition_zh: (形) 易怒的；脾氣壞的　(形) 不滿的；抱怨的
example_sentence: Having slept poorly, the grouchy manager complained about everything during the meeting.
sentence_zh: 因為睡眠不足，那位脾氣壞的經理在會議中對所有事情都抱怨。

definition_zh: (名) 地面；土地　(動) 使著陸；禁足　(形) 磨碎的；接地的
example_sentence: The plane landed on the ground that was covered with snow.
sentence_zh: 飛機降落在被雪覆蓋的地面上。

definition_zh: (形) 開創性的；具有創新意義的　(形) 革命性的；突破性的
example_sentence: The groundbreaking research on renewable energy impressed scientists worldwide.
sentence_zh: 那項關於再生能源的開創性研究讓全球科學家印象深刻。

definition_zh: (名) 群體；團體　(動) 分組；聚集
example_sentence: If students formed smaller study groups, test scores would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生組成較小的讀書小組，考試成績會顯著進步。

definition_zh: (名) 狂熱粉絲；追星族
example_sentence: The concert venue was filled with excited groupies hoping to meet their favorite band members.
sentence_zh: 演唱會場地擠滿了興奮的狂熱粉絲，希望見到他們最愛的樂團成員。

definition_zh: (名) 小樹林；果園
example_sentence: Walking through the shaded grove, students discovered ancient trees over a hundred years old.
sentence_zh: 穿過陰涼的小樹林，學生們發現了超過一百年的古樹。

definition_zh: (動) 生長；成長　(動) 變得；逐漸變成
example_sentence: As plants grow taller in spring, they need more water and sunlight daily.
sentence_zh: 當植物在春天長高時，它們每天需要更多水和陽光。

definition_zh: (形) 增長的；發展的　(動) 成長；種植
example_sentence: Only through consistent practice does growing confidence emerge in English learners.
sentence_zh: 唯有透過持續練習，英語學習者才能逐漸增長信心。

definition_zh: (動) 低聲咆哮；發出沙啞聲　(名) 咆哮聲；沙啞聲
example_sentence: The angry dog that was tied to the fence began to growl at strangers passing by.
sentence_zh: 被拴在柵欄上的那隻憤怒的狗開始對經過的陌生人低聲咆哮。

definition_zh: (形) 成人的；長大的　(名) 成人；大人
example_sentence: Many teenagers work part-time jobs to earn money and become financially independent grown-ups.
sentence_zh: 許多青少年打工賺錢，目的是成為財務獨立的成人。

definition_zh: (名) 成年人；大人　(形) 成年的；長大的
example_sentence: Becoming a grownup means taking responsibility for your own decisions and future.
sentence_zh: 成為成年人意味著要為自己的決定和未來負責。

definition_zh: (名) 成長；發展　(動) 增長；變大
example_sentence: Regular exercise and healthy eating promote physical growth in teenagers.
sentence_zh: 定期運動和健康飲食促進青少年的身體成長。

definition_zh: (名) 稀粥；清湯
example_sentence: As the supplies ran low during the winter, the family survived on gruel made from barley and water.
sentence_zh: 當冬天物資短缺時，這個家庭靠著用大麥和水煮成的稀粥活了下去。

definition_zh: (形) 極其疲勞的；令人筋疲力盡的　(動) 使極度疲勞；使筋疲力盡
example_sentence: Grueling training sessions, the athletes pushed through exhaustion to prepare for nationals.
sentence_zh: 經過令人筋疲力盡的訓練課程，這些運動員頂著疲勞為全國賽做準備。

definition_zh: (形) 令人厭惡的；恐怖的　(形) 令人不安的；可怕的
example_sentence: The gruesome crime scene that detectives discovered shocked the entire community deeply.
sentence_zh: 偵探們發現的那個令人厭惡的犯罪現場震驚了整個社區。

definition_zh: (動) 抱怨；嘟囔　(名) 抱怨；低沉的聲音
example_sentence: If students grumble about homework, teachers will listen to their concerns carefully.
sentence_zh: 如果學生對功課發牢騷，老師會仔細聽取他們的想法。

definition_zh: (動) 發出低沉聲音；咕噥　(名) 低沉的聲音；咕噥聲
example_sentence: The construction workers grunted to lift the heavy metal beams.
sentence_zh: 建築工人發出低沉聲音來抬起沉重的金屬樑。

definition_zh: (動) 發出低沉聲音；嘟囔　(名) 低沉的聲音；嘟囔聲
example_sentence: The weightlifter, grunting with effort, lifted the heavy barbell above her head.
sentence_zh: 那位舉重運動員發出低沉的聲音，用力將重槓鈴舉過頭頂。

definition_zh: (名) 保證；擔保　(動) 保證；確保
example_sentence: Since the store guarantees all electronics for one year, customers can shop without worry.
sentence_zh: 由於商店保證所有電子產品一年內有效，顧客可以放心購物。

definition_zh: (形) 保證的；有保障的　(動) 保證；擔保
example_sentence: Having guaranteed delivery within three days, the online store won many loyal customers.
sentence_zh: 該網路商店因保證三天內送達，贏得了許多忠實顧客。

definition_zh: (名) 守衛；警衛　(動) 保護；看守　(名) 護衛隊；防衛
example_sentence: The security guards who work at the school entrance check student IDs every morning.
sentence_zh: 在學校入口工作的保安人員每天早上都會檢查學生證件。

definition_zh: (名) 監護人；保護者　(名) 守護神；保衛者
example_sentence: The legal guardian of the minor child must sign consent forms for school trips.
sentence_zh: 未成年孩子的法定監護人必須簽署學校戶外教學的同意書。

definition_zh: (名) 番石榴；芭樂
example_sentence: If fresh guavas were available at the market, many students would buy them for snacks.
sentence_zh: 如果新鮮的番石榴在市場裡有售，許多學生會買來當點心。

definition_zh: (名) 游擊隊；游擊戰士　(形) 游擊的；非正規的
example_sentence: Guerrilla fighters used surprise attacks to fight against the powerful military.
sentence_zh: 游擊隊員用突襲戰術對抗強大的軍隊。

definition_zh: (動) 猜測；推測　(名) 猜測；推測
example_sentence: Guessing the answer without reading the passage carefully, the student failed the exam.
sentence_zh: 沒有仔細閱讀文章就猜測答案，那位學生考試不及格。

definition_zh: (名) 客人；賓客　(動) 作為客人來訪
example_sentence: While the guest was enjoying dinner, the host told funny stories about their school trip.
sentence_zh: 當客人享受晚餐時，主人講述了關於他們校外旅行的有趣故事。

definition_zh: (名) 指導；引導　(名) 建議；忠告
example_sentence: Only after receiving guidance from experienced teachers could the students improve their writing skills significantly.
sentence_zh: 只有在經驗豐富的老師的指導之後，學生才能大幅提升他們的寫作技能。

definition_zh: (動) 帶領；指導　(名) 導遊；指南
example_sentence: The experienced tour guide who knows every corner of Taipei shares fascinating stories with visitors.
sentence_zh: 那位認識台北每個角落的經驗豐富導遊，與遊客分享迷人的故事。

definition_zh: (名) 指導方針；準則　(名) 指引；標準
example_sentence: The school issued new guidelines to help students prepare for the CSAT exam effectively.
sentence_zh: 學校發布了新的指導方針，以幫助學生有效地準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (名) 同業公會；行會　(名) 遊戲中的玩家團隊；公會
example_sentence: Joining an online gaming guild helps players cooperate and complete difficult quests together.
sentence_zh: 加入線上遊戲公會能幫助玩家互相合作並一起完成困難的任務。

definition_zh: (名) 內疚；罪惡感　(形) 有罪的；內疚的
example_sentence: Feeling guilt after lying to parents, the student finally confessed the truth.
sentence_zh: 那名學生因說謊而感到內疚，最後終於坦白了真相。

definition_zh: (形) 無罪的；清白的　(形) 無辜的；無咎的
example_sentence: Although the suspect was initially arrested, he was found guiltless after the investigation revealed the true culprit.
sentence_zh: 雖然嫌疑人最初被逮捕，但調查揭露真正的犯人後，他被判無罪。

definition_zh: (副) 無罪地；沒有內疚感地
example_sentence: Having prepared thoroughly for the exam, the student answered all questions guiltlessly without hesitation.
sentence_zh: 充分準備了考試，這位學生沒有內疚感地毫不猶豫地回答了所有問題。

definition_zh: (形) 有罪的；內疚的　(形) 犯過錯的；感到懊悔的
example_sentence: The student who felt guilty about cheating decided to confess to the teacher.
sentence_zh: 那位因作弊而感到內疚的學生決定向老師坦白。

definition_zh: (名) 吉他；結他
example_sentence: If students practice guitar regularly, they will improve their musical skills.
sentence_zh: 如果學生定期練習吉他，他們的音樂技能會進步。

definition_zh: (名) 吉他手；彈吉他的人
example_sentence: The talented guitarist performed an amazing solo at the concert.
sentence_zh: 那位才華洋溢的吉他手在演唱會上表演了一首驚人的獨奏。

definition_zh: (名) 海灣；灣　(名) 深淵；鴻溝
example_sentence: Scientists study the Persian Gulf to understand ocean currents and marine ecosystems.
sentence_zh: 科學家研究波斯灣以瞭解洋流和海洋生態系統。

definition_zh: (形) 容易受騙的；輕信的
example_sentence: Gullible people often believe fake news and misleading advertisements without checking the facts carefully.
sentence_zh: 容易受騙的人經常相信假新聞和誤導性廣告，而不仔細核查事實。

definition_zh: (動) 大口吞嚥；一口氣喝下　(名) 一大口；一口吞
example_sentence: As the exam results were announced, students gulped nervously while waiting for their names.
sentence_zh: 當考試成績公布時，學生們在等待點名的過程中緊張地大口吞嚥。

definition_zh: (名) 膠水；口香糖　(動) 粘合；用膠水粘
example_sentence: Having chewed gum throughout the exam, the student finally realized concentrating was impossible.
sentence_zh: 在整場考試中一直嚼著口香糖，那個學生最後才意識到無法專心。

definition_zh: (名) 槍；槍枝　(動) 開槍；射擊
example_sentence: The police officer used the gun that was found at the crime scene to solve the case.
sentence_zh: 警察用在犯罪現場發現的槍來破案。

definition_zh: (名) 炮艇；武裝砲船
example_sentence: The historical museum displayed photographs of gunboats used during the colonial period in Asia.
sentence_zh: 這間歷史博物館展示了亞洲殖民時期使用的炮艇照片。

definition_zh: (名) 持槍者；槍手
example_sentence: If the gunman had not been arrested quickly, many more people would have been injured.
sentence_zh: 如果那名槍手沒有被迅速逮捕，許多人會受傷。

definition_zh: (名) 陣風；突然的強風　(動) 突然吹來；狂風吹動
example_sentence: A sudden gust of wind knocked over the outdoor umbrella during the typhoon.
sentence_zh: 颱風期間，一陣突然的強風吹倒了戶外的傘。

definition_zh: (名) 熱情；興致　(動) 滿懷熱情地做
example_sentence: Tackling the challenging project with great gusto, the team members achieved outstanding results.
sentence_zh: 滿懷熱情地進行這項具挑戰性的專案，團隊成員取得了傑出的成果。

definition_zh: (名) 腸；直覺　(形) 憑直覺的；內在的　(動) 挖空；取出內臟
example_sentence: Although scientific data supported the project, the manager rejected it because his gut feeling told him something was wrong.
sentence_zh: 儘管科學數據支持該項目，但經理因為直覺告訴他有問題而拒絕了它。

definition_zh: (名) 勇氣；膽量　(名) 腸子；內臟
example_sentence: Only with great courage does an athlete have the guts to compete internationally.
sentence_zh: 唯有具備極大勇氣，運動員才有膽量在國際賽事中競爭。

definition_zh: (形) 勇敢的；有膽量的；大膽的
example_sentence: The gutsy entrepreneur who started her business without family support deserves recognition.
sentence_zh: 那位沒有家人支持就創業的勇敢企業家值得認可。

definition_zh: (形) 勇敢的；有骨氣的　(形) 堅定的；有決心的
example_sentence: The student studied hard every day to be gutty enough to face the challenging CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 這位學生每天努力讀書，為的是要有足夠的勇氣去面對困難的學測考試。

definition_zh: (名) 男孩；男人；傢伙
example_sentence: That guy over there is playing basketball with his friends after school.
sentence_zh: 那個傢伙在放學後正和他的朋友在那邊打籃球。

definition_zh: (名) 健身房；體育館
example_sentence: Many students go to the gym after school to exercise and stay healthy.
sentence_zh: 許多學生放學後去健身房運動，保持身體健康。

definition_zh: (名) 體操運動員；體操選手
example_sentence: Performing difficult tricks on the balance beam, the gymnast impressed all the judges.
sentence_zh: 在平衡木上表演困難的技巧，這位體操運動員給所有評審留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 體操；體操運動
example_sentence: Gymnastics, which requires both strength and flexibility, is a popular Olympic sport that many Taiwanese athletes practice.
sentence_zh: 體操是一項需要力量和柔軟度的運動，是許多台灣運動員練習的受歡迎奧運項目。

definition_zh: (名) 婦科；婦女疾病學
example_sentence: If a woman suspects reproductive health issues, consulting a gynecology specialist would be the wisest decision.
sentence_zh: 如果女性懷疑生殖健康有問題，諮詢婦科醫生將是最明智的決定。

definition_zh: (名) 吉普賽人；流浪者　(形) 吉普賽的；流浪的
example_sentence: The gypsy family traveled across Europe in their colorful caravan for many years.
sentence_zh: 那個吉普賽家庭多年來乘著彩色的篷車在歐洲各地流浪。

definition_zh: (名) 習慣；癖好　(動) 習慣於；穿著
example_sentence: Reading English news every day helps develop a good habit to improve vocabulary.
sentence_zh: 每天閱讀英文新聞有助於養成提升詞彙的好習慣。

definition_zh: (形) 適合居住的；可以住人的
example_sentence: Scientists are searching for habitable planets similar to Earth in distant galaxies.
sentence_zh: 科學家正在遙遠的星系中尋找類似地球的宜居行星。

definition_zh: (名) 居民；住居者
example_sentence: Although habitant communities struggled to preserve their language, younger generations eventually embraced cultural pride.
sentence_zh: 雖然居民社群努力保存他們的語言，但年輕世代最終接受了文化認同。

definition_zh: (名) 棲息地；生活環境
example_sentence: Having lost most of their natural habitat, endangered pandas now rely heavily on conservation efforts.
sentence_zh: 失去大部分自然棲息地後，瀕危的熊貓現在高度依賴保育工作。

definition_zh: (名) 居住；棲息地　(名) 住所；居住場所
example_sentence: The old mansion, which served as a habitation for wealthy families for centuries, now stands abandoned.
sentence_zh: 那座古老的大宅，曾是富裕家族數世紀以來的居住地，如今已荒廢。

definition_zh: (形) 習慣的；經常的　(形) 慣常的；通常的
example_sentence: Drinking coffee every morning is a habitual behavior that many students develop during high school.
sentence_zh: 每天早上喝咖啡是許多學生在高中養成的習慣性行為。

definition_zh: (副) 習慣性地；通常；經常地
example_sentence: If Marcus did not habitually check his phone, missing important messages would become a serious problem.
sentence_zh: 如果馬可士沒有習慣性地檢查手機，漏掉重要訊息就會成為嚴重問題。

definition_zh: (動) 砍；劈　(名) 黑客；駭客
example_sentence: The programmer tried to hack into the company's computer system.
sentence_zh: 那位程式設計師試圖入侵公司的電腦系統。

definition_zh: (名) 駭客；非法入侵電腦系統者　(名) 電腦高手；程式設計者
example_sentence: Breaking into the bank's database, the hacker stole millions of dollars in cryptocurrency.
sentence_zh: 這名駭客侵入銀行資料庫，盜取了數百萬美元的加密貨幣。

definition_zh: (動) 討價還價；講價　(名) 討價還價
example_sentence: Although the vendor refused to lower the price, customers kept haggling until reaching a better deal.
sentence_zh: 儘管攤販拒絕降價，顧客們持續討價還價直到達成更好的交易。

definition_zh: (名) 冰雹　(動) 稱讚；歡迎　(動) 招呼；打招呼
example_sentence: Seldom does such severe hail damage crop fields so extensively in Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 台灣很少發生如此嚴重的冰雹對農田造成如此廣泛的損害。

definition_zh: (名) 頭髮；毛髮　(形) 毛髮的；頭髮的
example_sentence: The girl whose hair is long and black enjoys swimming after school.
sentence_zh: 那位頭髮長且黑的女孩喜歡在放學後游泳。

definition_zh: (名) 剪髮；髮型　(動) 剪髮；修剪
example_sentence: Maria went to the salon to get a haircut before the school dance.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞為了在校舞會前整理儀容，去美髮沙龍剪髮。

definition_zh: (名) 髮型師；美髮師
example_sentence: My mother visits the hairdresser every month to get a new style.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽每個月都去美髮師那裡做新髮型。

definition_zh: (名) 髮夾；U形夾子
example_sentence: Sarah used a hairpin to keep her long hair in place during the exam.
sentence_zh: 莎拉用髮夾在考試期間固定她的長髮。

definition_zh: (名) 髮型；髮式
example_sentence: Since Sarah changed her hairstyle, many classmates have complimented her new look.
sentence_zh: 因為莎拉換了髮型，許多同學都稱讚她的新造型。

definition_zh: (形) 多毛的；毛茸茸的　(形) 危險的；令人緊張的
example_sentence: Feeling nervous about the exam, the student found even the hairy details of grammar rules confusing.
sentence_zh: 感到對考試緊張，那位學生甚至覺得文法的複雜細節令人困惑。

definition_zh: (形) 健康的；強壯的　(形) 完好的；完整的
example_sentence: The elderly man, hale and hearty despite his age, walked five kilometers every morning.
sentence_zh: 那位年邁的老人儘管上了年紀，身體依然強壯健康，每天早上都走五公里。

definition_zh: (名) 上半場；中場休息時間　(形) 兼職的；半職的
example_sentence: If the soccer team scores more goals in the second half, they would win the championship.
sentence_zh: 如果足球隊在下半場進更多球，他們就會贏得冠軍。

definition_zh: (名) 一半；中間　(形) 一半的；不完全的　(副) 部分地；幾乎
example_sentence: Eating half of the pizza at lunch left room for dessert.
sentence_zh: 午餐吃掉一半的披薩，還留下空間吃甜點。

definition_zh: (形) 不夠用心的；敷衍的　(形) 缺乏熱情的；冷淡的
example_sentence: The student made a halfhearted attempt to finish homework in order to watch the drama series.
sentence_zh: 這名學生做出敷衍的嘗試來完成功課，目的是為了看連續劇。

definition_zh: (副) 半路；中途　(名) 中點；半途
example_sentence: The marathon runner took a water break halfway through the race.
sentence_zh: 馬拉松選手在比賽進行到一半時喝水休息。

definition_zh: (名) 大廳；走廊　(名) 禮堂；會館
example_sentence: As soon as students enter the school hall, they must keep quiet during the assembly.
sentence_zh: 當學生一進入學校大廳，他們在集會中必須保持安靜。

definition_zh: (名) 特徵；標誌　(動) 標示；表明
example_sentence: Having perfected its craft over decades, the luxury brand's hallmark became synonymous with quality and elegance.
sentence_zh: 經過數十年的精進，這個奢侈品牌的特徵已成為品質與優雅的代名詞。

definition_zh: (動) 使神聖；尊崇　(形) 神聖的；受尊敬的
example_sentence: The ancient temple, which hallows the memories of ancestors, attracts pilgrims every year.
sentence_zh: 這座古廟尊崇祖先的回憶，每年都吸引朝聖者前來。

definition_zh: (名) 萬聖節；萬聖夜
example_sentence: Halloween is a popular holiday when children dress up in costumes and go trick-or-treating.
sentence_zh: 萬聖節是個受歡迎的節日，孩子們穿上服裝去討糖果。

definition_zh: (名) 幻覺；幻想
example_sentence: If the patient had not taken that medicine, hallucination would not have occurred during the night.
sentence_zh: 如果病患那晚沒有服用那種藥物，就不會產生幻覺。

definition_zh: (名) 走廊；過道
example_sentence: Students walk through the hallway between classes every day.
sentence_zh: 學生們每天在課堂之間通過走廊行走。

definition_zh: (名) 鹵素；一類化學元素
example_sentence: Containing halogen, the disinfectant effectively kills bacteria in laboratory experiments.
sentence_zh: 含有鹵素的消毒劑在實驗室實驗中能有效殺死細菌。

definition_zh: (動) 停止；中止　(名) 停止；暫停
example_sentence: The factory halted production when the safety inspector arrived.
sentence_zh: 當安全檢查員到達時，工廠停止了生產。

definition_zh: (形) 停頓的；遲疑的　(動) 停止；猶豫
example_sentence: Hardly ever do students find the halting speech of nervous presenters inspiring or engaging.
sentence_zh: 學生們幾乎很少認為緊張演講者遲疑不決的發言令人鼓舞或引人入勝。

definition_zh: (動) 減半；平分　(動) 將...切成兩部分
example_sentence: The recipe calls for flour that we should halve to make smaller portions for the party.
sentence_zh: 這份食譜需要麵粉，我們應該減半以便為派對製作更小的份量。

definition_zh: (名) 火腿；豬腿肉　(動) 表演過度；誇張地演出
example_sentence: Sarah bought ham to make sandwiches for her family picnic.
sentence_zh: 莎拉買了火腿為家人的野餐製作三明治。

definition_zh: (名) 哈馬斯（巴勒斯坦伊斯蘭主義政治和軍事組織）
example_sentence: Hamas, a Palestinian political and military organization, has controlled Gaza since 2007.
sentence_zh: 哈馬斯是一個巴勒斯坦政治和軍事組織，自2007年以來一直控制加薩走廊。

definition_zh: (名) 哈瑪斯（巴勒斯坦伊斯蘭政治和軍事組織）
example_sentence: Hamas is a Palestinian political and military organization founded in 1987.
sentence_zh: 哈瑪斯是一個成立於1987年的巴勒斯坦政治和軍事組織。

definition_zh: (名) 小村莊；小鎮
example_sentence: Located in the countryside, the quiet hamlet attracted many tourists seeking peaceful rural life.
sentence_zh: 坐落在鄉村的寧靜小村莊吸引了許多尋求平靜鄉村生活的遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 槌子；錘子　(動) 敲打；錘打
example_sentence: The carpenter used a hammer that was heavy enough to drive the nail deep into the wooden board.
sentence_zh: 木匠使用一把夠重的槌子，足以將釘子深深敲進木板裡。

definition_zh: (動) 阻礙；妨礙　(名) 籃子；妨礙物
example_sentence: If bad weather hampers the outdoor sports day, the school will reschedule it for next week.
sentence_zh: 如果惡劣天氣妨礙戶外運動會，學校將把它改期到下週。

definition_zh: (名) 腿筋；後大腿肌肉　(動) 削弱；阻礙
example_sentence: Injuries can hamstring an athlete's career and dreams.
sentence_zh: 受傷可能會削弱運動員的職業生涯和夢想。

definition_zh: (名) 手；手部　(動) 遞給；交給　(名) 工人；幫手
example_sentence: Students need to hand in their homework to pass the class.
sentence_zh: 學生需要交出功課才能通過這堂課。

definition_zh: (名) 手提包；女用皮包
example_sentence: Sarah's leather handbag matches her shoes perfectly for the interview.
sentence_zh: 莎拉的皮革手提包與她面試穿的鞋子完美搭配。

definition_zh: (名) 手冊；指南　(名) 參考書；說明書
example_sentence: As students prepare for the CSAT, consulting the study handbook helps them understand exam requirements.
sentence_zh: 當學生準備學測時，查閱學習手冊幫助他們了解考試要求。

definition_zh: (名) 一把；少量　(名) 難以控制的人或物
example_sentence: Having collected a handful of seashells, the child proudly showed them to friends.
sentence_zh: 那個孩子收集了一把貝殼後，驕傲地向朋友展示。

definition_zh: (名) 障礙；不利條件　(動) 妨礙；使處於不利地位　(形) 身心障礙的
example_sentence: Students who have a handicap that affects their learning should receive extra support from the school.
sentence_zh: 有影響學習的障礙的學生應該獲得學校的額外協助。

definition_zh: (形) 身體殘疾的；有缺陷的　(動) 妨礙；使處於不利地位
example_sentence: The school building was renovated to accommodate handicapped students and ensure equal access.
sentence_zh: 學校建築經過改造以容納身體殘疾的學生並確保平等使用權。

definition_zh: (名) 手工藝；手工製品
example_sentence: If traditional handicraft techniques were taught in schools, students would appreciate cultural heritage more deeply.
sentence_zh: 如果學校教導傳統手工藝技巧，學生會更深入地欣賞文化遺產。

definition_zh: (副) 輕鬆地；容易地　(副) 靈敏地；熟練地
example_sentence: The basketball player handily defeated his opponent in the final match yesterday.
sentence_zh: 那位籃球選手在昨天的決賽中輕鬆擊敗了對手。

definition_zh: (名) 手帕；手絹
example_sentence: Wiping away tears with a handkerchief, Sarah felt much better after the sad movie.
sentence_zh: 莎拉用手帕擦去眼淚，看完這部悲傷的電影後感覺好多了。

definition_zh: (動) 處理；應對　(名) 把手；柄

sentence_zh: 當經理有效地處理客訴時，公司獲得更多忠誠客戶。

definition_zh: (形) 手工製造的；手工的

sentence_zh: 手工藝品不僅美麗，而且還能支持當地工藝師。

definition_zh: (名) 女僕；侍女　(名) 附庸；工具

sentence_zh: 這項技術是科學研究的輔助工具，它已經徹底改變了實驗室工作。

definition_zh: (名) 講義；傳單　(動) 分發；發放

sentence_zh: 老師準備講義來幫助學生在考試前複習文法。

definition_zh: (動) 精心挑選；精挑細選

sentence_zh: 教練為國家隊精心挑選了五名才華洋溢的球員。

definition_zh: (形) 精心挑選的；仔細選出的
example_sentence: The coach handpicked five players for the national team.
sentence_zh: 教練為國家隊精心挑選了五名球員。

definition_zh: (形) 親身實踐的；實際操作的　(副) 以實際操作方式；親身參與地
example_sentence: Because the chemistry teacher provides hands-on experiments, students understand molecular structures much more effectively.
sentence_zh: 由於化學老師提供親身實驗的機會，學生更有效地理解分子結構。

definition_zh: (形) 英俊的；帥氣的　(形) 大方的；慷慨的
example_sentence: Looking handsome in his new suit, the actor attracted many fans at the premiere.
sentence_zh: 穿著新西裝看起來英俊的那位演員在首映會上吸引了許多粉絲。

definition_zh: (名) 筆跡；手寫字　(形) 手寫的；手工的
example_sentence: The teacher praised the student's handwriting, which was neat and easy to read.
sentence_zh: 老師稱讚那位學生的筆跡，那筆跡整潔且容易閱讀。

definition_zh: (形) 方便的；易用的　(形) 靈巧的；有用的
example_sentence: If a dictionary app were handy, studying English vocabulary would become much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果字典應用程式很方便，學習英文單字就會變得容易得多。

definition_zh: (動) 閒逛；一起玩；聚在一起
example_sentence: Friends like to hang out at the coffee shop after school.
sentence_zh: 朋友們喜歡在放學後到咖啡館閒逛。

definition_zh: (動) 掛；懸掛　(動) 停留；逗留
example_sentence: Students often hang out at the café to relax after school.
sentence_zh: 學生經常在咖啡館逗留放鬆放學後的心情。

definition_zh: (名) 衣架；衣服吊架　(名) 飛機庫；機庫
example_sentence: Hanging wet clothes on a wooden hanger helps them dry evenly without wrinkles.
sentence_zh: 將濕衣服掛在木製衣架上有助於衣服均勻乾燥而不起皺。

definition_zh: (形) 懸掛的；吊著的　(動) 懸掛；吊起
example_sentence: Hanging from the ceiling, the decorative lanterns created a festive atmosphere for the school celebration.
sentence_zh: 懸掛在天花板上，這些裝飾燈籠為學校慶祝活動營造了節慶氣氛。

definition_zh: (名) 宿醉；酒後的不適感　(形) 宿醉的；遺留下來的
example_sentence: Having drunk too much at the party, Tom woke up with a terrible hangover and regretted his choices.
sentence_zh: 在派對上喝太多酒後，湯姆醒來時感到可怕的宿醉，後悔自己的選擇。

definition_zh: (形) 隨意的；無計畫的　(動) 冒險；碰運氣
example_sentence: The project's haphazard approach, which lacked proper planning, led to numerous delays.
sentence_zh: 這個專案的隨意方法（缺乏適當規劃）導致了許多延誤。

definition_zh: (副) 隨意地；無計畫地　(副) 雜亂地；混亂地
example_sentence: The student arranged the research materials haphazardly on the desk, making it impossible to find anything quickly.
sentence_zh: 這名學生隨意地在桌上堆放研究資料，導致很難快速找到任何東西。

definition_zh: (動) 碰巧；恰好發生　(片) 碰巧；偶然
example_sentence: If you happened to see my lost wallet on the street, would you call me immediately?
sentence_zh: 如果你碰巧在街上看到我遺失的錢包，你會立即打電話給我嗎？

definition_zh: (動) 發生；出現　(動) 碰巧；恰好
example_sentence: A surprising event happened during the school festival yesterday.
sentence_zh: 昨天校慶時發生了一件令人驚訝的事件。

definition_zh: (副) 快樂地；幸福地　(副) 幸運地；碰巧地
example_sentence: Happily finishing the exam early, Sarah rushed to meet her friends at the café.
sentence_zh: 莎拉開心地提早完成考試，急忙趕到咖啡館與朋友見面。

definition_zh: (名) 幸福；快樂　(名) 喜悅；滿足感
example_sentence: Although studying for the CSAT is stressful, students find happiness when they achieve their academic goals.
sentence_zh: 雖然準備學測很有壓力，但當學生達成學業目標時會找到幸福感。

definition_zh: (形) 快樂的；開心的　(形) 幸運的；幸福的
example_sentence: Seldom has winning a scholarship made the student feel so happy and proud.
sentence_zh: 很少有贏得獎學金能讓這個學生感到如此快樂和驕傲。

definition_zh: (動) 騷擾；困擾　(動) 持續攻擊；折磨
example_sentence: Students who are harassed by classmates should report the situation to teachers.
sentence_zh: 被同學騷擾的學生應該向老師舉報這種情況。

definition_zh: (名) 騷擾；困擾　(動) 騷擾；不斷地打擾
example_sentence: The school created new rules to prevent harassment and protect all students.
sentence_zh: 學校制定了新規則來預防騷擾並保護所有學生。

definition_zh: (名) 港灣；海港　(動) 懷有；庇護
example_sentence: Many fishing boats and cargo ships safely harbor in the protected bay during typhoon season.
sentence_zh: 颱風季節期間，許多漁船和貨輪安全地停靠在受保護的港灣裡。

definition_zh: (形) 堅定的；徹底的　(名) 核心成員；忠實支持者
example_sentence: Hard-core fans waited all night for concert tickets.
sentence_zh: 忠實的粉絲整晚等待演唱會門票。

definition_zh: (形) 根深蒂固的；天生的　(形) 內置的；固定的
example_sentence: Because human brains are hard-wired to seek social connection, teenagers often feel anxious when isolated from friends.
sentence_zh: 因為人類大腦根深蒂固地傾向於尋求社交連結，青少年與朋友隔離時常會感到焦慮。

definition_zh: (形) 勤奮的；努力工作的　(形) 辛勤的；勤勞的
example_sentence: Working diligently on the project, hard-working students completed it ahead of schedule.
sentence_zh: 勤奮工作的學生們認真投入這個專案，提前完成了任務。

definition_zh: (形) 堅硬的；困難的　(副) 努力地；用力地
example_sentence: The math problem that requires hard thinking challenges students who prepare for the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 需要努力思考的數學問題挑戰準備學測的學生。

definition_zh: (名) 硬皮書；精裝本
example_sentence: If a student buys a hardcover textbook, the book will last longer than a paperback version.
sentence_zh: 如果學生買精裝本教科書，這本書會比平裝本更耐用。

definition_zh: (動) 變硬；使堅硬　(動) 變得冷酷；使堅強
example_sentence: Repeated practice hardens the skills needed for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 反覆練習使準備學測所需的技能變得堅實。

definition_zh: (形) 強硬的；不妥協的　(名) 強硬派；強硬立場
example_sentence: The government adopted a hardline policy to crack down on illegal activities.
sentence_zh: 政府採取強硬政策以打擊非法活動。

definition_zh: (名) 強硬派人士；堅持立場的人
example_sentence: Political hardliners on both sides refuse to compromise on the controversial issue.
sentence_zh: 雙方的政治強硬派人士拒絕在這個有爭議的議題上妥協。

definition_zh: (副) 幾乎不；幾乎沒有　(副) 剛剛；才剛
example_sentence: Hardly had the exam finished when students rushed out of the classroom.
sentence_zh: 考試才剛結束，學生們就衝出教室。

definition_zh: (名) 艱難；困苦　(名) 艱苦的經歷；磨難
example_sentence: Having endured years of hardship, the refugee family finally found stability in their new home.
sentence_zh: 經歷了多年的艱難困苦，這個難民家庭終於在新家中找到了穩定。

definition_zh: (名) 硬體；五金　(名) 電腦硬體

sentence_zh: 學生線上課程所需的電腦硬體必須支援視訊會議。

definition_zh: (名) 硬木；實木
example_sentence: Hardwood flooring requires regular maintenance to keep its natural beauty and durability.
sentence_zh: 硬木地板需要定期保養以保持其天然的美觀和耐久性。

definition_zh: (形) 勤奮的；努力的　(形) 辛勤的；勞動密集的
example_sentence: If students adopted a hardworking attitude toward their studies, achieving excellent CSAT scores would become much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在功課上採取勤奮的態度，取得優異的學測成績就會容易得多。

definition_zh: (形) 強壯的；耐寒的　(形) 勇敢的；堅強的
example_sentence: Hardy mountain climbers endure extreme cold and thin air during expeditions.
sentence_zh: 強壯的登山者在登山探險中能忍受極端寒冷和稀薄空氣。

definition_zh: (形) 強健的；堅強的　(形) 耐寒的；耐久的
example_sentence: Hardy plants surviving harsh winters without special care thrive beautifully in mountain gardens.
sentence_zh: 那些耐寒的植物在沒有特殊照顧的情況下熬過嚴冬，在山地花園中蓬勃生長。

definition_zh: (名) 後宮；妃嬪集合
example_sentence: Although the palace harem housed many women, only the empress held real political power.
sentence_zh: 雖然宮殿後宮住著許多女性，但只有皇后握有真正的政治權力。

definition_zh: (動) 傷害；損害　(名) 傷害；危害
example_sentence: Hardly ever will careless driving harm innocent passengers on the road.
sentence_zh: 粗心駕駛很少不會傷害路上的無辜乘客。

definition_zh: (形) 有害的；傷害的　(形) 危險的；不利的
example_sentence: Eating too much junk food, which is harmful to health, should be avoided by students.
sentence_zh: 吃太多垃圾食物（這對健康有害）應該被學生避免。

definition_zh: (形) 無害的；沒有傷害的　(形) 溫和的；無惡意的
example_sentence: The medicine is harmless enough to give to children without causing any side effects.
sentence_zh: 這種藥物足夠無害，可以給孩子服用而不會引起任何副作用。

definition_zh: (副) 無害地；安全地　(副) 溫和地；溫順地
example_sentence: The dog barked loudly but harmlessly at the mailman outside the gate.
sentence_zh: 那隻狗對著外面的郵差大聲吠叫，但卻是無害的。

definition_zh: (形) 和諧的；協調的　(名) 泛音；諧音

sentence_zh: 樂團發出美妙的和諧之聲，感動了音樂廳裡的每一個人。

definition_zh: (名) 口琴；豎琴

sentence_zh: 雖然口琴體積小又便於攜帶，但要精通它需要多年的練習。

definition_zh: (形) 和諧的；協調的　(形) 溫和的；友善的
example_sentence: Working together harmoniously, the team members created an impressive project for the science competition.
sentence_zh: 團隊成員和諧地合作，為科學競賽創作了一項令人印象深刻的專案。

definition_zh: (名) 和諧；協調　(名) 和聲；音樂的和聲
example_sentence: The school values harmony, which creates a pleasant learning environment.
sentence_zh: 學校重視和諧，這樣才能創造出舒適的學習環境。

definition_zh: (名) 馬具；安全帶　(動) 利用；駕馭；套上馬具
example_sentence: If renewable energy sources are harnessed effectively, Taiwan will reduce carbon emissions significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果可再生能源被有效利用，台灣將大幅減少碳排放。

definition_zh: (名) 豎琴；竪琴　(動) 反覆談論；不斷說起
example_sentence: The musician played a beautiful melody on the golden harp.
sentence_zh: 音樂家用金色豎琴演奏了優美的旋律。

definition_zh: (動) 折磨；困擾　(名) 耙子；痛苦
example_sentence: Students study hard every day to harrow through the challenging CSAT exam successfully.
sentence_zh: 學生每天努力讀書是為了能夠熬過困難的學測考試。

definition_zh: (形) 令人極度恐懼的；令人極度不安的
example_sentence: The harrowing experience of failing the final exam multiple times left students feeling deeply discouraged.
sentence_zh: 多次沒有通過期末考試這種令人極度不安的經歷讓學生們感到沮喪。

definition_zh: (形) 刺耳的；粗糙的　(形) 嚴厲的；無情的
example_sentence: Although the teacher's harsh criticism hurt, the student realized it would help improve her essay.
sentence_zh: 雖然老師的嚴厲批評令人受傷，但這位學生意識到它會幫助她改進作文。

definition_zh: (名) 收穫；豐收　(動) 收穫；採收
example_sentence: Having harvested the rice fields, the farmers prepared for the next planting season.
sentence_zh: 收穫完稻田後，農民們為下一個種植季節做準備。

definition_zh: (名) 井字號標籤；話題標籤
example_sentence: The social media post that included a popular hashtag received thousands of likes.
sentence_zh: 那篇包含熱門話題標籤的社群媒體貼文獲得了數千個讚。

definition_zh: (名) 麻煩；困擾　(動) 使困擾；騷擾
example_sentence: Dealing with phone calls and emails all day is a real hassle for busy office workers.
sentence_zh: 整天處理電話和電子郵件對忙碌的辦公室工作者來說是真正的麻煩。

definition_zh: (名) 匆忙；急速　(動) 匆忙進行；加快速度
example_sentence: If students didn't haste their exam preparation, better results would certainly follow.
sentence_zh: 如果學生們不在考試準備上匆忙行動，更好的成績肯定會隨之而來。

definition_zh: (動) 加快；催促　(動) 趕快；急忙
example_sentence: The students hastened to finish their homework before the deadline.
sentence_zh: 學生們趕快完成功課以趕上截止日期。

definition_zh: (副) 匆忙地；倉促地　(副) 急速地；急促地
example_sentence: Finishing his homework hastily, Tom made several careless mistakes on the exam.
sentence_zh: 匆忙地完成功課，湯姆在考試上犯了幾個粗心的錯誤。

definition_zh: (形) 匆忙的；急躁的　(副) 匆忙地；急促地
example_sentence: Although Maria made a hasty decision, she managed to correct her mistake before the deadline.
sentence_zh: 雖然瑪莉亞做出了匆忙的決定，但她在截止日期前設法改正了錯誤。

definition_zh: (名) 帽子；帽類　(動) 戴帽子；穿上帽子
example_sentence: Only after putting on a hat did the student feel ready for the outdoor photo session.
sentence_zh: 只有戴上帽子後，這位學生才感到為戶外拍照做好了準備。

definition_zh: (名) 艙口；孵化　(動) 孵化；打開艙門　(動) 密謀；策劃
example_sentence: The baby chickens that hatched from the eggs were very cute.
sentence_zh: 從蛋孵化出來的小雞非常可愛。

definition_zh: (動) 討厭；恨　(名) 仇恨；厭惡
example_sentence: Many students study hard to hate falling behind their classmates.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力讀書是為了避免落後同學。

definition_zh: (形) 令人厭惡的；可憎的　(形) 充滿仇恨的；惡毒的
example_sentence: The hateful comments on social media hurt many innocent people deeply.
sentence_zh: 社交媒體上那些令人厭惡的評論深深傷害了許多無辜的人。

definition_zh: (名) 仇恨；厭惡　(動) 痛恨；憎恨
example_sentence: The hatred between the two countries lasted for many years.
sentence_zh: 這兩個國家之間的仇恨持續了許多年。

definition_zh: (副) 傲慢地；自大地
example_sentence: Although the wealthy businessman spoke haughtily to the job applicants, nobody appreciated his arrogant attitude.
sentence_zh: 雖然那位富有的商人傲慢地對求職者說話，但沒有人欣賞他傲慢的態度。

definition_zh: (形) 傲慢的；自大的　(形) 高傲的；目中無人的
example_sentence: Displaying haughty behavior toward classmates, the top student lost many friends at school.
sentence_zh: 那位頂尖學生對同學表現出傲慢的態度，在學校失去了許多朋友。

definition_zh: (動) 拖拉；運輸　(名) 一次的運輸量；收穫
example_sentence: The fishermen brought in a huge catch that they had to haul back to the harbor.
sentence_zh: 漁民們帶回了一個巨大的漁獲，他們必須把它拖回港口。

definition_zh: (動) 縈繞；困擾　(動) 經常出沒於
example_sentence: If memories of that accident haunt you, talking to a counselor might help.
sentence_zh: 如果那場意外的記憶縈繞著你，與諮商師談話或許會有幫助。

definition_zh: (形) 令人難忘的；縈繞心頭的　(形) 幽靈般的；陰森的
example_sentence: The haunting melody from the old film stayed with students for weeks.
sentence_zh: 那部老電影中令人難忘的旋律在學生心中縈繞了數週。

definition_zh: (片) 喜愛；對...有好感
example_sentence: Many Taiwanese students have a fondness for learning English to prepare for future opportunities.
sentence_zh: 許多台灣學生喜愛學英文以準備未來的機會。

definition_zh: (片語) 玩得開心；度過美好時光
example_sentence: The class went to the beach for a picnic and had a good time playing volleyball.
sentence_zh: 這班同學去海邊野餐，玩排球並度過了美好時光。

definition_zh: (片語) 很難；困難地進行
example_sentence: Although studying for the CSAT is challenging, many students have a hard time balancing school and part-time work.
sentence_zh: 雖然準備學測很有挑戰性，但許多學生很難平衡學校課業和打工。

definition_zh: (動) 有；持有　(片) 對…有看法；對…有觀點
example_sentence: Having considered various viewpoints, the debate team formed a clear view on climate change policy.
sentence_zh: 辯論隊在審視了各種觀點後，對氣候變遷政策形成了明確的看法。

definition_zh: (片) 存在很久；經歷過很多事；有經驗的
example_sentence: The old bookstore, which has been around for fifty years, attracts many literature lovers.
sentence_zh: 這家老書店已經存在了五十年，吸引了許多文學愛好者。

definition_zh: (動) 有；擁有　(片) 困難；難處
example_sentence: Many students have difficulty understanding complex grammar rules during exam preparation.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在準備考試時難以理解複雜的文法規則。

definition_zh: (動) 玩得開心；享受樂趣
example_sentence: If Sophia attended the beach party tomorrow, she would have fun with her classmates.
sentence_zh: 如果蘇菲亞明天參加海灘派對，她就會和同學們玩得開心。

definition_zh: (片) 別無選擇，不得不；只好
example_sentence: The company had no choice but to close the factory due to low sales.
sentence_zh: 由於銷售不佳，該公司別無選擇，只好關閉工廠。

definition_zh: (片) 盯著某人/某物；有意獲得某人/某物
example_sentence: Having one's eye on the scholarship, the student studied diligently every evening.
sentence_zh: 眼睛盯著那份獎學金，這名學生每晚都認真讀書。

definition_zh: (片語) 一心一意想要；決心要做某事
example_sentence: Having her heart set on becoming a doctor, Maria studied hard every day.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞一心想成為醫生，所以每天都認真讀書。

definition_zh: (片) 有共同之處；志趣相投
example_sentence: Not only do Sarah and Mike enjoy reading, but also they have something in common in their love for classical music.
sentence_zh: 莎拉和麥克不僅喜歡閱讀，而且在對古典音樂的熱愛中有共同之處。

definition_zh: (動) 有；擁有　(動) 吃；喝
example_sentence: Students who have completed their homework can leave early.
sentence_zh: 完成家庭作業的學生可以早點離開。

definition_zh: (片語) 很難做某事；很難應付
example_sentence: Many students have a hard time learning English vocabulary to prepare for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生為了準備學測考試而很難學習英文單字。

definition_zh: (名) 避難所；港口　(名) 安全地方；天堂
example_sentence: The library became a peaceful haven for students studying hard before the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 圖書館成為努力準備學測考試的學生們的寧靜避難所。

definition_zh: (名) 大混亂；嚴重破壞　(動) 造成混亂；摧毀
example_sentence: The typhoon wreaked havoc on the coastal town, destroying many homes and businesses.
sentence_zh: 那場颱風對沿海小鎮造成巨大破壞，摧毀了許多房屋和商店。

definition_zh: (名) 鷹；鷲　(動) 鷹眼般地盯著；急切地尋求
example_sentence: As the hawk circles overhead, small birds scatter in all directions.
sentence_zh: 當鷹在頭頂盤旋時，小鳥四散逃竄。

definition_zh: (名) 乾草；牧草
example_sentence: Farmers, harvesting hay in summer, prepare feed for winter months.
sentence_zh: 農民在夏季收割乾草，為冬季準備飼料。

definition_zh: (名) 危險；危害　(動) 冒...的風險；危及　(形) 危險的；有害的
example_sentence: Drivers who ignore traffic rules face hazards that could result in serious accidents.
sentence_zh: 忽視交通規則的駕駛人面臨可能導致嚴重事故的危險。

definition_zh: (形) 危險的；有害的　(形) 冒險的；不安全的
example_sentence: If improper waste disposal continues, hazardous chemicals will contaminate the groundwater.
sentence_zh: 如果不當廢棄物處理持續進行，危險化學物質將污染地下水。

definition_zh: (名) 霧靄；煙霧　(動) 被霧靄籠罩
example_sentence: The morning haze covered the mountain, making the view less clear.
sentence_zh: 早晨的霧靄籠罩著山脈，使景色不太清楚。

definition_zh: (形) 朦朧的；模糊的　(形) 煙霧濛濛的；不清楚的
example_sentence: Students wore sunglasses to reduce glare on hazy afternoons during outdoor activities.
sentence_zh: 學生在霧濛濛的下午戶外活動時，戴上太陽眼鏡以減少眩光。

definition_zh: (形) 正面的；迎頭的　(副) 迎面地；直接地
example_sentence: The two cars collided head-on at the intersection, causing serious injuries.
sentence_zh: 兩輛汽車在十字路口迎頭相撞，造成重傷。

definition_zh: (名) 頭；頭部　(動) 領導；率領　(形) 主要的；首位的
example_sentence: As the team captain headed toward the field, the players followed behind eagerly.
sentence_zh: 當隊長朝著球場走去時，球員們熱切地跟在後面。

definition_zh: (名) 頭痛；令人煩惱的事
example_sentence: Having stayed up late studying, Sarah suffered a terrible headache during the exam.
sentence_zh: 由於熬夜讀書，莎拉在考試時飽受劇烈頭痛之苦。

definition_zh: (名) 頭帶；髮帶
example_sentence: The athlete wore a headband that absorbed sweat during the intense match.
sentence_zh: 那位運動員在激烈的比賽中戴著吸汗的頭帶。

definition_zh: (動) 朝著...前進；前往
example_sentence: After finishing the exam, many students head for the cafeteria to celebrate.
sentence_zh: 考試結束後，許多學生前往餐廳慶祝。

definition_zh: (名) 頭盔；護頭裝備
example_sentence: If athletes wore proper headgear during contact sports, serious head injuries would be prevented.
sentence_zh: 如果運動員在對抗性運動中配戴適當的頭盔，就能預防嚴重的頭部傷害。

definition_zh: (名) 標題；題目　(名) 方向；航向
example_sentence: The article's heading clearly explains the main topic of the text.
sentence_zh: 這篇文章的標題清楚地解釋了文本的主要主題。

definition_zh: (名) 標題；頭條新聞　(動) 擔任主要角色；做為頭條刊登
example_sentence: Highlighting the economic crisis, the newspaper's headline caught readers' attention immediately.
sentence_zh: 突出經濟危機的報紙標題立即吸引了讀者的注意。

definition_zh: (名) 校長；學校主任
example_sentence: Because the headmaster announced new rules, students had to adjust their daily schedules accordingly.
sentence_zh: 因為校長宣布了新規則，學生必須相應地調整他們的日常時間表。

definition_zh: (名) 耳機；頭戴式耳機
example_sentence: Only after putting on headphones could the student focus on the online lesson.
sentence_zh: 只有戴上耳機後，這位學生才能專注於線上課程。

definition_zh: (名) 總部；司令部　(名) 中樞機關；指揮中心
example_sentence: The company headquarters, which relocated to Taipei last year, now employs over five thousand staff members.
sentence_zh: 該公司總部（去年遷至台北）現在僱用超過五千名員工。

definition_zh: (名) 總部；司令部　(名) 指揮中心；總指揮處
example_sentence: The company opened a new office to expand its headquarters in Taipei.
sentence_zh: 這家公司開設了一個新辦公室來擴展其在台北的總部。

definition_zh: (名) 進展；進度　(名) 前進的速度或距離
example_sentence: Making headway in English studies requires consistent effort and daily practice.
sentence_zh: 在英文學習上取得進展需要持續的努力和每日的練習。

definition_zh: (動) 治癒；痊癒　(動) 修復；改善
example_sentence: Regular exercise and good nutrition help heal minor injuries quickly.
sentence_zh: 定期運動和良好營養有助於迅速治癒輕微傷口。

definition_zh: (名) 療癒；治療　(動) 治癒；癒合　(形) 有療癒作用的；舒緩的
example_sentence: As time passes, the emotional wound gradually becomes healing, allowing people to move forward.
sentence_zh: 隨著時間過去，情感創傷逐漸得到療癒，讓人們能夠向前邁進。

definition_zh: (名) 健康
example_sentence: Eating balanced meals and exercising regularly, teenagers improve their overall health significantly.
sentence_zh: 青少年透過均衡飲食和規律運動，能顯著改善整體健康。

definition_zh: (形) 有益健康的；促進健康的
example_sentence: Eating healthful foods, which contain plenty of vitamins and minerals, helps students maintain energy throughout school days.
sentence_zh: 食用含有豐富維生素和礦物質的有益健康食物，可以幫助學生在整個上課日維持精力。

definition_zh: (形) 健康的；健全的　(形) 有益健康的；良好的
example_sentence: If students eat a healthy diet and exercise regularly, their grades will improve.
sentence_zh: 如果學生吃健康的飲食並定期運動，他們的成績就會進步。

definition_zh: (名) 堆；大量　(動) 堆積；積累
example_sentence: A heap of old books sat in the corner of the library.
sentence_zh: 一大堆舊書堆放在圖書館的角落裡。

definition_zh: (動) 聽說；聽聞　(動) 得知；了解到
example_sentence: Many students study hard to hear of their acceptance into top universities.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力讀書，為的是聽說自己被頂尖大學錄取。

definition_zh: (動) 聽見；聽到　(動) 得知；聽說
example_sentence: Did you hear the news about the school festival next month?
sentence_zh: 你有沒有聽說下個月校慶的消息？

definition_zh: (名) 聽力；聽覺　(名) 聆訊；聽證會
example_sentence: Although the student's hearing had improved, she still needed to wear headphones during class lectures.
sentence_zh: 雖然這位學生的聽力有所改善，但她在課堂講座中仍需要戴耳機。

definition_zh: (名) 心臟；心　(動) 衷心支持；鼓勵
example_sentence: Having lost her grandmother, the girl kept her memory close in her heart.
sentence_zh: 失去祖母後，女孩把對祖母的記憶深深放在心裡。

definition_zh: (名) 心碎；深深的傷痛　(名) 令人心碎的事
example_sentence: The heartbreak that Sarah experienced after losing her best friend was difficult to overcome.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在失去摯友後所經歷的心碎是很難克服的。

definition_zh: (形) 真誠的；發自內心的　(形) 衷心的；摯誠的
example_sentence: The teacher's heartfelt words of encouragement helped struggling students regain confidence.
sentence_zh: 老師發自內心的鼓勵言語幫助了苦苦掙扎的學生重新獲得信心。

definition_zh: (形) 溫暖人心的；令人感動的
example_sentence: If the documentary showed more heartwarming stories, audiences would feel more hopeful.
sentence_zh: 如果這部紀錄片展示更多令人感動的故事，觀眾會感到更加希望。

definition_zh: (形) 熱烈的；誠摯的　(形) 豐盛的；量大的
example_sentence: The coach gave the team a hearty welcome after their championship victory.
sentence_zh: 教練在隊伍贏得冠軍後給予他們熱烈的歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 熱；熱度　(動) 加熱；變熱　(形) 熱的；燙的
example_sentence: Heating the metal rod in the furnace, the engineer observed its color change gradually.
sentence_zh: 工程師在爐中加熱金屬棒，觀察它的顏色逐漸變化。

definition_zh: (形) 激烈的；熱烈的　(形) 生氣的；憤怒的
example_sentence: Although the debate became heated, both candidates remained respectful throughout the discussion.
sentence_zh: 雖然辯論變得激烈，但兩位候選人在整個討論中始終保持尊重。

definition_zh: (名) 暖氣機；加熱器
example_sentence: Seldom does a student turn off the heater after class ends.
sentence_zh: 課堂結束後，學生很少關掉暖氣機。

definition_zh: (名) 加熱；供暖　(形) 令人激動的；熱烈的
example_sentence: The heating system that warms our classroom during winter is very efficient.
sentence_zh: 在冬天為我們教室供暖的加熱系統非常有效率。

definition_zh: (名) 中暑；熱中風
example_sentence: Athletes drink plenty of water to prevent heatstroke during summer training.
sentence_zh: 運動員在夏季訓練期間喝大量水來預防中暑。

definition_zh: (動) 舉起；拋起　(名) 用力的一推
example_sentence: The sailors had to heave the heavy cargo onto the ship before sunset.
sentence_zh: 水手們必須在日落前把沉重的貨物舉上船。

definition_zh: (名) 天堂；極樂世界　(名) 天國；樂園
example_sentence: Many people believe heaven is a peaceful place after death.
sentence_zh: 許多人相信天堂是死後一個寧靜的地方。

definition_zh: (形) 天堂的；極好的；美妙的　(副) 非常；極其
example_sentence: The music was so heavenly that the audience sat in silence, moved by every note.
sentence_zh: 音樂是如此美妙，以至於觀眾坐著靜靜聆聽，被每個音符所感動。

definition_zh: (副) 沉重地；大量地　(副) 認真地；深深地
example_sentence: Heavily burdened by schoolwork, many students struggle to maintain good health.
sentence_zh: 被沉重的功課所負擔，許多學生難以維持良好的健康。

definition_zh: (形) 重的；沉重的　(形) 繁重的；費力的
example_sentence: The homework that the teacher assigned is so heavy that students need extra time.
sentence_zh: 老師指派的功課非常繁重，學生需要額外的時間。

definition_zh: (名) 重量級選手；重要人物　(形) 重量級的；有影響力的
example_sentence: If a heavyweight boxer trains harder, winning the championship becomes more likely.
sentence_zh: 如果一位重量級拳擊手訓練更加刻苦，贏得冠軍就會更有可能。

definition_zh: (片) 該死的；討厭的（用於表達輕微的煩惱或驚訝）
example_sentence: What the heck is taking Mom so long at the grocery store today?
sentence_zh: 媽媽在雜貨店裡到底在磨蹭什麼？

definition_zh: (名) 公頃（面積單位）
example_sentence: Farmers need to expand their land by ten hectares to grow more crops.
sentence_zh: 農民需要擴大十公頃的土地來種植更多作物。

definition_zh: (形) 忙亂的；紛亂的　(形) 繁忙的；匆促的
example_sentence: Preparing for the CSAT requires managing a hectic schedule with multiple subjects and practice tests.
sentence_zh: 準備學測需要管理多個科目和模擬考的忙亂時間表。

definition_zh: (名) 樹籬；灌木籬笆　(動) 用樹籬圍住；迴避　(動) 對沖；規避風險
example_sentence: Although the company hedged its investment risks by diversifying, unexpected market changes still caused significant losses.
sentence_zh: 雖然公司透過多元化投資來對沖風險，但意外的市場變化仍造成重大損失。

definition_zh: (形) 享樂主義的；追求快樂的
example_sentence: Having pursued hedonistic pleasures throughout university, the graduate finally realized the importance of meaningful work.
sentence_zh: 在大學期間一直追求享樂主義的快樂後，這位畢業生終於體會到有意義的工作的重要性。

definition_zh: (動) 注意；理會　(動) 遵守；聽從
example_sentence: Students who heed their teacher's advice about test preparation often achieve better exam results.
sentence_zh: 注意老師關於考試準備建議的學生，通常能取得更好的成績。

definition_zh: (名) 腳跟；鞋跟　(動) 用腳跟踢；緊跟
example_sentence: The runner's heel struck the ground with each powerful stride.
sentence_zh: 這位跑者每一步都用腳跟著地，力量十足。

definition_zh: (名) 霸權；領導權　(名) 優勢地位；統治力
example_sentence: If one country achieved hegemony over all others, international cooperation would become unnecessary and conflicts would increase.
sentence_zh: 如果一個國家對所有其他國家獲得霸權，國際合作將變得不必要，衝突也會增加。

definition_zh: (名) 高度；身高　(動) 提高；增加
example_sentence: The height of the building is over two hundred meters tall.
sentence_zh: 這棟建築物的高度超過兩百公尺。

definition_zh: (動) 提高；加強　(動) 增強；突出
example_sentence: Heightening awareness of mental health, the campaign reached thousands of students across Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 這項活動提高了對心理健康的認識，接觸了台灣各地數千名學生。

definition_zh: (形) 令人厭惡的；極其邪惡的　(形) 殘暴的；罪惡深重的
example_sentence: Because the criminal committed heinous acts against innocent people, the court sentenced him to life imprisonment.
sentence_zh: 因為那個罪犯對無辜者犯下極其邪惡的行為，法院判處他終身監禁。

definition_zh: (名) 繼承人；法定繼承人　(名) 繼承者；承人
example_sentence: Not only will the eldest son inherit the throne, but the heir apparent must also receive intensive political training.
sentence_zh: 不僅長子將繼承王位，法定繼承人也必須接受密集的政治培訓。

definition_zh: (名) 直升機；直升飛機
example_sentence: The helicopter that rescued hikers from the mountain arrived within minutes.
sentence_zh: 那架從山上救出登山者的直升機在數分鐘內抵達。

definition_zh: (名) 太陽；日光　(形) 與太陽有關的
example_sentence: Scientists use helio instruments to study solar energy in order to develop renewable power.
sentence_zh: 科學家使用日光儀器來研究太陽能，目的是開發再生能源。

definition_zh: (名) 地獄；地下世界　(名) 極其痛苦的地方或情況
example_sentence: Going through high school entrance exams feels like hell, but surviving it makes students stronger.
sentence_zh: 經歷高中入學考試感覺像地獄，但熬過它能讓學生變得更強。

definition_zh: (感) 你好；問候；打招呼的用語
example_sentence: Hello! How are you doing today?
sentence_zh: 你好！你今天怎麼樣？

definition_zh: (名) 頭盔；安全帽
example_sentence: Although riding a motorcycle is convenient, wearing a helmet is essential whenever safety matters most.
sentence_zh: 雖然騎機車很方便，但只要安全最重要，戴安全帽就是必須的。

definition_zh: (動) 幫助；協助　(名) 幫忙；幫助
example_sentence: Helping elderly neighbors cross the street, the volunteers felt truly satisfied.
sentence_zh: 志願者們幫助年長的鄰居過馬路，感到真正滿足。

definition_zh: (形) 有幫助的；有用的　(形) 樂於助人的；體貼的
example_sentence: The tutor's advice, which was helpful and clear, guided many students toward better test scores.
sentence_zh: 那位家教的建議（既有幫助又清楚）引導許多學生朝更好的考試成績邁進。

definition_zh: (形) 無助的；無能為力的　(形) 沒有幫助的；毫無用處的
example_sentence: If students feel helpless about their studies, seeking teacher guidance will improve their confidence.
sentence_zh: 如果學生對課業感到無助，尋求老師的指導會改善他們的信心。

definition_zh: (名) 半球；地球的一半
example_sentence: The Western Hemisphere includes North and South America.
sentence_zh: 西半球包括北美洲和南美洲。

definition_zh: (名) 母雞；雞母　(名) 女人；女性
example_sentence: Farmers raise hens to produce eggs for breakfast.
sentence_zh: 農民飼養母雞以生產早餐用的雞蛋。

definition_zh: (副) 因此；所以　(連) 由此；從而
example_sentence: Studying hard now will help you pass the exam, and hence achieve your university dreams.
sentence_zh: 現在努力讀書將幫助你通過考試，因此實現你的大學夢想。

definition_zh: (副) 從今以後；今後
example_sentence: Henceforth, all students must submit assignments online before midnight.
sentence_zh: 從今以後，所有學生必須在午夜前線上繳交作業。

definition_zh: (名) 指甲花；海娜染料　(動) 用海娜染色
example_sentence: Having applied henna to her hands, the bride looked radiant at the wedding ceremony.
sentence_zh: 新娘用海娜染過手後，在婚禮上看起來容光煥發。

definition_zh: (名) 先驅；預告者　(動) 預示；宣佈
example_sentence: The arrival of spring flowers, which herald the end of winter, brought joy to gardeners.
sentence_zh: 春花的到來預示了冬天的結束，這使得園丁們感到喜悅。

definition_zh: (名) 藥草；香草　(名) 草本植物
example_sentence: Growing fresh herbs in a kitchen garden makes cooking more enjoyable.
sentence_zh: 在廚房菜園裡種植新鮮香草使烹飪更加令人愉快。

definition_zh: (名) 草食動物；食草者
example_sentence: If zebras were not herbivores, the African savanna ecosystem would look completely different today.
sentence_zh: 如果斑馬不是草食動物，非洲草原生態系統今天看起來會完全不同。

definition_zh: (形) 食草的；吃植物的
example_sentence: Cows and sheep are herbivorous animals that eat grass and plants.
sentence_zh: 牛和羊是食草動物，吃草和植物。

definition_zh: (名) 牛群；獸群　(動) 聚集；驅趕
example_sentence: Herding cattle across the mountain pasture, the farmer guided the animals toward fresh grass.
sentence_zh: 牧民驅趕牛群穿過山地牧場，引導動物走向新鮮的草地。

definition_zh: (名) 牧民；牧人　(名) 牲畜飼養者
example_sentence: As the herder watched over the sheep, dark clouds gathered above the mountains.
sentence_zh: 當牧民照看羊群時，烏雲聚集在山上空。

definition_zh: (副) 在這裡；到這裡　(介) 在…處；向…處
example_sentence: Here comes the school bus that brings students home every afternoon.
sentence_zh: 載學生每天下午回家的校車來了。

definition_zh: (副) 今後；以後　(連) 在...之後
example_sentence: The new environmental law, which takes effect hereafter, will reduce plastic waste in schools.
sentence_zh: 新環保法律（自今後生效）將減少學校的塑膠廢棄物。

definition_zh: (副) 藉此；因此　(介) 憑著；通過
example_sentence: The new law aims to reduce pollution hereby encouraging companies to use green energy.
sentence_zh: 這項新法律旨在藉此鼓勵公司使用綠色能源以減少污染。

definition_zh: (名) 遺傳；遺傳性　(名) 遺傳特徵；遺傳因素
example_sentence: Eye color and hair texture are determined by heredity and environmental factors.
sentence_zh: 眼睛顏色和頭髮質感由遺傳和環境因素決定。

definition_zh: (副) 以下；此後　(連) 在以下內容中
example_sentence: The contract states the following terms: hereinafter, all payments must be made in full.
sentence_zh: 合約規定以下條款：此後，所有款項必須全額支付。

definition_zh: (副) 對此；關於此事
example_sentence: The contract states all terms and conditions, and the attached document provides further details hereto.
sentence_zh: 合約中列明所有條款與條件，附件文件對此提供進一步的詳細資訊。

definition_zh: (副) 到目前為止；以前
example_sentence: Having ignored the teacher's warnings heretofore, the student finally decided to study harder.
sentence_zh: 那位學生迄今為止一直忽視老師的警告，最後終於決定更努力讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 遺產；文化遺產　(名) 傳統；遺留
example_sentence: The ancient temple, which is a precious heritage that our ancestors left behind, attracts many tourists every year.
sentence_zh: 這座古老的寺廟是我們祖先留下的寶貴遺產，每年吸引許多遊客前往參觀。

definition_zh: (名) 隱士；隱居者　(名) 隱居修士
example_sentence: If a person chose to live as a hermit, they would escape the stress of modern society.
sentence_zh: 如果一個人選擇隱居生活，他們就會逃避現代社會的壓力。

definition_zh: (名) 隱士的住所；隱居處　(名) 偏遠的寧靜地方
example_sentence: The old monk lived in a small hermitage high in the mountains for forty years.
sentence_zh: 那位老和尚在高山上的小隱居處裡住了四十年。

definition_zh: (名) 英雄；勇士　(名) 英勇人物；偶像
example_sentence: Many students study hard to become a hero and help their community.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力讀書，目的是成為英雄並幫助他們的社區。

definition_zh: (形) 英勇的；勇敢的　(形) 壯觀的；宏大的
example_sentence: The firefighters' heroic rescue effort saved the trapped family from the burning building.
sentence_zh: 消防員英勇的救援行動將被困的家庭從燃燒的建築物中救出。

definition_zh: (名) 海洛因；毒品
example_sentence: Although heroin addiction destroys lives, many communities lack adequate treatment programs.
sentence_zh: 雖然海洛因成癮會摧毀生命，但許多社區缺乏適當的治療計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 女英雄；女主角
example_sentence: Having faced numerous challenges, the heroine finally saved her village from danger.
sentence_zh: 這位女英雄經歷了無數挑戰後，最終拯救了她的村莊免受危險。

definition_zh: (名) 鯡魚；鹹鯡魚
example_sentence: The herring that fishermen caught off the coast is a popular food in Northern Europe.
sentence_zh: 漁民在海岸外捕獲的鯡魚是北歐的常見食物。

definition_zh: (代) 她的；她的東西
example_sentence: Sarah's notebook is blue, but hers is red.
sentence_zh: 莎拉的筆記本是藍色的，但她的是紅色的。

definition_zh: (形) 猶豫的；遲疑的　(形) 不確定的；缺乏信心的
example_sentence: If Sarah were not hesitant about joining the debate team, she would gain confidence speaking publicly.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉對加入辯論隊不那麼猶豫，她就能在公開演講時獲得信心。

definition_zh: (副) 猶豫地；遲疑地
example_sentence: The student hesitantly raised her hand to answer the difficult question.
sentence_zh: 那位學生猶豫地舉手回答這個困難的問題。

definition_zh: (動) 猶豫；遲疑　(名) 猶豫；遲疑
example_sentence: Hesitating before answering, the student finally raised his hand confidently.
sentence_zh: 那位學生在回答前猶豫不決，最後終於自信地舉起手來。

definition_zh: (形) 異性戀的；對異性有吸引力的　(名) 異性戀者
example_sentence: Not only does sexual orientation vary widely, but heterosexual relationships also face modern challenges today.
sentence_zh: 不僅性向差異很大，而且異性戀關係在當今也面臨現代挑戰。

definition_zh: (名) 全盛時期；黃金年代
example_sentence: The 1980s was the heyday when rock music dominated the entertainment industry.
sentence_zh: 1980年代是搖滾樂統治娛樂產業的全盛時期。

definition_zh: (名) 中斷；暫停　(名) 空白；間隔
example_sentence: The actor took a hiatus to rest and spend time with family.
sentence_zh: 這位演員暫時停止工作以休息並陪伴家人。

definition_zh: (動) 冬眠；蟄伏　(名) 冬眠狀態
example_sentence: Bears hibernate during winter to conserve energy and survive the cold season.
sentence_zh: 熊在冬天冬眠以節省能量並度過寒冷季節。

definition_zh: (形) 隱藏的；隱祕的　(動) 隱藏；躲藏
example_sentence: The hidden treasure map was discovered in the old attic yesterday.
sentence_zh: 那張隱祕的寶藏地圖昨天在老閣樓裡被發現了。

definition_zh: (動) 隱藏；躲起來　(名) 獸皮；隱藏處
example_sentence: Before the teacher arrived, students hid their phones where no one could find them.
sentence_zh: 在老師到達之前，學生們把手機藏在沒人能找到的地方。

definition_zh: (名) 隱蔽處；秘密藏身處　(形) 隱蔽的；秘密的
example_sentence: Finding a quiet hideaway deep in the mountains, tired hikers finally rested peacefully.
sentence_zh: 在山深處找到一個安靜的隱蔽處，疲憊的登山者終於能安心休息。

definition_zh: (形) 思想保守的；不願改變的　(形) 受到嚴格限制的
example_sentence: The company's hidebound policies, which rejected all modern technology, caused talented employees to leave.
sentence_zh: 這家公司那些拒絕所有現代科技的保守政策，導致有才能的員工離職。

definition_zh: (形) 令人厭惡的；醜陋的　(形) 極其不愉快的；令人反感的
example_sentence: If the building's hideous design were changed, the neighborhood would become more attractive.
sentence_zh: 如果那棟建築物令人厭惡的設計被改變，這個社區就會變得更有吸引力。

definition_zh: (副) 極其醜陋地；可怕地
example_sentence: The old abandoned house looked hideously dark and frightening at midnight.
sentence_zh: 那棟廢棄的舊房子在午夜時看起來極其陰森恐怖。

definition_zh: (名) 階級制度；等級體系　(名) 領導階層；上層人士
example_sentence: Companies organize employee roles to establish clear hierarchy to improve workflow efficiency.
sentence_zh: 公司組織員工職位以建立清晰的階級制度來提高工作效率。

definition_zh: (形) 高級的；頂級的　(名) 高端市場；奢侈品
example_sentence: This high-end smartphone features the latest technology and premium design.
sentence_zh: 這款高級智慧型手機具有最新科技和精緻設計。

definition_zh: (形) 高果糖的；含高果糖的
example_sentence: Although high-fructose corn syrup is cheap to produce, many people avoid it because it may cause health problems.
sentence_zh: 雖然高果糖玉米糖漿便宜製造，但許多人避免食用，因為它可能導致健康問題。

definition_zh: (形) 高知名度的；備受矚目的　(形) 引人注目的；高調的
example_sentence: Having gained significant media attention, the high-profile celebrity faced constant scrutiny from reporters and fans everywhere.
sentence_zh: 由於獲得了重大的媒體關注，這位高知名度的名人受到記者和粉絲的持續審視。

definition_zh: (形) 高層的；摩天樓的　(名) 高樓；摩天大樓
example_sentence: The high-rise apartment building that stands downtown attracts many young professionals seeking convenient city living.
sentence_zh: 矗立在市中心的高樓公寓建築吸引許多尋求便利城市生活的年輕專業人士。

definition_zh: (形) 高的；高度大的　(副) 高地；在高處　(名) 高度；高點
example_sentence: High school students preparing for the CSAT exam often study late into the night.
sentence_zh: 準備學測的高中學生經常熬夜讀書到很晚。

definition_zh: (動) 強調；突出　(名) 最精彩的部分；亮點
example_sentence: If the presentation highlighted the company's achievements, investors would show greater interest.
sentence_zh: 如果這份簡報強調了公司的成就，投資者就會表現出更大的興趣。

definition_zh: (副) 高度地；非常　(副) 極其；很
example_sentence: The teacher praised Maria's highly organized project during class.
sentence_zh: 老師在課堂上稱讚瑪麗亞組織得非常好的專案。

definition_zh: (名) 高速公路；幹道
example_sentence: Traveling along the highway connecting major cities, commuters enjoy faster journeys to work.
sentence_zh: 沿著連接主要城市的高速公路旅行，通勤者享受更快速的上班路程。

definition_zh: (動) 劫持；非法奪取　(名) 劫持行為
example_sentence: As the plane was being hijacked by criminals, passengers remained calm and followed crew instructions.
sentence_zh: 當飛機被罪犯劫持時，乘客保持冷靜並遵循機組人員的指示。

definition_zh: (名) 劫機者；劫持者
example_sentence: Only after the hijacker was arrested did the passengers feel safe again.
sentence_zh: 直到劫機者被逮捕後，乘客們才感到安全。

definition_zh: (名) 劫持；劫機　(動) 劫持的；非法奪取的
example_sentence: The plane hijacking, which shocked the entire nation, led to stricter airport security measures.
sentence_zh: 那起震驚全國的劫機事件導致了更嚴格的機場安全措施。

definition_zh: (動) 登山；去郊遊　(名) 登山；郊遊
example_sentence: Many students hike on weekends to enjoy nature and stay healthy.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在週末登山以享受大自然並保持健康。

definition_zh: (名) 登山者；登山愛好者
example_sentence: A dedicated hiker climbed the mountain trail early in the morning.
sentence_zh: 一位熱情的登山者在清晨攀登山路。

definition_zh: (名) 登山；健行　(動) 去登山；去健行
example_sentence: Hiking in the mountains on weekends helps me relax and stay healthy.
sentence_zh: 週末在山裡健行可以幫助我放鬆並保持健康。

definition_zh: (名) 小山；丘陵　(動) 堆成小山；加土覆蓋
example_sentence: As the hikers climbed the hill, they enjoyed a beautiful view of the valley below.
sentence_zh: 當登山者爬上小山時，他們欣賞了下方山谷的美景。

definition_zh: (名) 山坡；丘陵的側面
example_sentence: Walking along the hillside covered with wildflowers, students discovered rare plants.
sentence_zh: 沿著開滿野花的山坡行走，學生們發現了稀有植物。

definition_zh: (形) 多丘陵的；起伏的
example_sentence: The hiking trail that winds through the hilly terrain offers stunning valley views.
sentence_zh: 穿過起伏山丘的登山步道提供了壯觀的山谷景觀。

definition_zh: (形) 後面的；後部的　(名) 母鹿；雌鹿
example_sentence: If the hind legs of a deer were injured, the animal would struggle to escape from predators in the forest.
sentence_zh: 如果鹿的後腿受傷，這隻動物將很難在森林中逃離掠食者。

definition_zh: (動) 妨礙；阻礙　(動) 阻止；延遲
example_sentence: Bad weather hindered our outdoor camping trip last weekend.
sentence_zh: 糟糕的天氣阻礙了我們上週末的戶外露營活動。

definition_zh: (名) 事後諸葛亮；後見之明　(名) 回顧；回看
example_sentence: Students review past exam mistakes to gain hindsight and improve future performance.
sentence_zh: 學生複習過去的考試錯誤以獲得後見之明並改進未來的表現。

definition_zh: (名) 印度教；印度教信仰
example_sentence: Hinduism, one of the world's major religions, emphasizes karma and the cycle of rebirth.
sentence_zh: 印度教是世界主要宗教之一，強調業力和輪迴循環。

definition_zh: (名) 鉸鏈；轉軸　(動) 依靠；取決於
example_sentence: The success of the school festival hinges on whether enough students volunteer to help.
sentence_zh: 學校慶典的成功取決於是否有足夠的學生自願幫忙。
subject_type: noun (The success of the school festival)

definition_zh: (名) 提示；暗示　(動) 暗示；提示
example_sentence: Having hinted at the surprise party, the teacher couldn't help smiling at students' confused faces.
sentence_zh: 已經暗示了驚喜派對後，老師看著學生困惑的表情忍不住微笑。

definition_zh: (形) 時髦的；流行的　(名) 臀部；髖部
example_sentence: The fashion brand that teenagers find hip is the one which combines traditional and modern styles.
sentence_zh: 青少年覺得時髦的那個時尚品牌是結合傳統和現代風格的品牌。

definition_zh: (動) 雇用；聘用　(名) 租賃；出租
example_sentence: If the company hired more workers, production would increase significantly next quarter.
sentence_zh: 如果公司雇用更多工人，下一季的產量將大幅增加。

definition_zh: (動) 發出嘶聲；(名) 嘶聲
example_sentence: The angry cat hissed at the dog approaching its kittens.
sentence_zh: 那隻憤怒的貓對著靠近小貓的狗發出嘶聲。

definition_zh: (名) 歷史學家；歷史研究者
example_sentence: Having studied ancient texts for decades, the historian presented groundbreaking evidence at the international conference.
sentence_zh: 這位歷史學家花了數十年研究古代文獻，在國際會議上提出了突破性的證據。

definition_zh: (形) 歷史性的；有歷史意義的　(形) 著名的；重要的
example_sentence: Because the Moon landing was historic, scientists celebrated this achievement for years.
sentence_zh: 因為登月是一個歷史性事件，科學家們為這項成就慶祝了許多年。

definition_zh: (形) 歷史的；歷史上的　(形) 重要的；有重大意義的
example_sentence: Only after the discovery of ancient documents did the historical significance of the site become clear to scholars.
sentence_zh: 只有在發現古代文獻之後，該遺址的歷史重要性才對學者變得明顯。

definition_zh: (名) 歷史；過去發生的事件　(名) 由來；背景
example_sentence: The ancient civilization that built these temples left behind a rich history spanning thousands of years.
sentence_zh: 建造這些廟宇的古代文明留下了跨越數千年的豐富歷史。

definition_zh: (片) 深深打動；引起共鳴
example_sentence: The documentary used powerful stories to hit home with viewers about climate change.
sentence_zh: 那部紀錄片用有力的故事來深深打動觀眾，讓他們認識氣候變遷的問題。

definition_zh: (動) 勃然大怒；暴跳如雷
example_sentence: When the teacher discovered the students cheating on the exam, she hit the ceiling.
sentence_zh: 當老師發現學生在考試中作弊時，她勃然大怒。

definition_zh: (片) 開始旅行；出發　(片) 離開；遠行
example_sentence: After finishing the project, the team decided to hit the road for a weekend trip.
sentence_zh: 完成項目後，團隊決定出發去週末旅行。

definition_zh: (片) 大發雷霆；勃然大怒
example_sentence: When the teacher discovered the cheating scandal, she hit the roof, and the entire class fell silent immediately.
sentence_zh: 當老師發現作弊醜聞時，她大發雷霆，整個班級立刻陷入沉默。

definition_zh: (片) 恰好滿足需要；正好合意
example_sentence: Having skipped lunch, the cold juice hitting the spot made Sarah feel refreshed immediately.
sentence_zh: 由於跳過午餐，冰涼的果汁恰好滿足莎拉的需要，讓她立刻感到精神煥發。

definition_zh: (動) 打；擊　(名) 打擊；成功的事
example_sentence: The movie that hit theaters last week became a huge success.
sentence_zh: 上週上映的那部電影成為巨大的成功。

definition_zh: (動) 搭便車；綁住　(名) 便車；故障
example_sentence: If you hitch a ride with a friend to the concert, you will save money on transportation costs.
sentence_zh: 如果你搭朋友的便車去音樂會，你就能節省交通費。

definition_zh: (名) 蜂巢；蜂房　(名) 繁忙的地方
example_sentence: The bees in the hive work together to produce honey.
sentence_zh: 蜂巢裡的蜜蜂一起合作生產蜂蜜。

definition_zh: (名) 白霜；霜凍　(形) 灰白的；蒼白的
example_sentence: Farmers wake up early to check hoar frost and protect their crops from freezing damage.
sentence_zh: 農民早起檢查白霜，以保護他們的作物免受凍害。

definition_zh: (動) 囤積；儲存　(名) 囤積物；存貨
example_sentence: During the pandemic, many people hoarded toilet paper and hand sanitizer out of fear.
sentence_zh: 在疫情期間，許多人因為害怕而囤積衛生紙和乾洗手液。

definition_zh: (名) 囤積者；貪心收集者　(動) 囤積；大量收集
example_sentence: Since Maria became a hoarder, her apartment has been filled with old magazines and useless items.
sentence_zh: 由於瑪麗亞變成了囤積狂，她的公寓裡堆滿了舊雜誌和無用物品。

definition_zh: (形) 沙啞的；嘶啞的　(動) 使沙啞
example_sentence: Having shouted throughout the concert, the singer's voice turned hoarse by the final song.
sentence_zh: 在整場演唱會中大喊過後，歌手到了最後一首歌時聲音變得沙啞。

definition_zh: (名) 騙局；假新聞　(動) 欺騙；捏造
example_sentence: The viral video that claimed aliens landed was a hoax which many people believed.
sentence_zh: 那部聲稱外星人著陸的病毒式影片是一個許多人相信的騙局。

definition_zh: (動) 跛行；蹣跚走路　(動) 妨礙；阻礙
example_sentence: The injured athlete hobbled across the finish line with determination and pride.
sentence_zh: 這位受傷的運動員跛著腳跨過終點線，展現決心和自豪感。

definition_zh: (名) 嗜好；愛好　(名) 習慣；慣性
example_sentence: If painting were not such an expensive hobby, more students would pursue artistic dreams.
sentence_zh: 如果繪畫不是那麼昂貴的嗜好，更多學生就會追求藝術夢想。

definition_zh: (名) 踝關節；腿的下部　(動) 典當；抵押
example_sentence: The horse's hock was injured after the long race.
sentence_zh: 經過長距離賽跑後，馬的踝關節受傷了。

definition_zh: (名) 冰上曲棍球；陸地曲棍球
example_sentence: Playing hockey in winter, athletes develop strong leg muscles and quick reflexes.
sentence_zh: 在冬天打冰上曲棍球，運動員會培養強大的腿部肌肉和敏捷的反應能力。

definition_zh: (動) 抑制；克制　(動) 隱瞞；保留
example_sentence: Although Mark wanted to laugh, he held back his emotions when his friend shared the sad news.
sentence_zh: 雖然馬克想要笑，但當他的朋友分享悲傷的消息時，他克制住了自己的情感。

definition_zh: (動) 抑制；忍住　隱瞞；保留
example_sentence: Hardly could the student hold in her excitement when the exam results were announced.
sentence_zh: 當考試成績公佈時，那位學生幾乎無法抑制她的興奮之情。

definition_zh: (動) 堅持；撐住　(動) 拒絕投降；抵抗
example_sentence: The company held out against pressure from competitors that threatened its market position.
sentence_zh: 該公司堅持抵抗威脅其市場地位的競爭對手施加的壓力。

definition_zh: (名) 搶劫；耽擱　(動) 搶劫；延遲
example_sentence: The bank robbery was a dramatic hold-up that shocked the entire city.
sentence_zh: 銀行搶劫是一場令整個城市震驚的重大搶劫事件。

definition_zh: (動) 拿著；握住　(動) 舉辦；進行　(名) 把握；控制權
example_sentence: The school will hold a sports meeting and a talent show next month.
sentence_zh: 學校下個月將舉辦一場運動會和才藝表演。

definition_zh: (名) 持有人；所有者　(名) 容器；架子
example_sentence: The ticket holder must show identification at the entrance.
sentence_zh: 購票者必須在入口出示身份證明。

definition_zh: (名) 持有；控股　(動) 握著；保持　(形) 吸引人的；迷人的
example_sentence: While holding her diploma, Sarah felt proud of all her hard work during high school.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在握著文憑的同時，為她高中時期的所有努力感到驕傲。

definition_zh: (名) 洞；孔　(動) 挖洞；鑽孔
example_sentence: The workers, digging holes in the ground, prepared the site for building.
sentence_zh: 工人們在地上挖洞，為建築工程做準備。

definition_zh: (名) 假日；節日　(名) 假期；休假
example_sentence: The holiday that falls in February is the most important celebration for Taiwanese families.
sentence_zh: 二月份的假日是台灣家庭最重要的慶祝活動。

definition_zh: (形) 空心的；中空的　(動) 挖空；使凹陷
example_sentence: If the ancient tree were not hollow, it could not have survived so many years of storms.
sentence_zh: 如果那棵古樹不是空心的，它就無法度過這麼多年的暴風雨。

definition_zh: (名) 大屠殺；浩劫　(名) 猶太人大屠殺
example_sentence: The Holocaust remains one of history's darkest chapters and most tragic events.
sentence_zh: 大屠殺仍然是歷史上最黑暗和最悲慘的事件之一。

definition_zh: (形) 神聖的；聖潔的　(形) 虔誠的；值得尊敬的
example_sentence: Many pilgrims visit holy sites to deepen their spiritual faith and connect with tradition.
sentence_zh: 許多朝聖者訪問聖地以加深靈性信仰並與傳統相連。

definition_zh: (名) 敬意；致敬　(動) 向…表示敬意；致敬
example_sentence: The famous director paying homage to classic films inspired many young filmmakers.
