sentence_zh: 那位著名導演向經典電影致敬的做法激勵了許多年輕電影製作人。

definition_zh: (形) 自製的；家做的　(形) 簡陋的；粗糙的
example_sentence: Because the cake was home-made, it tasted much fresher than store-bought desserts.
sentence_zh: 因為蛋糕是自製的，所以嚐起來比商店買的甜點新鮮得多。

definition_zh: (名) 家；家庭　(名) 家鄉；故鄉　(形) 家庭的；本地的
example_sentence: Having finished homework, Sarah returned home exhausted but satisfied.
sentence_zh: 完成家庭作業後，莎拉疲憊但滿足地回到家。

definition_zh: (名) 宅男；宅女　(形) 居家型的；喜歡待在家裡的
example_sentence: My cousin, who is a homebody, prefers watching movies at home to going out with friends.
sentence_zh: 我表弟是個宅男，他寧願在家看電影也不願跟朋友出去。

definition_zh: (名) 祖國；故鄉　(名) 家鄉；本土
example_sentence: Many immigrants miss their homeland and return to visit family every summer.
sentence_zh: 許多移民思念祖國，每年夏天都回去探親。

definition_zh: (形) 無家可歸的；沒有住處的
example_sentence: If more job opportunities existed, homelessness would decrease and fewer people would live on streets.
sentence_zh: 如果有更多的工作機會，無家可歸的現象就會減少，較少人會流落街頭。

definition_zh: (名) 在家教育；家庭學校教育
example_sentence: Some parents choose homeschool for their children to provide personalized learning.
sentence_zh: 有些家長選擇在家教育孩子，以提供個人化的學習。

definition_zh: (名) 在家接受教育；家庭教育
example_sentence: Choosing homeschooling, many parents customize their children's curriculum to match individual learning styles and interests.
sentence_zh: 選擇在家教育的許多家長會根據孩子個人的學習風格和興趣調整課程。

definition_zh: (形) 想家的；思鄉的
example_sentence: Although living in a hostel near campus, many students feel homesick whenever they think of their families.
sentence_zh: 雖然住在校園附近的宿舍，許多學生每當想到家人時就感到想家。

definition_zh: (名) 故鄉；家鄉
example_sentence: Only after leaving for university did Maria truly appreciate her quiet hometown.
sentence_zh: 直到離開家鄉上大學後，瑪麗亞才真正欣賞她安靜的故鄉。

definition_zh: (形) 朝家方向的；回家的　(副) 向家；朝家方向
example_sentence: The students walking homeward after school stopped at the convenience store near their neighborhood.
sentence_zh: 那些放學後走在回家路上的學生在鄰近社區的便利商店停下來。

definition_zh: (名) 家庭作業；功課
example_sentence: Students do homework after school to practice and review what they learned in class.
sentence_zh: 學生放學後做家庭作業以練習和複習課堂所學內容。

definition_zh: (名) 殺人；殺人罪
example_sentence: The detective investigated the homicide case with great care and attention.
sentence_zh: 偵探用極大的謹慎和注意力調查這起殺人案件。

definition_zh: (形) 同類的；成分相同的　(形) 均勻的；一致的
example_sentence: The homogeneous mixture of oil and water cannot be easily separated.
sentence_zh: 油和水的同類混合物無法輕易分離。

definition_zh: (動) 使均勻；使一致
example_sentence: As the company homogenizes its products across different markets, local customers lose unique cultural flavors.
sentence_zh: 當公司在不同市場統一其產品時，當地顧客失去了獨特的文化特色。

definition_zh: (形) 同質的；一致的　(形) 均勻的；相同成分的
example_sentence: Composed of similar elements, the homogenous mixture required careful heating to avoid separation.
sentence_zh: 由相似物質組成的這種均勻混合物需要小心加熱以防分離。

definition_zh: (形) 同性戀的；同性吸引的　(名) 同性戀者；同性戀人士
example_sentence: The documentary explores the lives of homosexual couples who have fought for marriage equality and social acceptance.
sentence_zh: 這部紀錄片探討了為婚姻平權和社會接納而奮鬥的同性戀伴侶的生活。

definition_zh: (形) 誠實的；老實的　(形) 坦白的；真摯的
example_sentence: If students are honest about their mistakes, teachers will help them improve.
sentence_zh: 如果學生對自己的錯誤誠實以對，老師就會幫助他們進步。

definition_zh: (副) 誠實地；老實說　(副) 坦白地；說實話
example_sentence: Honestly, studying hard every day helps students pass the exam.
sentence_zh: 老實說，每天認真讀書能幫助學生通過考試。

definition_zh: (名) 誠實；老實　(形) 誠實的；坦白的
example_sentence: Students study hard to develop honesty and build trust with teachers.
sentence_zh: 學生努力讀書是為了培養誠實品格，建立與老師的信任。

definition_zh: (名) 蜂蜜；甜蜜的東西　(名) 親愛的；寶貝（昵稱）
example_sentence: Honey and lemon tea is a popular drink for sore throats among students.
sentence_zh: 蜂蜜檸檬茶是學生喉嚨痛時的熱門飲品。

definition_zh: (名) 蜜月；新婚旅行
example_sentence: After getting married, the couple went to Paris for their honeymoon while their families stayed home.
sentence_zh: 結婚後，這對夫妻去巴黎度蜜月，而他們的家人則待在家裡。

definition_zh: (動) 按喇叭；鳴笛　(名) 喇叭聲；汽車鳴笛聲
example_sentence: Having honked the horn repeatedly, the driver warned pedestrians of the approaching vehicle.
sentence_zh: 駕駛員反覆按了喇叭後，警告行人注意靠近的車輛。

definition_zh: (名) 榮譽；名譽　(動) 尊敬；表彰　(形) 光榮的；值得尊敬的
example_sentence: The award was given to the athlete who showed honor and integrity throughout the competition.
sentence_zh: 這個獎項頒發給在比賽中始終展現榮譽和誠信的運動員。

definition_zh: (形) 光榮的；值得尊敬的　(形) 誠實的；正直的
example_sentence: Winning the National Science Competition brought honorable recognition to the entire school.
sentence_zh: 贏得全國科學競賽為整個學校帶來了光榮的認可。

definition_zh: (形) 名譽的；榮譽的　(形) 無報酬的；義務的
example_sentence: If the university offered him an honorary degree, he would accept it with great pride.
sentence_zh: 如果大學頒發給他名譽學位，他會欣然接受。

definition_zh: (名) 榮譽者；受表揚者
example_sentence: The scholarship honoree received a certificate and a monetary award.
sentence_zh: 這位獎學金得主獲得了證書和獎金。

definition_zh: (形) 敬語的；尊敬的　(名) 敬語；敬稱
example_sentence: Using honorific titles when addressing elderly people, students show respect for tradition.
sentence_zh: 學生在稱呼長輩時使用敬語，表現出對傳統的尊重。

definition_zh: (名) 兜帽；風帽　(名) 街區；社區
example_sentence: Although wearing a hood kept him warm, the student couldn't see clearly during the snowstorm.
sentence_zh: 儘管兜帽使他保持溫暖，但在暴風雪期間這名學生看不清楚。

definition_zh: (名) 蹄；馬蹄
example_sentence: Seldom does a horse injure its hoof without limping for weeks.
sentence_zh: 馬很少在不傷蹄的情況下跛行數周。

definition_zh: (名) 鉤子；魚鉤　(動) 用鉤子鉤住；吸引　(片) 打右勾拳
example_sentence: The fishing hook that dangled from the line caught three large fish yesterday.
sentence_zh: 昨天從釣線上懸掛的魚鉤抓住了三條大魚。

definition_zh: (動) 跳躍；單足跳　(名) 跳躍；啤酒花
example_sentence: Many students hop on one foot to build strength for basketball.
sentence_zh: 許多學生單足跳躍來增強籃球的力量。

definition_zh: (名) 希望；期望　(動) 希望；期待
example_sentence: Studying hard and hoping for success is what every student should do.
sentence_zh: 認真讀書並希望成功是每個學生應該做的事。

definition_zh: (形) 充滿希望的；樂觀的　(形) 有可能發生的；有前景的
example_sentence: Despite the difficult exam, many students felt hopeful about their results.
sentence_zh: 儘管考試很難，許多學生對他們的成績感到充滿希望。

definition_zh: (副) 懷抱希望地；但願；(表示講者希望)但願
example_sentence: Hopefully, the new restaurant near school will open next month.
sentence_zh: 但願學校附近的新餐廳下個月會開幕。

definition_zh: (形) 無望的；絕望的　(形) 無能的；沒有希望的
example_sentence: Feeling hopeless about the exam, many students stopped studying and gave up entirely.
sentence_zh: 對考試感到絕望，許多學生停止讀書，完全放棄了。

definition_zh: (名) 地平線；視野　(名) 前景；範圍
example_sentence: The sun disappeared beyond the horizon that stretched endlessly across the ocean.
sentence_zh: 太陽消失在延伸無盡的地平線後面，橫跨整個海洋。

definition_zh: (形) 水平的；橫向的　(副) 水平地；橫向地
example_sentence: If the desk surface were horizontal, books would not slide off easily during the earthquake.
sentence_zh: 如果桌面是水平的，地震時書籍就不會容易滑落。

definition_zh: (副) 水平地；橫向地
example_sentence: The artist drew a long line horizontally across the white canvas.
sentence_zh: 藝術家在白色畫布上水平地畫了一條長線。

definition_zh: (名) 激素；荷爾蒙　(名) 內分泌物；促進生長的物質
example_sentence: Regular exercise helps balance hormones to improve overall health and mood.
sentence_zh: 定期運動有助於平衡激素以改善整體健康和心情。

definition_zh: (名) 喇叭；號角　(名) 角；獸角　(動) 用角頂；插嘴
example_sentence: The car horn sounded loudly when the driver spotted danger ahead on the busy street.
sentence_zh: 當駕駛在繁忙街道上發現前方危險時，汽車喇叭大聲響起。

definition_zh: (形) 好色的；色慾旺盛的　(形) 渴望的；急切想要的
example_sentence: Although the protagonist felt horny after seeing the attractive character, he focused on his exam preparation instead.
sentence_zh: 儘管主角在看到那個迷人的角色後感到好色，他還是專注於考試準備。

definition_zh: (形) 極其可怕的；駭人的　(形) 極其糟糕的；令人厭惡的
example_sentence: Having experienced the horrendous earthquake, the community rebuilt stronger infrastructure.
sentence_zh: 經歷了那場駭人的地震後，該社區重建了更強大的基礎設施。

definition_zh: (形) 可怕的；討厭的　(形) 極壞的；糟糕的
example_sentence: The movie that received horrible reviews was cancelled before its official release.
sentence_zh: 那部獲得惡評的電影在正式上映前被取消了。

definition_zh: (形) 令人恐怖的；驚人的　令人厭惡的；非常糟糕的
example_sentence: The horrific car accident on the highway shocked the entire community yesterday.
sentence_zh: 昨天高速公路上那場令人恐怖的車禍震驚了整個社區。

definition_zh: (形) 非常害怕的；驚恐的　(動過) 使...感到恐懼；嚇壞
example_sentence: If the students discovered the truth about the exam cheat, teachers would be horrified at such dishonesty.
sentence_zh: 如果學生發現考試作弊的真相，老師會對這種不誠實感到非常驚恐。

definition_zh: (動) 使恐怖；使驚駭　(動) 使感到極度厭惡
example_sentence: The terrible accident horrified all the students at school.
sentence_zh: 那可怕的事故使學校所有學生都感到極度驚駭。

definition_zh: (形) 令人恐懼的；驚人的　(動) 使恐懼；使害怕
example_sentence: Horrifying videos spreading online, teenagers often feel anxious about their safety.
sentence_zh: 令人驚駭的影片在網上傳播，青少年常常為自身安全感到焦慮。

definition_zh: (名) 恐怖；驚駭　(形) 令人恐怖的；可怕的
example_sentence: Although the horror movie scared many viewers, some teenagers still enjoyed watching it.
sentence_zh: 雖然那部恐怖電影嚇到許多觀眾，但有些青少年仍然喜歡看它。

definition_zh: (名) 馬；馬匹
example_sentence: Only after mounting the horse did the cowboy realize the saddle was missing.
sentence_zh: 只有在騎上馬之後，牛仔才意識到馬鞍不見了。

definition_zh: (名) 馬力；動力
example_sentence: Racing cars that have high horsepower can accelerate much faster than ordinary vehicles.
sentence_zh: 具有高馬力的賽車比普通車輛加速快得多。

definition_zh: (名) 軟管；水管　(動) 用軟管澆灑；沖洗
example_sentence: The gardener used a long hose to water the flowers in the backyard.
sentence_zh: 園丁用一條長軟管來澆灑後院的花朵。

definition_zh: (形) 好客的；熱情招待的　殷勤款待的
example_sentence: The host's warm and hospitable nature made all the guests feel welcome and comfortable throughout the evening.
sentence_zh: 主人熱情好客的性格使所有客人在整晚都感到受歡迎和舒適。

definition_zh: (名) 醫院；醫療機構
example_sentence: My grandmother stayed in the hospital for two weeks after surgery.
sentence_zh: 我祖母在手術後在醫院住了兩週。

definition_zh: (名) 好客；熱情款待　殷勤招待
example_sentence: Although the hotel's rooms were small, the staff's hospitality made guests feel genuinely welcome and cared for.
sentence_zh: 雖然飯店的房間很小，但員工的熱情款待讓客人感到真正受歡迎和被照顧。

definition_zh: (動) 將…送入醫院；住院治療
example_sentence: Hospitalized after a serious car accident, the patient received intensive care for three weeks.
sentence_zh: 在一場嚴重車禍後被送入醫院，患者接受了三週的密集治療。

definition_zh: (名) 主人；東道主　(動) 主持；招待　(名) 寄主；宿主
example_sentence: The school that hosts the annual science competition is known for its excellent facilities.
sentence_zh: 主辦年度科學競賽的學校以其優良設施而聞名。

definition_zh: (名) 人質；抵押品　(動) 扣押為人質
example_sentence: If the negotiator secures the hostage's release, the crisis will end immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果談判代表確保人質獲釋，危機將立即結束。

definition_zh: (名) 青年旅舍；旅館
example_sentence: Backpackers often stay in hostels to save money while traveling.
sentence_zh: 背包客經常住在青年旅舍以節省旅遊開支。

definition_zh: (名) 女主人；女房東　(名) 女招待；空姐
example_sentence: The hostess greeted guests at the door to make them feel welcome.
sentence_zh: 女主人在門口迎接客人，目的是讓他們感到受歡迎。

definition_zh: (形) 充滿敵意的；不友善的　(形) 敵對的；對立的
example_sentence: The hostile attitude between the two rival schools made peaceful cooperation nearly impossible.
sentence_zh: 這兩所競爭學校之間充滿敵意的態度使得和平合作幾乎不可能。

definition_zh: (名) 敵意；憎恨　(名) 對抗；衝突
example_sentence: Although the two countries had signed a peace treaty, hostility between their citizens remained strong for years.
sentence_zh: 雖然兩國簽署了和平條約，但公民之間的敵意多年來仍然強烈。

definition_zh: (名) 易怒的脾氣；急躁　(形) 脾氣暴躁的；容易生氣的
example_sentence: Having lost his temper repeatedly, the coach finally understood his hot temper was hurting the team.
sentence_zh: 那位教練因為多次發脾氣，最後終於明白他易怒的脾氣傷害了球隊。

definition_zh: (形) 熱的；高溫的　(形) 辛辣的；有香辣味的
example_sentence: The soup that my mother made this morning is still hot and delicious.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽今早煮的湯仍然是熱的而且很好喝。

definition_zh: (名) 旅館；飯店
example_sentence: Many tourists stay at luxury hotels in Taipei during their vacation.
sentence_zh: 許多遊客在假期期間住在台北的豪華旅館。

definition_zh: (名) 飯店老闆；旅館經營者
example_sentence: If the hotelier offered better service, more tourists would choose this hotel.
sentence_zh: 如果飯店老闆提供更好的服務，更多遊客就會選擇這家旅館。

definition_zh: (名) 熱點；熱門地點　(名) 問題區域；衝突地帶
example_sentence: This beach is a popular hotspot for tourists during summer vacation.
sentence_zh: 這個海灘在暑假期間是遊客的熱門景點。

definition_zh: (名) 獵犬；狗　(動) 窮追；逼迫
example_sentence: Hounded by endless homework, students often feel stressed during exam season.
sentence_zh: 被無止盡的家庭作業窮追，學生在考試季節經常感到壓力很大。

definition_zh: (名) 小時；鐘頭　(名) 時刻；時間
example_sentence: While the exam lasted three hours, many students felt their hearts racing.
sentence_zh: 當考試進行三小時時，許多學生感到心跳加速。

definition_zh: (副) 每小時；按小時計算　(形) 每小時的；按小時進行的
example_sentence: Hardly ever does the convenience store raise its hourly wage for part-time workers.
sentence_zh: 便利商店幾乎從未提高兼職員工的時薪。

definition_zh: (名) 房子；住宅　(動) 提供住所；容納
example_sentence: The house that my family bought last year is located near the MRT station.
sentence_zh: 我家人去年買的房子位於捷運站附近。

definition_zh: (名) 家戶；住戶　(形) 家庭的；家用的
example_sentence: Many families buy energy-efficient appliances to reduce household electricity costs.
sentence_zh: 許多家庭購買節能電器以降低家庭用電費用。

definition_zh: (名) 管家；傭人　(名) 家務管理員
example_sentence: The housekeeper cleans every room and prepares meals for the family.
sentence_zh: 那位管家打掃每個房間並為家人準備餐點。

definition_zh: (名) 家庭主婦；主婦
example_sentence: Many housewives manage their families and household tasks every day.
sentence_zh: 許多家庭主婦每天管理她們的家庭和家務。

definition_zh: (名) 家務；家事　(名) 家庭作業；功課
example_sentence: Before going to the movies, Maria finished her housework so her parents could relax.
sentence_zh: 在去電影院之前，瑪麗亞先做完家務，這樣她的父母就可以放鬆。

definition_zh: (名) 住房；住宅　(名) 住房供應；房屋建設
example_sentence: Rising housing prices affecting young families, many students delay their plans to buy homes.
sentence_zh: 飆升的房價影響年輕家庭，許多學生延遲購屋計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 破陋的小屋；簡陋的住所
example_sentence: The homeless family lived in a hovel that had no running water.
sentence_zh: 那個無家可歸的家庭住在沒有自來水的破陋小屋裡。

definition_zh: (動) 懸停；盤旋　(動) 徘徊；不決定
example_sentence: If the drone hovers above the building, the surveyor would collect detailed aerial images.
sentence_zh: 如果無人機在建築物上方懸停，測量師就能收集詳細的空中影像。

definition_zh: (副) 怎樣；如何　(代) 什麼方式；在什麼程度上
example_sentence: How do you usually study English vocabulary before the CSAT exam?
sentence_zh: 在學測考試前，你通常怎樣背英文單字？

definition_zh: (連) 然而；但是　(副) 無論如何；不管怎樣
example_sentence: The exam is difficult; however, studying hard every day helps students succeed.
sentence_zh: 考試很難；然而，每天用功唸書有助於學生成功。

definition_zh: (動) 嚎叫；號叫　(名) 嚎叫聲；哭喊聲
example_sentence: The wind howled loudly through the mountains, and the dogs howled in response.
sentence_zh: 風吹過山谷發出嚎叫聲，狗隻也隨之號叫起來。

definition_zh: (名) 中心；樞紐　(名) 輪轂；輪盤中心
example_sentence: Because Shanghai serves as a major financial hub in Asia, many international companies establish their headquarters there.
sentence_zh: 因為上海是亞洲的主要金融中心，許多國際公司在那裡設立總部。

definition_zh: (名) 傲慢；自大；過度自信
example_sentence: Having won three championships in a row, the team's hubris led to their unexpected defeat.
sentence_zh: 連贏三次冠軍後，該隊的傲慢導致他們意外落敗。

definition_zh: (動) 聚集；擠在一起　(名) 緊急會議；密集討論
example_sentence: The team huddles in a circle that protects them from the cold wind.
sentence_zh: 在保護他們免受冷風侵襲的圓圈中，隊伍緊密聚集在一起。

definition_zh: (名) 色調；色彩　(名) 色度；色澤
example_sentence: The warm hue of sunset painted the sky in shades of orange and red.
sentence_zh: 夕陽溫暖的色調將天空染成橙色和紅色。

definition_zh: (動) 擁抱；緊抱　(名) 擁抱；抱
example_sentence: If tired students could hug their parents after exams, stress would disappear completely.
sentence_zh: 如果疲倦的學生考試後能擁抱父母，壓力就會完全消失。

definition_zh: (形) 巨大的；龐大的　(形) 極大的；非常的
example_sentence: The huge stadium can hold over fifty thousand people comfortably.
sentence_zh: 那座巨大的體育館可以舒適地容納五萬多人。

definition_zh: (副) 巨大地；非常地　極其；大幅度地
example_sentence: Winning the national debate competition, the team became hugely popular among students.
sentence_zh: 贏得全國辯論賽，該隊在學生中變得非常受歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 船殼；外殼　(動) 去除外殼；剝去
example_sentence: After the ship's hull was damaged by rocks, the crew had to abandon the vessel quickly.
sentence_zh: 在船殻被岩石損壞後，船員必須迅速棄船。

definition_zh: (動) 哼唱；發出嗯聲　(名) 嗡嗡聲；低鳴聲
example_sentence: Hardly had the concert begun when the audience hummed the familiar melody together.
sentence_zh: 音樂會才剛開始，觀眾就幾乎立刻一起哼唱那首熟悉的旋律。

definition_zh: (名) 人類；人們
example_sentence: Human beings who care about the environment often recycle their plastic waste responsibly.
sentence_zh: 關心環境的人類通常會負責任地回收他們的塑膠廢物。

definition_zh: (名) 人肉搜索；網路肉搜
example_sentence: Online activists organized a human flesh search to identify the person responsible for the animal abuse incident.
sentence_zh: 網路活動人士組織人肉搜索，目的是找出對動物虐待事件負責的人。

definition_zh: (名) 人；人類　(形) 人的；人類的
example_sentence: Every human being deserves respect and equal treatment in society.
sentence_zh: 每個人都應該在社會中獲得尊重和平等對待。

definition_zh: (形) 人道的；仁慈的　(形) 富有同情心的；溫和的
example_sentence: The organization's humane treatment of animals earned widespread public support.
sentence_zh: 這個組織對動物的人道對待獲得了廣泛的公眾支持。

definition_zh: (副) 人道地；仁慈地　以人道的方式
example_sentence: The animal shelter treats all rescued dogs humanely, ensuring they receive proper care and affection.
sentence_zh: 動物收容所人道地對待所有被救的狗，確保牠們得到適當的照顧和關愛。

definition_zh: (形) 人道主義的；人文的　(名) 人道主義者；慈善家
example_sentence: Focusing on humanitarian aid, the organization helped earthquake survivors rebuild their homes.
sentence_zh: 專注於人道援助，該組織幫助地震災民重建家園。

definition_zh: (名) 人性；人類　(名) 人道；人文精神
example_sentence: The doctor showed great humanity toward patients who were suffering from severe illness.
sentence_zh: 那位醫生對患有重病的患者展現了偉大的人道精神。

definition_zh: (動) 使人性化；使更有人情味
example_sentence: If doctors humanize their communication with patients, medical treatment will become more effective.
sentence_zh: 如果醫生使他們與病人的溝通更人性化，醫療效果將會更好。

definition_zh: (名) 人類；人種
example_sentence: Humankind must work together to protect our planet for future generations.
sentence_zh: 人類必須攜手合作，為子孫後代保護我們的地球。

definition_zh: (形) 謙虛的；謙遜的　(動) 使謙卑；貶低
example_sentence: Winning the competition motivated Maria to humble herself and help younger students improve their English skills.
sentence_zh: 贏得比賽激勵瑪莉亞謙虛自己，幫助年輕學生改進英文技能。

definition_zh: (形) 潮濕的；濕度高的　(形) 悶熱的；濕悶的
example_sentence: The humid summer air makes studying in the classroom feel uncomfortable and sticky.
sentence_zh: 潮濕的夏日空氣使得在教室裡讀書感到不舒服且黏膩。

definition_zh: (名) 濕度；潮溼；濕氣
example_sentence: As humidity increases during summer, students find it harder to concentrate in classroom.
sentence_zh: 當夏季濕度上升時，學生發現在教室裡更難集中注意力。

definition_zh: (動) 使蒙羞；羞辱　(動) 貶低；使感到羞愧
example_sentence: Having been humiliated by the coach's harsh criticism in front of teammates, the player worked harder to prove himself.
sentence_zh: 在隊友面前被教練的尖刻批評所羞辱後，這名選手更加努力去證明自己。

definition_zh: (名) 羞辱；恥辱　(動) 使蒙羞；貶低
example_sentence: The student who received public humiliation during the class presentation felt deeply ashamed.
sentence_zh: 在課堂報告中受到公開羞辱的學生感到極為羞愧。

definition_zh: (名) 謙虛；謙卑　(名) 謙遜的態度
example_sentence: Winning the competition with humility and gratitude made the champion deeply respected.
sentence_zh: 以謙虛和感激之心贏得比賽的冠軍獲得了深深的敬重。

definition_zh: (形) 巨大的；龐大的　(形) 非常大的；極其龐大的
example_sentence: If the humongous shopping mall were built downtown, traffic congestion would become unbearable for residents.
sentence_zh: 如果那座龐大的購物中心在市中心建成，交通擁堵對居民來說將變得無法忍受。

definition_zh: (名) 幽默；幽默感　(動) 迎合；配合
example_sentence: The teacher's humor made the chemistry class enjoyable and helped students learn better.
sentence_zh: 老師的幽默感使化學課變得有趣，並幫助學生學習得更好。

definition_zh: (形) 幽默的；滑稽的　(形) 有趣的；令人發笑的
example_sentence: Making clever jokes, the comedian entertained the audience with humorous stories.
sentence_zh: 喜劇演員透過講述幽默故事，用巧妙的笑話娛樂觀眾。

definition_zh: (副) 幽默地；以滑稽的方式
example_sentence: Although the teacher explained the grammar rule humorously, many students still found it confusing.
sentence_zh: 儘管老師以幽默的方式解釋文法規則，但許多學生仍然感到困惑。

definition_zh: (名) 直覺；預感　(動) 憑直覺猜測；有預感
example_sentence: Seldom does a detective rely on mere hunch when solving complex criminal cases.
sentence_zh: 偵探在破解複雜刑事案件時，很少僅憑直覺來判斷。

definition_zh: (名) 百；百個　(數) 百的；一百個的
example_sentence: The school held a ceremony for the hundred students who passed the entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 這所學校為通過入學考試的一百名學生舉辦了典禮。

definition_zh: (名) 飢餓；飢荒　(動) 渴望；想要
example_sentence: Many developing nations struggle to provide enough food to reduce hunger and improve living standards.
sentence_zh: 許多開發中國家努力提供足夠的食物以減少飢荒並改善生活水準。

definition_zh: (形) 飢餓的；肚子餓的　(形) 渴望的；渴求的
example_sentence: After finishing morning exercise, the hungry students rushed into the school cafeteria for lunch.
sentence_zh: 做完早操後，飢餓的學生們衝進學校餐廳吃午餐。

definition_zh: (動) 獵捕；狩獵　(名) 狩獵；搜尋
example_sentence: Hunters hunt deer in the forest every autumn season.
sentence_zh: 獵人每年秋季在森林裡獵捕鹿。

definition_zh: (名) 獵人；狩獵者　(名) 追求者；尋求者
example_sentence: As the hunter tracked the deer through the forest, morning mist gradually lifted from the valley.
sentence_zh: 當獵人在森林中追蹤鹿隻時，晨霧逐漸從山谷中散去。

definition_zh: (名) 跨欄；障礙　(動) 跨越；克服
example_sentence: Having hurdles to overcome during exam preparation, many students develop stronger problem-solving skills.
sentence_zh: 在準備考試期間克服障礙，許多學生培養了更強的解題能力。

definition_zh: (動) 用力投擲；猛扔　(動) 怒罵；謾罵
example_sentence: The angry fan hurled insults at the referee who made a terrible call.
sentence_zh: 那位憤怒的球迷對做出糟糕判決的裁判怒罵不止。

definition_zh: (名) 颶風；強烈風暴
example_sentence: If a hurricane approaches the coast, residents must evacuate their homes immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果颶風逼近海岸，居民必須立即撤離家園。

definition_zh: (動) 匆忙；急速　(名) 匆忙；急促
example_sentence: We must hurry to catch the morning bus to school.
sentence_zh: 我們必須匆忙趕上早上到學校的公車。

definition_zh: (動) 傷害；使疼痛　(形) 受傷的；疼痛的
example_sentence: Students study hard to avoid hurting their chances of getting into college.
sentence_zh: 學生努力讀書以避免傷害他們進入大學的機會。

definition_zh: (形) 令人傷心的；傷人的　(形) 造成傷害的；令人不快的
example_sentence: Making hurtful comments about someone's appearance can damage their self-confidence.
sentence_zh: 對某人的外表做出傷人的評論會損害他們的自信心。

definition_zh: (名) 丈夫；老公
example_sentence: Although her husband works abroad, they video call every evening after dinner.
sentence_zh: 雖然她的丈夫在國外工作，但他們每晚吃完飯後都會視訊通話。

definition_zh: (動) 嘘聲；使安靜　(名) 寂靜；沉默
example_sentence: Hushed by the teacher's stern look, the noisy students finally settled down quietly.
sentence_zh: 被老師嚴厲的目光制止住，那些吵鬧的學生終於安靜地坐下了。

definition_zh: (名) 外殼；穀殼　(動) 去殼；剝去外皮
example_sentence: The corn husk, which farmers removed before cooking, was dried and used for animal bedding.
sentence_zh: 農民在烹飪前去掉的玉米殼被曬乾後用作動物墊料。

definition_zh: (名) 忙碌；熙攘　(動) 忙碌地活動；熙攘
example_sentence: The hustle and bustle of Taipei's night markets attracts thousands of visitors every weekend.
sentence_zh: 台北夜市的熙攘忙碌每個週末都吸引數千名遊客。

definition_zh: (動) 努力工作；奮力爭取　(名) 忙碌的活動；辛苦工作
example_sentence: If ambitious students didn't hustle during high school, they would regret missing opportunities for top universities.
sentence_zh: 如果上進的學生在高中時沒有努力奮鬥，他們會後悔錯失進入頂尖大學的機會。

definition_zh: (名) 小屋；茅舍　(名) 簡陋的房子
example_sentence: The mountain climbers built a small hut to shelter from the cold wind.
sentence_zh: 登山者建造了一間小屋來躲避寒風。

definition_zh: (名) 混合物；混種動物　(形) 混合的；雜交的
example_sentence: Combining traditional and digital methods, hybrid learning approaches help students adapt to modern education.
sentence_zh: 結合傳統與數位方法，混合學習方式幫助學生適應現代教育。

definition_zh: (名) 繡球花；八仙花
example_sentence: Since the hydrangea blooms in summer, many students visit botanical gardens when the flowers are in full display.
sentence_zh: 因為繡球花在夏天盛開，許多學生在花朵盛放時會去植物園參觀。

definition_zh: (名) 消防栓；滅火栓
example_sentence: Only after the fire broke out did firefighters locate the nearest hydrant quickly.
sentence_zh: 只有在火災爆發之後，消防隊員才迅速找到最近的消防栓。

definition_zh: (動) 補充水分；保持水分　(名) 水合物；含水化合物
example_sentence: Athletes who hydrate properly before competition perform better than those who neglect this habit.
sentence_zh: 在比賽前適當補充水分的運動員表現比忽視這個習慣的運動員更好。

definition_zh: (名) 水合作用；補充水分
example_sentence: Athletes drink water to maintain proper hydration during intense exercise.
sentence_zh: 運動員在劇烈運動期間喝水以維持適當的補充水分。

definition_zh: (名) 氫；氫氣
example_sentence: Hydrogen gas mixed with oxygen produces water through chemical reaction.
sentence_zh: 氫氣與氧氣透過化學反應結合產生水。

definition_zh: (名) 恐水症；對水的極度恐懼
example_sentence: People with hydrophobia often avoid swimming and taking showers.
sentence_zh: 患有恐水症的人通常避免游泳和洗澡。

definition_zh: (形) 疏水的；防水的　(形) 害怕水的；恐水的
example_sentence: Because the fabric is hydrophobic, water beads up and rolls off without soaking in.
sentence_zh: 因為這種布料是疏水的，水會形成水珠並滑落而不會滲入。

definition_zh: (名) 鬣狗；非洲野生動物
example_sentence: Laughing loudly at their prey, the hyenas circled around the weakened zebra.
sentence_zh: 發出刺耳笑聲攻擊獵物，鬣狗群繞著虛弱的斑馬轉圈。

definition_zh: (名) 衛生；衛生習慣　(形) 衛生的；清潔的
example_sentence: Students who maintain good hygiene habits are less likely to catch colds during flu season.
sentence_zh: 在流感季節，保持良好衛生習慣的學生較不容易感冒。

definition_zh: (形) 衛生的；清潔的　(形) 健康的；符合衛生標準的
example_sentence: If restaurant kitchens maintain hygienic conditions, customers will feel safe eating there.
sentence_zh: 如果餐廳廚房維持衛生的環境，顧客就會放心在那裡用餐。

definition_zh: (名) 讚美詩；聖歌
example_sentence: The church choir sang a beautiful hymn during the Sunday service.
sentence_zh: 教堂唱詩班在週日禮拜中唱了一首優美的讚美詩。

definition_zh: (形) 過度興奮的；興奮過度的　(副) 過度地；非常地
example_sentence: Students drink energy drinks to stay hyper during late-night study sessions before the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 學生喝能量飲料來在學測考前的深夜讀書時保持興奮狀態。

definition_zh: (形) 過動的；多動的　(形) 興奮過度的；活躍過度的
example_sentence: The hyperactive child found it difficult to sit still during class.
sentence_zh: 那個過動的孩子在課堂上很難坐著不動。

definition_zh: (名) 大型超級市場；超大賣場
example_sentence: While shopping at the hypermarket, customers can find affordable groceries and household items.
sentence_zh: 當顧客在超大賣場購物時，可以找到平價的食品雜貨和日用品。

definition_zh: (名) 菌絲；真菌的細絲狀結構
example_sentence: Having grown through the soil, the fungal hyphae formed a vast underground network.
sentence_zh: 真菌菌絲在土壤中生長後，形成了龐大的地下網絡。

definition_zh: (名) 菌絲；真菌絲狀體
example_sentence: Fungi spread through soil using hyphae, which are thin filaments that absorb nutrients.
sentence_zh: 真菌藉由菌絲在土壤中擴散，而菌絲是吸收養分的細長絲狀結構。

definition_zh: (形) 菌絲的；與菌絲有關的
example_sentence: Fungal infections spread through hyphal networks growing beneath the skin's surface.
sentence_zh: 真菌感染通過在皮膚表面下方生長的菌絲網絡傳播。

definition_zh: (動) 用連字符連接；用連字符分開
example_sentence: If writers hyphenated compound adjectives correctly, their writing would appear more professional and easier to read.
sentence_zh: 如果作者正確地用連字符連接複合形容詞，他們的寫作會顯得更專業、更容易閱讀。

definition_zh: (形) 催眠的；迷人的　(形) 令人昏昏欲睡的
example_sentence: The hypnotic music and soft lighting made customers feel relaxed and comfortable.
sentence_zh: 催眠般的音樂和柔和的燈光讓顧客感到放鬆舒適。

definition_zh: (名) 偽善；虛偽　(名) 虛假的言行；虛偽的態度
example_sentence: Criticizing others while hiding personal faults, hypocrisy undermines trust in relationships.
sentence_zh: 批評他人卻隱瞞個人缺點，虛偽削弱了人際關係中的信任。

definition_zh: (名) 偽君子；虛偽的人　(形) 虛偽的；假善的
example_sentence: Although Mark claims to support environmental protection, his wasteful lifestyle reveals he is a hypocrite.
sentence_zh: 雖然馬克聲稱支持環保，但他揮霍浪費的生活方式揭露他是個偽君子。

definition_zh: (名) 下視丘；腦部控制激素和體溫的區域
example_sentence: Only after the hypothalamus receives signals from the body does temperature regulation begin automatically.
sentence_zh: 只有在下視丘接收到身體信號後，體溫調節才會自動開始。

definition_zh: (名) 低體溫症；體溫過低
example_sentence: Mountaineers who suffer from hypothermia, which reduces body heat dangerously, must seek warmth immediately.
sentence_zh: 患低體溫症的登山者，其體溫會危險地下降，必須立即尋求溫暖。

definition_zh: (名) 假說；假設　(名) 推測；猜想
example_sentence: Scientists form a hypothesis to better understand natural phenomena.
sentence_zh: 科學家提出假說以更好地理解自然現象。

definition_zh: (動) 假設；提出假說　推測；猜想
example_sentence: Scientists hypothesize that climate change affects ocean temperatures significantly.
sentence_zh: 科學家假設氣候變遷會顯著影響海洋溫度。

definition_zh: (形) 假設的；假想的　(形) 理論上的；假定的
example_sentence: A hypothetical scenario helps students understand how to handle emergencies effectively.
sentence_zh: 一個假想的情景幫助學生理解如何有效處理緊急情況。

definition_zh: (形) 歇斯底里的；瘋狂的　(副) 歇斯底里地；瘋狂地
example_sentence: When the fire alarm went off, some students ran out hysterical, screaming and pushing each other.
sentence_zh: 當火警警報響起時，一些學生歇斯底里地跑出去，尖叫並互相推擠。

definition_zh: (名) 冰山；冰塊　(名) 隱藏的危險
example_sentence: Floating in the Arctic Ocean, the iceberg threatened nearby ships.
sentence_zh: 漂浮在北冰洋的冰山威脅了附近的船隻。

definition_zh: (名) 冰柱；冰錐
example_sentence: The icicles that hang from the roof during winter are beautiful but dangerous.
sentence_zh: 冬天時掛在屋頂上的冰柱很漂亮但很危險。

definition_zh: (名) 糖衣；糖霜　(動) 撒糖衣；結冰
example_sentence: If the baker adds icing to the cake, the dessert will taste much sweeter.
sentence_zh: 如果烘焙師在蛋糕上撒糖衣，這個甜點會嚐起來甜得多。

definition_zh: (名) 圖標；icon　(名) 偶像；代表人物
example_sentence: The app icon on the home screen makes it easy to find and open the application quickly.
sentence_zh: 主螢幕上的應用程式圖標使得快速尋找和開啟該應用程式變得容易。

definition_zh: (形) 象徵性的；代表性的　(形) 著名的；具有代表性的
example_sentence: The Statue of Liberty stands in New York to represent freedom and hope to the world.
sentence_zh: 自由女神像聳立在紐約，以代表世界的自由和希望。

definition_zh: (形) 冰冷的；覆蓋冰的　(形) 冷漠的；不友善的
example_sentence: The icy road conditions made driving dangerous after the winter storm.
sentence_zh: 冬季風暴後，冰冷的路面狀況使得開車變得危險。

definition_zh: (名) 想法；主意　(名) 概念；觀念
example_sentence: As soon as a good idea comes to mind, write it down before forgetting it.
sentence_zh: 當好的想法出現在腦海中時，在忘記前把它寫下來。

definition_zh: (形) 理想的；完美的　(名) 理想；標準
example_sentence: Having completed extensive research, the team identified the ideal solution for the environmental problem.
sentence_zh: 完成了廣泛的研究後，團隊找到了解決環境問題的理想方案。

definition_zh: (名) 理想主義；追求完美的信念
example_sentence: The teacher's idealism, which inspired many students to pursue their dreams, shaped their future careers.
sentence_zh: 那位老師的理想主義激勵了許多學生追求夢想，塑造了他們的未來職業。

definition_zh: (副) 理想地；最好的情況下　(副) 按理想狀態；完美地
example_sentence: Ideally, students should study consistently every day rather than cramming before exams.
sentence_zh: 理想情況下，學生應該每天持續唸書，而不是在考試前才臨時抱佛腳。

definition_zh: (動) 構思；想像　(動) 產生想法；創意發想
example_sentence: If the design team ideated together more often, better solutions would emerge from collaboration.
sentence_zh: 如果設計團隊更常一起進行創意發想，更好的方案就會從合作中產生。

definition_zh: (形) 完全相同的；一模一样的　(形) 同一的；同一个的
example_sentence: The twins wore identical uniforms to school every day.
sentence_zh: 这对双胞胎每天穿着一模一样的制服上学。

definition_zh: (名) 身份證明；辨認　(名) 確認；認同
example_sentence: Providing valid identification when entering the building, students must show their school IDs.
sentence_zh: 進入校舍時提供有效身份證明，學生必須出示學生證。

definition_zh: (名) 識別符號；標識物　(名) 識別者；鑑定者
example_sentence: Since the username serves as an identifier, students must remember it for login.
sentence_zh: 由於使用者名稱作為識別符號，學生必須記住它才能登入。

definition_zh: (動) 認同；贊同　(動) 與...產生共鳴
example_sentence: Seldom does a teenager identify with parents' old-fashioned ideas about success.
sentence_zh: 很少有青少年認同父母對成功的老派想法。

definition_zh: (動) 識別；辨認　(動) 確認；指出
example_sentence: Students who identify the main idea can answer the reading comprehension questions easily.
sentence_zh: 能夠識別主要觀點的學生可以輕鬆回答閱讀理解題。

definition_zh: (名) 身份；認同　(名) 特徵；特性
example_sentence: Students need to verify their identity to access the school's online learning platform.
sentence_zh: 學生需要驗證身份才能進入學校的線上學習平臺。

definition_zh: (形) 意識形態的；思想體系的　(形) 理論性的；原則性的
example_sentence: Political parties often promote ideological beliefs through education and media campaigns.
sentence_zh: 政黨經常透過教育和媒體宣傳活動來推廣意識形態信念。

definition_zh: (名) 意識形態；思想體系　(名) 一套信念或原則
example_sentence: Different political ideologies shape how people view government policy.
sentence_zh: 不同的政治意識形態影響人們如何看待政府政策。

definition_zh: (名) 習語；成語　(名) 慣用語；片語
example_sentence: Since English idioms often confuse non-native speakers, learning them requires patience and practice.
sentence_zh: 因為英文習語經常使非英語使用者困惑，所以學習它們需要耐心和練習。

definition_zh: (名) 白痴；傻瓜　(形) 愚蠢的；傻的
example_sentence: Failing the test repeatedly, the idiot student finally asked the teacher for help.
sentence_zh: 那個考試一再不及格的白痴學生，終於向老師求助了。

definition_zh: (形) 閒散的；懶惰的　(動) 閒置；虛度
example_sentence: Students who idle away their time before exams will regret their lack of preparation.
sentence_zh: 在考試前虛度光陰的學生會為準備不足而後悔。

definition_zh: (名) 偶像；崇拜的對象　(名) 偶像；明星
example_sentence: If K-pop idols practice harder every day, their performances will become even more impressive.
sentence_zh: 如果K-pop偶像每天練習更努力，他們的表演將變得更令人印象深刻。

definition_zh: (動) 崇拜；把...視為偶像　(動) 極度讚美；景仰
example_sentence: Many teenagers idolize famous singers and follow their careers closely.
sentence_zh: 許多青少年崇拜著名歌手，並密切關注他們的事業發展。

definition_zh: (形) 田園詩般的；理想的　(形) 寧靜美好的；和平的
example_sentence: Young couples travel to the countryside to find an idyllic place to build their dream home.
sentence_zh: 年輕夫婦前往鄉村尋找一個理想的地方來建造他們的夢想家園。

definition_zh: (片) 要是就好了；只要；但願
example_sentence: If only I had studied harder, passing the CSAT would have been easier.
sentence_zh: 要是我當初讀書更用功就好了，通過學測會容易得多。

definition_zh: (連) 如果；若是　(名) 條件；如果
example_sentence: If you study hard every day, you will pass the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 如果你每天努力讀書，你就會通過學測考試。

definition_zh: (名) 冰屋；因紐特人的冰雪小屋
example_sentence: Built from compacted snow, the igloo provided shelter for the Arctic explorers during their expedition.
sentence_zh: 用壓實的雪塊建造的冰屋為北極探險隊提供了遠征期間的庇護所。

definition_zh: (動) 點燃；引發　(名) 點火裝置
example_sentence: The speech that ignited passion among young voters changed the election outcome.
sentence_zh: 引發年輕選民熱情的演講改變了選舉結果。

definition_zh: (名) 點火；發動　(名) 引燃；著火
example_sentence: The car's ignition system requires regular maintenance to ensure reliable starting performance.
sentence_zh: 汽車的點火系統需要定期維護，以確保可靠的啟動性能。

definition_zh: (名) 無知；缺乏知識　(名) 不了解；不認識
example_sentence: If ignorance of traffic rules were not so common, road accidents would decrease significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果對交通規則的無知不那麼普遍，道路事故就會大幅減少。

definition_zh: (形) 無知的；缺乏知識的　(形) 不了解的；沒有意識到的
example_sentence: Remaining ignorant about climate change will only harm our planet's future.
sentence_zh: 對氣候變遷一無所知只會傷害我們星球的未來。

definition_zh: (動) 忽視；不理睬　(動) 漠視；置之不理
example_sentence: Ignoring the teacher's warning, many students failed the chemistry exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生忽視老師的警告，結果化學考試不及格。

definition_zh: (名) 鬣蜥；綠鬣蜥
example_sentence: Although iguanas live in tropical rainforests, some people keep them as exotic pets at home.
sentence_zh: 雖然鬣蜥生活在熱帶雨林中，但有些人在家飼養牠們作為異域寵物。

definition_zh: (形) 脾氣不好的；易怒的
example_sentence: Seldom does an ill-tempered boss create a happy and productive workplace for employees.
sentence_zh: 脾氣不好的老闆很少能為員工創造快樂和高效的工作環境。

definition_zh: (形) 生病的；患病的　(形) 不好的；有害的
example_sentence: Students who feel ill should report to the school nurse immediately.
sentence_zh: 感到生病的學生應該立即向校護報告。

definition_zh: (形) 非法的；違法的
example_sentence: Downloading movies without paying is illegal to protect copyright holders' rights.
sentence_zh: 不付費下載電影是違法的，目的是保護著作權人的權利。

definition_zh: (副) 非法地；違法地
example_sentence: Downloading copyrighted movies without permission and distributing them illegally online can result in serious legal consequences.
sentence_zh: 未經許可下載受著作權保護的電影並在網路上非法傳播可能導致嚴重的法律後果。

definition_zh: (名) 難以辨讀；字跡不清
example_sentence: The illegibility of the handwritten note made it impossible for everyone to understand the message.
sentence_zh: 那份手寫便條的難以辨讀使得每個人都無法理解其中的訊息。

definition_zh: (形) 難以辨認的；字跡模糊的
example_sentence: Because the teacher's handwriting was illegible, students struggled to copy the notes from the blackboard.
sentence_zh: 因為老師的字跡難以辨認，學生很難從黑板抄筆記。

definition_zh: (副) 難以辨認地；字跡模糊地
example_sentence: Scribbling illegibly on the exam paper, the student realized too late that the grader could not read the answers.
sentence_zh: 在考卷上潦草地寫字，學生太晚才明白閱卷老師看不懂答案。

definition_zh: (形) 非法的；違法的　(形) 暗地的；秘密的
example_sentence: The police discovered illicit drugs that the suspect had hidden in the warehouse.
sentence_zh: 警察發現了嫌疑人藏在倉庫裡的非法毒品。

definition_zh: (形) 文盲的；不識字的　(名) 文盲；不識字的人
example_sentence: If a student remains illiterate after years of schooling, the teacher should provide additional support.
sentence_zh: 如果一個學生在多年的教育後仍然是文盲，老師應該提供額外的幫助。

definition_zh: (名) 疾病；病症　(名) 不健康；身體不適
example_sentence: Missing school due to illness is common among high school students.
sentence_zh: 因為疾病而缺課在高中生中很普遍。

definition_zh: (動) 照亮；點亮　(動) 闡明；說明
example_sentence: The city installed bright streetlights to illuminate the dark streets at night.
sentence_zh: 城市安裝明亮的路燈以便在夜間照亮昏暗的街道。

definition_zh: (名) 照明；光照　(名) 啟蒙；開悟
example_sentence: The bright illumination in the library helps students focus on reading and studying effectively.
sentence_zh: 圖書館明亮的照明幫助學生有效地專注於閱讀和學習。

definition_zh: (名) 照明器；發光體　(名) 闡明者；解釋者
example_sentence: Because the illuminator brightened the dark museum hall, visitors could see ancient artifacts clearly.
sentence_zh: 因為照明器照亮了黑暗的博物館大廳，訪客能夠清楚地看到古代文物。

definition_zh: (名) 幻覺；幻想　(動) 迷惑；欺騙
example_sentence: Fooled by the magician's trick, the audience believed the illusion was real magic.
sentence_zh: 被魔術師的把戲所愚弄，觀眾相信這個幻覺是真正的魔法。

definition_zh: (動) 說明；闡述　(動) 繪製；配圖
example_sentence: The textbook, which illustrates key concepts through colorful diagrams, helps students understand biology effectively.
sentence_zh: 這本教科書透過彩色圖表說明重要概念，幫助學生有效理解生物學。

definition_zh: (名) 插圖；圖解　(名) 說明；舉例
example_sentence: The science textbook includes detailed illustrations showing how plants grow from seeds.
sentence_zh: 這本科學課本包含詳細的插圖，說明植物如何從種子生長。

definition_zh: (形) 說明性的；舉例的　(形) 用來解釋或說明的
example_sentence: If the teacher provided more illustrative examples, students would understand the grammar concept much more easily.
sentence_zh: 如果老師提供更多說明性的例子，學生就會更容易理解這個文法概念。

definition_zh: (名) 插畫家；圖解者
example_sentence: The illustrator drew beautiful pictures for the children's book.
sentence_zh: 那位插畫家為兒童書籍繪製了精美的圖片。

definition_zh: (形) 著名的；傑出的　(形) 光榮的；崇高的
example_sentence: Having earned countless awards, the illustrious scientist inspired generations of researchers.
sentence_zh: 獲得無數獎項後，這位著名科學家激勵了幾代研究人員。

definition_zh: (副) 光榮地；赫赫有名地
example_sentence: The scientist illustrated discoveries so illustriously that universities worldwide recognized achievements.
sentence_zh: 這位科學家以如此光榮的方式展示發現，以至於世界各地的大學都認可其成就。

definition_zh: (名) 形象；影像　(動) 想像；描繪
example_sentence: Only by improving public image can the company regain customer trust.
sentence_zh: 只有改善公眾形象，該公司才能重新獲得顧客信任。

definition_zh: (名) 意象；想像　(名) 影像；圖像
example_sentence: The poet's imagery, which painted vivid pictures of nature, deeply moved the readers.
sentence_zh: 詩人的意象，描繪出大自然的生動圖像，深深打動了讀者。

definition_zh: (形) 可想像的；想得到的
example_sentence: Scientists use computers to model every imaginable scenario to predict climate change.
sentence_zh: 科學家使用電腦來模擬每個可以想像的情境，以預測氣候變化。

definition_zh: (形) 虛構的；想像的　(形) 不真實的；幻想的
example_sentence: The imaginary friend living in the boy's mind helped him feel less lonely.
sentence_zh: 住在這個男孩腦海中的虛構朋友幫助他感到不那麼孤單。

definition_zh: (名) 想像力；想像　(名) 創意；創造力
example_sentence: Reading fantasy novels helps develop children's imagination and creative thinking abilities.
sentence_zh: 閱讀奇幻小說有助於培養孩童的想像力和創意思考能力。

definition_zh: (形) 富有想像力的；創意十足的　(形) 虛構的；假想的
example_sentence: Although the story is imaginative, it teaches readers valuable lessons about courage and friendship.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個故事是虛構的，但它教導讀者有關勇氣和友誼的寶貴課題。

definition_zh: (動) 想像；猜想　(動) 假設；推測
example_sentence: Imagining a future career, many students attended the university open day.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在想像未來職業的同時，參加了大學開放日。

definition_zh: (名) 影像；成像　(動) 成像；想像
example_sentence: The imaging technology that hospitals use helps doctors diagnose diseases more accurately.
sentence_zh: 醫院使用的成像技術幫助醫生更準確地診斷疾病。

definition_zh: (名) 失衡；不平衡　(動) 使失衡；破壞平衡
example_sentence: If poor diet and lack of exercise continue, a serious health imbalance will develop.
sentence_zh: 如果飲食不良和缺乏運動繼續下去，嚴重的健康失衡就會發生。

definition_zh: (形) 不平衡的；失衡的　(形) 不對稱的；不均衡的
example_sentence: An imbalanced diet lacking vegetables can harm your health significantly.
sentence_zh: 缺乏蔬菜的不均衡飲食會對你的健康造成重大傷害。

definition_zh: (動) 灌輸；使充滿　注入；浸透
example_sentence: Teachers use storytelling to imbue students with confidence and moral values.
sentence_zh: 老師用說故事的方式來灌輸學生信心和道德價值觀。

definition_zh: (動) 模仿；仿造　(動) 假裝；模仿他人
example_sentence: Young children often imitate their parents' behavior and speech patterns.
sentence_zh: 年幼的孩子經常模仿父母的行為和說話方式。

definition_zh: (名) 模仿；仿造　(名) 仿製品；冒牌貨
example_sentence: As the designer created cheaper imitation products, many customers bought them without realizing the quality difference.
sentence_zh: 當設計師製造便宜的仿製品時，許多顧客在沒有意識到品質差異的情況下購買了它們。

definition_zh: (形) 完美無瑕的；潔淨的
example_sentence: Having cleaned the entire kitchen thoroughly, Maria presented an immaculate workspace to her impressed parents.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞徹底清潔了整個廚房後，向她印象深刻的父母展示了一個完美無瑕的工作空間。

definition_zh: (形) 不成熟的；幼稚的　(形) 未發育完全的；發展不完全的
example_sentence: The teenager's immature behavior, which embarrassed his parents, gradually improved over time.
sentence_zh: 那個青少年的幼稚行為（令他父母感到尷尬）隨著時間逐漸改善了。

definition_zh: (形) 無法測量的；極大的　(形) 極其巨大的；無限的
example_sentence: The immeasurable kindness shown by volunteers during the disaster touched everyone's hearts deeply.
sentence_zh: 災難期間志工展現的無法估量的善良深深觸動了每個人的心。

definition_zh: (副) 無法測量地；極大地　不可估量地；非常地
example_sentence: If students did not study hard, their future prospects would be immeasurably damaged by poor exam results.
sentence_zh: 如果學生不努力讀書，他們的未來前景將會因為考試成績不佳而受到無法估量的傷害。

definition_zh: (形) 立即的；即時的　(副) 立即地；馬上
example_sentence: The doctor needs immediate treatment for the patient's serious injury.
sentence_zh: 醫生需要對患者的重傷進行立即治療。

definition_zh: (副) 立刻；馬上　(副) 直接地；緊接著
example_sentence: Hearing the alarm, students immediately grabbed their belongings and left the classroom.
sentence_zh: 聽到警報聲，學生們立刻拿起他們的物品並離開教室。

definition_zh: (形) 自古以來的；久遠的　(副) 自古以來地；悠久地
example_sentence: Since time immemorial, families have gathered together during the Lunar New Year to celebrate and strengthen their bonds.
sentence_zh: 自古以來，家庭在農曆新年期間聚在一起慶祝並加強彼此的關係。

definition_zh: (形) 極大的；廣闊的　(形) 龐大的；無邊無際的
example_sentence: Seldom has the scientific community witnessed an immense breakthrough in renewable energy technology.
sentence_zh: 科學界很少見證再生能源技術中如此巨大的突破。

definition_zh: (副) 非常地；極其地　(副) 廣闊地；無邊無際地
example_sentence: The historical museum, which impresses visitors immensely with its ancient artifacts, attracts thousands of school groups annually.
sentence_zh: 這座歷史博物館以其古代文物給訪客留下深刻印象，每年吸引數千個學校團體參觀。

definition_zh: (動) 沉浸；浸入　(動) 專注於；沈溺於
example_sentence: Students immerse themselves in English novels to improve reading comprehension skills.
sentence_zh: 學生沉浸在英文小說中以提高閱讀理解能力。

definition_zh: (名) 沉浸；浸入　(名) 完全投入；專注
example_sentence: Total immersion in English-speaking environments helps students develop fluency quickly and naturally.
sentence_zh: 在全英文環境中完全沉浸可以幫助學生快速自然地提高流利度。

definition_zh: (名) 移民；移居者　(形) 移民的；外來的
example_sentence: Many immigrants move to Taiwan to find better job opportunities and build new lives.
sentence_zh: 許多移民搬到台灣尋求更好的工作機會並開創新生活。

definition_zh: (動) 移民；移居到另一個國家
example_sentence: Although many families immigrate to find better jobs, cultural adjustment remains challenging.
sentence_zh: 雖然許多家庭移民以尋求更好的工作機會，但文化適應仍然充滿挑戰。

definition_zh: (名) 移民；移居　(動) 移民的；移居的
example_sentence: Facing immigration policies, many families considered relocating to find better opportunities abroad.
sentence_zh: 面對移民政策，許多家庭考慮搬遷到國外尋求更好的機會。

definition_zh: (形) 即將發生的；迫在眉睫的
example_sentence: With dark clouds gathering overhead, a storm that seemed imminent forced the outdoor concert to be postponed.
sentence_zh: 隨著烏雲聚集在頭頂，看似迫在眉睫的暴風雨迫使戶外音樂會被延期。

definition_zh: (形) 不能動的；靜止的　(形) 無法移動的；固定的
example_sentence: If the injured player remains immobile during the match, the coach will substitute immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果受傷的選手在比賽中保持不動，教練將立即進行替補。

definition_zh: (形) 不道德的；缺乏品德的　(形) 邪惡的；不正當的
example_sentence: Cheating on exams is immoral and violates school rules.
sentence_zh: 考試作弊是不道德的，也違反了校規。

definition_zh: (名) 不道德；缺乏道德
example_sentence: Religious leaders spoke out to condemn immorality and encourage citizens to live ethically.
sentence_zh: 宗教領袖發言譴責不道德行為，並鼓勵民眾過著有道德的生活。

definition_zh: (動) 使不道德；敗壞道德　(動) 詆毀；抹黑
example_sentence: Spreading false rumors about classmates will immoralize their reputation and hurt them deeply.
sentence_zh: 散佈同學的虛假謠言會敗壞他們的名譽，深深傷害他們。

definition_zh: (形) 不朽的；永恆的　(形) 長生不老的；不死的
example_sentence: Although the athlete's career was brief, his immortal records continue inspiring young runners wherever they train.
sentence_zh: 雖然這位運動員的職業生涯很短暫，他不朽的紀錄在年輕選手訓練的任何地方都持續激勵著他們。

definition_zh: (形) 免疫的；不受影響的　(動) 使免除；豁免
example_sentence: Having received the vaccine, the students became immune to the disease spreading through school.
sentence_zh: 接種過疫苗後，學生們對在學校蔓延的疾病產生了免疫力。

definition_zh: (名) 免疫力；豁免權　(動) 使免疫；豁免
example_sentence: The vaccine provides immunity that protects people from serious infectious diseases.
sentence_zh: 疫苗提供了保護人們免受嚴重傳染病侵害的免疫力。

definition_zh: (名) 免疫球蛋白；抗體
example_sentence: Immunoglobulin molecules help the immune system recognize and fight harmful bacteria.
sentence_zh: 免疫球蛋白分子幫助免疫系統識別並對抗有害細菌。

definition_zh: (名) 免疫療法；免疫治療
example_sentence: If cancer patients received immunotherapy earlier, their survival rates would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果癌症患者更早接受免疫療法，他們的存活率會大幅提高。

definition_zh: (名) 影響；衝擊　(動) 影響；衝撞
example_sentence: The new policy will have a significant impact on student learning.
sentence_zh: 這項新政策將對學生學習產生重大影響。

definition_zh: (動) 損害；削弱　(動) 妨礙；減少
example_sentence: Lacking sleep impairs students' ability to concentrate during important exams.
sentence_zh: 缺乏睡眠會削弱學生在重要考試中集中注意力的能力。

definition_zh: (動) 傳授；教授　(動) 傳達；告知
example_sentence: As the mentor imparted valuable experience to the young engineers, their confidence grew significantly.
sentence_zh: 當導師向年輕工程師傳授寶貴經驗時，他們的信心明顯增長。

definition_zh: (形) 公正的；不偏私的　(形) 客觀的；中立的
example_sentence: Seldom does a referee make an impartial decision when personal feelings interfere with judgment.
sentence_zh: 很少有裁判在個人感受干擾判斷時能做出公正的決定。

definition_zh: (名) 公正；公平　不偏不倚
example_sentence: The judge's impartiality, which was recognized by all parties involved, ensured a fair trial.
sentence_zh: 法官的公正態度（被所有相關方認可）確保了審判的公平性。

definition_zh: (副) 公平地；不偏私地
example_sentence: The judge must evaluate both sides impartially to ensure a fair verdict.
sentence_zh: 法官必須公平地評估雙方，以確保判決公正。

definition_zh: (名) 僵局；困境　(名) 死胡同；無法解決的狀況
example_sentence: After months of failed negotiations, the two companies reached an impasse and decided to end their partnership.
sentence_zh: 經過幾個月失敗的協商後，兩家公司陷入僵局，決定結束合作關係。

definition_zh: (動) 使充滿熱情；激發激情
example_sentence: The coach's inspiring speech impassioned the entire team before the championship game.
sentence_zh: 教練鼓舞人心的演講在冠軍賽前激發了整個隊伍的熱情。

definition_zh: (形) 充滿熱情的；激情的　(形) 熱烈的；激動的
example_sentence: Because the coach was impassioned about winning the championship, the team trained harder every day.
sentence_zh: 因為教練對贏得冠軍充滿熱情，球隊每天訓練得更加刻苦。

definition_zh: (形) 急躁的；沒耐心的　(形) 渴望的；急切的
example_sentence: Growing impatient waiting for the exam results, many students checked their phones repeatedly.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在等待考試成績時變得越來越急躁，不斷查看手機。

definition_zh: (動) 彈劾；指控　(動) 質疑；懷疑
example_sentence: The committee impeached the president whose policies many citizens questioned.
sentence_zh: 該委員會彈劾了那位許多公民質疑其政策的總統。

definition_zh: (形) 無懈可擊的；完美的　無瑕疵的；無可指責的
example_sentence: If the restaurant's service were impeccable, customers would definitely return next time.
sentence_zh: 如果餐廳的服務完美無缺，顧客下次一定會再來。

definition_zh: (名) 阻抗；阻力
example_sentence: High impedance in an electrical circuit reduces current flow effectively.
sentence_zh: 電路中的高阻抗能有效地降低電流。

definition_zh: (動) 阻礙；妨礙　(動) 延緩；阻止
example_sentence: Poor internet connection can impede students to complete their online homework effectively.
sentence_zh: 不良的網路連線會阻礙學生有效完成線上功課。

definition_zh: (名) 阻礙者；妨礙物　(動) 阻礙；妨礙
example_sentence: Poor internet connection and lack of study materials are major impediments to learning.
sentence_zh: 網路連線不穩定和缺乏教材是學習的主要阻礙。

definition_zh: (名) 阻礙；妨礙　(名) 言語障礙
example_sentence: Although financial problems presented an impediment, the students pursued their university dreams with determination.
sentence_zh: 雖然財務困難成為阻礙，但學生們仍以決心追求大學夢想。

definition_zh: (動) 驅使；促使　(動) 推動；激勵
example_sentence: Impelled by curiosity, the students eagerly explored the science museum's interactive exhibits.
sentence_zh: 受好奇心驅使，學生們熱切地探索科學博物館的互動展示。

definition_zh: (動) 即將發生；迫在眉睫
example_sentence: The storm that impends will bring heavy rain to the coastal regions tomorrow.
sentence_zh: 即將到來的暴風雨明天將為沿海地區帶來大雨。

definition_zh: (形) 無法穿透的；難以理解的
example_sentence: If the enemy's defense were not impenetrable, the army would have won the battle.
sentence_zh: 如果敵人的防線不是無法穿透的，軍隊就會贏得這場戰役。

definition_zh: (形) 急迫的；必要的　(名) 必要的事；祈使句
example_sentence: Learning English is imperative for students preparing for the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 對於準備學測的學生來說，學習英文是必要的。

definition_zh: (形) 難以察覺的；無法感知的　(形) 極細微的；幾乎看不出的
example_sentence: The temperature changing imperceptibly throughout the day made the climate control system unnecessary.
sentence_zh: 整天氣溫難以察覺地緩慢變化，使得氣候控制系統變得多餘。

definition_zh: (形) 不完美的；有缺陷的　(名) 未完成式
example_sentence: Although the painting was imperfect, the artist's passion shone through every brushstroke clearly.
sentence_zh: 雖然這幅畫不完美，但藝術家的熱情清楚地閃耀在每一筆筆觸中。

definition_zh: (名) 缺點；不完美　(名) 瑕疵；缺陷
example_sentence: Only after recognizing her imperfection did Sarah accept herself and find true confidence.
sentence_zh: 只有在認識到自己的缺點後，莎拉才接納自己並找到真正的自信。

definition_zh: (形) 帝國的；皇帝的　(形) 宏偉的；壯麗的
example_sentence: The imperial palace, which attracts millions of visitors yearly, showcases ancient architectural beauty.
sentence_zh: 那座每年吸引數百萬遊客的帝國宮殿展現了古代建築的優美。

definition_zh: (動) 危害；使處於危險中　(動) 威脅；危及
example_sentence: Reckless driving can imperil the safety of pedestrians on busy streets.
sentence_zh: 魯莽駕駛會危害繁忙街道上行人的安全。

definition_zh: (形) 不滲透的；防水的　不允許通過的；不透氣的
example_sentence: The waterproof jacket is made of impermeable fabric that keeps rain and moisture completely out.
sentence_zh: 這件防水夾克採用不滲透的布料製成，能完全阻擋雨水和濕氣。

definition_zh: (形) 不個人的；冷淡的　(形) 客觀的；沒有個人感情的
example_sentence: The company's impersonal customer service made customers feel frustrated and unvalued.
sentence_zh: 公司那種冷淡的客服態度讓顧客感到沮喪且不受重視。

definition_zh: (形) 不禮貌的；無禮的　(形) 不恰當的；不合適的
example_sentence: Although the question was impertinent, the teacher answered it patiently anyway.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個問題很無禮，老師還是耐心地回答了。

definition_zh: (形) 不滲透的；防水的　(形) 不受影響的；冷漠的
example_sentence: Being impervious to criticism, the athlete continued training without doubt.
sentence_zh: 運動員對批評不受影響，繼續堅定地訓練。

definition_zh: (名) 推動力；促進力　(名) 衝力；動力
example_sentence: The scholarship program, which provided impetus for many students to pursue higher education, changed their lives.
sentence_zh: 這項獎學金計畫提供了許多學生追求高等教育的推動力，改變了他們的人生。

definition_zh: (名) 壓迫；妨礙　(動) 壓迫的；妨礙的
example_sentence: If nerve impingement occurs in the spine, patients will experience severe back pain.
sentence_zh: 如果脊椎神經受到壓迫，患者就會經歷嚴重的背痛。

definition_zh: (名) ['ɪmplænt] 移植物；植入物　(動) [ɪm'plænt] 植入；種植
example_sentence: Doctors implant a small device into patients' hearts to help them beat regularly.
sentence_zh: 醫生將一個小裝置植入患者的心臟，幫助心臟正常跳動。

definition_zh: (形) 難以置信的；不太可能的
example_sentence: The detective dismissed the suspect's alibi as implausible to establish his guilt.
sentence_zh: 偵探駁斥嫌疑人的不在場證明難以置信，以此確立他的罪行。

definition_zh: (副) 難以置信地；不大可能地
example_sentence: The movie's ending was implausibly perfect, making many viewers roll their eyes.
sentence_zh: 這部電影的結局難以置信地完美，讓許多觀眾翻了白眼。

definition_zh: (動) [`Impləˌmɛnt] 實施；執行　(名) [`Impləmənt] 工具；器具
example_sentence: As the government implements the new education policy, schools must adapt their teaching methods accordingly.
sentence_zh: 當政府實施新的教育政策時，學校必須相應地調整教學方法。

definition_zh: (名) 暗示；含義　(名) 牽連；涉及
example_sentence: Having implied that the project would fail, the manager's words carried serious implications for team morale.
sentence_zh: 經理暗示該專案會失敗，他的言論對團隊士氣產生了嚴重的含義。

definition_zh: (形) 隱含的；暗示的　含蓄的；不明說的
example_sentence: The teacher's implicit criticism of the student's work hurt his confidence deeply.
sentence_zh: 老師對學生作業的隱含批評深深傷害了他的信心。

definition_zh: (副) 暗示地；含蓄地　不明言地；隱含地
example_sentence: The teacher's criticism of his work, though stated implicitly rather than directly, made him feel discouraged and embarrassed.
sentence_zh: 老師對他作品的批評雖然是含蓄地而非直接地陳述，但還是讓他感到沮喪和尷尬。

definition_zh: (動) 懇求；哀求　(動) 苦苦請求；乞求
example_sentence: If the student implored the teacher for extra time, the deadline might be extended.
sentence_zh: 如果學生懇求老師延長時間，截止日期可能會被延後。

definition_zh: (動) 暗示；暗指　(動) 隱含；意味著
example_sentence: His silence implies agreement with the decision made by the committee.
sentence_zh: 他的沉默暗示他同意委員會做出的決定。

definition_zh: (形) 無禮的；不禮貌的
example_sentence: Not greeting the teacher, the student appeared impolite and disrespectful to everyone.
sentence_zh: 沒有向老師打招呼，那名學生看起來對每個人都很無禮且不尊重。

definition_zh: (動) [ɪm`pɔrt] 進口；輸入　(名) [`ɪmpɔrt] 進口商品；重要性
example_sentence: Although many countries import oil from the Middle East, Taiwan must find alternative energy sources.
sentence_zh: 雖然許多國家從中東進口石油，但台灣必須尋找替代能源。

definition_zh: (名) 重要性；重要　(名) 重視；看重
example_sentence: Only after graduating from high school does the importance of time management become clear to students.
sentence_zh: 只有高中畢業後，時間管理的重要性才對學生變得明顯。

definition_zh: (形) 重要的；重大的　(形) 有影響力的；有權勢的
example_sentence: The decision that the principal made is important for all students.
sentence_zh: 校長做出的決定對所有學生都很重要。

definition_zh: (副) 重要地；值得注意地
example_sentence: Students study hard to improve grades, and importantly, to develop critical thinking skills.
sentence_zh: 學生努力讀書以提高成績，更重要的是，為了培養批判性思維能力。

definition_zh: (名) 進口；進口商品　(名) 進口行為；輸入
example_sentence: The government imposed new tariffs on the importation of foreign automobiles and electronic devices.
sentence_zh: 政府對進口外國汽車和電子產品課徵新關稅。

definition_zh: (動) 強加；施加　課稅；徵收
example_sentence: The government imposed new tax rules on all businesses last month.
sentence_zh: 政府上個月對所有企業強加了新的稅收規定。

definition_zh: (形) 堂皇的；壯觀的　(形) 令人印象深刻的；氣勢宏大的
example_sentence: Although the old temple seemed ordinary from outside, its interior was imposing, leaving visitors speechless.
sentence_zh: 雖然這座古廟從外面看起來很普通，但它的內部卻非常堂皇，讓遊客印象深刻。

definition_zh: (名) 強加；課稅　(動) 強加；徵收
example_sentence: Accepting the new dress code without complaint, many students faced the imposition of stricter regulations next semester.
sentence_zh: 許多學生默默接受新的著裝規定，卻面臨下學期更嚴格規章的強加。

definition_zh: (形) 不可能的；辦不到的　(形) 難以忍受的；令人厭惡的
example_sentence: The task that seems impossible to complete requires patience and practice.
sentence_zh: 那項看起來不可能完成的任務需要耐心和練習。

definition_zh: (名) 冒牌者；騙子　冒充他人身分的人
example_sentence: If the company hires an impostor without proper background checks, serious problems would occur.
sentence_zh: 如果公司在沒有適當背景調查的情況下僱用冒牌者，會發生嚴重問題。

definition_zh: (名) 冒充；詐騙　(動) 冒充；假扮
example_sentence: The con artist's imposture fooled many wealthy investors for several years.
sentence_zh: 那位詐騙犯的冒充行為騙了許多富有的投資者好幾年。

definition_zh: (動) 扣留；沒收　充公；扣押
example_sentence: The government will impound illegally parked cars to enforce traffic regulations effectively.
sentence_zh: 政府將扣留違法停放的汽車以有效執行交通規定。

definition_zh: (動) 使貧困；使貧窮　(動) 使枯竭；使耗盡
example_sentence: Decades of war and corruption impoverished the nation, leaving millions struggling without food or shelter.
sentence_zh: 數十年的戰爭和腐敗使該國陷入貧困，導致數百萬人為溫飽而掙扎。

definition_zh: (形) 貧困的；窮困的　(形) 匱乏的；貧瘠的
example_sentence: Although the region remained impoverished for decades, new factories finally brought employment and hope.
sentence_zh: 儘管該地區數十年來一直很貧困，新工廠終於帶來了就業機會和希望。

definition_zh: (形) 不切實際的；不實用的
example_sentence: Having ignored practical constraints, the designer's impractical proposal was rejected by the committee.
sentence_zh: 由於忽視了實際限制，設計師那個不切實際的提案被委員會駁回了。

definition_zh: (形) 不精確的；模糊的　(形) 含混的；籠統的
example_sentence: The imprecise measurements that the lab technician recorded led to incorrect experimental results.
sentence_zh: 實驗室技術員記錄的不精確測量數據導致實驗結果錯誤。

definition_zh: (動) 留下深刻印象；使印象深刻　(動) 壓印；蓋印章
example_sentence: The student's creative presentation impressed both the teacher and classmates greatly.
sentence_zh: 這位學生富有創意的簡報給老師和同學留下了深刻的印象。

definition_zh: (名) 印象；感受　(名) 影響；效果
example_sentence: If the opening scene were more creative, the film would leave a stronger impression on audience members.
sentence_zh: 如果開場場景更有創意，這部電影會對觀眾留下更深刻的印象。

definition_zh: (形) 令人印象深刻的；令人驚嘆的
example_sentence: The student's impressive performance in the math competition impressed all the judges.
sentence_zh: 那位學生在數學競賽中令人印象深刻的表現，使所有評委都印象深刻。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈɪmˌprɪnt] 印記；痕跡　(動) [ɪmˈprɪnt] 留下印象；印刷
example_sentence: Imprinted on the student's memory, the teacher's encouraging words motivated her throughout the exam preparation.
sentence_zh: 銘刻在學生心中，老師的鼓勵話語在她的考試準備過程中激勵著她。

definition_zh: (動) 監禁；關進監獄　(動) 限制自由；束縛
example_sentence: Although the government imprisoned many activists, public protest continued throughout the nation.
sentence_zh: 雖然政府監禁了許多活動人士，但全國的公眾抗議仍然持續進行。

definition_zh: (名) 監禁；囚禁　(名) 被監禁的狀態
example_sentence: Only after committing serious crimes does imprisonment become the judge's likely punishment.
sentence_zh: 只有在犯下重罪之後，監禁才會成為法官可能的懲罰。

definition_zh: (形) 不太可能的；不像會發生的
example_sentence: The ending that nobody expected was so improbable that viewers questioned the plot.
sentence_zh: 沒有人預期的結局如此不太可能，以至於觀眾質疑劇情的合理性。

definition_zh: (形) 不恰當的；不適合的　(形) 不禮貌的；失禮的
example_sentence: Students should avoid using improper language to communicate with teachers.
sentence_zh: 學生應該避免使用不恰當的語言來與老師溝通。

definition_zh: (動) 改善；改進　(動) 進步；提高
example_sentence: Practicing regularly and studying harder will improve your English test scores.
sentence_zh: 定期練習和更加努力讀書將會改善你的英文考試成績。

definition_zh: (動) 改進；改善　(動) 進步；改良
example_sentence: Regular practice will help students improve their English speaking skills.
sentence_zh: 定期練習將幫助學生改進他們的英語口語技能。

definition_zh: (名) 改善；進步　(名) 改進的事物；改良
example_sentence: As the student practiced regularly, noticeable improvement in English speaking ability emerged.
sentence_zh: 當學生定期練習時，英文口說能力出現了顯著的進步。

definition_zh: (名) 即興創作；臨時應變　(動) 即興地做；臨時組合
example_sentence: Creating a funny skit through improvisation, the comedy club audience burst into laughter.
sentence_zh: 透過即興創作做出有趣的短劇，喜劇俱樂部的觀眾放聲大笑。

definition_zh: (形) 不謹慎的；輕率的　(形) 缺乏深思熟慮的；冒失的
example_sentence: The imprudent decision that the manager made caused the company to lose millions.
sentence_zh: 經理所做出的那個輕率決定導致公司損失了數百萬元。

definition_zh: (名) 衝動；突然的慾望　(名) 推動力；刺激　(動) 推動；激勵
example_sentence: If teenagers control their impulse to buy things, they will save more money for future education.
sentence_zh: 如果青少年控制購物衝動，他們就會為未來教育存更多錢。

definition_zh: (形) 衝動的；易衝動的　(形) 突然的；無計劃的
example_sentence: Buying expensive items without thinking is an impulsive decision many teenagers regret.
sentence_zh: 沒有經過思考就買昂貴商品是許多青少年會後悔的衝動決定。

definition_zh: (名) 不受懲罰；免罰權
example_sentence: The dictator acted with impunity to suppress all political opposition without fear.
sentence_zh: 獨裁者為了毫無顧慮地壓制所有政治對立而肆無忌憚地行動。

definition_zh: (名) 雜質；不純淨　(名) 道德缺點；不誠實
example_sentence: The presence of impurities in the water supply poses a serious health risk to the community.
sentence_zh: 供水中雜質的存在對社區健康構成嚴重風險。

definition_zh: (副) 一瞬間；轉眼之間　(副) 快速地；突然地
example_sentence: The door opened in a flash, and the rescue team rushed inside to help the trapped workers.
sentence_zh: 門瞬間打開了，救援隊迅速衝進去幫助被困的工人。

definition_zh: (副) 連續地；一個接一個地　(片) 連續成功；不間斷
example_sentence: Having won three games in a row, the basketball team felt confident about the championship match.
sentence_zh: 籃球隊連贏三場比賽，對於冠軍賽感到很有信心。

definition_zh: (連) 此外；另外　(副) 而且；加上
example_sentence: The school offers math and English courses, in addition to which students can choose electives.
sentence_zh: 學校開設數學和英文課程，除此之外，學生還可以選擇選修課。

definition_zh: (介) 萬一；以防；如果發生
example_sentence: In case of fire, please use the emergency exit near the classroom.
sentence_zh: 萬一發生火災，請使用教室附近的緊急出口。

definition_zh: (介) 以防；萬一　(連) 假如；倘若
example_sentence: If heavy rain occurred, bringing an umbrella would prevent getting soaking wet.
sentence_zh: 如果下大雨，帶傘會防止淋濕。

definition_zh: (介) 為了慶祝；紀念
example_sentence: The school held a special assembly in celebration of the basketball team's national championship victory.
sentence_zh: 學校舉辦特別集會，為了慶祝籃球隊的全國冠軍勝利。

definition_zh: (片) 負責；掌管　(形) 主管的；負責的
example_sentence: Being in charge of the school club, Sarah organized activities every week.
sentence_zh: 莎拉負責學校社團，每週都組織各項活動。

definition_zh: (介) 共同；相同　(副) 共同地；一致地
example_sentence: Although the two students came from different backgrounds, they discovered they had much in common when discussing their favorite books.
sentence_zh: 雖然這兩名學生來自不同的背景，但當討論他們最喜歡的書籍時，他們發現有很多共同之處。

definition_zh: (片) 總之；最後　(連) 綜合以上；結論是
example_sentence: Not only did the experiment fail, but in conclusion, the hypothesis proved completely wrong.
sentence_zh: 不僅實驗失敗了，而且總之這個假說完全被證明是錯誤的。

definition_zh: (片) 掌控；控制中　(形) 受控的；有掌握的
example_sentence: The captain, who is in control of the team's strategy, made a crucial decision during the match.
sentence_zh: 掌控球隊戰術的隊長在比賽中做出了關鍵決定。

definition_zh: (片) 實際上；事實上
example_sentence: Learning English regularly helps students improve their skills in fact.
sentence_zh: 定期學習英文實際上能幫助學生提高他們的技能。

definition_zh: (介) 在…前面；在…的正前方
example_sentence: The convenience store stands in front of the train station entrance.
sentence_zh: 便利商店坐落在火車站入口的正前方。

definition_zh: (片) 全力進行中；如火如荼
example_sentence: The school sports festival is in full swing, with students competing in various events.
sentence_zh: 學校運動會正在如火如荼地進行中，學生們參加各種比賽。

definition_zh: (副) 立刻；馬上；很快地
example_sentence: The doctor arrived in no time, and the patient's condition improved quickly.
sentence_zh: 醫生立刻趕到，病人的狀況迅速好轉。

definition_zh: (副) 絕不；決不
example_sentence: Ignoring the teacher's advice, the student's grades improved in no way during the semester.
sentence_zh: 忽視老師的建議，該學生在整個學期中的成績絕不會進步。

definition_zh: (介) 按照；依照順序　(片語) 為了；以便
example_sentence: Students must submit their essays in order of the class roster that the teacher announced yesterday.
sentence_zh: 學生必須按照老師昨天公布的班級名單順序提交他們的作文。

definition_zh: (介) 為了；以便　(連) 為了；以便
example_sentence: If students study hard in order to pass the CSAT, their chances of success will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生努力唸書以便通過學測，他們成功的機會將大幅提高。

definition_zh: (連) 換句話說；也就是說
example_sentence: The project needs more time; in other words, the deadline should be extended.
sentence_zh: 這個專案需要更多時間；換句話說，截止日期應該延長。

definition_zh: (副) 特別是；尤其是　(片) 具體來說；尤其
example_sentence: Many students study hard to improve their grades, in particular to prepare for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力讀書以提高成績，尤其是為了準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (介) 代替；取代
example_sentence: The school hired a substitute teacher in place of the absent instructor.
sentence_zh: 學校聘請了一位代課老師來代替那位缺席的教師。

definition_zh: (介) 在公開場合；公開地
example_sentence: Having embarrassed himself in public, the student avoided eye contact with classmates the next day.
sentence_zh: 在眾人面前出醜後，這名學生隔天避免與同學有眼神接觸。

definition_zh: (介片) 尋求；追求　(介片) 為了找到；想要得到
example_sentence: The explorer traveled through the Amazon rainforest in quest of a legendary lost civilization that local tribes had long protected carefully.
sentence_zh: 那位探險家穿越亞馬遜雨林，尋求當地部落長期保護的傳奇失落文明。

definition_zh: (介片) 所指的；有爭議的　(形) 受質疑的；有問題的
example_sentence: The scientist's data in question showed unusual results that required further investigation.
sentence_zh: 有爭議的那位科學家的數據顯示了需要進一步調查的異常結果。

definition_zh: (介) 關於；就…而言
example_sentence: If the school improved its facilities in regard to sports equipment, more students would participate in athletic clubs.
sentence_zh: 如果學校改善運動器材的設施，更多學生就會參加運動社團。

definition_zh: (介) 關於；涉及　(介) 相比之下；對比
example_sentence: The new school policy in relation to mobile phones affects all students significantly.
sentence_zh: 關於手機的新校規對所有學生影響重大。

definition_zh: (介) 作為回報；相對地　(名) 回報；交換
example_sentence: Having received excellent service from the restaurant, customers left generous tips in return.
sentence_zh: 因為收到餐廳的優質服務，顧客作為回報留下了豐厚的小費。

definition_zh: (副) 簡言之；總之　(連) 簡單說；一句話
example_sentence: The project faced budget cuts, scheduling delays, and staff shortages; in short, management needed immediate intervention.
sentence_zh: 該專案面臨預算削減、時程延誤和人員不足；簡言之，管理層需要立即採取行動。

definition_zh: (介) 關於；在…方面　(片) 就…而言；從…角度看
example_sentence: Not only in terms of academic performance but also in terms of character development does the school excel.
sentence_zh: 這所學校不僅在學業成績方面表現傑出，在品格發展方面也表現優秀。

definition_zh: (副) 起初；最初　(片) 一開始；初期
example_sentence: In the beginning, which was difficult for many students, the new curriculum faced strong resistance.
sentence_zh: 一開始時，這對許多學生來說很困難，新課程面臨強烈反對。

definition_zh: (介) 在...的情況下；如果　(連) 假如；若
example_sentence: In the case of emergency, students need to follow the evacuation procedure to ensure safety.
sentence_zh: 在緊急情況下，學生需要遵循疏散程序以確保安全。

definition_zh: (副) 首先；第一點　(連) 首先；在最初
example_sentence: In the first place, students should complete their homework before playing video games.
sentence_zh: 首先，學生應該在玩電玩遊戲之前完成功課。

definition_zh: (介片) 希望；抱著……的希望
example_sentence: Students study hard in the hope of passing the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們努力讀書，希望能通過學測考試。

definition_zh: (片) 在進行中；在製作中；逐漸形成中
example_sentence: While the new shopping mall is in the making, local residents eagerly await its opening next year.
sentence_zh: 當新購物中心在進行中時，當地居民急切地期待它明年開幕。

definition_zh: (副) 同時；在此期間
example_sentence: Waiting for the exam results, students studied other subjects in the meantime.
sentence_zh: 等待考試成績期間，學生們同時準備其他科目。

definition_zh: (副) 在此期間；同時　(連) 與此同時
example_sentence: The meeting was postponed, and in the meantime, the team reviewed the project proposal carefully.
sentence_zh: 會議被延期了，與此同時，團隊仔細審查了專案提案。

definition_zh: (介) 在…過程中；進行中
example_sentence: If the company improves its services in the process, customers will be more satisfied.
sentence_zh: 如果公司在改進的過程中提升服務，顧客會更滿意。

definition_zh: (副) 及時；按時　(介片) 在…之前；不遲到
example_sentence: The doctor arrived in time to save the patient's life.
sentence_zh: 醫生及時趕到，救了患者的生命。

definition_zh: (副) 依次；輪流　(介) 作為...的回應
example_sentence: Students took turns to speak in class in order to practice English pronunciation.
sentence_zh: 學生們輪流在課堂上發言，以便練習英文發音。

definition_zh: (片) 徒勞；白白地；沒有結果
example_sentence: Despite studying hard for weeks, the student's effort was in vain when the exam got cancelled.
sentence_zh: 儘管學生努力複習了好幾週，但考試取消了，他的努力白白浪費了。

word: in view of the fact that
definition_zh: (連) 鑑於...這個事實；由於...的原因
example_sentence: In view of the fact that climate change threatens our future, governments must act immediately.
sentence_zh: 鑑於氣候變遷威脅我們的未來，各國政府必須立即採取行動。

definition_zh: (形) 內部的；公司內部進行的　(副) 在公司內部；內部地
example_sentence: Having completed the in-house training program, new employees felt confident tackling their first projects.
sentence_zh: 完成了公司內部培訓計畫後，新員工對於處理他們的第一批專案感到有信心。

definition_zh: (名) 無能；能力不足　(名) 不能；無法
example_sentence: The inability to speak English fluently is a problem that many students face.
sentence_zh: 流利說英文的無能是許多學生面臨的問題。

definition_zh: (形) 無法接近的；難以到達的　(形) 難以理解的；不容易得到的
example_sentence: The mountain village remained inaccessible to tourists during the heavy snowstorm.
sentence_zh: 在大雪暴期間，那個山區村莊對遊客來說仍然無法接近。

definition_zh: (形) 不準確的；不精確的　(形) 錯誤的；有誤的
example_sentence: If the weather forecast were not inaccurate, farmers would plan their planting schedule more confidently.
sentence_zh: 如果天氣預報不那麼不準確，農民就會更有信心地規劃他們的播種日程。

definition_zh: (形) 不活躍的；無效的　(形) 閒置的；未使用的
example_sentence: The old factory remained inactive for five years before reopening.
sentence_zh: 那家舊工廠在重新開啟前閒置了五年。

definition_zh: (形) 不足的；不適當的　(形) 不夠的；不充分的
example_sentence: Lacking proper training, the staff found their skills inadequate for handling the emergency situation.
sentence_zh: 由於缺乏適當的培訓，員工發現他們的技能不足以應對緊急情況。

definition_zh: (副) 不充分地；不足地　(副) 不適當地；不恰當地
example_sentence: Although the teacher explained the grammar inadequately, students still managed to understand the main points.
sentence_zh: 雖然老師解釋文法不充分，學生仍然設法理解了要點。

definition_zh: (形) 不可採納的；不能被接受的
example_sentence: Hardly admissible in court were the defendant's hearsay statements about the crime.
sentence_zh: 被告關於犯罪的傳聞證詞幾乎不可在法庭上採納。

definition_zh: (形) 無生命的；沒有生命的
example_sentence: Rocks and stones, which are inanimate objects, cannot grow or feel.
sentence_zh: 岩石和石頭是無生命的物體，無法生長或感受。

definition_zh: (形) 不恰當的；不適合的　(形) 不禮貌的；粗魯的
example_sentence: Teachers use classroom rules to prevent inappropriate behavior during lessons.
sentence_zh: 老師使用課堂規則來防止課堂中不恰當的行為。

definition_zh: (形) 不恰當的；不適合的　(形) 笨拙的；無能的
example_sentence: Choosing a formal suit for beach volleyball was inapt and made everyone laugh.
sentence_zh: 選擇正式的西裝去打沙灘排球是不恰當的，讓大家都笑了。

definition_zh: (名) 不注意；疏忽
example_sentence: The driver's inattention caused a serious accident on the highway.
sentence_zh: 駕駛的不注意導致高速公路上發生嚴重車禍。

definition_zh: (形) 首次的；就職的　(形) 初次舉行的；開幕的
example_sentence: Although the president's inaugural speech lasted two hours, citizens listened attentively throughout.
sentence_zh: 雖然總統的就職演說持續了兩小時，但民眾始終專注聆聽。

definition_zh: (動) 正式開幕；舉行就職典禮　(動) 開始；創立
example_sentence: Inaugurating the new library, the principal gave an inspiring speech to all students.
sentence_zh: 校長在為新圖書館舉行開幕典禮時，向全體學生發表了鼓舞人心的演講。

definition_zh: (名) 就職典禮；就職儀式　(名) 開始；開幕
example_sentence: The inauguration ceremony, which was attended by thousands of citizens, marked the president's official start of office.
sentence_zh: 那場就職典禮（有數千名市民參加）標誌著總統正式就職。

definition_zh: (形) 與生俱來的；先天的　(形) 天生的；固有的
example_sentence: If musical talent were inborn, every child would become a skilled musician without practice.
sentence_zh: 如果音樂天賦是與生俱來的，那麼每個孩子不需練習就能成為熟練的音樂家。

definition_zh: (形) 白熱的；發熱發光的　(形) 熱情洋溢的；充滿激情的
example_sentence: The incandescent light bulb glowed warmly in the old classroom.
sentence_zh: 白熱燈泡在舊教室裡溫暖地發光。

definition_zh: (名) 咒語；魔法公式　(名) 反覆吟唱；念誦
example_sentence: The wizard recited an ancient incantation to summon magical power.
sentence_zh: 巫師誦讀古老的咒語來召喚魔法力量。

definition_zh: (動) 使失去能力；使無法行動　使喪失戰鬥力
example_sentence: The serious injury incapacitated the athlete from competing in the championship.
sentence_zh: 這次嚴重的受傷使得運動員無法參加錦標賽。

definition_zh: (動) 監禁；關押　(動) 投獄；囚禁
example_sentence: Before the suspect was incarcerated, the police had gathered sufficient evidence to prove guilt.
sentence_zh: 在容疑人被監禁之前，警察已經蒐集足夠的證據來證明其有罪。

definition_zh: (名) 化身；代表　(名) 轉世；投生
example_sentence: Having studied ancient mythology for years, the professor saw Hercules as the incarnation of human courage and strength.
sentence_zh: 這位教授多年來研究古代神話，將赫拉克勒斯視為人類勇氣和力量的化身。

definition_zh: (介) 萬一；如果；以防
example_sentence: In case of emergency, students should follow the evacuation plan that the school has prepared.
sentence_zh: 萬一發生緊急情況，學生應該遵循學校準備的疏散計畫。

definition_zh: (名) [ˋɪnsɛns] 香；香料　(動) [ɪnˋsɛns] 激怒；惹怒
example_sentence: Burning incense sticks during temple festivals creates a peaceful and spiritual atmosphere.
sentence_zh: 在廟宇慶典中燃燒香枝能創造出平靜而神聖的氛圍。

definition_zh: (名) 獎勵；動力　(形) 有激勵作用的；鼓勵性的
example_sentence: If the company offered higher salary incentives, more talented employees would apply for the position.
sentence_zh: 如果公司提供更高的薪資獎勵，更多有才能的員工就會申請這個職位。

definition_zh: (動) 鼓勵；激勵　提供誘因
example_sentence: Offering bonuses incentivizes employees to work harder and improve performance.
sentence_zh: 提供獎金可以鼓勵員工更努力工作並提高績效。

definition_zh: (名) 開始；起源　(名) 初期；萌芽
example_sentence: Beginning with the project's inception, the team worked tirelessly to achieve their ambitious goals.
sentence_zh: 從專案的開始時起，團隊不懈地工作以達成他們的遠大目標。

definition_zh: (形) 不間斷的；持續不停的　(形) 無休止的；煩人的
example_sentence: Although the incessant rain disrupted the outdoor festival, thousands of visitors still attended the event.
sentence_zh: 儘管不間斷的雨水擾亂了戶外音樂節，數千名遊客仍然參加了這場活動。

definition_zh: (副) 不斷地；不停地　(副) 持續不絕地；無休止地
example_sentence: Seldom does the noise from the construction site stop incessantly disturbing our study.
sentence_zh: 建築工地的噪音很少停止不斷地干擾我們的學習。

definition_zh: (名) 英寸；一點點　(動) 緩慢移動；逐漸推進
example_sentence: The ruler that measures exactly twelve inches is the one we need for math class.
sentence_zh: 量起來正好十二英寸的那把尺是我們數學課需要的。

definition_zh: (名) 發生率；發生次數　(名) 入射；照射
example_sentence: Doctors study disease incidence to better understand health risks affecting teenagers.
sentence_zh: 醫生研究疾病發生率以更好地了解影響青少年的健康風險。

definition_zh: (名) 事件；事故　(名) 衝突；糾紛
example_sentence: The traffic incident on the highway delayed thousands of commuters this morning.
sentence_zh: 高速公路上的交通事故今早延誤了數千名通勤者。

definition_zh: (名) 事件；事故　(名) 插曲；衝突
example_sentence: A serious traffic incident closed the highway for three hours yesterday.
sentence_zh: 一起嚴重的交通事故昨天使高速公路關閉了三小時。

definition_zh: (形) 附帶的；偶然的　(副) 順便地；附帶地
example_sentence: Although the main purpose was to learn English, making new friends was incidental to attending the summer camp.
sentence_zh: 雖然主要目的是學習英語，但交新朋友是參加夏令營時附帶發生的事。

definition_zh: (副) 順便地；附帶地　巧合地；碰巧
example_sentence: Discovering a rare book while cleaning the attic, Sarah found old family photos incidentally stored inside.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在清理閣樓時發現了一本罕見的書，順便發現了裡面附帶保存的舊家庭照片。

definition_zh: (動) 焚燒；火化　(動) 徹底銷毀
example_sentence: The factory that incinerated tons of waste yearly faced strict environmental regulations from the government.
sentence_zh: 那家每年焚燒數噸廢棄物的工廠面臨政府嚴格的環境規定。

definition_zh: (形) 初期的；剛開始的　(形) 萌芽的；初現的
example_sentence: If the incipient infection is not treated promptly, it will develop into a serious disease.
sentence_zh: 如果初期感染沒有迅速治療，它將發展成嚴重疾病。

definition_zh: (動) 切割；雕刻　(動) 銘刻；深深印在
example_sentence: The artist incised fine details into the wooden surface with a sharp tool.
sentence_zh: 藝術家用銳利的工具在木製表面上雕刻出精細的細節。

definition_zh: (形) 尖銳的；一針見血的　(形) 敏銳的；深刻的
example_sentence: The professor's incisive questions helped students to understand the complex theory better.
sentence_zh: 教授那尖銳的問題幫助學生更好地理解這個複雜的理論。

definition_zh: (動) 煽動；激起　鼓動；驅使
example_sentence: The controversial speech incited violent protests and angry confrontations throughout the city.
sentence_zh: 那場有爭議的演講在全市激起了暴力抗議和憤怒對抗。

definition_zh: (名) 煽動；激勵　(動) 煽動；鼓動
example_sentence: Because the politician's speech was seen as incitement to violence, the government launched an investigation into his remarks.
sentence_zh: 由於該政治人物的演講被視為煽動暴力，政府對他的言論展開調查。

definition_zh: (形) 惡劣的；不利的　(形) 寒冷且潮濕的
example_sentence: Having encountered inclement weather during the hiking trip, the outdoor club postponed the event to next month.
sentence_zh: 由於登山活動中遭遇惡劣天氣，戶外俱樂部將活動延後到下個月。

definition_zh: (名) 傾向；偏好　(名) 斜坡；傾斜
example_sentence: Students whose academic inclination leans toward science often excel in physics and chemistry courses.
sentence_zh: 學業傾向偏向科學的學生通常在物理和化學課程中表現出色。

definition_zh: (動) [ɪnˈklaɪn] 傾斜；彎曲　(名) [ˈɪnklaɪn] 斜坡；坡度
example_sentence: The mountain road inclines steeply upward, making the climb challenging for hikers.
sentence_zh: 那條山路陡峭地向上傾斜，使得登山者的攀登變得困難。

definition_zh: (形) 傾向的；願意的　(動) 傾斜；彎向
example_sentence: If students were more inclined to study regularly, their exam scores would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生更傾向於定期讀書，他們的考試成績會大幅進步。

definition_zh: (動) 包括；包含　(動) 將…計入；納入
example_sentence: The ticket price includes meals, accommodation, and transportation.
sentence_zh: 票價包括餐點、住宿和交通。

definition_zh: (形) 包括的；包含在內的　(動) 包括；包含
example_sentence: The package included a free gift, making students very happy.
sentence_zh: 這個包裹包含了免費禮物，讓學生們非常高興。

definition_zh: (介) 包括；含括　(動) 包含；計入
example_sentence: Everyone attended the meeting, including the principal, teachers, and students.
sentence_zh: 包括校長、教師和學生在內，所有人都參加了會議。

definition_zh: (名) 包含；納入　(名) 包容性；融合
example_sentence: Only after the school adopted inclusive policies did true inclusion of all students become possible.
sentence_zh: 只有在學校採納包容政策之後，所有學生的真正融合才成為可能。

definition_zh: (介片) 包括；含有
example_sentence: The hotel package, inclusive of breakfast and airport transfer, costs five thousand dollars.
sentence_zh: 這個飯店套餐，包括早餐和機場接送，費用為五千元。

definition_zh: (形) 包含的；包容性的　(形) 全部包括的；費用全包的
example_sentence: The school designed an inclusive program to help all students succeed together.
sentence_zh: 這所學校設計了一項包容性方案，旨在幫助所有學生一起成功。

definition_zh: (副) 包括在內地；包括所有的
example_sentence: The conference schedule, inclusively covering registration and three keynote speeches, runs from 8 AM to 5 PM.
sentence_zh: 這次會議的日程，包括報到和三場主題演講在內，從上午8點進行到下午5點。

definition_zh: (名) 包容性；包括所有人的特質
example_sentence: The school promotes inclusivity by welcoming students from all backgrounds.
sentence_zh: 學校透過歡迎來自各種背景的學生來推動包容性。

definition_zh: (形) 不連貫的；不清楚的　(形) 言語混亂的；思路混亂的
example_sentence: Because the witness's testimony was incoherent, the jury struggled to understand what actually happened.
sentence_zh: 因為證人的證詞不連貫，陪審團難以理解實際發生了什麼。

definition_zh: (名) 收入；所得　(名) 進來的金錢
example_sentence: Having a stable income, many students feel more confident planning their university education.
sentence_zh: 擁有穩定的收入，許多學生在規劃大學教育時感到更有信心。

definition_zh: (形) 即將到來的；新到任的　(名) 進來；收入
example_sentence: The incoming freshmen who attended the orientation program felt excited about starting high school.
sentence_zh: 參加新生說明會的即將入學新生對開始高中生活感到興奮。

definition_zh: (形) 無可比較的；獨一無二的　(形) 無與倫比的；極好的
example_sentence: If the quality of their service were incomparable, customers would definitely choose their company over competitors.
sentence_zh: 如果他們的服務品質無與倫比，顧客一定會選擇他們的公司而非競爭對手。

definition_zh: (形) 不相容的；不能共存的　(形) 不相適的；不協調的
example_sentence: The couple found their lifestyles completely incompatible after marriage.
sentence_zh: 這對夫婦婚後發現他們的生活方式完全不相容。

definition_zh: (形) 不勝任的；無能的　(名) 無能的人；不稱職者
example_sentence: The manager hired a training program to help incompetent employees improve their work skills.
sentence_zh: 經理聘請了培訓課程來幫助不稱職的員工改進他們的工作技能。

definition_zh: (形) 不完整的；未完成的　(形) 殘缺的；不全的
example_sentence: The homework assignment remained incomplete because the student ran out of time before the deadline.
sentence_zh: 因為學生在截止期限前時間不足，家庭作業仍然未完成。

definition_zh: (形) 不體貼的；不為他人著想的　(形) 粗魯的；無禮的
example_sentence: Because Mark was inconsiderate, leaving dishes in the sink without washing them, his roommate grew increasingly frustrated.
sentence_zh: 因為馬克不體貼，把盤子留在水槽裡不洗，他的室友變得越來越沮喪。

definition_zh: (名) 不一致；前後不符　(名) 矛盾；自相矛盾
example_sentence: Having received conflicting instructions, the manager addressed the inconsistency by clarifying expectations.
sentence_zh: 經理收到相互矛盾的指示後，通過澄清期望來解決這種不一致的問題。

definition_zh: (形) 不一致的；前後不符的　(形) 矛盾的；相互抵觸的
example_sentence: The student's test scores, which were inconsistent with his usual performance, surprised the teacher.
sentence_zh: 這名學生的考試成績與他平時的表現不一致，讓老師感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (形) 無法安慰的；極度悲傷的
example_sentence: After losing the championship, the team's inconsolable players refused to accept the silver medal.
sentence_zh: 在失去冠軍後，這支隊伍無法安慰的球員拒絕接受銀牌。

definition_zh: (形) 易變的；不穩定的　(形) 浮躁的；不忠誠的
example_sentence: If Jake's work attitude were less inconstant, his grades would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果傑克的工作態度不那麼易變，他的成績會大幅進步。

definition_zh: (名) 不便；麻煩　(動) 使困擾；造成不便
example_sentence: Arriving late would inconvenience other people waiting for you.
sentence_zh: 遲到會給等你的人帶來不便。

definition_zh: (形) 不便的；麻煩的　(形) 不適合的；不方便的
example_sentence: Being stuck in traffic during rush hour, taking the bus became increasingly inconvenient for commuting students.
sentence_zh: 在尖峰時間堵車，搭公車對通勤的學生變得越來越不便。

definition_zh: (動) 併入；納入　(動) 成立公司；設立法人
example_sentence: As the company incorporated new technology into its products, customer satisfaction increased significantly.
sentence_zh: 當該公司將新技術納入其產品時，顧客滿意度大幅提升。

definition_zh: (名) 合併；併入　(名) 成立公司；設立法人
example_sentence: Only after the incorporation of advanced technology did the company achieve rapid growth.
sentence_zh: 只有在整合先進技術之後，該公司才取得快速成長。

definition_zh: (形) 不正確的；錯誤的
example_sentence: The answer that John submitted was incorrect, so he lost points on the exam.
sentence_zh: 約翰提交的答案是不正確的，所以他在考試中扣分了。

definition_zh: (動) [ɪnˈkris] 增加；提高　(名) [ˈɪnkris] 增加；增長
example_sentence: The school raised tuition fees to increase funding for new science laboratories.
sentence_zh: 學校提高學費以增加新科學實驗室的經費。

definition_zh: (形) 增加的；不斷增長的　(動) 增加；變多
example_sentence: The increasing number of students choosing online courses surprises many teachers.
sentence_zh: 選擇線上課程的學生人數不斷增加，令許多老師驚訝。

definition_zh: (形) 逐漸增加的；不斷增長的　(動) 增加；增長
example_sentence: The increasing number of students choosing STEM majors surprises many parents.
sentence_zh: 選擇理工科系的學生人數不斷增加，這讓許多家長感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (形) 難以置信的；驚人的　(形) 極好的；了不起的
example_sentence: Winning the championship without losing a single game, the team delivered an incredible performance that amazed all spectators.
sentence_zh: 沒有輸過一場比賽就贏得冠軍，該隊呈現了令所有觀眾驚嘆的不可思議表現。

definition_zh: (副) 令人難以置信地；非常地　極其；相當地
example_sentence: The new smartphone, which is incredibly thin and lightweight, impressed all the tech reviewers.
sentence_zh: 這款新智慧型手機非常輕薄，讓所有科技評論家都印象深刻。

definition_zh: (名) 懷疑；不相信　(名) 驚訝；難以置信
