example_sentence: If the witness had shown less incredulity toward the evidence, the jury would have reached a verdict faster.
sentence_zh: 如果證人對證據表現出較少的懷疑，陪審團會更快達成裁決。

definition_zh: (形) 不相信的；懷疑的　(形) 難以置信的；令人難以接受的
example_sentence: The teacher looked incredulous when the student claimed to have finished the homework in five minutes.
sentence_zh: 當學生聲稱五分鐘內完成功課時，老師露出懷疑的表情。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈɪnkrəmənt] 增量；增幅　(動) [ɪnˈkrɛmənt] 增加；提高
example_sentence: The company raised salaries to increment employee motivation and improve work performance.
sentence_zh: 公司提高薪資以增加員工的積極性並改善工作表現。

definition_zh: (形) 逐步的；增量的　(形) 漸進的；分階段的
example_sentence: The company made incremental improvements to its product design each quarter.
sentence_zh: 該公司每季度對產品設計進行逐步改進。

definition_zh: (動) 控告；指控　　(動) 使自己暴露在指控下
example_sentence: Although the witness tried to remain neutral, her testimony incriminated the defendant because she described his presence at the crime scene.
sentence_zh: 雖然證人試圖保持中立，但她的證詞控告了被告，因為她描述了他在犯罪現場出現的情形。

definition_zh: (形) 控告的；指控性的　(形) 證明有罪的；不利的
example_sentence: Having been discovered at the crime scene, the suspect's incriminatory evidence led to his arrest.
sentence_zh: 被發現在犯罪現場，嫌疑人的控告性證據導致他被逮捕。

definition_zh: (動) 孵化；培育　(名) 孵化器；培養器
example_sentence: The eggs that the farmer incubates in the warm room will hatch in three weeks.
sentence_zh: 農夫在溫暖房間孵化的雞蛋將在三週後孵出。

definition_zh: (形) 孵化的；潛伏的　(形) 培養的；發展中的
example_sentence: The incubative period of the virus requires careful monitoring and strict isolation procedures.
sentence_zh: 病毒的潛伏期需要仔細監測和嚴格的隔離措施。

definition_zh: (名) 孵化器；培養器　(名) 育成中心；新創企業培育機構
example_sentence: If startup founders had access to a good incubator, their businesses would grow much faster.
sentence_zh: 如果新創企業創辦人能夠進入一個好的育成中心，他們的事業會成長得快得多。

definition_zh: (形) 現任的；在職的　(名) 現任者；在職者
example_sentence: The incumbent president faced strong opposition from rival candidates during the election.
sentence_zh: 現任總統在選舉中面臨來自對手候選人的強烈反對。

definition_zh: (動) 招致；引起　遭受；承擔
example_sentence: Incurring heavy debts, the startup struggled to survive its first year.
sentence_zh: 因招致沉重債務，這家新創公司努力在第一年度過難關。

definition_zh: (形) 無法治癒的；不可救藥的　(形) 難以改正的；頑固的
example_sentence: Although the disease is incurable, patients can still live a quality life with proper treatment.
sentence_zh: 雖然這種疾病是無法治癒的，患者仍然可以透過適當的治療過上高品質的生活。

definition_zh: (副) 確實；的確　(片) 是的；沒錯
example_sentence: Not only is the exam difficult, but the preparation time is indeed limited for many students.
sentence_zh: 不僅考試很難，許多學生的準備時間確實也很有限。

definition_zh: (形) 不確定的；模糊的　(形) 不明確的；不肯定的
example_sentence: The project timeline, which remains indefinite, worries the team members.
sentence_zh: 這個專案的時程表仍然不確定，讓團隊成員感到擔憂。

definition_zh: (形) 永久的；難以消除的　(形) 深刻的；不可磨滅的
example_sentence: Writing a diary helps students to create indelible memories of their high school years.
sentence_zh: 寫日記幫助學生創造關於高中歲月不可磨滅的回憶。

definition_zh: (動) [ɪnˋdɛnt] 縮進；凹陷　(名) [ˋɪndɛnt] 凹痕；縮進
example_sentence: When writing essays, students must indent the first line of each paragraph.
sentence_zh: 寫作文時，學生必須將每個段落的第一行縮進。

definition_zh: (名) 縮進；凹陷　(名) 行首空格
example_sentence: The first line of each paragraph has a slight indentation for better readability.
sentence_zh: 每個段落的第一行都有輕微的縮進，以便更容易閱讀。

definition_zh: (名) 獨立；自主　(名) 自由；自治
example_sentence: Although gaining independence from colonial rule was difficult, many nations eventually achieved self-governance.
sentence_zh: 雖然從殖民統治中獲得獨立很困難，但許多國家最終都實現了自治。

definition_zh: (形) 獨立的；自主的　(形) 自立的；不依賴他人的
example_sentence: Working independently on projects, students develop critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
sentence_zh: 獨立進行專案工作，學生培養批判性思維和解決問題的能力。

definition_zh: (副) 獨立地；自主地　(副) 單獨地；不依賴他人地
example_sentence: Students who study independently without relying on tutors often develop stronger problem-solving skills.
sentence_zh: 不依賴補習班而獨立學習的學生通常會培養出更強的解題能力。

definition_zh: (名) 食指；指標手指
example_sentence: If a student points with the index finger during a presentation, the audience will pay attention to that important detail.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在簡報中用食指指向某處，觀眾就會注意到那個重要的細節。

definition_zh: (名) 索引；指數　(動) 編製索引；標明
example_sentence: The stock market index rose by two percent this week.
sentence_zh: 股票市場指數本週上升了百分之二。

definition_zh: (名) 印度；南亞國家
example_sentence: Many students travel to India to experience its rich culture and history.
sentence_zh: 許多學生前往印度以體驗其豐富的文化和歷史。

definition_zh: (形) 印度的；印度人的　(名) 印度人；印第安人
example_sentence: Many Indian students study hard to pass the CSAT exam every year.
sentence_zh: 許多印度學生每年都努力準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (動) 表明；指出　(動) 表示；暗示
example_sentence: As the dark clouds gathered overhead, the weather forecast indicated that a typhoon would arrive soon.
sentence_zh: 隨著烏雲在頭頂聚集，氣象預報表明颱風即將來臨。

definition_zh: (名) 指示；跡象　(名) 徵兆；暗示
example_sentence: Having studied the test results carefully, the doctor found clear indications of a serious health issue.
sentence_zh: 醫生仔細研究了測試結果後，發現了嚴重健康問題的明確跡象。

definition_zh: (形) 指示性的；表明的　(名) 直述語氣
example_sentence: The high unemployment rate, which is indicative of economic slowdown, concerns many investors.
sentence_zh: 高失業率表明經濟放緩，這令許多投資者感到擔憂。

definition_zh: (名) 指標；標誌　(名) 儀表；指針
example_sentence: Rising unemployment is a key economic indicator of recession.
sentence_zh: 失業率上升是經濟衰退的關鍵指標。

definition_zh: (動) 起訴；控告　(動) 表明有罪；指控
example_sentence: If the prosecutor had sufficient evidence, the grand jury would indict the suspect of fraud.
sentence_zh: 如果檢察官有足夠證據，陪審團就會起訴該嫌疑人詐欺罪。

definition_zh: (名) 起訴；控告　(名) 批評；譴責
example_sentence: The indictment against the company revealed serious violations of environmental laws.
sentence_zh: 針對該公司的起訴揭露了嚴重的環境法律違反行為。

definition_zh: (名) 漠不關心；冷漠　(形) 漠不關心的；冷淡的
example_sentence: Showing indifference toward others' suffering, the wealthy businessman ignored their pleas.
sentence_zh: 那位富有的商人對他人的痛苦漠不關心，無視他們的懇求。

definition_zh: (形) 冷淡的；不關心的　(形) 普通的；平庸的
example_sentence: Although the movie was highly praised, many audiences remained indifferent to its plot.
sentence_zh: 雖然這部電影獲得高度讚賞，但許多觀眾對其情節仍然不感興趣。

definition_zh: (形) 土著的；原住民的　(形) 本地的；本土的
example_sentence: Not only do indigenous peoples possess deep cultural knowledge, but also sustainable living practices.
sentence_zh: 土著民族不僅擁有深厚的文化知識，而且還具備永續生活的實踐方法。

definition_zh: (形) 難以消化的；難以理解的
example_sentence: The greasy food that the restaurant served was indigestible, causing stomach discomfort throughout the evening.
sentence_zh: 餐廳提供的那份油膩食物難以消化，整晚都引起胃部不適。

definition_zh: (名) 消化不良；腸胃不適
example_sentence: Eating too fast can cause indigestion, so chewing slowly helps prevent stomach discomfort.
sentence_zh: 吃太快會導致消化不良，所以慢慢咀嚼有助於預防胃部不適。

definition_zh: (形) 憤怒的；生氣的　(形) 不滿的；怨恨的
example_sentence: Feeling indignant about the unfair treatment, the students decided to voice their complaints to the principal.
sentence_zh: 對於不公平的待遇感到憤怒，學生們決定向校長表達他們的不滿。

definition_zh: (副) 憤怒地；不滿地
example_sentence: The student responded indignantly when accused of cheating unfairly.
sentence_zh: 那名學生在被不公平地控告作弊時，憤怒地回應。

definition_zh: (名) 憤怒；義憤
example_sentence: Although the government apologized sincerely, public indignation at the corruption scandal remained strong.
sentence_zh: 雖然政府真誠道歉，但公眾對貪汙醜聞的憤怒仍然很強烈。

definition_zh: (形) 間接的；不直接的　(副) 間接地；迂迴地
example_sentence: Taking an indirect route to avoid traffic, the delivery driver arrived later than expected.
sentence_zh: 送貨司機採取間接路線以避開交通，結果比預期晚到達。

definition_zh: (副) 間接地；直接影響以外地　(副) 拐彎抹角地；含蓄地
example_sentence: The teacher's comment about punctuality, which was directed at the whole class, indirectly criticized Tom's frequent tardiness.
sentence_zh: 老師關於準時的評論（針對全班的）間接地批評了湯姆經常遲到的習慣。

definition_zh: (形) 不謹慎的；輕率的　(形) 言行不當的；缺乏分寸的
example_sentence: If Mark makes an indiscreet comment about his boss's decision, he will surely regret it later.
sentence_zh: 如果馬克對老闆的決定發表不謹慎的言論，他稍後肯定會後悔。

definition_zh: (形) 不分皂白的；無分別的　(形) 濫亂的；無選擇的
example_sentence: Bombing indiscriminate targets harms innocent civilians and families.
sentence_zh: 轟炸無區別的目標會傷害無辜的平民和家庭。

definition_zh: (形) 不可或缺的；必不可少的　(名) 必需品；不可缺少的東西
example_sentence: Learning basic math skills is indispensable to succeed in high school entrance exams.
sentence_zh: 學習基礎數學技能對於在高中入學考試中成功是不可或缺的。

definition_zh: (名) 輕微的不適；不舒服　(名) 不願意；厭煩
example_sentence: A slight indisposition kept Sarah from attending the school festival yesterday afternoon.
sentence_zh: 輕微的不適使莎拉昨天下午無法參加學校慶典。

definition_zh: (形) 模糊的；不清楚的　(形) 不明顯的；模糊不清
example_sentence: Although the photo is indistinct, we can still recognize the main building in the background.
sentence_zh: 雖然照片模糊不清，我們仍然能辨認出背景中的主要建築。

definition_zh: (形) 個人的；單獨的　(名) 個人；個體
example_sentence: Having completed the project individually, each student presented their own findings to the class.
sentence_zh: 完成了個人專案後，每位學生向班級呈現自己的研究成果。

definition_zh: (副) 個別地；單獨地　(副) 逐個地；分別地
example_sentence: Students who complete assignments individually demonstrate stronger problem-solving skills than those working in groups.
sentence_zh: 單獨完成作業的學生展現出比小組合作學生更強的解決問題能力。

definition_zh: (形) 室內的；在室內的　(副) 在室內；到室內
example_sentence: Indoor activities like basketball and badminton are popular among Taiwanese high school students.
sentence_zh: 籃球和羽毛球等室內活動在台灣高中生中很受歡迎。

definition_zh: (副) 在室內；屋內　(形) 室內的；戶內的
example_sentence: If the weather were bad this weekend, the sports day would be held indoors instead of at the field.
sentence_zh: 如果這個週末天氣很糟，運動會就會在室內而不是在操場舉行。

definition_zh: (動) 引起；導致　(動) 誘導；勸說
example_sentence: Eating too much junk food can induce serious health problems.
sentence_zh: 吃太多垃圾食物會導致嚴重的健康問題。

definition_zh: (動) 引發；導致　(動) 勸誘；誘導
example_sentence: Inducing students to study harder, teachers often praise their progress and efforts.
sentence_zh: 老師經常稱讚學生的進步和努力，以此引發他們更努力學習。

definition_zh: (名) 歸納法；推理　(名) 感應；誘導
example_sentence: As induction requires careful observation of patterns, scientists must collect sufficient data before reaching conclusions.
sentence_zh: 由於歸納法需要仔細觀察規律，科學家在得出結論前必須蒐集充分的數據。

definition_zh: (動) 沉溺於；放縱　享受；滿足
example_sentence: Only after finishing homework should students indulge in playing video games.
sentence_zh: 只有完成功課後，學生才應該沉溺於玩電動遊戲。

definition_zh: (名) 縱容；放縱　(名) 嗜好；喜好
example_sentence: Excessive screen time, which is an indulgence many teenagers struggle to control, harms their sleep quality.
sentence_zh: 過度使用螢幕，這是許多青少年難以控制的縱容習慣，會損害他們的睡眠品質。

definition_zh: (形) 工業的；產業的　(形) 工業級的；大規模製造的
example_sentence: Many factories use industrial robots to improve production efficiency and reduce labor costs.
sentence_zh: 許多工廠使用工業機器人以提高生產效率並降低勞動成本。

definition_zh: (動) 使工業化；發展工業
example_sentence: Rapid development and industrialize regions often face pollution and resource depletion challenges.
sentence_zh: 快速發展且工業化的地區經常面臨污染和資源枯竭的挑戰。

definition_zh: (形) 工業化的；已發展工業的
example_sentence: Industrialized nations produce more goods than developing countries.
sentence_zh: 工業化國家的產品產量比開發中國家多。

definition_zh: (形) 勤勞的；勤奮的　(形) 刻苦的；認真的
example_sentence: Because Maria is industrious, she completes her assignments before deadlines and earns excellent grades.
sentence_zh: 因為瑪麗亞很勤勞，她在截止日期前完成作業並獲得優異成績。

definition_zh: (名) 工業；產業　(名) 勤勞；勤奮
example_sentence: Operating high-tech factories, Taiwan's semiconductor industry leads the global market.
sentence_zh: 經營高科技工廠，臺灣的半導體產業領導全球市場。

definition_zh: (形) 無效的；沒有效果的　(形) 不起作用的；失效的
example_sentence: The medicine that the doctor prescribed proved ineffective for treating the patient's severe headache.
sentence_zh: 醫生開的那個藥物對治療病患的嚴重頭痛證明是無效的。

definition_zh: (形) 無效率的；效率低的　(形) 浪費的；不能勝任的
example_sentence: If the company adopts inefficient production methods, it will lose market competitiveness quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果公司採用無效率的生產方法，它將很快失去市場競爭力。

definition_zh: (形) 不符合資格的；無資格的
example_sentence: Students with failing grades are ineligible for the scholarship award.
sentence_zh: 成績不及格的學生沒有資格獲得獎學金。

definition_zh: (形) 笨拙的；不適任的　(形) 無能的；缺乏技能的
example_sentence: The new employee was too inept to handle complex projects without constant supervision.
sentence_zh: 這位新員工太笨拙了，無法在沒有持續監督下處理複雜的專案。

definition_zh: (名) 無能；笨拙　(名) 不適當；不恰當
example_sentence: The manager's ineptitude in handling the budget crisis led to the company's financial collapse.
sentence_zh: 經理在處理預算危機上的無能導致了公司的財務崩潰。

definition_zh: (名) 不平等；不相等　(名) 貧富差距；差異
example_sentence: Although many countries have made progress, inequality in education remains a serious problem that affects millions of students.
sentence_zh: 雖然許多國家已取得進展，但教育不平等仍然是一個嚴重問題，影響著數百萬名學生。

definition_zh: (形) 惰性的；不活躍的　(形) 懶散的；遲鈍的
example_sentence: Having remained inert throughout the debate, the student failed to impress the judges with meaningful contributions.
sentence_zh: 在整場辯論中保持不活躍，這名學生未能以有意義的貢獻給評審留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 惰性；慣性　(名) 不願改變的傾向
example_sentence: The heavy box, which had inertia that resisted movement, stayed on the shelf.
sentence_zh: 那個沉重的箱子因為有阻止移動的慣性，所以留在架子上。

definition_zh: (形) 不可避免的；必然的　(形) 無法阻止的；確定會發生的
example_sentence: Climate change and rising sea levels are inevitable consequences of global warming.
sentence_zh: 氣候變遷和海平面上升是全球暖化不可避免的後果。

definition_zh: (副) 不可避免地；必然地
example_sentence: If students ignored their studies completely, they would inevitably fail the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 如果學生完全忽視功課，他們必然會在學測考試中失敗。

definition_zh: (形) 取之不盡的；用不完的　(形) 無窮無盡的；不會疲倦的
example_sentence: The sun provides an inexhaustible source of clean energy for future generations.
sentence_zh: 太陽為未來世代提供了取之不盡的清潔能源。

definition_zh: (副) 無窮地；無限地　(副) 取之不盡地；源源不斷地
example_sentence: Drawing inspiration inexhaustibly from nature, the artist created masterpieces throughout her entire life.
sentence_zh: 從大自然中無窮地汲取靈感，這位藝術家在她的整個人生中創作了傑作。

definition_zh: (形) 便宜的；不昂貴的　(形) 廉價的；低價的
example_sentence: Although the restaurant is inexpensive, the food quality remains surprisingly good.
sentence_zh: 雖然這家餐廳很便宜，但食物品質仍然出人意料地好。

definition_zh: (形) 缺乏經驗的；沒有經驗的
example_sentence: Hardly ever does an inexperienced team win the national competition without proper coaching.
sentence_zh: 沒有適當教練指導，缺乏經驗的隊伍幾乎不可能贏得全國比賽。

definition_zh: (形) 不可彌補的；無法原諒的
example_sentence: The crime, which was inexpiable in nature, devastated the entire community.
sentence_zh: 這起本質上不可原諒的犯罪摧毀了整個社區。

definition_zh: (形) 無法解釋的；莫名其妙的
example_sentence: The sudden power outage was inexplicable, leaving engineers unable to determine its cause.
sentence_zh: 突然停電無法解釋，工程師無法確定其原因。

definition_zh: (形) 不會犯錯的；絕對正確的　(形) 萬無一失的；可靠的
example_sentence: No system is completely infallible, so checking your work twice remains important before submission.
sentence_zh: 沒有任何系統是完全不會出錯的，所以在提交前檢查兩次仍然很重要。

definition_zh: (形) 臭名昭著的；惡名遠播的　(形) 令人厭惡的；可恥的
example_sentence: The infamous pirate Blackbeard terrorized ships sailing the Atlantic Ocean.
sentence_zh: 臭名昭著的海盜黑鬍子恐嚇了大西洋上的許多船隻。

definition_zh: (副) 惡名昭彰地；臭名遠揚地
example_sentence: The dictator infamously ordered the arrest of thousands, causing widespread fear throughout the nation.
sentence_zh: 這位獨裁者惡名昭彰地下令逮捕數千人，在全國引發廣泛恐懼。

definition_zh: (名) 嬰幼兒時期；初期階段
example_sentence: Being still in its infancy, the social media platform faced many technical challenges.
sentence_zh: 這個社交媒體平台仍處於初期階段，面臨許多技術挑戰。

definition_zh: (名) 嬰兒；幼兒　(形) 嬰幼的；初期的
example_sentence: The infant who was born prematurely required special medical care and attention.
sentence_zh: 那個早產的嬰兒需要特殊的醫療照顧和關注。

definition_zh: (名) 步兵；步兵部隊
example_sentence: If the infantry were equipped with modern weapons, the battle would be won more easily.
sentence_zh: 如果步兵配備現代武器，這場戰役會更容易贏得勝利。

definition_zh: (動) 使感染；傳染　(名) 感染
example_sentence: Eating unwashed vegetables can infect your digestive system with harmful bacteria.
sentence_zh: 吃未洗淨的蔬菜會讓有害細菌感染你的消化系統。

definition_zh: (形) 受感染的；被感染的　(動) 感染；傳染
example_sentence: Doctors prescribed antibiotics to treat the infected wound and prevent serious complications.
sentence_zh: 醫生開了抗生素來治療受感染的傷口，以防止嚴重併發症。

definition_zh: (動) 感染；傳染　(形) 具有傳染性的；易傳播的
example_sentence: The virus infecting thousands of people spread rapidly through the community.
sentence_zh: 感染數千人的病毒在社區中迅速傳播。

definition_zh: (名) 感染；傳染　(名) 感染症；傳染病
example_sentence: Because bacterial infection spreads rapidly, doctors prescribed antibiotics immediately to prevent serious complications.
sentence_zh: 因為細菌感染快速擴散，醫生立即開了抗生素以防止嚴重併發症。

definition_zh: (形) 有傳染性的；會傳染的　(形) 引起傳播的；具感染力的
example_sentence: Having caught the flu, Maria spread the infectious disease to her classmates during exam week.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞染上流感後，在考試週將這種傳染病傳給了她的同學。

definition_zh: (動) 推論；推斷　(動) 暗示；意味著
example_sentence: The detective inferred the suspect's guilt from clues that were found at the crime scene.
sentence_zh: 偵探從在犯罪現場發現的線索推斷出嫌疑人有罪。

definition_zh: (形) 較差的；低級的　(形) 下位的；次要的
example_sentence: Low-quality materials and poor workmanship make this product clearly inferior to competitors' offerings.
sentence_zh: 低劣的材料和糟糕的工藝使這款產品明顯不如競爭對手的產品。

definition_zh: (形) 不肥沃的；貧瘠的　(形) 不孕的；無生育能力的
example_sentence: If the farmland were not infertile, farmers would produce much more rice for Taiwan's food security.
sentence_zh: 如果農地不是不肥沃的，農民就能為台灣的糧食安全生產更多米。

definition_zh: (形) 無限的；無窮的　(名) 無限；無窮
example_sentence: The universe contains an infinite number of stars beyond our imagination.
sentence_zh: 宇宙包含無限數量的星星，超越我們的想像。

definition_zh: (名) 學校或機構內的醫務室；小型醫院
example_sentence: Feeling dizzy during class, the student went to the infirmary seeking medical attention immediately.
sentence_zh: 在課堂上感到暈眩，該學生立即去醫務室尋求醫療協助。

definition_zh: (名) 虛弱；衰弱　(名) 疾病；病痛
example_sentence: Although the elderly man suffered from various infirmities, he remained optimistic about life.
sentence_zh: 雖然這位老人遭受各種疾病困擾，但他對生活仍保持樂觀態度。

definition_zh: (動) 使發炎；激怒　(動) 加劇；惡化
example_sentence: Never should inflammatory comments inflame tensions between different social groups.
sentence_zh: 煽動性評論絕不應該激化不同社群之間的緊張關係。

definition_zh: (形) 發炎的；紅腫的　(形) 激怒的；憤怒的
example_sentence: The athlete's knee, which was inflamed from the injury, required immediate medical attention.
sentence_zh: 那位運動員的膝蓋因受傷而發炎，需要立即就醫。

definition_zh: (形) 易燃的；可燃的　(形) 容易激怒的；易激動的
example_sentence: The factory installed fire extinguishers to prevent inflammable materials from catching fire.
sentence_zh: 工廠安裝滅火器以防止易燃物質著火。

definition_zh: (名) 發炎；炎症　(名) 激怒；煽動
example_sentence: The inflammation in the patient's knee joint caused severe pain and swelling.
sentence_zh: 患者膝關節的發炎造成了嚴重的疼痛和腫脹。

definition_zh: (形) 炎症性的；發炎的　(形) 煽動性的；激怒人的
example_sentence: The doctor said the patient's inflammatory response caused swelling and pain.
sentence_zh: 醫生說患者的炎症反應引起了腫脹和疼痛。

definition_zh: (形) 發炎的；炎症性的　(形) 煽動性的；容易激怒人的
example_sentence: Although the patient's inflammatory response decreased, the doctor continued monitoring his condition carefully.
sentence_zh: 雖然患者的炎症反應減少了，但醫生仍然繼續仔細監測他的狀況。

definition_zh: (形) 可充氣的；膨脹的
example_sentence: Being lightweight and portable, inflatable boats are perfect for weekend camping trips near Taiwanese rivers.
sentence_zh: 充氣船重量輕且便於攜帶，非常適合週末在台灣河流附近的露營之旅。

definition_zh: (動) 充氣；膨脹　(動) 誇大；抬高
example_sentence: The balloon that children inflate at the party floats high into the sky.
sentence_zh: 孩子們在派對上充氣的氣球飄向高空。

definition_zh: (名) 通貨膨脹；物價上升　(名) 充氣；膨脹
example_sentence: If the central bank does not control inflation, the purchasing power of citizens will decrease significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果中央銀行無法控制通貨膨脹，國民的購買力將大幅下降。

definition_zh: (動) 造成；使承受　(動) 強加；施加
example_sentence: The storm inflicted severe damage on coastal villages throughout the region.
sentence_zh: 這場暴風雨對整個地區的沿海村莊造成了嚴重的損害。

definition_zh: (名) 影響；影響力　(動) 影響；左右
example_sentence: Good teachers often influence students to pursue their dreams and achieve success.
sentence_zh: 好老師常常影響學生去追求夢想並取得成功。

definition_zh: (名) 網紅；有影響力的人　(名) 社群媒體上的知名人物
example_sentence: Popular social media influencers often promote products to their millions of followers.
sentence_zh: 受歡迎的社群媒體網紅經常向數百萬粉絲推廣產品。

definition_zh: (形) 有影響力的；有勢力的
example_sentence: Because the scientist was influential in the field, many students followed his research method.
sentence_zh: 因為這位科學家在該領域很有影響力，許多學生都跟隨他的研究方法。

definition_zh: (名) 流感；流行性感冒
example_sentence: Having contracted influenza last winter, the athlete missed three important competitions.
sentence_zh: 在去年冬天染上流感後，這位運動員錯過了三場重要比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 大量涌入；流入　(動) 涌入；流入
example_sentence: The influx of tourists that occurred during summer vacation created traffic jams in the city.
sentence_zh: 夏假期間發生的大量遊客湧入造成城市交通堵塞。

definition_zh: (動) 通知；告訴　(動) 提供資訊；使了解
example_sentence: The school will inform all students and parents about the schedule change.
sentence_zh: 學校將通知所有學生和家長關於課程安排的變更。

definition_zh: (形) 非正式的；不正規的　(形) 隨便的；輕鬆的
example_sentence: If the meeting were informal, employees would feel more comfortable sharing honest opinions.
sentence_zh: 如果會議是非正式的，員工會更樂意分享誠實的想法。

definition_zh: (名) 信息；資訊　(名) 情報；信息
example_sentence: The teacher provided useful information about the college entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 老師提供了關於大學入學考試的有用信息。

definition_zh: (形) 提供資訊的；有教育意義的；富有啟發性的
example_sentence: Providing detailed explanations, the teacher's informative lecture helped students understand complex grammar concepts.
sentence_zh: 老師提供詳細的說明，其內容豐富的講課幫助學生理解複雜的文法概念。

definition_zh: (形) 知情的；了解情況的　(動) 告知；通知
example_sentence: Informed about the exam schedule, students could prepare their study plans more effectively.
sentence_zh: 既然得到了考試時間表的通知，學生們就能更有效地準備他們的讀書計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 資訊娛樂；寓教於樂的媒體內容
example_sentence: Only through well-designed infotainment programs can young audiences learn while having genuine fun.
sentence_zh: 只有透過設計良好的資訊娛樂節目，年輕觀眾才能邊學習邊真正享受樂趣。

definition_zh: (名) 違反；輕微違法行為　(名) 侵害；侵犯
example_sentence: The parking infraction that the driver received was a minor violation of traffic rules.
sentence_zh: 駕駛人收到的停車違規是對交通規則的輕微違反。

definition_zh: (名) 基礎設施；基礎建設　(名) 公共設施；下層結構
example_sentence: The government invested in infrastructure to improve transportation and reduce traffic congestion.
sentence_zh: 政府投資基礎設施以改善交通運輸並減少交通擁堵。

definition_zh: (形) 不頻繁的；罕見的　(形) 稀少的；偶爾發生的
example_sentence: Infrequent visits to the dentist can lead to serious tooth problems over time.
sentence_zh: 不經常看牙醫會導致牙齒問題隨著時間變得嚴重。

definition_zh: (副) 不頻繁地；很少地
example_sentence: Sarah visits her grandparents infrequently, usually only during summer vacation.
sentence_zh: 莎拉不常拜訪祖父母，通常只在暑假時去。

definition_zh: (動) 侵犯；違反　侵害；冒犯
example_sentence: Although the company claimed to innovate freely, their new design infringed on the patent that the competitor had registered years ago.
sentence_zh: 雖然該公司聲稱可自由創新，但他們的新設計卻侵犯了競爭對手多年前註冊的專利。

definition_zh: (動) 激怒；惹怒　(形) 令人極為憤怒的
example_sentence: Seeing the unfair test results, students felt infuriated by the teacher's unclear grading system.
sentence_zh: 看到不公平的測驗成績，學生對老師不清楚的評分制度感到激怒。

definition_zh: (名) 注入；灌輸　(名) 浸泡；沏茶
example_sentence: The infusion of traditional values into modern education is a practice that many Taiwanese schools embrace.
sentence_zh: 將傳統價值觀注入現代教育的做法是許多臺灣學校所采納的實踐。

definition_zh: (形) 聰慧的；富有創意的　(形) 巧妙的；靈巧的
example_sentence: If the engineer designs an ingenious solution, the factory will reduce production costs significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果工程師設計出巧妙的解決方案，工廠將大幅降低生產成本。

definition_zh: (名) 聰慧；機智　(名) 創意；巧妙的方法
example_sentence: The engineer's ingenuity solved the problem in an unexpected way.
sentence_zh: 這位工程師的機智以意想不到的方式解決了問題。

definition_zh: (動) 吞嚥；攝入　(動) 食用；吸收
example_sentence: Doctors advise patients to ingest plenty of water daily for better health.
sentence_zh: 醫生建議患者每天攝入大量水分以保持健康。

definition_zh: (形) 可吞嚥的；可食用的
example_sentence: The new ingestible capsule sensor helps doctors monitor patients' digestive health without surgery.
sentence_zh: 這種新的可吞嚥膠囊感應器幫助醫生在不進行手術的情況下監測患者的消化道健康。

definition_zh: (名) 攝取；吞嚥　(名) 食物進入體內
example_sentence: Because ingestion of contaminated water causes serious illness, the school provided bottled water during the field trip.
sentence_zh: 因為攝取受污染的水會導致嚴重疾病，學校在戶外教學期間提供瓶裝水。

definition_zh: (動) 深深種植；使根深蒂固　(形) 根深蒂固的；難以改變的
example_sentence: Having ingrained good study habits since childhood, the student found exam preparation manageable and efficient.
sentence_zh: 由於從小就養成了良好的學習習慣，這位學生發現考試準備既易於管理又有效率。

definition_zh: (形) 根深蒂固的；牢固的　(動) 深深植入；使根深蒂固
example_sentence: Traditional values, which are deeply ingrained in Taiwanese society, influence generational attitudes toward family.
sentence_zh: 傳統價值觀，這些在台灣社會中根深蒂固的信念，影響著一代人對家庭的態度。

definition_zh: (動) 討好；逢迎　(動) 使自己受歡迎
example_sentence: Flattering the boss and bringing gifts every day are ways to ingratiate oneself with authority.
sentence_zh: 每天奉承老闆和帶禮物是討好權威人士的方式。

definition_zh: (形) 討好的；奉承的　(動) 討好；獲得好感
example_sentence: If the candidate adopted an ingratiating tone during the interview, employers would likely view him more favorably.
sentence_zh: 如果該候選人在面試中採取討好的語調，雇主可能會對他更有利。

definition_zh: (名) 材料；配料　(名) 要素；成分
example_sentence: The main ingredients for this cake are flour, eggs, and butter.
sentence_zh: 這個蛋糕的主要材料是麵粉、雞蛋和奶油。

definition_zh: (動) 居住；棲息　(動) 占據；存在於
example_sentence: Inhabiting remote mountain villages, indigenous tribes maintain their unique cultural traditions for generations.
sentence_zh: 居住在偏遠山區的原住民部落世代維持著獨特的文化傳統。

definition_zh: (名) 居民；住民
example_sentence: Since the earthquake damaged many buildings, the inhabitants had to relocate to temporary shelters.
sentence_zh: 由於地震損毀許多建築物，該地的居民不得不遷移到臨時庇護所。

definition_zh: (動) 吸入；吸氣
example_sentence: Only when nervous does the athlete inhale deeply before the competition.
sentence_zh: 只有在緊張時，運動員才會在比賽前深深吸氣。

definition_zh: (形) 內在的；固有的　(形) 天生的；與生俱來的
example_sentence: The problems inherent in this system require immediate attention from government officials.
sentence_zh: 這個系統中固有的問題需要政府官員立即關注。

definition_zh: (副) 本質上；固有地　(副) 內在地；根本上
example_sentence: Studying grammar regularly helps students to improve language skills inherently.
sentence_zh: 定期學習文法有助於學生本質上提升語言能力。

definition_zh: (動) 繼承；傳承　(動) 遺傳；獲得
example_sentence: Children often inherit both money and family values from their parents.
sentence_zh: 孩子經常從父母那裡繼承金錢和家庭價值觀。

definition_zh: (名) 遺產；繼承　(名) 遺傳；世襲
example_sentence: The old house became part of Maria's inheritance after her grandmother passed away.
sentence_zh: 祖母過世後，那棟老房子成為瑪麗亞遺產的一部分。

definition_zh: (動) 抑制；阻止　(動) 抑制；禁止
example_sentence: Although strict rules inhibit students' freedom, they help maintain order in school.
sentence_zh: 雖然嚴格的規則阻止學生的自由，但它們幫助維持學校秩序。

definition_zh: (形) 受抑制的；害羞的　(動) 抑制；阻止
example_sentence: Feeling inhibited by strict classroom rules, many students hesitated to ask questions during lessons.
sentence_zh: 受到嚴格教室規則的抑制，許多學生在課堂上猶豫是否要提問。

definition_zh: (名) 抑制；禁止　(名) 害羞；拘謹
example_sentence: The student's inhibition about speaking English in class is a problem that regular practice can solve.
sentence_zh: 這個學生在課堂上說英文的抑制心理是一個可以通過定期練習解決的問題。

definition_zh: (形) 不好客的；不友善的　冷淡的；荒涼的
example_sentence: If the local residents remain inhospitable, tourists will choose other destinations for their holidays.
sentence_zh: 如果當地居民仍然不好客，遊客將選擇其他地方度假。

definition_zh: (副) 殘忍地；不人道地　(副) 極度地；非常地
example_sentence: The factory treated workers inhumanly, forcing them to labor without rest or proper food.
sentence_zh: 該工廠對待工人極其殘忍，迫使他們在沒有休息或適當食物的情況下工作。

definition_zh: (形) 最初的；開始的　(名) 姓名縮寫；首字母
example_sentence: Students need to submit their initial application form to register for the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 學生需要提交初始申請表以報名參加學測。

definition_zh: (名) 首字母縮略詞；字首詞
example_sentence: FBI and NASA are common initialisms that English learners must recognize quickly.
sentence_zh: FBI和NASA是英文學習者必須快速辨認的常見首字母縮略詞。

definition_zh: (副) 最初；起初　開始時；初期地
example_sentence: Initially, the students found the math problem difficult, but they gradually understood the solution.
sentence_zh: 最初，學生們覺得這道數學題很難，但他們逐漸理解了解法。

definition_zh: (動) 開始；發起　(動) 啟動；著手
example_sentence: Having initiated the project last month, the team now focuses on meeting deadlines.
sentence_zh: 在上個月開始這個項目後，團隊現在專注於按時完成。

definition_zh: (名) 主動；首創精神　(名) 倡議；計劃　(形) 主動的；積極的
example_sentence: The environmental project that the student council launched showed real initiative in addressing climate change.
sentence_zh: 學生會推動的那個環保計劃展現了真正的主動精神，在解決氣候變遷方面表現積極。

definition_zh: (動) 注射；打針　(動) 注入；灌輸
example_sentence: The doctor injected medicine into the patient's arm to relieve the pain.
sentence_zh: 醫生向患者的手臂注射藥物以緩解疼痛。

definition_zh: (名) 注射；注入　(名) 注射液；藥劑
example_sentence: If the doctor had recommended an injection earlier, the patient would have recovered much faster.
sentence_zh: 如果醫生早些建議注射，病人恢復得會快得多。

definition_zh: (動) 傷害；受傷　(動) 損害；危害
example_sentence: The accident injured several passengers, and doctors treated them immediately.
sentence_zh: 那場事故傷害了幾名乘客，醫生立即進行治療。

definition_zh: (形) 受傷的；受害的　(動) 傷害；損害
example_sentence: Injured in the car accident, the athlete had to cancel all competitions this season.
sentence_zh: 在車禍中受傷，這位運動員必須取消本賽季的所有比賽。

definition_zh: (形) 有害的；傷害性的
example_sentence: Injurious as smoking is to health, many teenagers still start the habit.
sentence_zh: 吸菸對健康有害，儘管如此，許多青少年仍然養成這個習慣。

definition_zh: (名) 傷害；受傷　(動) 傷害；損傷
example_sentence: Seldom does a serious injury fail to affect an athlete's performance during competition.
sentence_zh: 一項嚴重的傷害很少不會影響運動員在比賽中的表現。

definition_zh: (名) 不公正；冤屈　(名) 不公平的行為；冤案
example_sentence: The student who suffered injustice deserved a fair hearing from school authorities.
sentence_zh: 遭受冤屈的學生值得獲得學校當局的公正聆訊。

definition_zh: (名) 墨水；墨汁　(動) 用墨水書寫；簽署
example_sentence: Students use ink to sign their names on important documents.
sentence_zh: 學生使用墨水在重要文件上簽署姓名。

definition_zh: (形) 內陸的；靠近內陸的　(名) 內陸；內地
example_sentence: Farmers in inland areas rely heavily on irrigation systems for crop production.
sentence_zh: 內陸地區的農民主要依靠灌溉系統進行農作物生產。

definition_zh: (名) 入口；灣；狹窄的海灣
example_sentence: The boat sailed slowly into the rocky inlet near the fishing village.
sentence_zh: 漁船緩緩駛入漁村附近的岩石灣。

definition_zh: (名) 獄中囚犯；監獄受刑人
example_sentence: Although the inmate had served ten years in prison, rehabilitation programs gave him hope for a better future.
sentence_zh: 雖然這名獄中囚犯已在監獄服刑十年，但更生計畫卻給了他美好未來的希望。

definition_zh: (名) 旅館；小旅社　(名) 酒吧；客棧
example_sentence: Staying at a small inn nestled in the mountain village, tourists enjoyed authentic local meals.
sentence_zh: 遊客住在坐落於山村的小旅館，享受道地的在地美食。

definition_zh: (名) 內臟；腸子　(名) 內部結構；內在機制
example_sentence: The machine's innards, which were exposed during repair, revealed countless tiny gears working together.
sentence_zh: 那台機器的內部結構在修理時被暴露出來，顯示無數個小齒輪一起運作。

definition_zh: (片) 需要；在困境中　(形) 貧困的；急需的
example_sentence: Students in need of extra tutoring should sign up early.
sentence_zh: 需要額外輔導的學生應該提早報名。

definition_zh: (形) 內部的；內心的　(名) 內部；內心
example_sentence: Many students practice meditation to develop their inner peace and focus.
sentence_zh: 許多學生練習冥想是為了培養內心的平靜和專注力。

definition_zh: (形) 最內層的；最深處的　(形) 最隱祕的；內心深處的
example_sentence: The innermost thoughts buried in one's heart often reveal true character.
sentence_zh: 埋藏在心底最深處的想法往往能夠顯露一個人的真實性格。

definition_zh: (名) 局；回合　(名) 棒球比賽中一隊的攻擊機會
example_sentence: Although the home team was losing by three runs, they scored five points in the ninth inning and won the game.
sentence_zh: 雖然主隊落後三分，但他們在第九局得了五分並贏得比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 天真；無辜　(形) 純潔的；無罪的
example_sentence: Having lost her innocence through betrayal, the young woman learned to trust fewer people.
sentence_zh: 因背叛而失去天真，這位年輕女性學會了相信較少的人。

definition_zh: (形) 無罪的；清白的　(形) 天真的；無知的
example_sentence: The defendant who was declared innocent by the court returned home with relief.
sentence_zh: 被法院宣判無罪的被告滿懷安慰地回家了。

definition_zh: (副) 天真地；無辜地　無知地；純真地
example_sentence: The young student innocently asked the teacher a question that made everyone laugh.
sentence_zh: 那位年輕的學生天真地問老師一個問題，使得大家都笑了。

definition_zh: (動) 創新；革新　(名) 創新；創新事物
example_sentence: If companies innovated their products regularly, they would attract more customers and stay competitive.
sentence_zh: 如果公司定期創新產品，就會吸引更多顧客並保持競爭力。

definition_zh: (名) 創新；革新　(名) 創新事物；新發明
example_sentence: The company introduced an innovation in smartphone technology last year.
sentence_zh: 這家公司去年在智慧型手機技術推出了一項創新。

definition_zh: (形) 創新的；革新的　(名) 創新者；革新者
example_sentence: Combining traditional crafts with modern technology, innovative designers created products winning international awards.
sentence_zh: 創新設計師結合傳統工藝與現代科技，創作出贏得國際獎項的產品。

definition_zh: (名) 創新者；革新家　(名) 發明家；開創者
example_sentence: Although the entrepreneur faced many challenges, becoming an innovator required persistent effort and creative thinking.
sentence_zh: 雖然這位企業家面臨許多挑戰，但成為創新者需要持續的努力和創意思考。

definition_zh: (形) 無數的；數不清的　(形) 極多的；眾多的
example_sentence: Seldom have scientists discovered innumerable species in a single rainforest ecosystem.
sentence_zh: 科學家很少在單一雨林生態系統中發現無數物種。

definition_zh: (動) 接種；注射疫苗　(動) 灌輸；傳入
example_sentence: Students who receive the vaccine that doctors inoculate before entering university will be better protected.
sentence_zh: 在進入大學前接受醫生注射疫苗的學生會受到更好的保護。

definition_zh: (名) 輸入；投入　(動) 輸入；輸進
example_sentence: Students need to input their personal data to register for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 學生需要輸入個人資料以便報名學測。

definition_zh: (動) 詢問；打聽　(動) 調查；探究
example_sentence: The journalist inquired about the accident and collected detailed information from witnesses.
sentence_zh: 記者詢問了這起事故，並從目擊者那裡蒐集了詳細的資訊。

definition_zh: (形) 詢問的；好奇的　(動) 詢問；打聽
example_sentence: The inquiring student asked her teacher many thoughtful questions about the science project.
sentence_zh: 那位好奇的學生向老師提出許多關於科學專題的深思熟慮的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 詢問；調查　(動) 詢問；打聽
example_sentence: As the scandal deepened, government officials launched a formal inquiry into the matter.
sentence_zh: 隨著醜聞惡化，政府官員對此事展開正式調查。

definition_zh: (名) 侵佔；滲透　(動) 逐漸侵入；佔領
example_sentence: Making steady inroads into the market, the startup company attracted many investors and customers.
sentence_zh: 這家新創公司逐漸滲透市場，吸引了許多投資者和顧客。

definition_zh: (形) 瘋狂的；精神失常的　(形) 極端的；荒謬的
example_sentence: The training schedule that the coach designed was so insane that many athletes complained about it.
sentence_zh: 教練設計的訓練計劃非常瘋狂，許多運動員都抱怨它。

definition_zh: (形) 不衛生的；髒的　(形) 不適合居住的；危害健康的
example_sentence: If the kitchen remains insanitary, the restaurant will face serious health code violations.
sentence_zh: 如果廚房仍然不衛生，餐廳將面臨嚴重的衛生法規違規。

definition_zh: (名) 瘋狂；精神失常　(名) 極度愚蠢；荒謬
example_sentence: Repeating the same mistake and expecting different results is pure insanity.
sentence_zh: 重複犯同樣的錯誤卻期望得到不同結果，這純粹是瘋狂。

definition_zh: (形) 永遠滿足不了的；無法滿足的
example_sentence: Athletes practice relentlessly to satisfy their insatiable hunger for victory.
sentence_zh: 運動員不懈練習以滿足他們對勝利永遠滿足不了的渴望。

definition_zh: (動) 銘刻；雕刻　題寫；簽名
example_sentence: The jeweler inscribed the couple's initials on the back of the wedding ring.
sentence_zh: 珠寶商在婚戒背面銘刻了這對夫婦的首字母。

definition_zh: (名) 銘文；題詞　(名) 題贈；簽名
example_sentence: As visitors walked through the museum, they read the inscription carved on the ancient stone tablet carefully.
sentence_zh: 當參觀者走過博物館時，他們仔細閱讀刻在古石碑上的銘文。

definition_zh: (名) 昆蟲；蟲子
example_sentence: Having studied the insect's wings closely, the biologist discovered a new species.
sentence_zh: 仔細研究過這隻昆蟲的翅膀後，生物學家發現了一個新物種。

definition_zh: (名) 殺蟲劑；農藥　(形) 殺蟲的；殺蟲用的
example_sentence: Farmers spray insecticide on crops that have been damaged by pests.
sentence_zh: 農民在受蟲害損害的農作物上噴灑殺蟲劑。

definition_zh: (形) 不安全的；沒有自信的　(形) 缺乏信心；易感到焦慮的
example_sentence: Feeling insecure about academic performance, many students study harder before major exams.
sentence_zh: 對學業表現感到沒有自信，許多學生在大考前更加用功讀書。

definition_zh: (形) 無感覺的；無生命的
example_sentence: If a stone were insentient, it would not respond to any external stimuli.
sentence_zh: 如果石頭是無生命的，它就不會對任何外部刺激做出反應。

definition_zh: (形) 不可分離的；密不可分的
example_sentence: The two best friends were inseparable, spending every day together.
sentence_zh: 這兩個最好的朋友密不可分，每天都在一起。

definition_zh: (名) ['ɪnsɝt] 插頁；嵌入物　(動) [ɪn'sɝt] 插入；放入；刊登
example_sentence: Inserting a USB drive into the computer, the student downloaded the homework files quickly.
sentence_zh: 將USB隨身碟插入電腦，那位學生快速下載了作業檔案。

definition_zh: (副) 簡言之；總之
example_sentence: In short, studying regularly helps students pass the CSAT exam more easily.
sentence_zh: 簡言之，定期讀書能幫助學生更容易通過學測考試。

definition_zh: (片) 徹底地；完全地　(片) 裡外翻轉；顛倒
example_sentence: Only after turning the bag inside out did Maria find her lost keys.
sentence_zh: 只有把包包完全翻轉後，瑪麗亞才找到她遺失的鑰匙。

definition_zh: (形) 內部的；裡面的　(副) 在...裡面；內部　(名) 內部；裡面
example_sentence: The secret documents inside the locked drawer revealed information that officials had hidden for years.
sentence_zh: 鎖著的抽屜內部的機密文件揭露了官員多年來隱藏的資訊。

definition_zh: (名) 內部人士；知情人　(形) 內部的；機密的
example_sentence: Company executives hired an insider to help analyze competitors' strategies.
sentence_zh: 公司高管聘請一位內部人士來幫助分析競爭對手的策略。

definition_zh: (形) 隱伏的；暗中危害的　(形) 陰險的；狡詐的
example_sentence: Insidious diseases spread quietly without obvious symptoms, making early detection difficult.
sentence_zh: 隱伏性疾病悄悄蔓延，沒有明顯症狀，使得早期發現很困難。

definition_zh: (名) 洞察；領悟　(名) 深刻的理解
example_sentence: Reading this novel gave me insight into why teenagers often feel misunderstood.
sentence_zh: 閱讀這部小說使我對青少年為何經常感到被誤解有了深刻的理解。

definition_zh: (形) 富有洞察力的；深刻的　(形) 聰慧的；有眼光的
example_sentence: Because the article is insightful, many students find it helpful for understanding social issues.
sentence_zh: 因為這篇文章很有洞察力，許多學生覺得它有助於理解社會議題。

definition_zh: (形) 微不足道的；不重要的　(形) 細小的；無關緊要的
example_sentence: Lacking proper research methods, the study's findings proved insignificant in the medical field.
sentence_zh: 缺乏適當研究方法，該研究的發現在醫學領域微不足道。

definition_zh: (動) 暗示；含沙射影　(動) 巧妙地引入；逐漸滲入
example_sentence: The politician insinuated that his opponent had committed fraud, which caused public outrage.
sentence_zh: 那位政治人物暗示他的對手犯了欺詐罪，這引起了公眾憤怒。

definition_zh: (動) 堅持；主張　(動) 堅決要求；執意
example_sentence: If the coach insists on early morning practice, athletes must adjust their sleep schedules.
sentence_zh: 如果教練堅持早晨練習，運動員必須調整他們的睡眠時間。

definition_zh: (名) 堅持；執意　(名) 強調；主張
example_sentence: The teacher's insistence on homework completion helped students improve their grades.
sentence_zh: 老師堅持要求學生完成作業，幫助了他們提高成績。

definition_zh: (形) 堅持的；執著的　(形) 持續的；不斷的
example_sentence: The teacher was insistent to help struggling students improve their exam scores.
sentence_zh: 老師堅持要幫助成績落後的學生提高考試成績。

definition_zh: (形) 無禮的；傲慢的　(名) 無禮的人；傲慢者
example_sentence: The student's insolent remark about the teacher's appearance caused serious trouble.
sentence_zh: 那位學生關於老師外貌的無禮評論引起了嚴重的麻煩。

definition_zh: (名) 失眠；失眠症
example_sentence: Because insomnia affected her sleep quality, Sarah studied harder during daytime hours.
sentence_zh: 因為失眠影響了她的睡眠品質，莎拉在白天時間更加認真讀書。

definition_zh: (動) 檢查；視察　(動) 檢視；查看
example_sentence: Having inspected the laboratory equipment carefully, the science teacher approved the experiment.
sentence_zh: 仔細檢查了實驗室設備後，科學老師批准了這項實驗。

definition_zh: (名) 檢查；檢驗　(名) 視察；查驗
example_sentence: The building inspection, which revealed serious structural problems, forced the school to close temporarily.
sentence_zh: 那棟建築物的檢驗顯示出嚴重的結構問題，迫使學校暫時關閉。

definition_zh: (名) 檢查官；視察員　(名) 警探；偵查員
example_sentence: The school inspector visited our classroom to check teaching quality and student progress.
sentence_zh: 學校視察員來到我們的教室檢查教學品質和學生進度。

definition_zh: (名) 靈感；啟發　(名) 鼓舞；激勵
example_sentence: If artistic inspiration struck more often, many young writers would complete their novels faster.
sentence_zh: 如果藝術靈感更經常降臨，許多年輕作家會更快完成他們的小說。

definition_zh: (形) 鼓舞人心的；激勵的　(形) 令人受到啟發的；富有靈感的
example_sentence: The athlete's comeback story proved inspirational to millions of young people.
sentence_zh: 那位運動員的復出故事對數百萬年輕人證明是鼓舞人心的。

definition_zh: (動) 激勵；鼓舞
example_sentence: Inspired by her mentor's success, the student worked harder to achieve her goals.
sentence_zh: 受到導師成功的啟發，這位學生更加努力以達成她的目標。

definition_zh: (形) 鼓舞人心的；激勵人的　(動) 啟發；激勵
example_sentence: Because the teacher's inspiring words motivated the students, many of them worked harder on their studies.
sentence_zh: 因為老師鼓舞人心的話語激勵了學生們，他們許多人在功課上更加努力。

definition_zh: (名) 不穩定；不安定　(名) 搖晃；波動
example_sentence: Never has political instability affected student life more severely than during election season.
sentence_zh: 政治不穩定在選舉季節對學生生活的影響從未如此嚴重。

definition_zh: (動) 安裝；設置　(動) 就任；讓...就職
example_sentence: The software that the technician installed on the school computer works perfectly.
sentence_zh: 技術人員安裝在學校電腦上的軟體運作完美。

definition_zh: (名) 安裝；裝置　(名) 設施；基地
example_sentence: The company hired workers to install solar panels on the roof.
sentence_zh: 這家公司雇用工人在屋頂上安裝太陽能板。

definition_zh: (名) 分期付款；部分款項　(名) 連載篇章；集數
example_sentence: Buying a car through monthly installments makes it affordable for many families.
sentence_zh: 通過每月分期付款購買汽車使許多家庭能夠負擔得起。

definition_zh: (名) 例子；實例　(名) 情況；情形
example_sentence: For instance, studying English every day helps improve your test scores.
sentence_zh: 例如，每天讀英文有助於提高你的考試成績。

definition_zh: (名) 瞬間；一瞬　(形) 立即的；即時的　(副) 立刻；馬上
example_sentence: The student submitted the homework the instant the teacher opened the online platform.
sentence_zh: 學生在老師一打開線上平臺，就立刻提交了功課。

definition_zh: (形) 瞬間的；即時的　(形) 立刻的；同時發生的
example_sentence: Occurring instantaneously, the chemical reaction produced bright light and intense heat.
sentence_zh: 化學反應瞬間發生，產生了耀眼的光和強烈的熱。

definition_zh: (副) 立刻；馬上　(副) 瞬間地；即時地
example_sentence: The message that arrived instantly made the student feel relieved about the exam result.
sentence_zh: 立刻到達的訊息讓學生對考試結果感到放心。

definition_zh: (介) 代替；而不是　(連) 不是…而是
example_sentence: If students studied grammar instead of memorizing vocabulary lists, exam scores would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生研習文法而不是死記單字清單，考試成績會顯著進步。

definition_zh: (副) 代替；反而　(介) 而不是
example_sentence: Instead of playing video games, students should spend time studying for the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 學生應該花時間準備學測，而不是玩電子遊戲。

definition_zh: (名) 本能；直覺　(動) 憑直覺驅使
example_sentence: Animals rely on instinct to survive and find food in the wild.
sentence_zh: 動物依靠本能在野外生存和尋找食物。

definition_zh: (形) 本能的；直覺的　(形) 自然反應的；天生的
example_sentence: When danger approaches, running away is an instinctive reaction for most animals.
sentence_zh: 當危險來臨時，逃跑對大多數動物來說是一種本能反應。

definition_zh: (副) 本能地；直覺地　(副) 不假思索地；自然而然地
example_sentence: Instinctively reaching for the phone, the student checked the exam result immediately after logging in.
sentence_zh: 那名學生本能地伸手拿起手機，登入後立刻查看考試成績。

definition_zh: (名) 機構；研究所　(動) 建立；設立
example_sentence: Having instituted new policies, the research institute quickly improved its academic reputation.
sentence_zh: 建立了新政策後，該研究所迅速提升了學術聲譽。

definition_zh: (名) 機構；制度　(名) 慈善機關；學校
example_sentence: The university is a prestigious institution that has educated generations of leaders.
sentence_zh: 這所大學是一個培育出許多領袖的著名機構。

definition_zh: (形) 制度的；機構的　(形) 體制上的；組織性的
example_sentence: The university's institutional policies require all students to complete community service hours.
sentence_zh: 這所大學的制度政策要求所有學生完成社區服務時數。

definition_zh: (動) 指導；教導　(動) 命令；通知
example_sentence: If the teacher instructed students more clearly, they would understand the math concept better.
sentence_zh: 如果老師教導學生更清楚，他們會更好地理解數學概念。

definition_zh: (名) 指示；說明　(名) 教學；指導
example_sentence: The teacher gave clear instructions on how to complete the science project.
sentence_zh: 老師給了關於如何完成科學專題的清楚說明。

definition_zh: (形) 有教育意義的；啟發性的　富有指導意義的；有益的
example_sentence: Taking notes while listening to lectures, students gain instructive knowledge helping their exam preparation.
sentence_zh: 學生在聽講座時做筆記，獲得有教育意義的知識，幫助準備考試。

definition_zh: (名) 教練；講師　(名) 指導者；教官
example_sentence: As the swimming instructor demonstrated the technique, students watched carefully before entering the pool.
sentence_zh: 當游泳教練示範技巧時，學生在進入泳池前仔細觀看。

definition_zh: (名) 樂器；工具　(名) 儀器；裝置
example_sentence: Only after mastering the piano does this musician truly appreciate the instrument's beauty.
sentence_zh: 只有在精通鋼琴之後，這位音樂家才真正欣賞到這件樂器的美。

definition_zh: (形) 有幫助的；起重要作用的　(形) 器樂的；用樂器演奏的
example_sentence: The new technology, which proved instrumental in solving the problem, was developed by local engineers.
sentence_zh: 新技術在解決問題上起了關鍵作用，它是由當地工程師開發的。

definition_zh: (名) 儀器；工具　(名) 樂器的應用或組合
example_sentence: Engineers used advanced instrumentation to measure the bridge's structural stability.
sentence_zh: 工程師使用先進的儀器來測量橋樑的結構穩定性。

definition_zh: (形) 不服從的；違抗的　(名) 違抗者；不服從的人
example_sentence: The insubordinate employee refused to follow the manager's instructions and faced immediate dismissal.
sentence_zh: 那位違抗上司的員工拒絕遵守經理的指示，因此面臨立即解僱。

definition_zh: (形) 不足的；不夠的　(形) 不充分的；缺乏的
example_sentence: Insufficient sleep before the exam hurt his test performance.
sentence_zh: 考試前睡眠不足傷害了他的考試表現。

definition_zh: (動) 隔離；使孤立　(動) 絕緣；隔熱
example_sentence: Since the house was insulated with thick walls, the family stayed warm throughout the cold winter.
sentence_zh: 因為房子用厚牆隔熱，所以家人整個寒冬都保持溫暖。

definition_zh: (名) 胰島素；由胰臟分泌調節血糖的激素
example_sentence: Lacking sufficient insulin production, diabetic patients must inject this hormone daily.
sentence_zh: 由於缺乏足夠的胰島素分泌，糖尿病患者必須每天注射這種激素。

definition_zh: (動) [In`s^lt] 侮辱；辱罵　(名) [`Ins^lt] 侮辱；無禮
example_sentence: The rude comment that he made was an insult to everyone in the classroom.
sentence_zh: 他說的那句粗魯的評論是對全班同學的侮辱。

definition_zh: (名) 保險；保險單　(名) 保障；保護措施
example_sentence: If students buy travel insurance before the trip, unexpected medical costs will be covered.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在旅行前購買旅遊保險，突發醫療費用就會獲得賠償。

definition_zh: (動) 保險；確保
example_sentence: Buying travel insurance will insure your safety during the trip.
sentence_zh: 購買旅遊保險將確保你在旅程中的安全。

definition_zh: (名) 保險公司；保險人
example_sentence: Homeowners contact their insurer to file a claim after the storm.
sentence_zh: 屋主在暴風雨後聯絡保險公司以提出索賠。

definition_zh: (名) 叛亂者；反抗者　(形) 造反的；叛亂的
example_sentence: Armed insurgents fought against government forces in the conflict zone.
sentence_zh: 武裝叛亂者在衝突地區與政府軍隊對抗。

definition_zh: (名) 武裝叛亂；起義
example_sentence: Although the insurrection was quickly suppressed, it sparked widespread discussion about government policies.
sentence_zh: 雖然武裝叛亂很快被鎮壓，但它引發了對政府政策的廣泛討論。

definition_zh: (形) 與起義相關的；與暴動有關的
example_sentence: Having launched insurrectional activities across the region, the rebel movement quickly gained public support.
sentence_zh: 在整個地區發起了起義活動後，反抗運動迅速獲得了公眾支持。

definition_zh: (形) 完整的；未損壞的　(形) 未受影響的；保持原狀的
example_sentence: The ancient pottery, which remained intact despite centuries of burial, amazed museum archaeologists worldwide.
sentence_zh: 這件古代陶器儘管埋藏了幾個世紀，但保持完整，讓世界各地的博物館考古學家感到驚嘆。

definition_zh: (名) 攝入量；進氣　(動) 吸入；納入
example_sentence: Daily water intake and balanced nutrition support better academic performance.
sentence_zh: 每日的水分攝入和均衡營養有助於更好的學業表現。

definition_zh: (形) 無形的；摸不到的　(名) 無形資產；無形物
example_sentence: If brand reputation were intangible, companies would struggle to measure its true value.
sentence_zh: 如果品牌聲譽是無形的，公司就會很難衡量其真實價值。

definition_zh: (形) 必不可少的；不可或缺的　(名) 積分
example_sentence: Regular exercise is integral to maintaining good health and fitness.
sentence_zh: 定期運動對維持良好的健康和體適能是不可或缺的。

definition_zh: (動) 整合；融合　(動) 使…融入；使…一體化
example_sentence: Integrating different cultural perspectives, the international team created an innovative project.
sentence_zh: 將不同的文化觀點融合在一起，這個國際團隊創造了一個創新的專案。

definition_zh: (名) 整合；融合　(名) 種族融合；一體化
example_sentence: As cultural integration progresses, young people embrace diverse traditions from different backgrounds.
sentence_zh: 隨著文化整合的進展，年輕人接受來自不同背景的多元傳統。

definition_zh: (名) 正直；誠實　(名) 完整性；整體
example_sentence: Not only does honest business practice matter; integrity in daily conduct does too.
sentence_zh: 不只誠實的商業行為重要；日常行為中的正直也同樣重要。

definition_zh: (名) 智力；理智　(名) 聰慧的人；知識份子
example_sentence: Students whose intellect is sharpened by reading widely often excel in examinations.
sentence_zh: 智力透過廣泛閱讀而磨練的學生常在考試中表現優異。

definition_zh: (形) 聰慧的；智慧的　(名) 知識份子；聰慧的人
example_sentence: Many students study hard to become intellectual leaders in their communities.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力念書以成為社區中的知識領袖。

definition_zh: (副) 聰慧地；理智地　用理性或智力的方式
example_sentence: Solving difficult math problems requires thinking intellectually rather than just memorizing formulas.
sentence_zh: 解決困難的數學問題需要理性思考，而不只是死記公式。

definition_zh: (名) 智力；聰慧　(名) 情報；資訊
example_sentence: High intelligence helps students solve difficult math problems quickly.
sentence_zh: 高度的智力幫助學生快速解決困難的數學問題。

definition_zh: (形) 聰慧的；有智慧的　(形) 聰明的；聰敏的
example_sentence: Although the problem seemed difficult, the student solved it because intelligent thinking helped her find the key.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個問題看似困難，但因為聰慧的思考幫助她找到關鍵，這名學生解決了它。

definition_zh: (副) 聰慧地；智慧地　(副) 理解地；懂得地
example_sentence: Designing the website intelligently, the team created a user-friendly interface that impressed all clients.
sentence_zh: 該團隊聰慧地設計網站，創造了一個讓所有客戶印象深刻的使用者友善介面。

definition_zh: (形) 容易理解的；清晰的　(形) 可以聽懂的；明白的
example_sentence: The teacher's explanation was so intelligible that even struggling students understood the complex math concept.
sentence_zh: 老師的解釋清晰易懂，連成績落後的學生都理解了複雜的數學概念。

definition_zh: (動) 打算；想要　(動) 意圖；目的
example_sentence: If students intend to improve their test scores, they must study harder.
sentence_zh: 如果學生打算提高考試成績，他們必須更努力地讀書。

definition_zh: (形) 強烈的；激烈的　(形) 認真的；專注的
example_sentence: The intense heat during summer makes studying difficult for many students.
sentence_zh: 夏季強烈的熱氣使許多學生難以專心讀書。

definition_zh: (副) 強烈地；熱烈地　(副) 深深地；極度地
example_sentence: Students study intensely to prepare for the CSAT entrance examination.
sentence_zh: 學生們為了準備學測入學考試而強烈地用功讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 增強；加強　(名) 加劇；激化
example_sentence: The intensification of climate change requires governments and citizens to take immediate action together.
sentence_zh: 氣候變遷的加劇需要政府和民眾一起立即採取行動。

definition_zh: (動) 加強；增強　(動) 使更激烈；惡化
example_sentence: As the competition intensified, the team trained harder every day.
sentence_zh: 隨著比賽加劇，球隊每天訓練得更加努力。

definition_zh: (名) 強度；強烈程度　(名) 熱烈；專注
example_sentence: Having intensified training for months, the athlete's intensity in competition impressed everyone.
sentence_zh: 經過數月強化訓練後，該運動員在比賽中的專注度給所有人留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (形) 密集的；強烈的　(形) 集中的；深入的
example_sentence: The intensive English course that Maria enrolled in requires daily practice and homework.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞報名的密集英文課程需要每天練習和做功課。

definition_zh: (副) 集中地；密集地　深入地；徹底地
example_sentence: The students studied intensively for three months before taking the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們在參加學測考試前密集地準備了三個月。

definition_zh: (名) 意圖；目的　(形) 專注的；認真的
example_sentence: If the company's intent were to maximize profits, it would abandon environmental responsibility entirely.
sentence_zh: 如果該公司的意圖是要最大化利潤，它就會完全放棄環保責任。

definition_zh: (名) 意圖；目的　(名) 打算；想法
example_sentence: The student's intention was to improve her English before the exam.
sentence_zh: 那位學生的意圖是在考試前提高英文。

definition_zh: (形) 故意的；有意的　(副) 故意地；有意地
example_sentence: Intentionally breaking the classroom rule, the student faced serious consequences.
sentence_zh: 那名學生故意打破教室規則，面臨了嚴重的後果。

definition_zh: (副) 故意地；有意地　刻意地；蓄意地
example_sentence: Maria intentionally arrived late to the meeting so she could avoid giving the presentation.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞故意遲到參加會議，以便避免做報告。

definition_zh: (動) 埋葬；安葬　(動) 插入；置於中間
example_sentence: Only after the ceremony ended did mourners inter the coffin in the family tomb.
sentence_zh: 只有在典禮結束後，哀悼者才在家族墓地埋葬棺木。

definition_zh: (動) 互動；相互作用　(名) 互動；交互作用
example_sentence: Students who interact with their teachers regularly tend to improve their grades significantly.
sentence_zh: 經常與老師互動的學生往往會大幅提高成績。

definition_zh: (名) 交互作用；相互影響　(名) 互動；交流
example_sentence: Students need to participate in class interaction to improve their English speaking skills.
sentence_zh: 學生需要參與課堂互動以提高他們的英語口語能力。

definition_zh: (形) 互動的；互相作用的　(形) 交互式的；需要參與者互動的
example_sentence: Using interactive games and activities helps students learn English vocabulary more effectively.
sentence_zh: 使用互動遊戲和活動能幫助學生更有效地學習英文單字。

definition_zh: (副) 互動地；以互相作用的方式
example_sentence: The teacher uses software to teach English interactively with all students in class.
sentence_zh: 老師用軟體與全班學生互動地教授英文。

definition_zh: (動) 仲裁；調停　(動) 代求；說項
example_sentence: When the two friends argued bitterly, their teacher interceded to help resolve the conflict peacefully.
sentence_zh: 當兩個朋友激烈爭論時，他們的老師出面調停以幫助和平解決衝突。

definition_zh: (形) 可互換的；能替代的
example_sentence: Having interchangeable parts, the broken machine could be quickly repaired using spare components.
sentence_zh: 由於具有可互換的零件，這台壞機器可以用備用部件快速修復。

definition_zh: (名) 交流；溝通　(名) 性交；兩性關係
example_sentence: The friendly intercourse between the two countries strengthened their diplomatic relationship.
sentence_zh: 兩國間友善的交流加強了它們的外交關係。

definition_zh: (形) 無利息的；免息的
example_sentence: If the store offers interest-free installment plans, buying a laptop becomes more affordable for students.
sentence_zh: 如果店家提供免息分期付款，學生購買筆記型電腦就變得更容易負擔。

definition_zh: (名) 興趣；愛好　(名) 利息　(動) 使感興趣
example_sentence: Learning English interests many high school students preparing for exams.
sentence_zh: 學習英文使許多準備考試的高中學生感到有興趣。

definition_zh: (形) 感興趣的；有興趣的　(形) 關心的；在乎的
example_sentence: Many students attended the science fair to learn about new technology.
sentence_zh: 許多感興趣的學生參加科學展覽以了解新科技。

definition_zh: (形) 有趣的；引人入勝的　(形) 令人感興趣的；吸引人的
example_sentence: Learning about ancient Taiwan history and exploring old temples together makes weekend trips really interesting.
sentence_zh: 學習台灣古代歷史並一起探索老廟宇使得週末旅遊真的很有趣。

definition_zh: (副) 有趣地；引人注意地
example_sentence: Interestingly, many students find that studying with friends improves their test scores significantly.
sentence_zh: 有趣的是，許多學生發現與朋友一起讀書能大幅提高他們的考試成績。

definition_zh: (動) 干擾；妨礙　(動) 介入；插手
example_sentence: Having interfered with the experiment, the scientist repeated the whole process carefully.
sentence_zh: 在干擾了實驗後，科學家仔細地重複了整個過程。

definition_zh: (名) 干擾；妨礙　(名) 干涉；介入
example_sentence: The radio interference that disturbed the signal forced the engineers to adjust their equipment.
sentence_zh: 那個干擾了訊號的無線電干擾迫使工程師調整他們的設備。

definition_zh: (形) 暫時的；臨時的　(名) 過渡期；中間時期
example_sentence: The interim principal will lead the school until a permanent replacement arrives next semester.
sentence_zh: 這位臨時校長將領導學校，直到下學期有正式替代人選到任。

definition_zh: (形) 內部的；室內的　(名) 內部；室內
example_sentence: If the designer would rearrange the interior space, the apartment would feel much more spacious.
sentence_zh: 如果設計師重新安排室內空間，這間公寓會感覺寬敞得多。

definition_zh: (動) 互相連接；咬合　(名) 互鎖裝置；連鎖機制
example_sentence: The puzzle pieces interlock perfectly to form a complete picture.
sentence_zh: 拼圖的碎片完美地互相連接，形成一幅完整的圖畫。

definition_zh: (名) 中介人；仲介者　(形) 居中的；中間的
example_sentence: Acting as an intermediary between the two companies, the lawyer successfully resolved their business dispute.
sentence_zh: 律師充當兩家公司的中介人，成功解決了他們的商業糾紛。

definition_zh: (形) 中等的；中級的　(名) 中級者；中介物
example_sentence: As the course progresses to intermediate level, students must master more complex grammar structures.
sentence_zh: 當課程進展到中級程度時，學生必須掌握更複雜的文法結構。

definition_zh: (名) 中場休息；幕間休息　(名) 暫停；間斷
example_sentence: Only after the intermission did the audience return to their seats for the second act.
sentence_zh: 只有在中場休息後，觀眾才回到座位看第二幕。

definition_zh: (形) 間歇的；斷斷續續的　(形) 不連續的；時有時無的
example_sentence: The intermittent rain that fell throughout the morning made outdoor activities difficult for students.
sentence_zh: 整個上午斷斷續續下的雨使學生們難以進行戶外活動。

definition_zh: (副) 間歇地；時斷時續地　(副) 不連續地；斷斷續續地
example_sentence: The student reviewed vocabulary intermittently to reinforce long-term memory retention.
sentence_zh: 這名學生間歇地複習詞彙，以加強長期記憶保留。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈɪntɝn] 實習生；見習生　(動) [ɪnˈtɝn] 實習；做實習生
example_sentence: Working as an intern at a law firm teaches practical skills beyond textbooks.
sentence_zh: 在律師事務所做實習生能學到課本以外的實用技能。

definition_zh: (形) 內部的；內在的　(形) 體內的；內臟的
example_sentence: The doctor examined the patient's internal organs carefully.
sentence_zh: 醫生仔細檢查了病人的內臟器官。

definition_zh: (形) 國際的；國際間的　(副) 國際上；在國際範圍內
example_sentence: As international trade grows, many companies expand their business to different countries.
sentence_zh: 隨著國際貿易成長，許多公司將業務擴展到不同國家。

definition_zh: (副) 在國際上；國際地　(副) 跨越國家；世界範圍內
example_sentence: Having studied internationally, many graduates find employment opportunities across different continents.
sentence_zh: 曾在國際上學習過的許多畢業生在不同大陸找到工作機會。

definition_zh: (名) 網際網路；網路
example_sentence: The internet, which connects billions of people worldwide, has changed how students learn and communicate.
sentence_zh: 網際網路連接了全球數十億人，它改變了學生學習和溝通的方式。

definition_zh: (名) 實習；實習期　(名) 實習生的職位
example_sentence: If students complete a summer internship at a tech company, they will gain valuable work experience.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在科技公司完成暑期實習，他們將獲得寶貴的工作經驗。

definition_zh: (動) 解釋；詮釋　(動) 翻譯；傳譯
example_sentence: The tour guide interpreted the ancient temple's history for visiting students.
sentence_zh: 導遊為參訪的學生解釋了古廟的歷史。

definition_zh: (名) 解釋；說明　(名) 詮釋；表演方式
example_sentence: The director's interpretation of the play helps the audience understand the characters' emotions.
sentence_zh: 導演對該劇的詮釋幫助觀眾理解角色的情感。

definition_zh: (名) 口譯員；翻譯者　(名) 解釋者；闡述者
example_sentence: The conference interpreter translated the speech from English into Mandarin smoothly.
sentence_zh: 會議口譯員流暢地將演講從英文翻譯成普通話。

definition_zh: (形) 疑問的；詢問的　(名) 疑問詞；疑問句
example_sentence: Because the teacher used an interrogative tone, students knew she wanted answers rather than agreements.
sentence_zh: 因為老師使用疑問的語氣，學生知道她想要的是答案而非同意。

definition_zh: (動) 打斷；中斷　(動) 插嘴；干擾
example_sentence: Having interrupted the meeting multiple times, the manager finally let others speak freely.
sentence_zh: 那位經理已經多次打斷會議，最後終於讓其他人自由發言。

definition_zh: (名) 中斷；打擾　(動) 打斷；插話
example_sentence: The meeting, which suffered several interruptions from phone calls, ended late.
sentence_zh: 那場會議受到多次電話打擾，結束時已很晚。

definition_zh: (形) 打斷的；中斷的　(形) 容易中斷的；干擾的
example_sentence: The constant phone notifications create an interruptive environment that reduces student concentration during study time.
sentence_zh: 持續的手機通知會製造一個容易打斷的環境，減少學生在讀書時間的專注力。

definition_zh: (動) 相交；交叉　(動) 穿過；橫越
example_sentence: If two roads intersected at that corner, traffic accidents would happen frequently.
sentence_zh: 如果兩條道路在那個角落相交，交通事故就會頻繁發生。

definition_zh: (名) 交叉點；十字路口　(名) 交集；相交部分
example_sentence: The car stopped at the intersection while waiting for the traffic light to turn green.
sentence_zh: 那輛車在十字路口停下，等著紅綠燈轉綠。

definition_zh: (形) 涉及多個相交層面的；考慮多重身分交集的
example_sentence: Recognizing intersectional discrimination, schools must support students facing overlapping challenges based on gender, race, and family background.
sentence_zh: 認識到交集性的歧視，學校必須支持面臨多重挑戰的學生，這些挑戰基於性別、種族和家庭背景的交集。

definition_zh: (動) 散佈；夾雜　(動) 點綴；分散
example_sentence: As the chef prepared the dish, interspersing fresh herbs throughout the ingredients created a balanced flavor.
sentence_zh: 當廚師準備菜餚時，在材料中夾雜新鮮香草創造了平衡的風味。

definition_zh: (形) 州際的；各州之間的　(名) 州際公路
example_sentence: Not only does the interstate highway connect distant cities, but it also stimulates economic growth across multiple states.
sentence_zh: 州際公路不僅連接遠方城市，而且促進了多州的經濟成長。

definition_zh: (動) 交織；纏繞　(動) 連結；相互關聯
example_sentence: The vines that intertwine around the old fence create a beautiful natural pattern.
sentence_zh: 纏繞在老籬笆周圍的藤蔓創造出美麗的自然圖案。

definition_zh: (名) 間隔；間隙　(名) 休息時間；中場休息
example_sentence: Students need short intervals to rest and recharge during long study sessions.
sentence_zh: 學生需要短暫的間隔時間來在長時間讀書期間休息和恢復精力。

definition_zh: (動) 干預；介入　(動) 調停；仲裁
example_sentence: The teacher intervened in the argument between two students and resolved the conflict peacefully.
sentence_zh: 老師介入了兩個學生之間的爭執，並和平地解決了衝突。

definition_zh: (名) 介入；干預　(名) 調停；制止
example_sentence: Government intervention in the economy can help stabilize prices.
sentence_zh: 政府對經濟的介入可以幫助穩定物價。

definition_zh: (名) 干涉主義者；介入政策的支持者　(形) 主張干涉的；支持介入政策的
example_sentence: Although the government claimed to be neutral, interventionist policies soon became apparent when trade barriers were raised.
sentence_zh: 雖然政府聲稱保持中立，但當貿易壁壘提高時，干涉主義政策很快就顯露出來。

definition_zh: (名) 面試；訪問　(動) 面試；採訪
example_sentence: Preparing for the job interview, Maria reviewed common questions and practiced confident answers.
sentence_zh: 瑪莉亞為了準備工作面試，複習常見問題並練習自信地回答。

definition_zh: (名) 受訪者；被面試者
example_sentence: The interviewee who prepared thoroughly answered all questions with confidence.
sentence_zh: 充分準備的受訪者自信地回答了所有問題。

definition_zh: (名) 面試官；採訪者　(動) 進行面試；採訪
example_sentence: If the interviewer asks about your weakness, you should answer honestly and constructively.
sentence_zh: 如果面試官問起你的弱點，你應該誠實且建設性地回答。

definition_zh: (名) 腸；小腸　(形) 腸的；內部的
example_sentence: The small intestine absorbs nutrients from food during digestion.
sentence_zh: 小腸在消化時吸收食物的營養。

definition_zh: (介) 萬一；如果發生；在...的情況下
example_sentence: In the event of a fire alarm, students must evacuate the building calmly to ensure everyone's safety.
sentence_zh: 萬一發生火警警報，學生必須冷靜地撤離建築物以確保每個人的安全。

definition_zh: (名) 親密；親近　(名) 私密；隱私
example_sentence: Building emotional intimacy and trust requires consistent communication between partners over time.
sentence_zh: 在伴侶之間建立情感親密和信任需要長期的持續溝通。

definition_zh: (形) [ˋɪntəmɪt] 親密的；密切的　(動) [ˋɪntəmet] 暗示；透露
example_sentence: As the two friends became more intimate, they shared secrets that few people knew.
sentence_zh: 隨著這兩個朋友變得更親密，他們分享了很少人知道的祕密。

definition_zh: (副) 親密地；密切地　(副) 深入地；詳細地
example_sentence: Having studied the novel intimately for months, the literature student could explain every character's motivation with confidence.
sentence_zh: 這位文學生經過幾個月的深入研究，已能自信地解釋每個角色的動機。

definition_zh: (形) 令人害怕的；令人感到威脅的　(動) 暗示；暗指
example_sentence: The bully's intimidating behavior, which made classmates fear confrontation, eventually led to school suspension.
sentence_zh: 那個霸凌者令人害怕的行為使同學們害怕對抗，最終導致他被學校停學。

definition_zh: (名) 暗示；隱約的跡象　(動) 暗示；間接表達
example_sentence: The teacher's subtle intimation of disappointment made students understand the assignment needed improvement.
sentence_zh: 老師對失望的微妙暗示讓學生明白作業需要改進。

definition_zh: (動) 威脅；恫嚇　(動) 使害怕；使畏縮
example_sentence: If the bully did not intimidate weaker students, the school would be a safer place.
sentence_zh: 如果那個霸凌者沒有威脅較弱的學生，學校會是個更安全的地方。

definition_zh: (形) 感到害怕的；受恐嚇的　(動) 使害怕；恐嚇
example_sentence: The new student felt intimidated by the older students' loud voices.
sentence_zh: 那位新生被哥哥姐姐們的大聲說話嚇得很害怕。

definition_zh: (形) 令人害怕的；令人感到威脅的　(動) 使害怕；威嚇
example_sentence: Facing an intimidating exam schedule, many students felt stressed and worried.
sentence_zh: 面對令人害怕的考試時間表，許多學生感到緊張和擔憂。

definition_zh: (介) 進入；到...裡面　(介) 轉變為；變成
example_sentence: As soon as Sarah walked into the classroom, she realized the test had started.
sentence_zh: 當莎拉一走進教室，她就意識到考試已經開始了。

definition_zh: (形) 無法忍受的；令人厭惡的
example_sentence: So intolerable was the heat that students could barely focus during the exam.
sentence_zh: 炎熱天氣令人無法忍受，以至於學生在考試中幾乎無法專心。

definition_zh: (形) 不寬容的；不能容忍的　(形) 無法接納異己的；狹隘的
example_sentence: People who are intolerant of different opinions often struggle to understand others' perspectives.
sentence_zh: 不能容忍不同意見的人通常很難理解他人的觀點。

definition_zh: (名) 語調；聲調　(名) 音高變化；抑揚頓挫
example_sentence: Teachers adjust intonation to make English lessons more engaging and help students understand meaning.
sentence_zh: 教師調整語調以使英文課程更引人入勝，並幫助學生理解意思。

definition_zh: (動) 使醉；使中毒　(動) 使興奮；使陶醉
example_sentence: Drinking too much alcohol intoxicates the brain and affects driving ability seriously.
sentence_zh: 喝太多酒精會使大腦中毒並嚴重影響駕駛能力。

definition_zh: (形) 喝醉的；陶醉的　(動過分) 使醉酒；使陶醉
example_sentence: After drinking too much beer at the party, David became intoxicated and could not drive home safely.
sentence_zh: 在派對上喝了太多啤酒後，大衛變得醉醺醺的，無法安全開車回家。

definition_zh: (名) 不妥協；固執立場
example_sentence: Because the two countries showed intransigence in negotiations, reaching a peace agreement became increasingly difficult.
sentence_zh: 由於兩國在談判中表現出不妥協的態度，達成和平協議變得越來越困難。

definition_zh: (形) 不妥協的；頑固的　(形) 堅決不讓步的；固執的
example_sentence: Refusing to compromise, the intransigent negotiator blocked every peace proposal.
sentence_zh: 拒絕妥協，那位頑固的談判代表阻擋了每一項和平提案。

definition_zh: (形) 無畏的；勇敢的　(形) 大膽的；無懼的
example_sentence: The intrepid explorer who discovered the remote island became famous worldwide.
sentence_zh: 那位發現偏遠島嶼的無畏探險家在全世界聲名大噪。

definition_zh: (名) 複雜性；複雜的細節　(名) 錯綜；繁難
example_sentence: If students understand the intricacy of the problem, they will solve it more successfully.
sentence_zh: 如果學生理解這個問題的複雜性，他們就會更成功地解決它。

definition_zh: (形) 複雜的；精細的　(形) 難以理解的；曲折的
example_sentence: The intricate design of the ancient temple impressed every visitor who came.
sentence_zh: 古廟複雜精細的設計給每位來訪的遊客留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (動) [In`trig] 引起興趣；吸引　激起好奇心　(名) [`Intrig] 陰謀；詭計
example_sentence: The mysterious letter was designed to intrigue readers and encourage them to discover its hidden meaning.
sentence_zh: 那封神祕的信件旨在引起讀者的興趣，並促使他們發現其隱藏的含義。

definition_zh: (形) 引起興趣的；迷人的　(形) 神秘的；令人費解的
example_sentence: The mystery box with a strange symbol and hidden treasure inside proved intriguing to all the students.
sentence_zh: 那個有著奇怪符號和隱藏寶藏的神秘盒子對所有學生來說都很引人入勝。

definition_zh: (副) 引人入勝地；神秘地
example_sentence: Intriguingly, the ancient temple's hidden room contained treasures that historians had long forgotten.
sentence_zh: 引人入勝的是，這座古廟的隱藏房間裡放著歷史學家早已遺忘的寶物。

definition_zh: (形) 內在的；本質的　固有的；與生俱來的
example_sentence: Having studied the subject deeply, Maria discovered the intrinsic value hidden beneath the surface.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞深入研究了這個主題後，發現了隱藏在表面下的內在價值。

definition_zh: (副) 本質上；根本上　從根本或固有的性質上
example_sentence: Honesty, which is intrinsically valuable to society, should never be sacrificed for personal gain.
sentence_zh: 誠實是本質上對社會有價值的，絕不應為個人利益而犧牲。

definition_zh: (動) 介紹；引入　(動) 推出；開始使用
example_sentence: The teacher introduced a new teaching method to help students learn English more effectively.
sentence_zh: 老師向學生介紹了一種新的教學方法，幫助他們更有效地學習英文。

definition_zh: (名) 介紹；引見　(名) 入門；基礎
example_sentence: If the introduction to the textbook were clearer, students would understand the main topic better.
sentence_zh: 如果課本的介紹更清楚，學生就會更了解主要主題。

definition_zh: (名) 內向；性格內斂
example_sentence: Introversion is a personality trait where people prefer quiet environments and small groups.
sentence_zh: 內向是一種人格特徵，內向的人更喜歡安靜的環境和小團體。

definition_zh: (名) 內向的人；性格內斂者　(形) 內向的；性格內斂的
example_sentence: Being an introvert, Sarah prefers studying alone rather than joining group projects at school.
sentence_zh: 由於個性內向，莎拉寧願獨自讀書，也不願在學校參加小組專題。

definition_zh: (形) 內向的；害羞的
example_sentence: Although Marcus is introverted, he still enjoys attending school social events with friends.
sentence_zh: 雖然馬克斯性格內向，但他仍然喜歡和朋友參加學校的社交活動。

definition_zh: (動) 侵入；打擾　(動) 擅自進入；闖入
example_sentence: Hardly had the guests arrived when unwanted noise intruded upon the quiet garden.
sentence_zh: 客人才剛到達，不速之客的噪音就侵擾了寧靜的花園。

definition_zh: (名) 入侵者；闖入者　(名) 不速之客；侵略者
example_sentence: The security guard caught the intruder who had broken into the museum at midnight.
sentence_zh: 保安抓住了在午夜闖入博物館的入侵者。

definition_zh: (名) 侵入；干擾　(動) 侵犯；打擾
example_sentence: The school installed security cameras to prevent student intrusion into restricted areas.
sentence_zh: 學校安裝安全攝影機以防止學生侵入禁區。

definition_zh: (形) 侵入性的；打擾人的　(形) 不受歡迎的；冒昧的
example_sentence: Constant notifications from social media apps can be intrusive and distract students from studying.
sentence_zh: 社群媒體應用程式的持續通知可能具有侵入性，會分散學生的學習注意力。

definition_zh: (名) 直覺；憑直覺；不經思考的理解
example_sentence: Maria's intuition told her the test would be difficult.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞的直覺告訴她這次考試會很難。

definition_zh: (形) 直覺的；憑直覺的　(副) 直覺地；憑直覺
example_sentence: Because the app interface is intuitive, users can navigate it without reading the manual.
sentence_zh: 因為這個應用程式的介面很直覺，使用者不需要閱讀說明書就能操作。

definition_zh: (動) 淹沒；大量湧入　(名) 洪水；大量涌入
example_sentence: Inundated with homework, students barely had time to relax after school.
sentence_zh: 被大量功課淹沒，學生課後幾乎沒有時間放鬆。

definition_zh: (動) 淹沒；大量湧入　(動) 淹水；淹沒
example_sentence: The coastal town, which was inundated by heavy rainfall, needed emergency rescue efforts.
sentence_zh: 那個被暴雨淹沒的沿海城鎮需要緊急救援工作。

definition_zh: (形) 淹沒的；被淹沒的　(動過去分詞) 淹沒；氾濫成災
example_sentence: If heavy rain continues, the coastal village will be inundated with floodwaters.
sentence_zh: 如果大雨持續，沿海村莊將被洪水淹沒。

definition_zh: (名) 淹沒；氾濫　(名) 大量湧入；充斥
example_sentence: Heavy rainfall caused serious inundation in the coastal town.
sentence_zh: 大雨導致沿海城鎮發生嚴重的淹沒災害。

definition_zh: (動) 入侵；侵略　(動) 闖入；打擾
example_sentence: The enemy army planned to invade the neighboring country to expand their territory.
sentence_zh: 敵軍計劃入侵鄰國以擴大他們的領土。

definition_zh: (形) 無效的；作廢的　(名) 病人；患者
example_sentence: The contract became invalid after the company failed to sign all required documents.
sentence_zh: 在公司未能簽署所有必要文件後，該合約變得無效。

definition_zh: (形) 極其寶貴的；無法估價的
example_sentence: Although the old photograph was damaged, it remained invaluable because it captured a precious family memory.
sentence_zh: 雖然那張舊照片已受損，但它仍然無法估價，因為它捕捉了珍貴的家庭回憶。

definition_zh: (形) 不變的；恆定的　(副) 始終；向來
example_sentence: Having remained invariable for decades, the school's admission standards attracted students from across the island.
sentence_zh: 該校的入學標準幾十年來保持不變，吸引了全島各地的學生。

definition_zh: (副) 總是；不變地　永遠不變地；始終如一地
example_sentence: The quality of service, which invariably meets our high standards, makes this restaurant popular.
sentence_zh: 這家餐廳的服務品質始終符合我們的高標準，因此很受歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 入侵；侵略　(名) 大量湧入；入侵
example_sentence: The alien invasion in the science fiction movie scared many audience members during the premiere.
sentence_zh: 科幻電影中的外星人入侵在首映時嚇到許多觀眾。

definition_zh: (形) 侵入的；入侵的　(形) 擴散的；蔓延的
example_sentence: If invasive species were not controlled quickly, native plants would disappear from the island.
sentence_zh: 如果入侵物種沒有被快速控制，原生植物就會從島上消失。

definition_zh: (動) 發明；創造　(動) 編造；捏造
example_sentence: Thomas Edison invented the electric light bulb in 1879.
sentence_zh: 湯瑪斯愛迪生在1879年發明了電燈泡。

definition_zh: (名) 發明；發明物　(名) 創意；創新
example_sentence: Having invented a revolutionary smartphone app, the young engineer's invention quickly attracted millions of users.
sentence_zh: 這位年輕工程師發明了一款革命性的智慧手機應用程式，他的發明迅速吸引了數百萬用戶。

definition_zh: (形) 有創意的；富於發明的　(形) 新穎的；獨特的
example_sentence: Although the restaurant's menu was inventive, many dishes were too strange for traditional diners.
sentence_zh: 雖然這家餐廳的菜單很有創意，但許多菜餚對傳統食客來說太奇怪了。

definition_zh: (名) 發明家；創造者
example_sentence: Not only did the inventor create the light bulb, but also revolutionized modern life.
sentence_zh: 這位發明家不僅創造了燈泡，而且還改革了現代生活。

definition_zh: (名) 庫存；存貨　(名) 詳細清單；盤點
example_sentence: The store checked the inventory that had been sitting in the warehouse for months.
sentence_zh: 這家店盤點了在倉庫裡放了好幾個月的存貨。

definition_zh: (名) ['ɪnvɝt] 倒置物　(動) [ɪn'vɝt] 翻轉；顛倒；反轉
example_sentence: The gymnast inverted her body to perform an impressive handstand on the balance beam.
sentence_zh: 這位體操選手翻轉身體以在平衡木上表演令人印象深刻的倒立。

definition_zh: (形) 倒轉的；顛倒的　(動) 反轉；使上下顛倒
example_sentence: The inverted pyramid structure helps readers find important news information quickly.
sentence_zh: 倒金字塔結構幫助讀者迅速找到重要的新聞資訊。

definition_zh: (動) 投資；花錢購買　(動) 投入時間或精力
example_sentence: Many young people invest in stocks to build wealth for the future.
sentence_zh: 許多年輕人投資股票以為未來累積財富。

definition_zh: (動) 調查；偵查　(動) 研究；檢查
example_sentence: As the police investigated the crime scene, new evidence emerged that solved the case.
sentence_zh: 當警察調查犯罪現場時，新的證據出現並解決了這個案件。

definition_zh: (名) 調查；偵查　(名) 研究；探查
example_sentence: Investigating the accident thoroughly, the police officers found crucial evidence at the scene.
sentence_zh: 警察人員徹底調查該事故，在現場發現了關鍵證據。

definition_zh: (名) 調查員；偵查人員
example_sentence: The investigator who examined the crime scene found crucial evidence at the location.
sentence_zh: 檢視犯罪現場的調查員在該地點發現了關鍵證據。

definition_zh: (名) 投資；投資額　(名) 被投資的東西；投資物
example_sentence: If students make wise investment decisions early, their future financial security will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生早期做出明智的投資決定，他們未來的財務安全將會顯著改善。

definition_zh: (名) 投資者；投資人
example_sentence: Successful investors study market trends and make smart financial decisions.
sentence_zh: 成功的投資者研究市場趨勢，做出聰明的財務決定。

definition_zh: (形) 令人不滿的；引起嫉妒的　引起怨恨的；不公平的
example_sentence: The teacher avoided making invidious comparisons to prevent students from feeling discouraged.
sentence_zh: 老師避免做出令人不滿的比較，以防學生感到灰心。

definition_zh: (形) 看不見的；無形的　(形) 隱形的；不可見的
example_sentence: Wearing an invisible coat in the magical world, Harry Potter escaped from his enemies.
sentence_zh: 在魔法世界裡穿著隱形斗篷，哈利波特從敵人手中逃脫了。

definition_zh: (名) 邀請；邀請函
example_sentence: Since Sarah received the invitation to the graduation party, she has been excited for weeks.
sentence_zh: 由於莎拉收到畢業派對的邀請函，她已經興奮了好幾週。

definition_zh: (動) 邀請；邀約　(動) 吸引；引起
example_sentence: Having invited several classmates over, Sarah prepared snacks and games for the party.
sentence_zh: 莎拉邀請了幾位同學來家裡後，她準備了零食和遊戲來舉辦派對。

definition_zh: (動) 邀請；邀約　(動) 引發；招致
example_sentence: The students who were invited to the graduation ceremony felt very honored.
sentence_zh: 被邀請參加畢業典禮的學生感到非常榮幸。

definition_zh: (形) 吸引人的；誘人的　(動) 邀請；招待
example_sentence: The warm sunlight and fresh sea breeze make the beach very inviting on summer afternoons.
sentence_zh: 溫暖的陽光和清新的海風使得海灘在夏日午後非常吸引人。

definition_zh: (副) 誘人地；吸引人地
example_sentence: If the café displayed its desserts invitingly in the window, more customers would stop by daily.
sentence_zh: 如果咖啡館在窗邊誘人地展示甜點，每天就會有更多客人停下來。

definition_zh: (名) ['ɪnvɔɪs] 發票；請款單　(動) [ɪn'vɔɪs] 開發票；結帳
example_sentence: The company sent the customer an invoice for the goods delivered last week.
sentence_zh: 公司寄給客戶一張上週交付的商品發票。

definition_zh: (動) 祈求；懇求　援用；引用
example_sentence: Invoking ancient wisdom, the teacher inspired students to think deeply about life.
sentence_zh: 援用古代智慧，老師激勵學生深入思考人生。

definition_zh: (副) 不自願地；無意中　被迫地；身不由己地
example_sentence: When the fire alarm rang, everyone evacuated the building involuntarily, even though it was just a drill.
sentence_zh: 當火警警報響起時，雖然只是演習，但每個人都不自願地疏散了大樓。

definition_zh: (形) 非自願的；無意識的　(形) 無法控制的；被迫的
example_sentence: Hardly ever do involuntary muscle movements occur without some underlying physical cause.
sentence_zh: 幾乎不會有無意識的肌肉運動發生，除非有潛在的生理原因。

definition_zh: (動) 涉及；牽涉　(動) 使參與；讓...參加
example_sentence: The project that involves teamwork and creativity excites most students.
sentence_zh: 那個涉及團隊合作和創意的專案讓大多數學生感到興奮。

definition_zh: (形) 涉及的；參與的　(動) 涉及；牽涉
example_sentence: Students joined the volunteer project to become involved in community service.
sentence_zh: 學生參加志工項目是為了參與社區服務。

definition_zh: (名) 參與；涉及　(名) 投入；牽連
example_sentence: Increasing involvement in school clubs helps students develop leadership skills and make lasting friendships.
sentence_zh: 增加對學校社團的參與能幫助學生發展領導能力並建立長久的友誼。

definition_zh: (形) 向內的；內部的　(副) 向內；朝裡面
example_sentence: The door opens inward, so be careful when entering the room.
sentence_zh: 這扇門向內開，所以進房間時要小心。

definition_zh: (名) 離子；帶電粒子
example_sentence: As the salt dissolves in water, ions separate and conduct electricity through the solution.
sentence_zh: 當鹽溶解在水中時，離子分離並通過溶液傳導電流。

definition_zh: (名) 智商；智力商數
example_sentence: Having a high IQ, the student quickly solved the complex math problem.
sentence_zh: 擁有高智商，這名學生迅速解決了複雜的數學問題。

definition_zh: (名) 憤怒；怒火　(動) 激怒；惹怒
example_sentence: The unfair rules that sparked public ire forced the government to revise its policy.
sentence_zh: 引發公眾憤怒的不公平規則迫使政府修改其政策。

definition_zh: (名) 愛爾蘭（歐洲國家）；愛爾蘭島
example_sentence: If tourists visit Ireland, they will discover beautiful green landscapes and rich cultural heritage.
sentence_zh: 如果遊客造訪愛爾蘭，他們將發現美麗的綠色風景和豐富的文化遺產。

definition_zh: (形) 愛爾蘭的；愛爾蘭人的　(名) 愛爾蘭人；愛爾蘭語
example_sentence: Many Irish families celebrate St. Brigid's Day with traditional music and green decorations.
sentence_zh: 許多愛爾蘭家庭用傳統音樂和綠色裝飾慶祝聖布里吉德節。

definition_zh: (名) 鐵；熨斗　(動) 熨燙；解決　(形) 堅硬的；鐵製的
example_sentence: Students use an iron to press their uniforms before school every morning.
sentence_zh: 學生每天早上上學前用熨斗熨燙制服。

definition_zh: (形) 堅不可摧的；無懈可擊的　(形) 鐵甲的；用鐵包裹的
example_sentence: The contract contained ironclad guarantees protecting both the company and its employees.
sentence_zh: 這份合約包含了保護公司和員工的堅不可摧的保證條款。

definition_zh: (形) 諷刺的；具有反諷意義的　(形) 與預期相反的；出人意料的
example_sentence: Although the fire safety officer warned about danger, ironically the building caught fire the very next day.
sentence_zh: 雖然消防官員警告過危險，諷刺的是，那棟建築物卻在隔天就失火了。

definition_zh: (副) 諷刺地；有諷刺意味地　(副) 出人意料地；令人啼笑皆非地
example_sentence: Having studied hard for months, the student ironically failed the exam due to careless mistakes.
sentence_zh: 那名學生經過數月的努力準備，結果卻因粗心大意而考試不及格，實在令人啼笑皆非。

definition_zh: (名) 諷刺；反諷　(名) 出乎意料的情況；戲劇化的巧合
example_sentence: The irony that troubled her most was the situation in which success brought her loneliness.
sentence_zh: 最讓她感到諷刺的是成功反而為她帶來孤獨的局面。

definition_zh: (形) 不理性的；無理由的　(形) 不合理的；不符邏輯的
example_sentence: Buying expensive clothes without thinking is irrational and wasteful behavior.
sentence_zh: 不經思考就購買昂貴衣服是不理性且浪費的行為。

definition_zh: (形) 不規則的；不規律的　(形) 不均勻的；參差不齐的
example_sentence: If the bus schedule were not so irregular, commuting to school would be much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果公車時刻表不是那麼不規律，上學通勤會容易得多。

definition_zh: (副) 不規則地；無規律地
example_sentence: The bus arrives irregularly, so commuters often wait longer than expected.
sentence_zh: 公車不規則地到達，所以通勤者經常等待比預期更長的時間。

definition_zh: (形) 無關的；不相關的　(形) 不適用的；不恰當的
example_sentence: Having little interest in sports, the new student found gym class irrelevant to personal goals.
sentence_zh: 由於對運動興趣不大，這位新同學認為體育課與個人目標無關。

definition_zh: (形) 無法修復的；不可挽回的
example_sentence: Although the company tried to fix the problem, the damage to its reputation was irreparable.
sentence_zh: 儘管公司試圖解決問題，但對其聲譽的傷害是無法挽回的。

definition_zh: (副) 無法修復地；不可挽救地
example_sentence: Not only was the ancient temple damaged, but the irreparably harmed artifacts were lost forever.
sentence_zh: 那座古廟不僅受損，而且那些無法修復的文物也永遠丟失了。

definition_zh: (形) 無法取代的；珍貴獨特的
example_sentence: The friendship that develops through years of shared experience is irreplaceable.
sentence_zh: 經過多年共同經歷而建立的友誼是無法取代的。

definition_zh: (形) 無法抗拒的；難以抵抗的
example_sentence: The delicious chocolate cake was irresistible, so everyone ate two pieces.
sentence_zh: 那個美味的巧克力蛋糕無法抗拒，所以每個人都吃了兩片。

definition_zh: (形) 不管；不論　(介) 不論；無論
example_sentence: Irrespective of weather conditions, the school sports day will proceed as planned.
sentence_zh: 不論天氣如何，學校運動會都會按計畫進行。

definition_zh: (形) 不負責任的；不可靠的
example_sentence: Leaving homework incomplete is irresponsible behavior that affects your grades.
sentence_zh: 不完成功課是不負責任的行為，會影響你的成績。

definition_zh: (形) 不可逆轉的；無法改變的
example_sentence: Since the decision was irreversible, the company had to accept the consequences and move forward.
sentence_zh: 因為這個決定是不可逆轉的，公司必須接受後果並向前邁進。

definition_zh: (形) 不可撤銷的；無法改變的
example_sentence: Having signed the contract, the company faced an irrevocable commitment to the project's completion.
sentence_zh: 簽署合約後，該公司面臨必須完成該專案的不可撤銷承諾。

definition_zh: (副) 不可撤銷地；永久地　(副) 無法改變地；決定性地
example_sentence: The decision made by the government, which affected millions of citizens irrevocably, sparked widespread debate.
sentence_zh: 政府做出的決定永久地影響了數百萬公民，引發了廣泛的辯論。

definition_zh: (名) 灌溉；灌溉系統
example_sentence: If farmers improve their irrigation systems, crop yields will increase significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果農民改善他們的灌溉系統，農作物產量將大幅增加。

definition_zh: (名) 易激惹；容易發怒　(名) 煩躁；脾氣差
example_sentence: Lack of sleep increases irritability and makes concentrating on homework difficult.
sentence_zh: 睡眠不足會加重易激惹，使專注於功課變得困難。

definition_zh: (形) 易怒的；容易惹惱的　(形) 易受刺激的；敏感的
example_sentence: Doctors recommend regular exercise to reduce irritable mood and improve mental health.
sentence_zh: 醫生建議定期運動以減少易怒情緒並改善心理健康。

definition_zh: (名) 刺激物；惱人的東西　(形) 令人惱怒的；刺激性的
example_sentence: Wearing tight clothes all day becomes an irritant that makes your skin feel uncomfortable and itchy.
sentence_zh: 整天穿著緊身衣服成為一種刺激物，使你的皮膚感到不舒服和發癢。

definition_zh: (動) 激怒；惹惱　(動) 使發炎；刺激
example_sentence: Although the teacher explained the rule clearly, some students remained irritated because they didn't understand it.
sentence_zh: 雖然老師清楚地解釋了規則，但由於一些學生不理解，他們仍然感到激怒。

definition_zh: (形) 惱怒的；煩躁的　(動) 使惱怒；激怒
example_sentence: Irritated by the constant noise, Maria decided to move to a quieter apartment.
sentence_zh: 瑪莉亞被持續的噪音所惱怒，決定搬到更安靜的公寓。

definition_zh: (形) 令人煩惱的；惱人的　(形) 使人不耐煩的；引起激怒的
example_sentence: The noise that comes from the construction site is irritating to students studying for exams.
sentence_zh: 來自建築工地的噪音令正在為考試讀書的學生感到煩惱。

definition_zh: (名) 惱怒；生氣　(名) 皮膚發炎；紅腫
example_sentence: Constant noise and interruptions cause irritation for students preparing for exams.
sentence_zh: 持續的噪音和打斷對準備考試的學生造成惱怒。

definition_zh: (名) 伊斯蘭教；伊斯蘭信仰
example_sentence: If more students understood Islam's basic principles, religious conflicts would decrease significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果更多學生了解伊斯蘭教的基本原則，宗教衝突就會大幅減少。
