definition_zh: (形) 伊斯蘭教的；伊斯蘭文化的
example_sentence: Islamic art and architecture attract many tourists from around the world.
sentence_zh: 伊斯蘭藝術和建築吸引了世界各地的許多遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 島；島嶼
example_sentence: Surrounded by blue ocean water, the island attracts many tourists every year.
sentence_zh: 被藍色海水包圍著，這座島每年吸引許多遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 島嶼；小島
example_sentence: As the ship approached the isle, the passengers could see palm trees swaying in the wind.
sentence_zh: 當船靠近那座島嶼時，乘客可以看到棕櫚樹在風中搖曳。

definition_zh: (動) 隔離；孤立　(動) 分離；區分
example_sentence: Only after the virus spreads widely does the government isolate infected patients from the community.
sentence_zh: 只有在病毒廣泛傳播後，政府才將感染者從社區隔離。

definition_zh: (形) 孤立的；隔離的　(形) 偏遠的；與世隔絕的
example_sentence: The mountain village, isolated from modern cities for decades, maintained its traditional culture.
sentence_zh: 這個與現代城市隔離數十年的山村，保留了它的傳統文化。

definition_zh: (名) 隔離；孤立　(動) 隔離；分離
example_sentence: The hospital created isolation wards to prevent disease spread.
sentence_zh: 醫院設置隔離病房以防止疾病傳播。

definition_zh: (名) 孤立主義；隔離政策
example_sentence: Some historians argue that isolationism in the 1930s prevented early action against rising threats.
sentence_zh: 一些歷史學家主張1930年代的孤立主義政策阻止了對日益增長威脅的早期行動。

definition_zh: (名) 問題；議題　(動) 發行；頒布
example_sentence: The government issued new rules about school uniforms last month.
sentence_zh: 政府上個月發布了關於校服的新規定。

definition_zh: (名) 癢；搔癢感　(動) 發癢；使發癢　(形) 發癢的；想要做的
example_sentence: As the mosquito bite continued to itch, Sarah tried not to scratch it during the exam.
sentence_zh: 隨著蚊子叮咬持續發癢，莎拉在考試中盡力不去抓它。

definition_zh: (形) 發癢的；令人不適的
example_sentence: Feeling itchy after gym class, Sarah scratched her arms repeatedly.
sentence_zh: 下課後感到發癢，莎拉不斷抓她的手臂。

definition_zh: (名) 項目；物品　(名) 條款；項次
example_sentence: The exam includes several items that students find challenging.
sentence_zh: 這次考試包含許多學生覺得困難的項目。

definition_zh: (動) 列舉；逐項列出　詳細說明
example_sentence: If the accountant itemizes every expense, the audit report would be more accurate and transparent.
sentence_zh: 如果會計師逐項列出每筆支出，審計報告將會更加準確和透明。

definition_zh: (動) 重複；多次進行　(動) 逐次改進
example_sentence: The software engineer will iterate the code to fix all bugs.
sentence_zh: 軟體工程師將多次修改程式碼以修復所有錯誤。

definition_zh: (名) 反覆；迭代　(動) 反覆執行；逐次改進
example_sentence: The software company uses iteration to improve the application.
sentence_zh: 這家軟體公司使用反覆迭代來改進這個應用程式。

definition_zh: (形) 流動的；巡迴的　(名) 流動工人；巡迴者
example_sentence: The itinerant street musicians traveling across Taiwan performed traditional folk songs at local night markets.
sentence_zh: 那些在台灣四處巡迴的流動街頭音樂家在當地夜市表演傳統民謠。

definition_zh: (名) 旅遊行程；路線圖
example_sentence: Before traveling to Japan, Sarah carefully planned her itinerary so that she could visit all the famous temples.
sentence_zh: 在前往日本旅遊之前，莎拉仔細規劃她的行程，以便她能參觀所有著名的寺廟。

definition_zh: (名) 象牙；象牙色　(形) 象牙製的；象牙色的
example_sentence: Having been carved from ivory, the ancient statue was displayed carefully in the museum.
sentence_zh: 這尊古代雕像由象牙雕刻而成，被小心地展示在博物館裡。

definition_zh: (名) 常春藤；葉藤　(形) 覆滿常春藤的；被葉藤包裹的
example_sentence: The old castle, whose walls were completely covered with ivy, attracted many tourists every summer.
sentence_zh: 那座古老城堡，其牆壁被常春藤完全覆蓋，每年夏天都吸引許多遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 千斤頂；插頭　(名) 男孩；傢伙　(動) 抬起；頂起
example_sentence: Using a car jack carefully prevents accidents during tire changes.
sentence_zh: 使用汽車千斤頂時要小心，可以防止換輪胎時發生意外。

definition_zh: (名) 夾克；外套　(名) 書的護封；套子
example_sentence: If Marcus wore a thicker jacket, he would stay warm during winter mountain hiking trips.
sentence_zh: 如果馬克思穿一件更厚的夾克，他在冬季登山旅行時就會保持溫暖。

definition_zh: (名) 大獎；頭獎　(名) 巨大的成功或收益
example_sentence: Winning the lottery jackpot would change your life completely.
sentence_zh: 中了樂透頭獎會完全改變你的人生。

definition_zh: (名) 玉；翡翠　(形) 玉製的；翠綠色的
example_sentence: Carved from precious jade, the ancient sculpture displayed the artist's remarkable skill and dedication.
sentence_zh: 這件古老的雕像由珍貴玉石雕刻而成，展現了藝術家非凡的技巧和奉獻精神。

definition_zh: (名) 鋸齒；尖刺　(動) 刺傷；割破
example_sentence: Although the rock had a jagged edge, climbers scaled it with safety equipment.
sentence_zh: 雖然這塊岩石邊緣參差不齊，登山者仍然用安全設備攀登它。

definition_zh: (名) 監獄；牢房　(動) 監禁；關進監獄
example_sentence: Seldom does a student commit a crime so serious as to end up in jail.
sentence_zh: 學生很少犯下如此嚴重的罪行而被關進監獄。

definition_zh: (名) 果醬；困境　(動) 卡住；擁擠　(形) 擁擠的；堵塞的
example_sentence: The traffic jam that caused the delay is something drivers must avoid during rush hour.
sentence_zh: 導致延誤的交通堵塞是駕駛在尖峰時段必須避免的狀況。

definition_zh: (名) 清潔工；門房
example_sentence: The school hired a new janitor to keep all classrooms clean and organized.
sentence_zh: 學校聘請了一位新的清潔工來保持所有教室的清潔和整理。

definition_zh: (形) 清潔工的；保管的；有關建築物維護的
example_sentence: The school hired a new janitorial staff member to keep hallways and classrooms clean.
sentence_zh: 學校聘請了一位新的清潔工人員來保持走廊和教室的清潔。

definition_zh: (名) 一月；1月
example_sentence: January is the first month of the year, and many students start their new study plans then.
sentence_zh: 一月是一年的第一個月，許多學生在那時開始他們的新學習計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 日本；日本國
example_sentence: Since Japan is located in East Asia, many Taiwanese students choose to study there during summer holidays.
sentence_zh: 由於日本位於東亞，許多台灣學生選擇在暑假期間到那裡學習。

definition_zh: (形) 日本的；日本人的　(名) 日本人；日語
example_sentence: Studying Japanese, many students find the writing system challenging but fascinating.
sentence_zh: 學習日語的許多學生覺得書寫系統既具挑戰性又令人著迷。

definition_zh: (名) 罐子；玻璃瓶　(動) 使震動；刺激
example_sentence: The jam jar that sits on the kitchen shelf contains homemade strawberry preserves.
sentence_zh: 放在廚房架子上的果醬罐裡裝著自製的草莓果醬。

definition_zh: (名) 茉莉花；茉莉　(形) 茉莉花的；淡黃色的
example_sentence: If jasmine flowers bloom in your garden, their sweet fragrance will fill the entire house.
sentence_zh: 如果茉莉花在你的花園裡盛開，它們的甜蜜香氣將充滿整個房子。

definition_zh: (名) 短途旅行；遊歷　(動) 作短途旅行；去遊歷
example_sentence: Taking a weekend jaunt to Jiufen Old Street is popular with Taipei students.
sentence_zh: 到九份老街進行週末短途旅行對台北學生很受歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 爪哇島；爪哇咖啡　(名) 咖啡；電腦程式語言
example_sentence: Many programmers learn Java to develop mobile applications for smartphones.
sentence_zh: 許多程式設計師學習Java是為了開發手機應用程式。

definition_zh: (名) 下顎；頜　(名) 顎骨；下巴
example_sentence: The shark's powerful jaws can bite through thick metal.
sentence_zh: 鯊魚強有力的下顎能咬穿厚金屬。

definition_zh: (動) 亂過馬路；闖紅燈走過街道
example_sentence: Although the traffic light was red, many pedestrians jaywalked across the busy intersection.
sentence_zh: 雖然紅綠燈是紅色，許多行人仍亂過這個繁忙的十字路口。

definition_zh: (名) 亂穿馬路；闖紅燈　(動) 亂穿馬路
example_sentence: Having jaywalked across the busy intersection, the student received a traffic fine from the police officer.
sentence_zh: 那位學生亂穿馬路穿過繁忙的十字路口後，收到了警察開的罰單。

definition_zh: (名) 爵士樂；爵士音樂　(動) 使活躍；使興奮　(形) 爵士樂的；時髦的
example_sentence: The jazz musician who performed at the festival last month impressed audiences with his improvisation skills.
sentence_zh: 上個月在音樂節表演的爵士樂手以他的即興演奏技巧給觀眾留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (形) 嫉妒的；忌妒的　(形) 警惕的；保護的
example_sentence: My older brother felt jealous and angry when his girlfriend talked to another boy at the party.
sentence_zh: 我哥哥在派對上看到他的女友和另一個男孩聊天，感到嫉妒和生氣。

definition_zh: (副) 嫉妒地；忌妒地　(副) 警惕地；謹慎地
example_sentence: If Sarah did not guard her relationship jealously, her boyfriend would probably leave her for someone else.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉不嫉妒地守護她的感情，她的男友可能會為了別人而離開她。

definition_zh: (名) 妒忌；嫉妒　(形) 妒忌的；猜疑的
example_sentence: Sarah felt jealousy when her best friend started spending more time with another classmate.
sentence_zh: 當莎拉的好友開始花更多時間和另一位同學相處時，她感到妒忌。

definition_zh: (名) 牛仔褲；牛仔布
example_sentence: Wearing faded jeans, the student looked casual and comfortable at school.
sentence_zh: 穿著褪色牛仔褲，這個學生在學校看起來很隨便舒適。

definition_zh: (名) 吉普車；軍用越野車
example_sentence: As the jeep climbed the steep mountain road, passengers held tight to avoid falling.
sentence_zh: 當吉普車爬上陡峭的山路時，乘客緊緊抓住以免摔下來。

definition_zh: (動) 嘲笑；嗤笑　(名) 嘲笑聲；譏笑
example_sentence: Seldom did the audience jeer at the performer's sincere effort on stage.
sentence_zh: 觀眾很少嘲笑表演者舞台上的真誠努力。

definition_zh: (名) 果凍；膠凍　(形) 果凍狀的；軟的
example_sentence: The dessert that the bakery made was a colorful jelly which tasted delicious.
sentence_zh: 麵包店製作的那道甜點是一份美味的果凍，色彩繽紛。

definition_zh: (動) 危害；危及　使...處於危險中
example_sentence: Cheating on the exam would jeopardize your academic record and university admission.
sentence_zh: 在考試中作弊會危害你的學業成績和大學入學機會。

definition_zh: (名) 危險；風險　(動) 危害；危及
example_sentence: Failing this exam would put her university plans in jeopardy.
sentence_zh: 考試不及格會危及她的大學計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 混蛋；討厭的人　(動) 突然猛拉；急速移動
example_sentence: Don't jerk the rope too hard or it might break.
sentence_zh: 不要太用力突然猛拉繩子，否則它可能會斷。

definition_zh: (形) 急促的；顛簸的　(名) 肉乾；牛肉乾
example_sentence: As the bus moved with jerky motions, passengers struggled to keep their balance during the mountain road ride.
sentence_zh: 當公車以急促顛簸的動作移動時，乘客在山路行駛中努力保持平衡。

definition_zh: (名) 柴油桶；鐵製油桶
example_sentence: Carrying a jerrycan filled with fuel, the rescue team rushed toward the stranded hikers.
sentence_zh: 扛著裝滿燃料的柴油桶，救援隊急速趕向被困的登山者。

definition_zh: (名) 運動衫；球衣　(名) 澤西牛；細毛織物
example_sentence: The soccer player wore a jersey that displayed his team's name and number.
sentence_zh: 那位足球運動員穿著一件展示球隊名稱和號碼的球衣。

definition_zh: (名) 噴氣；噴流　(名) 噴射機；客機　(動) 噴出；急速移動
example_sentence: If a commercial jet encounters severe turbulence, pilots will reduce speed immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果一架商用噴射機遭遇嚴重亂流，飛行員將立即減速。

definition_zh: (動) 拋棄；放棄　(動) 投棄（貨物以減輕重量）
example_sentence: The airline had to jettison excess cargo to make the plane lighter.
sentence_zh: 航空公司必須拋棄多餘貨物來使飛機變輕。

definition_zh: (名) 寶石；珠寶　(名) 珍寶；寶貴的人或物
example_sentence: Museums display rare jewels to educate and inspire visitors from around the world.
sentence_zh: 博物館展示稀有寶石，以教育和啟發來自世界各地的遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 珠寶商；珠寶設計師
example_sentence: The skilled jeweler carefully crafted an elegant diamond ring for the bride.
sentence_zh: 那位技藝高超的珠寶商為新娘精心打造了一枚優雅的鑽石戒指。

definition_zh: (名) 珠寶；首飾　(名) 珠寶店；珠寶商
example_sentence: Although jewellery can be expensive, many people enjoy wearing it for special occasions.
sentence_zh: 雖然珠寶可能很昂貴，但許多人喜歡在特殊場合佩戴它。

definition_zh: (名) 珠寶；首飾　(名) 珠寶飾品；裝飾品
example_sentence: Having saved money for years, Maria finally bought the diamond jewelry she had always wanted.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞存了多年的錢，終於買到了她一直想要的鑽石首飾。

definition_zh: (名) 拼圖；錯綜複雜的事物　(形) 拼圖的；複雜的
example_sentence: The puzzle that Sarah bought is a difficult jigsaw with over one thousand pieces.
sentence_zh: 莎拉買的拼圖是一個複雜的拼圖遊戲，有超過一千片。

definition_zh: (名) 鈴聲；叮噹聲　(動) 發出叮噹聲；使發鈴聲
example_sentence: The jingle bell on the Christmas tree jingles whenever wind blows through the window.
sentence_zh: 聖誕樹上的鈴鐺每當風吹過窗戶時就會發出叮噹聲。

definition_zh: (名) 工作；職位　(動) 做零工；臨時工作
example_sentence: If Maria had a better job, she would earn more money and support her family.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪麗亞有更好的工作，她就會賺更多錢並支持她的家人。

definition_zh: (形) 失業的；沒有工作的
example_sentence: Many jobless workers in the city are looking for new opportunities.
sentence_zh: 城市裡許多失業的工人正在尋找新的機會。

definition_zh: (名) 騎師；馬術選手　(動) 駕馭；操縱
example_sentence: Jockeys, riding horses at high speed, must maintain perfect balance throughout the entire race.
sentence_zh: 騎師們在高速騎馬時，必須在整個比賽中保持完美的平衡。

definition_zh: (動) 慢跑；輕推　(名) 慢跑；輕推
example_sentence: As Maria jogs through the park every morning, she enjoys fresh air and stays healthy.
sentence_zh: 由於瑪麗亞每天早上在公園慢跑，她享受新鮮空氣並保持健康。

definition_zh: (動) 輕輕搖動；晃動　(名) 輕微的搖動
example_sentence: Hardly did the photographer joggle the camera during the important shot.
sentence_zh: 攝影師在重要的拍攝中幾乎沒有晃動相機。

definition_zh: (動) 加入；參加　(動) 連接；接合
example_sentence: Students who join the music club often make friends with people that share similar interests.
sentence_zh: 加入音樂社的學生經常和有相似興趣的人交朋友。

definition_zh: (名) 木工接合技術；木工活
example_sentence: Carpenters use traditional joinery techniques to build sturdy wooden furniture without nails.
sentence_zh: 木匠使用傳統木工接合技術來製造堅固的木製家具，不需要釘子。

definition_zh: (名) 關節；接合處　(動) 連接；結合　(形) 共同的；聯合的
example_sentence: The hip joint connects the leg to the body, allowing movement during sports.
sentence_zh: 髖關節將腿與身體連接，使運動時能夠活動。

definition_zh: (副) 共同地；聯合地　一起；合作地
example_sentence: The two companies jointly developed a new smartphone app for teenagers.
sentence_zh: 這兩家公司聯合開發了一個專為青少年設計的新手機應用程式。

definition_zh: (名) 笑話；玩笑　(動) 開玩笑；說笑話
example_sentence: Although the comedian told a funny joke, some audience members didn't laugh at all.
sentence_zh: 雖然喜劇演員講了一個有趣的笑話，但有些觀眾根本沒有笑。

definition_zh: (副) 開玩笑地；戲謔地
example_sentence: Speaking jokingly about the difficult exam, Maya reduced everyone's stress instantly.
sentence_zh: 瑪亞開玩笑地談論困難的考試，立即減輕了每個人的壓力。

definition_zh: (形) 快樂的；愉快的　(形) 熱鬧的；歡樂的
example_sentence: The Christmas party, which was jolly and full of laughter, made everyone forget their worries.
sentence_zh: 那場充滿歡樂和笑聲的聖誕派對讓每個人都忘記了煩惱。

definition_zh: (名) 猛然的推動；驚嚇　(動) 突然推動；使驚跳
example_sentence: If the bus driver brakes suddenly, passengers will jolt forward in their seats.
sentence_zh: 如果公車司機突然煞車，乘客將在座位上向前猛然傾身。

definition_zh: (名) 日記；日誌　(名) 雜誌；期刊
example_sentence: Writing in a journal every morning helps students organize their thoughts clearly.
sentence_zh: 每天早上寫日記可以幫助學生清楚地整理思緒。

definition_zh: (名) 新聞工作；新聞業
example_sentence: Many students study journalism to become professional reporters and share important news with the public.
sentence_zh: 許多學生學習新聞工作以成為專業記者，並與大眾分享重要新聞。

definition_zh: (名) 記者；新聞工作者　(形) 新聞的；記者的
example_sentence: The journalist investigated the corruption case and published her findings online.
sentence_zh: 那位記者調查了貪汙案件，並在網路上發表了她的調查結果。

definition_zh: (名) 旅程；旅行　(動) 去旅行；遊歷
example_sentence: As Sarah traveled across Europe, her journey became more meaningful with each new city she visited.
sentence_zh: 當莎拉橫跨歐洲旅行時，她的旅程隨著每個她造訪的新城市而變得更有意義。

definition_zh: (名) 熟練工人；技藝純熟者　(名) 中級技工；經驗豐富的工作者
example_sentence: Having completed his apprenticeship, the journeyman carpenter built custom furniture with impressive skill and precision.
sentence_zh: 完成學徒期後，這位熟練木匠以令人印象深刻的技藝和精確度製作客製化傢具。

definition_zh: (名) 喜悅；歡樂　(動) 歡欣；感到高興
example_sentence: The birthday party, which brought joy to everyone present, lasted until midnight.
sentence_zh: 那場生日派對為在場的每個人帶來喜悅，一直持續到午夜。

definition_zh: (形) 充滿喜悅的；快樂的　(形) 令人高興的；令人愉快的
example_sentence: The joyful children sang and danced at the school festival with big smiles.
sentence_zh: 那些快樂的孩子在學校慶典上唱歌跳舞，臉上帶著燦爛笑容。

definition_zh: (形) 歡樂的；充滿喜悅的　(形) 快樂的；欣喜的
example_sentence: If winning the university entrance exam were easier, students would feel more joyous throughout their preparation.
sentence_zh: 如果贏得大學入學考試更容易，學生在準備過程中會感到更加歡樂。

definition_zh: (名) 法官；評判者　(動) 判斷；評估；批評
example_sentence: The judge decided the case fairly after hearing all evidence.
sentence_zh: 那位法官在聽取所有證據後，公平地判決了這個案件。

definition_zh: (名) 判斷；評判　(名) 判決；裁決
example_sentence: Having studied the evidence carefully, the judge delivered a fair judgment that satisfied most people.
sentence_zh: 仔細研究過證據後，法官做出了讓大多數人滿意的公正判決。

definition_zh: (形) 司法的；法官的　法庭的；審判的
example_sentence: Although the judicial system requires careful review, many cases are still resolved efficiently.
sentence_zh: 雖然司法制度需要仔細審查，許多案件仍然能有效解決。

definition_zh: (名) 司法部門；法院系統　(形) 司法的；法官的
example_sentence: Only after the judiciary reviewed the case did the truth finally emerge.
sentence_zh: 只有在司法部門複審此案後，真相才最終浮現。

definition_zh: (形) 明智的；審慎的　判斷力好的；謹慎的
example_sentence: The principal made a judicious decision that satisfied both students and parents alike.
sentence_zh: 校長做出了一個明智的決定，令學生和家長都感到滿意。

definition_zh: (名) 水罐；壺　(動) 倒飲料；裝入罐中
example_sentence: Students use a large jug to pour water into cups for the class.
sentence_zh: 學生用一個大水罐把水倒進杯子裡供全班使用。

definition_zh: (動) 雜耍；同時處理多項任務　(名) 雜耍表演；平衡行為
example_sentence: Balancing homework, club activities, and part-time work requires students to juggle multiple responsibilities effectively.
sentence_zh: 平衡功課、社團活動和打工，需要學生有效地同時處理多項責任。

definition_zh: (名) 雜耍者；玩雜耍的人　(名) 同時處理多項工作的人
example_sentence: The street juggler entertained crowds by tossing colorful balls high into the air.
sentence_zh: 街頭雜耍者用彩色球拋向空中來娛樂群眾。

definition_zh: (名) 果汁；鮮汁　(動) 榨果汁
example_sentence: As soon as morning classes end, students drink juice to refresh themselves before afternoon lessons.
sentence_zh: 早上課程一結束，學生們就喝果汁來在下午課程前提神。

definition_zh: (形) 多汁的；含水分多的　(形) 趣味盎然的；有吸引力的
example_sentence: Biting into the juicy orange, Sarah enjoyed its sweet and refreshing taste during lunch.
sentence_zh: 咬著多汁的柳橙，莎拉在午餐時享受它甜美清爽的味道。

definition_zh: (名) 七月
example_sentence: July, which is the hottest month in Taiwan, requires students to stay hydrated during outdoor activities.
sentence_zh: 七月是台灣最炎熱的月份，學生在戶外活動時必須保持水分補充。

definition_zh: (動) 混亂；搞混　(名) 混亂物；雜亂
example_sentence: If students jumble up their notes before the exam, they will struggle to find important information quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試前把筆記搞混，他們將很難快速找到重要資訊。

definition_zh: (形) 巨大的；超大的　(名) 大象；巨型物品
example_sentence: The jumbo jet can carry hundreds of passengers across the ocean.
sentence_zh: 這架超大型噴射客機可以搭載數百名乘客飛越大洋。

definition_zh: (動) 跳躍；跳起　(名) 跳躍；跳躍的距離
example_sentence: Athletes practice every day to jump higher and win the competition.
sentence_zh: 運動員每天練習為了跳得更高並贏得比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 跳繩；連帽運動衫　(名) 跳躍的人；跳高者
example_sentence: Sarah bought a new jumper to wear during cold winter mornings before school.
sentence_zh: 莎拉買了一件新連帽運動衫，在寒冷的冬季上學前穿著。

definition_zh: (名) 交叉點；樞紐　(名) 連接；接合
example_sentence: As the bus approached the junction, passengers held tight while the driver slowed down.
sentence_zh: 當公車接近十字路口時，乘客們緊緊抓住，司機減速了。

definition_zh: (名) 關鍵時刻；轉折點　(名) 接合點；連接處
example_sentence: Having faced numerous setbacks, the company reached a critical juncture requiring immediate strategic decisions.
sentence_zh: 經歷了許多挫折後，該公司到達了需要立即做出策略決定的關鍵時刻。

definition_zh: (名) 六月
example_sentence: The graduation ceremony, which takes place in June, is an important event for all students.
sentence_zh: 在六月舉行的畢業典禮對所有學生來說都是一件重要的活動。

definition_zh: (名) 叢林；密林　(形) 叢林的；荒蕪的
example_sentence: Explorers discovered ancient temples hidden deep within the dense jungle.
sentence_zh: 探險家在茂密的叢林深處發現了古老的廟宇。

definition_zh: (名) 三年級學生；年幼者　(形) 年幼的；資淺的
example_sentence: If Tom were a junior in high school, he would have more time to prepare for the CSAT next year.
sentence_zh: 如果湯姆是高中三年級學生，他明年就會有更多時間準備學測。

definition_zh: (名) 廢棄物；垃圾　(動) 丟棄；廢棄　(形) 品質差的；破舊的
example_sentence: The old computer in the storage room is junk and should be recycled.
sentence_zh: 儲存室裡的舊電腦是廢棄物，應該被回收。

definition_zh: (名) 毒癮者；藥物成癮者　(形) 沉迷的；上癮的
example_sentence: Struggling with addiction, the junkie finally decided to enter rehabilitation.
sentence_zh: 與毒癮搏鬥，那位藥物成癮者終於決定進入戒毒中心。

definition_zh: (名) 司法管轄權；管轄範圍　(名) 權力；權限
example_sentence: Although the case occurred in Taipei, the court determined that another city had jurisdiction over the matter.
sentence_zh: 雖然案件發生在台北，但法院判定另一個城市對此事有司法管轄權。

definition_zh: (名) 陪審團成員；陪審員
example_sentence: Only after careful evidence review did the juror cast a vote.
sentence_zh: 只有在仔細審視證據後，陪審員才投下一票。

definition_zh: (名) 陪審團；評委會
example_sentence: The jury that decided the court case included twelve ordinary citizens from the community.
sentence_zh: 決定該法庭案件的陪審團包括來自社區的十二位普通市民。

definition_zh: (連) 正如；恰如　(副) 恰好；正好
example_sentence: Just as students prepare for the CSAT to improve their academic prospects, teachers revise lessons.
sentence_zh: 正如學生為了提高學習成績而準備學測，老師也會複習課程。

definition_zh: (副) 剛剛；剛才　(副) 現在；此刻
example_sentence: The phone rang just now, and Sarah answered it immediately.
sentence_zh: 電話剛才響了，莎拉立刻接了。

definition_zh: (副) 剛剛；才；只是　(形) 公平的；正義的
example_sentence: The bell just rang, so class is about to start now.
sentence_zh: 鐘聲剛剛響起，所以現在課程即將開始。

definition_zh: (名) 正義；公正　(名) 司法；審判
example_sentence: Although the trial took years, justice was finally served when the innocent person received a fair verdict.
sentence_zh: 雖然審判耗時多年，但當無辜者最終獲得公正判決時，正義終於伸張了。

definition_zh: (形) 可以辯護的；有道理的　(形) 能證明正當的；可接受的
example_sentence: Having studied the contract carefully, the manager found the salary increase justifiable and approved it immediately.
sentence_zh: 經過仔細研究合約，經理認為加薪是有道理的，立即同意了。

definition_zh: (名) 正當理由；辯解　(名) 合理的解釋；證明正確
example_sentence: The student's justification for missing class, which the teacher found unconvincing, did not satisfy school regulations.
sentence_zh: 那位學生缺課的正當理由（老師認為不夠有說服力）未能滿足校規要求。

definition_zh: (形) 有正當理由的；合理的　(動) 證明...是合理的；為...辯護
example_sentence: If the extra homework is justified by clear learning goals, students will accept it more willingly.
sentence_zh: 如果額外功課有明確的學習目標作為正當理由，學生會更樂意接受。

definition_zh: (動) 為...辯護；說明理由　證明...正當
example_sentence: Students must justify their choice of university major with clear reasons.
sentence_zh: 學生必須用清楚的理由為自己選擇的大學科系辯護。

definition_zh: (形) 青少年的；未成熟的　(名) 青少年；少年犯
example_sentence: The school established a mentorship program to help juvenile offenders develop better decision-making skills.
sentence_zh: 該校建立了一個導師計畫，目的是幫助少年犯養成更好的決策能力。

definition_zh: (名) 羽衣甘藍；綠色蔬菜
example_sentence: Eating leafy green kale provides essential vitamins and minerals for daily health.
sentence_zh: 食用葉狀綠色羽衣甘藍為日常健康提供必需的維生素和礦物質。

definition_zh: (名) 袋鼠
example_sentence: As kangaroos hop across the Australian outback, their powerful tails help them maintain balance and jump higher.
sentence_zh: 當袋鼠在澳洲荒漠跳躍時，牠們強壯的尾巴幫助牠們保持平衡並跳得更高。

definition_zh: (名) 漢字；日文漢字
example_sentence: Having studied kanji for two years, the Japanese language student finally passed the proficiency test.
sentence_zh: 學了兩年漢字後，這位日語學生終於通過了語言能力測試。

definition_zh: (名) 皮划艇；獨木舟
example_sentence: The kayak that Sarah paddled through the river was made of lightweight plastic.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在河上划行的皮划艇是用輕質塑料製成的。

definition_zh: (形) 熱情的；積極的　(形) 敏銳的；靈敏的
example_sentence: Sarah's keen interest in science and her dedication to studying made her stand out among classmates.
sentence_zh: 莎拉對科學的熱情和她的學習投入使她在同學中脫穎而出。

definition_zh: (動) 留意；監視　照顧；注意
example_sentence: If parents kept an eye on their children's online activities, cyberbullying would decrease significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果父母監視孩子的網路活動，網路霸凌就會大幅減少。

definition_zh: (片) 留意；注意　(片) 尋找；搜尋
example_sentence: Keep an eye out for the new scholarship announcement posted on the school bulletin board.
sentence_zh: 留意學校佈告欄上貼出的新獎學金公告。

definition_zh: (動) 保留；留著　(動) 與...保持往來
example_sentence: Keeping old photos around helps us remember precious childhood memories.
sentence_zh: 保留舊照片有助於我們記住珍貴的童年回憶。

definition_zh: (動) 堅持做；持續努力
example_sentence: As long as students keep at their homework, they will eventually master difficult math problems.
sentence_zh: 只要學生堅持做功課，他們最終會掌握難的數學問題。

definition_zh: (片) 遠離；躲開　(動) 保持距離；避開
example_sentence: Never should dangerous chemicals be kept away from children's reach.
sentence_zh: 危險的化學物質絕不應該放在孩子們能夠到達的地方。

definition_zh: (動) 保留；隱瞞　(動) 阻止；抑制
example_sentence: The teacher kept back the information that would upset the students who had worked hard.
sentence_zh: 老師保留了那些會令認真用功的學生感到沮喪的信息。

definition_zh: (動) 抑制；壓低　(動) 控制；減少
example_sentence: Eating healthy food helps students keep down stress to improve exam performance.
sentence_zh: 吃健康的食物幫助學生抑制壓力以改善考試表現。

definition_zh: (動) 防止；阻止　(動) 克制；忍住
example_sentence: Sarah's quick thinking kept the accident from happening on the highway.
sentence_zh: 莎拉的快速反應防止了高速公路上的事故發生。

definition_zh: (動) 記住；牢記　(動) 留意；注意
example_sentence: Keep in mind that the CSAT exam requires careful time management.
sentence_zh: 請記住學測考試需要仔細的時間管理。

definition_zh: (動) 與...保持聯絡；與...保持接觸
example_sentence: Although graduation separated us into different cities, we keep in touch with each other through social media.
sentence_zh: 雖然畢業將我們分散到不同城市，但我們透過社群媒體保持彼此聯絡。

definition_zh: (動) 與...保持友好關係；討好...
example_sentence: Keeping in with the student council president, Maria volunteered for the school festival committee.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞為了與學生會長保持友好關係，自願參加校慶委員會。

definition_zh: (動) 保持；維持　(動) 關進；禁閉
example_sentence: The student who keeps in regular contact with his teacher finds studying easier.
sentence_zh: 與老師保持定期聯繫的學生發現讀書比較容易。

definition_zh: (動) 避免靠近；遠離　(動) 禁止進入；不要踐踏
example_sentence: If students keep off the newly painted floor, the paint will dry quickly without damage.
sentence_zh: 如果學生們遠離新油漆的地板，油漆會迅速乾燥而不受損傷。

definition_zh: (動) 繼續；持續　(動) 不停地做
example_sentence: The music kept on playing throughout the entire graduation ceremony.
sentence_zh: 音樂在整個畢業典禮中持續播放。

definition_zh: (片) 禁止進入；阻止；擋在外面
example_sentence: The security guard posted a sign to keep out unauthorized visitors from the construction site.
sentence_zh: 保全人員貼了標誌以禁止未經授權的訪客進入建築工地。

definition_zh: (動) 跟上；不落後於　(動) 與...保持同步
example_sentence: Working hard every day helps students keep up at the same pace as their classmates.
sentence_zh: 每天努力學習幫助學生與同學保持同步的進度。

definition_zh: (動) 跟上；保持進度　(動) 與...同步；不落後
example_sentence: As technology advances rapidly, students must study hard to keep up with the latest developments in their fields.
sentence_zh: 隨著科技快速進步，學生必須努力讀書，才能跟上他們領域的最新發展。

definition_zh: (動) 跟上；維持　(動) 與…保持聯繫
example_sentence: Having kept up with her studies all semester, Maria felt confident taking the final exam.
sentence_zh: 瑪莉亞整個學期都跟上課業進度，參加期末考時感到很有信心。

definition_zh: (動) 保持；維持　保留；保管　(名) 飼養費；生活費
example_sentence: The habit that students keep throughout high school often influences their future success.
sentence_zh: 學生在高中期間保持的習慣常常影響他們未來的成功。

definition_zh: (名) 守門人；看守者　(名) 飼養者；保管人
example_sentence: The zookeeper feeds the animals every morning and checks their health carefully.
sentence_zh: 動物園飼養員每天早上餵食動物並仔細檢查牠們的健康。

definition_zh: (名) 海帶；昆布
example_sentence: If coastal pollution were controlled better, kelp forests would grow much healthier and support more marine life.
sentence_zh: 如果沿岸污染得到更好的控制，海帶林會生長得更健康，並支持更多海洋生物。

definition_zh: (動) 知道；了解　(名) 知識；眼界
example_sentence: Beyond our ken, distant galaxies continue to expand and evolve in ways.
sentence_zh: 在我們的知識範圍之外，遙遠的星系繼續以各種方式膨脹和演變。

definition_zh: (名) 犬舍；狗窩
example_sentence: Boarding at the kennel during summer vacation, the puppy learned to socialize with other dogs.
sentence_zh: 小狗在暑假時住在犬舍，學會了與其他狗互動。

definition_zh: (名) 角蛋白；角質素
example_sentence: Because keratin makes hair strong and shiny, many shampoos contain this protein to improve hair quality.
sentence_zh: 因為角蛋白能使頭髮強韌有光澤，許多洗髮精都含有這種蛋白質來改善髮質。

definition_zh: (名) 核心；內核　(名) 穀粒；果核
example_sentence: Only at the kernel of the problem did the team finally discover the real solution.
sentence_zh: 只有在問題的核心，這個團隊才終於發現了真正的解決方案。

definition_zh: (名) 番茄醬；蕃茄醬
example_sentence: The fast food restaurant serves burgers with ketchup, which customers love.
sentence_zh: 那家速食餐廳提供附番茄醬的漢堡，這是顧客喜歡的。

definition_zh: (名) 酮體生成；酮化作用
example_sentence: During fasting, the liver undergoes ketogenesis to produce ketone bodies for energy.
sentence_zh: 在禁食期間，肝臟進行酮體生成以產生酮體供能量使用。

definition_zh: (形) 酮生的；生酮的
example_sentence: A ketogenic diet high in fat and low in carbohydrates helps some people lose weight quickly.
sentence_zh: 高脂肪、低碳水化合物的生酮飲食幫助某些人快速減重。

definition_zh: (名) 酮；酮體
example_sentence: Ketones are produced when the body burns fat for energy instead of carbohydrates.
sentence_zh: 當身體用脂肪而不是碳水化合物燃燒以產生能量時，酮就會被產生。

definition_zh: (名) 酮症；生酮狀態
example_sentence: Although ketosis can help some people lose weight, doctors warn that prolonged ketosis may cause serious health problems.
sentence_zh: 雖然酮症可以幫助某些人減肥，但醫生警告長期酮症可能導致嚴重的健康問題。

definition_zh: (名) 水壺；茶壺
example_sentence: Boiling water in the kettle, Mom prepared tea for our guests arriving soon.
sentence_zh: 媽媽燒著水壺裡的水，為即將到來的客人準備茶。

definition_zh: (片) 按下鍵盤或按鈕；保持按壓狀態
example_sentence: The player whose finger stays key down on the space bar wins the reaction test.
sentence_zh: 手指保持按下空格鍵的那位玩家贏得了反應測試。

definition_zh: (動) 專注於；鎖定目標　(動) 集中注意力於
example_sentence: If the marketing team keys in on teenage customers, product sales will increase significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果行銷團隊專注於青少年消費者，產品銷售將會大幅增加。

definition_zh: (動) 輸入；鍵入　(動) 參與；加入
example_sentence: Students must key in their passwords before accessing the online exam system.
sentence_zh: 學生必須輸入密碼才能進入線上考試系統。

definition_zh: (動) 著重；強調　(動) 依靠；利用
example_sentence: The marketing team decided to key on social media to reach more teenage customers.
sentence_zh: 行銷團隊決定著重社群媒體以接觸更多青少年顧客。

definition_zh: (介) 關鍵；重要的　(名) 成功的要素；關鍵因素
example_sentence: Regular practice is the key to improving English skills and passing the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 定期練習是提升英文能力和通過學測的關鍵因素。

sentence_zh: 莎拉的臥室架子上展示了許多她旅行時蒐集的彩色小擺設。

sentence_zh: 運動員努力訓練以擊倒對手並贏得冠軍。

sentence_zh: 馬克思埋頭苦幹準備功課後，他的數學成績終於進步了。

sentence_zh: 這家公司屈服於壓力，這導致員工獲得了更好的福利。

sentence_zh: 京都不僅以廟宇聞名，而且其傳統花園每年吸引數百萬遊客造訪。

definition_zh: (名) 實驗室；化驗室

sentence_zh: 學生進行實驗的化學實驗室配備了現代化的安全設備。

definition_zh: (名) 標籤；貼紙　(動) 貼標籤；稱呼

sentence_zh: 商店在標籤上使用條碼以快速追蹤和識別不同的產品。

definition_zh: (名) 勞動；勞工　(動) 勞力工作；努力

sentence_zh: 許多學生在暑假期間將兼職勞動與學校課業取得平衡。

definition_zh: (名) 實驗室；化學室

sentence_zh: 學生們在科學課期間在實驗室進行化學實驗。

definition_zh: (名) 勞動者；工人　(名) 體力勞動者；苦力

sentence_zh: 雖然那位工人在炎熱的陽光下長時間工作，他仍然致力於養家。

definition_zh: (形) 費力的；辛苦的　(形) 冗長乏味的；繁瑣的
example_sentence: Completing the research project, students found the laborious process exhausting but rewarding.
sentence_zh: 學生們在完成研究專案時，發現這個費力的過程令人疲憊，但最後也很有收穫。

definition_zh: (名) 蕾絲；花邊　(動) 用蕾絲裝飾；綁緊

sentence_zh: 新娘穿著的婚禮禮服上有精緻的蕾絲圖案。

definition_zh: (名) 缺乏；不足　(動) 缺少；短缺

sentence_zh: 如果學生缺乏定期練習，他們的英文能力就不會明顯進步。

definition_zh: (形) 缺乏光彩的；平庸的　(形) 不夠出色的；無趣的

sentence_zh: 這部電影獲得了評論家不太好的評價，令大多數觀眾失望。

definition_zh: (名) 男孩；少年　(名) 小伙子；年輕男性

sentence_zh: 那個男孩決定認真讀書以準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (名) 梯子；階梯　(名) 晉升的途徑；升遷機會

sentence_zh: 學生們被沉重的課本壓得喘不過氣來，緩緩走向校門。

sentence_zh: 用勺舀好熱湯倒入碗裡後，服務生小心地把它們送到每張桌子。

definition_zh: (名) 女士；夫人　(名) 女性；女孩

sentence_zh: 教我們英文的那位女士非常耐心又親切。

definition_zh: (名) 瓢蟲；七星瓢蟲

definition_zh: (動) 落後；進度緩慢　(動) 被超越；跟不上

sentence_zh: 如果學生不定期複習，他們在備考時會被同學超越。

definition_zh: (動) 落後；滯後　(名) 延遲；時間差

sentence_zh: 線上考試期間網路連線開始延遲，讓許多學生感到沮喪。

sentence_zh: 被珊瑚礁包圍的熱帶瀉湖為各種海洋生物提供庇護所。

definition_zh: (名) 湖；湖泊
example_sentence: As the sun sets over the lake, many students enjoy cycling along the peaceful shore.
sentence_zh: 當太陽在湖面落下時，許多學生喜歡在寧靜的湖岸邊騎自行車。

sentence_zh: 馬克為缺交作業所給的藉口非常蹩腳，沒人相信。

definition_zh: (動) 哀悼；悲嘆　(名) 悲歌；哀歌

sentence_zh: 學生聚集在一起為他們敬愛的老師去世而哀悼。

sentence_zh: 我書桌上的台燈幫助我更清楚地閱讀功課。

sentence_zh: 飛機在五小時的飛行後將在台北著陸。

sentence_zh: 因為莎拉忽視了警告信號，她最終陷入了與父母的嚴重麻煩中。

definition_zh: (動) 著陸；降落　(動) 與…一起；用

sentence_zh: 飛行員精確著陸，安全地將飛機引導到跑道上。

definition_zh: (名) 著陸；登陸　(名) 平台；樓梯間

sentence_zh: 飛機平穩的著陸讓所有乘客感到安全舒適。

definition_zh: (名) 女房東；女地主

sentence_zh: 房客聯絡女房東報告破損的窗戶。

definition_zh: (名) 房東；地主　(名) 旅館老闆；酒館老闆

definition_zh: (名) 地標；landmark　(名) 里程碑；重要事件

sentence_zh: 當台北101屹立於此時，許多遊客造訪它，因為它是著名的地標。

definition_zh: (名) 風景；景觀　(動) 進行景觀設計

sentence_zh: 贏得絕大多數票的這位候選人成為了新市長。

sentence_zh: 公車司機保持在左車道以避免高速公路上的交通。

definition_zh: (名) 語言；文字　(名) 表達方式；說話風格

sentence_zh: 在炎熱的夏日午後，學生們感到無精打采，很難專注於課程。

sentence_zh: 當狗貪婪地從碗裡喝水時，它高興地搖著尾巴。

sentence_zh: 很少有游泳選手在完成一圈而不感到疲憊，來自於高強度的訓練。

sentence_zh: 學生用於線上課程的筆記型電腦必須有長的電池續航力。

sentence_zh: 麵包師傅使用豬油來製作酥脆的酥皮點心和美味的餅乾。

sentence_zh: 校園裡那間寬敞的圖書館有數千本書供學生使用。

sentence_zh: 主要是因為線上學習變得更普遍，許多學生現在傾向在家裡讀書。

sentence_zh: 在教室裡胡鬧的學生們沒有注意到老師的到來。

sentence_zh: 醫生在手術中使用的激光技術已大大改善了患者的恢復速度。

definition_zh: (動) 用繩子牢固綁住；強烈批評

sentence_zh: 如果貨物沒有牢固綁住，在航行中就會移位。

sentence_zh: 教練因為球隊昨天比賽中粗心犯下的錯誤而嚴厲責罵他們。

definition_zh: (動) 猛力揮打；抨擊　(動) 反對；攻擊

sentence_zh: 環保人士組織抗議活動以反對該工廠的污染。

definition_zh: (動) 猛烈批評；對…發怒　(動) 突然攻擊；對…出手

sentence_zh: 當教練批評他的表現時，這名運動員在記者會上對不公平的言論猛烈回擊。

definition_zh: (動) 對...發怒；對...猛烈抨擊

sentence_zh: 當考試成績令人失望時，沮喪的學生對老師不公平地發怒。

definition_zh: (動) 猛烈抨擊；發洩怒火
example_sentence: Having lashed out at his teammates during practice, the coach later apologized for his harsh words.
sentence_zh: 在練習中猛烈抨擊隊友之後，教練後來為他的言語道歉。

definition_zh: (動) 鞭打；猛烈抨擊　(名) 鞭子；睫毛
example_sentence: The criticism that lashed the government's environmental policy prompted immediate reform discussions.
sentence_zh: 那份猛烈抨擊政府環境政策的批評促進了立即的改革討論。

definition_zh: (形) 最後的；最近的　(副) 最後；上次　(動) 持續；維持

sentence_zh: 在午夜離開車站的最後一班公車載著許多學生回家。

sentence_zh: 如果良好的學習習慣能夠持久，學生們就會取得更好的考試成績。

sentence_zh: 最後，在交卷前記得檢查你的答案。

definition_zh: (動) 緊緊抓住；死纏爛打

sentence_zh: 新產品才上市，顧客們就死纏爛打地看中它的創新設計。

definition_zh: (名) 門閂；掛鉤　(動) 上門閂；扣上

sentence_zh: 那個在暴風雨中損壞的窗戶門閂需要立即修理。

sentence_zh: 學生們熬夜以完成截止日期前的功課。

sentence_zh: 最近，許多學生為了學測考試而更努力地學習英文。

example_sentence: Having studied the map carefully, the navigator determined the ship's latitude and adjusted the course accordingly.
sentence_zh: 已經仔細研究了地圖，導航員判斷出船隻的緯度並相應調整了航向。

definition_zh: (形) 後者的；後面的　(代) 後者；兩者中的後一個
example_sentence: Between the two job offers, the latter one provides better benefits, which attracted many applicants.
sentence_zh: 在兩份工作機會中，後者提供更好的福利，這吸引了許多求職者。

definition_zh: (名) 格子；網狀結構　(形) 格子狀的；交叉的
example_sentence: The garden fence features a wooden lattice pattern that allows climbing roses to grow beautifully.
sentence_zh: 花園柵欄採用木製格子圖案，讓爬藤玫瑰能夠美麗生長。

definition_zh: (動) 稱讚；讚美　(動) 歌頌；讚揚
example_sentence: If the school principal lauded academic excellence more often, students would work harder to achieve their goals.
sentence_zh: 如果校長更經常稱讚學業成就，學生就會更努力地達成目標。

definition_zh: (動) 嘲笑；輕視　一笑置之；不當一回事
example_sentence: The student laughed off the criticism and focused on improving her grades.
sentence_zh: 那個學生一笑置之地對待批評，專注於提高成績。

definition_zh: (動) 笑；發笑　(名) 笑聲；笑
example_sentence: Laughing at the funny joke, the students couldn't stop giggling during the entire class.
sentence_zh: 對著有趣的笑話大笑，學生們在整堂課中都無法停止咯咯笑。

definition_zh: (名) 笑聲；歡笑
example_sentence: As the comedian told jokes, laughter filled the auditorium and made everyone feel joyful.
sentence_zh: 當喜劇演員講笑話時，笑聲充滿了禮堂，讓每個人都感到快樂。

definition_zh: (動) 發射；推出　(名) 發射；推出
example_sentence: Only after the company launched the new product did sales increase dramatically.
sentence_zh: 只有在公司推出新產品之後，銷售額才大幅增長。

definition_zh: (名) 洗衣服；洗衣店　(名) 待洗衣物；已洗衣物
example_sentence: The laundry that accumulated during the busy school semester finally got washed yesterday.
sentence_zh: 在繁忙的學期期間累積的洗衣物終於在昨天被洗了。

definition_zh: (名) 獲獎者；得獎人　(形) 獲獎的；榮獲獎項的
example_sentence: The Nobel Prize laureate studied hard to become a world-class scientist.
sentence_zh: 這位諾貝爾獎得主努力用功以成為世界級的科學家。

definition_zh: (名) 月桂樹；月桂冠　(動) 授予榮譽；表彰
example_sentence: Winning the national debate competition earned Maria the laurel of academic excellence.
sentence_zh: 贏得全國辯論比賽使瑪麗亞獲得了學術卓越的榮譽。

definition_zh: (名) 熔岩；火山岩漿
example_sentence: Hot lava flowed down the mountain during the volcanic eruption.
sentence_zh: 火山爆發期間，熾熱的熔岩沿著山坡流了下來。

definition_zh: (名) 廁所；盥洗室
example_sentence: Before boarding the airplane, passengers should use the lavatory so they feel comfortable during the flight.
sentence_zh: 上飛機前，乘客應該使用廁所，這樣他們在飛行中會感到舒適。

definition_zh: (名) 薰衣草；淡紫色　(形) 薰衣草色的；淡紫色的
example_sentence: Picking lavender flowers from the garden, Sarah prepared homemade soap for her friends.
sentence_zh: 莎拉從花園裡採摘薰衣草花朵，為朋友準備自製肥皂。

definition_zh: (形) 奢華的；豪華的　(動) 揮霍；慷慨給予
example_sentence: The wedding reception, which featured lavish decorations and expensive cuisine, impressed all the guests.
sentence_zh: 那場婚宴，配有奢華的裝飾和昂貴的美食，給所有賓客留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 法律；法令　(動) 控告；起訴
example_sentence: If students break school law, they will receive punishment from the discipline office.
sentence_zh: 如果學生違反校規，紀律室就會給予處罰。

definition_zh: (形) 合法的；守法的
example_sentence: Driving with a valid license is lawful, but breaking traffic rules is not.
sentence_zh: 持有有效駕照開車是合法的，但違反交通規則就不是。

definition_zh: (名) 立法者；議員
example_sentence: Lawmakers passed new education policies to improve school funding across Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 立法者通過新教育政策以改善台灣各校的經費。

definition_zh: (名) 草坪；草地
example_sentence: Every weekend, gardeners mow the lawn in front of the school building.
sentence_zh: 每個週末，園丁都在學校建築物前面修剪草坪。

definition_zh: (名) 訴訟；法律訴訟　(名) 民事案件
example_sentence: As the lawsuit dragged on for years, both companies spent millions on legal fees.
sentence_zh: 因為訴訟拖延了多年，兩家公司都花費數百萬元在法律費用上。

definition_zh: (名) 律師；法律顧問
example_sentence: Having graduated from law school, the lawyer defended his client with great skill in court.
sentence_zh: 從法律學院畢業後，這位律師在法庭上以高超的技巧為委託人辯護。

definition_zh: (形) 鬆散的；不嚴格的　(形) 疏忽的；怠惰的
example_sentence: The school's lax attendance policy, which allowed students to skip classes freely, eventually led to serious academic problems.
sentence_zh: 學校鬆散的出席政策（允許學生自由翹課）最終導致了嚴重的學業問題。

definition_zh: (動) 分期付款購買；預先訂購　(動) 暫時擱置；延後處理
example_sentence: Sarah decided to lay away a new winter coat by paying small amounts monthly.
sentence_zh: 莎拉決定透過每月支付小額款項來分期購買一件新的冬季外套。

definition_zh: (片) 聲稱擁有；主張權利
example_sentence: If the company laid claim to the patent, it would face years of expensive legal battles.
sentence_zh: 如果該公司聲稱擁有專利權，它將面臨多年昂貴的法律訴訟。

definition_zh: (動) 放下；放平　(動) 制定；規定
example_sentence: The doctor told the patient to lay down on the bed for a check-up.
sentence_zh: 醫生告訴病人在床上躺下進行檢查。

definition_zh: (動) 鋪設；放置　(動片) le ɪn ɑn 猛烈攻擊；痛罵
example_sentence: Laying in on his opponent with fierce criticism, the debater dominated the entire competition.
sentence_zh: 以激烈的批評猛烈攻擊對手，這位辯手主宰了整場比賽。

definition_zh: (動) 猛烈批評；嚴厲責罵　(動) 用力打擊；猛烈攻擊
example_sentence: After the team lost the final game, the coach laid into the players because they didn't play well.
sentence_zh: 在球隊輸掉最後比賽後，教練因為球員表現不佳而嚴厲責罵他們。

definition_zh: (動) 解僱；裁員　(動) 停止騷擾或打擾
example_sentence: Hardly ever does a company lay off workers without warning its employees first.
sentence_zh: 公司很少在沒有事先警告員工的情況下解僱工人。

definition_zh: (動) 供應；提供　(動) 責備；批評
example_sentence: The restaurant laid on a special dinner for guests who arrived early.
sentence_zh: 這家餐廳為提早到達的客人安排了特別晚餐。

definition_zh: (動) 陳列；展示　(動) 規劃；設計
example_sentence: The teacher laid out the poster boards to display students' research projects.
sentence_zh: 老師陳列海報板以展示學生的研究專案。

definition_zh: (動) 放置；鋪設　(動) 下蛋；產卵
example_sentence: The construction workers laid the foundation and built the house carefully.
sentence_zh: 建築工人鋪設地基並仔細建造房屋。

definition_zh: (名) 層；層次　(動) 分層；按層排列
example_sentence: The cake has three layers of chocolate and cream.
sentence_zh: 這個蛋糕有三層巧克力和奶油。

definition_zh: (名) 外行人；非專家　(形) 外行的；業餘的
example_sentence: Although the medical procedure seemed simple to the layman, the surgeon explained its complexity.
sentence_zh: 雖然這項醫療程序對外行人似乎很簡單，但外科醫生解釋了它的複雜性。

definition_zh: (名) 版面配置；設計構想　(動) 安排；布置
example_sentence: Having carefully planned the layout, the design team presented their new magazine cover to the editor.
sentence_zh: 經過仔細規劃版面配置後，設計團隊將他們新的雜誌封面呈現給編輯。

definition_zh: (名) 中途停留；轉機　(名) 中途停留的地點
example_sentence: The flight to New York, which includes a layover in Tokyo, departs at midnight.
sentence_zh: 這班飛往紐約的班機，在東京有中途停留，午夜時起飛。

definition_zh: (形) 懶惰的；不想動的　(形) 緩慢的；懶散的
example_sentence: If students are lazy about studying, they will fail the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 如果學生對讀書很懶惰，他們會在學測中不及格。

definition_zh: (名) 液晶顯示屏；液晶顯示器
example_sentence: Modern smartphones and televisions use LCD screens to display bright, clear images.
sentence_zh: 現代智慧型手機和電視使用液晶顯示屏來呈現明亮清晰的影像。

definition_zh: (動) 誘騙；哄騙　(動) 引導；帶領
example_sentence: Don't believe his promise—he's trying to lead you on to waste your time.
sentence_zh: 別相信他的承諾——他想哄騙你來浪費你的時間。

definition_zh: (動) 導致；引起　(動) 通往；經過
example_sentence: Eating too much junk food leads to serious health problems.
sentence_zh: 吃太多垃圾食物導致嚴重的健康問題。

definition_zh: (動) 導向；引向　(動) 逐漸發展到
example_sentence: Several small arguments led up to their final decision to break up.
sentence_zh: 幾場小爭執逐漸導向他們最後分手的決定。

definition_zh: (名) 引入；開場白　(動) 引導進入；作為開場
example_sentence: Having prepared a strong lead-in, the news anchor captured the audience's attention immediately.
sentence_zh: 新聞主播已準備好強有力的開場白，立即吸引了觀眾的注意力。

definition_zh: (動) 領導；帶領　(名) 領導；鉛
example_sentence: The captain who led the team to victory is someone that everyone respects.
sentence_zh: 帶領球隊取得勝利的隊長是每個人都尊敬的人。

definition_zh: (名) 領導者；首領
example_sentence: The student council leader organized the school event and inspired all team members.
sentence_zh: 學生會領導者組織了學校活動，並激勵了所有團隊成員。

definition_zh: (名) 領導；領導能力　領導者的角色或素質
example_sentence: If the student council president demonstrated stronger leadership, the school would organize better activities for everyone.
sentence_zh: 如果學生會主席展現出更強的領導力，學校就會為大家組織更好的活動。

definition_zh: (形) 領先的；主要的　(動) 帶領；引導
example_sentence: The leading technology company will launch a new smartphone next month.
sentence_zh: 領先的科技公司將於下個月推出新手機。

definition_zh: (名) 葉子；樹葉　(動) 翻頁；離開
example_sentence: Falling leaves scattered across the ground, creating a colorful autumn scene.
sentence_zh: 飄落的樹葉散落在地面上，呈現出繽紛的秋季景象。

definition_zh: (名) 傳單；小冊子
example_sentence: Because the community center distributed leaflets widely, many residents learned about the new health program.
sentence_zh: 由於社區中心廣泛發放傳單，許多居民得知了新的健康計畫。

definition_zh: (形) 葉子多的；生滿葉子的　(形) 翠綠的；蒼翠的
example_sentence: Only in leafy parks can urban students escape pollution and enjoy fresh air.
sentence_zh: 只有在生滿葉子的公園裡，城市學生才能逃離污染並享受新鮮空氣。

definition_zh: (名) 聯盟；協會　(名) 水平；等級
example_sentence: Athletes who compete in the professional league that offers the highest salary often attract global sponsorship deals.
sentence_zh: 在提供最高薪資的職業聯盟中競爭的運動員常常吸引全球贊助合約。

definition_zh: (動) 洩露；透露　(動) 滲漏；漏出
example_sentence: The company hired security consultants to prevent confidential information from leaking out.
sentence_zh: 這家公司聘請安全顧問以防止機密資訊洩露。

definition_zh: (名) 洩漏；漏水　(動) 洩露；漏出
example_sentence: The water leak under the kitchen sink needs immediate repair and attention.
sentence_zh: 廚房水槽下的漏水需要立即修理和處理。

definition_zh: (動) 依靠；倚賴　(動) 向某人借錢或尋求幫助
example_sentence: When facing difficulties, many students lean on their parents for support and advice.
sentence_zh: 面對困難時，許多學生依靠父母的支持和建議。

definition_zh: (形) 瘦的；精幹的　(動) 傾斜；靠著　(副) 朝向；傾向
example_sentence: As the deadline approaches, the budget becomes leaner, forcing the team to prioritize essential projects.
sentence_zh: 當截止日期臨近時，預算變得更加緊縮，迫使團隊優先考慮重要專案。

definition_zh: (動) 急忙抓住；迫不及待地接受
example_sentence: Seeing the job opportunity, many graduates leaped at the chance to join the company.
sentence_zh: 看到這份工作機會，許多畢業生迫不及待地接受了加入公司的機會。

definition_zh: (動) 跳躍；飛躍　(動) 突然出現；跳出
example_sentence: The unexpected plot twist, which leaped out at viewers, made the movie unforgettable.
sentence_zh: 那個突然跳出來的意想不到的情節轉折讓這部電影令人難以忘懷。

definition_zh: (動) 跳躍；跳過　(名) 跳躍；飛躍
example_sentence: If students leap at the opportunity to study abroad, their future career prospects will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生抓住出國留學的機會，他們未來的職業前景將會大幅改善。

definition_zh: (動) 學習；學會　(動) 得知；聽說
example_sentence: Students learn English grammar and vocabulary every day.
sentence_zh: 學生每天學習英文文法和單字。

definition_zh: (形) 有學問的；博學的　(動) 學到；獲得知識
example_sentence: Maria attended the university lecture to learn advanced physics from learned professors.
sentence_zh: 瑪莉亞參加大學講座，目的是向博學的教授學習先進物理學。

definition_zh: (名) 學習者；學生
example_sentence: Language learners benefit from practicing conversation with native speakers regularly.
sentence_zh: 語言學習者能藉由經常與母語使用者交談而獲益。

definition_zh: (名) 學習；學問　(動) 學習；獲悉
example_sentence: Since learning a new language requires daily practice, many students find it challenging to maintain progress.
sentence_zh: 由於學習新語言需要每天練習，許多學生發現很難保持進度。

definition_zh: (名) 租約；租賃　(動) 出租；租賃
example_sentence: Having leased the apartment for two years, the tenant decided to buy a house instead.
sentence_zh: 租賃該公寓兩年後，房客決定改買房子。

definition_zh: (名) 皮帶；繩子　(動) 用皮帶拴住；束縛
example_sentence: The dog that broke free from its leash ran wildly through the park.
sentence_zh: 那條從皮帶掙脫的狗在公園裡狂奔。

definition_zh: (形) 最少的；最小的　(副) 最少；至少
example_sentence: Studying at least one hour every day helps students improve their English scores significantly.
sentence_zh: 每天至少學習一小時能幫助學生顯著提高英文成績。

definition_zh: (名) 皮革；皮革製品　(形) 皮革的；用皮革製成的
example_sentence: If the leather jacket were not so expensive, many students would buy one for winter.
sentence_zh: 如果皮夾克不那麼昂貴，許多學生就會為了冬天而購買一件。

definition_zh: (動) 遺棄；放棄不管
example_sentence: The injured hiker was left for dead in the mountains until rescue workers found him.
sentence_zh: 那名受傷的登山者在山區被遺棄，直到救難人員找到他為止。

definition_zh: (動) 保持開啟；繼續亮著　(動) 依靠；靠...生活
example_sentence: Leaving the bedroom light on all night, Sarah wasted a lot of electricity.
sentence_zh: 整晚保持臥室燈亮著，莎拉浪費了很多電力。

definition_zh: (動) 遺漏；忽略　(動) 不包括；排除
example_sentence: When listing team members, the coach left out the injured players who couldn't attend practice.
sentence_zh: 當列舉隊員名單時，教練遺漏了無法參加練習的受傷球員。

definition_zh: (動) 離開；出發　(動) 留下；遺留
example_sentence: Only after the teacher leaves will students relax and chat with friends.
sentence_zh: 只有在老師離開之後，學生們才會放鬆並和朋友聊天。

definition_zh: (動) 離開前往；出發去
example_sentence: The train that leaves for Taipei departs every hour during rush time.
sentence_zh: 前往台北的火車在尖峰時段每小時出發一班。

definition_zh: (名) 講座；演講　(動) 給...上課；講演
example_sentence: Many students attend the chemistry lecture to understand difficult concepts better.
sentence_zh: 許多學生參加化學講座，以便更好地理解困難的概念。

definition_zh: (名) 講師；講課者　(名) 演講；講演
example_sentence: The visiting lecturer from National Taiwan University shared research findings with our chemistry class yesterday.
sentence_zh: 來自國立臺灣大學的客座講師昨天與我們化學班分享研究發現。

definition_zh: (名) 帳簿；總分類帳　(名) 記錄簿；登記冊
example_sentence: The accountant updates the company ledger every month.
sentence_zh: 會計每個月更新公司的帳簿。

definition_zh: (名) 船的下風側；庇護處　(形) 在下風的；受保護的
example_sentence: As the storm approached, the sailors moved to the lee side of the island where winds were calmer.
sentence_zh: 當暴風雨靠近時，水手們移動到島嶼的下風側，那裡風平浪靜。

definition_zh: (名) 韭菜；蔥
example_sentence: Leeks, growing tall in the vegetable garden, provide essential nutrients for healthy cooking.
sentence_zh: 在菜園中長高的韭菜提供了健康烹飪所需的必要營養。

definition_zh: (名) 左翼；左派　(形) 左翼的；左派的
example_sentence: The left wing, which advocates for social equality, gained more support among younger voters.
sentence_zh: 主張社會平等的左翼在年輕選民中獲得了更多支持。

definition_zh: (形) 左手的；用左手的　(名) 左手；左手人
example_sentence: If a student were left-hand, the teacher would provide a specially designed desk for writing.
sentence_zh: 如果學生是左撇子，老師會提供特殊設計的書桌供其書寫。

definition_zh: (形) 左邊的；左側的　(動) 離開；留下
example_sentence: Students turned left to enter the classroom and find their seats.
sentence_zh: 學生向左轉進教室去尋找他們的座位。

definition_zh: (名) 剩飯；剩菜　(形) 剩餘的；多餘的
example_sentence: My mother always saves the leftover rice and vegetables for lunch tomorrow.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽總是把剩飯和剩菜留到明天午餐吃。

definition_zh: (名) 剩飯；剩菜
example_sentence: Before throwing away leftovers, Mom always wraps them carefully so they stay fresh.
sentence_zh: 在丟掉剩飯之前，媽媽總是小心地包好它們，這樣它們才能保持新鮮。

definition_zh: (名) 腿；腿部　(名) 褲腿；衣服的腿部
example_sentence: Having broken his leg during the basketball game, the player sat on the bench for weeks.
sentence_zh: 在籃球比賽中腿部骨折後，這名球員在板凳上坐了好幾週。

definition_zh: (名) 遺產；傳承　(名) 遺留物；影響
example_sentence: The university's legacy, which was built by generations of dedicated educators, continues to inspire countless students.
sentence_zh: 這所大學的遺產是由歷代奉獻的教育工作者建立的，持續激勵著無數學生。

definition_zh: (形) 合法的；法律的　(形) 正當的；有效的
example_sentence: Obtaining a driver's license is the legal requirement for operating a vehicle safely.
sentence_zh: 取得駕照是合法開車的必要條件。

definition_zh: (副) 合法地；依法地　(副) 正式地；正當地
example_sentence: If the company did not operate legally, the government would shut down its business immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果公司沒有合法經營，政府會立即關閉其業務。

definition_zh: (名) 傳奇；傳說　(名) 圖例；說明
example_sentence: The soccer player became a legend after winning three world cups.
sentence_zh: 這位足球選手在贏得三次世界盃後成為傳奇人物。

definition_zh: (形) 傳說中的；著名的　(形) 非常出色的；傳奇的
example_sentence: Having trained for years, the legendary athlete finally won the Olympic gold medal.
sentence_zh: 經過多年訓練，這位傳奇運動員終於贏得奧運金牌。

definition_zh: (形) 清晰易讀的；易辨認的
example_sentence: Although the old letter's ink had faded, the handwriting remained legible enough for historians to study.
sentence_zh: 雖然那封老信的墨水已褪色，但筆跡仍夠清晰易讀，讓歷史學家能夠研究。

definition_zh: (名) 軍團；大批　(名) 美國退伍軍人組織
example_sentence: Not only did the soldiers form a legion, but also their courage inspired the entire nation.
sentence_zh: 不僅士兵們組成了一支軍團，而且他們的勇氣鼓舞了整個國家。

definition_zh: (動) 立法；制定法律　(動) 通過法律
example_sentence: The parliament that legislates environmental protection laws must consider public health carefully.
sentence_zh: 制定環保法律的國會必須仔細考慮公共衛生。

definition_zh: (名) 法律；法案　(名) 立法；制定法律
example_sentence: The government passed new legislation to protect the environment and reduce pollution.
sentence_zh: 政府通過新法律以保護環境並減少污染。

definition_zh: (形) 立法的；法律制定的　(形) 立法權的；議會的
example_sentence: The legislative branch of government passes laws affecting all citizens and their daily lives.
sentence_zh: 政府的立法部門制定影響所有公民日常生活的法律。

definition_zh: (名) 立法者；議員　(名) 國會議員；代表
example_sentence: The legislators debated the new education policy for several hours.
sentence_zh: 立法者們就新的教育政策辯論了好幾個小時。

definition_zh: (名) 立法機關；立法部門
example_sentence: Because the legislature must approve the new education policy, the government held public hearings to gather opinions.
sentence_zh: 因為立法機關必須批准新的教育政策，政府舉辦公聽會來蒐集意見。

definition_zh: (名) 合法性；正當性　(名) 權威性；可信度
example_sentence: Having transparent policies, the government gained public legitimacy among skeptical voters.
sentence_zh: 透過透明的政策，政府在懷疑的選民中獲得了公眾的合法性。

definition_zh: (形) 合法的；正當的　(形) 真實的；正宗的
example_sentence: The government's decision, which many citizens viewed as legitimate, sparked heated debate among lawmakers.
sentence_zh: 政府的決定（許多市民認為該決定是正當的）在立法者之間引發激烈辯論。

definition_zh: (副) 合法地；正當地　(副) 真正地；確實地
example_sentence: If students submit assignments on time, teachers will legitimately give them full credit for their work.
sentence_zh: 如果學生按時繳交作業，老師就會合法地給予他們的作業滿分。

definition_zh: (名) 豆科植物；豆類
example_sentence: Peanuts and soybeans are popular legumes grown by farmers.
sentence_zh: 花生和大豆是農民種植的受歡迎豆科植物。

definition_zh: (名) 閒暇；休閒時間　(形) 悠閒的；不急的
example_sentence: Many students use weekends to relax and pursue leisure activities they enjoy.
sentence_zh: 許多學生利用週末來放鬆身心，從事他們喜愛的閒暇活動。

definition_zh: (副) 悠閒地；不急不躁地　(形) 悠閒的；從容的
example_sentence: After finishing the exam, students walked leisurely through the school garden, enjoying the afternoon sunshine.
sentence_zh: 考試結束後，學生悠閒地穿過校園，享受午後陽光。

definition_zh: (名) 旅鼠；鼠類動物
example_sentence: Although lemmings are small rodents, they migrate in massive groups when food becomes scarce.
sentence_zh: 雖然旅鼠是小型嚙齒動物，但當食物變得稀缺時，牠們會大規模遷徙。

definition_zh: (名) 檸檬；檸檬色　(形) 有缺陷的；不滿意的
example_sentence: Having squeezed the lemon, Maria added the juice to her tea.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞擠完檸檬後，將檸檬汁加入茶裡。

definition_zh: (名) 檸檬汽水；檸檬飲料
example_sentence: The lemonade that Maria made for the summer picnic was refreshingly sweet.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞為夏日野餐製作的檸檬汽水既清涼又甜美。

definition_zh: (動) 借出；貸款　(名) 借貸；貸款
example_sentence: Banks lend money to customers who want to buy houses or start businesses.
sentence_zh: 銀行借錢給想買房子或創業的客戶。

definition_zh: (名) 長度；長さ　(名) 時間長度；期間
example_sentence: If the essay length were shorter, students would finish the exam more easily.
sentence_zh: 如果論文長度更短，學生會更容易完成考試。

definition_zh: (動) 延長；拉長
example_sentence: The coach decided to lengthen the training session by thirty minutes.
sentence_zh: 教練決定將訓練課程延長三十分鐘。

definition_zh: (形) 冗長的；冗贅的　(形) 漫長的；持久的
example_sentence: Lasting several hours, the lengthy meeting left students feeling exhausted and frustrated.
sentence_zh: 這場冗長的會議持續了好幾個小時，使學生感到疲憊和沮喪。

definition_zh: (名) 透鏡；鏡片　(名) 鏡頭；相機的光學系統
example_sentence: As the camera lens captures the sunset, students can appreciate how light bends through curved glass.
sentence_zh: 當相機鏡頭捕捉日落時，學生可以欣賞光如何透過彎曲的玻璃折射。

definition_zh: (名) 豹；花豹
example_sentence: Seldom does a leopard change its spots in the wild African savanna.
sentence_zh: 野生非洲稀樹草原中，豹很少改變其身上的斑點。

definition_zh: (名) 痲瘋病患者；被隔離的人
example_sentence: The leper, who was rejected by his family, found acceptance in the monastery.
sentence_zh: 那位被家人拒絕的痲瘋病患者在修道院裡找到了接納。

definition_zh: (名) 女同志；女同性戀者　(形) 女同志的；女同性戀的
example_sentence: The organization started a support group to help lesbian teenagers feel accepted and confident.
sentence_zh: 該組織開始了一個支持小組，目的是幫助女同志青少年感到被接納和自信。

definition_zh: (片) 沒那麼大的轉變；不是很大的跳躍
example_sentence: Switching from high school to university is less of a leap when students attend orientation programs beforehand.
sentence_zh: 當學生事先參加迎新活動時，從高中升大學就沒那麼大的轉變。

definition_zh: (形) 較少的；更少的　(副) 較少地；更少　(介) 除去；減去
example_sentence: Eating less sugar and drinking more water helps improve health.
sentence_zh: 吃較少的糖和喝更多的水有助於改善健康。

definition_zh: (動) 減少；減輕　(動) 降低；緩和
example_sentence: As the medicine takes effect, the patient's pain lessens significantly.
sentence_zh: 當藥物開始起作用時，病人的疼痛明顯減輕。

definition_zh: (形) 較少的；較小的　(代) 較少量；更小的東西
example_sentence: Considering the environmental impact, choosing the lesser option reduces plastic waste significantly.
sentence_zh: 考慮到環境影響，選擇較少的塑膠垃圾的選項能顯著減少廢料。

definition_zh: (名) 課程；課　(名) 教訓；經驗教訓
example_sentence: The lesson which the teacher explained yesterday was quite difficult for most students.
sentence_zh: 老師昨天講解的課程對大多數學生來說相當困難。

definition_zh: (連) 以免；唯恐　(介) 以免；免得
example_sentence: Students must review their notes regularly lest they forget important grammar rules before the exam.
sentence_zh: 學生必須定期複習筆記，以免在考試前忘記重要的文法規則。

definition_zh: (動) 令人失望；辜負　(動) 放下；降低
example_sentence: Missing the final exam let down the entire study group's expectations.
sentence_zh: 缺席期末考讓整個讀書小組感到失望。

definition_zh: (動) 告訴某人祕密；讓某人參與
example_sentence: Sarah decided to let her best friend in on the surprise party plans.
sentence_zh: 莎拉決定告訴她最好的朋友這個驚喜派對的計畫。

definition_zh: (動) 讓進入；允許進入　(動) 開始下雨；開始漏水
example_sentence: The security guard let in only authorized visitors with valid identification cards.
sentence_zh: 保安人員只讓持有有效識別證的授權訪客進入。

definition_zh: (動) 放掉；釋放　(動) 免除；放過
example_sentence: Although the police caught the thief, they let him off with a warning.
sentence_zh: 雖然警察逮捕了小偷，但他們只是警告他就放他走了。

definition_zh: (動) 洩露；暗示　(動) 假裝；揭露
example_sentence: Having let on about the surprise party, Sarah regretted her careless words immediately.
sentence_zh: 已經洩露了驚喜派對的秘密後，莎拉立即為她粗心的言語感到後悔。

definition_zh: (動) 發出；放出　(動) 租出；出租
example_sentence: The stadium let out a roar that echoed through the entire city.
sentence_zh: 這座體育館發出的吶喊聲迴盪整個城市。

definition_zh: (動) 減弱；停止；放鬆　(動) 緩解；減輕
example_sentence: The heavy rain finally let up, allowing the outdoor concert to continue.
sentence_zh: 這場大雨終於減弱了，讓戶外音樂會能夠繼續進行。

definition_zh: (動) 讓；允許　(動) 出租；租出
example_sentence: If parents let their children practice English daily, speaking ability would improve dramatically.
sentence_zh: 如果父母讓孩子每天練習英文，說話能力就會大幅進步。

definition_zh: (動) 讓；允許　(動) 出租；租出
example_sentence: My parents let me stay up late on weekends to watch movies.
sentence_zh: 我的父母在週末讓我熬夜看電影。

definition_zh: (形) 致命的；可致死的　(形) 極其有害的；嚴重的
example_sentence: Containing lethal doses of poison, the contaminated water spread rapidly through the town.
sentence_zh: 含有致命劑量毒物的受污染水源在城鎮中迅速蔓延。

definition_zh: (名) 昏睡；精神不振　(形) 無精打采的；遲鈍的
example_sentence: Although the medication helped her illness, the side effects caused such lethargy that studying became difficult.
sentence_zh: 雖然藥物幫助了她的病情，但副作用造成的精神不振使得讀書變得困難。

definition_zh: (片) 洩露；透露　(動) 放出；發出
example_sentence: Not only did the student let out a secret, but also regretted immediately.
sentence_zh: 那位學生不但洩露了秘密，而且立刻感到後悔。

definition_zh: (名) 信；信件　(名) 字母；文字
example_sentence: The letter that Sarah received from her pen pal in Japan made her very happy.
sentence_zh: 莎拉從日本筆友收到的那封信讓她非常高興。

definition_zh: (名) 信紙抬頭；公司信箋
example_sentence: Companies use letterhead to print their name and address in order to look professional.
sentence_zh: 公司使用信紙抬頭以便看起來更專業。

definition_zh: (名) 萵苣；生菜
example_sentence: Fresh lettuce and tomato make a healthy salad for lunch.
sentence_zh: 新鮮的萵苣和番茄做成健康的午餐沙拉。

definition_zh: (名) 減弱；緩和　(動) 減少；停止
example_sentence: After weeks of rain, there was finally a letup in the bad weather.
sentence_zh: 經過幾週的雨後，惡劣天氣終於有所減弱。

definition_zh: (動) 趨於平穩；停止上升　(動) 保持穩定；達到平衡
example_sentence: After the initial excitement faded, sales leveled off at a steady rate each month.
sentence_zh: 初期的興奮褪去後，銷售額趨於平穩，每個月保持穩定的速度。

definition_zh: (動) 升級；進階　(動) 提升技能或水平
example_sentence: Leveling up in the game, players unlock powerful new weapons and abilities.
sentence_zh: 在遊戲中升級，玩家會解鎖強大的新武器和能力。

definition_zh: (動) 與某人坦誠相告；平坦對待　(動) 與某人平等相待；開誠布公
example_sentence: The manager decided to level with employees who questioned the company's new policy.
sentence_zh: 經理決定與質疑公司新政策的員工坦誠相告。

definition_zh: (名) 水準；等級　(動) 使平坦；使相等　(形) 平的；水平的
example_sentence: If students maintain a consistent study schedule, their English proficiency level will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生維持一致的學習進度，他們的英文程度將會顯著進步。

definition_zh: (名) 槓桿；控制桿　(動) 用槓桿撬動；舉起
example_sentence: The engineer used a metal lever to lift the heavy machine.
sentence_zh: 工程師用金屬槓桿舉起那台重機器。

definition_zh: (名) 巨獸；龐然大物　(名) 海怪；怪獸
example_sentence: Environmental groups mobilized to confront the corporate leviathan threatening coastal ecosystems.
sentence_zh: 環保團體動員起來對抗威脅沿海生態系的龐大企業怪獸。

definition_zh: (動) 浮起；懸浮　(名) 浮起；懸浮現象
example_sentence: The magician made the assistant levitate above the stage during the amazing performance.
sentence_zh: 魔術師在令人驚豔的表演中，讓助手在舞台上方浮起。

definition_zh: (名) 懸浮者；使物體漂浮的人或物
example_sentence: Although the magician performed as a levitator on stage, few audience members understood the scientific principles behind the illusion.
sentence_zh: 雖然魔術師在舞臺上表演為懸浮者，但很少觀眾理解這場幻覺背後的科學原理。

definition_zh: (動) 徵收；課稅　(名) 稅款；徵收
example_sentence: Having levied a new property tax, the government faced strong public criticism.
sentence_zh: 在徵收新的房產稅後，政府面臨強烈的公眾批評。

definition_zh: (名) 責任；法律責任　(名) 缺點；不利因素
example_sentence: The company faces a serious liability that could damage its reputation among consumers.
sentence_zh: 該公司面臨一項嚴重的責任，這可能會傷害其在消費者中的聲譽。

definition_zh: (形) 可能的；容易的　(形) 有責任的；需要負責的
example_sentence: Drivers who park illegally are liable to receive a fine from traffic police.
sentence_zh: 違法停車的駕駛人可能會被交通警察罰款。

definition_zh: (名) 說謊者；騙子
example_sentence: If that student were a liar, teachers would never trust his test answers again.
sentence_zh: 如果那個學生是說謊者，老師就不會再相信他的考試答案。

definition_zh: (名) 誹謗；不實指控　(動) 誹謗；誣告
example_sentence: Publishing false statements about someone's character constitutes libel.
sentence_zh: 發表關於某人品格的虛假陳述構成誹謗罪。

definition_zh: (形) 自由的；開放的　(形) 寬宏的；慷慨的
example_sentence: Having liberal parents who encourage independent thinking, many teenagers develop stronger critical skills.
sentence_zh: 擁有支持獨立思考的開放型父母，許多青少年培養出更強的批判性思維能力。

definition_zh: (動) 使自由化；放寬限制
example_sentence: As the government liberalizes trade policies, more foreign companies enter the market.
sentence_zh: 當政府放寬貿易政策時，更多外國公司進入市場。

definition_zh: (副) 慷慨地；大量地　自由地；不嚴格地
example_sentence: Not only did the charity distribute food liberally, but also provided medical care.
sentence_zh: 不僅慈善機構慷慨分發食物，而且還提供醫療照護。

definition_zh: (動) 解放；使自由　(動) 使擺脫；減輕
example_sentence: The government policies that liberate young people from excessive academic pressure have gained widespread support.
sentence_zh: 那些使年輕人擺脫過度學業壓力的政府政策獲得了廣泛支持。

definition_zh: (名) 解放；自由　(名) 獲得自由的行為
example_sentence: Many activists fought to achieve liberation and build a more just society.
sentence_zh: 許多活動人士為了爭取解放並建立更公正的社會而奮鬥。

definition_zh: (名) 解放者；救星　(名) 拯救者；自由鬥士
example_sentence: Nelson Mandela became the liberator of South Africa through decades of courageous struggle.
sentence_zh: 納爾遜·曼德拉通過數十年的勇敢鬥爭成為了南非的解放者。

definition_zh: (名) 自由；自主　(名) 許可；權利
example_sentence: Freedom and liberty are important values in democratic societies.
sentence_zh: 自由和權利是民主社會中的重要價值。

definition_zh: (名) 圖書館員；書籍管理員
example_sentence: Because the librarian organized books carefully, students found research materials easily.
sentence_zh: 由於圖書館員細心整理書籍，學生很容易找到研究資料。

definition_zh: (名) 圖書館；藏書室
example_sentence: Studying in the library, students prepare for the CSAT exam quietly.
sentence_zh: 在圖書館讀書，學生們為學測考試安靜地準備。

definition_zh: (名) 執照；許可證　(動) 頒發執照；核准
example_sentence: A driver's license that expires next month requires immediate renewal at the local office.
sentence_zh: 一張下個月到期的駕駛執照需要在當地辦公室立即更新。

definition_zh: (名) 持證人；被授權人　獲得許可證的個人或公司
example_sentence: If the licensee fails to pay the annual fee, the company will suspend their operating rights immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果持證人未能按時繳納年費，公司將立即暫停其營運權。

definition_zh: (動) 舔；舥　(動) 戰勝；擊敗
example_sentence: The dog licked its owner's face after they came home from school.
sentence_zh: 那隻狗在主人放學回家後舔了主人的臉。

definition_zh: (名) 蓋子；蓋　(動) 用蓋子蓋住；覆蓋
example_sentence: Use a lid to cover the pot in order to keep the heat inside.
sentence_zh: 用蓋子蓋住鍋子以便保留內部的熱度。

definition_zh: (動) 懶散地躺著；閒散地放在某處
example_sentence: Dirty clothes lie around the bedroom floor, waiting to be washed.
sentence_zh: 髒衣服懶散地散落在臥室地板上，等著被洗。

definition_zh: (動) 躺下；臥下　(片語) 仰卧於
example_sentence: After finishing homework, the student lay down on the bed to rest for a few minutes.
sentence_zh: 完成功課後，這名學生躺在床上休息幾分鐘。

definition_zh: (動) 躺下；平躺
example_sentence: Having lain down for an hour, the exhausted student finally felt ready to sleep.
sentence_zh: 那名疲憊的學生躺了一小時後，終於感到準備好睡覺了。

definition_zh: (動) 在於；存在於　(動) 躺在床上；睡懶覺
example_sentence: The main problem that lies in the education system requires immediate reform and attention.
sentence_zh: 存在於教育系統中的主要問題需要立即改革和關注。

definition_zh: (動) 在於；存在於　(動) 與...有關；由...引起
example_sentence: The problem lies with poor communication between the two departments.
sentence_zh: 問題在於兩個部門之間的溝通不良。

definition_zh: (動) 說謊；撒謊　(名) 謊言；假話
example_sentence: If students lied about their homework, teachers would give them a serious warning.
sentence_zh: 如果學生謊報功課，老師就會給他們一個嚴重警告。

definition_zh: (名) 中尉；副官
example_sentence: The lieutenant led the troops across the battlefield with great courage.
sentence_zh: 那位中尉以極大的勇氣帶領部隊穿過戰場。

definition_zh: (名) 生命；人生　(名) 生活；生活方式
example_sentence: Living a healthy life, many students improve their exam performance.
sentence_zh: 過著健康的生活，許多學生提高了他們的考試成績。

definition_zh: (名) 救生艇；生命艇
example_sentence: As the ship began to sink, passengers rushed toward the lifeboats before it was too late.
sentence_zh: 當船開始沉沒時，乘客在為時已晚之前衝向救生艇。

definition_zh: (名) 生命週期；產品生命週期
example_sentence: Only after a product enters the market does its lifecycle truly begin.
sentence_zh: 只有在產品進入市場後，它的生命週期才真正開始。

definition_zh: (名) 救生員；生命衛士　(動) 擔任救生員；保護
example_sentence: The lifeguard who watched the beach every summer rescued many swimmers in danger.
sentence_zh: 每個夏天都在海灘監視的那位救生員救了許多處於危險中的游泳者。

definition_zh: (形) 栩栩如生的；逼真的　(形) 活靈活現的；生動的
example_sentence: The museum used lifelike dolls to show visitors how people lived long ago.
sentence_zh: 博物館使用栩栩如生的娃娃向遊客展示古人的生活方式。

definition_zh: (形) 終身的；一生的　(副) 整個人生期間
example_sentence: Learning a foreign language is a lifelong journey requiring constant practice and dedication.
sentence_zh: 學習外語是終身的旅程，需要不斷的練習和奉獻。

definition_zh: (名) 壽命；人生期間　(名) 使用期限；存在期間
example_sentence: The average human lifespan has increased significantly over the past century.
sentence_zh: 過去一個世紀，人類平均壽命明顯延長。

definition_zh: (名) 生活方式；生活風格
example_sentence: As people become more health-conscious, adopting an active lifestyle becomes increasingly important for overall wellness.
sentence_zh: 隨著人們越來越重視健康，採取積極的生活方式對整體健康變得越來越重要。

definition_zh: (名) 一生；終身　(名) 人生經歷；生涯
example_sentence: Having achieved his dream throughout his lifetime, the scientist inspired countless young researchers worldwide.
sentence_zh: 這位科學家在他的一生中實現了夢想，激勵了世界各地無數年輕研究者。

definition_zh: (動) 起飛；升空　(動) 開始；啟動
example_sentence: The rocket, which had been prepared for months, lifted off successfully at dawn.
sentence_zh: 那枚經過數月準備的火箭在黎明時成功起飛。

definition_zh: (名) 電梯；升起　(動) 舉起；提高　(動) 搭便車
example_sentence: If students lift heavy boxes without proper technique, their back muscles will become injured.
sentence_zh: 如果學生沒有正確的技巧舉起重箱子，他們的背部肌肉會受傷。

definition_zh: (名) 火箭升空；起飛
example_sentence: The rocket's liftoff was delayed due to bad weather conditions.
sentence_zh: 由於天氣惡劣，火箭的升空被延遲了。

definition_zh: (名) 韌帶；連接組織
example_sentence: Athletes need strong ligaments to prevent injuries during intense physical training.
sentence_zh: 運動員需要強健的韌帶以防止在高強度訓練中受傷。

definition_zh: (片) 逃跑；迅速離開
example_sentence: When the police arrived at the scene, the suspect lit out for the nearby forest.
sentence_zh: 警察抵達現場時，嫌疑人迅速逃往附近的森林。

definition_zh: (動) 點亮；照亮　(動) 興奮；變得高興
example_sentence: When Sarah received the acceptance letter, her face lit up with joy and excitement.
sentence_zh: 當莎拉收到錄取通知時，她的臉因喜悅和興奮而綻放光彩。

definition_zh: (形) 輕鬆愉快的；不嚴肅的
example_sentence: Having finished the difficult exam, students enjoyed a light-hearted conversation about their summer plans.
sentence_zh: 完成了困難的考試後，學生們享受了一場關於暑假計畫的輕鬆愉快的談話。

definition_zh: (名) 光；燈　(形) 輕的；淡的　(動) 點燃；照亮
example_sentence: The lamp that provides light in the classroom helps students read textbooks easily.
sentence_zh: 在教室裡提供光線的那盞燈幫助學生輕鬆閱讀課本。

definition_zh: (動) 放松；不要那么严肃　(動) 减轻；使变轻
example_sentence: Stop worrying about the test result and lighten up a bit.
sentence_zh: 别再担心考试成绩了，放松一点吧。

definition_zh: (動) 減輕；使變輕　(動) 使心情好轉；改善
example_sentence: If students lighten their study load before the CSAT, their stress would decrease significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在學測前減輕讀書負擔，他們的壓力就會明顯降低。

definition_zh: (形) 輕鬆愉快的；不嚴肅的　(形) 無憂無慮的；開朗的
example_sentence: The lighthearted comedy movie made the entire audience laugh throughout the whole film.
sentence_zh: 那部輕鬆愉快的喜劇電影讓全場觀眾從頭笑到尾。

definition_zh: (名) 燈塔；指引方向的建築物
example_sentence: Standing on the rocky cliff, the lighthouse guided lost ships safely back to harbor.
sentence_zh: 矗立在岩石峭壁上的燈塔將失迷的船隻安全引導回港口。

definition_zh: (名) 照明；燈光　(動) 點燃；照亮
example_sentence: As the stage lighting dimmed, the audience fell silent and waited for the performance to begin.
sentence_zh: 當舞台燈光暗淡下來時，觀眾沉默了，等待表演開始。

definition_zh: (名) 閃電；電光　(形) 閃電般的；迅速的
example_sentence: Hardly had the storm started when lightning struck the tall building near the school.
sentence_zh: 暴風雨才剛開始，閃電就擊中了學校附近的高樓。

definition_zh: (形) 輕量的；重量輕的　(名) 輕量級選手
example_sentence: The backpack, which is lightweight and durable, is perfect for students who travel to school daily.
sentence_zh: 這個輕量化的背包既耐用又完美，適合每天通勤上學的學生。

definition_zh: (片語) 獨一無二的；無與倫比的
example_sentence: The new smartphone's camera quality is like no other to attract young customers.
sentence_zh: 這款新智慧型手機的相機品質無與倫比，目的是吸引年輕消費者。

definition_zh: (動) 喜歡；喜愛　(介) 像；如同　(名) 喜好；偏好
example_sentence: Many students like studying with friends and drinking bubble tea together.
sentence_zh: 許多學生喜歡和朋友一起讀書並喝珍珠奶茶。

definition_zh: (名) 可能性；機率
example_sentence: The likelihood of rain tomorrow increases based on weather forecasts.
sentence_zh: 根據天氣預報，明天下雨的可能性增加了。

definition_zh: (副) 可能地；很可能　(形) 可能的；有希望的
example_sentence: Since the weather forecast predicts rain tomorrow, outdoor sports activities are likely to be postponed.
sentence_zh: 由於天氣預報預測明天會下雨，戶外運動活動很可能會延期。

definition_zh: (名) 相似；相似之處　(名) 肖像；畫像
example_sentence: Bearing a striking likeness to her mother, the daughter attracted everyone's attention at the family reunion.
sentence_zh: 那個女兒與母親有著驚人的相似之處，在家庭聚會上吸引了所有人的注意。

definition_zh: (副) 同樣地；也；同樣　(連) 同樣；並且
example_sentence: Sarah studied hard for the exam, and her classmates, likewise diligent in their preparation, achieved excellent results.
sentence_zh: 莎拉為考試用功讀書，而她的同學們同樣認真準備，也取得了優異的成績。

definition_zh: (名) 百合花；百合　(名) 百合球莖
example_sentence: If gardeners plant lilies in spring, the flowers will bloom beautifully by summer.
sentence_zh: 如果園丁在春天種植百合花，花朵將在夏天美麗地綻放。

definition_zh: (名) 四肢；手臂或腿　(名) 樹枝；分支
example_sentence: The athlete injured her left limb during the basketball game last week.
sentence_zh: 那位運動員在上週的籃球比賽中傷到左臂。

definition_zh: (片) 為了做某事而熱身；為了準備而練習
example_sentence: Athletes stretch and jog to limber up for the track meet this weekend.
sentence_zh: 運動員伸展和慢跑是為了為本週末的田徑賽做準備。

definition_zh: (動) 暖身；做準備活動
example_sentence: The soccer team limbered up for thirty minutes before the match began.
sentence_zh: 足球隊在比賽開始前花了三十分鐘來暖身。

definition_zh: (形) 柔軟的；靈活的　(動) 做柔軟操；放鬆身體
example_sentence: Before the basketball game starts, the players stretch their muscles so that their bodies become limber and ready to play.
sentence_zh: 籃球比賽開始前，選手們伸展肌肉，使身體變得柔軟靈活並準備好比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 不確定的狀態；邊緣　(名) 舞蹈遊戲
example_sentence: Having waited for the exam results for weeks, students found themselves in limbo.
sentence_zh: 等待考試成績數週後，學生們發現自己處於不確定的狀態。

definition_zh: (名) 萊姆；酸橙　(名) 石灰　(形) 萊姆色的；淡綠色的
example_sentence: The fresh limes that the vendor sells at the market are always sour and juicy.
sentence_zh: 小販在市場販售的新鮮萊姆總是酸多汁的。

definition_zh: (名) 聚光燈；受關注的焦點　(動) 使成為焦點；突出
example_sentence: Winning the championship put the young athlete in the limelight.
sentence_zh: 贏得冠軍讓這位年輕運動員成為聚焦的焦點。

definition_zh: (名) 限制；界限　(動) 限制；受限於
example_sentence: If students didn't limit their screen time, their study performance would drop significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生不限制使用螢幕的時間，他們的學習表現就會大幅下降。

definition_zh: (名) 限制；局限　(名) 缺點；弱點
example_sentence: The main limitation of this smartphone is its short battery life.
sentence_zh: 這支智慧型手機的主要限制是電池續航力短。

definition_zh: (形) 有限的；受限制的　(動) 限制；制限
example_sentence: Facing limited time before the exam, students must study more efficiently.
sentence_zh: 面對考試前有限的時間，學生必須更有效率地讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 豪華轎車；禮車
example_sentence: Although the limousine was expensive, the company rented it when the CEO visited Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 雖然豪華轎車很昂貴，但當執行長訪台時公司租用了它。

definition_zh: (動) 跛行；一瘸一拐地走　(形) 無力的；軟弱的
example_sentence: Not only did the injured athlete limp across the finish line, but the crowd also cheered wildly.
sentence_zh: 受傷的運動員不僅一瘸一拐地衝過終點線，觀眾也熱烈歡呼。

definition_zh: (形) 跛的；一瘸一拐的　(動) 跛行；瘸著走
example_sentence: The injured athlete, whose leg was badly hurt, limped across the finish line with determination.
sentence_zh: 那位腿部嚴重受傷的受傷運動員，瘸著腳跨越終點線，展現決心。

definition_zh: (動) 排隊；列隊　(動) 安排；準備
example_sentence: Students need to line up early to get good seats for the school concert.
sentence_zh: 學生需要早點排隊以便為學校音樂會取得好座位。

definition_zh: (名) 線；行　(動) 排成一行；沿著畫線　(形) 直的；成一直線的
example_sentence: Students waiting in line at the school cafeteria must keep the line straight and orderly.
sentence_zh: 在學校食堂排隊等候的學生必須保持隊伍整齊有序。

definition_zh: (名) 血統；家族世系　(名) 祖先；家系
example_sentence: The royal family's lineage can be traced back over a thousand years.
sentence_zh: 這個皇家的血統可以追溯到一千多年前。

definition_zh: (形) 線性的；直線的　(形) 按順序的；逐步的
example_sentence: As the temperature increases linearly, the metal expands at a constant rate.
sentence_zh: 當溫度線性上升時，金屬以恆定速率膨脹。

definition_zh: (名) 亞麻布；亞麻製品　(形) 亞麻製的；亞麻色的
example_sentence: Wearing linen clothes, students felt comfortable during the hot summer exam season.
sentence_zh: 穿著亞麻衣服，學生們在炎熱的暑期考試季節感到舒適。

definition_zh: (名) 班輪；定期客輪　(名) 眼線筆；眼影膏
example_sentence: The cruise liner, which attracts thousands of tourists annually, offers luxury accommodations and diverse entertainment options.
sentence_zh: 這艘吸引數千名遊客的豪華郵輪每年都提供奢華住宿和多樣娛樂選擇。

definition_zh: (名) 隊伍；陣容　(名) 節目安排；播放清單
example_sentence: If the basketball team's lineup includes star players, fans will definitely buy tickets to watch the game.
sentence_zh: 如果籃球隊的陣容包括明星球員，球迷一定會買票看比賽。

definition_zh: (動) 逗留；停留　(動) 緩慢消散；拖延
example_sentence: The sweet aroma of coffee lingered in the empty classroom after school.
sentence_zh: 學校放學後，咖啡的甜香在空教室裡緩慢消散。

definition_zh: (名) 語言學家；精通多種語言的人
example_sentence: Maria studied linguistics for years to become a linguist and help preserve endangered languages.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞學習語言學多年，目的是成為語言學家並幫助保護瀕危語言。

definition_zh: (名) 襯裡；內襯　(名) 襯墊物；保護層
example_sentence: The silver lining of this difficult situation is that we learned valuable lessons from failure.
sentence_zh: 這個困難情況的一線希望是我們從失敗中學到了寶貴的教訓。

definition_zh: (動) 連結；與…有關聯　(動) 連接；把…聯繫在一起
example_sentence: As social media links to increased screen time, teenagers should balance online activities with outdoor exercise.
sentence_zh: 由於社群媒體與增加的螢幕時間有關，青少年應該平衡線上活動與戶外運動。

definition_zh: (動) 與…聯繫；與…連結
example_sentence: Having linked up with the volunteer organization, the community center successfully launched its charity program.
sentence_zh: 與志工組織聯繫後，社區中心成功推動了慈善計劃。

definition_zh: (動) 連接；聯繫　(動) 聯合；合作
example_sentence: The two companies that link up will create a stronger business network for customers.
sentence_zh: 這兩家連接起來的公司將為顧客創造更強大的商業網絡。

definition_zh: (名) 連結；環節　(動) 連接；連結
example_sentence: Social media links millions of people around the world every single day.
sentence_zh: 社群媒體每天將世界各地的數百萬人連結在一起。

definition_zh: (名) 獅子；勇敢的人
example_sentence: If the lion were not sleeping in the shade, the zebras would not graze so peacefully near the watering hole.
sentence_zh: 如果獅子沒有在陰涼處睡覺，斑馬就不會在水源附近如此安心地吃草。

definition_zh: (形) 勇敢的；膽大的　無所畏懼的
example_sentence: The lionhearted firefighters rescued people from the burning building.
sentence_zh: 那些勇敢的消防員從燃燒的建築物中救出了人們。

definition_zh: (名) 嘴唇；脣　(名) 邊緣；杯口
example_sentence: Biting her lip nervously, Sarah waited for the exam results outside the classroom.
sentence_zh: 莎拉緊張地咬著嘴唇，在教室外等待考試成績。

definition_zh: (名) 脂肪；類脂質
example_sentence: Since lipids store energy in the body, consuming healthy fats helps maintain proper nutrition.
sentence_zh: 由於脂肪在體內儲存能量，攝取健康的脂肪有助於維持適當的營養。

definition_zh: (名) 口紅；唇膏
example_sentence: Seldom does a makeup bag lack the essential lipstick that completes any look.
sentence_zh: 化妝包裡幾乎沒有不備著完成整體造型的必備口紅。

definition_zh: (動) 液化；使變成液體　(動) 融化；溶解
example_sentence: The heat that melts the ice is the same heat which liquefies the gas into liquid.
sentence_zh: 融化冰的熱量就是將氣體液化成液體的熱量。

definition_zh: (名) 液體　(形) 液態的；流動的
example_sentence: Adding liquid to the mixture helps dissolve the sugar completely.
sentence_zh: 向混合物中加液體有助於完全溶解糖。

definition_zh: (動) 清算；結清　(動) 變現資產；出售
example_sentence: The failing company decided to liquidate its assets and distribute the money to shareholders.
sentence_zh: 這家倒閉的公司決定清算資產，並將資金分配給股東。

definition_zh: (名) 流動性；易變現性　(名) 資金周轉能力
example_sentence: Banks need high liquidity to meet customer withdrawal demands quickly.
sentence_zh: 銀行需要高流動性以快速滿足客戶提款需求。

definition_zh: (名) 酒；烈酒　(名) 液體；溶液
example_sentence: Although liquor is widely available, many students avoid drinking before major exams.
sentence_zh: 雖然酒類隨處可得，許多學生在大考前會避免飲酒。

definition_zh: (名) 口吃；發音不清　(動) 口吃地說；含糊不清地講
example_sentence: Lisping slightly when nervous, the student still delivered a confident presentation about environmental protection.
sentence_zh: 那名學生在緊張時略帶口吃，但仍然自信地發表了一場關於環境保護的演講。

definition_zh: (名) 清單；列表　(動) 列出；記錄
example_sentence: The shopping list that Sarah made includes items we need for the party.
sentence_zh: 莎拉製作的購物清單包括了派對需要的物品。

definition_zh: (動) 留意；注意　(動) 聆聽；傾聽
example_sentence: If the fire alarm sounds, listeners should listen out for the emergency announcement immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果火警警報響起，聽眾應該立即留意緊急廣播。

definition_zh: (片) 注意聽；仔細聽
example_sentence: Listen up, everyone! The teacher is about to announce the exam results.
sentence_zh: 注意聽，各位！老師即將宣布考試成績。

definition_zh: (動) 聆聽；傾聽　(動) 注意；理會
example_sentence: Students should listen carefully to understand the teacher's explanation.
sentence_zh: 學生應該仔細聆聽以理解老師的解釋。

definition_zh: (名) 聽者；聽眾　(名) 收音機接收器
example_sentence: Active listeners pay close attention and ask thoughtful questions during class discussions.
sentence_zh: 積極的聽眾在課堂討論中專注聆聽並提出深思熟慮的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 列表；清單　(名) 掛牌；刊登
example_sentence: Since the apartment listing appeared online, many families have expressed interest in viewing it.
sentence_zh: 由於該公寓的刊登出現在網上，許多家庭都表示有興趣看房。

definition_zh: (形) 沒精打采的；缺乏活力的　(形) 懶散的；無精力的
example_sentence: Having failed the midterm exam, the student sat listless at the desk, staring at nothing.
sentence_zh: 期中考不及格後，那名學生無精打采地坐在課桌前，呆呆地凝視著虛空。

definition_zh: (名) 公升；升　(形) 文學的；文化的
example_sentence: A water bottle that holds one liter is the size which most students carry daily.
sentence_zh: 裝一公升水的水瓶是大多數學生每天攜帶的尺寸。

definition_zh: (名) 讀寫能力；識字率　(名) 文化修養；知識
example_sentence: Digital literacy and financial literacy have become essential skills for modern teenagers preparing for university entrance exams.
sentence_zh: 數位素養和金融知識已成為準備大學入學考的現代青少年必備技能。

definition_zh: (形) 字面的；逐字的　(形) 真實的；確實的
example_sentence: If the instructions were followed in a literal way, the project would succeed without confusion.
sentence_zh: 如果按照字面上的方式遵循指示，該專案就不會有困惑而成功。

definition_zh: (副) 字面上；逐字地　(副) 確實地；真的
example_sentence: The restaurant's name literally means 'house of noodles' in Chinese.
sentence_zh: 這家餐廳的名字在中文中字面上的意思就是「麵食之家」。

definition_zh: (副) 文學上地；按字面意思　(副) 逐字地；確實地
example_sentence: Speaking literarily, the novel's protagonist represents society's inner conflict and moral struggle.
sentence_zh: 從文學角度來說，這部小說的主角代表了社會的內心衝突和道德掙扎。

definition_zh: (形) 文學的；文學性的　(形) 逐字的；字面上的
example_sentence: As the novel became increasingly literary in style, fewer teenage readers finished it without feeling confused.
sentence_zh: 當這部小說的風格變得愈來愈文學性時，較少青少年讀者在沒有感到困惑的情況下讀完它。

definition_zh: (形) 有文化修養的；識字的　(形) 精通某領域的；有學問的
example_sentence: Only after completing the digital literacy program were students truly literate in modern technology.
sentence_zh: 只有在完成數位素養課程之後，學生才真正具備現代科技的讀寫能力。

definition_zh: (名) 文學；文學作品　(名) 文獻；印刷品
example_sentence: The classic novels that define modern literature often explore themes of identity and social change.
sentence_zh: 定義現代文學的經典小說通常探討身份認同和社會變遷的主題。

definition_zh: (動) 提起訴訟；進行法律訴訟
example_sentence: The company decided to litigate in court to protect its intellectual property rights.
sentence_zh: 該公司決定向法院提起訴訟以保護其智慧財產權。

definition_zh: (名) 垃圾；廢棄物　(動) 亂丟垃圾；散落
example_sentence: Throwing litter in public places harms the environment and affects community health.
sentence_zh: 在公共場所亂丟垃圾會傷害環境，並影響社區衛生。

definition_zh: (形) 小的；年幼的　(副) 稍微；有點
example_sentence: The little girl enjoyed reading picture books in the library.
sentence_zh: 那個小女孩喜歡在圖書館裡讀圖畫書。

definition_zh: (動) 依靠…生活；以…為生　(動) 遵守；實踐
example_sentence: Many farmers live by growing rice and vegetables as their main source of income.
sentence_zh: 許多農民靠種植稻米和蔬菜為生，作為他們主要的收入來源。

definition_zh: (動) 消除不良名聲；擺脫羞辱
example_sentence: Working hard at school, the student finally lived down his reputation for being lazy.
sentence_zh: 在學校努力用功，那位學生終於擺脫了懶惰的名聲。

definition_zh: (動) 為...而活；靠...生活
example_sentence: Many athletes live for the competitions that challenge their limits.
sentence_zh: 許多運動員為挑戰自己極限的比賽而活。

definition_zh: (動) 住在；居住於
example_sentence: If students live in a dormitory, they will learn to be independent quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生住在宿舍，他們會很快學會獨立。

definition_zh: (片) 盡情享樂；痛快玩樂
example_sentence: During summer vacation, many students travel abroad to live it up with friends.
sentence_zh: 暑假期間，許多學生出國旅遊，和朋友盡情享樂。

definition_zh: (動) 依靠；靠...生活　(動) 以...為食；從...中獲取
example_sentence: Many students work part-time jobs to live off their own earnings during university.
sentence_zh: 許多學生打工是為了在大學期間靠自己的收入生活。

definition_zh: (動) 靠...生活；以...為生　(動) 住在...上面；在...之上生活
example_sentence: Many families in rural areas live on farming and raising livestock for income.
sentence_zh: 許多鄉村地區的家庭靠種田和養家畜來維持生計。

definition_zh: (動) 實現；度過　(動) 搬出去；離開
example_sentence: As Maria lived out her childhood dream of becoming a doctor, she studied hard every day.
sentence_zh: 當瑪麗亞實現她從小的醫生夢想時，她每天都努力讀書。

definition_zh: (動) 經歷；度過　(動) 穿過；通過
example_sentence: Having lived through the pandemic, many students developed stronger resilience and adaptability.
sentence_zh: 經歷過疫情，許多學生培養出更強的韌性和適應能力。

definition_zh: (動) 同居；一起住　(動) 共同生活
example_sentence: Couples who live together before marriage often understand each other better.
sentence_zh: 在婚前同居的情侶通常能更加瞭解彼此。

definition_zh: (動) 符合；達到　(動) 不辜負；實踐
example_sentence: Winning the scholarship means Sarah must live up to her parents' high expectations this semester.
sentence_zh: 贏得獎學金意味著莎拉這學期必須符合父母的高期望。

definition_zh: (動) 忍受；接受　(動) 與...同住；共同生活
example_sentence: If Maria lived with her grandparents, she would understand their traditional values better.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪麗亞和祖父母同住，她會更了解他們的傳統價值觀。

definition_zh: (形) 住在工作地點的；同住的　(動) 住在某處；在家裡生活
example_sentence: A live-in caregiver helps elderly people with daily tasks at home.
sentence_zh: 一位住家看護幫助老年人在家中完成日常工作。

definition_zh: (動) 居住；生活　(形) 現場的；直播的
example_sentence: Living in a big city, many students enjoy taking the MRT to school every day.
sentence_zh: 住在大城市的許多學生每天都喜歡搭捷運上學。

definition_zh: (片) 住在；居住在　(動) 在...地方生活；同居
example_sentence: While living in a dormitory, many students learn independence and responsibility.
sentence_zh: 當住在宿舍時，許多學生學會了獨立和責任感。

definition_zh: (名) 活力；生氣　(名) 生動；活潑
example_sentence: Not only does her energetic personality bring liveliness to the classroom, but also inspires her classmates daily.
sentence_zh: 她充滿活力的個性不僅為教室帶來生氣，而且每天激勵同學們。

definition_zh: (形) 活潑的；充滿生氣的　(形) 熱鬧的；生動的
example_sentence: The classroom, which became lively after the teacher announced the field trip, filled with excited voices.
sentence_zh: 教室在老師宣布校外教學後變得活潑，充滿了興奮的聲音。
