definition_zh: (動) 使活躍；使生動　(動) 使氣氛變好；活絡
example_sentence: The host told funny jokes to liven up the boring class reunion.
sentence_zh: 主持人講了許多笑話來活躍那個無聊的同學聚會。

definition_zh: (名) 肝臟；肝　(名) 生活者；居住者
example_sentence: Eating healthy foods helps protect your liver from damage.
sentence_zh: 吃健康的食物有助於保護你的肝臟免受傷害。

definition_zh: (名) 家畜；牲畜　(名) 牲口；家禽
example_sentence: Farmers raise livestock such as cows and chickens for food production.
sentence_zh: 農民飼養牲畜，例如牛和雞，用於食品生產。

definition_zh: (名) 生活；謀生　(形) 活著的；現存的　(副) 活著地；現在
example_sentence: Living in a busy city, many students find it hard to balance schoolwork and social life.
sentence_zh: 住在繁忙的城市裡，許多學生發現很難平衡功課和社交生活。

definition_zh: (名) 蜥蜴；蜴蜴
example_sentence: Basking in the afternoon sun, the lizard remained motionless on the warm rock.
sentence_zh: 那隻蜥蜴沐浴在午後陽光中，靜靜地躺在溫暖的岩石上。

definition_zh: (名) 駝馬；羊駝
example_sentence: The llama, which is an animal that lives in the Andes mountains, produces soft wool.
sentence_zh: 駝馬是一種生活在安地斯山脈的動物，牠能生產柔軟的羊毛。

definition_zh: (動) 使負擔沉重；加重負擔
example_sentence: If students load down their schedules with too many clubs, their grades would suffer.
sentence_zh: 如果學生用太多社團填滿他們的時間表，他們的成績就會下滑。

definition_zh: (動) 大量購買或儲備；囤積
example_sentence: Before the typhoon arrives, families load up on water and food supplies.
sentence_zh: 颱風來臨前，家庭會大量購買水和食物物資。

definition_zh: (動) 裝滿；載滿　(動) 上傳；載入
example_sentence: Students load up their backpacks to carry heavy textbooks to school every day.
sentence_zh: 學生每天裝滿背包來攜帶沉重的教科書上學。

definition_zh: (名) 負荷；載重　(動) 裝載；負擔　(形) 沉重的；繁重的
example_sentence: The heavy workload during exam season makes studying both challenging and stressful for many students.
sentence_zh: 考試季節的繁重課業負擔讓許多學生的讀書過程既具挑戰性又充滿壓力。

definition_zh: (形) 裝滿的；負擔重的　(動) 裝載；加重
example_sentence: Loaded with heavy textbooks, the student struggled to climb the stairs after school.
sentence_zh: 裝滿沉重課本的學生在放學後費力地爬樓梯。

definition_zh: (動) 懶散地閒蕩；虛度時光　(名) 一條麵包
example_sentence: Having loafed around the shopping mall all afternoon, the students finally headed home for dinner.
sentence_zh: 在購物中心閒蕩了整個下午後，學生們終於回家吃晚餐。

definition_zh: (名) 貸款；借款　(動) 借出；貸予
example_sentence: The bank approved the loan that the young entrepreneur requested for starting a business.
sentence_zh: 銀行批准了那位年輕企業家為創業所申請的貸款。

definition_zh: (動) 厭惡；討厭　(動) 極度不喜歡；憎恨
example_sentence: Many students loathe early morning classes and prefer studying in the afternoon.
sentence_zh: 許多學生厭惡早晨上課，更喜歡在下午唸書。

definition_zh: (名) 大廳；遊說　(動) 遊說；施壓
example_sentence: If environmental groups lobbied the government more actively, stricter pollution laws would be passed.
sentence_zh: 如果環保團體對政府進行更積極的遊說，就會通過更嚴格的污染法律。

definition_zh: (名) 龍蝦；螯蝦
example_sentence: Fresh lobster is expensive but delicious at fancy seafood restaurants.
sentence_zh: 新鮮的龍蝦在高級海鮮餐廳很貴但很美味。

definition_zh: (形) 當地的；本地的　(名) 當地人；本地居民
example_sentence: Visiting local markets, tourists discovered authentic Taiwanese snacks and fresh produce.
sentence_zh: 遊客參觀當地市場，發現了道地的台灣小食和新鮮的農產品。

definition_zh: (名) 地點；地區　(形) 當地的；本地的
example_sentence: When the film crew arrived at the coastal locale, local residents welcomed them warmly.
sentence_zh: 當電影劇組抵達那個海邊地點時，當地居民熱烈歡迎他們。

definition_zh: (名) 地點；地區　(名) 地方；場所
example_sentence: Only in this locality can students find such rare historical artifacts from ancient times.
sentence_zh: 只有在這個地區，學生們才能找到來自古代的如此罕見的歷史文物。

definition_zh: (名) 本地化；在地化　(名) 定位；確定位置
example_sentence: The software company adopted localization strategies that adapted products to regions where customers lived.
sentence_zh: 該軟體公司採用了在地化策略，使產品適應顧客所居住的地區。

definition_zh: (動) 定位；查明位置　(動) 建立；設置
example_sentence: Scientists use GPS technology to locate the missing research station in Antarctica.
sentence_zh: 科學家使用全球定位系統來定位在南極洲失蹤的研究站。

definition_zh: (形) 位於；坐落於　(動) 找出；定位
example_sentence: The new library, located near the train station, opened last month.
sentence_zh: 位於火車站附近的新圖書館上個月開幕了。

definition_zh: (名) 位置；地點　(名) 場所；所在地
example_sentence: The new shopping mall's location near the train station is very convenient.
sentence_zh: 這家新購物中心的位置靠近火車站，非常方便。

definition_zh: (動) 將某物鎖起來收藏；將某人監禁
example_sentence: After the store closes, the manager locks away the valuable items so that thieves cannot steal them.
sentence_zh: 商店關門後，經理將貴重物品鎖起來，這樣小偷就無法偷竊。

definition_zh: (動) 封鎖；隔離　(名) 封鎖期間；隔離措施
example_sentence: Locking down the building after the security breach, authorities prevented unauthorized access for weeks.
sentence_zh: 在安全漏洞事件後封鎖建築物，當局數週內防止了未經授權的進入。

definition_zh: (動) 確保；鎖定　(動) 與...達成協議
example_sentence: The contract that both companies locked in guarantees favorable terms for five years.
sentence_zh: 兩家公司鎖定的合約保證了五年的有利條款。

definition_zh: (動) 鎖定；瞄準　(動) 緊緊跟蹤；集中注意力
example_sentence: If the radar system locks onto the target aircraft, the missile will automatically follow its movement.
sentence_zh: 如果雷達系統鎖定目標飛機，飛彈將自動跟蹤其運動。

definition_zh: (動) 把...關在門外；拒絕進入　(動) 鎖定；停止營運
example_sentence: Forgetting the house key locked Sarah out until evening.
sentence_zh: 忘記帶家門鑰匙讓莎拉被關在門外直到晚上。

definition_zh: (動) 上鎖；鎖起來　(動) 監禁；逮捕
example_sentence: The security guard locked up the store to prevent theft and robbery.
sentence_zh: 保全人員上鎖店鋪以防止偷竊和搶劫。

definition_zh: (動片) 把自己關起來；與世隔絕
example_sentence: After failing the exam, Tom locked himself away in his room for a week without talking to anyone.
sentence_zh: 考試失敗後，湯姆把自己關在房間裡一週，沒有和任何人說話。

definition_zh: (名) 鎖；門栓　(動) 鎖上；上鎖　(動) 擁抱；緊握
example_sentence: Before the store closes, the manager locks the cash register so that no one can steal money.
sentence_zh: 在商店關門前，經理鎖上收銀機，以便沒有人能偷錢。

definition_zh: (名) 封鎖；禁閉　(動) 對...實施封鎖
example_sentence: Having experienced a strict lockdown during the pandemic, many students adjusted their study habits to online learning.
sentence_zh: 在疫情期間經歷嚴格封鎖後，許多學生調整了他們的學習習慣以適應線上學習。

definition_zh: (名) 置物櫃；儲物櫃
example_sentence: The locker that stores gym uniforms is located near the entrance.
sentence_zh: 存放運動服的置物櫃位於入口附近。

definition_zh: (名) 運動；移動　(名) 行走能力；運動方式
example_sentence: Different animals use various forms of locomotion to travel across land and water.
sentence_zh: 不同的動物用各種運動方式在陸地和水上移動。

definition_zh: (名) 機車頭；火車頭　(形) 移動的；運動的
example_sentence: If the locomotive were more powerful, trains could carry heavier cargo across mountains.
sentence_zh: 如果機車頭更強大，火車就能運送更重的貨物越過山脈。

definition_zh: (名) 位置；地點　(名) 軌跡；路線
example_sentence: The locus of the disease outbreak was identified as the crowded market downtown.
sentence_zh: 該疾病爆發的位置被確認為市中心擁擠的市場。

definition_zh: (名) 蝗蟲；飛蝗
example_sentence: Swarming across farmland, locusts destroyed crops faster than farmers could protect them.
sentence_zh: 蝗蟲成群飛過農地，摧毀莊稼的速度比農民能保護它們的速度還快。

definition_zh: (動) 提出；提交　(名) 小屋；山間小住所
example_sentence: As soon as the hikers lodge a complaint about the trail conditions, the park ranger will investigate the issue.
sentence_zh: 登山者一提出對步道狀況的投訴，公園護管員就會調查這個問題。

definition_zh: (名) 租賃住宅；旅館
example_sentence: Seldom does a lodging-house offer such comfortable rooms at reasonable prices.
sentence_zh: 很少有租賃住宅能以合理的價格提供如此舒適的房間。

definition_zh: (名) 住宿；旅館　(名) 臨時住所；棲身處
example_sentence: The hostel provides affordable lodging where budget travelers can rest comfortably.
sentence_zh: 這家青年旅館提供經濟實惠的住宿，讓預算有限的旅客能舒適地休息。

definition_zh: (名) 閣樓；夾層　(動) 把…放在閣樓裡
example_sentence: Many students use a loft to store extra textbooks and study materials.
sentence_zh: 許多學生使用閣樓來存放額外的課本和學習材料。

definition_zh: (形) 崇高的；高遠的　(形) 高聳的；宏偉的
example_sentence: The university's lofty goals of advancing science and culture inspire countless students.
sentence_zh: 這所大學崇高的科學文化進步目標激勵了無數學生。

definition_zh: (動) 登入；登錄
example_sentence: Students must log in to the online learning platform before class.
sentence_zh: 學生必須在上課前登入線上學習平台。

definition_zh: (動) 登出；登出帳戶　(片) 結束線上連線
example_sentence: Finishing homework, students often forget logging off their school platform before leaving.
sentence_zh: 完成作業後，學生常常在離開前忘記登出校園平台。

definition_zh: (動) 登出；退出登入
example_sentence: If you forget to log out from the school computer, someone else might access your account.
sentence_zh: 如果你忘記從學校電腦登出，別人可能會進入你的帳號。

definition_zh: (名) 木頭；原木　(名) 日誌；記錄　(動) 記錄；登記
example_sentence: The campers gathered firewood and logs to build a warm fire.
sentence_zh: 露營者收集木柴和原木來生火取暖。

definition_zh: (名) 伐木；木材業　(動) 記錄；砍伐
example_sentence: The government restricts logging in rainforests to preserve endangered animal habitats.
sentence_zh: 政府限制雨林伐木以保護瀕危動物的棲息地。

definition_zh: (名) 邏輯；邏輯學　(名) 推理方式；思考方式
example_sentence: Clear logic and strong evidence make persuasive arguments much more effective.
sentence_zh: 清晰的邏輯和強有力的證據使說服性論據更加有效。

definition_zh: (形) 合理的；邏輯的　(形) 符合理性的；講道理的
example_sentence: Since the evidence is logical and convincing, the jury reached a guilty verdict quickly.
sentence_zh: 因為證據合理且令人信服，陪審團很快就做出了有罪判決。

definition_zh: (副) 邏輯上；合理地　根據邏輯推理地
example_sentence: Having analyzed the evidence carefully, the detective concluded logically that the suspect was guilty.
sentence_zh: 經過仔細分析證據後，偵探邏輯上推論出嫌疑人有罪。

definition_zh: (名) 標誌；商標　(名) 企業標識；品牌符號
example_sentence: The logo that Apple designed has become one of the most recognizable symbols in the world.
sentence_zh: 蘋果公司設計的標誌已成為世界上最容易辨認的符號之一。

definition_zh: (動) 閒晃；遊蕩　(動) 逗留；徘徊
example_sentence: Loitering around the convenience store late at night is not only illegal but also dangerous.
sentence_zh: 深夜在便利商店附近閒晃不僅違法而且危險。

definition_zh: (動) 懶散地躺著；慵懒地靠著　(動) 舌頭伸出
example_sentence: If Mark did not have so much homework, he would loll on the beach all afternoon.
sentence_zh: 如果馬克沒有那麼多功課，他會整個下午懶散地躺在海灘上。

definition_zh: (名) 棒棒糖；圓形糖果
example_sentence: The child enjoyed eating a colorful lollipop after school.
sentence_zh: 那個孩子放學後享受吃一根彩色的棒棒糖。

definition_zh: (名) 倫敦；英國首都
example_sentence: Located in southeastern England, London serves millions of tourists visiting its historic landmarks annually.
sentence_zh: 位於英格蘭東南部的倫敦每年吸引數百萬遊客參觀其歷史地標。

definition_zh: (形) 孤獨的；獨自的　(形) 偏遠的；寂寞的
example_sentence: Though the lone traveler felt scared, determination kept pushing forward along the mountain path.
sentence_zh: 雖然那位獨自旅行者感到害怕，但決心持續驅使他沿著山路向前行。

definition_zh: (名) 孤獨；寂寞　(名) 孤獨感；落單
example_sentence: Rarely does loneliness strike the person who maintains strong friendships and family connections.
sentence_zh: 很少有孤獨感會困擾那些維持親密友誼和家庭關係的人。

definition_zh: (形) 孤獨的；寂寞的　(形) 偏遠的；荒涼的
example_sentence: The old man who lives in that lonely house rarely talks to anyone.
sentence_zh: 住在那棟孤獨房子裡的老人很少和任何人說話。

definition_zh: (名) 孤獨的人；獨行者　(形) 孤獨的；獨自的
example_sentence: Marcus chose to study alone in the library to become a loner.
sentence_zh: 馬克斯選擇獨自在圖書館讀書，目的是成為一個獨來獨往的人。

definition_zh: (形) 孤獨的；寂寞的　(形) 荒涼的；冷清的
example_sentence: The long and lonesome road stretched across the empty desert.
sentence_zh: 那條漫長而寂寞的道路延伸穿過空曠的沙漠。

definition_zh: (形) 長期持有的；長久以來的信念
example_sentence: The long-held belief that hard work guarantees success is being questioned by modern economists.
sentence_zh: 長期以來努力工作保證成功的信念正受到現代經濟學家的質疑。

definition_zh: (形) 長壽的；壽命長的　(形) 持久的；長期存在的
example_sentence: Because the giant tortoise is long-lived, scientists can study its behavior over many decades.
sentence_zh: 由於巨型烏龜壽命很長，科學家可以在數十年間研究它的行為。

definition_zh: (形) 遠距離的；長程的　(名) 遠距離；長程範圍
example_sentence: Having developed long-range missiles, the country strengthened its defense capabilities significantly.
sentence_zh: 開發遠距離飛彈後，該國大幅加強了防禦能力。

definition_zh: (形) 長期存在的；由來已久的
example_sentence: The long-standing tradition of Lunar New Year celebrations that families observe brings everyone together.
sentence_zh: 家族遵守的由來已久的農曆新年慶祝傳統將每個人聚在一起。

definition_zh: (形) 長期的；長遠的　(名) 長期；長遠
example_sentence: If students invest time in long-term study habits, their exam scores will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生投入時間養成長期讀書習慣，他們的考試成績就會大幅進步。

definition_zh: (形) 長的；冗長的　(副) 長期地；久地
example_sentence: Learning English requires long practice and patience every day.
sentence_zh: 學習英文需要每天長期練習和耐心。

definition_zh: (名) 長壽；長命　(名) 壽命；生命期限
example_sentence: Many people exercise regularly to promote longevity and maintain good health.
sentence_zh: 許多人定期運動是為了促進長壽並維持良好健康。

definition_zh: (名) 經度；東西方向的角度距離
example_sentence: The Earth's longitude and latitude lines help sailors navigate across oceans accurately.
sentence_zh: 地球的經度和緯度線幫助水手精確地在海洋上航行。

definition_zh: (形) 持續很久的；長期進行的
example_sentence: Since the TV drama has been long-running for five seasons, millions of fans eagerly await the final episode.
sentence_zh: 由於這部電視劇已經長期播映五季，數百萬粉絲熱切期待最後一集。

definition_zh: (形) 持續多年的；長期播出的
example_sentence: Having run for fifteen seasons, the long-running drama series finally ended last month.
sentence_zh: 這部長期播出的電視劇已經播了十五季，終於在上個月結束了。

definition_zh: (名) 絲瓜；浴球
example_sentence: The loofah, which my grandmother grows in her garden, is perfect for cleaning skin gently.
sentence_zh: 我奶奶在花園裡種植的絲瓜，非常適合溫和地清潔皮膚。

definition_zh: (動) 照顧；關心　照看；照料
example_sentence: My older sister looks after my younger brother every afternoon after school.
sentence_zh: 我姐姐每天放學後都照顧我弟弟。

definition_zh: (動) 回顧；回想　(動) 懷念
example_sentence: If graduating students looked back on their high school years, they would realize how valuable those friendships were.
sentence_zh: 如果畢業生回顧他們的高中歲月，他們會意識到那些友誼有多珍貴。

definition_zh: (動) 回顧；往後看　(動) 懷念；回憶過去
example_sentence: Looking back on high school days, many students cherish their friendships most.
sentence_zh: 回顧高中時光，許多學生最珍惜的是他們的友誼。

definition_zh: (動) 看不起；輕視　(動) 俯視；居高臨下
example_sentence: Looking down on classmates from poorer families, that student lost many friendships.
sentence_zh: 那位學生看不起來自較貧困家庭的同學，因此失去了許多友誼。

definition_zh: (動) 尋找；尋求　(動) 期待；盼望
example_sentence: While looking for his lost wallet, Marcus found an old photo of his childhood friends.
sentence_zh: 當馬克斯尋找遺失的錢包時，他發現了一張童年朋友的舊照片。

definition_zh: (動) 期待；盼望　(片) 期許；等待
example_sentence: Not only does Maria look forward to summer vacation, but also to the school trip.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞不僅期待暑假，而且期待校外教學。

definition_zh: (動) 查看；看望　探視；照顧
example_sentence: The nurse who looked in on the patient every morning ensured his recovery was progressing well.
sentence_zh: 每天早上查看病人的護士確保了他的康復進展良好。

definition_zh: (動) 查看；檢查　(動) 訪問；拜訪
example_sentence: Sarah opened the refrigerator to look in and find ingredients for dinner.
sentence_zh: 莎拉打開冰箱去查看並尋找晚餐的食材。

definition_zh: (動) 調查；查詢　(動) 研究；了解
example_sentence: The police officer decided to look into the mysterious accident at the school intersection.
sentence_zh: 警察決定調查發生在學校十字路口的神祕車禍。

definition_zh: (動) 看待；把...視為　(動) 在；持續
example_sentence: Many people look on as a great opportunity for personal growth and learning.
sentence_zh: 許多人把這視為個人成長和學習的絕佳機會。

definition_zh: (動) 旁觀；袖手旁觀　(動) 看待；認為
example_sentence: While the accident happened, many people looked on without offering help to the injured.
sentence_zh: 當事故發生時，許多人袖手旁觀，沒有幫助傷者。

definition_zh: (片) 留意；注意　(片) 小心；警惕
example_sentence: While walking home late at night, students should look out for any suspicious activity around them.
sentence_zh: 在夜間走路回家時，學生應該留意周圍任何可疑的活動。

definition_zh: (動) 小心；當心　(片) 留意；注意
example_sentence: The hikers who looked out for falling rocks completed the mountain trail safely.
sentence_zh: 那些留意落石的登山者安全完成了登山路線。

definition_zh: (動) 檢查；審視　(動) 忽視；不理會
example_sentence: If the manager looked over the report carefully, he would catch the error immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果經理仔細檢查這份報告，他會立即發現錯誤。

definition_zh: (動) 環顧；向四周看　(動) 逛街；到處逛
example_sentence: Sarah looked round the shopping mall and found many interesting shops.
sentence_zh: 莎拉環顧購物中心四周，發現了許多有趣的商店。

definition_zh: (動) 瀏覽；翻閱　(動) 審視；檢查
example_sentence: The teacher asked students to look through the textbook chapter to find the main ideas before class.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生在上課前翻閱課本章節以找出主要概念。

definition_zh: (動) 期望；依靠　(動) 注視；朝向
example_sentence: Many students look to their teachers for guidance when making important career decisions.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在做重要職涯決定時期望從老師那裡得到指引。

definition_zh: (動) 敬佩；仰慕　(動) 查詢；查閱
example_sentence: Because many students look up to their teachers, they work hard to achieve their dreams.
sentence_zh: 因為許多學生敬佩他們的老師，所以他們努力實現自己的夢想。

definition_zh: (動) 查閱；查找　(動) 抬頭；向上看
example_sentence: Having looked up the unknown words in the dictionary, the student completed the reading assignment confidently.
sentence_zh: 查完字典裡的生詞後，這位學生自信地完成了閱讀作業。

definition_zh: (動) 把...看作；視為　(動) 尊重；尊敬
example_sentence: The teacher looks upon her students as future leaders who will change society.
sentence_zh: 那位老師把她的學生視為未來會改變社會的領導者。

definition_zh: (動) 看；觀看　(名) 外表；樣子　(片) 看起來；似乎
example_sentence: Looking at the test questions carefully helps students understand what the exam requires.
sentence_zh: 仔細看測驗題目能幫助學生理解考試要求。

definition_zh: (片語) 變得重要；顯得突出；迫在眉睫
example_sentence: If climate change loomed large in the discussion, the government would take immediate action.
sentence_zh: 如果氣候變遷在討論中顯得突出，政府將會採取立即行動。

definition_zh: (動) 逼近；隱約出現　(名) 織布機
example_sentence: Dark clouds loomed over the mountain as the storm approached quickly.
sentence_zh: 當暴風雨快速接近時，烏雲籠罩在山的上方。

definition_zh: (名) 潛水鳥；瘋子　(形) 瘋狂的；古怪的
example_sentence: Laughing hysterically at nothing, the loony student disrupted the entire classroom during the exam.
sentence_zh: 那個古怪的學生歇斯底里地笑著，打亂了整個考試教室。

definition_zh: (形) 瘋狂的；古怪的　(形) 愚蠢的；荒唐的
example_sentence: Although the plan seemed loony, the team decided to try it anyway.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個計畫看起來很荒唐，團隊還是決定試試看。

definition_zh: (名) 迴圈；環形　(動) 環繞；循環
example_sentence: Only after the programmer fixed the endless loop did the software finally run smoothly.
sentence_zh: 直到程式設計師修正無限迴圈後，軟體才終於順利執行。

definition_zh: (名) 漏洞；法律漏洞　(動) 利用漏洞
example_sentence: The tax regulation, which contained a loophole that many companies exploited, was finally closed.
sentence_zh: 那項稅務規定含有許多公司利用的漏洞，最後終於被堵住了。

definition_zh: (形) 鬆的；不緊的　(動) 放鬆；解開
example_sentence: Students exercise regularly to loosen tight muscles after long study sessions.
sentence_zh: 學生定期運動以放鬆長時間讀書後緊繃的肌肉。

definition_zh: (副) 鬆散地；不緊密地　(副) 大略地；粗略地
example_sentence: The teacher explained the grammar rules loosely, so many students felt confused about the details.
sentence_zh: 老師粗略地解釋了文法規則，所以許多學生對細節感到困惑。

definition_zh: (動) 放鬆；變得輕鬆　(動) 變得更友善或自在
example_sentence: After finishing the exam, students finally loosened up and laughed together.
sentence_zh: 考試結束後，學生們終於放鬆下來，一起笑了。

definition_zh: (動) 鬆開；放鬆　(動) 減輕；緩和
example_sentence: As the deadline approaches, the teacher loosened the strict rules so students could focus on learning.
sentence_zh: 隨著截止日期臨近，老師放鬆了嚴格的規則，使學生能專注於學習。

definition_zh: (名) 掠奪品；贓物　(動) 掠奪；搶劫
example_sentence: Looting the abandoned warehouse, thieves discovered stacks of stolen electronics.
sentence_zh: 搶劫廢棄倉庫時，小偷們發現了成堆被盜的電子產品。

definition_zh: (名) 搶劫者；掠奪者
example_sentence: The looters who broke into the store during the riot were eventually caught by police.
sentence_zh: 在暴亂期間闖入商店的搶劫者最終被警察逮捕了。

definition_zh: (名) 掠奪；搶劫　(動) 掠奪；搶掠
example_sentence: If stores were not protected during the disaster, looting would occur immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果商店在災難期間沒有被保護，掠奪行為會立即發生。

definition_zh: (動) 用長步幅跑；蹦跳著跑
example_sentence: The dog loped across the park with its tongue hanging out happily.
sentence_zh: 那隻狗用輕鬆的步伐蹦跳著跑過公園，舌頭快樂地垂著。

definition_zh: (形) 不平衡的；偏向一邊的　(形) 不公平的；片面的
example_sentence: The committee redesigned the voting system to avoid lopsided results favoring wealthy regions.
sentence_zh: 委員會重新設計投票制度以避免偏向富裕地區的不平衡結果。

definition_zh: (副) 不平衡地；偏向一側地
example_sentence: The competition was lopsidedly won by the champion team, who scored three times more points than their opponents.
sentence_zh: 這場比賽被冠軍隊不平衡地贏得，他們的得分是對手的三倍。

definition_zh: (動) 對...傲慢專制；欺凌
example_sentence: Although the new club president tried to lord it over the members, nobody respected his leadership.
sentence_zh: 雖然新任社長試圖對成員傲慢專制，但沒有人尊重他的領導。

definition_zh: (名) 貴族；領主　(名) 上帝；神
example_sentence: Having ruled the kingdom for decades, the lord finally passed his title to his eldest son.
sentence_zh: 那位貴族統治王國數十年後，終於將爵位傳給了長子。

definition_zh: (動) 錯失；喪失　(動) 無法得到；被排除在外
example_sentence: Missing the early registration deadline meant students would lose out on scholarship opportunities for next semester.
sentence_zh: 錯過提早註冊的截止時間意味著學生將喪失下學期獎學金的機會。

definition_zh: (動) lúz 輸給；不如　aʊt tə 被...超越；失敗
example_sentence: If our team didn't practice harder, we would lose out to our rivals in the championship.
sentence_zh: 如果我們的隊伍不更努力練習，在錦標賽中就會被對手超越。

definition_zh: (動) 損失；虧損　(動) 失去機會；被淘汰
example_sentence: Companies that fail to adapt to new technology will lose out to competitors.
sentence_zh: 無法適應新科技的公司會被競爭對手打敗。

definition_zh: (動) lúz 失去聯繫；與...斷絕來往　(動) 保持接觸；聯絡
example_sentence: Losing touch with old friends after graduation, many students feel nostalgic about their school days.
sentence_zh: 畢業後與老朋友失去聯繫，許多學生懷念起他們的學生時代。

definition_zh: (動) 遺失；失去　(動) 輸掉；失敗
example_sentence: Because students lose their concentration during long lectures, taking short breaks helps improve learning.
sentence_zh: 因為學生在冗長的講座中失去專注力，所以休息片刻有助於改善學習效果。

definition_zh: (名) 失敗者；輸家　(名) 失去的東西；損失
example_sentence: Not only does studying hard matter; so does believing you're not a loser.
sentence_zh: 不僅認真讀書重要，相信自己不是失敗者也同樣重要。

definition_zh: (名) 損失；虧損　(名) 失去；喪失
example_sentence: The company faced a significant financial loss that affected employees who worked there.
sentence_zh: 該公司面臨重大財務損失，這影響了在那裡工作的員工。

definition_zh: (形) 迷失的；失去的　(動) 失去；遺失
example_sentence: Students study hard to avoid getting lost in the competitive exam.
sentence_zh: 學生努力唸書以避免在競爭激烈的考試中感到迷茫。

definition_zh: (名) 許多；大量　(名) 地塊；土地　(名) 命運；遭遇
example_sentence: A lot of students study hard to prepare for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力讀書為大學入學考試做準備。

definition_zh: (名) 乳液；潤膚霜　(名) 藥水；洗液
example_sentence: Applying sunscreen lotion before going to the beach protects skin effectively.
sentence_zh: 去海灘前塗防曬乳液能有效保護皮膚。

definition_zh: (名) 樂透；彩券　(名) 抽籤制度；碰運氣的事
example_sentence: Although buying lottery tickets is exciting, most players lose money because the odds are extremely low.
sentence_zh: 儘管購買樂透彩券令人興奮，但大多數玩家都會虧錢，因為中獎的機率極低。

definition_zh: (名) 蓮花；荷花　(形) 蓮花的；優雅的
example_sentence: Floating on the pond, the lotus flowers bloomed beautifully during the summer festival.
sentence_zh: 漂浮在池塘上的蓮花在夏季節慶中美麗綻放。

definition_zh: (形) 大聲的；響亮的　(副) 大聲地；響亮地
example_sentence: The loud noise that disturbed the neighborhood came from the construction site.
sentence_zh: 打擾鄰里的那個大聲噪音是從建築工地傳來的。

definition_zh: (副) 大聲地；喧鬧地
example_sentence: If the teacher speaks loudly during class, students will pay more attention to the lesson.
sentence_zh: 如果老師在課堂上大聲說話，學生會更專注於課程。

definition_zh: (名) 擴音器；喇叭
example_sentence: The school's loudspeaker announced the morning news to all students.
sentence_zh: 學校的擴音器向所有學生宣布了早晨新聞。

definition_zh: (名) 休閒室；酒吧　(動) 懶散地躺著；閒散地度過
example_sentence: Students often visit the school lounge to relax between classes.
sentence_zh: 學生經常到學校的休閒室放鬆課間時光。

definition_zh: (形) 糟糕的；差勁的　(形) 骯髒的；邋遢的
example_sentence: The lousy weather and broken equipment ruined our camping trip completely.
sentence_zh: 糟糕的天氣和壞掉的設備完全毀了我們的露營之旅。

definition_zh: (名) 愛；愛情　(動) 愛；喜愛
example_sentence: Because Sarah loves reading, she spends every weekend at the library studying for exams.
sentence_zh: 因為莎拉喜愛閱讀，她每個週末都在圖書館花時間準備考試。

definition_zh: (形) 可愛的；美好的　(形) 令人愉快的；迷人的
example_sentence: Having decorated the classroom with flowers, the students created a lovely atmosphere for the celebration.
sentence_zh: 學生們用花朵裝飾了教室後，為慶祝活動創造了一個美好的氛圍。

definition_zh: (名) 戀人；情人　(名) 愛好者；喜愛者
example_sentence: The lover who waited at the train station every evening finally reunited with his girlfriend.
sentence_zh: 每晚都在火車站等待的戀人終於與女友重聚。

definition_zh: (形) 充滿愛的；深情的　(動) 喜愛；熱愛
example_sentence: Her loving care and gentle support helped her friend through difficult times.
sentence_zh: 她充滿愛的關懷和溫柔的支持幫助朋友度過了困難時期。

definition_zh: (形) 低的；矮的　(副) 低地；在下面　(名) 低點；低潮
example_sentence: If battery power ran low, the phone would shut down automatically.
sentence_zh: 如果電池電量降低，手機就會自動關機。

definition_zh: (動) 降低；放低　(形) 較低的；下面的
example_sentence: Lowering the volume helps students concentrate better during study time.
sentence_zh: 降低音量有助於學生在讀書時更專心。

definition_zh: (名) 煙燻鮭魚；醃漬鮭魚
example_sentence: Topped with cream cheese and fresh dill, the lox bagel became a favorite breakfast choice for many students.
sentence_zh: 淋上奶油起司和新鮮蒔蘿的燻鮭魚貝果成為許多學生最愛的早餐選擇。

definition_zh: (形) 忠誠的；真實的　(形) 忠心的；可靠的
example_sentence: Because customers remained loyal to the brand, the company expanded into five new markets.
sentence_zh: 因為顧客對該品牌保持忠誠，所以公司擴展到五個新市場。

definition_zh: (名) 忠誠；忠心　(名) 忠貞；忠實
example_sentence: Only through years of dedicated service can true loyalty to one's country be earned.
sentence_zh: 唯有透過多年的奉獻服務，才能獲得對國家的真正忠誠。

definition_zh: (名) 潤滑油；潤滑劑　(動) 潤滑；上油
example_sentence: The engine oil, which serves as a lube that reduces friction, requires regular replacement.
sentence_zh: 這種引擎油是能夠減少摩擦力的潤滑油，需要定期更換。

definition_zh: (動) 潤滑；加潤滑油
example_sentence: Mechanics lubricate the engine parts regularly to prevent rust and wear.
sentence_zh: 機械師定期潤滑引擎零件以防止生鏽和磨損。

definition_zh: (形) 清晰的；易理解的　(形) 頭腦清醒的；思路清楚的
example_sentence: The student's lucid explanation of the chemistry concept helped classmates understand the difficult lesson.
sentence_zh: 那位學生對化學概念的清晰解說幫助同學們理解了這堂困難的課程。

definition_zh: (副) 清楚地；明白地　(副) 理性地；清醒地
example_sentence: The physics teacher explained the complex theory lucidly, making all students understand it easily.
sentence_zh: 物理老師清楚地解釋了這個複雜的理論，讓所有學生都能輕易理解。

definition_zh: (動) 幸運地獲得；僥倖得到
example_sentence: Although lacking experience, the student luckily lucked into an internship at a tech company.
sentence_zh: 雖然缺乏經驗，但這名學生僥倖獲得了科技公司的實習機會。

definition_zh: (動) 幸運地成功；僥倖贏得
example_sentence: Winning the lottery after buying just one ticket, Mark lucked out and received a year's supply of free groceries.
sentence_zh: 馬克買了一張彩券就中獎，真是僥倖成功，贏得一年份的免費食品供應。

definition_zh: (名) 運氣；幸運　(形) 幸運的；運氣好的
example_sentence: Students who have good luck in the exam often prepare well beforehand.
sentence_zh: 在考試中運氣好的學生通常事先準備充分。

definition_zh: (副) 幸運地；運氣好地　幸幸運運地
example_sentence: Luckily, if Sarah studies hard for the exam, she will pass the CSAT test.
sentence_zh: 幸運地，如果莎拉為考試努力讀書，她就會通過學測。

definition_zh: (形) 幸運的；運氣好的　(形) 帶來好運的
example_sentence: Winning the lottery made Sarah feel lucky for the rest of the year.
sentence_zh: 贏得彩券獎金讓莎拉在那一整年都感到很幸運。

definition_zh: (形) 賺錢的；有利可圖的　(形) 高利潤的；收益豐厚的
example_sentence: Many graduates pursue careers in finance to secure lucrative job opportunities.
sentence_zh: 許多畢業生從事金融工作以獲得高薪的工作機會。

definition_zh: (副) 有利可圖地；獲利豐厚地
example_sentence: Working lucratively in the tech industry and gaining valuable experience simultaneously appealed to many graduates.
sentence_zh: 在科技業既能獲利豐厚又能累積寶貴經驗的工作吸引了許多畢業生。

definition_zh: (形) 荒唐的；可笑的　(形) 荒謬的；極其愚蠢的
example_sentence: Although the plan seemed ludicrous, the team decided to try it anyway.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個計劃看起來荒唐，團隊仍然決定嘗試。

definition_zh: (副) 荒唐地；可笑地　極其愚蠢地；離譜地
example_sentence: Having ludicrously overestimated the project budget, the manager faced serious criticism from the board.
sentence_zh: 經理荒唐地高估了專案預算，結果遭到董事會的嚴厲批評。

definition_zh: (名) 荒唐；可笑
example_sentence: The ludicrousness of the claim, which nobody believed anyway, made everyone laugh.
sentence_zh: 那個荒唐的說法（沒有人相信）讓每個人都笑了。

definition_zh: (名) 行李；旅行箱
example_sentence: Before boarding the plane, passengers must check their luggage at the counter.
sentence_zh: 登機前，乘客必須在櫃台托運他們的行李。

definition_zh: (形) 溫溫的；不冷不熱的　(形) 冷淡的；缺乏熱情的
example_sentence: If the coffee were lukewarm, most customers would probably order a fresh cup instead.
sentence_zh: 如果咖啡溫溫的，大多數顧客可能會改點一杯新鮮的咖啡。

definition_zh: (動) 使平靜；哄入睡　(動) 暫時停止；減弱
example_sentence: Soft music lulled the baby to sleep after a long day.
sentence_zh: 柔和的音樂在漫長的一天後哄寶寶入睡。

definition_zh: (名) 搖籃曲；催眠曲
example_sentence: Singing a soft lullaby, the mother gently rocked her baby to sleep.
sentence_zh: 媽媽唱著溫柔的搖籃曲，輕輕搖著寶寶入睡。

definition_zh: (動) 笨重地移動；蹣跚走動　(名) 木材；廢料
example_sentence: As the tired hikers lumbered up the mountain, they stopped frequently to catch their breath.
sentence_zh: 當疲憊的登山者笨重地往山上走時，他們經常停下來喘氣。

definition_zh: (名) 流明（光通量單位）；亮度單位
example_sentence: Only after scientists invented the lumen unit could lighting engineers measure brightness accurately.
sentence_zh: 直到科學家發明流明這個單位後，照明工程師才能夠準確測量亮度。

definition_zh: (名) 亮度；發光強度
example_sentence: The luminance of the screen, which affects eye comfort during study sessions, should be adjusted properly.
sentence_zh: 螢幕的亮度（這會影響讀書時眼睛的舒適度）應該要調整得當。

definition_zh: (形) 發光的；明亮的　(形) 聰慧的；傑出的
example_sentence: The scientist designed luminous markers to help identify emergency exits during power outages.
sentence_zh: 這位科學家設計了發光的標記，目的是在停電時幫助識別緊急出口。

definition_zh: (名) 腫塊；疙瘩　(動) 把...合併；歸為一類　(形) 成塊的；結塊的
example_sentence: A lump sum payment allows the student to settle tuition fees in one single installment.
sentence_zh: 一次性付款允許該學生在單一分期內結清學費。

definition_zh: (形) 有塊狀的；不平滑的　(形) 笨重的；遲鈍的
example_sentence: The lumpy mattress made sleeping uncomfortable all night long.
sentence_zh: 那張有塊狀的床墊讓整晚睡眠都不舒服。

definition_zh: (形) 月球的；月亮的　(形) 新月形的；弧形的
example_sentence: Since the lunar landing in 1969 changed space exploration forever, astronauts continue studying the Moon.
sentence_zh: 由於1969年的月球登陸永遠改變了太空探索，太空人持續研究月球。

definition_zh: (名) 瘋子；精神病患　(形) 瘋狂的；精神錯亂的
example_sentence: Ranting wildly about conspiracy theories, the lunatic disturbed everyone on the train.
sentence_zh: 那個瘋子狂亂地高喊陰謀論，打擾了火車上的每個人。

definition_zh: (名) 午餐；午飯　(動) 吃午餐
example_sentence: The lunch that Maria packed for her brother contained rice, vegetables, and fish.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞為哥哥準備的午餐裡有米飯、蔬菜和魚。

definition_zh: (名) 午餐時間；午休時間
example_sentence: If students bring their lunch from home, lunchtime becomes more enjoyable and budget-friendly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生從家裡帶便當，午餐時間會變得更愉快且更省錢。

definition_zh: (名) 肺；肺部
example_sentence: Deep breathing exercises help keep your lungs healthy and strong.
sentence_zh: 深呼吸運動有助於保持肺部健康而強壯。

definition_zh: (動) 突然刺；猛衝
example_sentence: The fencer lunges forward to score a point against the opponent.
sentence_zh: 劍擊手向前突然刺擊以得分擊敗對手。

definition_zh: (動) 突然搖晃；蹣跚而行　(名) 搖晃；困境
example_sentence: The ship lurched forward suddenly, causing passengers to stumble and grab nearby railings.
sentence_zh: 船隻突然向前搖晃，導致乘客蹣跚而行並抓住附近的欄杆。

definition_zh: (動) 吸引；誘惑　(名) 誘餌；吸引力
example_sentence: As the online game lured more players in, teenagers spent less time studying.
sentence_zh: 當線上遊戲吸引越來越多玩家時，青少年花在讀書上的時間減少了。

definition_zh: (形) 血淋淋的；駭人的　令人不安的；聳動的
example_sentence: Horrified by the lurid details, the news report shocked viewers across Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 被血腥駭人的細節嚇到，這則新聞報導震撼了全台灣的觀眾。

definition_zh: (動) 潛伏；躲藏　(動) 暗中注視；窺探
example_sentence: The suspicious man who lurked behind the corner was finally caught by police.
sentence_zh: 那個在角落後面潛伏的可疑男子最後被警察逮捕了。

definition_zh: (形) 茂密的；翠綠的　(形) 豐富的；奢華的
example_sentence: The lush green forest and tropical vegetation attracted many tourists exploring the national park.
sentence_zh: 那片茂密的綠色森林和熱帶植被吸引了許多探索國家公園的遊客。

definition_zh: (動) 貪戀；渴望得到
example_sentence: If wealthy celebrities did not lust after fame, the entertainment industry would look completely different.
sentence_zh: 如果富有的名人不貪戀名聲，娛樂產業看起來會完全不同。

definition_zh: (名) 光澤；光彩　(動) 發出光澤；閃耀
example_sentence: The diamond's beautiful luster attracted everyone at the jewelry store.
sentence_zh: 那顆鑽石美麗的光澤在珠寶店吸引了所有人。

definition_zh: (動) 盡情享受；沉溺於舒適
example_sentence: Luxuriating in a warm bath after school, the student felt all stress melt away.
sentence_zh: 放學後沉溺在溫暖的浴缸中，這名學生感到所有壓力都消散了。

definition_zh: (形) 奢華的；豪華的　(形) 舒適的；享樂的
example_sentence: Although the luxurious hotel room was expensive, many tourists booked it because it offered exceptional comfort.
sentence_zh: 雖然那間豪華的飯店房間很昂貴，但許多遊客仍預訂它，因為它提供了卓越的舒適感。

definition_zh: (名) 奢侈；奢華　(形) 豪華的；奢侈的
example_sentence: Only after saving for years could the family afford such luxury.
sentence_zh: 只有經過多年的存錢，這個家庭才買得起這樣的奢侈品。

definition_zh: (名) 荔枝；荔枝樹
example_sentence: The lychee orchard that my grandmother tends produces the sweetest fruit.
sentence_zh: 我祖母照顧的荔枝果園生產最甜的水果。

definition_zh: (動) 私刑處死；集體暴力殺害
example_sentence: The mob gathered to lynch the accused man without awaiting a fair trial.
sentence_zh: 群眾聚集起來要對被控的人執行私刑，而不等待公正的審判。

definition_zh: (名) 歌詞；抒情詩　(形) 抒情的；富有感情的
example_sentence: The singer wrote beautiful lyrics that touched many people's hearts deeply.
sentence_zh: 這位歌手創作了優美的歌詞，深深打動了許多人的心。

definition_zh: (名) 女士；夫人　(名) 媽媽；母親
example_sentence: Excuse me, ma'am. May I ask you a quick question about this product?
sentence_zh: 請問，女士，我可以問您一個關於這個產品的快速問題嗎？

definition_zh: (名) 媽媽；母親　(感) 媽呀（驚訝或痛苦的感嘆）
example_sentence: Mom baked cookies while her children did homework in the living room.
sentence_zh: 當孩子們在客廳做功課時，媽媽烤著餅乾。

definition_zh: (名) 瑪奇朵咖啡（濃縮咖啡加少量牛奶泡沫）
example_sentence: Ordering a macchiato, the barista carefully topped the espresso with velvety milk foam.
sentence_zh: 點一杯瑪奇朵咖啡時，咖啡師小心地在濃縮咖啡上蓋上絲滑的牛奶泡沫。

definition_zh: (名) 機器；機械　(名) 機構；組織
example_sentence: The washing machine that my parents bought last month has already broken down.
sentence_zh: 我父母上個月買的洗衣機已經故障了。

definition_zh: (名) 機械；機器　(名) 機械裝置；機制
example_sentence: If the factory maintains its machinery regularly, production efficiency will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果工廠定期維護其機械，生產效率將大幅提高。

definition_zh: (名) 麻繩編織藝術；手工繩結裝飾
example_sentence: Sarah learned macramé techniques to create decorative wall hangings for her bedroom.
sentence_zh: 莎拉學習麻繩編織技巧，為她的臥室製作裝飾性的壁掛。

definition_zh: (形) 宏觀的；大規模的　(名) 巨集；宏指令
example_sentence: Economists use macro analysis to understand overall economic trends.
sentence_zh: 經濟學家使用宏觀分析來了解整體經濟趨勢。

definition_zh: (形) 生氣的；憤怒的　(形) 瘋狂的；發瘋的
example_sentence: Getting a low test score made Sarah mad, and she stayed angry all evening.
sentence_zh: 考試成績不好讓莎拉生氣，她整個晚上都很憤怒。

definition_zh: (名) 女士；夫人　(名) 妓院老鴇
example_sentence: As the madam entered the conference room, all the executives stood up respectfully.
sentence_zh: 當這位女士進入會議室時，所有主管都恭敬地站起來。

definition_zh: (形) 虛構的；編造的　(形) 化妝的；打扮的
example_sentence: Having made up a ridiculous story about aliens, the student couldn't keep a straight face.
sentence_zh: 這位學生編造了一個荒謬的外星人故事，面無表情都很困難。

definition_zh: (名) 黑手黨；有組織的犯罪集團
example_sentence: The mafia organization, which operated in the city for decades, was finally shut down by police.
sentence_zh: 那個在城市裡經營了數十年的黑手黨組織，最終被警方關閉。

definition_zh: (名) 雜誌；期刊　(名) 彈匣；藥室
example_sentence: Reading fashion magazines helps teenagers stay updated with current trends.
sentence_zh: 閱讀時尚雜誌幫助青少年了解最新的潮流。

definition_zh: (動) 變魔法使其消失；想辦法消除
example_sentence: If pressing the reset button could magic away all computer problems, students would never need technical support.
sentence_zh: 如果按下重設鍵就能變魔法讓所有電腦問題消失，學生就永遠不需要技術支援。

definition_zh: (動) 變出；憑空製造
example_sentence: The magician magicked up a rabbit from an empty hat.
sentence_zh: 魔術師從空帽子裡變出了一隻兔子。

definition_zh: (名) 魔法；魔術　(形) 魔法的；神奇的
example_sentence: Using magic tricks, the magician amazed the audience with impossible illusions.
sentence_zh: 魔術師利用魔術技巧，以不可能的幻覺驚艷了觀眾。

definition_zh: (形) 魔法的；神奇的　(形) 令人驚奇的；奇妙的
example_sentence: As the concert unfolded, the magical atmosphere made the audience forget their daily troubles.
sentence_zh: 當音樂會展開時，那神奇的氛圍使觀眾忘卻日常的煩惱。

definition_zh: (名) 魔術師；魔法師
example_sentence: Only after years of practice can a skilled magician master illusions.
sentence_zh: 只有經過多年練習，一位技巧高超的魔術師才能掌握幻覺技巧。

definition_zh: (形) 威嚴的；專斷的　(形) 高傲的；傲慢的
example_sentence: The principal's magisterial tone, which brooked no disagreement, silenced the entire assembly hall.
sentence_zh: 校長那威嚴的語氣——不容任何異議——使整個禮堂鴉雀無聲。

definition_zh: (名) 地方法官；治安官　(動) 擔任地方法官
example_sentence: The magistrate reviewed the case to determine appropriate penalties for the defendants.
sentence_zh: 地方法官審查該案件以判定被告的適當處罰。

definition_zh: (名) 磁鐵；磁石　(名) 吸引力強的人或物
example_sentence: The strong magnetic field of this magnet attracts iron filings easily.
sentence_zh: 這個磁鐵強大的磁場很容易吸引鐵屑。

definition_zh: (形) 磁的；具有磁性的　(形) 有吸引力的；迷人的
example_sentence: The magnetic field around Earth protects us from solar radiation.
sentence_zh: 地球周圍的磁場保護我們免受太陽輻射的傷害。

definition_zh: (名) 磁性；磁力　(名) 吸引力；魅力
example_sentence: Because magnetism attracts iron objects, scientists use it to study Earth's magnetic field.
sentence_zh: 因為磁性能吸引鐵製物體，科學家用它來研究地球的磁場。

definition_zh: (名) 壯麗；宏偉　(名) 豪華；富麗
example_sentence: Displaying breathtaking magnificence, the ancient palace impressed every visitor exploring its grand halls.
sentence_zh: 那座古宮殿展現出令人屏息的壯麗，給每位探索其宏大廳堂的訪客留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (形) 壯麗的；宏偉的　(形) 傑出的；卓越的
example_sentence: The ancient temple, which stands on the hilltop, is a magnificent structure that attracts many visitors.
sentence_zh: 那座矗立在山頂上的古廟是一座吸引許多遊客的宏偉建築。

definition_zh: (副) 壯麗地；宏偉地　輝煌地；傑出地
example_sentence: If the architect designs the building magnificently, the city will attract more tourists and investors.
sentence_zh: 如果建築師設計得這棟建築物宏偉壯麗，這座城市將吸引更多遊客和投資者。

definition_zh: (名) 放大鏡；放大裝置
example_sentence: Using a magnifier helps students examine tiny details in biology experiments.
sentence_zh: 使用放大鏡幫助學生在生物實驗中檢查微小的細節。

definition_zh: (動) 放大；擴大　(動) 誇大；渲染
example_sentence: Scientists use powerful microscopes to magnify cells in order to study their structure.
sentence_zh: 科學家使用強大的顯微鏡放大細胞以便研究其結構。

definition_zh: (名) 大小；規模　(名) 星等；亮度
example_sentence: The magnitude of the earthquake's impact shocked the entire nation and changed disaster response policies.
sentence_zh: 這次地震影響的規模震驚了整個國家，並改變了防災政策。

definition_zh: (名) 女僕；女傭　(名) 年輕女性
example_sentence: While the maid was cleaning the bedroom, the family prepared dinner together.
sentence_zh: 當女僕在打掃臥室時，家人一起準備晚餐。

definition_zh: (名) 未婚女子；處女　(形) 首次的；初次的
example_sentence: Having completed her maiden voyage across the Atlantic, the ship returned to port with great celebration.
sentence_zh: 這艘船完成了她跨越大西洋的首航後，載譽返港。

definition_zh: (名) 郵件；信件　(動) 寄送；投遞
example_sentence: The package that arrived yesterday was the mail I had been waiting for.
sentence_zh: 昨天送達的包裹是我一直在等待的郵件。

definition_zh: (名) 郵箱；信箱
example_sentence: Every morning, Sarah checks her mailbox for letters and packages from online shopping.
sentence_zh: 每天早上，莎拉檢查郵箱，看是否有信件和網購包裹。

definition_zh: (名) 郵差；郵遞員
example_sentence: If the mailman delivered packages more carefully, neighbors would complain less about damaged items.
sentence_zh: 如果郵差投遞包裹更小心，鄰居就不會那麼常抱怨東西受損。

definition_zh: (名) 主要女友；正牌女友
example_sentence: He broke up with his main chick after dating her for three years.
sentence_zh: 他在和正牌女友交往三年後分了手。

definition_zh: (形) 主要的；重要的　(名) 主幹；主要部分
example_sentence: The main reason affecting students' grades is lacking sufficient sleep at night.
sentence_zh: 影響學生成績的主要原因是夜間睡眠不足。

definition_zh: (名) 大陸；內陸　(形) 大陸的；內陸的
example_sentence: Although mainland China has developed rapidly, cultural differences still exist when people from the mainland visit Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 雖然中國大陸發展迅速，但當大陸人民訪問台灣時，文化差異仍然存在。

definition_zh: (副) 主要地；大部分地　(副) 通常；一般來說
example_sentence: Mainly responsible for the project were the engineering team and the marketing department.
sentence_zh: 主要負責該專案的是工程團隊和行銷部門。

definition_zh: (名) 主要支柱；中堅力量　(形) 主要的；最重要的
example_sentence: Agriculture, which is the mainstay of Taiwan's rural economy, requires sustainable practices.
sentence_zh: 農業是臺灣鄉村經濟的主要支柱，需要永續的做法。

definition_zh: (名) 主流；潮流　(形) 主流的；流行的
example_sentence: Many students study popular music to join the mainstream and express their identity.
sentence_zh: 許多學生學習流行音樂以加入主流並表達自己的身份。

definition_zh: (動) 維持；保持　保養；維修
example_sentence: Regular exercise and a balanced diet maintain good health and strong bones.
sentence_zh: 定期運動和均衡飲食維持良好的健康和強壯的骨骼。

definition_zh: (名) 維護；保養　(名) 生活費；撫養費
example_sentence: Regular maintenance of school equipment prevents costly repairs later.
sentence_zh: 學校設備的定期保養可以防止日後昂貴的維修。

definition_zh: (名) 玉米；玉蜀黍
example_sentence: Because maize grows well in warm climates, farmers plant it extensively throughout Taiwan's countryside.
sentence_zh: 因為玉米在溫暖的氣候中生長良好，農民在台灣鄉村地區廣泛種植它。

definition_zh: (形) 雄偉的；莊嚴的　(形) 堂皇的；壯麗的
example_sentence: Standing majestically on the mountain peak, the ancient temple impressed thousands of visitors yearly.
sentence_zh: 矗立在山頂上莊嚴壯麗的古廟每年給數千名遊客留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (副) 莊嚴地；雄偉地
example_sentence: The ancient palace, which stood majestically on the hilltop for centuries, attracts thousands of visitors yearly.
sentence_zh: 那座古老宮殿莊嚴地聳立在山頂上已有幾百年，每年吸引數千名遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 威嚴；莊嚴　(名) 陛下；皇帝
example_sentence: If the royal family maintained their majesty with dignity, the nation would respect them more deeply.
sentence_zh: 如果皇室用尊嚴維持其威嚴，國家會更深刻地尊重他們。

definition_zh: (名) 主修科目；專業　(形) 主要的；重大的
example_sentence: Choosing a major is one of the most important decisions for college students.
sentence_zh: 選擇主修科目是大學生最重要的決定之一。

definition_zh: (名) 多數；大多數　(名) 成年；法定年齡
example_sentence: The majority of students study hard to pass the CSAT entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 大多數學生努力念書是為了通過學測入學考試。

definition_zh: (動) 東山再起；回歸　(名) 復出；回歸
example_sentence: After retiring from professional tennis, the champion made a comeback and won the tournament.
sentence_zh: 退休後，這位冠軍東山再起，贏得了比賽冠軍。

definition_zh: (動) 做出決定；決定
example_sentence: Before applying to university, many students must make a decision about their future carefully.
sentence_zh: 在申請大學之前，許多學生必須謹慎地做出關於自己未來的決定。

definition_zh: (動) 嘲笑；愚弄　使某人出醜
example_sentence: Having made a fool of himself during the presentation, Tom decided to skip the next class meeting.
sentence_zh: 在演講中出醜後，湯姆決定翹掉下次的班會。

definition_zh: (動片) 為自己創造名聲；出名
example_sentence: The young athlete who made a name for herself won three gold medals at the Olympics.
sentence_zh: 那位為自己創造名聲的年輕運動員在奧運會贏得了三枚金牌。

definition_zh: (動) 成名；建立名聲
example_sentence: The young athlete made a name for herself by winning three Olympic gold medals.
sentence_zh: 這位年輕運動員透過贏得三枚奧運金牌而成名。

definition_zh: (動) 承諾；許諾
example_sentence: If Sarah made a promise to help with the project, she would keep it no matter what.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉承諾幫忙這個專案，她無論如何都會信守承諾。

definition_zh: (動) mek 預訂；預約　(名) 預訂；訂位
example_sentence: Booking a restaurant table online makes dinner planning much easier.
sentence_zh: 在網上預訂餐廳位子使晚餐計畫容易得多。

definition_zh: (動) 許願；祈福
example_sentence: Closing her eyes and making a wish, Sarah blew out all the birthday candles.
sentence_zh: 莎拉閉上眼睛許願，然後吹熄所有的生日蠟燭。

definition_zh: (動) 追趕；追蹤
example_sentence: After the thief ran away, the police officer made after him with determination and speed.
sentence_zh: 小偷逃走後，警察官決心迅速地追趕他。

definition_zh: (動) 努力；盡力
example_sentence: Only after failing the first attempt did students make an effort to study harder.
sentence_zh: 只有在第一次失敗後，學生們才努力更認真地讀書。

definition_zh: (片) 偷走；盜取　(片) 逃走；逃脫
example_sentence: The thieves who made away with the jewelry were caught by police near the airport.
sentence_zh: 偷走珠寶的小偷在機場附近被警察逮捕。

definition_zh: (動) 說清楚；解釋明白　(動) 澄清；消除誤會
example_sentence: The teacher wrote examples on the board to make clear how to solve the problem.
sentence_zh: 老師在黑板上寫了例子，以清楚解釋如何解決這個問題。

definition_zh: (動) 將就；湊合　(動) 用…勉強應付
example_sentence: When the restaurant ran out of chicken, customers made do with fish instead.
sentence_zh: 當餐廳的雞肉用完時，客人就用魚肉將就一下。

definition_zh: (片) 勉強維持生計；收支平衡
example_sentence: Working two part-time jobs helps Sarah make ends meet each month.
sentence_zh: 打兩份兼職工作幫助莎拉每個月勉強維持生計。

definition_zh: (動) 前往；導致　(動) 有助於；促進
example_sentence: As the storm approaches rapidly, residents make for the nearest shelter to stay safe.
sentence_zh: 當風暴迅速逼近時，居民們前往最近的避難所以保持安全。

definition_zh: (動) 把…變成；製成
example_sentence: Breaking down large projects into smaller tasks, students find studying more manageable.
sentence_zh: 把大型專案分解成較小的任務，學生發現讀書更容易應付。

definition_zh: (動) 到達；及時趕上　(動) 成功進入
example_sentence: The students who make it to the final round of the competition will receive scholarships and recognition.
sentence_zh: 進入競賽最後一輪的學生將獲得獎學金和表揚。

definition_zh: (動) 成功到達；趕上
example_sentence: If Maya practices the violin every day, she will make it to the national competition next month.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪雅每天練習小提琴，她將能趕上下個月的全國比賽。

definition_zh: (動) 補償；彌補　(動) 和好；修復關係
example_sentence: After arguing with his friend, David bought him lunch to make it up to him.
sentence_zh: 和朋友吵架後，大衛買他午餐來彌補。

definition_zh: (動) 成功；達成　取得成就；及時趕上
example_sentence: Working hard every day is necessary to make it into a top university.
sentence_zh: 每天努力工作對於成功進入頂尖大學是必要的。

definition_zh: (動) 理解；看待　(動) 製造；組成
example_sentence: What do you make of the new school policy announcement?
sentence_zh: 你如何看待這項新的學校政策宣布？

definition_zh: (動) 偷走；搶走　(動) 逃離；溜走
example_sentence: After the security guard left his post, the thief made off with several expensive paintings before anyone noticed the theft.
sentence_zh: 保全人員離開崗位後，小偷在任何人發現失竊前就帶著好幾幅昂貴的畫作逃走了。

definition_zh: (動) 逃跑；逃離　溜走；偷偷離開
example_sentence: Having made off with the stolen jewels, the thief disappeared into the crowded market.
sentence_zh: 小偷偷走珠寶後逃之夭夭，在擁擠的市場中消失了。

definition_zh: (動) 成名；建立名聲　(動) 闖出一片天；出人頭地
example_sentence: The young athlete who made her name in last year's Olympics is now training for the next competition.
sentence_zh: 那位在去年奧運會上成名的年輕運動員，現在正為下一場比賽進行訓練。

definition_zh: (動) 用...製造；由...組成
example_sentence: The old house was made out of wood and stone.
sentence_zh: 這棟老房子是用木頭和石頭製造的。

definition_zh: (動) 與…親吻；與…接吻
example_sentence: If Sarah made out with her crush at the party, her friends would tease her for weeks.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉在派對上與她喜歡的人接吻，她的朋友會嘲笑她好幾週。

definition_zh: (動) 親吻；接吻　(動) 理解；搞清楚
example_sentence: Tom couldn't make out what his teacher said in the noisy classroom.
sentence_zh: 湯姆在吵雜的教室裡聽不清楚他老師說的話。

definition_zh: (動) 改造；翻新　(名) 改造；美容
example_sentence: Having a professional makeover, Sarah felt more confident walking into her job interview.
sentence_zh: 莎拉經過專業的改造，走進工作面試時感到更加自信。

definition_zh: (動) 騰出空間；為...讓出位置
example_sentence: As the new student arrived, everyone shifted to make room for her at the lunch table.
sentence_zh: 當新同學到達時，大家都移動身體為她騰出午餐桌的位置。

definition_zh: (動) 有道理；說得通　(動) 被理解；被懂
example_sentence: Only after careful review did the confusing math problem finally make sense to Sarah.
sentence_zh: 只有經過仔細檢查，這個令人困惑的數學題才對莎拉有了意義。

definition_zh: (動) 確保；確認　(動) 查證；驗證
example_sentence: Before submitting the application, Sarah made sure that all required documents were included in the folder.
sentence_zh: 在提交申請之前，莎拉確保所有必需的文件都包含在資料夾中。

definition_zh: (動) 朝著...前進；向...走去
example_sentence: After finishing the exam, students rushed to make towards the school gate.
sentence_zh: 考試結束後，學生們衝向校門口。

definition_zh: (動) 補償；彌補　(動) 彌補損失或缺陷
example_sentence: Working extra hours on weekends can make up for the time lost during the week.
sentence_zh: 週末加班可以彌補整週浪費的時間。

definition_zh: (動) 補償；彌補　(動) 討好；和解
example_sentence: After arguing with his friend, Tom bought coffee to make up to him.
sentence_zh: 與朋友爭執後，湯姆買咖啡來討好他。

definition_zh: (動) 組成；彌補　(動) 化妝；補考
example_sentence: Although the two friends had argued yesterday, making up before school started was important to both of them.
sentence_zh: 雖然兩個朋友昨天吵過架，但在上學前彌補關係對他們兩人都很重要。

definition_zh: (動) 利用；運用　(動) 充分利用；善用
example_sentence: Making use of available resources, the student completed the project efficiently.
sentence_zh: 充分利用現有資源，這位學生有效率地完成了專案。

definition_zh: (動) 用...製作；用...做出　(動) 與...相處；與...合作
example_sentence: The artist makes beautiful sculptures with materials that others consider waste.
sentence_zh: 這位藝術家用他人認為是廢料的材料製作美麗的雕像。

definition_zh: (動) 製造；製作　(動) 使得；讓～變成
example_sentence: Studying hard makes your dream come true.
sentence_zh: 努力讀書讓你的夢想成真。

definition_zh: (名) 改頭換面；整容　(動) 給...改頭換面；翻新
example_sentence: Sarah got a makeover to improve her appearance before the school dance.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在校舞前進行整容改造，以改善她的外貌。

definition_zh: (名) 製造者；製作人　(名) 品牌；廠商
example_sentence: The smartphone maker announced a new product at the tech conference yesterday.
sentence_zh: 那家智慧型手機製造商昨天在科技展上宣佈推出新產品。

definition_zh: (形) 臨時湊合的；簡陋應急的
example_sentence: Because the library was closed for repairs, students studied in a makeshift classroom until it reopened.
sentence_zh: 由於圖書館關閉進行維修，學生在臨時湊合的教室裡讀書，直到它重新開放。

definition_zh: (名) 化妝品；彩妝　(動) 補考；彌補
example_sentence: Having applied makeup carefully, the actress walked confidently onto the stage for her important performance.
sentence_zh: 女演員仔細塗上化妝品後，自信地走上舞台進行她重要的演出。

definition_zh: (名) 製造；製作　(動) 製造；做　(形) 有利的；成功的
example_sentence: The innovative smartphone making waves in the tech industry attracts millions of young consumers worldwide.
sentence_zh: 在科技業掀起波瀾的創新智慧型手機吸引了全球數百萬年輕消費者。

definition_zh: (名) 疾病；病痛　(名) 弊害；不適
example_sentence: A mysterious skin malady affected many students during winter, causing concern throughout the school.
sentence_zh: 一種神祕的皮膚疾病在冬天影響了許多學生，引起全校關注。

definition_zh: (名) 不適感；身體不舒服　(名) 心情沮喪；精神不振
example_sentence: If students suffered from constant malaise during exam season, proper rest would improve their focus and performance.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試季節持續感到身體不適，充分休息會改善他們的專注力和表現。

definition_zh: (名) 瘧疾；瘧病
example_sentence: Malaria is a serious disease spread by mosquitoes in tropical regions.
sentence_zh: 瘧疾是一種在熱帶地區由蚊子傳播的嚴重疾病。

definition_zh: (名) 不滿的人；心懷不滿者　(形) 不滿的；心有怨言的
example_sentence: Feeling frustrated with unfair treatment, the malcontent employee decided to resign.
sentence_zh: 感到受到不公平待遇而感到沮喪，這位心懷不滿的員工決定辭職。

definition_zh: (形) 男性的；男的　(名) 男性；男人
example_sentence: Although the male students trained hard, the female team won the basketball championship.
sentence_zh: 雖然男學生訓練刻苦，但女隊贏得了籃球冠軍。

definition_zh: (名) 惡意；邪惡　(形) 充滿惡意的；邪惡的
example_sentence: Seldom does such malevolence appear in the hearts of ordinary people.
sentence_zh: 這樣的惡意很少出現在普通人的心中。

definition_zh: (形) 惡意的；有害的　(形) 邪惡的；凶險的
example_sentence: The malevolent witch who cast a curse on the village was finally defeated.
sentence_zh: 那個對村莊施加詛咒的惡意女巫最終被打敗了。

definition_zh: (名) 故障；失靈　(動) 發生故障；運作不正常
example_sentence: The engineer inspected the machine to find and fix the malfunction.
sentence_zh: 工程師檢查機器以找出並修復故障。

definition_zh: (名) 惡意；仇恨　(形) 懷有惡意的；充滿敵意的
example_sentence: The malicious comment on social media was filled with pure malice toward the celebrity.
sentence_zh: 社群媒體上那則惡毒的留言充滿了對這位名人的純粹惡意。

definition_zh: (形) 惡意的；有害的　(形) 故意傷害他人的；懷恨的
example_sentence: The malicious rumors spread quickly among students at school.
sentence_zh: 那些惡意的謠言在學校裡迅速傳播。

definition_zh: (動) 詆毀；傷害　(形) 惡毒的；有害的
example_sentence: Although the politician tried to malign his opponent's record, voters recognized the truth and rejected false accusations.
sentence_zh: 雖然那位政治人物試圖詆毀對手的紀錄，但選民識破謊言並拒絕了不實指控。

definition_zh: (形) 惡性的；有害的　(形) 懷惡意的；仇恨的
example_sentence: Spreading rapidly through the body, the malignant tumor required immediate surgical intervention.
sentence_zh: 惡性腫瘤迅速在體內擴散，需要立即進行手術干預。

definition_zh: (形) 被誣衊的；遭惡意中傷的
example_sentence: The politician, maligned by critics for years, finally proved innocence.
sentence_zh: 這位遭到評論家多年誣衊的政治人物，最終證明了自己的清白。

definition_zh: (名) 購物中心；商場　(名) 室內購物區
example_sentence: If you visit the mall on weekends, you will find it crowded with shoppers.
sentence_zh: 如果你在週末去購物中心，你會發現那裡擠滿了購物者。

definition_zh: (形) 易改變的；柔軟的　(形) 可塑造的；易適應的
example_sentence: Gold is a malleable metal that craftspeople can shape into beautiful jewelry.
sentence_zh: 黃金是一種易塑造的金屬，工匠可以將它製成精美的珠寶。

definition_zh: (名) 木槌；槌子　(動) 用槌敲打
example_sentence: The carpenter used a wooden mallet to drive the chisel into the wood.
sentence_zh: 木匠用木槌敲擊鑿子以切割木材。

definition_zh: (名) 麥芽糖；含有兩個葡萄糖分子的雙糖
example_sentence: Maltose, a simple sugar formed from two glucose units, is commonly found in grains and malt beverages.
sentence_zh: 麥芽糖是由兩個葡萄糖單位形成的簡單糖，常見於穀物和麥芽飲料中。

definition_zh: (名) 惡意軟體；病毒軟體
example_sentence: Since malware can steal personal information, students should install antivirus software on their devices.
sentence_zh: 因為惡意軟體會竊取個人資訊，學生應該在他們的裝置上安裝防毒軟體。

definition_zh: (名) 哺乳動物；有奶腺的動物
example_sentence: Having evolved over millions of years, mammals now inhabit nearly every environment on Earth.
sentence_zh: 經過數百萬年的演化，哺乳動物現在棲息在地球上幾乎每個環境中。

definition_zh: (名) 金錢；財富　(名) 貪婪；物欲
example_sentence: The wealthy businessman, whose life Mammon had completely consumed, finally realized his true priorities.
sentence_zh: 那位富有的商人，其生活已被金錢慾望完全吞噬，最後終於明白了真正的優先順序。

definition_zh: (名) 猛瑪象；長毛象　(形) 巨大的；龐大的
example_sentence: The ancient mammoth skeleton discovered in Siberia amazed paleontologists worldwide.
sentence_zh: 在西伯利亞發現的古代猛瑪象骨架令古生物學家震驚。

definition_zh: (片) 有人受傷或倒下；緊急狀況　(動) 宣布有人倒下或受傷
example_sentence: If a player went down with a serious injury, the coach would immediately call 'man down' to stop the game.
sentence_zh: 如果一名球員因重傷倒下，教練會立即喊『man down』來停止比賽。

definition_zh: (片) 鼓起勇氣；勇敢面對
example_sentence: When facing difficult challenges, students must man up and try their best.
sentence_zh: 面對困難的挑戰時，學生必須鼓起勇氣並盡力。

definition_zh: (動) 駐守；操作　(名) 男人；人類
example_sentence: Managing the website, the IT team ensured smooth operation throughout the school year.
sentence_zh: 資訊小組駐守網站，確保全學年運作順暢。

definition_zh: (名) 男人；人類　(動) 操作；配置人員　(形) 男性的；勇敢的
example_sentence: As the team captain manned the defense, the opposing players struggled to score any points.
sentence_zh: 當隊長配置防守人員時，對方球員很難得分。

definition_zh: (形) 人造的；人工的　(形) 人為的；非天然的
example_sentence: Seldom can natural ecosystems recover from man-made pollution as quickly as scientists hope.
sentence_zh: 人造污染很少能像科學家期望的那樣快地讓自然生態系統恢復。

definition_zh: (名) 男人；人類　(動) 操控；守衛
example_sentence: The man who won the science competition is studying at our school.
sentence_zh: 贏得科學競賽的那個男人正在我們學校念書。

definition_zh: (名) 腳鐐；手銬　(動) 用鐐銬束縛；限制自由
example_sentence: The government imposed strict rules to manacle citizens and prevent their freedom of speech.
sentence_zh: 政府實施嚴格規則來束縛公民並限制言論自由。

definition_zh: (動) 設法做到；成功地做　(動) 勉強能做；雖然困難但做到
example_sentence: Despite having a full schedule, Sarah managed to finish her homework before dinner.
sentence_zh: 儘管日程滿檔，莎拉仍設法在晚餐前完成功課。

definition_zh: (動) 管理；處理　(動) 設法做到；勉強應付
example_sentence: The student manager successfully managed the school's basketball team this year.
sentence_zh: 這位學生經理今年成功地管理了學校籃球隊。

definition_zh: (形) 容易處理的；可控制的　(形) 可管理的；易於應對的
example_sentence: Although the project deadline is tight, the workload remains manageable as long as team members cooperate effectively.
sentence_zh: 雖然專案截止期限很緊，但只要團隊成員有效合作，工作量仍然是容易處理的。

definition_zh: (名) 管理；經營　(名) 管理階層；經營者
example_sentence: Managing the school club effectively, the president improved member participation significantly.
sentence_zh: 有效地管理學校社團，社長明顯提高了成員的參與度。

definition_zh: (名) 經理；管理人　(動) 管理；經營
example_sentence: The manager who oversees our school's sports program is very supportive of student athletes.
sentence_zh: 那位監督我們學校體育項目的經理非常支持學生運動員。

definition_zh: (形) 管理的；經理的　(形) 管理階層的；主管的
example_sentence: If the company implements better managerial practices, employee productivity would increase significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果公司採用更好的管理方法，員工生產力會大幅提高。

definition_zh: (名) 普通話；國語　(形) 橙黃色的；普通話的
example_sentence: Learning Mandarin Chinese helps students understand their cultural heritage better.
sentence_zh: 學習普通話幫助學生更好地了解他們的文化遺產。

definition_zh: (名) 授權；委任　(動) 委任；授權給
example_sentence: The government received a mandate to reduce carbon emissions and protect the environment.
sentence_zh: 政府受委授權減少碳排放並保護環境。

definition_zh: (形) 強制的；必須的　(形) 法定的；規定的
example_sentence: Attending the school assembly is a mandatory activity for all students every Monday morning.
sentence_zh: 參加學校集會是每週一早上所有學生必須進行的活動。

definition_zh: (動) 機動；調動；操縱　(名) 戰術；移動
example_sentence: As the chess player maneuvered her pieces strategically, her opponent struggled to predict the next move.
sentence_zh: 當西洋棋選手戰略性地調動她的棋子時，她的對手努力預測下一步棋。

definition_zh: (形) 易於操縱的；靈活的　(形) 可控制的；便於轉向的
example_sentence: Having practiced for months, the pilot found the newly designed aircraft maneuverable and responsive to every command.
sentence_zh: 經過數月練習，飛行員發現這架新設計的飛機易於操縱且反應靈敏。

definition_zh: (名) 疥癬；皮膚病　(動) 患疥癬；破壞
example_sentence: The stray dog that suffered from mange needed immediate veterinary treatment.
sentence_zh: 患有疥癬的流浪狗需要立即的獸醫治療。

definition_zh: (名) 芒果；一種熱帶水果
example_sentence: Fresh mango juice is a popular summer drink among Taiwanese students.
sentence_zh: 新鮮的芒果汁是台灣學生喜愛的夏季飲料。

definition_zh: (名) 紅樹林；紅樹
example_sentence: If mangrove forests were not protected, coastal ecosystems would lose their natural barriers against storms.
sentence_zh: 如果紅樹林未受保護，沿海生態系統就會失去抵禦風暴的天然屏障。

definition_zh: (名) 人孔蓋；下水道入口
example_sentence: Workers repaired the broken pipe through the manhole in the street.
sentence_zh: 工人透過街道上的人孔蓋修理破裂的管子。

definition_zh: (名) 狂熱；躁狂症　(形) 瘋狂的；狂熱的
example_sentence: Obsessing over online games, mania gradually consumed the teenager's daily life.
sentence_zh: 沉迷於線上遊戲，狂熱症逐漸吞噬了這名青少年的日常生活。

definition_zh: (名) 瘋狂的人；狂熱者　(形) 瘋狂的；狂熱的
example_sentence: The fitness maniac trained every day until exhaustion became his only companion.
sentence_zh: 這位健身狂人每天訓練，直到精疲力竭成為他唯一的伴侶。

definition_zh: (動) 顯示；表現　(形) 明顯的；顯而易見的
example_sentence: Only after careful investigation did the serious problems manifest themselves in the company's financial records.
sentence_zh: 只有經過仔細調查，這家公司財務紀錄中的嚴重問題才顯現出來。

definition_zh: (名) 表現；顯現　(名) 具體表現；象徵
example_sentence: The student's improved grades are a clear manifestation of the hard work that she has invested in her studies.
sentence_zh: 該學生進步的成績是她投入課業努力的明確表現。

definition_zh: (動) 操縱；控制　巧妙處理；操作
example_sentence: Politicians often manipulate public opinion to achieve their political goals.
sentence_zh: 政治人物經常操縱輿論以達成他們的政治目標。

definition_zh: (名) 人類；全體人類
example_sentence: Advances in technology have helped mankind solve many health problems over the past century.
sentence_zh: 在過去一個世紀裡，科技進步幫助人類解決了許多健康問題。

definition_zh: (名) 方式；方法　(名) 禮貌；舉止
example_sentence: The way she speaks shows a polite and respectful manner toward everyone.
sentence_zh: 她說話的方式對每個人都表現出有禮貌且尊重的態度。

definition_zh: (名) 特殊舉止；習慣性動作　(名) 矯揉造作；刻板作風
example_sentence: Although the actor's mannerism of tilting his head annoyed some viewers, loyal fans found it charming and distinctive.
sentence_zh: 雖然演員歪頭的特殊舉止惹惱了一些觀眾，但忠實粉絲卻覺得它迷人且獨特。

definition_zh: (名) 莊園；大宅　(名) 舉止；態度
example_sentence: Owning a sprawling manor, the wealthy family enjoyed a lavish lifestyle surrounded by gardens.
sentence_zh: 擁有一座廣闊的莊園，這個富有家族享受著被花園環繞的奢華生活。

definition_zh: (名) 豪宅；大宅邸
example_sentence: The mansion that overlooks the city attracts wealthy investors from around the world.
sentence_zh: 那座俯瞰城市的豪宅吸引了來自世界各地的富有投資者。

definition_zh: (名) 螳螂；一種掠食性昆蟲
example_sentence: If a mantis encounters a grasshopper, it will attack with lightning-fast reflexes.
sentence_zh: 如果螳螂遇到蝗蟲，它會以閃電般的速度發動攻擊。

definition_zh: (名) 斗篷；披肩　(名) 地幔；外層　(動) 覆蓋；包裹
example_sentence: The superhero wore a red mantle that flowed behind him as he flew through the city.
sentence_zh: 那位超級英雄穿著紅色斗篷，當他飛過城市時，斗篷在他身後飄動。

definition_zh: (名) 咒語；口訣　(名) 座右銘；信條
example_sentence: Students repeat their personal mantra every morning to build confidence before the exam.
sentence_zh: 學生每天早上重複他們的個人口訣，以便在考試前建立信心。

definition_zh: (形) 手工的；手動的　(名) 手冊；說明書
example_sentence: Operating the manual transmission car requires skill and practice from new drivers.
sentence_zh: 操作手動變速箱的汽車需要新駕駛具備技能和練習。

definition_zh: (副) 用手工；手動地　用人力；人工地
example_sentence: Although the software can process data automatically, the manager still prefers checking results manually to ensure accuracy.
sentence_zh: 雖然軟體可以自動處理數據，但經理仍偏好手動檢查結果以確保準確性。

definition_zh: (動) 製造；生產　(名) 製造商；廠商
example_sentence: Having manufactured smartphones for over a decade, the company became a global technology leader.
sentence_zh: 該公司製造智慧型手機超過十年後，成為全球科技領導者。

definition_zh: (名) 製造商；製造廠
example_sentence: The car manufacturer that produces electric vehicles has won many international awards.
sentence_zh: 生產電動車的那家汽車製造商贏得了許多國際獎項。

definition_zh: (名) 製造；製造業　(形) 製造的；生產的
example_sentence: Manufacturing companies in Taiwan export electronic products worldwide.
sentence_zh: 臺灣的製造公司向世界各地出口電子產品。

definition_zh: (名) 手稿；原稿　(名) 手寫文件；手寫本
example_sentence: If the author submitted the manuscript on time, the publisher would print the book before summer.
sentence_zh: 如果作者按時提交手稿，出版商就會在夏天前印刷這本書。

definition_zh: (形) 許多的；很多的　(代) 許多人；很多
example_sentence: Many students study hard to pass the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力讀書以通過學測考試。

definition_zh: (名) 地圖；地形圖　(動) 繪製地圖；標示位置
example_sentence: Using a detailed map, the hiking group successfully navigated through the mountain trail.
sentence_zh: 使用詳細的地圖，登山隊成功地在山徑中找到了方向。

definition_zh: (名) 楓樹；楓葉　(形) 楓樹的；楓色的
example_sentence: As autumn arrives, maple leaves turn brilliant red, creating stunning scenery throughout Taiwan's mountains.
sentence_zh: 當秋天到來時，楓葉變成鮮豔的紅色，在台灣的山區創造出令人驚艷的景色。

definition_zh: (動) 損壞；破壞　(動) 破壞…的外觀
example_sentence: Rarely does careless handling mar the quality of handmade crafts so much.
sentence_zh: 很少有粗心的處理能這麼損壞手工藝品的品質。

definition_zh: (名) 馬拉松；持久的活動
example_sentence: The charity marathon that raises money for hospitals attracts thousands of runners annually.
sentence_zh: 為醫院籌款的慈善馬拉松每年吸引數千名跑者參加。

definition_zh: (名) 大理石；彈珠　(形) 大理石的；冷漠的
example_sentence: Architects use marble to build beautiful monuments in order to preserve history.
sentence_zh: 建築師使用大理石來建造美麗的紀念碑，以便保存歷史。

definition_zh: (名) 三月；行進　(動) 行走；遊行
example_sentence: Thousands of students march through the city streets to protest unfair education policies.
sentence_zh: 數千名學生穿過城市街道遊行，抗議不公平的教育政策。

definition_zh: (名) 母馬；牝馬
example_sentence: The rider guided the mare across the green pasture this morning.
sentence_zh: 騎士今早引導那匹母馬穿過翠綠的草地。

definition_zh: (名) 邊緣；利潤　(名) 空白處；餘地
example_sentence: Although the company operates with a narrow profit margin, it continues to expand whenever market conditions improve.
sentence_zh: 雖然公司利潤微薄，但只要市場狀況改善，就繼續擴展業務。

definition_zh: (形) 邊際的；微小的　(形) 勉強的；勉勉強強的
example_sentence: Facing marginal profits, the struggling company decided to cut costs and restructure operations.
sentence_zh: 面臨利潤微薄，這家陷入困境的公司決定削減成本並重組業務。

definition_zh: (動) 使邊緣化；排斥　忽視；貶低
example_sentence: Students whose families lack resources often face systems that marginalize them in academic settings.
sentence_zh: 家庭資源不足的學生常面對在學術環境中將他們邊緣化的制度。

definition_zh: (動) 用醬汁浸泡；醃製
example_sentence: If the chef marinates the chicken in soy sauce overnight, the meat will taste much more flavorful and tender.
sentence_zh: 如果廚師把雞肉在醬油中醃一晚，肉會變得更有味道且更嫩。

definition_zh: (形) 海洋的；海生的　(名) 海軍；海員
example_sentence: Marine ecosystems around Taiwan support thousands of fish species.
sentence_zh: 臺灣周圍的海洋生態系統支持數千種魚類。

definition_zh: (名) 水手；海員　(名) 航海者；船員
example_sentence: Modern mariners train extensively to navigate dangerous ocean waters safely.
sentence_zh: 現代水手受過廣泛訓練，以便安全航行在危險的海洋中。

definition_zh: (形) 海的；海洋的　(名) 海事；航海
example_sentence: Maritime trade routes connect Taiwan with countries across the Pacific Ocean every day.
sentence_zh: 海事貿易路線每天將台灣與太平洋各國連接起來。

definition_zh: (動片) 將...標記為；將...記為
example_sentence: Because the supplier failed to deliver on time, the manager marked down as unreliable for future orders.
sentence_zh: 因為供應商未能準時交貨，經理將其標記為不可靠的未來訂單供應商。

definition_zh: (動) 降價；打折　(動) 標記；記錄
example_sentence: Having marked down all winter coats by fifty percent, the store attracted many eager shoppers.
sentence_zh: 冬季外套被降價百分之五十後，這家店吸引了許多急切的購物者。

definition_zh: (動) 標記；劃去　(動) 區分；分開
example_sentence: The runners who marked off the route early received certificates from the organizers.
sentence_zh: 那些提早標記路線的跑者從主辦單位獲得了證書。

definition_zh: (動) 標記為；挑選出來
example_sentence: The coach marked out three promising players for the national team.
sentence_zh: 教練挑選了三名有潛力的選手進入國家隊。

definition_zh: (動) 將...與眾不同地區分出來；使...突出
example_sentence: If her excellent grades hadn't marked her out from other applicants, the university wouldn't have offered her a scholarship.
sentence_zh: 如果她優異的成績沒有把她與其他申請者區分開來，大學就不會提供她獎學金。

definition_zh: (動) 標示；劃出　(動) 指定；選出
example_sentence: The coach marked out the football field with white lines yesterday.
sentence_zh: 昨天教練用白線在足球場上標示出場地。

definition_zh: (動) 提高價格；標記　(名) 漲價；加價
example_sentence: Marking up prices by thirty percent, the store owner attracted criticism from regular customers.
sentence_zh: 將商品價格提高百分之三十後，店主招致了常客的批評。

definition_zh: (名) 標記；記號　(動) 標記；做記號　(名) 成績；分數
example_sentence: As the teacher marks the exam papers, students wait anxiously for their test scores.
sentence_zh: 當老師批改考卷時，學生們焦急地等待考試成績。

definition_zh: (名) 降價；打折　(動) 降低價格；打折扣
example_sentence: Only after the holiday sale ended did the store markdown its winter clothing inventory significantly.
sentence_zh: 只有在假期促銷結束後，商店才大幅降低冬季服裝庫存的價格。

definition_zh: (形) 明顯的；顯著的　(動) 標記；做記號
example_sentence: The marked improvement in exam scores surprised teachers who had doubted the students.
sentence_zh: 令人驚訝的是，那些曾懷疑學生的教師看到了考試成績明顯進步的情況。

definition_zh: (副) 顯著地；明顯地　(副) 清楚地；肯定地
example_sentence: Exercise regularly to markedly improve both physical health and mental well-being.
sentence_zh: 定期運動以顯著改善身體健康和心理健康。

definition_zh: (名) 標記；筆　(動) 標示；做記號
example_sentence: Using a highlighter marker helps students mark important information in textbooks.
sentence_zh: 使用螢光筆標記有助於學生在課本中標示重要資訊。

definition_zh: (名) 市場；超市　(動) 銷售；推銷
example_sentence: The farmer sells fresh vegetables at the local market every Saturday morning.
sentence_zh: 那位農夫每個星期六早上在當地市場販賣新鮮蔬菜。

definition_zh: (名) 行銷；市場行銷　(動) 推銷；進行市場行銷
example_sentence: Because marketing strategies focus on social media, many young consumers discover new products online.
sentence_zh: 因為行銷策略專注於社群媒體，許多年輕消費者在網路上發現新產品。

definition_zh: (名) 市場；商業環境　(名) 交易場所；購物地點
example_sentence: Attracting more online shoppers, the digital marketplace has grown into a major retail hub.
sentence_zh: 吸引更多線上購物者，這個數位市場已成長為主要零售中心。

definition_zh: (形) 深褐紅色的；暗紅色的　(名) 深褐紅色；暗紅色
example_sentence: The maroon uniforms that the sports team wore impressed everyone at the competition.
sentence_zh: 運動隊穿著的深褐紅色制服在比賽中給所有人留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 大帳篷；華麗的遮篷　(名) 劇院入口的裝飾招牌
example_sentence: If the outdoor concert had a large marquee, rain would not ruin the event for thousands of attendees.
sentence_zh: 如果戶外音樂會有大帳篷，雨就不會對數千名觀眾毀掉活動。

definition_zh: (名) 婚姻；結婚　(動) 與...結婚；結合
example_sentence: A successful marriage requires patience, trust, and constant communication between partners.
sentence_zh: 成功的婚姻需要伴侶之間的耐心、信任和持續的溝通。

definition_zh: (形) 已婚的；結婚的
example_sentence: Many couples save money for years to buy a house after getting married.
sentence_zh: 許多夫妻結婚後會存錢多年以購買房子。

definition_zh: (動) 通過結婚而加入；娶入；嫁入
example_sentence: The young woman decided to marry into a wealthy family and move to Taipei.
sentence_zh: 那位年輕女性決定嫁入一個富有的家族，搬到台北去。

definition_zh: (動) 把...嫁出去；替...安排婚事
example_sentence: After her daughter graduated from university, the mother wanted to marry off her eldest son before considering retirement.
sentence_zh: 在女兒大學畢業後，母親想在考慮退休前替長子安排婚事。

definition_zh: (動) 嫁出去；娶出去　(動) 與外人通婚
example_sentence: Having married out to a distant city, the daughter rarely visits her hometown during holidays.
sentence_zh: 女兒已嫁到遠方城市，假期很少回老家探親。

definition_zh: (動) 相互匹配；協調；配對
example_sentence: The software features that marry up with user needs will attract more customers.
sentence_zh: 與用戶需求相互匹配的軟體功能會吸引更多顧客。

definition_zh: (動) 與…結婚；娶；嫁　(動) 使結合；聯合
example_sentence: My older sister will marry her high school sweetheart next summer.
sentence_zh: 我的姐姐明年夏天將與她的高中戀人結婚。

definition_zh: (名) 沼澤；濕地　(動) 行進；邁進
example_sentence: If the wetland were not protected as a marsh, biodiversity in the region would disappear completely.
sentence_zh: 如果該濕地不被保護為沼澤，該地區的生物多樣性將會完全消失。

definition_zh: (名) 元帥；警長　(動) 組織；集結
example_sentence: The police marshal directed traffic at the busy intersection during rush hour.
sentence_zh: 警察元帥在尖峰時段指揮繁忙十字路口的交通。

definition_zh: (名) 棉花糖；軟糖
example_sentence: Roasting marshmallows over a campfire, the students enjoyed a perfect evening.
sentence_zh: 在營火上烤棉花糖，學生們享受了完美的夜晚。

definition_zh: (名) 有袋動物；袋鼠　(形) 有袋的；袋鼠的
example_sentence: Since kangaroos are marsupials, mothers carry their babies in pouches.
sentence_zh: 由於袋鼠是有袋動物，母親在育兒袋裡攜帶牠們的寶寶。

definition_zh: (形) 軍事的；戰爭的　(形) 好戰的；勇武的
example_sentence: Only after intense martial training did the athlete gain the discipline necessary for Olympic success.
sentence_zh: 只有在激烈的軍事訓練之後，這位運動員才獲得了奧運成功所需的紀律。

definition_zh: (名) 奇蹟；令人驚嘆的事物　(動) 對…感到驚奇；讚嘆
example_sentence: The ancient temple, which was a marvel of architectural design, attracted thousands of visitors every year.
sentence_zh: 這座古廟是建築設計的奇蹟，每年吸引數千名遊客前往參觀。

definition_zh: (形) 絕妙的；驚人的　(形) 令人驚嘆的；極好的
example_sentence: Maria studied hard to achieve marvelous results on the college entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞用功讀書是為了在大學入學考試中取得絕妙的成績。

definition_zh: (名) 吉祥物；代表符號
example_sentence: The school's mascot, a friendly tiger, appears at every sports event and competition.
sentence_zh: 學校的吉祥物是一隻友善的老虎，在每場運動會和比賽上都會出現。

definition_zh: (形) 男性的；陽剛的　(形) 男人的特徵
example_sentence: The actor's masculine voice and strong appearance impressed many fans.
sentence_zh: 那位演員陽剛的嗓音和健壯的外表給許多粉絲留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 男性氣質；陽剛之氣　(名) 男性特徵；男子氣概
example_sentence: Although masculinity is often linked to physical strength, emotional intelligence matters equally in modern society.
sentence_zh: 雖然男性氣質常與體力相連，但情感智力在現代社會中同樣重要。

definition_zh: (動) 混合；搗碎　(名) 混合物；改編作品
example_sentence: Mashing up different music styles, the DJ created an exciting remix that thrilled the young audience.
sentence_zh: 混合不同的音樂風格，這位DJ創作了令年輕觀眾興奮的混音作品。

definition_zh: (動) 搗碎；壓爛　(名) 混合物；馬鈴薯泥
example_sentence: The potatoes that the chef mashed were served as a creamy side dish.
sentence_zh: 廚師搗碎的馬鈴薯被當作奶油狀配菜供應。

definition_zh: (名) 面具；口罩　(動) 隱藏；掩蓋
example_sentence: If students wear protective masks during flu season, they will reduce the risk of infection.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在流感季節戴上防護口罩，他們會降低感染風險。

definition_zh: (名) 石匠；泥水匠　(名) 共濟會會員
example_sentence: The mason carefully laid bricks to build the garden wall.
sentence_zh: 那位石匠小心翼翼地鋪磚來建造花園的牆。

definition_zh: (名) 化妝舞會；偽裝　(動) 偽裝；冒充
example_sentence: The spy used a fake identity to masquerade as a diplomat to gather secret information.
sentence_zh: 那名間諜使用假身分冒充外交官以蒐集機密資訊。

definition_zh: (動) 大量生產；批量製造
example_sentence: Factories mass-produce smartphones to meet global demand every year.
sentence_zh: 工廠每年大量生產智慧型手機以滿足全球需求。

definition_zh: (名) 大量；群眾　(形) 大規模的；廣泛的
example_sentence: As social media spreads rapidly, mass communication shapes public opinion in ways previous generations never imagined.
sentence_zh: 當社群媒體迅速傳播時，大眾傳播以前代人從未想像過的方式塑造輿論。

definition_zh: (名) 大屠殺；慘案　(動) 大規模殺害；屠殺
example_sentence: Having massacred thousands of civilians, the invading army faced international condemnation and severe consequences.
sentence_zh: 入侵軍隊在屠殺了數千名平民後，面臨國際譴責和嚴重後果。

definition_zh: (名) 按摩；馬殺雞　(動) 按摩；揉搓
example_sentence: The massage therapy that relaxes tight muscles is popular among athletes.
sentence_zh: 能放鬆緊繃肌肉的按摩療法在運動員中很受歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 按摩器；揉搓機
example_sentence: Using a neck massager after studying helps relieve shoulder tension.
sentence_zh: 讀書後使用頸部按摩器有助於舒緩肩膀緊張。

definition_zh: (名) 按摩師；推拿師
example_sentence: If a masseur had better training, the client would experience more effective pain relief.
sentence_zh: 如果按摩師接受過更好的訓練，客人就會感受到更有效的疼痛緩解。

definition_zh: (名) 女按摩師；女療癒師
example_sentence: The masseuse helped relax my tight shoulder muscles after the long study session.
sentence_zh: 那位女按摩師在我長時間讀書後幫助放鬆我緊繃的肩膀肌肉。

definition_zh: (形) 巨大的；龐大的　(形) 大規模的；廣泛的
example_sentence: Facing massive budget cuts, the school decided to reduce extracurricular programs.
sentence_zh: 面臨龐大的預算削減，學校決定減少課外活動。

definition_zh: (名) 大師；高手　(動) 精通；掌握
example_sentence: As long as you practice consistently, mastering a new language becomes achievable and rewarding.
sentence_zh: 只要你持續練習，精通一門新語言就變得可達到且有益。

definition_zh: (名) 傑作；大師之作　(名) 代表作；最佳作品
example_sentence: Only after years of dedication did the artist finally complete her masterpiece.
sentence_zh: 只有在經過多年的奉獻之後，這位藝術家才終於完成了她的傑作。

definition_zh: (名) 精通；掌握　(名) 優越；統治
example_sentence: The violin virtuoso achieved mastery of a difficult concerto that most musicians never master.
sentence_zh: 那位小提琴大師精通了大多數音樂家永遠無法精通的困難協奏曲。

definition_zh: (名) 墊子；地墊　(動) 使變得暗淡
example_sentence: Athletes use yoga mats to protect their joints during exercise.
sentence_zh: 運動員使用瑜伽墊來在運動時保護他們的關節。

definition_zh: (名) 比賽；競賽　(動) 相配；搭配　(名) 火柴
example_sentence: The tennis match between the two champions attracted thousands of excited fans to the stadium.
sentence_zh: 兩位冠軍之間的網球比賽吸引了數千名興奮的粉絲來到體育館。

definition_zh: (名) 朋友；伙伴　(動) 與…相伴；配對
example_sentence: My classmate and I studied together for the math test.
sentence_zh: 我的同學和我一起為數學考試讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 材料；物質　(形) 物質的；重要的
example_sentence: Because the building material was of poor quality, the construction company had to replace it.
sentence_zh: 因為建築材料品質不好，建築公司必須更換它。

definition_zh: (名) 唯物主義；物質主義　(形) 唯物的；物質至上的
example_sentence: Obsessing over buying new clothes and gadgets, materialism often leaves teenagers feeling empty and unsatisfied.
sentence_zh: 沉迷於購買新衣服和小工具，唯物主義常使青少年感到空虛和不滿足。

definition_zh: (動) 實現；成形　(動) 出現；具體化
example_sentence: The business plan that the team developed materialized into a successful company within two years.
sentence_zh: 該團隊制定的商業計畫在兩年內實現成為一家成功的公司。

definition_zh: (名) 數學；計算
example_sentence: If students study math regularly, they will improve their test scores significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生定期學習數學，他們的考試成績會顯著進步。

definition_zh: (形) 數學的；與數學有關的　精確的；準確的
example_sentence: Understanding mathematical concepts helps solve real-world problems more effectively.
sentence_zh: 理解數學概念有助於更有效地解決現實問題。

definition_zh: (副) 數學上地；用數學方法地
example_sentence: Engineers use computer software to calculate measurements mathematically in order to ensure precision.
sentence_zh: 工程師使用電腦軟體來數學上計算測量值，以確保精確度。

definition_zh: (名) 數學
example_sentence: Mathematics is an important subject that helps students develop problem-solving skills.
sentence_zh: 數學是一門重要科目，幫助學生培養解決問題的能力。

definition_zh: (形) 無光澤的；啞光的　(名) 啞光漆；無光澤表面
example_sentence: Although the furniture had a matt finish, dust particles made it appear dull and dirty.
sentence_zh: 儘管傢俱有啞光表面，灰塵粒子使它看起來又暗又髒。

definition_zh: (形) 糾結的；打結的　(動) 使糾結；使打結
example_sentence: Matted hair tangled after sleeping overnight without brushing.
sentence_zh: 一夜未梳理後，頭髮糾結打結在一起。

definition_zh: (名) 物質；事情　(動) 很重要；有關係　(形) 重要的
example_sentence: The environmental issues that matter most to young people today include climate change and plastic pollution.
sentence_zh: 現今最重要的環境議題包括氣候變遷和塑膠污染。

definition_zh: (名) 床墊；褥子
example_sentence: A comfortable mattress is important for good sleep and back health.
sentence_zh: 舒適的床墊對於良好睡眠和背部健康很重要。

definition_zh: (形) 成熟的；懂事的　(動) 成熟；變成熟
example_sentence: If students matured emotionally, they would handle peer pressure more wisely.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在情感上變得成熟，他們會更明智地應對同儕壓力。

definition_zh: (名) 成熟；成人期　(形) 成熟的；老練的
example_sentence: Reaching maturity means taking responsibility for your own decisions and future.
sentence_zh: 達到成熟意味著為自己的決定和未來負責。

definition_zh: (動) 粗暴地對待；傷害　(動) 撕裂；拉扯
example_sentence: Mauling the opponent during the match, the aggressive player received a red card.
sentence_zh: 那名好鬥的選手在比賽中粗暴地對待對手，結果被罰下場。

definition_zh: (名) 陵墓；紀念碑
example_sentence: Although the mausoleum was built centuries ago, visitors still admire its impressive architecture today.
sentence_zh: 雖然這座陵墓是在幾個世紀前建造的，遊客今天仍然欣賞它令人印象深刻的建築。

definition_zh: (名) 特立獨行的人；標新立異者　(形) 獨立的；不循規蹈矩的
example_sentence: Never does a true maverick follow the crowd's expectations without questioning.
sentence_zh: 真正特立獨行的人絕不會不加質疑就跟隨群眾的期望。

definition_zh: (名) 格言；名言　(名) 原則；座右銘
example_sentence: The maxim that hard work leads to success is one many students believe in.
sentence_zh: 「勤奮導致成功」這句格言是許多學生相信的。

definition_zh: (動) 最大化；使達到最大　(動) 充分利用；發揮到最大
example_sentence: Students should study hard to maximize their chances of passing the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 學生應該努力讀書以發揮最大潛力，爭取通過學測。

definition_zh: (名) 最大值；最高限度　(形) 最大的；最高的
example_sentence: The maximum temperature today reached 35 degrees Celsius, breaking last year's record.
sentence_zh: 今天最高溫度達到攝氏35度，打破了去年的紀錄。

definition_zh: (助) 可能；或許　(動) 可能會；也許會
example_sentence: Students may need more time to understand this difficult grammar concept.
sentence_zh: 學生可能需要更多時間來理解這個困難的文法概念。

definition_zh: (副) 也許；可能　(連) 或許；說不定
example_sentence: Maybe the exam will be easier than we expect, so we should study hard anyway.
sentence_zh: 也許考試會比我們預期的簡單，所以無論如何我們應該努力讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 美乃滋；蛋黃醬
example_sentence: Made with eggs and oil, mayonnaise adds richness to sandwiches and salads.
sentence_zh: 美乃滋由雞蛋和油製成，為三明治和沙拉增添濃郁風味。

definition_zh: (名) 市長；鎮長
example_sentence: The mayor who was elected last year has implemented many new policies for the city.
sentence_zh: 去年當選的市長已經為這個城市實施了許多新政策。

definition_zh: (形) 市長的；與市長有關的
example_sentence: If the mayoral candidate wins the election, the city will implement new environmental policies.
sentence_zh: 如果這位市長候選人贏得選舉，這個城市將實施新的環保政策。

definition_zh: (名) 草地；牧場　(名) 花草地
example_sentence: The family enjoyed a picnic in the sunny meadow near the village.
sentence_zh: 這個家庭在村莊附近陽光充足的草地上享受野餐。

definition_zh: (形) 貧乏的；不足的　(形) 簡陋的；微薄的
example_sentence: The refugee family received meager food rations to survive each difficult week.
sentence_zh: 難民家庭獲得微薄的糧食配給以度過每個艱難的週期。

definition_zh: (名) 餐；飯　(名) 一餐食物
example_sentence: Eating a healthy breakfast meal every morning helps students concentrate better in class.
sentence_zh: 每天早上吃一頓健康的早餐，有助於學生在課堂上專注力更好。

definition_zh: (形) 刻薄的；不友善的　(動) 表示；意思是
example_sentence: As the exam results were mean across the class, the teacher decided to review the material again.
sentence_zh: 由於全班的考試成績不理想，老師決定再次複習教材。

definition_zh: (動) 蜿蜒流動；曲折前進　(名) 蜿蜒；曲折的路線
example_sentence: Having meandered through the mountain valleys for hours, the hiking group finally reached the scenic viewpoint.
sentence_zh: 登山隊蜿蜒地穿過山谷數小時後，終於到達了風景優美的觀景點。

definition_zh: (名) 意思；含義　(名) 目的；意圖
example_sentence: The poem, whose meaning students struggled to understand, became clearer after class discussion.
sentence_zh: 這首詩的意思讓學生難以理解，課堂討論後變得更清楚了。

definition_zh: (形) 有意義的；有重要意義的　(形) 深長的；意味深長的
example_sentence: Volunteering at the community center provides meaningful experience for high school students.
sentence_zh: 在社區中心志願服務為高中生提供了有意義的經驗。

definition_zh: (副) 有意義地；深刻地　(副) 實質性地；充分地
example_sentence: If students engaged meaningfully with the assigned reading materials, their exam scores would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生能充分投入於指定的閱讀教材，他們的考試成績就會大幅提高。

definition_zh: (形) 無意義的；毫無意義的　(形) 空洞的；無用的
example_sentence: Spending hours on social media without learning feels meaningless to many students.
sentence_zh: 對許多學生來說，花數小時在社群媒體上而沒有學到東西感覺毫無意義。

definition_zh: (名) 方法；手段　(動) 意味著；表示　(動) 打算；想要
example_sentence: Using public transportation means reducing carbon emissions and protecting our environment.
sentence_zh: 使用大眾運輸工具意味著減少碳排放並保護我們的環境。

definition_zh: (名) 同時；其間　(副) 在此期間；與此同時
example_sentence: The construction will take six months; meantime, the old building remains open to the public.
sentence_zh: 這項施工將耗時六個月；在此期間，舊建築物仍對民眾開放。

definition_zh: (副) 同時；其間　(連) 當...的時候；同時
example_sentence: Not only did Sarah study for the exam, but meanwhile her classmates prepared presentation slides.
sentence_zh: 莎拉不僅為考試而讀書，同時她的同學們在準備簡報投影片。

definition_zh: (名) 麻疹；一種傳染病
example_sentence: The measles, which spreads through respiratory droplets, requires immediate medical attention.
sentence_zh: 麻疹是通過呼吸道飛沫傳播的疾病，需要立即就醫。

definition_zh: (形) 可測量的；可衡量的　(形) 明顯的；顯著的
example_sentence: Teachers use measurable goals to track student progress throughout the semester.
sentence_zh: 教師使用可測量的目標來追蹤學生整個學期的進度。

definition_zh: (動) 用...作為標準評估；與...比較
example_sentence: The company's performance this year should be measured against last year's results.
sentence_zh: 公司今年的表現應該與去年的成績進行比較。

definition_zh: (動) 量出；標記出　(動) 分割；劃分
example_sentence: The carpenter measured off six feet of wood for the bookshelf.
sentence_zh: 木匠量出六英尺的木材來做書架。

definition_zh: (動) 符合；達到　(動) 與...相比較
example_sentence: Although Sarah studied hard, her test score didn't measure up to what her parents expected.
sentence_zh: 儘管莎拉努力讀書，但她的考試成績沒有達到父母的期望。

definition_zh: (動) 達到標準；符合要求　(動) 與...相比；相等
example_sentence: Graduating from a top university and earning a high salary, Mark measured up to his parents' expectations perfectly.
sentence_zh: 馬克從頂尖大學畢業並賺取高薪，完全符合父母的期望。

definition_zh: (名) 措施；方法　(動) 測量；衡量　(形) 適度的；有分寸的
example_sentence: The new safety measures that the school introduced have reduced accidents significantly.
sentence_zh: 學校推行的新安全措施已經大幅減少了意外事故。

definition_zh: (名) 測量；量度　(名) 尺寸；大小
example_sentence: If accurate measurement is taken before construction begins, the building will meet safety standards.
sentence_zh: 如果在施工前進行準確的測量，這棟建築物將符合安全標準。
