definition_zh: (名) 肉；肉類
example_sentence: My family enjoys eating meat and vegetables for dinner every night.
sentence_zh: 我的家人每晚都喜歡吃肉和蔬菜當晚餐。

definition_zh: (形) 有肉的；實質的　(形) 充實的；有內容的
example_sentence: Reading classic novels helps students develop meaty arguments to support their essay thesis.
sentence_zh: 閱讀經典小說幫助學生發展充實的論點來支持他們的論文主題。

definition_zh: (名) 技工；機械師　(形) 機械的；機械式的
example_sentence: The car mechanic repaired the engine problem in just two hours.
sentence_zh: 汽車技工只用兩小時就修好了引擎問題。

definition_zh: (形) 機械的；機械性的　(形) 自動的；無意識的
example_sentence: Although the machine performed its mechanical movements perfectly, engineers discovered a serious defect inside.
sentence_zh: 雖然機器完美地執行了它的機械動作，工程師們發現了內部的一個嚴重缺陷。

definition_zh: (副) 機械地；無意識地　(副) 按部就班地；自動地
example_sentence: Having followed the same routine mechanically for years, the factory worker finally decided to try a new job.
sentence_zh: 這位工廠工人多年來機械地遵循同樣的日常工作，最後決定嘗試新的工作。

definition_zh: (名) 力學；機械學　(名) 機械裝置；運作方式
example_sentence: The mechanics that make airplanes fly are principles which students study in physics class.
sentence_zh: 使飛機飛行的力學原理是學生在物理課上研究的內容。

definition_zh: (名) 機制；機構　(名) 方法；途徑
example_sentence: Understanding the mechanism of photosynthesis helps students grasp how plants produce energy.
sentence_zh: 了解光合作用的機制幫助學生掌握植物如何產生能量。

definition_zh: (動) 機械化；用機器做　(動) 使自動化；簡化工作
example_sentence: If factories mechanized their production lines, manufacturing costs would decrease significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果工廠將生產線機械化，製造成本將會大幅下降。

definition_zh: (名) 獎牌；勳章　(動) 獲得獎牌；贏得勳章
example_sentence: The Olympic swimmer won three gold medals at the international competition.
sentence_zh: 那位奧運游泳選手在國際比賽中贏得三枚金牌。

definition_zh: (名) 媒體；新聞機構　(名) 媒介；傳播工具
example_sentence: Using social media platforms, students can share their learning experiences more easily.
sentence_zh: 利用社群媒體平台，學生能更容易地分享他們的學習經驗。

definition_zh: (名) 中位數；中央值　(形) 居中的；中等的
example_sentence: Median income rose significantly as the economy improved after the recession ended.
sentence_zh: 當經濟在衰退結束後好轉時，中位數收入大幅上升。

definition_zh: (動) 調停；斡旋　(動) 居中協調；仲裁
example_sentence: Only after the teacher mediated between the two arguing students did peace finally return to the classroom.
sentence_zh: 只有在老師調停那兩個爭執的學生之後，教室才終於恢復和平。

definition_zh: (名) 調解人；仲裁者　(動) 調解；居中協調
example_sentence: The mediator who helped resolve the dispute between the two companies earned great respect.
sentence_zh: 那位幫助解決兩家公司爭議的調解人獲得了極大的尊重。

definition_zh: (形) 醫學的；醫療的　(形) 醫生的；病的
example_sentence: Students visited the hospital to observe medical procedures and learn about patient care.
sentence_zh: 學生參訪醫院以觀察醫療程序並學習病患照護。

definition_zh: (形) 含藥的；經過藥物治療的
example_sentence: The medicated cream helps reduce skin irritation and itching quickly.
sentence_zh: 這款含藥乳膏能幫助快速減輕皮膚刺激和瘙癢。

definition_zh: (名) 藥物；藥　(名) 醫療；用藥
example_sentence: Taking the correct medication regularly helps control the patient's blood pressure.
sentence_zh: 定期服用正確的藥物可以幫助患者控制血壓。

definition_zh: (名) 藥物；醫學　(名) 藥；治療方法
example_sentence: Although taking medicine regularly helps control blood pressure, many patients forget their daily doses.
sentence_zh: 雖然定期服藥有助於控制血壓，但許多患者卻忘記每日服藥。

definition_zh: (形) 中世紀的；中古的　(形) 古老的；陳舊的
example_sentence: Featuring elaborate stone castles, medieval European architecture fascinates modern historians studying past civilizations.
sentence_zh: 以精美石堡為特色，中世紀歐洲建築迷住了研究過去文明的現代歷史學家。

definition_zh: (形) 平庸的；普通的　(形) 品質一般的；不出色的
example_sentence: The restaurant serves mediocre food that fails to impress customers who expect quality.
sentence_zh: 那家餐廳提供的食物平庸，無法令期待品質的顧客印象深刻。

definition_zh: (動) 冥想；沉思　(動) 深思熟慮；思考
example_sentence: If students meditate before exams, their anxiety would decrease significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試前冥想，他們的焦慮會明顯降低。

definition_zh: (名) 冥想；靜思　(動) 靜坐冥想
example_sentence: Daily meditation helps reduce stress and improves mental clarity for students.
sentence_zh: 每天靜坐冥想可以幫助學生減少壓力並提高專注力。

definition_zh: (形) 冥想的；沉思的　(形) 寧靜的；安詳的
example_sentence: Many students practice meditative breathing to calm their minds before the big exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生練習冥想呼吸來在大考前平靜心緒。

definition_zh: (名) 冥想者；打坐的人
example_sentence: The experienced meditator sat peacefully in the garden every morning before school.
sentence_zh: 那位有經驗的冥想者每天上學前都在花園裡靜坐。

definition_zh: (名) 媒介；媒體　(形) 中等的；適中的
example_sentence: As the teacher explained the lesson through various media, students understood the concept more clearly.
sentence_zh: 當老師透過各種媒介解釋課程時，學生更清楚地理解了這個概念。

definition_zh: (形) 溫和的；謙遜的　(形) 柔順的；順從的
example_sentence: Having been raised in a humble family, the meek student rarely spoke up in class discussions.
sentence_zh: 這位溫和的學生因為在貧苦家庭中長大，在課堂討論中很少發言。

definition_zh: (名) 溫順；謙順　(形) 溫順的；謙遜的
example_sentence: The student's meekness, which annoyed some classmates, actually helped maintain classroom peace.
sentence_zh: 這名學生的溫順性格雖然惹惱了一些同學，實際上卻有助於維持課堂和諧。

definition_zh: (動) 與...碰面；與...見面
example_sentence: After school, Sarah decided to meet up with her friends at the coffee shop downtown.
sentence_zh: 放學後，莎拉決定在市中心的咖啡店與朋友碰面。

definition_zh: (動) 見面；碰面　(動) 聚集；集合
example_sentence: If Maya had more free time, she would meet up with her friends after school.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪雅有更多空閒時間，她就會在放學後和朋友見面。

definition_zh: (動) 與...會面；與...相遇　(動) 遇到；碰上
example_sentence: The principal will meet with parents to discuss student progress next week.
sentence_zh: 校長下週將與家長會面討論學生的進度。

definition_zh: (動) 遇見；相遇　(動) 滿足；符合
example_sentence: Meeting the application deadline, Sarah submitted her university entrance exam forms on time.
sentence_zh: 莎拉趕上了申請截止期限，及時提交了大學入學考試表格。

definition_zh: (名) 會議；會面　(動) 遇見；滿足
example_sentence: Before the meeting starts, students must submit their project reports to the teacher.
sentence_zh: 會議開始之前，學生必須向老師提交專案報告。

definition_zh: (形) 超大的；巨大的　(名) 百萬；大人物
example_sentence: Only after the concert became a mega success did the band members realize their dream.
sentence_zh: 只有在演唱會成為巨大成功之後，樂隊成員才意識到他們的夢想。

definition_zh: (名) 自大狂；妄想症　(形) 患自大狂的；極度自負的
example_sentence: The dictator's megalomania, which led him to build massive monuments, eventually caused the nation's economic collapse.
sentence_zh: 那位獨裁者的自大狂導致他建造巨大紀念碑，最終造成國家經濟崩潰。

definition_zh: (名) 妄想症患者；自大狂　(形) 患妄想症的；極度自大的
example_sentence: The dictator built enormous monuments to glorify himself, acting like a megalomaniac seeking eternal fame.
sentence_zh: 這位獨裁者建造了巨大紀念碑來美化自己，表現得像一個妄想症患者，尋求永恆的名聲。

definition_zh: (名) 深度憂鬱；沮喪
example_sentence: The artist's melancholia and deep sadness are reflected in every dark painting.
sentence_zh: 這位藝術家的憂鬱和深度沮喪反映在每一幅黑暗的畫作中。

definition_zh: (形) 憂鬱的；沮喪的　(名) 憂鬱質氣質的人
example_sentence: The melancholiac artist created dark paintings reflecting inner sadness and loneliness.
sentence_zh: 那位憂鬱質的藝術家創作黑暗繪畫，反映內心的悲傷與孤獨。

definition_zh: (形) 憂鬱的；悲傷的　(形) 沉鬱的；哀傷的
example_sentence: Although the music was beautiful, its melancholic tone made listeners feel deeply sad and reflective.
sentence_zh: 雖然音樂很優美，但其憂鬱的音調使聽眾感到深深的悲傷和沉思。

definition_zh: (形) 憂鬱的；沮喪的　(名) 憂鬱；悲傷
example_sentence: Feeling melancholy after the concert ended, Sarah walked home slowly through the quiet streets.
sentence_zh: 演唱會結束後感到憂鬱，莎拉緩緩走過安靜的街道回家。

definition_zh: (名) 黑色素增多症；黑化現象
example_sentence: The peppered moths, which displayed melanism during the Industrial Revolution, became darker to survive in polluted environments.
sentence_zh: 工業革命期間展現黑化現象的樺尺蛾變得更深色，以在污染環境中存活。

definition_zh: (形) 黑化的；黑色素過多的
example_sentence: If a melanistic leopard were born in the wild, its dark coat would make hunting at night easier.
sentence_zh: 如果野生環境中出生了一隻黑化的豹，牠的深色毛皮會使夜間獵食更容易。

definition_zh: (形) 柔和的；成熟的　(動) 變得柔和；使溫和
example_sentence: The mellow taste of ripe fruit makes the dessert absolutely delicious.
sentence_zh: 熟透水果柔和的味道使甜點絕對美味可口。

definition_zh: (名) 旋律；曲調　(名) 悅耳的聲音；音樂
example_sentence: The composer wrote a beautiful melody to help audiences remember the musical theme.
sentence_zh: 這位作曲家創作了優美的旋律，目的是幫助聽眾記住這個音樂主題。

definition_zh: (名) 瓜；甜瓜
example_sentence: Watermelon and honeydew melon are popular summer fruits in Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 西瓜和蜜瓜是台灣受歡迎的夏季水果。

definition_zh: (動) 情緒崩潰；發脾氣　(動) 熔化；融化
example_sentence: As the pressure mounted, the athlete melted down during the final game, losing all composure.
sentence_zh: 當壓力增加時，這名運動員在決賽中情緒崩潰，完全失去了冷靜。

definition_zh: (動) 融化；溶化　(動) 消散；逐漸消失
example_sentence: Having melted in the summer heat, the ice cream dripped onto the sidewalk.
sentence_zh: 冰淇淋在夏日高溫中融化後，滴落在人行道上。

definition_zh: (名) 成員；會員　(名) 肢體；身體部分
example_sentence: Students who are members of the debate club must attend weekly meetings.
sentence_zh: 參加辯論社的學生必須參加每週的會議。

definition_zh: (名) 會員資格；成員身分　(名) 會員總數；會員群體
example_sentence: Getting a gym membership helps students stay healthy and active during busy school days.
sentence_zh: 辦理健身房會員資格能幫助學生在繁忙的上學日保持健康和活躍。

definition_zh: (名) 網路迷因；文化基因單位
example_sentence: If funny memes were banned from social media, online communities would lose their creative humor.
sentence_zh: 如果有趣的迷因被禁止在社群媒體上分享，網路社群將失去創意幽默。

definition_zh: (名) 紀念品；紀念物
example_sentence: Sarah keeps a ticket stub as a memento of her favorite concert.
sentence_zh: 莎拉保留一張票根作為她最喜愛演唱會的紀念品。

definition_zh: (名) 備忘錄；便條　(動) 寫備忘錄給
example_sentence: Forgetting to read the memo sent by the principal, the students missed the important announcement.
sentence_zh: 由於忘記閱讀校長發送的備忘錄，學生們錯過了重要通知。

definition_zh: (名) 回憶錄；傳記　(名) 個人的記憶；往事
example_sentence: As the author wrote her memoir, she recalled every detail of her youth with vivid emotion.
sentence_zh: 當這位作者在撰寫她的回憶錄時，她以鮮明的情感回顧了青年時期的每個細節。

definition_zh: (形) 難忘的；值得記住的　(形) 令人印象深刻的；顯著的
example_sentence: Seldom have such memorable moments been shared by the entire class during the school trip.
sentence_zh: 學校旅行中，全班很少一起分享過這樣難忘的時刻。

definition_zh: (名) 備忘錄；便條　(名) 公司內部通知
example_sentence: The memorandum that the principal issued outlined new school policies for all teachers.
sentence_zh: 校長發布的備忘錄概述了所有教師的新學校政策。

definition_zh: (名) 紀念碑；紀念物　(形) 紀念的；追悼的
example_sentence: The school built a memorial to honor those who sacrificed their lives.
sentence_zh: 學校建造了一座紀念碑來紀念那些犧牲生命的人。

definition_zh: (動) 記住；背誦　(動) 牢記；熟記
example_sentence: Students preparing for the CSAT must memorize key vocabulary and important historical dates.
sentence_zh: 準備學測的學生必須背誦關鍵詞彙和重要的歷史日期。

definition_zh: (名) 記憶；記憶力　(名) 回憶；往事
example_sentence: My childhood memories of visiting the seaside remain vivid and precious.
sentence_zh: 我童年拜訪海邊的記憶仍然清晰而珍貴。

definition_zh: (名) 威脅；危險　(動) 威脅；騷擾
example_sentence: Although social media can be a menace, teenagers must learn to use it responsibly.
sentence_zh: 雖然社群媒體可能是一種威脅，但青少年必須學會負責任地使用它。

definition_zh: (動) 修理；修補　(動) 改善；改正
example_sentence: Mending the torn jacket, Sarah felt proud of her new sewing skills.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在修補破損的夾克時，為自己新學的縫紉技能感到驕傲。

definition_zh: (形) 低賤的；卑微的　(形) 瑣碎的；不重要的
example_sentence: The intern refused to do menial tasks that did not develop professional skills.
sentence_zh: 那位實習生拒絕做那些無法培養專業技能的低賤工作。

definition_zh: (名) 半月板；彎曲液面
example_sentence: If the meniscus in the graduated cylinder is read incorrectly, the measurement result would be inaccurate.
sentence_zh: 如果量筒中的彎曲液面讀取不正確，測量結果將會不準確。

definition_zh: (形) 心理的；精神的　(形) 心智的；頭腦的
example_sentence: Regular exercise improves both physical and mental health significantly.
sentence_zh: 定期運動能顯著改善身體和心理健康。

definition_zh: (名) 心態；思想方式　(名) 心智能力；智力
example_sentence: Athletes train hard to develop a winning mentality for competition.
sentence_zh: 運動員努力訓練以培養競賽的勝利心態。

definition_zh: (副) 在精神上；心理上　在頭腦中；智力上
example_sentence: Staying mentally healthy during exam season requires proper rest and stress management.
sentence_zh: 在考試季節保持心理健康需要適當的休息和壓力管理。

definition_zh: (名) 薄荷醇；薄荷提取物
example_sentence: Because menthol produces a cooling sensation, many cough drops contain this ingredient.
sentence_zh: 因為薄荷醇會產生清涼的感覺，許多喉糖都含有這種成分。

definition_zh: (動) 提到；說起　(名) 提及；提到
example_sentence: Having mentioned the project deadline, the manager emphasized its importance to the team.
sentence_zh: 提到了項目截止日期後，經理強調了它對團隊的重要性。

definition_zh: (名) 導師；良師　(動) 指導；輔導
example_sentence: The experienced teacher who mentors young students inspires many to pursue their dreams.
sentence_zh: 那位指導年輕學生的資深老師激勵許多人追求夢想。

definition_zh: (名) 菜單；菜譜　(名) 功能表；選單
example_sentence: The restaurant's menu offers both traditional and modern dishes for diners to choose from.
sentence_zh: 這家餐廳的菜單為顧客提供傳統和現代菜色供選擇。

definition_zh: (形) 唯利是圖的；為金錢工作的　(名) 傭兵；雇傭軍人
example_sentence: If a company hired mercenary workers, it would face serious ethical problems and lose public trust.
sentence_zh: 如果一家公司雇用唯利是圖的員工，就會面臨嚴重的倫理問題並失去公眾信任。

definition_zh: (名) 商品；貨物　(動) 推銷；販售商品
example_sentence: The store displays attractive merchandise to encourage customers to make purchases.
sentence_zh: 這家商店展示吸引人的商品以鼓勵顧客購買。

definition_zh: (名) 商人；貿易商　(形) 商業的；貿易的
example_sentence: Operating a successful online store, the merchant expanded into international markets last year.
sentence_zh: 經營一家成功的線上商店，這位商人去年擴展到國際市場。

definition_zh: (形) 仁慈的；寬恕的　(形) 溫和的；善良的
example_sentence: Although the judge was strict, she gave a merciful sentence because the defendant showed genuine remorse.
sentence_zh: 雖然法官很嚴厲，但因為被告表現出真誠的悔意，她判了寬恕的刑罰。

definition_zh: (副) 幸運地；幸好　(副) 仁慈地；寬恕地
example_sentence: Mercifully did the heavy rain stop before the outdoor concert began.
sentence_zh: 幸好大雨在戶外演唱會開始前停了下來。

definition_zh: (形) 無情的；殘忍的　(形) 毫不留情的；冷酷無情的
example_sentence: The general's merciless strategy, which ignored civilian safety, shocked the international community.
sentence_zh: 那位將軍毫不留情的策略（忽視平民安全）震驚了國際社會。

definition_zh: (名) 水銀；汞　(名) 溫度計中的液體
example_sentence: Scientists use mercury to measure temperature in order to record weather data accurately.
sentence_zh: 科學家使用水銀來測量溫度，以便準確記錄氣象數據。

definition_zh: (名) 憐憫；慈悲　(名) 寬恕；饒恕
example_sentence: The judge showed mercy to the young offender, reducing the harsh sentence considerably.
sentence_zh: 法官對年輕罪犯表示憐憫，大幅減輕了嚴厲的刑罰。

definition_zh: (形) 僅僅的；只不過的　(名) 湖；池塘
example_sentence: Winning a scholarship is mere luck without hard work and dedication.
sentence_zh: 不付出辛勤努力和專注，贏得獎學金僅僅是運氣而已。

definition_zh: (副) 僅僅；只不過　(副) 純粹；單純地
example_sentence: Although the test was difficult, students merely needed to answer half the questions correctly to pass.
sentence_zh: 雖然測驗很難，學生們僅僅需要答對一半的題目就能及格。

definition_zh: (動) 合併；融合　(名) 合併；融合
example_sentence: Merging two smaller companies into one, the new organization became much more competitive in the market.
sentence_zh: 將兩家較小的公司合併為一家，新組織在市場上變得更具競爭力。

definition_zh: (名) 合併；兼併　(動) 合併；融合
example_sentence: The merger that created a stronger company pleased many investors who wanted growth.
sentence_zh: 那次創造出一家更強大公司的合併令許多想要增長的投資者滿意。

definition_zh: (名) 優點；長處　(動) 值得；應得
example_sentence: If hard work has merit, then students who study consistently will achieve better exam results.
sentence_zh: 如果努力學習有優點，那麼持續念書的學生將會取得更好的考試成績。

definition_zh: (名) 精英統治制；才能治國制　(形) 精英統治的；按能力選拔的
example_sentence: A true meritocracy rewards hard work and talent rather than family connections.
sentence_zh: 真正的精英統治制獎勵努力工作和才能，而非家族人脈。

definition_zh: (形) 以能力和成績為基礎的；績效至上的
example_sentence: Many universities design admission systems to select talented students based on merit.
sentence_zh: 許多大學設計入學制度來根據能力選拔優秀學生。

definition_zh: (名) 美人魚；人魚
example_sentence: The mermaid legend has fascinated sailors and storytellers throughout human history.
sentence_zh: 美人魚的傳說在整個人類歷史中一直吸引著水手和說故事的人。

definition_zh: (副) 快樂地；愉快地　高興地；開心地
example_sentence: The children sang merrily as they decorated the classroom for the holiday celebration.
sentence_zh: 當孩子們為假日慶祝裝飾教室時，他們高興地唱著歌。

definition_zh: (形) 快樂的；充滿歡樂的　(形) 愉快的；高興的
example_sentence: Having celebrated their exam success, the students felt merry and carefree.
sentence_zh: 已經慶祝完考試成功，學生們感到快樂而無憂無慮。

definition_zh: (名) 網眼；網狀物　(動) 嚙合；相互配合　(形) 網狀的；有網眼的
example_sentence: The wire mesh that covers the window prevents insects from entering the house.
sentence_zh: 覆蓋窗戶的鐵絲網可防止昆蟲進入房子。

definition_zh: (名) 迷住；著迷　(名) 催眠狀態；深深吸引
example_sentence: The magician's mesmerization of the audience was so complete that nobody moved during the entire performance.
sentence_zh: 魔術師對觀眾的迷住效果完全無敵，整場表演期間沒有人動過。

definition_zh: (動) 使著迷；迷住　(動) 吸引注意力；使目不轉睛
example_sentence: If the magic show's illusions mesmerized the audience, everyone would leave the theater speechless.
sentence_zh: 如果魔術表演的幻覺迷住了觀眾，每個人都會無言地離開劇院。

definition_zh: (動) 隨意搗亂；亂擺弄　胡亂處理；浪費時間
example_sentence: Stop messing about with your phone during class and focus on the lesson.
sentence_zh: 下課時別再亂擺弄你的手機，專心聽課。

definition_zh: (動) 浪費時間；胡亂嘗試　(動) 惹麻煩；搗亂
example_sentence: Messing about with the computer all afternoon, Tom forgot to finish his homework.
sentence_zh: 湯姆整個下午亂玩電腦，忘了完成功課。

definition_zh: (動) 欺騙；傷害　(動) 搞砸；毀壞
example_sentence: Because the manager messed over the employees with unfair pay, many workers decided to quit their jobs.
sentence_zh: 由於經理用不公平的薪資欺騙員工，許多工作者決定辭職。

definition_zh: (動) 搞砸；弄亂
example_sentence: Never should a student mess up the final exam after months of preparation.
sentence_zh: 經過數月準備後，學生絕不應該在期末考搞砸。

definition_zh: (動) 惹麻煩；騷擾　惹怒；戲弄
example_sentence: Students who mess with their classmates' belongings often face serious consequences.
sentence_zh: 那些惹麻煩給同學物品的學生常常面臨嚴重後果。

definition_zh: (名) 混亂；髒亂　(動) 弄亂；弄髒
example_sentence: Students clean up the classroom to avoid making a mess during lunch break.
sentence_zh: 學生在午餐時間前打掃教室以避免製造混亂。

definition_zh: (名) 訊息；消息　(動) 傳達訊息；發送消息
example_sentence: The teacher sent a message about tomorrow's exam to all students.
sentence_zh: 老師傳送了一則關於明天考試的訊息給所有學生。

definition_zh: (名) 信使；使者　(名) 通訊軟體
example_sentence: The messenger delivered the important package to the office this morning.
sentence_zh: 信使今早把重要包裹送到辦公室。

definition_zh: (副) 凌亂地；雜亂地
example_sentence: Because the student completed her homework messily, the teacher asked her to redo it carefully.
sentence_zh: 因為該學生凌亂地完成功課，老師要求她仔細重做。

definition_zh: (形) 凌亂的；雜亂的　(形) 航髒的；不整潔的
example_sentence: Finding his desk covered with papers and books, Tom spent the afternoon organizing the messy workspace.
sentence_zh: 湯姆發現他的書桌上堆滿紙張和書籍，他花了整個下午整理這個凌亂的工作空間。

definition_zh: (名) 新陳代謝；代謝作用
example_sentence: Regular exercise speeds up the metabolism that controls how the body burns calories.
sentence_zh: 規律運動能加快控制身體燃燒卡路里的新陳代謝。

definition_zh: (名) 金屬　(形) 金屬製的；由金屬組成的
example_sentence: If aluminum metal is exposed to oxygen, it will form a protective oxide layer.
sentence_zh: 如果鋁金屬暴露在氧氣中，它就會形成一層保護性的氧化物層。

definition_zh: (形) 金屬的；含金屬的　(形) 金屬光澤的；金屬色的
example_sentence: The metallic taste in the water made everyone reluctant to drink it.
sentence_zh: 水中的金屬味道使每個人都不願意喝它。

definition_zh: (名) 隱喻；比喻
example_sentence: Authors use metaphor to help readers understand complex ideas more clearly.
sentence_zh: 作者使用隱喻來幫助讀者更清楚地理解複雜的想法。

definition_zh: (動) 分配；給予　(動) 處罰；施加
example_sentence: The judge will mete out a fair punishment to the defendant based on the evidence presented in court.
sentence_zh: 根據法庭上提出的證據，法官將對被告施加公正的懲罰。

definition_zh: (名) 流星；隕星　(名) 氣象儀器
example_sentence: As the meteor streaked across the night sky, thousands of students paused to make a wish together.
sentence_zh: 當流星劃過夜空時，成千上萬的學生停下來一起許願。

definition_zh: (形) 氣象的；氣象學的
example_sentence: Having studied meteorological data for weeks, the weather forecasters predicted the typhoon's exact path.
sentence_zh: 氣象預報員研究了數週的氣象資料後，準確預測了颱風的路徑。

definition_zh: (名) 公尺；米　(名) 儀表；計量器　(名) 韻律；節拍
example_sentence: The running track that students measure every morning is exactly 400 meters long.
sentence_zh: 學生每天早上測量的跑道是恰好400公尺長的。

definition_zh: (名) 甲烷；沼氣
example_sentence: Methane gas released from landfills contributes significantly to global warming.
sentence_zh: 從垃圾掩埋場釋放出的甲烷氣體對全球暖化有重大貢獻。

definition_zh: (名) 方法；方式　(名) 步驟；程序
example_sentence: If students adopted a systematic method for studying, exam scores would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生採用系統化的學習方法，考試成績會顯著提高。

definition_zh: (形) 有條理的；系統的　(形) 仔細的；謹慎的
example_sentence: A methodical approach to studying helps students prepare well for exams.
sentence_zh: 有條理的讀書方法能幫助學生為考試做好準備。

definition_zh: (副) 有條理地；方法性地　(副) 循序漸進地；一步步地
example_sentence: Working methodically through each math problem, the student avoided careless mistakes.
sentence_zh: 學生一步步有條理地解決每道數學題，避免了粗心的錯誤。

definition_zh: (名) 方法論；研究方法　(名) 方法體系；步驟系統
example_sentence: Because the research methodology was carefully designed, the results proved reliable and worthy of academic publication.
sentence_zh: 因為研究方法論經過仔細設計，所以結果證明可靠且值得學術發表。

definition_zh: (形) 一絲不苟的；細緻的　(形) 認真仔細的；精確的
example_sentence: Seldom does a designer pay such meticulous attention to every small detail.
sentence_zh: 設計師很少對每個細微的細節都付出如此一絲不苟的關注。

definition_zh: (副) 細心地；謹慎地　小心翼翼地；精確地
example_sentence: The architect examined the building plans meticulously, catching errors that others had missed.
sentence_zh: 這位建築師細心地檢查建築藍圖，發現了別人遺漏的錯誤。

definition_zh: (名) 轉喻；轉喻法
example_sentence: Writers use metonymy to replace words in order to create more vivid and interesting descriptions.
sentence_zh: 作家使用轉喻來替換詞彙，以便創造更生動有趣的描寫。

definition_zh: (形) 公制的；以米為單位的　(名) 度量衡；指標
example_sentence: The metric system, adopted by most countries worldwide, measures distance and weight using standard units.
sentence_zh: 公制系統（由世界上大多數國家採用）使用標準單位測量距離和重量。

definition_zh: (名) 地鐵；捷運　(形) 都市的；大都會的
example_sentence: Taking the metro to school is faster than driving a car.
sentence_zh: 搭捷運上學比開車更快。

definition_zh: (名) 節拍器；打拍子的機器
example_sentence: As the metronome ticked steadily, the pianist practiced the difficult piece with perfect timing.
sentence_zh: 當節拍器穩定地滴答聲響起時，鋼琴家以完美的節奏練習這首困難的曲子。

definition_zh: (名) 大都市；首都
example_sentence: Bustling with millions of people, Tokyo stands as Asia's largest metropolis attracting students worldwide.
sentence_zh: 東京作為亞洲最大的大都市，熙熙攘攘，吸引了世界各地的學生前往。

definition_zh: (形) 大都市的；首都的　(名) 大都市居民；大主教
example_sentence: The metropolitan areas which attract millions of tourists every year offer excellent cultural experiences.
sentence_zh: 每年吸引數百萬遊客的大都市地區提供了優異的文化體驗。

definition_zh: (名) 勇氣；精神　(名) 品格；脾氣
example_sentence: If the athlete shows true mettle during the championship, the team will definitely win the gold medal.
sentence_zh: 如果這位運動員在冠軍賽中展現真正的勇氣，球隊肯定會贏得金牌。

definition_zh: (形) 微小的；微觀的　(名) 巨集；微觀
example_sentence: The micro changes in climate affect weather patterns over time.
sentence_zh: 氣候的微小變化隨著時間影響天氣模式。

definition_zh: (名) 微晶片；晶片
example_sentence: Engineers designed the microchip to improve smartphone processing speed significantly.
sentence_zh: 工程師設計微晶片以顯著提高智慧型手機的處理速度。

definition_zh: (名) 微生物；細菌
example_sentence: Microorganisms in soil help plants absorb nutrients from the environment.
sentence_zh: 土壤中的微生物幫助植物從環境中吸收養分。

definition_zh: (名) 麥克風；話筒
example_sentence: Although the microphone was broken, the singer continued performing with great confidence.
sentence_zh: 雖然麥克風壞了，這位歌手仍然充滿信心地繼續表演。

definition_zh: (名) 微塑膠；極小塑膠顆粒
example_sentence: Having accumulated in the ocean for decades, microplastics now contaminate fish and threaten marine ecosystems worldwide.
sentence_zh: 經過數十年在海洋中累積，微塑膠現在汙染了魚類並威脅全球海洋生態系統。

definition_zh: (名) 顯微鏡；放大鏡
example_sentence: The microscope, which magnifies tiny objects thousands of times, revealed bacteria invisible to the naked eye.
sentence_zh: 這臺顯微鏡可將微小物體放大數千倍，它揭露了肉眼看不見的細菌。

definition_zh: (名) 微波；微波爐　(動) 用微波爐加熱
example_sentence: Heating leftover pizza in the microwave takes only three minutes.
sentence_zh: 用微波爐加熱剩餘的披薩只需三分鐘。

definition_zh: (名) 空中；半空中　(形) 空中的；半空的
example_sentence: If the acrobat fell mid-air, landing safely would require perfect timing and skill.
sentence_zh: 如果特技演員在半空中墜落，安全著陸將需要完美的時機和技巧。

definition_zh: (形) 中間的；中部的　(名) 中間；中部
example_sentence: Mid-term exams are coming next month, so students study harder now.
sentence_zh: 期中考試下個月就要來了，所以學生現在讀得更認真。

definition_zh: (名) 空中；半空中　(形) 在空中的；空中的
example_sentence: Caught in midair, the acrobat performing the dangerous stunt amazed the entire audience.
sentence_zh: 那位表演危險特技、在空中被抓住的雜技演員讓全場觀眾驚艷不已。

definition_zh: (名) 正午；中午　(副) 在正午；於中午時分
example_sentence: Midday arrives, students must return to school for afternoon classes.
sentence_zh: 當正午來臨時，學生必須回到學校參加下午課程。

definition_zh: (名) 中東；中東地區
example_sentence: Not only does the Middle East possess vast oil reserves, but also rich cultural heritage.
sentence_zh: 中東不僅擁有豐富的石油儲備，而且也有豐富的文化遺產。

definition_zh: (形) 中年的；中年人的
example_sentence: Middle-aged professionals who want to advance their careers often pursue additional training.
sentence_zh: 想要推進職業發展的中年專業人士經常尋求額外的培訓。

definition_zh: (名) 中間；中點　(形) 中間的；中等的　(動) 位於…中間
example_sentence: Students study hard in the middle of the term to prepare for the midterm exam.
sentence_zh: 學生在學期中間努力讀書以準備期中考。

definition_zh: (名) 午夜；深夜
example_sentence: The midnight train from Taipei to Kaohsiung departs every evening.
sentence_zh: 從台北到高雄的午夜列車每晚出發。
subject_type: noun (common noun as noun adjunct modifier)

definition_zh: (介) 在…之中；在…中間　(名) 中間；中央
example_sentence: In the midst of the exam season, students need to stay calm and focused.
sentence_zh: 在考試季的中間，學生需要保持冷靜和專注。

definition_zh: (助) 可能；也許　(動) 是；存在
example_sentence: The project might have been completed on time if the team had received better equipment.
sentence_zh: 如果小組獲得更好的設備，那個專案可能已經按時完成了。

definition_zh: (助動) 可能已經；也許曾經
example_sentence: Having studied harder, the student might have had a better test score.
sentence_zh: 更加努力讀書的話，那名學生可能已經獲得更好的考試成績。

definition_zh: (助) 可能；也許　(名) 力量；威力
example_sentence: The typhoon might cause damage that could affect millions of families.
sentence_zh: 這場颱風可能造成會影響數百萬家庭的損害。

definition_zh: (助動) 可能不會；也許不會
example_sentence: If Sarah doesn't study hard, she mightn't pass the chemistry exam.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉不認真讀書，她可能不會通過化學考試。

definition_zh: (形) 強大的；有力的　(形) 巨大的；龐大的
example_sentence: The mighty river flows through the valley and supplies water to millions of people.
sentence_zh: 那條強大的河流流經山谷，為數百萬人供應水源。

definition_zh: (名) 偏頭痛；嚴重頭痛
example_sentence: Taking medicine early helps prevent migraines from becoming unbearable during exams.
sentence_zh: 早期服藥有助於防止偏頭痛在考試期間變得無法忍受。

definition_zh: (名) 移民；遷移者　(形) 遷移的；流動的
example_sentence: Migrant workers from rural areas contribute significantly to urban economic development.
sentence_zh: 來自農村地區的移工對城市經濟發展做出重大貢獻。

definition_zh: (動) 遷移；遷徙　(動) 移居；移動
example_sentence: As winter approaches, birds migrate south to find warmer places and abundant food.
sentence_zh: 當冬天來臨時，鳥類遷徙到南方尋找溫暖的地方和充足的食物。

definition_zh: (名) 遷移；移居　(名) 遷徙；遷移
example_sentence: Having completed their migration to the city, the farming family struggled to adapt to urban life.
sentence_zh: 完成了進城的遷移後，這個農民家庭很難適應城市生活。

definition_zh: (形) 遷移的；候鳥的　(形) 流浪的；漂泊的
example_sentence: Arctic terns, which are migratory birds, travel over 44,000 miles annually.
sentence_zh: 北極燕鷗是候鳥，它們每年飛行超過44,000英里。

definition_zh: (形) 溫和的；溫柔的　(形) 輕微的；不嚴重的
example_sentence: Drinking mild tea and reading novels helps reduce stress after studying.
sentence_zh: 喝溫和的茶並閱讀小說有助於減輕讀書後的壓力。

definition_zh: (副) 輕微地；溫和地　(副) 略微；稍微
example_sentence: If the teacher criticized the homework more mildly, students would feel less stressed about making mistakes.
sentence_zh: 如果老師以較溫和的方式批評功課，學生對犯錯就不會感到那麼有壓力。

definition_zh: (名) 英里（長度單位）；里程
example_sentence: The distance between Taipei and Taichung is about one hundred miles.
sentence_zh: 台北和台中之間的距離約一百英里。

definition_zh: (名) 里程；英里數　(名) 行駛距離；燃油效率
example_sentence: Calculating the car's mileage, the mechanic discovered an engine problem needing immediate repair.
sentence_zh: 計算汽車的里程後，技師發現了一個需要立即修理的引擎問題。

definition_zh: (名) 里程碑；重要的進展
example_sentence: As graduation approached, completing the final project became a major milestone for most students.
sentence_zh: 隨著畢業日期逼近，完成最後一個專題成為大多數學生的重要里程碑。

definition_zh: (形) 好鬥的；激進的　(名) 激進份子；鬥士
example_sentence: Not only did the militant group oppose the policy, but they also organized public protests.
sentence_zh: 不僅那個激進團體反對這項政策，他們還組織了公開抗議活動。

definition_zh: (形) 軍國主義的；好戰的
example_sentence: The government's militaristic policies, which emphasized military expansion, alarmed neighboring countries.
sentence_zh: 該政府強調軍事擴張的軍國主義政策令鄰國感到警惕。

definition_zh: (動) 軍事化；使軍國化　使擁有軍事特徵
example_sentence: The government increased military spending to militarize the border region against potential threats.
sentence_zh: 政府增加軍事開支以軍事化邊境地區來對抗潛在威脅。

definition_zh: (形) 軍事化的；武裝的
example_sentence: The heavily militarized border between the two nations remains a source of regional tension.
sentence_zh: 兩國之間高度軍事化的邊界仍然是地區緊張局勢的根源。

definition_zh: (形) 軍事的；軍隊的　(名) 軍隊；軍方
example_sentence: Taiwan's military service requirements have changed significantly over recent years.
sentence_zh: 臺灣的軍事服役要求在近年來改變很大。

definition_zh: (名) 民兵；民間武裝力量
example_sentence: Although the militia trained regularly, they lacked the professional equipment that military forces possessed.
sentence_zh: 雖然民兵定期訓練，但他們缺乏正規軍隊所擁有的專業裝備。

definition_zh: (名) 牛奶；奶　(動) 擠奶；榨取
example_sentence: Milking cows every morning, the farmer supplies fresh milk to local stores.
sentence_zh: 每天早上擠奶，這位農民為當地商店供應新鮮牛奶。

definition_zh: (名) 虱目魚；一種台灣常見的魚類
example_sentence: The milkfish that farmers raise in coastal ponds is an important food source.
sentence_zh: 農民在沿海魚塭飼養的虱目魚是一項重要的食物來源。

definition_zh: (名) 奶昔；牛奶飲料
example_sentence: If students drink a milkshake before studying, their concentration might improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在讀書前喝奶昔，他們的專注力可能會明顯提升。

definition_zh: (動) 漫無目的地走動；閒散地聚集
example_sentence: Students milled about in the school courtyard after the assembly ended.
sentence_zh: 集會結束後，學生們在校園裡漫無目的地走動。

definition_zh: (名) 磨坊；工廠　(動) 磨；碾碎
example_sentence: Farmers use a wheat mill to grind grain into flour for baking.
sentence_zh: 農民用小麥磨坊磨穀粒成麵粉來烘焙。

definition_zh: (名) 千年期；數千年
example_sentence: Ancient civilizations flourished for millennia before gradually declining and disappearing.
sentence_zh: 古代文明在逐漸衰退並消失之前繁榮了數千年。

definition_zh: (名) 千禧一代；八零九零後　(形) 千禧世代的；關於千禧一代的
example_sentence: Although millennials grew up with technology, many struggle with work-life balance.
sentence_zh: 儘管千禧一代在科技環境中成長，許多人仍為工作與生活平衡而苦惱。

definition_zh: (名) 千年；千年期
example_sentence: Having celebrated the new millennium, people worldwide felt optimistic about future possibilities.
sentence_zh: 在慶祝新千年之後，世界各地的人民對未來的可能性感到樂觀。

definition_zh: (名) 磨粉機操作者；碾磨者
example_sentence: The miller who operates the old stone mill produces flour that local bakeries depend on.
sentence_zh: 經營舊石磨坊的磨粉師傅生產當地烤包坊所依賴的麵粉。

definition_zh: (名) 小米；穀粟
example_sentence: Millet grain is a nutritious cereal crop widely grown in Asia for food and animal feed.
sentence_zh: 小米穀粒是一種營養豐富的穀物，在亞洲廣泛種植用於食物和飼料。

definition_zh: (名) 毫米；公釐
example_sentence: If the gap were only a millimeter wider, the component would fit perfectly.
sentence_zh: 如果間隙寬度只寬一毫米，零件就會完全吻合。

definition_zh: (名) 百萬；一百萬個
example_sentence: The charity received donations from a million people around the world.
sentence_zh: 這個慈善機構收到來自世界各地一百萬人的捐款。

definition_zh: (名) 百萬富翁；百萬富豪
example_sentence: Having inherited a successful business, the millionaire donated millions to local charities.
sentence_zh: 這位百萬富翁因為繼承了一家成功的企業，而捐贈了數百萬給當地慈善機構。

definition_zh: (名) 毫秒；千分之一秒
example_sentence: Since the computer processes data in milliseconds, users hardly notice any delay when clicking the button.
sentence_zh: 由於電腦在毫秒內處理資料，使用者點擊按鈕時幾乎察覺不到任何延遲。

definition_zh: (名) 毫伏；千分之一伏特
example_sentence: Only after the technician measured the voltage did the millivolt reading reveal the circuit's problem.
sentence_zh: 直到技師量測電壓後，毫伏數讀數才揭示了電路的問題。

definition_zh: (動) 模仿；學...的樣子　(名) 模仿者；學舌者
example_sentence: The student who mimics his teacher's accent in class always makes everyone laugh.
sentence_zh: 那位在課堂上模仿老師口音的學生總是讓大家笑得很開心。

definition_zh: (動) 切碎；剁碎　(動) 說話吞吞吐吐；掩飾真意
example_sentence: The chef minced garlic to add flavor to the delicious sauce.
sentence_zh: 廚師切碎大蒜以便為美味醬汁增添風味。

definition_zh: (名) 心智；思想　(動) 介意；照顧　(形) 心理的；精神的
example_sentence: Never mind making mistakes; learning from them matters more than perfection.
sentence_zh: 別介意犯錯；從錯誤中學習比追求完美更重要。

definition_zh: (名) 心態；思維方式　(名) 信念；觀點
example_sentence: A positive mindset helps students overcome challenges during exam preparation.
sentence_zh: 積極的心態幫助學生在準備考試期間克服困難。

definition_zh: (代) 我的；屬於我的　(名) 礦；礦場
example_sentence: While the gold mine operated, thousands of workers extracted precious metals daily.
sentence_zh: 當這座金礦運作時，數千名工人每天開採貴金屬。

definition_zh: (名) 礦工；採礦者　(名) 未成年人
example_sentence: Working in dangerous conditions, miners extracted coal deep underground for decades.
sentence_zh: 礦工在危險的工作環境中工作，數十年來在地底深處開採煤炭。

definition_zh: (名) 礦物；礦質　(形) 礦物的；含礦物的
example_sentence: The geological survey identified several rare minerals that exist in the mountain region where ancient civilizations once thrived.
sentence_zh: 地質調查發現了在古文明曾經繁榮的山區中存在的幾種稀有礦物。

definition_zh: (動) 混合；交往　(動) 社交；聯誼
example_sentence: If students mingle with people from different backgrounds, their perspectives will broaden considerably.
sentence_zh: 如果學生與來自不同背景的人交往，他們的視野將會大幅擴展。

definition_zh: (形) 極小的；縮小的　(名) 微小物；縮小版
example_sentence: The museum displays a miniature model of the ancient temple.
sentence_zh: 博物館展示了古老寺廟的縮小模型。

definition_zh: (動) 使微小化；縮小
example_sentence: Engineers miniaturized the circuit to fit more components into the smartphone.
sentence_zh: 工程師縮小了電路以便在智慧型手機中放入更多零件。

definition_zh: (形) 最小的；極少的　(形) 最低的；基本的
example_sentence: The company requires minimal experience, making entry-level positions accessible to recent graduates.
sentence_zh: 該公司要求最少的工作經驗，使新鮮人容易申請基層職位。

definition_zh: (名) 極簡主義；簡約風格　(形) 極簡的；簡約的
example_sentence: As minimalism becomes increasingly popular, many teenagers adopt simple lifestyles by reducing unnecessary possessions and clutter.
sentence_zh: 隨著極簡主義變得越來越流行，許多青少年透過減少不必要的物品和雜亂來採取簡單的生活方式。

definition_zh: (名) 極簡主義者；簡約主義者　(形) 極簡的；簡約風格的
example_sentence: Having rejected unnecessary possessions, the minimalist designer created a clean, spacious apartment with only essential furniture.
sentence_zh: 拒絕了不必要的物品後，那位極簡主義設計師創造了一個乾淨、寬敞的公寓，裡面只有必要的家具。

definition_zh: (副) 最少地；極少地　(副) 基本上；最起碼
example_sentence: The company, which operated minimally during the pandemic, gradually recovered its workforce.
sentence_zh: 那家公司在疫情期間以最少規模運營，逐漸恢復了員工人數。

definition_zh: (動) 使最小化；減少　(動) 縮小；貶低
example_sentence: To minimize risk and maximize profit, the company adjusted its investment strategy carefully.
sentence_zh: 為了將風險最小化並使利潤最大化，該公司仔細調整了投資策略。

definition_zh: (名) 最低限度；最小量　(形) 最少的；最低的
example_sentence: If students did not study the minimum required material, they would fail the exam.
sentence_zh: 如果學生沒有讀最少的必需教材，他們就會考試不及格。

definition_zh: (名) 採礦；挖礦　(動) 開採；開掘
example_sentence: Mining for coal is dangerous work requiring special equipment.
sentence_zh: 開採煤炭是需要特殊設備的危險工作。

definition_zh: (名) 部長；部會首長　(動) 提供幫助；照顧
example_sentence: As the education minister addressed the assembly, students listened attentively to his proposals.
sentence_zh: 當教育部長在大會上發言時，學生們認真地聽取他的提案。

definition_zh: (形) 部長的；閣員的　(形) 內閣的；政府的
example_sentence: Only after the ministerial meeting ended could the cabinet members discuss the education reform plan.
sentence_zh: 只有在部長會議結束後，內閣成員才能討論教育改革計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 部；閣；ministry　(名) 聖職；宗教事業
example_sentence: The ministry that handles education policy must listen to teachers and parents.
sentence_zh: 負責教育政策的那個部必須聽取老師和家長的意見。

definition_zh: (形) 輕微的；較小的　(名) 未成年人；輔修科目
example_sentence: Students study chemistry to understand minor chemical reactions in daily life.
sentence_zh: 學生學習化學是為了了解日常生活中輕微的化學反應。

definition_zh: (名) 少數；少數派　(形) 少數的；少數人的
example_sentence: Students from minority backgrounds often face unique challenges in competitive entrance exams.
sentence_zh: 來自少數背景的學生在競爭激烈的入學考試中常面臨獨特的挑戰。

definition_zh: (名) 薄荷；薄荷糖　(形) 嶄新的；未使用過的
example_sentence: The toothpaste has a fresh mint flavor that students enjoy every morning.
sentence_zh: 這款牙膏擁有清新的薄荷風味，學生們每天早上都喜歡使用。

definition_zh: (介) 減去；扣除　(形) 負的；消極的　(名) 負號；缺點
example_sentence: Although the exam was difficult, minus the final essay section, most students found the questions manageable.
sentence_zh: 雖然考試很難，但除了最後的作文部分外，大多數學生覺得題目還算好應付。

definition_zh: (形) 極小的；微小的　(形) 不重要的；微不足道的
example_sentence: Containing only minuscule amounts of sugar, the new energy drink appeals to health-conscious teenagers.
sentence_zh: 這種新能量飲料含有極小量的糖分，吸引了注重健康的青少年。

definition_zh: (形) 極小的；微小的　(名) 分鐘；一分鐘
example_sentence: The scientist discovered minute details in the sample that were invisible to the naked eye.
sentence_zh: 科學家發現樣本中那些肉眼看不見的極小細節。

definition_zh: (副) 詳細地；仔細地　(副) 極小地；微小地
example_sentence: If the doctor examines the patient's skin minutely, serious diseases can be detected early.
sentence_zh: 如果醫生仔細檢查患者的皮膚，就能及早發現嚴重疾病。

definition_zh: (名) 微小的細節；瑣碎的事項
example_sentence: Historians often debate historical minutiae rather than focusing on major events.
sentence_zh: 歷史學家經常爭論歷史上的細微細節，而不是專注於重大事件。

definition_zh: (名) 調皮的女孩；輕浮的女子
example_sentence: Sarah dressed boldly to shock her conservative parents and act like a minx.
sentence_zh: 莎拉穿著大膽來驚嚇保守的父母，並表現得像個調皮的女孩。

definition_zh: (名) 奇蹟；奇蹟般的事　(形) 奇蹟的；不可思議的
example_sentence: Winning the championship after losing ten games in a row was nothing short of a miracle.
sentence_zh: 在連輸十場比賽後贏得冠軍簡直是個奇蹟。

definition_zh: (形) 奇蹟般的；不可思議的　(副) 奇蹟般地；神奇地
example_sentence: Although the experiment seemed impossible, the results were miraculous when all variables aligned perfectly.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個實驗看似不可能，但當所有變數完美配合時，結果卻是奇蹟般的。

definition_zh: (副) 奇蹟般地；神奇地　(副) 不可思議地；出人意料地
example_sentence: Having survived the earthquake miraculously, the rescue team discovered three survivors beneath the collapsed building.
sentence_zh: 救援隊奇蹟般地在地震中存活下來，他們在倒塌的建築物下發現了三名倖存者。

definition_zh: (名) 泥沼；困境　(動) 使陷入困境；纏住
example_sentence: The project became mired in complications that delayed its completion by months.
sentence_zh: 這個專案陷入了複雜的問題，導致它的完成延遲了好幾個月。

definition_zh: (形) 陷入困境的；泥濘的；困頓的
example_sentence: The project became mired in endless bureaucratic delays and funding issues.
sentence_zh: 這項專案陷入了無盡的行政延誤和經費問題。

definition_zh: (名) 鏡子；鏡像　(動) 反映；映照
example_sentence: If students looked into a mirror every morning, they would build more confidence.
sentence_zh: 如果學生每天早上照鏡子，他們會建立更多自信。

definition_zh: (名) 厭男；仇恨男性
example_sentence: Misandry, like any form of discrimination, harms society and prevents true equality.
sentence_zh: 厭男主義就像任何形式的歧視一樣，傷害社會並阻礙真正的平等。

definition_zh: (名) 厭惡人類的人；憤世嫉俗者
example_sentence: Avoiding social gatherings and criticizing others constantly, the misanthrope gradually lost all meaningful friendships.
sentence_zh: 那個厭惡人類的人不斷避開社交聚會並批評他人，最終逐漸失去了所有有意義的友誼。

definition_zh: (動) 行為不當；表現不好
example_sentence: Because the student misbehaved during the exam, the teacher warned him seriously.
sentence_zh: 因為那位學生在考試中表現不當，老師嚴厲警告他。

definition_zh: (名) 流產；小產　(名) 失敗；挫折
example_sentence: Only after careful medical examination did the doctor confirm the miscarriage had occurred.
sentence_zh: 只有在仔細的醫學檢查之後，醫生才證實流產已經發生。

definition_zh: (形) 雜樊的；各式各樣的
example_sentence: The school gift shop sells miscellaneous items that students find useful for daily study.
sentence_zh: 學校禮品店出售各式各樣的物品，是學生日常讀書時會用到的東西。

definition_zh: (名) 惡作劇；調皮　(動) 製造麻煩；搗亂
example_sentence: Students played pranks to cause mischief and make their classmates laugh.
sentence_zh: 學生們惡作劇是為了讓同學們笑。

definition_zh: (形) 頑皮的；愛捣亂的　(形) 惡作劇的；調皮的
example_sentence: The mischievous boy hid his sister's homework and laughed at her confused reaction.
sentence_zh: 那個頑皮的男孩藏起他妹妹的功課，對她困惑的反應大笑。

definition_zh: (名) 錯誤的想法；誤解
example_sentence: Many students have the misconception that studying harder always means better grades.
sentence_zh: 許多學生有一個錯誤想法，認為讀書越努力成績一定越好。

definition_zh: (名) 不當行為；惡行　(名) 過錯；壞事
example_sentence: Although the student committed a serious misdeed, the principal gave him a second chance.
sentence_zh: 儘管學生犯了一個嚴重的過錯，校長還是給了他改過的機會。

definition_zh: (名) 輕罪；不端行為　(名) 違反市鎮條例的罪行
example_sentence: Having committed a misdemeanor, the student faced suspension from school.
sentence_zh: 由於犯了輕罪，這名學生面臨被學校停學的處分。

definition_zh: (名) 守財奴；吝嗇鬼
example_sentence: The miser who refused to spend money on his children's education was widely criticized.
sentence_zh: 那位拒絕為孩子教育花錢的守財奴受到廣泛批評。

definition_zh: (形) 悲慘的；痛苦的　(形) 令人厭惡的；糟糕的
example_sentence: If the weather becomes miserable, the outdoor sports day will be postponed to next week.
sentence_zh: 如果天氣變得糟糕，戶外運動會將延期到下週舉行。

definition_zh: (副) 悲慘地；極其難受地　非常地；令人難受地
example_sentence: The student failed the math exam miserably and felt completely discouraged.
sentence_zh: 那位學生數學考試慘烈失敗，感到完全沮喪。

definition_zh: (形) 小氣的；吝嗇的　(副) 以小氣的方式；吝嗇地
example_sentence: The wealthy businessman refused to donate money to rebuild the village school.
sentence_zh: 那位富有的商人拒絕捐款以重建鄉村學校，顯得非常小氣。

definition_zh: (名) 痛苦；悲慘　(名) 貧困；困境
example_sentence: Losing his job and home brought years of misery and hardship to the family.
sentence_zh: 失去工作和家園為這個家庭帶來多年的痛苦和困難。

definition_zh: (名) 不幸；厄運　(名) 災難；困難
example_sentence: Although misfortune struck the family last year, they remained hopeful and supportive of each other.
sentence_zh: 雖然去年不幸降臨到這個家庭，但他們仍然保持希望並互相支持。

definition_zh: (名) 疑慮；不安　(形) 令人擔憂的；令人懷疑的
example_sentence: Having experienced previous failures, the team approached the project with serious misgivings about success.
sentence_zh: 由於經歷過先前的失敗，該隊伍對專案的成功抱持著嚴重的疑慮。

definition_zh: (動) 誤導；引入歧途　(形) 被誤導的；被引入歧途的
example_sentence: Students who are misguided by unreliable online sources often fail the exam.
sentence_zh: 被不可靠的網路資源誤導的學生常常會在考試中失敗。

definition_zh: (形) 被誤導的；方向錯誤的
example_sentence: The misguided decision to skip studying led to a failing exam score.
sentence_zh: 那個被誤導的決定——跳過讀書——導致了考試不及格的成績。

definition_zh: (名) 混亂的混合物；雜亂無章　(形) 混亂的；雜亂的
example_sentence: If the party decorations weren't such a mishmash of colors, the room would look much more elegant.
sentence_zh: 如果派對裝飾不是這麼雜亂無章的顏色混合，房間看起來會優雅得多。

definition_zh: (動) 誤解；誤釋　(動) 曲解；理解錯誤
example_sentence: The teacher explained the assignment again because many students had misinterpreted her instructions.
sentence_zh: 因為許多學生誤解了她的指示，老師再次解釋了這項作業。

definition_zh: (動) 誤導；欺騙　(動) 引入歧途；使人上當
example_sentence: Relying on misleading advertisements, many students wasted money on useless courses.
sentence_zh: 依賴誤導性廣告，許多學生浪費金錢在無用的課程上。

definition_zh: (形) 誤導的；欺騙性的
example_sentence: Although the advertisement looks attractive, the misleading claims about the product's quality disappointed many customers.
sentence_zh: 雖然廣告看起來很吸引人，但該產品品質的誤導性聲稱讓許多顧客感到失望。

definition_zh: (名) 厭女症；仇恨女性
example_sentence: Rarely does misogyny fail to damage women's opportunities in the workplace.
sentence_zh: 厭女症很少不在職場中傷害女性的機會。

definition_zh: (名) 厭惡聲音的恐懼症；對噪音的病態恐懼
example_sentence: People with misophobia, which causes extreme anxiety from certain sounds, often struggle in noisy environments.
sentence_zh: 患有厭惡聲音恐懼症的人（這種症狀會因某些聲音引發極度焦慮）往往在嘈雜環境中掙扎。

definition_zh: (動) 放錯地方；遺失　(動) 弄丟；找不到
example_sentence: Sarah organized her desk to avoid misplacing important documents during exam season.
sentence_zh: 莎拉整理她的書桌以避免在考試季節遺失重要文件。

definition_zh: (動) 誤讀；理解錯誤　(動) 看錯；曲解
example_sentence: Misreading the exam instructions caused many students to lose points unnecessarily.
sentence_zh: 誤讀考試說明導致許多學生不必要地失分。

definition_zh: (動) 不實地代表；歪曲事實
example_sentence: The company misrepresented its product's safety features in advertisements.
sentence_zh: 那家公司在廣告中歪曲了產品的安全特性。

definition_zh: (動) 錯過；失去機會　(動) 無法參與；被排除
example_sentence: If students don't study hard now, they will miss out on better universities and job opportunities later.
sentence_zh: 如果學生現在不認真讀書，他們之後將會錯過進入更好大學和獲得更好工作的機會。

definition_zh: (動) 錯過；遺漏　(動) 未能參與；失去機會
example_sentence: Missing out on the school festival, many students felt disappointed about their lost weekend.
sentence_zh: 錯過了校慶活動，許多學生對失去的週末感到失望。

definition_zh: (動) 未擊中；錯過　(動) 想念；懷念
example_sentence: The student who missed the morning class had to stay after school.
sentence_zh: 那位錯過早上課程的學生必須留校。

definition_zh: (名) 飛彈；導彈　(名) 投擲物；拋出物
example_sentence: If the country develops advanced missiles, regional security would become increasingly unstable.
sentence_zh: 如果該國開發先進飛彈，區域安全將變得愈來愈不穩定。

definition_zh: (形) 失蹤的；不見的　(動) 錯過；思念
example_sentence: The missing student was found safe near the train station.
sentence_zh: 那位失蹤的學生在火車站附近被安全找到。

definition_zh: (名) 任務；使命　(名) 目標；宗旨
example_sentence: The astronauts trained hard to complete their space mission successfully.
sentence_zh: 太空人努力訓練以成功完成他們的太空任務。

definition_zh: (名) 傳教士；宣教師　(形) 傳教的；宣教的
example_sentence: The missionary organization worked to build schools and hospitals in remote villages.
sentence_zh: 這個傳教組織致力於在偏遠村莊建立學校和醫院。

definition_zh: (名) 霧；薄霧　(動) 使模糊；噴霧
example_sentence: As the morning mist cleared, the mountain trail became visible to hikers.
sentence_zh: 當早晨的霧散去時，登山步道對登山者變得清晰可見。

definition_zh: (動) 把...誤認為；搞混
example_sentence: Having mistaken the stranger for an old friend, Sarah rushed over to greet him warmly.
sentence_zh: 莎拉把那陌生人誤認為老朋友，匆忙跑過去熱情地問候他。

definition_zh: (名) 錯誤；過失　(動) 誤解；弄錯
example_sentence: The error that the student made on the exam was a careless mistake.
sentence_zh: 那個學生在考試中犯的錯誤是不小心的過失。

definition_zh: (形) 錯誤的；弄錯的　(動) 誤認；搞錯
example_sentence: Being mistaken about the exam date, many students arrived late to class.
sentence_zh: 由於對考試日期弄錯了，許多學生遲到到了教室。

definition_zh: (名) 先生；客人　(動) 稱...為先生
example_sentence: If the customer weren't such a difficult mister, the store manager would handle the complaint more patiently.
sentence_zh: 如果這位客人不是那麼難相處，店經理會更耐心地處理投訴。

definition_zh: (動) 虐待；不公正對待　(動) 濫用；惡待
example_sentence: Animal welfare organizations work to prevent companies from mistreating animals in factories.
sentence_zh: 動物福利組織致力於阻止公司在工廠裡虐待動物。

definition_zh: (名) 情婦；姘頭　(名) 女主人；女師傅
example_sentence: Having discovered his affair, the wife confronted her husband about his mistress.
sentence_zh: 發現丈夫外遇後，妻子當面質問他關於他的情婦。

definition_zh: (形) 不信任的；懷疑的　(形) 警惕的；不放心的
example_sentence: Because the company's past behavior was dishonest, investors remained mistrustful of its financial reports.
sentence_zh: 因為該公司過去的行為不誠實，投資者對其財務報告仍然不信任。

definition_zh: (形) 霧濛濛的；朦朧的　(形) 模糊的；不清楚的
example_sentence: Seldom do students enjoy misty mornings when cycling to school without clear visibility.
sentence_zh: 學生很少喜歡騎自行車上學時霧濛濛的早晨，因為能見度很低。

definition_zh: (動) 誤解；理解錯誤　(名) 誤會；誤解
example_sentence: The argument arose from a misunderstanding that caused confusion between the two friends.
sentence_zh: 這場爭執源於導致兩位朋友之間困惑的誤會。

definition_zh: (名) 誤會；誤解　(動) 誤解；理解錯誤
example_sentence: The teacher explained the lesson again to clear up the misunderstanding and help students grasp the concept.
sentence_zh: 老師再次解釋課程內容以消除誤會，幫助學生理解概念。

definition_zh: (動) [mɪsˈjuz] 誤用；濫用　(名) [mɪsˈjus] 誤用；濫用
example_sentence: Misusing social media platforms can harm students' mental health and academic performance.
sentence_zh: 誤用社群媒體平台會傷害學生的心理健康和學業表現。

definition_zh: (動) 減輕；緩解　(動) 降低；減少
example_sentence: Planting more trees helps mitigate the effects of climate change.
sentence_zh: 種植更多樹木有助於減輕氣候變化的影響。

definition_zh: (動) 混淆；搞混　(動) 混合；配製
example_sentence: When the teacher mixed up the test papers, students couldn't find their own exams easily.
sentence_zh: 當老師把考卷搞混時，學生找不到自己的考試卷子。

definition_zh: (動) 混合；混媒　(名) 混合物；混音
example_sentence: Mixing different colors together, the artist created a beautiful purple shade.
sentence_zh: 藝術家混合不同顏色，創造出美麗的紫色陰影。

definition_zh: (形) 混合的；混合成的　(動過) 混合；混在一起
example_sentence: The mixed reactions from students who attended the concert showed diverse opinions.
sentence_zh: 參加音樂會的學生所表現的混合反應顯示了多種不同的意見。

definition_zh: (名) 混合物；混合　(動) 混合；摻合
example_sentence: If students combine salt and sugar, the resulting mixture will taste both salty and sweet.
sentence_zh: 如果學生混合鹽和糖，產生的混合物會既鹹又甜。

definition_zh: (動) 呻吟；抱怨　(名) 呻吟聲；哭訴
example_sentence: The patient began to moan softly as the nurse adjusted the hospital bed.
sentence_zh: 當護士調整病床時，患者開始輕聲呻吟。

definition_zh: (名) 烏合之眾；暴動群眾　(動) 成群包圍；蜂擁而至
example_sentence: Security guards formed a barrier to prevent angry fans from mobbing the celebrity.
sentence_zh: 保安人員排成一道防線，以防止憤怒的粉絲蜂擁包圍那位名人。

definition_zh: (形) 可移動的；流動的　(名) 手機；行動電話
example_sentence: Many students use mobile devices to access online learning materials during study time.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在讀書時間使用行動裝置來取得線上學習資料。

definition_zh: (名) 流動性；活動能力　(名) 社會流動；職業轉換的機會
example_sentence: Although urban transportation improved mobility for commuters, many rural areas still lack convenient public systems.
sentence_zh: 雖然城市交通改善了通勤者的流動性，但許多鄉村地區仍缺乏便捷的公共運輸系統。

definition_zh: (動) 動員；集結　(動) 調動；激勵
example_sentence: Having mobilized community volunteers, the environmental group successfully cleaned the coastal area.
sentence_zh: 已動員了社區志願者，該環保團體成功清潔了海岸地區。

definition_zh: (動) 製作模型；試驗性製造　(名) 模型；樣品
example_sentence: The prototype mock up that the engineering team designed solved problems before production began.
sentence_zh: 工程團隊設計的原型模型解決了生產開始前的問題。

definition_zh: (動) 嘲笑；模仿　(形) 假的；虛假的
example_sentence: Students taking mock exams before the CSAT gain valuable test-taking experience.
sentence_zh: 學生參加學測前的模擬考試獲得寶貴的應考經驗。

definition_zh: (名) 嘲笑；嘲弄　(動) 嘲笑；愚弄
example_sentence: If the plan were to succeed, continued mockery from critics would only strengthen the team's determination.
sentence_zh: 如果計畫成功，評論家持續的嘲笑只會加強團隊的決心。

definition_zh: (名) 模仿鳥；嘲鳥
example_sentence: The mockingbird sang many different songs throughout the morning.
sentence_zh: 這隻模仿鳥整個上午唱了許多不同的歌曲。

definition_zh: (名) 方式；模式　(名) 時尚；款式　(動) 塑造；模擬
example_sentence: Operating in sustainable mode, the factory reduces waste while maintaining productivity.
sentence_zh: 以永續模式運作，該工廠減少廢棄物同時維持生產力。

definition_zh: (名) 模型；範例　(動) 塑造；示範　(形) 模範的；完美的
example_sentence: As the fashion model walked down the runway, cameras flashed constantly.
sentence_zh: 當這位時裝模特兒走在伸展台上時，相機不斷閃光。

definition_zh: (形) [ˋmɑdərɪt] 適度的；溫和的　(動) [ˋmɑdəˌret] 減輕；調和
example_sentence: Only rarely does moderate exercise fail to improve both physical and mental health.
sentence_zh: 只有在極少數情況下，適度的運動才無法改善身心健康。

definition_zh: (副) 適度地；中等程度地　(副) 有節制地；溫和地
example_sentence: The restaurant serves moderately priced dishes that satisfy students who study with limited budgets.
sentence_zh: 這家餐廳提供適度定價的菜色，滿足預算有限而專心唸書的學生。

definition_zh: (名) 適度；溫和　(動) 調節；主持
example_sentence: Eating in moderation helps students maintain energy to study effectively.
sentence_zh: 適度飲食幫助學生保持精力以便有效讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 主持人；調解人　(名) 調節器；控制裝置
example_sentence: The debate moderator asked each candidate thoughtful questions about education policy.
sentence_zh: 辯論主持人針對教育政策向每位候選人提出深思熟慮的問題。

definition_zh: (形) 現代的；當代的　(形) 新式的；摩登的
example_sentence: Modern technology makes communication between people much easier and faster.
sentence_zh: 現代科技使人與人之間的溝通變得更加容易和迅速。

definition_zh: (名) 現代主義者；現代派藝術家　(形) 現代主義的；前衛的
example_sentence: Because the architect was a modernist who rejected traditional styles, the museum building featured bold geometric shapes and glass walls.
sentence_zh: 因為建築師是一位拒絕傳統風格的現代主義者，所以這座美術館建築具有大膽的幾何形狀和玻璃牆。

definition_zh: (名) 現代化；使現代化
example_sentence: Modernizing its infrastructure, the city attracted many new businesses and residents.
sentence_zh: 該城市透過現代化其基礎設施，吸引了許多新企業和居民。

definition_zh: (動) 使現代化；改進　(動) 更新；升級
example_sentence: The factory that modernized its production equipment last year achieved higher efficiency.
sentence_zh: 去年現代化其生產設備的工廠達到了更高的效率。

definition_zh: (形) 謙虛的；不傲慢的　(形) 適度的；不過分的
example_sentence: If Lin studies with modest expectations, achieving excellent results will bring greater satisfaction.
sentence_zh: 如果林以謙虛的期望念書，取得優異成績將帶來更大的滿足感。

definition_zh: (名) 謙虛；謙遜　(形) 適度的；不過分的
example_sentence: The famous athlete showed great modesty despite winning many awards.
sentence_zh: 那位著名運動員儘管贏得許多獎項，卻表現出極大的謙虛。

definition_zh: (名) 修改；改良　(動) 修改；改進
example_sentence: Engineers made several modifications to improve the car's performance and safety.
sentence_zh: 工程師進行了幾項修改以改善汽車的性能和安全性。

definition_zh: (動) 修改；改變　(動) 調整；改進
example_sentence: The architect modified the building design to meet new safety requirements.
sentence_zh: 建築師修改了建築設計以符合新的安全要求。

definition_zh: (形) 時髦的；流行的　(形) 新穎的；符合潮流的
example_sentence: Although the old dress was modish when grandmother wore it, fashion trends change so quickly nowadays.
sentence_zh: 雖然那件舊洋裝在奶奶年代很時髦，但時尚潮流變化得非常快。

definition_zh: (動) 調整；調節　(動) 改變音量或語調
example_sentence: Having modulated the guitar's volume, the musician delivered a more balanced performance.
sentence_zh: 調整過吉他音量後，這位音樂家呈現了更均衡的表演。

definition_zh: (名) 模組；單元　(名) 課程單位；模塊
example_sentence: The online course includes ten modules that students must complete before graduation.
sentence_zh: 這個線上課程包含十個學生畢業前必須完成的模組。

definition_zh: (形) 潮濕的；濕潤的　(動) 使潮濕；弄濕
example_sentence: The moist tropical climate and warm weather make growing tropical fruits easier for local farmers.
sentence_zh: 潮濕的熱帶氣候和溫暖的天氣使當地農民更容易種植熱帶水果。

definition_zh: (動) 使濕潤；使潮濕
example_sentence: If students moistened their lips before singing, their voices would sound much clearer.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在唱歌前潤濕嘴唇，他們的聲音聽起來會清晰得多。

definition_zh: (名) 濕度；水分　(動) 使濕潤；增加水分
example_sentence: High moisture in the air makes summer feel uncomfortable and sticky.
sentence_zh: 空氣中的高濕度使夏天感覺不舒服且黏膩。

definition_zh: (名) 黴菌；霉　(動) 形成；塑造
example_sentence: Bread left in a damp place, developing mold quickly, should be discarded immediately.
sentence_zh: 放在潮濕地方的麵包，快速長黴，應該立即丟棄。

definition_zh: (形) 發黴的；有黴菌的
example_sentence: Because the bathroom was moldy, the family decided to renovate it completely.
sentence_zh: 因為浴室發黴了，這個家庭決定徹底整修它。

definition_zh: (形) 分子的；分子層面的
example_sentence: Only after scientists studied molecular structures did they understand protein folding mechanisms.
sentence_zh: 只有在科學家研究了分子結構之後，他們才理解蛋白質摺疊機制。

definition_zh: (名) 分子；分子結構
example_sentence: Water molecules, which are composed of hydrogen and oxygen atoms, are essential for life.
sentence_zh: 由氫原子和氧原子組成的水分子對生命來說是必不可少的。

definition_zh: (形) 熔融的；熔化的　(動) 熔化；融化
example_sentence: Factories heat metal to extremely high temperatures to obtain molten steel for making tools.
sentence_zh: 工廠將金屬加熱到極高溫度以取得用於製造工具的熔融鋼。

definition_zh: (名) 時刻；瞬間　(名) 重要性；意義
example_sentence: The moment the exam started, all students stopped talking and began writing.
sentence_zh: 考試開始的那一刻，所有學生都停止說話並開始寫題目。

definition_zh: (形) 短暫的；片刻的　(形) 瞬間的；轉眼的
example_sentence: The power outage lasted only a few momentary seconds before electricity returned.
sentence_zh: 停電只持續了片刻的幾秒鐘，電力就恢復了。

definition_zh: (形) 重大的；重要的　(形) 影響深遠的；關鍵性的
example_sentence: Although the decision seemed small at first, it proved momentous when the company expanded internationally.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個決定起初似乎很小，但當公司國際擴張時，它被證明是重大的。

definition_zh: (名) 動量；勢頭　(名) 推進力；發展勢頭
example_sentence: Building momentum by winning consecutive matches, the basketball team advanced to the championship finals.
sentence_zh: 通過連勝建立勢頭，籃球隊晉級了冠軍決賽。

definition_zh: (名) 君主；統治者　(名) 帝王蝶
example_sentence: The monarch who ruled the kingdom for fifty years left behind a legacy that historians still study today.
sentence_zh: 統治王國五十年的君主留下了歷史學家至今仍在研究的遺產。

definition_zh: (名) 君主制；君主統治　(名) 君主國；王國
example_sentence: If a country maintains monarchy, its king or queen will hold significant political power.
sentence_zh: 如果一個國家保持君主制，它的國王或王后將掌握重大的政治權力。

definition_zh: (名) 修道院；寺院
example_sentence: The ancient monastery in the mountains attracts many visitors every year.
sentence_zh: 山裡那座古老的修道院每年吸引許多遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 星期一；周一
example_sentence: Students attend morning assembly on Monday to start the school week together.
sentence_zh: 學生在星期一參加早會以開始整週的校園生活。

definition_zh: (形) 貨幣的；金錢的　(形) 與金融制度相關的
example_sentence: The central bank's monetary policy directly affects interest rates and inflation across the entire economy.
sentence_zh: 中央銀行的貨幣政策直接影響整個經濟中的利率和通貨膨脹。

definition_zh: (動) 將某物轉換為金錢；從某物獲利
example_sentence: As social media platforms monetize user data, privacy concerns grow increasingly serious.
sentence_zh: 當社群媒體平台將用戶數據轉換為收益時，隱私問題變得愈來愈嚴重。

definition_zh: (名) 金錢；錢　(名) 貨幣；鈔票
example_sentence: Having earned money from summer tutoring, the student could finally afford textbooks.
sentence_zh: 由於從暑期補習中賺取了金錢，這個學生終於買得起課本。

definition_zh: (名) 監視器；螢幕　(動) 監控；監測
example_sentence: The security camera that monitors the school entrance recorded the incident clearly.
sentence_zh: 監控學校入口的保安攝像頭清楚地記錄了這起事件。

definition_zh: (名) 和尚；僧侶
example_sentence: The Buddhist monk spent years studying ancient texts in the mountain monastery.
sentence_zh: 那位佛教和尚在山上的寺院裡花了多年研究古老的經文。

definition_zh: (動) 胡鬧；瞎搗蛋　(動) 浪費時間；閒混
example_sentence: If students monkeyed about instead of studying, they would fail the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 如果學生們胡鬧而不讀書，他們就會在學測中落榜。

definition_zh: (名) 猴子；猿猴
example_sentence: The monkey climbed the tree and ate bananas quickly.
sentence_zh: 那隻猴子爬上樹並迅速吃香蕉。

definition_zh: (形) 單色的；黑白的　(名) 單色畫；黑白影像
example_sentence: The designer, creating a monochrome poster, successfully captured the minimalist aesthetic.
sentence_zh: 設計師創作單色海報，成功捕捉了極簡主義美感。

definition_zh: (形) 單眼的；只用一隻眼睛的
example_sentence: Because the injury left him monocular, the athlete had to adjust his depth perception during training.
sentence_zh: 因為受傷使他只能用一隻眼睛，這位運動員必須在訓練中調整他的深度感知。

definition_zh: (名) 獨白；長篇獨自談話　(動) 進行獨白；自言自語
example_sentence: Only after the actor finished his monologue did the audience burst into thunderous applause.
sentence_zh: 只有在演員完成獨白之後，觀眾才爆發出雷鳴般的掌聲。

definition_zh: (動) 壟斷；獨占　(動) 佔據全部；獨佔
example_sentence: The large company monopolizes the market, which limits consumer choices.
sentence_zh: 那家大公司壟斷市場，這限制了消費者的選擇。

definition_zh: (名) 單調的聲調；單色　(形) 單調的；無變化的
example_sentence: The speaker used a monotone voice to explain the complex math problem.
sentence_zh: 那位講者用單調的聲音來解釋這個複雜的數學問題。

definition_zh: (形) 單調的；乏味的　(形) 聲調不變的；沉悶的
example_sentence: Listening to the same monotonous music every day makes studying feel boring and tiring.
sentence_zh: 每天聽同樣單調的音樂使得讀書感到無聊又疲倦。

definition_zh: (副) 單調乏味地；重複枯燥地
example_sentence: The teacher spoke monotonously for two hours, making students feel very sleepy.
sentence_zh: 老師單調乏味地講了兩個小時的課，讓學生感到非常睏倦。

definition_zh: (名) 單調；乏味　(形) 單調的；無變化的
example_sentence: Although the job offers good salary, monotony in daily tasks makes many employees feel unmotivated.
sentence_zh: 雖然這份工作薪水不錯，但日常工作的單調性使許多員工感到缺乏動力。

definition_zh: (名) 季風；季節風　(形) 季風的；受季風影響的
example_sentence: Bringing heavy rainfall to Southeast Asia, the summer monsoon transforms farming regions into lush green landscapes.
sentence_zh: 帶來東南亞大雨的夏季季風，將農業地區變成蒼翠的綠色景觀。

definition_zh: (名) 怪物；妖怪　(名) 殘忍的人；惡棍
example_sentence: The creature that lurked in the dark forest was a monster feared by all villagers.
sentence_zh: 在黑暗森林裡潛伏的那個怪物是所有村民都害怕的。

definition_zh: (名) 怪物；醜陋的東西　令人厭惡的事物
example_sentence: If the architect had ignored safety rules, the building would become a monstrosity that endangered residents.
sentence_zh: 如果建築師忽視安全規則，這棟建築將成為危害居民的怪物。

definition_zh: (形) 怪物般的；令人厭惡的　(形) 巨大的；極端的
example_sentence: The monstrous size of the typhoon alarmed meteorologists and forced evacuations across the island.
sentence_zh: 那場颱風怪物般的規模令氣象學家警惕，並迫使全島疏散。

definition_zh: (名) 月份；一個月的時間
example_sentence: Students need to study hard for one month to prepare for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們需要努力讀書一個月來準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (形) 每月的；月度的　(副) 每月；按月
example_sentence: The school publishes a monthly newsletter to keep parents informed about student activities.
sentence_zh: 學校每月發行通訊以告知家長學生的各項活動。

definition_zh: (名) 紀念碑；紀念建築　(名) 歷史遺跡；重要證據
example_sentence: Although the ancient monument stands in the museum, many visitors still travel far to see it.
sentence_zh: 雖然古代紀念碑矗立在博物館裡，許多遊客仍然遠道而來參觀它。

definition_zh: (形) 紀念性的；宏大的　(形) 重要的；具有歷史意義的
example_sentence: Having completed the first trans-Pacific flight, the pilot achieved a monumental feat recognized worldwide.
sentence_zh: 完成了首次跨太平洋飛行後，這位飛行員達成了舉世公認的重大壯舉。

definition_zh: (動) 閒晃；無所事事　(動) 蹭吃蹭喝
example_sentence: Students mooch about the shopping mall that has no entrance fee.
sentence_zh: 學生們在沒有入場費的購物中心裡無所事事地閒晃。

definition_zh: (名) 心情；情緒　(名) 氣氛；感覺
example_sentence: Studying for the CSAT in a good mood makes learning more effective.
sentence_zh: 在心情好的狀態下準備學測，使得學習更有效率。

definition_zh: (形) 心情易變的；喜怒無常　(形) 陰沉的；沉悶的
example_sentence: If Sophia weren't so moody, her friends would enjoy studying with her much more.
sentence_zh: 如果蘇菲亞不是那麼喜怒無常，她的朋友們就會更喜歡和她一起讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 月亮；月球　(名) 月份
example_sentence: The moon rises above the mountains every night.
sentence_zh: 月亮每晚都在山頂上升起。

definition_zh: (名) 月光；月光照　(形) 被月光照亮的；月光的
example_sentence: Bathed in moonlight, the lake surface sparkled like thousands of tiny diamonds.
sentence_zh: 被月光照亮，湖面閃爍得像數千顆微小的鑽石。

definition_zh: (名) 荒野；沼澤地　(動) 停泊；繫泊
example_sentence: As the ship moored near the harbor, passengers prepared to disembark onto the peaceful island.
sentence_zh: 當船隻停泊在港口附近時，乘客準備上岸前往這個寧靜的島嶼。

definition_zh: (名) 拖把；抹布　(動) 用拖把擦；清理
example_sentence: Hardly ever does a student mop the classroom floor without complaining about the work.
sentence_zh: 學生幾乎不會在不抱怨的情況下用拖把擦教室地板。

definition_zh: (動) 擦乾淨；清理　收尾；完成
example_sentence: The cleaning staff mopped up the spilled water that covered the gymnasium floor.
sentence_zh: 清潔人員擦乾淨了蓋住體育館地板的溢出水。

definition_zh: (名) 拖把；地板擦　(動) 用拖把擦；清潔
example_sentence: Mom uses a mop to clean the kitchen floor every week.
sentence_zh: 媽媽每週使用拖把來清潔廚房地板。

definition_zh: (動) 悶悶不樂地閒晃；無精打采地遊蕩
example_sentence: After failing the math exam, Tom moped about the school campus all week.
sentence_zh: 數學考試不及格後，湯姆整個禮拜都在校園裡悶悶不樂地閒晃。

definition_zh: (形) 道德的；倫理的　(名) 品格；道德教訓
example_sentence: Good moral values help students make better choices in life.
sentence_zh: 良好的道德價值觀幫助學生在生活中做出更好的選擇。

definition_zh: (名) 士氣；精神面貌　(形) 道德的；倫理的
example_sentence: Although the team lost the match, their morale remained high because they believed in future success.
sentence_zh: 雖然隊伍輸了比賽，但因為他們相信未來的成功，士氣仍然高昂。

definition_zh: (名) 道德；品德　(名) 道德性；倫理性
example_sentence: Recognizing the importance of honesty, the student built strong morality in daily life.
sentence_zh: 認識到誠實的重要性，那位學生在日常生活中建立了堅強的品德。

definition_zh: (副) 道德上；在道德方面　(副) 倫理上；按照道德原則
example_sentence: The businessman who acted morally in the scandal gained public respect.
sentence_zh: 在醜聞中道德上行動得當的那位商人獲得了大眾尊重。

definition_zh: (片) 不僅僅是；遠超過於　(片) 超越；不止
example_sentence: If good grades are more than just test scores, developing critical thinking skills would benefit students throughout their lives.
sentence_zh: 如果優異成績不僅僅是考試分數，培養批判思維能力將使學生終身受益。

definition_zh: (形) 更多的；較多的　(副) 更；較；再　(代) 更多的人或物
example_sentence: Learning more vocabulary helps students score better on the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 學習更多的單字幫助學生在學測中取得更好的成績。

definition_zh: (連) 而且；此外　(副) 而且；更甚者
example_sentence: Students should attend class regularly to improve their grades; moreover, doing homework helps build good study habits.
sentence_zh: 學生應該定期上課以提高成績；而且，做功課有助於養成良好的學習習慣。

definition_zh: (名) 早上；上午　(形) 早晨的；上午的
example_sentence: Every morning, students gather at school before the flag ceremony.
sentence_zh: 每個早上，學生在升旗典禮前聚集在學校。

definition_zh: (名) 笨蛋；傻瓜
example_sentence: Although Tom studied hard, he failed the test because he was a complete moron.
sentence_zh: 雖然湯姆認真讀書，但因為他是個十足的笨蛋，所以考試不及格。

definition_zh: (形) 愚蠢的；低能的　(形) 荒謬的；很傻的
example_sentence: Having made such moronic mistakes in the math exam, Tom felt deeply embarrassed about his careless performance.
sentence_zh: 在數學考試中犯了這樣愚蠢的錯誤後，湯姆為自己的粗心表現感到非常尷尬。

definition_zh: (名) 一小塊；少量　(名) 一口食物；小份食物
example_sentence: The hungry child ate every morsel of bread that mother prepared for lunch.
sentence_zh: 飢餓的孩子吃完了媽媽為午餐準備的每一小塊麵包。

definition_zh: (形) 致命的；會導致死亡的　(形) 凡人的；人類的
example_sentence: A mortal wound from the accident left the victim in critical condition at the hospital.
sentence_zh: 這場意外造成的致命傷使受害者在醫院陷入危急狀態。

definition_zh: (名) 砂漿；灰泥　(名) 臼；研缽
example_sentence: If construction workers mixed mortar with better quality sand, the brick wall would last much longer.
sentence_zh: 如果建築工人用更高品質的沙混合砂漿，磚牆會持續更久。

definition_zh: (名) 抵押貸款；房貸　(動) 抵押；以房屋作為貸款擔保
example_sentence: Buying a house usually requires taking out a long-term mortgage from a bank.
sentence_zh: 購買房屋通常需要向銀行申請長期房貸。

definition_zh: (名) 停屍間；殯儀館
example_sentence: Grieving families, entering the quiet mortuary, found solace in remembering their loved ones.
sentence_zh: 悲傷的家族成員進入安靜的停屍間，從回憶摯愛中找到慰藉。

definition_zh: (名) 清真寺；伊斯蘭教禮拜堂
example_sentence: When Muslims gather at the mosque for prayer, they remove their shoes before entering the sacred space.
sentence_zh: 當穆斯林在清真寺聚集祈禱時，他們進入神聖空間前會脫掉鞋子。

definition_zh: (名) 蚊子；蚊
example_sentence: Seldom do mosquitoes bother students studying outdoors on cool autumn evenings.
sentence_zh: 蚊子很少在涼爽的秋天傍晚打擾在戶外讀書的學生。

definition_zh: (名) 苔蘚；青苔
example_sentence: The old stone wall that is covered with moss looks ancient and mysterious.
sentence_zh: 覆蓋著苔蘚的古老石牆看起來很神秘。

definition_zh: (形) 最多的；大多數的　(副) 最；非常
example_sentence: Students study hard most of the time to pass the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 學生大部分時間都努力讀書以通過學測考試。

definition_zh: (副) 大多；主要地　(副) 幾乎；差不多
example_sentence: The students in our class are mostly interested in science and technology subjects.
sentence_zh: 我們班的學生大多對科學和技術科目感興趣。

definition_zh: (名) 汽車旅館；旅館
example_sentence: Families often stay at motels during road trips across Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 家庭在台灣公路旅行時常住在汽車旅館。

definition_zh: (名) 蛾；飛蛾
example_sentence: Although the moth is attracted to light, it can still survive in dark forests.
sentence_zh: 雖然蛾被光吸引，但它仍然能在黑暗的森林中生存。

definition_zh: (名) 母親；媽媽　(動) 照顧；養育
example_sentence: Caring for her younger siblings, the mother managed both work and family responsibilities.
sentence_zh: 照顧年幼弟妹的母親同時處理工作和家庭責任。

definition_zh: (名) 母親身分；母親的狀態
example_sentence: Motherhood, which requires endless patience and unconditional love, transforms women forever.
sentence_zh: 母親身分需要無限的耐心和無條件的愛，它永遠改變女性。

definition_zh: (名) 主題；圖案　(名) 動機；目的
example_sentence: If the designer repeats the flower motif throughout the poster, the overall composition will appear more cohesive.
sentence_zh: 如果設計師在整張海報中重複花卉主題，整體構圖就會顯得更加和諧。

definition_zh: (名) 動作；運動　(動) 揮手示意；提議
example_sentence: The dancer's graceful motion impressed the audience during the performance.
sentence_zh: 那位舞者優雅的動作在演出中令觀眾印象深刻。

definition_zh: (動) 激勵；鼓舞　(動) 促使；驅使
example_sentence: Teachers use praise to motivate students to study harder for the exam.
sentence_zh: 老師用讚美來激勵學生為考試更努力地讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 動力；激勵　(名) 理由；目的
example_sentence: Because students lack motivation, many struggle to study effectively for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 因為學生缺乏動力，許多人難以有效準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (形) 鼓舞的；激勵的　(形) 提高幹勁的；振奮人心的
example_sentence: Having watched the motivational speech, the students felt encouraged to pursue their dreams.
sentence_zh: 看過那場激勵人心的演講後，學生們感到受到鼓舞去追求自己的夢想。

definition_zh: (名) 動機；目的　(形) 推動的；促動的
example_sentence: The detective investigated the suspect whose motive for the crime remained unclear.
sentence_zh: 偵探調查那名嫌疑人，其犯罪動機仍不清楚。

definition_zh: (名) 馬達；電動機　(形) 與運動有關的；運動的
example_sentence: Electric motor vehicles are becoming increasingly popular among young drivers in Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 電動馬達汽車在台灣年輕駕駛者中變得越來越受歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 摩托車；機車
example_sentence: If motorcycle prices were lower, more teenagers would buy them for commuting to school.
sentence_zh: 如果摩托車價格更便宜，更多青少年就會買來上下學通勤。

definition_zh: (名) 汽車駕駛人；開車的人
example_sentence: Every motorist must follow traffic rules to keep roads safe.
sentence_zh: 每位汽車駕駛人都必須遵守交通規則以保持道路安全。

definition_zh: (名) 座右銘；格言　(名) 口號；標語
example_sentence: As the school motto emphasizes, students should pursue excellence whenever facing challenges.
sentence_zh: 當學校座右銘所強調的那樣，學生在面對挑戰時應該追求卓越。

definition_zh: (名) 黴菌；黴　(動) 使發黴；塑造
example_sentence: Seldom does mould grow on dry surfaces in well-ventilated rooms.
sentence_zh: 黴菌很少在通風良好的乾燥表面上生長。

definition_zh: (名) 土堆；丘陵　(動) 堆積；隆起
example_sentence: The ancient mound that archaeologists excavated revealed pottery dating back thousands of years.
sentence_zh: 考古學家挖掘的那座古老土堆揭露了距今數千年前的陶器。

definition_zh: (動) 累積；增加　(動) 登上；爬上
example_sentence: Expenses mount up quickly to exceed the monthly budget.
sentence_zh: 費用迅速累積，超過月度預算。

definition_zh: (動) 爬上；登上　(動) 安裝；架設　(名) 坐騎；馬匹
example_sentence: Mountain climbers must prepare equipment carefully before mounting the peak.
sentence_zh: 登山者在攀登山峰之前必須仔細準備裝備。

definition_zh: (名) 山；高山
example_sentence: The mountain near our school is very tall and beautiful.
sentence_zh: 我們學校附近的山很高也很漂亮。

definition_zh: (形) 多山的；山區的　(形) 起伏不平的；崎嶇的
example_sentence: Because the region is mountainous, building roads there requires advanced engineering techniques.
sentence_zh: 因為該地區多山，在那裡修建道路需要先進的工程技術。

definition_zh: (形) 安裝的；固定的　(動) 騎上；登上
example_sentence: Mounted on the classroom wall, the digital screen displays today's lesson objectives clearly.
sentence_zh: 安裝在教室牆上的數位螢幕清楚地顯示今天的課程目標。

definition_zh: (動) 哀悼；悲傷　(動) 為…感到遺憾
example_sentence: The nation mourned the loss of the renowned educator whose contributions had transformed countless lives.
sentence_zh: 這個國家為失去那位貢獻卓著、改變了無數人生命的著名教育家而哀悼。

definition_zh: (形) 悲傷的；令人哀傷的　(形) 愁苦的；沉鬱的
example_sentence: If the funeral music were not so mournful, the mourners might find some comfort in memories.
sentence_zh: 如果葬禮音樂不是那麼令人哀傷，哀悼者也許能從回憶中找到些許安慰。

definition_zh: (名) 滑鼠；鼠標　(名) 老鼠；小鼠
example_sentence: Click the mouse to open the file on your computer.
sentence_zh: 點擊滑鼠開啟電腦上的文件。

definition_zh: (名) 鬍子；上唇鬍
example_sentence: Growing a moustache to look more mature impressed many of his classmates.
sentence_zh: 留鬍子來看起來更成熟讓許多同學印象深刻。

definition_zh: (名) 嘴巴；口　(名) 言論；說話方式
example_sentence: Opening one's mouth too wide while eating is considered impolite in many cultures.
sentence_zh: 吃飯時張開嘴巴太大在許多文化中被認為是不禮貌的。

definition_zh: (動) 大聲抱怨；出言不遜
example_sentence: Although the student mouthed off about the unfair test, the teacher remained calm and patient.
sentence_zh: 雖然那位學生對不公平的考試大聲抱怨，但老師仍然保持冷靜和耐心。

definition_zh: (名) 嘴；口腔　(動) 用嘴說；開口說話
example_sentence: Having opened his mouth to speak, the student hesitated before answering the teacher's difficult question.
sentence_zh: 那位學生張開嘴準備說話，但在回答老師的難題前猶豫了。

definition_zh: (名) 發言人；代言人　(名) 話筒；麥克風
example_sentence: The politician who served as the mouthpiece for the environmental group faced criticism from opposing parties.
sentence_zh: 這位曾擔任環保團體發言人的政治人物遭到對黨的批評。

definition_zh: (形) 令人垂涎欲滴的；非常誘人的
example_sentence: The mouthwatering aroma of fresh pizza drew hungry students into the school cafeteria.
sentence_zh: 新鮮披薩令人垂涎欲滴的香氣吸引了飢餓的學生進入學校餐廳。

definition_zh: (形) 可移動的；活動的　(形) 不固定的；流動的
example_sentence: If the desk were movable, students would rearrange the classroom more easily during group projects.
sentence_zh: 如果課桌是可移動的，學生在分組專題時會更容易重新安排教室。

definition_zh: (動) 前進；取得進展　(動) 向前；領先
example_sentence: After graduating, many students move ahead with their college dreams and careers.
sentence_zh: 畢業後，許多學生繼續前進，追求大學夢想和職業發展。

definition_zh: (動) 繼續前進；向前走　(動) 停止逗留；離開
example_sentence: Moving along the crowded street, the tourists stopped to take photos at every corner.
sentence_zh: 沿著擁擠的街道繼續前進，遊客在每個角落都停下來拍照。

definition_zh: (動) 遠離；搬家離開
example_sentence: As pollution worsened in the city, many families moved away from the industrial area.
sentence_zh: 當城市污染惡化時，許多家庭遠離了工業區。

definition_zh: (動) 搬家；遷移　(動) 遠離；離開
example_sentence: Only after graduating from high school did many students move away from their hometowns.
sentence_zh: 只有高中畢業後，許多學生才搬離了他們的家鄉。

definition_zh: (動) 向下移動；降低　(片) 搬家；遷居
example_sentence: The students whose grades moved down significantly received extra tutoring from teachers who specialized in struggling learners.
sentence_zh: 那些成績大幅下降的學生獲得了專門幫助低成就學習者的老師的額外輔導。

definition_zh: (動) 逼近；威脅　(動) 開始進攻；搶佔
example_sentence: The rival company began to move in on our market share to gain more profit.
sentence_zh: 競爭對手開始逼近我們的市場佔有率以獲得更多利潤。

definition_zh: (動) 搬進去；遷入　(動) 靠近；逼近
example_sentence: After graduation, many students move in with roommates to share apartment expenses.
sentence_zh: 畢業後，許多學生搬進去和室友一起住以分擔公寓費用。

definition_zh: (動) 搬進；遷入　(動) 開始居住
example_sentence: After graduation, Maria moved into a small apartment near the university.
sentence_zh: 畢業後，瑪麗亞搬進了大學附近的一間小公寓。

definition_zh: (動) 繼續前進；放下過去　(動) 離開；搬家
example_sentence: After failing the first exam, students should move on and prepare harder for the next one.
sentence_zh: 考試失敗後，學生應該放下過去，為下一次考試做更充分的準備。

definition_zh: (動) 搬家；遷出　(動) 離開；搬離
example_sentence: Having saved enough money, Sarah moved out of her parents' apartment into her own studio.
sentence_zh: 存夠了錢後，莎拉搬離了父母的公寓，住進了自己的套房。

definition_zh: (動) 移動；朝向　(動) 朝著；趨向
example_sentence: The company moved towards digital transformation, which helped increase efficiency significantly.
sentence_zh: 該公司朝數位轉型發展，這幫助大幅提高了效率。

definition_zh: (動) 升職；晉升　(動) 向上移動；上升
example_sentence: If employees work hard and show good performance, they will move up to better positions.
sentence_zh: 如果員工努力工作並展現良好表現，他們將升職到更好的職位。

definition_zh: (動) 移動；搬家　(名) 動作；移動
example_sentence: The heavy box was difficult to move up the stairs.
sentence_zh: 那個沉重的箱子很難搬上樓梯。

definition_zh: (名) 運動；移動　(名) 動作；姿態
example_sentence: Students joined the environmental movement to protect forests and oceans.
sentence_zh: 學生加入環境運動以保護森林和海洋。

definition_zh: (名) 搬家工人；移動者　(名) 推動者；發起人
example_sentence: The furniture mover carefully wrapped each piece before loading it onto the truck.
sentence_zh: 搬家工人小心地將每件家具包裹好，才把它們裝上卡車。

definition_zh: (名) 看電影的人；電影迷
example_sentence: Although moviegoers rushed to the theater when the superhero film premiered, many complained about the confusing plot afterward.
sentence_zh: 雖然當超級英雄電影首映時看電影的人蜂擁進入戲院，但許多人後來抱怨情節令人困惑。

definition_zh: (形) 感人的；令人感動的　(動) 移動；搬家
example_sentence: Having moved to a new city, the family found themselves deeply moved by their neighbors' warm welcome.
sentence_zh: 搬到新城市後，這個家庭被鄰居們溫暖的歡迎深深打動了。

definition_zh: (動) 剪草；割草
example_sentence: The gardener mowed the lawn that had grown wild during the rainy season.
sentence_zh: 園丁剪了在雨季期間長得很茂盛的草坪。

definition_zh: (名) 割草機；修剪機
example_sentence: The gardener used a lawn mower to cut the grass in the park.
sentence_zh: 園丁用割草機修剪公園裡的草坪。

definition_zh: (副) 更不用說；何況　(連) 更不用說
example_sentence: If winning the CSAT were difficult, much less getting into a top university without extra tutoring would be possible.
sentence_zh: 如果考上學測很困難，更不用說沒有補習就能進入頂尖大學了。

definition_zh: (形) 非常需要的；急需的　(片) 急需；迫切需要
example_sentence: After the flood, the village received much needed supplies from the government.
sentence_zh: 洪水過後，村莊收到政府提供的急需物資。

definition_zh: (形) 許多的；大量的　(副) 非常；很　(代) 許多；大量
example_sentence: Having much homework to do, students often feel stressed preparing for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 由於有許多功課要做，學生在準備學測時常感到壓力很大。

definition_zh: (名) 黏液；鼻涕
example_sentence: Although mucus protects the respiratory system, excessive buildup can cause discomfort.
sentence_zh: 雖然黏液能保護呼吸系統，但過量堆積會造成不適。

definition_zh: (名) 泥巴；泥漿　(動) 弄髒；使混亂
example_sentence: Hardly ever does the construction site look clean; mud covers every corner.
sentence_zh: 建築工地幾乎看不到乾淨的地方；泥巴覆蓋了每個角落。

definition_zh: (動) 勉強應付；混日子　(動) 勉力前進；湊合著過
example_sentence: Students who muddle along without studying hard often regret their choices before exams.
sentence_zh: 那些沒有認真念書而勉強應付的學生，常在考試前感到後悔。

definition_zh: (動) 渾渾噩噩地度過；勉強應付
example_sentence: Many students muddle through their assignments to finish them on time.
sentence_zh: 許多學生為了按時完成作業而勉強應付。

definition_zh: (動) 搞混；弄亂　使變得混亂或困惑
example_sentence: Don't muddle up the test papers before handing them to the principal.
sentence_zh: 在把測驗卷交給校長之前，別把它們搞混了。

definition_zh: (動) 使混亂；弄混　(名) 混亂的狀態
example_sentence: Don't muddle the papers on my desk before the exam.
sentence_zh: 考試前不要把我桌子上的資料弄混亂。

definition_zh: (形) 泥濘的；混濁的　(動) 弄髒；攪渾
example_sentence: As the storm made the playground muddy, students couldn't play soccer today.
sentence_zh: 由於暴風雨使操場泥濘不堪，學生今天無法踢足球。

definition_zh: (動) 用布料包裹以減弱聲音；掩蓋　(形) 被包裹的；被壓制的
example_sentence: Muffling the drum with a thick cloth, the musician created a softer, warmer tone.
sentence_zh: 樂手用厚布包裹鼓以減弱聲音，創造出更柔和、溫暖的音色。

definition_zh: (名) 消音器；靜音裝置　(名) 圍巾；披肩
example_sentence: The car's muffler, which reduces engine noise, needs to be replaced soon.
sentence_zh: 那輛車的消音器，能夠降低引擎噪音，很快就需要更換了。

definition_zh: (動) 臨時突擊複習；趕快準備
example_sentence: If students mug up on the history chapters before the exam, they might pass the test.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試前臨時突擊複習歷史章節，他們可能會通過測驗。

definition_zh: (動) 臨時突擊讀書；死背硬記
example_sentence: Students often mug up before exams instead of studying all semester.
sentence_zh: 學生經常在考試前突擊讀書，而不是整個學期都認真讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 馬克杯；杯子　(動) 搶劫；打擊
example_sentence: Students buy a ceramic mug to hold hot coffee during winter mornings.
sentence_zh: 學生買一個陶瓷馬克杯來在冬天早上裝熱咖啡。

definition_zh: (形) 悶熱的；潮濕悶熱的
example_sentence: Walking to school on muggy summer mornings makes students feel tired and uncomfortable.
sentence_zh: 在悶熱的夏日早晨走路上學讓學生感到疲倦和不適。

definition_zh: (名) 騾；固執的人
example_sentence: Because the mule is stubborn and refuses to move, the farmer must wait patiently.
sentence_zh: 因為騾很固執且拒絕移動，農夫必須耐心等待。

definition_zh: (動) 仔細考慮；反復思考
example_sentence: Having mulled over the job offer for days, Sarah finally decided to accept it.
sentence_zh: 經過數天的仔細考慮，莎拉最後決定接受這份工作機會。

definition_zh: (動) 仔細思考；深思　(動) 反覆考慮；琢磨
example_sentence: The decision that the manager mulled for weeks finally satisfied the entire team.
sentence_zh: 經理深思數週的那個決定最終讓整個團隊感到滿意。

definition_zh: (形) 多邊的；多國參與的
example_sentence: The multilateral trade agreement between several Asian countries promotes economic cooperation.
sentence_zh: 幾個亞洲國家之間的多邊貿易協議促進了經濟合作。

definition_zh: (形) 多語言的；通曉多種語言的
example_sentence: If students were multilingual, they would have better career opportunities in international companies.
sentence_zh: 如果學生通曉多種語言，他們在國際公司會有更好的職業機會。

definition_zh: (名) 多媒體；多種媒體形式
example_sentence: Modern education uses multimedia tools like videos and interactive presentations.
sentence_zh: 現代教育使用多媒體工具，如影片和互動式簡報。

definition_zh: (形) 跨國的；多國的　(形) 涉及多個國家的
example_sentence: Operating in over fifty countries, multinational corporations shape global trade and employment opportunities.
sentence_zh: 跨國公司在五十多個國家營運，塑造了全球貿易和就業機會。

definition_zh: (名) 複選題；多項選擇題
example_sentence: Because the exam uses multiple choice questions, students can eliminate wrong answers before selecting the best option.
sentence_zh: 因為考試採用複選題的形式，學生可以在選擇最佳答案前先排除錯誤選項。

definition_zh: (形) 多個的；多重的　(名) 倍數；多重項
example_sentence: Not only does the project require multiple skills, but it also demands strong teamwork.
sentence_zh: 這個專案不僅需要多種技能，而且還需要強大的團隊合作。

definition_zh: (名) 乘法；倍增
example_sentence: The multiplication method that students learned in primary school is fundamental to advanced mathematics.
sentence_zh: 學生在小學學過的乘法方法對高等數學來說是基礎。

definition_zh: (動) 乘以；相乘　(動) 增加；繁殖
example_sentence: Students need to multiply these numbers to solve the math problem quickly.
sentence_zh: 學生需要將這些數字相乘以快速解決數學問題。

definition_zh: (動) 同時處理多項工作；一心多用
example_sentence: Students multitasking during online classes often struggle to concentrate effectively.
sentence_zh: 在線上課程中同時處理多項工作的學生往往難以有效集中注意力。

definition_zh: (名) 同時處理多項工作；多工
example_sentence: Doing homework while watching videos is multitasking, but it often lowers study quality.
sentence_zh: 一邊做功課一邊看影片是多工處理，但通常會降低讀書品質。

definition_zh: (名) 大量；眾多　(名) 群眾；大批人群
example_sentence: Although a multitude of students applied for the scholarship, only ten were selected by the committee.
sentence_zh: 雖然有大量學生申請獎學金，但委員會只選了十位。

definition_zh: (動) 含糊地說；咕噥　(名) 含糊的聲音；低聲說話
example_sentence: Mumbling his excuses, the student handed in his late homework to the teacher.
sentence_zh: 那名學生含糊地說著藉口，把遲交的功課交給了老師。

definition_zh: (名) 腮腺炎；流行性腮腺炎
example_sentence: The contagious disease mumps, which spreads through saliva droplets, causes facial swelling.
sentence_zh: 腮腺炎這種透過唾液飛沫傳播的傳染病會導致臉部腫脹。

definition_zh: (動) 咀嚼；大口吃　(動) 發出咀嚼聲
example_sentence: If you munch snacks while studying, your concentration will definitely decrease.
sentence_zh: 如果你在讀書時咀嚼零食，你的專注力肯定會下降。

definition_zh: (形) 平凡的；單調的　(形) 日常的；普通的
example_sentence: Studying the same textbook every day feels mundane and boring to many students.
sentence_zh: 每天讀同一本課本對許多學生來說感覺很平凡無趣。

definition_zh: (形) 市政的；市立的　(形) 地方政府的；城市的
example_sentence: The city council approved a new budget to improve municipal services for residents.
sentence_zh: 市議會批准了新預算以改善居民的市政服務。

definition_zh: (名) 壁畫；牆上的畫　(形) 牆壁的；壁的
example_sentence: The colorful mural on the school building wall celebrates our local community.
sentence_zh: 學校建築物牆上的彩色壁畫慶祝我們的在地社區。

definition_zh: (名) 謀殺；兇殺　(動) 謀殺；兇殺
example_sentence: Although the detective solved the murder case, the criminal escaped before arrest.
sentence_zh: 雖然偵探破解了謀殺案件，但犯人在逮捕前逃脫了。

definition_zh: (名) 謀殺犯；殺人兇手
