example_sentence: Having committed the crime years ago, the murderer was finally arrested by police detectives.
sentence_zh: 多年前犯下罪行的那個殺人兇手終於被警探逮捕了。

definition_zh: (動) 使混濁；弄髒　(形) 黑暗的；模糊的
example_sentence: The water that murks easily after rain makes the river unsafe for swimming.
sentence_zh: 雨後容易變混濁的水讓河流不適合游泳。

definition_zh: (形) 陰暗的；模糊的　(形) 渾濁的；不清澈的
example_sentence: The murky water in the old pond made it impossible to see the bottom clearly.
sentence_zh: 老池塘中陰暗渾濁的水使得人們無法清楚地看到底部。

definition_zh: (動) 低聲說話；嘀咕　(名) 低聲的說話；嘟囔聲
example_sentence: If students murmured complaints during the exam, teachers would immediately ask them to leave the classroom.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試時低聲嘀咕抱怨，老師就會立刻要求他們離開教室。

definition_zh: (動) 強行進入；硬擠進去　(動) 強佔；奪取
example_sentence: The new company muscled in on the market and took away many customers.
sentence_zh: 那家新公司硬擠進市場，搶走了許多顧客。

definition_zh: (動) 強行介入；硬闖進去
example_sentence: Muscling in on the project without permission, the new manager upset the entire team.
sentence_zh: 那位新經理未經許可強行介入這個專案，惹惱了整個團隊。

definition_zh: (動) 強行進入；硬擠進去
example_sentence: Although the new company lacked experience, it muscled into the competitive market by offering lower prices.
sentence_zh: 雖然這家新公司缺乏經驗，但它透過提供更低的價格而強行進入競爭激烈的市場。

definition_zh: (動) 用力擠出；強行進入；排擠他人
example_sentence: Hardly could the smaller company muscle out its larger competitors without strategic innovation.
sentence_zh: 沒有策略創新，較小的公司幾乎無法排擠較大的競爭對手。

definition_zh: (名) 肌肉；肌肉組織　(名) 力量；體力
example_sentence: Athletes who develop strong muscle through regular training often achieve better sports performance.
sentence_zh: 通過定期訓練而發達強健肌肉的運動員往往能取得更好的運動成績。

definition_zh: (形) 肌肉發達的；強健的
example_sentence: Athletes train hard every day to build muscular strength for competition.
sentence_zh: 運動員每天努力訓練以增強肌肉力量來參加比賽。

definition_zh: (動) 沉思；冥想　(名) 繆思；靈感女神
example_sentence: Lost in thought, the poet mused on life's deepest questions and mysteries.
sentence_zh: 陷入沉思中，詩人冥想著人生最深層的問題和謎團。

definition_zh: (名) 博物館；美術館
example_sentence: The museum displays ancient artifacts from thousands of years ago.
sentence_zh: 這間博物館展示來自數千年前的古代文物。

definition_zh: (名) 蘑菇；菌類　(動) 迅速增長；蓬勃發展
example_sentence: As the rainy season arrived, mushrooms sprouted everywhere in the forest.
sentence_zh: 當雨季來臨時，蘑菇在森林各處迅速生長。

definition_zh: (形) 軟爛的；感傷的；多愁善感的
example_sentence: Becoming mushy after watching romantic movies, teenagers often call their friends to share feelings.
sentence_zh: 看完愛情電影後變得感傷，青少年常常打電話給朋友分享感受。

definition_zh: (名) 音樂；樂曲　(動) 為…譜曲
example_sentence: The concert features music that attracts thousands of teenagers every year.
sentence_zh: 這場音樂會演奏吸引數千名青少年的音樂。

definition_zh: (形) 音樂的；有音樂天賦的　(名) 音樂劇；歌舞劇
example_sentence: If students practice musical instruments regularly, their concentration and memory will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生定期練習樂器，他們的專注力和記憶力將會顯著進步。

definition_zh: (名) 音樂家；音樂人
example_sentence: The musician played the piano beautifully at the school concert.
sentence_zh: 那位音樂家在學校音樂會上彈奏鋼琴彈得很優美。

definition_zh: (名) 穆斯林；伊斯蘭教信徒
example_sentence: Many organizations work to promote interfaith dialogue to better understand Muslim communities.
sentence_zh: 許多組織致力於促進宗教間對話，以便更好地理解穆斯林社區。

definition_zh: (名) 貽貝；淡菜　(名) 肌肉
example_sentence: Fresh mussels from the seafood market taste delicious when steamed with garlic.
sentence_zh: 來自海鮮市場的新鮮貽貝用大蒜蒸後味道很好吃。

definition_zh: (助) 必須；一定　(動) 必定；應該
example_sentence: Students must study hard if they want to pass the college entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 如果學生想要通過大學入學考試，就必須努力讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 鬍子；八字鬍
example_sentence: Having grown a thick mustache over the summer, the actor looked completely different in the new film.
sentence_zh: 那位演員在夏天留了濃密的鬍子，在新電影中看起來完全不同。

definition_zh: (名) 芥末；黃色調料　(形) 芥末色的；黃褐色的
example_sentence: The spicy mustard sauce that the restaurant serves is loved by many customers.
sentence_zh: 餐廳提供的那種辛辣芥末醬很受許多顧客喜愛。

definition_zh: (助) 一定不；千萬別
example_sentence: Students must not bring mobile phones into the examination hall.
sentence_zh: 學生千萬別把手機帶進考試會場。

definition_zh: (名) 突變體；變種生物　(形) 變異的；突變的
example_sentence: If the virus were to mutate into a dangerous strain, hospitals would need better equipment.
sentence_zh: 如果病毒變成危險的病株，醫院就需要更好的設備。

definition_zh: (動) 突變；改變　(動) 使發生突變
example_sentence: Exposure to radiation can cause cells to mutate into cancer.
sentence_zh: 暴露在輻射中會導致細胞突變成癌症。

definition_zh: (名) 突變；變異　(名) 基因突變；遺傳變化
example_sentence: Mutations occurring in DNA can cause significant changes in living organisms.
sentence_zh: 發生在DNA中的突變會導致生物體出現重大變化。

definition_zh: (形) 沉默的；無聲的　(動) 使沉默；消音
example_sentence: Although the student remained mute during the debate, his written arguments were quite persuasive.
sentence_zh: 雖然這位學生在辯論中保持沉默，但他的書面論點相當有說服力。

definition_zh: (動) 殘害；毀損　(動) 切斷；截肢
example_sentence: Only after the accident did the doctors mutilate his damaged leg to save his life.
sentence_zh: 只有在事故發生後，醫生才切斷了他受損的腿來拯救他的生命。

definition_zh: (動) 低聲說話；嘀咕　(名) 低聲的抱怨
example_sentence: The frustrated student muttered complaints that nobody could hear clearly in class.
sentence_zh: 那位沮喪的學生低聲說著沒人能在課堂上清楚聽到的抱怨。

definition_zh: (名) 羊肉（來自成年綿羊）
example_sentence: Many restaurants offer mutton dishes to provide customers with rich protein.
sentence_zh: 許多餐廳提供羊肉料理以便顧客獲取豐富的蛋白質。

definition_zh: (形) 相互的；彼此的　(形) 共同的；雙方的
example_sentence: Building mutual respect and trust between partners is essential for success.
sentence_zh: 在夥伴之間建立相互尊重和信任對成功至關重要。

definition_zh: (副) 相互地；互相地　彼此地；相互之間
example_sentence: The two countries agreed mutually to reduce trade barriers and increase cooperation.
sentence_zh: 這兩個國家互相同意減少貿易障礙並加強合作。

definition_zh: (名) 近視；目光短淺
example_sentence: Although myopia affects many teenagers, wearing corrective glasses helps them see the blackboard clearly.
sentence_zh: 雖然近視影響許多青少年，但配戴矯正眼鏡幫助他們清楚看見黑板。

definition_zh: (名) 極多的數量；無數　(形) 無數的；極多的
example_sentence: Facing myriad problems arising from climate change, scientists worldwide are collaborating on sustainable solutions.
sentence_zh: 面對由氣候變遷引起的無數問題，全球科學家正在合作尋求永續解決方案。

definition_zh: (形) 神祕的；謎一樣的　(形) 難以理解的；隱祕的
example_sentence: The old mansion that stood on the hilltop was mysterious, attracting curious visitors every weekend.
sentence_zh: 那棟矗立在山頂上的老宅邸是神祕的，每個週末都吸引好奇的訪客。

definition_zh: (副) 神秘地；詭秘地　以神祕或不清楚的方式
example_sentence: If the ancient temple disappears mysteriously, archaeologists will investigate the cause carefully.
sentence_zh: 如果古老廟宇神祕地消失，考古學家將會仔細調查原因。

definition_zh: (名) 謎；神祕的事物　(形) 神祕的；難以理解的
example_sentence: The old castle on the hill remains a mystery to local residents.
sentence_zh: 山上的老城堡對當地居民來說仍然是個謎。

definition_zh: (形) 神祕的；奧祕的　(名) 神祕主義者；靈性修行者
example_sentence: Ancient monks studied mystic texts to understand the spiritual world.
sentence_zh: 古代僧侶研究神祕的經文以瞭解靈性世界。

definition_zh: (形) 神祕的；奧祕的　(形) 靈性的；超自然的
example_sentence: The ancient temple hidden in the mountains has a mystical and spiritual atmosphere that attracts many visitors.
sentence_zh: 隱藏在山區的古廟擁有神祕而靈性的氛圍，吸引許多遊客前來。

definition_zh: (名) 神祕感；魅力　(形) 神祕的；難以理解的
example_sentence: Although the celebrity's mystique attracts millions of fans, her private life remains completely unknown to the public.
sentence_zh: 雖然這位名人的神祕感吸引了數百萬粉絲，但她的私生活對大眾來說仍然完全未知。

definition_zh: (名) 神話；傳說　(名) 虛假的信念；謊言
example_sentence: Having studied ancient cultures, scholars debunked the myth that Greeks invented democracy alone.
sentence_zh: 經過研究古代文明，學者們戳穿了古希臘人獨自發明民主制度的神話。

definition_zh: (形) 神話的；傳說的　(形) 虛構的；想像的
example_sentence: The mythic hero whose adventures inspired countless generations remains a cultural symbol.
sentence_zh: 那位激勵無數世代冒險故事的神話英雄仍然是文化象徵。

definition_zh: (名) 神話；神話故事　(名) 神話體系；傳說
example_sentence: If ancient Greek mythology did not exist, modern literature would lack countless inspiring stories.
sentence_zh: 如果古希臘神話不存在，現代文學將缺少無數鼓舞人心的故事。

definition_zh: (名) 最低點；最差時期　(名) 天底點；對點
example_sentence: After failing the entrance exam, Tom felt he had reached the nadir of his academic career.
sentence_zh: 在入學考試失敗後，湯姆感覺他的學業生涯已經到達了最低點。

definition_zh: (片) 滾開；閉嘴　(片) 去死一邊去
example_sentence: Telling annoying classmates to naff off, frustrated students finally enjoyed peaceful lunch breaks.
sentence_zh: 叫那些煩人的同學滾開，沮喪的學生終於享受到安靜的午餐時間。

definition_zh: (動) 不斷嘮叨；持續抱怨
example_sentence: Although Sarah's mother nagged at her about studying harder, she still preferred scrolling through social media.
sentence_zh: 雖然莎拉的媽媽不斷嘮叨她要更用功讀書，但她仍然寧可滑手機。

definition_zh: (動) 嘮叨；煩擾　(名) 愛嘮叨的人
example_sentence: Seldom does Mother nag about household chores without good reason.
sentence_zh: 母親很少沒有正當理由就為家務嘮叨。

definition_zh: (動) 確定；敲定　(動) 釘牢；固定
example_sentence: The contract that both companies nail down will take effect next month.
sentence_zh: 兩家公司敲定的合約將於下個月生效。

definition_zh: (名) 釘子；指甲　(動) 釘；固定
example_sentence: The carpenter used nails to secure the wooden boards together.
sentence_zh: 木匠用釘子將木板固定在一起。

definition_zh: (形) 天真的；單純的　(形) 缺乏經驗的；幼稚的
example_sentence: The naive student believed every word the salesman said without questioning.
sentence_zh: 那個天真的學生沒有質疑就相信了銷售員說的每句話。

definition_zh: (副) 天真地；幼稚地　(副) 輕信地；不懷疑地
example_sentence: Students naively believed that studying the night before would guarantee exam success.
sentence_zh: 學生們天真地相信臨時抱佛腳會保證考試成功。

definition_zh: (形) 赤裸的；裸露的　(形) 無防護的；無掩飾的
example_sentence: Although the trees stood naked in winter, they would soon regain their leaves.
sentence_zh: 雖然樹木在冬天赤裸裸地站著，但它們很快就會重新長出葉子。

definition_zh: (動) 以...命名；按...起名　(動) 為了紀念...而命名
example_sentence: The baby girl, whom parents named after a famous actress, brought joy to the family.
sentence_zh: 這個嬰兒女孩是按一位著名女演員命名的，為家庭帶來了喜悅。

definition_zh: (名) 名字；名稱　(動) 命名；取名
example_sentence: If you name your pet dog Lucky, it will bring good fortune to your family.
sentence_zh: 如果你替寵物狗取名為Lucky，它會為你的家庭帶來好運。

definition_zh: (動) 命名；取名　(形) 被命名的；有名字的
example_sentence: The university named its new library after a famous alumnus.
sentence_zh: 這所大學以一位著名校友的名字命名了新圖書館。

definition_zh: (副) 也就是說；即　(連) 即；也就是
example_sentence: The school offers three main subjects, namely English, mathematics, and history, to help students prepare for university entrance.
sentence_zh: 學校提供三門主要科目，即英文、數學和歷史，以幫助學生準備大學入學考試。

definition_zh: (名) 保姆；褓姆　(動) 照顧小孩
example_sentence: The nanny picks up the children from school every afternoon.
sentence_zh: 那位保姆每天下午都去學校接小孩。

definition_zh: (名) 小睡；打盹　(動) 打盹；小睡
example_sentence: As the teacher lectured about history, several students took a nap in the back row.
sentence_zh: 當老師講述歷史時，幾位學生在後排打盹。

definition_zh: (名) 餐巾；餐紙　(名) 衛生紙；紙巾
example_sentence: Having spilled juice on the tablecloth, the hostess quickly grabbed a napkin to wipe it clean.
sentence_zh: 主人在桌布上灑了果汁後，迅速拿起餐巾擦乾淨。

definition_zh: (名) 自戀；自我中心
example_sentence: The influencer's narcissism, which was evident in every post, eventually damaged his reputation.
sentence_zh: 這位網紅的自戀，在每篇貼文中都很明顯，最終損害了他的名譽。

definition_zh: (名) 水仙花；自戀者
example_sentence: The narcissus flowers blooming in spring gardens attract many visitors each year.
sentence_zh: 春天花園裡盛開的水仙花每年都吸引許多遊客。

definition_zh: (動) 敘述；講述　(動) 旁白；配音解說
example_sentence: If the documentary narrator narrated the story more clearly, audiences would understand the historical events better.
sentence_zh: 如果紀錄片旁白員敘述故事更清楚，觀眾就會更了解這些歷史事件。

definition_zh: (名) 敘述；故事　(形) 敘述的；故事性的
example_sentence: The film's narrative follows a young woman discovering her family's hidden past.
sentence_zh: 這部電影的敘述跟隨一名年輕女性發現她家族隱藏的過去。

definition_zh: (名) 敘述者；旁白者　(名) 講述故事的人
example_sentence: Speaking directly to the audience, the narrator explained the mysterious events unfolding in the ancient village.
sentence_zh: 直接對觀眾說話，敘述者解釋了發生在古老村莊裡的神祕事件。

definition_zh: (動) 縮小範圍；排除選項　(動) 消除；淘汰
example_sentence: As candidates eliminated unsuitable options, the selection committee narrowed down the list to five finalists.
sentence_zh: 當候選人排除了不合適的選項，選拔委員會就把名單縮小到五位決賽者。

definition_zh: (形) 狹窄的；狹隘的　(動) 縮小；變窄
example_sentence: Hardly had the path narrowed before the hikers found themselves surrounded by tall trees.
sentence_zh: 小徑幾乎一變窄，登山者就發現自己被高樹包圍了。

definition_zh: (副) 勉強地；差一點　(副) 狹窄地；局限地
example_sentence: The student who narrowly passed the exam studied harder for the next test.
sentence_zh: 那位勉強及格的學生為下次考試更用功讀書。

definition_zh: (形) 鼻的；鼻音的　(名) 鼻音
example_sentence: Students practiced pronouncing nasal consonants to improve their English accent.
sentence_zh: 學生練習發鼻音輔音以改進英文口音。

definition_zh: (形) 令人厭惡的；討厭的　(形) 惡劣的；不愉快的
example_sentence: Dealing with nasty weather and broken equipment made the school trip quite challenging.
sentence_zh: 應對惡劣的天氣和損壞的設備使得這次校外旅行相當具有挑戰性。

definition_zh: (名) 國家；民族
example_sentence: Every nation has its own flag and national anthem.
sentence_zh: 每個國家都有自己的國旗和國歌。

definition_zh: (形) 國家的；民族的　(形) 全國性的；國民的
example_sentence: Although national examinations are challenging, many students prepare hard every day.
sentence_zh: 雖然國家考試很困難，許多學生每天都努力準備。

definition_zh: (形) 國家的；民族的　(形) 全國的；國內的
example_sentence: Participating in the national math competition, many students gain valuable experience.
sentence_zh: 參加全國數學競賽的許多學生獲得了寶貴的經驗。

definition_zh: (名) 民族主義；國家主義
example_sentence: The rise of nationalism, which emphasizes national pride and identity, has shaped modern political movements worldwide.
sentence_zh: 強調國家尊嚴和認同的民族主義興起，已塑造了全球現代政治運動。

definition_zh: (名) 民族主義者；國家主義者　(形) 民族主義的；國家主義的
example_sentence: If the nationalist movement continues to grow, the government would need to address citizens' demands more carefully.
sentence_zh: 如果民族主義運動持續增長，政府將需要更認真地回應公民的要求。

definition_zh: (名) 國籍；國民身份　(名) 民族；國民性
example_sentence: Many students apply for different nationalities after completing their university education.
sentence_zh: 許多學生完成大學教育後申請不同的國籍。

definition_zh: (形) 全國的；遍及全國的　(副) 在全國範圍內
example_sentence: The government launched a nationwide campaign to promote environmental protection across all cities.
sentence_zh: 政府啟動了全國性的宣傳活動，以便在所有城市推廣環境保護。

definition_zh: (介) 原產於；源自於　(形) 原生於；土生土長的
example_sentence: The koala, native to Australia, is found nowhere else in the wild.
sentence_zh: 無尾熊原產於澳洲，在野生環境中別處找不到。

definition_zh: (形) 本地的；本國的　(名) 本地人；原住民
example_sentence: Native speakers often pronounce words differently because they learned the language from childhood.
sentence_zh: 本地使用者的發音常常不同，因為他們從小就學習這種語言。

definition_zh: (形) 自然的；天然的　(形) 正常的；自然而然的
example_sentence: Having practiced piano for years, the musician's performance sounded completely natural and effortless.
sentence_zh: 那位音樂家練習鋼琴多年後，表演聽起來完全自然輕鬆。

definition_zh: (名) 自然學家；博物學家　(名) 裸體主義者
example_sentence: The naturalist who studied tropical birds discovered three unknown species in the rainforest.
sentence_zh: 那位研究熱帶鳥類的自然學家在雨林中發現了三個未知物種。

definition_zh: (副) 自然地；當然　(副) 天生地；與生俱來地
example_sentence: Naturally curious about science, many students choose to study biology and chemistry in senior year.
sentence_zh: 對科學充滿好奇心的許多學生，自然地選擇在高中時期學習生物和化學。

definition_zh: (名) 自然；大自然　(名) 本性；特性
example_sentence: If people understood nature better, they would protect the environment more seriously.
sentence_zh: 如果人們更了解大自然，他們會更認真地保護環境。

definition_zh: (形) 調皮的；淘氣的　(形) 不聽話的；頑皮的
example_sentence: The naughty child refused to listen to the teacher's instructions during class.
sentence_zh: 那個調皮的孩子在上課時拒絕聽老師的指示。

definition_zh: (名) 噁心；想吐　(動) 使噁心；使厭煩
example_sentence: Feeling nausea after eating too much seafood, Sarah decided to rest in the car.
sentence_zh: 莎拉吃了太多海鮮後感到噁心，決定在車裡休息。

definition_zh: (形) 航海的；船舶的　與航海或船隻有關的
example_sentence: Although nautical terms are difficult, sailors must master them before embarking on long voyages.
sentence_zh: 雖然航海術語很難，但水手在長途航海前必須掌握它們。

definition_zh: (形) 海軍的；軍艦的
example_sentence: Only after extensive naval training did the recruits master advanced combat skills.
sentence_zh: 只有在進行大量海軍訓練之後，新兵才掌握了先進的戰鬥技能。

definition_zh: (名) 肚臍；臍部
example_sentence: The belly button, which is also called the navel, is the scar left after birth.
sentence_zh: 肚臍，也叫做臍部的地方，是出生後留下的疤痕。

definition_zh: (動) 航行；導航　航行；駕駛
example_sentence: Pilots use advanced technology to navigate through dense clouds safely.
sentence_zh: 飛行員使用先進技術在密集的雲層中安全航行。

definition_zh: (名) 導航；航海　(名) 船舶航行；飛行
example_sentence: GPS navigation systems help drivers find the fastest route to their destinations.
sentence_zh: GPS導航系統幫助駕駛者找到前往目的地最快的路線。

definition_zh: (名) 航海者；導航員　(名) 導航系統；衛星定位器
example_sentence: The ship's navigator used a map and compass to find the correct route across the ocean.
sentence_zh: 船上的航海者用地圖和羅盤找到穿越大洋的正確路線。

definition_zh: (名) 海軍；艦隊　(形) 深藍色的；海軍的
example_sentence: As the navy expanded its operations, more young people joined the military service.
sentence_zh: 當海軍擴大行動時，更多年輕人加入軍事服務。

definition_zh: (名) 納粹黨人；納粹主義者　(形) 納粹的；法西斯的
example_sentence: Studying Nazi Germany's history, students understood the dangers of totalitarianism.
sentence_zh: 研究納粹德國的歷史，學生們理解了極權主義的危害。

definition_zh: (形) 靠近的；接近的　(介) 在...附近；靠近
example_sentence: The convenience store near the school is where students often study.
sentence_zh: 靠近學校的便利商店是學生經常讀書的地方。

definition_zh: (形) 附近的；鄰近的　(副) 在附近；靠近
example_sentence: If a convenience store is nearby, students can buy lunch without traveling far.
sentence_zh: 如果附近有便利商店，學生就可以不用走遠就買午餐。

definition_zh: (副) 幾乎；差不多　(副) 接近；靠近
example_sentence: The exam is nearly finished, and most students have already submitted their papers.
sentence_zh: 考試幾乎快結束了，大多數學生已經交卷了。

definition_zh: (形) 近視的；目光短淺的
example_sentence: Wearing glasses helps nearsighted students to see the blackboard clearly during class.
sentence_zh: 戴眼鏡幫助近視的學生在課堂上清楚地看到黑板。

definition_zh: (名) 近視；近視眼
example_sentence: Nearsightedness is a common eye condition affecting many high school students who study long hours.
sentence_zh: 近視是一種常見的眼睛疾病，影響許多長時間讀書的高中學生。

definition_zh: (形) 整潔的；乾淨的　(形) 巧妙的；靈巧的
example_sentence: Although the room was small, it looked neat because Maria organized everything carefully.
sentence_zh: 雖然房間很小，但因為瑪麗亞仔細整理一切，所以看起來很整潔。

definition_zh: (副) 必然地；必定　(副) 必要地；不得不
example_sentence: Having finished the exam early, students don't necessarily leave the classroom immediately afterward.
sentence_zh: 已經提早完成考試的學生不一定要立刻離開教室。

definition_zh: (形) 必要的；需要的　(形) 不可避免的；必然的
example_sentence: The skills that are necessary for passing the CSAT exam require consistent practice.
sentence_zh: 通過學測所必要的技能需要持續練習。

definition_zh: (動) 需要；必需　使成為必要
example_sentence: The sudden budget cuts necessitate finding new ways to reduce spending without affecting quality.
sentence_zh: 突然的預算削減需要找到新的方法來降低支出，同時不影響品質。

definition_zh: (名) 必需；必要性　(名) 必需品；生活必需物
example_sentence: If basic education were not a necessity, many families would not sacrifice for their children's tuition.
sentence_zh: 如果基礎教育不是必需品，許多家庭就不會為孩子的學費而犧牲。

definition_zh: (名) 脖子；頸部　(名) 衣領；領口
example_sentence: The scarf around my neck keeps me warm on cold winter days.
sentence_zh: 圍繞在我脖子上的圍巾在寒冷的冬天讓我保持溫暖。

definition_zh: (名) 項鍊；頸飾
example_sentence: Wearing a delicate silver necklace, Sarah felt more confident during her job interview.
sentence_zh: 戴著精緻的銀項鍊，莎拉在工作面試中感到更自信。

definition_zh: (名) 領帶；頸帶
example_sentence: Although wearing a necktie makes students feel uncomfortable, many schools require it for formal occasions.
sentence_zh: 雖然穿領帶讓學生感到不舒服，但許多學校在正式場合要求穿著。

definition_zh: (名) 花蜜；甘露　(名) 神酒；美酒
example_sentence: Only after bees drink nectar from flowers can they produce honey.
sentence_zh: 只有在蜜蜂從花朵吸取花蜜後，牠們才能製造蜂蜜。

definition_zh: (動) 需要；必須　(名) 需要；必需品
example_sentence: The textbooks that students need for the exam are available in the school library.
sentence_zh: 學生準備考試所需的教科書在學校圖書館都有。

definition_zh: (名) 針；針頭　(動) 用針刺；慢慢推進
example_sentence: The nurse used a needle to inject medicine into the patient's arm.
sentence_zh: 護士用針在病人的手臂上注射藥物。

definition_zh: (片) 不用說；當然；顯而易見
example_sentence: Needless to say, studying hard is essential for passing the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 不用說，認真讀書對於通過學測考試是必要的。

definition_zh: (形) 不必要的；不需要的
example_sentence: Needless to say, studying hard is the key to passing exams.
sentence_zh: 不用說，認真讀書是通過考試的關鍵。

definition_zh: (形) 需要幫助的；貧困的　(形) 過度依賴他人的；黏人的
example_sentence: Since Mark felt needy after his parents moved away, his friends tried to support him more often.
sentence_zh: 因為馬克在父母搬家後感到需要依靠別人，他的朋友試著更常支持他。

definition_zh: (形) 邪惡的；罪惡的　(形) 危害的；有害的
example_sentence: Having committed nefarious crimes for years, the fugitive finally faced justice in court.
sentence_zh: 多年來犯下邪惡罪行的逃犯終於在法庭上面臨正義的制裁。

definition_zh: (動) 否定；駁斥　(動) 抵消；使無效
example_sentence: The evidence that negates the original theory requires careful scientific examination.
sentence_zh: 否定原始理論的證據需要仔細的科學檢驗。

definition_zh: (形) 否定的；消極的　(名) 否定；負面的事物
example_sentence: If students adopt a negative attitude toward studying, their grades will definitely suffer.
sentence_zh: 如果學生對學習採取消極態度，他們的成績肯定會受到影響。

definition_zh: (動) 忽視；疏忽　(名) 疏忽；忽視
example_sentence: Neglecting homework and sleep will hurt your health during exam preparation.
sentence_zh: 在備考期間忽視功課和睡眠會傷害你的健康。

definition_zh: (形) 疏忽的；不細心的　(形) 怠慢的；不負責任的
example_sentence: Parents should not be neglectful in order to ensure their children's healthy development.
sentence_zh: 父母不應該疏忽，以便確保孩子健康發展。

definition_zh: (副) 疏忽地；不謹慎地　粗心地；漫不經心地
example_sentence: The student neglectfully left important notes at home before the final exam.
sentence_zh: 那名學生粗心地在期末考前將重要筆記遺留在家。

definition_zh: (名) 疏忽；過失　(名) 不小心；粗心
example_sentence: Because negligence caused the accident, the factory was fined heavily by the government.
sentence_zh: 由於疏忽導致了這起事故，該工廠被政府罰款很重。

definition_zh: (形) 疏忽的；不小心的　(形) 草率的；馬虎的
example_sentence: Having neglected safety procedures, the negligent factory manager faced serious consequences.
sentence_zh: 由於忽視安全規程，那位疏忽的工廠經理面臨嚴重後果。

definition_zh: (形) 可以忽略的；微不足道的　(形) 極少的；不重要的
example_sentence: The cost increase, which is negligible compared to total expenses, won't affect budget planning.
sentence_zh: 成本增加微不足道，與總支出相比不會影響預算規劃。

definition_zh: (動) 談判；協商　(動) 克服；度過
example_sentence: The two countries negotiated a trade agreement to resolve their economic disputes.
sentence_zh: 這兩個國家透過談判達成貿易協議以解決經濟爭議。

definition_zh: (名) 協商；談判　(動) 進行談判；協商
example_sentence: If both companies entered serious negotiation, a fair contract would be reached within weeks.
sentence_zh: 如果兩家公司進行認真談判，公平的合約將在數週內達成。

definition_zh: (名) 談判者；協商人　(名) 協商代表；仲介人
example_sentence: The trade negotiator worked hard to reach an agreement between the two countries.
sentence_zh: 貿易談判者努力在兩國之間達成協議。

definition_zh: (名) 鄰居；隔壁的人　(動) 與...相鄰；毗鄰
example_sentence: Living next to a helpful neighbor, Sarah found it easy to borrow tools and ask for advice.
sentence_zh: 住在樂於助人的鄰居隔壁，莎拉發現很容易借用工具和請求建議。

definition_zh: (名) 鄰近地區；社區　(名) 鄰近的人；鄰居
example_sentence: As the neighborhood became safer, more families decided to move there.
sentence_zh: 由於鄰近地區變得更安全，更多家庭決定搬到那裡。

definition_zh: (形) 相鄰的；鄰近的　(名) 鄰近地區；相鄰的事物
example_sentence: Hardly ever do neighboring countries resolve territorial disputes without international mediation.
sentence_zh: 相鄰國家很少在沒有國際調解的情況下解決領土爭端。

definition_zh: (形) 兩個都不；都不是　(連) 也不；既不
example_sentence: Neither of the two solutions that the engineering team proposed could solve the problem completely.
sentence_zh: 工程團隊提出的兩個解決方案都無法完全解決這個問題。

definition_zh: (名) 宿敵；克星　(名) 報應；懲罰
example_sentence: The rival team trained hard to defeat their longtime nemesis in the championship game.
sentence_zh: 對手隊伍努力訓練，目的是在冠軍賽中擊敗他們的宿敵。

definition_zh: (名) 霓虹；霓虹燈　(形) 霓虹色的；鮮豔的
example_sentence: The neon sign outside the convenience store glows brightly at night.
sentence_zh: 便利商店外面的霓虹招牌在夜間發出明亮的光。

definition_zh: (名) 外甥；侄子
example_sentence: My uncle's son is my nephew, and we often play basketball together.
sentence_zh: 我叔叔的兒子是我的外甥，我們常一起打籃球。

definition_zh: (名) 裙帶關係；用人唯親
example_sentence: Although the company claimed to hire based on merit, nepotism flourished whenever the CEO's relatives applied for positions.
sentence_zh: 雖然公司聲稱根據能力聘僱員工，但只要執行長的親戚申請職位，用人唯親的現象就會出現。

definition_zh: (名) 書呆子；不善社交的人　(形) 書呆子的；沉迷於學習的
example_sentence: Spending countless hours coding, the nerd developed an impressive programming skill.
sentence_zh: 那個書呆子花無數小時編寫程式，培養了令人印象深刻的程式設計能力。

definition_zh: (形) 令人極度緊張的；讓人感到焦慮不安的
example_sentence: The university entrance exam, which is nerve-wracking for most students, requires months of preparation.
sentence_zh: 大學入學考試對大多數學生來說令人極度緊張，需要好幾個月的準備。

definition_zh: (名) 神經；勇氣　(動) 鼓起勇氣；使膽怯
example_sentence: If students nerve themselves before the exam, they will perform better under pressure.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試前鼓起勇氣，他們在壓力下會表現得更好。

definition_zh: (形) 緊張的；不安的　(形) 膽小的；害怕的
example_sentence: Many students feel nervous before taking the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在參加學測前感到緊張。

definition_zh: (名) 緊張；神經質　(名) 不安；焦慮
example_sentence: Taking deep breaths before the exam helps reduce nervousness and improve focus.
sentence_zh: 考試前深呼吸有助於減少緊張感並提高專注力。

definition_zh: (名) 巢；窩　(動) 築巢；嵌入
example_sentence: The bird built its nest high in the old oak tree near our school.
sentence_zh: 那隻鳥在學校附近的老橡樹上築了一個很高的巢。

definition_zh: (動) 舒適地依靠；窩著　(動) 靠近；親密接觸
example_sentence: As the winter wind grew colder, the cat nestled deeper into its warm blanket.
sentence_zh: 當冬風變得更冷時，貓舒適地窩在溫暖的毛毯裡。

definition_zh: (名) 網；網子　(動) 用網捕捉；獲得淨利　(形) 淨的；純的
example_sentence: Having caught in the net, the fish struggled desperately to escape.
sentence_zh: 被網捕住後，那條魚拼命掙扎逃脫。

definition_zh: (名) 網民；網路使用者
example_sentence: Netizens who actively participate in online discussions often influence public opinion on social media.
sentence_zh: 積極參與線上討論的網民經常在社群媒體上影響輿論。

definition_zh: (名) 網絡；網路　(動) 建立關係；交際
example_sentence: Building a strong professional network helps students find better job opportunities after graduation.
sentence_zh: 建立強大的專業網絡幫助學生在畢業後找到更好的工作機會。

definition_zh: (名) 人脈建立；網路交流　(動) 建立人脈；進行網路交流
example_sentence: If students invested more time in networking, they would build stronger professional connections for their future careers.
sentence_zh: 如果學生投入更多時間建立人脈，他們將為未來的職業發展建立更強大的專業關係。

definition_zh: (名) 神經科醫生；腦科專家
example_sentence: The neurologist diagnosed the patient's headache as a common migraine.
sentence_zh: 神經科醫生診斷那位患者的頭痛是普通的偏頭痛。

definition_zh: (動) 閹割；使成無性別　(形) 中性的；無性別的
example_sentence: Neutering the cat, the veterinarian ensured it would not reproduce.
sentence_zh: 獸醫替那隻貓進行閹割手術，確保牠無法繁殖。

definition_zh: (形) 中立的；不偏不倚　(形) 中性的；無色的
example_sentence: Although both countries had different views, Switzerland remained neutral when the conflict broke out.
sentence_zh: 儘管兩國觀點不同，但瑞士在衝突爆發時保持中立。

definition_zh: (名) 中子；(物理學中原子核內不帶電的粒子)
example_sentence: Only after scientists discovered the neutron did our understanding of atomic structure fundamentally change.
sentence_zh: 只有在科學家發現中子之後，我們對原子結構的理解才根本改變。

definition_zh: (副) 從不；決不　(副) 絕不會
example_sentence: Students who never study hard will regret their decision during exam season.
sentence_zh: 那些從不努力讀書的學生在考試季節會後悔他們的決定。

definition_zh: (形) 無盡的；永無止境的　(形) 連續不斷的；不停止的
example_sentence: Students study neverending grammar rules to master English communication skills.
sentence_zh: 學生研習永無止境的文法規則以掌握英文溝通技能。

definition_zh: (副) 然而；不過　(連) 儘管如此；但是
example_sentence: The weather was terrible; nevertheless, thousands of students attended the outdoor study camp.
sentence_zh: 天氣很糟；然而，數千名學生參加了戶外讀書營。

definition_zh: (形) 新的；嶄新的　(形) 陌生的；不熟悉的
example_sentence: Sarah bought a new phone last week and loves it.
sentence_zh: 莎拉上週買了一支新手機，她很喜歡。

definition_zh: (名) 新來的人；新手　(名) 初入者；剛到的人
example_sentence: Although Sarah was a newcomer to the debate club, she won the first round because she practiced hard.
sentence_zh: 雖然莎拉是辯論社的新手，但她因為認真練習而贏得第一輪比賽。

definition_zh: (副) 最近；新近　(形) 新的；剛成立的
example_sentence: Newly built schools in the city provide modern facilities for students learning there.
sentence_zh: 城市裡新建的學校為在那裡學習的學生提供現代化設施。

definition_zh: (形) 新婚的；剛結婚的
example_sentence: The newlywed couple who just returned from their honeymoon are planning to buy a house.
sentence_zh: 剛從蜜月回來的新婚夫婦正計畫買房子。

definition_zh: (名) 新聞媒體；新聞機構
example_sentence: If a news outlet reports facts accurately, public trust in journalism would strengthen significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果新聞媒體準確報導事實，公眾對新聞業的信任就會大幅增強。

definition_zh: (名) 新聞；消息　(名) 新的或重要的信息
example_sentence: I read the news about the election on my phone every morning.
sentence_zh: 我每天早上在手機上閱讀關於選舉的新聞。

definition_zh: (名) 新聞播報；新聞節目
example_sentence: Many students watch the evening newscast to stay informed about current events.
sentence_zh: 許多學生觀看晚間新聞播報以了解時事。

definition_zh: (名) 新聞播報員；新聞主播
example_sentence: The experienced newscaster delivered the evening news with calm confidence and clear pronunciation.
sentence_zh: 那位經驗豐富的新聞主播以沉著的信心和清晰的發音播報晚間新聞。

definition_zh: (名) 報紙；新聞紙
example_sentence: Because the newspaper reported the election results, many voters understood the candidates' positions.
sentence_zh: 由於報紙報導了選舉結果，許多選民了解了候選人的立場。

definition_zh: (名) 新聞短片；新聞影片
example_sentence: Having watched the newsreel shown before the main film, audiences learned about major world events.
sentence_zh: 看過在正片前播放的新聞短片後，觀眾們了解了世界上發生的重大事件。

definition_zh: (名) 報紙雜誌攤；書報攤
example_sentence: The newsstand that opens early every morning sells the latest magazines and daily newspapers.
sentence_zh: 每天早上很早就營業的報紙攤販賣最新的雜誌和日報。

definition_zh: (形) 值得報導的；具新聞價值的
example_sentence: The mayor's unexpected resignation became newsworthy and dominated local headlines for weeks.
sentence_zh: 市長意外的辭職成為具新聞價值的事件，並在當地媒體上佔據頭條數週。

definition_zh: (形) 下一個的；隔壁的　(副) 其次；然後　(名) 下一個人或事物
example_sentence: If the exam were next Monday, studying this weekend would help students prepare more thoroughly.
sentence_zh: 如果考試是下週一，這個週末讀書會幫助學生準備得更充分。

definition_zh: (名) 菸鹼酸；維生素B3
example_sentence: Niacin helps your body convert food into energy for daily activities.
sentence_zh: 菸鹼酸幫助身體將食物轉化為日常活動所需的能量。

definition_zh: (動) 輕咬；小口咬　(名) 小咬一口；少量食物
example_sentence: Nibbling on snacks while studying, the student gradually lost focus during the exam preparation.
sentence_zh: 在念書時輕咬著零食，那名學生在考試準備期間逐漸失去專注力。

definition_zh: (形) 令人愉快的；美好的　(形) 親切的；友善的
example_sentence: Although the weather was rainy, the camping trip turned out to be quite nice.
sentence_zh: 雖然天氣下雨，露營旅行結果卻相當令人愉快。

definition_zh: (名) 利基市場；專業領域　(名) 合適的位置；棲息地
example_sentence: Only after finding her niche in graphic design did Sarah discover true career satisfaction.
sentence_zh: 只有在找到自己的平面設計利基市場後，莎拉才發現真正的職涯滿足感。

definition_zh: (名) 小傷口；刻痕　(動) 割傷；刻下
example_sentence: The knife made a small nick in the wood that needed to be sanded smooth.
sentence_zh: 那把刀在木頭上留下了一道小刻痕，需要用砂紙磨平。

definition_zh: (名) 鎳；五分硬幣
example_sentence: Many factories use nickel to make stainless steel products.
sentence_zh: 許多工廠使用鎳來製造不鏽鋼產品。

definition_zh: (名) 暱稱；綽號　(動) 給…起綽號；稱呼
example_sentence: My classmates gave me the nickname 'Speedy' because I always finish tests first.
sentence_zh: 我的同學給我起了綽號「快手」，因為我總是最先完成測驗。

definition_zh: (名) 外甥女；侄女
example_sentence: My uncle's daughter is my niece, and we often spend holidays together.
sentence_zh: 我叔叔的女兒是我的外甥女，我們經常一起過假期。

definition_zh: (名) 夜晚；夜間　(形) 夜間的；黑暗的
example_sentence: When night falls, students often study in the library until closing time.
sentence_zh: 當夜幕降臨時，學生們通常在圖書館學習到關閉時間。

definition_zh: (名) 夜間俱樂部；夜店
example_sentence: Attracting thousands of young people, the newly opened nightclub became popular quickly.
sentence_zh: 吸引數千名年輕人的新開夜店迅速流行起來。

definition_zh: (名) 夜鶯；夜鶯鳥
example_sentence: The nightingale, which sings beautifully at night, inspired many poets throughout history.
sentence_zh: 夜鶯在夜間唱歌美妙，它啟發了整個歷史上許多詩人。

definition_zh: (副) 每晚；夜間地　(形) 每夜的；夜間的
example_sentence: If students study nightly, their test scores will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生每晚讀書，他們的考試成績將會大幅進步。

definition_zh: (名) 噩夢；惡夢　(名) 令人極度困擾的事物
example_sentence: After eating spicy food before bed, Tom had a terrible nightmare all night.
sentence_zh: 睡前吃辛辣食物後，湯姆整晚都做了一場可怕的惡夢。

definition_zh: (形) 像惡夢一樣的；恐怖的　(形) 令人極度不安的；可怕的
example_sentence: Students studied the nightmarish exam questions to prepare for the CSAT test.
sentence_zh: 學生研究那些像惡夢一樣的考試題目來準備學測。

definition_zh: (名) 無；零　(形) 毫無的；沒有的
example_sentence: The company's profit this quarter was nil, disappointing investors and shareholders alike.
sentence_zh: 該公司本季度的利潤為零，令投資者和股東感到失望。

definition_zh: (形) 靈活的；敏捷的　(形) 聰慧的；機靈的
example_sentence: Because the dancer's movements were nimble, the audience was captivated by her graceful performance.
sentence_zh: 因為舞者的動作靈活敏捷，觀眾被她優雅的表演所吸引。

definition_zh: (名) 靈活；敏捷　(名) 輕快；迅速
example_sentence: Having trained for months, the gymnast demonstrated remarkable nimbleness, executing each routine with graceful precision.
sentence_zh: 經過數月的訓練，這位體操選手展現出非凡的靈活性，每套動作都執行得優雅而精準。

definition_zh: (名) 九；九個　(形) 九的；九個的
example_sentence: The nine students who won the competition will receive scholarships next month.
sentence_zh: 贏得比賽的九名學生下個月將獲得獎學金。

definition_zh: (名) 十九；19　(形) 十九的
example_sentence: Nineteen students from our school participated in the national science competition last month.
sentence_zh: 上個月我們學校有十九名學生參加了全國科學競賽。

definition_zh: (名) 九十；九十個　(形) 九十的
example_sentence: If graduation were ninety days away, students would begin preparing their final projects immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果畢業只剩九十天，學生們會立即開始準備他們的最終專題。

definition_zh: (序數) 第九；第九個
example_sentence: The ninth floor of this building has a beautiful view of the city.
sentence_zh: 這棟建築的第九層樓有美麗的城市景觀。

definition_zh: (動) 掐掉；剪斷　(動) 匆匆離開；快速結束
example_sentence: Nipping off the dead flowers, the gardener kept the plant healthy and beautiful.
sentence_zh: 園丁掐掉枯花，使植物保持健康美麗。

definition_zh: (動) 掐；夾；咬　(動) 及時制止；阻止
example_sentence: Before the argument escalates further, the teacher nipped the conflict in the bud.
sentence_zh: 在爭執進一步升溫之前，老師及時制止了這場衝突。

definition_zh: (名) 硝酸鹽；硝酸類肥料　(動) 用硝酸鹽處理；硝化
example_sentence: Only after adding nitrate fertilizer did the farmers see their crop yields increase significantly.
sentence_zh: 只有在施加硝酸鹽肥料後，農民才看到他們的作物產量大幅增加。

definition_zh: (名) 氮；氮氣
example_sentence: Nitrogen, which is essential for plant growth, makes up most of Earth's atmosphere.
sentence_zh: 氮是植物生長所必需的元素，它構成了地球大氣的大部分。

definition_zh: (動) 取消；否決　(動) 拒絕；駁回
example_sentence: The principal decided to nix the field trip to save school expenses.
sentence_zh: 校長決定取消校外教學以節省學校經費。

definition_zh: (副) 不再；已不　(連) 不再…；再也不…
example_sentence: After graduating from high school, Sarah no longer needs to wake up early for classes.
sentence_zh: 從高中畢業後，莎拉不再需要為了上課而早起。

definition_zh: (名) 顯而易見的選擇；輕而易舉的決定
example_sentence: Choosing to study hard before the CSAT is a no-brainer for every student.
sentence_zh: 在學測前選擇努力讀書對每個學生來說都是顯而易見的選擇。

definition_zh: (名) 不信任；不信心　(形) 不信任的；表示反對的
example_sentence: Although the government announced new policies, voters expressed no-confidence because previous promises were broken.
sentence_zh: 雖然政府宣布了新政策，但選民表達了不信任，因為先前的承諾被打破了。

definition_zh: (形) 簡樸的；基本的，不含額外服務或裝飾的
example_sentence: Offering only essential features, the no-frills airline reduces ticket prices significantly.
sentence_zh: 這家廉價航空公司只提供基本服務，因此大幅降低了機票價格。

definition_zh: (形) 沒有的；無　(副) 不；沒有　(名) 否定；拒絕
example_sentence: The student who received no help from anyone still passed the difficult exam.
sentence_zh: 那位沒有從任何人那裡獲得幫助的學生仍然通過了這場困難的考試。

definition_zh: (名) 貴族身份；高貴　(名) 高尚品格；崇高
example_sentence: If a leader possesses nobility of character, citizens will respect and follow their decisions.
sentence_zh: 如果領導者具有崇高的品格，公民就會尊重並追隨他們的決定。

definition_zh: (形) 高尚的；崇高的　(形) 貴族的；出身高貴的
example_sentence: Helping others without expecting reward is a noble act that many admire.
sentence_zh: 幫助他人而不期望回報是許多人欽佩的高尚行為。

definition_zh: (代) 沒有人；無人　(名) 無名小卒；小人物
example_sentence: Sarah studied hard every day to become somebody, not nobody in her class.
sentence_zh: 莎拉每天用功讀書，為了成為班上的重要人物，而不是無人注意的學生。

definition_zh: (名) 夜間頻尿；夜尿症
example_sentence: Nocturia caused by excessive night drinking disrupts sleep quality significantly.
sentence_zh: 由過量夜間飲酒引起的夜間頻尿會嚴重擾亂睡眠品質。

definition_zh: (形) 夜間的；夜行的
example_sentence: Although nocturnal animals sleep during the day, they become very active when night falls.
sentence_zh: 雖然夜行動物在白天睡覺，但當夜幕降臨時它們會變得非常活躍。

definition_zh: (名) 夜曲；夜間場景　(形) 夜間的；與夜晚有關的
example_sentence: Having completed the nocturne composition, the pianist performed it elegantly at the concert.
sentence_zh: 完成了夜曲作品後，鋼琴家在音樂會上優雅地演奏它。

definition_zh: (動) 打瞌睡；入睡
example_sentence: The student who nodded off during the lecture missed the important exam tips.
sentence_zh: 在講座中打瞌睡的學生錯過了重要的考試提示。

definition_zh: (動) 點頭同意；輕易批准
example_sentence: The board nodded through the budget proposal without serious discussion.
sentence_zh: 董事會輕易批准了預算案，沒有進行認真的討論。

definition_zh: (動) 點頭；表示同意　(名) 點頭的動作
example_sentence: If the teacher nodded at your answer, you would feel more confident during the exam.
sentence_zh: 如果老師對你的答案點頭，你在考試中會感到更有信心。

definition_zh: (形) 簡樸的；無裝飾的　(名) 簡樸商品；便宜貨
example_sentence: Budget airlines offer no-frills flights with basic services only.
sentence_zh: 廉價航空公司提供簡樸航班，只有基本服務。

definition_zh: (名) 噪音；雜音　(動) 傳播；宣揚
example_sentence: Disturbed by the loud noise coming from the construction site, the students couldn't concentrate on their homework.
sentence_zh: 受到來自建築工地的大聲噪音影響，學生無法集中精力做功課。

definition_zh: (形) 吵雜的；喪雜的　(形) 嘈雜的；充滿噪音的
example_sentence: Although the classroom was noisy, students continued to focus on their homework.
sentence_zh: 雖然教室很吵雜，學生們仍然繼續專注於功課。

definition_zh: (形) 遊牧的；流動的　(形) 居無定所的；四處漂泊的
example_sentence: Seldom do nomadic tribes remain in one location for more than a few months.
sentence_zh: 遊牧部落很少在同一地點停留超過幾個月。

definition_zh: (名) 命名法；術語體系　(名) 專業名稱；名稱標準
example_sentence: The scientific nomenclature, which biologists use to classify living organisms, follows strict international rules.
sentence_zh: 生物學家用來分類生物的科學命名法遵循嚴格的國際規則。

definition_zh: (形) 名義上的；有名無實的　(形) 微不足道的；極少的
example_sentence: The company kept a nominal office in Taipei to maintain its legal registration there.
sentence_zh: 該公司在台北保持一個名義辦公室以維持其法律登記。

definition_zh: (動) 提名；推薦　(動) 任命；指定
example_sentence: The school nominated five students for the national science competition award.
sentence_zh: 學校提名五位學生參加全國科學競賽獎項。

definition_zh: (名) 提名；任命　(動) 提名；被提名
example_sentence: The film received five nominations for major awards at the ceremony.
sentence_zh: 這部電影在典禮上獲得五項主要獎項的提名。

definition_zh: (名) 被提名人；候選人　(名) 代理人；受託人
example_sentence: Although the nominee had limited experience, the committee decided to support her candidacy for the scholarship.
sentence_zh: 雖然被提名人經驗有限，委員會決定支持她的獎學金候選資格。

definition_zh: (形) 非政府的；民間的
example_sentence: Operating independently from state control, non-governmental organizations help marginalized communities access education and healthcare.
sentence_zh: 獨立於國家控制而運作，非政府組織幫助邊緣化社群獲得教育和醫療資源。

definition_zh: (形) 不停的；連續的　(副) 不間斷地；連續地
example_sentence: The flight that departs at noon is a non-stop service to Tokyo.
sentence_zh: 中午出發的班機是前往東京的直飛航班。

definition_zh: (形) 漠不關心的；若無其事的
example_sentence: If Chen acted nonchalant about the test results, his parents would definitely become suspicious and worried.
sentence_zh: 如果陳若無其事地對待考試成績，他的父母肯定會感到懷疑和擔憂。

definition_zh: (代) 沒有一個；沒有任何人　(名) 沒有；零
example_sentence: None of the students finished the exam on time yesterday.
sentence_zh: 昨天沒有任何學生按時完成考試。

definition_zh: (連) 然而；但是　(副) 儘管如此；仍然
example_sentence: The exam was difficult; nonetheless, studying hard helps students to pass successfully.
sentence_zh: 考試很難；儘管如此，努力讀書有助於學生順利通過。

definition_zh: (形) 非金屬的；不含金屬的
example_sentence: Plastic and rubber are nonmetallic materials commonly used in everyday products.
sentence_zh: 塑膠和橡膠是日常產品中常用的非金屬材料。

definition_zh: (形) 不偏袒的；公正的　(形) 超越政黨的；不分黨派的
example_sentence: Although the election was controversial, the nonpartisan committee investigated the results fairly and transparently.
sentence_zh: 雖然選舉很有爭議，但超越政黨的委員會公平且透明地調查了結果。

definition_zh: (名) 非營利組織；慈善機構　(形) 非營利的；不以盈利為目的的
example_sentence: Having established a nonprofit focused on education, the organization has helped thousands of underprivileged students.
sentence_zh: 這個非營利組織成立後，已幫助了數千名貧困學生。

definition_zh: (名) 廢話；胡說八道　(形) 荒謬的；不合理的
example_sentence: The excuse that Mark gave for missing the test was nonsense that nobody believed.
sentence_zh: 馬克為缺考所編的藉口是沒有人相信的廢話。

definition_zh: (形) 毫無意義的；荒謬的
example_sentence: The plot of that movie was so nonsensical that nobody understood the ending.
sentence_zh: 那部電影的劇情毫無意義，沒有人理解結局。

definition_zh: (形) 不黏的；防粘的
example_sentence: If cooking oil were not applied, nonstick cookware would prevent food from sticking to the surface.
sentence_zh: 如果沒有塗上食用油，不黏的鍋具仍然可以防止食物粘著在表面上。

definition_zh: (形) 不間斷的；連續的　(副) 不停地；連續地
example_sentence: The flight from Taipei to Los Angeles is a nonstop journey lasting about thirteen hours.
sentence_zh: 從台北飛往洛杉磯的航班是一段持續約十三小時的不間斷旅程。

definition_zh: (形) 非暴力的；和平的
example_sentence: Adopting nonviolent methods, the protesters successfully achieved their political goals.
sentence_zh: 採取非暴力方式，抗議者成功實現了他們的政治目標。

definition_zh: (名) 麵條；麵食
example_sentence: When the cooking time is over, the noodle becomes soft and ready to eat.
sentence_zh: 當烹飪時間結束時，麵條變軟而且準備好吃。

definition_zh: (名) 正午；中午
example_sentence: Not only does the sun shine brightest at noon, but the heat also becomes most intense.
sentence_zh: 不僅正午時太陽照得最亮，而且熱度也變得最強烈。

definition_zh: (連) 也不；既不　(連) 也沒有
example_sentence: The exam was neither difficult nor easy, which made students feel uncertain about their performance.
sentence_zh: 這場考試既不難也不簡單，這使得學生對自己的表現感到不確定。

definition_zh: (名) 準則；規範　(名) 常態；標準
example_sentence: Students follow classroom norms to create a respectful learning environment.
sentence_zh: 學生遵循課堂規範以營造尊重的學習環境。

definition_zh: (形) 正常的；通常的　(名) 標準；常態
example_sentence: Going to school every weekday is a normal routine for high school students.
sentence_zh: 每個工作日上學是高中學生的正常日常。

definition_zh: (名) 正常；常態　(名) 正常的狀態或行為
example_sentence: After the pandemic, many people wanted to return to normality and resume daily activities.
sentence_zh: 疫情過後，許多人想要回到正常生活並恢復日常活動。

definition_zh: (副) 通常；一般地　正常地；照常
example_sentence: Normally, students attend classes five days a week, but during exam season, schedules become much busier.
sentence_zh: 通常，學生一週上課五天，但在考試季節，課表會變得繁忙得多。

definition_zh: (名) 東北；東北方　(形) 東北的；向東北的
example_sentence: Moving northeast across the island, the cold front brought heavy rain and strong winds.
sentence_zh: 向東北方移動穿過島嶼，冷鋒帶來了大雨和強風。

definition_zh: (名) 西北；西北方　(形) 西北的；朝西北的
example_sentence: The mountain village, which lies in the north-west region, attracts many hikers during autumn.
sentence_zh: 那個位於西北地區的山村在秋天吸引許多登山者。

definition_zh: (名) 北方；北　(形) 北方的；向北的　(副) 向北；朝北
example_sentence: If students travel north from Taipei, they will reach Jiufen Old Street.
sentence_zh: 如果學生從台北向北旅行，他們會到達九份老街。

definition_zh: (形) 北方的；北部的　(形) 來自北方的
example_sentence: The northern part of Taiwan has cooler temperatures during winter.
sentence_zh: 台灣北部在冬天有較低的溫度。

definition_zh: (動) 打探；探聽　窺探；四處尋找
example_sentence: The detective nosed about the crime scene to find important evidence.
sentence_zh: 那名偵探在犯罪現場打探，目的是尋找重要證據。

definition_zh: (動) 以微弱優勢贏得；勉強獲勝
example_sentence: The school basketball team nosed out their rivals by just two points in the final game.
sentence_zh: 學校籃球隊在決賽中以微弱優勢以兩分擊敗對手。

definition_zh: (名) 鼻子；鼻部　(動) 用鼻子嗅；探嗅
example_sentence: As the dog's nose twitched, it caught the scent of fresh food in the kitchen.
sentence_zh: 當狗的鼻子抖動時，它聞到廚房裡新鮮食物的氣味。

definition_zh: (名) 急速下降；暴跌　(動) 急速下降；暴跌
example_sentence: Having nosedived in recent months, the company's stock price finally stabilized yesterday.
sentence_zh: 該公司的股價在近幾個月內急速下跌後，昨天終於穩定下來。

definition_zh: (名) 懷舊；思鄉之情　(形) 懷舊的；令人懷念的
example_sentence: The old photographs, which brought back memories of childhood, filled grandmother with deep nostalgia.
sentence_zh: 那些喚起童年回憶的舊照片，讓奶奶充滿了懷舊之情。

definition_zh: (名) 鼻孔；鼻腔開口
example_sentence: Breathing through the nose-passages called nostrils helps filter dust and warm air.
sentence_zh: 通過稱為鼻孔的鼻腔通道呼吸有助於過濾灰塵並溫暖空氣。

definition_zh: (副) 一點也不；根本不
example_sentence: If students did not study at all before the exam, they would fail completely.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試前根本不讀書，他們就會完全不及格。

definition_zh: (片) 不少；許多
example_sentence: Not a few students in our class passed the CSAT with excellent scores.
sentence_zh: 我們班有許多學生以優異成績通過學測。

definition_zh: (副) 不再；不復如昔
example_sentence: Having finished high school, Mark no longer sees his childhood friends anymore.
sentence_zh: 馬克高中畢業後，已不再看到他的童年朋友。

definition_zh: (連) 不是……而是；而是……不是
example_sentence: Success comes not from talent but rather from consistent hard work and dedication.
sentence_zh: 成功不是源於天才，而是來自於持續的努力和奉獻。

definition_zh: (連) 不但...而且；非但...反而　(片) 只是；僅僅
example_sentence: Not only did Sarah ace the final exam, but she also won the school's science competition.
sentence_zh: 莎拉不但在期末考得高分，而且還贏得了學校的科學競賽。

definition_zh: (片) 不說話；關係冷淡　(片) 絕交；不來往
example_sentence: The two former friends, who were not on speaking terms, avoided each other at the class reunion.
sentence_zh: 這兩位從前的朋友關係冷淡，在班級聚會上彼此迴避。

definition_zh: (連) 不僅…而且；既…又…
example_sentence: Learning English requires not only studying grammar but also practicing conversation to improve fluency.
sentence_zh: 學習英文不僅需要研究文法，而且還要練習對話以提高流利度。

definition_zh: (副) 不；沒有　(助) 不是；並非
example_sentence: The exam is not difficult, but most students did not study hard enough.
sentence_zh: 這次考試不難，但大多數學生沒有足夠認真唸書。

definition_zh: (名) 名氣；知名度　(名) 值得注意的特質；重要性
example_sentence: The notability of this scientist comes from her groundbreaking research discoveries.
sentence_zh: 這位科學家的名氣來自於她的突破性研究發現。

definition_zh: (形) 值得注意的；著名的　(名) 著名人物；名人
example_sentence: Notable as the scientist's breakthrough was, many experts remained skeptical about the findings.
sentence_zh: 儘管科學家的突破值得注意，但許多專家對其發現仍持懷疑態度。

definition_zh: (副) 特別地；值得注意地　尤其；明顯地
example_sentence: Notably improving grades over three semesters, the student earned a scholarship.
sentence_zh: 該學生在三個學期中成績明顯進步，因而獲得獎學金。

definition_zh: (動) 公證；認證
example_sentence: The legal documents that the bank requires must be notarized by an official before submission.
sentence_zh: 銀行要求的法律文件在提交前必須由官員公證。

definition_zh: (名) 公證人；公證員
example_sentence: If the document is stamped by a notary, the bank will accept it as valid proof.
sentence_zh: 如果該文件由公證人蓋章，銀行就會接受它作為有效證明。

definition_zh: (名) 符號；記號　(名) 標記法；表示法
example_sentence: Musical notation helps musicians read and play songs correctly.
sentence_zh: 樂譜符號幫助音樂家正確地閱讀和演奏歌曲。

definition_zh: (名) 刻痕；凹口　(動) 刻下；達到
example_sentence: Athletes train hard every day to notch a victory in the national competition.
sentence_zh: 運動員每天努力訓練以便在全國比賽中贏得勝利。

definition_zh: (動) 音標 記下；記錄　(動) 下來；向下
example_sentence: During the chemistry lecture, students must note down the key formulas and experimental steps carefully.
sentence_zh: 化學課中，學生必須仔細記下關鍵公式和實驗步驟。

definition_zh: (名) 筆記；便條　(動) 注意；記下　(形) 著名的；有名的
example_sentence: As the teacher explained the grammar rules, students took notes so they would remember everything.
sentence_zh: 當老師講解文法規則時，學生做筆記以便他們能記住所有內容。

definition_zh: (名) 筆記本；記事本　(名) 小型筆記型電腦
example_sentence: Having filled the notebook with important formulas, the student felt well-prepared for the math exam.
sentence_zh: 學生把筆記本填滿重要公式後，感到自己已為數學考試做好充分準備。

definition_zh: (形) 著名的；有名的　(動) 注意到；記下
example_sentence: The famous scientist, noted for his groundbreaking research in physics, won the Nobel Prize.
sentence_zh: 那位因物理學突破性研究而著名的著名科學家獲得了諾貝爾獎。

definition_zh: (名) 記事本；便籤本
example_sentence: Keep a notepad beside your desk to write down important homework assignments quickly.
sentence_zh: 在你的書桌旁放一本記事本，快速記下重要的家庭作業。

definition_zh: (形) 值得注意的；重要的　(形) 顯著的；引人注目的
example_sentence: If the research findings were more noteworthy, the university would publish them in a prestigious journal immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果研究結果更值得注意，大學就會立即在著名期刊上發表。

definition_zh: (片) 僅僅；只不過；只有
example_sentence: The exam was nothing but a waste of time for unprepared students.
sentence_zh: 這次考試對於沒有準備的學生來說僅僅是浪費時間。

definition_zh: (片) 不過是；僅僅是　(連) 只不過；無非是
example_sentence: Winning the competition, nothing more than achieving our goal through teamwork and dedication.
sentence_zh: 贏得比賽，不過是通過團隊合作和奉獻而達成我們的目標。

definition_zh: (名) 無物；沒有　(代) 沒有東西；不重要的事
example_sentence: Nothing matters when students focus on preparing for the CSAT.
sentence_zh: 當學生專注於準備學測時，沒有其他事情重要。

definition_zh: (動) 注意到；察覺　(名) 通知；布告
example_sentence: Not until the teacher entered the classroom did students notice the surprise quiz on the board.
sentence_zh: 直到老師進教室，學生才注意到黑板上的隨堂考。

definition_zh: (形) 明顯的；易察覺的　(形) 引人注目的；顯著的
example_sentence: The improvement in exam scores, which was noticeable after three months of tutoring, encouraged all students.
sentence_zh: 考試成績的進步（在進行三個月家教後變得很明顯），鼓勵了所有學生。

definition_zh: (副) 明顯地；顯著地　容易看出的方式
example_sentence: Sarah studied harder to improve her test scores noticeably.
sentence_zh: 莎拉更努力讀書是為了明顯提高她的考試成績。

definition_zh: (動) 通知；告知　(動) 報告；宣布
example_sentence: The school will notify parents and students about the exam schedule changes immediately.
sentence_zh: 學校將立即通知家長和學生考試時間表的變化。

definition_zh: (名) 觀念；想法　(名) 衝動；傾向
example_sentence: Many students have the notion that studying harder guarantees better exam scores.
sentence_zh: 許多學生有一個觀念，認為讀書更努力就保證會考得更好。

definition_zh: (形) 臭名昭著的；惡名遠播的　(形) 聲名狼藉的；臭名遠揚的
example_sentence: Although the politician became notorious for corruption, many citizens still voted for him.
sentence_zh: 雖然那位政治人物因貪汙而臭名昭著，許多市民仍投票支持他。

definition_zh: (介) 儘管；雖然　(連) 儘管；不過
example_sentence: Notwithstanding the heavy rain falling on test day, many students still arrived early to review their notes.
sentence_zh: 儘管考試那天下著大雨，許多學生仍然提早到達以複習筆記。

definition_zh: (名) 名詞；詞彙
example_sentence: The noun that describes a person or place is essential for clear writing.
sentence_zh: 用來描述人或地點的名詞對於清楚的寫作是必要的。

definition_zh: (動) 滋養；供養　(動) 培養；促進
example_sentence: If balanced nutrition nourishes the body regularly, students will concentrate better in class and perform well on exams.
sentence_zh: 如果均衡的營養定期滋養身體，學生在課堂上會更集中注意力，考試成績也會更好。

definition_zh: (名) 營養；滋養　(名) 營養品；食物
example_sentence: Eating balanced meals provides essential nourishment for growing teenagers.
sentence_zh: 均衡飲食為成長中的青少年提供必要的營養。

definition_zh: (形) 新穎的；新奇的　(名) 小說；長篇虛構作品
example_sentence: Students read classic novels to improve their English vocabulary and understanding.
sentence_zh: 學生閱讀經典小說以提高英文單字和理解能力。

definition_zh: (名) 小說家；創作小說的人
example_sentence: The famous novelist published her latest work last month, attracting millions of readers worldwide.
sentence_zh: 那位著名小說家上個月出版了她最新的作品，吸引了世界各地數百萬讀者。

definition_zh: (名) 新奇；新穎的事物　(名) 新奇感；新鮮感
example_sentence: Although the smartphone's novelty wore off quickly, students still found it useful for studying.
sentence_zh: 雖然智慧型手機的新奇感很快消褪，學生仍然發現它對讀書很有幫助。

definition_zh: (名) 十一月
example_sentence: Having finished their midterm exams in November, students finally relaxed.
sentence_zh: 在十一月完成期中考後，學生們終於放鬆了。

definition_zh: (名) 初學者；新手　(形) 初級的；缺乏經驗的
example_sentence: The novice programmer who just joined our team needs guidance on coding standards.
sentence_zh: 剛加入我們團隊的初學者程式設計師需要關於編碼標準的指導。

definition_zh: (副) 現在；此刻　(連) 既然；因為
example_sentence: Right now, students must study hard and prepare for the CSAT exam coming soon.
sentence_zh: 現在學生必須努力讀書，為即將到來的學測做準備。

definition_zh: (副) 現在；如今　(名) 現代；當今
example_sentence: If smartphones did not exist nowadays, students would spend more time reading books and doing homework.
sentence_zh: 如果現在不存在智慧型手機，學生就會花更多時間閱讀書籍和做功課。

definition_zh: (副) 任何地方都沒有；無處　(名) 偏遠的地方；荒涼之地
example_sentence: The lost hiker found nowhere to rest during the storm.
sentence_zh: 那位迷路的登山者在暴風雨中找不到任何地方休息。

definition_zh: (形) 有害的；有毒的　(形) 令人厭惡的；不愉快的
example_sentence: Containing harmful chemicals, noxious fumes spread throughout the factory, forcing workers to evacuate immediately.
sentence_zh: 含有有害化學物質，有毒氣體在工廠內擴散，迫使工人立即撤離。

definition_zh: (名) 細微的差別；微妙之處　(動) 表現出細微差別
example_sentence: Although both paintings look similar at first glance, the artist captured important nuances that distinguish masterpieces from ordinary works.
sentence_zh: 雖然兩幅畫初看相似，但藝術家捕捉到了區分傑作與平凡作品的重要細微差別。

definition_zh: (形) 細微的；微妙的　(形) 含有細緻差異的
example_sentence: Only after careful reading did the nuanced differences between the two theories become clear.
sentence_zh: 只有仔細閱讀後，這兩個理論之間微妙的差異才變得清楚。

definition_zh: (形) 核的；核能的　(形) 中心的；核心的
example_sentence: The nuclear power plant, which supplies electricity to millions of people, requires strict safety measures.
sentence_zh: 提供數百萬人用電的核電廠需要嚴格的安全措施。

definition_zh: (名) 細胞核；原子核　(名) 中心；核心
example_sentence: Scientists study the nucleus to understand how cells divide and grow.
sentence_zh: 科學家研究細胞核以了解細胞如何分裂和生長。

definition_zh: (形) 裸露的；赤身的　(名) 裸體；裸露
example_sentence: The museum's new exhibition displays classical nude sculptures alongside contemporary artwork.
sentence_zh: 博物館的新展覽展出古典裸體雕塑和當代藝術作品。

definition_zh: (名) 小塊；金塊　(名) 雞塊；炸雞塊
example_sentence: Chicken nuggets are a popular fast food choice among teenagers.
sentence_zh: 雞塊是青少年中很受歡迎的快餐選擇。

definition_zh: (名) 討厭的人或事；麻煩
example_sentence: Although the noisy construction site is a nuisance, residents must accept it temporarily.
sentence_zh: 雖然吵雜的建築工地很令人厭煩，居民必須暫時接受它。

definition_zh: (形) 麻木的；無感覺的　(動) 使麻木；使無感覺
example_sentence: Feeling numb from the cold, the athlete still finished the marathon race.
sentence_zh: 運動員因寒冷而感到麻木，仍然完成了馬拉松比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 數字；號碼　(動) 編號；計數
example_sentence: The student whose number is five must submit the homework that the teacher assigned yesterday.
sentence_zh: 號碼是五號的學生必須提交老師昨天指定的功課。

definition_zh: (形) 數字的；用數字表示的　(形) 數值的；數量上的
example_sentence: If students understand numerical data clearly, they will find statistical analysis much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果學生能清楚理解數字資料，他們就會發現統計分析容易得多。

definition_zh: (形) 眾多的；許多的　(形) 數量龐大的；無數的
example_sentence: Numerous students attended the university entrance exam preparation seminar last weekend.
sentence_zh: 上週末有許多學生參加大學入學考試準備講座。

definition_zh: (名) 修女；尼姑
example_sentence: Maria entered the convent to become a nun and dedicate her life to helping others.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞進入修道院成為修女，以奉獻她的一生幫助他人。

definition_zh: (名) 護士；看護　(動) 護理；照顧
example_sentence: The school nurse provides first aid to injured students every day.
sentence_zh: 校護士每天為受傷的學生提供急救。

definition_zh: (名) 幼兒園；托兒所　(名) 苗圃；種苗場
example_sentence: While the nursery provides care during weekday mornings, parents can focus on work without constant worry.
sentence_zh: 當幼兒園在工作日上午提供照顧時，父母可以專注於工作而不用經常擔心。

definition_zh: (名) 護理；護士工作　(形) 哺育的；護理的
example_sentence: Having completed her nursing degree, Sarah began working at a major hospital.
sentence_zh: 完成護理學位後，莎拉開始在一家大型醫院工作。

definition_zh: (動) 培養；養育　(名) 營養；培育
example_sentence: Parents who nurture their children's curiosity create learners that excel in school.
sentence_zh: 培養孩子好奇心的父母會造就在學校表現優異的學習者。

definition_zh: (動) 解決；理清　(動) 計算出；弄明白
example_sentence: The team will nut out a strategy before tomorrow's important competition.
sentence_zh: 該隊將在明天的重要比賽前制定出策略。

definition_zh: (名) 堅果；核果　(名) 螺帽；螺栓
example_sentence: If students ate more nuts daily, their brain function would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生每天吃更多堅果，他們的大腦功能會明顯改善。

definition_zh: (名) 營養物質；養分
example_sentence: Plants absorb nutrients from soil to grow strong and healthy.
sentence_zh: 植物從土壤吸收養分以健康生長。

definition_zh: (名) 營養；營養學　(形) 營養的；有益健康的
example_sentence: Providing balanced nutrition, school lunch programs help students concentrate better in class.
sentence_zh: 學校午餐計畫提供均衡營養，幫助學生在課堂上更專心。

definition_zh: (形) 營養的；與營養有關的　(形) 有營養價值的
example_sentence: Because the meal lacks nutritional value, students should add more vegetables to their diet.
sentence_zh: 因為這頓飯缺乏營養價值，學生應該在飲食中加入更多蔬菜。

definition_zh: (形) 營養豐富的；有營養的
example_sentence: Not only does this meal taste delicious, but it is also highly nutritious for growing teenagers.
sentence_zh: 這頓飯不僅嘗起來美味，而且對發育中的青少年極為營養豐富。

definition_zh: (名) 堅果殼；核心　(介) 簡而言之；一句話
example_sentence: The argument, which can be explained in a nutshell, centers on environmental protection issues.
sentence_zh: 這場辯論的核心（可以簡單解釋）集中在環境保護問題上。

definition_zh: (動) 親暱地靠著；依偎在…身上
example_sentence: The puppy nuzzled up against its mother to feel warm and safe during the cold night.
sentence_zh: 小狗依偎在媽媽身上以獲得溫暖和安全感，度過寒冷的夜晚。

definition_zh: (動) 親暱地靠近；溫柔地蜷縮靠著
example_sentence: The puppy nuzzled up to its mother for warmth and comfort.
sentence_zh: 小狗親暱地靠近母狗以獲得溫暖和安慰。

definition_zh: (名) 尼龍；人造纖維
example_sentence: My backpack is made of nylon and very durable for daily use.
sentence_zh: 我的背包是用尼龍製成的，日常使用非常耐用。

definition_zh: (名) 時刻；點鐘
example_sentence: When the clock strikes three o'clock, students must submit their exam papers immediately.
sentence_zh: 當時鐘敲三點時，學生必須立即交卷。

definition_zh: (名) 橡樹；橡木　(形) 橡木製的；堅固的
example_sentence: Standing in the forest, the ancient oak trees provided cool shade for hikers exploring the mountain trail.
sentence_zh: 站在森林裡，這些古老的橡樹為登山健行者提供了涼爽的樹蔭。

definition_zh: (名) 槳；划槳的人
example_sentence: The rower gripped the oar that had guided their boat through the turbulent river.
sentence_zh: 划手緊握那支曾經引導他們的船通過湍急河流的槳。

definition_zh: (名) 綠洲；生機勃勃的地方
example_sentence: If the desert explorers had found an oasis, they would have survived the harsh journey.
sentence_zh: 如果沙漠探險家發現了綠洲，他們就會活著完成這次艱苦的旅程。

definition_zh: (名) 燕麥；燕麥粒
example_sentence: Many athletes eat oats for breakfast to gain energy before training.
sentence_zh: 許多運動員在訓練前吃燕麥早餐來獲得能量。

definition_zh: (名) 誓言；誓約　(動) 發誓；起誓
example_sentence: Athletes take an oath to compete fairly and follow all competition rules.
sentence_zh: 運動員發誓要公平競賽並遵守所有比賽規則。

definition_zh: (名) 燕麥粥；燕麥片
example_sentence: Eating a bowl of oatmeal for breakfast provides energy and helps digestion throughout the day.
sentence_zh: 早餐吃一碗燕麥粥提供能量，並幫助整天消化。

definition_zh: (前綴) 向；朝向　(前綴) 反對；否定
example_sentence: As the storm approached, the ship's captain ordered the crew to obey all safety procedures without hesitation.
sentence_zh: 當暴風雨逼近時，船長命令船員毫不猶豫地遵守所有安全程序。

definition_zh: (介) ['ɑb] 朝向；對著　(動) [əb'струkt] 阻礙；妨礙
example_sentence: Obstructed by heavy traffic, the delivery truck arrived late at the warehouse.
sentence_zh: 被沈重的交通堵塞所阻礙，這輛送貨卡車遲到才到達倉庫。

definition_zh: (形) 固執的；頑固的　(形) 難以改變的；堅硬的
example_sentence: The student's obdurate refusal to listen to feedback made progress impossible.
sentence_zh: 這位學生固執地拒絕聽取回饋意見，使得進步變得不可能。

definition_zh: (名) 服從；遵從　(名) 順從；聽命
example_sentence: Strict obedience to school rules and teacher instructions helps maintain discipline.
sentence_zh: 對學校規則和老師指示的嚴格服從有助於維持紀律。

definition_zh: (形) 聽話的；服從的　(形) 順從的；乖的
example_sentence: If children were more obedient, parents would spend less time enforcing rules daily.
sentence_zh: 如果孩子更聽話，父母每天就不必花那麼多時間執行規則。

definition_zh: (副) 順從地；聽話地　(副) 服從地；恭順地
example_sentence: The students followed the teacher's instructions obediently during the field trip.
sentence_zh: 在校外教學中，學生們順從地遵循老師的指示。

definition_zh: (形) 肥胖的；過度肥胖的
example_sentence: Struggling with obesity, many teenagers adopt healthier eating habits gradually.
sentence_zh: 許多青少年與肥胖問題奮鬥，逐漸養成更健康的飲食習慣。

definition_zh: (名) 肥胖症；肥胖
example_sentence: Because obesity increases health risks significantly, many teenagers adopt healthier eating habits.
sentence_zh: 由於肥胖症大幅增加健康風險，許多青少年採取更健康的飲食習慣。

definition_zh: (動) 聽從；服從　遵守；按照...行動
example_sentence: Seldom do students obey rules without understanding their purpose.
sentence_zh: 學生很少在不理解規則目的的情況下就服從規則。

definition_zh: (名) 訃聞；追悼文
example_sentence: The obituary, which appeared in the newspaper last week, described the teacher's remarkable contributions to education.
sentence_zh: 這份訃聞出現在上週的報紙上，描述了這位老師對教育的傑出貢獻。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈɑbdʒɪkt] 物體；對象　(動) [əbˈdʒɛkt] 反對；提出異議
example_sentence: Many parents object to raise their children's screen time to prevent digital addiction.
sentence_zh: 許多家長反對增加孩子的螢幕時間，以防止數位成癮。

definition_zh: (名) 反對；異議　(名) 反對的理由；缺點
example_sentence: Raising objections to the new school policy without offering solutions creates unnecessary conflict.
sentence_zh: 對新的校園政策提出異議而不提供解決方案會造成不必要的衝突。

definition_zh: (形) 客觀的；不偏不倚的　(名) 目標；目的
example_sentence: The scientist's objective research findings proved that regular exercise improves health.
sentence_zh: 科學家客觀的研究結果證明了規律運動能改善健康。

definition_zh: (副) 客觀地；公正地　不帶個人偏見地
example_sentence: Objectively speaking, both candidates have strong qualifications for the leadership position.
sentence_zh: 客觀來說，兩位候選人都具有擔任領導職位的強大資格。

definition_zh: (動) 強制；迫使　(形) 必須的；有約束力的
example_sentence: Obligated to complete the project on time, the team worked through the weekend.
sentence_zh: 受迫必須按時完成專案，團隊在周末也繼續工作。

definition_zh: (名) 義務；責任　(名) 債務；恩情
example_sentence: Students who have financial obligations to their families often work part-time jobs.
sentence_zh: 有對家庭財務責任的學生通常會打工。

definition_zh: (形) 強制的；義務性的　(形) 必須的；非做不可的
example_sentence: If attending the school assembly is obligatory, students must arrive before eight o'clock.
sentence_zh: 如果參加學校集會是強制性的，學生必須在八點前到達。

definition_zh: (動) 幫忙；協助　(動) 迫使；強制
example_sentence: The teacher's kind words obliged the shy student to speak up.
sentence_zh: 老師親切的話語促使那位害羞的學生開口說話。

definition_zh: (形) 斜的；間接的　(副) 斜地；間接地
example_sentence: The architect designed the staircase at an oblique angle to maximize the small space.
sentence_zh: 建築師以斜角設計樓梯，目的是最大化利用小空間。

definition_zh: (副) 斜地；間接地　(副) 迂迴地；旁敲側擊地
example_sentence: The sunlight streamed obliquely through the classroom window, casting long shadows across the desk.
sentence_zh: 陽光斜射進教室窗戶，在桌子上投出長長的影子。

definition_zh: (動) 完全摧毀；徹底消滅　(動) 抹去；使消失
example_sentence: Before the volcano erupted and obliterated the entire village, families escaped to safety.
sentence_zh: 在火山爆發並徹底摧毀整個村莊之前，居民逃到了安全的地方。

definition_zh: (形) 不注意的；沒有察覺的　(形) 遺忘的；健忘的
example_sentence: Having focused entirely on their phones, the students remained oblivious to the teacher's important announcement about the exam.
sentence_zh: 完全專注於手機，學生們對老師關於考試的重要宣布毫無察覺。

definition_zh: (形) 長方形的；橢圓形的
example_sentence: The table, which has an oblong shape that fits perfectly in the dining room, was a great purchase.
sentence_zh: 那張桌子有長方形的形狀，完美地放在餐廳裡，是很好的購買。

definition_zh: (形) 淫穢的；下流的　(形) 令人厭惡的；令人反感的
example_sentence: The obscene language and explicit content in that movie shocked many viewers.
sentence_zh: 那部電影中的淫穢言語和露骨內容令許多觀眾感到震驚。

definition_zh: (形) [əb`skjʊr] 模糊的；不清楚的　(動) [əbskj`ʊr] 使...模糊；隱瞞
example_sentence: If the instructions were not so obscure, students would understand the assignment more easily.
sentence_zh: 如果說明不是那麼模糊，學生們會更容易理解這項作業。

definition_zh: (形) 過分殷勤的；諂媚的　(形) 奉承的；討好的
example_sentence: The assistant's obsequious behavior toward the manager annoyed all colleagues.
sentence_zh: 那位助理對經理過分殷勤的態度惹惱了所有同事。

definition_zh: (形) 可觀察的；易察覺的
example_sentence: Observing the data carefully, researchers found observable changes in student performance.
sentence_zh: 研究人員仔細觀察數據，發現學生表現出明顯的進步。

definition_zh: (名) 遵守；遵循　(名) 儀式；慶祝活動
example_sentence: As observance of traffic rules is important, drivers must always obey speed limits.
sentence_zh: 由於遵守交通規則很重要，駕駛者必須始終遵守速度限制。

definition_zh: (形) 善於觀察的；細心的　(形) 留意的；注意到的
example_sentence: Seldom does an observant student miss important details during the history lecture.
sentence_zh: 一位善於觀察的學生很少在歷史課中遺漏重要細節。

definition_zh: (名) 觀察；觀察結果　(名) 註解；評論
example_sentence: The careful observation which scientists made revealed hidden patterns in animal behavior.
sentence_zh: 科學家所做的仔細觀察揭露了動物行為中隱藏的規律。

definition_zh: (名) 天文台；觀測站　(名) 瞭望台；觀察處
example_sentence: Astronomers built the observatory to observe distant stars and planets.
sentence_zh: 天文學家建造了天文台來觀察遠處的星星和行星。

definition_zh: (動) 觀察；注意　(動) 遵守；遵循
example_sentence: Scientists observe the behavior of endangered animals and record their findings carefully.
sentence_zh: 科學家觀察瀕危動物的行為並仔細記錄他們的發現。

definition_zh: (名) 觀察者；觀察員　(名) 旁觀者；見證人
example_sentence: The observer watched the experiment carefully to record all the data.
sentence_zh: 觀察員仔細觀看實驗以記錄所有數據。

definition_zh: (動) 沉迷於；執著於　(動) 使著迷；使困擾
example_sentence: Although many students obsess over exam scores, developing critical thinking matters more.
sentence_zh: 雖然許多學生沉迷於考試成績，但培養批判性思維更重要。

definition_zh: (名) 癡迷；執著　(名) 令人癡迷的事物
example_sentence: Obsessing over social media likes, many teenagers forget to focus on their studies.
sentence_zh: 許多青少年因為沉迷於社群媒體的按讚數而忽略了學業。

definition_zh: (形) 執著的；過度專注的　(形) 強迫性的；令人著迷的
example_sentence: Sarah's obsessive behavior, which involved checking her phone constantly, worried her parents.
sentence_zh: 莎拉執著的行為，就是不斷檢查手機，讓她的父母很擔心。

definition_zh: (形) 逐漸過時的；即將淘汰的
example_sentence: If smartphone technology continues advancing rapidly, current models will become obsolescent within two years.
sentence_zh: 如果智慧型手機技術持續快速進步，現在的型號在兩年內就會變得逐漸過時。

definition_zh: (形) 過時的；廢棄的　(形) 老舊的；陳舊的
example_sentence: Smartphones have made paper maps completely obsolete.
sentence_zh: 智慧型手機讓紙本地圖完全過時了。

definition_zh: (名) 障礙；阻礙　(名) 困難；難題
example_sentence: Students study hard every day to overcome obstacles and achieve their dreams.
sentence_zh: 學生每天努力讀書以克服障礙並實現夢想。

definition_zh: (形) 頑固的；固執的　(形) 堅持不懈的；執著的
example_sentence: The obstinate student refused to listen to teacher feedback and kept making same mistakes.
sentence_zh: 那個頑固的學生拒絕聽老師的意見，並一直重複犯同樣的錯誤。

definition_zh: (動) 阻擋；妨礙　(動) 堵塞；阻止
example_sentence: Because fallen trees obstructed the mountain road, hiking groups had to find an alternative route.
sentence_zh: 因為倒下的樹木阻擋了山路，登山隊必須找到另一條路線。

definition_zh: (名) 阻礙；障礙物　(名) 阻擋；堵塞
example_sentence: Having removed the fallen tree obstructing the road, workers restored traffic flow.
sentence_zh: 工人移除了阻擋道路的倒樹後，恢復了交通流通。

definition_zh: (形) 妨礙的；阻礙的　(形) 造成堵塞的；導致阻塞的
example_sentence: The obstructive policy that the government implemented last year prevented many small businesses from expanding their operations.
sentence_zh: 政府去年實施的那項妨礙政策阻止了許多小企業擴展營運。

definition_zh: (動) 獲得；取得　(動) 達成；實現
example_sentence: Students who study hard and participate actively in class can obtain excellent grades.
sentence_zh: 認真唸書並積極參與課堂活動的學生能夠獲得優異的成績。

definition_zh: (形) 可獲得的；可得到的
example_sentence: If better study materials were obtainable, many students would improve their test scores significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果能取得更好的教材，許多學生就能顯著提高考試成績。

definition_zh: (形) 遲鈍的；愚鈍的　(形) 不尖銳的；鈍的
example_sentence: The student's obtuse comments during class showed little understanding of the lesson.
sentence_zh: 那位學生在課堂上遲鈍的評論顯示對課程理解甚少。

definition_zh: (形) 明顯的；易看出的　(形) 顯然的；不言而喻的
example_sentence: Noticing the obvious mistake in the homework, the teacher asked students to correct it immediately.
sentence_zh: 注意到功課中明顯的錯誤，老師要求學生立即更正。

definition_zh: (副) 明顯地；顯然地　(副) 當然地；必然地
example_sentence: Obviously the exam is difficult, so students need to study hard for weeks.
sentence_zh: 顯然這次考試很難，所以學生需要花數週時間努力準備。

definition_zh: (名) 場合；時刻　(名) 機會；原因　(動) 引起；造成
example_sentence: Only on special occasions does graduation ceremony hold such deep meaning for students.
sentence_zh: 只有在特殊場合，畢業典禮才對學生有如此深刻的意義。

definition_zh: (形) 偶爾的；間歇的　(形) 偶發的；非經常性的
example_sentence: The coffee shop that we visit occasionally offers free WiFi to customers.
sentence_zh: 我們偶爾造訪的咖啡館向顧客提供免費網路。

definition_zh: (副) 偶爾；間或　(副) 時不時；有時候
example_sentence: Students study at the library occasionally to improve their focus and concentration.
sentence_zh: 學生偶爾到圖書館讀書以提高他們的專注力和集中力。

definition_zh: (名) 入住率；佔有率　(名) 佔據；使用
example_sentence: The hotel's occupancy rate dropped significantly during the low season, affecting revenue.
sentence_zh: 旅館在淡季的入住率大幅下降，影響了收益。

definition_zh: (名) 佔據者；住戶　(名) 乘客；乘坐者
example_sentence: The building's occupants evacuated quickly during the fire alarm.
sentence_zh: 火警警報期間，大樓的住戶迅速撤離。

definition_zh: (名) 職業；工作　(名) 佔領；占據
example_sentence: Although studying medicine requires years of hard work, many students choose it as their occupation.
sentence_zh: 雖然學習醫學需要多年的努力，但許多學生選擇它作為自己的職業。

definition_zh: (形) 被佔據的；忙碌的　(動) 佔據；占領
example_sentence: Occupied with homework, many students skip lunch during exam season.
sentence_zh: 被功課佔據，許多學生在考試季節時會跳過午餐。

definition_zh: (動) 佔據；佔領　(動) 使某人忙碌；使某人專注
example_sentence: The protesters who occupied the plaza for weeks demanded fair treatment from the government.
sentence_zh: 佔據廣場數週的抗議者要求政府給予公平對待。

definition_zh: (動) 想到；浮現　(動) 發生；被想起
example_sentence: If a good idea occurred to Maria, she would write it down immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果一個好主意浮現在瑪莉亞的腦海中，她會立刻把它寫下來。

definition_zh: (動) 發生；出現　(動) 存在；被發現
example_sentence: Accidents often occur on rainy days, so drivers must stay alert.
sentence_zh: 雨天經常發生事故，所以駕駛必須保持警覺。

definition_zh: (名) 發生；出現　(名) 事件；情況
example_sentence: Scientists study rare volcanic occurrences to predict future eruptions accurately.
sentence_zh: 科學家研究罕見的火山爆發事件以準確預測未來的火山噴發。

definition_zh: (名) 海洋；大洋　(名) 大量；許多
example_sentence: The Pacific Ocean covers an enormous area of Earth's surface.
sentence_zh: 太平洋覆蓋了地球表面的巨大面積。

definition_zh: (形) 海洋的；與海洋有關的
example_sentence: Oceanic creatures live in deep waters, whereas coastal animals adapt to shallow environments.
sentence_zh: 海洋生物生活在深水中，而沿岸動物則適應淺水環境。

definition_zh: (名) 八邊形；八角形
example_sentence: Having studied geometry for months, students finally understood the octagon's properties.
sentence_zh: 經過數月的幾何學習，學生們終於理解了八邊形的性質。

definition_zh: (名) 辛烷；汽油品質指數
example_sentence: High-octane gasoline, which burns more efficiently, powers sports cars better.
sentence_zh: 高辛烷汽油能更有效地燃燒，能更好地為跑車提供動力。

definition_zh: (名) 十月
example_sentence: October is the month when autumn leaves turn golden and the weather becomes cooler.
sentence_zh: 十月是秋葉轉金黃且天氣變涼爽的月份。

definition_zh: (名) 章魚；八爪魚
example_sentence: If an octopus had bones, it would escape from aquarium tanks much more easily.
sentence_zh: 如果章魚有骨頭，牠會更容易從水族館的水槽裡逃脫。

definition_zh: (形) 奇怪的；奇特的　(形) 奇數的；不成對的
example_sentence: Finding old letters in the attic seemed odd to the teenager exploring the dusty space.
sentence_zh: 在閣樓裡發現舊信件對探索塵埃滿布空間的少年來說似乎很奇怪。

definition_zh: (名) 奇怪的人或事；古怪之處
example_sentence: Noticing the oddity in his behavior, the teacher decided to speak with him privately.
sentence_zh: 察覺到他行為的古怪之處，老師決定私下與他談話。

definition_zh: (副) 奇怪地；古怪地　(副) 令人困惑地；莫名地
example_sentence: Oddly, the museum remained open even though most shops had closed for renovation.
sentence_zh: 奇怪的是，儘管大多數商店已關閉進行整修，但博物館仍然開放。

definition_zh: (片) 很可能；八九不離十
example_sentence: Odds are that the final exam will cover chapters five through eight.
sentence_zh: 期末考很可能會考第五到第八章。

definition_zh: (名) 機率；勝算　(名) 差異；分歧
example_sentence: The student who studies hard will improve academic performance regardless of the odds that seem impossible.
sentence_zh: 認真讀書的學生無論面臨多大的困難機率，都能提升學業成績。

definition_zh: (形) 令人厭惡的；討厭的　(形) 可恨的；令人反感的
example_sentence: The school board decided to ban the odious bullying behavior to protect student safety.
sentence_zh: 校董事會決定禁止令人厭惡的霸凌行為以保護學生安全。

definition_zh: (名) 氣味；臭味　(名) 香氣；芳香
example_sentence: The unpleasant odor from the garbage can attracted flies and insects.
sentence_zh: 垃圾桶散發的難聞氣味吸引了蒼蠅和昆蟲。

definition_zh: (片) 有史以來；迄今最
example_sentence: Michael Jordan is considered the greatest basketball player of all time.
sentence_zh: 麥可·喬丹被認為是有史以來最偉大的籃球選手。

definition_zh: (片) 首選的；最受歡迎的
example_sentence: Coffee is the beverage of choice for many students studying late at night.
sentence_zh: 咖啡是許多學生熬夜讀書時的首選飲料。

definition_zh: (形) 禁止進入的；不准碰的
example_sentence: Being strictly off-limits, the principal's office intimidated many curious students.
sentence_zh: 由於被嚴格禁止進入，校長室嚇到了許多好奇的學生。

definition_zh: (形) 關閉的；停止的　(副) 離開；遠離
example_sentence: The light switch that Sarah turned off was in the dark hallway.
sentence_zh: 莎拉關掉的那個電燈開關在黑暗的走廊裡。

definition_zh: (動) 冒犯；得罪　惹惱；傷害
example_sentence: If you make jokes about someone's family, you will offend them easily.
sentence_zh: 如果你拿某人的家庭開玩笑，你很容易會冒犯他們。

definition_zh: (名) 冒犯；得罪　(名) 犯罪行為；違法行為
example_sentence: Making rude comments about someone's appearance causes offense easily.
sentence_zh: 對某人的外表做粗魯的評論很容易冒犯他人。

definition_zh: (形) 冒犯的；令人不快的　(形) 攻擊性的；進攻的
example_sentence: The comedian used offensive jokes to make the audience laugh at the show.
sentence_zh: 那位喜劇演員在演出中使用冒犯性的笑話來逗觀眾發笑。

definition_zh: (副) 經常；常常　(名) 多次；許多時候
example_sentence: Oftentimes students find preparing for the CSAT challenging, yet consistent practice helps them succeed.
sentence_zh: 學生經常發現準備學測具有挑戰性，但是持續練習幫助他們成功。

definition_zh: (動) 提供；提議　(名) 提議；報價
example_sentence: As the company offered better salary and benefits, many employees decided to switch jobs.
sentence_zh: 由於公司提供更好的薪資和福利，許多員工決定轉職。

definition_zh: (名) 祭品；供品　(名) 提供；提議
example_sentence: Having offered the local temple a generous donation, the family felt blessed throughout the year.
sentence_zh: 在向當地廟宇提供慷慨捐獻後，這個家庭全年都感到蒙福。

definition_zh: (名) 辦公室；辦公處　(名) 職位；官職
example_sentence: The office where my mother works is a building that overlooks the city.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽工作的辦公室是一棟可以俯瞰城市的建築。

definition_zh: (名) 警察；官員　(名) 公司或組織的主管；幹部
example_sentence: The police officer helped the lost child find the way home.
sentence_zh: 那位警察幫助迷路的孩子找到回家的路。

definition_zh: (形) 官方的；正式的　(名) 官員；負責人
example_sentence: If the government released an official report, citizens would trust the information more easily.
sentence_zh: 如果政府發布官方報告，市民會更容易信任這些資訊。

definition_zh: (副) 正式地；官方地　公開地；明確地
example_sentence: The school officially announced the exam date to all students yesterday.
sentence_zh: 學校昨天正式向全校學生公布考試日期。

definition_zh: (名) 即將發生的事；將來　(形) 即將到來的；近在眼前的
example_sentence: Facing the offing storm, the fishing boats quickly returned to harbor.
sentence_zh: 面對即將來臨的暴風雨，漁船迅速返回港口。

definition_zh: (形) 離線的；不上網的　(副) 離線地；不連接網路
example_sentence: Since the internet connection failed, students had to work offline until the technician restored the network.
sentence_zh: 因為網際網路連線失敗，學生必須離線工作，直到技術人員恢復網路。

definition_zh: (名) [ˋɔfˏsɛt] 抵消；補償　(動) [ˋɔfˋsɛt] 抵消；彌補
example_sentence: Only by planting more trees can environmental damage be offset effectively.
sentence_zh: 只有透過種植更多樹木，才能有效地抵消環境傷害。

definition_zh: (形) 海外的；離岸的　(副) 在海外；向海外
example_sentence: Many tech companies that operate offshore banking services face strict regulatory requirements which governments impose to prevent tax evasion.
sentence_zh: 許多經營離岸銀行服務的科技公司面臨嚴格的監管要求，政府為了防止逃稅而施加這些要求。

definition_zh: (名) 後代；子孫　(名) 子女；產物
example_sentence: Many endangered species need protection to ensure their offspring survive into the next generation.
sentence_zh: 許多瀕危物種需要保護以確保牠們的後代能存活到下一代。

definition_zh: (副) 經常；常常　(副) 時常；頻繁地
example_sentence: Students often study in the library after school to prepare for exams.
sentence_zh: 學生經常在放學後到圖書館讀書，為考試做準備。

definition_zh: (感) 哦；喔　(感) 表示驚訝或理解
example_sentence: Oh, I didn't know the exam was moved to next week!
sentence_zh: 哦，我不知道考試被改到下週了！

definition_zh: (名) 油；石油　(動) 給…加油；潤滑
example_sentence: As the machine runs without oil, it produces strange noises every day.
sentence_zh: 由於機器沒有油，它每天都發出奇怪的聲音。

definition_zh: (形) 油膩的；含油的　(形) 油滑的；虛偽的
example_sentence: Having eaten oily food all week, the student felt sluggish during the exam.
sentence_zh: 整週都吃油膩食物，該學生在考試中感到遲鈍無力。

definition_zh: (名) 軟膏；油膏　(名) 藥膏；塗抹劑
example_sentence: The ointment that the doctor prescribed helps reduce skin inflammation quickly.
sentence_zh: 醫生開的軟膏能快速減輕皮膚發炎。

definition_zh: (片) 好的；可以　(形) 不錯的；還好的　(動) 同意；批准
example_sentence: If the weather is OK tomorrow, the school trip to Jiufen will go ahead as planned.
sentence_zh: 如果明天天氣還好的話，到九份的校外教學就會按計畫進行。

definition_zh: (形) 過時的；老式的
example_sentence: My grandmother's old-fashioned dress style looks charming in old photos.
sentence_zh: 我祖母在舊照片中那件過時的服裝風格看起來很迷人。

definition_zh: (形) 年長的；老的　(形) 舊的；陳舊的
example_sentence: Many students study old documents to understand Taiwan's history better.
sentence_zh: 許多學生研讀舊文獻以更好地了解台灣的歷史。

definition_zh: (名) 橄欖；橄欖樹　(形) 橄欖色的；深黃綠色的
example_sentence: Olive oil, extracted from olive trees, is a healthy cooking ingredient widely used in Mediterranean cuisine.
sentence_zh: 橄欖油是從橄欖樹中提取的，是地中海料理中廣泛使用的健康烹飪原料。

definition_zh: (形) 奧運的；奧林匹克運動會的
example_sentence: Although Olympic athletes train for years, they compete for only a few minutes.
sentence_zh: 雖然奧運運動員訓練多年，但他們只競賽幾分鐘。

definition_zh: (名) 煎蛋捲；歐姆蛋
example_sentence: Having prepared the ingredients, Mom made a fluffy cheese omelet for breakfast.
sentence_zh: 媽媽準備好材料後，為早餐做了一份蓬鬆的起司煎蛋捲。

definition_zh: (動) 省略；遺漏　(動) 不做；不履行
example_sentence: The report omits important details that readers need to understand the situation.
sentence_zh: 那份報告省略了讀者需要的重要細節以理解情況。

definition_zh: (名) 雜食性動物；兼食肉類和植物的動物
example_sentence: Bears are omnivores that eat fish, berries, and other available foods.
sentence_zh: 熊是雜食性動物，吃魚、漿果和其他可取得的食物。

definition_zh: (介) 代表；為了……的利益
example_sentence: If the student council president were absent, the vice president would speak on behalf of the school at the ceremony.
sentence_zh: 如果學生會主席缺席，副主席就會在典禮上代表學校發言。

definition_zh: (片) 值班；在工作崗位上
example_sentence: The nurse on duty helped the patient immediately.
sentence_zh: 值班的護士立即幫助了那位病人。

definition_zh: (片) 到底；究竟　(片) 在世界上；存在
example_sentence: Not knowing what to study, students struggling with career choices often ask themselves what on earth they should do after graduation.
sentence_zh: 不知道要學什麼，為職業選擇而苦惱的學生常常問自己到底該在畢業後做什麼。

definition_zh: (片) 借用中；暫借　(介) 貸款；借用
example_sentence: The famous painting is on loan from the British Museum, so visitors can view it at our gallery until next month.
sentence_zh: 這幅名畫是從大英博物館借用的，所以遊客可以在我們的美術館看到它，直到下個月。

definition_zh: (名) 上班；往來　(動) 通勤；往返
example_sentence: Seldom does Sarah check her phone on the commute home after a tiring day at work.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在疲憊的上班日結束後，在回家的通勤途中很少查看手機。

definition_zh: (副) 總的來說；整體而言　(片) 基本上；大體上
example_sentence: The movie, which was on the whole entertaining, kept the audience engaged throughout.
sentence_zh: 這部電影整體而言很有趣，使觀眾始終保持專注。

definition_zh: (副) 準時；按時
example_sentence: Students must arrive on time to take the CSAT exam without any delay.
sentence_zh: 學生必須準時到達才能參加學測考試，不能遲到。

definition_zh: (形) 現場的；在地的　(副) 在現場；就地
example_sentence: The on-site inspection team discovered safety problems in the factory's production area.
sentence_zh: 現場檢查小組在工廠生產區發現了安全問題。

definition_zh: (副) 一次；曾經　(連) 一旦；一...就...
example_sentence: I visited Japan once last year and loved every moment of the trip.
sentence_zh: 我去年去過日本一次，非常喜歡那段旅程的每一刻。

definition_zh: (形) 片面的；不公平的　(形) 單方面的；偏頗的
example_sentence: Although the debate seemed one-sided, the opposing team gradually gained support from the audience.
sentence_zh: 雖然辯論看起來片面不公，反方隊伍逐漸獲得觀眾的支持。

definition_zh: (形) 一次性的；一次的　(副) 一次；曾經
example_sentence: Having used the one-time discount code, students cannot apply it again next month.
sentence_zh: 使用過一次性折扣代碼後，學生下個月無法再次使用。

definition_zh: (代) 自己的；自身的　(形) 個人的；專屬的
example_sentence: Every student should develop their own learning strategies that suit their personal needs.
sentence_zh: 每位學生都應該發展適合自己個人需求的學習策略。

definition_zh: (代) 自己；本身
example_sentence: If students prepare oneself thoroughly, the exam will feel much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果學生充分準備自己，考試會感覺輕鬆得多。

definition_zh: (形) 持續的；進行中的　(形) 不斷的；未完成的
example_sentence: The ongoing construction project near our school will last until next summer.
sentence_zh: 學校附近進行中的建築計畫將持續到明年夏天。

definition_zh: (名) 洋蔥；洋蔥球
example_sentence: Cooking onions slowly helps bring out their natural sweetness and flavor.
sentence_zh: 慢慢烹飪洋蔥有助於帶出它們天然的甜味和風味。

definition_zh: (形) 在線的；網上的　(副) 在線地；通過網絡
example_sentence: Students can submit homework through the online learning platform anytime.
sentence_zh: 學生可以隨時通過網上學習平台提交作業。

definition_zh: (副) 僅僅；只有　(連) 除非；但是
example_sentence: Only after finishing homework can students play video games on weekends.
sentence_zh: 只有完成家庭作業後，學生才能在週末玩電玩遊戲。

definition_zh: (名) 開始；發作　(動) 開始；襲來
example_sentence: Having suffered a serious injury, the athlete's career decline had its onset that season.
sentence_zh: 經歷了一次嚴重傷害後，那位運動員的職業生涯衰退從那個賽季開始。

definition_zh: (名) 猛烈攻擊；突然大量來襲
example_sentence: The relentless onslaught of social media notifications that distracted students made studying increasingly difficult.
sentence_zh: 那些分散學生注意力的社群媒體通知的猛烈來襲使得讀書變得越來越困難。

definition_zh: (介) 在...上面；轉向...　(動) 發現；認識到
example_sentence: The detective finally caught onto the criminal's clever disguise hiding in plain sight.
sentence_zh: 那名偵探終於識破了罪犯藏在眾目睽睽之下的巧妙偽裝。

definition_zh: (動) 滲出；流出　(名) 滲出物；黏液
example_sentence: If the wound were not cleaned properly, infected fluid would ooze from the bandage.
sentence_zh: 如果傷口沒有妥善清潔，受感染的液體就會從繃帶滲出。

definition_zh: (名) 蛋白石；乳色寶石
example_sentence: The jeweler set a beautiful opal in the silver ring.
sentence_zh: 珠寶商將一顆美麗的蛋白石鑲在銀戒指上。

definition_zh: (形) 不透明的；模糊的　(形) 難以理解的；費解的
example_sentence: Not being transparent, the opaque glass window prevented students from seeing outside during the exam.
sentence_zh: 由於不透明，那扇不透光的玻璃窗讓學生在考試期間看不到外面。

definition_zh: (動) 打開；開放　敞開心扉；坦白說
