example_sentence: As the company opened up new markets in Southeast Asia, revenue increased significantly.
sentence_zh: 當該公司在東南亞開放新市場時，營收大幅增長。

definition_zh: (動) 打開；開啟　(形) 開放的；敞開的
example_sentence: Only after the door opens can students enter the classroom for the exam.
sentence_zh: 只有在門打開之後，學生才能進入教室參加考試。

definition_zh: (名) 開瓶器；開罐器　(名) 首場比賽；開場項目
example_sentence: The bottle opener that Sarah found in the kitchen drawer was a tool which made opening wine bottles much easier.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在廚房抽屜裡找到的開瓶器是一個讓開紅酒瓶變得容易得多的工具。

definition_zh: (名) 開口；機會　(動) 打開；開始　(形) 開始的；初步的
example_sentence: The company held interviews to find talented people for the job opening.
sentence_zh: 該公司舉辦面試以尋找適合該職位空缺的優秀人才。

definition_zh: (副) 公開地；坦白地　(副) 明顯地；毫不隱瞞地
example_sentence: The student spoke openly about her concerns during the class meeting.
sentence_zh: 那位學生在班會上坦白地說出了她的擔憂。

definition_zh: (名) 歌劇；歌劇院
example_sentence: Attending a famous opera in Taipei introduced students to classical music.
sentence_zh: 參加台北著名的歌劇介紹學生認識古典音樂。

definition_zh: (動) 動手術；進行手術
example_sentence: After the doctor operated on the patient's knee, the athlete could finally return to training.
sentence_zh: 醫生替患者進行膝蓋手術後，這位運動員終於可以回到訓練。

definition_zh: (動) 操作；運作　(動) 經營；管理
example_sentence: Operating the new laboratory equipment, students discovered fascinating chemical reactions during the experiment.
sentence_zh: 操作新的實驗室設備，學生在實驗中發現了迷人的化學反應。

definition_zh: (名) 操作；運作　(名) 手術；醫療行為
example_sentence: The surgical operation that saved the patient's life was performed by doctors who had extensive experience.
sentence_zh: 那個拯救病患生命的手術是由有豐富經驗的醫生進行的。

definition_zh: (形) 可操作的；可運作的　(形) 實際可行的；有效運行中的
example_sentence: If the new system becomes operational next month, the company will improve its efficiency significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果新系統在下個月開始運作，公司的效率將會大幅提升。

definition_zh: (形) 有效的；起作用的　(名) 操作員；特務
example_sentence: The new safety rules became operative after the factory accident last month.
sentence_zh: 工廠上月發生意外後，新的安全規則隨之生效。

definition_zh: (名) 操作員；接線員　(名) 經營者；運營者
example_sentence: The phone operator picked up the call to help customers find the right department.
sentence_zh: 電話接線員接起電話，以幫助客戶找到正確的部門。

definition_zh: (名) 鰓蓋；蓋骨
example_sentence: The fish's operculum protects its delicate gills from damage and water loss.
sentence_zh: 魚的鰓蓋保護其脆弱的鰓免受傷害和失水。

definition_zh: (形) 眼睛的；眼科的
example_sentence: Before the surgery was performed, the patient underwent ophthalmic tests to ensure vision safety.
sentence_zh: 在手術進行之前，患者接受了眼科檢查以確保視力安全。

definition_zh: (名) 意見；看法　(名) 觀點；見解
example_sentence: Having considered various perspectives, the committee formed a balanced opinion on the policy.
sentence_zh: 審視了各種觀點後，委員會對該政策形成了平衡的看法。

definition_zh: (名) 鴉片類藥物；類鴉片物質　(形) 鴉片類的；類鴉片的
example_sentence: Doctors must carefully monitor patients who take opioid medications that can cause serious addiction.
sentence_zh: 醫生必須仔細監控服用可能導致嚴重成癮的鴉片類藥物的患者。

definition_zh: (名) 鴉片；罌粟製麻醉藥
example_sentence: Opium addiction devastated many families during the 19th-century Opium Wars in China.
sentence_zh: 鴉片成癮在十九世紀中國鴉片戰爭期間摧毀了許多家庭。

definition_zh: (名) 對手；敵手　(名) 反對者；反對派
example_sentence: If the tennis player trained harder, beating the opponent would become much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果這位網球選手訓練得更努力，擊敗對手就會變得容易得多。

definition_zh: (名) 機會；良機　(名) 機遇；可能性
example_sentence: Learning English opens many opportunities for future jobs.
sentence_zh: 學英文為未來工作開啟許多機會。

definition_zh: (動) 反對；對抗　(動) 相對；相反
example_sentence: Opposing the new policy, many students organized a petition to express their concerns.
sentence_zh: 反對新政策，許多學生組織了請願書來表達他們的關切。

definition_zh: (形) 相反的；對面的　(名) 對立面；反面　(介) 在…對面
example_sentence: Although the two candidates held opposite views on education policy, both wanted to improve student outcomes.
sentence_zh: 雖然兩位候選人在教育政策上持相反的看法，但兩人都想改善學生的學習成果。

definition_zh: (名) 反對；反對者　(名) 對抗；抵抗
example_sentence: Only after facing strong opposition did the government finally reconsider its controversial policy.
sentence_zh: 只有在面對強烈的反對之後，政府才終於重新考慮其有爭議的政策。

definition_zh: (動) 壓迫；欺壓　(動) 使沮喪；使苦惱
example_sentence: The oppressive government that ruled the nation for decades finally collapsed.
sentence_zh: 統治這個國家數十年的壓迫性政府最終崩潰了。

definition_zh: (名) 壓迫；壓制　(名) 沉悶感；抑鬱
example_sentence: Citizens organized protests to resist political oppression and regain their fundamental rights.
sentence_zh: 公民組織抗議活動以反抗政治壓迫並重獲基本權利。

definition_zh: (形) 壓抑的；令人窒息的　(形) 專制的；暴虐的
example_sentence: The oppressive heat and humidity made summer days feel unbearable for most students.
sentence_zh: 那種壓抑悶熱的天氣讓大多數學生覺得夏日難以忍受。

definition_zh: (動) 選擇；決定要
example_sentence: Many students opt for science subjects when choosing their university major.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在選擇大學主修時決定選讀理科科目。

definition_zh: (動) 選擇參加；同意加入
example_sentence: Before the school collects student data, parents must opt in if they agree with the policy.
sentence_zh: 在學校收集學生資料之前，如果家長同意該政策，就必須選擇加入。

definition_zh: (動) 選擇退出；放棄參加
example_sentence: Students who opt out of the school lunch program must bring their own meals.
sentence_zh: 選擇退出學校午餐計畫的學生必須自己帶便當。

definition_zh: (動) 選擇；決定　(動) 選用；採用
example_sentence: If students opt for the science track, they will study physics and chemistry.
sentence_zh: 如果學生選擇自然組，他們將學習物理和化學。

definition_zh: (形) 眼睛的；視覺的　(名) 光學
example_sentence: The optic nerve carries visual information from the eye to the brain.
sentence_zh: 視神經將視覺信息從眼睛傳遞到大腦。

definition_zh: (形) 光學的；視覺的　(形) 光學儀器的；眼鏡的
example_sentence: Students use optical microscopes to examine tiny cells in biology class.
sentence_zh: 學生在生物課上使用光學顯微鏡來檢視微小的細胞。

definition_zh: (形) 最佳的；最優的　(形) 最理想的；最適當的
example_sentence: Finding the optimal study schedule helps students balance preparation and rest effectively.
sentence_zh: 找到最佳的讀書時間表能幫助學生有效地平衡準備和休息。

definition_zh: (名) 樂觀；樂觀主義　(形) 樂觀的
example_sentence: Although facing many challenges, the team moved forward with optimism, believing success was possible.
sentence_zh: 雖然面臨許多挑戰，該隊懷著樂觀的態度向前邁進，相信成功是可能的。

definition_zh: (形) 樂觀的；充滿希望的
example_sentence: Having studied hard for months, the students felt optimistic about passing the exam.
sentence_zh: 經過數個月的努力學習，學生們對通過考試感到樂觀。

definition_zh: (動) 最佳化；優化　(動) 充分利用；改進效率
example_sentence: The company optimized the production process, which reduced costs significantly.
sentence_zh: 該公司優化了生產流程，這大幅降低了成本。

definition_zh: (名) 最佳狀態；最適條件　(形) 最佳的；最優的
example_sentence: Finding the optimum balance between study and rest helps students perform better on exams.
sentence_zh: 找到讀書和休息的最佳平衡有助於學生在考試中表現更好。

definition_zh: (名) 選擇；選項　(名) 可能性；機會
example_sentence: If students had more options, they would choose subjects matching their interests.
sentence_zh: 如果學生有更多選擇，他們就會選擇符合自己興趣的科目。

definition_zh: (形) 可選的；非必須的　(形) 自願的；任意的
example_sentence: Attending the school assembly is optional for all senior students.
sentence_zh: 參加學校集會對所有高年級學生是可選的。

definition_zh: (副) 可選擇地；可有可無地　(副) 任意地；隨意地
example_sentence: Choosing colors optionally, students designed their own posters for the art competition.
sentence_zh: 學生可自由選擇顏色，為美術競賽設計自己的海報。

definition_zh: (名) 豐富；奢華　(形) 豐富的；奢華的
example_sentence: Although the royal palace displayed opulence everywhere, the king lived a simple life.
sentence_zh: 雖然皇宮到處展示奢華，但國王過著簡樸的生活。

definition_zh: (形) 豪華的；奢侈的　(形) 富裕的；充裕的
example_sentence: Not only was the palace opulent, but the royal family's lifestyle also impressed countless visitors.
sentence_zh: 不僅宮殿豪華，皇室的生活方式也給無數遊客留下深刻印象。

definition_zh: (副) 左右；大約；或多或少
example_sentence: The exam lasted two hours or so, which made many students feel exhausted.
sentence_zh: 考試持續了大約兩小時，這讓許多學生感到疲憊。

definition_zh: (連) 或者；或是　(介) 否則；要不然
example_sentence: Study hard or you will fail the exam.
sentence_zh: 努力讀書，否則你會考試不及格。

definition_zh: (名) 神諭；預言　(名) 神殿；智者
example_sentence: The ancient oracle at Delphi predicted the outcome of many important battles.
sentence_zh: 古代德爾菲的神諭預言了許多重要戰役的結果。

definition_zh: (形) 口頭的；口說的　(形) 口腔的；口部的
example_sentence: The oral exam tests students' speaking skills and confidence.
sentence_zh: 口頭考試測試學生的說話技能和自信心。

definition_zh: (副) 口頭地；用言語
example_sentence: When the teacher asked students to present their reports orally, many felt nervous about speaking in front of the class.
sentence_zh: 當老師要求學生口頭報告時，許多人對著全班說話感到緊張。

definition_zh: (名) 橙子；柳橙　(形) 橙色的；橙色
example_sentence: Peeling the orange carefully, Sarah discovered several juicy segments inside.
sentence_zh: 莎拉仔細剝橙子，發現裡面有好幾個多汁的果肉瓣。

definition_zh: (名) 演說家；雄辯家　(名) 善於演講的人
example_sentence: The orator who delivered the speech at the graduation ceremony impressed all the students present.
sentence_zh: 在畢業典禮上發表演講的那位演說家給所有在場的學生留下了深刻的印象。

definition_zh: (名) 球體；天體　(動) 環繞；公轉
example_sentence: If the moon were closer to Earth, its orbital sphere would appear much larger in night sky.
sentence_zh: 如果月球離地球更近，它的球體在夜空中看起來會大得多。

definition_zh: (名) 軌道；軌跡　(動) 繞…運行；環繞
example_sentence: The Moon orbits Earth every twenty-nine days.
sentence_zh: 月球每二十九天繞地球一圈。

definition_zh: (形) 軌道的；眼眶的　(名) 軌道；眼眶
example_sentence: Scientists use powerful telescopes to observe orbital patterns in order to predict planetary movements.
sentence_zh: 科學家使用強大的望遠鏡觀察軌道運行規律，以便預測行星運動。

definition_zh: (名) 軌道衛星；環繞衛星
example_sentence: The Mars orbiter collected valuable data about the planet's atmosphere.
sentence_zh: 火星環繞衛星收集了關於該行星大氣的寶貴數據。

definition_zh: (名) 果園；蘋果園
example_sentence: When spring arrives, the orchard fills with white and pink blossoms.
sentence_zh: 春天到來時，果園裡開滿了白色和粉紅色的花。

definition_zh: (名) 管弦樂隊；樂團
example_sentence: Having performed at the National Concert Hall, the orchestra received standing ovations from the audience.
sentence_zh: 在國家音樂廳演出過後，管弦樂隊從觀眾獲得了起立喝彩。

definition_zh: (動) 策劃；組織　精心安排
example_sentence: The principal orchestrated a school event that impressed all parents who attended.
sentence_zh: 校長精心策劃了一場讓所有到場家長都印象深刻的校園活動。

definition_zh: (名) 蘭花；蘭科植物
example_sentence: The rare purple orchid blooming in the botanical garden attracted many visitors yesterday.
sentence_zh: 昨天在植物園盛開的稀有紫色蘭花吸引了許多遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 嚴峻的考驗；磨難
example_sentence: If the disaster had not occurred, the survivors would not have endured such a terrible ordeal.
sentence_zh: 如果災難沒有發生，倖存者就不會經歷如此可怕的考驗。

definition_zh: (動) 指揮；命令　(動) 對...發號施令
example_sentence: The coach ordered the players about during the entire practice session.
sentence_zh: 教練在整個練習期間對球員發號施令。

definition_zh: (動) 訂購；叫外送　(動) 命令進入
example_sentence: Ordering in pizza after finishing homework, Sarah and her friends enjoyed a relaxed Friday night.
sentence_zh: 完成功課後訂購披薩，莎拉和朋友們享受了輕鬆的週五夜晚。

definition_zh: (動) 叫外送；外帶訂購
example_sentence: When Mom is too tired to cook, the family orders out for pizza from the nearby restaurant.
sentence_zh: 當媽媽太累無法煮飯時，全家就從附近餐廳叫外送披薩。

definition_zh: (動) 訂購外賣；訂購外帶食物
example_sentence: Never did the family order out so often until the parents both started working overtime.
sentence_zh: 直到父母都開始加班後，這個家庭才從未如此頻繁地訂購外賣。

definition_zh: (名) 順序；秩序　(動) 訂購；命令　(形) 整齊的；有序的
example_sentence: The students who follow the classroom order are praised by the teacher.
sentence_zh: 遵守課堂秩序的學生受到老師的表揚。

definition_zh: (形) 整齊的；有秩序的　(副) 按順序地；井然有序地
example_sentence: The teacher arranged the classroom furniture in orderly rows to create a comfortable learning environment.
sentence_zh: 老師按順序排列教室家具，目的是營造舒適的學習環境。

definition_zh: (副) 通常；往往　(副) 普通地；平凡地
example_sentence: Ordinarily, students prepare for the CSAT by reviewing grammar and vocabulary daily.
sentence_zh: 通常，學生透過每天複習文法和單字來準備學測。

definition_zh: (形) 普通的；平凡的　(形) 日常的；常見的
example_sentence: Most students find daily homework ordinary, but challenging projects inspire them.
sentence_zh: 大多數學生認為日常功課很普通，但具挑戰性的專案能激勵他們。

definition_zh: (名) 礦石；礦　(名) 礦物資源
example_sentence: Because iron ore is essential for making steel, many countries invest heavily in mining operations.
sentence_zh: 因為鐵礦石對製造鋼鐵很重要，許多國家在採礦業投入大量資金。

definition_zh: (名) 器官；風琴
example_sentence: Playing the organ every weekend brings the old man great joy.
sentence_zh: 每個週末彈奏風琴為這位老人帶來極大的快樂。

definition_zh: (形) 有機的；有機體的
example_sentence: Choosing organic vegetables, the student supported local farmers.
sentence_zh: 選擇有機蔬菜，這位學生支持了當地農民。

definition_zh: (名) 生物；有機體
example_sentence: Every living organism needs water and sunlight to survive.
sentence_zh: 每個生物都需要水和陽光才能生存。

definition_zh: (名) 組織；機構
example_sentence: If the student organization had more members, it would plan a bigger charity event.
sentence_zh: 如果這個學生組織有更多成員，它就會規劃一個更大的慈善活動。

definition_zh: (動) 組織；安排
example_sentence: The students decided to organize a charity event for the homeless.
sentence_zh: 學生們決定為無家可歸的人組織一場慈善活動。

definition_zh: (動) 組織；安排　(形) 有組織的；有條理的
example_sentence: After the club fair organized the booths, new members quickly signed up.
sentence_zh: 社團博覽會安排好攤位後，新成員很快就報名了。

definition_zh: (名) 主辦人；組織者
example_sentence: After the class party, the organizer collected all the decorations.
sentence_zh: 班級派對結束後，主辦人收集了所有的裝飾品。

definition_zh: (名) 狂歡；放縱
example_sentence: The party turned into an orgy of eating and dancing.
sentence_zh: 派對變成了一場吃喝玩樂的狂歡。

definition_zh: (動) 使適應；確定方向
example_sentence: New students should orient themselves to campus life before classes begin.
sentence_zh: 新生應該在開課前熟悉校園生活。

definition_zh: (形) 東方的；東方風格的　(名) 東方人
example_sentence: The oriental garden features a beautiful pond and a traditional wooden bridge.
sentence_zh: 這座東方花園以美麗的池塘和傳統木橋為特色。

definition_zh: (名) 定向；迎新說明會
example_sentence: Before the new semester, the school provides a one-day orientation for freshmen.
sentence_zh: 新學期開始前，學校為新生提供了一天的迎新說明會。

definition_zh: (形) 定向的；以…為導向的
example_sentence: The new student is more oriented toward science than art.
sentence_zh: 這位新學生更傾向於科學而非藝術。

definition_zh: (名) 起源；來源
example_sentence: Many students trace the origin of their family name to learn about their ancestors.
sentence_zh: 許多學生追溯他們姓氏的起源，以了解他們的祖先。

definition_zh: (形) 原始的；最初的 (名) 原件；原文
example_sentence: The original painting by that artist is now worth millions.
sentence_zh: 那位藝術家的原畫現在價值數百萬。

definition_zh: (名) 原創性；獨創性
example_sentence: The teacher praised Amy's originality in solving the math problem.
sentence_zh: 老師稱讚艾米在解決數學問題時的原創性。

definition_zh: (副) 原本；起初
example_sentence: This restaurant was originally a small noodle shop run by a local family.
sentence_zh: 這家餐廳原本是一家當地家庭經營的小麵館。

definition_zh: (動) 起源；發源
example_sentence: Many traditional festivals originate from ancient agricultural customs in Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 許多傳統節日起源於台灣古老的農業習俗。

definition_zh: (名) 裝飾品；飾物
example_sentence: Many students add a small ornament to their backpack for a personal touch.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在背包上添加一個小裝飾品，以增添個人風格。

definition_zh: (形) 裝飾的；觀賞用的
example_sentence: Many students grow ornamental plants in their school garden to learn about nature.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在學校花園種植觀賞植物，以學習自然知識。

definition_zh: (形) 華麗的；裝飾華美的
example_sentence: The ornate architecture of the temple attracted many visitors.
sentence_zh: 寺廟華麗的建築吸引了許多遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 孤兒　(動) 使成孤兒
example_sentence: The charity raised funds to support every orphan in the rural village.
sentence_zh: 該慈善機構籌集資金以支持鄉村地區的每一位孤兒。

definition_zh: (名) 孤兒院
example_sentence: The students visited the old orphanage to learn about community service.
sentence_zh: 學生們參觀了那間舊孤兒院，以了解社區服務。

definition_zh: (形) 正統的；傳統的
example_sentence: Seldom does the orthodox view of history change without strong evidence.
sentence_zh: 正統的歷史觀點很少在沒有強烈證據的情況下改變。

definition_zh: (動) 擺動；振盪
example_sentence: If the fan oscillated more smoothly, the room would feel cooler.
sentence_zh: 如果電風扇擺動得更平順，房間就會感覺更涼爽。

definition_zh: (形) 浮誇的；炫耀的
example_sentence: The ostentatious watch that Mark wore drew everyone's attention.
sentence_zh: 馬克戴的那隻浮誇手錶引起了所有人的注意。

definition_zh: (名) 骨關節炎
example_sentence: Many elderly patients suffer from osteoarthritis in their knees.
sentence_zh: 許多老年患者膝蓋患有骨關節炎。

definition_zh: (名) 鴕鳥
example_sentence: The ostrich at the zoo buried its head in the sand.
sentence_zh: 動物園裡的鴕鳥把頭埋進沙子裡。

definition_zh: (形) 其他的；另外的　(代) 其他的人或事物
example_sentence: Other students in the class enjoy reading science fiction books.
sentence_zh: 班上其他學生喜歡閱讀科幻書籍。

definition_zh: (副) 否則；不然
example_sentence: Students must finish their homework on time; otherwise, the teacher will deduct points.
sentence_zh: 學生必須按時完成作業；否則老師會扣分。

definition_zh: (名) 長軟椅；無靠背的坐墊
example_sentence: Having rested on the ottoman, the student felt ready to study again.
sentence_zh: 在長軟椅上休息過後，這位學生覺得準備好再次念書了。

definition_zh: (助動) 應該
example_sentence: Worried about the exam, students ought to review their notes carefully.
sentence_zh: 擔心考試，學生們應該仔細複習筆記。

definition_zh: (名) 盎司；少量
example_sentence: The recipe calls for an ounce of dark chocolate.
sentence_zh: 食譜需要一盎司的黑巧克力。

definition_zh: (代) 我們的
example_sentence: Students study hard to improve our future opportunities.
sentence_zh: 學生們努力學習以改善我們未來的機會。

definition_zh: (代) 我們的
example_sentence: Our team finished the project before ours was even started.
sentence_zh: 我們的團隊在我們的專案甚至還沒開始之前就完成了。

definition_zh: (代) 我們自己
example_sentence: After finishing the project, we congratulated ourselves on a job well done.
sentence_zh: 完成專題後，我們為自己出色的工作感到祝賀。

definition_zh: (動) 驅逐；罷免
example_sentence: Ousted by the board, the CEO refused to comment on the scandal.
sentence_zh: 被董事會趕下台後，這位執行長拒絕評論這起醜聞。

definition_zh: (片) 失控；無法控制
example_sentence: If a fire gets out of control, the entire forest could burn.
sentence_zh: 如果火勢失控，整片森林都可能燒毀。

definition_zh: (片) 不妨礙；不擋路；偏僻的
example_sentence: The old bookshelf was moved out of the way to create more space.
sentence_zh: 舊書架被移開以騰出更多空間。

definition_zh: (形) 好得不得了；非凡的
example_sentence: The bubble tea at that shop is out of this world.
sentence_zh: 那家店的珍珠奶茶好喝到不行。

definition_zh: (名) 停電；中斷
example_sentence: The power outage that affected the whole city lasted for three hours.
sentence_zh: 影響整個城市的停電持續了三個小時。

definition_zh: (名) 爆發；突然發生
example_sentence: The government acted quickly to control the outbreak of the disease.
sentence_zh: 政府迅速採取行動控制疾病的爆發。

definition_zh: (名) 爆發；發作
example_sentence: When the teacher announced the quiz, an outburst of complaints filled the classroom.
sentence_zh: 當老師宣布小考時，一陣抱怨的爆發充滿了教室。

definition_zh: (名) 結果；成果
example_sentence: The outcome of the science fair surprised everyone in the class.
sentence_zh: 科展的結果讓班上每個人都感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (形) 過時的；落伍的
example_sentence: The outdated textbook still uses data from the 1990s.
sentence_zh: 這本過時的教科書仍在使用1990年代的資料。

definition_zh: (動) 超越；遠勝於
example_sentence: The runner who outdistanced all rivals broke the school record.
sentence_zh: 那名超越所有對手的跑者打破了學校紀錄。

definition_zh: (形) 戶外的；野外的
example_sentence: Students who enjoy outdoor activities often join school clubs.
sentence_zh: 喜歡戶外活動的學生經常參加學校社團。

definition_zh: (副) 在戶外
example_sentence: Exercising outdoors every morning improves both physical and mental health.
sentence_zh: 每天早上在戶外運動能改善身心健康。

definition_zh: (形) 外面的；外部的
example_sentence: Having explored the outer space, the astronaut shared his amazing experience.
sentence_zh: 探索過外太空後，太空人分享了他驚人的經歷。

definition_zh: (形) 最外層的；最遠的
example_sentence: The outermost layer of the Earth is called the crust.
sentence_zh: 地球的最外層稱為地殼。

definition_zh: (名) 服裝；裝備　(動) 配備；裝備
example_sentence: Jenny bought a new outfit for the school festival.
sentence_zh: 珍妮為學校園遊會買了一套新服裝。

definition_zh: (動) 智勝；比…更狡猾
example_sentence: The clever fox that outfoxed the hunter escaped into the forest.
sentence_zh: 那隻智勝獵人的聰明狐狸逃進了森林。

definition_zh: (形) 外向的；好交際的
example_sentence: Seldom have I met such an outgoing person at school.
sentence_zh: 在學校我很少遇到這麼外向的人。

definition_zh: (名) 遠足；郊遊
example_sentence: The class outing that the teacher planned was a great success.
sentence_zh: 老師規劃的班級遠足非常成功。

definition_zh: (形) 怪異的；奇特的
example_sentence: The student's outlandish costume drew everyone's attention at the party.
sentence_zh: 那位學生怪異的服裝在派對上吸引了所有人的注意。

definition_zh: (動) 比…持久；比…耐用
example_sentence: The battery that outlasts all others is the best choice.
sentence_zh: 這顆比所有其他電池都耐用的電池是最佳選擇。

definition_zh: (動) [aʊt'lɔ] 宣布...為非法；禁止　(名) ['aʊt'lɔ] 罪犯；亡命之徒
example_sentence: The government plans to outlaw the use of plastic bags in stores.
sentence_zh: 政府計劃在商店中禁止使用塑膠袋。

definition_zh: (名) 出口；管線；紓解途徑
example_sentence: Many students find an outlet for stress through sports and music.
sentence_zh: 許多學生透過運動和音樂找到紓解壓力的管道。

definition_zh: (動) 概述；列出要點　(名) 輪廓；大綱
example_sentence: The teacher asked us to outline the main points of the article.
sentence_zh: 老師要求我們列出文章的重點。

definition_zh: (動) 比...活得久；在...之後仍然存在
example_sentence: The old tree that outlived the storm still stands in the park.
sentence_zh: 那棵在暴風雨中存活下來的老樹依然矗立在公園裡。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈaʊtˌlʊk] 觀點；展望　(動) [aʊtˈlʊk] 比...好看
example_sentence: The student's outlook on the future changed after she read the inspiring book.
sentence_zh: 這個學生對未來的看法在她讀了那本鼓舞人心的書之後改變了。

definition_zh: (形) 偏遠的；外圍的
example_sentence: The government plans to build a new school in an outlying village.
sentence_zh: 政府計劃在一個偏遠村莊建造一所新學校。

definition_zh: (動) 在數量上超過
example_sentence: Girls in this class outnumber boys by a large margin.
sentence_zh: 這個班級的女生人數遠遠超過男生。

definition_zh: (動) 超越；比…更快
example_sentence: If the company wants to outpace its rivals, it must innovate faster.
sentence_zh: 如果這家公司想要超越競爭對手，就必須更快地創新。

definition_zh: (名) 門診病人
example_sentence: Because the hospital was crowded, the outpatient waited for two hours.
sentence_zh: 因為醫院很擁擠，那位門診病人等了兩個小時。

definition_zh: (動) 表現優於；勝過
example_sentence: The new smartphone that outperforms its rivals is very popular.
sentence_zh: 這款性能超越競爭對手的新智慧型手機非常受歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 湧現；傾瀉
example_sentence: The outpouring of support from classmates cheered up the injured student.
sentence_zh: 來自同學的支持湧現，讓受傷的學生振作起來。

definition_zh: (名) 產量；輸出
example_sentence: When the team increased its output, the factory met its monthly goal.
sentence_zh: 當團隊提高產量時，工廠達成了月度目標。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈaʊtˌredʒ] 憤怒；暴行　(動) [aʊtˈredʒ] 激怒；使震怒
example_sentence: The unfair grading policy caused public outrage among students.
sentence_zh: 不公平的評分政策引發了學生們的公憤。

definition_zh: (形) 憤怒的；憤慨的
example_sentence: Outraged by the unfair grading, the students demanded a meeting with the teacher.
sentence_zh: 學生們因不公正的評分感到憤怒，要求與老師會面。

definition_zh: (形) 離譜的；令人氣憤的
example_sentence: Never have I heard such an outrageous rumor about our teacher.
sentence_zh: 我從未聽過關於我們老師如此離譜的謠言。

definition_zh: (名) 推廣；外展服務
example_sentence: The school's outreach program that helps poor families is very popular.
sentence_zh: 這所學校幫助貧困家庭的推廣計畫非常受歡迎。

definition_zh: (副) [aʊt'raɪt] 完全地；坦率地；立即　(形) ['aʊtˌraɪt] 完全的；直率的
example_sentence: Having rejected the offer outright, the company faced a difficult future.
sentence_zh: 公司斷然拒絕了這項提議，因此面臨艱難的未來。

definition_zh: (動) 跑得比……快；超越
example_sentence: The new electric car can outrun most gasoline vehicles on the highway.
sentence_zh: 這輛新的電動車能在高速公路上超越大多數汽油車。

definition_zh: (動) 賣得比...多；銷量超過
example_sentence: This new smartphone model outsells all previous versions in the market.
sentence_zh: 這款新智慧型手機型號在市場上比所有舊款都賣得好。

definition_zh: (名) 開始；開端
example_sentence: The project faced financial problems from the outset.
sentence_zh: 這個計畫從一開始就面臨財務問題。

definition_zh: (副) 在外面　(介) 在...外面　(名) 外面
example_sentence: If the weather outside were nicer, the students would play basketball.
sentence_zh: 如果外面的天氣更好，學生們就會打籃球。

definition_zh: (名) 局外人；外人
example_sentence: The new student felt like an outsider in the crowded classroom.
sentence_zh: 那位新學生在擁擠的教室裡感覺像個局外人。

definition_zh: (名) 郊區；邊緣地帶
example_sentence: The factory on the outskirts of the city provides many jobs.
sentence_zh: 位於城市郊區的那家工廠提供了許多工作機會。

definition_zh: (動) 智勝；比…更聰明
example_sentence: Although the test was difficult, Sarah managed to outsmart the tricky questions.
sentence_zh: 雖然考試很難，莎拉還是設法智取了那些刁難的題目。

definition_zh: (形) 直言不諱的；坦率的
example_sentence: The student council president remained outspoken to advocate for better cafeteria food.
sentence_zh: 學生會會長為了爭取更好的午餐而保持直言不諱。

definition_zh: (形) 傑出的；未解決的
example_sentence: Her outstanding performance in the science fair earned her a scholarship.
sentence_zh: 她在科展中的傑出表現為她贏得了獎學金。

definition_zh: (動) 伸展；張開
example_sentence: The eagle outstretches its wings before taking flight.
sentence_zh: 老鷹在起飛前伸展翅膀。

definition_zh: (形) 外表的；向外的　(副) 向外；在外
example_sentence: Her outward calmness hid a deep anxiety about the exam.
sentence_zh: 她外表上的冷靜隱藏了對考試的深深焦慮。

definition_zh: (動) 超過；重於
example_sentence: The benefits of studying abroad outweigh the costs.
sentence_zh: 出國留學的好處超過了成本。

definition_zh: (動) 智勝；以機智取勝
example_sentence: The clever student who outwits the tricky puzzle earns extra credit.
sentence_zh: 那個解開棘手謎題的聰明學生獲得了額外分數。

definition_zh: (形) 橢圓形的　(名) 橢圓形
example_sentence: If the table had an oval shape, it would fit better in the corner.
sentence_zh: 如果這張桌子是橢圓形的，它會更適合放在角落。

definition_zh: (名) 熱烈鼓掌；歡呼
example_sentence: The singer received a standing ovation from the crowd.
sentence_zh: 那位歌手從群眾那裡得到了起立鼓掌。

definition_zh: (名) 烤箱；爐
example_sentence: After the cake is ready, the oven should be turned off.
sentence_zh: 蛋糕準備好後，烤箱應該關掉。

definition_zh: (副) 一再地；反覆地
example_sentence: The teacher repeated the instructions over and over until everyone understood.
sentence_zh: 老師一遍又一遍地重複指示，直到每個人都理解為止。

definition_zh: (片) 在…過程中
example_sentence: Seldom over the course of a single lecture has such profound insight been shared.
sentence_zh: 很少在一場演講的過程中分享如此深刻的見解。

definition_zh: (片) 誇張的；過度的
example_sentence: The movie's special effects were over the top and unrealistic.
sentence_zh: 這部電影的特效誇張且不真實。

definition_zh: (片) 隨著時間過去；久而久之
example_sentence: The garden that my grandmother tended over time became a beautiful oasis.
sentence_zh: 我祖母長期照料的花園變成了一個美麗的綠洲。

definition_zh: (介) 在…之上；超過　(副) 結束；越過
example_sentence: Worried over the exam, Linda studied all night.
sentence_zh: 琳達擔心考試，整晚都在念書。

definition_zh: (形) 整體的；全面的　(副) 總體上；大體上
example_sentence: Having considered all factors, the team gave an overall positive review of the project.
sentence_zh: 考慮了所有因素後，團隊對該專案給予了整體正面的評價。

definition_zh: (形) 專橫的；傲慢的
example_sentence: If the manager were less overbearing, the team would feel more motivated.
sentence_zh: 如果經理不那麼專橫，團隊會更有動力。

definition_zh: (動) 超售；超額預訂
example_sentence: Airlines often overbook flights to maximize their profits during holidays.
sentence_zh: 航空公司常在假期超售機票以最大化利潤。

definition_zh: (形) 陰天的；多雲的　(動) 遮蔽；使陰暗
example_sentence: The sky being overcast, the outdoor concert was canceled.
sentence_zh: 天空陰沉沉的，戶外音樂會因此取消了。

definition_zh: (名) 大衣
example_sentence: Because the weather was cold, Mary wore a thick overcoat to school.
sentence_zh: 因為天氣很冷，瑪麗穿了一件厚大衣去上學。

definition_zh: (動) 克服；戰勝
example_sentence: The student who overcomes her fear of speaking will succeed in class.
sentence_zh: 克服了發言恐懼的學生將在課堂上取得成功。

definition_zh: (動) 做得過頭；過度
example_sentence: Students often overdo their studying before final exams.
sentence_zh: 學生們在期末考前常常讀書過度。

definition_zh: (名) 透支；透支額
example_sentence: The bank charged a high fee for the account overdraft.
sentence_zh: 銀行對帳戶透支收取高額費用。

definition_zh: (形) 過期的；延誤的
example_sentence: The library book that is overdue must be returned tomorrow.
sentence_zh: 那本逾期未還的圖書館書必須在明天歸還。

definition_zh: (動) 吃太多；暴食
example_sentence: To avoid overeating, many students choose smaller meal portions.
sentence_zh: 為了避免吃太多，許多學生選擇較小的餐食份量。

definition_zh: (名) 暴飲暴食；過量進食
example_sentence: Many students try to avoid overeating during exam season.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在考試期間試圖避免暴飲暴食。

definition_zh: (動) 高估
example_sentence: Many students overestimate their ability to finish homework quickly.
sentence_zh: 許多學生高估了自己快速完成作業的能力。

definition_zh: (動) 氾濫；溢出
example_sentence: The river might overflow after a week of heavy rain.
sentence_zh: 在連續一週的大雨之後，這條河可能會氾濫。

definition_zh: (形) 雜草叢生的；長滿植物的
example_sentence: The overgrown garden behind the school needs immediate cleaning.
sentence_zh: 學校後面雜草叢生的花園需要立即清理。

definition_zh: (動) 徹底檢修；全面改革
example_sentence: The school decided to overhaul the library to create a modern study space.
sentence_zh: 學校決定徹底翻新圖書館，以打造一個現代的學習空間。

definition_zh: (形) 頭頂上的；上方的　(副) 在頭頂上；在上方　(名) 經常性開支；管理費用
example_sentence: The overhead wires on the street provide electricity for the trains.
sentence_zh: 街道上方的電線為火車提供電力。

definition_zh: (動) 過熱
example_sentence: If the computer continued to overheat, the teacher would shut it down.
sentence_zh: 如果電腦繼續過熱，老師就會關掉它。

definition_zh: (形) 非常高興的；狂喜的
example_sentence: If the school wins the competition, the students will be overjoyed.
sentence_zh: 如果學校贏得比賽，學生們會非常高興。

definition_zh: (動) [ˌovɚ'læp] 重疊；部分重複　(名) ['ovɚˌlæp] 重疊部分
example_sentence: The schedule of the two clubs may overlap this semester.
sentence_zh: 這兩個社團的行程這學期可能會重疊。

definition_zh: (名) 超載；負荷過重　(動) 使超載；使負荷過重
example_sentence: The server that experienced an overload crashed during the final exam.
sentence_zh: 在期末考期間，經歷超載的伺服器當機了。

definition_zh: (動) 忽略；俯視
example_sentence: Having overlooked the deadline, the student had to submit the report late.
sentence_zh: 忽略了截止日期，那名學生不得不遲交報告。

definition_zh: (副) 過度地；過分地
example_sentence: The teacher thinks the student is overly worried about the test.
sentence_zh: 老師認為這位學生對考試過度擔心。

definition_zh: (副) 在夜間；一夜之間　(形) 夜間的；突然的
example_sentence: If a typhoon struck overnight, the school would announce a holiday.
sentence_zh: 如果颱風在夜間來襲，學校就會宣布放假。

definition_zh: (名) 天橋；陸橋
example_sentence: The new overpass that connects the school to the park is very convenient.
sentence_zh: 連接學校和公園的新天橋非常方便。

definition_zh: (動) 壓倒；制服
example_sentence: The strong smell of garlic can overpower the other flavors in a dish.
sentence_zh: 大蒜的強烈氣味會壓過菜餚中的其他味道。

definition_zh: (動) 對……定價過高；索價過高
example_sentence: That electronics store tends to overprice its headphones.
sentence_zh: 那家電子用品店傾向於高價出售其耳機。

definition_zh: (動) 過度伸手；越權
example_sentence: If the company overreaches in its expansion, it may face serious losses.
sentence_zh: 如果公司在擴張上過度伸手，可能會面臨嚴重損失。

definition_zh: (動) 推翻；凌駕；優先於
example_sentence: The new safety rules override the old ones.
sentence_zh: 新的安全規則取代了舊的。

definition_zh: (副) 在國外；在海外　(形) 海外的；國外的
example_sentence: Many students dream of studying overseas after high school.
sentence_zh: 許多學生夢想高中畢業後出國留學。

definition_zh: (動) 監督；監管
example_sentence: The construction manager will oversee the new building project.
sentence_zh: 建築經理將監督新建築工程。

definition_zh: (動) 遮蔽；使黯然失色
example_sentence: Never has the beauty of the night sky been overshadowed by city lights.
sentence_zh: 城市燈光從未掩蓋夜空之美。

definition_zh: (名) 疏忽；監管
example_sentence: The oversight that caused the error was quickly corrected by the teacher.
sentence_zh: 導致錯誤的疏忽很快被老師糾正了。

definition_zh: (形) 過大的；特大號的
example_sentence: The oversized backpack made it hard for Jenny to enter the crowded bus.
sentence_zh: 這個過大的背包讓珍妮很難擠進擁擠的公車。

definition_zh: (動) 睡過頭
example_sentence: Because Mia oversleeps, her mother drives her to school.
sentence_zh: 因為米亞睡過頭，她媽媽開車送她去學校。

definition_zh: (形) 人員過剩的；冗員過多的
example_sentence: Seldom is a company so overstaffed that it wastes resources.
sentence_zh: 很少有公司會人員過剩到浪費資源的地步。

definition_zh: (動) 誇大；言過其實
example_sentence: To avoid misleading the public, reporters must not overstate the facts.
sentence_zh: 為了避免誤導大眾，記者不得誇大事實。

definition_zh: (名) 誇大；誇張
example_sentence: Calling the test too easy is a clear overstatement of its difficulty.
sentence_zh: 稱這次考試太簡單是對其難度的明顯誇大。

definition_zh: (動) 逾越；越權
example_sentence: If a student overstepped the school rules, the teacher would give a warning.
sentence_zh: 如果學生逾越了校規，老師會給予警告。

definition_zh: (形) 公開的；明顯的
example_sentence: The team's overt strategy surprised their opponents during the game.
sentence_zh: 這支隊伍公開的策略在比賽中讓對手感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (動) 追上；超越
example_sentence: The car behind us tried to overtake on the narrow mountain road.
sentence_zh: 我們後面的車試圖在狹窄的山路上超車。

definition_zh: (動) [ˌovɚ'θro] 推翻；顛覆　(名) ['ovɚˌθro] 推翻；垮臺
example_sentence: The rebels planned to overthrow the corrupt government.
sentence_zh: 叛亂分子計劃推翻腐敗的政府。

definition_zh: (名) 加班；超時工作
example_sentence: If the project requires overtime, the team will receive extra pay.
sentence_zh: 如果專案需要加班，團隊將獲得額外報酬。

definition_zh: (副) 公開地；明顯地
example_sentence: Students who overtly protest school rules may face detention.
sentence_zh: 公開抗議校規的學生可能會面臨留校察看的處分。

definition_zh: (動) 推翻；顛覆
example_sentence: The court's decision could overturn the previous ruling on student rights.
sentence_zh: 法院的判決可能推翻先前關於學生權利的裁決。

definition_zh: (名) 概述；概觀
example_sentence: The teacher gave an overview of the history before the final exam.
sentence_zh: 老師在期末考前概略介紹了歷史。

definition_zh: (形) 過重的；超重的
example_sentence: Many students exercise regularly to avoid becoming overweight.
sentence_zh: 許多學生定期運動以避免變得過重。

definition_zh: (動) [ˌovɚˈwɛlm] 壓垮；淹沒　(名) ['ovɚˌwɛlm] 壓倒；征服
example_sentence: To avoid being overwhelmed by homework, students should plan their time well.
sentence_zh: 為了避免被作業壓垮，學生應該好好規劃時間。

definition_zh: (形) 壓倒性的；無法抵抗的
example_sentence: The overwhelming amount of homework made many students stay up late.
sentence_zh: 大量的作業讓許多學生熬夜。

definition_zh: (形) 壓倒性的；無法抗拒的
example_sentence: Students formed a study group to overcome the overwhelming amount of homework.
sentence_zh: 學生們組成讀書小組，以克服壓倒性的作業量。

definition_zh: (副) 壓倒性地；無法抗拒地
example_sentence: If the test were overwhelmingly difficult, many students would fail.
sentence_zh: 如果考試壓倒性地困難，許多學生就會不及格。

definition_zh: (動) [ˌovɚ'wɝk] 過度工作；過勞　(名) ['ovɚˌwɝk] 過度工作；過勞
example_sentence: If students overwork before exams, their health often suffers.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試前過度工作，他們的健康常常會受損。

definition_zh: (片) 歸因於；由於
example_sentence: Owing to the heavy rain, the school sports day was postponed.
sentence_zh: 由於大雨，學校運動會延期了。

definition_zh: (動) 欠；歸功於
example_sentence: Owing money to friends often causes awkward situations.
sentence_zh: 欠朋友的錢常常造成尷尬的情況。

definition_zh: (名) 貓頭鷹
example_sentence: The owl hooted loudly from the tree near our school at night.
sentence_zh: 那隻貓頭鷹在我們學校附近的樹上大聲鳴叫。

definition_zh: (片) 承認；坦白
example_sentence: The student finally owned up to breaking the classroom window.
sentence_zh: 那名學生終於承認打破了教室的窗戶。

definition_zh: (名) 所有者；主人
example_sentence: Having found the lost wallet, the owner expressed his gratitude.
sentence_zh: 找到遺失的錢包後，失主表達了他的感謝。

definition_zh: (名) 所有權；物主身份
example_sentence: If the company had full ownership of the land, it would build a park.
sentence_zh: 如果這家公司擁有這塊土地的完全所有權，它就會建造一座公園。

definition_zh: (名) 公牛；牛
example_sentence: The strong ox that pulled the cart was very tired.
sentence_zh: 那頭拉車的強壯公牛非常疲倦。

definition_zh: (名) 氧化劑
example_sentence: If the oxidant level rises, the chemical reaction will speed up.
sentence_zh: 如果氧化劑濃度上升，化學反應就會加速。

definition_zh: (名) 氧化物
example_sentence: Iron oxide forms a red layer on rusty metal surfaces.
sentence_zh: 氧化鐵在生鏽的金屬表面形成一層紅色的膜。

definition_zh: (動) 氧化；使氧化
example_sentence: Seldom does iron oxidize as quickly as copper in the same environment.
sentence_zh: 鐵很少在同樣的環境中像銅一樣快速氧化。

definition_zh: (名) 氧；氧氣
example_sentence: If plants lack oxygen, their roots cannot grow properly.
sentence_zh: 如果植物缺乏氧氣，它們的根部就無法正常生長。

definition_zh: (名) 牡蠣；蠔
example_sentence: The oyster in the market is fresh and delicious.
sentence_zh: 市場裡的牡蠣新鮮又美味。

definition_zh: (名) 臭氧
example_sentence: Scientists study the ozone layer to understand its role in protecting Earth.
sentence_zh: 科學家研究臭氧層，以了解它在保護地球中的作用。

definition_zh: (名) 步伐；速度　(動) 踱步；為……定速度
example_sentence: Walking at a steady pace, the students finished the run easily.
sentence_zh: 以穩定的步伐行走，學生們輕鬆完成了跑步。

definition_zh: (名) 心律調節器；起搏器
example_sentence: The doctor recommended a pacemaker for the patient's irregular heartbeat.
sentence_zh: 醫生建議病人使用心律調節器來治療不規則的心跳。

definition_zh: (名) 領先者；先驅
example_sentence: Being a pacesetter in technology, Apple inspires many young innovators.
sentence_zh: 作為科技領域的領先者，蘋果公司啟發了許多年輕的創新者。

definition_zh: (動) 使平靜；平息
example_sentence: Having pacified the argument, the teacher continued the lesson.
sentence_zh: 平息了爭論後，老師繼續上課。

definition_zh: (名) 和平主義；反戰主義
example_sentence: Having studied pacifism, the student wrote a persuasive essay against war.
sentence_zh: 研究了和平主義後，這位學生寫了一篇反對戰爭的說服性文章。

definition_zh: (名) 和平主義者；反戰者
example_sentence: Although many admire his ideals, the pacifist faces criticism during wartime.
sentence_zh: 雖然許多人欽佩他的理想，但這位和平主義者在戰時仍面臨批評。

definition_zh: (動) 安撫；平息
example_sentence: The manager who tried to pacify the angry customers failed.
sentence_zh: 那位試圖安撫憤怒顧客的經理失敗了。

definition_zh: (片) 收拾；儲存
example_sentence: After the party, the students pack away the leftover food for lunch.
sentence_zh: 派對結束後，學生們把剩餘的食物收拾起來當午餐。

definition_zh: (片) 吸引（大量人群）；擠滿
example_sentence: The concert managed to pack in thousands of excited fans.
sentence_zh: 這場演唱會成功吸引了數千名興奮的粉絲。

definition_zh: (片) 收工；停止做某事
example_sentence: The exhausted team decided to pack it in after the long rehearsal.
sentence_zh: 疲憊的團隊在長時間排練後決定收工。

definition_zh: (片) 打發；送走
example_sentence: Having packed off her younger brother, the student focused on her homework.
sentence_zh: 打發弟弟離開後，那個學生專心做作業。

definition_zh: (片) 擠滿；裝滿
example_sentence: Having packed out the auditorium, the students waited for the guest speaker.
sentence_zh: 學生們擠滿了禮堂後，等待著演講嘉賓。

definition_zh: (片) 打包；收拾
example_sentence: After the final exam, students pack up their bags quickly.
sentence_zh: 期末考後，學生們迅速收拾書包。

definition_zh: (動) 打包；包裝　(名) 背包；一包
example_sentence: If you pack your bag tonight, you will save time tomorrow.
sentence_zh: 如果你今晚打包好你的包包，你明天就能節省時間。

definition_zh: (名) 包裹；包裝　(動) 包裝；打包
example_sentence: The package that arrived this morning contains a new book.
sentence_zh: 今天早上送達的包裹裡有一本新書。

definition_zh: (形) 包裝好的
example_sentence: The packaged snacks in the vending machine are very popular.
sentence_zh: 販賣機裡的包裝零食非常受歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 包裝；包裝材料
example_sentence: If the company reduced its packaging, the environment would benefit greatly.
sentence_zh: 如果這家公司減少包裝，環境將會大大受益。

definition_zh: (動) 擠滿；塞滿　(形) 擁擠的；塞滿的
example_sentence: The stadium packed with cheering fans erupted in celebration.
sentence_zh: 擠滿歡呼粉絲的體育館爆發出慶祝聲。

definition_zh: (名) 小包；封套
example_sentence: The student opened a packet of chips during lunch break.
sentence_zh: 那名學生在午休時間打開了一包洋芋片。

definition_zh: (名) 包裝；打包　(動) 包裝；收拾行李
example_sentence: If packing for a trip took less time, students would travel more often.
sentence_zh: 如果打包行李花更少時間，學生就會更常旅行。

definition_zh: (名) 協議；條約
example_sentence: Signing a climate pact, the two countries promised to reduce carbon emissions.
sentence_zh: 簽署氣候協議後，這兩個國家承諾減少碳排放。

definition_zh: (片) 搜身；拍打檢查
example_sentence: The guard who pads down every visitor at the entrance is very strict.
sentence_zh: 在入口處對每位訪客進行搜身的警衛非常嚴格。

definition_zh: (片) 加些無關內容以拉長（文章、講話等）
example_sentence: If the student padded out his essay, the teacher would notice.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在文章中加些無關內容，老師會注意到。

definition_zh: (動) 填塞；墊襯　(名) 墊子；便箋簿
example_sentence: Padding his backpack with extra clothes, the student prepared for the school trip.
sentence_zh: 用額外的衣物填滿背包後，這位學生為學校旅行做準備。

definition_zh: (名) 槳；槳板　(動) 用槳划船；涉水
example_sentence: Paddling a canoe across the lake, the campers enjoyed the peaceful morning.
sentence_zh: 露營者划著獨木舟穿過湖面，享受寧靜的早晨。

definition_zh: (形) 小兒科的
example_sentence: Because the child had a high fever, the paediatric doctor examined her carefully.
sentence_zh: 因為孩子發高燒，小兒科醫生仔細檢查了她。

definition_zh: (名) 異教徒；無宗教信仰者　(形) 異教的；無宗教信仰的
example_sentence: The old temple was built by pagan tribes centuries ago.
sentence_zh: 這座古老的寺廟是幾個世紀前由異教徒部落建造的。

definition_zh: (名) 頁；頁面　(動) 呼叫；翻頁
example_sentence: The student turned to page 45 for the reading exercise.
sentence_zh: 這位學生翻到第45頁做閱讀練習。

definition_zh: (名) 選美比賽；盛會
example_sentence: Although the pageant was canceled, the contestants still practiced their walks.
sentence_zh: 雖然選美比賽取消了，參賽者仍然練習走台步。

definition_zh: (名) 呼叫器；傳呼機
example_sentence: The doctor carried a pager to receive emergency calls.
sentence_zh: 醫生帶著呼叫器以接收緊急電話。

definition_zh: (動) 支付；給報酬　(形) 有薪的；已支付的
example_sentence: Paid well for his part-time job, Tom bought a new laptop.
sentence_zh: 兼職工作報酬不錯，湯姆買了一台新筆電。

definition_zh: (名) 水桶；提桶
example_sentence: Having filled the pail with water, the farmer carried it to the thirsty crops.
sentence_zh: 將水桶裝滿水後，農夫把它提去給乾渴的作物。

definition_zh: (名) 疼痛；痛苦　(動) 使痛苦
example_sentence: Never before had the athlete felt such intense pain in his ankle.
sentence_zh: 這位運動員從未感到腳踝如此劇烈的疼痛。

definition_zh: (形) 痛苦的；令人疼痛的
example_sentence: Studying for the math exam was a painful experience for many students.
sentence_zh: 為數學考試而讀書對許多學生來說是一次痛苦的經歷。

definition_zh: (形) 費盡心力的；煞費苦心的
example_sentence: The students' painstaking research on local rivers earned them a science award.
sentence_zh: 學生們對當地河川的費心研究為他們贏得了科學獎項。

definition_zh: (副) 費力地；一絲不苟地
example_sentence: If a student painstakingly reviews notes, better exam results will follow.
sentence_zh: 如果學生仔細地複習筆記，就會有更好的考試成績。

definition_zh: (動) 畫；塗油漆　(名) 油漆；顏料
example_sentence: The student needs to paint a picture for art class.
sentence_zh: 這位學生需要為美術課畫一幅畫。

definition_zh: (名) 畫筆；油漆刷
example_sentence: The artist cleaned her paintbrush carefully after finishing the watercolor.
sentence_zh: 藝術家在完成水彩畫後仔細地清潔了她的畫筆。

definition_zh: (名) 畫家；油漆工
example_sentence: Because the painter used bright colors, the painting looked cheerful.
sentence_zh: 因為畫家使用了明亮的顏色，這幅畫看起來很歡快。

definition_zh: (名) 繪畫；畫作　(動) 繪畫（paint 的動名詞形式）
example_sentence: After finishing her homework, Amy started a new painting of the sunset.
sentence_zh: 做完功課後，艾咪開始畫一幅新的日落畫作。

definition_zh: (片) 與…配對；與…結成對
example_sentence: The teacher asked the students to pair off with a partner for the project.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生們為這個專題與一位夥伴配對。

definition_zh: (片) 配對；成對分開
example_sentence: If the teacher pairs off the students, each group will have two members.
sentence_zh: 如果老師把學生兩兩配對，每組將有兩名成員。

definition_zh: (片) 配對；組成一對
example_sentence: Having paired up with a partner, the students began the science project.
sentence_zh: 與夥伴配對後，學生們開始了科學專題。

definition_zh: (動) 配對；使成對　(名) 一對；一副
example_sentence: The teacher asked each student to pair with a new classmate for the project.
sentence_zh: 老師要求每位學生為了這個專題與一位新同學配對。

definition_zh: (名) 睡衣
example_sentence: Wearing warm pajamas helps the girl sleep better on cold nights.
sentence_zh: 穿著溫暖的睡衣有助於女孩在寒冷的夜晚睡得更好。

definition_zh: (片) 閒逛；結伴遊玩
example_sentence: Two old friends like to pal about in the park every weekend.
sentence_zh: 兩個老朋友喜歡每個週末在公園裡閒逛。

definition_zh: (片) 與…交朋友；結交
example_sentence: The student who pals up with a new classmate often feels less lonely.
sentence_zh: 和新聞學交朋友的學生通常比較不孤單。

definition_zh: (名) 朋友；夥伴
example_sentence: The pal who helped me with my math homework is very kind.
sentence_zh: 那個幫我寫數學作業的朋友非常友善。

definition_zh: (名) 宮殿；宏偉的建築
example_sentence: After the tour ended, the palace remained a symbol of ancient glory.
sentence_zh: 導覽結束後，這座宮殿仍是古代榮耀的象徵。

definition_zh: (名) 味覺；口味
example_sentence: The chef's new dish pleased every palate at the table.
sentence_zh: 主廚的新菜餚滿足了桌上每個人的味覺。

definition_zh: (形) 蒼白的；淡的
example_sentence: The student who felt pale after the exam drank some water.
sentence_zh: 那個考試後臉色蒼白的學生喝了一些水。

definition_zh: (名) 古生物學家
example_sentence: A young paleontologist discovered a rare dinosaur fossil in the desert.
sentence_zh: 一位年輕的古生物學家在沙漠中發現了一個罕見的恐龍化石。

definition_zh: (名) 調色板；色調
example_sentence: Having chosen a vibrant palette, the artist began to paint the sunset.
sentence_zh: 選擇了鮮豔的色調後，藝術家開始畫夕陽。

definition_zh: (片) 以假充真；騙賣
example_sentence: The salesman tried to palm off a fake watch as a genuine Rolex.
sentence_zh: 那位銷售員試圖把假手錶偽裝成正品勞力士出售。

definition_zh: (片) 騙售；以欺騙方式推銷
example_sentence: The salesman tried to palm off fake watches on the tourists.
sentence_zh: 這個銷售員試圖將假錶推銷給觀光客。

definition_zh: (名) 手掌；掌心　(動) 把…藏在手中
example_sentence: The student pressed his palm against the window to see the rainbow.
sentence_zh: 那名學生把手掌貼在窗戶上，以便看見彩虹。

definition_zh: (動) 寵愛；縱容
example_sentence: My grandmother loves to pamper her grandchildren with homemade cookies.
sentence_zh: 我的祖母喜歡用自製餅乾寵愛她的孫子們。

definition_zh: (名) 小冊子
example_sentence: Seldom have I seen a more informative pamphlet on environmental issues.
sentence_zh: 我很少看到一份關於環境議題更具資訊性的小冊子。

definition_zh: (片) 成功；結果是
example_sentence: Students work hard to make their group project pan out.
sentence_zh: 學生們努力讓他們的團體專案成功。

definition_zh: (名) 平底鍋；盤子
example_sentence: The chef used a large pan to fry the vegetables.
sentence_zh: 廚師用一個大平底鍋來炒蔬菜。

definition_zh: (名) 萬靈丹；解決問題的對策
example_sentence: Thinking technology is a panacea, many students ignore the importance of basic skills.
sentence_zh: 認為科技是萬靈丹，許多學生忽略了基本技能的重要性。

definition_zh: (名) 鬆餅；薄煎餅
example_sentence: If Emma ate a pancake every morning, she would feel full until lunch.
sentence_zh: 如果艾瑪每天早上吃一塊鬆餅，她會飽到午餐。

definition_zh: (名) 熊貓
example_sentence: The panda at the Taipei Zoo eats bamboo every day.
sentence_zh: 台北動物園的熊貓每天吃竹子。

definition_zh: (名) 大流行病；疫情
example_sentence: Since the pandemic began, students have adapted to online learning.
sentence_zh: 自從疫情開始以來，學生們已經適應了線上學習。

definition_zh: (名) 窗格玻璃；一片玻璃
example_sentence: After the storm, a large pane of glass fell from the window.
sentence_zh: 暴風雨過後，一大片玻璃從窗戶掉下來。

definition_zh: (名) 面板；控制板
example_sentence: The control panel that the technician fixed yesterday is working again.
sentence_zh: 技術員昨天修理的那個控制面板又恢復正常了。

definition_zh: (名) 座談會成員；討論小組成員
example_sentence: The panelist shared her opinion on the new recycling program.
sentence_zh: 那位座談會成員分享了她對新回收計畫的意見。

definition_zh: (名) 恐慌；驚慌　(動) 使恐慌；驚慌失措
example_sentence: The sudden power outage caused a panic among the students.
sentence_zh: 突然的停電在學生中引起了恐慌。

definition_zh: (形) 恐慌的；驚慌失措的
example_sentence: The dog's panicky barking woke the entire neighborhood before dawn.
sentence_zh: 那隻狗驚慌的吠叫聲在黎明前吵醒了整個社區。

definition_zh: (動) 喘氣；(名) 喘氣
example_sentence: The dog that was panting heavily after the run needed water.
sentence_zh: 那隻跑步後氣喘吁吁的狗需要喝水。

definition_zh: (名) 泛神論
example_sentence: Pantheism finds nature and the universe to be divine.
sentence_zh: 泛神論認為自然和宇宙是神聖的。

definition_zh: (形) 泛神論的
example_sentence: Many ancient cultures held a pantheistic view of nature.
sentence_zh: 許多古老文化對自然抱持泛神論的觀點。

definition_zh: (名) 萬神殿；眾神
example_sentence: The history class studied the Roman pantheon of gods.
sentence_zh: 歷史課研究了羅馬的眾神神殿。

definition_zh: (名) 食品儲藏室；餐具室
example_sentence: The pantry in our kitchen stores canned goods and snacks.
sentence_zh: 我們廚房裡的儲藏室存放罐頭和零食。

definition_zh: (名) 褲子
example_sentence: The student who wears loose pants feels more comfortable in class.
sentence_zh: 穿寬鬆褲子的學生在課堂上感覺更舒服。

definition_zh: (名) 褲裝（女用套裝）
example_sentence: The manager wore a blue pantsuit to impress the clients.
sentence_zh: 經理穿了一套藍色褲裝來給客戶留下好印象。

definition_zh: (名) 爸爸（兒語）
example_sentence: My little sister calls my father papa when she wants a favor.
sentence_zh: 我的小妹妹想要幫忙時，會叫我爸爸「爸爸」。

definition_zh: (名) 木瓜蛋白酶
example_sentence: Using papain, the chef tenderized the beef for the stew.
sentence_zh: 廚師使用木瓜蛋白酶來嫩化燉牛肉。

definition_zh: (名) 狗仔隊；八卦記者
example_sentence: When the celebrity stepped out, the paparazzi crowded around her car.
sentence_zh: 當那位名人走出來時，狗仔隊擠在她的車周圍。

definition_zh: (名) 狗仔隊；攝影記者
example_sentence: A paparazzo followed the famous singer to the airport.
sentence_zh: 一名狗仔隊跟蹤那位知名歌手到機場。

definition_zh: (名) 木瓜
example_sentence: The papaya in the market is sweet and fresh.
sentence_zh: 市場裡的木瓜又甜又新鮮。

definition_zh: (片) 掩蓋；粉飾
example_sentence: The school tried to paper over the conflict between students.
sentence_zh: 學校試圖掩蓋學生之間的衝突。

definition_zh: (名) 紙；論文
example_sentence: The students need to bring paper and a pen to class.
sentence_zh: 學生需要帶紙和筆來上課。

definition_zh: (名) 平裝書
example_sentence: This paperback novel is much lighter than a hardcover book.
sentence_zh: 這本平裝小說比精裝書輕得多。

definition_zh: (名) 論文；報告；文件
example_sentence: Having finished all her papers, Sarah finally relaxed with her friends.
sentence_zh: 完成所有報告後，莎拉終於和朋友們放鬆了。

definition_zh: (名) 紙鎮
example_sentence: If this paperweight were lighter, the stack of papers would not stay in place.
sentence_zh: 如果這個紙鎮更輕一些，那疊紙就不會固定住了。

definition_zh: (名) 文書工作；書面作業
example_sentence: Because the paperwork was incomplete, the teacher asked for revisions.
sentence_zh: 因為文書作業不完整，老師要求修改。

definition_zh: (名) 標準桿數；同等水準
example_sentence: After the golf match, the coach analyzed each player's par.
sentence_zh: 高爾夫球賽結束後，教練分析了每位選手的標準桿數。

definition_zh: (名) ['pɛrəˌʃut] 降落傘　(動) [ˌpɛrə'ʃut] 跳傘；空投
example_sentence: The pilot used a parachute to land safely after the engine failed.
sentence_zh: 飛行員在引擎故障後使用降落傘安全著陸。

definition_zh: (名) 遊行；檢閱　(動) 遊行；列隊行進
example_sentence: If the weather is fine, the school parade will start at nine.
sentence_zh: 如果天氣好的話，學校遊行將在九點開始。

definition_zh: (名) 典範；模式
example_sentence: If the old paradigm fails, a new approach must replace it.
sentence_zh: 如果舊典範失敗，新方法必須取代它。

definition_zh: (名) 天堂；樂園
example_sentence: This small island is a paradise for divers exploring coral reefs.
sentence_zh: 這個小島是潛水者探索珊瑚礁的天堂。

definition_zh: (名) 矛盾；悖論
example_sentence: The paradox of saving money while spending more confuses many students.
sentence_zh: 存錢卻花更多的矛盾現象讓許多學生感到困惑。

definition_zh: (形) 矛盾的；似非而是的
example_sentence: The paradoxical rule that students must sleep in class confuses everyone.
sentence_zh: 這個矛盾的規定——學生必須在課堂上睡覺——讓每個人都感到困惑。

definition_zh: (動) 滑翔；玩飛行傘
example_sentence: The student who wants to paraglide must first take a safety course.
sentence_zh: 想要玩飛行傘的學生必須先上安全課程。

definition_zh: (名) 滑翔傘；滑翔傘飛行員
example_sentence: The paraglider soared above the green hills near Taipei.
sentence_zh: 滑翔傘在台北附近的綠色山丘上空翱翔。

definition_zh: (名) 段落
example_sentence: The teacher asked the class to read the second paragraph aloud.
sentence_zh: 老師要求全班大聲朗讀第二段。

definition_zh: (形) 平行的；(動) 與…平行；(名) 平行線
example_sentence: The two roads run parallel to each other through the park.
sentence_zh: 這兩條路平行地穿過公園。

definition_zh: (名) 麻痺；癱瘓
example_sentence: Traffic paralysis during rush hour frustrates many commuters.
sentence_zh: 尖峰時段的交通癱瘓讓許多通勤者感到沮喪。

definition_zh: (動) 使癱瘓；使麻痺
example_sentence: A sudden power outage can paralyze the entire transportation system.
sentence_zh: 突然的停電可能會癱瘓整個交通系統。

definition_zh: (名) 參數；參數值
example_sentence: If the parameter were set correctly, the experiment would succeed.
sentence_zh: 如果參數設定正確，實驗就會成功。

definition_zh: (形) 至關重要的；首要的
example_sentence: If environmental protection is paramount, our school must reduce waste.
sentence_zh: 如果環境保護至關重要，我們的學校就必須減少廢棄物。

definition_zh: (形) 寄生的
example_sentence: Some parasitic plants steal nutrients from their host trees.
sentence_zh: 某些寄生植物從宿主樹木中竊取養分。

definition_zh: (形) 寄生的；寄生蟲的
example_sentence: Living a parasitical lifestyle, the freelancer always relied on others for money.
sentence_zh: 過著寄生般的生活，這個自由工作者總是依賴他人提供金錢。

definition_zh: (名) 包裹；一片（土地）　(動) 打包；分配
example_sentence: Having parcelled the gifts for the charity event, the students felt proud.
sentence_zh: 將送給慈善活動的禮物打包好後，學生們感到自豪。

definition_zh: (名) 羊皮紙；文件
example_sentence: This ancient parchment contains secrets about the lost city.
sentence_zh: 這張古老的羊皮紙包含了關於失落城市的秘密。

definition_zh: (名) 原諒；寬恕　(動) 原諒；赦免
example_sentence: The teacher asked for pardon after accidentally hurting a student's feelings.
sentence_zh: 老師在無意中傷害了學生的感情後請求原諒。

definition_zh: (片) 削減；縮減
example_sentence: The school decided to pare back its budget for extracurricular activities.
sentence_zh: 學校決定削減課外活動的預算。

definition_zh: (片) 削減；精簡
example_sentence: Not only did the school pare down its budget, but it also reduced waste.
sentence_zh: 學校不僅削減了預算，還減少了浪費。

definition_zh: (名) 父母；家長
example_sentence: If every parent spent more time with their children, family bonds would grow stronger.
sentence_zh: 如果每位家長多花時間陪伴孩子，家庭關係就會更緊密。

definition_zh: (名) 巴黎（法國首都）
example_sentence: Paris is a city famous for its art and delicious food.
sentence_zh: 巴黎是一座以藝術和美食聞名的城市。

definition_zh: (名) 教區；教區居民
example_sentence: Living near the parish, the family often attended Sunday services.
sentence_zh: 住在教區附近，這家人經常參加週日禮拜。

definition_zh: (名) 平等；同等
example_sentence: The government aims to achieve gender parity in the workplace by 2030.
sentence_zh: 政府目標是在2030年前實現職場性別平等。

definition_zh: (名) 公園　(動) 停車
example_sentence: My brother went to the park to play basketball with his friends.
sentence_zh: 我哥哥去公園和他的朋友打籃球。

definition_zh: (名) 停車；停車位
example_sentence: Finding no parking spot, the driver circled the block twice.
sentence_zh: 找不到停車位，司機繞了街區兩次。

definition_zh: (名) 議會；國會
example_sentence: The young parliament member proposed a new law to protect the environment.
sentence_zh: 這位年輕的國會議員提出了一項保護環境的新法律。

definition_zh: (名) 店舖；營業廳
example_sentence: The ice cream parlor that opened last month serves delicious mango shaved ice.
sentence_zh: 上個月開的那家冰淇淋店提供美味的芒果刨冰。

definition_zh: (名) 模仿作品；搞笑模仿　(動) 模仿；戲仿
example_sentence: The student's parody of the teacher's lecture made the whole class laugh.
sentence_zh: 這位學生對老師講課的搞笑模仿讓全班都笑了。

definition_zh: (名) 鸚鵡　(動) 鸚鵡學舌般地重複；機械地模仿
example_sentence: The parrot that lives in the pet shop can mimic human speech.
sentence_zh: 住在寵物店裡的那隻鸚鵡能模仿人類說話。

definition_zh: (名) 巴西里；洋芫荽
example_sentence: Many students add parsley to salads for extra flavor.
sentence_zh: 許多學生為了增添風味，在沙拉中加入巴西里。

definition_zh: (名) 巴西里；荷蘭芹
example_sentence: Many students add parsley to their noodles for extra flavor.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在麵裡加巴西里以增添風味。

definition_zh: (片) 割愛；放棄；賣掉
example_sentence: The antique vase that Grandma had to part with was sold online.
sentence_zh: 奶奶不得不割愛的那個古董花瓶在網上被賣掉了。

definition_zh: (形) 兼職的；(副) 部分時間地
example_sentence: If a student had a part-time job, time management would become crucial.
sentence_zh: 如果學生有兼職工作，時間管理就會變得至關重要。

definition_zh: (名) 部分；角色　(動) 分開；分離　(片) 參與；扮演角色
example_sentence: Having part in the school play, the students felt proud of their performance.
sentence_zh: 參與了學校話劇演出後，學生們對自己的表現感到驕傲。

definition_zh: (片) 參加；參與
example_sentence: If more students partook in the debate club, the school would benefit greatly.
sentence_zh: 如果有更多學生參加辯論社，學校會大大受益。

definition_zh: (動) 參加；分享
example_sentence: Partaking in the school's charity run, Emily felt a strong sense of community.
sentence_zh: 參加學校的慈善路跑，艾蜜莉感受到強烈的社區歸屬感。

definition_zh: (形) 部分的；偏袒的；不完整的
example_sentence: The teacher gave a partial explanation for the confusing math problem.
sentence_zh: 老師對這個令人困惑的數學問題給了一個不完整的解釋。

definition_zh: (副) 部分地；不完全地
example_sentence: The science experiment was partially successful due to equipment issues.
sentence_zh: 這個科學實驗因為設備問題只有部分成功。

definition_zh: (名) 參與者；參加者
example_sentence: Every participant in the science fair must prepare a project.
sentence_zh: 科學展覽的每位參與者都必須準備一個作品。

definition_zh: (動) 參加；參與
example_sentence: Participating in the school debate team improved her confidence.
sentence_zh: 參加學校辯論隊提升了她的自信心。

definition_zh: (名) 參與；參加
example_sentence: Active participation in class discussions helps students learn more effectively.
sentence_zh: 在課堂討論中積極參與有助於學生更有效地學習。

definition_zh: (形) 參與的；參與式的
example_sentence: Students enjoy participatory learning when teachers encourage group discussions.
sentence_zh: 當老師鼓勵小組討論時，學生們享受參與式學習。

definition_zh: (名) 分詞
example_sentence: If a student misused a participle, the teacher would correct the grammar.
sentence_zh: 如果學生誤用了分詞，老師會糾正文法。

definition_zh: (名) 粒子；微粒
example_sentence: If a dust particle enters the computer, the fan may stop working.
sentence_zh: 如果灰塵粒子進入電腦，風扇可能會停止運作。

definition_zh: (形) 特定的；特別的
example_sentence: The teacher has a particular way of explaining math formulas.
sentence_zh: 這位老師有一套特定的方式來解釋數學公式。

definition_zh: (副) 特別地；尤其
example_sentence: This math problem is not particularly difficult for students.
sentence_zh: 這道數學題對學生來說不是特別困難。

definition_zh: (形) 黨派的；有偏袒的　(名) 黨徒；支持者
example_sentence: Divided by partisan views, the class struggled to reach a consensus.
sentence_zh: 因黨派觀點而分裂，這個班級難以達成共識。

definition_zh: (名) 黨派之爭；黨派偏見
example_sentence: Not only does partisanship divide the nation, but it also hinders progress.
sentence_zh: 黨派之爭不僅分裂國家，也阻礙進步。

definition_zh: (名) 隔板；分區　(動) 分割；隔開
example_sentence: Partitioning the hard drive into two sections, the student organized his files more efficiently.
sentence_zh: 將硬碟分割成兩個區塊後，這位學生更有效率地整理了他的檔案。

definition_zh: (副) 部分地；某種程度上
example_sentence: Many students failed the exam partly because they studied at the last minute.
sentence_zh: 許多學生考試不及格，部分原因是他們在最後一刻才唸書。

definition_zh: (名) 夥伴；搭檔　(動) 合夥；配對
example_sentence: If your partner finishes the report, we can submit it today.
sentence_zh: 如果你的夥伴完成報告，我們今天就可以提交。

definition_zh: (名) 合作關係；夥伴關係
example_sentence: Forming a partnership with local businesses, the school created a job shadowing program.
sentence_zh: 與當地企業建立合作關係，學校創建了一個工作見習計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 派對；聚會　(動) 舉辦派對；狂歡
example_sentence: Excited about the party, Lisa decorated the room with colorful balloons.
sentence_zh: 對派對感到興奮，麗莎用彩色氣球裝飾了房間。

definition_zh: (片) 傳遞；傳閱
example_sentence: The teacher asked the students to pass around the handouts.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生們傳閱講義。

definition_zh: (片) 假裝成；冒充
example_sentence: Dressed in a suit, the young intern tried to pass as a manager.
sentence_zh: 穿著西裝，這位年輕的實習生試圖假裝成經理。

definition_zh: (動) 去世；逝世
example_sentence: The elderly neighbor passed away peacefully after a long illness.
sentence_zh: 那位年長的鄰居在久病後安詳地去世了。

definition_zh: (片) 傳回；歸還
example_sentence: The teacher asked the students to pass back the quizzes.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生把測驗卷傳回來。

definition_zh: (片) 經過；路過
example_sentence: Many students pass by the library on their way to class.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在去上課的路上經過圖書館。

definition_zh: (片) 傳遞；流傳
example_sentence: Families often pass down traditional recipes from one generation to the next.
sentence_zh: 家庭經常將傳統食譜從一代傳給下一代。

definition_zh: (片) 被當作；冒充
example_sentence: The old uniform that Tom wore could pass for a vintage costume.
sentence_zh: 湯姆穿的那件舊制服可以被當作復古服裝。

definition_zh: (動) 冒充；假裝
example_sentence: The old car was passed off as a classic model by the dishonest seller.
sentence_zh: 那輛舊車被不誠實的賣家冒充成經典車型。

definition_zh: (片) 傳遞；轉交
example_sentence: The teacher asked the students to pass on the message to their classmates.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生把訊息傳遞給他們的同學。

definition_zh: (片) 昏倒；分發
example_sentence: Only after the long exam did several students pass out from exhaustion.
sentence_zh: 只有在漫長的考試之後，才有幾名學生因筋疲力竭而昏倒。

definition_zh: (片) 忽略；不考慮
example_sentence: Seldom does the teacher pass over a student's mistake in the exam.
sentence_zh: 老師很少在考試中忽略學生的錯誤。

definition_zh: (片) 打發時間；消磨時間
example_sentence: Listening to music helps passengers pass the time on long bus rides.
sentence_zh: 聽音樂幫助乘客在長途公車上打發時間。

definition_zh: (動) 穿過；經歷
example_sentence: The train will pass through several small towns before arriving at the station.
sentence_zh: 這列火車在抵達車站前會經過幾個小鎮。

definition_zh: (片) 錯過；放棄（機會）
example_sentence: Students who pass up this opportunity may regret it later.
sentence_zh: 錯過這個機會的學生以後可能會後悔。

definition_zh: (動) 通過；及格　(名) 通行證；及格
example_sentence: If you study hard, you will pass the exam easily.
sentence_zh: 如果你努力讀書，你會輕鬆通過考試。

definition_zh: (名) 通道；段落；通路
example_sentence: After reading the passage, the students discussed its main ideas.
sentence_zh: 讀完這段文章後，學生們討論了它的主要觀點。

definition_zh: (名) 通道；走廊
example_sentence: The students use this narrow passageway to reach the library faster.
sentence_zh: 學生們利用這條狹窄的通道更快到達圖書館。

definition_zh: (名) 乘客；旅客
example_sentence: Every passenger must fasten their seatbelt before the plane takes off.
sentence_zh: 每位乘客在飛機起飛前都必須繫好安全帶。

definition_zh: (名) 路人；過路人
example_sentence: A kind passer-by helped the elderly woman cross the busy street.
sentence_zh: 一位好心的路人幫助那位老婦人穿過繁忙的街道。

definition_zh: (名) 通過；經過　(動) 經過；傳遞
example_sentence: The passing of the new law will affect many students.
sentence_zh: 這項新法律的通過將影響許多學生。

definition_zh: (名) 熱情；愛好
example_sentence: Her passion for music led her to join the school band.
sentence_zh: 她對音樂的熱情促使她加入了學校樂隊。

definition_zh: (形) 熱情的；充滿激情的
example_sentence: A passionate teacher can inspire students to love learning.
sentence_zh: 一位充滿熱情的老師能激發學生愛上學習。

definition_zh: (副) 熱情地；激昂地
example_sentence: The young artist passionately painted her feelings on the canvas.
sentence_zh: 這位年輕藝術家熱情地在畫布上畫出她的感受。

definition_zh: (形) 被動的；消極的
example_sentence: A passive attitude toward studying can hurt your grades.
sentence_zh: 對學習採取被動的態度可能會損害你的成績。

definition_zh: (副) 被動地；消極地
example_sentence: Having passively watched the movie, the student missed the key clues.
sentence_zh: 被動地看完電影後，那名學生錯過了關鍵線索。

definition_zh: (名) 護照
example_sentence: A passport is necessary for traveling to other countries.
sentence_zh: 護照是出國旅行所必需的。

definition_zh: (名) 密碼
example_sentence: Students should never share their password with classmates.
sentence_zh: 學生絕不應該與同學分享他們的密碼。

definition_zh: (介) 經過；越過　(形) 過去的；以前的　(名) 過去；往事
example_sentence: Walking past the library, the student noticed a new book display.
sentence_zh: 走過圖書館時，那名學生注意到一個新的書籍展示。

definition_zh: (動) 黏貼；張貼　(名) 麵團；糊狀物
example_sentence: The student used glue to paste the picture onto the poster.
sentence_zh: 這位學生用膠水把圖片貼在海報上。

definition_zh: (名) 消遣；娛樂
example_sentence: Reading comic books is a popular pastime among teenagers in Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 閱讀漫畫書是台灣青少年中受歡迎的消遣活動。

definition_zh: (形) 田園的；鄉村的
example_sentence: The painting that depicts a pastoral landscape hangs in the school library.
sentence_zh: 那幅描繪田園景色的畫作掛在學校圖書館裡。

definition_zh: (名) 糕點；油酥點心
example_sentence: The baker used fresh butter to make a flaky pastry.
sentence_zh: 麵包師傅用新鮮奶油來製作酥脆的糕點。

definition_zh: (名) 牧場；草地　(動) 放牧
example_sentence: If the pasture dries up, the cattle will need extra feed.
sentence_zh: 如果牧場乾涸，牛群將需要額外的飼料。

definition_zh: (片) 輕拍（以檢查藏匿物品）；搜身
example_sentence: Before entering the stadium, security will pat down every visitor.
sentence_zh: 在進入體育館之前，安檢人員會輕拍每位訪客以檢查。

definition_zh: (名) 輕拍　(動) 輕拍；拍打
example_sentence: The teacher gave the student a gentle pat on the back.
sentence_zh: 老師在學生背上輕輕拍了拍。

definition_zh: (片) 拼湊；勉強湊合
example_sentence: Only after the flood did the community patch together a temporary shelter.
sentence_zh: 洪水過後，社區才拼湊出一個臨時避難所。

definition_zh: (片) 修補；解決（爭端）
example_sentence: The students tried to patch up their friendship after the argument.
sentence_zh: 學生們在爭吵後試圖修補他們的友誼。

definition_zh: (名) 補丁；一小片　(動) 修補；連接
