sentence_zh: 如果天氣主要保持晴朗，我們學校就會在戶外舉辦運動會。

definition_zh: (名) 卓越；傑出
example_sentence: If the school achieved preeminence in science, more students would apply.
sentence_zh: 如果這所學校在科學方面取得卓越地位，將會有更多學生申請。

definition_zh: (形) 卓越的；傑出的
example_sentence: This university is preeminent in the field of engineering.
sentence_zh: 這所大學在工程領域是卓越的。

definition_zh: (動) 打扮；自滿
example_sentence: If a student preened too much before a test, their focus would be lost.
sentence_zh: 如果一個學生在考試前過度打扮，他們的專注力就會喪失。

definition_zh: (動) 預製；預先建造
example_sentence: Having prefabricated the parts, the construction team assembled the house quickly.
sentence_zh: 預製好零件後，建築團隊迅速組裝了房屋。

definition_zh: (名) 序言；前言
example_sentence: The preface that the author wrote was very brief.
sentence_zh: 作者寫的序言非常簡短。

definition_zh: (名) 縣；轄區
example_sentence: Located in the heart of Japan, this prefecture attracts many international tourists.
sentence_zh: 位於日本中心，這個縣吸引了許多國際觀光客。

definition_zh: (動) 偏好；更喜歡
example_sentence: Students who prefer studying alone often get better test scores.
sentence_zh: 喜歡獨自讀書的學生通常考試成績較好。

definition_zh: (形) 更可取的；更好的
example_sentence: Studying in a quiet library is preferable to reviewing at a noisy café.
sentence_zh: 在安靜的圖書館讀書比在吵雜的咖啡廳複習更可取。

definition_zh: (副) 最好；更理想地
example_sentence: Students should submit their homework online, preferably before midnight.
sentence_zh: 學生應該在網上提交作業，最好在午夜之前。

definition_zh: (名) 偏好；偏愛
example_sentence: My preference for studying alone often helps me focus better.
sentence_zh: 我偏好獨自讀書，這通常能幫助我更專注。

definition_zh: (名) 懷孕；妊娠期
example_sentence: Having experienced a difficult pregnancy, the young mother joined a support group.
sentence_zh: 經歷了一次艱難的懷孕後，這位年輕的母親加入了一個支持團體。

definition_zh: (形) 懷孕的
example_sentence: The pregnant woman decided to attend yoga classes for her health.
sentence_zh: 這位懷孕的女士決定參加瑜伽課程以促進健康。

definition_zh: (動) 預先加熱；預熱
example_sentence: The chef always preheats the oven before baking cookies.
sentence_zh: 廚師總是在烤餅乾前預熱烤箱。

definition_zh: (形) 史前的
example_sentence: Students in the museum learned about prehistoric animals from the exhibition.
sentence_zh: 學生們在博物館裡從展覽中學到關於史前動物的知識。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈprɛdʒədɪs] 偏見；歧視　(動) [prɪˈdʒɛdɪs] 使有偏見；損害
example_sentence: To reduce prejudice, the school invited a guest speaker to share her story.
sentence_zh: 為了減少偏見，學校邀請了一位客座講者分享她的故事。

definition_zh: (形) 初步的；預備的
example_sentence: The team completed a preliminary survey before starting the main project.
sentence_zh: 團隊在開始主要項目之前完成了一項初步調查。

definition_zh: (名) 序幕；前奏
example_sentence: The opening ceremony served as a prelude to the school sports day.
sentence_zh: 開幕典禮是學校運動會的序幕。

definition_zh: (形) 過早的；早產的
example_sentence: The premature celebration ended when the team lost the final game.
sentence_zh: 當球隊輸掉決賽時，過早的慶祝活動結束了。

definition_zh: (動) 預謀；預先策劃
example_sentence: The crime that the suspect premeditated shocked the entire community.
sentence_zh: 嫌疑犯預謀的罪行震驚了整個社區。

definition_zh: (形) 預謀的；事先策劃的
example_sentence: The court found the attack was premeditated, so the sentence was harsh.
sentence_zh: 法院判定這次攻擊是預謀的，因此判刑很重。

definition_zh: (名) 預謀；預先策劃
example_sentence: The court found strong evidence of premeditation in the crime.
sentence_zh: 法院發現這起犯罪中有預謀的強力證據。

definition_zh: (名) 總理；首相
example_sentence: The premier announced a new policy to improve public transportation.
sentence_zh: 總理宣布了一項改善大眾運輸的新政策。

definition_zh: (名) 首映；初次公演　(動) 首次公演；首次上演
example_sentence: The premiere of the new sci-fi movie attracted many fans.
sentence_zh: 這部新科幻電影的首映吸引了許多粉絲。

definition_zh: (名) 前提；假定
example_sentence: The company's success was built on the premise of customer satisfaction.
sentence_zh: 這家公司的成功建立在顧客滿意的前提上。

definition_zh: (名) 場所；房屋連地基
example_sentence: Inspecting the premises before signing the lease is essential for tenants.
sentence_zh: 在簽署租約前檢查場地，對租戶來說是必要的。

definition_zh: (名) 保費；獎金　(形) 高級的；優質的
example_sentence: Buying a premium ticket for the concert gives you access to the VIP area.
sentence_zh: 購買演唱會的頂級門票可以讓你進入VIP區。

definition_zh: (形) 產前的；孕期的
example_sentence: The prenatal vitamins that the doctor recommended are important for health.
sentence_zh: 醫生推薦的產前維生素對健康很重要。

definition_zh: (名) 專注；全神貫注
example_sentence: Her preoccupation with social media affected her study time.
sentence_zh: 她對社交媒體的專注影響了她的學習時間。

definition_zh: (動) 使專注；使忙於
example_sentence: Because the final exam is approaching, many students preoccupy themselves with endless review.
sentence_zh: 因為期末考即將來臨，許多學生忙於無止境的複習。

definition_zh: (形) 預付的；預付費的
example_sentence: The prepaid card my sister bought can be used for online shopping.
sentence_zh: 我姐姐買的這張預付卡可以用來線上購物。

definition_zh: (名) 準備；預備
example_sentence: If students started their preparation earlier, the exam would feel less stressful.
sentence_zh: 如果學生早點開始準備，考試就不會那麼有壓力。

definition_zh: (動) 準備；預備
example_sentence: The students who prepare for the exam every day often get good scores.
sentence_zh: 每天準備考試的學生通常會得到好成績。

definition_zh: (動) 準備；預備　(形) 準備好的
example_sentence: Having prepared thoroughly for the exam, the students felt confident.
sentence_zh: 充分準備考試後，學生們感到有信心。

definition_zh: (名) 準備；防備
example_sentence: The government's preparedness for earthquakes saved many lives last year.
sentence_zh: 政府對地震的防備在去年拯救了許多生命。

definition_zh: (名) 介系詞；前置詞
example_sentence: The teacher asked the students to memorize the preposition list for the quiz.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生背誦介系詞列表以準備小考。

definition_zh: (名) 先決條件；必備條件
example_sentence: A high school diploma is a prerequisite for most college applications.
sentence_zh: 高中文憑是大多數大學申請的先決條件。

definition_zh: (形) 有先見之明的；預知性的
example_sentence: The scientist's prescient warning about climate change saved many lives.
sentence_zh: 這位科學家對氣候變遷的先見之明警告拯救了許多生命。

definition_zh: (動) 開（藥方）；規定
example_sentence: Having prescribed the medicine, the doctor explained the possible side effects.
sentence_zh: 開完藥後，醫生解釋了可能的副作用。

definition_zh: (名) 處方；藥方
example_sentence: The doctor wrote a prescription for the student's cough medicine.
sentence_zh: 醫生為那位學生開了咳嗽藥的處方。

definition_zh: (名) 出席；存在
example_sentence: If a student's presence is required, the teacher will mark attendance.
sentence_zh: 如果學生的出席是必要的，老師就會記點名。

definition_zh: (動) 呈現；展示
example_sentence: Presenting her project to the class, the student felt nervous.
sentence_zh: 向全班展示她的專題時，這位學生感到緊張。

definition_zh: (名) 簡報；報告
example_sentence: Having finished her presentation, the student received praise from the teacher.
sentence_zh: 完成簡報後，那名學生得到了老師的讚賞。

definition_zh: (副) 目前；不久
example_sentence: Seldom does the teacher presently assign such a difficult homework.
sentence_zh: 老師目前很少指派這麼困難的作業。

definition_zh: (名) 保存；保護
example_sentence: If students learn the preservation of nature, our environment will improve.
sentence_zh: 如果學生學習保護自然，我們的環境將會改善。

definition_zh: (名) 防腐劑　(形) 防腐的
example_sentence: When buying snacks, many students check the label for preservatives.
sentence_zh: 購買零食時，許多學生會檢查標籤上是否有防腐劑。

definition_zh: (動) 保存；保護
example_sentence: The museum works hard to preserve the ancient artifacts for future generations.
sentence_zh: 這間博物館努力保存古代文物，以供後代子孫欣賞。

definition_zh: (動) 主持；擔任主席
example_sentence: The principal presides over the morning assembly every Monday.
sentence_zh: 校長每週一主持早會。

definition_zh: (名) 總統任期；總統職位
example_sentence: During her presidency, the country made significant progress in education.
sentence_zh: 在她的總統任期內，該國在教育方面取得了重大進展。

definition_zh: (名) 總統當選人
example_sentence: The president-elect will give a speech about education reform next week.
sentence_zh: 總統當選人將在下週發表關於教育改革的演講。

definition_zh: (名) 總統；會長；校長
example_sentence: Having met the president, the delegation felt honored.
sentence_zh: 會見總統後，代表團感到榮幸。

definition_zh: (形) 總統的；總統制的
example_sentence: If the presidential election were held today, many young people would vote.
sentence_zh: 如果今天舉行總統大選，許多年輕人會去投票。

definition_zh: (片) 繼續進行；毅然推進
example_sentence: Despite the heavy rain, the team decided to press ahead with the project.
sentence_zh: 儘管下著大雨，團隊仍決定繼續推進這個專案。

definition_zh: (片) 極力要求；敦促
example_sentence: Seldom does the student press for an extension on homework.
sentence_zh: 這個學生很少要求延長作業期限。

definition_zh: (片) 繼續推進；堅持進行
example_sentence: The student who decided to press forward with the project won the science fair.
sentence_zh: 決定繼續推進這個計畫的學生贏得了科學展覽。

definition_zh: (片) 徵用；強迫使用
example_sentence: The school had to press old laptops into service for online classes.
sentence_zh: 學校不得不將舊筆電徵用於線上課程。

definition_zh: (片) 繼續前進；堅持
example_sentence: The team decided to press on despite the heavy rain.
sentence_zh: 儘管下著大雨，團隊仍決定繼續前進。

definition_zh: (片) 強調；強烈要求
example_sentence: The teacher pressed upon her students the importance of studying hard.
sentence_zh: 老師向她的學生強調努力學習的重要性。

definition_zh: (動) 按；壓　(名) 報紙；新聞界
example_sentence: When the bell rings, press the button to start the test.
sentence_zh: 當鈴聲響起時，按下按鈕開始考試。

definition_zh: (形) 緊迫的；迫切的
example_sentence: Because the deadline was pressing, the team worked through the night.
sentence_zh: 因為截止期限緊迫，團隊徹夜工作。

definition_zh: (名) 壓力；壓迫
example_sentence: The pressure of exams often makes students feel anxious.
sentence_zh: 考試的壓力常常讓學生感到焦慮。

definition_zh: (名) 聲望；威信
example_sentence: The university's prestige attracts many top students from all over the country.
sentence_zh: 這所大學的聲望吸引了來自全國各地的許多頂尖學生。

definition_zh: (形) 有聲望的； prestigious
example_sentence: Not only is the school prestigious but also it offers many scholarships.
sentence_zh: 這所學校不僅聲望卓著，還提供許多獎學金。

definition_zh: (副) 想必；大概
example_sentence: The missing homework was presumably left on the bus by accident.
sentence_zh: 那份不見的作業想必是意外遺留在公車上了。

definition_zh: (動) 假定；推測
example_sentence: Presuming the test is easy, many students skipped studying.
sentence_zh: 假定考試很簡單，許多學生跳過了複習。

definition_zh: (名) 假設；推測
example_sentence: The teacher's presumption about the student's laziness was unfair.
sentence_zh: 老師對學生懶惰的假設是不公平的。

definition_zh: (動) 假裝；偽裝
example_sentence: Having pretended to study, the student played video games all night.
sentence_zh: 假裝念書後，那名學生整晚都在玩電玩。

definition_zh: (形) 矯揉造作的；自命不凡的
example_sentence: The student who called his art pretentious was criticized by the teacher.
sentence_zh: 那個稱呼他的藝術矯揉造作的學生被老師批評了。

definition_zh: (名) 藉口；託詞
example_sentence: If the student used illness as a pretext, the teacher would still expect homework.
sentence_zh: 如果學生以生病為藉口，老師仍然會預期作業要交。

definition_zh: (形) 漂亮的；相當的　(副) 相當地
example_sentence: Students study hard to get pretty good grades on the exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們努力學習以在考試中取得相當好的成績。

definition_zh: (動) 戰勝；盛行
example_sentence: The team's hard work and determination will prevail over any obstacle.
sentence_zh: 團隊的努力和決心將戰勝任何障礙。

definition_zh: (形) 盛行的；普遍的
example_sentence: The prevailing wind in winter brings cold air from the north.
sentence_zh: 冬季盛行的風從北方帶來冷空氣。

definition_zh: (名) 流行；普遍
example_sentence: The prevalence of smartphones has changed student study habits.
sentence_zh: 智慧型手機的普及改變了學生的讀書習慣。

definition_zh: (形) 普遍的；流行的
example_sentence: Smartphone addiction is prevalent among teenagers in Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 智慧型手機成癮在台灣青少年中很普遍。

definition_zh: (動) 預防；阻止
example_sentence: A good diet can prevent many health problems.
sentence_zh: 良好的飲食可以預防許多健康問題。

definition_zh: (名) 預防；防止
example_sentence: The prevention of disease is a key goal for public health officials.
sentence_zh: 預防疾病是公共衛生官員的一個關鍵目標。

definition_zh: (形) 預防的；防止的
example_sentence: The school adopted preventive measures to stop the spread of the flu.
sentence_zh: 學校採取了預防措施來阻止流感的傳播。

definition_zh: (動) 預習；預覽
example_sentence: Before the exam, students should preview the key chapters.
sentence_zh: 考試前，學生應該預習重點章節。

definition_zh: (形) 先前的；以往的
example_sentence: The previous exam was much easier than this one.
sentence_zh: 之前的考試比這次簡單得多。

definition_zh: (副) 先前；以前
example_sentence: The experiment, which previously failed, finally succeeded with a new method.
sentence_zh: 這個先前失敗的實驗，終於用新方法成功了。

definition_zh: (片) 捕食；欺騙；傷害
example_sentence: Online scammers often prey on elderly people who are not tech-savvy.
sentence_zh: 網路詐騙者經常欺騙不善科技的老年人。

definition_zh: (名) 獵物；犧牲者　(動) 捕食；折磨
example_sentence: If a predator hunts its prey, the prey might escape quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果掠食者追捕獵物，獵物可能會迅速逃脫。

definition_zh: (副) 令人卻步地；過高地
example_sentence: The cost of the new smartphone was prohibitively high for most students.
sentence_zh: 新智慧型手機的價格對大多數學生來說高得令人卻步。

definition_zh: (片) 將……計入價格中
example_sentence: The store decided to price in the shipping costs for online orders.
sentence_zh: 這家商店決定將運費計入線上訂單的價格中。

definition_zh: (片) 給……定價；提高……的價格
example_sentence: Having priced up the components, the manufacturer adjusted the final cost.
sentence_zh: 在給零件定價後，製造商調整了最終成本。

definition_zh: (名) 價格；代價　(動) 定價；標價
example_sentence: The price of this notebook is too high for a student.
sentence_zh: 這本筆記本的價格對學生來說太高了。

definition_zh: (形) 無價的；極珍貴的
example_sentence: The museum's priceless collection of ancient artifacts attracts scholars worldwide.
sentence_zh: 這座博物館無價的古代文物收藏吸引了世界各地的學者。

definition_zh: (形) 昂貴的；價格高的
example_sentence: Many students save their allowance to buy pricey concert tickets.
sentence_zh: 許多學生存零用錢是為了買昂貴的演唱會門票。

definition_zh: (名) 刺痛感；刺
example_sentence: A sudden prickle of fear ran down her spine during the dark movie.
sentence_zh: 在黑暗的電影中，一陣突然的恐懼刺痛感沿著她的脊椎而下。

definition_zh: (形) 多刺的；易怒的
example_sentence: The prickly cactus plant survived the long drought without any water.
sentence_zh: 這棵多刺的仙人掌植物在沒有水的情況下熬過了長時間的乾旱。

definition_zh: (名) 驕傲；自尊　(動) 以...自豪
example_sentence: The team took pride in winning the school basketball championship.
sentence_zh: 這支隊伍以贏得學校籃球冠軍為榮。

definition_zh: (名) 牧師；神父
example_sentence: The priest visited the hospital to comfort sick patients.
sentence_zh: 這位牧師去醫院安慰生病的病人。

definition_zh: (名) 首要；主導地位
example_sentence: The primacy of education is widely recognized in Taiwanese society.
sentence_zh: 教育的主導地位在台灣社會中被廣泛認可。

definition_zh: (形) 主要的；初級的
example_sentence: The primary goal of this project is to reduce waste at school.
sentence_zh: 這個專案的主要目標是減少學校的浪費。

definition_zh: (形) 主要的；首要的　(名) 全盛時期；最佳部分　(動) 使準備好
example_sentence: The prime suspect in the case was seen near the school.
sentence_zh: 這起案件的主要嫌疑人在學校附近被看到。

definition_zh: (名) 底漆；入門書
example_sentence: The student who forgot the primer struggled with the painting.
sentence_zh: 那個忘了打底漆的學生在繪畫時遇到困難。

definition_zh: (形) 原始的；早期的
example_sentence: Living in a primitive village, the artist found inspiration in nature.
sentence_zh: 住在原始村落裡，這位藝術家從大自然中找到靈感。

definition_zh: (形) 原始的；最初的
example_sentence: Scientists study primordial forests to understand Earth's early ecosystems.
sentence_zh: 科學家研究原始森林以了解地球早期的生態系統。

definition_zh: (名) 王子
example_sentence: The prince decided to visit the local school and talk to students.
sentence_zh: 王子決定拜訪當地的學校並與學生交談。

definition_zh: (名) 公主
example_sentence: The young princess visited a local school to learn about education.
sentence_zh: 這位年輕的公主參觀了一所當地學校，以了解教育情況。

definition_zh: (名) 校長；（形）主要的
example_sentence: The principal announced that the school fair would be held next month.
sentence_zh: 校長宣布校慶將在下個月舉辦。

definition_zh: (副) 主要地；首要地
example_sentence: This report is principally about the effects of pollution on local rivers.
sentence_zh: 這份報告主要關於污染對當地河流的影響。

definition_zh: (名) 原則；原理
example_sentence: The principle of fairness guides every decision in our school.
sentence_zh: 公平的原則指導我們學校的每一個決定。

definition_zh: (片) 印出；列印出來
example_sentence: Needing a hard copy, the student printed out the report.
sentence_zh: 需要一份紙本，這位學生印出了報告。

definition_zh: (動) 列印；印刷　(名) 印刷品；指紋
example_sentence: If you print the report now, the teacher will see it tomorrow.
sentence_zh: 如果你現在列印報告，老師明天就會看到。

definition_zh: (名) 印表機；印刷機
example_sentence: The printer in the computer lab needs new ink cartridges.
sentence_zh: 電腦教室裡的印表機需要新的墨水匣。

definition_zh: (形) 先前的；較早的　(副) 在前；居先
example_sentence: Students must complete the homework prior to the exam to review key concepts.
sentence_zh: 學生必須在考試前完成作業，以複習關鍵概念。

definition_zh: (動) 優先處理；優先考慮
example_sentence: Having prioritized her homework, Lisa enjoyed a relaxing evening.
sentence_zh: 優先處理完作業後，麗莎享受了一個輕鬆的夜晚。

definition_zh: (名) 優先；優先事項
example_sentence: Finishing the group project on time became a top priority for the team.
sentence_zh: 準時完成小組專案成了團隊的首要任務。

definition_zh: (名) 監獄
example_sentence: The prison that was built last year now holds over 500 inmates.
sentence_zh: 去年建造的那座監獄現在關押了超過500名囚犯。

definition_zh: (名) 囚犯；犯人
example_sentence: The prisoner, locked in a small cell, missed his family.
sentence_zh: 那名囚犯被鎖在小牢房裡，很想念他的家人。

definition_zh: (形) 原始的；純淨的
example_sentence: If the park remained pristine, more families would visit it.
sentence_zh: 如果公園保持原始狀態，更多家庭會來訪。

definition_zh: (名) 隱私；私密
example_sentence: If students value their privacy, they should avoid sharing passwords online.
sentence_zh: 如果學生重視他們的隱私，就應該避免在網路上分享密碼。

definition_zh: (形) 私人的；私有的
example_sentence: Before entering the room, please keep your private thoughts to yourself.
sentence_zh: 進入房間前，請將你的私人想法保留給自己。

definition_zh: (副) 私下地；秘密地
example_sentence: The principal spoke privately with the student about the issue.
sentence_zh: 校長私下與學生談論這個問題。

definition_zh: (動) 使私有化；將……民營化
example_sentence: The government plans to privatize the national railway system next year.
sentence_zh: 政府計劃明年將國營鐵路系統私有化。

definition_zh: (名) 特權；優待　(動) 給予特權
example_sentence: Students who have the privilege of studying abroad gain valuable experience.
sentence_zh: 擁有出國留學特權的學生獲得寶貴的經驗。

definition_zh: (形) 有特權的；享有特權的
example_sentence: Students from privileged backgrounds often have more educational resources.
sentence_zh: 來自特權背景的學生通常擁有更多的教育資源。

definition_zh: (名) 獎品；獎金　(動) 珍視；珍惜

sentence_zh: 科學展覽會的第一名頒給了來自台北的一位學生。

definition_zh: (名) 專家；職業選手
example_sentence: Many students join the debate club to become a pro.
sentence_zh: 許多學生加入辯論社是為了成為專家。

definition_zh: (形) 主動的；積極的
example_sentence: Having taken a proactive approach, the student committee resolved the scheduling conflict quickly.
sentence_zh: 採取主動積極的態度後，學生委員會迅速解決了排程衝突。

definition_zh: (副) 很可能；大概
example_sentence: Feeling nervous, the student probably forgot to bring his exam pencil.
sentence_zh: 感到緊張，那位學生可能忘了帶他的考試用鉛筆。

definition_zh: (動) 探究；探測　(名) 探針；調查
example_sentence: If the scientist probed deeper, the discovery would surprise everyone.
sentence_zh: 如果科學家更深入探究，這項發現會讓所有人驚訝。

definition_zh: (名) 益生菌　(形) 益生菌的
example_sentence: Many students drink probiotic yogurt to improve their digestion after lunch.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在午餐後喝益生菌優格來改善消化。

definition_zh: (名) 誠信；正直
example_sentence: Having demonstrated probity throughout the project, the student leader earned everyone's trust.
sentence_zh: 在整個專案中展現了誠信後，這位學生領袖贏得了大家的信任。

definition_zh: (名) 問題；難題
example_sentence: The math problem on the test was very hard for everyone.
sentence_zh: 考試中的數學問題對每個人來說都很難。

definition_zh: (形) 有問題的；可疑的
example_sentence: The student's attitude became problematic after he skipped class.
sentence_zh: 那名學生的態度在他翹課後變得有問題。

definition_zh: (名) 喙；長鼻
example_sentence: The butterfly uses its long proboscis to drink nectar from flowers.
sentence_zh: 蝴蝶用牠的長喙從花朵中吸取花蜜。

definition_zh: (名) 程序；步驟
example_sentence: Before starting the experiment, students must follow the safety procedure.
sentence_zh: 在開始實驗之前，學生必須遵循安全程序。

definition_zh: (動) 繼續進行；前進

sentence_zh: 獲得批准後，團隊繼續進行該專案。

definition_zh: (名) 程序；進程

sentence_zh: 只有在會議之後，程序才終於開始。

definition_zh: (名) 收益；收入

sentence_zh: 慈善機構將利用這些收益建造一所新的學校圖書館。

sentence_zh: 這家工廠使用一種特殊流程來回收塑膠廢棄物。

definition_zh: (名) 隊伍；行列

sentence_zh: 長長的畢業生隊伍緩慢地走過舞台。

definition_zh: (名) 處理器；中央處理器

sentence_zh: 當處理器過熱時，電腦會明顯變慢。

definition_zh: (動) 宣布；聲明

sentence_zh: 校長將於明天早上宣布新的學校政策。

definition_zh: (動) 拖延；耽擱

sentence_zh: 拖延的學生常常錯過作業截止日期。

definition_zh: (名) 拖延者；做事拖拉的人

sentence_zh: 我們班上的拖延者總是在最後一刻才完成作業。

definition_zh: (動) 生育；創作

sentence_zh: 有抱負的藝術家經常使用平板和觸控筆來創作數位作品。

definition_zh: (名) 生育；繁衍

sentence_zh: 許多伴侶將生育視為婚姻中的自然階段。

definition_zh: (形) 生育的；生殖的

sentence_zh: 學校很少討論健康教育中關於生育的方面。

definition_zh: (名) 監考人員；監考者

sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試中作弊，監考人員會立即報告。

definition_zh: (動) 取得；設法獲得

sentence_zh: 採購必要的材料後，團隊提前完成了專案。

sentence_zh: 這位年輕的天才每天練習鋼琴，為了贏得全國比賽。

definition_zh: (動) [prə'djus] 生產；製造　(名) ['prɑdjus] 農產品
example_sentence: The organic farm produces fresh vegetables for the local market.
sentence_zh: 這家有機農場為當地市場生產新鮮蔬菜。

definition_zh: (名) 製作人；生產者

sentence_zh: 這位音樂製作人工作到很晚，在截止日期前完成了新專輯。

definition_zh: (名) 產品；產物

sentence_zh: 學生們購買這項產品以支持當地農民。

definition_zh: (名) 生產；產量

sentence_zh: 電動車的產量在近年來有所增加。

definition_zh: (形) 生產的；有成效的

sentence_zh: 小組學習比單獨學習更有效率。

definition_zh: (副) 有成效地；高效地

sentence_zh: 小組學習可以幫助你更有效地利用時間。

definition_zh: (名) 生產力；工作效率

sentence_zh: 新軟體大幅提升了團隊上一季的生產力。

definition_zh: (形) 褻瀆的；不敬的

sentence_zh: 那名學生在課堂上說的褻瀆言語震驚了老師。

definition_zh: (動) 聲稱；自稱；表明

sentence_zh: 自稱找到解藥的科學家必須出示證據。

definition_zh: (名) 職業；專業

sentence_zh: 教學是一項需要耐心和奉獻的職業。

definition_zh: (形) 專業的；職業的　(名) 專業人士

sentence_zh: 這位專業攝影師捕捉到了日落的美景。

definition_zh: (名) 專業精神；專業素養

sentence_zh: 展現出專業精神後，這位實習生獲得了一份全職工作機會。

definition_zh: (名) 教授

sentence_zh: 這位教授就氣候變遷發表了一場長篇演講。

definition_zh: (名) 熟練；精通

sentence_zh: 這份工作需要高水平的英語能力。

definition_zh: (形) 熟練的；精通的
example_sentence: A proficient speaker can express ideas clearly in English.
sentence_zh: 一位熟練的說話者能用英語清楚地表達想法。

definition_zh: (名) 簡歷；側面輪廓　(動) 概述；描繪輪廓
example_sentence: Reading her profile, the manager noticed her strong leadership skills.
sentence_zh: 閱讀她的簡歷時，經理注意到她強大的領導能力。

definition_zh: (名) 利潤；利益　(動) 獲利；有益於

sentence_zh: 這家公司今年報告的利潤讓許多投資人感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (形) 有利可圖的；有益的
example_sentence: Starting a small online business can be very profitable.
sentence_zh: 經營一個小型線上生意可以非常有利可圖。

definition_zh: (副) 有利可圖地；獲利地

sentence_zh: 以小額獲利的方式經營小生意需要仔細的規劃和努力。

definition_zh: (形) 深刻的；深遠的
example_sentence: Having read the novel, the student felt a profound sense of empathy.
sentence_zh: 讀完這本小說後，這位學生感受到深刻的同理心。

definition_zh: (副) 深刻地；深深地
example_sentence: Reading this novel profoundly changed her view on social justice.
sentence_zh: 閱讀這本小說深刻地改變了她對社會正義的看法。

definition_zh: (形) 大量的；充沛的
example_sentence: The gardener's profuse apology surprised the principal after the incident.
sentence_zh: 園丁大量的道歉讓校長在事件後感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (副) 極度地；大量地
example_sentence: The student apologized profusely for arriving late to class.
sentence_zh: 這位學生為上課遲到而極度道歉。

definition_zh: (名) 預後；預測
example_sentence: Seldom does a doctor give a prognosis without thorough tests.
sentence_zh: 醫生很少在沒有徹底檢查的情況下給出預後。

definition_zh: (名) 節目；課程　(動) 規劃；編程
example_sentence: If this program helps students learn, the school will keep it.
sentence_zh: 如果這個課程幫助學生學習，學校就會保留它。

definition_zh: (名) 程式設計師；程式員
example_sentence: Inspired by her teacher, the young programmer created a useful app.
sentence_zh: 受到老師的啟發，這位年輕的程式設計師創造了一個有用的應用程式。

definition_zh: (名) [`prɑgrɛs] 進步；進展　(動) [prə`grɛs] 前進；進展
example_sentence: The students made good progress in their English writing this semester.
sentence_zh: 這學期學生們在英文寫作上取得了良好的進步。

definition_zh: (形) 進步的；漸進的
example_sentence: The progressive teacher introduced a new way to learn English.
sentence_zh: 那位進步的老師引入了一種學習英文的新方法。

definition_zh: (副) 逐漸地；越來越
example_sentence: The city's air quality has progressively worsened over the past decade.
sentence_zh: 這座城市的空氣品質在過去十年中逐漸惡化。

definition_zh: (動) 禁止；阻止
example_sentence: Having been prohibited by the school, students cannot use phones during class.
sentence_zh: 被學校禁止後，學生在上課期間不能使用手機。

definition_zh: (名) 禁止；禁令
example_sentence: The prohibition of smoking in public places has improved air quality.
sentence_zh: 公共場所禁菸改善了空氣品質。

definition_zh: (形) 昂貴得令人卻步的；禁止的
example_sentence: The prohibitive cost of living in Taipei discourages many young people.
sentence_zh: 台北高昂的生活費用讓許多年輕人卻步。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈprɑdʒɛkt] 專題；方案　(動) [prəˈdʒɛkt] 投射；計劃
example_sentence: Our science project on solar energy won first prize.
sentence_zh: 我們的太陽能科學專題得了第一名。

definition_zh: (名) 預測；投射
example_sentence: The teacher's projection of the test results surprised everyone.
sentence_zh: 老師對考試結果的預測讓大家都很驚訝。

definition_zh: (名) 投影機；放映機
example_sentence: The projector that the teacher used in class was very bright.
sentence_zh: 老師在課堂上使用的投影機非常明亮。

definition_zh: (動) 擴散；激增
example_sentence: The rumor that fake news can proliferate quickly worries many students.
sentence_zh: 假新聞可能迅速擴散的謠言讓許多學生擔憂。

definition_zh: (名) 擴散；激增
example_sentence: If the proliferation of fake news continues, social trust will decline.
sentence_zh: 如果假新聞的擴散持續下去，社會信任將會下降。

definition_zh: (形) 多產的；作品豐富的

sentence_zh: 因為這位科學家非常多產，她的研究團隊發表了許多論文。

definition_zh: (形) 長期的；持續很久的
example_sentence: The prolonged drought caused many crops to wither in the fields.
sentence_zh: 長期的乾旱導致許多農作物在田裡枯萎。

definition_zh: (名) 舞會；畢業舞會
example_sentence: The senior prom was held at a fancy hotel last Saturday.
sentence_zh: 畢業舞會上週六在一家高級飯店舉行。

definition_zh: (名) 普羅米修斯（希臘神話中盜火給人類的泰坦）
example_sentence: Many students study the myth of Prometheus in English class.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在英文課上研讀普羅米修斯的神話。

definition_zh: (名) 顯著；突出
example_sentence: The scientist whose work gained prominence won a national award.
sentence_zh: 那位工作獲得顯著成就的科學家贏得了一項國家獎項。

definition_zh: (形) 突出的；顯眼的
example_sentence: The prominent tower in the city center attracts many visitors every year.
sentence_zh: 市中心那座顯眼的塔每年吸引許多遊客。

definition_zh: (副) 顯著地；突出地

sentence_zh: 學校的新圖書館顯著地設有一個安靜的閱讀區。

definition_zh: (形) 混亂的；濫交的

sentence_zh: 由於有著混亂的約會歷史，莎拉經常面對同學們的評判。

definition_zh: (名) 承諾；諾言　(動) 承諾；保證
example_sentence: The teacher made a promise to help us with the project.
sentence_zh: 老師承諾幫助我們完成這個專題。

definition_zh: (形) 有前途的；有希望的

sentence_zh: 那位有前途的學生獲得獎學金出國留學。

definition_zh: (動) 促進；推銷

sentence_zh: 學校社團博覽會有助於促進團隊合作和領導技能。

definition_zh: (名) 晉升；推廣
example_sentence: After the manager announced the promotion, the team celebrated with a party.
sentence_zh: 在經理宣布升職後，團隊以派對慶祝。

definition_zh: (形) 迅速的；即時的　(動) 促使；提示
example_sentence: The teacher's prompt response helped the students finish the project on time.
sentence_zh: 老師迅速的回應幫助學生按時完成專題。

definition_zh: (名) 提詞員；提示器

sentence_zh: 老師使用提示器來提醒學生重點。

definition_zh: (副) 迅速地；立即地；準時地

sentence_zh: 老師要求學生準時提交作業。

definition_zh: (形) 易於……的；有……傾向的

sentence_zh: 代名詞取代名詞以避免句子中的重複。

definition_zh: (動) 發音；宣稱

sentence_zh: 老師要求學生正確地發音這個單詞。

definition_zh: (形) 明顯的；顯著的
example_sentence: The teacher's pronounced English accent helped students understand better.
sentence_zh: 老師明顯的英語口音幫助學生更好地理解。

definition_zh: (名) 發音；讀音

sentence_zh: 良好的發音幫助學生在英語中更清楚地溝通。

sentence_zh: 這位科學家找到了太陽系中一顆新行星的證據。

definition_zh: (動) 校對；校訂

sentence_zh: 編輯要求實習生在出版前校對文章。

definition_zh: (片) 支撐；支持

definition_zh: (動) 支撐；支持

sentence_zh: 當舞台燈光壞掉時，工作人員用掃帚把它撐住。

sentence_zh: 政府的宣傳影響了許多年輕選民在選舉期間的行為。

definition_zh: (動) 傳播；繁殖

definition_zh: (名) 丙烷

sentence_zh: 用完所有丙烷後，營火終於熄滅了。

definition_zh: (動) 推進；驅動

definition_zh: (片) 為……加油；支持
example_sentence: If our school team reaches the finals, the whole class will pull for them.
sentence_zh: 如果我們校隊打進決賽，全班都會為他們加油。

definition_zh: (片) 停靠；駛入
example_sentence: The driver who pulled in at the station checked the tires.
sentence_zh: 在車站停靠的司機檢查了輪胎。

definition_zh: (片) 成功完成；脫下
example_sentence: The student managed to pull off a perfect score on the final exam.
sentence_zh: 這位學生在期末考試中成功取得了滿分。

definition_zh: (動) 穿上；拉上
example_sentence: Students pull on their coats to stay warm during the cold winter morning.
sentence_zh: 學生們穿上外套，以便在寒冷的冬季早晨保暖。

definition_zh: (片) 退出；抽身
example_sentence: The student decided to pull out of the competition.
sentence_zh: 這位學生決定退出比賽。

definition_zh: (片) 路邊停車；靠邊停車
example_sentence: The police officer asked the driver to pull over for a safety check.
sentence_zh: 警察要求駕駛路邊停車以進行安全檢查。

definition_zh: (片) 度過難關；恢復健康
example_sentence: The patient managed to pull through after a difficult surgery.
sentence_zh: 這位病人在一次困難的手術後成功度過難關。

definition_zh: (片) 靠邊（停車）；拉向
example_sentence: If the bus breaks down, the driver will pull to the side.
sentence_zh: 如果公車拋錨，司機會靠邊停。

definition_zh: (片) 團結合作；齊心協力
example_sentence: The team that managed to pull together won the championship.
sentence_zh: 成功團結合作的隊伍贏得了冠軍。

definition_zh: (片) 停靠；拉起來
example_sentence: Pulling up to the curb, the bus stopped to let students off.
sentence_zh: 巴士靠邊停車，讓學生下車。

definition_zh: (片) 振作起來；控制情緒
example_sentence: Feeling overwhelmed by the exam, Sarah pulled herself together and studied harder.
sentence_zh: 感到考試壓力很大，莎拉振作起來，更加努力學習。

definition_zh: (動) 拉；拖
example_sentence: Please pull the door gently when you enter the classroom.
sentence_zh: 當你進入教室時，請輕輕拉門。

definition_zh: (名) 果肉；紙漿　(動) 將…製成紙漿
example_sentence: The pulp in orange juice provides essential vitamins for students.
sentence_zh: 柳橙汁中的果肉為學生提供必要的維生素。

definition_zh: (名) 脈搏；脈衝　(動) 搏動；跳動
example_sentence: The doctor checked the patient's pulse to see if it was normal.
sentence_zh: 醫生檢查病人的脈搏，看看是否正常。

definition_zh: (動) 粉碎；摧毀
example_sentence: The storm pulverized the coastal village, leaving nothing but debris.
sentence_zh: 暴風雨粉碎了沿海村莊，只留下殘骸。

definition_zh: (名) 泵；打氣筒　(動) 抽水；打氣
example_sentence: Pumping water from the well, the farmer watered his crops.
sentence_zh: 從井裡抽水灌溉，農民為他的作物澆水。

definition_zh: (片) 向...灌輸；把...注入
example_sentence: Before the game, the coach will pump into the team a sense of confidence.
sentence_zh: 比賽前，教練會向球隊灌輸信心。

definition_zh: (片) 抽出；排出
example_sentence: The team used a machine to pump out the floodwater from the basement.
sentence_zh: 團隊用機器從地下室抽出積水。

definition_zh: (片) 使振奮；打氣
example_sentence: The music that pumps up the team is always loud.
sentence_zh: 讓團隊振奮的音樂總是很響亮。

definition_zh: (名) 南瓜
example_sentence: After the harvest, the farmer carved a large pumpkin into a lantern.
sentence_zh: 收成後，農夫把一個大南瓜雕刻成燈籠。

definition_zh: (名) 重拳；打擊　(動) 用拳猛擊；打孔
example_sentence: Never has a single punch changed the game so dramatically.
sentence_zh: 從未有一記重拳如此戲劇性地改變了比賽。

definition_zh: (形) 準時的；守時的
example_sentence: Being punctual for class shows respect for both the teacher and classmates.
sentence_zh: 準時上課顯示出對老師和同學的尊重。

definition_zh: (名) 準時；守時
example_sentence: Punctuality is highly valued in both school and work settings.
sentence_zh: 準時在學校和工作場合都受到高度重視。

definition_zh: (副) 準時地；如期地
example_sentence: The bus arrived punctually at eight o'clock this morning.
sentence_zh: 公車今天早上八點準時到達。

definition_zh: (動) 刺破；刺穿　(名) 刺孔；小洞
example_sentence: If a tire punctured on the highway, the driver would stay calm.
sentence_zh: 如果輪胎在高速公路上爆胎，駕駛會保持冷靜。

definition_zh: (形) 刺鼻的；辛辣的
example_sentence: If the cheese smelled more pungent, the chef would not use it.
sentence_zh: 如果這塊起司聞起來更刺鼻，廚師就不會使用它。

definition_zh: (動) 懲罰；處罰
example_sentence: If the school punished students for minor mistakes, many would feel discouraged.
sentence_zh: 如果學校因為小錯誤懲罰學生，許多人會感到沮喪。

definition_zh: (名) 懲罰；處罰
example_sentence: If a student broke the school rules, a fair punishment would follow.
sentence_zh: 如果學生違反校規，公平的懲罰就會隨之而來。

definition_zh: (形) 懲罰的；懲戒性的
example_sentence: The school's punitive measures against cheating surprised many students.
sentence_zh: 學校針對作弊的懲罰性措施讓許多學生感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (名) 龐克；龐克音樂　(形) 龐克風格的
example_sentence: Because the punk band played loudly, many neighbors complained.
sentence_zh: 因為這個龐克樂團演奏得很大聲，許多鄰居抱怨了。

definition_zh: (名) 小狗；幼犬
example_sentence: If a puppy were lost in the park, a kind student would help it.
sentence_zh: 如果一隻小狗在公園裡迷路，好心的學生會幫助牠。

definition_zh: (名) 學生；瞳孔
example_sentence: Each pupil in the class must finish the homework on time.
sentence_zh: 班上每個學生都必須準時完成作業。

definition_zh: (名) 傀儡；木偶
example_sentence: The students used a puppet to explain their science project.
sentence_zh: 學生們用一個傀儡來解釋他們的科學專題。

definition_zh: (名) 小狗
example_sentence: The puppy that my sister adopted is very playful.
sentence_zh: 我妹妹收養的那隻小狗非常愛玩。

definition_zh: (動) 購買
example_sentence: Many students purchase snacks from the school store after class.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在下課後從學校商店購買零食。

definition_zh: (形) 純淨的；純粹的
example_sentence: The pure water from the mountain spring is safe to drink.
sentence_zh: 來自山泉的純淨水可以安全飲用。

definition_zh: (名) 泥；糊
example_sentence: The chef prepared a smooth pumpkin puree for the soup.
sentence_zh: 主廚為湯品準備了順滑的南瓜泥。

definition_zh: (副) 純粹地；完全地
example_sentence: Many students study hard purely to get into a good university.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力學習純粹是為了進入一所好大學。

definition_zh: (動) 清除；肅清
example_sentence: After the scandal, the company decided to purge all corrupt officials.
sentence_zh: 醜聞之後，該公司決定清除所有貪腐官員。

definition_zh: (名) 淨化；純化
example_sentence: The water purification system that the school installed ensures clean drinking water.
sentence_zh: 學校安裝的水淨化系統確保了乾淨的飲用水。

definition_zh: (動) 淨化；純化
example_sentence: Using a filter to purify the water is a simple method.
sentence_zh: 使用濾心來淨化水是一種簡單的方法。

definition_zh: (名) 純淨；純度
example_sentence: Testing the purity of tap water is a common science experiment.
sentence_zh: 測試自來水的純度是一項常見的科學實驗。

definition_zh: (名) 紫色　(形) 紫色的
example_sentence: The purple flowers in the garden bloom every spring.
sentence_zh: 花園裡的紫色花朵每年春天盛開。

definition_zh: (名) 意圖；主旨
example_sentence: The article's main purport was to criticize the school's new policy.
sentence_zh: 這篇文章的主要意圖是批評學校的新政策。

definition_zh: (名) 目的；用途
example_sentence: The main purpose of this project is to help the community.
sentence_zh: 這個專案的主要目的是幫助社區。

definition_zh: (形) 有目的的；堅定的
example_sentence: The purposeful discussion among students led to a better understanding of the topic.
sentence_zh: 學生們有目的的討論促進了對這個主題更好的理解。

definition_zh: (副) 故意地；有目的地
example_sentence: The student purposefully ignored the teacher's warning about using phones in class.
sentence_zh: 那名學生故意無視老師關於在課堂上使用手機的警告。

definition_zh: (副) 故意地；特意地
example_sentence: The student purposely left his homework at home.
sentence_zh: 這個學生故意把作業留在家裡。

definition_zh: (名) 錢包；手提包
example_sentence: The woman searched her purse for the missing keys.
sentence_zh: 那位女士在她的錢包裡尋找遺失的鑰匙。

definition_zh: (動) 追求；追趕
example_sentence: Many students pursue higher education to improve their future careers.
sentence_zh: 許多學生追求高等教育以改善他們未來的職業生涯。

definition_zh: (名) 追求；追尋
example_sentence: If the pursuit of knowledge were easy, more students would achieve their goals.
sentence_zh: 如果追求知識很容易，更多學生就會達成他們的目標。

definition_zh: (名) 供應商；提供者
example_sentence: When the festival began, the purveyor of local snacks set up a popular stall.
sentence_zh: 當節日開始時，當地小吃供應商設立了一個受歡迎的攤位。

definition_zh: (名) 膿；膿液
example_sentence: Never before had the wound discharged such thick pus.
sentence_zh: 傷口從未流出過如此濃稠的膿液。

definition_zh: (片) 到處惹事；欺壓
example_sentence: If the new student keeps pushing about, the teacher will have to intervene.
sentence_zh: 如果新來的學生繼續到處惹事，老師將不得不出面干預。

definition_zh: (片) 繼續進行；推行
example_sentence: Only after the debate did the committee push ahead with the new policy.
sentence_zh: 只有在辯論之後，委員會才繼續推行新政策。

definition_zh: (片) 推進；繼續進行
example_sentence: The science team decided to push ahead with the experiment despite the storm.
sentence_zh: 科學團隊決定儘管有風暴仍繼續進行實驗。

definition_zh: (片) 推動；推進
example_sentence: The strong wind pushed along the fallen leaves across the street.
sentence_zh: 強風將落葉沿著街道吹動。

definition_zh: (片) 插隊；擠入
example_sentence: The student who tried to push in was asked to wait.
sentence_zh: 那個試圖插隊的學生被要求等待。

definition_zh: (片) 出發；離開
example_sentence: If the boat is ready, we can push off from the dock.
sentence_zh: 如果船準備好了，我們就可以從碼頭出發。

definition_zh: (片) 繼續前進；奮力推進
example_sentence: Feeling exhausted, the team decided to push on toward the finish line.
sentence_zh: 感到筋疲力竭，團隊決定繼續朝終點線前進。

definition_zh: (片) 推出；淘汰；驅逐
example_sentence: If the company pushed out older workers, younger employees would have more opportunities.
sentence_zh: 如果公司淘汰年長員工，年輕員工就會有更多機會。

definition_zh: (動) 推倒；使倒下
example_sentence: The strong wind might push over the old tree in the yard.
sentence_zh: 強風可能會吹倒院子裡的老樹。

definition_zh: (片) 克服；擠過；推進
example_sentence: Seldom does the team push through such difficult challenges without strong leadership.
sentence_zh: 這個團隊很少在沒有強有力領導的情況下克服如此困難的挑戰。

definition_zh: (動) 推；催促
example_sentence: Seldom did the teacher push her students to finish the project early.
sentence_zh: 老師很少催促學生提前完成專題。

definition_zh: (名) 推車；手推車
example_sentence: The old man who sells fruit uses a wooden pushcart every morning.
sentence_zh: 那位賣水果的老人每天早上使用一台木頭推車。

definition_zh: (名) 容易打敗的人或事物；簡單的事
example_sentence: Not only is this exam a pushover, but also it tests real understanding.
sentence_zh: 這場考試不只是簡單，還考驗真正的理解。

definition_zh: (名) 貓咪
example_sentence: Many students adopt a stray pussy to practice responsibility.
sentence_zh: 許多學生收養流浪貓來練習責任感。

definition_zh: (片) 傳達；表達
example_sentence: Explaining the project clearly, the student put across his main ideas.
sentence_zh: 清楚解釋專題後，那名學生成功地傳達了他的主要想法。

definition_zh: (片) 擱置；儲存
example_sentence: Having put aside her phone, Jenny focused on her homework.
sentence_zh: 把手機放在一邊後，珍妮專心寫作業。

definition_zh: (片) 收拾；放好
example_sentence: After dinner, Mary always puts away the dishes quickly.
sentence_zh: 晚餐後，瑪麗總是迅速把碗盤收拾好。

definition_zh: (片) 放回；歸還
example_sentence: Carefully putting back the borrowed book, Lisa returned it to the shelf.
sentence_zh: 小心地放回借來的書，麗莎把它放回書架上。

definition_zh: (片) 儲蓄；積攢
example_sentence: The money that my grandmother put by helped pay for my college.
sentence_zh: 我祖母儲蓄的那筆錢幫助支付了我的大學費用。

definition_zh: (片) 為（某人）報名；將（某人）列入名單
example_sentence: My parents put me down for a summer volunteer program.
sentence_zh: 我的父母為我報名了一個暑期志工計畫。

definition_zh: (片) 歸因於；認為是...所致
example_sentence: Many students put their low grades down to a lack of sleep.
sentence_zh: 許多學生將他們成績不佳歸因於睡眠不足。

definition_zh: (片) 放下；寫下；鎮壓
example_sentence: After the teacher asked a question, the student put down his pen to think.
sentence_zh: 老師問了一個問題後，學生放下筆思考。

definition_zh: (片) 提出；提議
example_sentence: The student council decided to put forward a new proposal for the school festival.
sentence_zh: 學生會決定為校慶提出一項新提案。

definition_zh: (片) 申請；正式提出（要求）
example_sentence: After finishing the project, Mary put in for a promotion.
sentence_zh: 完成專案後，瑪麗申請了升職。

definition_zh: (片) 投入；付出
example_sentence: After studying hard, the student put in extra effort before the final exam.
sentence_zh: 努力讀書後，這位學生在期末考前投入了額外的努力。

definition_zh: (片) 推遲；拖延
example_sentence: Only after finishing homework should students put off their chores.
sentence_zh: 只有在完成作業後，學生才應該推遲他們的雜務。

definition_zh: (片) 穿上；戴上；播放；舉辦
example_sentence: Seldom does the teacher put on a movie during class.
sentence_zh: 老師很少在課堂上播放電影。

definition_zh: (片) 撲滅；熄滅
example_sentence: The fire department worked hard to put out the forest fire.
sentence_zh: 消防隊努力撲滅森林大火。

definition_zh: (片) 提出；傳達
example_sentence: Putting over a persuasive argument, the student won the debate.
sentence_zh: 提出一個有說服力的論點，那名學生贏得了辯論。

definition_zh: (片) 接通（電話）；使經歷
example_sentence: After the storm, the phone company put through the emergency calls quickly.
sentence_zh: 暴風雨過後，電話公司迅速接通了緊急電話。

definition_zh: (片) 組裝；拼湊；整理
example_sentence: The science club put together a model rocket for the school fair.
sentence_zh: 科學社團為學校園遊會組裝了一個模型火箭。

definition_zh: (片) 將…用於；把…貢獻給
example_sentence: Putting the extra money towards her college fund, Sarah felt responsible.
sentence_zh: 莎拉把多餘的錢存進大學基金，覺得自己很負責任。

definition_zh: (片) 慫恿；唆使
example_sentence: My friend tried to put me up to skipping class.
sentence_zh: 我朋友試圖慫恿我翹課。

definition_zh: (片) 忍受；容忍
example_sentence: The noise that residents put up with every night is unacceptable.
sentence_zh: 居民每晚忍受的噪音令人無法接受。

definition_zh: (動) 張貼；搭建；忍受
example_sentence: The students who put up the posters for the event worked hard.
sentence_zh: 那些為活動張貼海報的學生們工作很努力。

definition_zh: (名) 貶低；奚落
example_sentence: The teacher's harsh put-down that embarrassed the student was completely unnecessary.
sentence_zh: 老師那句讓學生難堪的苛刻貶低之言是完全沒必要的。

definition_zh: (動) 放置；放
example_sentence: The students put their books on the shelf before lunch.
sentence_zh: 學生們在午餐前把他們的書放在書架上。

definition_zh: (名) 推桿；輕擊球
example_sentence: After the golfer missed the fairway, his putt rolled past the hole.
sentence_zh: 在高爾夫球手錯過球道後，他的推桿滾過了球洞。

definition_zh: (動) 使困惑；使為難　(名) 謎；難題
example_sentence: Having puzzled over the math problem for hours, the student finally found the answer.
sentence_zh: 在對這道數學題困惑了好幾個小時後，這名學生終於找到了答案。

definition_zh: (形) 困惑的；迷惑的
example_sentence: The puzzled student stared at the math problem for ten minutes.
sentence_zh: 那位困惑的學生盯著數學題目看了十分鐘。

definition_zh: (名) 金字塔
example_sentence: The ancient pyramid stood tall against the desert sky.
sentence_zh: 這座古老的金字塔在沙漠的天空下巍然聳立。

definition_zh: (名) 金字塔；角錐體
example_sentence: Before building the pyramid, the ancient Egyptians planned carefully.
sentence_zh: 在建造金字塔之前，古埃及人仔細規劃。

definition_zh: (名) 火葬柴堆；大堆可燃物
example_sentence: The villagers built a large pyre for the autumn festival.
sentence_zh: 村民為秋季慶典建造了一個大火葬柴堆。

definition_zh: (名) 鴨叫聲；(動) 發出鴨叫聲
example_sentence: The duck's quack echoed across the quiet pond.
sentence_zh: 鴨子的叫聲在安靜的池塘上迴盪。

definition_zh: (動) 使成四倍；翻兩番　(形) 四倍的
example_sentence: The company aims to quadruple its profits by launching new products.
sentence_zh: 這家公司旨在透過推出新產品使利潤翻兩番。

definition_zh: (形) 古雅的；奇特而有趣的
example_sentence: Seldom have I seen such a quaint little bookstore in this modern city.
sentence_zh: 我很少在這個現代城市裡看到這麼古雅的小書店。

definition_zh: (名) 資格；學歷
example_sentence: Having obtained the necessary qualification, Lisa applied for the engineering program.
sentence_zh: 獲得必要的資格後，麗莎申請了工程學程。

definition_zh: (動) 有資格；合格　(形) 合格的；有資格的
example_sentence: If more students qualified for the contest, the school would send a bigger team.
sentence_zh: 如果有更多學生有資格參加比賽，學校就會派出更大的隊伍。

definition_zh: (名) 資格者；合格者
example_sentence: The student who earned the highest score was the qualifier for the national competition.
sentence_zh: 獲得最高分的學生是全國比賽的資格者。

definition_zh: (動) 使有資格；符合資格
example_sentence: A good score on the test will qualify you for the scholarship.
sentence_zh: 考試的好成績將使你有資格獲得獎學金。

definition_zh: (形) 質性的；性質上的
example_sentence: Having conducted a qualitative study, the researcher presented her findings on student motivation.
sentence_zh: 進行了一項質性研究後，研究人員展示了關於學生動機的發現。

definition_zh: (名) 品質；質量　(形) 優質的
example_sentence: If this product had better quality, more customers would buy it.
sentence_zh: 如果這個產品的品質更好，更多顧客就會購買。

definition_zh: (動) 量化；測量
example_sentence: Scientists need to quantify the impact of air pollution on health.
sentence_zh: 科學家需要量化空氣污染對健康的影響。

definition_zh: (形) 數量的；量化的
example_sentence: Because the survey required quantitative data, the students used statistical methods.
sentence_zh: 因為這項調查需要量化數據，學生們使用了統計方法。

definition_zh: (名) 數量；大量
example_sentence: The store ordered a large quantity of school supplies.
sentence_zh: 這家商店訂購了大量的學校用品。

definition_zh: (名) 量子；(形) 量子的
example_sentence: Quantum physics explores the behavior of tiny particles.
sentence_zh: 量子物理學探討微小粒子的行為。

definition_zh: (名) 隔離；檢疫　(動) 隔離；使孤立
example_sentence: After the quarantine ended, the students returned to school happily.
sentence_zh: 隔離結束後，學生們快樂地回到學校。

definition_zh: (片) 爭吵；吵嘴
example_sentence: The two friends had a minor quarrel out in the hallway.
sentence_zh: 那兩個朋友在走廊上發生了一場小爭吵。

definition_zh: (片) 與...吵架；爭論
example_sentence: If your brother quarrels with his classmate, the teacher will intervene.
sentence_zh: 如果你哥哥和他的同學吵架，老師就會介入。

definition_zh: (動) 爭吵；吵架
example_sentence: If two friends quarrel over a small thing, their relationship might suffer.
sentence_zh: 如果兩個朋友為小事爭吵，他們的關係可能會受損。

definition_zh: (形) 愛爭吵的；好辯的
example_sentence: Whenever the quarrelsome student spoke, the teacher asked for silence.
sentence_zh: 每當那個愛爭吵的學生說話時，老師就要求安靜。

definition_zh: (名) 夸脫（容量單位）
example_sentence: If the recipe needs a quart of milk, use whole milk for better flavor.
sentence_zh: 如果食譜需要一夸脫牛奶，使用全脂牛奶以獲得更好風味。

definition_zh: (名) 四分之一；一刻鐘；一季
example_sentence: After the first quarter of the game, our team was leading by ten points.
sentence_zh: 比賽的第一節結束後，我們隊領先十分。

definition_zh: (形) 每季的；季度的　(副) 每季地；按季地
example_sentence: The company releases a quarterly report on its sales performance.
sentence_zh: 該公司每季發布一份關於其銷售業績的報告。

definition_zh: (名) 四重奏；四重唱
example_sentence: A string quartet performed at the school concert last Friday.
sentence_zh: 一個弦樂四重奏在上週五的學校音樂會上表演。

definition_zh: (名) 石英
example_sentence: The quartz in this watch helps keep accurate time.
sentence_zh: 這隻手錶裡的石英有助於保持精準的時間。

definition_zh: (名) 女王；王后
example_sentence: The queen who visited our school gave a speech on leadership.
sentence_zh: 拜訪我們學校的女王發表了一場關於領導力的演講。

definition_zh: (片) 搞砸；打亂
example_sentence: If the rain queered up our picnic, the students would stay indoors.
sentence_zh: 如果這場雨打亂了我們的野餐，學生們就會待在室內。

definition_zh: (形) 奇怪的；不舒服的
example_sentence: Having felt queer all day, the student decided to see the school nurse.
sentence_zh: 整天感到不舒服後，那名學生決定去看學校護士。

definition_zh: (動) 解（渴）；熄滅
example_sentence: Drinking cold water can quench your thirst after a long run.
sentence_zh: 長跑後喝冷水可以解渴。

definition_zh: (名) 疑問；查詢　(動) 詢問；質疑
example_sentence: The student's query about the homework confused the teacher.
sentence_zh: 學生關於作業的疑問讓老師感到困惑。

definition_zh: (名) 追尋；探索
example_sentence: The scientist's quest for a cure inspired many young students.
sentence_zh: 這位科學家對治療方法的追尋啟發了許多年輕學生。

definition_zh: (名) 問題；疑問　(動) 質疑；詢問
example_sentence: Having questioned the teacher's explanation, the student looked for more evidence.
sentence_zh: 在質疑老師的解釋後，這個學生尋找更多證據。

definition_zh: (名) 問卷調查；問卷
example_sentence: Completing the questionnaire helped the school improve its services.
sentence_zh: 完成這份問卷調查幫助學校改善了服務。

definition_zh: (名) 問卷；調查表
example_sentence: The questionnaire asked students about their favorite after-school activities.
sentence_zh: 這份問卷調查詢問學生們最喜歡的課後活動。

definition_zh: (片) 排隊
example_sentence: Students often queue up early to get the best seats in the library.
sentence_zh: 學生們常常早早排隊，以便在圖書館搶到最好的位子。

definition_zh: (名) 排隊；長列
example_sentence: A long queue formed outside the popular bubble tea shop.
sentence_zh: 受歡迎的珍珠奶茶店外排起了長隊。

definition_zh: (形) 快的；迅速的　(副) 快速地
example_sentence: Having a quick breakfast, the student rushed to catch the school bus.
sentence_zh: 快速吃完早餐後，那個學生衝去趕校車。

definition_zh: (副) 快速地；迅速地
example_sentence: The student finished the test quickly to catch the bus.
sentence_zh: 那名學生為了趕上公車而快速完成了測驗。

definition_zh: (片) 安靜下來；平靜下來
example_sentence: The teacher asked the noisy students to quiet down before the lesson.
sentence_zh: 老師要求吵鬧的學生在上課前安靜下來。

definition_zh: (形) 安靜的；平靜的　(動) 使安靜；平靜下來
example_sentence: If the library were quiet, students could focus on their homework.
sentence_zh: 如果圖書館安靜，學生就能專心做功課。

definition_zh: (副) 安靜地；悄悄地
example_sentence: The students quietly read their books during the study hall.
sentence_zh: 學生們在自習時間安靜地看書。

definition_zh: (副) 安靜地；平靜地
example_sentence: If the student studied quietly, the librarian would not complain.
sentence_zh: 如果那位學生安靜地讀書，圖書館員就不會抱怨。

definition_zh: (名) 棉被；被子
example_sentence: Seldom have I seen such a beautifully handmade quilt at the local market.
sentence_zh: 我很少在當地市場看到如此精美的手工棉被。

definition_zh: (動) 說俏皮話；嘲弄　(名) 俏皮話；諷刺
example_sentence: If a classmate quip about the test, the teacher would not laugh.
sentence_zh: 如果有同學對考試說俏皮話，老師不會笑。

definition_zh: (名) 奇特之處；怪癖
example_sentence: Students often study a quirk of grammar to improve their writing skills.
sentence_zh: 學生們經常研究文法中的一項奇特之處，以提升寫作技巧。

definition_zh: (形) 古怪的；離奇的
example_sentence: Many students visit the quirky cafe to enjoy its unique decor.
sentence_zh: 許多學生造訪這間古怪的咖啡館，以享受其獨特的裝飾。

definition_zh: (片) 放棄；拋棄
example_sentence: The team decided to practice harder to never quit on their goal.
sentence_zh: 團隊決定更努力練習，以絕不放棄他們的目標。

definition_zh: (動) 辭去；戒除
example_sentence: Never will Tom quit his part-time job before college.
sentence_zh: 湯姆絕不會在大學前辭掉他的兼職工作。

definition_zh: (副) 相當；頗
example_sentence: The movie was quite interesting, so my friends enjoyed it a lot.
sentence_zh: 這部電影相當有趣，所以我的朋友們很喜歡它。

definition_zh: (動) 顫抖；顫動　(名) 顫抖；箭筒
example_sentence: The small rabbit's nose began to quiver when it smelled the fresh carrot.
sentence_zh: 小兔子的鼻子聞到新鮮胡蘿蔔時開始顫動。

definition_zh: (名) 小考；測驗
example_sentence: The teacher gave us a pop quiz on new vocabulary words.
sentence_zh: 老師給我們一個關於新單字的小考。

definition_zh: (名) 法定人數
example_sentence: Because the meeting lacked a quorum, the committee postponed the vote.
sentence_zh: 因為會議未達法定人數，委員會推遲了投票。

definition_zh: (名) 配額；限額
example_sentence: If the school sets a quota for club members, many students will be disappointed.
sentence_zh: 如果學校為社團成員設定配額，許多學生將會感到失望。

definition_zh: (名) 報價單；引文
example_sentence: Checking the quotation, the student found a mistake in the price.
sentence_zh: 核對報價單時，學生發現價格上有一個錯誤。

definition_zh: (動) 引用；報價
example_sentence: Quoting the expert, the student finished her report on climate change.
sentence_zh: 引用專家的話，這位學生完成了她關於氣候變遷的報告。

definition_zh: (名) 兔子
example_sentence: The rabbit hid behind the tree when it heard a loud noise.
sentence_zh: 兔子聽到大聲響時，躲到了樹後面。

definition_zh: (形) 狂犬病的；瘋狂的
example_sentence: The rabid dog chased the children through the park.
sentence_zh: 那隻狂犬病的狗在公園裡追逐孩子們。

definition_zh: (名) 狂犬病
example_sentence: If a stray dog bit a student, rabies would be a serious concern.
sentence_zh: 如果流浪狗咬傷學生，狂犬病會是一個嚴重的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 浣熊
example_sentence: A raccoon climbed the fence behind my house last night.
sentence_zh: 一隻浣熊昨晚爬上了我家後面的圍籬。

definition_zh: (片) 衝出去；趕快離開
example_sentence: The students race off to the library when the final bell rings.
sentence_zh: 當最後的鐘聲響起時，學生們衝向圖書館。

definition_zh: (名) 種族；競賽　(動) 競賽；全速進行
example_sentence: Excited by the challenge, the team raced to finish the project on time.
sentence_zh: 受到挑戰的激勵，團隊為了準時完成專案而全力以赴。

definition_zh: (形) 種族的；人種的
example_sentence: Having faced racial discrimination, the student joined a human rights club.
sentence_zh: 在面臨種族歧視後，那名學生加入了一個人權社團。

definition_zh: (名) 賽車；競賽　(動) 競速；賽跑
example_sentence: The racing driver sped around the track with great skill.
sentence_zh: 賽車手以高超的技巧在賽道上疾馳。

definition_zh: (名) 種族歧視；種族主義
example_sentence: Many students join clubs to fight racism in their schools.
sentence_zh: 許多學生加入社團，以對抗校園中的種族歧視。

definition_zh: (形) 種族歧視的；(名) 種族主義者
example_sentence: If a person makes racist comments, true friends will speak up against them.
sentence_zh: 如果有人發表種族歧視的言論，真正的朋友會站出來反對。

definition_zh: (片) 刮掉；除去
example_sentence: Racking off the old paint, the workers prepared the wall for a fresh coat.
sentence_zh: 刮掉舊油漆後，工人們準備好牆壁要塗上一層新漆。

definition_zh: (片) 睡覺；休息
example_sentence: Racking out after a long day of studying, the student felt fully refreshed.
sentence_zh: 在長時間的學習後好好睡一覺，這位學生感到完全恢復精神。

definition_zh: (動) 累積；獲得（大量分數、債務等）
example_sentence: Many students study hard to rack up high scores on the exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力學習，以便在考試中累積高分。

definition_zh: (動) 折磨；使痛苦；(名) 架子；擱架
example_sentence: Racking his brain for an answer, Tom finally solved the math problem.
sentence_zh: 湯姆絞盡腦汁尋找答案，終於解出了那道數學題。

definition_zh: (名) 雷達
example_sentence: The radar system helps pilots see through thick clouds during bad weather.
sentence_zh: 雷達系統幫助飛行員在惡劣天氣中看穿厚厚的雲層。

definition_zh: (名) 光輝；光彩
example_sentence: The morning sun filled the classroom with a warm, golden radiance.
sentence_zh: 早晨的陽光讓教室充滿了溫暖的金色光輝。

definition_zh: (形) 燦爛的；光芒四射的
example_sentence: The radiant smile of the volunteer brightened everyone's day.
sentence_zh: 那位志工燦爛的笑容照亮了每個人的一天。

definition_zh: (動) 輻射；散發
example_sentence: The sun's rays radiate warmth across the entire park.
sentence_zh: 太陽的光線將溫暖散播到整個公園。

definition_zh: (名) 輻射；放射線
example_sentence: Exposed to high levels of radiation, the scientist wore protective gear.
sentence_zh: 暴露在高輻射水平下，那位科學家穿著防護裝備。

definition_zh: (名) 散熱器；暖氣片
example_sentence: The old radiator in the classroom makes a loud noise every morning.
sentence_zh: 教室裡的老舊散熱器每天早上都會發出很大的噪音。

definition_zh: (形) 根本的；激進的
example_sentence: A radical change in school rules surprised many students this semester.
sentence_zh: 學校規定的一項徹底改變讓這學期許多學生感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (副) 徹底地；根本地
example_sentence: The new policy will radically change how we recycle plastic waste.
sentence_zh: 這項新政策將徹底改變我們回收塑膠廢棄物的方式。

definition_zh: (名) 收音機；無線電
example_sentence: Listening to the radio helps students relax after school.
sentence_zh: 聽收音機幫助學生放學後放鬆。

definition_zh: (形) 放射性的
example_sentence: Having been exposed to radioactive waste, the ground near the factory became unsafe.
sentence_zh: 暴露在放射性廢棄物中後，工廠附近的地面變得不再安全。

definition_zh: (名) 放射學；放射科
example_sentence: The hospital's radiology department uses advanced machines for scans.
sentence_zh: 醫院的放射科使用先進的機器進行掃描。

definition_zh: (名) 蘿蔔
example_sentence: My grandmother grows radish in her small garden every spring.
sentence_zh: 我祖母每年春天在她的小菜園裡種植蘿蔔。

definition_zh: (名) 抽獎；摸彩
example_sentence: The school club organized a raffle to raise funds for charity.
sentence_zh: 學校社團舉辦了一場抽獎活動，為慈善機構籌集資金。

definition_zh: (名) 木筏；橡皮艇
example_sentence: If a raft broke apart in the river, the team would struggle to survive.
sentence_zh: 如果木筏在河中解體，團隊將難以生存。

definition_zh: (名) 破布；抹布
example_sentence: If the old rag is too dirty, Mom will throw it away.
sentence_zh: 如果那塊舊抹布太髒，媽媽就會把它扔掉。

definition_zh: (名) 憤怒；暴怒　(動) 發怒；肆虐
example_sentence: The driver's sudden rage caused an accident on the busy highway.
sentence_zh: 司機的突然暴怒在繁忙的高速公路上引發了一場事故。

definition_zh: (形) 破爛的；衣衫襤褸的
example_sentence: The ragged boy wore a torn jacket and dirty shoes.
sentence_zh: 那個衣衫襤褸的男孩穿著一件破爛的夾克和髒鞋子。

definition_zh: (形) 猛烈的；狂暴的
example_sentence: The raging storm forced the school to cancel all outdoor activities.
sentence_zh: 猛烈的暴風雨迫使學校取消所有戶外活動。

definition_zh: (名) 突襲；搶劫　(動) 突襲；搶劫
example_sentence: The sudden raid on the convenience store shocked the entire neighborhood.
sentence_zh: 便利商店的突然搶劫震驚了整個社區。

definition_zh: (名) 掠奪者；襲擊者
example_sentence: The corporate raider who targeted the small company faced legal issues.
sentence_zh: 那個瞄準小公司的企業掠奪者面臨了法律問題。

definition_zh: (名) 鐵軌；欄杆
example_sentence: The old iron rail that runs through the park is being replaced.
sentence_zh: 那條穿過公園的舊鐵軌正在被更換。

definition_zh: (名) 鐵路；(動) 用鐵路運輸
example_sentence: The new railroad will connect the city to the mountain town.
sentence_zh: 這條新的鐵路將連接城市和山區小鎮。

definition_zh: (名) 鐵路；鐵道
example_sentence: Many students take the railway to visit their grandparents on weekends.
sentence_zh: 許多學生週末搭火車去拜訪祖父母。

definition_zh: (片) 如雨點般落下；大量湧來
example_sentence: The criticism that rained down on the new policy surprised many students.
sentence_zh: 如雨點般落在那項新政策上的批評讓許多學生感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (片) 因雨取消；因雨延期
example_sentence: The baseball game was rained off last night.
sentence_zh: 昨晚的棒球比賽因雨取消。

definition_zh: (片) 掃興；潑冷水
example_sentence: The teacher who rained on the parade gave a difficult test.
sentence_zh: 那個掃興的老師出了一份很難的考卷。

definition_zh: (名) 雨　(動) 下雨
example_sentence: If it rains tomorrow, the baseball game will be canceled.
sentence_zh: 如果明天下雨，棒球賽就會被取消。

definition_zh: (名) 彩虹
example_sentence: A beautiful rainbow appeared after the heavy rain stopped.
sentence_zh: 一場美麗的彩虹在豪雨停止後出現。

definition_zh: (名) 雨衣
example_sentence: The student who forgot his raincoat got wet on the way home.
sentence_zh: 那個忘了帶雨衣的學生在回家的路上淋濕了。

definition_zh: (名) 雨滴
example_sentence: Having felt a raindrop on her arm, the girl quickly opened her umbrella.
sentence_zh: 感覺到手臂上有一滴雨滴，女孩迅速打開了雨傘。

definition_zh: (名) 降雨；降雨量
example_sentence: After the heavy rainfall, the school sports day was canceled.
sentence_zh: 大雨過後，學校的運動會取消了。

definition_zh: (形) 下雨的；多雨的
example_sentence: A rainy day often makes students feel sleepy in class.
sentence_zh: 下雨天常讓學生在課堂上感到睏倦。

definition_zh: (片) 提高…的知名度；提升…的形象
example_sentence: Seldom does a single event raise the profile of an entire community.
sentence_zh: 單一事件很少能提升整個社區的知名度。

definition_zh: (動) 養育；提高；籌集
example_sentence: The farmer raises chickens and sells their eggs at the market.
sentence_zh: 這位農夫養雞，並在市場上賣牠們的蛋。

definition_zh: (名) 募款者；籌集者
example_sentence: The charity raiser collected enough funds for the new library.
sentence_zh: 這場慈善募款活動為新圖書館籌集了足夠的資金。

definition_zh: (名) 葡萄乾
example_sentence: My mother added a raisin to the oatmeal for extra sweetness.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽在燕麥粥裡加了一顆葡萄乾以增加甜味。

definition_zh: (片) 賺進；大量獲得
example_sentence: If the company offered better service, it would rake in more profits.
sentence_zh: 如果這家公司提供更好的服務，它就會賺進更多利潤。

definition_zh: (片) 大賺一筆；賺進大筆錢財
example_sentence: If that tech startup raked it in, its success would inspire many students.
sentence_zh: 如果那家科技新創公司大賺一筆，它的成功會激勵許多學生。

definition_zh: (片) 作弊；撈取（不正當利益）
example_sentence: The student who tried to rake off the test was caught by the teacher.
sentence_zh: 那個試圖在考試中作弊的學生被老師抓到了。

definition_zh: (片) 翻舊帳；重提（不愉快的往事）
example_sentence: The teacher asked the class not to rake over old mistakes.
sentence_zh: 老師要求全班不要翻舊帳。

definition_zh: (片) 翻出；重提（不愉快的事）
example_sentence: The journalist who tried to rake up old scandals faced criticism.
sentence_zh: 試圖翻出舊醜聞的記者面臨了批評。

definition_zh: (名) 耙子　(動) 耙；搜尋
example_sentence: After the storm, the gardener used a rake to clear the wet leaves.
sentence_zh: 暴風雨過後，園丁用耙子清理潮濕的落葉。

definition_zh: (名) 集會；恢復　(動) 召集；恢復
example_sentence: The school rally inspired students to work harder for their exams.
sentence_zh: 學校的集會激勵學生為考試更努力。

definition_zh: (片) 漫無邊際地閒扯；喋喋不休
example_sentence: The teacher told the class not to ramble on during presentations.
sentence_zh: 老師告訴全班同學在報告時不要漫無邊際地閒扯。

definition_zh: (動) 漫談；閒聊
example_sentence: The teacher asked the students not to ramble during the discussion.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生在討論時不要漫談。

definition_zh: (名) 結果；後果
example_sentence: If the project fails, the ramification could affect the entire school.
sentence_zh: 如果這個專案失敗，其影響可能波及整個學校。

definition_zh: (名) 結果；影響
example_sentence: The student council considered the ramifications before changing the school lunch menu.
sentence_zh: 學生議會在改變學校午餐菜單前考慮了其影響。

definition_zh: (片) 增加；加強
example_sentence: Having ramped up production, the factory met its monthly target ahead of schedule.
sentence_zh: 在提高產量後，這家工廠提前達成了月度目標。

definition_zh: (形) 猖獗的；泛濫的
example_sentence: Because pollution is rampant, many students wear masks to school.
sentence_zh: 因為污染猖獗，許多學生戴口罩上學。

definition_zh: (名) 牧場；大農場
example_sentence: Seldom has a ranch been this close to the city center.
sentence_zh: 很少有牧場這麼靠近市中心。

definition_zh: (形) 腐臭的；酸敗的
example_sentence: Finding the rancid milk in the fridge, the student immediately threw it away.
sentence_zh: 學生在冰箱裡發現變質的牛奶後，立刻把它扔掉。

definition_zh: (形) 隨機的；任意的
example_sentence: The teacher selected a random student to answer the difficult question.
sentence_zh: 老師隨機選了一名學生來回答這個困難的問題。

definition_zh: (副) 隨機地；任意地
example_sentence: The teacher randomly selected five students to answer the questions.
sentence_zh: 老師隨機選了五名學生來回答問題。

definition_zh: (片) 範圍從…到…不等
example_sentence: The prices of drinks in the store range from 30 to 80 dollars.
sentence_zh: 這家商店的飲料價格從30元到80元不等。

definition_zh: (名) 範圍；山脈　(動) 排列；（在…之間）變化
example_sentence: The price range of these shoes is from 500 to 2000 dollars.
sentence_zh: 這些鞋子的價格範圍在500到2000元之間。

definition_zh: (名) 排名；等級　(動) 排名；分級
example_sentence: Ranked by test scores, the students felt a lot of pressure.
sentence_zh: 按考試成績排名，學生們感到很大的壓力。

definition_zh: (名) 排名；等級
example_sentence: The school's ranking in the national exam improved this year.
sentence_zh: 該校在全國考試中的排名今年有所提升。

definition_zh: (動) 洗劫；掠奪
example_sentence: After the burglars ransacked the house, the police arrived.
sentence_zh: 在竊賊洗劫房屋後，警察抵達了。

definition_zh: (名) 贖金
example_sentence: After the kidnappers demanded a ransom, the family called the police immediately.
sentence_zh: 綁匪要求贖金後，家人立刻報警。

definition_zh: (名) 咆哮；怒斥　(動) 咆哮；發怒
example_sentence: The customer's angry rant about the broken headphones annoyed everyone nearby.
sentence_zh: 那位顧客關於壞掉的耳機的憤怒咆哮惹惱了附近的每個人。

definition_zh: (片) 急促地說出；厲聲說出
example_sentence: When the fire alarm rang, the teacher began to rap out urgent instructions.
sentence_zh: 當火災警報響起時，老師開始急促地說出緊急指示。

definition_zh: (名) 饒舌歌；敲擊聲　(動) 敲擊；責罵
example_sentence: Having heard the rap about social issues, the class debated its message.
sentence_zh: 聽完這首關於社會議題的饒舌歌後，全班同學辯論了它的訊息。

definition_zh: (形) 貪婪的；掠奪的
example_sentence: The rapacious corporation destroyed the local environment for profit.
sentence_zh: 這家貪婪的公司為了利潤破壞了當地環境。

definition_zh: (副) 貪婪地；掠奪地
example_sentence: The corporation rapaciously consumed small businesses for profit.
sentence_zh: 這家公司貪婪地吞併小企業以謀取利潤。

definition_zh: (名) 強暴；強姦
example_sentence: The news report covered the tragic case of rape in the city.
sentence_zh: 這則新聞報導涵蓋了城市中一樁悲慘的強暴案件。

definition_zh: (形) 快速的；迅速的
example_sentence: The rapid growth of the city caused many traffic problems.
sentence_zh: 這座城市的快速成長導致了許多交通問題。

definition_zh: (形) 稀有的；罕見的
example_sentence: It is rare for students to miss the school bus on a sunny day.
sentence_zh: 學生在晴天錯過校車的情況很少見。

definition_zh: (副) 很少；罕見地
example_sentence: Tom rarely eats lunch in the school cafeteria.
sentence_zh: 湯姆很少在學校餐廳吃午餐。

definition_zh: (名) 稀有；罕見
example_sentence: Only after the auction did the collector realize the rarity of the ancient vase.
sentence_zh: 直到拍賣會結束後，收藏家才意識到這個古花瓶的稀有性。

definition_zh: (名) 淘氣鬼；流氓
example_sentence: The little rascal hid Tom's backpack before the math class.
sentence_zh: 那個小淘氣在數學課前藏了湯姆的書包。

definition_zh: (形) 輕率的；魯莽的　(名) 疹子
example_sentence: Making a rash decision without thinking can lead to serious problems.
sentence_zh: 不經思考就做出草率的決定可能會導致嚴重的問題。

definition_zh: (副) 魯莽地；輕率地
example_sentence: The young man rashly quit his job without any backup plan.
sentence_zh: 這個年輕人魯莽地辭職，沒有任何備用計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 刺耳聲；銼刀　(動) 發出刺耳聲；用銼刀銼
example_sentence: The rasp of the metal file annoyed the students in the workshop.
sentence_zh: 金屬銼刀的刺耳聲讓工作室裡的學生感到煩躁。

definition_zh: (片) 告密；出賣
example_sentence: Many students choose to stay silent rather than rat on their friends.
sentence_zh: 許多學生選擇保持沉默，而不是出賣朋友。

definition_zh: (片) 批准；通過
example_sentence: The committee decided to rat through the new policy quickly.
sentence_zh: 委員會決定迅速批准通過新政策。

definition_zh: (名) 老鼠；耗子
example_sentence: The students set traps to catch the rat in the kitchen.
sentence_zh: 學生們在廚房裡設陷阱捕捉那隻老鼠。

definition_zh: (動) 逐漸增加；逐步加強
example_sentence: Many companies ratchet up their marketing efforts before major product launches.
sentence_zh: 許多公司在重大產品發布前會逐漸加強行銷力度。

definition_zh: (名) 速率；比率　(動) 評價；評定等級
example_sentence: Students who study at a fast rate often understand the material better.
sentence_zh: 以快速學習的學生通常更能理解教材。

definition_zh: (片) 而不是；與其...不如
example_sentence: Many students choose online courses rather than attending physical classes.
sentence_zh: 許多學生選擇線上課程而不是參加實體課程。

definition_zh: (副) 相當；頗　(連) 寧願；與其...不如
example_sentence: Many students choose to study rather than play video games.
sentence_zh: 許多學生選擇讀書而不是玩電玩。

definition_zh: (片) 而不是；寧可...也不願
example_sentence: Many students choose to study abroad ratherthan attend local universities to broaden their horizons.
sentence_zh: 許多學生選擇出國留學，而非就讀本地大學，以拓展視野。

definition_zh: (動) 批准；認可
example_sentence: The committee will ratify the new environmental policy next week.
sentence_zh: 委員會將於下週批准這項新的環境政策。

definition_zh: (名) 評分；等級
example_sentence: After checking the online rating, the student chose the best restaurant.
sentence_zh: 查看線上評分後，那名學生選擇了最好的餐廳。

definition_zh: (名) 比率；比例
example_sentence: The student-teacher ratio in this school is very low.
sentence_zh: 這所學校的師生比例非常低。

definition_zh: (動) 配給；定量供應　(名) 配給量；口糧
example_sentence: The school cafeteria must ration the food during the typhoon season.
sentence_zh: 學校餐廳在颱風季節期間必須配給食物。

definition_zh: (形) 理性的；合理的
example_sentence: Before making a decision, a rational person considers all the facts.
sentence_zh: 在做決定之前，一個理性的人會考慮所有事實。

definition_zh: (名) 理由；邏輯依據
example_sentence: The teacher explained the rationale behind the new grading system.
sentence_zh: 老師解釋了新評分制度背後的理由。

definition_zh: (片) 快速說出；流利背誦
example_sentence: Standing at the podium, the professor rattled off historical dates.
sentence_zh: 站在講台上，教授迅速說出一連串歷史日期。

definition_zh: (動) 發出嘎嘎聲；使作響　(名) 嘎嘎聲；撥浪鼓
example_sentence: The old window rattles loudly when the wind blows through the cracks.
sentence_zh: 當風吹過裂縫時，那扇舊窗戶發出很大的嘎嘎聲。

definition_zh: (形) 喧鬧的；吵鬧的
example_sentence: The raucous laughter from the classroom annoyed the teacher next door.
sentence_zh: 來自教室的喧鬧笑聲惹惱了隔壁的老師。

definition_zh: (動) 摧毀；蹂躪
example_sentence: The typhoon did ravage the coastal village last summer.
sentence_zh: 去年夏天颱風確實摧毀了沿海村莊。

definition_zh: (動) 狂讚；極力讚揚
example_sentence: If a student raved about the new library, the principal would be thrilled.
sentence_zh: 如果學生對新圖書館讚不絕口，校長會非常高興。

definition_zh: (形) 極餓的；貪婪的
example_sentence: After the long hike, the ravenous students devoured their lunch boxes.
sentence_zh: 長途徒步後，飢餓的學生們狼吞虎嚥地吃光了他們的午餐盒。

definition_zh: (形) 生的；未經加工的
example_sentence: The chef used raw fish to make fresh sushi for the customers.
sentence_zh: 廚師使用生魚為顧客製作新鮮壽司。

definition_zh: (名) 光線；射線
example_sentence: After the storm, a bright ray of sunlight broke through the clouds.
sentence_zh: 暴風雨過後，一道明亮的陽光穿透雲層。

definition_zh: (動) 夷為平地；徹底摧毀
example_sentence: Razed by the earthquake, the old school had to be rebuilt.
sentence_zh: 被地震夷為平地後，那所舊學校不得不重建。

definition_zh: (名) 刮鬍刀；剃刀
example_sentence: Tom bought a new razor to shave his beard before the school party.
sentence_zh: 湯姆買了一把新刮鬍刀，以便在學校派對前刮鬍子。

definition_zh: (片) 伸手去拿；尋求幫助
example_sentence: The student who reaches out for help often finds a solution.
sentence_zh: 主動尋求幫助的學生通常能找到解決辦法。

definition_zh: (片) 伸出手；聯繫；尋求幫助
example_sentence: After the exam, students should reach out to their teachers for help.
sentence_zh: 考試後，學生應該向老師尋求幫助。

definition_zh: (片) 主動聯繫；伸出援手
example_sentence: If your friend felt lonely, would you reach out to them?
sentence_zh: 如果你的朋友感到孤獨，你會主動聯繫他們嗎？

definition_zh: (動) 到達；達成
example_sentence: The student who works hard can reach her goal.
sentence_zh: 努力用功的學生可以達成她的目標。

definition_zh: (片) 伸手拿；達到；追求
example_sentence: When students reach for their goals, hard work is always required.
sentence_zh: 當學生努力追求目標時，努力總是必要的。

definition_zh: (動) 反應；回應
example_sentence: The way students react to stress can affect their health.
sentence_zh: 學生對壓力的反應方式會影響他們的健康。

definition_zh: (名) 反應；回應
example_sentence: Seldom did the teacher expect such a strong reaction from the students.
sentence_zh: 老師很少預料到學生會有如此強烈的反應。

definition_zh: (名) 反應器；反應爐
example_sentence: The nuclear reactor in the science museum fascinated many students.
sentence_zh: 科學博物館裡的核反應爐讓許多學生著迷。

definition_zh: (片) 讀出；宣讀
example_sentence: After the experiment, the scientist read off the data from the screen.
sentence_zh: 實驗結束後，科學家從螢幕上讀出數據。

definition_zh: (片) 大聲念出；宣讀
example_sentence: Standing before the class, the teacher read out the exam results.
sentence_zh: 老師站在全班面前，大聲念出考試成績。

definition_zh: (片) 研讀；查閱資料
example_sentence: Before the science exam, many students read up on chemistry formulas.
sentence_zh: 科學考試前，許多學生研讀化學公式。

definition_zh: (動) 閱讀；朗讀
example_sentence: If you read more books, your vocabulary will improve quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果你多讀書，你的詞彙量會快速進步。

definition_zh: (名) 讀者；閱讀器
example_sentence: If a reader finishes this novel, the library will offer a prize.
sentence_zh: 如果讀者讀完這本小說，圖書館將提供獎品。

definition_zh: (名) 讀者群；讀者人數
example_sentence: The magazine's readership has grown significantly this year.
sentence_zh: 這本雜誌的讀者群今年顯著成長。

definition_zh: (副) 樂意地；迅速地
example_sentence: Many students readily use online dictionaries to improve their vocabulary.
sentence_zh: 許多學生樂於使用線上字典來增進他們的詞彙量。

definition_zh: (名) 閱讀；讀物　(動) 閱讀；朗讀
example_sentence: Students who enjoy reading often improve their vocabulary quickly.
sentence_zh: 喜歡閱讀的學生通常能快速提升詞彙量。

definition_zh: (形) 準備好的；樂意的
example_sentence: Getting ready for the exam, the student reviewed all her notes.
sentence_zh: 為了準備考試，這位學生複習了她所有的筆記。

definition_zh: (名) 試劑；反應物
example_sentence: If the student added the reagent slowly, the experiment would succeed.
sentence_zh: 如果學生慢慢加入試劑，實驗就會成功。

definition_zh: (形) 真正的；實際的
example_sentence: Seeing the real problem, the students found a better solution.
sentence_zh: 看到真正的問題後，學生們找到了更好的解決方案。

definition_zh: (名) 寫實主義；現實主義
example_sentence: Many students appreciate the realism in modern novels about social issues.
sentence_zh: 許多學生欣賞現代社會議題小說中的寫實主義。

definition_zh: (形) 現實的；實際的
example_sentence: Setting a realistic goal helps students stay motivated.
sentence_zh: 設定一個實際的目標有助於學生保持動力。

definition_zh: (名) 現實；實際情況
example_sentence: The reality of climate change affects everyone's daily life.
sentence_zh: 氣候變遷的現實影響每個人的日常生活。

definition_zh: (名) 領悟；實現
example_sentence: The sudden realization that the exam was tomorrow shocked the students.
sentence_zh: 突然意識到考試就在明天，讓學生們震驚不已。

definition_zh: (動) 體認；實現
example_sentence: Many students realize the importance of time management in high school.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在高中時體認到時間管理的重要性。

definition_zh: (副) 真正地；非常
example_sentence: Feeling really tired, the student decided to take a short nap.
sentence_zh: 感到真的很累，那個學生決定小睡片刻。

definition_zh: (動) 擴孔；仔細檢查
example_sentence: Reaming the document, the intern discovered several errors.
sentence_zh: 在擴孔文件時，實習生發現了幾個錯誤。

definition_zh: (動) 獲得；收割
example_sentence: Farmers who work hard all year will reap a good harvest in autumn.
sentence_zh: 全年辛勤工作的農夫將在秋天獲得豐收。

definition_zh: (動) 重新出現；再現
example_sentence: The student who thought he lost his phone saw it reappear in his bag.
sentence_zh: 那個以為手機弄丟的學生看到它重新出現在他的包包裡。

definition_zh: (動) 養育；飼養；種植
example_sentence: The teacher asked the students to rear the plants carefully in the greenhouse.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生們在溫室裡小心地養護植物。

definition_zh: (名) 後視鏡
example_sentence: The driver checked the rearview mirror before changing lanes.
sentence_zh: 駕駛在變換車道前檢查了後視鏡。

definition_zh: (片) 推理出；推論出
example_sentence: When the math problem seemed impossible, the student tried to reason out the answer.
sentence_zh: 當數學問題看似不可能時，這位學生試圖推理出答案。

definition_zh: (名) 理由；原因　(動) 推理；思考
example_sentence: Having lost his reason for studying, Tom decided to take a break.
sentence_zh: 失去了學習的理由後，湯姆決定休息一下。

definition_zh: (形) 合理的；通情達理的
example_sentence: The teacher's reasonable explanation helped the students understand the complex topic.
sentence_zh: 老師合理的解釋幫助學生理解這個複雜的主題。

definition_zh: (副) 合理地；適度地
example_sentence: Students who study reasonably can achieve good results.
sentence_zh: 合理讀書的學生可以取得好成績。

definition_zh: (名) 推理；論證　(動) 推理；思考
example_sentence: If you practice logical reasoning, your argument skills will improve.
sentence_zh: 如果你練習邏輯推理，你的論證技巧就會進步。

definition_zh: (動) 使安心；安慰
example_sentence: The teacher's smile reassured the nervous students before the exam.
sentence_zh: 老師的微笑在考試前安撫了緊張的學生。

definition_zh: (名) 折扣；退款
example_sentence: If Sarah buys a new laptop, the store will offer a 10% rebate.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉買一台新筆記型電腦，這家店會提供10%的折扣。

definition_zh: (動) 反抗；叛逆
example_sentence: Many teenagers rebel against their parents to express their independence.
sentence_zh: 許多青少年為了表達獨立而反抗父母。

definition_zh: (名) 反抗；叛亂
example_sentence: The student's rebellion against strict school rules surprised his teachers.
sentence_zh: 該學生對嚴格校規的反抗讓他的老師們感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (形) 叛逆的；反抗的
example_sentence: If a student became rebellious, the teacher would discuss the issue with their parents.
sentence_zh: 如果學生變得叛逆，老師就會和他們的家長討論這個問題。

definition_zh: (名) 重生；復興
example_sentence: Not only did the city experience a rebirth, but its culture also flourished.
sentence_zh: 這座城市不僅經歷了重生，其文化也蓬勃發展。

definition_zh: (動) 反彈；回升　(名) 反彈；復甦
example_sentence: The basketball hit the backboard and then rebounded to the guard.
sentence_zh: 籃球擊中籃板，然後反彈給後衛。

definition_zh: (動) 重建；改造
example_sentence: Seldom do students rebuild their study habits after a long break.
sentence_zh: 學生很少在長假後重建他們的學習習慣。

definition_zh: (名) 責備；指責　(動) 責備；訓斥
example_sentence: The teacher's sharp rebuke that surprised the class made everyone silent.
sentence_zh: 老師那番讓全班驚訝的嚴厲責備讓每個人都安靜了下來。

definition_zh: (動) 回憶；召回
example_sentence: The teacher asked the class to recall the main events of the story.
sentence_zh: 老師要求全班回憶故事的主要事件。

definition_zh: (動) 退去；減退
example_sentence: The floodwaters will recede after the heavy rain stops.
sentence_zh: 洪水在暴雨停止後將會退去。

definition_zh: (名) 收據；發票　(動) 收到；簽收
example_sentence: The cashier gave me a receipt after I paid for the book.
sentence_zh: 收銀員在我付了書錢後給了我一張收據。

definition_zh: (動) 收到；接受
example_sentence: Students who study hard often receive good grades on exams.
sentence_zh: 努力學習的學生通常在考試中獲得高分。

definition_zh: (名) 接收者；聽筒；外野手
example_sentence: The receiver who dropped the ball felt very sorry.
sentence_zh: 那個漏接球的外野手感到非常抱歉。

sentence_zh: 由於冷媒洩漏，空調停止正常運作。

sentence_zh: 冰箱因為昨晚停電而停止運轉。

definition_zh: (名) 避難所；庇護

sentence_zh: 這座山間避難所為登山者在暴風雨期間提供了庇護。

definition_zh: (名) 難民；避難者

sentence_zh: 這個難民家庭在長途跋涉後，終於在一個小村莊找到了安全。

definition_zh: (名) ['riˌfʌnd] 退款　(動) [rɪ'fʌnd] 退還；退款
example_sentence: The store offered a full refund for the damaged laptop.
sentence_zh: 這家商店為受損的筆記型電腦提供了全額退款。

definition_zh: (形) 可退款的；可退還的
example_sentence: The ticket that Emma bought yesterday is refundable within 30 days.
sentence_zh: 艾瑪昨天買的那張票在30天內可以退款。

definition_zh: (動) 翻新；整修
example_sentence: The school decided to refurbish the old library to create a better study space.
sentence_zh: 學校決定翻新舊圖書館，以創造更好的學習空間。

definition_zh: (名) 翻新；整修
example_sentence: If the school funded the refurbishment, the library would attract more students.
sentence_zh: 如果學校資助翻新，圖書館會吸引更多學生。

definition_zh: (名) 拒絕

sentence_zh: 那位學生拒絕加入社團，讓大家都很驚訝。

definition_zh: (動) 拒絕

sentence_zh: 這位學生拒絕參加週末的讀書會。

definition_zh: (動) 反駁；駁斥

sentence_zh: 這位科學家用強有力的數據反駁了錯誤的理論。

definition_zh: (動) 重新獲得；恢復
example_sentence: After the long illness, the athlete worked hard to regain her strength.
sentence_zh: 在久病之後，這位運動員努力恢復體力。

definition_zh: (動) 視為；看待

sentence_zh: 學生很少把作業視為學習的機會。

definition_zh: (動) 將…視為；看待　(名) 尊重；關心
example_sentence: Never did the students regard their teacher as a friend.
sentence_zh: 學生們從未將他們的老師視為朋友。

definition_zh: (介) 關於；至於
example_sentence: The new policy regarding homework has reduced student stress.
sentence_zh: 關於作業的新政策減輕了學生的壓力。

definition_zh: (片) 不管；不顧
example_sentence: Many students join the club regardless of their busy schedules to make new friends.
sentence_zh: 許多學生不顧繁忙的日程加入社團，以結交新朋友。

definition_zh: (副) 無論；不管
example_sentence: All students are welcome to join the club, regardless of their experience level.
sentence_zh: 所有學生都歡迎加入這個社團，不論他們的經驗程度如何。

definition_zh: (名) 雷鬼音樂
example_sentence: Although reggae music originated in Jamaica, many young people enjoy its relaxing rhythm.
sentence_zh: 雖然雷鬼音樂起源於牙買加，但許多年輕人喜歡它放鬆的節奏。

definition_zh: (名) 政權；管理體制
example_sentence: The new regime in the country has changed many old laws.
sentence_zh: 該國的新政權改變了許多舊法律。

definition_zh: (名) 養生法；作息計畫

sentence_zh: 如果學生遵循嚴格的作息計畫，學業成績就會進步。

definition_zh: (動) 嚴格管制；統治

sentence_zh: 如果學校嚴格規定我們的每日作息，學生的自由時間就會減少。

definition_zh: (名) 地區；區域

sentence_zh: 這個地區在夏季月份降雨量很大。

definition_zh: (形) 地區的；區域的
example_sentence: If the regional competition were held next month, our team would prepare harder.
sentence_zh: 如果下個月舉辦區域比賽，我們的隊伍會更努力準備。

definition_zh: (動) 登記；註冊
example_sentence: If more students registered for the club, it would get more funding.
sentence_zh: 如果有更多學生登記加入社團，它就會獲得更多資金。

definition_zh: (名) 登記；註冊；報名
example_sentence: The online registration for the summer camp closes this Friday.
sentence_zh: 夏令營的線上報名將於本週五截止。

definition_zh: (形) 倒退的；退步的
example_sentence: This regressive policy will hurt young students in Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 這項倒退的政策將傷害台灣的年輕學生。

definition_zh: (動) 後悔；遺憾
example_sentence: Having regretted his decision, the student worked harder to improve his grades.
sentence_zh: 後悔自己的決定後，這名學生更加努力以提升成績。

definition_zh: (形) 後悔的；遺憾的
example_sentence: If the team remains regretful about the loss, they will not improve.
sentence_zh: 如果團隊對失敗感到後悔，他們將不會進步。

definition_zh: (形) 令人遺憾的；可惜的
example_sentence: The team's loss in the final game was truly regrettable.
sentence_zh: 該隊在決賽中的失利確實令人遺憾。

definition_zh: (副) 遺憾地；可惜地
example_sentence: Regrettably, the school's art club had to cancel its annual exhibition.
sentence_zh: 遺憾的是，學校的美術社團不得不取消其年度展覽。

definition_zh: (形) 規律的；固定的
example_sentence: Students who follow a regular study schedule often perform better on exams.
sentence_zh: 遵循固定讀書計畫的學生通常在考試中表現更好。

definition_zh: (副) 定期地；經常地
example_sentence: Having regularly reviewed his notes, Tom felt confident before the exam.
sentence_zh: 定期複習筆記後，湯姆在考試前感到很有信心。

definition_zh: (動) 調節；管理
example_sentence: Having regulated the speed of the fan, the engineer checked the temperature again.
sentence_zh: 在調節了風扇的速度後，工程師再次檢查了溫度。

definition_zh: (名) 規定；規章

sentence_zh: 這項新規定要求所有學生穿校服。

definition_zh: (名) 監管機構；調節器

sentence_zh: 當監管機構制定新規則時，公司必須迅速適應。

definition_zh: (動) 恢復；使復原
example_sentence: Seldom do communities fully rehabilitate polluted rivers after industrial accidents.
sentence_zh: 在工業事故後，社區很少能完全恢復受污染的河流。

definition_zh: (名) 復健；重建

sentence_zh: 提供復健的中心幫助受傷的運動員恢復。

definition_zh: (名) 排練；預演

sentence_zh: 在校園話劇開演前，全體演員在禮堂進行了最後一次排練。

definition_zh: (動) 排練；預演
example_sentence: The drama club will rehearse their play every day after school this week.
sentence_zh: 戲劇社團這週每天放學後都會排練他們的戲劇。

definition_zh: (名) 統治時期；王朝

sentence_zh: 國王的統治為整個國家帶來了和平與繁榮。

definition_zh: (動) 報銷；補償

sentence_zh: 公司會報銷提交旅行收據的員工的費用。

definition_zh: (名) 報銷；退款

sentence_zh: 公司迅速處理了那台受損筆電的報銷。

definition_zh: (片) 控制；約束

sentence_zh: 老師不得不在校外教學時控制學生的興奮情緒。

definition_zh: (動) 控制；約束　(名) 韁繩

sentence_zh: 市長試圖控制城市在非必要項目上的開支。

definition_zh: (動) 使重生；使轉世
example_sentence: If a scientist could reincarnate a dinosaur, many people would visit the museum.
sentence_zh: 如果科學家能讓恐龍重生，許多人會去參觀博物館。

definition_zh: (名) 輪迴；轉世

sentence_zh: 輪迴的概念讓許多在哲學課上的學生著迷。

definition_zh: (名) 輪迴論者；轉世論者

sentence_zh: 古老的輪迴理論讓班上許多學生著迷。

definition_zh: (動) 加強；增援
example_sentence: The teacher used extra exercises to reinforce the grammar rules.
sentence_zh: 老師用額外的練習來加強文法規則。

definition_zh: (名) 增強；補強　(動) 無

sentence_zh: 工程師研究橋樑設計，以對薄弱處提供補強。

definition_zh: (動) 恢復；使復職

sentence_zh: 學校董事會投票恢復受歡迎的課後計畫。

definition_zh: (動) 重新整合；重新融入

sentence_zh: 如果專案失敗，團隊必須重新整合其成員。

definition_zh: (動) [rɪ'dʒɛkt] 拒絕；駁回　(名) ['ridʒɛkt] 被拒之人；廢品
example_sentence: The school committee decided to reject the outdated dress code proposal.
sentence_zh: 校務委員會決定拒絕過時的服裝規定提案。

definition_zh: (名) 拒絕；退回
example_sentence: Submitting a job application often leads to rejection before an interview.
sentence_zh: 提交工作申請往往在面試前就會遭到拒絕。

definition_zh: (動) 歡喜；高興
example_sentence: The whole school rejoiced when the team won the championship.
sentence_zh: 整個學校在球隊贏得冠軍時歡欣鼓舞。

definition_zh: (動) 使恢復活力；使煥然一新
example_sentence: Rejuvenated by the weekend rest, the students returned to school with fresh energy.
sentence_zh: 經過週末休息而恢復活力後，學生們帶著煥然一新的精力回到學校。

definition_zh: (名) 復甦；更新
example_sentence: The garden project that students led brought rejuvenation to the old park.
sentence_zh: 學生主導的花園計畫為舊公園帶來了復甦。

definition_zh: (形) 能引起共鳴的；有共鳴的

sentence_zh: 這本小說的主角對青少年來說非常能引起共鳴。

definition_zh: (動) 與...有關；敘述；建立關係
example_sentence: Relating to others, the student shared his experience in class.
sentence_zh: 與他人建立關係時，這位學生在課堂上分享了他的經驗。

definition_zh: (形) 相關的；有親戚關係的

sentence_zh: 這個與台灣早期移民相關的歷史專題非常引人入勝。

definition_zh: (名) 關係；關聯
example_sentence: The relation between hard work and success is very clear.
sentence_zh: 努力與成功之間的關係非常清楚。

definition_zh: (名) 親戚；親屬　(形) 相對的；比較的
