sentence_zh: 我的阿姨是一位親近的親戚，每個假期都會來拜訪我們。

definition_zh: (副) 相對地；比較地
example_sentence: Compared to other cities, living costs here are relatively low.
sentence_zh: 與其他城市相比，這裡的生活費用相對較低。

definition_zh: (名) 相對論；相對性
example_sentence: Learning about relativity, the student found physics more interesting.
sentence_zh: 學習相對論後，這位學生發現物理更有趣。

definition_zh: (動) 放鬆；休息
example_sentence: Students who finish their exams early can relax in the library.
sentence_zh: 提早考完試的學生可以在圖書館放鬆。

definition_zh: (名) 放鬆；休閒
example_sentence: If students find time for relaxation, their study efficiency improves.
sentence_zh: 如果學生找到時間放鬆，他們的學習效率會提高。

definition_zh: (形) 放鬆的；悠閒的
example_sentence: Seldom have the students felt so relaxed before a major exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們很少在大考前感到如此放鬆。

definition_zh: (形) 放鬆的；令人放鬆的
example_sentence: Taking a relaxing bath after exams helps students reduce stress.
sentence_zh: 考試後泡個放鬆的澡有助於學生減輕壓力。

definition_zh: (動) 傳達；轉發
example_sentence: Relaying the message quickly, the teacher ensured everyone understood.
sentence_zh: 快速傳達訊息後，老師確保每個人都理解了。

definition_zh: (動) 釋放；發布　(名) 釋放；發布
example_sentence: The company plans to release a new smartphone next month.
sentence_zh: 這家公司計劃下個月發布一款新的智慧型手機。

definition_zh: (動) 貶低；使降級
example_sentence: The coach decided to relegate the lazy player to the second team.
sentence_zh: 教練決定將那個懶惰的球員降級到二隊。

definition_zh: (動) 減弱；緩和
example_sentence: The heavy rain will not relent until tomorrow morning.
sentence_zh: 大雨要到明天早上才會緩和。

definition_zh: (形) 持續的；不留情的
example_sentence: The relentless rain caused flooding in many low-lying areas.
sentence_zh: 持續不斷的大雨在許多低窪地區造成淹水。

definition_zh: (副) 不懈地；無情地
example_sentence: The journalist pursued the truth relentlessly despite many obstacles.
sentence_zh: 這位記者不顧重重障礙，堅持不懈地追尋真相。

definition_zh: (名) 相關性；關聯
example_sentence: If the topic lacks relevance to daily life, students may lose interest quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果這個主題與日常生活缺乏關聯，學生可能會很快失去興趣。

definition_zh: (形) 相關的；切題的
example_sentence: Students should select courses relevant to their future careers.
sentence_zh: 學生應選擇與未來職業相關的課程。

definition_zh: (副) 相關地；適切地
example_sentence: Her comment was not relevantly connected to the discussion topic.
sentence_zh: 她的評論與討論主題沒有相關地連結。

definition_zh: (名) 可靠性；信賴度
example_sentence: If the software lacked reliability, users would switch to other apps.
sentence_zh: 如果這個軟體缺乏可靠性，使用者就會轉用其他應用程式。

definition_zh: (形) 可靠的；可信賴的
example_sentence: This bicycle is reliable for commuting to school every day.
sentence_zh: 這輛腳踏車每天通勤上學很可靠。

definition_zh: (副) 可靠地；可信賴地
example_sentence: Reliably, the school bus arrives at the same time every morning.
sentence_zh: 可靠地，校車每天早晨都在同一時間抵達。

definition_zh: (名) 依賴；依靠

sentence_zh: 該公司對單一供應商的嚴重依賴引發了一場危機。

definition_zh: (形) 依賴的；依靠的

sentence_zh: 台灣過度依賴進口能源來滿足其需求。

definition_zh: (名) 遺物；遺跡
example_sentence: The ancient relic in the museum attracts many visitors every day.
sentence_zh: 博物館裡的古代遺物每天吸引許多遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 減輕；解脫
example_sentence: The final exam results brought great relief to the students.
sentence_zh: 期末考成績給學生們帶來了極大的解脫。

definition_zh: (動) 減輕；緩解
example_sentence: Taking a short walk can relieve the stress from studying for exams.
sentence_zh: 短暫散步可以緩解準備考試的壓力。

definition_zh: (形) 感到鬆一口氣的；欣慰的
example_sentence: Having finished the final exam, the students felt relieved.
sentence_zh: 考完期末考後，學生們感到鬆了一口氣。

definition_zh: (名) 宗教；宗教信仰
example_sentence: Many people find peace and comfort in their religion.
sentence_zh: 許多人在他們的宗教信仰中找到平靜與安慰。

definition_zh: (形) 宗教的；虔誠的
example_sentence: The religious festival attracts many visitors every year.
sentence_zh: 這個宗教節日每年吸引許多訪客。

definition_zh: (動) 放棄；交出

sentence_zh: 這支隊伍絕不會不戰而放棄他們的冠軍頭銜。

definition_zh: (名) 樂趣；滋味
example_sentence: The book that the teacher recommended is a relish for the mind.
sentence_zh: 老師推薦的那本書是心靈的樂趣。

definition_zh: (動) 搬遷；重新安置
example_sentence: If our company decided to relocate, many employees would face a difficult choice.
sentence_zh: 如果我們公司決定搬遷，許多員工將面臨一個困難的選擇。

definition_zh: (名) 不情願；勉強

sentence_zh: 儘管她不情願，這位學生還是加入了環保社團的清掃活動。

definition_zh: (形) 不情願的；勉強的

sentence_zh: 許多學生不願意在課堂上提問。

definition_zh: (副) 不情願地；勉強地
example_sentence: Seldom did the student reluctantly accept the group project revision.
sentence_zh: 這個學生很少不情願地接受小組作業的修改。

definition_zh: (片) 依賴；依靠
example_sentence: Students who rely on smartphones for research must check their sources carefully.
sentence_zh: 依賴智慧型手機做研究的學生必須仔細檢查他們的資料來源。

definition_zh: (動) 依賴；信任
example_sentence: Students rely on their teachers to guide them through difficult subjects.
sentence_zh: 學生依賴老師引導他們度過困難科目。

definition_zh: (動) 保持；留下

sentence_zh: 即使雨停了，地面仍然濕了好幾個小時。

definition_zh: (名) 剩餘部分；其餘的人

sentence_zh: 考完試後，班上剩餘的學生檢討了答案。

definition_zh: (形) 剩下的；其餘的
example_sentence: Students saved the remaining snacks for tomorrow's field trip.
sentence_zh: 學生們把剩下的零食留到明天的校外教學。

definition_zh: (動) 保持；遺留　(名) 遺跡；殘餘
example_sentence: If the old temple remains untouched, it will attract more visitors.
sentence_zh: 如果這座古老的寺廟保持原樣，它會吸引更多遊客。

definition_zh: (名) 評論；陳述　(動) 評論；談及
example_sentence: The teacher's remark about the exam surprised everyone in class.
sentence_zh: 老師關於考試的評論讓班上每個人都感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (形) 非凡的；引人注目的
example_sentence: The student's remarkable improvement in math surprised everyone.
sentence_zh: 這位學生在數學上的驚人進步讓每個人都感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (副) 顯著地；非凡地

sentence_zh: 這位學生的考試成績在加入讀書小組後顯著進步。

definition_zh: (動) 重新錄製；重新製作
example_sentence: When the band remastered their old album, fans appreciated the clearer sound.
sentence_zh: 當樂團重新錄製他們的舊專輯時，歌迷們欣賞到了更清晰的聲音。

definition_zh: (名) 補救方法；治療法
example_sentence: If students found a remedy for test anxiety, their scores would improve.
sentence_zh: 如果學生找到解決考試焦慮的方法，他們的成績就會進步。

definition_zh: (動) 記住；記得
example_sentence: The student wrote a note to remember the new vocabulary words.
sentence_zh: 這個學生寫了一張便條來記住新的單字。

definition_zh: (名) 回憶；紀念
example_sentence: The old photograph brought back a sad remembrance of the past.
sentence_zh: 那張舊照片帶回了對過去的悲傷回憶。

definition_zh: (動) 提醒；使想起
example_sentence: This note will remind you to bring your homework tomorrow.
sentence_zh: 這張便條會提醒你明天帶作業。

definition_zh: (名) 提醒；提示

sentence_zh: 老師關於考試的提醒激勵學生更努力學習。

definition_zh: (名) 回憶；懷舊

sentence_zh: 她突然對童年夏天的回憶讓她熱淚盈眶。

definition_zh: (形) 令人想起的；懷舊的
example_sentence: The old classroom was reminiscent of simpler times before exams.
sentence_zh: 這間舊教室讓人想起考試前那段更簡單的時光。

definition_zh: (名) 匯款；寄款

sentence_zh: 這位學生每月收到來自台北父母的匯款。

definition_zh: (名) 殘餘；殘留物

sentence_zh: 走過舊市場時，老師發現了一塊傳統布料的殘餘。

definition_zh: (動) 改造；改建

sentence_zh: 這家人決定改造他們的廚房以提升其功能性。

definition_zh: (名) 懊悔；自責

sentence_zh: 那名學生因考試作弊而感到深深的懊悔。

definition_zh: (形) 懊悔的；悔恨的

sentence_zh: 那名學生在期末考作弊後感到懊悔。

definition_zh: (副) 懊悔地；悔恨地

sentence_zh: 打破窗戶的學生懊悔地看著老師。

sentence_zh: 那座偏遠的村莊沒有網路供學生使用。

sentence_zh: 從教室移除舊家具花了兩個小時。

definition_zh: (動) 移除；脫掉

sentence_zh: 在重新粉刷前去除舊漆是必要的。

definition_zh: (動) 報酬；酬勞

sentence_zh: 許多公司公平地報酬實習生以吸引頂尖人才。

definition_zh: (名) 報酬；酬勞

sentence_zh: 如果公司提供公平的報酬，更多有才華的畢業生就會應徵。

sentence_zh: 很少有兼職工作對高中生來說如此報酬豐厚。

sentence_zh: 在學習文藝復興之後，全班參觀了一間美術館。

sentence_zh: 這座城市的文化復興吸引了許多年輕藝術家。

definition_zh: (動) 使成為；提供

sentence_zh: 當暴風雨來襲時，洪水使得許多道路無法通行。

sentence_zh: 雖然損害看起來很嚴重，但這段友誼透過誠實溝通還是可以修補的。

sentence_zh: 知道廣泛的曲目，合唱團給評審留下了深刻印象。

sentence_zh: 學生們從未見過如此豐富的劇目庫。

definition_zh: (名) 重複；反覆

sentence_zh: 如果這種重複繼續下去，老師會注意到同樣的錯誤。

sentence_zh: 重複的作業很少幫助學生學習。

sentence_zh: 學校計畫下個月用新電腦替換舊電腦。

definition_zh: (名) 替代品；更換

sentence_zh: 老師很快找到了壞掉投影機的替代品。

definition_zh: (動) 重播；重放

sentence_zh: 比賽結束後，教練決定重播最後一分鐘。

sentence_zh: 這間圖書館資源豐富，吸引了許多學生。

definition_zh: (名) 複製品；拷貝

sentence_zh: 博物館展示了一件完美複製的古花瓶。

definition_zh: (動) 複製；重複
example_sentence: The experiment that the students tried to replicate failed completely.
sentence_zh: 學生們試圖重複的實驗完全失敗了。

definition_zh: (動) 回答；回覆

sentence_zh: 老師要求全班在星期五之前回覆那封電子郵件。

definition_zh: (名) 報告；報導　(動) 報告；舉報
example_sentence: Seldom does the school report such a high level of student satisfaction.
sentence_zh: 學校很少報告如此高的學生滿意度。

sentence_zh: 這位學生關於當地環境問題的報導贏得了第一名。

sentence_zh: 這位知名歌手據報導因生病取消了演唱會。

sentence_zh: 那位正在寫文章的記者問了許多問題。

definition_zh: (動) 報導；報告

sentence_zh: 學生團隊練習報導校園新聞，以提升他們的新聞技巧。

sentence_zh: 如果學校有數位儲存庫，學生會更容易找到資源。

sentence_zh: 學生會會長將代表我們班參加學校會議。

definition_zh: (名) 代表；呈現；描述

sentence_zh: 那位學生對數據的呈現清晰且準確。

sentence_zh: 學生代表在會議中分享她的想法。

sentence_zh: 壓抑住怒氣，這位學生冷靜地與老師討論不公平的分數。

definition_zh: (名) 壓制；壓抑

sentence_zh: 政府對抗議的壓制很少能帶來持久的和平。

definition_zh: (形) 壓制的；高壓的

sentence_zh: 這個高壓的政府限制了該國的言論自由。

definition_zh: (名) 責備；指責　(動) 責備；指責

sentence_zh: 老師的責備讓學生為了下次考試更努力念書。

definition_zh: (動) 複製；繁殖

sentence_zh: 細胞必須自我複製以保持身體健康。

definition_zh: (名) 複製品；繁殖

sentence_zh: 當博物館展示這件複製品時，許多學生讚賞它的細節。

definition_zh: (名) 爬蟲類動物
example_sentence: Observing a reptile in the wild, the biology class learned about its cold-blooded nature.
sentence_zh: 在野外觀察爬蟲類動物時，生物課學到了牠們的冷血特性。

definition_zh: (形) 共和國的；共和黨的　(名) 共和黨員

sentence_zh: 共和黨候選人就稅改發表了演說。

definition_zh: (名) 共和國；共和政體

sentence_zh: 共和國是一種公民選舉其領導人的政府形式。

definition_zh: (動) 否認；拒絕接受

sentence_zh: 這位學生決定否認關於他同學的虛假謠言。

definition_zh: (形) 令人反感的；排斥的
example_sentence: The idea of eating insects is repulsive to many students.
sentence_zh: 吃昆蟲的想法對許多學生來說是令人反感的。

definition_zh: (動) 重新利用；改變用途

sentence_zh: 學生們將舊寶特瓶重新利用，製成了花盆。

definition_zh: (形) 聲譽好的；可信賴的

sentence_zh: 因為這家公司信譽良好，許多學生申請那裡的實習。

definition_zh: (名) 名聲；聲譽
example_sentence: A good reputation takes years to build but seconds to destroy.
sentence_zh: 好的名聲需要多年建立，卻能在幾秒內摧毀。

definition_zh: (名) 名聲；聲望
example_sentence: The scientist of high repute won the national award last year.
sentence_zh: 那位聲望很高的科學家去年贏得了國家獎項。

definition_zh: (副) 據說；一般認為
example_sentence: Seldom is this reputedly haunted mansion visited by locals.
sentence_zh: 這棟據說鬧鬼的豪宅很少有當地人拜訪。

definition_zh: (名) 請求；要求　(動) 請求；要求
example_sentence: The student made a polite request to the teacher for more time.
sentence_zh: 那名學生向老師提出一個禮貌的請求，希望能有更多時間。

definition_zh: (動) 要求；需要

sentence_zh: 這門課要求學生完成一個小組專題。

definition_zh: (名) 要求；必要條件

sentence_zh: 學校對所有學生有一項新要求。

definition_zh: (形) 必要的；必備的

sentence_zh: 缺乏必備技能的學生通常在進階課程中感到吃力。

definition_zh: (名) 正式申請；徵用　(動) 正式要求；徵用

sentence_zh: 學校對新電腦的申請被校長批准了。

definition_zh: (動) 撤銷；廢除

sentence_zh: 校務委員會在學生抗議後決定撤銷這項新規定。

sentence_zh: 如果登山客迷路，救援隊會搜索他們。

definition_zh: (名) 研究；調查　(動) 研究；調查
example_sentence: The student conducted research on local water pollution.
sentence_zh: 這位學生針對當地水污染進行了研究。

definition_zh: (名) 研究員；研究者

sentence_zh: 這位年輕的研究員用顯微鏡來研究微小的細胞。

definition_zh: (動) 類似；像

sentence_zh: 新的圖書館大樓像一本巨大的書。

definition_zh: (動) 怨恨；厭惡

sentence_zh: 有些學生怨恨週末還得做額外的家庭作業。

definition_zh: (形) 憤恨的；不滿的

sentence_zh: 如果學生對過多的作業感到不滿，他們的成績可能會下降。

definition_zh: (名) 怨恨；不滿

sentence_zh: 這位學生對嚴格規定的怨恨隨著時間增長。

definition_zh: (名) 預訂；保留

sentence_zh: 那位學生在圖書館預訂了自習室。

definition_zh: (動) 預訂；保留　(名) 儲備；保留區

sentence_zh: 提前預訂了桌子，這家人一起享受了一頓輕鬆的晚餐。

definition_zh: (形) 預訂的；保留的；矜持的

sentence_zh: 即使那個座位已經被預訂，那位學生還是坐在那裡。

definition_zh: (名) 水庫；儲藏所

sentence_zh: 為這座城市儲存水的水庫幾乎是空的。

definition_zh: (動) 居住；存在

sentence_zh: 住在那棟老房子裡的那家人是我的鄰居。

definition_zh: (名) 住所；居住

sentence_zh: 住在宿舍時，這位學生比較喜歡校園附近安靜的住所。

sentence_zh: 這個社區的每位居民都必須遵守回收規則。

definition_zh: (形) 住宅的；住宿的

sentence_zh: 許多學生選擇住宿學院以求更好的學習環境。

sentence_zh: 颱風的殘餘影響導致學校停課三天。

definition_zh: (動) 逆轉；倒車　(名) 相反；背面　(形) 相反的；背面的
example_sentence: The new policy may reverse the trend of pollution in the city.
sentence_zh: 這項新政策可能會逆轉城市中的污染趨勢。

definition_zh: (形) 可逆的；可翻轉的
example_sentence: Made from recycled plastic, this reversible jacket is perfect for hiking.
sentence_zh: 這件由回收塑膠製成的可雙面穿夾克非常適合登山。

definition_zh: (動) 恢復；回到（原狀）
example_sentence: The editor advised the writer not to revert to the original version.
sentence_zh: 編輯建議作者不要恢復到原始版本。

definition_zh: (動) 複習；檢討　(名) 複習；評論
example_sentence: Before the final exam, students should review their notes carefully.
sentence_zh: 期末考前，學生應該仔細複習他們的筆記。

definition_zh: (動) 修訂；修改
example_sentence: The student needs to revise her essay before the deadline.
sentence_zh: 這位學生需要在截止日前修改她的文章。

definition_zh: (名) 複習；修訂
example_sentence: Students do revision before exams to improve their grades.
sentence_zh: 學生們在考試前複習以提升成績。

definition_zh: (名) 復興；振興
example_sentence: The government launched a project for the revitalization of old neighborhoods.
sentence_zh: 政府啟動了一個計畫，旨在復興老舊社區。

definition_zh: (動) 使復興；使恢復活力
example_sentence: The plan that the city proposed will revitalize the old market.
sentence_zh: 市政府提出的計畫將復興舊市場。

definition_zh: (名) 復興；復活
example_sentence: The revival of traditional crafts has attracted many young people in Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 傳統工藝的復興吸引了台灣許多年輕人。

definition_zh: (動) 復甦；重新振作
example_sentence: After the long break, the student council tried to revive school spirit.
sentence_zh: 長假過後，學生會試圖重振校園精神。

definition_zh: (形) 可撤銷的；可廢除的
example_sentence: This contract is revocable within the first three days.
sentence_zh: 這份合約在頭三天內是可以撤銷的。

definition_zh: (名) 反抗；叛亂　(動) 反抗；叛亂
example_sentence: The students' revolt against the new uniform policy surprised the teachers.
sentence_zh: 學生們對新制服政策的反抗讓老師們感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (形) 令人作嘔的；令人厭惡的
example_sentence: If the food tastes revolting, the cafeteria should replace it immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果食物嚐起來令人作嘔，自助餐廳應該立即更換。

definition_zh: (名) 革命；變革
example_sentence: The Industrial Revolution changed how people worked and lived.
sentence_zh: 工業革命改變了人們工作和生活的方式。

definition_zh: (形) 革命性的；創新的
example_sentence: Students studied the revolutionary ideas of the inventor for their science report.
sentence_zh: 學生們為了科學報告研究了這位發明家的革命性理念。

definition_zh: (動) 徹底改革；革新
example_sentence: Revolutionizing communication, the smartphone has changed daily life.
sentence_zh: 革新了通訊方式，智慧型手機改變了日常生活。

definition_zh: (動) 旋轉；繞行；以…為中心
example_sentence: The Earth revolves around the Sun once every year.
sentence_zh: 地球每年繞太陽公轉一次。

definition_zh: (形) 旋轉的
example_sentence: The revolving door at the bank entrance is always busy.
sentence_zh: 銀行入口的旋轉門總是很忙碌。

definition_zh: (名) 獎勵；報酬　(動) 獎賞；酬謝
example_sentence: The school offered a reward for the best science project.
sentence_zh: 學校為最佳科學專題提供了一項獎勵。

definition_zh: (形) 有報酬的；有意義的；值得的
example_sentence: Volunteering at the animal shelter is a rewarding experience for students.
sentence_zh: 在動物收容所做志工對學生來說是一種有收穫的經驗。

definition_zh: (動) 重寫；改寫
example_sentence: Before submitting the essay, the student had to rewrite the conclusion.
sentence_zh: 在提交論文之前，學生必須重寫結論。

definition_zh: (名) 修辭；言辭；花言巧語
example_sentence: The politician's rhetoric about equality failed to convince many students.
sentence_zh: 這位政客關於平等的言辭未能說服許多學生。

definition_zh: (形) 修辭的；修辭學的
example_sentence: If the politician used rhetorical questions, the audience would feel more engaged.
sentence_zh: 如果那位政治人物使用修辭問句，聽眾會覺得更投入。

definition_zh: (名) 類風濕性關節炎
example_sentence: Rheumatoid arthritis causes joint pain and stiffness in many patients.
sentence_zh: 類風濕性關節炎在許多患者身上引起關節疼痛和僵硬。

definition_zh: (名) 犀牛
example_sentence: If a rhinoceros charges at you, find a tree to hide behind.
sentence_zh: 如果犀牛朝你衝過來，找一棵樹躲在後面。

definition_zh: (名) 杜鵑花
example_sentence: If the rhododendron gets enough sunlight, it will bloom beautifully.
sentence_zh: 如果杜鵑花獲得足夠的陽光，它就會美麗地綻放。

definition_zh: (名) 菱形
example_sentence: If the rhombus has equal sides, its area is easy to calculate.
sentence_zh: 如果菱形有相等的邊，它的面積就容易計算。

definition_zh: (動) 押韻　(名) 韻；押韻詞
example_sentence: The poet tried to make each line of the poem rhyme perfectly.
sentence_zh: 這位詩人試著讓詩的每一行都完美押韻。

definition_zh: (名) 節奏；韻律
example_sentence: Learning to dance requires a good sense of rhythm.
sentence_zh: 學跳舞需要良好的節奏感。

definition_zh: (形) 有節奏的；節奏的
example_sentence: If the music has a rhythmic beat, more students will dance at the party.
sentence_zh: 如果音樂有節奏感，更多學生會在派對上跳舞。

definition_zh: (名) 肋骨
example_sentence: Finding a broken rib, the doctor ordered an X-ray immediately.
sentence_zh: 發現一根斷裂的肋骨，醫生立即安排了X光檢查。

definition_zh: (名) 緞帶；絲帶
example_sentence: The girl tied a red ribbon around her birthday gift.
sentence_zh: 那個女孩在她的生日禮物上繫了一條紅色緞帶。

definition_zh: (名) 米糠
example_sentence: The rice bran that the bakery uses is rich in fiber.
sentence_zh: 那家麵包店使用的米糠富含纖維。

definition_zh: (名) 米；稻米
example_sentence: Not only does rice grow well in Taiwan, but it also supports local farmers.
sentence_zh: 稻米不僅在台灣生長良好，也支持了當地農民。

definition_zh: (形) 富裕的；豐富的；肥沃的
example_sentence: If this soil were richer, the farmer would grow more vegetables.
sentence_zh: 如果這片土壤更肥沃，農夫就能種更多蔬菜。

definition_zh: (名) 財富；豐富
example_sentence: Seeking only material riches, the young man ignored his family's advice.
sentence_zh: 只追求物質財富，這個年輕人忽略了家人的建議。

definition_zh: (名) 豐富；豐饒
example_sentence: The richness of the local culture attracts many students to study it.
sentence_zh: 當地文化的豐富性吸引許多學生去研究它。

definition_zh: (形) 搖晃的；不穩固的
example_sentence: If the rickety bridge collapsed, many students would be late for school.
sentence_zh: 如果那座搖搖欲墜的橋倒塌了，許多學生上學就會遲到。

definition_zh: (動) 使擺脫；消除
example_sentence: The students who want to rid their school of waste started a recycling program.
sentence_zh: 想要消除學校垃圾的學生們啟動了一個回收計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 謎；謎語
example_sentence: The riddle that the teacher gave us was very hard to solve.
sentence_zh: 老師給我們的謎語非常難解。

definition_zh: (片) 騎車離開；騎走
example_sentence: The cyclist decided to ride away from the crowded city park.
sentence_zh: 那位自行車騎士決定騎車離開擁擠的城市公園。

definition_zh: (片) 騎乘；搭乘
example_sentence: Many students ride on the MRT to get to school quickly.
sentence_zh: 許多學生搭乘捷運快速到校。

definition_zh: (片) 安然度過；挺過
example_sentence: The old house managed to ride out the powerful typhoon last night.
sentence_zh: 這棟老房子昨晚成功度過了強勁的颱風。

definition_zh: (片) 騎車前往；騎上去
example_sentence: Students often ride up to school to save time on crowded buses.
sentence_zh: 學生們常常騎車上學，以節省在擁擠公車上的時間。

definition_zh: (動) 騎；乘坐　(名) 騎乘；搭乘
example_sentence: Riding a bike to school saves time and money.
sentence_zh: 騎腳踏車上學省時又省錢。

definition_zh: (名) 騎車者；騎士
example_sentence: The motorcyclist slowed down to let the rider cross the street safely.
sentence_zh: 機車騎士減速，讓騎車者安全過馬路。

definition_zh: (名) 山脊；屋脊
example_sentence: Walking along the mountain ridge, the hiker enjoyed a stunning sunset.
sentence_zh: 沿著山脊行走，這名徒步旅行者享受了壯麗的日落。

definition_zh: (名) 嘲笑；奚落　(動) 嘲笑；奚落
example_sentence: The student's strange question became the target of ridicule in class.
sentence_zh: 那位學生的奇怪問題成了課堂上嘲笑的對象。

definition_zh: (名) 步槍；來福槍
example_sentence: The soldier cleaned his rifle after the training exercise.
sentence_zh: 士兵在訓練演習後清潔了他的步槍。

definition_zh: (名) 裂縫；分歧
example_sentence: Because of a growing rift, the student council failed to agree on the budget.
sentence_zh: 由於日益嚴重的分歧，學生會未能就預算達成共識。

definition_zh: (動) 操縱；裝配
example_sentence: Seldom does the team rig the game to ensure a victory.
sentence_zh: 這個團隊很少為了確保勝利而操縱比賽。

definition_zh: (動) 操縱；舞弊　(名) 索具；裝備
example_sentence: The student who was accused of rigging the election faced serious consequences.
sentence_zh: 那個被指控操縱選舉的學生面臨了嚴重的後果。

definition_zh: (名) 右翼；右派
example_sentence: Believing in traditional values, the right wing politician opposed the new policy.
sentence_zh: 由於相信傳統價值，這位右翼政治家反對這項新政策。

definition_zh: (形) 右手的；得力的
example_sentence: Having used his right-hand tool, the mechanic finished the repair quickly.
sentence_zh: 使用了他的右手工具後，技師很快完成了修理。

definition_zh: (形) 右翼的
example_sentence: Although many students disagree, the right-wing group holds traditional values.
sentence_zh: 雖然許多學生不同意，但這個右翼團體堅持傳統價值觀。

definition_zh: (名) 權利；右邊　(形) 對的；正確的　(副) 直接地；正好
example_sentence: Students have the right to express their opinions in class.
sentence_zh: 學生有權利在課堂上表達他們的意見。

definition_zh: (形) 正直的；正義的
example_sentence: A righteous judge always makes fair decisions in court.
sentence_zh: 一位正直的法官總是在法庭上做出公平的判決。

definition_zh: (副) 正直地；正義地
example_sentence: If students act righteously, their teachers will respect them more.
sentence_zh: 如果學生行事正直，他們的老師會更尊重他們。

definition_zh: (名) 正義；公正
example_sentence: Believing in righteousness, the community worked together to help the homeless.
sentence_zh: 相信正義，社區共同努力幫助無家可歸的人。

definition_zh: (形) 合法的；正當的
example_sentence: The rightful winner of the competition received a standing ovation.
sentence_zh: 這場比賽的合法獲勝者獲得了起立鼓掌。

definition_zh: (副) 理所當然地；正當地
example_sentence: The prize rightfully belongs to the student who worked hardest.
sentence_zh: 這個獎項理所當然屬於那位最努力的學生。

definition_zh: (副) 正確地；理所當然地
example_sentence: The teacher rightly praised the student for his hard work.
sentence_zh: 老師正確地稱讚了這位學生努力學習。

definition_zh: (形) 嚴格的；僵硬的
example_sentence: The school's rigid rules on uniforms upset many students.
sentence_zh: 學校對制服的嚴格規定讓許多學生感到不滿。

definition_zh: (副) 嚴格地；死板地
example_sentence: The school rules were rigidly enforced by the principal.
sentence_zh: 學校的規定被校長嚴格執行。

definition_zh: (名) 嚴格；嚴謹；艱苦
example_sentence: The academic rigor of this course challenges many high school students.
sentence_zh: 這門課程的學術嚴謹性挑戰了許多高中生。

definition_zh: (形) 嚴格的；嚴謹的
example_sentence: The rigorous training program prepared the athletes for the competition.
sentence_zh: 嚴格的訓練計畫讓運動員為比賽做好準備。

definition_zh: (副) 嚴格地；嚴謹地
example_sentence: The school rigorously enforces the no-phone rule during exams.
sentence_zh: 學校在考試期間嚴格執行禁止使用手機的規定。

definition_zh: (名) 邊緣；輪緣
example_sentence: The rim of the cup is chipped from constant use.
sentence_zh: 杯子的邊緣因長期使用而缺了一角。

definition_zh: (片) 回電話
example_sentence: If my friend calls after class, I will ring back later.
sentence_zh: 如果我朋友下課後打電話來，我會稍後回電。

definition_zh: (片) 迎接；敲鐘慶祝
example_sentence: Many students ring in the new year with fireworks and snacks.
sentence_zh: 許多學生用煙火和點心來迎接新年。

definition_zh: (片) 響個不停
example_sentence: Seldom did the phone ring off during the exam.
sentence_zh: 考試期間電話很少響個不停。

definition_zh: (片) 響起；發出響亮的聲音
example_sentence: The bell that rings out every morning signals the start of school.
sentence_zh: 每天早上響起的鐘聲標誌著學校的開始。

definition_zh: (片) 四處響起；傳遍
example_sentence: When the bell rings round the school, students rush to their next class.
sentence_zh: 當鈴聲在校園中響起，學生們衝向下一堂課。

definition_zh: (片) 結帳；記錄
example_sentence: The cashier will ring up your items at the counter.
sentence_zh: 收銀員會在櫃檯結算你的商品。

definition_zh: (片) 迴盪著；充滿（聲音）
example_sentence: Having rung with laughter, the classroom felt warm and welcoming.
sentence_zh: 教室裡迴盪著笑聲，感覺溫馨又令人愉快。

definition_zh: (名) 戒指；環狀物　(動) 按鈴；打電話
example_sentence: Her gold ring sparkled under the bright classroom lights.
sentence_zh: 她的金戒指在明亮的教室燈光下閃閃發光。

definition_zh: (名) 溜冰場；溜冰場
example_sentence: The new ice rink in the city center attracts many young skaters.
sentence_zh: 市中心的新溜冰場吸引了許多年輕溜冰者。

definition_zh: (動) 沖洗；漂洗
example_sentence: The chef rinses the vegetables thoroughly to remove any dirt.
sentence_zh: 廚師徹底沖洗蔬菜以去除任何污垢。

definition_zh: (名) 暴動；騷亂
example_sentence: The riot in the city center caused many shops to close early.
sentence_zh: 市中心的暴動導致許多商店提早關門。

definition_zh: (形) 喧鬧的；暴動的
example_sentence: The principal warned that riotous behavior would not be tolerated at the school assembly.
sentence_zh: 校長警告說，學校集會中不會容忍喧鬧的行為。

definition_zh: (片) 敲竹槓；欺騙；剝削
example_sentence: Before buying a souvenir, tourists should check the price to avoid being ripped off.
sentence_zh: 在購買紀念品前，遊客應先檢查價格以免被敲竹槓。

definition_zh: (動) 撕；撕裂　(名) 裂口；撕裂處
example_sentence: Never rip the poster off the wall without permission.
sentence_zh: 未經允許，絕不要撕下牆上的海報。

definition_zh: (形) 河岸的；水邊的
example_sentence: The riparian zone along the river supports many unique plant species.
sentence_zh: 沿河的河岸區域支持了許多獨特的植物物種。

definition_zh: (形) 成熟的
example_sentence: The fruit on the tree is ripe enough to eat.
sentence_zh: 樹上的水果已經熟到可以吃了。

definition_zh: (動) 成熟
example_sentence: The fruit left on the counter will ripen quickly in the warm weather.
sentence_zh: 放在櫃檯上的水果在溫暖天氣中會很快成熟。

definition_zh: (名) 漣漪；波紋　(動) 起漣漪；擴散
example_sentence: Having seen the ripple in the pond, the student paused to watch.
sentence_zh: 看到池塘裡的漣漪，那位學生停下來觀看。

definition_zh: (片) 克服；超越
example_sentence: To rise above peer pressure, students must build strong self-confidence.
sentence_zh: 為了超越同儕壓力，學生必須建立強大的自信心。

definition_zh: (片) 站起來；起立
example_sentence: The student who heard the good news rose to his feet quickly.
sentence_zh: 聽到好消息的學生迅速站了起來。

definition_zh: (片) 起義；反抗；站出來
example_sentence: Many citizens rise up to demand fair treatment from the government.
sentence_zh: 許多市民站出來要求政府公平對待。

definition_zh: (動) 上升；起床
example_sentence: Students rise early to study for the big exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們早起是為了準備大考。

definition_zh: (動) 上升；增加；(形) 新興的；升起的
example_sentence: Rising early every day, the student improved his exam scores.
sentence_zh: 每天早起，這位學生提高了他的考試成績。

definition_zh: (片) 冒生命危險
example_sentence: Having risked life and limb to save the hiker, the firefighter received a medal.
sentence_zh: 冒著生命危險救了那名登山客後，消防員獲得了一枚獎章。

definition_zh: (名) 風險；危險　(動) 冒⋯⋯的風險
example_sentence: Driving a scooter without a helmet is a serious risk.
sentence_zh: 不戴安全帽騎機車是嚴重的風險。

definition_zh: (形) 危險的；有風險的
example_sentence: Students who take risky shortcuts often face serious consequences.
sentence_zh: 走危險捷徑的學生常常面臨嚴重的後果。

definition_zh: (名) 儀式；典禮
example_sentence: Before the graduation ceremony, the school performed a traditional rite.
sentence_zh: 在畢業典禮之前，學校舉行了一項傳統儀式。

definition_zh: (名) 儀式；例行公事　(形) 儀式的；例行公事的
example_sentence: Performing the morning ritual, the student felt ready for the school day.
sentence_zh: 進行早晨的例行儀式後，這位學生感覺準備好迎接學校的一天。

definition_zh: (名) 競爭者；對手　(動) 與…匹敵；競爭
example_sentence: If a rival team cheated, our school would lose the championship.
sentence_zh: 如果對手隊伍作弊，我們學校就會失去冠軍。

definition_zh: (名) 競爭；對抗
example_sentence: The friendly rivalry between the two classes pushed everyone to study harder.
sentence_zh: 兩個班級之間友好的競爭促使每個人更加努力學習。

definition_zh: (名) 河流
example_sentence: The river that flows through the city is very clean now.
sentence_zh: 流經這座城市的河流現在非常乾淨。

definition_zh: (動) 吸引；使專注
example_sentence: The audience riveted their eyes on the speaker to understand every word.
sentence_zh: 觀眾們為了理解每一個字而將目光緊盯在演講者身上。

definition_zh: (形) 引人入勝的；極有趣的
example_sentence: Students read the riveting novel to understand its deeper themes.
sentence_zh: 學生們閱讀這本引人入勝的小說，以理解其更深層的主題。

definition_zh: (名) 蟑螂
example_sentence: A roach crawled across the kitchen floor last night.
sentence_zh: 一隻蟑螂昨晚爬過了廚房地板。

definition_zh: (名) 路；道路
example_sentence: The road to the library is very long and busy.
sentence_zh: 通往圖書館的路又長又繁忙。

definition_zh: (名) 路邊
example_sentence: The roadside stall that sells bubble tea is always crowded.
sentence_zh: 那個賣珍珠奶茶的路邊攤總是很擁擠。

definition_zh: (動) 吼叫；歡呼
example_sentence: The crowd began to roar when the team scored the winning goal.
sentence_zh: 當球隊踢進致勝球時，群眾開始大聲歡呼。

definition_zh: (動) 烤；烘烤　(名) 烤肉
example_sentence: My mother likes to roast chicken for Sunday dinner.
sentence_zh: 我母親喜歡在週日晚餐烤雞。

definition_zh: (動) 搶劫；盜取
example_sentence: The thief tried to rob the bank during the night.
sentence_zh: 小偷試圖在夜間搶劫銀行。

definition_zh: (名) 強盜；搶匪
example_sentence: The robber who stole the money was caught by the police.
sentence_zh: 那個偷錢的強盜被警察抓住了。

definition_zh: (名) 搶劫；搶奪案
example_sentence: The recent robbery at the convenience store shocked the whole neighborhood.
sentence_zh: 最近便利商店的搶劫案震驚了整個社區。

definition_zh: (名) 長袍；浴袍
example_sentence: The student who wore a white robe graduated with honors.
sentence_zh: 那位穿著白色長袍的學生以優異成績畢業了。

definition_zh: (名) 知更鳥
example_sentence: A robin built a nest in the tree near the school.
sentence_zh: 一隻知更鳥在學校附近的樹上築了巢。

definition_zh: (名) 機器人
example_sentence: After the robot finished cleaning the floor, it turned off automatically.
sentence_zh: 機器人掃完地板後，會自動關閉。

definition_zh: (形) 強健的；堅固的
example_sentence: Having a robust immune system helps students avoid catching colds easily.
sentence_zh: 擁有強健的免疫系統有助於學生避免輕易感冒。

definition_zh: (片) 不請自來；突然出現
example_sentence: When the guests rock up late, the host feels frustrated.
sentence_zh: 當客人姍姍來遲時，主人會感到沮喪。

definition_zh: (名) 岩石；石頭　(動) 搖動；使搖晃
example_sentence: If the rock falls from the cliff, the hiker will be in danger.
sentence_zh: 如果那顆石頭從懸崖上掉下來，登山者就會有危險。

definition_zh: (名) 火箭　(動) 迅速增加；發射
example_sentence: The rocket launched successfully from the space center last night.
sentence_zh: 火箭昨晚從太空中心成功發射。

definition_zh: (形) 岩石多的；崎嶇的；困難重重的
example_sentence: Walking along the rocky path, the hiker lost his balance.
sentence_zh: 沿著崎嶇的小徑行走時，那位徒步者失去了平衡。

definition_zh: (名) 棒；桿
example_sentence: Students use a metal rod to open the stuck window.
sentence_zh: 學生們用一根金屬棒撬開卡住的窗戶。

definition_zh: (名) 囓齒動物
example_sentence: If a rodent enters the kitchen, the trap will catch it.
sentence_zh: 如果一隻囓齒動物進入廚房，捕鼠器會抓住牠。

definition_zh: (形) 兇猛的；異常的；(名) 流氓；惡棍
example_sentence: The rogue wave surprised everyone on the beach last summer.
sentence_zh: 那波 rogue 海浪去年夏天讓沙灘上的每個人都大吃一驚。

definition_zh: (動) 攪亂；使混濁
example_sentence: Having roiled the calm discussion, the student quickly apologized.
sentence_zh: 攪亂了平靜的討論後，那位學生迅速道歉。

definition_zh: (形) 翻騰的；洶湧的
example_sentence: The roiling storm forced students to stay inside the classroom.
sentence_zh: 翻騰的暴風雨迫使學生們待在教室內。

definition_zh: (名) 角色；作用
example_sentence: The role of a teacher is to guide students in learning.
sentence_zh: 老師的角色是引導學生學習。

definition_zh: (片) 撤銷；減少
example_sentence: Seldom does the government roll back environmental regulations.
sentence_zh: 政府很少撤銷環境法規。

definition_zh: (片) 流逝；過去
example_sentence: The days roll by quickly during winter vacation.
sentence_zh: 寒假期間，日子過得很快。

definition_zh: (片) 滾落；滾下
example_sentence: Only after the storm did the leaves roll down the street.
sentence_zh: 暴風雨過後，樹葉才沿著街道滾落下來。

definition_zh: (片) 滾進；湧入；大量到來
example_sentence: The homework assignments continue to roll in as the exam week approaches.
sentence_zh: 隨著考試週的到來，作業持續湧入。

definition_zh: (片) 滾落；滾離
example_sentence: The student who saw the pen roll off the desk was surprised.
sentence_zh: 看到筆滾下桌子的學生感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (片) 繼續進行；滾動
example_sentence: The team's hard work will roll on until the project is finished.
sentence_zh: 團隊的努力將會持續進行直到專案完成。

definition_zh: (片) 推出；展開
example_sentence: The company that plans to roll out a new app is hiring students.
sentence_zh: 那家計劃推出新應用程式的公司正在招募學生。

definition_zh: (片) 捲起袖子（準備工作或努力）
example_sentence: The team leader decided to roll up his sleeves and help with the project.
sentence_zh: 組長決定捲起袖子幫忙這個專案。

definition_zh: (片) 捲起；到達
example_sentence: Rolling up his sleeves, Tom began cleaning the messy classroom.
sentence_zh: 湯姆捲起袖子，開始清理凌亂的教室。

definition_zh: (動) 滾動；翻滾
example_sentence: If the ball rolled off the table, the dog would chase it.
sentence_zh: 如果球滾下桌子，狗會追它。

definition_zh: (名) 雲霄飛車；情緒的起伏
example_sentence: The roller coaster ride gave everyone an unforgettable thrill.
sentence_zh: 雲霄飛車的乘坐體驗給了每個人難忘的刺激。

definition_zh: (名) 滾筒；滾軸；雲霄飛車
example_sentence: If the roller coaster breaks down, the park staff will assist everyone.
sentence_zh: 如果雲霄飛車故障，園區工作人員會協助所有人。

definition_zh: (名) 浪漫；愛情故事　(動) 追求；談戀愛
example_sentence: Not only did the novel explore romance, but it also examined social class.
sentence_zh: 這部小說不僅探討了浪漫愛情，還審視了社會階級。

definition_zh: (形) 浪漫的；多情的
example_sentence: Seldom has a movie been as romantic as this one.
sentence_zh: 很少有一部電影像這部一樣浪漫。

definition_zh: (副) 浪漫地；愛情地
example_sentence: The movie ended romantically with a sunset kiss on the beach.
sentence_zh: 這部電影以沙灘上的夕陽之吻浪漫地結束。

definition_zh: (片) 嬉鬧；玩耍
example_sentence: The puppy that loves to romp in the garden is always happy.
sentence_zh: 那隻喜歡在花園裡嬉鬧的小狗總是很開心。

definition_zh: (片) 輕鬆完成；輕易通過
example_sentence: The talented pianist could romp through the difficult piece effortlessly.
sentence_zh: 這位才華洋溢的鋼琴家可以輕鬆地彈完這首困難的曲子。

definition_zh: (名) 嬉鬧；玩耍　(動) 嬉戲；玩鬧
example_sentence: The little dog went for a romp in the park after the rain stopped.
sentence_zh: 雨停後，小狗在公園裡嬉鬧玩耍。

definition_zh: (名) 屋頂；車頂
example_sentence: The old roof that leaks during heavy rain needs repair.
sentence_zh: 那在下大雨時會漏水的舊屋頂需要修理。

definition_zh: (片) 有空間；有餘地
example_sentence: The crowded bus had no room in the aisle for more passengers.
sentence_zh: 擁擠的公車在走道上沒有空間容納更多乘客。

definition_zh: (名) 空間；房間
example_sentence: Feeling cramped, the students asked for more room to study.
sentence_zh: 感到擁擠，學生們要求更多空間來讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 室友
example_sentence: Having found a messy roommate, David moved out of the dormitory.
sentence_zh: 發現室友很邋遢後，大衛搬出了宿舍。

definition_zh: (形) 寬敞的；寬大的
example_sentence: Students chose a roomy backpack to carry all their textbooks.
sentence_zh: 學生們選擇一個寬敞的背包來攜帶他們所有的教科書。

definition_zh: (名) 公雞；雄雞
example_sentence: Seldom does a rooster crow so loudly at midnight.
sentence_zh: 公雞很少在半夜這麼大聲啼叫。

definition_zh: (片) 翻找；搜尋
example_sentence: The curious student rooted about in the old library for ancient maps.
sentence_zh: 這位好奇的學生在舊圖書館裡翻找古老的地圖。

definition_zh: (片) 根除；杜絕
example_sentence: The school decided to root out cheating during exams.
sentence_zh: 學校決定根除考試中的作弊行為。

definition_zh: (片) 連根拔起；根除
example_sentence: Before planting new flowers, the gardener had to root up the old weeds.
sentence_zh: 在種植新花之前，園丁必須把舊雜草連根拔起。

definition_zh: (名) 根；根源　(動) 紮根；起源於
example_sentence: The root of this tree grows deep into the soil.
sentence_zh: 這棵樹的根深深長入土壤中。

definition_zh: (片) 拉攏；說服…加入
example_sentence: The teacher tried to rope in a few students to help organize the event.
sentence_zh: 老師試圖拉攏幾名學生來幫忙組織活動。

definition_zh: (片) 說服（某人）參與；拉攏
example_sentence: Roped into organizing the school festival, Amy felt overwhelmed by the tasks.
sentence_zh: 被拉去組織學校園遊會，艾咪被這些任務壓得喘不過氣。

definition_zh: (片) 用繩子圍起；封鎖
example_sentence: The school had to rope off the parking lot for the sports day.
sentence_zh: 學校為了運動會不得不將停車場用繩子圍起來。

definition_zh: (名) 繩子；索　(動) 用繩子捆綁
example_sentence: The students used a thick rope to pull the heavy box up the stairs.
sentence_zh: 學生們用一條粗繩子將重箱子拉上樓梯。

definition_zh: (名) 玫瑰；薔薇
example_sentence: Seeing the beautiful rose, the girl smiled with joy.
sentence_zh: 看到那朵美麗的玫瑰，女孩高興地笑了。

definition_zh: (名) 迷迭香
example_sentence: Having dried the rosemary from her garden, Mia added it to the soup.
sentence_zh: 把從花園裡採收的迷迭香曬乾後，米亞把它加進湯裡。

definition_zh: (動) 腐爛；敗壞
example_sentence: If the fruit started to rot, the farmer would throw it away.
sentence_zh: 如果水果開始腐爛，農夫就會把它扔掉。

definition_zh: (形) 旋轉的；(名) 扶輪社
example_sentence: Students who join the rotary club often volunteer for community service.
sentence_zh: 加入扶輪社的學生經常為社區服務擔任志工。

definition_zh: (動) 旋轉；輪流
example_sentence: If the Earth stopped rotating, life would face extreme changes.
sentence_zh: 如果地球停止自轉，生命將會面臨極端的變化。

definition_zh: (名) 旋轉；輪換
example_sentence: The rotation of the Earth causes day and night.
sentence_zh: 地球的自轉導致了白天和黑夜。

definition_zh: (形) 腐爛的；變質的
example_sentence: The rotten fruit in the refrigerator made the whole kitchen smell bad.
sentence_zh: 冰箱裡腐爛的水果讓整個廚房聞起來很臭。

definition_zh: (名) 腮紅；口紅　(動) 塗口紅；擦腮紅
example_sentence: Having applied too much rouge, the actress looked unnatural on stage.
sentence_zh: 擦了太多腮紅，那位女演員在舞台上顯得不自然。

definition_zh: (片) 草擬；勾勒
example_sentence: Only after the meeting did the team rough out a basic plan.
sentence_zh: 只有在會議之後，團隊才草擬出一個基本計畫。

definition_zh: (動) 粗暴對待；毆打
example_sentence: The student who was rough up by the bully felt scared.
sentence_zh: 那個被惡霸粗暴對待的學生感到害怕。

definition_zh: (形) 粗糙的；崎嶇的
example_sentence: If the road is rough, drivers should slow down to stay safe.
sentence_zh: 如果路面崎嶇，駕駛應該減速以保持安全。

definition_zh: (副) 大約；粗略地
example_sentence: Roughly half of the students finished the exam early.
sentence_zh: 大約一半的學生提早寫完考卷。

definition_zh: (片) 無條件捨去；向下取整
example_sentence: The store manager decided to round down the total price to 500 dollars.
sentence_zh: 商店經理決定將總價無條件捨去至500元。

definition_zh: (片) 圓滿結束；使完美
example_sentence: Seldom does a good essay round off without a strong conclusion.
sentence_zh: 一篇好文章很少沒有強而有力的結論來圓滿結束。

definition_zh: (片) 圍攻；圍住（某人以尋求幫助或責備）
example_sentence: The teacher, whom the students round on for extra help, is always patient.
sentence_zh: 學生們為了獲得額外幫助而圍住的那位老師總是很耐心。

definition_zh: (片) 使圓滿；使完善
example_sentence: The internship that helped round out her resume was very valuable.
sentence_zh: 那份幫助完善她履歷的實習非常有價值。

definition_zh: (片) 集合；聚集
example_sentence: The teacher who helped round up the students was very kind.
sentence_zh: 那位幫忙集合學生的老師非常親切。

definition_zh: (形) 圓的；圓形的　(名) 圓形；圓形物　(動) 使成圓形；繞行
example_sentence: The round table in the classroom is perfect for group discussions.
sentence_zh: 教室裡那張圓桌非常適合小組討論。

definition_zh: (名) ['raʊndəˌbaʊt] 圓環；迂迴路線　(形) [raʊnd'baʊt] 迂迴的；間接的
example_sentence: The roundabout at the school gate helps reduce traffic jams.
sentence_zh: 校門口的那個圓環有助於減少交通堵塞。

definition_zh: (動) 喚醒；叫醒
example_sentence: The loud alarm clock rouses the sleepy student every morning.
sentence_zh: 響亮的鬧鐘每天早上喚醒睏倦的學生。

definition_zh: (名) 路線；路途
example_sentence: The route that the bus takes every morning is very scenic.
sentence_zh: 公車每天早上走的路線風景非常優美。

definition_zh: (名) 路由器
example_sentence: After the router rebooted, the internet connection became stable again.
sentence_zh: 路由器重新啟動後，網路連線又變得穩定了。

definition_zh: (名) 例行公事；常規　(形) 例行的；常規的
example_sentence: Students often follow a strict routine to prepare for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們經常遵循嚴格的例行公事來準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (副) 例行地；常規地
example_sentence: Seldom does the bus arrive routinely on time.
sentence_zh: 這班公車很少按時抵達。

definition_zh: (動) 漫遊；流浪
example_sentence: The stray dog continued to rove around the campus looking for food.
sentence_zh: 那隻流浪狗繼續在校園裡四處遊蕩尋找食物。

definition_zh: (名) 探測車；漫遊者
example_sentence: The Mars rover discovered ancient signs of water on the red planet.
sentence_zh: 這輛火星探測車在紅色星球上發現了古老的水跡。

definition_zh: (形) 巡迴的；流動的
example_sentence: The roving reporter interviewed students about their summer plans.
sentence_zh: 這位巡迴記者採訪學生們關於他們的暑假計劃。

definition_zh: (動) 划船；　(名) 一排；一行
example_sentence: If the students row with their teammates, the coach will be happy.
sentence_zh: 如果學生們和隊友一起划船，教練會很開心。

definition_zh: (形) 皇家的；王室的
example_sentence: The royal family visited the local school to promote education.
sentence_zh: 皇室家族訪問當地學校以推廣教育。

definition_zh: (名) 皇室；皇家成員
example_sentence: The museum's royalty exhibition attracted many visitors last weekend.
sentence_zh: 博物館的皇室展覽上週末吸引了許多參觀者。

definition_zh: (片) 和睦相處；勉強應付
example_sentence: Although their opinions differ, the team members rub along well.
sentence_zh: 儘管意見不同，團隊成員仍能和睦相處。

definition_zh: (片) 按摩；擦乾
example_sentence: The trainer taught the athlete to rub down after each workout.
sentence_zh: 教練教導運動員每次鍛鍊後要按摩放鬆。

definition_zh: (片) 塗抹（使吸收）；反覆強調（令人厭煩）
example_sentence: Having rubbed in the lotion, the athlete felt his muscles relax.
sentence_zh: 塗抹了乳液後，運動員感到肌肉放鬆了。

definition_zh: (片) 刻意強調（令人不快的）；反覆提起（別人的失敗）
example_sentence: My older brother always rubs it in when I lose a game.
sentence_zh: 我的哥哥總是在我輸掉比賽時刻意強調這件事。

definition_zh: (片) 影響；感染
example_sentence: Students join clubs to let positive attitudes rub off on them.
sentence_zh: 學生加入社團，讓積極的態度影響他們。

definition_zh: (片) 擦掉；抹去
example_sentence: Students should carefully rub out their pencil marks before submitting the test.
sentence_zh: 學生在交卷前應該仔細擦掉鉛筆痕跡。

definition_zh: (片) 蹭；擦到
example_sentence: The cat rubbed up against my leg while I was studying.
sentence_zh: 那隻貓在我讀書時蹭著我的腿。

definition_zh: (動) 摩擦；擦
example_sentence: After the long hike, Tom rubbed his sore feet with a towel.
sentence_zh: 長途健行後，湯姆用毛巾摩擦他痠痛的腳。

definition_zh: (名) 橡膠；橡皮
example_sentence: Recycling rubber from old tires helps reduce waste in landfills.
sentence_zh: 從舊輪胎回收橡膠有助於減少垃圾掩埋場的廢棄物。

definition_zh: (名) 垃圾；廢物
example_sentence: Students should not throw rubbish on the school playground after lunch.
sentence_zh: 學生們不應該在午餐後將垃圾丟在學校操場上。

definition_zh: (名) 舵
example_sentence: Without a rudder, the ship drifted aimlessly in the storm.
sentence_zh: 沒有舵，船隻在暴風雨中漫無目的地漂流。

definition_zh: (形) 無禮的；粗魯的
example_sentence: Being rude to the teacher is not acceptable in class.
sentence_zh: 對老師無禮在課堂上是不被接受的。

definition_zh: (名) 基礎；初步
example_sentence: Learning the rudiments of coding, the student built a simple app.
sentence_zh: 學習編碼的基礎知識後，那名學生建立了一個簡單的應用程式。

definition_zh: (形) 基本的；簡陋的
example_sentence: Although the robot's design was rudimentary, it successfully completed the task.
sentence_zh: 雖然機器人的設計很簡陋，但它成功完成了任務。

definition_zh: (副) 懊悔地；悲傷地
example_sentence: The student ruefully admitted that he had forgotten his homework again.
sentence_zh: 這位學生懊悔地承認他又忘記帶作業了。

definition_zh: (名) 小地毯；毯子
example_sentence: The small rug in the living room adds a touch of warmth.
sentence_zh: 客廳裡的小地毯增添了一絲溫暖。

definition_zh: (名) 橄欖球
example_sentence: Excited by the match, the students practiced rugby after school.
sentence_zh: 學生們因比賽而興奮，放學後練習了橄欖球。

definition_zh: (形) 崎嶇的；堅韌的
example_sentence: The rugged path to the mountain top required careful climbing.
sentence_zh: 通往山頂的那條崎嶇小徑需要小心攀爬。

definition_zh: (動) 毀壞；毀滅　(名) 廢墟；毀滅
example_sentence: To ruin your health by staying up late is not worth the effort.
sentence_zh: 熬夜毀掉你的健康是不值得的。

definition_zh: (名) 廢墟；遺跡　(動) 毀壞；破壞
example_sentence: The ancient temple ruins attract many visitors every weekend.
sentence_zh: 這座古廟遺跡每個週末吸引許多遊客。

definition_zh: (片) 排除；拒絕考慮
example_sentence: The doctor cannot rule out a possible infection without more tests.
sentence_zh: 在沒有更多檢驗的情況下，醫生無法排除感染的可能性。

definition_zh: (名) 規則；規定　(動) 統治；支配
example_sentence: A rule that students must follow is no running in the hallways.
sentence_zh: 學生必須遵守的規定是走廊上禁止奔跑。

definition_zh: (名) 尺；統治者
example_sentence: The student used a ruler to draw a straight line for his math homework.
sentence_zh: 這位學生用一把尺為他的數學作業畫一條直線。

definition_zh: (名) 裁決；統治　(形) 主要的；支配的
example_sentence: After the judge issued the ruling, the students discussed its impact.
sentence_zh: 在法官做出裁決後，學生們討論了它的影響。

definition_zh: (動) 發出隆隆聲；轟隆隆地行進
example_sentence: Having rumbled through the old factory, the train finally came to a stop.
sentence_zh: 火車轟隆隆地駛過舊工廠後，終於停了下來。

definition_zh: (動) 翻找；搜尋
example_sentence: The students rummage through old boxes in the classroom for lost homework.
sentence_zh: 學生們在教室裡翻找舊箱子，尋找遺失的作業。

definition_zh: (名) 謠言；傳聞
example_sentence: If the rumor about the exam were true, students would panic.
sentence_zh: 如果關於考試的謠言是真的，學生們會驚慌。

definition_zh: (片) 偶然遇到；碰到
example_sentence: If a student ran across a rare book, the library would be excited.
sentence_zh: 如果學生偶然發現一本稀有的書，圖書館會很興奮。

definition_zh: (片) 追趕；追求
example_sentence: The dog that always runs after cars belongs to my neighbor.
sentence_zh: 那隻總是追著車子跑的狗是我鄰居的。

definition_zh: (片) 與…競爭；對抗
example_sentence: When our school team runs against a stronger opponent, everyone cheers loudly.
sentence_zh: 當我們校隊與更強的對手競爭時，每個人都大聲加油。

definition_zh: (片) 離開；走開
example_sentence: If the teacher asked us to run along, we would leave the classroom immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果老師叫我們離開，我們會立刻離開教室。

definition_zh: (片) 逃跑；逃避
example_sentence: The frightened cat tried to run away from the loud noise.
sentence_zh: 那隻受驚的貓試圖逃離巨大的噪音。

definition_zh: (片) 向…簡報；快速檢查
example_sentence: The student council will run by the principal the new event proposal.
sentence_zh: 學生會將向校長簡報新的活動提案。

definition_zh: (片) 壞掉；筋疲力盡；貶低
example_sentence: If the old bus runs down completely, the school will need to replace it.
sentence_zh: 如果那輛舊公車完全壞掉，學校就需要更換它。

definition_zh: (片) 競選
example_sentence: If a student wants to win the election, he must run for president.
sentence_zh: 如果學生想贏得選舉，他必須競選會長。

definition_zh: (片) 磨合；試用（新鞋等）
example_sentence: Our team needs to run in the new shoes before the marathon.
sentence_zh: 我們的團隊需要在馬拉松前磨合新鞋。

definition_zh: (片) 偶然遇到；撞上
example_sentence: Students who run into problems should ask the teacher for help.
sentence_zh: 遇到問題的學生應該向老師尋求幫助。

definition_zh: (片) 跑掉；匆忙離開
example_sentence: If the deadline approaches, many students run off to finish their projects.
sentence_zh: 如果截止日期臨近，許多學生會匆忙跑去完成他們的作業。

definition_zh: (片) 靠…運行；以…為動力
example_sentence: This old computer runs on a very outdated operating system.
sentence_zh: 這台舊電腦運行著一個非常過時的作業系統。

definition_zh: (片) 用完；耗盡
example_sentence: Running out of time, the students finished their exams quickly.
sentence_zh: 時間快用完了，學生們迅速完成了考試。

definition_zh: (片) 輾過；撞倒
example_sentence: The careless driver almost ran over a stray cat on the street.
sentence_zh: 那個粗心的駕駛差點在街上輾過一隻流浪貓。

definition_zh: (片) 排練；快速瀏覽
example_sentence: The song that the band will run through tonight is their new single.
sentence_zh: 樂團今晚將排練的那首歌是他們的新單曲。

definition_zh: (片) 跑向；趕往
example_sentence: The students who run to school every morning stay fit.
sentence_zh: 每天早上跑步上學的學生保持身體健康。

definition_zh: (片) 遭遇（困難、問題等）
example_sentence: The student council ran up against a tight budget for the school festival.
sentence_zh: 學生會舉辦校慶時遇到了預算緊張的問題。

definition_zh: (片) 突然接近；跑向
example_sentence: Seldom does a stranger run up on a group of students in the library.
sentence_zh: 陌生人很少在圖書館裡突然接近一群學生。

definition_zh: (片) 累積；達到（某金額）
example_sentence: The delivery fees run up to fifty dollars for a small order.
sentence_zh: 小訂單的配送費累積到五十美元。

definition_zh: (片) 失去控制；瘋長
example_sentence: Having run wild in the park, the children were called home for dinner.
sentence_zh: 在公園裡瘋跑之後，孩子們被叫回家吃晚飯。

definition_zh: (片) 採用；與……一起跑
example_sentence: If our team runs with the new strategy, the project will succeed.
sentence_zh: 如果我們的團隊採用新策略，這個專案就會成功。

definition_zh: (動) 徹底檢查；使疲憊　(形) 破舊的；疲憊的
example_sentence: Having run-down the old building, the workers started to demolish it.
sentence_zh: 工人們徹底檢查了那棟舊建築後，開始將其拆除。

definition_zh: (形) 普通的；平凡的；平庸的
example_sentence: Students who submit run-of-the-mill essays often receive average grades.
sentence_zh: 交出平庸論文的學生通常得到普通的分數。

definition_zh: (名) 助跑；準備階段
example_sentence: Having completed the run-up, the athlete prepared for the long jump.
sentence_zh: 完成助跑後，運動員為跳遠做準備。

definition_zh: (動) 跑；奔跑
example_sentence: The students run around the track every morning.
sentence_zh: 學生們每天早上在跑道上跑步。

definition_zh: (名) 簡報；概要　(形) 疲憊的；失修的
example_sentence: After the party, the volunteers gave a rundown of the cleanup tasks.
sentence_zh: 派對結束後，志工們簡要說明了清理工作的內容。

definition_zh: (名) 亞軍；第二名
example_sentence: Having trained for months, the runner-up felt proud of her achievement.
sentence_zh: 訓練了幾個月後，亞軍為自己的成就感到自豪。

definition_zh: (名) 跑步者；賽跑的人
example_sentence: The runner finished the race with a new personal record.
sentence_zh: 這位跑者以新的個人紀錄完成了比賽。

definition_zh: (形) 流動的；運轉中的　(名) 跑步；經營
example_sentence: The running water in the park fountain is very clean.
sentence_zh: 公園噴泉裡流動的水非常乾淨。

definition_zh: (名) 最瘦小的動物；矮子
example_sentence: The runt of the litter needed extra care from the veterinarian.
sentence_zh: 這窩幼崽中最瘦小的一隻需要獸醫的額外照顧。

definition_zh: (名) 跑道；伸展台
example_sentence: While the model walked on the runway, the audience applauded loudly.
sentence_zh: 當模特兒走在伸展台上時，觀眾大聲鼓掌。

definition_zh: (名) [`rʌptʃɚ] 破裂；斷裂　(動) [rʌp`tʃɚ] 破裂；斷裂
example_sentence: The sudden rupture of the water pipe flooded the entire hallway.
sentence_zh: 水管的突然破裂淹沒了整個走廊。

definition_zh: (形) 鄉村的；農村的
example_sentence: Many students prefer rural life to city life during holidays.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在假期期間偏好鄉村生活勝過城市生活。

definition_zh: (片) 匆匆離開；急忙走開
example_sentence: The students rush away from the classroom after the final bell rings.
sentence_zh: 學生們在最後的鈴聲響起後匆匆離開教室。

definition_zh: (名) 尖峰時間；擁擠時段
example_sentence: Having left home early, the students avoided the rush hour traffic.
sentence_zh: 因為早早離開家，學生們避開了尖峰時段的交通。

definition_zh: (片) 匆忙進入；衝動行事
example_sentence: Rushing into the final exam without studying, many students felt anxious.
sentence_zh: 沒有準備就衝進期末考，許多學生感到焦慮。

definition_zh: (片) 匆忙離開；趕去
example_sentence: The student who had to rush off missed the bus.
sentence_zh: 那個必須匆忙離開的學生錯過了公車。

definition_zh: (片) 衝出；匆忙離開
example_sentence: Students often rush out of the classroom when the bell rings.
sentence_zh: 學生們經常在鈴響時衝出教室。

definition_zh: (動) 匆忙行事；催促　(名) 匆忙；搶購
example_sentence: If a student rushed through the exam, the teacher would notice the mistakes.
sentence_zh: 如果學生匆匆作答，老師會注意到錯誤。

definition_zh: (名) 俄羅斯
example_sentence: Students who study Russia's history often visit museums.
sentence_zh: 研究俄羅斯歷史的學生經常參觀博物館。

definition_zh: (形) 俄羅斯的；俄語的　(名) 俄羅斯人；俄語
example_sentence: The Russian teacher showed us a famous painting from Moscow.
sentence_zh: 那位俄國老師向我們展示了一幅來自莫斯科的名畫。

definition_zh: (動) 生鏽　(名) 鏽；鐵鏽
example_sentence: The old bicycle left in the rain began to rust.
sentence_zh: 那輛被留在雨中的舊腳踏車開始生鏽。

definition_zh: (形) 鄉村的；質樸的
example_sentence: The rustic wooden table in our classroom has a charming design.
sentence_zh: 我們教室裡那張質樸的木桌有著迷人的設計。

definition_zh: (片) 張羅；設法弄到
example_sentence: The student who needed food quickly tried to rustle up a simple meal.
sentence_zh: 那位需要快速獲得食物的學生試圖張羅一頓簡單的餐點。

definition_zh: (動) 發出沙沙聲；使沙沙作響
example_sentence: The dry leaves rustle underfoot as students walk to class.
sentence_zh: 乾燥的樹葉在學生們走去上課時在腳下沙沙作響。

definition_zh: (名) 沙沙聲；瑟瑟聲　(形) 發出沙沙聲的
example_sentence: The rustling leaves in the wind kept the students awake during the exam.
sentence_zh: 風中沙沙作響的樹葉讓學生在考試期間保持清醒。

definition_zh: (形) 生鏽的；生疏的
example_sentence: My bicycle chain is rusty from riding in the rain.
sentence_zh: 我的腳踏車鏈條因為在雨中騎車而生鏽了。

definition_zh: (形) 殘酷的；無情的
example_sentence: The ruthless competition for university admissions stresses many students.
sentence_zh: 大學入學的殘酷競爭讓許多學生感到壓力。

definition_zh: (名) 軍刀；馬刀
example_sentence: The soldier's saber gleamed under the bright sun during the parade.
sentence_zh: 士兵的軍刀在遊行時於烈日下閃閃發光。

definition_zh: (動) 蓄意破壞；妨礙
example_sentence: The student who tried to sabotage the group project was caught.
sentence_zh: 試圖破壞小組作業的學生被抓住了。

definition_zh: (名) 袋子；布袋
example_sentence: The student used a cloth sac to carry her heavy textbooks.
sentence_zh: 這位學生用一個布袋來裝她沉重的教科書。

definition_zh: (片) 倒頭大睡；睡覺
example_sentence: After the long exam, the tired students sack out in the library.
sentence_zh: 漫長考試後，疲憊的學生在圖書館裡倒頭大睡。

definition_zh: (名) 袋子；麻袋　(動) 解僱；開除
example_sentence: The student who carried a heavy sack of books felt tired.
sentence_zh: 那個背著一袋沉重書籍的學生感到疲倦。

definition_zh: (形) 神聖的；莊嚴的
example_sentence: The temple's sacred atmosphere made visitors speak in whispers.
sentence_zh: 寺廟的神聖氣氛讓訪客輕聲細語。

definition_zh: (名) ['sækrəˌfaɪs] 犧牲；奉獻　(動) [ˈsækrəˌfaɪs] 犧牲；獻出
example_sentence: Never before had the team made such a great sacrifice for victory.
sentence_zh: 這支隊伍從未為了勝利做出如此巨大的犧牲。

definition_zh: (形) 悲傷的；難過的
example_sentence: Seldom has a teacher looked so sad after the final exam results.
sentence_zh: 很少有老師在期末考成績出來後看起來如此難過。

definition_zh: (動) 使悲傷；使難過
example_sentence: The news of the accident saddened the whole school community.
sentence_zh: 事故的消息讓整個學校社區感到悲傷。

definition_zh: (片) 備鞍；準備騎馬
example_sentence: Saddling up for the early morning ride, the students felt a sense of adventure.
sentence_zh: 為清晨的騎行備好馬鞍，學生們感到一陣冒險的興奮。

definition_zh: (動) 使負擔；強加於
example_sentence: The new project saddles the team with extra work.
sentence_zh: 這個新項目給團隊增加了額外的工作。

definition_zh: (名) 馬鞍；鞍座　(動) 給…裝鞍；使負擔
example_sentence: Seldom does a loose saddle cause such a serious accident.
sentence_zh: 鬆脫的馬鞍很少造成如此嚴重的事故。

definition_zh: (副) 可惜地；悲傷地
example_sentence: Sadly, the school band lost the final competition yesterday.
sentence_zh: 可惜的是，學校樂團昨天輸掉了決賽。

definition_zh: (名) 悲傷；難過
example_sentence: Overwhelmed with sadness, the student decided to talk to her teacher.
sentence_zh: 被悲傷淹沒，那名學生決定和她的老師談談。

definition_zh: (名) 野生動物觀賞之旅；狩獵旅行
example_sentence: The safari that our school organized last summer was an unforgettable experience.
sentence_zh: 我們學校去年夏天組織的那次野生動物觀賞之旅是一次難忘的經歷。

definition_zh: (形) 安全的；平安的　(名) 保險箱
example_sentence: The students feel safe when the teacher stays in the classroom.
sentence_zh: 當老師留在教室時，學生們感到安全。

definition_zh: (動) 保護；防衛
example_sentence: Students should safeguard their personal data against online theft.
sentence_zh: 學生應該保護他們的個人資料免受網路盜竊。

definition_zh: (副) 安全地；平安地
example_sentence: Students should learn how to use the internet safely.
sentence_zh: 學生應該學習如何安全地使用網路。

definition_zh: (名) 保險箱；安全箱
example_sentence: The safety box that my father bought keeps our important documents secure.
sentence_zh: 我父親買的保險箱讓我們的重要文件保持安全。

definition_zh: (名) 安全；平安
example_sentence: The school's safety rules require all students to wear helmets.
sentence_zh: 學校的安全規定要求所有學生戴安全帽。

definition_zh: (片) 翹課；逃避責任
example_sentence: Students often sag off school to play video games at internet cafes.
sentence_zh: 學生們經常翹課去網咖打電玩。

definition_zh: (動) 凹陷；下垂
example_sentence: Having sagged under the heavy rain, the tent collapsed suddenly.
sentence_zh: 在豪雨下凹陷後，帳篷突然倒塌了。

definition_zh: (形) 明智的；賢明的　(名) 聖人；智者
example_sentence: The sage advice that my grandfather gave me still guides my decisions today.
sentence_zh: 祖父給我的睿智建議至今仍引導著我的決定。

definition_zh: (片) 輕鬆進入；順利進行
example_sentence: The student decided to sail into the final exam with confidence.
sentence_zh: 這位學生決定充滿自信地迎接期末考試。

definition_zh: (片) 順利通過；輕鬆完成
example_sentence: The student who sailed through the exam felt very relieved.
sentence_zh: 那位順利通過考試的學生感到非常輕鬆。

definition_zh: (名) 帆；航行　(動) 航行；駕駛船隻
example_sentence: Sailing across the ocean, the team enjoyed the fresh wind.
sentence_zh: 航行穿過海洋時，團隊享受著清新的風。

definition_zh: (名) 航行；帆船運動
example_sentence: Sailing across the ocean requires careful planning and teamwork.
sentence_zh: 航行穿越海洋需要仔細的規劃和團隊合作。

definition_zh: (名) 水手；船員
example_sentence: The young sailor learned to navigate using only the stars.
sentence_zh: 那位年輕的水手學會了只靠星星來導航。

definition_zh: (名) 聖人；聖徒
example_sentence: If the saint visits our school, many students will ask for blessings.
sentence_zh: 如果這位聖人拜訪我們的學校，許多學生會請求祝福。

definition_zh: (名) 目的；利益
example_sentence: For the sake of her future, Emily decided to study harder.
sentence_zh: 為了她的未來，艾蜜莉決定更加努力學習。

definition_zh: (名) 沙拉；涼拌菜
example_sentence: Making a fresh salad for dinner is a healthy choice.
sentence_zh: 晚餐做一份新鮮的沙拉是健康的選擇。

definition_zh: (名) 薪水；薪資
example_sentence: Working part-time, the student earned a decent salary.
sentence_zh: 兼職打工，這位學生賺取了一份不錯的薪水。

definition_zh: (名) 銷售；拍賣；大減價
example_sentence: Having seen the sale, many students bought new books.
sentence_zh: 看到促銷活動後，許多學生買了新書。

definition_zh: (名) 業務員；推銷員
example_sentence: The salesman demonstrated the new smartphone features to the students.
sentence_zh: 這位業務員向學生們展示了新智慧型手機的功能。

definition_zh: (名) 銷售人員；售貨員
example_sentence: The salesperson at the computer store helped me choose a good laptop.
sentence_zh: 電腦店的銷售人員幫我選了一台好筆電。

definition_zh: (形) 顯著的；突出的
example_sentence: Many students study hard to identify the salient points in textbooks.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力學習，以便找出課本中的重點。

definition_zh: (形) 鹽的；含鹽的　(名) 鹽水；生理食鹽水
example_sentence: The nurse used a saline solution to clean the wound.
sentence_zh: 護士用生理食鹽水清洗傷口。

definition_zh: (名) 唾液；口水
example_sentence: The saliva that the doctor collected was sent to the lab for analysis.
sentence_zh: 醫生收集的唾液被送到實驗室進行分析。

definition_zh: (片) 出發；衝出
example_sentence: The brave knight decided to sally forth from the castle at dawn.
sentence_zh: 勇敢的騎士決定在黎明時從城堡出發。

definition_zh: (名) 鮭魚；三文魚
example_sentence: Students who eat salmon regularly may improve their focus in class.
sentence_zh: 經常吃鮭魚的學生可能會改善他們在課堂上的專注力。

definition_zh: (名) 沙龍；美髮院
example_sentence: The new salon near the school offers affordable haircuts for students.
sentence_zh: 學校附近的新沙龍為學生提供平價理髮服務。

definition_zh: (名) 酒吧；沙龍；大廳
example_sentence: After school, the old saloon near the station was crowded with people.
sentence_zh: 放學後，車站附近那間老式酒吧擠滿了人。

definition_zh: (名) 莎莎醬（一種墨西哥調味醬）
example_sentence: After the cooking class, the students made fresh salsa for the party.
sentence_zh: 烹飪課後，學生們為派對製作了新鮮的莎莎醬。

definition_zh: (片) 儲蓄；存錢
example_sentence: The smart student salts away part of her allowance every month.
sentence_zh: 那位聰明的學生每個月都會存下部分零用錢。

definition_zh: (名) 鹽；(動) 加鹽於
example_sentence: Never before has salt been this expensive in local markets.
sentence_zh: 當地的市場從未見過鹽這麼貴。

definition_zh: (名) 鹽田；鹽池
example_sentence: The old saltpan near the coast has been abandoned for years.
sentence_zh: 海岸附近的那個舊鹽田已經廢棄多年。

definition_zh: (形) 鹹的；含鹽的
example_sentence: The soup was too salty for most students to enjoy.
sentence_zh: 這碗湯對大多數學生來說太鹹了，難以入口。

definition_zh: (形) 有益的；有幫助的
example_sentence: Reading about historical failures had a salutary effect on the students.
sentence_zh: 閱讀歷史上的失敗對學生產生了有益的效果。

definition_zh: (名) 招呼；致意
example_sentence: Having offered a warm salutation, the teacher began the lesson.
sentence_zh: 在熱情致意後，老師開始上課。

definition_zh: (動) 敬禮；致敬　(名) 敬禮；致意
example_sentence: The soldier raised his hand to salute the national flag.
sentence_zh: 那位士兵舉手向國旗敬禮。

definition_zh: (動) 搶救；打撈
example_sentence: The team worked hard to salvage the damaged equipment from the flood.
sentence_zh: 團隊努力從洪水中搶救受損的設備。

definition_zh: (名) 拯救；解脫
example_sentence: Many students find salvation in music during stressful exam periods.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在壓力大的考試期間從音樂中獲得解脫。

definition_zh: (形) 相同的；同一的　(代) 同樣的人或事物
example_sentence: Students join the same club to make new friends.
sentence_zh: 學生加入同一個社團來結交新朋友。

definition_zh: (名) 薩摩耶犬
example_sentence: After the long walk, the samoyed rested in the shade.
sentence_zh: 長途散步後，薩摩耶犬在陰涼處休息。

definition_zh: (名) 樣本；樣品　(動) 品嚐；體驗
example_sentence: Before the final exam, the teacher gave us a sample test to practice.
sentence_zh: 期末考前，老師給了我們一份模擬試題來練習。

definition_zh: (名) 制裁；批准　(動) 批准；制裁
example_sentence: The new school rule, which the principal will sanction, requires uniforms.
sentence_zh: 校長將會批准的新校規要求穿制服。

definition_zh: (名) 制裁；處罰
example_sentence: New economic sanctions against the country affect global trade.
sentence_zh: 針對該國的新經濟制裁影響了全球貿易。

definition_zh: (名) 庇護所；聖所；保護區
example_sentence: After the storm, many birds found sanctuary in the nearby forest.
sentence_zh: 暴風雨過後，許多鳥兒在附近的森林中找到了庇護所。

definition_zh: (名) 沙子；沙灘
example_sentence: The sand that covers the beach feels soft and warm.
sentence_zh: 覆蓋沙灘的沙子摸起來柔軟又溫暖。

definition_zh: (名) 涼鞋；拖鞋
example_sentence: A broken sandal can make a long walk very uncomfortable.
sentence_zh: 一雙壞掉的涼鞋會讓長途步行變得很不舒服。

definition_zh: (名) 砂紙
example_sentence: Using sandpaper smooths the rough edges of a wooden shelf.
sentence_zh: 使用砂紙可以磨平木架粗糙的邊緣。

definition_zh: (名) 三明治
example_sentence: My mother made a delicious sandwich for my lunch today.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽今天為我的午餐做了一個美味的三明治。

definition_zh: (形) 沙質的；含沙的
example_sentence: The sandy beach near my hometown is a popular spot for swimming.
sentence_zh: 我家附近的那片沙灘是游泳的熱門地點。

definition_zh: (形) 心智健全的；明智的
example_sentence: If the plan sounded sane, the committee would approve it.
sentence_zh: 如果這個計畫聽起來合理，委員會就會批准它。

definition_zh: (形) 衛生的；清潔的
example_sentence: The school kitchen must maintain sanitary conditions for food safety.
sentence_zh: 學校廚房必須保持衛生條件以確保食品安全。

definition_zh: (名) 衛生設備；公共衛生
example_sentence: Poor sanitation in rural areas can cause serious diseases.
sentence_zh: 鄉村地區的衛生條件差可能導致嚴重疾病。

definition_zh: (動) 消毒；使衛生
example_sentence: Before cooking, the chef must sanitize all kitchen surfaces to prevent food poisoning.
sentence_zh: 烹飪前，廚師必須消毒所有廚房表面，以防止食物中毒。

definition_zh: (動) 耗盡；使衰弱
example_sentence: Sapped by the long hike, the students rested under a tree.
sentence_zh: 被長途徒步旅行耗盡體力後，學生們在一棵樹下休息。

definition_zh: (名) 樹苗；幼苗
example_sentence: Seldom does a sapling grow into a strong tree without enough sunlight.
sentence_zh: 一棵樹苗若沒有充足的陽光，很少能長成強壯的樹。

definition_zh: (名) 藍寶石
example_sentence: Because the sapphire ring was expensive, Mia saved money for months.
sentence_zh: 因為這枚藍寶石戒指很昂貴，Mia 存了好幾個月的錢。

definition_zh: (形) 諷刺的；挖苦的
example_sentence: Her sarcastic comment during class made everyone uncomfortable.
sentence_zh: 她在課堂上的諷刺評論讓每個人都不舒服。

definition_zh: (形) 無禮的；活潑的
example_sentence: The sassy comment from the student surprised the whole class.
sentence_zh: 那位學生無禮的評論讓全班同學感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (名) 撒旦；魔鬼
example_sentence: Having resisted satan's temptation, the hero saved the village.
sentence_zh: 抵抗了撒旦的誘惑後，英雄拯救了村莊。

definition_zh: (名) 衛星；人造衛星
example_sentence: If a satellite stops working, scientists can lose important data.
sentence_zh: 如果衛星停止運作，科學家可能會失去重要的資料。

definition_zh: (名) 諷刺；諷刺作品
example_sentence: Although the cartoon seemed funny, the satire criticized government policies.
sentence_zh: 雖然這部卡通看起來有趣，但其中的諷刺批評了政府政策。

definition_zh: (動) 諷刺；譏諷
example_sentence: The cartoonist often satirizes political leaders through his comic strips.
sentence_zh: 這位漫畫家經常透過他的連環漫畫諷刺政治領袖。

definition_zh: (名) 滿足；滿意
example_sentence: Finishing the difficult project on time gave the team great satisfaction.
sentence_zh: 按時完成困難的專案帶給團隊極大的滿足感。

definition_zh: (形) 令人滿意的；符合要求的
example_sentence: If your project receives a satisfactory score, you may join the contest.
sentence_zh: 如果你的專案獲得滿意的分數，你就可以參加比賽。

definition_zh: (形) 滿意的；滿足的
example_sentence: If the team finishes the project on time, the manager will feel satisfied.
sentence_zh: 如果團隊按時完成專案，經理會感到滿意。

definition_zh: (動) 滿足；使滿意
example_sentence: A good meal can satisfy a hungry stomach after a long day at school.
sentence_zh: 一頓好餐可以在漫長的一天學校生活後滿足飢餓的胃。

definition_zh: (形) 令人滿足的；令人滿意的
example_sentence: The satisfying taste of the mango shaved ice made everyone smile.
sentence_zh: 芒果刨冰令人滿足的味道讓每個人都笑了。

definition_zh: (動) 使濕透；使飽和
example_sentence: The sponge that saturates quickly is useful for cleaning spills.
sentence_zh: 那塊迅速吸飽水的海綿對清理潑灑物很有用。

definition_zh: (形) 飽和的；濕透的
example_sentence: The saturated market left little room for new businesses to grow.
sentence_zh: 飽和的市場幾乎沒有留給新企業成長的空間。

definition_zh: (名) 星期六
example_sentence: Saturday is a great day for students to relax and have fun.
sentence_zh: 星期六是學生放鬆和玩樂的好日子。

definition_zh: (名) 土星

sentence_zh: 天文社參觀天文臺以研究土星環。

definition_zh: (名) 醬汁；醬料
example_sentence: The chef added a special sauce to the noodles for extra flavor.
sentence_zh: 主廚在麵條裡加了特製醬料以增添風味。

definition_zh: (名) 碟子；茶托
example_sentence: The flying saucer landed quietly in the park, surprising everyone.
sentence_zh: 飛碟靜靜地降落在公園裡，嚇了大家一跳。

definition_zh: (名) 桑拿浴；三溫暖
example_sentence: Seldom does a sauna feel so refreshing after a long day at school.
sentence_zh: 在學校漫長的一天之後，很少有桑拿浴讓人感覺如此清爽。

definition_zh: (名) 香腸
example_sentence: If my brother ate too much sausage, he would feel sick.
sentence_zh: 如果我哥哥吃太多香腸，他會感到不舒服。

definition_zh: (動) 快炒；嫩煎
example_sentence: The chef who sauteed the vegetables added garlic for extra flavor.
sentence_zh: 那位炒蔬菜的廚師加了大蒜來增添風味。

definition_zh: (形) 野蠻的；兇猛的；猛烈的
example_sentence: The storm's savage winds destroyed several houses in the small town.
sentence_zh: 暴風的猛烈強風摧毀了小鎮上的幾棟房屋。

definition_zh: (片) 節省；省下
example_sentence: By taking the bus to school, students can save on transportation costs.
sentence_zh: 透過搭公車上學，學生可以節省交通費用。

definition_zh: (動) 節省；儲存
example_sentence: My father always saves money for my college education.
sentence_zh: 我父親總是為我的大學教育存錢。

definition_zh: (名) 節約；儲蓄
example_sentence: The government's saving plan aims to reduce waste and protect the environment.
sentence_zh: 政府的節約計畫旨在減少浪費並保護環境。

definition_zh: (名) 儲蓄；存款
example_sentence: Only after careful planning can our savings grow steadily.
sentence_zh: 只有在仔細規劃之後，我們的儲蓄才能穩定增長。

definition_zh: (名) 救星；拯救者
example_sentence: Having saved the drowning child, the brave savior received a medal from the mayor.
sentence_zh: 拯救了溺水兒童後，這位勇敢的救星從市長那裡獲得了一枚獎章。

definition_zh: (動) 享受；品味
example_sentence: Many students savor the quiet moments before a big exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生享受大考前平靜的時刻。

definition_zh: (形) 美味的；鹹香的
example_sentence: The savory aroma of grilled meat filled the air at the night market.
sentence_zh: 烤肉的鹹香氣味瀰漫在夜市的空氣中。

definition_zh: (動) 品嚐；享受
example_sentence: The students savour every moment of their graduation trip.
sentence_zh: 學生們享受畢業旅行的每一刻。

definition_zh: (名) 皺葉甘藍；一種甘藍菜
example_sentence: After the class discussed its origin, the teacher served savoy cabbage soup.
sentence_zh: 在班上討論其起源後，老師端出了皺葉甘藍湯。

definition_zh: (形) 精明的；有見識的
example_sentence: The tech-savvy student who fixed the computer won the competition.
sentence_zh: 那位精通科技的學生修理好電腦，贏得了比賽。

definition_zh: (片) 鋸；來回鋸
example_sentence: If the carpenter saws at the wood carefully, the shelf will be sturdy.
sentence_zh: 如果木匠小心地鋸木頭，架子就會很堅固。

definition_zh: (片) 锯断；锯掉
example_sentence: The carpenter used a hacksaw to saw off the broken chair leg.
sentence_zh: 木匠用钢锯锯断了坏掉的椅子腿。

definition_zh: (片) 鋸成小塊；鋸斷
example_sentence: Before the storm arrived, the workers saw up the fallen tree.
sentence_zh: 在暴風雨來臨前，工人們把倒下的樹鋸成小塊。

definition_zh: (動) 看見；鋸
example_sentence: Walking in the park, Lisa saw a beautiful rainbow after the rain.
sentence_zh: 在公園散步時，麗莎在雨後看到了一道美麗的彩虹。

definition_zh: (動) 說；講
example_sentence: The teacher asked the students to say their names.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生說出他們的名字。

definition_zh: (名) 諺語；格言　(動) 說（say的動名詞形式）
example_sentence: If that saying were true, more students would study harder.
sentence_zh: 如果那句俗語是真的，更多學生就會更努力讀書。

definition_zh: (動) 燙傷；用沸水燙
example_sentence: The hot soup scalded the cook's hand during lunch preparation.
sentence_zh: 熱湯在午餐準備期間燙傷了廚師的手。

definition_zh: (片) 縮減；減少（規模）
example_sentence: Because the budget was too high, the school decided to scale back the project.
sentence_zh: 由於預算過高，學校決定縮減該計畫的規模。

definition_zh: (片) 擴大；增加規模
example_sentence: If the company scaled up production, it would meet global demand.
sentence_zh: 如果公司擴大生產，就能滿足全球需求。

definition_zh: (名) 規模；比例　(動) 攀登；縮放
example_sentence: The scale of the problem surprised the entire team.
sentence_zh: 這個問題的規模讓整個團隊感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (形) 不等邊的
example_sentence: The scalene triangle drawn by the student had three unequal sides.
sentence_zh: 這個學生畫的不等邊三角形有三條不相等的邊。

definition_zh: (名) 海獅
example_sentence: The scalion that lives in the zoo has a long tail.
sentence_zh: 住在動物園的那隻海獅有一條長尾巴。

definition_zh: (名) 蔥；青蔥
example_sentence: The chef who used fresh scallion in the dish won the cooking contest.
sentence_zh: 那位在菜餚中使用新鮮蔥的廚師贏得了烹飪比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 干貝；扇貝
example_sentence: My mother ordered grilled scallops at the seafood restaurant last weekend.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽上週末在海鮮餐廳點了烤干貝。

definition_zh: (名) 手術刀
example_sentence: The surgeon used a sharp scalpel to make a precise incision.
sentence_zh: 外科醫生用一把鋒利的手術刀做出精確的切口。

definition_zh: (名) 騙局；詐騙
example_sentence: The email scam that promised free prizes tricked many students.
sentence_zh: 那個承諾免費獎品的電子郵件騙局欺騙了許多學生。

definition_zh: (名) 小淘氣；頑皮的傢伙　(動) 偷懶；敷衍了事
example_sentence: That scamp stole my lunch money during the break.
sentence_zh: 那個小淘氣在休息時間偷了我的午餐錢。

definition_zh: (動) 掃描；瀏覽
example_sentence: The doctor will scan the patient's injured leg with a machine.
sentence_zh: 醫生會用機器掃描病人受傷的腿。

definition_zh: (名) 醜聞；醜事
example_sentence: Shocked by the scandal, the school board held an emergency meeting.
sentence_zh: 震驚於這起醜聞，校務委員會召開了緊急會議。

definition_zh: (名) 掃描器；掃描機
example_sentence: The library scanner can quickly digitize old documents.
sentence_zh: 圖書館的掃描器可以快速數位化舊文件。

definition_zh: (形) 不足的；稀少的
example_sentence: The scant evidence in the report disappointed the entire team.
sentence_zh: 報告中稀少的證據讓整個團隊感到失望。

definition_zh: (名) 疤痕；(動) 留下疤痕
example_sentence: The deep scar on her knee reminded her of the accident.
sentence_zh: 她膝蓋上的深深疤痕讓她想起那場意外。

definition_zh: (形) 缺乏的；稀有的
example_sentence: If clean water became scarce, the town would suffer greatly.
sentence_zh: 如果乾淨的水變得稀少，這個小鎮將會遭受極大的痛苦。

definition_zh: (副) 幾乎不；剛一...就
example_sentence: Scarcely had the bell rung when the students rushed out of the classroom.
sentence_zh: 鈴聲幾乎一響，學生們就衝出了教室。

definition_zh: (片) 嚇跑；嚇走
example_sentence: Loud noises during the exam scare away the students' concentration.
sentence_zh: 考試期間的噪音嚇跑了學生的專注力。

definition_zh: (動) 驚嚇；嚇走
example_sentence: The loud noise from the street scared the cat away.
sentence_zh: 街上的大噪音把貓嚇跑了。

definition_zh: (名) 稻草人
example_sentence: The farmer placed a scarecrow in the field to protect the crops from birds.
sentence_zh: 農夫在田裡放了一個稻草人，以保護作物免受鳥類侵害。

definition_zh: (形) 害怕的；恐懼的
example_sentence: Tom felt scared when he saw a big spider in his room.
sentence_zh: 湯姆在房間裡看到一隻大蜘蛛時感到害怕。

definition_zh: (名) 圍巾；領巾
example_sentence: Sarah wore a warm scarf to school during the cold winter.
sentence_zh: 莎拉在寒冷的冬天戴了一條溫暖的圍巾上學。

definition_zh: (形) 鮮紅色的；深紅色的　(名) 鮮紅色；深紅色
example_sentence: Many students wear scarlet scarves to support the school sports team.
sentence_zh: 許多學生繫著鮮紅色的圍巾來支持學校的運動隊。

definition_zh: (形) 恐怖的；嚇人的
example_sentence: The scary movie about a haunted house made the students scream.
sentence_zh: 那部關於鬼屋的恐怖電影讓學生們尖叫。

definition_zh: (動) 使分散；散開
example_sentence: Seldom do strong winds scatter the autumn leaves so evenly.
sentence_zh: 強風很少如此均勻地吹散秋天的落葉。

definition_zh: (動) 撒；分散　(形) 分散的；零散的
example_sentence: Having scattered the seeds, the farmer waited for rain.
sentence_zh: 撒完種子後，農夫等待下雨。

definition_zh: (名) 食腐動物；拾荒者
example_sentence: Not only is a scavenger a cleaner, but also a recycler in nature.
sentence_zh: 食腐動物不僅是清潔工，也是大自然中的回收者。

definition_zh: (名) 情況；劇本
example_sentence: The teacher asked the class to imagine a worst-case scenario for the project.
sentence_zh: 老師要求全班想像這個專案最壞的情況。

definition_zh: (名) 場景；景象
example_sentence: The first scene of the movie was filmed in Taipei.
sentence_zh: 這部電影的第一個場景是在台北拍攝的。

definition_zh: (名) 風景；景色
example_sentence: Having seen the breathtaking scenery, the students felt more relaxed.
sentence_zh: 看過這令人嘆為觀止的風景後，學生們感到更加放鬆。

definition_zh: (形) 風景優美的；景色如畫的
example_sentence: The scenic mountain trail attracts many hikers on weekends.
sentence_zh: 這條風景優美的山間小徑在週末吸引許多健行者。

definition_zh: (名) 氣味；香氣　(動) 嗅；聞到
example_sentence: The scent of fresh bread filled the kitchen every morning.
sentence_zh: 新鮮麵包的香氣每天早晨充滿廚房。

definition_zh: (名) 日程；時間表　(動) 安排；預定
example_sentence: The teacher checked the class schedule before the bell rang.
sentence_zh: 老師在鈴響前檢查了課表。

definition_zh: (名) 方案；計畫　(動) 策劃；圖謀
example_sentence: The government's new scheme aims to reduce air pollution in Taipei.
sentence_zh: 政府的新方案旨在減少台北的空氣汙染。

definition_zh: (名) 學者
example_sentence: Because the scholar studied hard, she received a prestigious award.
sentence_zh: 因為這位學者努力研究，她獲得了一個享有盛譽的獎項。

definition_zh: (形) 學術的；有學問的
example_sentence: The professor's scholarly article earned her great respect in the academic community.
sentence_zh: 那位教授的學術文章為她在學術界贏得了極大的尊重。

definition_zh: (名) 獎學金
example_sentence: Winning this scholarship requires excellent grades and community service.
sentence_zh: 贏得這項獎學金需要優異的成績和社區服務。

definition_zh: (形) 學術的；學校的
example_sentence: If the scholastic competition attracts more participants, the school will gain prestige.
sentence_zh: 如果學術競賽吸引更多參加者，學校將獲得聲望。

definition_zh: (名) 學校；上學
example_sentence: My sister goes to school by bus every day.
sentence_zh: 我妹妹每天搭公車去上學。

definition_zh: (名) 男學生
example_sentence: While the schoolboy studied hard for his exam, his friends played outside.
