definition_zh: (形) 久坐的；需要久坐的
example_sentence: Spending hours on homework, many students lead a sedentary lifestyle.
sentence_zh: 花費數小時做功課，許多學生過著久坐不動的生活方式。

definition_zh: (名) 沉積物；沉澱物
example_sentence: The sediment that the river carried formed a delta at the coast.
sentence_zh: 河流攜帶的沉積物在海岸形成了三角洲。

definition_zh: (名) 沉積；沉澱
example_sentence: Soil sedimentation after heavy rain can damage farmland and crops.
sentence_zh: 大雨過後的土壤沉積物會損害農田和作物。

definition_zh: (名) 煽動叛亂；叛亂言論
example_sentence: If the politician promoted sedition, the law would punish him severely.
sentence_zh: 如果這位政治人物煽動叛亂，法律會嚴厲懲罰他。

definition_zh: (名) 誘惑；魅力
example_sentence: The advertisement's seduction of teenagers often leads to excessive spending.
sentence_zh: 廣告對青少年的誘惑常常導致過度消費。

definition_zh: (形) 誘人的；有吸引力的
example_sentence: The seductive advertisement convinced many students to buy the new phone.
sentence_zh: 那則誘人的廣告說服許多學生購買新手機。

definition_zh: (片) 處理；安排
example_sentence: The student council will see about organizing a charity event for local shelters.
sentence_zh: 學生會將處理為當地收容所組織慈善活動的事宜。

definition_zh: (片) 看穿；洞察
example_sentence: Seeing into the complex issue, the teacher explained it clearly.
sentence_zh: 看穿了這個複雜的問題，老師清楚地解釋了它。

definition_zh: (片) 送行；送別
example_sentence: The whole class gathered at the airport to see off their teacher.
sentence_zh: 全班同學聚集在機場為他們的老師送行。

definition_zh: (片) 堅持完成；送客
example_sentence: If the rain stops soon, the team will see out the match.
sentence_zh: 如果雨很快停，球隊就會堅持完成比賽。

definition_zh: (片) 看穿；識破
example_sentence: If a student lies often, teachers can see through the dishonesty quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生經常說謊，老師能很快看穿不誠實的行為。

definition_zh: (片) 負責；照料
example_sentence: If the club president sees to the arrangements, the event will run smoothly.
sentence_zh: 如果社長負責安排，活動就會順利進行。

definition_zh: (動) 看見；理解
example_sentence: My brother and I often see our grandparents on weekends.
sentence_zh: 我哥哥和我常在週末去看祖父母。

definition_zh: (名) 種子；(動) 播種
example_sentence: Farmers buy seeds in spring to plant their crops.
sentence_zh: 農夫在春天買種子來種植他們的作物。

definition_zh: (片) 尋找；找出
example_sentence: The research team aims to seek out new solutions for plastic pollution.
sentence_zh: 研究團隊旨在尋找塑膠污染的新解決方案。

definition_zh: (動) 尋找；尋求
example_sentence: Many students seek part-time jobs to gain work experience.
sentence_zh: 許多學生尋找兼職工作以獲得工作經驗。

definition_zh: (動) 似乎；看起來
example_sentence: Having seemed exhausted after the exam, the student fell asleep in class.
sentence_zh: 考試後看起來筋疲力盡，那名學生在課堂上睡著了。

definition_zh: (形) 表面上的；看起來的
example_sentence: The seeming simplicity of the math problem fooled many students.
sentence_zh: 這個數學問題表面上的簡單欺騙了許多學生。

definition_zh: (副) 看似；表面上
example_sentence: The seemingly simple math problem confused many students.
sentence_zh: 這個看似簡單的數學問題困住了許多學生。

definition_zh: (動) 滲出；滲漏
example_sentence: Water seep through the cracks in the old classroom walls.
sentence_zh: 水從舊教室牆壁的裂縫中滲出。

definition_zh: (名) 蹺蹺板
example_sentence: Watching the children play on the seesaw, the teacher smiled.
sentence_zh: 看著孩子們在蹺蹺板上玩耍，老師笑了。

definition_zh: (名) [ˋsɛgmənt] 部分；片段　(動) [sɛgˋmɛnt] 分割；切分
example_sentence: Seldom does a single news segment cover such a complex issue.
sentence_zh: 很少有單一新聞片段能涵蓋如此複雜的議題。

definition_zh: (動) 隔離；分離
example_sentence: The school policy should not segregate students based on their academic performance.
sentence_zh: 學校政策不應根據學業表現隔離學生。

definition_zh: (形) 隔離的；被分開的
example_sentence: After the policy changed, the school ended segregated seating in the cafeteria.
sentence_zh: 政策改變後，學校終止了餐廳中的隔離座位安排。

definition_zh: (名) 隔離；分離
example_sentence: The segregation of students by gender is no longer allowed.
sentence_zh: 按性別隔離學生已不再被允許。

definition_zh: (形) 地震的；劇烈變動的
example_sentence: The seismic activity in the region caused many buildings to collapse.
sentence_zh: 該地區的地震活動導致許多建築物倒塌。

definition_zh: (名) 地震學家
example_sentence: When the earthquake struck, the seismologist quickly analyzed the data.
sentence_zh: 地震發生時，地震學家迅速分析了數據。

definition_zh: (片) 抓住；利用
example_sentence: The report that critics seize on highlights a major flaw in the policy.
sentence_zh: 批評人士抓住的那份報告突顯了該政策的一個重大缺陷。

definition_zh: (動) 抓住；奪取
example_sentence: Having seized the chance to study abroad, Emily improved her English quickly.
sentence_zh: 抓住出國讀書的機會後，艾蜜莉的英文進步得很快。

definition_zh: (名) 癲癇發作；抓住
example_sentence: The patient took medication to prevent a seizure.
sentence_zh: 病人服藥以防止癲癇發作。

definition_zh: (副) 很少；不常
example_sentence: Students who seldom study often struggle with exams.
sentence_zh: 很少讀書的學生常常在考試中掙扎。

definition_zh: (動) 選擇；挑選
example_sentence: Students who select their courses carefully often perform better in exams.
sentence_zh: 仔細選課的學生通常在考試中表現更好。

definition_zh: (名) 選擇；精選品
example_sentence: The library offers a wide selection of books for students.
sentence_zh: 圖書館為學生提供多種書籍選擇。

definition_zh: (形) 選擇性的；嚴格挑選的
example_sentence: If the school were more selective, fewer students would be admitted.
sentence_zh: 如果學校更嚴格篩選，錄取的學生就會更少。

definition_zh: (形) 寫好地址的；回郵的
example_sentence: Not only did the teacher require a self-addressed envelope, but also a stamp.
sentence_zh: 老師不僅要求一個寫好地址的回郵信封，還要求一張郵票。

definition_zh: (形) 以自我為中心的；自私的
example_sentence: A self-centered student often ignores others' feelings in group projects.
sentence_zh: 一個以自我為中心的學生在團體專題中經常忽略他人的感受。

definition_zh: (名) 自尊；自尊心
example_sentence: Seldom does a lack of self-esteem lead to real success.
sentence_zh: 缺乏自尊心很少能帶來真正的成功。

definition_zh: (形) 自我調節的；自律的
example_sentence: Self-regulated learning helps students manage their study time effectively.
sentence_zh: 自我調節的學習幫助學生有效管理他們的學習時間。

definition_zh: (形) 自我調節的；自動調控的
example_sentence: The smart home system uses self-regulating technology to save energy.
sentence_zh: 這個智慧家庭系統使用自我調節技術來節省能源。

definition_zh: (名) 自我調節；自律
example_sentence: If students practiced self-regulation, their academic performance would improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生練習自我調節，他們的學業表現會顯著提升。

definition_zh: (名) 自我；本身
example_sentence: Seldom does a student find true self through social media alone.
sentence_zh: 學生很少能單單透過社群媒體找到真實的自我。

definition_zh: (形) 自私的；自利的
example_sentence: Students who are selfish often lose friends quickly.
sentence_zh: 自私的學生通常很快就會失去朋友。

definition_zh: (形) 無私的；不計較的
example_sentence: The selfless nurse who worked through the night saved many lives.
sentence_zh: 那位無私的護士整夜工作，拯救了許多生命。

definition_zh: (片) 出售；變賣
example_sentence: The company decided to sell off its old computers to raise funds.
sentence_zh: 這家公司決定出售其舊電腦以籌集資金。

definition_zh: (片) 推銷；說服（某人接受某想法或產品）
example_sentence: Selling on the idea of saving energy, the club gained many supporters.
sentence_zh: 推銷節能這個想法，該社團獲得了許多支持者。

definition_zh: (片) 售罄；賣光
example_sentence: The concert tickets that the band sold out in minutes were very popular.
sentence_zh: 樂團在幾分鐘內售罄的演唱會門票非常受歡迎。

definition_zh: (片) 賣掉（家業、財產等）
example_sentence: The family who decided to sell up their farm moved to Taipei.
sentence_zh: 那個決定賣掉農場的家庭搬到了台北。

definition_zh: (動) 賣；銷售
example_sentence: The store will sell fresh fruit and vegetables every morning.
sentence_zh: 這家商店每天早上會賣新鮮水果和蔬菜。

definition_zh: (形) 語義的；語義學的
example_sentence: The semantic difference between these two words is very small.
sentence_zh: 這兩個詞之間的語義差異非常小。

definition_zh: (名) 語意學；語意
example_sentence: The semantics of this poem confuse many students.
sentence_zh: 這首詩的語意讓許多學生感到困惑。

definition_zh: (名) 學期
example_sentence: This semester, my best friend and I joined the school's basketball team.
sentence_zh: 這學期，我最好的朋友和我加入了學校的籃球隊。

definition_zh: (名) 準決賽
example_sentence: If our team wins the semi-final, the coach will celebrate with us.
sentence_zh: 如果我們隊贏了準決賽，教練就會和我們一起慶祝。

definition_zh: (名) 半導體
example_sentence: A semiconductor is a material that can conduct electricity under certain conditions.
sentence_zh: 半導體是一種能在特定條件下導電的材料。

definition_zh: (名) 研討會；討論課
example_sentence: The professor will lead a seminar on climate change next Tuesday.
sentence_zh: 教授將在下週二主持一場關於氣候變遷的研討會。

definition_zh: (形) 半寶石的
example_sentence: If a stone is semiprecious, its value often depends on its color.
sentence_zh: 如果一顆石頭是半寶石，它的價值通常取決於其顏色。

definition_zh: (名) 參議院；立法機構
example_sentence: Debating the new bill, the senate delayed the vote until next week.
sentence_zh: 在辯論新法案時，參議院將投票延至下週。

definition_zh: (名) 參議員
example_sentence: Seldom has a senator proposed such a controversial policy.
sentence_zh: 很少有參議員提出如此具爭議性的政策。

definition_zh: (片) 寄回；退還
example_sentence: The jacket that I bought online was sent back due to a wrong size.
sentence_zh: 我在網路上買的那件夾克因為尺寸不對被寄回去了。

definition_zh: (片) 派人去請；派人去拿
example_sentence: Only after the accident did the manager send for an ambulance.
sentence_zh: 只有在事故發生後，經理才派人去叫救護車。

definition_zh: (片) 提交；寄送
example_sentence: Students send in their homework to receive feedback from teachers.
sentence_zh: 學生們交作業以獲得老師的回饋。

definition_zh: (片) 郵購；函索
example_sentence: Bored with local stores, the designer sent off for rare fabric samples.
sentence_zh: 設計師厭倦了當地的商店，便郵購了稀有的布料樣品。

definition_zh: (片) 歡送；寄出
example_sentence: The school will send off the graduating students with a special ceremony.
sentence_zh: 學校將以特別的典禮歡送畢業生。

definition_zh: (片) 訂購（外送食物）
example_sentence: The student who sent out for pizza forgot his wallet.
sentence_zh: 那個訂購披薩的學生忘了帶錢包。

definition_zh: (片) 發出；寄出
example_sentence: Before the party, the club sent out invitations to all members.
sentence_zh: 派對前，社團寄出了邀請函給所有成員。

definition_zh: (片) 發射；使上升
example_sentence: Seldom does the rocket send up a satellite without careful planning.
sentence_zh: 火箭很少在沒有仔細規劃的情況下發射衛星。

definition_zh: (動) 發送；寄
example_sentence: Seldom does the teacher send homework on weekends.
sentence_zh: 老師很少在週末發作業。

definition_zh: (名) 年長者；高年級學生　(形) 年長的；資深的
example_sentence: If a senior student joins the club, younger members will benefit.
sentence_zh: 如果高年級學生加入社團，較年輕的成員將會受益。

definition_zh: (名) 感覺；轟動
example_sentence: The strange sensation of being watched made her nervous.
sentence_zh: 那種被監視的奇怪感覺讓她緊張。

definition_zh: (形) 轟動的；聳人聽聞的
example_sentence: The sensational discovery shocked the entire scientific community.
sentence_zh: 這個轟動的發現震驚了整個科學界。

definition_zh: (名) 感覺；意識　(動) 感覺到；意識到
example_sentence: After the long hike, a strong sense of accomplishment filled the students.
sentence_zh: 長途健行後，強烈的成就感充滿了學生們。

definition_zh: (形) 無意義的；愚蠢的
example_sentence: Watching the news report, the students found the act senseless.
sentence_zh: 觀看新聞報導時，學生們認為這行為毫無意義。

definition_zh: (名) 感受力；敏感度
example_sentence: The artist's sensibility deeply influenced her creative works.
sentence_zh: 這位藝術家的感受力深刻影響了她的創作作品。

definition_zh: (形) 明智的；合理的
example_sentence: A sensible student always reviews notes before taking a test.
sentence_zh: 明智的學生總是在考試前複習筆記。

definition_zh: (副) 明智地；合理地
example_sentence: The school installed more lights to sensibly improve safety at night.
sentence_zh: 學校安裝了更多燈光，以明智地在夜間提升安全。

definition_zh: (形) 敏感的；易受影響的
example_sentence: A sensitive topic like this needs careful handling in class.
sentence_zh: 像這樣一個敏感的話題需要在課堂上小心處理。

definition_zh: (副) 敏感地；細心地
example_sentence: Having been treated sensitively, the rescued dog began to trust humans again.
sentence_zh: 在被細心對待後，那隻獲救的狗開始再次信任人類。

definition_zh: (名) 敏感度；敏感性
example_sentence: The teacher's sensitivity to students' needs made her popular.
sentence_zh: 這位老師對學生需求的敏感度使她受歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 感應器；傳感器
example_sentence: A motion sensor in the room turns on the lights automatically.
sentence_zh: 房間裡的動作感應器會自動打開燈。

definition_zh: (形) 感官的；感覺的
example_sentence: The new sensory garden at school helps students relax during breaks.
sentence_zh: 學校的新感官花園幫助學生在休息時間放鬆。

definition_zh: (名) 句子；判決　(動) 判刑
example_sentence: The judge will sentence the thief to three years in prison.
sentence_zh: 法官將判處這名小偷三年監禁。

definition_zh: (名) 情感；意見
example_sentence: Although the movie received mixed sentiments, its soundtrack won a major award.
sentence_zh: 雖然這部電影獲得褒貶不一的評價，但它的原聲帶贏得了一項大獎。

definition_zh: (形) 感傷的；多愁善感的
example_sentence: The old photos made Grandma feel sentimental about her youth.
sentence_zh: 那些舊照片讓奶奶對她的青春感到感傷。

definition_zh: (形) 可分離的；可分割的
example_sentence: Students use separable verbs to create clearer sentences in writing.
sentence_zh: 學生使用可分離動詞來在寫作中創造更清晰的句子。

definition_zh: (動) [ˋsɛpəˌret] 分開；分離　(形) [ˋsɛpərɪt] 分開的；不同的
example_sentence: Separated from his phone for a day, Mark felt anxious.
sentence_zh: 與手機分開一天，馬克感到焦慮。

definition_zh: (形) 分開的；分離的　(動) 分開；隔離
example_sentence: The twins, who were separated at birth, finally met last year.
sentence_zh: 這對雙胞胎在出生時被分開，去年終於見面了。

definition_zh: (副) 分開地；個別地
example_sentence: The students worked on their projects separately to avoid copying.
sentence_zh: 學生們分開做他們的專題，以避免抄襲。

definition_zh: (名) 分離；分開
example_sentence: Fearing separation from his friends, Tom cried at the airport.
sentence_zh: 因為害怕和朋友分離，湯姆在機場哭了。

definition_zh: (名) 分離主義
example_sentence: The government strictly opposes any form of separatism in the region.
sentence_zh: 政府嚴格反對該地區任何形式的分離主義。

definition_zh: (名) 分離主義者
example_sentence: The separatist group's actions threatened the country's stability.
sentence_zh: 這個分離主義團體的行動威脅了國家的穩定。

definition_zh: (名) 九月
example_sentence: School starts in September, and students prepare for new classes.
sentence_zh: 學校在九月開學，學生們為新課程做準備。

definition_zh: (名) 續集；後續
example_sentence: The movie sequel that everyone has been waiting for finally comes out next month.
sentence_zh: 那部大家一直在等待的電影續集終於在下個月上映。

definition_zh: (名) 順序；連續　(動) 按順序排列
example_sentence: Following the correct sequence of steps, the experiment succeeded.
sentence_zh: 遵循正確的步驟順序，實驗成功了。

definition_zh: (形) 偶然的；幸運的
example_sentence: A serendipitous meeting with a tutor helped Lisa improve her English.
sentence_zh: 與一位老師的偶然相遇幫助麗莎提升了她的英文。

definition_zh: (名) 意外發現的驚喜；機緣巧合
example_sentence: If a lucky accident occurred, the discovery would be serendipity.
sentence_zh: 如果一個幸運的意外發生了，這個發現就是意外之喜。

definition_zh: (形) 寧靜的；平靜的
example_sentence: The serene lake reflected the clear blue sky above the mountains.
sentence_zh: 寧靜的湖面倒映著山巒上方清澈的藍天。

definition_zh: (名) 士官；中士
example_sentence: The sergeant who trained our team was very strict.
sentence_zh: 訓練我們隊伍的士官非常嚴格。

definition_zh: (名) 連續劇；系列　(形) 連續的；一系列的
example_sentence: The police are investigating a serial of thefts in the neighborhood.
sentence_zh: 警方正在調查社區內的一連串偷竊案。

definition_zh: (名) 系列；連續
example_sentence: The school organized a series of workshops on environmental protection.
sentence_zh: 學校組織了一系列關於環境保護的工作坊。

definition_zh: (形) 嚴重的；嚴肅的
example_sentence: To solve the serious problem, the team worked all night.
sentence_zh: 為了解決這個嚴重的問題，團隊工作了一整夜。

definition_zh: (副) 嚴肅地；認真地
example_sentence: Taking this exam seriously is important for your future.
sentence_zh: 認真看待這場考試對你的未來很重要。

definition_zh: (名) 說教；佈道
example_sentence: Never have I heard such a boring sermon from the teacher.
sentence_zh: 我從未聽過老師如此無聊的說教。

definition_zh: (名) 蛇（尤指大蛇）
example_sentence: When the old man saw the serpent in the garden, he called for help.
sentence_zh: 當老人看到花園裡的那條大蛇時，他大聲呼救。

definition_zh: (名) 血清；精華液
example_sentence: Using this serum daily improves skin hydration and brightness.
sentence_zh: 每天使用這種精華液可以改善皮膚保濕和光澤。

definition_zh: (名) 僕人；傭人
example_sentence: The loyal servant who worked for the family was very kind.
sentence_zh: 那位為這個家庭工作的忠實僕人非常友善。

definition_zh: (片) 擔任；充當
example_sentence: When the teacher is absent, the class monitor will serve as a substitute.
sentence_zh: 當老師缺席時，班長將擔任代課者。

definition_zh: (片) 提供；端上
example_sentence: The cafeteria workers serve up rice and three dishes every lunch.
sentence_zh: 自助餐廳的工作人員每天午餐提供米飯和三道菜。

definition_zh: (片) 有用；有幫助
example_sentence: Learning to communicate clearly will serve well in future careers.
sentence_zh: 學習清楚溝通將在未來職業中很有幫助。

definition_zh: (動) 服務；提供
example_sentence: The student council serves the school by organizing events.
sentence_zh: 學生會透過舉辦活動來服務學校。

definition_zh: (名) 伺服器；服務員
example_sentence: The server that crashed during the exam caused a lot of problems.
sentence_zh: 考試期間當機的伺服器造成了很多問題。

definition_zh: (名) 服務；維修　(動) 維修；為…服務
example_sentence: The customer service at this store is always friendly and helpful.
sentence_zh: 這家商店的客戶服務總是友善且樂於助人。

definition_zh: (名) 軍人；服務人員
example_sentence: Although a serviceman works hard, his family often worries about his safety.
sentence_zh: 雖然軍人工作辛苦，但他的家人經常擔心他的安全。

definition_zh: (名) 一份（食物或飲料）　(動) 服務；供應（serve的現在分詞）
example_sentence: A single serving of this snack contains too much sugar.
sentence_zh: 這種零食的一份含有太多糖分。

definition_zh: (名) 會議；一場
example_sentence: After the first session ended, the students discussed the key points.
sentence_zh: 第一場會議結束後，學生們討論了重點。

definition_zh: (片) 開始；著手
example_sentence: After finishing her homework, Emily set about cleaning her room.
sentence_zh: 做完作業後，艾蜜莉開始打掃她的房間。

definition_zh: (片) 使…與眾不同；區分；撥出（時間或金錢）
example_sentence: The qualities that set apart a great leader are integrity and vision.
sentence_zh: 使偉大領袖與眾不同的特質是正直與遠見。

definition_zh: (片) 撥出；留出
example_sentence: Every student should set aside some time for daily exercise.
sentence_zh: 每個學生都應該每天撥出一些時間運動。

definition_zh: (片) 延後；耽擱
example_sentence: Many students set back their study plans to prepare for the exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生為了準備考試而延後他們的讀書計畫。

definition_zh: (片) 提出；闡述；出發
example_sentence: Before the debate, the team set forth their main arguments clearly.
sentence_zh: 辯論前，團隊清楚地闡述了他們的主要論點。

definition_zh: (片) 開始；來臨
example_sentence: The rainy season has set in earlier than usual this year.
sentence_zh: 今年雨季比往年提早來臨。

definition_zh: (片) 出發；引爆；引起
example_sentence: Setting off early in the morning, the hikers avoided the midday heat.
sentence_zh: 一大早出發，登山者避開了正午的炎熱。

definition_zh: (片) 決心；開始（做某事）
example_sentence: The students set on a plan to clean up the school garden after class.
sentence_zh: 學生們決心在課後清理校園花園。

definition_zh: (片) 下定決心；專注於
example_sentence: Many students set their minds on studying abroad to broaden their horizons.
sentence_zh: 許多學生下定決心出國留學，以拓展視野。

definition_zh: (片) 出發；開始；陳列
example_sentence: The young scientist set out to find a cure for the disease.
sentence_zh: 這位年輕科學家出發去尋找這種疾病的治療方法。

definition_zh: (片) 準備好；著手
example_sentence: The team is set to launch its new app next month.
sentence_zh: 這個團隊準備在下個月推出他們的新應用程式。

definition_zh: (片) 建立；設置；安排
example_sentence: Before the science fair, our team decided to set up the experiment carefully.
sentence_zh: 在科學展覽之前，我們團隊決定仔細設置實驗。

definition_zh: (名) 布置；安排
example_sentence: The science fair set-up required careful planning by the students.
sentence_zh: 科展的布置需要學生們仔細規劃。

definition_zh: (動) 放置；設定　(名) 一套；組
example_sentence: Having set the table for dinner, the family sat down together.
sentence_zh: 擺好晚餐的餐桌後，全家人一起坐下。

definition_zh: (名) 挫折；阻礙
example_sentence: Facing a major setback, the team decided to revise their strategy.
sentence_zh: 面對重大挫折，團隊決定修改策略。

definition_zh: (名) 環境；背景
example_sentence: The peaceful setting of the park helps students relax after exams.
sentence_zh: 公園寧靜的環境幫助學生在考試後放鬆。

definition_zh: (片) 定居；安定下來
example_sentence: After graduation, many students settle down in big cities for job opportunities.
sentence_zh: 畢業後，許多學生為了工作機會在大城市定居下來。

definition_zh: (片) 勉強接受；將就
example_sentence: Many students settle for a lower score to avoid extra stress.
sentence_zh: 許多學生為了避免額外壓力而勉強接受較低的分數。

definition_zh: (片) 安頓下來；適應新環境
example_sentence: Many international students take a language course to settle in before classes begin.
sentence_zh: 許多國際學生在開課前修讀語言課程，以便適應環境。

definition_zh: (片) 決定；選定
example_sentence: If the team cannot settle on a plan, the project will fail.
sentence_zh: 如果團隊無法就一個計劃達成一致，這個項目就會失敗。

definition_zh: (片) 結清帳款；付清欠款
example_sentence: After the group dinner, everyone had to settle up before leaving the restaurant.
sentence_zh: 在團體晚餐後，每個人都必須在離開餐廳前結清帳款。

definition_zh: (動) 解決；安頓
example_sentence: After the debate, the committee will settle the final decision.
sentence_zh: 辯論結束後，委員會將確定最終決定。

definition_zh: (動) 解決；定居
example_sentence: The students settled the argument before the teacher arrived.
sentence_zh: 學生們在老師到達之前解決了爭論。

definition_zh: (名) 解決；協議；定居點
example_sentence: Only after the long negotiation did the two sides reach a settlement.
sentence_zh: 只有在漫長的談判之後，雙方達成了和解。

definition_zh: (名) 定居者；殖民者
example_sentence: The early settler built a small house near the river.
sentence_zh: 早期的定居者在河邊蓋了一間小房子。

definition_zh: (名) 設置；安排
example_sentence: The quick setup of the new app impressed every student in the class.
sentence_zh: 新應用程式的快速設置給班上每位學生留下了深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 七；七個　(形) 七的；七個的
example_sentence: The seven students in the group finished their project early.
sentence_zh: 小組裡的七名學生提早完成了他們的專題。

definition_zh: (名) 十七
example_sentence: After saving seventeen dollars, the student bought a new notebook.
sentence_zh: 在存了十七美元後，那名學生買了一本新筆記本。

definition_zh: (形) 第七的；(名) 第七；七分之一
example_sentence: Students study hard to secure seventh place in the national competition.
sentence_zh: 學生們努力學習，以在全國比賽中確保第七名。

definition_zh: (名) 七十
example_sentence: If the school had seventy more computers, each student could use one.
sentence_zh: 如果學校再多七十台電腦，每個學生就能使用一台。

definition_zh: (動) 切斷；中斷
example_sentence: If a typhoon severs the power lines, the school will close.
sentence_zh: 如果颱風切斷電線，學校就會關閉。

definition_zh: (形) 幾個的；若干的
example_sentence: Several students in my class joined the school's English club.
sentence_zh: 我們班上有好幾個學生加入了學校的英語社團。

definition_zh: (形) 嚴重的；嚴厲的
example_sentence: Students must take severe measures to prepare for the final exam.
sentence_zh: 學生必須採取嚴厲的措施來準備期末考試。

definition_zh: (副) 嚴重地；劇烈地
example_sentence: If the typhoon severely damages the crops, food prices may rise.
sentence_zh: 如果颱風嚴重損害農作物，食物價格可能會上漲。

definition_zh: (名) 嚴重；嚴厲
example_sentence: The severity of the storm, which surprised many residents, caused widespread damage.
sentence_zh: 這場暴風雨的嚴重性讓許多居民驚訝，並造成了廣泛的破壞。

definition_zh: (動) 縫；縫製
example_sentence: Before the festival, my grandmother taught me how to sew a traditional dress.
sentence_zh: 在節日前，我的祖母教我如何縫製傳統服裝。

definition_zh: (名) [ˈsuɚ] 下水道；污水管　(動) [ˈsoɚ] 縫製；縫合
example_sentence: If the sewer overflowed, the neighborhood would face serious flooding.
sentence_zh: 如果下水道溢流，社區將面臨嚴重的洪水。

definition_zh: (動) 美化；使更吸引人
example_sentence: The movie tried to sex up the historical story with romantic scenes.
sentence_zh: 這部電影試圖用浪漫場景來美化歷史故事。

definition_zh: (名) 性；性別
example_sentence: Many students study sex education to understand human relationships better.
sentence_zh: 許多學生學習性教育是為了更了解人際關係。

definition_zh: (形) 性的；性別的
example_sentence: Sexual education in schools helps teenagers understand their bodies.
sentence_zh: 學校的性教育幫助青少年了解自己的身體。

definition_zh: (名) 性傾向；性特質
example_sentence: Many students attend lectures to explore their own sexuality and identity.
sentence_zh: 許多學生參加講座，以探索自己的性傾向與認同。

definition_zh: (副) 性別上地；與性有關地
example_sentence: The movie was criticized for its sexually suggestive scenes.
sentence_zh: 這部電影因其帶有性暗示的場景而受到批評。

definition_zh: (形) 性感的；迷人的
example_sentence: The new perfume advertisement was considered too sexy for school.
sentence_zh: 這個新的香水廣告被認為對學校來說太過性感。

definition_zh: (形) 破舊的；簡陋的
example_sentence: The shabby chair in the classroom finally broke during the test.
sentence_zh: 教室裡那張破舊的椅子終於在考試期間壞掉了。

definition_zh: (片) 同居；隨意住在一起
example_sentence: Shacking up with friends before college can save money.
sentence_zh: 上大學前和朋友同居可以省錢。

definition_zh: (名) 棚屋；簡陋小屋
example_sentence: Many students use a small shack near the school as a quiet study room.
sentence_zh: 許多學生利用學校附近的小棚屋作為安靜的讀書空間。

definition_zh: (片) 塗暗；畫陰影
example_sentence: The artist who uses a soft pencil will shade in the drawing.
sentence_zh: 使用軟鉛筆的藝術家會將圖畫的陰影塗上。

definition_zh: (名) 陰涼處；樹蔭　(動) 遮蔽；遮光
example_sentence: Students often sit in the shade of the banyan tree to study.
sentence_zh: 學生們常坐在榕樹的樹蔭下讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 影子；陰影　(動) 跟蹤；遮蔽
example_sentence: If a dark shadow followed her, Maria would feel scared.
sentence_zh: 如果一個黑影跟著她，瑪麗亞會感到害怕。

definition_zh: (形) 陰涼的；可疑的
example_sentence: Students found a shady spot under the tree to study.
sentence_zh: 學生們在樹下找到一個陰涼的地方讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 軸；柄
example_sentence: The long metal shaft that supports the ceiling fan needs repair.
sentence_zh: 支撐吊扇的那根長金屬軸需要修理。

definition_zh: (形) 毛茸茸的；蓬鬆的
example_sentence: The shaggy dog ran through the muddy park after school.
sentence_zh: 那隻毛茸茸的狗放學後跑過了泥濘的公園。

definition_zh: (動) 勒索；敲詐
example_sentence: The gang that tried to shake down local shops was arrested.
sentence_zh: 那個試圖向當地商店勒索的幫派被逮捕了。

definition_zh: (片) 擺脫；甩掉
example_sentence: Never could the team shake off their recent losing streak.
sentence_zh: 這支隊伍從未能擺脫最近連敗的陰影。

definition_zh: (片) 抖出；抖落
example_sentence: Shaking out the dusty rug, the student sneezed loudly.
sentence_zh: 抖掉那塊滿是灰塵的地毯時，學生大聲打了個噴嚏。

definition_zh: (動) 搖動；整頓；使震驚　(片) 動搖；徹底改革
example_sentence: The new principal decided to shake up the school by changing the rules.
sentence_zh: 新校長決定透過改變規則來整頓學校。

definition_zh: (名) 改組；整頓
example_sentence: After the company's poor performance, a major shake-up occurred in management.
sentence_zh: 在公司表現不佳之後，管理階層發生了一次重大改組。

definition_zh: (動) 搖晃；震動　(名) 搖動；震動
example_sentence: The earthquake made the whole building shake violently.
sentence_zh: 地震使整棟建築物劇烈搖晃。

definition_zh: (助) 將；會
example_sentence: If the teacher shall assign extra homework, the students would complete it.
sentence_zh: 如果老師會指派額外作業，學生們就會完成它。

definition_zh: (形) 淺的；淺薄的
example_sentence: Having only a shallow understanding of history, the student misread the article.
sentence_zh: 由於對歷史只有淺薄的理解，這位學生誤讀了文章。

definition_zh: (名) 騙局；虛假的事物　(動) 假裝；冒充　(形) 虛假的
example_sentence: Although the product looked promising, the entire design was a sham.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個產品看起來很有前景，但整個設計是個騙局。

definition_zh: (動) 蹣跚地走；拖著腳步走
example_sentence: Many students shamble to school to avoid morning traffic.
sentence_zh: 許多學生為了避開早晨的交通而拖著腳步上學。

definition_zh: (名) 羞愧；恥辱
example_sentence: The student felt great shame after cheating on the test.
sentence_zh: 這個學生在考試作弊後感到極大的羞愧。

definition_zh: (形) 可恥的；羞愧的
example_sentence: The student felt shameful after cheating on the exam.
sentence_zh: 那名學生在考試作弊後感到羞愧。

definition_zh: (名) 洗髮精；洗髮乳
example_sentence: This shampoo leaves my hair soft and shiny.
sentence_zh: 這瓶洗髮精讓我的頭髮柔軟又有光澤。

definition_zh: (片) 改善；好轉；振作起來
example_sentence: Unless this project shapes up soon, the manager will cancel it.
sentence_zh: 除非這個專案很快有起色，否則經理會取消它。

definition_zh: (動) 塑造；形成　(名) 形狀；外形
example_sentence: Regular exercise helps shape a healthy body and mind.
sentence_zh: 規律的運動有助於塑造健康的身心。

definition_zh: (形) 塑造的；成形的
example_sentence: Shaped by strict school rules, students learn to follow orders.
sentence_zh: 受到嚴格的校規塑造，學生學會遵守命令。

definition_zh: (片) 分享；分擔
example_sentence: Students share in the responsibility for keeping the classroom clean.
sentence_zh: 學生共同分擔保持教室整潔的責任。

definition_zh: (片) 分配；分攤
example_sentence: The teacher asked the group to share out the work fairly.
sentence_zh: 老師要求小組公平地分攤工作。

definition_zh: (動) 分享；分配
example_sentence: The students share their lunch with friends every day.
sentence_zh: 學生們每天和朋友分享午餐。

definition_zh: (名) 股東
example_sentence: The company's shareholders voted to approve the new environmental policy.
sentence_zh: 該公司的股東投票通過了新的環保政策。

definition_zh: (名) 鯊魚
example_sentence: The shark that swam near the beach scared many swimmers.
sentence_zh: 那隻在海灘附近游動的鯊魚嚇壞了許多游泳者。

definition_zh: (形) 銳利的；鋒利的　(副) 準時地；突然地
example_sentence: Having sharp eyes, the eagle spotted its prey from a great distance.
sentence_zh: 擁有銳利的眼睛，老鷹從很遠的距離就發現了獵物。

definition_zh: (動) 磨利；使鋒利
example_sentence: The chef's knife, which needs to be sharpened, cuts vegetables slowly.
sentence_zh: 廚師的刀需要磨利，切蔬菜很慢。

definition_zh: (副) 嚴厲地；急劇地
example_sentence: The teacher criticized the student sharply for not finishing homework.
sentence_zh: 老師嚴厲批評學生沒有完成作業。

definition_zh: (動) 粉碎；震碎
example_sentence: The loud noise from the construction site could shatter the window glass.
sentence_zh: 來自工地的巨大噪音可能會震碎窗戶玻璃。

definition_zh: (動) 剃除；削減
example_sentence: Many students shave from their schedules unnecessary activities to focus on studies.
sentence_zh: 許多學生從他們的行程中剃除不必要的活動，以專注於學業。

definition_zh: (片) 刮掉；剃掉
example_sentence: The barber who shaves off his beard is very skilled.
sentence_zh: 那位刮掉鬍子的理髮師技術很好。

definition_zh: (動) 刮鬍子；剃毛
example_sentence: My father uses an electric razor to shave every morning.
sentence_zh: 我父親每天早上用電動刮鬍刀刮鬍子。

definition_zh: (名) 刮鬍刀；剃鬚刀
example_sentence: My father bought a new electric shaver for his morning routine.
sentence_zh: 我父親為他的早晨例行公事買了一個新的電動刮鬍刀。

definition_zh: (名) 刨花；削屑
example_sentence: The carpenter swept the wood shavings from the floor.
sentence_zh: 木匠把地板上的木屑掃乾淨。

definition_zh: (名) 披肩；圍巾
example_sentence: Because the wind was strong, Emily wrapped a shawl around her shoulders.
sentence_zh: 因為風很大，艾蜜莉把一條披肩裹在肩上。

definition_zh: (代) 她
example_sentence: She saves money to buy a new laptop for online classes.
sentence_zh: 她為了線上課程存錢買一台新筆電。

definition_zh: (名) 棚子；小屋　(動) 脫落；流出
example_sentence: The old shed behind the school was torn down last week.
sentence_zh: 學校後面的舊棚子上周被拆除了。

definition_zh: (名) 光澤；光輝
example_sentence: Polishing the wooden floor, the cleaner restored its sheen.
sentence_zh: 清潔工擦亮木地板，恢復了它的光澤。

definition_zh: (名) 羊；綿羊
example_sentence: The sheep that belongs to the farmer is very friendly.
sentence_zh: 那隻屬於農夫的羊非常友善。

definition_zh: (名) 牧羊犬
example_sentence: The farmer trained a young sheepdog to herd the sheep in the field.
sentence_zh: 農夫訓練了一隻年輕的牧羊犬，以便在田野中驅趕羊群。

definition_zh: (形) 純粹的；完全的；陡峭的
example_sentence: The sheer size of the campus surprised every new student.
sentence_zh: 校園的龐大規模讓每位新生感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (名) 床單；一張（紙）
example_sentence: The sheet that the teacher gave us was very difficult.
sentence_zh: 老師給我們的那張考卷非常難。

definition_zh: (名) 架子；層架
example_sentence: The top shelf in the kitchen holds many cups and plates.
sentence_zh: 廚房裡的最高層架子放著許多杯子和盤子。

definition_zh: (片) 支付；掏錢
example_sentence: My parents had to shell out a lot of money for my summer camp.
sentence_zh: 我的父母不得不為我的夏令營支付一大筆錢。

definition_zh: (名) 殼；貝殼　(動) 剝殼；去殼
example_sentence: The turtle that found a big shell on the beach looked safe.
sentence_zh: 那隻在沙灘上找到一個大殼的海龜看起來很安全。

definition_zh: (名) 避難所；遮蔽物　(動) 庇護；遮蔽
example_sentence: The old shelter near the park provides safety for stray animals.
sentence_zh: 公園附近的那個舊避難所為流浪動物提供安全。

definition_zh: (名) 惡作劇；詭計
example_sentence: The teacher stopped the student's shenanigan during class.
sentence_zh: 老師在課堂上制止了學生的惡作劇。

definition_zh: (名) 惡作劇；詭計

sentence_zh: 大聲呼救後，這位迷路的登山客終於引起了一名路人的注意。

sentence_zh: 演唱會結束時，人群開始推擠。

sentence_zh: 如果學生的努力沒有表現出來，老師會感到失望。

definition_zh: (片) 出現；露面

sentence_zh: 如果老師展現更多耐心，學生就會問更多問題。

sentence_zh: 學生們常在晨間運動後快速沖個澡。

sentence_zh: 雖然這件裙子很花俏，瑪麗亞還是選擇它去參加派對。

sentence_zh: 廚師決定將高麗菜切碎做沙拉。

sentence_zh: 用霧氣籠罩舞台後，工作人員為開場做準備。

definition_zh: (片) 擺脫；不當一回事

definition_zh: (動) 聳肩（表示不在乎、不知道或無奈）

definition_zh: (名) 快門；百葉窗

definition_zh: (名) 接駁車；穿梭交通
