definition_zh: (名) 兄弟姊妹；手足
example_sentence: Seldom does a single sibling get to enjoy the whole cake alone.
sentence_zh: 很少有獨生子女能獨自享用整塊蛋糕。

definition_zh: (形) 生病的；噁心的
example_sentence: The sick student stayed home from school yesterday.
sentence_zh: 那位生病的學生昨天請假待在家裡。

definition_zh: (形) 多病的；虛弱的
example_sentence: The sickly kitten needed special care from the vet.
sentence_zh: 這隻生病的小貓需要獸醫的特別照顧。

definition_zh: (名) 疾病；不適
example_sentence: Feeling a sudden sickness, the student asked for permission to visit the nurse.
sentence_zh: 感到突然的不適，這名學生請求允許去保健室。

definition_zh: (名) 小三；情婦
example_sentence: The rumor about a side chick spread quickly through the school.
sentence_zh: 關於小三的謠言很快在學校傳開。

definition_zh: (名) 配菜；小菜
example_sentence: A cold side dish like coleslaw is often served with fried chicken.
sentence_zh: 像涼拌高麗菜這樣的冷盤配菜常與炸雞一起上桌。

definition_zh: (名) 副作用
example_sentence: Taking this medicine may cause a serious side effect like dizziness.
sentence_zh: 服用這種藥可能會引起像頭暈這樣的嚴重副作用。

definition_zh: (片) 支持；站在……一邊
example_sentence: Siding with her friend, the student defended the group project idea.
sentence_zh: 這個學生站在朋友這邊，為小組專題的想法辯護。

definition_zh: (名) 邊；側面　(動) 支持；站在…一邊　(形) 側面的；次要的
example_sentence: The students moved to the side to let the teacher pass.
sentence_zh: 學生們移到旁邊讓老師通過。

definition_zh: (名) 隨身武器；腰間佩槍
example_sentence: The police officer drew her sidearm during the training exercise.
sentence_zh: 警察在訓練演習中拔出了她的隨身武器。

definition_zh: (動) 使退出；使靠邊站　(名) 邊線；次要角色
example_sentence: The coach decided to sideline the injured player for the rest of the game.
sentence_zh: 教練決定讓受傷的球員在比賽剩下的時間裡退場。

definition_zh: (名) 人行道
example_sentence: The old sidewalk needs repair after heavy rain.
sentence_zh: 這條舊人行道在大雨後需要修繕。

definition_zh: (副) 斜向一邊地；側面地
example_sentence: Having glanced sideways at the test answers, the student felt guilty.
sentence_zh: 瞥了一眼旁邊的考試答案後，那名學生感到內疚。

definition_zh: (片) 悄悄靠近；溜到…旁邊
example_sentence: The shy student sidled up to the teacher after class.
sentence_zh: 害羞的學生在課後悄悄走近老師。

definition_zh: (名) 圍攻；包圍
example_sentence: The city ended the siege after weeks of heavy fighting.
sentence_zh: 該城市在數週的激烈戰鬥後結束了圍攻。

definition_zh: (名) 篩子；濾網　(動) 篩；過濾
example_sentence: The chef uses a fine sieve to separate the flour from the lumps.
sentence_zh: 主廚用一個細篩子將麵粉和結塊分開。

definition_zh: (片) 篩選；仔細查看
example_sentence: While the students sift through the data, the teacher explains the results.
sentence_zh: 當學生仔細篩選資料時，老師解釋結果。

definition_zh: (動) 篩；過濾
example_sentence: The chef used a fine mesh strainer to sift the flour for the cake.
sentence_zh: 主廚用細網篩子篩麵粉做蛋糕。

definition_zh: (名) 嘆息；嘆氣　(動) 嘆息；嘆氣
example_sentence: The teacher let out a deep sigh after the noisy class.
sentence_zh: 老師在吵鬧的課後發出一聲深深的嘆息。

definition_zh: (名) 視力；景象；景點　(動) 看見；觀看
example_sentence: Sightseeing in the city, the students enjoyed the famous sights.
sentence_zh: 在城市觀光時，學生們享受了著名的景點。

definition_zh: (名) 目擊；看見
example_sentence: Sighting a rare bird, the students recorded its behavior for their science project.
sentence_zh: 看到一隻罕見的鳥，學生們記錄了牠的行為作為他們的科學專題。

definition_zh: (名) 觀光；遊覽
example_sentence: The family spent the whole afternoon sightseeing in the old town.
sentence_zh: 這家人花了整個下午在舊城區觀光。

definition_zh: (片) 簽字放棄；簽字讓與
example_sentence: If a student signs away the scholarship, the school will revoke the offer.
sentence_zh: 如果學生簽署放棄獎學金，學校將撤銷該錄取資格。

definition_zh: (片) 簽收；簽名表示收到
example_sentence: The delivery man who came to sign for the package was very polite.
sentence_zh: 前來簽收包裹的送貨員非常有禮貌。

definition_zh: (片) 登入；簽到
example_sentence: Signing in with a student ID makes the process faster.
sentence_zh: 使用學生證登入可以加快流程。

definition_zh: (片) 登入；註冊
example_sentence: Students must sign into the online learning platform before class.
sentence_zh: 學生必須在上課前登入線上學習平台。

definition_zh: (名) 手語
example_sentence: Learning sign language helps deaf students communicate with their teachers.
sentence_zh: 學習手語幫助聽障學生與老師溝通。

definition_zh: (片) 批准；認可
example_sentence: Before the project starts, the manager must sign off on the budget.
sentence_zh: 在專案開始前，經理必須批准預算。

definition_zh: (片) 簽退；結束廣播或通訊
example_sentence: Signing off the broadcast, the news anchor reminded viewers to stay safe.
sentence_zh: 簽退廣播時，新聞主播提醒觀眾注意安全。

definition_zh: (片) 與...簽約；加入
example_sentence: Many students sign on with cram schools to improve their test scores.
sentence_zh: 許多學生與補習班簽約以提高考試成績。

definition_zh: (片) 報名；簽署
example_sentence: Many students sign on for after-school tutoring to improve their grades.
sentence_zh: 許多學生報名參加課後輔導以提升成績。

definition_zh: (片) 登出（帳號、系統）
example_sentence: Students must sign out of their accounts before leaving the computer lab.
sentence_zh: 學生在離開電腦教室前必須登出他們的帳號。

definition_zh: (片) 登出；簽退
example_sentence: Students who forget to sign out of the library system will be fined.
sentence_zh: 忘記登出圖書館系統的學生將被罰款。

definition_zh: (片) 報名；簽約
example_sentence: If more students signed up for the club, the activities would be more diverse.
sentence_zh: 如果有更多學生報名參加社團，活動會更多元。

definition_zh: (片) 與……簽約；簽署
example_sentence: Many students sign with a tutor to improve their grades.
sentence_zh: 許多學生為了提升成績而與家教簽約。

definition_zh: (動) 簽名；簽署　(名) 標誌；招牌
example_sentence: If you sign the form, the teacher will accept your late homework.
sentence_zh: 如果你簽了表格，老師就會接受你遲交的作業。

definition_zh: (名) 信號；標誌　(動) 發信號；標誌
example_sentence: The traffic signal turned red, so the driver stopped the car.
sentence_zh: 交通號誌轉為紅燈，所以駕駛人停車。

definition_zh: (名) 簽名；署名
example_sentence: The student's signature on the permission slip was required for the field trip.
sentence_zh: 學生在許可單上的簽名是校外教學所必需的。

definition_zh: (形) 重要的；意義重大的
example_sentence: If the school made a significant change, students would benefit greatly.
sentence_zh: 如果學校做出重大的改變，學生們將受益匪淺。

definition_zh: (名) 重要性；意義
example_sentence: The significance of this discovery was not fully understood by the students.
sentence_zh: 這項發現的重要性並未被學生們完全理解。

definition_zh: (副) 顯著地；重要地
example_sentence: Eating more vegetables can significantly improve your health.
sentence_zh: 多吃蔬菜能顯著改善你的健康。

definition_zh: (動) 表示；意味著
example_sentence: Students raise their hands to signify agreement during class discussions.
sentence_zh: 學生在課堂討論中舉手表示同意。

definition_zh: (名) 安靜；沉默　(動) 使安靜；壓制
example_sentence: The silence in the library helped students focus on their homework.
sentence_zh: 圖書館裡的安靜幫助學生專注於他們的作業。

definition_zh: (形) 沉默的；安靜的
example_sentence: Sitting silent in the library, the student finished his homework quickly.
sentence_zh: 靜靜坐在圖書館裡，那名學生很快完成了作業。

definition_zh: (名) 剪影；輪廓
example_sentence: Having seen her silhouette against the sunset, the photographer pressed the shutter.
sentence_zh: 看到她在日落下的剪影後，攝影師按下了快門。

definition_zh: (名) 矽；矽元素
example_sentence: The silicon chip inside a smartphone processes millions of commands every second.
sentence_zh: 智慧型手機內的矽晶片每秒處理數百萬個指令。

definition_zh: (名) 絲；絲綢
example_sentence: The silk scarf that my grandmother gave me feels very smooth.
sentence_zh: 我祖母送我的那條絲巾摸起來非常光滑。

definition_zh: (名) 蠶
example_sentence: When the silkworm spins its cocoon, farmers carefully collect the silk threads.
sentence_zh: 當蠶吐絲結繭時，農民會仔細收集蠶絲。

definition_zh: (形) 愚蠢的；可笑的
example_sentence: The silly joke made the whole class laugh loudly.
sentence_zh: 那個愚蠢的笑話讓全班大笑。

definition_zh: (名) 銀；銀色　(形) 銀製的；銀色的
example_sentence: If the silver necklace tarnishes, the store will replace it.
sentence_zh: 如果這條銀項鍊變色，商店會更換它。

definition_zh: (名) 銀器；銀餐具
example_sentence: The chef carefully placed the silverware on the dining table.
sentence_zh: 主廚小心地將銀器餐具放在餐桌上。

definition_zh: (形) 相似的；類似的
example_sentence: This math problem is similar to the one we did yesterday.
sentence_zh: 這道數學題和我們昨天做的那道很相似。

definition_zh: (名) 相似；類似
example_sentence: Seldom does a similarity exist between the two paintings.
sentence_zh: 這兩幅畫之間很少存在相似之處。

definition_zh: (副) 類似地；同樣地
example_sentence: Students should manage their time similarly to achieve better grades.
sentence_zh: 學生應該類似地管理他們的時間，以獲得更好的成績。

definition_zh: (片) 冷靜下來；平息怒氣
example_sentence: The students simmered down after the teacher entered the classroom.
sentence_zh: 老師進入教室後，學生們冷靜了下來。

definition_zh: (動) 慢煮；燉
example_sentence: Many students let the soup simmer to develop richer flavors.
sentence_zh: 許多學生讓湯慢煮以發展更濃郁的味道。

definition_zh: (形) 簡單的；樸素的
example_sentence: The instructions for the game are simple and easy to follow.
sentence_zh: 這款遊戲的說明簡單且容易遵循。

definition_zh: (名) 簡單；簡樸
example_sentence: The simplicity of the solution surprised the entire class.
sentence_zh: 這個解決方案的簡單性讓全班同學都感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (動) 簡化
example_sentence: The new app helps simplify the process of booking train tickets.
sentence_zh: 這個新應用程式有助於簡化訂火車票的流程。

definition_zh: (形) 過於簡單化的；簡單化的
example_sentence: The teacher found the student's analysis too simplistic for the project.
sentence_zh: 老師認為學生的分析對這個專案來說過於簡單化。

definition_zh: (片) 簡單地說；簡而言之
example_sentence: Simply put, the new policy will reduce homework stress for students.
sentence_zh: 簡單來說，這項新政策將減輕學生的作業壓力。

definition_zh: (副) 僅僅；簡直
example_sentence: To solve this math problem is simply a matter of practice.
sentence_zh: 解決這個數學問題只是練習的問題。

definition_zh: (動) 模擬；模仿
example_sentence: The science class used a computer program to simulate a volcanic eruption.
sentence_zh: 科學課用電腦程式模擬火山爆發。

definition_zh: (名) 模擬；模擬操作
example_sentence: The flight simulation gave students a realistic experience of piloting an airplane.
sentence_zh: 這次飛行模擬讓學生體驗到駕駛飛機的真實感受。

definition_zh: (形) 同時的；同步的
example_sentence: The simultaneous translation service helped the audience understand the speech.
sentence_zh: 同步翻譯服務幫助觀眾理解演講。

definition_zh: (副) 同時地
example_sentence: The students simultaneously solved the math problems while listening to music.
sentence_zh: 學生們同時解數學題目並聽音樂。

definition_zh: (名) 罪；罪惡
example_sentence: The sin of lying can damage a friendship that lasts for years.
sentence_zh: 說謊的罪過會傷害維持多年的友誼。

definition_zh: (介) 自從；從...以來　(連) 因為；既然；自從
example_sentence: Since the exam is next week, students study hard to prepare.
sentence_zh: 既然考試在下週，學生們努力學習以做準備。

definition_zh: (形) 真誠的；誠摯的
example_sentence: A sincere apology can often repair a broken friendship.
sentence_zh: 真誠的道歉往往能修補一段破碎的友誼。

definition_zh: (副) 真誠地；誠摯地
example_sentence: The student sincerely thanked her teacher for the helpful advice.
sentence_zh: 這位學生真誠地感謝老師提供有用的建議。

definition_zh: (名) 真誠；誠摯
example_sentence: Her sincerity in helping others earned her the respect of the whole class.
sentence_zh: 她幫助他人的真誠贏得了全班同學的尊敬。

definition_zh: (片) 跟著唱；一起唱
example_sentence: The whole class likes to sing along to popular English songs.
sentence_zh: 全班都喜歡跟著唱流行英文歌曲。

definition_zh: (片) 大聲唱；大聲說出
example_sentence: If the choir director asked for volunteers, Maria would sing out bravely.
sentence_zh: 如果合唱團指揮徵求志願者，瑪麗亞會勇敢地大聲唱出來。

definition_zh: (片) 報名；登記參加
example_sentence: Having sung up for the talent show, Maria felt nervous.
sentence_zh: 報名參加才藝表演後，瑪麗亞感到緊張。

definition_zh: (動) 唱；唱歌
example_sentence: The little girl sings a happy song every morning.
sentence_zh: 那個小女孩每天早上唱一首快樂的歌。

definition_zh: (名) 新加坡
example_sentence: Singapore is a popular travel destination for Taiwanese students.
sentence_zh: 新加坡是台湾学生喜爱的旅游目的地。

definition_zh: (形) 新加坡的；(名) 新加坡人
example_sentence: Many Singaporean students study hard for their exams.
sentence_zh: 許多新加坡學生為考試努力讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 歌手；歌唱家
example_sentence: After the concert ended, the singer thanked her fans for their support.
sentence_zh: 演唱會結束後，這位歌手感謝粉絲們的支持。

definition_zh: (名) 唱歌；歌聲　(動) 唱歌
example_sentence: The girl who enjoys singing in the shower is my younger sister.
sentence_zh: 那個喜歡在淋浴時唱歌的女孩是我的妹妹。

definition_zh: (形) 單一的；單身的　(名) 單程票；單身者
example_sentence: Having never missed a single class, Tom earned the teacher's praise.
sentence_zh: 從未缺過任何一堂課，湯姆贏得了老師的讚賞。

definition_zh: (形) 非凡的；單一的
example_sentence: The scientist made a singular discovery that changed the field of biology.
sentence_zh: 這位科學家做出了一項非凡的發現，改變了生物學領域。

definition_zh: (副) 獨特地；非凡地
example_sentence: The teacher singularly focused on helping each student improve their writing skills.
sentence_zh: 這位老師獨特地專注於幫助每位學生提升寫作技巧。

definition_zh: (形) 不祥的；邪惡的
example_sentence: When the lights went out, a sinister figure appeared in the hallway.
sentence_zh: 當燈光熄滅時，一個不祥的身影出現在走廊上。

definition_zh: (片) 被理解；被領會
example_sentence: The importance of studying hard slowly began to sink in.
sentence_zh: 努力學習的重要性慢慢開始被理解。

definition_zh: (名) 水槽；洗碗槽　(動) 下沉；沈沒
example_sentence: The old sink in the kitchen started to leak yesterday.
sentence_zh: 廚房裡的老舊水槽昨天開始漏水。

definition_zh: (名) 罪人；有過失者
example_sentence: After the teacher's lesson, the sinner felt deep regret for his actions.
sentence_zh: 在老師的教導之後，這個罪人對自己的行為感到深深的悔意。

definition_zh: (名) 鼻竇；竇道
example_sentence: If a sinus infection occurs, a doctor may prescribe antibiotics.
sentence_zh: 如果鼻竇感染發生，醫生可能會開抗生素。

definition_zh: (名) 一小口　(動) 小口喝；啜飲
example_sentence: After finishing the race, the runner took a sip of water.
sentence_zh: 跑完比賽後，跑者喝了一小口水。

definition_zh: (名) 先生；長官
example_sentence: The student asked the teacher, "Excuse me, sir, can you help me?"
sentence_zh: 學生問老師：「不好意思，先生，你能幫我嗎？」

definition_zh: (名) 姊妹；姐妹
example_sentence: My sister who studies in Taipei is a kind girl.
sentence_zh: 我那位在台北讀書的姊姊是一個善良的女孩。

definition_zh: (名) 姊妹情誼；姊妹關係
example_sentence: Forming a strong sisterhood, the club members supported each other through challenges.
sentence_zh: 形成強大的姊妹情誼，社團成員在挑戰中互相支持。

definition_zh: (片) 閒坐；無所事事
example_sentence: Students should not sit about during the final exam preparation.
sentence_zh: 學生在準備期末考時不該閒坐著。

definition_zh: (片) 袖手旁觀；放鬆地坐著
example_sentence: After finishing his homework, Tom decided to sit back and relax.
sentence_zh: 做完功課後，湯姆決定坐下來放鬆一下。

definition_zh: (片) 坐在…旁；袖手旁觀
example_sentence: Students often sit by the window to read during breaks.
sentence_zh: 學生們常在休息時間坐在窗邊閱讀。

definition_zh: (片) 坐下；就座
example_sentence: Students sit down in the library to study for the final exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們坐在圖書館裡為期末考試而讀書。

definition_zh: (片) 參加（考試）；應考
example_sentence: Seldom do students sit for exams without feeling nervous.
sentence_zh: 學生很少在考試時不感到緊張。

definition_zh: (片) 代理；代替
example_sentence: Sitting in for the manager, Linda led the morning meeting.
sentence_zh: 代理經理，琳達主持了早上的會議。

definition_zh: (片) 旁聽；列席
example_sentence: Sitting in on the advanced math class, many students felt inspired.
sentence_zh: 旁聽進階數學課時，許多學生感到備受啟發。

definition_zh: (片) 旁聽；參加（會議等）
example_sentence: The student who decided to sit in for the debate was very nervous.
sentence_zh: 決定旁聽辯論的那名學生非常緊張。

definition_zh: (片) 袖手旁觀；拖延處理
example_sentence: When the teacher asks a tough question, many students sit on their hands.
sentence_zh: 當老師問一個困難的問題時，許多學生袖手旁觀。

definition_zh: (片) 缺席；不參加
example_sentence: If the weather were rainy, the team would sit out the game.
sentence_zh: 如果天氣下雨，球隊就會缺席比賽。

definition_zh: (片) 坐在...旁邊；監視
example_sentence: If the teacher sits over the students, they will focus on the exam review.
sentence_zh: 如果老師坐在學生旁邊，他們就會專注於考試複習。

definition_zh: (片) 耐著性子聽完；坐到結束
example_sentence: Students often find it hard to sit through long lectures without falling asleep.
sentence_zh: 學生們常常覺得很難在漫長的課堂中坐著聽講而不睡著。

definition_zh: (動) 坐直；坐起來
example_sentence: The teacher asked the sleepy students to sit up in class.
sentence_zh: 老師叫那些昏昏欲睡的學生在課堂上坐直。

definition_zh: (片) 忍受；與…共處
example_sentence: The feeling that students sit with during exams is often anxiety.
sentence_zh: 學生在考試期間所感受到的情緒常常是焦慮。

definition_zh: (名) 坐下來談的會議；靜坐抗議
example_sentence: If the manager called a sit-down, the team would resolve the conflict.
sentence_zh: 如果經理召開一場坐下來談的會議，團隊就會解決衝突。

definition_zh: (名) 靜坐抗議；佔據抗議
example_sentence: The sit-in that students organized last week was peaceful.
sentence_zh: 學生們上週組織的靜坐抗議是和平的。

definition_zh: (動) 坐；就座
example_sentence: Having sat in the front row, the student could see the board clearly.
sentence_zh: 坐在前排後，那名學生可以清楚地看到黑板。

definition_zh: (名) 地點；場所　(動) 設置；選址
example_sentence: The construction site must be fenced off before workers arrive.
sentence_zh: 建築工地在工人到達之前必須用圍籬隔開。

definition_zh: (動) 使位於；使坐落於
example_sentence: Situated near the school, the new library offers a quiet space for study.
sentence_zh: 位於學校附近的新圖書館提供了一個安靜的學習空間。

definition_zh: (形) 位於...的；坐落於...的
example_sentence: Seldom is the school situated in such a convenient location.
sentence_zh: 這所學校很少位於如此便利的地點。

definition_zh: (名) 情況；局面
example_sentence: The situation that the students faced was very stressful.
sentence_zh: 學生們面臨的情況壓力很大。

definition_zh: (名) 六　(形) 六的
example_sentence: The student who finished six assignments received a prize.
sentence_zh: 完成六項作業的學生獲得了一份獎品。

definition_zh: (名) 十六　(形) 十六的
example_sentence: The student who is sixteen just joined the school's robotics club.
sentence_zh: 那位十六歲的學生剛加入學校的機器人社團。

definition_zh: (名) 第六；第六位　(形) 第六的
example_sentence: The student who finished sixth in the race received a medal.
sentence_zh: 在比賽中獲得第六名的學生收到了一枚獎牌。

definition_zh: (名) 六十；六十個
example_sentence: The student who scored sixty points on the math test felt disappointed.
sentence_zh: 在數學考試中得了六十分的學生感到失望。

definition_zh: (形) 相當大的；可觀的
example_sentence: Having saved a sizable amount of money, the student bought a new laptop.
sentence_zh: 存了一筆可觀的錢後，那名學生買了一台新筆記型電腦。

definition_zh: (片) 評估；判斷
example_sentence: If a student sizes up the exam difficulty, better preparation becomes possible.
sentence_zh: 如果學生評估考試難度，更好的準備就成為可能。

definition_zh: (名) 大小；尺寸　(動) 按大小分類；估量
example_sentence: Not only does the size of the bag matter, but also its color.
sentence_zh: 不僅包包的大小很重要，它的顏色也是。

definition_zh: (動) 發出嘶嘶聲；煎得滋滋作響
example_sentence: When the steak hits the hot pan, it starts to sizzle loudly.
sentence_zh: 當牛排碰到熱鍋時，它開始發出嘶嘶聲。

definition_zh: (形) 嘶嘶作響的；炙熱的
example_sentence: The sizzling pan warns everyone to stay away from the hot stove.
sentence_zh: 發出嘶嘶聲的平底鍋警告每個人遠離熱爐子。

definition_zh: (動) 溜冰；滑冰
example_sentence: Having skated for hours, the young girl finally learned a new trick.
sentence_zh: 滑了好幾個小時後，那個小女孩終於學會了一個新招數。

definition_zh: (名) 滑冰；溜冰
example_sentence: Many students go to the ice rink for skating on weekends.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在週末去溜冰場滑冰。

definition_zh: (名) 骨骼；骨架
example_sentence: Seldom does a skeleton remain intact after centuries in the soil.
sentence_zh: 很少有骨骼在土壤中經過數世紀後仍保持完整。

definition_zh: (形) 懷疑的；不相信的
example_sentence: Many students are skeptical about the new grading system at school.
sentence_zh: 許多學生對學校的新評分制度持懷疑態度。

definition_zh: (名) 懷疑；懷疑主義
example_sentence: If a scientist shows skepticism, the research results become more reliable.
sentence_zh: 如果科學家表現出懷疑態度，研究結果就會更可靠。

definition_zh: (名) 素描；草圖　(動) 畫素描；概述
example_sentence: Having finished her sketch of the city park, Emma added shadows to the trees.
sentence_zh: 完成城市公園的素描後，艾瑪在樹木上添加了陰影。

definition_zh: (動) 串起；刺穿　(名) 串肉扦；烤肉叉
example_sentence: The chef skewered the shrimp and vegetables for the barbecue.
sentence_zh: 廚師將蝦和蔬菜串起來準備燒烤。

definition_zh: (動) 滑雪
example_sentence: If the snow is deep enough, our class will ski on the mountain.
sentence_zh: 如果雪夠深，我們班就會在山上去滑雪。

definition_zh: (名) 滑雪；(動) 滑雪
example_sentence: Skiing down the mountain, Amy enjoyed the crisp winter air.
sentence_zh: 滑雪下山時，艾咪享受著清新的冬日空氣。

definition_zh: (名) 技能；技巧　(動) 熟練掌握
example_sentence: Learning a new skill requires patience and daily practice.
sentence_zh: 學習一項新技能需要耐心和每日練習。

definition_zh: (形) 熟練的；有技巧的
example_sentence: A skilled carpenter can build a beautiful wooden table in one day.
sentence_zh: 一位熟練的木匠能在一天內建造一張漂亮的木桌。

definition_zh: (形) 熟練的；靈巧的
example_sentence: If the chef were more skillful, the restaurant would attract more customers.
sentence_zh: 如果這位廚師更熟練，這家餐廳就會吸引更多顧客。

definition_zh: (副) 熟練地；巧妙地
example_sentence: The chef skillfully chopped the vegetables for the salad.
sentence_zh: 廚師熟練地切好沙拉用的蔬菜。

definition_zh: (動) 瀏覽；略讀　(名) 脫脂；表面的一層
example_sentence: Skimming the article quickly, the student found the key information.
sentence_zh: 快速瀏覽這篇文章後，學生找到了關鍵資訊。

definition_zh: (動) 節省；吝嗇
example_sentence: Many students skimp on breakfast to save time for studying.
sentence_zh: 許多學生為了節省時間讀書而忽略早餐。

definition_zh: (形) 不足的；吝嗇的
example_sentence: Although the lunch portion was skimpy, the students still felt satisfied.
sentence_zh: 雖然午餐份量很少，學生們還是感到滿意。

definition_zh: (形) 緊身的；貼身的
example_sentence: The dancer wore a skin-tight costume that sparkled under the stage lights.
sentence_zh: 那位舞者穿著一件在舞台燈光下閃閃發亮的緊身服裝。

definition_zh: (名) 皮膚；(動) 剝皮
example_sentence: Having dry skin in winter, many students use moisturizer after washing their faces.
sentence_zh: 冬天皮膚乾燥時，許多學生在洗臉後會使用保濕霜。

definition_zh: (動) 裸泳
example_sentence: The teenagers decided to skinny dip in the lake at midnight.
sentence_zh: 這些青少年決定在午夜時分到湖裡裸泳。

definition_zh: (形) 極瘦的；皮包骨的
example_sentence: Although the model looks skinny, her diet is actually quite unhealthy.
sentence_zh: 雖然那位模特兒看起來很瘦，但她的飲食其實相當不健康。

definition_zh: (動) 跳過；略過　(名) 跳躍；跳過
example_sentence: If the bus were late, I would skip the first class.
sentence_zh: 如果公車遲到，我就會翹掉第一堂課。

definition_zh: (名) 船長；隊長
example_sentence: The skipper navigated the boat through the narrow channel.
sentence_zh: 船長駕駛船隻通過狹窄的航道。

definition_zh: (名) 裙子
example_sentence: The new skirt my mom bought for me is very comfortable.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽買給我的新裙子非常舒適。

definition_zh: (名) 頭骨；骷髏
example_sentence: The doctor studied the skull to learn about ancient diseases.
sentence_zh: 醫生研究頭骨以了解古代疾病。

definition_zh: (名) 天空
example_sentence: Having seen the clear sky, the students decided to have an outdoor class.
sentence_zh: 看到晴朗的天空後，學生們決定上一堂戶外課。

definition_zh: (動) 跳傘；特技跳傘
example_sentence: Inspired by the view, the group decided to skydive together.
sentence_zh: 受到景色的啟發，這群人決定一起跳傘。

definition_zh: (名) 跳傘者
example_sentence: If a skydiver forgot their parachute, they would face serious danger.
sentence_zh: 如果跳傘者忘記帶降落傘，他們將面臨嚴重的危險。

definition_zh: (名) 摩天大樓
example_sentence: Having seen the skyscraper, the students felt amazed by its height.
sentence_zh: 看到這棟摩天大樓後，學生們對它的高度感到驚嘆。

definition_zh: (名) 厚板；平板
example_sentence: The construction worker used a thick concrete slab to support the bridge.
sentence_zh: 建築工人使用一塊厚水泥板來支撐橋樑。

definition_zh: (片) 偷懶；懈怠
example_sentence: Slacking off during group projects often leads to lower grades.
sentence_zh: 在團體專題中偷懶常常導致成績較低。

definition_zh: (動) 懈怠；偷懶
example_sentence: If students slack off, their grades will drop quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果學生偷懶，他們的成績會迅速下滑。

definition_zh: (片) 鬆懈；懈怠
example_sentence: Students who slacken off often regret their exam results later.
sentence_zh: 鬆懈下來的學生常常事後後悔他們的考試成績。

definition_zh: (片) 辱罵；批評
example_sentence: If a classmate continues to slag off others, the teacher will intervene.
sentence_zh: 如果同學繼續辱罵他人，老師將會介入。

definition_zh: (名) 爐渣；熔渣
example_sentence: Only after the furnace cools can workers remove the slag.
sentence_zh: 只有在熔爐冷卻後，工人才能移除爐渣。

definition_zh: (動) 砰地關上；猛擊
example_sentence: The strong wind slammed the door shut during the typhoon.
sentence_zh: 強風在颱風期間把門砰地關上。

definition_zh: (名) 俚語；行話
example_sentence: Using too much slang in a formal essay, students often lose marks.
sentence_zh: 在正式論文中使用太多俚語，學生經常會失去分數。

definition_zh: (片) 傾向於；有……的趨勢
example_sentence: If the weather forecast slants toward rain, students should bring umbrellas.
sentence_zh: 如果天氣預報傾向於下雨，學生應該帶傘。

definition_zh: (名) 偏見；傾向　(動) 傾斜；歪曲
example_sentence: The reporter's political slant influenced the article's tone.
sentence_zh: 記者的政治偏見影響了文章的語氣。

definition_zh: (動) 打耳光；拍打　(名) 一巴掌；拍打聲
example_sentence: Never should a student slap a classmate in anger.
sentence_zh: 學生絕不該在憤怒時打同學一巴掌。

definition_zh: (動) 砍；削減；(名) 斜線；砍痕
example_sentence: Slashing prices during the holiday sale, the store attracted many customers.
sentence_zh: 在假期促銷期間大幅降價，這家商店吸引了許多顧客。

definition_zh: (名) 石板；候選人名單　(動) 預定；提名
example_sentence: The teacher used a small slate to write the math problem.
sentence_zh: 老師用一塊小石板來寫數學題目。

definition_zh: (動) 塗抹；大量塗上
example_sentence: After a long run, the athlete likes to slather on sunscreen.
sentence_zh: 長跑後，這位運動員喜歡塗上防曬乳。

definition_zh: (名) 屠殺；屠宰　(動) 屠殺；屠宰
example_sentence: If the government banned the slaughter of stray dogs, many activists would celebrate.
sentence_zh: 如果政府禁止屠殺流浪狗，許多動保人士會慶祝。

definition_zh: (名) 屠宰場
example_sentence: A slaughterhouse that treats animals humanely is rare in the industry.
sentence_zh: 一家人道對待動物的屠宰場在業界很少見。

definition_zh: (名) 奴隸
example_sentence: The factory owner treated his workers like slaves.
sentence_zh: 工廠老闆對待他的工人像奴隸一樣。

definition_zh: (名) 奴隸制度；奴役
example_sentence: Students study the history of slavery to understand human rights.
sentence_zh: 學生研讀奴隸制度的歷史以了解人權。

definition_zh: (動) 殺死；殘殺
example_sentence: If the hero slays the dragon, the kingdom will be saved.
sentence_zh: 如果英雄殺死巨龍，王國就能得救。

definition_zh: (名) 雪橇　(動) 乘雪橇
example_sentence: The wooden sled that Grandpa built still glides smoothly on snowy hills.
sentence_zh: 爺爺做的木製雪橇在雪丘上仍然滑行順暢。

definition_zh: (片) 到處和別人上床；濫交
example_sentence: My cousin warned me not to sleep around during summer break.
sentence_zh: 我的表姊告誡我暑假時不要到處和別人上床。

definition_zh: (片) 睡到很晚；睡懶覺
example_sentence: Seldom does a student sleep in on a school day.
sentence_zh: 學生很少在上學日睡到很晚。

definition_zh: (片) 睡得很沉；睡得像死豬一樣
example_sentence: After the long exam, Tom slept like a log for ten hours.
sentence_zh: 在漫長的考試後，湯姆像木頭一樣睡了十個小時。

definition_zh: (片) 用睡眠消除（疲勞、不適等）
example_sentence: After the long hike, Tom tried to sleep off his tiredness.
sentence_zh: 長途健行後，湯姆試著用睡覺來消除疲勞。

definition_zh: (片) 小看；忽略
example_sentence: Don't sleep on that internship opportunity; it could change your future.
sentence_zh: 別小看那個實習機會；它可能改變你的未來。

definition_zh: (片) 露宿；在外過夜
example_sentence: The camping club members decided to sleep out under the stars.
sentence_zh: 露營社團的成員決定在星空下露宿。

definition_zh: (片) 在別人家過夜；留宿
example_sentence: Excited about the movie, Jenny decided to sleep over at her friend's house.
sentence_zh: 對電影感到興奮，珍妮決定在朋友家過夜。

definition_zh: (片) 睡過頭（而錯過某事）
example_sentence: Sleeping through the alarm, the student missed the morning exam.
sentence_zh: 因為睡過頭沒聽到鬧鐘，這位學生錯過了早上的考試。

definition_zh: (片) 一起睡；同床共枕
example_sentence: Having slept together in the tent, the campers felt a strong bond.
sentence_zh: 在帳篷裡一起睡過之後，露營者們感受到強烈的連結。

definition_zh: (名) 睡眠；睡覺　(動) 睡；入睡
example_sentence: A short sleep after lunch helps students focus better in class.
sentence_zh: 午餐後小睡片刻有助於學生在課堂上更專注。

definition_zh: (動) 睡覺
example_sentence: Sleepin in class can lead to missing important lessons.
sentence_zh: 在課堂上睡覺可能會錯過重要的課程。

definition_zh: (形) 睏的；想睡的
example_sentence: If the student felt sleepy, she would drink a cup of tea.
sentence_zh: 如果學生感到睏，她就會喝一杯茶。

definition_zh: (名) 雨夾雪；冰雹
example_sentence: The weather forecast that predicted sleet worried many students.
sentence_zh: 預測有雨夾雪的天氣預報讓許多學生感到擔心。

definition_zh: (名) 袖子
example_sentence: The sleeves of this jacket are too long for me.
sentence_zh: 這件外套的袖子對我來說太長了。

definition_zh: (名) 雪橇
example_sentence: Having finished the race, the sleigh rested under the snow-covered trees.
sentence_zh: 完成比賽後，雪橇在覆雪的樹下休息。

definition_zh: (形) 纖細的；苗條的
example_sentence: Standing by the window, the slender girl watched the rain.
sentence_zh: 那個纖細的女孩站在窗邊，看著雨。

definition_zh: (片) 切下；削去
example_sentence: The chef used a sharp knife to slice off a thin piece of cake.
sentence_zh: 廚師用一把鋒利的刀切下一薄片蛋糕。

definition_zh: (片) 切片；切碎
example_sentence: After the chef slices up the vegetables, he adds them to the hot pan.
sentence_zh: 主廚將蔬菜切片後，把它們加入熱鍋中。

definition_zh: (動) 切；切片　(名) 片；薄片
example_sentence: The baker used a sharp knife to slice the bread for sandwiches.
sentence_zh: 麵包師傅用一把鋒利的刀來切麵包做三明治。

definition_zh: (形) 光滑的；流暢的
example_sentence: The smartphone that my cousin bought has a slick design.
sentence_zh: 我表弟買的那支智慧型手機設計很流暢。

definition_zh: (名) 雨衣；防水外套
example_sentence: My father bought a new rain slicker for the typhoon season.
sentence_zh: 我父親為颱風季買了一件新的雨衣。

definition_zh: (名) 滑梯；滑水道　(動) 滑行；滑動
example_sentence: Students use a water slide to cool off in summer.
sentence_zh: 學生在夏天使用滑水道來消暑。

definition_zh: (形) 輕微的；細小的　(動) 輕視；怠慢
example_sentence: The slight difference in the test scores surprised the teacher.
sentence_zh: 測驗分數上的微小差異讓老師感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (副) 稍微；略為
example_sentence: If the soup is slightly too salty, add a little water.
sentence_zh: 如果湯稍微太鹹，加一點水。

definition_zh: (形) 苗條的；薄的
example_sentence: Eating a diet of fruits and vegetables helps keep a slim figure.
sentence_zh: 吃水果和蔬菜的飲食有助於保持苗條的身材。

definition_zh: (動) 溜走；錯失
example_sentence: If the opportunity slipped away, a student would regret it forever.
sentence_zh: 如果機會溜走了，學生會後悔一輩子。

definition_zh: (動) 流逝；溜走
example_sentence: Never does a day slip by without her practicing the piano.
sentence_zh: 沒有一天不讓她練習鋼琴就過去了。

definition_zh: (片) 滑倒；下滑
example_sentence: A wet floor sign can prevent people from slipping down the stairs.
sentence_zh: 濕地板標誌可以防止人們在樓梯上滑倒。

definition_zh: (片) 溜進；偷偷進入
example_sentence: If a student tries to slip in late, the teacher will notice.
sentence_zh: 如果學生試圖偷偷溜進來遲到，老師會注意到。

definition_zh: (片) 溜進；悄悄穿上
example_sentence: After a long day of studying, many students slip into comfortable clothes.
sentence_zh: 經過漫長的一天學習後，許多學生會換上舒適的衣服。

definition_zh: (片) 溜走；悄悄離開
example_sentence: The student who slipped off to the library avoided the noisy classroom.
sentence_zh: 那個偷偷溜去圖書館的學生避開了吵鬧的教室。

definition_zh: (片) 滑落；脫落
example_sentence: If the raincoat slips off the hook, it will get wet.
sentence_zh: 如果雨衣從掛鉤上滑落，它就會弄濕。

definition_zh: (片) 滑倒；滑落
example_sentence: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor after the rain.
sentence_zh: 雨後小心不要在地板上滑倒。

definition_zh: (片) 滑出；洩露；溜走
example_sentence: The secret plans slipped out during the heated debate.
sentence_zh: 機密計畫在激烈的辯論中洩露了出去。

definition_zh: (片) 溜過；逃過（注意或檢查）
example_sentence: A small mistake in the report might slip through the editor's review.
sentence_zh: 報告中的一個小錯誤可能會溜過編輯的審查。

definition_zh: (片) 犯錯；失誤
example_sentence: Students who slip up on the exam must retake it next week.
sentence_zh: 在考試中犯錯的學生必須在下週重考。

definition_zh: (動) 滑倒；溜走　(名) 滑倒；紙條
example_sentence: The student who did not slip on the wet floor was very careful.
sentence_zh: 那個沒有在濕滑地板上滑倒的學生非常小心。

definition_zh: (名) 拖鞋
example_sentence: After a long day at school, slipping into my slippers feels wonderful.
sentence_zh: 在學校度過漫長的一天後，穿上我的拖鞋感覺很舒服。

definition_zh: (形) 滑的；狡猾的
example_sentence: Walking on the wet floor after the rain can be very slippery.
sentence_zh: 雨後在濕滑的地板上行走可能會非常滑。

definition_zh: (名) 裂縫；狹長切口　(動) 切開；撕裂
example_sentence: The tailor made a small slit in the skirt for easier movement.
sentence_zh: 裁縫在裙子上開了一個小口，方便活動。

definition_zh: (動) 滑行；蜿蜒移動
example_sentence: A snake can slither silently through the tall grass.
sentence_zh: 蛇能無聲地滑行穿過高高的草叢。

definition_zh: (片) 懶散度日；無所事事
example_sentence: Many students choose to slob about on weekends to relax after exams.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在考試後選擇在週末懶散放鬆。

definition_zh: (名) 口號；標語
example_sentence: The company's new slogan, which promotes environmental protection, appeals to young consumers.
sentence_zh: 這家公司提倡環保的新口號吸引了年輕消費者。

definition_zh: (名) 斜坡；坡度　(動) 傾斜；使傾斜
example_sentence: The steep slope near the school is dangerous after rain.
sentence_zh: 學校附近的陡坡在雨後很危險。

definition_zh: (副) 草率地；馬虎地
example_sentence: The report, which was written sloppily, received a low grade.
sentence_zh: 那份寫得很草率的報告得到了低分。

definition_zh: (形) 潦草的；馬虎的
example_sentence: If your homework looks sloppy, the teacher may ask you to rewrite it.
sentence_zh: 如果你的作業看起來很潦草，老師可能會要求你重寫。

definition_zh: (名) 時段；位置
example_sentence: The student reserved a time slot for the library study room.
sentence_zh: 這位學生預約了圖書館讀書室的時段。

definition_zh: (名) 樹懶；懶惰
example_sentence: The sloth that lives in the rainforest moves very slowly.
sentence_zh: 住在雨林中的樹懶移動得非常緩慢。

definition_zh: (動) 無精打采地坐(或站、走)；低頭垂肩地坐(或站、走)
example_sentence: The student tends to slouch in his chair during class.
sentence_zh: 這個學生在課堂上傾向於懶散地靠在椅子上。

definition_zh: (片) 擺脫；拋棄
example_sentence: If students slough off their bad habits, their grades may improve.
sentence_zh: 如果學生擺脫壞習慣，他們的成績可能會進步。

definition_zh: (動) 放慢；減速　(片) 慢下來；放鬆
example_sentence: Many students slow down their pace to review notes before exams.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在考試前放慢腳步來複習筆記。

definition_zh: (片) 減速；放慢
example_sentence: The driver decided to slow up to avoid hitting a dog.
sentence_zh: 司機決定減速以避免撞到狗。

definition_zh: (形) 慢的；遲緩的　(動) 減慢；放慢
example_sentence: The bus was so slow that the students missed the first class.
sentence_zh: 公車太慢了，以至於學生錯過了第一節課。

definition_zh: (名) 減速；放緩
example_sentence: Seldom does a sudden economic slowdown benefit small businesses.
sentence_zh: 經濟突然放緩很少有利於小型企業。

definition_zh: (名) 污泥；爛泥
example_sentence: The city built a treatment plant to process the toxic sludge from factories.
sentence_zh: 這座城市建造了一座處理廠來處理工廠產生的有毒污泥。

definition_zh: (片) 奮戰到底；激烈競爭
example_sentence: The two basketball teams decided to slug it out until the final buzzer.
sentence_zh: 兩支籃球隊決定奮戰到底，直到比賽結束的蜂鳴器響起。

definition_zh: (名) 蛞蝓；子彈
example_sentence: Because the garden was too wet, a slug appeared on the leaf.
sentence_zh: 因為花園太潮濕，一隻蛞蝓出現在葉子上。

definition_zh: (形) 遲緩的； sluggish 沒有不同的發音。
example_sentence: Students drink coffee to overcome sluggish mornings during exam week.
sentence_zh: 學生在考試週喝咖啡來克服昏沉的早晨。

definition_zh: (名) 貧民窟；陋巷
example_sentence: The government plans to improve the living conditions in the slum.
sentence_zh: 政府計畫改善貧民窟的生活條件。

definition_zh: (動) 暴跌；驟降　(名) 暴跌；衰退期
example_sentence: The student's grades slumped after he lost interest in studying.
sentence_zh: 這名學生的成績在他失去學習興趣後急遽下降。

definition_zh: (動) 吸食；出聲地喝
example_sentence: Having slurped his ramen too loudly, Kevin felt embarrassed in the quiet restaurant.
sentence_zh: 大聲地吸完拉麵後，凱文在安靜的餐廳裡感到尷尬。

definition_zh: (形) 狡猾的；狡詐的
example_sentence: The sly fox tricked the farmer into losing his chickens.
sentence_zh: 那隻狡猾的狐狸欺騙農夫，讓他失去了他的雞。

definition_zh: (片) 帶有…意味；含有…跡象
example_sentence: The plan that smacks of dishonesty was rejected by the committee.
sentence_zh: 這個帶有欺騙意味的計畫被委員會否決了。

definition_zh: (動) 拍打；摑
example_sentence: Many students smack their heads when they forget answers during tests.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在考試中忘記答案時會拍打自己的頭。

definition_zh: (形) 小的；少的
example_sentence: A small cat sat on the warm sofa.
sentence_zh: 一隻小貓坐在溫暖的沙發上。

definition_zh: (名) 天花
example_sentence: The doctor who treated smallpox patients wore protective clothing.
sentence_zh: 治療天花患者的醫生穿著防護衣。

definition_zh: (形) 聰明的；智慧的
example_sentence: Many students buy a smart watch to track their daily exercise.
sentence_zh: 許多學生買智慧手錶來追蹤他們每天的運動。

definition_zh: (片) 撞倒；摧毀
example_sentence: Having smashed down the old wall, the workers started to build a new one.
sentence_zh: 工人們撞倒舊牆後，開始建造新牆。

definition_zh: (片) 打破；猛擊
example_sentence: Smashing in the window, the firefighter rescued the trapped kitten.
sentence_zh: 消防員打破窗戶，救出了受困的小貓。

definition_zh: (片) 砸毀；搗毀
example_sentence: A group of bored teenagers decided to smash up the abandoned house.
sentence_zh: 一群無聊的青少年決定砸毀那棟廢棄的房子。

definition_zh: (動) 粉碎；猛擊　(名) 扣殺；破碎聲
example_sentence: The volleyball player managed to smash the ball over the net.
sentence_zh: 那位排球選手成功地把球扣殺過網。

definition_zh: (動) 聞到；嗅　(名) 氣味；臭味
example_sentence: Having smelled the burning toast, the teacher quickly opened the kitchen door.
sentence_zh: 聞到燒焦的吐司味道後，老師迅速打開了廚房門。

definition_zh: (形) 有臭味的；難聞的
example_sentence: The smelly garbage in the corner attracted many flies and ants.
sentence_zh: 角落裡的臭垃圾吸引了許多蒼蠅和螞蟻。

definition_zh: (名) 微笑；笑容　(動) 微笑
example_sentence: The girl with a bright smile won the singing contest.
sentence_zh: 那個帶著燦爛笑容的女孩贏得了歌唱比賽。

definition_zh: (動) 得意地笑；假笑
example_sentence: The arrogant student smirked at the teacher's simple question.
sentence_zh: 那個傲慢的學生對老師簡單的問題露出了得意的笑。

definition_zh: (動) 重擊；懲罰
example_sentence: The ancient hero used a magic sword to smite the evil dragon.
sentence_zh: 這位古代英雄用一把魔法劍擊敗了邪惡的巨龍。

definition_zh: (名) 罩衫；工作服
example_sentence: Wearing a paint-stained smock, the student worked on her art project.
sentence_zh: 穿著一件沾滿顏料的罩衫，這位學生正在進行她的美術作業。

definition_zh: (名) 煙霧；霧霾
example_sentence: The government installed air purifiers to reduce smog in classrooms.
sentence_zh: 政府安裝空氣清淨機以減少教室內的煙霧。

definition_zh: (片) 用煙燻出；查出；揭露
example_sentence: Only after the fire did the firefighters smoke out the hidden flames.
sentence_zh: 只有在火災之後，消防員才用煙燻出隱藏的火焰。

definition_zh: (名) 煙；抽菸　(動) 抽菸；冒煙
example_sentence: Having smoked for years, the old man finally quit last month.
sentence_zh: 抽菸多年後，那位老先生終於在上個月戒菸了。

definition_zh: (名) 吸菸；抽菸　(動) 吸菸；抽菸
example_sentence: Many students quit smoking to improve their lung health.
sentence_zh: 許多學生為了改善肺部健康而戒菸。

definition_zh: (形) 煙霧瀰漫的；冒煙的
example_sentence: The kitchen became smoky after the toast was left in the oven too long.
sentence_zh: 廚房變得煙霧瀰漫，因為吐司在烤箱裡烤太久。

definition_zh: (形) 平坦的；順利的
example_sentence: A smooth road makes biking to school much easier.
sentence_zh: 一條平坦的道路讓騎腳踏車上學變得容易多了。

definition_zh: (副) 平穩地；順利地
example_sentence: The project ran smoothly after the team solved the main problem.
sentence_zh: 團隊解決主要問題後，專案順利進行。

definition_zh: (動) 使窒息；籠罩
example_sentence: The thick fog began to smother the entire valley by noon.
sentence_zh: 濃霧在中午前開始籠罩整個山谷。

definition_zh: (動) 弄髒；玷污　(名) 污漬；模糊痕跡
example_sentence: The student's dirty fingers smudge the clean notebook page.
sentence_zh: 學生髒兮兮的手指弄髒了乾淨的筆記本頁面。

definition_zh: (動) 走私；偷運
example_sentence: The police caught a man trying to smuggle drugs into the country.
sentence_zh: 警方抓到一名試圖將毒品走私入境的男子。

definition_zh: (名) 點心；小吃　(動) 吃點心
example_sentence: Many students enjoy a quick snack after school.
sentence_zh: 許多學生放學後喜歡吃個快速點心。

definition_zh: (動) 搶購；迅速取得
example_sentence: Many students snaffle up cheap snacks during the short break.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在短暫的休息時間搶購便宜零食。

definition_zh: (名) 蝸牛
example_sentence: A snail moves slowly because the rain makes the ground wet.
sentence_zh: 蝸牛移動得很慢，因為雨水讓地面變濕。

definition_zh: (名) 蛇　(動) 蜿蜒前進
example_sentence: A snake crawled under the rock when the boy walked by.
sentence_zh: 當男孩走過時，一條蛇爬到了岩石底下。

definition_zh: (動) 折斷；突然折斷
example_sentence: The strong wind caused a branch to snap off the tree.
sentence_zh: 強風導致樹枝從樹上折斷。

definition_zh: (片) 振作起來；擺脫負面情緒
example_sentence: Students who feel discouraged need to snap out of it quickly.
sentence_zh: 感到沮喪的學生需要趕快振作起來。

definition_zh: (片) 立刻行動；趕快做
example_sentence: The student who snapped to it finished the homework early.
sentence_zh: 那個立刻行動的學生提早完成了作業。

definition_zh: (片) 搶購；爭相購買
example_sentence: Fans tried to snap up the limited edition sneakers quickly.
sentence_zh: 粉絲們試圖迅速搶購限量版運動鞋。

definition_zh: (動) 折斷；發出折斷聲　(名) 啪嗒聲；快照
example_sentence: When the cold weather comes, the tree branches snap easily.
sentence_zh: 當寒冷的天氣來臨時，樹枝很容易折斷。

definition_zh: (名) 陷阱；(動) 捕捉；誘捕
example_sentence: If a student fell into the snare of procrastination, their grades would suffer.
sentence_zh: 如果學生陷入拖延的陷阱，他們的成績就會受影響。

definition_zh: (片) 堵住；纏住
example_sentence: The traffic snarled up by the accident caused long delays.
sentence_zh: 被事故堵住的交通造成了長時間的延誤。

definition_zh: (動) 搶奪；奪取
example_sentence: The thief tried to snatch the old woman's purse on the crowded bus.
sentence_zh: 小偷試圖在擁擠的公車上搶走老婦人的錢包。

definition_zh: (片) 偷偷溜出；悄悄離開
example_sentence: The curious student sneaked out of the classroom to explore the campus.
sentence_zh: 那位好奇的學生偷偷溜出教室去探索校園。

definition_zh: (片) 偷偷接近；突然襲擊
example_sentence: Seldom does a quiet test sneak up on a prepared student.
sentence_zh: 一場安靜的考試很少偷偷襲擊一個準備充分的學生。

definition_zh: (動) 偷偷地走；偷帶
example_sentence: The boy tried to sneak a snack into the library.
sentence_zh: 那個男孩試圖偷偷帶零食進圖書館。

definition_zh: (名) 運動鞋
example_sentence: The sneaker that Tom wore yesterday is now on sale.
sentence_zh: 湯姆昨天穿的那雙運動鞋現在正在特價。

definition_zh: (名) 運動鞋
example_sentence: Because the track was wet, the teacher warned us not to wear sneakers.
sentence_zh: 因為跑道潮濕，老師警告我們不要穿運動鞋。

definition_zh: (形) 鬼鬼祟祟的；狡猾的
example_sentence: The sneaky cat hid under the sofa to avoid taking a bath.
sentence_zh: 那隻鬼鬼祟祟的貓躲在沙發下，以避免洗澡。

definition_zh: (名) 譏笑；冷笑　(動) 譏諷；冷笑
example_sentence: The bully's sneer made the new student feel unwelcome.
sentence_zh: 那個霸凌者的譏笑讓新來的學生感到不受歡迎。

definition_zh: (片) 對…打噴嚏；輕視
example_sentence: If Tom sneezes at the dusty books, he will get a runny nose.
sentence_zh: 如果湯姆對著滿是灰塵的書打噴嚏，他就會流鼻水。

definition_zh: (名) 噴嚏　(動) 打噴嚏
example_sentence: A sudden sneeze in class can make everyone turn around.
sentence_zh: 課堂上突然打噴嚏會讓每個人都轉頭看。

definition_zh: (動) 偷笑；竊笑
example_sentence: The students tried not to snicker during the teacher's serious speech.
sentence_zh: 學生們在老師嚴肅的演講期間努力忍住不偷笑。

definition_zh: (片) 四處打探；暗中調查
example_sentence: The journalist decided to sniff around the old factory for a story.
sentence_zh: 記者決定在老工廠四處打探，尋找報導題材。

definition_zh: (片) 輕視；嗤之以鼻
example_sentence: Even though the plan had flaws, our team did not sniff at it.
sentence_zh: 儘管這個計畫有缺陷，我們的團隊並沒有輕視它。

definition_zh: (片) 嗅出；察覺
example_sentence: The detective used a trained dog to sniff out the hidden evidence.
sentence_zh: 偵探用一隻受過訓練的狗來嗅出隱藏的證據。

definition_zh: (動) 嗅；聞
example_sentence: The dog sniffed the ground to find the missing keys.
sentence_zh: 這隻狗嗅著地面以尋找遺失的鑰匙。

definition_zh: (名) 鼻水聲；輕微的鼻塞
example_sentence: The student who had a sniffle stayed home from school.
sentence_zh: 那個流鼻水的學生請假沒去上學。

definition_zh: (名) 竊笑；暗笑　(動) 竊笑
example_sentence: The student tried to hide a snigger during the teacher's lecture.
sentence_zh: 那名學生在老師講課時試圖忍住竊笑。

definition_zh: (片) 告密；打小報告
example_sentence: The student who snitches on classmates often loses friends.
sentence_zh: 那個向同學告密的學生經常失去朋友。

definition_zh: (動) 告密；告發
example_sentence: If a student snitches on a classmate, trust in the class will break.
sentence_zh: 如果學生告發同學，班上的信任就會破裂。

definition_zh: (名) 斯諾克撞球
example_sentence: After school, many students enjoy playing snooker at the local club.
sentence_zh: 放學後，許多學生喜歡在當地的俱樂部打斯諾克撞球。

definition_zh: (動) 打鼾；打呼　(名) 打鼾聲
example_sentence: The loud snoring from my father kept me awake all night.
sentence_zh: 我父親大聲的打鼾讓我整晚睡不著。

definition_zh: (動) 浮潛；(名) 呼吸管
example_sentence: If a student snorkeled in the ocean, the colorful fish would amaze him.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在海洋中浮潛，色彩繽紛的魚會讓他驚嘆。

definition_zh: (名) 鼻息聲；噴鼻聲　(動) 噴鼻息；哼鼻子
example_sentence: A loud snort from the back of the class surprised the teacher.
sentence_zh: 教室後方傳來的一聲響亮鼻息讓老師嚇了一跳。

definition_zh: (名) 口鼻部；鼻子
example_sentence: The pig's long snout helps it find food in the mud.
sentence_zh: 豬的長鼻子幫助牠在泥巴中找到食物。

definition_zh: (名) 雪　(動) 下雪
example_sentence: Many students use the heavy snow to build a big snowman.
sentence_zh: 許多學生利用大雪來堆一個大雪人。

definition_zh: (名) 雪人
example_sentence: The children built a snowman in the park after the heavy snowfall.
sentence_zh: 孩子們在大雪過後在公園裡堆了一個雪人。

definition_zh: (形) 下雪的；積雪的
example_sentence: The snowy mountain roads made the bus ride very slow.
sentence_zh: 積雪的山路使公車行駛非常緩慢。

definition_zh: (片) 依偎；貼近
example_sentence: The little puppy likes to snuggle up to its owner on cold nights.
sentence_zh: 那隻小狗喜歡在寒冷的夜晚依偎在主人身邊。

definition_zh: (片) 依偎；緊靠
example_sentence: Whenever the weather turns cold, my cat likes to snuggle up on my lap.
sentence_zh: 每當天氣變冷時，我的貓喜歡依偎在我的腿上。

definition_zh: (片) 以便；為了
example_sentence: Seldom did the teacher raise his voice so that students would stay calm.
sentence_zh: 老師很少提高音量，以便學生保持冷靜。

definition_zh: (形) 所謂的；號稱的
example_sentence: Rejecting the so-called quick fixes, the scientist insisted on thorough research.
sentence_zh: 拒絕所謂的速成方案，這位科學家堅持徹底的研究。

definition_zh: (副) 如此；這麼　(連) 所以；因此
example_sentence: The movie was so boring that many students fell asleep.
sentence_zh: 這部電影太無聊了，以至於許多學生都睡著了。

definition_zh: (片) 吸收；沉浸於
example_sentence: Many students go to the library to soak up knowledge before exams.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在考試前去圖書館吸收知識。

definition_zh: (動) 浸泡；浸濕
example_sentence: Students who forget to soak their clothes may find them stiff.
sentence_zh: 忘記浸泡衣服的學生可能會發現衣服變硬。

definition_zh: (名) 肥皂
example_sentence: Using soap every morning keeps your skin clean and healthy.
sentence_zh: 每天早上用肥皂能讓你的皮膚保持清潔健康。

definition_zh: (動) 翱翔；急升
example_sentence: Never before had the eagle's flight so high above the clouds.
sentence_zh: 這隻老鷹的飛行從未如此高聳於雲端之上。

definition_zh: (形) 飆漲的；高飛的　(動) 飆升；高飛
example_sentence: The soaring cost of living worries many Taiwanese families.
sentence_zh: 生活費用的飆漲讓許多台灣家庭感到擔憂。

definition_zh: (動) 啜泣；嗚咽
example_sentence: The little boy began to sob after losing his favorite toy.
sentence_zh: 那個小男孩在失去他最喜歡的玩具後開始啜泣。

definition_zh: (動) 清醒；使清醒
example_sentence: After the party, Tom spent an hour sobering up with strong coffee.
sentence_zh: 派對結束後，湯姆花了一小時喝濃咖啡來清醒。

definition_zh: (形) 清醒的；未醉的
example_sentence: Drivers must stay sober to avoid causing accidents on the road.
sentence_zh: 駕駛人必須保持清醒，以避免在路上造成事故。

definition_zh: (名) 足球
example_sentence: Many students play soccer after school to relax and have fun.
sentence_zh: 許多學生放學後踢足球來放鬆和玩得開心。

definition_zh: (形) 好交際的；友善的
example_sentence: The new student is sociable and quickly makes friends with everyone.
sentence_zh: 那位新學生很友善，很快就和大家交上朋友。

definition_zh: (名) 社群媒體
example_sentence: Before using social media, many students check their notifications first.
sentence_zh: 在使用社群媒體之前，許多學生會先檢查通知。

definition_zh: (形) 社會的；社交的
example_sentence: Having joined the social club, Mark made many new friends.
sentence_zh: 加入社交俱樂部後，馬克交了許多新朋友。

definition_zh: (名) 社會主義
example_sentence: Socialism, which emphasizes equality, has influenced many countries.
sentence_zh: 社會主義強調平等，影響了許多國家。

definition_zh: (名) 社會主義者　(形) 社會主義的
example_sentence: The socialist party proposed a new policy for affordable housing.
sentence_zh: 這個社會主義政黨提出了一項新的可負擔住房政策。

definition_zh: (名) 社交名流；社交界名人
example_sentence: Invited to many charity galas, the socialite enjoyed her glamorous lifestyle.
sentence_zh: 受邀參加許多慈善晚會，這位社交名流享受她光鮮亮麗的生活方式。

definition_zh: (動) 社交；交際
example_sentence: Joining a club is a great way to socialize with new friends.
sentence_zh: 加入社團是結交新朋友的好方法。

definition_zh: (副) 社交上；社交性地
example_sentence: The shy student found it hard to talk socially at the party.
sentence_zh: 這位害羞的學生發現在派對上社交性的交談很困難。

definition_zh: (形) 社會的
example_sentence: A societal trend that affects teenagers is the popularity of social media.
sentence_zh: 一個影響青少年的社會趨勢是社交媒體的普及。

definition_zh: (名) 社會
example_sentence: A society that values education often invests more in its schools.
sentence_zh: 重視教育的社會通常會對其學校投入更多資源。

definition_zh: (形) 社會學的
example_sentence: The sociological study examined family structures in modern Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 這項社會學研究檢視了現代台灣的家庭結構。

definition_zh: (名) 社會學
example_sentence: Studying sociology helps students understand social inequality in modern cities.
sentence_zh: 學習社會學有助於學生理解現代城市中的社會不平等。

definition_zh: (片) 籠罩；封鎖（因天氣而無法運作）
example_sentence: The airport was socked in by heavy fog this morning.
sentence_zh: 機場今早被濃霧籠罩。

definition_zh: (名) 襪子
example_sentence: Never have I found a sock with such a strange pattern.
sentence_zh: 我從未發現過一隻圖案如此奇怪的襪子。

definition_zh: (名) 插座；插口
example_sentence: The electric socket behind the desk needs to be fixed soon.
sentence_zh: 桌子後面的電源插座需要盡快修理。

definition_zh: (名) 襪子
example_sentence: After the PE class, Tom put on his clean socks.
sentence_zh: 體育課後，湯姆穿上他的乾淨襪子。

definition_zh: (名) 汽水；蘇打
example_sentence: Drinking too much soda can cause health problems for teenagers.
sentence_zh: 喝太多汽水會對青少年造成健康問題。

definition_zh: (名) 鈉
example_sentence: When people eat too much sodium, their blood pressure may rise.
sentence_zh: 當人們攝取過多的鈉時，他們的血壓可能會升高。

definition_zh: (名) 沙發
example_sentence: If my sofa were larger, my cat would sleep more comfortably.
sentence_zh: 如果我的沙發更大，我的貓會睡得更舒服。

definition_zh: (形) 柔軟的；軟的
example_sentence: Having slept on a soft pillow, the baby felt refreshed.
sentence_zh: 睡了柔軟的枕頭後，寶寶感到精神煥發。

definition_zh: (名) 壘球
example_sentence: The softball that our school team won last year is on display.
sentence_zh: 去年我們校隊贏得的壘球正在展示中。

definition_zh: (片) 軟化；討好
example_sentence: The student who tried to soften up the teacher still got detention.
sentence_zh: 那個試圖討好老師的學生還是被留校了。

definition_zh: (動) 使變軟；軟化
example_sentence: Having softened the butter, the chef added sugar and mixed the batter.
sentence_zh: 將奶油軟化後，廚師加入糖並攪拌麵糊。

definition_zh: (名) 軟膠囊
example_sentence: If this softgel contained a higher dose, the treatment would be more effective.
sentence_zh: 如果這顆軟膠囊含有更高劑量，治療效果會更好。

definition_zh: (名) 軟體
example_sentence: This new software helps students learn English vocabulary more efficiently.
sentence_zh: 這款新軟體幫助學生更有效地學習英文單字。

definition_zh: (形) 濕透的；濕軟的
example_sentence: After the heavy rain, the soggy field made soccer practice impossible.
sentence_zh: 大雨過後，濕漉漉的場地讓足球練習無法進行。

definition_zh: (名) 土壤；土地　(動) 弄髒；污損
example_sentence: Many farmers use natural methods to protect the soil from erosion.
sentence_zh: 許多農夫使用自然方法來保護土壤免受侵蝕。

definition_zh: (動) 暫居；旅居
example_sentence: Many students sojourn in libraries to prepare for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在圖書館暫居，以準備學測考試。

definition_zh: (形) 太陽的；太陽能的
example_sentence: The school installed solar panels to reduce electricity costs.
sentence_zh: 學校安裝了太陽能板以降低電費。

definition_zh: (片) 堅持下去；繼續努力
example_sentence: The team decided to soldier on despite the heavy rain during the game.
sentence_zh: 儘管比賽中下著大雨，球隊仍決定堅持下去。

definition_zh: (名) 士兵；軍人
example_sentence: Standing guard at the gate, the soldier saluted the general.
sentence_zh: 在門口站崗時，士兵向將軍敬禮。

definition_zh: (形) 唯一的；單獨的　(名) 腳底；鞋底
example_sentence: Wearing her sole pair of sneakers, Mia joined the charity run.
sentence_zh: 穿著她唯一的一雙運動鞋，Mia參加了慈善路跑。

definition_zh: (副) 僅僅；完全地
example_sentence: Success in the exam depends solely on your consistent effort.
sentence_zh: 考試的成功完全取決於你持續的努力。

definition_zh: (形) 莊嚴的；嚴肅的
example_sentence: Never before had such a solemn ceremony been held in our school.
sentence_zh: 我們學校從未舉行過如此莊嚴的典禮。

definition_zh: (動) 懇求；徵求
example_sentence: The school club solicited donations for a local charity event.
sentence_zh: 學校社團為當地慈善活動募款。

definition_zh: (名) 律師；事務律師
example_sentence: After the accident, the solicitor advised the family about their legal rights.
sentence_zh: 事故發生後，律師就法律權益向家屬提供建議。

definition_zh: (形) 固體的；堅固的；扎實的　(名) 固體
example_sentence: A solid understanding of math helps students solve problems quickly.
sentence_zh: 對數學的扎實理解幫助學生快速解決問題。

definition_zh: (名) 團結；團結一致
example_sentence: Student solidarity during the school festival made the event truly memorable.
sentence_zh: 學生在學校園遊會期間的團結讓這場活動真正令人難忘。

definition_zh: (動) 凝固；鞏固
example_sentence: Seldom does the concrete solidify properly without enough water.
sentence_zh: 沒有足夠的水，混凝土很少能正確凝固。

definition_zh: (副) 堅固地；穩固地
example_sentence: The foundation of the old building was built solidly to last for decades.
sentence_zh: 這棟老建築的地基被建造得很堅固，能夠維持數十年。

definition_zh: (形) 孤獨的；獨自的
example_sentence: A solitary walk in the park helped Jenny clear her mind.
sentence_zh: 在公園裡獨自散步幫助珍妮理清思緒。

definition_zh: (名) 孤獨；獨處
example_sentence: Many students seek solitude in the library to study for exams.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在圖書館尋求獨處來準備考試。

definition_zh: (名) 獨奏；獨唱　(形) 單獨的；獨自的
example_sentence: Having practiced the piano solo for weeks, Emily performed confidently at the school concert.
sentence_zh: 練習了鋼琴獨奏好幾個星期後，艾蜜莉在學校音樂會上自信地演出。

definition_zh: (形) 可溶的；可解決的
example_sentence: This powder is soluble in water, so the experiment is easy.
sentence_zh: 這種粉末可溶於水，因此實驗很容易。

definition_zh: (名) 解決方法；解決方案
example_sentence: Having found a solution to the math problem, the student felt relieved.
sentence_zh: 找到數學問題的解決方法後，那位學生感到鬆了一口氣。

definition_zh: (動) 解決；解答
example_sentence: The math problem that the teacher gave us is hard to solve.
sentence_zh: 老師給我們的數學題目很難解。

definition_zh: (形) 陰沉的；憂鬱的
example_sentence: The sky turned somber before the heavy rain started.
sentence_zh: 天空在豪雨開始前變得陰沉。

definition_zh: (形) 一些；某個
example_sentence: Seldom does some food taste as good as this pizza.
sentence_zh: 很少有些食物嘗起來像這塊披薩一樣好吃。

definition_zh: (代) 某人；有人
example_sentence: If somebody calls, please take a message for me.
sentence_zh: 如果有人打電話來，請幫我留言。

definition_zh: (副) 有一天；將來某時
example_sentence: Amy hopes to visit Japan someday and experience its culture.
sentence_zh: 艾咪希望有一天能去日本並體驗其文化。

definition_zh: (副) 不知怎地；以某種方式
example_sentence: Somehow, the students managed to finish the science project on time.
sentence_zh: 不知怎地，學生們設法準時完成了科學專題。

definition_zh: (代) 某事物；某東西
example_sentence: The student found something interesting in the library yesterday.
sentence_zh: 該學生昨天在圖書館裡發現了一些有趣的東西。

definition_zh: (副) 在某個時候
example_sentence: The students plan to meet sometime next week for group study.
sentence_zh: 學生們計劃下週某個時間見面進行小組學習。

definition_zh: (副) 有時；偶爾
example_sentence: Never have I sometimes felt so relaxed after a long exam week.
sentence_zh: 在漫長的考試週之後，我從未感到如此放鬆。

definition_zh: (副) 有點；稍微
example_sentence: The final exam was somewhat more difficult than expected.
sentence_zh: 期末考比預期的稍微難一些。

definition_zh: (副) 某處；在某處
example_sentence: Seldom does a hidden gem lie somewhere unnoticed in this city.
sentence_zh: 這座城市裡很少有一顆隱藏的寶石躺在某個不為人知的地方。

definition_zh: (名) 兒子
example_sentence: Having finished his homework, the proud son showed his report card to his mother.
sentence_zh: 完成功課後，這個驕傲的兒子把成績單拿給媽媽看。

definition_zh: (名) 歌曲；歌
example_sentence: This song reminds me of my happy childhood days.
sentence_zh: 這首歌讓我想起快樂的童年時光。

definition_zh: (副) 很快；不久
example_sentence: Finishing the project soon, the team felt relieved.
sentence_zh: 很快完成專案後，團隊感到鬆了一口氣。

definition_zh: (名) 煤灰；煤煙
example_sentence: The factory's black soot covered the nearby houses and cars.
sentence_zh: 工廠的黑煤灰覆蓋了附近的房屋和汽車。

definition_zh: (動) 安撫；緩和
example_sentence: A warm cup of tea can soothe your nerves after a long day.
sentence_zh: 一杯熱茶可以在漫長的一天後安撫你的神經。

definition_zh: (動) 使精緻；使複雜
example_sentence: The new smartphone app aims to sophisticate the user interface for better experience.
sentence_zh: 這款新的智慧型手機應用程式旨在使使用者介面更精緻，以提供更好的體驗。

definition_zh: (形) 複雜精密的；高雅的
example_sentence: If a student uses a sophisticated phone, the teacher might confiscate it.
sentence_zh: 如果學生使用高階手機，老師可能會沒收它。

definition_zh: (名) 精緻；複雜性；世故
example_sentence: If this smartphone lacks sophistication, students may find it less appealing.
sentence_zh: 如果這款智慧型手機缺乏精緻度，學生可能會覺得它較不吸引人。

definition_zh: (名) 二年級學生；大學二年級生
example_sentence: The sophomore class president organized a charity event for the local community.
sentence_zh: 這位二年級班長為當地社區組織了一場慈善活動。

definition_zh: (形) 疼痛的；痠痛的
example_sentence: After the long run, my legs felt sore and tired.
sentence_zh: 在長跑之後，我的腿感到痠痛又疲憊。

definition_zh: (名) 痠痛；疼痛
example_sentence: The muscle soreness that follows intense exercise often lasts for two days.
sentence_zh: 劇烈運動後出現的肌肉痠痛通常會持續兩天。

definition_zh: (名) 悲傷；哀痛
example_sentence: The old photo brought great sorrow to the family.
sentence_zh: 那張舊照片給這個家庭帶來了巨大的悲傷。

definition_zh: (形) 悲傷的；憂傷的
example_sentence: The sorrowful melody of the piano filled the empty classroom.
sentence_zh: 鋼琴那悲傷的旋律充滿了空蕩的教室。

definition_zh: (形) 抱歉的；難過的
example_sentence: The student who felt sorry for his mistake apologized to the teacher.
sentence_zh: 那個對自己的錯誤感到抱歉的學生向老師道了歉。

definition_zh: (片) 整理；解決
example_sentence: The problem that the students need to sort out is quite complex.
sentence_zh: 學生們需要解決的這個問題相當複雜。

definition_zh: (動) 分類；整理　(名) 種類；類型
example_sentence: The teacher asked us to sort the books by size.
sentence_zh: 老師要求我們按大小把書分類。

definition_zh: (副) 有點；有幾分
example_sentence: Feeling sort of tired, the student decided to take a short nap.
sentence_zh: 感覺有點累，這個學生決定小睡片刻。

definition_zh: (名) 靈魂；精神
example_sentence: The old artist put his soul into every painting.
sentence_zh: 這位老藝術家將他的靈魂投入每一幅畫作中。

definition_zh: (片) 大聲抱怨；公開表達不滿
example_sentence: The coach, who always sounded off about punctuality, arrived late.
sentence_zh: 那位總是對準時大聲抱怨的教練，自己卻遲到了。

definition_zh: (片) 試探；打聽
example_sentence: The team decided to sound out the new policy before making a final decision.
sentence_zh: 團隊決定在做出最終決定前試探新政策的反應。

definition_zh: (名) 聲音；聲響　(動) 聽起來；發出聲音　(形) 健全的；合理的
example_sentence: The sound of the bell reminds students to change classes quickly.
sentence_zh: 鐘聲提醒學生快速換課。

definition_zh: (形) 隔音的
example_sentence: Because the music room is soundproof, students can practice drums without disturbing others.
sentence_zh: 因為音樂教室是隔音的，學生可以練習打鼓而不打擾他人。

definition_zh: (名) 原聲帶；電影配樂
example_sentence: The movie's soundtrack includes both classic songs and new compositions.
sentence_zh: 這部電影的原聲帶包含經典歌曲和新創作。

definition_zh: (名) 湯；羹
example_sentence: Eating hot soup on a cold day makes me feel warm.
sentence_zh: 在寒冷的日子裡喝熱湯讓我感到溫暖。

definition_zh: (形) 酸的；酸味的
example_sentence: Tasting sour, the lemon made the student's face scrunch up.
sentence_zh: 嚐起來很酸，這顆檸檬讓學生的臉皺了起來。

definition_zh: (名) 來源；出處
example_sentence: The sun is a clean source of energy for our planet.
sentence_zh: 太陽是我們地球的清潔能源來源。

definition_zh: (副) 向東南地　(形) 東南的　(名) 東南方
example_sentence: Having traveled south-east for two days, the team finally reached the coast.
sentence_zh: 向東南方向旅行了兩天後，團隊終於抵達海岸。

definition_zh: (名) 西南方
example_sentence: The typhoon that hit the south-west coast caused severe flooding.
sentence_zh: 襲擊西南海岸的颱風造成了嚴重的水災。

definition_zh: (名) 南方；南部　(形) 南方的；向南的　(副) 向南方
example_sentence: Having traveled south for two days, the team finally reached the warm coast.
sentence_zh: 往南行進兩天後，團隊終於抵達溫暖的海岸。

definition_zh: (形) 南方的；南部的
example_sentence: The southern part of Taiwan has warm weather in winter.
sentence_zh: 台灣南部地區在冬天有溫暖的天氣。

definition_zh: (名) 紀念品
example_sentence: The souvenir that Amy bought in Japan is a small keychain.
sentence_zh: 艾米在日本買的紀念品是一個小鑰匙圈。

definition_zh: (名) 君主；最高統治者　(形) 主權的；獨立的
example_sentence: A sovereign nation must protect its borders to ensure security.
sentence_zh: 一個主權國家必須保護其邊界以確保安全。

definition_zh: (名) 主權；獨立自主
example_sentence: Many nations argue that their sovereignty must be respected by others.
sentence_zh: 許多國家主張其主權必須受到他國尊重。

definition_zh: (動) 播種；散播
example_sentence: Sowing seeds in the garden, the farmer hoped for a good harvest.
sentence_zh: 在花園裡播種，農夫希望有個好收成。

definition_zh: (名) 醬油
example_sentence: If the soy sauce spills on the table, clean it up quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果醬油灑在桌上，要趕快擦乾淨。

definition_zh: (名) 大豆；黃豆
example_sentence: Many farmers grow soybeans because they are rich in protein.
sentence_zh: 許多農夫種植大豆，因為它們富含蛋白質。

definition_zh: (名) 空間；太空
example_sentence: The study space in the library is quiet and bright.
sentence_zh: 圖書館的學習空間既安靜又明亮。

definition_zh: (名) 太空船；航天器
example_sentence: Launched last year, the spacecraft is now exploring Mars.
sentence_zh: 去年發射的太空船現在正在探索火星。

definition_zh: (名) 太空船；宇宙飛船
example_sentence: The spaceship launched from Earth will explore a distant planet.
sentence_zh: 這艘從地球發射的太空船將探索一顆遙遠的行星。

definition_zh: (形) 寬敞的；廣闊的
example_sentence: Walking into the spacious library, the students felt a sense of calm.
sentence_zh: 走進寬敞的圖書館，學生們感到一陣平靜。

definition_zh: (名) 義大利麵
example_sentence: After boiling the spaghetti, Tom added some tomato sauce.
sentence_zh: 煮完義大利麵後，湯姆加了一些番茄醬。

definition_zh: (動) 跨越；涵蓋　(名) 跨度；一段時間
example_sentence: Students often use a smartphone to span the distance between classes.
sentence_zh: 學生們常使用智慧型手機來縮短課堂之間的時間距離。

definition_zh: (動) 跨越；持續
example_sentence: A career spanning several decades requires constant learning.
sentence_zh: 一個跨越數十年的職業需要不斷學習。

definition_zh: (動) 抽出（時間）；讓出；節省　(形) 多餘的；備用的
example_sentence: Can you spare a few minutes to help me with this math problem?
sentence_zh: 你能抽出幾分鐘幫我解這道數學題嗎？

definition_zh: (形) 節省的；吝嗇的；少量的
example_sentence: The teacher was sparing with her praise for the student's work.
sentence_zh: 老師對學生的作品讚美不多。

definition_zh: (片) 引發；觸發
example_sentence: The teacher's harsh criticism sparked off a heated debate among students.
sentence_zh: 老師嚴厲的批評在學生之間引發了一場激烈的辯論。

sentence_zh: 許多學生在困難時期支持他們的朋友。

definition_zh: (片) 退出；退位

sentence_zh: 選舉結果公布後，落敗的候選人決定退出。

definition_zh: (片) 代表；主張

sentence_zh: 許多學生加入社團，以代表他們的信念和價值觀。

definition_zh: (片) 代替；暫代

sentence_zh: 老師請湯姆代替缺席的班長。

definition_zh: (片) 突出；脫穎而出

sentence_zh: 她富有創意的設計幫助她在比賽中脫穎而出。

sentence_zh: 經得起時間考驗的友誼往往帶來極大的快樂。

sentence_zh: 學生必須在課堂討論中捍衛自己的信念。

definition_zh: (形) 站立的；單人喜劇的　(名) 脫口秀；站立表演

sentence_zh: 全班決定為學校園遊會舉辦一場脫口秀表演。

definition_zh: (動) 站立；忍受　(名) 立場；攤位

definition_zh: (形) 獨立的；獨立運作的

sentence_zh: 一個獨立運作的應用程式不需要網路連線就能使用。

definition_zh: (名) 標準；水準　(形) 標準的；普通的

sentence_zh: 為了確保公平，學校決定標準化所有班級的評分系統。

definition_zh: (名) 立場；觀點

sentence_zh: 為了理解這個議題，學生必須考慮每個立場。

sentence_zh: 許多學生把零食藏在置物櫃裡以備稍後享用。

sentence_zh: 環境的狀況令我們學校許多學生擔憂。

sentence_zh: 在經理發表聲明後，團隊感到鬆了一口氣。

definition_zh: (名) 政治家；國務活動家

sentence_zh: 領導和平談判的政治家受到廣泛尊敬。

sentence_zh: 擔心這個上升的統計數字，老師向全班解釋了數據。

sentence_zh: 統計數據顯示了學生表現的明確趨勢。

definition_zh: (副) 統計上地

sentence_zh: 從統計上來說，定期讀書的學生在考試中得分較高。

definition_zh: (名) 統計學家；統計員

sentence_zh: 分析完數據後，這位統計學家向全班展示了清晰的趨勢。

definition_zh: (名) 統計；統計數據

sentence_zh: 統計數據顯示，越來越多的學生選擇自然科學課程。

sentence_zh: 公園裡的銅像每個週末吸引許多遊客。

sentence_zh: 擔心自己的社會地位，這個學生加入了許多社團。

sentence_zh: 只有在抗議之後，政府才修訂了那項有爭議的法規。

sentence_zh: 如果公司違反法定規定，可能面臨嚴厲處罰。

sentence_zh: 儘管外面風暴肆虐，她對安全的堅定信念讓每個人都保持冷靜。

sentence_zh: 老師要求學生在小組專題期間專注於任務。

definition_zh: (片) 不介入；避開；留在外面

sentence_zh: 老師告訴學生放學後不要惹麻煩。

sentence_zh: 如果颱風來襲，我的朋友會在我家過夜。

sentence_zh: 許多學生熬夜是為了在截止日期前完成作業。

definition_zh: (動) 停留；待

sentence_zh: 我的表弟決定待在家裡準備考試。

definition_zh: (形) 堅定的；不動搖的

sentence_zh: 這名學生在學習上堅定的努力使她獲得了最高分。

definition_zh: (片) 偷偷溜出；潛出

sentence_zh: 那位好奇的學生決定在休息時間偷偷溜出教室。
