definition_zh: (名) 鋼鐵；鋼
example_sentence: The bridge made of steel can hold many cars.
sentence_zh: 這座由鋼鐵製成的橋樑可以承載許多車輛。

definition_zh: (形) 鋼鐵般的；堅定的；冷酷的
example_sentence: The coach's steely gaze motivated the team to work harder.
sentence_zh: 教練鋼鐵般的目光激勵了團隊更加努力。

definition_zh: (片) 沉浸於；埋頭研究
example_sentence: Only after high school did many students steep themselves in English literature.
sentence_zh: 直到高中畢業後，許多學生才全心投入英國文學。

definition_zh: (形) 陡峭的；急遽的
example_sentence: The path to the old temple is too steep for many students.
sentence_zh: 通往古老寺廟的小路對許多學生來說太陡了。

definition_zh: (副) 陡峭地；急遽地
example_sentence: The path that led to the mountain top rose steeply.
sentence_zh: 通往山頂的那條小路陡峭地上升。

definition_zh: (片) 避開；繞開
example_sentence: Steering clear of junk food, the student improved his health.
sentence_zh: 避開垃圾食物，那名學生改善了健康。

definition_zh: (動) 駕駛；引導
example_sentence: The student who steers the group project must stay focused.
sentence_zh: 引導小組專題的學生必須保持專注。

definition_zh: (片) 源於；來自
example_sentence: Many of his problems stem from a lack of sleep.
sentence_zh: 他的許多問題源於睡眠不足。

definition_zh: (動) 阻止；遏制　(名) 莖；柄
example_sentence: Many students stem their anxiety by studying in groups.
sentence_zh: 許多學生透過小組讀書來控制焦慮。

definition_zh: (名) 家系；傳承譜系
example_sentence: Although the stemma of this ancient text is complex, historians can trace its origins.
sentence_zh: 雖然這份古代文本的傳承譜系很複雜，歷史學家仍能追溯其起源。

definition_zh: (名) 惡臭；臭氣
example_sentence: After the garbage truck left, a terrible stench filled the alley.
sentence_zh: 垃圾車離開後，一股可怕的惡臭充滿了巷子。

definition_zh: (名) 模板；蠟紙
example_sentence: The stencil that the art club uses has a beautiful floral pattern.
sentence_zh: 美術社使用的那個模板有美麗的花卉圖案。

definition_zh: (名) 速記員
example_sentence: If a stenographer records every word, the meeting minutes will be accurate.
sentence_zh: 如果速記員記錄每個字，會議記錄就會準確。

definition_zh: (片) 讓位；退讓
example_sentence: If the manager asked for a change, the veteran employee would step aside.
sentence_zh: 如果經理要求改變，這位資深員工會讓位。

definition_zh: (片) 退一步；退出
example_sentence: The project required a step back to evaluate the results.
sentence_zh: 這個專案需要退一步來評估結果。

definition_zh: (片) 辭職；下台
example_sentence: The principal decided to step down after twenty years of service.
sentence_zh: 校長在服務二十年後決定卸任。

definition_zh: (片) 上前；主動提供幫助
example_sentence: Having stepped forward to help, the student received praise from the teacher.
sentence_zh: 在主動上前幫忙後，那名學生得到了老師的讚揚。

definition_zh: (片) 介入；干預
example_sentence: When the argument became too heated, the teacher had to step in.
sentence_zh: 當爭論變得過於激烈時，老師不得不介入。

definition_zh: (片) 加快速度；踩油門
example_sentence: Having realized they were late, the driver decided to step on it.
sentence_zh: 意識到他們遲到了，司機決定踩油門加速。

definition_zh: (片) 走出；離開
example_sentence: The student who steps out of class early must get a permission slip.
sentence_zh: 提早離開教室的學生必須拿到許可單。

definition_zh: (片) 走向前；邁步走向
example_sentence: The student who steps to the front will receive a prize.
sentence_zh: 走到前面的學生將會獲得獎品。

definition_zh: (名) 腳步；步驟　(動) 踏；踩
example_sentence: The first step to success is setting a clear goal.
sentence_zh: 成功的第一步是設定一個明確的目標。

definition_zh: (名) 繼子；繼女
example_sentence: Feeling neglected, the stepchild worked hard to impress his new family.
sentence_zh: 感到被忽視，這個繼子努力表現以打動他的新家人。

definition_zh: (名) 繼父
example_sentence: My stepfather taught me how to fix a bicycle last weekend.
sentence_zh: 我的繼父上週末教我如何修理腳踏車。

definition_zh: (名) 梯凳；折梯
example_sentence: My father used a stepladder to reach the top shelf.
sentence_zh: 我父親用一個梯凳來夠到最上層的架子。

definition_zh: (名) 繼母；後母
example_sentence: Maria's stepmother helped her prepare for the school play.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞的繼母幫她準備學校話劇。

definition_zh: (名) 立體聲音響；立體聲系統
example_sentence: My new stereo system fills the room with clear sound.
sentence_zh: 我的新立體聲音響系統讓房間充滿清晰的聲音。

definition_zh: (名) 刻板印象　(動) 對…形成刻板印象
example_sentence: Stereotyping people based on their appearance often leads to misunderstanding.
sentence_zh: 根據外表對人產生刻板印象常導致誤解。

definition_zh: (形) 無菌的；消過毒的
example_sentence: After the surgery, the doctor ensured all tools were sterile.
sentence_zh: 手術後，醫生確保所有工具都是無菌的。

definition_zh: (名) 消毒器；殺菌器
example_sentence: The hospital sterilizer kills all harmful bacteria on surgical tools.
sentence_zh: 醫院的消毒器可以殺死手術工具上的所有有害細菌。

definition_zh: (名) 英鎊；純銀製品　(形) 純銀的；優秀的；可靠的
example_sentence: Many students save their sterling allowance to buy new books.
sentence_zh: 許多學生存下他們的英鎊零用錢來買新書。

definition_zh: (名) 聽診器
example_sentence: The doctor used a stethoscope to listen to the patient's heartbeat.
sentence_zh: 醫生用聽診器聽病人的心跳。

definition_zh: (動) 燉；悶煮　(名) 燉菜；悶煮的食物
example_sentence: Having stewed the beef for hours, the chef served a tender meal.
sentence_zh: 將牛肉燉了幾小時後，主廚端出一道軟嫩的菜餚。

definition_zh: (名) 乘務員；服務員
example_sentence: The flight steward helped the elderly passenger find her seat.
sentence_zh: 這位空服員幫助年長乘客找到她的座位。

definition_zh: (名) 空服員；女服務員
example_sentence: Never before had a stewardess been so kind to the nervous passenger.
sentence_zh: 空服員從未對緊張的乘客如此友善。

definition_zh: (片) 留下來；逗留
example_sentence: The students who stick around after class often ask the teacher questions.
sentence_zh: 放學後留下來的學生經常問老師問題。

definition_zh: (片) 支持；忠於
example_sentence: True friends always stick by each other through difficult times.
sentence_zh: 真正的朋友總是在困難時期互相支持。

definition_zh: (片) 黏住；貼牢
example_sentence: The teacher asked the students to stick down their notes in their notebooks.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生把筆記黏貼在筆記本上。

definition_zh: (片) 反抗；對抗；報復
example_sentence: The student decided to stick it to the strict teacher by finishing early.
sentence_zh: 這個學生決定提早完成，以此來對抗嚴格的老師。

definition_zh: (片) 堅持；極力維護
example_sentence: The students who stick out for their rights often gain respect.
sentence_zh: 那些堅持自己權利的學生經常贏得尊重。

definition_zh: (片) 伸出；突出
example_sentence: The teacher told the student not to stick out his tongue in class.
sentence_zh: 老師告訴學生不要在課堂上伸舌頭。

definition_zh: (片) 堅持；遵守
example_sentence: Students should stick to their study plan for better exam results.
sentence_zh: 學生應該堅持他們的讀書計畫以獲得更好的考試成績。

definition_zh: (片) 團結一致；互相支持
example_sentence: The team members decided to stick together during the difficult project.
sentence_zh: 團隊成員決定在困難的專案期間團結一致。

definition_zh: stick up for
(片) 貼上；豎起
example_sentence: If the poster does not stick up properly, use more tape.
sentence_zh: 如果海報沒有牢固地貼好，請多用一些膠帶。

definition_zh: (片) 堅持；繼續支持
example_sentence: Students who stick with their study plan often achieve better results.
sentence_zh: 堅持學習計畫的學生通常會取得更好的成績。

definition_zh: (動) 黏貼；插入　(名) 樹枝；棍子
example_sentence: The teacher asked the students to stick the poster on the wall.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生把海報貼在牆上。

definition_zh: (動) 黏住；堅持　(名) 棍棒；枝條
example_sentence: If you stick to your study plan, your grades will improve significantly.
sentence_zh: 如果你堅持你的讀書計畫，你的成績會顯著進步。

definition_zh: (名) 貼紙；黏貼物
example_sentence: The sticker that my friend gave me is on my laptop.
sentence_zh: 我朋友給我的那張貼紙在我的筆記型電腦上。

definition_zh: (形) 黏的；棘手的
example_sentence: The sticky candy melted quickly in the hot summer sun.
sentence_zh: 那顆黏黏的糖果在炎熱的夏日陽光下迅速融化了。

definition_zh: (形) 硬的；僵硬的；(態度) 嚴格的
example_sentence: If the teacher's grading were less stiff, students would feel more relaxed.
sentence_zh: 如果老師的評分不那麼嚴格，學生會感到更放鬆。

definition_zh: (片) 變得僵硬；緊張起來
example_sentence: Stiffening up before a big test, the student took deep breaths to relax.
sentence_zh: 在大型考試前變得僵硬，那名學生深呼吸以放鬆。

definition_zh: (動) 壓制；扼殺
example_sentence: The teacher's strict rules may stifle students' creativity in class.
sentence_zh: 老師的嚴格規定可能會壓制學生在課堂上的創造力。

definition_zh: (形) 汙名化的；恥辱的
example_sentence: Many students join the club to reduce the stigmatic view of mental illness.
sentence_zh: 許多學生加入社團，以減少對心理疾病的汙名化看法。

definition_zh: (動) 污名化；使蒙上汙名
example_sentence: The campaign aims to reduce the stigma that stigmatizes people with mental illness.
sentence_zh: 這項運動旨在減少污名化精神疾病患者的汙名。

definition_zh: (形) 靜止的；不動的　(副) 仍然；還是
example_sentence: Seldom still during class, the energetic boy often disturbs others.
sentence_zh: 這個精力充沛的男孩上課時很少安靜，經常打擾別人。

definition_zh: (動) 刺激；激發
example_sentence: The teacher's creative method can stimulate students' interest in science.
sentence_zh: 老師的創意方法能激發學生對科學的興趣。

definition_zh: (名) 刺激；激勵
example_sentence: The bright lights in the arcade provide constant stimulation for the players.
sentence_zh: 遊樂場裡的明亮燈光為玩家提供持續的刺激。

definition_zh: (名) 刺激；刺激物
example_sentence: The teacher used a funny video as a stimulus for class discussion.
sentence_zh: 老師用一個有趣的影片作為課堂討論的刺激物。

definition_zh: (動) 刺；螫　(名) 刺；刺痛
example_sentence: Having been stung by a bee, the boy cried loudly in the park.
sentence_zh: 被蜜蜂螫到後，那個男孩在公園裡大聲哭了起來。

definition_zh: (形) 小氣的；吝嗇的
example_sentence: My stingy classmate never shares his snacks with anyone.
sentence_zh: 我那個小氣的同學從不與任何人分享他的零食。

definition_zh: (動) 發臭；有臭味　(名) 臭味；惡臭
example_sentence: The garbage left in the sun began to stink after three days.
sentence_zh: 留在陽光下的垃圾三天後開始發臭。

definition_zh: (形) 臭的；有臭味的
example_sentence: The stinky tofu at the night market is surprisingly delicious.
sentence_zh: 夜市裡的臭豆腐出奇地美味。

definition_zh: (名) 工作期間；任期　(動) 節省；吝惜
example_sentence: Her brief stint as a volunteer teacher inspired many students.
sentence_zh: 她短暫擔任志工教師的經歷啟發了許多學生。

definition_zh: (動) 規定；明確要求
example_sentence: The contract, stipulating strict deadlines, was signed by both parties.
sentence_zh: 這份規定嚴格截止日期的合約由雙方簽署。

definition_zh: (名) 規定；條款
example_sentence: The contract includes a stipulation that all students must attend the orientation.
sentence_zh: 這份合約包含一項規定，所有學生都必須參加新生訓練。

definition_zh: (片) 煽動；激起
example_sentence: The politician tried to stir up anger among the crowd.
sentence_zh: 那位政治人物試圖在人群中煽動憤怒。

definition_zh: (名) 騷動；攪動　(動) 攪拌；攪動；激起
example_sentence: When the teacher asked a hard question, a sudden stir spread through the classroom.
sentence_zh: 當老師問了一個困難的問題時，一陣突然的騷動在教室裡蔓延開來。

definition_zh: (片) 縫合；拼湊；結合
example_sentence: After the earthquake, volunteers worked to stitch together the torn fabrics of the community.
sentence_zh: 地震過後，志工們努力將社區破碎的結構縫合起來。

definition_zh: (動) 縫合；縫補
example_sentence: If a doctor could stitch up the wound, the patient would recover faster.
sentence_zh: 如果醫生能縫合傷口，病人會恢復得更快。

definition_zh: (名) 一針；縫線　(動) 縫合；縫補
example_sentence: A single stitch can save a torn shirt from getting worse.
sentence_zh: 一針可以防止破掉的襯衫變得更糟。

definition_zh: (名) 存貨；股票　(動) 儲存；供應
example_sentence: If the store stocks more organic food, more customers will visit.
sentence_zh: 如果這家店儲備更多有機食品，就會有更多顧客光顧。

definition_zh: (名) 股票經紀人
example_sentence: Working as a stockbroker, Mr. Chen analyzes market trends daily.
sentence_zh: 身為股票經紀人，陳先生每天分析市場趨勢。

definition_zh: (名) 長襪；襪子
example_sentence: My grandmother knitted a warm stocking for my little brother.
sentence_zh: 我的祖母為我的小弟弟織了一隻溫暖的長襪。

definition_zh: (動) 囤積；積聚
example_sentence: Stockpiling face masks, the government prepared for the next pandemic.
sentence_zh: 政府囤積口罩，為下一次大流行做準備。

definition_zh: (形) 堅忍的；禁慾的
example_sentence: The athlete remained stoical despite the intense pain from his injury.
sentence_zh: 這位運動員儘管因傷感到劇烈疼痛，仍保持堅忍。

definition_zh: (副) 堅忍地；坦然地面對
example_sentence: The student who faced the exam results stoically impressed the teacher.
sentence_zh: 那位面對考試結果表現堅忍的學生讓老師印象深刻。

definition_zh: (名) 堅忍；禁慾主義
example_sentence: The patient's stoicism during the long treatment inspired the entire hospital staff.
sentence_zh: 這位病人在長期治療中的堅忍感動了整個醫院員工。

definition_zh: (名) 胃；腹部
example_sentence: Feeling a sharp pain in his stomach, Tom decided to visit the school nurse.
sentence_zh: 感到胃部一陣劇痛，湯姆決定去看學校護士。

definition_zh: (名) 胃痛；肚子痛
example_sentence: After eating too much ice cream, Tom had a terrible stomachache.
sentence_zh: 吃了太多冰淇淋後，湯姆肚子痛得很厲害。

definition_zh: (片) 跺腳離去；怒氣沖沖地走開
example_sentence: The angry customer stomped off after complaining about the service.
sentence_zh: 那位生氣的顧客在抱怨服務後跺腳離開。

definition_zh: (片) 用力踩；踐踏
example_sentence: After the game, angry fans stomp on the seats.
sentence_zh: 比賽結束後，憤怒的粉絲用力踩踏座位。

definition_zh: (動) 跺腳；踩踏
example_sentence: If a bully stomped on your foot, would you report it to the teacher?
sentence_zh: 如果惡霸踩了你的腳，你會向老師報告嗎？

definition_zh: (名) 石頭　(動) 向...扔石頭
example_sentence: If a student throws a stone into the pond, it will create ripples.
sentence_zh: 如果學生把石頭扔進池塘，它會產生漣漪。

definition_zh: (名) 常吸大麻的人；懶散的人
example_sentence: The stoner skipped class to hang out with his friends.
sentence_zh: 那個常吸大麻的人翹課去和朋友閒晃。

definition_zh: (名) 凳子；擱腳凳
example_sentence: The wooden stool in the kitchen is perfect for reaching high shelves.
sentence_zh: 廚房裡的那張木凳很適合用來拿高處的架子。

definition_zh: (動) 彎腰；屈身
example_sentence: Stooping to pick up trash, the student showed great environmental awareness.
sentence_zh: 彎腰撿垃圾時，那名學生展現了高度的環保意識。

definition_zh: (片) 停靠；逗留
example_sentence: If the bus stops around the corner, students can get on easily.
sentence_zh: 如果公車在轉角處停靠，學生就能輕鬆上車。

definition_zh: (片) 回到；再次拜訪
example_sentence: If you need more books, please stop back at the library.
sentence_zh: 如果你需要更多書，請再來圖書館一趟。

definition_zh: (片) 在……後面停下
example_sentence: The bus must stop behind the yellow line at the station.
sentence_zh: 公車必須在車站的黃線後方停車。

definition_zh: (片) 順道拜訪；短暫停留
example_sentence: The student whose house is near the library can stop by after school.
sentence_zh: 家離圖書館近的那位學生可以在放學後順道拜訪。

definition_zh: (片) 中途停留；順道拜訪
example_sentence: Having stopped off at a convenience store, the student bought a bottle of water.
sentence_zh: 在便利商店稍作停留後，那名學生買了一瓶水。

definition_zh: (片) 中途退出；停止參與
example_sentence: The heavy rain caused many students to stop out of the game.
sentence_zh: 大雨導致許多學生中途退出比賽。

definition_zh: (片) 中途停留；短暫停留
example_sentence: The family whose car broke down had to stop over in a small town.
sentence_zh: 車子拋錨的那家人不得不在一個小鎮停留過夜。

definition_zh: (片) 堵塞；阻塞
example_sentence: If the drain stopped up, the kitchen sink would overflow quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果排水管堵塞，廚房水槽很快就會溢出。

definition_zh: (動) 停止；停下　(名) 停止；車站
example_sentence: The bus will stop at the next corner to pick up passengers.
sentence_zh: 公車將在下一個街角停下來接乘客。

definition_zh: (名) 中途停留；短暫停留
example_sentence: The flight to Japan includes a short stopover in Taipei.
sentence_zh: 飛往日本的航班在台北有一次短暫的停留。

definition_zh: (名) 儲存；儲藏
example_sentence: The school built a new storage room for sports equipment.
sentence_zh: 學校為運動器材建造了一個新的儲藏室。

definition_zh: (片) 儲存；累積
example_sentence: If a student stores up notes before exams, the review becomes easier.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試前儲存筆記，複習就會變得更輕鬆。

definition_zh: (名) 商店；儲存　(動) 儲存；存放
example_sentence: Many students go to the store to buy snacks after school.
sentence_zh: 許多學生放學後去商店買零食。

definition_zh: (名) 倉庫；寶庫
example_sentence: If our school builds a storehouse for books, students can borrow them easily.
sentence_zh: 如果我們學校建造一個書籍倉庫，學生就能輕鬆借閱。

definition_zh: (名) 樓層
example_sentence: The new library has an extra storey for quiet study rooms.
sentence_zh: 新圖書館多了一層樓作為安靜的讀書室。

definition_zh: (名) 暴風雨；風暴
example_sentence: The students stayed indoors to wait for the storm to pass.
sentence_zh: 學生們待在室內，等待暴風雨過去。

definition_zh: (片) 憤然離去；怒氣沖沖地走開
example_sentence: The angry student stormed off after the teacher criticized his homework.
sentence_zh: 那位生氣的學生在老師批評他的作業後憤然離去。

definition_zh: (片) 怒氣沖沖地離開；拂袖而去
example_sentence: The angry customer stormed out of the store after the argument.
sentence_zh: 那位生氣的顧客在爭吵後衝出了商店。

definition_zh: (名) 暴風雨；風暴　(動) 猛攻；怒罵
example_sentence: Only after the storm passed did the students return to school.
sentence_zh: 暴風雨過去後，學生們才回到學校。

definition_zh: (形) 暴風雨的；激烈的
example_sentence: If the weather is stormy, the school will cancel the outdoor activity.
sentence_zh: 如果天氣是暴風雨的，學校就會取消戶外活動。

definition_zh: (名) 故事；傳聞
example_sentence: A good story can help people understand different cultures.
sentence_zh: 一個好故事可以幫助人們了解不同的文化。

definition_zh: (名) 故事講述者；說書人
example_sentence: The elderly storyteller captivated the children with his ancient tales.
sentence_zh: 那位年長的故事講述者用他的古老故事吸引了孩子們。

definition_zh: (形) 粗壯的；結實的　(名) 烈性黑啤酒
example_sentence: If a stout tree stands firm, the storm cannot break its branches.
sentence_zh: 如果一棵粗壯的樹屹立不搖，風暴就無法折斷它的枝幹。

definition_zh: (名) 爐子；火爐
example_sentence: The stove that my mother bought last week is very easy to clean.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽上週買的那個爐子非常容易清潔。

definition_zh: (片) 偷渡；偷偷藏匿
example_sentence: Stowing away on a ship, the young boy dreamed of adventure.
sentence_zh: 那個小男孩偷偷躲在船上，夢想著冒險。

definition_zh: (片) 直截了當地；開門見山地
example_sentence: Getting straight to the point, the teacher explained the exam format.
sentence_zh: 開門見山地，老師解釋了考試格式。

definition_zh: (形) 直的；直接的　(副) 直接地；筆直地
example_sentence: The path to the school goes straight through the park.
sentence_zh: 通往學校的路徑筆直地穿過公園。

definition_zh: (片) 整理；清理
example_sentence: Straightening up his room, the student found his lost homework.
sentence_zh: 整理房間時，那名學生找到了他遺失的作業。

definition_zh: (動) 弄直；整理
example_sentence: Straightening her messy desk, Mia found her missing pen.
sentence_zh: 整理她凌亂的書桌時，Mia 找到了她遺失的筆。

definition_zh: (形) 直接的；簡單的
example_sentence: The instructions for the science project were straightforward and easy to follow.
sentence_zh: 科學專題的說明非常直接且容易遵循。

definition_zh: (名) 壓力；負擔　(動) 拉緊；使疲勞
example_sentence: Students often strain their eyes by studying too long in dim light.
sentence_zh: 學生們常常因為在昏暗的燈光下讀書太久而讓眼睛過度疲勞。

definition_zh: (形) 緊張的；疲憊的　(動) 使緊張；過度使用
example_sentence: Strained by the heavy workload, the student decided to take a short break.
sentence_zh: 因課業繁重而感到壓力，這位學生決定短暫休息一下。

definition_zh: (名) 濾網；濾器
example_sentence: The metal strainer that my grandmother uses has tiny holes.
sentence_zh: 我祖母使用的金屬濾網有細小的孔洞。

definition_zh: (名) 海峽
example_sentence: The ship sailed through the narrow strait to reach the open sea.
sentence_zh: 這艘船穿過狹窄的海峽以到達開闊的海洋。

definition_zh: (名) 一股；一縷；線
example_sentence: A single strand of hair can hold important DNA information.
sentence_zh: 一根頭髮可以保存重要的DNA資訊。

definition_zh: (動) 使擱淺；使受困　(形) 擱淺的；無助的
example_sentence: If a typhoon hits, many travelers may become stranded on the highway.
sentence_zh: 如果颱風來襲，許多旅客可能會受困在高速公路上。

definition_zh: (形) 奇怪的；陌生的
example_sentence: A strange noise came from the empty classroom after school.
sentence_zh: 放學後，空教室裡傳來一個奇怪的聲音。

definition_zh: (副) 奇怪地；異常地
example_sentence: Strangely, the school library was completely empty during lunch break.
sentence_zh: 奇怪的是，學校圖書館在午休時間完全空無一人。

definition_zh: (名) 陌生人
example_sentence: If a stranger offered you candy, would you take it?
sentence_zh: 如果一個陌生人給你糖果，你會接受嗎？

definition_zh: (動) 扼殺；勒死
example_sentence: The government's new policy may strangle small businesses with heavy taxes.
sentence_zh: 政府的新政策可能用重稅扼殺小企業。

definition_zh: (名) 帶子；皮帶　(動) 用帶子捆紮；束緊
example_sentence: The strap of my backpack broke during the hike.
sentence_zh: 我背包的帶子在健行時斷了。

definition_zh: (形) 策略性的；戰略性的
example_sentence: If the company had a strategic plan, it would avoid these losses.
sentence_zh: 如果這家公司有策略性的計劃，它就能避免這些損失。

definition_zh: (動) 制定策略；策劃
example_sentence: The team needs to strategize carefully before the big competition.
sentence_zh: 團隊在大型比賽前需要仔細制定策略。

definition_zh: (名) 策略；戰略
example_sentence: If our team adopted a better strategy, we would win more games.
sentence_zh: 如果我們的團隊採用更好的策略，我們就會贏得更多比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 吸管；稻草
example_sentence: Having used a metal straw for a year, Emily reduced her plastic waste significantly.
sentence_zh: 使用金屬吸管一年後，艾蜜莉顯著減少了她的塑膠垃圾。

definition_zh: (名) 草莓
example_sentence: Picking fresh strawberries from the farm made the students very happy.
sentence_zh: 從農場採摘新鮮草莓讓學生們非常開心。

definition_zh: (形) 流浪的；迷路的　(動) 走失；偏離
example_sentence: If a stray dog appears near the school, students should stay calm.
sentence_zh: 如果一隻流浪狗出現在學校附近，學生應該保持冷靜。

definition_zh: (名) 條紋；一陣子；連勝　(動) 飛奔；加上條紋
example_sentence: The basketball player has a winning streak of ten games.
sentence_zh: 這位籃球選手已經連贏十場比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 小溪；水流　(動) 流動；播放
example_sentence: The streaming platform that students use for study offers many courses.
sentence_zh: 學生用來學習的串流平台提供許多課程。

definition_zh: (名) 串流；線上播放　(動) 串流播放
example_sentence: Seldom has streaming replaced traditional TV so quickly.
sentence_zh: 串流很少如此迅速地取代傳統電視。

definition_zh: (動) 簡化；使效率更高
example_sentence: The school decided to streamline its application process for students.
sentence_zh: 學校決定簡化學生的申請流程。

definition_zh: (形) 流線型的；精簡的
example_sentence: The streamlined design of the new electric scooter reduces air resistance.
sentence_zh: 新款電動滑板車的流線型設計減少了空氣阻力。

definition_zh: (名) 街道；馬路
example_sentence: After the rain stopped, the street was quiet and clean.
sentence_zh: 雨停之後，街道變得安靜又乾淨。

definition_zh: (名) 力量；力氣
example_sentence: Having built her strength through daily practice, the runner won the race.
sentence_zh: 透過每日練習增強體力後，這位跑者贏得了比賽。

definition_zh: (動) 加強；增強
example_sentence: Strengthening the school's recycling program can reduce waste.
sentence_zh: 加強學校的回收計畫可以減少廢棄物。

definition_zh: (形) 費力的；艱巨的
example_sentence: The teacher designed a strenuous exercise that improved our endurance.
sentence_zh: 老師設計了一項費力的運動，增強了我們的耐力。

definition_zh: (副) 費力地；奮力地
example_sentence: The athlete trained strenuously every day to win the gold medal.
sentence_zh: 這位運動員每天努力訓練以贏得金牌。

definition_zh: (動) 強調；施加壓力　(名) 壓力；重點
example_sentence: If students stress too much before exams, their health may suffer.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試前壓力太大，他們的健康可能會受影響。

definition_zh: (形) 感到壓力的；緊張的
example_sentence: Many students feel stressed before the big exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在大考前感到壓力很大。

definition_zh: (形) 壓力大的；緊張的
example_sentence: Preparing for the final exams can be very stressful for students.
sentence_zh: 準備期末考對學生來說可能壓力很大。

definition_zh: (名) 壓力來源；壓力因素
example_sentence: A major stressor that many students face is the pressure of exams.
sentence_zh: 許多學生面臨的主要壓力來源是考試的壓力。

definition_zh: (片) 伸展；伸懶腰
example_sentence: The cat likes to stretch out on the warm floor.
sentence_zh: 這隻貓喜歡在溫暖的地板上伸懶腰。

definition_zh: (片) 誇大其詞；說謊
example_sentence: Stretching the truth, the student exaggerated his role in the project.
sentence_zh: 那位學生誇大其詞，誇大了他在專案中的角色。

definition_zh: (片) 足夠支付；延伸到
example_sentence: If the budget stretched to a new computer, the school would buy one.
sentence_zh: 如果預算足夠買一台新電腦，學校就會買一台。

definition_zh: (名) 伸展；一段（時間或空間）　(動) 伸展；拉長
example_sentence: The long stretch of beach near my school is a popular spot for students.
sentence_zh: 靠近我學校的那片長長的海灘是學生的熱門去處。

definition_zh: (片) 用擔架抬離
example_sentence: If a player gets injured, the team must stretcher him off the field.
sentence_zh: 如果一名球員受傷，球隊必須用擔架把他抬離球場。

definition_zh: (名) 擔架；伸張器
example_sentence: The stretcher was carried carefully by the paramedics to the ambulance.
sentence_zh: 擔架被醫護人員小心地抬到救護車上。

definition_zh: (形) 嚴格的；嚴厲的
example_sentence: The teacher who is strict with us always checks our homework carefully.
sentence_zh: 對我們嚴格的老師總是仔細檢查我們的作業。

definition_zh: (副) 嚴格地；嚴厲地
example_sentence: If the school strictly banned phones, students would focus more in class.
sentence_zh: 如果學校嚴格禁止手機，學生在課堂上會更專注。

definition_zh: (名) 大步；進展　(動) 大步走；跨越
example_sentence: The athlete took a long stride to cross the finish line first.
sentence_zh: 運動員跨出一大步，率先越過終點線。

definition_zh: (片) 反擊；回擊
example_sentence: The team decided to strike back after losing the first game.
sentence_zh: 球隊在輸掉第一場比賽後決定反擊。

definition_zh: (動) 廢除；取消
example_sentence: The judge decided to strike down the unfair law.
sentence_zh: 法官決定廢除這項不公平的法律。

definition_zh: (片) 刪除；取消
example_sentence: The committee decided to strike off his name from the list.
sentence_zh: 委員會決定將他的名字從名單中刪除。

definition_zh: (片) 突然想到；發現
example_sentence: Striking on a new idea, the team quickly drafted a plan.
sentence_zh: 突然想到一個新點子後，團隊迅速草擬了一份計畫。

definition_zh: (片) 開創；獨立行動
example_sentence: After failing the first test, the team decided to strike out on their own.
sentence_zh: 在第一次測試失敗後，團隊決定自行開創。

definition_zh: (片) 開始（談話、友誼等）；搭訕
example_sentence: David decided to strike up a conversation with the new student.
sentence_zh: 大衛決定與新同學搭話。

definition_zh: (動) 罷工；打擊　(名) 罷工；襲擊
example_sentence: Striking workers demanded better pay and safer working conditions.
sentence_zh: 罷工的工人要求更好的薪資和更安全的工作條件。

definition_zh: (名) 前鋒；罷工者
example_sentence: If the striker scored more goals, his team would win the championship.
sentence_zh: 如果這位前鋒進更多球，他的球隊就會贏得冠軍。

definition_zh: (形) 顯著的；驚人的
example_sentence: The striking contrast between the two paintings caught everyone's attention.
sentence_zh: 這兩幅畫之間驚人的對比吸引了每個人的注意。

definition_zh: (副) 顯著地；驚人地
example_sentence: Only after seeing the data did the team find the results strikingly different.
sentence_zh: 只有在看到數據後，團隊才發現結果驚人地不同。

definition_zh: (片) 欺騙；敷衍；吊胃口
example_sentence: Feeling tricked by his promises, Mia refused to be strung along any longer.
sentence_zh: 覺得被他的承諾欺騙了，米亞拒絕再被敷衍下去。

definition_zh: (片) 拉長；延長
example_sentence: Having strung out the wire, the technician checked each connection carefully.
sentence_zh: 將電線拉長後，技術人員仔細檢查了每個連接處。

definition_zh: (片) 串聯；把…串在一起
example_sentence: The student used colorful beads to string together a necklace.
sentence_zh: 那位學生用彩色珠子串成一條項鍊。

definition_zh: (片) 掛起；懸掛
example_sentence: The students decided to string up lights for the school festival.
sentence_zh: 學生們決定為學校校慶掛上燈飾。

definition_zh: (名) 繩子；線　(動) 串起；繫
example_sentence: Students use a string to tie the balloons together for the festival.
sentence_zh: 學生們用一條繩子把氣球綁在一起，為節日做準備。

definition_zh: (片) 剝離；去除
example_sentence: The new policy that strips away outdated regulations will benefit students.
sentence_zh: 這項新政策剝離了過時的規定，將使學生受益。

definition_zh: (片) 脫掉；拆解；剝離
example_sentence: Having stripped down the engine, the mechanic found the broken part.
sentence_zh: 拆解引擎後，技師找到了損壞的零件。

definition_zh: (片) 剝奪；奪去
example_sentence: Having been stripped of his title, the former champion struggled to regain his confidence.
sentence_zh: 被剝奪頭銜後，這位前冠軍努力重拾信心。

definition_zh: (片) 剝去；脫掉
example_sentence: Stripping off the old paint, the workers prepared the wall for a fresh coat.
sentence_zh: 剝掉舊油漆後，工人們準備好牆面以便塗上新的一層。

definition_zh: (片) 去除；刪除
example_sentence: Having stripped out the unnecessary details, the report became much clearer.
sentence_zh: 去除不必要的細節後，這份報告變得清晰多了。

definition_zh: (片) 拆解到；剝去至
example_sentence: The mechanic needs to strip to the engine to find the problem.
sentence_zh: 技師需要拆卸到引擎才能找出問題。

definition_zh: (動) 剝去；脫掉　(名) 條；帶
example_sentence: The students will strip the paint from the old desks before class.
sentence_zh: 學生們會在課前把舊書桌的油漆剝掉。

definition_zh: (名) 條紋；斑紋　(動) 加條紋
example_sentence: The student painted a white stripe on the blue poster.
sentence_zh: 那位學生在藍色海報上畫了一條白色條紋。

definition_zh: (動) 剝除；脫去
example_sentence: The old paint was stripped from the classroom walls.
sentence_zh: 舊油漆從教室牆壁上被剝除。

definition_zh: (形) 條紋的；有條紋的
example_sentence: The stripy cat hid behind the old sofa in the living room.
sentence_zh: 那隻條紋貓躲在客廳的舊沙發後面。

definition_zh: (動) 努力；奮鬥
example_sentence: Students must strive to improve their English skills before the exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們必須在考試前努力提升他們的英語能力。

definition_zh: (名) 划水；中風　(動) 撫摸；划水
example_sentence: The swimmer uses a strong stroke to reach the shore quickly.
sentence_zh: 游泳者用強勁的划水動作迅速游到岸邊。

definition_zh: (動) 漫步；閒逛　(名) 散步
example_sentence: Before the exam, Linda likes to stroll through the park.
sentence_zh: 考試前，琳達喜歡在公園裡漫步。

definition_zh: (名) 嬰兒車；折疊式推車
example_sentence: The mother brought a stroller to carry her baby through the park.
sentence_zh: 那位母親帶了一台嬰兒車，以便推著寶寶穿過公園。

definition_zh: (形) 強壯的；強大的；堅固的
example_sentence: Feeling strong after a good night's sleep, the student finished the test quickly.
sentence_zh: 在睡了一晚好覺後感到精力充沛，這位學生快速完成了考試。

definition_zh: (副) 強烈地；堅決地
example_sentence: The principal strongly advised students to join the club.
sentence_zh: 校長強烈建議學生加入這個社團。

definition_zh: (形) 結構的；構造的
example_sentence: The team studied the structural design to improve the building's safety.
sentence_zh: 團隊研究結構設計以改善建築物的安全性。

definition_zh: (形) 結構的；結構性的
example_sentence: The structural damage to the old bridge required immediate repair.
sentence_zh: 這座舊橋的結構性損壞需要立即修復。

definition_zh: (名) 結構；構造
example_sentence: Seldom does the structure of a building remain unchanged for centuries.
sentence_zh: 建築物的結構很少能保持數世紀不變。

definition_zh: (動) 奮鬥；努力　(名) 掙扎；鬥爭
example_sentence: Many students struggle with time management during exam season.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在考試季節期間與時間管理奮鬥。

definition_zh: (動) 彈奏；撥弄
example_sentence: The guitarist began to strum a gentle melody on the old guitar.
sentence_zh: 吉他手開始在老吉他上輕柔地彈奏旋律。

definition_zh: (動) 趾高氣揚地走；昂首闊步　(名) 高視闊步；支柱
example_sentence: The peacock began to strut proudly across the garden.
sentence_zh: 孔雀開始驕傲地穿過花園昂首闊步。

definition_zh: (片) 熄滅（香煙）；掐滅
example_sentence: The student who forgot to stub out his cigarette caused a fire.
sentence_zh: 那個忘記熄滅香煙的學生引起了一場火災。

definition_zh: (名) 殘餘部分；存根　(動) 碰傷（腳趾）；使受阻
example_sentence: Students use a pencil stub to mark their answers on the test sheet.
sentence_zh: 學生們用鉛筆頭在答案卷上標記他們的答案。

definition_zh: (形) 固執的；頑固的
example_sentence: The stubborn boy refused to listen to any advice from his teacher.
sentence_zh: 那個固執的男孩拒絕聽從老師的任何建議。

definition_zh: (副) 固執地；頑固地
example_sentence: The little boy stubbornly refused to eat his vegetables at dinner.
sentence_zh: 那個小男孩固執地拒絕在晚餐時吃他的蔬菜。

definition_zh: (名) 種馬；釘子
example_sentence: The stud farmer raises horses that have strong legs.
sentence_zh: 那種種馬農場飼養的馬匹擁有強壯的腿。

definition_zh: (名) 學生
example_sentence: Many students use a dictionary to learn new words.
sentence_zh: 許多學生使用字典來學習新單字。

definition_zh: (名) 工作室；畫室；錄音室
example_sentence: Inspired by a famous painter, the studio opened a new art class for students.
sentence_zh: 受到一位著名畫家的啟發，這間工作室為學生開設了新的藝術課程。

definition_zh: (形) 用功的；勤奮的
example_sentence: Having been studious throughout high school, Emily earned a scholarship to her dream university.
sentence_zh: 高中時期一直很用功，艾蜜莉獲得了她夢想大學的獎學金。

definition_zh: (名) 讀書；研究　(動) 學習；研究
example_sentence: Seldom does a quiet library provide a better environment for study.
sentence_zh: 安靜的圖書館很少提供更好的讀書環境。

definition_zh: (名) 東西；物品　(動) 填塞；裝滿
example_sentence: The old stuff in the garage needs to be sorted out.
sentence_zh: 車庫裡的舊東西需要整理出來。

definition_zh: (形) 悶熱的；不通風的
example_sentence: Feeling stuffy in the crowded library, Amy opened the window.
sentence_zh: 在擁擠的圖書館裡感到悶熱，艾咪打開了窗戶。

definition_zh: (片) 偶然發現；無意中遇到
example_sentence: The student stumbled across a rare book in the library.
sentence_zh: 那名學生在圖書館裡偶然發現了一本罕見的書。

definition_zh: (動) 絆倒；結巴地說；(名) 絆倒
example_sentence: The student who stumbled during the presentation felt embarrassed.
sentence_zh: 在報告中絆倒的那位學生感到尷尬。

definition_zh: (片) 掏腰包；付錢
example_sentence: Stumping up the cash for a new phone, the student regretted his impulse.
sentence_zh: 為了新手機掏錢，這名學生對自己的衝動感到後悔。

definition_zh: (名) 樹樁；殘株　(動) 使困惑；難倒
example_sentence: The teacher used a difficult question to stump the entire class during the quiz.
sentence_zh: 老師在測驗中使用一個困難的問題來難倒全班。

definition_zh: (動) 使震驚；使目瞪口呆
example_sentence: The unexpected news about the exam change stunned every student in the class.
sentence_zh: 關於考試改變的意外消息震驚了班上每位學生。

definition_zh: (形) 令人震驚的；極美麗的
example_sentence: The stunning sunset over the ocean took everyone's breath away.
sentence_zh: 海洋上令人驚嘆的日落讓每個人都屏息。

definition_zh: (副) 驚人地；極其
example_sentence: The city skyline looked stunningly beautiful at night.
sentence_zh: 城市的天際線在夜晚看起來 stunningly 美麗。

definition_zh: (名) 特技；噱頭　(動) 阻礙；妨礙
example_sentence: The movie's dangerous car chase stunt amazed the audience.
sentence_zh: 電影中危險的飛車特技讓觀眾驚嘆不已。

definition_zh: (名) 特技演員
example_sentence: Working as a stuntman, Jason jumped from a moving car safely.
sentence_zh: 作為一名特技演員，傑森安全地從一輛行駛中的汽車跳下。

definition_zh: (形) 愚蠢的；笨的
example_sentence: That stupid mistake cost the team the game.
sentence_zh: 那個愚蠢的失誤讓球隊輸掉了比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 恍惚；昏迷
example_sentence: The student's stupor after the exam worried his teacher.
sentence_zh: 考試後學生的恍惚狀態讓他的老師很擔心。

definition_zh: (形) 堅固的；強壯的
example_sentence: The sturdy wooden desk has survived three generations of students.
sentence_zh: 這張堅固的木桌已經歷了三代學生。

definition_zh: (動) 口吃；結結巴巴地說　(名) 口吃
example_sentence: Many students who stutter find public speaking very challenging.
sentence_zh: 許多有口吃的學生覺得公開演講非常具有挑戰性。

definition_zh: (名) 針眼；麥粒腫
example_sentence: A painful stye on my eyelid made it hard to see clearly.
sentence_zh: 我眼皮上一個疼痛的針眼讓我看不清楚。

definition_zh: (名) 風格；樣式　(動) 設計；造型
example_sentence: Her unique writing style makes her essays stand out in class.
sentence_zh: 她獨特的寫作風格使她的文章在班上脫穎而出。

definition_zh: (形) 時尚的；流行的
example_sentence: Sarah bought a stylish backpack to carry her books to school.
sentence_zh: 莎拉買了一個時尚的背包，用來把她的書帶到學校。

definition_zh: (形) 風格的；文體上的
example_sentence: The designer chose a minimalist font for stylistic effect.
sentence_zh: 設計師選擇極簡字體以達到風格效果。

definition_zh: (動) 風格化；使具特定風格
example_sentence: If the school logo were more stylized, students would appreciate its design.
sentence_zh: 如果學校的標誌更具風格化，學生們會更欣賞它的設計。

definition_zh: (動) 阻礙；使困惑
example_sentence: The difficult math problem that stymied the students finally had a solution.
sentence_zh: 那道難倒學生的數學問題終於有了解法。

definition_zh: (動) 代替；替代
example_sentence: The teacher asked students to sub for the sick monitor during class.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生在課堂上代替生病的班長。

definition_zh: (形) 潛意識的；下意識的
example_sentence: If the subconscious mind stored more memories, learning would become easier.
sentence_zh: 如果潛意識儲存更多記憶，學習就會變得更容易。

definition_zh: (副) 潛意識地；不知不覺地
example_sentence: Subconsciously absorbing the stress, the student felt tired before the exam.
sentence_zh: 在不知不覺中吸收壓力，這位學生在考試前感到疲憊。

definition_zh: (動) 制服；壓抑；克制
example_sentence: Subdued by the heavy rain, the soccer match was postponed.
sentence_zh: 被大雨壓制，足球比賽被延後了。

definition_zh: (形) 低沉的；壓抑的；柔和的
example_sentence: After the intense debate, the classroom remained subdued for the rest of the period.
sentence_zh: 在激烈的辯論之後，教室在剩餘的課堂時間裡保持著低沉的氣氛。

definition_zh: (名) [ˋsʌbdʒɪkt] 主題；科目　(動) [səbˋdʒɛkt] 使服從；使遭受
example_sentence: The subject of today's class is global warming.
sentence_zh: 今天課程的主題是全球暖化。

definition_zh: (形) 主觀的；個人的
example_sentence: The teacher emphasized that art is a subjective experience for each student.
sentence_zh: 老師強調藝術對每位學生來說是一種主觀的體驗。

definition_zh: (形) 崇高的；壯麗的
example_sentence: Standing on the mountain peak, the students felt a sublime sense of freedom.
sentence_zh: 站在山頂上，學生們感受到一種崇高的自由感。

definition_zh: (名) 潛水艇；海底生物
example_sentence: Having explored the ocean floor, the submarine returned to the surface.
sentence_zh: 在探索過海底之後，潛艇返回了水面。

definition_zh: (動) 淹沒；浸沒
example_sentence: The heavy rain caused the river to submerge the nearby park.
sentence_zh: 大雨導致河水淹沒了附近的公園。

definition_zh: (名) 淹沒；浸沒
example_sentence: Having experienced near submersion in the flood, the village built higher barriers.
sentence_zh: 經歷了幾乎被洪水淹沒後，村莊建造了更高的防護牆。

definition_zh: (名) 提交；屈服
example_sentence: The student's late submission of the report resulted in a lower grade.
sentence_zh: 該學生遲交報告導致成績較低。

definition_zh: (形) 順從的；溫順的
example_sentence: The new student's submissive behavior surprised the entire class.
sentence_zh: 那位新同學順從的行為讓全班感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (動) 提交；呈送
example_sentence: Students must submit their homework before the deadline.
sentence_zh: 學生必須在截止日期前提交作業。

definition_zh: (名) 下屬；部屬　(形) 次要的；從屬的　(動) 使服從；使居下位
example_sentence: The manager asked his subordinate to finish the report by Friday.
sentence_zh: 經理要求他的下屬在星期五前完成報告。

definition_zh: (動) 訂閱；贊同
example_sentence: If more students subscribed to the science magazine, our club would have more funds.
sentence_zh: 如果有更多學生訂閱這本科學雜誌，我們社團就會有更多資金。

definition_zh: (名) 訂閱；訂購
example_sentence: The student canceled her magazine subscription after the price increased.
sentence_zh: 這位學生在價格上漲後取消了她的雜誌訂閱。

definition_zh: (名) 子序列；後續
example_sentence: Noticing a subsequence in the data, the researcher revised the theory.
sentence_zh: 注意到數據中的一個子序列，研究員修正了理論。

definition_zh: (形) 後續的；隨後的
example_sentence: The student's subsequent improvement surprised the entire class.
sentence_zh: 該學生後續的進步讓全班驚訝。

definition_zh: (副) 隨後；之後
example_sentence: The team failed to meet the deadline, subsequently losing the client's trust.
sentence_zh: 團隊未能按時完成任務，隨後失去了客戶的信任。

definition_zh: (形) 順從的；屈從的
example_sentence: Although the team worked hard, their subservient attitude frustrated the coach.
sentence_zh: 儘管團隊努力合作，他們順從的態度讓教練感到沮喪。

definition_zh: (動) 消退；減弱
example_sentence: The floodwaters began to subside after the heavy rain stopped.
sentence_zh: 大雨停止後，洪水開始消退。

definition_zh: (名) 子公司；(形) 附屬的

sentence_zh: 子公司通常遵循總公司的規則，以確保營運一致性。

definition_zh: (動) 補貼；資助
example_sentence: The government decided to subsidize the school lunch program for low-income families.
sentence_zh: 政府決定為低收入家庭補貼學校午餐計劃。

definition_zh: (名) 補助金；津貼

sentence_zh: 政府為搭乘大眾運輸工具上學的學生提供補助金。

definition_zh: (片) 靠……勉強維持生活；靠……存活
example_sentence: Having lost his job, the old man had to subsist on his meager savings.
sentence_zh: 失去工作後，這位老人不得不靠微薄的積蓄勉強過活。

definition_zh: (動) 勉強維持生計；生存
example_sentence: Many rural families subsist on farming and small businesses.
sentence_zh: 許多農村家庭靠務農和小生意勉強維持生計。

definition_zh: (名) 生存；生計
example_sentence: Many farmers rely on subsistence farming to feed their families.
sentence_zh: 許多農民依賴自給農業來養家糊口。

definition_zh: (名) 亞種

sentence_zh: 這種蝴蝶亞種只生活在台灣的山區。

definition_zh: (名) 物質；實質
example_sentence: If the substance contains harmful chemicals, the lab will reject it.
sentence_zh: 如果該物質含有有害化學物質，實驗室就會拒絕它。

definition_zh: (形) 不合格的；低於標準的
example_sentence: Having used substandard materials, the bridge collapsed during the earthquake.
sentence_zh: 由於使用了不合格的材料，這座橋樑在地震中倒塌了。

definition_zh: (形) 大量的；相當大的
example_sentence: A substantial number of students participated in the environmental club.
sentence_zh: 大量學生參加了環保社團。

definition_zh: (副) 大幅度地；相當地
example_sentence: If the school reduced its budget, the library would be substantially smaller.
sentence_zh: 如果學校削減預算，圖書館將會大幅縮小。

definition_zh: (名) 代用品；替代者　(動) 替代；取代
example_sentence: If a teacher fell ill, a substitute would take over the class.
sentence_zh: 如果老師生病了，代課老師會接手班級。

definition_zh: (名) 替代；替換
example_sentence: The coach made a quick substitution to improve the team's performance.
sentence_zh: 教練快速做了替換以提升球隊的表現。

definition_zh: (形) 微妙的；細微的
example_sentence: A subtle difference in ingredients can change the taste of a dish.
sentence_zh: 食材中細微的差異可以改變一道菜的味道。

definition_zh: (名) 微妙；細微差別
example_sentence: Noticing the subtlety of her argument, the teacher praised Emily.
sentence_zh: 注意到她論點中的微妙之處，老師稱讚了艾蜜莉。

definition_zh: (動) 減去；扣除
example_sentence: If students subtract their expenses from their allowance, they can save money.
sentence_zh: 如果學生從零用錢中減去他們的開支，他們就能存錢。

definition_zh: (名) 減法；減去
example_sentence: Subtraction in math class helps students understand number differences.
sentence_zh: 數學課上的減法幫助學生理解數字的差異。

definition_zh: (名) 郊區；近郊
example_sentence: The new shopping mall in the suburb attracts many families on weekends.
sentence_zh: 郊區的新購物中心在週末吸引許多家庭。

definition_zh: (形) 郊區的；郊外的
example_sentence: Many students prefer suburban schools with larger campuses and greener surroundings.
sentence_zh: 許多學生偏好擁有較大校園和更綠化環境的郊區學校。

definition_zh: (名) 地鐵；地下道
example_sentence: Since the subway was crowded, Emily decided to take the bus instead.
sentence_zh: 因為地鐵很擁擠，艾蜜莉決定改搭公車。

definition_zh: (動) 成功；接替
example_sentence: Only after hard work can a student succeed in the exam.
sentence_zh: 只有在努力之後，學生才能在考試中成功。

definition_zh: (名) 成功；成就
example_sentence: Studying hard every day is the key to success in high school.
sentence_zh: 每天努力讀書是高中成功的關鍵。

definition_zh: (形) 成功的；有成就的
example_sentence: A successful student always finishes homework before playing games.
sentence_zh: 一個成功的學生總是在玩遊戲前完成作業。

definition_zh: (副) 成功地
example_sentence: The student who studied hard successfully passed the exam.
sentence_zh: 那個努力學習的學生成功地通過了考試。

definition_zh: (名) 連續；繼承
example_sentence: A succession of rainy days caused the school sports day to be postponed.
sentence_zh: 一連串的雨天導致學校運動會延期。

definition_zh: (形) 連續的；接連的
example_sentence: Winning three successive championships, the team celebrated their hard-earned victory.
sentence_zh: 連續贏得三次冠軍後，這支隊伍慶祝他們得來不易的勝利。

definition_zh: (名) 繼任者；接班人
example_sentence: The new manager is seen as a worthy successor to the retiring boss.
sentence_zh: 新任經理被視為退休老闆的合適接班人。

definition_zh: (形) 多汁的；多肉植物的　(名) 多肉植物
example_sentence: The succulent plant that my sister bought needs bright sunlight.
sentence_zh: 我妹妹買的那盆多肉植物需要充足的陽光。

definition_zh: (動) 屈服；屈從
example_sentence: Never did the team succumb to pressure during the final game.
sentence_zh: 這支隊伍在決賽中從未屈服於壓力。

definition_zh: (片) 例如；諸如
example_sentence: Many Taiwanese students enjoy outdoor sports such as hiking and cycling.
sentence_zh: 許多台灣學生喜歡戶外運動，例如健行和騎自行車。

definition_zh: (形) 這樣的；如此的　(代) 這樣的人或事物
example_sentence: The teacher explained that such behavior is not acceptable in class.
sentence_zh: 老師解釋說，這樣的行為在課堂上是不被接受的。

definition_zh: (片) 吸收；吸入
example_sentence: When the teacher explained the lesson, the students tried to suck in every detail.
sentence_zh: 當老師解釋課程時，學生們試圖吸收每一個細節。

definition_zh: (片) 使沉迷；使陷入
example_sentence: If a student got sucked into online gaming, his grades would drop quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果一個學生沉迷於網路遊戲，他的成績就會迅速下滑。

definition_zh: (片) 奉承；拍馬屁
example_sentence: The new student tried to suck up to the teacher by bringing her coffee.
sentence_zh: 那位新學生試圖藉由帶咖啡給老師來拍馬屁。

definition_zh: (動) 吸；吮　(形) 糟糕的；令人不快的
example_sentence: When the battery level is low, the phone's performance can suck.
sentence_zh: 當電池電量低時，手機的效能可能會變得很糟。

definition_zh: (形) 突然的；意外的
example_sentence: The sudden rain forced the students to cancel their outdoor game.
sentence_zh: 突然的雨迫使學生取消了他們的戶外比賽。

definition_zh: (副) 突然地
example_sentence: The teacher stopped the lesson suddenly to answer an urgent phone call.
sentence_zh: 老師突然停課，去接一通緊急電話。

definition_zh: (動) 控告；起訴
example_sentence: The company decided to sue the competitor for stealing its design.
sentence_zh: 該公司決定控告競爭對手竊取其設計。

definition_zh: (動) [ˈsʌfɚ] 遭受；忍受　(名) [ˈsʌfərɪŋ] 痛苦；苦難
example_sentence: Suffering from a bad cold, the student missed an important exam.
sentence_zh: 由於患了重感冒，這位學生錯過了一場重要的考試。

definition_zh: (名) 患者；受苦者
example_sentence: Seldom does a sufferer of chronic illness find complete relief from symptoms.
sentence_zh: 慢性病患者很少能從症狀中找到完全緩解。

definition_zh: (動) 遭受；忍受　(名) 痛苦；苦難
example_sentence: When suffering from a cold, students should rest and drink warm water.
sentence_zh: 當學生感冒時，應該休息並喝溫水。

definition_zh: (動) 足夠；滿足
example_sentence: A short answer will suffice for the teacher's question.
sentence_zh: 一個簡短的答案就足以回答老師的問題。

definition_zh: (形) 足夠的；充分的
example_sentence: Students must get sufficient sleep to stay focused in class.
sentence_zh: 學生必須獲得足夠的睡眠才能在課堂上保持專注。

definition_zh: (名) 後綴
example_sentence: Having studied the suffix "-tion," the student identified its role in forming nouns.
sentence_zh: 研究了後綴「-tion」後，這位學生認出了它在形成名詞時的作用。

definition_zh: (動) 使窒息；悶死
example_sentence: The thick smoke in the burning building made everyone suffocate quickly.
sentence_zh: 燃燒建築物中的濃煙讓每個人都迅速窒息。

definition_zh: (名) 窒息；悶死
example_sentence: If the window were closed, suffocation would occur quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果窗戶關著，窒息會迅速發生。

definition_zh: (名) 選舉權；投票權
example_sentence: If suffrage were universal, more young people would vote.
sentence_zh: 如果選舉權是普遍的，更多年輕人就會投票。

definition_zh: (名) 糖
example_sentence: The cake that has too much sugar is not healthy for students.
sentence_zh: 含有太多糖的蛋糕對學生來說不健康。

definition_zh: (名) 甘蔗
example_sentence: If the price of sugarcane drops, many farmers will suffer.
sentence_zh: 如果甘蔗的價格下跌，許多農民將會受苦。

definition_zh: (形) 含糖的；甜的
example_sentence: Although the cake looked delicious, its sugary frosting hurt my teeth.
sentence_zh: 雖然蛋糕看起來很美味，但它含糖的糖霜傷了我的牙齒。

definition_zh: (動) 建議；暗示
example_sentence: The teacher suggested that the students review the notes before the exam.
sentence_zh: 老師建議學生在考試前複習筆記。

definition_zh: (名) 建議；提議
example_sentence: The teacher's suggestion to study together helped everyone prepare for the exam.
sentence_zh: 老師一起讀書的建議幫助大家準備考試。

definition_zh: (形) 自殺的；想自殺的
example_sentence: The student's suicidal thoughts worried his teachers and parents.
sentence_zh: 這位學生的自殺念頭讓他的老師和父母非常擔心。

definition_zh: (名) 自殺
example_sentence: Reading about suicide in the news often makes students feel sad.
sentence_zh: 在新聞中讀到自殺的消息常讓學生感到難過。

definition_zh: (名) 套裝；西裝　(動) 適合；合身
example_sentence: If this suit fits well, my father will buy it for the wedding.
sentence_zh: 如果這套西裝合身，我父親就會買它來參加婚禮。

definition_zh: (形) 適合的；適當的
example_sentence: The movie suitable for teenagers is popular among students.
sentence_zh: 這部適合青少年的電影在學生中很受歡迎。

definition_zh: (副) 適當地；得體地
example_sentence: Students who dress suitably for interviews often leave a good impression.
sentence_zh: 穿著得體去面試的學生通常會留下好印象。

definition_zh: (名) 手提箱；行李箱
example_sentence: The suitcase that my brother bought is very heavy.
sentence_zh: 我哥哥買的那個行李箱非常重。

definition_zh: (名) 套房；一套家具
example_sentence: The hotel suite that we booked for the trip has a stunning ocean view.

sentence_zh: 老師宣布了違規學生的停學處分。

definition_zh: (名) 懷疑；嫌疑
example_sentence: The teacher's suspicion about the student's excuse grew stronger.
sentence_zh: 老師對那個學生藉口的懷疑越來越強烈。

definition_zh: (形) 可疑的；懷疑的
example_sentence: The teacher found the student's sudden absence suspicious.
sentence_zh: 老師覺得學生突然缺席很可疑。

definition_zh: (副) 懷疑地；可疑地
example_sentence: The cashier looked suspiciously at the customer paying with crumpled bills.
sentence_zh: 收銀員懷疑地看著那位用皺巴巴鈔票付款的顧客。

definition_zh: (片) 查明；弄清楚
example_sentence: The teacher who tried to suss out the truth impressed the class.
sentence_zh: 那位試圖查明真相的老師讓全班印象深刻。

definition_zh: (動) 維持；支撐
example_sentence: The local farm cannot sustain its operations without enough rain.
sentence_zh: 當地的農場若沒有足夠的雨水，就無法維持其運作。

definition_zh: (形) 永續的；可持續的
example_sentence: If every student chooses sustainable options, the campus will become greener.
sentence_zh: 如果每位學生都選擇永續的選項，校園將變得更環保。

definition_zh: (動) 用棉花棒清潔；擦拭
example_sentence: Having swabbed the wound, the nurse carefully applied a bandage.
sentence_zh: 用棉花棒清潔傷口後，護士小心地貼上繃帶。

definition_zh: (名) 型砧；鍛模　(動) 用型砧加工
example_sentence: The blacksmith uses a hammer and swage to shape the hot metal.
sentence_zh: 鐵匠用鐵鎚和型砧來塑造熱金屬。

definition_zh: (片) 吞沒；吞噬
example_sentence: The rising sea levels will swallow up coastal villages within decades.
sentence_zh: 不斷上升的海平面將在幾十年內吞沒沿海村莊。

definition_zh: (動) 吞嚥；吞下
example_sentence: The doctor told me to swallow the medicine with water.
sentence_zh: 醫生告訴我用水吞藥。

definition_zh: (名) 沼澤；濕地　(動) 淹沒；使應接不暇
example_sentence: To avoid the swamp, the hikers chose a longer path.
sentence_zh: 為了避開沼澤，登山者選擇了一條較長的路徑。

definition_zh: (片) 閒逛；遊手好閒
example_sentence: The lazy cat likes to swan about the house all day.
sentence_zh: 那隻懶貓喜歡整天在房子裡閒逛。

definition_zh: (片) 昂首闊步地走進；得意洋洋地進入
example_sentence: Seldom does a new student swan in and impress everyone immediately.
sentence_zh: 很少有一位新生昂首闊步地走進來並立刻讓所有人印象深刻。

definition_zh: (片) 溜走；擅自離開
example_sentence: The bored student decided to swan off from the class early.
sentence_zh: 那位無聊的學生決定提早溜出課堂。

definition_zh: (名) 天鵝
example_sentence: A white swan floated gracefully across the lake in the park.
sentence_zh: 一隻白天鵝在公園的湖面上優雅地滑行。

definition_zh: (動) 交換；交易
example_sentence: Students can swap their old textbooks for new ones.
sentence_zh: 學生可以用舊課本交換新課本。

definition_zh: (名) 一大群（昆蟲等）；群體
example_sentence: A swarm of bees gathered near the school garden.
sentence_zh: 一大群蜜蜂聚集在學校花園附近。

definition_zh: (名) 蒼蠅拍
example_sentence: The store sells a plastic swatter for killing flies.
sentence_zh: 這家商店賣一種用來打蒼蠅的塑膠蒼蠅拍。

definition_zh: (動) 搖晃；影響　(名) 搖擺；影響力
example_sentence: The strong wind began to sway the tall trees near our school.
sentence_zh: 強風開始搖晃我們學校附近的高樹。

definition_zh: (片) 發誓靠；極其信賴
example_sentence: Swearing by her lucky pen, Lisa finished the exam with confidence.
sentence_zh: 麗莎發誓靠她的幸運筆，自信地完成了考試。

definition_zh: (片) 宣誓就職
example_sentence: If the new president is sworn in tomorrow, the ceremony will be broadcast live.
sentence_zh: 如果新總統明天宣誓就職，典禮將會現場直播。

definition_zh: (片) 發誓戒除；決心不再做
example_sentence: Having sworn off sugary drinks, Linda felt much healthier within weeks.
sentence_zh: 發誓戒掉含糖飲料後，琳達在幾週內感覺健康多了。

definition_zh: (動) 咒罵；發誓
example_sentence: The student who swore in class had to apologize.
sentence_zh: 在課堂上罵髒話的學生必須道歉。

definition_zh: (動) 流汗；(名) 汗水
example_sentence: If you sweat during exercise, your body cools down naturally.
sentence_zh: 如果你在運動時流汗，你的身體會自然降溫。

definition_zh: (名) 毛衣；運動衫
example_sentence: Seldom has a sweater been so warm and comfortable.
sentence_zh: 很少有一件毛衣如此溫暖又舒適。

definition_zh: (動) 迅速傳播；橫掃
example_sentence: A cold virus can sweep through the entire school quickly.
sentence_zh: 感冒病毒可以迅速席捲整個學校。

definition_zh: (動) 打掃；掃除
example_sentence: The janitor who sweeps the hallway every morning is very kind.
sentence_zh: 每天早上打掃走廊的清潔工非常友善。

definition_zh: (形) 甜的；親切的　(名) 糖果；甜點
example_sentence: The sweet cake that my mom made was very popular at the party.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽做的甜蛋糕在派對上很受歡迎。

definition_zh: (動) 使變甜；加糖
example_sentence: Adding honey to the tea can sweeten it naturally.
sentence_zh: 在茶裡加蜂蜜可以自然地使其變甜。

definition_zh: (名) 甜味劑；代糖
example_sentence: If this sweetener contains too much sugar, it may harm your health.
sentence_zh: 如果這種甜味劑含有太多糖，可能會損害你的健康。

definition_zh: (名) 甜味；甜蜜
example_sentence: The baker added extra sugar to enhance the sweetness of the cake.
sentence_zh: 麵包師傅加了額外的糖來提升蛋糕的甜味。

definition_zh: (動) 膨脹；上漲　(名) 膨脹；隆起
example_sentence: Seldom does the river swell so quickly after a short rain.
sentence_zh: 很少在一場短暫的雨後，河水會這麼快暴漲。

definition_zh: (動) 突然轉向；急轉彎
example_sentence: Only after the sudden rain did the driver swerve to avoid a puddle.
sentence_zh: 直到突然下起雨，駕駛才急轉方向以避開水坑。

definition_zh: (形) 迅速的；敏捷的
example_sentence: The swift response from the fire department saved the building.
sentence_zh: 消防隊的迅速反應拯救了這棟建築。

definition_zh: (副) 迅速地；敏捷地
example_sentence: The rescue team swiftly pulled the injured hiker to safety.
sentence_zh: 救援隊迅速將受傷的登山客拉到安全地帶。

definition_zh: (名) 迅速；敏捷
example_sentence: Seldom does the team's swiftness surprise their coach.
sentence_zh: 這支隊伍的迅速很少讓教練感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (動) 游泳
example_sentence: My brother and I swim at the beach every summer.
sentence_zh: 我和我哥哥每年夏天都在海邊游泳。

definition_zh: (名) 游泳；游泳運動　(動) 游泳
example_sentence: Having swum across the pool, the swimmer felt exhausted but proud.
sentence_zh: 游過泳池後，游泳者感到筋疲力盡但自豪。

definition_zh: (名) 泳衣；泳裝
example_sentence: My sister bought a new swimsuit for the beach trip.
sentence_zh: 我姊姊為了海灘旅行買了一件新泳衣。

definition_zh: (動) 詐騙；騙取
example_sentence: The dishonest man tried to swindle the elderly woman out of her savings.
sentence_zh: 那個不誠實的男人試圖騙取老婦人的積蓄。

definition_zh: (名) 騙子；詐騙者
example_sentence: The students reported the swindler to the police to protect others.
sentence_zh: 學生們向警方舉報了那個騙子，以保護其他人。

definition_zh: (名) 豬瘟
example_sentence: If an outbreak of swine fever occurred, farmers would lose many pigs.
sentence_zh: 如果爆發豬瘟，農民會損失許多豬隻。

definition_zh: (名) 豬；豬玀
example_sentence: Having been exposed to swine flu, the farmer quickly quarantined the entire barn.
sentence_zh: 暴露於豬流感後，農夫迅速隔離了整個穀倉。

definition_zh: (片) 突然轉向；急轉彎
example_sentence: The driver had to swing around the sudden obstacle on the road.
sentence_zh: 駕駛必須突然轉向以避開路上的障礙物。

definition_zh: (片) 揮擊；揮打
example_sentence: The batter, swinging at the fastball, missed the ball completely.
sentence_zh: 打者揮棒擊球，卻完全沒打中。

definition_zh: (片) 短暫拜訪；順便去
example_sentence: Swinging by the convenience store, the student grabbed a quick snack before class.
sentence_zh: 順路去便利商店時，那位學生在上課前匆匆買了個點心。

definition_zh: (動) 搖擺；盪鞦韆　(名) 鞦韆；擺動
example_sentence: The children swing on the old tire in the backyard after school.
sentence_zh: 孩子們放學後在後院的老輪胎上盪鞦韆。

definition_zh: (動) 刷（卡）；滑動
example_sentence: The student who swiped his card too quickly had to try again.
sentence_zh: 那個刷卡太快的学生必須再試一次。

definition_zh: (動) 旋轉；打旋　(名) 旋渦；漩渦狀
example_sentence: The leaves that swirl in the autumn wind create a beautiful scene.
sentence_zh: 在秋風中旋轉的樹葉創造了美麗的景象。

definition_zh: (片) 關掉；關閉
example_sentence: After finishing his homework, Tom likes to switch off his phone.
sentence_zh: 完成作業後，湯姆喜歡關掉手機。

definition_zh: (片) 打開（電器、開關）
example_sentence: The student forgot to switch on the computer before class.
sentence_zh: 那名學生在上課前忘記打開電腦。

definition_zh: (片) 轉換；改用
example_sentence: Many families switch over to LED bulbs to save electricity.
sentence_zh: 許多家庭改用LED燈泡以節省電費。

definition_zh: (動) 轉學
example_sentence: If a student switched school, the new environment would be challenging.
sentence_zh: 如果學生轉學，新的環境會很具挑戰性。

definition_zh: (動) 轉變；交換　(名) 開關；改變
example_sentence: If the student switched seats, the teacher would notice the change.
sentence_zh: 如果那個學生換了座位，老師就會注意到這個改變。

definition_zh: (動) 旋轉；轉動
example_sentence: The office chair can swivel 360 degrees for easy movement.
sentence_zh: 這張辦公椅可以旋轉360度，方便移動。

definition_zh: (形) 腫脹的
example_sentence: My ankle became swollen after I twisted it during basketball practice.
sentence_zh: 我的腳踝在籃球練習中扭傷後腫了起來。

definition_zh: (動) 俯衝；猛撲
example_sentence: The eagle swooped down to catch its prey in the field.
sentence_zh: 那隻老鷹俯衝下來捕捉田野裡的獵物。

definition_zh: (名) 劍；刀
example_sentence: The knight pulled his sword from the stone with great effort.
sentence_zh: 騎士費了很大的力氣將他的劍從石頭中拔出。

definition_zh: (名) 馬屁精；諂媚者
example_sentence: The teacher disliked the sycophant who always flattered her for better grades.
sentence_zh: 老師不喜歡那個總是為了成績更好而奉承她的馬屁精。

definition_zh: (形) 阿諛奉承的；諂媚的
example_sentence: The sycophantic student always agreed with the teacher's every opinion.
sentence_zh: 這個阿諛奉承的學生總是同意老師的每一個意見。

definition_zh: (形) 愛拍馬屁的；諂媚的
example_sentence: The sycophantish student always flatters the teacher for better grades.
sentence_zh: 這個愛拍馬屁的學生總是為了更好的成績討好老師。

definition_zh: (名) 音節
example_sentence: The teacher explained that every word has at least one syllable.
sentence_zh: 老師解釋說每個單字至少有一個音節。

definition_zh: (名) 課程大綱；教學進度表
example_sentence: This course syllabus outlines the topics for the entire semester.
sentence_zh: 這份課程大綱列出了整個學期的主題。

definition_zh: (形) 共生的；互利共存的
example_sentence: Many students study the symbiotic relationship between bees and flowers for biology class.
sentence_zh: 許多學生為了生物課而研究蜜蜂與花朵之間的共生關係。

definition_zh: (名) 象徵；符號
example_sentence: If a white dove appears, it is often a symbol of peace.
sentence_zh: 如果一隻白鴿出現，它通常代表和平的象徵。

definition_zh: (形) 象徵的；象徵性的
example_sentence: Having studied the symbolic meaning of colors, the class created their own flags.
sentence_zh: 在研究了顏色的象徵意義之後，全班創作了自己的旗幟。

definition_zh: (名) 象徵主義；象徵意義
example_sentence: Only after studying the novel did the class grasp its deep symbolism.
sentence_zh: 只有在研讀這部小說之後，全班才理解其深層的象徵意義。

definition_zh: (動) 象徵；代表
example_sentence: The rising sun symbolizes hope for a new day.
sentence_zh: 初升的太陽象徵著新一天的希望。

definition_zh: (形) 對稱的；勻稱的
example_sentence: The butterfly's wings display a symmetrical pattern that students find fascinating.
sentence_zh: 蝴蝶的翅膀展現出一種學生覺得迷人的對稱圖案。

definition_zh: (名) 對稱；勻稱
example_sentence: The symmetry of the building's design made it look balanced.
sentence_zh: 這棟建築設計的對稱性使其看起來平衡。

definition_zh: (形) 同情的；有同情心的
example_sentence: Feeling sympathetic, the teacher extended the project deadline for the stressed students.
sentence_zh: 感到同情，老師為壓力大的學生延長了專題截止日期。

definition_zh: (動) 同情；體諒
example_sentence: Many students sympathize with their friends who face exam stress.
sentence_zh: 許多學生同情那些面臨考試壓力的朋友。

definition_zh: (名) 同情；同情心
example_sentence: Many students showed sympathy for their classmate who lost his pet.
sentence_zh: 許多學生對失去寵物的同學表示同情。

definition_zh: (名) 交響樂；交響曲
example_sentence: The school orchestra played a beautiful symphony at the concert.
sentence_zh: 學校管弦樂團在音樂會上演奏了一首優美的交響樂。

definition_zh: (名) 研討會；座談會
example_sentence: The school symposium on climate change attracted many students.
sentence_zh: 學校關於氣候變遷的研討會吸引了許多學生。

definition_zh: (名) 症狀；徵兆
example_sentence: Having noticed the symptom, the student visited the school nurse.
sentence_zh: 注意到這個症狀後，這位學生去看了學校護士。

definition_zh: (名) 集團；犯罪組織
example_sentence: The local syndicate controlled all the street vendors in the night market.
sentence_zh: 這個在地的集團控制了夜市的所有路邊攤。

definition_zh: (名) 症候群；綜合症狀
example_sentence: If a student shows the burnout syndrome, the school counselor should offer help.
sentence_zh: 如果學生表現出倦怠症候群，學校輔導老師應提供幫助。

definition_zh: (名) 協同效應；綜效
example_sentence: Having achieved synergy, the marketing team launched a successful campaign.
sentence_zh: 達成協同效應後，行銷團隊發起了一場成功的活動。

definition_zh: (名) 同義詞
example_sentence: If students know a synonym for a word, their writing improves.
sentence_zh: 如果學生知道一個單詞的同義詞，他們的寫作就會進步。

definition_zh: (形) 同義的；等同的
example_sentence: In modern slang, 'lit' is often synonymous with 'exciting' or 'amazing'.
sentence_zh: 在現代俚語中，'lit' 常與 'exciting' 或 'amazing' 同義。

definition_zh: (名) 概要；大綱
example_sentence: Never have I read such a confusing synopsis of the movie.
sentence_zh: 我從未讀過這麼令人困惑的電影概要。

definition_zh: (形) 句法的；語法的
example_sentence: Wondering about the syntactic rules, Maria checked her grammar book.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗亞對句法規則感到疑惑，查閱了她的文法書。

definition_zh: (名) 句法；語法
example_sentence: Not only is the syntax complex, but also the vocabulary is advanced.
sentence_zh: 不僅語法複雜，詞彙也很進階。

definition_zh: (名) 合成；綜合
example_sentence: The chemistry lab requires a careful synthesis of two elements for the experiment.
sentence_zh: 化學實驗室需要仔細合成兩種元素以進行實驗。

definition_zh: (動) 合成；綜合
example_sentence: Scientists in the lab synthesize a new medicine for the disease.
sentence_zh: 實驗室的科學家合成一種治療這種疾病的新藥。

definition_zh: (形) 合成的；人造的
example_sentence: The scientist used synthetic materials to create a stronger fabric.
sentence_zh: 科學家使用合成材料來創造更堅固的布料。

definition_zh: (副) 以合成方式；人工地
example_sentence: Many scientists create synthetic diamonds synthetically to reduce mining costs.
sentence_zh: 許多科學家為了降低開採成本，用人工合成的方式製造人造鑽石。

definition_zh: (片) 挪用；抽走
example_sentence: Some politicians syphon off public funds for personal use.
sentence_zh: 一些政治人物為了個人用途而挪用公款。

definition_zh: (名) 糖漿；糖水
example_sentence: If the syrup were less sticky, making pancakes would be easier.
sentence_zh: 如果糖漿沒那麼黏，做鬆餅會更容易。

definition_zh: (名) 系統；制度
example_sentence: If the school system were more flexible, students would choose their classes.
sentence_zh: 如果學校系統更有彈性，學生們就會選擇自己的課程。

definition_zh: (形) 系統性的；有系統的
example_sentence: The scientist used a systematic approach to solve the complex problem.
sentence_zh: 這位科學家使用系統性的方法來解決這個複雜的問題。

example_sentence: The students designed a systematical approach to solve the pollution problem.
sentence_zh: 學生們設計了一套系統性的方法來解決污染問題。

definition_zh: (副) 有系統地；有條理地
example_sentence: The student reviewed the material systematically to prepare for the exam.
sentence_zh: 這位學生為了準備考試，有系統地複習了教材。

definition_zh: (名) T恤；短袖圓領運動衫
example_sentence: My brother wore a blue t-shirt to school yesterday.
sentence_zh: 我哥哥昨天穿了一件藍色T恤去上學。

definition_zh: (名) 桌子；表格　(動) 擱置；提交
example_sentence: After the teacher cleaned the table, the students began their homework.
sentence_zh: 老師清理桌子後，學生們開始做作業。

definition_zh: (名) 桌巾；桌布
example_sentence: Spilling juice on the white tablecloth, the girl quickly grabbed a napkin.
sentence_zh: 果汁灑在白色桌巾上，女孩趕快抓起一張餐巾紙。

definition_zh: (名) 大湯匙；一湯匙的量
example_sentence: Add one tablespoon of sugar to the mixture and stir well.
sentence_zh: 在混合物中加入一湯匙糖，並攪拌均勻。

definition_zh: (名) 平板電腦；藥片；牌匾
example_sentence: Students use a tablet to take notes in class every day.
sentence_zh: 學生們每天在課堂上使用平板電腦做筆記。

definition_zh: (名) 餐具
example_sentence: The new tableware that my mom bought for Chinese New Year is very elegant.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽為農曆新年買的新餐具非常優雅。

definition_zh: (名) 八卦報；小報
example_sentence: The tabloid newspaper published a shocking story about a famous singer.
sentence_zh: 這家八卦報紙刊登了一則關於一位著名歌手的驚人故事。

definition_zh: (名) 禁忌；忌諱　(形) 禁忌的
example_sentence: Discussing death remains a social taboo in many cultures, although younger generations challenge it.
sentence_zh: 討論死亡在許多文化中仍是社會禁忌，儘管年輕一代正在挑戰它。

definition_zh: (形) 默示的；不言而喻的
example_sentence: The team's tacit agreement on the project helped them finish early.
sentence_zh: 團隊對這個計畫的默契幫助他們提早完成。

definition_zh: (副) 默認地；心照不宣地

sentence_zh: 學生們默認同意對驚喜派對保密。

definition_zh: (片) 附加；添加

sentence_zh: 如果老師同意，我們可以附加一場額外的複習課。

definition_zh: (片) 附加；追加

sentence_zh: 老師決定在原定截止日期上追加時間。

definition_zh: (動) 用圖釘釘住；附加　(名) 圖釘；方針

sentence_zh: 老師決定把通知釘在布告欄上。

definition_zh: (動) 處理；應付　(名) 擒抱；工具

sentence_zh: 學校決定透過回收計畫來處理垃圾問題。

definition_zh: (形) 俗氣的；廉價的

sentence_zh: 這些廉價的裝飾讓派對看起來很俗氣。

sentence_zh: 好的領導者運用機智來解決團隊成員間的衝突。

definition_zh: (形) 圓融的；得體的

sentence_zh: 如果你的朋友犯了錯，一句得體的評論可以避免尷尬。

definition_zh: (名) 策略；戰術
example_sentence: A clever tactic used by the team helped them win the game.
sentence_zh: 團隊使用的一個聰明策略幫助他們贏得了比賽。

definition_zh: (形) 策略性的；戰術的
example_sentence: Using a tactical approach, the team won the debate competition.
sentence_zh: 運用策略性的方法，這個團隊贏得了辯論比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 策略；戰術
example_sentence: The coach used clever tactics to win the game.
sentence_zh: 教練使用巧妙的戰術來贏得比賽。

definition_zh: (片) 跟隨；尾隨

sentence_zh: 決定跟著朋友一起走的學生錯過了公車。

definition_zh: (片) 加入；附在...後面

sentence_zh: 有些學生總是在午餐時間加入受歡迎的團體。

definition_zh: (片) 用……標記；給……貼上標籤

sentence_zh: 學生們在旅行前必須用名牌標記他們的行李。

definition_zh: (名) 標籤；標牌　(動) 加標籤於
example_sentence: The student used a price tag to check the cost of the book.
sentence_zh: 那名學生用價格標籤來檢查書本的費用。

definition_zh: (動) 標記；貼標籤

sentence_zh: 學生們從未在書桌上標記答案。

definition_zh: (名) 中國太空人；航天員

sentence_zh: 從未有過一位太空人進行如此大膽的太空漫步。

definition_zh: (片) 逐漸變小；逐漸消失

sentence_zh: 老師的聲音隨著鐘聲響起而逐漸變小。

definition_zh: (片) 塞車；車流回堵

sentence_zh: 綿延數英里的車陣造成了嚴重的延誤。

definition_zh: (名) 尾巴；(動) 跟蹤

sentence_zh: 當男孩回家時，狗搖動了尾巴。

definition_zh: (形) 量身定做的；特製的

sentence_zh: 學校的暑期課程是為熱愛科學的學生量身打造的。

definition_zh: (名) 裁縫　(動) 修改；定做

sentence_zh: 這家公司的聲譽因醜聞而受損。

definition_zh: (片) 使吃驚；使措手不及

definition_zh: (片) 利用；善用

sentence_zh: 如果學生善用每一次機會，他們的技能就會迅速進步。

sentence_zh: 許多人說艾蜜莉在藝術天分上像她母親。

definition_zh: (片) 帶走；拿走

definition_zh: (片) 取回；收回（說的話）

sentence_zh: 那位學生想要拿回的書已經被借出了。

definition_zh: (片) 使某人屏息；令某人驚嘆

sentence_zh: 從山上俯瞰夜市的景色讓我屏息。

definition_zh: (片) 一舉成功；迅速征服

definition_zh: (片) 拆掉；記下

definition_zh: (片) 視為；誤以為

sentence_zh: 許多學生把老師的耐心視為理所當然。

definition_zh: (片) 吸收；理解；觀賞

sentence_zh: 博物館提供學生一個欣賞藝術展覽的機會。

definition_zh: (片) 把……發洩在……身上

sentence_zh: 輸掉比賽後，教練把他的沮喪發洩在球隊身上。

definition_zh: (片) 主動承擔；自告奮勇

sentence_zh: 老師辭職後，Mia 主動負責組織班級旅行。

definition_zh: (片) 輕鬆對待；不急不躁
example_sentence: The student who can take it easy before exams often performs better.
sentence_zh: 考試前能保持冷靜的學生通常表現更好。

definition_zh: (動) 脫掉；起飛；休假
example_sentence: Students take off their shoes before entering the library to keep it clean.
sentence_zh: 學生們在進入圖書館前脫鞋，以保持清潔。

definition_zh: (片) 承擔；開始做
example_sentence: Taking on new challenges, the student improved her leadership skills.
sentence_zh: 接受新挑戰後，這位學生提升了她的領導能力。

definition_zh: (片) 取出；帶出；移除

sentence_zh: 忘記倒垃圾的學生收到了警告。

definition_zh: (動) 接管；接替

sentence_zh: 新經理將在下個月接管這個專案。

definition_zh: (片) 發生；舉行

sentence_zh: 畢業典禮將在學校禮堂舉行。

definition_zh: (片) 以……為樂；喜歡

sentence_zh: 喜歡閱讀的人通常樂於學習新單字。

definition_zh: (片) 緩解；減輕

sentence_zh: 在公園裡短暫散步可以緩解壓力大的一天。

definition_zh: (片) 取代；代替

sentence_zh: 因為老師生病，一位代課老師取代了她的位置。

definition_zh: (片) 帶領...完成；詳細解釋

sentence_zh: 老師將帶領全班了解台灣的歷史。

definition_zh: (片) 需要時間；花費時間

sentence_zh: 學習一項新技能需要時間和持續的努力。

definition_zh: (片) 認真對待；放在心上

sentence_zh: 學生應該把老師的建議放在心上。

definition_zh: (片) 喜歡；開始喜歡；養成...的習慣

sentence_zh: 這位年輕藝術家從未喜歡以繪畫為職業。

definition_zh: (片) 輪流；依序

sentence_zh: 學生們輪流報告他們的專題，以增進口說能力。

definition_zh: (片) 開始從事；佔用（時間或空間）
example_sentence: If Linda took up painting, she would find a relaxing hobby.
sentence_zh: 如果琳達開始學畫畫，她會找到一個放鬆的嗜好。

definition_zh: (動) 拿；帶；花費；服用
example_sentence: Not only did the teacher take attendance, but she also checked homework.
sentence_zh: 老師不僅點了名，還檢查了作業。

definition_zh: (名) 外帶食物；要點；收穫

sentence_zh: 這場講座的主要收穫是回收的重要性。

definition_zh: (名) 起飛；起跳

sentence_zh: 飛機的起飛因大雨而延誤。

definition_zh: (名) 接管；收購

sentence_zh: 完成收購後，新管理層宣布了重大變革。

definition_zh: (名) 營業收入；進帳

sentence_zh: 商店關門後，經理清點了當天的營業收入。

definition_zh: (名) 故事；傳說

sentence_zh: 老師講了一個關於古龍的迷人故事。

definition_zh: (名) 天賦；才能

sentence_zh: 因為這位年輕藝術家展現了極大的天賦，她的老師稱讚了她的作品。

definition_zh: (形) 有才華的；有天賦的

sentence_zh: 許多有才華的學生加入美術社，以展示他們的創造力。

sentence_zh: 許多學生在下課後討論他們的未來計畫。

definition_zh: (片) 迴避（話題）；繞圈子說話

sentence_zh: 老師試圖繞著這個難題打轉，沒有給出直接答案。

definition_zh: (片) 對…說教；對…滔滔不絕地講

sentence_zh: 那位老師不僅對學生說教，還忽視他們的問題。

definition_zh: (片) 頂嘴；回嘴
example_sentence: Having talked back to the teacher, the student felt regretful.
sentence_zh: 對老師頂嘴後，那名學生感到後悔。

definition_zh: (片) 以居高臨下的態度說話；貶低

sentence_zh: 那位對學生說話居高臨下的老師常常失去他們的尊重。

definition_zh: (片) 說服；貶低

sentence_zh: 經理試圖說服憤怒的顧客降低投訴的強度。

definition_zh: (片) 說服；勸說
example_sentence: If your friend tries to talk you into skipping class, just say no.
sentence_zh: 如果你的朋友試圖說服你翹課，就直接拒絕。

definition_zh: (片) 說服（某人）不做（某事）；勸阻

sentence_zh: 我最好的朋友試圖說服我不要退出籃球隊。

definition_zh: (片) 討論；商量

sentence_zh: 如果學生們討論這個專案，老師會澄清細節。

definition_zh: (片) 詳細討論；商量

sentence_zh: 學生們決定在開始之前討論他們的專題構想。

definition_zh: (片) 誇大；說好話

sentence_zh: 那個為這個計畫說好話的學生獲得了大家的支持。

definition_zh: (動) 談論；說話　(名) 談話；會談
example_sentence: The teacher will talk about the new project in class tomorrow.
sentence_zh: 老師明天會在課堂上談論新專案。

definition_zh: (形) 多話的；愛說話的

sentence_zh: 坐在我旁邊那個多話的學生總是在上課時干擾課堂。

definition_zh: (形) 高的

sentence_zh: 我們班上那個高個子男孩每天打籃球。

definition_zh: (動) 計算；統計　(名) 計數；記錄
example_sentence: The teacher asked the class to tally the votes for the field trip destination.
sentence_zh: 老師要求全班統計戶外教學目的地的票數。

definition_zh: (形) 馴服的；溫順的　(動) 馴服；馴化
example_sentence: The once wild fox became a tame pet after living with the family.
sentence_zh: 那隻曾經野生的狐狸在與這家人同住後變成了溫順的寵物。

definition_zh: (動) 夯實；搗實
example_sentence: The construction worker used a heavy tool to tamp the soil firmly.
sentence_zh: 建築工人用重型工具將土壤夯實。

definition_zh: (動) 干預；亂動
example_sentence: The technician warned everyone not to tamper with the security system.
sentence_zh: 技術員警告大家不要亂動安全系統。

definition_zh: (名) 曬黑；棕褐色　(動) 曬黑；鞣革
example_sentence: Getting a tan at the beach is popular among teenagers in summer.
sentence_zh: 在沙灘上曬黑在夏天很受青少年歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 橘子；柑橘

sentence_zh: 這位學生帶了一顆橘子，想在午餐時和同學分享。

definition_zh: (形) 具體的；有形的；可觸摸的

sentence_zh: 這個團隊需要具體的證據來支持他們的主張。

definition_zh: (動) 纏繞；糾結　(名) 糾纏；混亂

sentence_zh: 電腦桌後面的電線經常纏成一個亂七八糟的結。

definition_zh: (名) 探戈舞；探戈舞曲
example_sentence: The tango that our school taught last semester was very popular.
sentence_zh: 我們學校上學期教的那首探戈非常受歡迎。

definition_zh: (形) 味道強烈而清新的；酸甜的

sentence_zh: 如果你多加一些檸檬汁，醬汁會變得酸甜清爽。

definition_zh: (名) 水槽；坦克

sentence_zh: 教室裡的魚缸需要定期清潔。

definition_zh: (名) 油輪；運油車

sentence_zh: 那艘漏油到海裡的油輪造成了嚴重的環境問題。

definition_zh: (動) [træn'zɪt] 經過；轉運　(名) ['trænsɪt] 運輸；轉變

sentence_zh: 載學生上學的公車會經過市中心。

definition_zh: (名) 道教；道家思想
example_sentence: If more students studied Taoism, they would understand its peaceful philosophy.
sentence_zh: 如果更多學生研究道教，他們就會理解其和平的哲學。

definition_zh: (形) 道家的；道教的　(名) 道家信徒；道教徒

sentence_zh: 讀了許多道家文本後，這位學生解釋了無為的概念。

definition_zh: (片) 輕敲（以獲取）；利用（資源）

sentence_zh: 老師要求學生節約用水，以節省資源。

definition_zh: (片) 利用；開發

sentence_zh: 學生可以利用線上資源進行小組專題。

definition_zh: (片) 以…開始；從…著手

sentence_zh: 籃球隊決定以一場友誼賽開始。

definition_zh: (片) 退出；認輸

sentence_zh: 筋疲力盡的跑者決定在完成比賽前退出。

definition_zh: (片) 徵召（球員）；招募

sentence_zh: 教練決定為冠軍賽徵召一名新球員。

definition_zh: (名) 自來水

definition_zh: (動) 輕拍；輕觸　(名) 水龍頭；輕拍

sentence_zh: 學生輕觸螢幕以查看他們的課表。

definition_zh: (名) 膠帶；錄音帶　(動) 用膠帶黏貼；錄音

sentence_zh: 老師用膠帶把海報固定在牆上。

definition_zh: (片) 逐漸減少；逐漸減弱

sentence_zh: 颱風過後，雨開始逐漸減弱。

definition_zh: (形) 逐漸變細的；錐形的
example_sentence: If the pencil is not sharpened, its tip will stay tapered.
sentence_zh: 如果鉛筆沒有被削尖，它的尖端就會保持逐漸變細的形狀。

definition_zh: (名) 掛毯；織錦
example_sentence: When the museum displayed the ancient tapestry, students admired its intricate design.
sentence_zh: 當博物館展示這幅古老的掛毯時，學生們讚嘆其精細的設計。

definition_zh: (名) 焦油；關稅　(動) 塗焦油於

sentence_zh: 如果政府提高進口關稅，商品價格就會上漲。

sentence_zh: 那名學生上課遲到，因為公車拋錨了。

sentence_zh: 如果團隊以高分為目標，每位成員都必須每天練習。

sentence_zh: 針對進口電子產品的新關稅提高了學生的價格。

sentence_zh: 雖然這個檸檬塔看起來很好吃，但主廚決定多加一些糖。

sentence_zh: 完成任務後，那個學生去打籃球了。

definition_zh: (名) 味道；品味　(動) 嚐；品嚐

sentence_zh: 廚師加鹽後，湯嚐起來好多了。

definition_zh: (形) 雅緻的；有品味的

sentence_zh: 教室裡雅緻的裝飾讓每個人印象深刻。

definition_zh: (形) 無味的；乏味的

sentence_zh: 湯在廚師加了太多水之後變得沒有味道。

definition_zh: (形) 美味的；可口的
example_sentence: The tasty lunch at the school cafeteria made everyone happy.
sentence_zh: 學校自助餐廳的美味午餐讓每個人都很開心。

definition_zh: (名) 刺青；紋身　(動) 刺青於；在...上紋身

sentence_zh: 如果學生刺青，他的父母可能會非常生氣。

definition_zh: (名) 刺青；紋身　(動) 刺青於；紋身於

sentence_zh: 手腕上的一個小刺青可以是一個有意義的象徵。

definition_zh: (名) 嘲諷；辱罵　(動) 嘲弄；譏笑

sentence_zh: 那位收到敵隊嘲諷的球員保持冷靜。

definition_zh: (形) 拉緊的；繃緊的

sentence_zh: 學生們將繩子拉緊以固定帳篷。

definition_zh: (名) 贅述；同義反覆
example_sentence: The student's essay contained a tautology that confused the reader.
sentence_zh: 這名學生的作文包含一個讓讀者困惑的贅述。

sentence_zh: 那間供應最好燉菜的舊酒館已經關門了。

sentence_zh: 在免稅商店購物為學生省下了不少錢。

definition_zh: (名) 稅；稅款　(動) 對……徵稅；課稅

sentence_zh: 如果政府提高含糖飲料的稅，購買的學生就會減少。

definition_zh: (名) 稅制；課稅

sentence_zh: 如果每位納稅人都繳納應繳的份額，公立學校就會有更多經費。

definition_zh: (名) 喝茶；品茶

sentence_zh: 喝完茶後，學生們打掃了教室。

definition_zh: (片) 合作；組隊

sentence_zh: 如果我們的社團與科學系合作，這個專案就會成功。

definition_zh: (名) 團隊；隊

sentence_zh: 贏得冠軍的那支籃球隊每天練習。

sentence_zh: 雖然電玩遊戲很刺激，莎拉還是得放下遊戲去讀書。

definition_zh: (片) 拆除；拆毀

sentence_zh: 決定拆除舊建築後，學校開始了施工。

sentence_zh: 撕掉那封舊信，這名學生感到一陣解脫。

definition_zh: (副) 淚汪汪地；含淚地

sentence_zh: 那名學生淚眼汪汪地為忘記作業向老師道歉。

definition_zh: (動) 取笑；戲弄

sentence_zh: 我哥哥喜歡拿我亂七八糟的房間開玩笑。

sentence_zh: 老師挑逗性地揚起眉毛，鼓勵害羞的學生。

sentence_zh: 修好電腦後，技術人員向學生解釋了問題。

definition_zh: (名) 技術；技巧

sentence_zh: 使用一種新技術，這位藝術家創作了一幅令人驚嘆的畫作。

definition_zh: (形) 科技的；技術的

sentence_zh: 科技進步改變了我們彼此溝通的方式。

definition_zh: (名) 科技；技術

sentence_zh: 現代科技幫助學生更輕鬆地學習英語。

definition_zh: (片) 嚴厲批評；責罵

sentence_zh: 教練在球員表現不佳後開始嚴厲批評他們。

sentence_zh: 安排這個專案的學生得到了老師的讚揚。

definition_zh: (動) 充滿；擁擠

sentence_zh: 如果街道擠滿了人，那這個節慶一定很成功。

example_sentence: If a teen spends too much time online, their grades may suffer.
sentence_zh: 如果青少年花太多時間上網，他們的成績可能會受影響。

definition_zh: (形) 青少年的

sentence_zh: 在國外度過青少年時期後，麗莎說一口流利的英文。

definition_zh: (名) 青少年（13至19歲）

sentence_zh: 一個喜歡音樂的青少年常花好幾個小時練習吉他。

definition_zh: (動) 搖搖欲墜；躊躇不決

sentence_zh: 如果經濟在崩潰邊緣搖搖欲墜，許多家庭將面臨困境。

definition_zh: (名) 電信；遠程通信

sentence_zh: 使用現代電信，學生可以從家裡參加線上課程。

definition_zh: (名) 電信；遠程通訊

definition_zh: (名) 電話會議；遠程會議

sentence_zh: 經理為海外團隊安排了一場電話會議。

definition_zh: (名) 視訊會議；遠程會議

sentence_zh: 使用視訊會議，學生可以從家裡上課。

definition_zh: (形) 上鏡的；適合電視的

sentence_zh: 這位上鏡的主持人讓談話節目在青少年中受歡迎。

definition_zh: (名) 電報

sentence_zh: 使用望遠鏡，那位學生觀察了月球上的隕石坑。

definition_zh: (動) 電視播送

sentence_zh: 這場週六現場直播的冠軍賽吸引了數百萬觀眾。

definition_zh: (名) 電視；電視機

sentence_zh: 看電視太久會傷害你的眼睛。

definition_zh: (片) 分辨；區分

sentence_zh: 這對雙胞胎長得太像了，很少有人能分辨他們。

definition_zh: (片) 責罵；訓斥

sentence_zh: 老師責罵那些在課堂上大聲聊天的人。

definition_zh: (片) 告發；打小報告

sentence_zh: 那名學生決定在考試期間告發作弊者。

definition_zh: (動) 告訴；講述

sentence_zh: 老師明天會告訴學生們考試的時間表。

definition_zh: (名) 出納員；講述者

sentence_zh: 銀行出納員快速清點現金，並對顧客微笑。

definition_zh: (動) 告訴；講述

sentence_zh: 老師正在告訴學生一個關於誠實的故事。

definition_zh: (形) 洩露祕密的；明顯的

sentence_zh: 泥巴中明顯的腳印揭示了小偷的逃跑路線。

definition_zh: (名) 地震

sentence_zh: 昨晚襲擊城市的那場地震造成了輕微的損害。

definition_zh: (名) 脾氣；性情　(動) 使回火；調和

sentence_zh: 老師警告學生在辯論時要控制自己的脾氣。

sentence_zh: 冷靜的氣質有助於學生更有效地應對考試壓力。

sentence_zh: 這位音樂家僱用了一位有耐心的助理來處理這台喜怒無常的設備。

definition_zh: (副) 氣質上；性情上

sentence_zh: 如果氣候更溫和，這個地區就能養活更多作物。

definition_zh: (名) 溫度；體溫

sentence_zh: 台灣夏天的溫度可以超過三十度。

definition_zh: (動) 回火；調和；鍛鍊

sentence_zh: 很少情況下，鋼的回火需要如此精確的控制。

sentence_zh: 如果這座古老的寺廟沒有受到保護，它就會變成廢墟。

definition_zh: (名) 節奏；速度

sentence_zh: 這首饒舌歌曲的快節奏讓學生們在休息時間充滿活力。

definition_zh: (形) 時間的；暫時的

sentence_zh: 如果時間數據是準確的，這個實驗將會成功。

sentence_zh: 被最新型智慧型手機誘惑後，珍妮花光了所有零用錢。

sentence_zh: 面對一道困難的數學題目，這位頑強的學生拒絕放棄。

sentence_zh: 租賃協議要求支付兩個月的押金。

definition_zh: (動) 傾向於；往往會
