sentence_zh: 青少年往往花太多時間在他們的智慧型手機上。

definition_zh: (動) 傾向於；照顧
example_sentence: If a student tends to procrastinate, their grades may suffer.
sentence_zh: 如果學生傾向於拖延，他們的成績可能會受影響。

definition_zh: (名) 傾向；趨勢
example_sentence: Teenagers often have a tendency to stay up late.
sentence_zh: 青少年常有熬夜的傾向。

definition_zh: (形) 嫩的；溫柔的
example_sentence: The chicken breast was so tender that it melted in my mouth.
sentence_zh: 這塊雞胸肉非常嫩，入口即化。

definition_zh: (副) 溫柔地；體貼地
example_sentence: The mother tenderly held her baby as he slept peacefully.
sentence_zh: 母親溫柔地抱著熟睡的嬰兒。

definition_zh: (動) 傾向於；易於
example_sentence: Students who tend to procrastinate often miss assignment deadlines.
sentence_zh: 傾向於拖延的學生經常錯過作業截止日期。

definition_zh: (副) 十倍地；以十倍
example_sentence: Studying tenfold harder before exams can boost your score significantly.
sentence_zh: 考試前用十倍的努力讀書可以顯著提高你的分數。

definition_zh: (名) 網球
example_sentence: Tired after school, Lisa practiced tennis with her friend.
sentence_zh: 放學後很累，麗莎還是和朋友練習網球。

definition_zh: (名) 主旨；大意；男高音
example_sentence: The calm tenor of his speech helped everyone focus during the meeting.
sentence_zh: 他演講的平靜主旨幫助每個人在會議中專注。

definition_zh: (片) 緊張；繃緊
example_sentence: If the test is too hard, many students tense up during the exam.
sentence_zh: 如果考試太難，許多學生在考試期間會緊張起來。

definition_zh: (形) 緊張的；拉緊的　(名) 時態
example_sentence: If the teacher feels tense before an exam, students will become nervous too.
sentence_zh: 如果老師在考試前感到緊張，學生也會變得焦慮。

definition_zh: (名) 緊張；拉緊
example_sentence: The tension between the two teams grew before the final game.
sentence_zh: 兩隊之間的緊張氣氛在決賽前加劇了。

definition_zh: (名) 帳篷
example_sentence: The tent that my cousin bought last summer is very easy to set up.
sentence_zh: 我表哥去年夏天買的那個帳篷很容易搭起來。

definition_zh: (形) 暫定的；試探性的
example_sentence: If our club made a tentative plan, more members would join the discussion.
sentence_zh: 如果我們的社團制定一個暫定的計劃，更多成員會加入討論。

definition_zh: (名) 第十；十分之一　(形) 第十的
example_sentence: The tenth student in line received a prize for punctuality.
sentence_zh: 隊伍中的第十名學生因準時而獲獎。

definition_zh: (名) 終身職；任期
example_sentence: Professor Chen attended the conference to discuss academic tenure reforms.
sentence_zh: 陳教授參加會議是為了討論學術終身職的改革。

definition_zh: (名) 學期報告
example_sentence: Many students read extra books to write a strong term paper.
sentence_zh: 許多學生閱讀額外的書籍以寫出一份紮實的學期報告。

definition_zh: (名) 術語；學期
example_sentence: Seldom does a student forget the term for a required course.
sentence_zh: 學生很少忘記必修課程的學期。

definition_zh: (名) 終點站；航站　(形) 末期的；終點的
example_sentence: Standing at the bus terminal, Mia checked her phone for the latest schedule.
sentence_zh: 站在公車總站，米亞查看手機上的最新時刻表。

definition_zh: (名) 終止；結束
example_sentence: The early termination of the contract caused many problems.
sentence_zh: 合約的提前終止導致了許多問題。

definition_zh: (名) 終結者；終止者
example_sentence: The terminator in the science fiction movie was a powerful robot.
sentence_zh: 那部科幻電影中的終結者是一個強大的機器人。

definition_zh: (名) 術語；專門用語
example_sentence: The scientific terminology that the teacher explained was very confusing.
sentence_zh: 老師解釋的科學術語非常令人困惑。

definition_zh: (名) 白蟻
example_sentence: The wooden house was damaged by a termite infestation.
sentence_zh: 這棟木屋被白蟻 infestation 破壞了。

definition_zh: (名) 條款；條件；術語
example_sentence: The contract terms were fair for both parties.
sentence_zh: 合約條款對雙方都公平。

definition_zh: (名) 露臺；陽臺
example_sentence: Students often use the terrace to study for exams in good weather.
sentence_zh: 學生們經常在天氣好時使用露臺準備考試。

definition_zh: (名) 地形；地勢
example_sentence: The mountainous terrain made the hiking trip very challenging for the students.
sentence_zh: 崎嶇的山地地形讓這次健行對學生來說非常具有挑戰性。

definition_zh: (名) 玻璃容器；植物箱
example_sentence: Emily's science project features a beautiful terrarium with moss and ferns.
sentence_zh: 艾蜜莉的科學作業中有一個美麗的玻璃容器，裡面有苔蘚和蕨類植物。

definition_zh: (形) 陸地的；地球的
example_sentence: The terrestrial ecosystem faces threats from pollution and climate change.
sentence_zh: 陸地生態系統面臨污染和氣候變遷的威脅。

definition_zh: (形) 可怕的；糟糕的
example_sentence: The terrible storm destroyed many houses in the small town.
sentence_zh: 那場可怕的暴風雨摧毀了小鎮上的許多房屋。

definition_zh: (副) 非常；極其
example_sentence: If Sarah forgets her umbrella, she will feel terribly embarrassed at school.
sentence_zh: 如果莎拉忘記帶傘，她在學校會感到非常尷尬。

definition_zh: (形) 極好的；絕妙的
example_sentence: Studying abroad offers a terrific chance to learn about different cultures.
sentence_zh: 出國留學提供了一個絕佳的機會去了解不同的文化。

definition_zh: (動) 使驚恐；嚇壞
example_sentence: The horror movie that my friends recommended didn't terrify me at all.
sentence_zh: 我朋友推薦的那部恐怖電影一點也沒嚇到我。

definition_zh: (形) 領土的；領地的
example_sentence: If the country expanded its territorial waters, neighboring nations would protest.
sentence_zh: 如果這個國家擴張其領海，鄰國將會抗議。

definition_zh: (名) 領域性；領土意識
example_sentence: Many species use territoriality to protect their food and nesting sites.
sentence_zh: 許多物種利用領域性來保護牠們的食物和築巢地點。

definition_zh: (名) 領土；領域
example_sentence: If a foreign army enters our territory, the government will defend it.
sentence_zh: 如果外國軍隊進入我們的領土，政府將會保衛它。

definition_zh: (名) 恐怖；恐懼
example_sentence: The sudden terror in the dark forest made the hikers freeze.
sentence_zh: 黑暗森林中突如其來的恐懼讓健行者們僵住了。

definition_zh: (名) 恐怖分子
example_sentence: The police arrested the terrorist who planned the attack.
sentence_zh: 警方逮捕了策劃攻擊的恐怖分子。

definition_zh: (形) 簡短的；精簡的
example_sentence: The teacher's terse reply surprised the entire class.
sentence_zh: 老師簡短的回答讓全班同學感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (形) 第三級的；高等的
example_sentence: Interested in tertiary education, many students apply to universities abroad.
sentence_zh: 由於對高等教育感興趣，許多學生申請國外大學。

definition_zh: (名) 考試；測驗　(動) 測試；考驗
example_sentence: The test that the teacher gave was very difficult for us.
sentence_zh: 老師給我們的考試對我們來說非常困難。

definition_zh: (名) 證明；遺囑
example_sentence: The student's high score is a testament to her hard work and dedication.
sentence_zh: 這位學生的高分是她努力和奉獻的證明。

definition_zh: (動) 作證；證明
example_sentence: The witness will testify in court about the accident.
sentence_zh: 證人將在法庭上就該事故作證。

definition_zh: (名) 證詞；證言
example_sentence: Shocked by the accident, the witness gave a powerful testimony in court.
sentence_zh: 受到事故震驚，目擊者在法庭上提供了有力的證詞。

definition_zh: (名) 睪固酮；雄性激素
example_sentence: The coach explained that testosterone levels affect muscle growth.
sentence_zh: 教練解釋說睪固酮水平會影響肌肉生長。

definition_zh: (動) 拴；連接　(名) 拴繩；繫鏈
example_sentence: Tethering her phone to the laptop, Sarah finished the project on time.
sentence_zh: 莎拉將手機連接到筆電，按時完成了專案。

definition_zh: (名) 簡訊；文字訊息
example_sentence: A text message from her friend made Linda smile during class.
sentence_zh: 來自朋友的一封簡訊讓琳達在上課時微笑。

definition_zh: (片) 用簡訊發出；傳送簡訊
example_sentence: Before the deadline, students should text out their final answers to the teacher.
sentence_zh: 在截止日期前，學生應該將最終答案簡訊發送給老師。

definition_zh: (名) 課文；文本　(動) 發簡訊
example_sentence: The teacher asked the class to read the text carefully.
sentence_zh: 老師要求全班仔細閱讀課文。

definition_zh: (名) 教科書；課本
example_sentence: This textbook explains global warming in simple language for students.
sentence_zh: 這本教科書用簡單的語言向學生解釋全球暖化。

definition_zh: (名) 紡織品；紡織業　(形) 紡織的
example_sentence: The textile industry in Taiwan creates many job opportunities for local workers.
sentence_zh: 台灣的紡織業為當地勞工創造了許多就業機會。

definition_zh: (形) 文本的；文字的
example_sentence: Students read the article for a textual analysis in class.
sentence_zh: 學生們為了課堂上的文本分析而閱讀這篇文章。

definition_zh: (名) 質地；口感
example_sentence: The smooth texture of this cake makes it so delicious.
sentence_zh: 這蛋糕的滑順口感讓它非常美味。

definition_zh: (形) 泰國的；泰語的　(名) 泰語；泰國人
example_sentence: If my friend visits Thailand, he will try authentic Thai street food.
sentence_zh: 如果我朋友去泰國，他會嘗試道地的泰式街頭小吃。

definition_zh: (介) 比；比較
example_sentence: This book is more interesting than that one.
sentence_zh: 這本書比那本書更有趣。

definition_zh: (動) 感謝；謝謝
example_sentence: The students thank their teacher for the helpful advice.
sentence_zh: 學生們感謝老師提供的實用建議。

definition_zh: (形) 感激的；感謝的
example_sentence: Feeling thankful for the support, the student wrote a letter to her teacher.
sentence_zh: 因為感激這份支持，這個學生寫了一封信給她的老師。

definition_zh: (名) 感謝；感恩
example_sentence: The teacher spoke about the importance of thankfulness in daily life.
sentence_zh: 老師談到了日常生活中感恩的重要性。

definition_zh: (名) 感恩；感恩節
example_sentence: Feeling grateful during thanksgiving, the family shared a large turkey dinner.
sentence_zh: 在感恩節期間感到感激，這家人共享了一頓豐盛的火雞大餐。

definition_zh: (代) 那個；那件事　(連) 引導名詞子句　(形) 那；那個
example_sentence: The movie that we watched yesterday was very interesting.
sentence_zh: 我們昨天看的那部電影非常有趣。

definition_zh: (代) 那是；那個
example_sentence: The student thinks that's a great idea for the class project.
sentence_zh: 那位學生認為這對班級專題來說是個好主意。

definition_zh: (動) 解凍；融化
example_sentence: Students left the frozen fish on the counter to thaw before cooking.
sentence_zh: 學生們在烹煮前把冷凍魚放在流理臺上解凍。

definition_zh: (名) 富人和窮人；有產者和無產者
example_sentence: If the haves and have-nots worked together, society would become more balanced.
sentence_zh: 如果富人和窮人合作，社會會變得更平衡。

definition_zh: (名) 細節；門道；來龍去脈
example_sentence: To master the ins and outs of coding, a student needs daily practice.
sentence_zh: 為了掌握編程的細節，學生需要每天練習。

definition_zh: (名) 前一天晚上；前夜
example_sentence: The night before the exam, Lisa reviewed all her notes carefully.
sentence_zh: 考試前一晚，麗莎仔細複習了所有筆記。

definition_zh: (名) 是非；對錯
example_sentence: Seldom do students consider the rights and wrongs of their actions.
sentence_zh: 學生很少考慮自己行為的是非對錯。

definition_zh: (名) 一直；始終
example_sentence: The teacher knew the students were chatting the whole time.
sentence_zh: 老師知道學生們一直在聊天。

definition_zh: (冠) 這；那
example_sentence: The book that the teacher recommended was very interesting.
sentence_zh: 老師推薦的那本書非常有趣。

definition_zh: (名) 戲院；劇場
example_sentence: After the movie ended, the theater quickly emptied.
sentence_zh: 電影結束後，戲院很快空了。

definition_zh: (形) 戲劇的；誇張的
example_sentence: The director used theatrical lighting to create a dramatic effect.
sentence_zh: 導演使用戲劇性的燈光來營造一種誇張的效果。

definition_zh: (名) 公司；陪伴
example_sentence: After the company announced its profits, the stock price rose sharply.
sentence_zh: 這家公司宣布獲利後，股價急遽上漲。

definition_zh: (名) 偷竊；盜竊
example_sentence: The security guard prevented the theft of a laptop from the library.
sentence_zh: 警衛阻止了圖書館內一台筆記型電腦的偷竊。

definition_zh: (名) 政府
example_sentence: The government announced a new policy for reducing air pollution.
sentence_zh: 政府宣布了一項減少空氣污染的新政策。

definition_zh: (代) 他們的；她們的；它們的
example_sentence: Many students join clubs to improve their social skills.
sentence_zh: 許多學生加入社團是為了提升他們的社交技巧。

definition_zh: (代) 他們的（東西）
example_sentence: Having finished their homework, the students compared theirs.
sentence_zh: 完成作業後，學生們比較了他們的作業。

definition_zh: (代) 他們；她們；它們
example_sentence: The students whose projects impressed them received awards.
sentence_zh: 那些作品令他們印象深刻的學生獲得了獎項。

definition_zh: (名) 主題；題目
example_sentence: If the school chose a different theme for the festival, more students would join.
sentence_zh: 如果學校為園遊會選擇不同的主題，更多學生就會參加。

definition_zh: (形) 主題的；以...為主題的
example_sentence: Themed around environmental protection, the school festival attracted many students.
sentence_zh: 以環保為主題的校慶吸引了許多學生。

definition_zh: (代) 他們自己；她們自己；它們本身
example_sentence: Students who taught themselves English often achieved higher scores.
sentence_zh: 自學英語的學生通常獲得較高的分數。

definition_zh: (副) 然後；接著
example_sentence: Students should finish their homework first, then they can watch TV.
sentence_zh: 學生應該先完成作業，然後他們才能看電視。

definition_zh: (副) 從那裡；因此
example_sentence: The students walked from the school to the library and thence to the park.
sentence_zh: 學生們從學校走到圖書館，然後從那裡走到公園。

definition_zh: (形) 神學的；宗教學的
example_sentence: The professor's theological lecture explored the concept of faith.
sentence_zh: 教授的宗教學講座探討了信仰的概念。

definition_zh: (形) 理論上的；假設的
example_sentence: Studying theoretical physics requires strong math skills and patience.
sentence_zh: 學習理論物理需要很強的數學技巧與耐心。

definition_zh: (副) 理論上
example_sentence: Theoretically, studying hard should lead to better grades.
sentence_zh: 理論上，努力學習應該會帶來更好的成績。

definition_zh: (動) 理論化；推論
example_sentence: The scientist conducted experiments to theorize about climate change.
sentence_zh: 這位科學家進行實驗，以理論化氣候變遷。

definition_zh: (名) 理論；學說
example_sentence: Testing the new theory, the students found it hard to believe.
sentence_zh: 測試這個新理論時，學生們發現很難相信它。

definition_zh: (形) 治療的；有療效的
example_sentence: Listening to calm music has a therapeutic effect on students.
sentence_zh: 聽平靜的音樂對學生有治療效果。

definition_zh: (名) 治療師；心理治療師
example_sentence: Only after seeing a therapist did her anxiety begin to fade.
sentence_zh: 只有在看過治療師後，她的焦慮才開始消退。

definition_zh: (名) 治療；療法
example_sentence: Physical therapy helped the athlete recover from his injury quickly.
sentence_zh: 物理治療幫助那位運動員從傷勢中快速康復。

definition_zh: (副) 在那裡；存在（用於there is/are結構）
example_sentence: There are many students studying in the library after school.
sentence_zh: 放學後有許多學生在圖書館讀書。

definition_zh: (代) 那裡有；存在
example_sentence: The store's prices are high, but there's a sale on shoes today.
sentence_zh: 這家店的價格很高，但今天鞋子有特價。

definition_zh: (副) 之後；此後
example_sentence: The student finished his homework and thereafter went to bed.
sentence_zh: 那位學生完成了他的作業，之後就去睡覺了。

definition_zh: (副) 因此；從而
example_sentence: The student completed the project on time, thereby earning the teacher's praise.
sentence_zh: 該學生按時完成了專題，因而贏得了老師的讚賞。

definition_zh: (副) 因此；所以
example_sentence: The teacher explained the rules, and therefore the students understood them.
sentence_zh: 老師解釋了規則，因此學生們理解了它們。

definition_zh: (副) 在其上；關於那
example_sentence: The student signed the agreement and placed his initials thereon.
sentence_zh: 那位學生簽署了協議，並在上面簽上姓名縮寫。

definition_zh: (形) 熱的；熱能的
example_sentence: The thermal energy from the sun powers solar panels efficiently.
sentence_zh: 來自太陽的熱能有效地為太陽能板提供動力。

definition_zh: (名) 體溫計；溫度計
example_sentence: Checking the thermometer, the nurse recorded the patient's high fever.
sentence_zh: 檢查體溫計後，護士記錄了病人的高燒。

definition_zh: (名) 保溫瓶；熱水瓶
example_sentence: A durable thermos keeps coffee hot during long study sessions.
sentence_zh: 一個耐用的保溫瓶能在長時間的學習中保持咖啡熱度。

definition_zh: (名) 恆溫器
example_sentence: A thermostat that keeps the room at a steady temperature saves energy.
sentence_zh: 一個能保持房間溫度穩定的恆溫器可以節省能源。

definition_zh: (名) 同義詞辭典
example_sentence: A thesaurus helps students find synonyms and antonyms for their essays.
sentence_zh: 同義詞辭典幫助學生找到作文的同義詞和反義詞。

definition_zh: (代) 這些
example_sentence: These books are very helpful for my English homework.
sentence_zh: 這些書對我的英文作業非常有幫助。

definition_zh: (名) 論文；論點
example_sentence: The student's thesis on climate change earned high praise from the teacher.
sentence_zh: 這位學生關於氣候變遷的論文得到了老師的高度讚揚。

definition_zh: (代) 他們（they had 或 they would 的縮寫）
example_sentence: Theyd better finish their homework before playing video games.
sentence_zh: 他們最好在玩電子遊戲前完成作業。

definition_zh: (形) 厚的；濃的
example_sentence: Because the fog was thick, the driver could not see the road clearly.
sentence_zh: 因為霧很濃，司機無法清楚看見道路。

definition_zh: (動) 使變稠；使變厚
example_sentence: Adding flour can thicken the sauce for a better texture.
sentence_zh: 加入麵粉可以使醬汁變稠，以獲得更好的口感。

definition_zh: (副) 濃厚地；厚厚地
example_sentence: The fog settled thickly over the small town, making it hard to see.
sentence_zh: 濃霧厚厚地籠罩著小鎮，讓人很難看清楚。

definition_zh: (名) 厚度；濃稠
example_sentence: The thickness of the blanket kept me warm during winter.
sentence_zh: 這條毯子的厚度讓我在冬天保持溫暖。

definition_zh: (名) 小偷；賊
example_sentence: The thief who stole my bike was caught by the police.
sentence_zh: 偷我腳踏車的小偷被警察抓住了。

definition_zh: (名) 大腿
example_sentence: Running too fast caused a sharp pain in Mark's thigh.
sentence_zh: 跑得太快導致馬克的大腿劇痛。

definition_zh: (形) 薄的；細的；稀的
example_sentence: The soup is too thin to satisfy my hunger after class.
sentence_zh: 這碗湯太稀了，無法滿足我下課後的飢餓。

definition_zh: (名) 事情；東西
example_sentence: Having finished the most difficult thing, the student felt relieved.
sentence_zh: 完成了最困難的事情後，那名學生感到鬆了一口氣。

definition_zh: (片) 考慮；思考
example_sentence: If a student thought about the consequences, he would study harder.
sentence_zh: 如果一個學生考慮到後果，他就會更努力學習。

definition_zh: (片) 把…視為；認為…是
example_sentence: If students think of exams as challenges, they will feel less stressed.
sentence_zh: 如果學生把考試視為挑戰，他們就會感到較少壓力。

definition_zh: (片) 想到；考慮
example_sentence: To think of a solution, the team brainstormed for hours.
sentence_zh: 為了想出解決方案，團隊進行了數小時的腦力激盪。

definition_zh: (片) 仔細考慮
example_sentence: Before making a decision, the committee needs to think over the proposal carefully.
sentence_zh: 在做決定之前，委員會需要仔細考慮這個提案。

definition_zh: (片) 徹底思考；仔細考慮
example_sentence: To think through the problem, the students used a flowchart.
sentence_zh: 為了徹底思考這個問題，學生們使用了流程圖。

definition_zh: (片) 三思而後行；重新考慮
example_sentence: If the plan fails, the team will think twice before investing again.
sentence_zh: 如果計畫失敗，團隊在再次投資前會三思而後行。

definition_zh: (片) 想出；發明
example_sentence: Before the science fair, the students had to think up a creative experiment.
sentence_zh: 在科展之前，學生們必須想出一個有創意的實驗。

definition_zh: (動) 想；認為　(名) 思考
example_sentence: The idea that he thinks is wrong surprises many students.
sentence_zh: 他認為是錯的那個想法讓許多學生感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (名) 思考；想法
example_sentence: Critical thinking helps students solve complex problems in daily life.
sentence_zh: 批判性思考幫助學生解決日常生活中的複雜問題。

definition_zh: (副) 薄薄地；細地
example_sentence: The baker thinly sliced the cake for the party.
sentence_zh: 麵包師傅為派對將蛋糕切得很薄。

definition_zh: (片) 第三次就會成功；第三次好運
example_sentence: Students who fail the test once believe that the third time’s the charm.
sentence_zh: 考試失敗一次的學生相信第三次就會成功。

definition_zh: (片) 第三次就會成功；第三次運氣好
example_sentence: To pass the exam, the student tried a third time’s the charm approach.
sentence_zh: 為了通過考試，這位學生採用了第三次就會成功的策略。

definition_zh: (形) 第三的　(名) 第三
example_sentence: Students use the library to study for their third exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們使用圖書館來準備他們的第三次考試。

definition_zh: (名) 口渴；渴望　(動) 渴望
example_sentence: After the long run, the athlete's thirst was finally quenched by cold water.
sentence_zh: 長跑後，運動員的口渴終於被冷水解除了。

definition_zh: (形) 口渴的；渴望的
example_sentence: The thirsty students drank water after the long run.
sentence_zh: 口渴的學生們在長跑後喝了水。

definition_zh: (名) 十三
example_sentence: Thirteen students, feeling nervous, waited for their exam results.
sentence_zh: 十三名學生感到緊張，等待著他們的考試成績。

definition_zh: (名) 三十
example_sentence: After waiting for thirty minutes, the bus finally arrived.
sentence_zh: 等了三十分鐘後，公車終於來了。

definition_zh: (形) 這個　(代) 這；這個
example_sentence: Students use this dictionary to improve their English vocabulary.
sentence_zh: 學生使用這本字典來提升他們的英文詞彙量。

definition_zh: (名) 刺；荊棘
example_sentence: The rose bush has many thorns that can scratch your skin easily.
sentence_zh: 玫瑰花叢有許多刺，很容易刮傷你的皮膚。

definition_zh: (形) 棘手的；多刺的
example_sentence: The thorny issue of climate change requires immediate attention from everyone.
sentence_zh: 氣候變遷這個棘手的問題需要每個人的立即關注。

definition_zh: (形) 徹底的；詳盡的
example_sentence: The student did a thorough review of the history notes before the test.
sentence_zh: 這位學生在考試前對歷史筆記做了徹底的複習。

definition_zh: (代) 那些⋯⋯的人
example_sentence: Those who studied hard would pass the exam if they had more time.
sentence_zh: 那些努力讀書的人如果有多一點時間，就會通過考試。

definition_zh: (代) 那些
example_sentence: Students study hard to pass those difficult exams.
sentence_zh: 學生們努力學習以通過那些困難的考試。

definition_zh: (連) 雖然；儘管　(副) 可是；不過
example_sentence: Though the test was hard, the students stayed calm.
sentence_zh: 雖然考試很難，學生們仍保持冷靜。

definition_zh: (形) 發人深省的；引人深思的
example_sentence: The teacher's thought-provoking question made the students think deeply.
sentence_zh: 老師發人深省的問題讓學生們深入思考。

definition_zh: (名) 想法；思想　(動) (think的過去式) 認為；想
example_sentence: The student's deep thought about the math problem helped him find the answer.
sentence_zh: 這位學生對數學問題的深思幫助他找到了答案。

definition_zh: (形) 體貼的；關心的
example_sentence: Sending a thoughtful gift to a friend can brighten their entire day.
sentence_zh: 送一份體貼的禮物給朋友可以照亮他們的一整天。

definition_zh: (名) 一千；一千個
example_sentence: The school library has over a thousand books for students to read.
sentence_zh: 學校圖書館有超過一千本書供學生閱讀。

definition_zh: (名) 線；細絲　(動) 穿線；穿過
example_sentence: If the thread breaks, the tailor will start again.
sentence_zh: 如果線斷了，裁縫會重新開始。

definition_zh: (名) 線；細絲
example_sentence: The threads of this sweater are starting to come loose.
sentence_zh: 這件毛衣的線開始鬆脫了。

definition_zh: (名) 威脅；恐嚇
example_sentence: The threat of heavy rain forced the school to cancel the sports day.
sentence_zh: 大雨的威脅迫使學校取消了運動會。

definition_zh: (動) 威脅；恐嚇
example_sentence: Seldom does a storm threaten the safety of the coastal village.
sentence_zh: 暴風雨很少威脅沿海村莊的安全。

definition_zh: (形) 威脅的；險惡的
example_sentence: The dark clouds threatening rain made the students hurry home.
sentence_zh: 烏雲威脅著要下雨，讓學生們趕緊回家。

definition_zh: (副) 威脅地；恐嚇地
example_sentence: The guard dog barked threateningly at the stranger near the gate.
sentence_zh: 那隻看門狗對著大門附近的陌生人威脅性地吠叫。

definition_zh: (名) 三；三個
example_sentence: Excited by the result, three students celebrated together.
sentence_zh: 受到結果的鼓舞，三名學生一起慶祝。

definition_zh: (名) 門檻；起點
example_sentence: Once students cross the threshold of the library, they must remain quiet.
sentence_zh: 學生一旦跨過圖書館的門檻，就必須保持安靜。

definition_zh: (名) 節儉；節約
example_sentence: Practicing thrift, the student saved money for a new laptop.
sentence_zh: 實踐節儉，這位學生存錢買新筆電。

definition_zh: (形) 節儉的；節約的
example_sentence: Because my grandmother is thrifty, she always saves money for emergencies.
sentence_zh: 因為我的祖母很節儉，她總是為緊急情況存錢。

definition_zh: (名) 興奮；震顫　(動) 使興奮；使震顫
example_sentence: The news of the school trip gave the students a thrill.
sentence_zh: 校外教學的消息讓學生們感到一陣興奮。

definition_zh: (形) 非常興奮的；極度激動的
example_sentence: Thrilled by the news, the entire class celebrated loudly.
sentence_zh: 全班同學因這個消息感到振奮，大聲慶祝。

definition_zh: (名) 驚悚片；恐怖小說
example_sentence: The thriller that my brother recommended kept me awake all night.
sentence_zh: 我哥哥推薦的那部驚悚片讓我整晚睡不著。

definition_zh: (形) 令人興奮的；驚險的
example_sentence: Watching the thrilling final match, the crowd cheered loudly.
sentence_zh: 觀看這場刺激的決賽，觀眾大聲歡呼。

definition_zh: (動) 茁壯成長；蓬勃發展
example_sentence: Many small businesses thrive by offering unique products online.
sentence_zh: 許多小型企業透過提供獨特的線上產品而蓬勃發展。

definition_zh: (動) 蓬勃發展；興旺
example_sentence: If the local business keeps thriving, more jobs will be created.
sentence_zh: 如果當地企業持續蓬勃發展，將會創造更多工作機會。

definition_zh: (名) 喉嚨
example_sentence: A sore throat can make it hard to speak in class.
sentence_zh: 喉嚨痛會讓你在課堂上說話變得困難。

definition_zh: (動) 跳動；抽痛
example_sentence: If the headache throbbed less, the student would focus on the exam.
sentence_zh: 如果頭痛跳動得沒那麼厲害，那位學生就能專心考試了。

definition_zh: (名) 王位；寶座
example_sentence: The prince sat on the throne after the king retired.
sentence_zh: 國王退休後，王子坐上了王位。

definition_zh: (名) 群眾；人群
example_sentence: The excited throng that waited for hours cheered wildly when the singer appeared.
sentence_zh: 那群等了數小時的興奮群眾，在歌手出現時瘋狂歡呼。

definition_zh: (介) 穿過；通過　(副) 完全地；自始至終　(形) 直達的；暢通的
example_sentence: The path through the forest leads to a beautiful lake.
sentence_zh: 穿過森林的小徑通往一個美麗的湖泊。

definition_zh: (介) 在...期間；遍及　(副) 始終；到處
example_sentence: The students worked hard throughout the entire semester.
sentence_zh: 學生們在整個學期都很努力。

definition_zh: (片) 扔掉；丟棄
example_sentence: Before throwing away old notebooks, students should check for important notes.
sentence_zh: 在扔掉舊筆記本之前，學生應該檢查是否有重要的筆記。

definition_zh: (片) 額外贈送；加入
example_sentence: The pizza shop decided to throw in free drinks for every order.
sentence_zh: 這家披薩店決定每筆訂單都附贈免費飲料。

definition_zh: (片) 匆匆穿上；披上
example_sentence: Students often throw on a jacket to stay warm between classes.
sentence_zh: 學生們常常在課間穿上夾克以保暖。

definition_zh: (片) 丟掉；拋棄
example_sentence: The old magazines that Dad threw out were collected by a recycling company.
sentence_zh: 爸爸丟掉的舊雜誌被一家回收公司收集走了。

definition_zh: (片) 匆匆湊合；胡亂拼湊
example_sentence: When friends arrive unexpectedly, a quick meal can be thrown together.
sentence_zh: 當朋友突然來訪時，可以快速湊合一頓飯。

definition_zh: (動) 嘔吐；吐出
example_sentence: If Mark ate too many snacks, he would throw up.
sentence_zh: 如果馬克吃太多零食，他會吐。

definition_zh: (片) 撲向；投靠
example_sentence: If the project fails, do not throw yourself at the manager for blame.
sentence_zh: 如果專案失敗了，不要為了責怪而撲向經理。

definition_zh: (片) 全心投入；致力於
example_sentence: After failing the first exam, Sarah decided to throw herself into studying harder.
sentence_zh: 第一次考試失敗後，莎拉決定全心投入更努力學習。

definition_zh: (動) 丟；投
example_sentence: Throwing old clothes away, the students organized a recycling drive.
sentence_zh: 丟棄舊衣服後，學生們組織了一場回收活動。

definition_zh: (名) 推；刺　(動) 推；刺
example_sentence: The sudden thrust of the crowd pushed Maria against the wall.
sentence_zh: 人群突然的推擠將瑪麗亞推向牆壁。

definition_zh: (動) 砰地落下；發出砰聲　(名) 砰的一聲
example_sentence: If a heavy box fell, it would thud loudly on the floor.
sentence_zh: 如果一個重箱子掉下來，它會砰地一聲撞在地板上。

definition_zh: (名) 拇指　(動) 豎起拇指表示贊成
example_sentence: Having given the project a thumbs-up, the teacher praised the students.
sentence_zh: 老師對這個專案豎起大拇指後，表揚了學生們。

definition_zh: (名) 雷；雷聲　(動) 打雷；轟隆作響
example_sentence: Hearing the loud thunder, the dog hid under the bed.
sentence_zh: 聽到巨大的雷聲，那隻狗躲到了床底下。

definition_zh: (名) 霹靂；雷電
example_sentence: If a thunderbolt struck the school, the principal would activate the emergency plan.
sentence_zh: 如果一道霹靂擊中學校，校長將會啟動應急計畫。

definition_zh: (形) 雷鳴般的；轟隆作響的
example_sentence: When the storm arrived, thunderous applause erupted from the crowd.
sentence_zh: 當暴風雨來臨時，人群中爆發出雷鳴般的掌聲。

definition_zh: (名) 雷雨；暴風雨
example_sentence: When a thunderstorm strikes, students should stay indoors to stay safe.
sentence_zh: 當雷雨來襲時，學生應待在室內以確保安全。

definition_zh: (名) 星期四
example_sentence: The history test on Thursday covers ancient civilizations.
sentence_zh: 星期四的歷史考試涵蓋古代文明。

definition_zh: (副) 因此；如此
example_sentence: Many students study hard thus to pass the difficult exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力學習，以便通過困難的考試。

definition_zh: (動) 阻礙；挫敗
example_sentence: The typhoon thwarted our plan to go hiking on Sunday.
sentence_zh: 颱風阻礙了我們週日去爬山的計畫。

definition_zh: (名) 百里香
example_sentence: Having chopped the thyme, the chef added it to the soup.
sentence_zh: 切好百里香後，廚師把它加進湯裡。

definition_zh: (片) 滴答過去；（時間）流逝
example_sentence: Not only did the clock tick away, but the deadline also approached.
sentence_zh: 時鐘不僅滴答作響，而且截止日期也逼近了。

definition_zh: (片) 時間流逝
example_sentence: The minutes that tick by during the exam feel like hours.
sentence_zh: 考試期間一分一秒過去的時間感覺像幾個小時。

definition_zh: (片) 點名；使生氣
example_sentence: If the teacher ticks off my name, I will be in trouble.
sentence_zh: 如果老師點到我的名字，我就有麻煩了。

definition_zh: (片) 緩慢運轉；勉強維持
example_sentence: While the manager is away, the business just ticks over.
sentence_zh: 當經理不在時，生意只是勉強維持運作。

definition_zh: (名) 滴答聲　(動) 發出滴答聲
example_sentence: The loud ticking of the clock kept the students awake during the test.
sentence_zh: 時鐘大聲的滴答聲讓學生在考試期間保持清醒。

definition_zh: (名) 票；車票　(動) 開罰單
example_sentence: If a student loses the bus ticket, the school can issue a new one.
sentence_zh: 如果學生遺失了公車票，學校可以補發一張新的。

definition_zh: (動) 逗樂；使發癢　(名) 癢；癢的感覺
example_sentence: The baby's laugh tickled everyone in the room.
sentence_zh: 嬰兒的笑聲逗樂了房間裡的每個人。

definition_zh: (形) 棘手的；難處理的；怕癢的
example_sentence: Having been ticklish about the topic, the student avoided discussing it.
sentence_zh: 對於這個話題感到棘手，那名學生避免討論它。

definition_zh: (名) 小趣聞；小珍聞
example_sentence: The teacher shared a fascinating tidbit about ancient Taiwanese culture.
sentence_zh: 老師分享了一個關於台灣古代文化的有趣小趣聞。

definition_zh: (片) 渡過（難關）；克服（困難）
example_sentence: The part-time job that helped tide over her expenses was a blessing.
sentence_zh: 那份幫助她渡過開銷的兼職工作真是個恩惠。

definition_zh: (名) 潮汐；潮流　(動) 順勢而為；渡過
example_sentence: The rising tide of pollution threatens the health of our local rivers.
sentence_zh: 日益嚴重的污染潮威脅著我們當地河流的健康。

definition_zh: (片) 整理；收拾
example_sentence: If the classroom were tidier, the students would tidy up more often.
sentence_zh: 如果教室更整潔，學生們就會更常整理。

definition_zh: (動) 整理；收拾　(形) 整潔的
example_sentence: The teacher asked the students to tidy their desks before class.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生在上課前整理好他們的書桌。

definition_zh: (片) 綁回去；繫回去
example_sentence: The gardener used a soft cloth to tie back the overgrown rose branches.
sentence_zh: 園丁用一塊軟布把過度生長的玫瑰枝條綁回去。

definition_zh: (片) 束縛；使無法脫身
example_sentence: If the project ties you down, the team can adjust the schedule.
sentence_zh: 如果這個專案讓你脫不了身，團隊可以調整時程。

definition_zh: (片) 結合；聯繫；使相關聯
example_sentence: Having tied in the new data, the report showed a clear trend.
sentence_zh: 在整合新數據後，報告顯示出一個明顯的趨勢。

definition_zh: (片) 繫緊；完成；處理
example_sentence: Before the trip, the students need to tie up all loose ends.
sentence_zh: 在旅行前，學生們需要把所有未完成的事情處理好。

definition_zh: (名) 延長賽；決勝局
example_sentence: The final match needed a tie-breaker to decide the winner.
sentence_zh: 決賽需要一場延長賽來決定勝負。

definition_zh: (動) 繫；綁　(名) 領帶；平局
example_sentence: The teacher asked the students to tie their shoelaces before the race.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生在賽跑前繫好鞋帶。

definition_zh: (名) 等級；層級
example_sentence: The company's new pricing tier offers more features for students.
sentence_zh: 這家公司的新定價等級為學生提供更多功能。

definition_zh: (名) 老虎
example_sentence: The tiger that lives in the zoo has orange and black stripes.
sentence_zh: 住在動物園裡的那隻老虎有橘色和黑色的條紋。

definition_zh: (形) 緊的；緊湊的
example_sentence: If the budget were tighter, the school would cancel the field trip.
sentence_zh: 如果預算更緊，學校就會取消校外教學。

definition_zh: (片) 加強；使更嚴格
example_sentence: The school decided to tighten up its security rules after the incident.
sentence_zh: 學校在事件後決定加強其安全規定。

definition_zh: (動) 使變緊；鎖緊
example_sentence: Tightening the screws on the chair, the student fixed it quickly.
sentence_zh: 鎖緊椅子上的螺絲，那名學生很快就修好了。

definition_zh: (名) 鋼索；艱難處境
example_sentence: The performer who walks the tightrope needs great balance.
sentence_zh: 走鋼索的表演者需要很好的平衡感。

definition_zh: (名) 波浪符號；代字號
example_sentence: Never had the student seen a tilde used in a math equation.
sentence_zh: 這位學生從未在數學方程式中看過波浪符號的使用。

definition_zh: (名) 磁磚；瓦片　(動) 鋪瓦；鋪瓷磚
example_sentence: The workers need extra tiles to finish the bathroom floor.
sentence_zh: 工人需要額外的磁磚來完成浴室地板。

definition_zh: (介) 直到…為止　(連) 直到…時候
example_sentence: The store stays open till 9 p.m. every day.
sentence_zh: 這家商店每天營業到晚上九點。

definition_zh: (動) 傾斜；使傾斜
example_sentence: The strong wind made the old tree tilt dangerously.
sentence_zh: 強風使那棵老樹危險地傾斜。

definition_zh: (名) 木材；木料
example_sentence: The timber that workers cut from the forest was used for building houses.
sentence_zh: 工人從森林砍伐的木材被用來建造房屋。

definition_zh: (形) 耗時的；花時間的
example_sentence: Preparing for the CSAT exam is a time-consuming process for many students.
sentence_zh: 準備學測考試對許多學生來說是一個耗時的過程。

definition_zh: (名) 暫停；休息時間
example_sentence: The coach called a time-out to discuss the team's strategy.
sentence_zh: 教練叫了暫停來討論球隊的策略。

definition_zh: (名) 時間；次數
example_sentence: The students always finish their homework on time before dinner.
sentence_zh: 學生們總是在晚餐前準時完成作業。

definition_zh: (形) 永恆的；不受時間影響的
example_sentence: If this timeless song continues to inspire, it will remain popular.
sentence_zh: 如果這首永恆的歌曲繼續激勵人心，它就會保持受歡迎。

definition_zh: (形) 及時的；適時的
example_sentence: Timely advice from the teacher helped the students avoid a big mistake.
sentence_zh: 老師及時的建議幫助學生避免了一個大錯誤。

definition_zh: (名) 鐘錶；計時器
example_sentence: Even though this old timepiece is broken, my grandfather refuses to throw it away.
sentence_zh: 即使這個老舊的鐘錶壞了，我的祖父仍拒絕丟掉它。

definition_zh: (名) 計時器；定時器
example_sentence: The kitchen timer helps students manage their study breaks effectively.
sentence_zh: 廚房計時器幫助學生有效管理他們的休息時間。

definition_zh: (名) 時間表；時刻表
example_sentence: The student checked the exam timetable before planning her study schedule.
sentence_zh: 這位學生在規劃讀書計畫前，先確認了考試時間表。

definition_zh: (形) 膽小的；羞怯的
example_sentence: If the student were less timid, she would join the debate team.
sentence_zh: 如果那個學生沒那麼膽小，她就會加入辯論隊。

definition_zh: (名) 時間安排；時機
example_sentence: The timing of the school festival was perfect for everyone.
sentence_zh: 學校園遊會的時間安排對每個人來說都很完美。

definition_zh: (名) 錫；罐頭；馬口鐵
example_sentence: The old tin roof that was damaged in the typhoon is being replaced.
sentence_zh: 在颱風中受損的舊鐵皮屋頂正在被更換。

definition_zh: (名) 錫片；錫板
example_sentence: If the tincutre is not recycled, it will harm the environment.
sentence_zh: 如果錫片沒有被回收，它會傷害環境。

definition_zh: (名) 叮噹聲；鈴聲
example_sentence: The student heard a soft tinkle from the distant bell tower.
sentence_zh: 那名學生聽到遠處鐘樓傳來輕柔的鈴聲。

definition_zh: (名) 色調；色澤　(動) 染色；著色
example_sentence: If my room had a darker tint, the afternoon sun would feel less harsh.
sentence_zh: 如果我的房間色調更深，午後的陽光就不會那麼刺眼。

definition_zh: (形) 極小的；微小的
example_sentence: Although the room was tiny, the students felt cozy and warm.
sentence_zh: 雖然房間很小，但學生們感到舒適又溫暖。

definition_zh: (動) 向...告密；透露消息
example_sentence: The student tipped off the teacher about the surprise party.
sentence_zh: 那名學生向老師透露了驚喜派對的消息。

definition_zh: (片) 翻倒；傾覆
example_sentence: When the cat jumped on the table, the vase tipped over.
sentence_zh: 當貓跳上桌子時，花瓶翻倒了。

definition_zh: (名) 尖端；小費；祕訣　(動) 傾倒；給小費
example_sentence: My grandmother gave me a useful tip for growing tomatoes in pots.
sentence_zh: 我的祖母給了我一個在花盆裡種植番茄的有用祕訣。

definition_zh: (形) 微醉的；微醺的
example_sentence: If a student drank too much soda, they would feel tipsy.
sentence_zh: 如果學生喝太多汽水，他們會感到微醺。

definition_zh: (動) 踮著腳尖走
example_sentence: The curious boy would tiptoe into the library to avoid disturbing others.
sentence_zh: 那個好奇的男孩會踮著腳尖走進圖書館，以免打擾別人。

definition_zh: (片) 厭倦；厭煩
example_sentence: Many students tire of studying for long hours without breaks.
sentence_zh: 許多學生厭倦了長時間不休息的學習。

definition_zh: (片) 使疲勞；使筋疲力竭
example_sentence: The marathon that tires out even the strongest runners is held every spring.
sentence_zh: 那場連最強壯的跑者都會累垮的馬拉松每年春天舉行。

definition_zh: (動) 使疲倦；厭倦
example_sentence: Many students tire of studying late at night.
sentence_zh: 許多學生對熬夜讀書感到厭倦。

definition_zh: (形) 疲倦的；厭倦的
example_sentence: After a long day at school, the students felt very tired.
sentence_zh: 在學校度過漫長的一天後，學生們感到非常疲倦。

definition_zh: (形) 不懈的；不知疲倦的
example_sentence: The researcher's tireless efforts led to a breakthrough in renewable energy.
sentence_zh: 這位研究人員不懈的努力促成了可再生能源的突破。

definition_zh: (形) 令人厭煩的；無聊的
example_sentence: The endless homework made the class feel tiresome.
sentence_zh: 無止盡的作業讓課堂感到令人厭煩。

definition_zh: (形) 令人疲憊的；累人的
example_sentence: After the long hike, the climb up the stairs became tiring.
sentence_zh: 長途健行後，爬樓梯變得令人疲憊。

definition_zh: (名) 紙巾；面紙；組織
example_sentence: Using a soft tissue to wipe your nose is better for the environment.
sentence_zh: 用柔軟的面紙擦鼻子對環境比較好。

definition_zh: (名) 巨人；巨物
example_sentence: Defeated by a stronger titan, the hero retreated to plan a new strategy.
sentence_zh: 被更強大的巨人擊敗後，英雄撤退以計劃新策略。

definition_zh: (形) 巨大的；龐大的
example_sentence: If the titanic ship sank, many lives would be lost.
sentence_zh: 如果這艘巨大的船沉沒，許多生命將會消失。

definition_zh: (名) 標題；頭銜　(動) 加標題；授予頭銜
example_sentence: The title of the book caught many students' attention.
sentence_zh: 這本書的標題引起了許多學生的注意。

definition_zh: (形) 名義上的；有名無實的
example_sentence: Seldom has the titular hero appeared in the final scene.
sentence_zh: 這位名義上的英雄很少出現在最後一幕。

definition_zh: (片) 僅舉幾例；舉例來說
example_sentence: Seldom have the students learned such useful expressions, to name just a few.
sentence_zh: 學生們很少學到如此有用的表達，僅舉幾例。

definition_zh: (名) 蟾蜍；癩蛤蟆
example_sentence: The toad that lives in the school garden has warty skin.
sentence_zh: 住在學校花園的那隻蟾蜍有疣狀的皮膚。

definition_zh: (動) 拍馬屁；奉承
example_sentence: The new student toadies to the teacher for better grades.
sentence_zh: 這位新學生為了更好的成績而拍老師馬屁。

definition_zh: (名) 吐司；乾杯　(動) 烤（麵包）；向…敬酒
example_sentence: Having toasted the bread, Lisa buttered it for breakfast.
sentence_zh: 烤好麵包後，麗莎塗上奶油當早餐。

definition_zh: (名) 菸草；菸草製品
example_sentence: Having banned tobacco sales to minors, the government saw a drop in youth smoking.
sentence_zh: 禁止向未成年人銷售菸草後，政府發現青少年吸菸率下降。

definition_zh: (名) 今天；現今　(副) 在今天；現今
example_sentence: Students study hard today to prepare for the college entrance exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們今天努力學習，以準備大學入學考試。

definition_zh: (片) 搖搖晃晃地走開
example_sentence: Having finished his homework, the little boy toddled off to bed.
sentence_zh: 做完功課後，小男孩搖搖晃晃地走去睡覺。

definition_zh: (動) 蹣跚行走；搖搖晃晃地走
example_sentence: Having toddled across the room, the baby reached for a toy.
sentence_zh: 搖搖晃晃地走過房間後，嬰兒伸手去拿玩具。

definition_zh: (名) 學步的幼兒；幼童
example_sentence: The toddler carefully stacked colorful blocks into a tall tower.
sentence_zh: 這個幼兒小心地將彩色積木堆疊成一座高塔。

definition_zh: (名) 腳趾
example_sentence: My little brother stubbed his toe on the door.
sentence_zh: 我弟弟的腳趾撞到了門。

definition_zh: (名) 腳趾甲
example_sentence: The toenail that the doctor removed was causing a lot of pain.
sentence_zh: 醫生移除的那個腳趾甲引起了很多疼痛。

definition_zh: (名) 豆腐
example_sentence: My mom often adds soft tofu to the hot pot.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽經常在火鍋裡加軟豆腐。

definition_zh: (副) 一起；共同
example_sentence: The students worked together on the science project.
sentence_zh: 學生們一起合作做科學專題。

definition_zh:
(動) 切換；轉換
(名) 切換開關
example_sentence: The user can toggle the dark mode setting in the app.
sentence_zh: 使用者可以在應用程式中切換深色模式設定。

definition_zh: (名) 辛勞；苦工　(動) 辛苦工作；艱難地行進
example_sentence: After years of toil, the farmer finally harvested a bountiful crop.
sentence_zh: 經過多年的辛勞，農夫終於收穫了豐盛的作物。

definition_zh: (名) 廁所；馬桶
example_sentence: The toilet that the janitor fixed is now working well.
sentence_zh: 清潔工修好的馬桶現在運作正常。

definition_zh: (名) 象徵；代幣　(動) 表示；代表
example_sentence: Receiving a token of appreciation, the teacher smiled warmly at the class.
sentence_zh: 收到一份感謝的象徵，老師對全班溫暖地微笑。

definition_zh: (名) 東京
example_sentence: Tokyo is a bustling city with many famous landmarks.
sentence_zh: 東京是一個繁華的城市，擁有許多著名地標。

definition_zh: (形) 可忍受的；尚可的
example_sentence: The summer heat in Taiwan is barely tolerable without air conditioning.
sentence_zh: 台灣的夏日炎熱若沒有空調幾乎難以忍受。

definition_zh: (名) 寬容；容忍
example_sentence: Learning tolerance helps students build stronger friendships at school.
sentence_zh: 學習寬容有助於學生在校園建立更穩固的友誼。

definition_zh: (形) 寬容的；容忍的
example_sentence: A tolerant teacher creates a safe space for different opinions.
sentence_zh: 一個寬容的老師為不同的意見創造了一個安全的空間。

definition_zh: (動) 容忍；忍受
example_sentence: The school cannot tolerate students cheating on exams.
sentence_zh: 學校無法容忍學生考試作弊。

definition_zh: (名) 傷亡人數；通行費　(動) 敲鐘；收取通行費
example_sentence: The heavy traffic toll on the highway surprised many drivers.
sentence_zh: 高速公路上沉重的交通傷亡人數讓許多駕駛感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (名) 收費站；收費亭
example_sentence: The driver stopped at the tollbooth to pay the fee.
sentence_zh: 駕駛在收費站停車繳費。

definition_zh: (名) 收費高速公路
example_sentence: The tollway that connects Taipei and Taoyuan is busy during holidays.
sentence_zh: 連接台北和桃園的收費高速公路在假期期間很繁忙。

definition_zh: (名) 番茄
example_sentence: A ripe tomato that is red and juicy tastes great in a salad.
sentence_zh: 一顆成熟、又紅又多汁的番茄在沙拉裡吃起來很棒。

definition_zh: (名) 墳墓；墓穴
example_sentence: The old tomb in the forest is covered with moss and leaves.
sentence_zh: 森林裡的那座古墓被苔蘚和樹葉覆蓋。

definition_zh: (名) 明天；未來　(副) 在明天
example_sentence: The game tomorrow will decide our team's ranking.
sentence_zh: 明天的比賽將決定我們隊伍的排名。

definition_zh: (名) 噸；大量
example_sentence: Recycling one ton of paper saves about seventeen trees from being cut down.
sentence_zh: 回收一噸的紙可以拯救大約十七棵樹免於被砍伐。

definition_zh: (片) 緩和；降低
example_sentence: Having toned down the harsh criticism, the teacher gave more constructive feedback.
sentence_zh: 在緩和了嚴厲的批評後，老師給了更具建設性的回饋。

definition_zh: (名) 語氣；音調　(動) 調和；定調
example_sentence: If the teacher's tone were kinder, students would listen more carefully.
sentence_zh: 如果老師的語氣更友善，學生們會更仔細聽。

definition_zh: (動) 用鉗子夾住；用夾子拿
example_sentence: Having tong the metal, the blacksmith carefully shaped it.
sentence_zh: 用鉗子夾住金屬後，鐵匠仔細地將其塑形。

definition_zh: (名) 夾子；鉗子
example_sentence: The metal tongs are used to pick up hot glass in science class.
sentence_zh: 金屬夾子在科學課上用於夾起熱玻璃。

definition_zh: (名) 繞口令
example_sentence: Practicing this tongue twister quickly, the student improved her pronunciation.
sentence_zh: 快速練習這個繞口令後，那位學生改善了發音。

definition_zh: (名) 舌頭；語言　(動) 用舌頭觸碰
example_sentence: When the teacher asked a hard question, the student held his tongue.
sentence_zh: 當老師問了一個難題，那名學生保持沉默。

definition_zh: (名) 補品；滋補劑　(形) 滋補的；使精神振奮的
example_sentence: Never had the tonic tasted so refreshing after a long hike.
sentence_zh: 在長途健行之後，這瓶補品從未喝起來如此清爽。

definition_zh: (名) 今晚　(副) 在今晚
example_sentence: Studying hard tonight, Tom hopes to pass the math test.
sentence_zh: 今晚努力讀書，湯姆希望能通過數學考試。

definition_zh: (名) 公噸；噸
example_sentence: Although the factory produces a tonne of waste daily, recycling efforts reduce the impact.
sentence_zh: 雖然工廠每天產生一噸廢棄物，但回收努力減少了影響。

definition_zh: (名) 扁桃腺
example_sentence: If a student had infected tonsils, the doctor would recommend surgery.
sentence_zh: 如果學生的扁桃腺受到感染，醫生會建議動手術。

definition_zh: (片) 太……而不能……
example_sentence: The assignment is too difficult to finish on time.
sentence_zh: 這份作業太難了，無法按時完成。

definition_zh: (副) 太；過於
example_sentence: The students study too hard to have any free time.
sentence_zh: 學生們讀書太用功，以至於沒有任何空閒時間。

definition_zh: (片) 為特定目的而裝備；配備工具
example_sentence: The company decided to tool up the factory for new electric car production.
sentence_zh: 公司決定為新的電動車生產而裝備工廠。

definition_zh: (名) 工具；用具
example_sentence: A hammer is a useful tool that helps students build birdhouses in class.
sentence_zh: 鎚子是一種有用的工具，可以幫助學生在課堂上建造鳥屋。

definition_zh: (名) 牙齒
example_sentence: The dentist said a broken tooth needs immediate care.
sentence_zh: 牙醫說一顆斷掉的牙齒需要立即處理。

definition_zh: (名) 牙痛
example_sentence: Seldom does a toothache go away without a visit to the dentist.
sentence_zh: 牙痛很少不需要看牙醫就能自行好轉。

definition_zh: (名) 牙刷
example_sentence: The student left her toothbrush on the bathroom sink this morning.
sentence_zh: 那位學生今天早上把她的牙刷留在浴室洗手台上。

definition_zh: (名) 牙膏
example_sentence: Having finished the toothpaste, Mom bought a new tube from the store.
sentence_zh: 用完牙膏後，媽媽從商店買了一條新的。

definition_zh: (動) 完成；結束
example_sentence: A big bowl of shaved ice can top off a hot summer day perfectly.
sentence_zh: 一大碗刨冰能完美地為炎熱的夏日畫下句點。

definition_zh: (動) 達到最高點；到達頂峰
example_sentence: The temperature is expected to top out at 35 degrees today.
sentence_zh: 今天的氣溫預計最高達到35度。

definition_zh: (片) 充值；加值
example_sentence: If your phone battery is low, you should top up your prepaid card.
sentence_zh: 如果你的手機電量不足，你應該為預付卡加值。

definition_zh: (形) 一流的；頂尖的
example_sentence: The top-notch restaurant serves delicious Taiwanese beef noodles.
sentence_zh: 這家一流的餐廳供應美味的台灣牛肉麵。

definition_zh: (名) 頂端；頂部　(形) 最高的；最好的　(動) 高於；勝過
example_sentence: The top student in our class always finishes homework early.
sentence_zh: 我們班上頂尖的學生總是早早完成作業。

definition_zh: (名) 主題；話題
example_sentence: The topic that the teacher chose for the debate was very interesting.
sentence_zh: 老師為辯論選擇的主題非常有趣。

definition_zh: (形) 時事的；話題的
example_sentence: Seldom is the topical debate so relevant to young people.
sentence_zh: 很少有時事辯論對年輕人如此相關。

definition_zh: (形) 上空的；上半身裸露的
example_sentence: The magazine featured a topless model on its controversial cover.
sentence_zh: 這本雜誌在其有爭議的封面上刊登了一位上身赤裸的模特兒。

definition_zh: (名) 配料；頂層
example_sentence: If the pizza had more cheese, the topping would taste even better.
sentence_zh: 如果披薩有更多起司，配料會更加美味。

definition_zh: (動) 推倒；顛覆
example_sentence: Seldom does a small storm topple such a massive tree.
sentence_zh: 一場小風暴很少能吹倒這麼大的一棵樹。

definition_zh: (形) 亂七八糟的；顛倒的
example_sentence: The students cleaned the topsy-turvy classroom to prepare for the exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們打掃了亂七八糟的教室，以準備考試。

definition_zh: (名) 火炬；手電筒
example_sentence: The hiker used a torch to light the dark trail after sunset.
sentence_zh: 登山者在日落後使用火炬照亮黑暗的小徑。

definition_zh: (動) [tɔr'mɛnt] 折磨；使痛苦　(名) ['tɔrmɛnt] 折磨；痛苦
example_sentence: The constant noise from the construction site torments the students during exams.
sentence_zh: 來自工地的持續噪音在考試期間折磨著學生們。

definition_zh: (名) 龍捲風
example_sentence: Frightened by the tornado, the students hid in the basement.
sentence_zh: 被龍捲風嚇到，學生們躲在地下室裡。

definition_zh: (名) 魚雷
example_sentence: The navy submarine launched a torpedo at the enemy ship.
sentence_zh: 海軍潛艇向敵艦發射了一枚魚雷。

definition_zh: (形) 遲鈍的；昏昏欲睡的
example_sentence: Feeling torpid in class, the student struggled to stay awake.
sentence_zh: 在課堂上感到昏昏欲睡，這個學生努力保持清醒。

definition_zh: (名) 扭力；扭矩
example_sentence: If the engine produces enough torque, the car will accelerate smoothly.
sentence_zh: 如果引擎產生足夠的扭力，汽車就會平穩加速。

definition_zh: (名) 急流；洪流
example_sentence: The sudden torrent of rain flooded the school's basketball court.
sentence_zh: 突如其來的暴雨淹沒了學校的籃球場。

definition_zh: (形) 傾盆的；洶湧的
example_sentence: Stranded by torrential rain, the students waited for the bus in the shelter.
sentence_zh: 被暴雨困住，學生們在候車亭等公車。

definition_zh: (名) 軀幹；半身像
example_sentence: The artist sculpted a detailed torso from clay for the exhibition.
sentence_zh: 這位藝術家為展覽用黏土雕刻了一個細節豐富的軀幹。

definition_zh: (名) 墨西哥薄餅；玉米餅
example_sentence: The tortilla that my mother made for dinner was delicious.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽晚餐做的墨西哥薄餅很好吃。

definition_zh: (名) 烏龜；陸龜
example_sentence: If a tortoise lived in a polluted pond, it would face many health problems.
sentence_zh: 如果一隻烏龜住在受污染的池塘裡，牠會面臨許多健康問題。

definition_zh: (名) 折磨；拷問　(動) 折磨；拷打
example_sentence: The prisoner's torture by the guards was a cruel act.
sentence_zh: 囚犯遭受守衛的折磨是一種殘酷的行為。

definition_zh: (動) 翻來覆去；使…搖擺不定
example_sentence: The strong wind tossed about the leaves in the schoolyard.
sentence_zh: 強風在校園裡吹得樹葉四處翻飛。

definition_zh: (片) 一口氣喝下；迅速喝光
example_sentence: After a long day of studying, Mia likes to toss back a cold drink.
sentence_zh: 在漫長的一天學習後，Mia喜歡一口氣喝下冷飲。

definition_zh: (片) 擲硬幣決定
example_sentence: After the coin toss for the game, the captain chose to kick first.
sentence_zh: 比賽擲硬幣後，隊長選擇先踢球。

definition_zh: (片) 迅速完成；輕鬆做
example_sentence: The chef can toss off a delicious meal in just ten minutes.
sentence_zh: 這位廚師能在短短十分鐘內輕鬆做出美味的餐點。

definition_zh: (片) 猶豫不決；投擲（硬幣等）
example_sentence: Tossing up between two options, the student chose the science club.
sentence_zh: 在兩個選項之間猶豫不決後，那名學生選擇了科學社團。

definition_zh: (動) 扔；拋；擲
example_sentence: The students toss their backpacks onto the floor after class.
sentence_zh: 學生們在下課後把書包扔到地板上。

definition_zh: (名) ['totl̩] 總數；總計　(形) ['totl̩] 總共的；完全的　(動) [totl̩] 總計達；完全摧毀
example_sentence: A total of thirty students joined the school clean-up activity.
sentence_zh: 總共有三十名學生參加了學校的清潔活動。

definition_zh: (副) 完全地；徹底地
example_sentence: If the students are totally prepared, the exam will feel much easier.
sentence_zh: 如果學生完全準備好了，考試就會感覺輕鬆很多。

definition_zh: (動) 手提；攜帶
example_sentence: If the weather is sunny, Amy will tote her books to the park.
sentence_zh: 如果天氣晴朗，艾米會提著她的書去公園。

definition_zh: (名) 圖騰；標誌
example_sentence: Our class designed a totem to represent our shared values.
sentence_zh: 我們班設計了一個圖騰來代表我們共同的價值觀。

definition_zh: (片) 降落；著陸
example_sentence: The pilot announced that the plane would touch down in ten minutes.
sentence_zh: 機長宣布飛機將在十分鐘後降落。

definition_zh: (片) 為……作擔保；為……付款
example_sentence: The kind man offered to touch for the old woman's medical bills.
sentence_zh: 那位好心男士主動為老婦人的醫療費用作擔保。

definition_zh: (片) 提及；談到
example_sentence: The teacher's lecture will touch on the causes of climate change.
sentence_zh: 老師的講座將提及氣候變遷的原因。

definition_zh: (片) 修飾；修補
example_sentence: The photographer used a brush to touch up the portrait before printing.
sentence_zh: 攝影師在印刷前用畫筆修飾了那幅肖像。

definition_zh: (動) 觸摸；感動
example_sentence: The painting that touched my heart was created by a local artist.
sentence_zh: 那幅觸動我心的畫是由一位當地藝術家創作的。

definition_zh: (形) 感人的；觸動人心的
example_sentence: Watching the touching movie, many students cried during the final scene.
sentence_zh: 看著那部感人的電影，許多學生在最後一幕哭了。

definition_zh: (名) 試金石；檢驗標準
example_sentence: Honesty is a touchstone for true friendship among students.
sentence_zh: 誠實是學生間真正友誼的試金石。

definition_zh: (形) 敏感的；易怒的
example_sentence: If the teacher brings up grades, Mike becomes touchy about his performance.
sentence_zh: 如果老師提起成績，Mike 就會對自己的表現變得敏感。

definition_zh: (形) 困難的；堅韌的
example_sentence: The students find the math exam tough to finish in time.
sentence_zh: 學生們覺得數學考試很難及時完成。

definition_zh: (名) 韌性；堅韌
example_sentence: If the team showed more toughness, they would win the final game.
sentence_zh: 如果這支隊伍展現更多韌性，他們就會贏得決賽。

definition_zh: (名) 旅遊；觀光　(動) 旅行；巡迴
example_sentence: The tour of the science museum lasted three hours.
sentence_zh: 科學博物館的導覽持續了三個小時。

definition_zh: (名) 觀光；旅遊業
example_sentence: Many students choose to study tourism to explore different cultures.
sentence_zh: 許多學生選擇讀觀光學系，以探索不同的文化。

definition_zh: (名) 觀光客；遊客
example_sentence: Many tourists visit the night market for local snacks.
sentence_zh: 許多觀光客為了當地小吃造訪夜市。

definition_zh: (形) 觀光化的；充滿觀光客的
example_sentence: The old street became too touristy for local residents.
sentence_zh: 那條老街變得過於觀光化，對當地居民來說不再舒適。

definition_zh: (名) 錦標賽；聯賽
example_sentence: Our school team practiced every day to win the basketball tournament.
sentence_zh: 我們學校的隊伍每天練習，以贏得籃球錦標賽。

definition_zh: (片) 拖走；拖吊
example_sentence: Only after the storm did the police tow away the abandoned cars.
sentence_zh: 暴風雨過後，警察才拖走廢棄車輛。

definition_zh: (動) 拖；拉；牽引
example_sentence: The car that broke down on the highway had to be towed away.
sentence_zh: 那輛在高速公路上拋錨的汽車必須被拖走。

definition_zh: (介) 朝向；為了
example_sentence: Many students work hard toward their goal of entering a good university.
sentence_zh: 許多學生努力朝著進入好大學的目標前進。

definition_zh: (名) 毛巾
example_sentence: Having used the towel, Lisa hung it in the bathroom.
sentence_zh: 用過毛巾後，麗莎把它掛在浴室裡。

definition_zh: (名) 塔；高樓
example_sentence: The students climbed the tower to see the city view.
sentence_zh: 學生們爬上塔去看城市風景。

definition_zh: (形) 高聳的；傑出的
example_sentence: Towering over the city, the skyscraper became a famous landmark.
sentence_zh: 高聳於城市之上，這座摩天大樓成了著名的地標。

definition_zh: (名) 拖繩；拖纜
example_sentence: Having secured the towline to the truck, the driver signaled to proceed.
sentence_zh: 將拖繩固定在卡車上後，司機示意前進。

definition_zh: (名) 城鎮；市鎮
example_sentence: Having visited the small town, the students wrote a report about its history.
sentence_zh: 參觀過這個小鎮後，學生們寫了一份關於其歷史的報告。

definition_zh: (名) 鎮；鄉鎮區
example_sentence: The student council visited the township to learn about local government.
sentence_zh: 學生會訪問了這個鄉鎮，以了解地方政府的運作。

definition_zh: (名) 鎮民；市民
example_sentence: The townspeople who attended the meeting supported the new park plan.
sentence_zh: 參加會議的鎮民支持了新的公園計畫。

definition_zh: (形) 有毒的；中毒的
example_sentence: The toxic waste from factories polluted the nearby river.
sentence_zh: 工廠排放的有毒廢物污染了附近的河流。

definition_zh: (名) 毒素
example_sentence: Environmental toxins can cause serious health problems for humans.
sentence_zh: 環境毒素可能對人類造成嚴重的健康問題。

definition_zh: (片) 玩弄；不認真對待
example_sentence: The student who toys at his phone during class misses important points.
sentence_zh: 那個在課堂上玩弄手機的學生錯過了重點。

definition_zh: (動) 玩弄；不認真對待
example_sentence: The idea that he would toy with our feelings shocked everyone.
sentence_zh: 他會玩弄我們感情的想法震驚了所有人。

definition_zh: (名) 玩具
example_sentence: The little boy bought a toy car to play with his friends.
sentence_zh: 那個小男孩買了一輛玩具車，以便和朋友們一起玩。

definition_zh: (片) 追溯；回溯
example_sentence: If students trace back their family history, they would discover interesting stories.
sentence_zh: 如果學生追溯家族歷史，他們會發現有趣的故事。

definition_zh: (名) 痕跡；微量　(動) 追蹤；描繪
example_sentence: The scientist found a trace of ancient water on Mars.
sentence_zh: 科學家在火星上發現了古代水的痕跡。

definition_zh: (片) 追蹤到；找到
example_sentence: The detective managed to track down the missing laptop.
sentence_zh: 偵探設法追蹤到了失竊的筆記型電腦。

definition_zh: (名) 跑道；軌道　(動) 追蹤；跟蹤
example_sentence: The athlete runs on the track every morning before school.
sentence_zh: 這位運動員每天上學前在跑道上跑步。

definition_zh: (形) 溫順的；易處理的
example_sentence: The tractable dog obeyed every command its owner gave.
sentence_zh: 這隻溫馴的狗服從主人的每一個指令。

definition_zh: (名) 牽引力；抓地力
example_sentence: The new sneakers provide good traction on wet floors.
sentence_zh: 這雙新運動鞋在潮濕的地板上提供良好的抓地力。

definition_zh: (名) 拖拉機；牽引機
example_sentence: Because the tractor broke down, the farmer had to finish the work by hand.
sentence_zh: 因為拖拉機壞了，農夫只好用手工完成工作。

definition_zh: (片) 換購較便宜的東西；降級消費
example_sentence: Families who trade down to smaller homes save money on utilities.
sentence_zh: 換到較小房子的家庭可以在水電費上省錢。

definition_zh: (片) 以舊換新；折價換購
example_sentence: Seldom does a student trade in an old laptop for a newer model.
sentence_zh: 學生很少會用舊筆電折價換新型號。

definition_zh: (片) 交換；取捨；犧牲...以換取
example_sentence: Students who trade off study time for gaming often regret it later.
sentence_zh: 那些為了玩遊戲而犧牲讀書時間的學生，之後往往會後悔。

definition_zh: (片) 利用（某事物）牟利；佔…的便宜
example_sentence: Many influencers trade on their fame to promote products online.
sentence_zh: 許多網紅利用自己的名氣在網路上推銷產品。

definition_zh: (片) 升級換購；以舊換新
example_sentence: Many students trade up their old phones for newer models each year.
sentence_zh: 許多學生每年將舊手機升級換成較新的機型。

definition_zh: (名) 以舊換新；折價換購
example_sentence: After using the old phone for two years, a trade-in offered a good discount.
sentence_zh: 使用舊手機兩年後，以舊換新提供了不錯的折扣。

definition_zh: (名) 取捨；權衡
example_sentence: Choosing a college involves a trade-off between location and cost.
sentence_zh: 選擇大學涉及地點和費用之間的取捨。

definition_zh: (名) 貿易；交易　(動) 交易；交換
example_sentence: Taiwan's trade with Japan has grown a lot this year.
sentence_zh: 台灣與日本的貿易今年成長了很多。

definition_zh: (名) 商標；標誌
example_sentence: A strong trademark helps a company build customer trust over time.
sentence_zh: 一個強大的商標能幫助公司隨著時間建立客戶信任。

definition_zh: (名) 交易員；商人
example_sentence: Watching the stock market closely, the experienced trader made a quick decision.
sentence_zh: 密切觀察股市後，這位經驗豐富的交易員迅速做出了決定。

definition_zh: (名) 傳統
example_sentence: This tradition that our family follows brings us closer every year.
sentence_zh: 我們家遵循的這項傳統每年都讓我們更親近。

definition_zh: (形) 傳統的
example_sentence: Many Taiwanese families enjoy traditional mooncakes during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
sentence_zh: 許多台灣家庭在中秋節期間享用傳統月餅。

definition_zh: (名) 傳統主義者；守舊者　(形) 傳統主義的；守舊的
example_sentence: The traditionalist teacher, who values old methods, rarely uses technology.
sentence_zh: 那位重視舊方法的傳統派老師很少使用科技。

definition_zh: (副) 傳統上；照傳統
example_sentence: Traditionally, Taiwanese families gather for dinner during the Lunar New Year.
sentence_zh: 傳統上，台灣家庭在農曆新年期間會聚在一起吃晚餐。

definition_zh: (名) 交通
example_sentence: When the traffic is heavy, students should leave home early for school.
sentence_zh: 當交通擁擠時，學生應該早點離家上學。

definition_zh: (名) 非法交易；販運
example_sentence: If the government stops trafficking, many lives will be saved.
sentence_zh: 如果政府停止販運，許多生命將被拯救。

definition_zh: (名) 悲劇；災難
example_sentence: The sudden tragedy shocked the entire school community deeply.
sentence_zh: 這場突如其來的悲劇深深震撼了整個學校社區。

definition_zh: (形) 悲慘的；悲劇的
example_sentence: Learning about the tragic accident deeply affected the students.
sentence_zh: 得知這起悲劇事故讓學生們深受影響。

definition_zh: (名) 痕跡；小徑　(動) 跟蹤；落後
example_sentence: A long trail of smoke followed the rocket as it flew into the sky.
sentence_zh: 一長串煙霧跟隨著火箭飛入天空。

definition_zh: (名) 先驅；開拓者
example_sentence: The young scientist became a trailblazer in renewable energy research.
sentence_zh: 這位年輕科學家成為再生能源研究的先驅。

definition_zh: (名) 拖車；預告片
example_sentence: If our school bought a trailer, we would use it for field trips.
sentence_zh: 如果我們學校買了一輛拖車，我們就會用它來進行校外教學。

definition_zh: (名) 火車；列車　(動) 訓練；培訓
example_sentence: The new train to Taipei leaves at seven in the morning.
sentence_zh: 前往台北的新火車在早上七點出發。

definition_zh: (名) 實習生；受訓者
example_sentence: The new trainee learned how to use the office software.
sentence_zh: 這位新實習生學會了如何使用辦公室軟體。

definition_zh: (名) 教練；訓練師
example_sentence: The trainer who helped our team improve is from the United States.
sentence_zh: 那位幫助我們團隊進步的教練來自美國。

definition_zh: (名) 訓練；培訓
example_sentence: Many students join the club for training in public speaking.
sentence_zh: 許多學生加入社團是為了接受公開演講的訓練。

definition_zh: (名) 特質；特徵
example_sentence: A positive trait like honesty can help students build trust with others.
sentence_zh: 像誠實這樣的正向特質可以幫助學生與他人建立信任。

definition_zh: (名) 叛徒；背叛者
example_sentence: The student who betrayed his friends was called a traitor.
sentence_zh: 背叛朋友的那個學生被稱為叛徒。

definition_zh: (形) 叛國的；不忠的
example_sentence: Because the soldier revealed secret plans, the general viewed him as traitorous.
sentence_zh: 因為那名士兵洩漏了機密計畫，將軍視他為叛國的。

definition_zh: (名) 軌跡；軌道
example_sentence: Students studied the satellite's trajectory to predict its landing point.
sentence_zh: 學生們研究衛星的軌跡以預測其著陸點。

definition_zh: (名) 流浪漢；長途步行　(動) 跋涉；踩踏
example_sentence: The old tramp who sleeps on the park bench often reads newspapers.
sentence_zh: 那個睡在公園長椅上的老流浪漢經常看報紙。

definition_zh: (動) 踩踏；踐踏　(名) 踩踏聲
example_sentence: Trampling the garden, the dog left muddy footprints everywhere.
sentence_zh: 那隻狗踩踏花園，到處留下泥巴腳印。

definition_zh: (形) 安靜的；寧靜的
example_sentence: After the final exam ended, the classroom became tranquil.
sentence_zh: 期末考結束後，教室變得安靜。

definition_zh: (動) 使鎮靜；使平靜
example_sentence: The vet used a special drug to tranquilize the injured deer.
sentence_zh: 獸醫用一種特殊藥物來鎮靜那隻受傷的鹿。

definition_zh: (名) 鎮定劑；鎮靜劑
example_sentence: The tranquilizer that the doctor prescribed helped the patient relax.
sentence_zh: 醫生開的鎮定劑幫助病人放鬆。

definition_zh: (動) 辦理；交易
example_sentence: After the meeting, the manager decided to transact the deal quickly.
sentence_zh: 會議結束後，經理決定快速處理這筆交易。

definition_zh: (名) 交易；處理
example_sentence: The bank transaction was completed in just a few seconds.
sentence_zh: 這筆銀行交易在短短幾秒內就完成了。

definition_zh: (名) 超越；超凡
example_sentence: The artist's search for transcendence inspired many young creators.
sentence_zh: 這位藝術家對超越的追尋啟發了許多年輕創作者。

definition_zh: (形) 超凡的；卓越的
example_sentence: The artist's transcendent painting moved every visitor in the gallery.
sentence_zh: 那位藝術家超凡的畫作感動了畫廊裡的每一位訪客。

definition_zh: (形) 超然的；超凡的
example_sentence: If the artist's work feels transcendental, many students would explore its deeper meaning.
sentence_zh: 如果這位藝術家的作品感覺超然，許多學生會探索其更深層的意義。

definition_zh: (動) 抄寫；記錄
example_sentence: While the professor speaks, her assistant will transcribe every word.
sentence_zh: 當教授說話時，她的助手會逐字記錄下來。

definition_zh: (名) 成績單；抄本
example_sentence: The student requested a copy of her transcript for the university application.
sentence_zh: 那位學生為大學申請索取了一份她的成績單副本。

definition_zh: (名) 轉錄；抄寫
example_sentence: The transcription of the interview took the student two hours.
sentence_zh: 訪談的轉錄花費了那位學生兩個小時。

definition_zh: (動) 轉移；調動
example_sentence: After the student transferred to a new school, he made many friends quickly.
sentence_zh: 那名學生轉到新學校後，很快就交到許多朋友。

definition_zh: (名) 轉移；遷移
example_sentence: Seldom does the transference of learning occur without practice.
sentence_zh: 學習的遷移很少在沒有練習的情況下發生。

definition_zh: (動) 使變形；使改觀
example_sentence: The morning sunlight transfigured the ordinary classroom into a golden hall.
sentence_zh: 早晨的陽光將平凡的教室變成了金色的大廳。

definition_zh: (動) 使呆住；使目瞪口呆
example_sentence: The sudden loud noise transfixed the students in the classroom.
sentence_zh: 突然的巨大噪音讓教室裡的學生呆住了。

definition_zh: (動) 轉變；改造
example_sentence: The abandoned factory transformed into a modern art museum.
sentence_zh: 這座廢棄的工廠轉變為一座現代美術館。

definition_zh: (名) 轉變；變革
example_sentence: The transformation of the old factory into a park surprised many residents.
sentence_zh: 這座舊工廠轉變為公園，讓許多居民感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (形) 變革性的；轉變的
example_sentence: This new policy has a transformational effect on our education system.
sentence_zh: 這項新政策對我們的教育體系產生了變革性的影響。

definition_zh: (形) 變革性的；轉變性的
example_sentence: If the new curriculum were adopted, its transformative effects would benefit many students.
sentence_zh: 如果新課程被採納，其變革性的影響將使許多學生受益。

definition_zh: (名) 變壓器；變換器
example_sentence: If a transformer fails, the power supply will be interrupted.
sentence_zh: 如果變壓器故障，電源供應將會中斷。

definition_zh: (名) 跨性別者　(形) 跨性別的
example_sentence: Having come out as transgender, the student found strong support from friends.
sentence_zh: 在公開自己為跨性別者後，這位學生得到了朋友們的大力支持。

definition_zh: (動) 違反；逾越
example_sentence: The student who transgresses the school rules must face the consequences.
sentence_zh: 違反校規的學生必須面對後果。

definition_zh: (形) 短暫的；暫時的
example_sentence: The transient beauty of cherry blossoms reminds students to cherish every moment.
sentence_zh: 櫻花短暫的美麗提醒學生珍惜每一刻。

definition_zh: (名) 電晶體；晶體管
example_sentence: The invention of the transistor revolutionized modern electronic devices.
