sentence_zh: 我父親在小溪裡捕到的鱒魚非常新鮮。

definition_zh: (名) 珍藏；寶庫
example_sentence: The old library contained a trove of rare books.
sentence_zh: 這間舊圖書館藏有大量珍本。

definition_zh: (名) 翹課者；曠課者　(動) 翹課；曠課
example_sentence: The student played truant to avoid the difficult math exam.
sentence_zh: 那名學生翹課以逃避困難的數學考試。

definition_zh: (名) 休戰；停戰
example_sentence: The two countries agreed to a truce after months of fighting.
sentence_zh: 這兩個國家在數月的戰鬥後同意休戰。

definition_zh: (名) 卡車；貨車
example_sentence: When the truck arrived, the workers unloaded the boxes quickly.
sentence_zh: 當卡車到達時，工人們迅速卸下箱子。

definition_zh: (動) 跋涉；艱難地行走
example_sentence: The hiker who had to trudge through the mud was exhausted.
sentence_zh: 那位必須在泥濘中艱難行走的徒步旅行者筋疲力盡。

definition_zh: (形) 真實的；忠實的
example_sentence: Having learned the true story, the students felt deeply moved.
sentence_zh: 得知真實的故事後，學生們深受感動。

definition_zh: (副) 真正地；確實地
example_sentence: Having truly enjoyed the concert, Maria decided to buy the album.
sentence_zh: 真正享受了那場音樂會後，瑪麗亞決定購買專輯。

definition_zh: (動) 捏造；虛構
example_sentence: The politician tried to trump up false charges against his opponent.
sentence_zh: 那位政治人物試圖捏造虛假指控來對付他的對手。

definition_zh: (名) 小號；喇叭　(動) 吹小號；宣揚
example_sentence: If the trumpet player practices daily, the performance will improve.
sentence_zh: 如果小號手每天練習，表演就會進步。

definition_zh: (名) 樹幹；軀幹；大箱子；行李箱
example_sentence: My brother uses a trunk to store his old comic books.
sentence_zh: 我哥哥用一個大箱子來存放他的舊漫畫書。

definition_zh: (名) 信任；信賴　(動) 信任；相信
example_sentence: The trust that students have in their teachers is very important.
sentence_zh: 學生對老師的信任非常重要。

definition_zh: (名) 受託人；理事
example_sentence: The trustee of the school managed the fund for new computers.
sentence_zh: 學校的受託人管理了用於新電腦的基金。

definition_zh: (形) 值得信賴的；可靠的
example_sentence: A trustworthy friend will always keep promises made to you.
sentence_zh: 一個值得信賴的朋友總會遵守對你做出的承諾。

definition_zh: (名) 真相；真理
example_sentence: The truth that hard work leads to success is simple.
sentence_zh: 努力帶來成功這個真相很簡單。

definition_zh: (形) 誠實的；真實的
example_sentence: If the student were truthful, the teacher would trust him more.
sentence_zh: 如果這個學生誠實，老師就會更信任他。

definition_zh: (副) 誠實地；真實地
example_sentence: The student answered the teacher's question truthfully during class.
sentence_zh: 那名學生在課堂上誠實地回答了老師的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 真實性；誠實
example_sentence: The journalist emphasized truthfulness to build public trust.
sentence_zh: 那位記者強調真實性，以建立公眾信任。

definition_zh: (片) 再試一次；再打電話
example_sentence: If the line were busy, a customer would try back later.
sentence_zh: 如果電話忙線，顧客會稍後再試著打一次。

definition_zh: (片) 爭取；努力得到
example_sentence: The student decided to try for a scholarship at the university.
sentence_zh: 那位學生決定爭取大學的獎學金。

definition_zh: (片) 試穿
example_sentence: The customer went to the fitting room to try it on.
sentence_zh: 顧客去試衣間試穿它。

definition_zh: (片) 試穿；試戴
example_sentence: Many students try on new school uniforms before buying them.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在購買新校服前會先試穿。

definition_zh: (片) 參加...的選拔；嘗試爭取（某個角色或位置）
example_sentence: Only after practicing daily did the team try out for the competition.
sentence_zh: 只有在每天練習之後，這個團隊才去參加比賽的選拔。

definition_zh: (片) 試用；測試
example_sentence: Having tried out the new study app, many students found it helpful.
sentence_zh: 試用過新的學習應用程式後，許多學生發現它很有幫助。

definition_zh: (動) 嘗試；試用
example_sentence: The new recipe that my mother tried yesterday tasted delicious.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽昨天嘗試的新食譜嚐起來很美味。

definition_zh: (名) 選拔；試演
example_sentence: Having passed the tryout, Maria earned a spot on the school basketball team.
sentence_zh: 通過選拔後，瑪麗亞在學校籃球隊獲得了一個名額。

definition_zh: (名) 密集恐懼症
example_sentence: Trypophobia makes many people feel uncomfortable when seeing clustered holes.
sentence_zh: 密集恐懼症讓許多人在看到成群的孔洞時感到不舒服。

definition_zh: (名) 海嘯
example_sentence: When a tsunami strikes, coastal residents must evacuate immediately.
sentence_zh: 當海嘯來襲時，沿海居民必須立即撤離。

definition_zh: (名) 浴缸；桶
example_sentence: After a long run, a cold tub helps tired muscles recover quickly.
sentence_zh: 長跑後，冷水浴缸有助疲勞的肌肉快速恢復。

definition_zh: (名) 管子；顯像管；捷運
example_sentence: When the tube broke, the game player stopped working.
sentence_zh: 當顯像管壞掉時，遊戲機停止運作。

definition_zh: (名) 肺結核；結核病
example_sentence: If a student had tuberculosis, the school would notify health authorities immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果學生罹患肺結核，學校會立即通知衛生當局。

definition_zh: (動) 藏起；儲存
example_sentence: The student tucked away the snacks that his mother had packed for him.
sentence_zh: 那個學生把他媽媽為他打包的零食藏了起來。

definition_zh: (片) 睡覺；把……塞好
example_sentence: After a long day at school, Sarah likes to tuck in early.
sentence_zh: 在學校度過漫長的一天後，莎拉喜歡早點睡覺。

definition_zh: (片) 狼吞虎嚥地吃；盡情享用
example_sentence: The hungry students tuck into their lunch boxes after morning classes.
sentence_zh: 飢餓的學生們在早上的課後狼吞虎嚥地吃他們的午餐盒。

definition_zh: (動) 挽起；折起
example_sentence: Never had the student tucked up his sleeves so neatly.
sentence_zh: 這名學生從未如此整齊地挽起他的袖子。

definition_zh: (動) 塞進；捲起
example_sentence: The student decided to tuck his shirt into his pants before the presentation.
sentence_zh: 這位學生決定在報告前把襯衫塞進褲子裡。

definition_zh: (動) 使疲憊
example_sentence: If the student tuckers his shirt in, the teacher will be pleased.
sentence_zh: 如果學生把襯衫塞進褲子裡，老師會很高興。

definition_zh: (名) 星期二
example_sentence: The band practice on Tuesday was canceled due to heavy rain.
sentence_zh: 星期二的樂團練習因大雨而取消了。

definition_zh: (名) 拔河比賽；激烈的競爭
example_sentence: Engaged in a tug-of-war, the two teams pulled with all their might.
sentence_zh: 兩支隊伍進行拔河比賽，全力以赴地拉動繩子。

definition_zh: (名) 拉力；拖船　(動) 用力拉；拖曳
example_sentence: The strong tug of the current pulled the swimmer away from the shore.
sentence_zh: 強勁的水流拉力將游泳者拉離了岸邊。

definition_zh: (名) 學費
example_sentence: Many students work part-time jobs to cover their university tuition.
sentence_zh: 許多學生打工來支付大學學費。

definition_zh: (名) 鬱金香
example_sentence: If a tulip bulb were planted in summer, it would not bloom.
sentence_zh: 如果鬱金香的球莖在夏天種下，它就不會開花。

definition_zh: (動) 跌倒；翻滾
example_sentence: If a child tumbles on the playground, a teacher must help.
sentence_zh: 如果孩子在操場上跌倒，老師必須幫忙。

definition_zh: (名) 平底玻璃杯；翻轉者
example_sentence: Dropped carelessly, the tumbler shattered into tiny pieces on the floor.
sentence_zh: 不小心掉落的平底玻璃杯在地上摔成了碎片。

definition_zh: (名) 肚子；胃
example_sentence: The baby's tummy felt soft and warm after the milk.
sentence_zh: 嬰兒的肚子在喝奶後感覺柔軟又溫暖。

definition_zh: (名) 腫瘤
example_sentence: The doctor found a small tumor in the patient's lung.
sentence_zh: 醫生在病人的肺部發現了一個小腫瘤。

definition_zh: (形) 動盪的；混亂的
example_sentence: If the political situation becomes tumultuous, the school will cancel the field trip.
sentence_zh: 如果政治情勢變得動盪，學校就會取消校外教學。

definition_zh: (名) 鮪魚；金槍魚
example_sentence: Not only does the tuna sandwich taste fresh, but it also looks appealing.
sentence_zh: 這個鮪魚三明治不僅吃起來新鮮，而且看起來也很吸引人。

definition_zh: (片) 收聽；收看
example_sentence: Students who tune in to the news daily improve their English skills.
sentence_zh: 每天收聽新聞的學生能提升他們的英語能力。

definition_zh: (片) 心不在焉；忽視
example_sentence: If the lecture became boring, many students would tune out immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果演講變得無聊，許多學生會立刻心不在焉。

definition_zh: (片) 調整；調校
example_sentence: Seldom does a mechanic tune up a car without checking the engine first.
sentence_zh: 技師很少在沒有先檢查引擎的情況下調整汽車。

definition_zh: (動) 調音；調整
example_sentence: The singer needs to tune her guitar before the concert.
sentence_zh: 這位歌手需要在演唱會前調好她的吉他。

definition_zh: (名) 隧道；地道
example_sentence: Having dug the tunnel through the mountain, the workers celebrated their success.
sentence_zh: 挖通了穿山隧道後，工人們慶祝他們的成功。

definition_zh: (名) 渦輪機
example_sentence: The new wind turbine generates clean energy for the school.
sentence_zh: 新的風力渦輪機為學校產生清潔能源。

definition_zh: (名) 湍流；動盪
example_sentence: The flight encountered severe turbulence over the Pacific Ocean.
sentence_zh: 航班在太平洋上空遭遇了剧烈的湍流。

definition_zh: (形) 動盪的；洶湧的
example_sentence: Facing turbulent economic times, the company decided to cut costs.
sentence_zh: 面對動盪的經濟時期，公司決定削減成本。

definition_zh: (名) 草皮；地盤　(動) 覆蓋草皮
example_sentence: If the team defends its home turf well, it will win the championship.
sentence_zh: 如果這支球隊能好好防守自己的主場，它就會贏得冠軍。

definition_zh: (名) 火雞；火雞肉
example_sentence: The turkey sandwich in the cafeteria tastes delicious every Thursday.
sentence_zh: 餐廳裡的火雞肉三明治每週四吃起來都很美味。

definition_zh: (名) 薑黃
example_sentence: Turmeric is a common ingredient in many Taiwanese curry dishes.
sentence_zh: 薑黃是許多台灣咖哩菜餚中常見的食材。

definition_zh: (名) 混亂；動盪
example_sentence: The sudden turmoil in the classroom made the teacher pause.
sentence_zh: 教室裡突然的混亂讓老師停了下來。

definition_zh: (片) 反對；背叛
example_sentence: Many voters began to turn against the new policy after the debate.
sentence_zh: 許多選民在辯論後開始反對這項新政策。

definition_zh: (片) 拒絕；轉開；把……打發走
example_sentence: When the charity asked for help, many people turned away.
sentence_zh: 當慈善機構請求幫助時，許多人轉身離開。

definition_zh: (片) 調低；拒絕
example_sentence: If the music is too loud, please turn down the volume.
sentence_zh: 如果音樂太大聲，請調低音量。

definition_zh: (片) 交（作業）；歸還；上床睡覺
example_sentence: The student who forgot to turn in his homework was worried.
sentence_zh: 那個忘記交作業的學生很擔心。

definition_zh: (片) 變成；轉變為
example_sentence: When spring arrives, cherry blossoms turn into beautiful pink clouds.
sentence_zh: 當春天到來時，櫻花會變成美麗的粉色雲朵。

definition_zh: (動) 打開（電器）；啟動　(片) 打開（開關）；發動
example_sentence: Having turned on the air conditioner, the room became cool and comfortable.
sentence_zh: 打開空調後，房間變得涼爽舒適。

definition_zh: (片) 結果是；證明是
example_sentence: The school festival turned out to be a huge success.
sentence_zh: 學校園遊會結果非常成功。

definition_zh: (片) 翻轉；移交
example_sentence: The student who forgot to turn over the page missed the answer.
sentence_zh: 那個忘記翻頁的學生錯過了答案。

definition_zh: (片) 轉向；求助於
example_sentence: Many students turn to online resources for homework help.
sentence_zh: 許多學生轉向線上資源尋求作業幫助。

definition_zh: (片) 出現；調高（音量）
example_sentence: The book that I thought was lost did turn up in the library.
sentence_zh: 我以為遺失的那本書後來在圖書館出現了。

definition_zh: (動) 轉動；轉變　(名) 轉彎；輪到
example_sentence: Having turned off the lights, the students left the classroom.
sentence_zh: 關掉燈後，學生們離開了教室。

definition_zh: (名) 轉機； turnaround
example_sentence: Having achieved a remarkable turnaround, the team celebrated their victory.
sentence_zh: 在取得顯著的轉機後，團隊慶祝了他們的勝利。

definition_zh: (名) 出席率；投票率
example_sentence: If the turnout is high, the student council election will be more meaningful.
sentence_zh: 如果投票率很高，學生會選舉就會更有意義。

definition_zh: (名) 流動率；營業額
example_sentence: The teacher worried about the high turnover of students in the club.
sentence_zh: 老師擔心社團中學生的高流動率。

definition_zh: (名) 旋轉閘門；十字轉門
example_sentence: After the concert ended, a long line formed at the turnstile.
sentence_zh: 演唱會結束後，旋轉閘門前排起了長隊。

definition_zh: (形) 藍綠色的；(名) 藍綠色；綠松石
example_sentence: The turquoise ocean and white sand create a stunning view.
sentence_zh: 藍綠色的海洋和白色的沙灘創造出令人驚嘆的景色。

definition_zh: (名) 烏龜
example_sentence: Seldom does a turtle move as fast as a rabbit.
sentence_zh: 烏龜很少像兔子一樣移動得那麼快。

definition_zh: (動) 扭打；爭奪
example_sentence: Tussling over the last piece of fried chicken, the siblings created a mess.
sentence_zh: 為了最後一塊炸雞扭打在一起，這對兄弟姊妹弄得一團亂。

definition_zh: (名) 家教；導師　(動) 輔導；當家教
example_sentence: My math tutor helps me understand difficult problems every week.
sentence_zh: 我的數學家教每週幫我理解困難的題目。

definition_zh: (名) 燕尾服；無尾晚禮服
example_sentence: The tux that my brother wore to prom looked very elegant.
sentence_zh: 我哥哥在畢業舞會上穿的燕尾服看起來非常優雅。

definition_zh: (名) 燕尾服；無尾禮服
example_sentence: The groom wore a classic black tuxedo to the wedding.
sentence_zh: 新郎穿著一件經典的黑色燕尾服參加婚禮。

definition_zh: (名) 鑷子；小鉗子
example_sentence: The tweezers that my mother bought are very sharp.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽買的鑷子非常鋒利。

definition_zh: (形) 第十二的
example_sentence: The twelfth student in the queue received a special prize.
sentence_zh: 隊伍中的第十二名學生獲得了一份特別的獎品。

definition_zh: (名) 十二
example_sentence: A dozen eggs cost twelve dollars at the supermarket near our school.
sentence_zh: 一打雞蛋在我們學校附近的超市要花十二美元。

definition_zh: (名) 二十；二十個
example_sentence: After studying for twenty minutes, Tom took a short break.
sentence_zh: 在學習二十分鐘後，湯姆休息了一下。

definition_zh: (動) 扭臀舞；擺動臀部
example_sentence: The dance teacher who showed us how to twerk moved with incredible energy.
sentence_zh: 教我們如何電臀舞的舞蹈老師以驚人的活力移動。

definition_zh: (副) 兩次；兩倍
example_sentence: The teacher asked the class to read the article twice.
sentence_zh: 老師要求全班把文章讀兩遍。

definition_zh: (名) 小樹枝；細枝
example_sentence: A small twig broke off the tree during the strong wind.
sentence_zh: 一根小樹枝在強風中從樹上折斷了。

definition_zh: (名) 暮光；黃昏
example_sentence: The beautiful twilight colors filled the sky after the heavy rain.
sentence_zh: 大雨過後，美麗的暮色佈滿了天空。

definition_zh: (名) 雙胞胎之一　(形) 雙胞胎的；成對的
example_sentence: My twin sister and I share the same birthday.
sentence_zh: 我的雙胞胎妹妹和我同一天生日。

definition_zh: (動) 閃爍；閃耀
example_sentence: The stars twinkling in the night sky caught the students' attention.
sentence_zh: 夜空中閃爍的星星吸引了學生們的注意。

definition_zh: (動) 扭轉；擰　(名) 扭轉；轉彎
example_sentence: Twisting the lid tightly, the student opened the bottle of water.
sentence_zh: 學生用力扭開瓶蓋，打開了那瓶水。

definition_zh: (動) 纏繞；扭曲　(形) 扭曲的；怪異的
example_sentence: If the wire gets twisted, the machine will stop working.
sentence_zh: 如果電線纏繞了，機器就會停止運作。

definition_zh: (名) 龍捲風；扭曲的東西
example_sentence: The sudden twister destroyed several houses in the small town.
sentence_zh: 突然的龍捲風摧毀了小鎮上的幾棟房子。

definition_zh: (名) 抽搐；痙攣　(動) 抽搐；抽動
example_sentence: A sudden twitch in my eyelid annoyed me during the exam.
sentence_zh: 考試期間眼皮突然抽搐讓我很煩躁。

definition_zh: (名) 二；兩個
example_sentence: The two students shared their lunch during the break.
sentence_zh: 那兩個學生在休息時間分享了他們的午餐。

definition_zh: (名) 大亨；巨頭
example_sentence: When the tycoon visited our school, many students asked for his autograph.
sentence_zh: 當這位大亨參觀我們學校時，許多學生向他索取簽名。

definition_zh: (片) 鍵入；輸入
example_sentence: After the teacher explained the instructions, students typed in their answers.
sentence_zh: 老師解釋完說明後，學生們打入了他們的答案。

definition_zh: (片) 打出；鍵入
example_sentence: Typing out the entire report, the student missed several obvious errors.
sentence_zh: 在打出整份報告的過程中，那名學生漏掉了幾個明顯的錯誤。

definition_zh: (片) 把…打字整理出來；打印出
example_sentence: After the interview, the manager asked her assistant to type up the notes.
sentence_zh: 面試後，經理請她的助理把筆記打出來。

definition_zh: (名) 類型；種類　(動) 打字
example_sentence: The teacher asked us to type our homework on the computer.
sentence_zh: 老師要求我們在電腦上打字交作業。

definition_zh: (名) 打字機
example_sentence: If the typewriter breaks, the teacher will buy a new one.
sentence_zh: 如果打字機壞了，老師會買一台新的。

definition_zh: (名) 颱風
example_sentence: If a typhoon hits Taiwan, schools will close for safety.
sentence_zh: 如果颱風襲擊台灣，學校會為了安全停課。

definition_zh: (形) 典型的；平常的
example_sentence: A typical student in Taiwan studies hard for the big exam.
sentence_zh: 台灣的典型學生為了大考努力讀書。

definition_zh: (副) 通常；典型地
example_sentence: Students typically spend two hours on homework every evening.
sentence_zh: 學生通常每天晚上花兩小時做功課。

definition_zh: (動) 是…的典型；代表
example_sentence: The student's dedication, typifying hard work, impressed the teacher.
sentence_zh: 這位學生的奉獻精神，體現了努力工作的特質，令老師印象深刻。

definition_zh: (名) 打字員；打字者
example_sentence: After the manager left, a new typist joined the office team.
sentence_zh: 經理離開後，一位新的打字員加入了辦公室團隊。

definition_zh: (名) 打字錯誤；排字錯誤
example_sentence: If the teacher found a typo in your essay, she would deduct points.
sentence_zh: 如果老師在你的文章中發現一個打字錯誤，她會扣分。

definition_zh: (形) 暴虐的；專制的
example_sentence: Students protest to resist the tyrannic rule of the principal.
sentence_zh: 學生們抗議以抵抗校長的專制統治。

definition_zh: (動) 壓迫；暴虐統治
example_sentence: The cruel king continued to tyrannize his people without mercy.
sentence_zh: 殘酷的國王繼續無情地壓迫他的人民。

definition_zh: (名) 暴政；專制
example_sentence: Fearing the tyranny of the new ruler, the villagers sought refuge in the mountains.
sentence_zh: 由於害怕新統治者的暴政，村民們在山中尋求避難。

definition_zh: (名) 暴君；專制統治者
example_sentence: Students organized a protest to oppose the tyrant's unfair policies.
sentence_zh: 學生們組織了一場抗議，以反對暴君的不公平政策。

definition_zh: (形) 無所不在的；普遍存在的
example_sentence: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern high school classrooms.
sentence_zh: 智慧型手機在現代高中教室中已變得無所不在。

definition_zh: (副) 普遍地；無所不在
example_sentence: Smartphones are ubiquitously used by students for homework and social media.
sentence_zh: 智慧型手機被學生普遍用於做功課和社交媒體。

definition_zh: (名) 普遍存在；無所不在
example_sentence: Because of smartphones, the ubiquity of social media is hard to ignore.
sentence_zh: 由於智慧型手機，社群媒體的普及難以忽視。

definition_zh: (名) 乳房
example_sentence: If a cow has a swollen udder, a farmer must check its health.
sentence_zh: 如果母牛的乳房腫脹，農夫必須檢查牠的健康。

definition_zh: (形) 醜陋的；難看的
example_sentence: Seldom has such an ugly rumor spread so quickly in our school.
sentence_zh: 我們學校很少傳播這麼難聽的謠言。

definition_zh: (名) 潰瘍
example_sentence: Worried about his stomach ulcer, the doctor recommended a strict diet.
sentence_zh: 擔心他的胃潰瘍，醫生建議了嚴格的飲食。

definition_zh: (形) 隱藏的；不可告人的
example_sentence: Many students suspect the teacher has an ulterior motive for giving extra homework.
sentence_zh: 許多學生懷疑老師給額外作業有隱藏的動機。

definition_zh: (形) 最終的；極致的
example_sentence: Winning the championship was the ultimate goal for the team.
sentence_zh: 贏得冠軍是這支隊伍的最終目標。

definition_zh: (副) 最終；終究
example_sentence: Struggling with the math problem, the student ultimately asked the teacher for help.
sentence_zh: 在與數學題奮鬥後，那名學生最終向老師求助。

definition_zh: (形) 紫外線的；(名) 紫外線
example_sentence: Ultraviolet rays can damage our skin and cause sunburn.
sentence_zh: 紫外線會傷害我們的皮膚並導致曬傷。

definition_zh: (名) 鮮味；旨味
example_sentence: Many chefs add seaweed to soup to create umami flavor.
sentence_zh: 許多廚師在湯中加入海帶以創造鮮味。

definition_zh: (名) 雨傘；傘
example_sentence: The student forgot his umbrella on the school bus this morning.
sentence_zh: 那位學生今天早上把他的雨傘忘在校車上了。

definition_zh: (名) 裁判；仲裁人
example_sentence: The umpire made a fair call when the player argued.
sentence_zh: 當球員爭論時，裁判做出了公平的判決。

definition_zh: (形) 不減弱的；持續的
example_sentence: The typhoon's strong winds continued unabated throughout the night.
sentence_zh: 颱風的強風整夜持續不減。

definition_zh: (形) 無法的；不能的
example_sentence: Unable to focus, the student asked the teacher for help.
sentence_zh: 無法專心，這個學生向老師求助。

definition_zh: (形) 不可接受的；無法接受的
example_sentence: If students cheat on exams, such behavior is unacceptable.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在考試中作弊，這種行為是不可接受的。

definition_zh: (形) 無人陪伴的；無伴隨的
example_sentence: Unaccompanied minors are not allowed to board the airplane.
sentence_zh: 無人陪伴的未成年人不得登機。

definition_zh: (形) 不負責任的；無法解釋的
example_sentence: If the manager were unaccountable, the team would lose trust.
sentence_zh: 如果經理不負責任，團隊就會失去信任。

definition_zh: (形) 未處理的；未解決的
example_sentence: The student's unaddressed concerns about the exam caused anxiety.
sentence_zh: 學生對於考試未獲解決的憂慮引起了焦慮。

definition_zh: (形) 樸素的；不加修飾的
example_sentence: The unadorned truth about the exam shocked many students.
sentence_zh: 關於考試的樸素真相震驚了許多學生。

definition_zh: (形) 純粹的；未摻雜的
example_sentence: The chef's unadulterated joy came from using fresh ingredients.
sentence_zh: 主廚純粹的快樂來自於使用新鮮食材。

definition_zh: (形) 不咄咄逼人的；溫和的
example_sentence: The unaggressive approach of the teacher helped shy students participate more.
sentence_zh: 老師不咄咄逼人的態度幫助害羞的學生更積極參與。

definition_zh: (形) 未受協助的；獨力的
example_sentence: Not only did the student complete the project unaided, but she also helped others.
sentence_zh: 這位學生不僅獨力完成了專題，還幫助了其他人。

definition_zh: (形) 明確的；不含糊的
example_sentence: The teacher gave unambiguous instructions to help students understand the project.
sentence_zh: 老師給了明確的指示，以幫助學生理解這個專題。

definition_zh: (形) 一致的；無異議的
example_sentence: The class reached a unanimous decision to cancel the exam.
sentence_zh: 全班一致決定取消考試。

definition_zh: (副) 一致地；無異議地
example_sentence: The class unanimously agreed to extend the project deadline by a week.
sentence_zh: 全班一致同意將專題截止日期延長一週。

definition_zh: (形) 不羞愧的；無恥的
example_sentence: Even after failing the test, the student remained unashamed of her effort.
sentence_zh: 即使在考试失败后，这名学生依然对自己的努力毫不羞愧。

definition_zh: (副) 毫不羞愧地；無恥地
example_sentence: The student unashamedly asked the teacher for help after class.
sentence_zh: 那名學生毫不羞愧地在課後向老師請求幫助。

definition_zh: (形) 未附上的；未連接的
example_sentence: The unattached report remained on the teacher's desk for weeks.
sentence_zh: 那份未附上的報告在老師的桌上放了好幾週。

definition_zh: (形) 未經授權的；未經許可的
example_sentence: Students need permission to use unauthorized devices during exams.
sentence_zh: 學生在考試期間需要許可才能使用未經授權的設備。

definition_zh: (名) 無法獲得；缺乏
example_sentence: Seldom has the unavailability of online resources caused such frustration.
sentence_zh: 線上資源的缺乏很少造成如此大的挫折。

definition_zh: (形) 無法獲得的；無法聯繫上的
example_sentence: The teacher being unavailable, the students studied on their own.
sentence_zh: 老師無法聯繫上，學生們便自己讀書。

definition_zh: (形) 無可避免的；必然的
example_sentence: Not only is failure unavoidable, but it also teaches valuable lessons.
sentence_zh: 失敗不僅無可避免，而且還能教導寶貴的教訓。

definition_zh: (副) 無可避免地；必然地
example_sentence: The heavy rain unavoidably delayed the outdoor sports event.
sentence_zh: 大雨無可避免地延誤了戶外運動賽事。

definition_zh: (形) 未察覺的；不知道的
example_sentence: Many students remained unaware of the new school policy until the principal announced it.
sentence_zh: 許多學生直到校長宣布才意識到新的學校政策。

definition_zh: (形) 無法忍受的；難以承受的
example_sentence: If the noise continued, the situation would become unbearable for everyone.
sentence_zh: 如果噪音繼續下去，情況對大家來說會變得無法忍受。

definition_zh: (形) 不敗的；未被擊敗的
example_sentence: Never has the team remained unbeaten throughout the entire season.
sentence_zh: 這支隊伍從未在整個賽季中保持不敗。

definition_zh: (形) 難以置信的；驚人的
example_sentence: Students found the test scores unbelievable after studying so hard.
sentence_zh: 學生們在如此努力學習後，發現考試成績令人難以置信。

definition_zh: (副) 難以置信地；非常地
example_sentence: The movie that received unbelievably positive reviews became a huge hit.
sentence_zh: 那部獲得難以置信好評的電影大受歡迎。

definition_zh: (形) 公正的；無偏見的
example_sentence: When grading essays, a teacher must remain completely unbiased.
sentence_zh: 批改作文時，老師必須保持完全公正。

definition_zh: (形) 無瑕的；潔白無瑕的
example_sentence: Having studied diligently, the student achieved an unblemished record.
sentence_zh: 經過勤奮學習，這位學生取得了無瑕的成績。

definition_zh: (形) 未中斷的；未破損的
example_sentence: Walking through the old village, the unbroken silence amazed the students.
sentence_zh: 走過古老的村莊，那未被打斷的寂靜讓學生們感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (形) 離奇的；不自然的
example_sentence: If the robot's movements seemed uncanny, the students would feel uneasy.
sentence_zh: 如果機器人的動作顯得不自然，學生們會感到不安。

definition_zh: (形) 不確定的；未確定的
example_sentence: Uncertain about the exam results, the student waited nervously.
sentence_zh: 對考試結果不確定，那名學生緊張地等待著。

definition_zh: (名) 不確定；不確定性
example_sentence: Students who face uncertainty about their future often feel anxious.
sentence_zh: 面對未來不確定性的學生常常感到焦慮。

definition_zh: (形) 不變的；未改變的
example_sentence: The old library's design has remained unchanged for decades.
sentence_zh: 這座老圖書館的設計數十年來保持不變。

definition_zh: (形) 未知的；未經探測的
example_sentence: If a typhoon took an uncharted path, the warning system would fail.
sentence_zh: 如果颱風走一條未被探測的路徑，預警系統就會失靈。

definition_zh: (動) 取消勾選；未選取
example_sentence: Students must uncheck the box before submitting the online form.
sentence_zh: 學生在提交線上表單前必須取消勾選該方塊。

definition_zh: (形) 不文明的；無禮的
example_sentence: Having behaved uncivil toward the new student, the group felt ashamed.
sentence_zh: 對新同學表現得不禮貌後，這群人感到羞愧。

definition_zh: (名) 叔叔；伯父；舅父
example_sentence: My uncle often takes me to the night market on weekends.
sentence_zh: 我叔叔經常在週末帶我去夜市。

definition_zh: (形) 不清楚的；不明確的
example_sentence: The reason for his absence remains unclear to everyone.
sentence_zh: 他缺席的原因對每個人來說仍然不清楚。

definition_zh: (形) 不舒服的；令人不自在的
example_sentence: When the air conditioner broke, the classroom became uncomfortably hot.
sentence_zh: 當冷氣壞掉時，教室變得熱得令人不舒服。

definition_zh: (形) 不常見的；罕見的
example_sentence: Finding a four-leaf clover is an uncommon event in nature.
sentence_zh: 找到四葉草在大自然中是不常見的事件。

definition_zh: (副) 異常地；罕見地
example_sentence: This summer has been uncommonly hot, causing many students to stay indoors.
sentence_zh: 今年夏天異常炎熱，導致許多學生待在室內。

definition_zh: (形) 簡單的；不複雜的
example_sentence: The instructions my teacher gave were uncomplicated and easy to follow.
sentence_zh: 老師給的指示簡單明瞭，容易遵循。

definition_zh: (形) 無條件的
example_sentence: A mother's love for her child is unconditional.
sentence_zh: 母親對孩子的愛是無條件的。

definition_zh: (副) 無條件地
example_sentence: A true friend supports you unconditionally through difficult times.
sentence_zh: 真正的朋友在困難時期無條件地支持你。

definition_zh: (形) 無意識的；失去知覺的
example_sentence: The player who was unconscious after the game was taken to the hospital.
sentence_zh: 比賽後失去意識的選手被送往醫院。

definition_zh: (副) 不自覺地；無意識地
example_sentence: The student who was unconsciously tapping his pen disturbed the class.
sentence_zh: 那個不自覺地敲打筆的學生打擾了課堂。

definition_zh: (形) 無法控制的；失控的
example_sentence: The student's uncontrollable laughter disrupted the entire class.
sentence_zh: 那名學生無法控制的笑聲打擾了整堂課。

definition_zh: (形) 非傳統的；不依常規的
example_sentence: Some artists use unconventional materials to create their masterpieces.
sentence_zh: 一些藝術家使用非傳統的材料來創作他們的傑作。

definition_zh: (動) 揭露；發現
example_sentence: The investigation aims to uncover the truth behind the scandal.
sentence_zh: 這項調查旨在揭露醜聞背後的真相。

definition_zh: (形) 未經耕種的；未開發的
example_sentence: Because the land remained uncultivated for years, wild grasses grew everywhere.
sentence_zh: 因為這片土地多年未經開墾，到處長滿了野草。

definition_zh: (形) 不畏懼的；勇敢的
example_sentence: The students remained undaunted by the difficult exam to achieve their goals.
sentence_zh: 學生們不畏困難的考試，以達成他們的目標。

definition_zh: (副) 無畏地；勇敢地
example_sentence: The team undauntedly faced the challenge of the science fair.
sentence_zh: 這個團隊無畏地面對科展的挑戰。

definition_zh: (形) 不可否認的；無可爭辯的
example_sentence: The undeniable impact of social media on teenagers is a major concern.
sentence_zh: 社群媒體對青少年的不可否認影響是一個主要關切。

definition_zh: (副) 無可否認地
example_sentence: Smartphones have undeniably changed the way people communicate.
sentence_zh: 智慧型手機無可否認地改變了人們溝通的方式。

definition_zh: (片) 在控制中；受控制
example_sentence: The fire in the science lab is now under control.
sentence_zh: 科學實驗室裡的火焰現在已受到控制。

definition_zh: (片) 在…的掩護下；趁著
example_sentence: If the spy moved under cover of darkness, the guards would not notice him.
sentence_zh: 如果間諜在黑暗的掩護下行動，守衛就不會注意到他。

definition_zh: (介) 在……的控制下
example_sentence: The digital camera, which is under the control of the teacher, records our experiments.
sentence_zh: 這台數位相機在老師的控制下，記錄我們的實驗。

definition_zh: (片) 受到威脅；處於威脅之下
example_sentence: The forest under threat from wildfires needs immediate protection.
sentence_zh: 受到野火威脅的森林需要立即保護。

definition_zh: (介) 在...下面；(副) 在下方
example_sentence: My cat likes to sleep under the warm blanket.
sentence_zh: 我的貓喜歡睡在溫暖的毯子下面。

definition_zh: (形) 臥底的；秘密的　(副) 祕密地；臥底地
example_sentence: Working undercover, the police officer gathered evidence against the drug dealers.
sentence_zh: 臥底工作時，警察收集了毒品販子的證據。

definition_zh: (動) 削價競爭；削弱
example_sentence: The new coffee shop tried to undercut its rival's prices.
sentence_zh: 這家新咖啡店試圖以低於對手的價格競爭。

definition_zh: (形) 發展不足的；未開發的
example_sentence: Having been underdeveloped for decades, the rural area finally received government funding.
sentence_zh: 歷經數十年的發展不足，這個農村地區終於獲得了政府資金。

definition_zh: (動) 低估；看輕
example_sentence: Many students underestimate the difficulty of the English exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生低估了英文考試的難度。

definition_zh: (動) 經歷；接受
example_sentence: If the patient undergoes surgery, the recovery period will be long.
sentence_zh: 如果病人接受手術，恢復期將會很長。

definition_zh: (名) 大學生
example_sentence: Seldom does an undergraduate have such a clear career plan.
sentence_zh: 很少有大學生有如此清晰的職業規劃。

definition_zh: (形) [ˌʌndɚ'graʊnd] 地下的；祕密的　(名) ['ʌndɚgraʊnd] 地下鐵；地下組織
example_sentence: The underground train system is very convenient in Taipei.
sentence_zh: 台北的地下鐵路系統非常方便。

definition_zh: (動) 構成…的基礎；為…的原因
example_sentence: Underlying the recent policy change is a growing concern for the environment.
sentence_zh: 支撐這項近期政策變革的，是對環境日益增長的擔憂。

definition_zh: (動) 在…下面劃線；強調
example_sentence: Seldom does the teacher underline the key points in the lecture.
sentence_zh: 老師很少在課堂中標記重點。

definition_zh: (名) 下屬；手下
example_sentence: The manager always treats every underling with respect and fairness.
sentence_zh: 這位經理總是尊重且公平對待每位下屬。

definition_zh: (形) 根本的；潛在的
example_sentence: The underlying cause of the problem remains unclear to many students.
sentence_zh: 這個問題的根本原因對許多學生來說仍然不清楚。

definition_zh: (動) 削弱；破壞
example_sentence: Spreading false rumors can undermine trust among classmates.
sentence_zh: 散布不實謠言會破壞同學之間的信任。

definition_zh: (介) 在...下面　(副) 在下面；在底下
example_sentence: The cat hid underneath the sofa during the thunderstorm.
sentence_zh: 那隻貓在雷雨期間躲藏在沙發下面。

definition_zh: (名) 地下道；地下通道
example_sentence: Walking through the underpass, the student avoided the heavy rain.
sentence_zh: 走過地下道，那名學生避開了大雨。

definition_zh: (動) 強調；在……下面劃線
example_sentence: Students underscore key points to prepare for the final exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們劃記重點以準備期末考試。

definition_zh: (動) 理解；明白
example_sentence: After the teacher explained the grammar rules, most students understood the lesson clearly.
sentence_zh: 老師解釋文法規則後，大多數學生清楚地理解了這堂課。

definition_zh: (形) 可理解的；能懂的
example_sentence: Given the tight budget, the school's decision to cancel the field trip is understandable.
sentence_zh: 鑑於預算緊縮，學校取消校外教學的決定是可以理解的。

definition_zh: (副) 可以理解地；難怪
example_sentence: The students were understandably upset about the sudden exam schedule change.
sentence_zh: 學生們對考試時間表的突然變動感到沮喪，這是可以理解的。

definition_zh: (名) 理解；了解　(形) 體諒的；有理解力的
example_sentence: Seldom does the teacher's understanding of students' struggles go unnoticed.
sentence_zh: 老師對學生困境的理解很少被忽視。

definition_zh: (名) 輕描淡寫；保守的說法
example_sentence: Calling the typhoon damage a small issue is an understatement.
sentence_zh: 稱颱風災害為小問題是一種輕描淡寫。

definition_zh: (動) 了解；懂
example_sentence: If students understand the rules, they can avoid punishment.
sentence_zh: 如果學生了解規則，他們就能避免懲罰。

definition_zh: (名) 下層植物；林下植被
example_sentence: Walking through the forest, the students studied the dense understorey plants.
sentence_zh: 走過森林時，學生們研究了茂密的下層植物。

definition_zh: (動) 承擔；著手進行
example_sentence: If the committee undertakes the project, funding must be secured first.
sentence_zh: 如果委員會承擔這個計畫，必須先確保資金。

definition_zh: (名) 殯葬業者；承辦人
example_sentence: The undertaker who prepared the funeral was very professional.
sentence_zh: 準備葬禮的殯葬業者非常專業。

definition_zh: (名) 工作；任務　(動) 從事；承擔
example_sentence: Starting a small business is a risky undertaking for young entrepreneurs.
sentence_zh: 對年輕創業家來說，創業是一項有風險的工作。

definition_zh: (副) 在水下；在水中　(形) 水下的；海底的
example_sentence: While diving underwater, the marine biologist discovered a new coral species.
sentence_zh: 在水下潛水時，海洋生物學家發現了一種新的珊瑚物種。

definition_zh: (形) 進行中的
example_sentence: If the project were underway, our team would start the testing phase.
sentence_zh: 如果這個專案正在進行中，我們的團隊就會開始測試階段。

definition_zh: (名) 內衣
example_sentence: Jenny bought new underwear for the school trip.
sentence_zh: 珍妮為了學校旅行買了新內衣。

definition_zh: (形) 體重過輕的；重量不足的
example_sentence: Because the stray cat was underweight, the vet recommended a special diet.
sentence_zh: 因為那隻流浪貓體重過輕，獸醫建議了特殊飲食。

definition_zh: (名) 黑社會；地下世界
example_sentence: The movie describes a criminal underworld in Taipei.
sentence_zh: 這部電影描述了台北的罪犯地下世界。

definition_zh: (動) 承銷；贊助；同意支付
example_sentence: The bank agreed to underwrite the company's new project to expand its business.
sentence_zh: 這家銀行同意承銷該公司的新專案，以擴展其業務。

definition_zh: (形) 未開發的；未發展的
example_sentence: The government set aside the land to preserve its undeveloped natural beauty.
sentence_zh: 政府保留這塊土地，以維護其未開發的自然美景。

definition_zh: (形) 不得體的；不莊重的
example_sentence: A student's undignified behavior in class embarrassed the teacher.
sentence_zh: 學生在課堂上不得體的行為讓老師感到尷尬。

definition_zh: (形) 未稀釋的；純粹的
example_sentence: Never have I tasted such undiluted joy as winning the championship.
sentence_zh: 我從未品嚐過像贏得冠軍這樣純粹的喜悅。

definition_zh: (形) 無可爭議的；公認的
example_sentence: Many students consider him the undisputed champion of the debate club.
sentence_zh: 許多學生認為他是辯論社無可爭議的冠軍。

definition_zh: (動) 撤銷；取消
example_sentence: The software update could undo all the progress we made.
sentence_zh: 這次軟體更新可能會撤銷我們取得的所有進展。

definition_zh: (名) 失敗的原因；毀滅
example_sentence: The student's laziness was his undoing in the final exam.
sentence_zh: 這個學生的懶惰是他期末考試失敗的原因。

definition_zh: (形) 未完成的；解開的
example_sentence: The homework was left undone because the student forgot it.
sentence_zh: 作業沒做完，因為學生忘記了。

definition_zh: (形) 無疑的；確定的
example_sentence: Undoubted by his peers, the student's project won first prize.
sentence_zh: 毫無疑問地，這位學生的專案獲得了第一名。

definition_zh: (副) 無疑地；必定
example_sentence: The new policy will undoubtedly improve the school's learning environment.
sentence_zh: 這項新政策無疑將改善學校的學習環境。

definition_zh: (形) 不當的；過度的
example_sentence: Having finished her homework, Maria avoided undue stress before the exam.
sentence_zh: 完成作業後，瑪麗亞避免了考試前不必要的壓力。

definition_zh: (形) 不朽的；永恆的
example_sentence: The hero's undying spirit inspired the entire community to keep fighting.
sentence_zh: 這位英雄不朽的精神鼓舞了整個社區繼續奮鬥。

definition_zh: (名) 不安；憂慮
example_sentence: Many students feel a sense of unease before the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在學測前感到不安。

definition_zh: (形) 不安的；不舒服的
example_sentence: Feeling uneasy about the test results, Emily checked her phone repeatedly.
sentence_zh: 對考試結果感到不安，艾蜜莉反覆查看手機。

definition_zh: (形) 失業的
example_sentence: If more people became unemployed, the local economy would suffer greatly.
sentence_zh: 如果有更多人失業，當地經濟將會受到嚴重影響。

definition_zh: (名) 失業；失業率
example_sentence: Rising unemployment worries many college graduates every year.
sentence_zh: 不斷上升的失業率每年都讓許多大學畢業生感到擔憂。

definition_zh: (形) 無負擔的；不受阻礙的
example_sentence: An unencumbered mind can focus better on challenging exams.
sentence_zh: 沒有負擔的心靈能更專注於有挑戰性的考試。

definition_zh: (形) 無盡的；不停的
example_sentence: Students join the club to escape the unending pressure of exams.
sentence_zh: 學生們加入社團以逃離考試的無盡壓力。

definition_zh: (形) 無比的；無可匹敵的
example_sentence: Her dedication to the team is unequaled by any other player.
sentence_zh: 她對團隊的奉獻是其他任何球員都無法比擬的。

definition_zh: (副) 不均地；不平等地
example_sentence: The new policy distributes resources unequally to different schools.
sentence_zh: 這項新政策不均等地分配資源給不同的學校。

definition_zh: (形) 無誤的；準確的
example_sentence: The archer's unerring aim won the competition for the school team.
sentence_zh: 這位弓箭手無誤的瞄準為校隊贏得了比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 聯合國教科文組織
example_sentence: Students visit UNESCO sites to learn about world heritage.
sentence_zh: 學生參觀聯合國教科文組織遺址以了解世界遺產。

definition_zh: (副) 不均勻地；不平衡地
example_sentence: The teacher distributed the test papers unevenly among the students.
sentence_zh: 老師不均勻地分發試卷給學生。

definition_zh: (形) 意想不到的；突然的
example_sentence: The unexpected heavy rain caused the outdoor concert to be canceled.
sentence_zh: 突如其來的大雨導致戶外音樂會被取消。

definition_zh: (副) 意外地；出乎意料地
example_sentence: The test ended unexpectedly early, giving students extra break time.
sentence_zh: 考試意外地提早結束，給學生額外的休息時間。

definition_zh: (形) 不公平的；不公正的
example_sentence: Many students think the new grading system is unfair.
sentence_zh: 許多學生認為新的評分系統不公平。

definition_zh: (形) 不熟悉的；陌生的
example_sentence: Unfamiliar with the software, the student asked the teacher for help.
sentence_zh: 由於不熟悉這個軟體，學生向老師求助。

definition_zh: (動) 展開；展現
example_sentence: If the mystery unfolds slowly, the readers will stay engaged.
sentence_zh: 如果謎團慢慢展開，讀者就會保持投入。

definition_zh: (形) 難忘的
example_sentence: Never have I experienced such an unforgettable summer camp.
sentence_zh: 我從未體驗過如此難忘的夏令營。

definition_zh: (形) 不寬容的；嚴厲的
example_sentence: Never has the teacher been so unforgiving toward late homework.
sentence_zh: 老師從未對遲交的作業如此不寬容。

definition_zh: (形) 不幸的；令人遺憾的
example_sentence: It was unfortunate that the school trip was canceled due to the typhoon.
sentence_zh: 不幸的是，學校旅行因颱風而取消了。

definition_zh: (副) 不幸地；遺憾地
example_sentence: The baseball game was canceled unfortunately due to the heavy rain.
sentence_zh: 不幸的是，棒球賽因大雨取消了。

definition_zh: (形) 不友善的；不友好的
example_sentence: The new student felt unfriendly toward the class.
sentence_zh: 那位新學生對班上同學感到不友善。

definition_zh: (副) 忘恩負義地；不領情地
example_sentence: The student who accepted the scholarship ungratefully ignored the donor's letter.
sentence_zh: 那位接受獎學金的學生忘恩負義地忽略了捐贈者的信。

definition_zh: (形) 不快樂的；不滿意的
example_sentence: The student who felt unhappy about the exam sought advice from the teacher.
sentence_zh: 對考試感到不開心的學生向老師尋求建議。

definition_zh: (形) 不健康的；有害健康的
example_sentence: Eating too much fast food is unhealthy for teenagers.
sentence_zh: 吃太多速食對青少年來說是不健康的。

definition_zh: (名) 獨角獸；獨角獸狀之物
example_sentence: The unicorn that the artist painted has a golden horn.
sentence_zh: 那位藝術家畫的獨角獸有一隻金色的角。

definition_zh: (形) 未經確認的；身份不明的
example_sentence: An unidentified object was found near the school playground.
sentence_zh: 一個不明物體在學校操場附近被發現。

definition_zh: (名) 統一；合併
example_sentence: The unification of the two schools brought many benefits to students and teachers.
sentence_zh: 兩所學校的合併為師生帶來了許多好處。

definition_zh: (名) 制服；(形) 統一的；一致的
example_sentence: All students must wear the school uniform every day.
sentence_zh: 所有學生每天必須穿校服。

definition_zh: (動) 統一；統合
example_sentence: The student council plans to unify different class opinions for the school festival.
sentence_zh: 學生會計劃為了校慶統合不同的班級意見。

definition_zh: (形) 不重要的；無關緊要的
example_sentence: The minor details in the report are unimportant for the project.
sentence_zh: 報告中的小細節對這個專案來說並不重要。

definition_zh: (形) 未入門的；缺乏經驗的
example_sentence: If the uninitiated student reads this guide, basic concepts will become clear.
sentence_zh: 如果未入門的學生閱讀這本指南，基本概念就會變得清楚。

definition_zh: (形) 意外的；非故意的
example_sentence: Many students chose easy courses to avoid unintended stress.
sentence_zh: 許多學生選擇簡單的課程以避免意外的壓力。

definition_zh: (形) 無意的；非故意的
example_sentence: The unintentional mistake on the test caused confusion among students.
sentence_zh: 考卷上無心的錯誤導致學生們困惑。

definition_zh: (副) 無意地；非故意地
example_sentence: The student who unintentionally broke the window felt sorry.
sentence_zh: 那個不小心打破窗戶的學生感到抱歉。

definition_zh: (形) 不間斷的；連續的
example_sentence: If students studied without interruptions, their focus would be uninterrupted.
sentence_zh: 如果學生不間斷地學習，他們的專注力就會保持不間斷。

definition_zh: (形) 不參與的；不關心的
example_sentence: If the student remained uninvolved in class, the teacher would worry.
sentence_zh: 如果那個學生在課堂上保持不參與，老師會擔心。

definition_zh: (名) 聯盟；工會；聯合
example_sentence: The student union organized a charity event for the local community.
sentence_zh: 學生會為當地社區組織了一場慈善活動。

definition_zh: (形) 獨特的；唯一的
example_sentence: Every student has a unique talent that makes them special.
sentence_zh: 每個學生都有讓自己與眾不同的獨特天賦。

definition_zh: (副) 獨特地；獨特地
example_sentence: This cafe is uniquely decorated with local art and plants.
sentence_zh: 這家咖啡廳以當地藝術和植物進行獨特的裝飾。

definition_zh: (名) 齊唱；一致
example_sentence: The choir members sang the national anthem in perfect unison.
sentence_zh: 合唱團成員完美地齊聲唱國歌。

definition_zh: (形) 一致的；同音的
example_sentence: The choir's unisonous voices created a harmonious melody that impressed everyone.
sentence_zh: 合唱團一致的聲音創造了令所有人印象深刻的和諧旋律。

definition_zh: (名) 單元；單位
example_sentence: Each unit of the science textbook includes a review section.
sentence_zh: 科學課本的每個單元都包含一個複習部分。

definition_zh: (動) 團結；聯合
example_sentence: If all students unite to clean the campus, the school will look better.
sentence_zh: 如果所有學生團結起來打掃校園，學校會看起來更好。

definition_zh: (動) 團結；統一　(形) 團結的；聯合的
example_sentence: Having united the team, the coach led them to victory.
sentence_zh: 團結了團隊後，教練帶領他們走向勝利。

definition_zh: (名) 團結；統一
example_sentence: National unity is important for a country to face challenges together.
sentence_zh: 國家團結對於一個國家共同面對挑戰很重要。

definition_zh: (形) 普遍的；通用的
example_sentence: The love of music is a universal language that connects people around the world.
sentence_zh: 對音樂的愛是一種連結世界各地人們的通用語言。

definition_zh: (副) 普遍地；無例外地
example_sentence: The theory is not universally accepted by scientists.
sentence_zh: 這個理論並未被科學家普遍接受。

definition_zh: (名) 宇宙；全世界
example_sentence: Scientists believe that the universe is expanding faster than before.
sentence_zh: 科學家相信宇宙正在比以前更快地膨脹。

definition_zh: (名) 大學
example_sentence: After finishing high school, many students apply to a university.
sentence_zh: 高中畢業後，許多學生申請大學。

definition_zh: (副) 不知不覺地；無意中
example_sentence: Many students unknowingly waste time on social media during study hours.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在讀書時間不知不覺地浪費時間在社群媒體上。

definition_zh: (形) 未知的；不明的　(名) 未知的人或事物
example_sentence: Because the test results were unknown, the students felt anxious.
sentence_zh: 由於考試結果未知，學生們感到焦慮。

definition_zh: (動) 釋放；發洩
example_sentence: Unleashing creativity, the students designed a unique solar-powered car.
sentence_zh: 釋放創造力後，學生們設計了一輛獨特的太陽能車。

definition_zh: (連) 除非；如果不
example_sentence: Students cannot enter the lab unless a teacher is present.
sentence_zh: 學生不能進入實驗室，除非有老師在場。

definition_zh: (介) 不像；和...不同　(形) 不同的；相異的
example_sentence: Unlike his brother, Mark prefers reading science fiction novels.
sentence_zh: 不像他的哥哥，馬克更喜歡讀科幻小說。

definition_zh: (形) 不太可能的；未必的
example_sentence: If the weather were sunny, an outdoor picnic would be unlikely.
sentence_zh: 如果天氣晴朗，戶外野餐就不太可能發生。

definition_zh: (形) 無限的；無限制的
example_sentence: The new streaming service offers unlimited access to movies and shows.
sentence_zh: 這項新的串流服務提供對電影和節目的無限存取。

definition_zh: (動) 卸下；卸貨
example_sentence: If the truck arrives early, the workers will unload the boxes quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果卡車早點到，工人就會快速卸下箱子。

definition_zh: (動) 解鎖；開啟
example_sentence: The new password will unlock your account safely.
sentence_zh: 新密碼將安全地解鎖你的帳戶。

definition_zh: (形) 不道德的；無道德的
example_sentence: The teacher explained that unmoral actions harm society.
sentence_zh: 老師解釋說，不道德的行為會傷害社會。

definition_zh: (形) 不必要的；多餘的
example_sentence: Students often study unnecessary details to impress their teachers.
sentence_zh: 學生們常常為了給老師留下好印象而學習不必要的細節。

definition_zh: (形) 沒有阻礙的；暢通無阻的
example_sentence: If the road is unobstructed, the bus will arrive on time.
sentence_zh: 如果道路暢通無阻，公車就會準時到達。

definition_zh: (形) 非正式的；未經官方認可的
example_sentence: The unofficial club meeting was held in the library after school.
sentence_zh: 這個非正式的社團會議在放學後於圖書館舉行。

definition_zh: (動) 打開（行李）；拆開
example_sentence: Students must unpack their bags before entering the classroom.
sentence_zh: 學生們在進入教室前必須打開他們的書包。

definition_zh: (形) 難吃的；令人不快的
example_sentence: Finding the cafeteria food unpalatable, many students brought lunch from home.
sentence_zh: 覺得餐廳食物難以下嚥，許多學生從家裡帶午餐。

definition_zh: (形) 無與倫比的；獨一無二的
example_sentence: The student's unparalleled dedication earned her the top scholarship.
sentence_zh: 這位學生無與倫比的奉獻精神為她贏得了最高獎學金。

definition_zh: (形) 不受干擾的；鎮定的
example_sentence: The teacher remained unperturbed during the noisy classroom discussion.
sentence_zh: 老師在吵鬧的課堂討論中保持鎮定。

definition_zh: (形) 不愉快的；令人討厭的
example_sentence: The unpleasant smell from the lab made many students cover their noses.
sentence_zh: 實驗室傳來的不愉快氣味讓許多學生摀住鼻子。

definition_zh: (形) 不受歡迎的；不流行的
example_sentence: If a student holds an unpopular opinion, the teacher should listen carefully.
sentence_zh: 如果學生持有不受歡迎的意見，老師應該仔細聆聽。

definition_zh: (形) 前所未有的；空前的
example_sentence: The unprecedented heat wave caused many schools to close early.
sentence_zh: 這波前所未有的熱浪導致許多學校提前停課。

definition_zh: (形) 不可預測的；難以預料的
example_sentence: The weather in Taiwan is unpredictable during typhoon season.
sentence_zh: 台灣的天氣在颱風季節時難以預測。

definition_zh: (形) 不利的；不吉利的
example_sentence: If the weather remained unpropitious, the picnic would be canceled.
sentence_zh: 如果天氣仍然不利，野餐就會被取消。

definition_zh: (形) 不合格的；無資格的
example_sentence: If an applicant is unqualified, the manager will not consider their resume.
sentence_zh: 如果申請人不合格，經理就不會考慮他們的履歷。

definition_zh: (形) 無可置疑的；確鑿的
example_sentence: Students study hard to achieve unquestionable success in the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 學生們努力學習，以在學測中取得無可置疑的成功。

definition_zh: (副) 無疑地；確定地
example_sentence: Her dedication to studying is unquestionably the key to her success.
sentence_zh: 她對學習的投入無疑是她成功的關鍵。

definition_zh: (動) 解開；闡明
example_sentence: As the mystery deepened, the detective worked to unravel the complex case.
sentence_zh: 隨著謎團加深，偵探努力解開這個複雜的案件。

definition_zh: (形) 無情的；不懈的
example_sentence: The unrelenting rain forced the school to cancel the outdoor sports day.
sentence_zh: 無情的雨迫使學校取消了戶外運動會。

definition_zh: (名) 不可靠性；不穩定性
example_sentence: The unreliability of the bus system made students late for school.
sentence_zh: 公車系統的不可靠性導致學生上學遲到。

definition_zh: (形) 不可靠的；靠不住的
example_sentence: Many students avoid unreliable sources to improve their research papers.
sentence_zh: 許多學生為了改善他們的研究報告而避免不可靠的來源。

definition_zh: (形) 未解決的；未確定的
example_sentence: Having left the issue unresolved, the committee faced strong criticism.
sentence_zh: 讓這個問題懸而未決，委員會面臨了強烈的批評。

definition_zh: (名) 動盪；不安
example_sentence: Facing growing social unrest, the government proposed new policies.
sentence_zh: 面對日益增長的社會動盪，政府提出了新政策。

definition_zh: (形) 不受限制的；無拘束的
example_sentence: If students spend unrestrained time on social media, their grades may suffer.
sentence_zh: 如果學生在社群媒體上花費不受限制的時間，他們的成績可能會受影響。

definition_zh: (形) 不受限制的；自由的
example_sentence: Students who have unrestricted access to the internet often face distractions.
sentence_zh: 那些擁有不受限制的網路存取權的學生經常面臨分心。

definition_zh: (形) 不守規矩的；難控制的
example_sentence: Because the unruly students disrupted the class, the teacher assigned extra homework.
sentence_zh: 因為那些不守規矩的學生擾亂了課堂，老師額外指定了作業。

definition_zh: (形) 不滿意的；不理想的
example_sentence: Students found the exam results unsatisfactory despite studying hard.
sentence_zh: 學生們發現考試成績不理想，儘管他們努力學習。

definition_zh: (形) 無私的；不自私的
example_sentence: Because her friend was upset, the unselfish girl shared her lunch.
sentence_zh: 因為朋友心情不好，這個無私的女孩分享了她的午餐。

definition_zh: (副) 無私地；不吝嗇地
example_sentence: If a student unselfishly shares notes, the whole class benefits.
sentence_zh: 如果一個學生無私地分享筆記，全班都會受益。

definition_zh: (名) 無私；慷慨
example_sentence: The teacher praised Amy's unselfishness to encourage others to help.
sentence_zh: 老師稱讚艾咪的無私，以鼓勵其他人幫忙。

definition_zh: (動) 使不安；擾亂
example_sentence: If the exam results unsettle students, teachers would offer more support.
sentence_zh: 如果考試成績使學生感到不安，老師會提供更多支持。

definition_zh: (形) 未定的；不穩定的
example_sentence: The student's future remained unsettled after the exam results.
sentence_zh: 那位學生的未來在考試成績出來後仍然未定。

definition_zh: (形) 令人不安的；使人擔憂的
example_sentence: The unsettling news about the earthquake worried many students.
sentence_zh: 關於地震的令人不安的消息讓許多學生感到憂慮。

definition_zh: (形) 難看的；不雅觀的
example_sentence: Leaving trash on the ground creates an unsightly mess in the park.
sentence_zh: 把垃圾丟在地上會造成公園裡難看的髒亂。

definition_zh: (形) 不穩定的；動盪的
example_sentence: Having felt unstable after the earthquake, the students stayed outside the classroom.
sentence_zh: 地震後感到不穩定，學生們待在教室外。

definition_zh: (形) 不成功的；失敗的
example_sentence: Although the team practiced hard, their project was unsuccessful.
sentence_zh: 儘管團隊努力練習，他們的專案仍不成功。

definition_zh: (形) 不適合的；不合適的
example_sentence: Choosing a career unsuitable for your skills can lead to frustration.
sentence_zh: 選擇一個不適合你技能的职业可能會導致挫折。

definition_zh: (形) 不確定的；無把握的
example_sentence: Unsure about the answer, the student raised her hand for help.
sentence_zh: 因為不確定答案，那名學生舉手求助。

definition_zh: (形) 未開發的；未利用的
example_sentence: The mountain region has untapped potential for solar energy.
sentence_zh: 這個山區有未開發的太陽能潛力。

definition_zh: (形) 難以想像的；不可思議的
example_sentence: The idea of failing the exam was unthinkable for the top student.
sentence_zh: 對於那位頂尖學生來說，考試不及格的想法是難以想像的。

definition_zh: (形) 不整齊的；凌亂的
example_sentence: Because his desk was untidy, the teacher asked him to clean it.
sentence_zh: 因為他的書桌不整齊，老師要求他清理乾淨。

definition_zh: (介) 直到…為止　(連) 直到…時
example_sentence: The students waited in the library until the rain stopped.
sentence_zh: 學生們在圖書館裡等到雨停。

definition_zh: (形) 未被觸碰的；未受影響的
example_sentence: If the ancient artifact remains untouched, its value will increase over time.
sentence_zh: 如果這件古物保持未被觸碰，它的價值會隨著時間增加。

definition_zh: (形) 不尋常的；罕見的
example_sentence: Although the weather was unusual, the baseball game continued as planned.
sentence_zh: 雖然天氣異常，棒球比賽仍按計畫進行。

definition_zh: (副) 異常地；不尋常地
example_sentence: This winter has been unusually warm, surprising many local farmers.
sentence_zh: 這個冬天異常溫暖，讓許多當地農民感到驚訝。

definition_zh: (形) 不變的；一成不變的
example_sentence: Having followed an unvarying routine, the student felt bored with daily life.
sentence_zh: 遵循著一成不變的例行公事，這位學生對日常生活感到無聊。

definition_zh: (動) 揭幕；推出
example_sentence: The company plans to unveil a new smartphone at the conference.
sentence_zh: 這家公司計劃在會議上推出一款新的智慧型手機。

definition_zh: (形) 不需要的；不受歡迎的
example_sentence: After the party, unwanted food was thrown away by the students.
sentence_zh: 派對結束後，學生們把不需要的食物丟掉了。

definition_zh: (形) 堅定不移的；不動搖的
example_sentence: The scientist's unwavering focus led to a major discovery.
sentence_zh: 這位科學家堅定不移的專注導致了一項重大發現。

definition_zh: (形) 不適的；不舒服的
example_sentence: Because Mia felt unwell this morning, she stayed home from school.
sentence_zh: 因為米亞今天早上感到不適，她待在家裡沒去上學。

definition_zh: (形) 笨重的；難處理的
example_sentence: The unwieldy box of books made moving it difficult.
sentence_zh: 那箱笨重的書本讓搬動它變得困難。

definition_zh: (形) 不願意的；勉強的
example_sentence: Although the project was interesting, Tom was unwilling to join the team.
sentence_zh: 雖然這個專題很有趣，湯姆還是不願意加入這個團隊。

definition_zh: (動) 放鬆；鬆開
example_sentence: Listening to soft music helps Sarah unwind after her exams.
sentence_zh: 聽輕柔的音樂幫助莎拉在考試後放鬆。

definition_zh: (形) 不明智的；愚蠢的
example_sentence: Thinking it was unwise, the student skipped the late-night party.
sentence_zh: 認為這是不明智的，那位學生錯過了深夜派對。

definition_zh: (形) 最新的；現代的
example_sentence: This website provides up-to-date information for our research project.
sentence_zh: 這個網站為我們的研究專題提供最新的資訊。

definition_zh: (形) 樂觀的；積極的
example_sentence: If the team stays upbeat, their practice will improve quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果團隊保持樂觀，他們的練習就會快速進步。

definition_zh: (名) 教養；養育
example_sentence: A strict upbringing often leads to a disciplined lifestyle.
sentence_zh: 嚴格的教養常會導致自律的生活方式。

definition_zh: (形) 即將到來的；即將發生的
example_sentence: Students preparing for the upcoming CSAT exam feel a lot of pressure.
sentence_zh: 準備即將到來的學測的學生感到很大的壓力。

definition_zh: (動) [ʌp'det] 更新；使現代化　(名) ['ʌp.det] 更新；最新消息
example_sentence: Seldom does the school update its software during the semester.
sentence_zh: 學校很少在學期中更新其軟體。

definition_zh: (動) 顛覆；打亂
example_sentence: If the new policy upends the schedule, students must adjust quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果新政策打亂了行程，學生必須迅速調整。

definition_zh: (動) [ʌp'gred] 升級；提升　(名) ['ʌp.gred] 升級；改進
example_sentence: If the school upgraded its computers, students would learn faster.
sentence_zh: 如果學校升級電腦，學生學習會更快。

definition_zh: (名) 動盪；劇變
example_sentence: The political upheaval caused many families to leave their homes.
sentence_zh: 政治動盪導致許多家庭離開家園。

definition_zh: (副) 向上地；艱難地　(形) 上坡的；費力的
example_sentence: The students worked uphill to improve their English scores.
sentence_zh: 學生們努力克服困難以提高他們的英文成績。

definition_zh: (動) 支持；維護
example_sentence: Upholding the school's rules, the student council president earned everyone's respect.
sentence_zh: 學生會長遵守學校規定，贏得了大家的尊重。

definition_zh: (名) 襯墊；家具裝飾材料
example_sentence: The old sofa's worn upholstery needs to be replaced soon.
sentence_zh: 這張舊沙發磨損的襯墊需要盡快更換。

definition_zh: (形) 令人振奮的；鼓舞人心的
example_sentence: Reading stories about overcoming adversity can be uplifting for students.
sentence_zh: 閱讀關於克服逆境的故事對學生來說可以振奮人心。

definition_zh: (動) 上傳
example_sentence: After finishing the video, the student will upload it to the school website.
sentence_zh: 完成影片後，這位學生會將它上傳到學校網站。

definition_zh: (介) 在...之上；一...就；根據
example_sentence: Upon hearing the good news, the students cheered loudly.
sentence_zh: 一聽到好消息，學生們大聲歡呼。

definition_zh: (名) 優勢；上風
example_sentence: Having practiced daily, the team gained the upper hand in the final match.
sentence_zh: 經過每日練習，該隊在決賽中取得了優勢。

definition_zh: (形) 上層的；較高的
example_sentence: The student who lives on the upper floor always keeps quiet.
sentence_zh: 住在樓上的學生總是保持安靜。

definition_zh: (形) 正直的；垂直的　(副) 垂直地；挺直地
example_sentence: The teacher asked the students to sit upright during the exam.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生在考試期間坐直。

definition_zh: (名) 正直；誠實
example_sentence: Having demonstrated uprightness throughout the project, the student earned everyone's respect.
sentence_zh: 在整個專案中展現了正直之後，那名學生贏得了大家的尊重。

definition_zh: (名) 起義；叛亂
example_sentence: The student uprising in 2014 demanded greater democracy for Taiwan.
sentence_zh: 2014年的學生起義要求台灣擁有更大的民主。

definition_zh: (動) 連根拔起；根除
example_sentence: The typhoon that uprooted many trees caused serious damage to the park.
sentence_zh: 那場颱風拔起了許多樹木，對公園造成嚴重破壞。

definition_zh: (名) 興衰；起伏
example_sentence: The movie that describes the ups and downs of a family is very touching.
sentence_zh: 那部描述一個家庭興衰的電影非常感人。

definition_zh: (形) ['ʌpsɛt] 心煩的；難過的　(動) [ʌp'sɛt] 使心煩；打亂
example_sentence: The bad news upset the whole team before the final game.
sentence_zh: 這個壞消息在總決賽前讓整個團隊感到難過。

definition_zh: (名) 好處；正面
example_sentence: The upside of studying hard is getting into a good university.
sentence_zh: 努力讀書的好處是進入一所好大學。

definition_zh: (動) [ʌp'stedʒ] 搶…風頭；使相形見絀　(副) ['ʌp'stedʒ] 在舞台後方
example_sentence: When the new student tried to upstage the teacher, the class felt uncomfortable.
sentence_zh: 當新學生試圖搶老師的風頭時，全班都感到不舒服。

definition_zh: (副) 在樓上；往樓上　(形) 樓上的
example_sentence: The noise upstairs kept the students from focusing on their homework.
sentence_zh: 樓上的噪音讓學生無法專心寫作業。

definition_zh: (副) 上游地；向上游地　(形) 上游的
example_sentence: Salmon swim upstream to reach their breeding grounds every year.
sentence_zh: 鮭魚每年向上游游泳以到達它們的繁殖地。

definition_zh: (名) 激增；急劇上升
example_sentence: The sudden upsurge in air pollution alarmed local residents.
sentence_zh: 空氣污染的突然激增震驚了當地居民。

definition_zh: (副) 向上地；朝上地　(形) 向上的；上升的
example_sentence: The kite flew upward into the clear blue sky.
sentence_zh: 風箏向上飛入清澈的藍天。

definition_zh: (副) 向上地；上升地
example_sentence: The cost of living has been adjusted upwards by the government this year.
sentence_zh: 今年政府已經調高了生活成本。

definition_zh: (名) 鈾
example_sentence: Concerned about safety, the government strictly controls uranium mining.
sentence_zh: 基於安全考量，政府嚴格控管鈾礦開採。

definition_zh: (形) 都市的；城市的
example_sentence: Students who live in urban areas often have more job opportunities.
sentence_zh: 住在都市地區的學生通常有更多的工作機會。

definition_zh: (名) 頑童；流浪兒
example_sentence: The little urchin, wearing a torn jacket, begged for spare change.
sentence_zh: 這個穿著破夾克的小流浪兒乞討零錢。

definition_zh: (名) 尿素
example_sentence: The urea in the fertilizer helps plants grow faster.
sentence_zh: 肥料中的尿素幫助植物長得更快。

definition_zh: (形) 不真實的；虛幻的
example_sentence: The company's new product was not real, only a marketing trick.
sentence_zh: 這家公司的新產品並非真實，只是行銷手法。

definition_zh: (片) 鼓勵；促使
example_sentence: Having been urged on by her coach, Linda finished the race with determination.
sentence_zh: 在教練的鼓勵下，琳達堅定地完成了比賽。

definition_zh: (名) 強烈的慾望；衝動　(動) 驅策；力勸
example_sentence: Feeling a strong urge to help, the student donated his allowance to the charity.
sentence_zh: 感受到強烈的衝動想去幫助，這位學生將他的零用錢捐給了慈善機構。

definition_zh: (名) 緊迫；緊急
example_sentence: If the teacher understood the urgency, she would assign the project today.
sentence_zh: 如果老師理解這份緊迫性，她就會今天指派這個專題。

definition_zh: (形) 緊急的；迫切的
example_sentence: The teacher said the homework was urgent and must be handed in today.
sentence_zh: 老師說這份作業很緊急，必須在今天交。

definition_zh: (副) 緊急地；急迫地
example_sentence: The school needs to fix the broken air conditioner urgently.
sentence_zh: 學校急需修理壞掉的冷氣機。

definition_zh: (形) 泌尿的
example_sentence: The doctor tested the patient's urinary system for any infection.
sentence_zh: 醫生檢查了病人的泌尿系統是否有任何感染。

definition_zh: (名) 尿液
example_sentence: When the doctor tests urine, it can show early signs of illness.
sentence_zh: 當醫生檢驗尿液時，它可以顯示疾病的早期徵兆。

definition_zh: (形) 熊的；似熊的
example_sentence: Having observed the ursine footprints, the hikers cautiously avoided the trail.
sentence_zh: 觀察到熊的足跡後，徒步者謹慎地避開了那條小徑。

definition_zh: (代) 我們（受格）
example_sentence: The teacher asked us to finish our homework before Friday.
sentence_zh: 老師要求我們在星期五之前完成作業。

definition_zh: (名) 使用；用法
example_sentence: Having studied the software usage guide, Tom completed the project efficiently.
sentence_zh: 研讀完軟體使用指南後，湯姆有效率地完成了專案。

definition_zh: (動) 使用；利用
example_sentence: Using a dictionary can help students learn new words.
sentence_zh: 使用字典可以幫助學生學習新單字。

definition_zh: (形) 有用的；有益的
example_sentence: Studying with a group can be useful for learning new ideas.
sentence_zh: 和小組一起學習對於學習新想法可能很有用。

definition_zh: (形) 無用的；沒用的
example_sentence: Because the old computer is useless, the school plans to donate it.
sentence_zh: 因為這台舊電腦沒用，學校打算將它捐出。

definition_zh: (形) 使用者友善的；容易使用的
example_sentence: Having designed the app to be user-friendly, the team received positive feedback.
sentence_zh: 將應用程式設計得對使用者友善後，團隊獲得了正面回饋。

definition_zh: (名) 使用者；用戶
example_sentence: Every user must follow the rules of the school library.
sentence_zh: 每位使用者都必須遵守學校圖書館的規定。

definition_zh: (片) 引進；開創；迎來
example_sentence: The new policy that will usher in better opportunities has been announced.
sentence_zh: 這項將迎來更好機會的新政策已經宣布了。

definition_zh: (動) 引領；迎接
example_sentence: Ushered in by the new principal, the school year began with fresh energy.
sentence_zh: 在新校長的帶領下，新學年以嶄新的活力開始。

definition_zh: (形) 通常的；平常的
example_sentence: My usual breakfast is a sandwich and a glass of milk.
sentence_zh: 我平常的早餐是三明治和一杯牛奶。

definition_zh: (副) 通常；一般
example_sentence: Students usually study in the library before exams.
sentence_zh: 學生通常在考試前在圖書館讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 器具；用具
example_sentence: Using the right utensil for cooking can make a big difference.
sentence_zh: 使用正確的烹飪器具可以產生很大的不同。

definition_zh: (名) 子宮
example_sentence: When a woman is pregnant, the uterus expands to accommodate the growing baby.
sentence_zh: 當女性懷孕時，子宮會擴張以容納成長中的胎兒。

definition_zh: (形) 功利主義的；實用的
example_sentence: Taking a utilitarian approach, the school chose the cheapest option for the new library.
sentence_zh: 採取功利主義的做法，學校為新圖書館選擇了最便宜的方案。

definition_zh: (名) 實用性；公用事業
example_sentence: The utility of this new app is clear to many students.
sentence_zh: 這個新應用程式的實用性對許多學生來說很明顯。

definition_zh: (名) 極限；最大可能　(形) 極度的；最遠的
example_sentence: The students put forth their utmost effort to win the science competition.
sentence_zh: 學生們付出最大的努力來贏得科學競賽。

definition_zh: (名) 烏托邦；理想國
example_sentence: Many students read novels to imagine a perfect utopia.
sentence_zh: 許多學生閱讀小說，以想像一個完美的烏托邦。

definition_zh: (動) 說出；發出(聲音)
example_sentence: The teacher asked him to utter his opinion during the class discussion.
sentence_zh: 老師要求他在課堂討論中說出自己的意見。

definition_zh: (名) 空缺；空位
example_sentence: If a vacancy appeared in the student council, Emma would apply immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果學生會出現一個空缺，艾瑪會立刻申請。

definition_zh: (形) 空著的；空缺的
example_sentence: The seat next to Tom has been vacant since class started.
sentence_zh: 湯姆旁邊的座位從上課開始就一直空著。

definition_zh: (名) 假期；休假
example_sentence: Having finished her exams, the student enjoyed a long vacation.
sentence_zh: 考完試後，這位學生享受了一個長長的假期。

definition_zh: (名) 度假者；休假者
example_sentence: Every vacationer should respect the local culture and environment.
sentence_zh: 每位度假者都應該尊重當地的文化和環境。

definition_zh: (動) 給…接種疫苗；注射疫苗
example_sentence: Getting vaccinated before flu season helps protect the elderly.
sentence_zh: 在流感季節前接種疫苗有助於保護老年人。

definition_zh: (名) 疫苗接種；接種疫苗
example_sentence: The school vaccination program helps protect students from preventable diseases.
sentence_zh: 學校的疫苗接種計劃有助於保護學生免受可預防疾病的侵害。

definition_zh: (名) 疫苗
example_sentence: The new vaccine helped reduce the spread of the virus.
sentence_zh: 這種新疫苗有助於減緩病毒的傳播。

definition_zh: (名) 真空；吸塵器　(動) 用吸塵器打掃
example_sentence: The vacuum cleaner in the living room needs a new bag.
sentence_zh: 客廳裡的吸塵器需要一個新集塵袋。

definition_zh: (名) 流浪者；遊民　(形) 流浪的；漂泊的
example_sentence: Seldom does a vagrant find a permanent home in the city.
sentence_zh: 流浪漢在城市中很少找到永久的家。

definition_zh: (形) 模糊的；不明確的
example_sentence: The instructions for the homework were too vague for the students.
sentence_zh: 這份作業的指示對學生來說太模糊了。

definition_zh: (副) 模糊地；隱約地
example_sentence: The student vaguely remembered the formula for the math test.
sentence_zh: 那位學生隱約記得數學考試的公式。

definition_zh: (形) 徒勞的；虛榮的
example_sentence: Trying to impress others with expensive clothes is often a vain effort.
sentence_zh: 試圖用昂貴的衣服來打動他人往往是徒勞的。

definition_zh: (名) 告別；告別詞；告別演說
example_sentence: The valediction that the principal delivered moved many students to tears.
sentence_zh: 校長發表的告別演說讓許多學生感動落淚。

definition_zh: (名) 畢業生致詞代表
example_sentence: If Anna became the valedictorian, her family would be very proud.
sentence_zh: 如果安娜成為畢業生致詞代表，她的家人會非常驕傲。

definition_zh: (形) 告別的；告辭的　(名) 告別演說
example_sentence: The valedictory speech by the senior class president inspired everyone to pursue their dreams.
sentence_zh: 畢業生代表的告別演說激勵了每個人去追求夢想。

definition_zh: (名) 情人；情人卡
example_sentence: My best friend gave me a handmade valentine for Valentine's Day.
sentence_zh: 我最好的朋友在情人節送了我一張手作情人卡。

definition_zh: (形) 英勇的；勇敢的
example_sentence: The young firefighter made a valiant effort to save the trapped cat.
sentence_zh: 這位年輕的消防員做出英勇的努力，拯救受困的貓咪。

definition_zh: (形) 有效的；合理的
example_sentence: The student's ID card is valid until the end of this semester.
sentence_zh: 這名學生的學生證有效期到本學期末。

definition_zh: (動) 驗證；確認

sentence_zh: 獸醫在動物醫院仔細檢查了那隻受傷的狗。
