sentence_zh: 許多公民在選舉中投票選擇他們的領袖。

definition_zh: (名) 選民；投票者
example_sentence: After reading the news, many voters decided to support the new policy.
sentence_zh: 看完新聞後，許多選民決定支持這項新政策。

definition_zh: (名) 折價券；憑證
example_sentence: Students must show their voucher at the bookstore to get the discount.
sentence_zh: 學生必須在書店出示他們的折價券才能獲得折扣。

definition_zh: (動) 發誓；誓言
example_sentence: Seldom does a student vow to study every day and actually keep it.
sentence_zh: 很少有學生發誓每天讀書並真正遵守。

definition_zh: (名) 母音；母音字母
example_sentence: The English teacher asked the class to identify each vowel in the word.
sentence_zh: 英文老師要求全班同學辨認單字中的每個母音。

definition_zh: (名) 航行；旅行
example_sentence: Excited about the voyage, the young sailor packed his bags quickly.
sentence_zh: 對這次航行感到興奮，那位年輕水手迅速收拾好行李。

definition_zh: (形) 粗俗的；低俗的
example_sentence: Many students avoid vulgar language to maintain a respectful atmosphere.
sentence_zh: 許多學生避免使用粗俗的語言，以維持尊重的氛圍。

definition_zh: (名) 脆弱性；弱點
example_sentence: The team's vulnerability to cyber attacks worried the school.
sentence_zh: 該團隊對網路攻擊的脆弱性讓學校感到擔憂。

definition_zh: (形) 脆弱的；易受傷的
example_sentence: Elderly people are especially vulnerable to the flu during winter.
sentence_zh: 老年人冬天特別容易感染流感。

definition_zh: (名) 禿鷹；貪婪的人
example_sentence: The vulture that circled above the desert was searching for food.
sentence_zh: 那隻在沙漠上空盤旋的禿鷹正在尋找食物。

definition_zh: (名) 怪人；瘋子
example_sentence: The teacher called the student a wacko for his strange behavior.
sentence_zh: 老師因為那名學生的奇怪行為而叫他怪人。

definition_zh: (形) 古怪的；滑稽的
example_sentence: The wacky idea that he proposed made everyone laugh.
sentence_zh: 他提出的那個古怪想法讓每個人都笑了。

definition_zh: (動) 搖搖擺擺地走；蹣跚而行
example_sentence: The ducklings waddle across the road to reach the pond.
sentence_zh: 小鴨子們搖搖擺擺地過馬路，以抵達池塘。

definition_zh: (片) 介入；插手
example_sentence: If a student waded in to help, the project would finish faster.
sentence_zh: 如果學生介入幫忙，這個專案會完成得更快。

definition_zh: (片) 介入；涉入（困難或爭議性的情況）
example_sentence: The student council president decided to wade into the debate on school uniforms.
sentence_zh: 學生會長決定介入關於學校制服的辯論。

definition_zh: (片) 費力地閱讀；艱難地通過
example_sentence: Before the exam, students had to wade through many difficult textbooks.
sentence_zh: 考試前，學生們必須費力閱讀許多困難的教科書。

definition_zh: (動) 涉水；跋涉
example_sentence: Having waded through the muddy river, the hikers finally reached the campsite.
sentence_zh: 涉過泥濘的河流後，健行者們終於到達了營地。

definition_zh: (動) 飄送；飄蕩
example_sentence: When the bakery door opens, the sweet smell of fresh bread wafts outside.
sentence_zh: 當麵包店的門打開時，新鮮麵包的香甜氣味飄散到外面。

definition_zh: (動) 搖擺；擺動
example_sentence: The dog began to wag its tail excitedly when its owner returned home.
sentence_zh: 那隻狗在主人回家時開始興奮地搖尾巴。

definition_zh: (片) 向……宣戰；對……發起鬥爭
example_sentence: The government decided to wage war on pollution after the river turned black.
sentence_zh: 政府在河流變黑後決定向污染宣戰。

definition_zh: (名) 工資；薪資
example_sentence: Having worked for six months, the intern finally received a fair wage.
sentence_zh: 工作了六個月後，這位實習生終於得到了公平的工資。

definition_zh: (名) 馬車；貨車
example_sentence: The old wagon that my grandfather built is still in the garage.
sentence_zh: 我祖父建造的那輛舊馬車仍然在車庫裡。

definition_zh: (動) 哭嚎；哀號
example_sentence: The baby began to wail loudly for its mother's attention.
sentence_zh: 嬰兒開始大聲哭鬧以引起母親的注意。

definition_zh: (名) 腰；腰部
example_sentence: The dancer's waist moved gracefully with the music during the performance.
sentence_zh: 舞者的腰部在表演中隨著音樂優美地擺動。

definition_zh: (片) 等待；等候
example_sentence: If the bus is late, students should wait about ten more minutes.
sentence_zh: 如果公車晚到，學生們應該再多等大約十分鐘。

definition_zh: (片) 留下來；在後面等待
example_sentence: The teacher asked the students to wait behind after class.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生們下課後留下來。

definition_zh: (片) 排隊等待
example_sentence: Students who wait in line for lunch often chat with friends.
sentence_zh: 排隊等午餐的學生經常和朋友聊天。

definition_zh: (片) 服務；招待
example_sentence: The new waiter must wait on customers quickly during the lunch rush.
sentence_zh: 新來的服務生在午餐尖峰時段必須快速服務顧客。

definition_zh: (片) 等待...結束；熬過
example_sentence: The students decided to wait out the heavy rain in the library.
sentence_zh: 學生們決定在圖書館裡等待大雨過去。

definition_zh: (片) 熬夜等待；不睡等著
example_sentence: My mother always waits up for me when I study late at the library.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽總是在我在圖書館念書到很晚時，熬夜等我回家。

definition_zh: (片) 熬夜等待；等著不睡
example_sentence: My parents always wait up for me when I come home late.
sentence_zh: 當我晚回家時，我的父母總是熬夜等我。

definition_zh: (片) 侍候；服務
example_sentence: The hotel staff wait upon guests with great care and attention.
sentence_zh: 飯店員工以極大的關心和注意服務客人。

definition_zh: (動) 等待；等候　(名) 等待；等待的時間
example_sentence: The students who wait for the bus every morning are very patient.
sentence_zh: 每天早上等公車的學生們非常有耐心。

definition_zh: (名) 服務生；侍者
example_sentence: The waiter brought the menu right after we sat down.
sentence_zh: 我們一坐下，服務生就把菜單拿來了。

definition_zh: (名) 女服務生；女侍者
example_sentence: The waitress brought us our drinks with a smile.
sentence_zh: 那位女服務生帶著微笑給我們送來了飲料。

definition_zh: (動) 免除；放棄
example_sentence: If the fee is too high, the school may waive the requirement.
sentence_zh: 如果費用太高，學校可能會免除這項要求。

definition_zh: (名) 放棄；豁免
example_sentence: The school granted a fee waiver for the student's extracurricular activity.
sentence_zh: 學校為學生的課外活動給予了費用減免。

definition_zh: (片) 意識到；察覺到
example_sentence: When students wake up to the news, they feel shocked.
sentence_zh: 當學生們意識到這個消息時，他們感到震驚。

definition_zh: (片) 喚醒；叫醒
example_sentence: Every morning, the alarm clock wakes up the whole family.
sentence_zh: 每天早上，鬧鐘叫醒全家人。

definition_zh: (動) 醒；喚醒
example_sentence: The loud noise from the street woke the sleeping baby.
sentence_zh: 街上的大聲噪音吵醒了正在睡覺的嬰兒。

definition_zh: (動) 喚醒；醒來
example_sentence: The loud noise from the street waken the sleeping baby.
sentence_zh: 街上的巨大噪音吵醒了睡著的嬰兒。

definition_zh: (片) 避開；離開
example_sentence: Many students choose to walk away from difficult problems during exams.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在考試中選擇避開困難的問題。

definition_zh: (片) 意外撞見；打斷
example_sentence: My roommate walked in on me while I was studying for the final exam.
sentence_zh: 我的室友在我準備期末考試時突然走進來。

definition_zh: (片) 走進
example_sentence: Many students walk into the library to study for exams.
sentence_zh: 許多學生走進圖書館，為了考試而讀書。

definition_zh: (片) 順手拿走；偷走
example_sentence: Seldom did the security guard walk off with any valuable items.
sentence_zh: 這位警衛很少順手拿走任何貴重物品。

definition_zh: (片) 走開；離開（尤指生氣地）
example_sentence: The angry customer decided to walk off without paying for the meal.
sentence_zh: 那位生氣的顧客決定不付餐費就離開。

definition_zh: (片) 踩在……上行走；踐踏
example_sentence: If students walk on the grass, the school may give them a warning.
sentence_zh: 如果學生踩踏草坪，學校可能會給他們一個警告。

definition_zh: (片) 棄（某人）而去；拋棄；放棄
example_sentence: The student who walked out on the exam later regretted his decision.
sentence_zh: 那個在考試中棄考的學生後來後悔了他的決定。

definition_zh: (片) 走出；罷工；退出
example_sentence: Having walked out of the exam hall, Maria felt a wave of relief.
sentence_zh: 走出考場後，瑪麗亞感到一陣如釋重負。

definition_zh: (片) 走過；瀏覽；排練
example_sentence: Walking through the crowded night market, the student found a quiet corner to study.
sentence_zh: 走過擁擠的夜市，這名學生找到了一個安靜的角落讀書。

definition_zh: (片) 走上；喚醒
example_sentence: If the alarm fails, David will walk up the hill before breakfast.
sentence_zh: 如果鬧鐘故障，大衛會在早餐前走上山丘。

definition_zh: (動) 走；散步　(名) 散步；步行
example_sentence: The old man who walks his dog every morning is my neighbor.
sentence_zh: 每天早上遛狗的那位老先生是我的邻居。

definition_zh: (名) 漫步；巡遊
example_sentence: The prime minister's walkabout in the park attracted many curious students.
sentence_zh: 總理在公園的漫步吸引了許多好奇的學生。

definition_zh: (名) 隨身聽
example_sentence: Using an old walkman, my father listened to his favorite cassettes.
sentence_zh: 用著舊隨身聽，我父親聽他最喜歡的卡帶。

definition_zh: (名) 罷工；罷課；退席抗議
example_sentence: Frustrated with the new policy, many students staged a walkout.
sentence_zh: 對新政策感到沮喪，許多學生發起了罷課。

definition_zh: (名) 牆；牆壁
example_sentence: Seldom does a wall stand so tall in this small town.
sentence_zh: 在這個小鎮上，很少有一道牆能矗立得這麼高。

definition_zh: (名) 錢包；皮夾
example_sentence: If your wallet is stolen, report it to the police immediately.
sentence_zh: 如果你的錢包被偷了，立刻向警方報案。

definition_zh: (名) 壁紙
example_sentence: After the wall got wet, the wallpaper started to peel off.
sentence_zh: 牆壁變濕後，壁紙開始剝落。

definition_zh: (名) 核桃；胡桃
example_sentence: The walnut tree in the school garden provides shade for students.
sentence_zh: 學校花園裡的核桃樹為學生們提供陰涼。

definition_zh: (名) 華爾滋舞；華爾滋舞曲　(動) 跳華爾滋舞
example_sentence: If the band plays a waltz, the dancers will move gracefully.
sentence_zh: 如果樂團演奏華爾滋，舞者們將會優雅地移動。

definition_zh: (片) 走神；離題
example_sentence: Seldom does a student wander off during Professor Wang's engaging lectures.
sentence_zh: 在王教授引人入勝的課堂上，學生很少會走神。

definition_zh: (動) 漫步；閒逛
example_sentence: The old man likes to wander through the park every morning.
sentence_zh: 那位老先生喜歡每天早上在公園裡漫步。

definition_zh: (形) 流浪的；漫遊的　(動) 流浪；漫遊
example_sentence: The stray dog wandering the streets was finally rescued by a kind neighbor.
sentence_zh: 那隻在街上流浪的流浪狗終於被一位好心的鄰居救起。

definition_zh: (動) 減退；減弱
example_sentence: The teacher's patience began to wane after the noisy class.
sentence_zh: 老師的耐心在吵鬧的課堂後開始減退。

definition_zh: (動) 打手槍；手淫
example_sentence: Seldom does a student wank in the classroom during class.
sentence_zh: 學生很少在課堂上打手槍。

definition_zh: (片) 想要出去；想要離開
example_sentence: The cat wants out of the house every morning.
sentence_zh: 那隻貓每天早上都想出門。

definition_zh: (動) 想要；需要
example_sentence: Having wanted a new laptop for months, Mark finally saved enough money.
sentence_zh: 想要一台新筆電好幾個月後，馬克終於存夠了錢。

definition_zh: (形) 任性的；恣意的
example_sentence: The wanton destruction of the park shocked many local residents.
sentence_zh: 對公園的肆意破壞震驚了許多當地居民。

definition_zh: (副) 肆意地；恣意地
example_sentence: The factory dumped waste wantonly into the nearby river.
sentence_zh: 這家工廠肆意地將廢棄物倒入附近的河流。

definition_zh: (名) 戰爭；衝突
example_sentence: Having witnessed the horrors of war, the soldier became a peace activist.
sentence_zh: 在目睹了戰爭的恐怖之後，這位士兵成為了一名和平倡導者。

definition_zh: (名) 病房；監護室
example_sentence: The hospital ward was quiet except for the nurse's footsteps.
sentence_zh: 醫院的病房很安靜，只有護士的腳步聲。

definition_zh: (名) 衣櫥；衣櫃
example_sentence: My new wardrobe is too small for all my clothes.
sentence_zh: 我的新衣櫥太小了，放不下我所有的衣服。

definition_zh: (名) 貨物；商品；(特定種類的) 器皿
example_sentence: Having inspected the damaged ware, the store manager offered a full refund.
sentence_zh: 檢查完受損的貨物後，商店經理提供了全額退款。

definition_zh: (名) 倉庫；貨倉
example_sentence: The new warehouse near the school stores many books for students.
sentence_zh: 學校附近的新倉庫為學生儲存許多書籍。

definition_zh: (名) 商品；貨物
example_sentence: The market vendor displayed his wares on a colorful table.
sentence_zh: 市場攤販在色彩繽紛的桌上展示他的商品。

definition_zh: (片) 熱身；暖身
example_sentence: Warming up before a run prevents muscle injuries.
sentence_zh: 跑步前熱身可以預防肌肉受傷。

definition_zh: (名) 熱身；準備活動
example_sentence: If the team does a proper warm-up, they will perform better in the game.
sentence_zh: 如果球隊做適當的熱身，他們就會在比賽中表現得更好。

definition_zh: (形) 溫暖的；暖和的　(動) 使溫暖；變暖
example_sentence: A warm coat is necessary for cold winter days.
sentence_zh: 一件溫暖的外套對寒冷的冬天是必要的。

definition_zh: (名) 暖化；變暖
example_sentence: Global warming is a serious problem that requires immediate action.
sentence_zh: 全球暖化是一個需要立即採取行動的嚴重問題。

definition_zh: (名) 溫暖；熱情
example_sentence: If the weather were colder, the warmth of the fireplace would feel even better.
sentence_zh: 如果天氣更冷，壁爐的溫暖會感覺更棒。

definition_zh: (動) 警告；告誡
example_sentence: The teacher warned the students to study hard for the final exam.
sentence_zh: 老師警告學生要為期末考試努力讀書。

definition_zh: (名) 警告；預兆
example_sentence: The warning that the teacher gave helped the students avoid trouble.
sentence_zh: 老師給予的警告幫助學生避免麻煩。

definition_zh: (動) 使變形；扭曲
example_sentence: Having warped the metal frame, the blacksmith had to start over.
sentence_zh: 使金屬框架變形後，鐵匠不得不重新開始。

definition_zh: (動) 保證；值得　(名) 授權；理由
example_sentence: The teacher's decision did not warrant any further discussion among the students.
sentence_zh: 老師的決定不值得學生們進一步討論。

definition_zh: (形) 可被證實的；正當的
example_sentence: Having produced warrantable results, the experiment was praised by the science teacher.
sentence_zh: 產生出可被證實的結果後，這項實驗得到了自然科老師的讚賞。

definition_zh: (名) 保固；保證
example_sentence: The store's warranty covers all repairs for two full years.
sentence_zh: 這家店的保固涵蓋所有維修，為期整整兩年。

definition_zh: (形) 交戰的；敵對的
example_sentence: Only after the ceasefire did the warring factions agree to negotiate.
sentence_zh: 只有在停火之後，交戰派系才同意談判。

definition_zh: (名) 戰士；勇士
example_sentence: Inspired by the ancient warrior, the student trained hard every day.
sentence_zh: 受到古代戰士的啟發，那名學生每天都努力訓練。

definition_zh: (名) 華沙（波蘭首都）
example_sentence: If Warsaw were the capital of a peaceful country, fewer conflicts would arise.
sentence_zh: 如果華沙是一個和平國家的首都，衝突就會減少。

definition_zh: (名) 軍艦；戰艦
example_sentence: The navy sent a warship to protect the fishing boats near the island.
sentence_zh: 海軍派遣一艘軍艦去保護島嶼附近的漁船。

definition_zh: (名) 疣；肉贅
example_sentence: If a wart appeared on your hand, would a doctor remove it safely?
sentence_zh: 如果手上長了一顆疣，醫生會安全地移除它嗎？

definition_zh: (名) 戰時
example_sentence: Wartime experiences often change people's perspectives on life.
sentence_zh: 戰時經驗常改變人們對人生的看法。

definition_zh: (形) 謹慎的；警戒的
example_sentence: The student remained wary of sharing personal information online.
sentence_zh: 這位學生對在網路上分享個人資訊保持謹慎。

definition_zh: (片) 沖走；洗掉
example_sentence: The heavy rain that washed away the soil damaged the crops.
sentence_zh: 沖走土壤的大雨損壞了農作物。

definition_zh: (片) 吞下；用飲料送服
example_sentence: Drinking cold water helps wash down the spicy hot pot.
sentence_zh: 喝冷水有助於吞下麻辣火鍋。

definition_zh: (片) 洗掉；洗去；沖洗
example_sentence: Having washed out the paintbrush, the artist began a new painting.
sentence_zh: 洗乾淨畫筆後，藝術家開始了一幅新畫作。

definition_zh: (動) 沖刷；淹沒
example_sentence: Many students went to the beach to let the waves wash over their feet.
sentence_zh: 許多學生去海邊讓海浪沖刷他們的腳。

definition_zh: (片) 洗碗；洗手
example_sentence: The boy who forgot to wash up left the kitchen messy.
sentence_zh: 那個忘記洗碗的男孩把廚房弄得亂七八糟。

definition_zh: (動) 洗；清洗
example_sentence: The student washes her hands before lunch every day.
sentence_zh: 這個學生每天午餐前洗手。

definition_zh: (名) 和紙膠帶
example_sentence: Many students use washi tape to decorate their notebooks.
sentence_zh: 許多學生使用和紙膠帶裝飾他們的筆記本。

definition_zh: (名) 洗滌；清洗　(動) 洗（wash的現在分詞）
example_sentence: Many students use a machine for washing their uniforms at home.
sentence_zh: 許多學生使用機器在家洗制服。

definition_zh: (名) 黃蜂；胡蜂
example_sentence: Having been stung by a wasp, the student rushed to the school clinic.
sentence_zh: 被黃蜂螫傷後，那名學生衝向學校保健室。

definition_zh: (片) 日漸消瘦；虛弱
example_sentence: The elderly patient began to waste away without proper nutrition.
sentence_zh: 年長病患因缺乏適當營養而開始日漸消瘦。

definition_zh: (名) 浪費；廢物　(動) 浪費
example_sentence: The food waste that students leave in the cafeteria is a serious problem.
sentence_zh: 學生留在餐廳的食物浪費是一個嚴重的問題。

definition_zh: (名) 荒地；廢墟
example_sentence: The abandoned factory became a wasteland after the company moved away.
sentence_zh: 那間廢棄的工廠在公司搬走後變成了一片荒地。

definition_zh: (片) 注意；小心
example_sentence: Drivers must watch out for pedestrians at crosswalks.
sentence_zh: 駕駛人在斑馬線必須注意行人。

definition_zh: (片) 看守；照顧；監督
example_sentence: The principal assigned a teacher to watch over the students during the exam.
sentence_zh: 校長指派一位老師在考試期間監督學生。

definition_zh: (動) 觀看；注視　(名) 手錶；監視
example_sentence: Students watch online videos to learn new skills after school.
sentence_zh: 學生們在放學後觀看線上影片來學習新技能。

definition_zh: (形) 警覺的；注意的
example_sentence: Having been watchful during the test, the students avoided careless mistakes.
sentence_zh: 在考試期間保持警覺後，學生們避免了粗心的錯誤。

definition_zh: (名) 管理員；看守人
example_sentence: The watchman, guarding the gate, saw a stray dog last night.
sentence_zh: 看守大門的管理員昨晚看到一隻流浪狗。

definition_zh: (片) 稀釋；打折扣
example_sentence: The teacher refused to water down the final exam questions.
sentence_zh: 老師拒絕降低期末考題的難度。

definition_zh: (名) 水　(動) 澆水；給水
example_sentence: When the weather is hot, water becomes a valuable resource for everyone.
sentence_zh: 當天氣炎熱時，水對每個人來說都成為一種寶貴的資源。

definition_zh: (名) 水彩；水彩畫
example_sentence: Amy's watercolor painting won first prize in the school art competition.
sentence_zh: 艾咪的水彩畫在學校藝術比賽中獲得第一名。

definition_zh: (名) 水上交通工具；船
example_sentence: Having repaired the damaged watercraft, the crew set sail again.
sentence_zh: 修好受損的水上交通工具後，船員們再次啟航。

definition_zh: (名) 瀑布
example_sentence: After the heavy rain, the waterfall became much more powerful and loud.
sentence_zh: 大雨過後，瀑布變得更加澎湃響亮。

definition_zh: (名) 濱水區；水邊地帶
example_sentence: When the typhoon hit, the waterfront area was quickly evacuated.
sentence_zh: 颱風來襲時，濱水區很快就被疏散了。

definition_zh: (動) 使積水；浸水
example_sentence: If the rice field becomes waterlogged, the farmers will lose their crops.
sentence_zh: 如果稻田積水，農民就會損失他們的作物。

definition_zh: (名) 西瓜
example_sentence: Cutting a watermelon, the chef smiled at the kids.
sentence_zh: 切著西瓜，廚師對孩子們微笑。

definition_zh: (形) 防水的；不透水的
example_sentence: A waterproof jacket is essential for hiking in Taiwan's rainy mountains.
sentence_zh: 一件防水夾克在台灣多雨的山區健行時是必備的。

definition_zh: (形) 防水的；嚴密的；無懈可擊的
example_sentence: Seldom is a watertight argument found in a high school debate.
sentence_zh: 在高中辯論中，很少能找到無懈可擊的論點。

definition_zh: (名) 水路；水道
example_sentence: Polluted by factories, the waterway became unsafe for swimming.
sentence_zh: 被工廠污染後，這條水道變得不宜游泳。

definition_zh: (形) 水分多的；稀薄的
example_sentence: Students brought umbrellas to avoid the watery puddles on campus.
sentence_zh: 學生們帶傘以避免校園裡積水的水坑。

definition_zh: (名) 瓦特（電功率單位）
example_sentence: Because the light bulb uses 60 watts, the classroom stays bright.
sentence_zh: 因為燈泡使用60瓦，教室保持明亮。

definition_zh: (片) 揮手驅開；不予理會；不當一回事
example_sentence: The principal waved aside the students' complaints about the new rule.
sentence_zh: 校長對學生們關於新規定的抱怨不予理會。

definition_zh: (片) 攔下（車輛或人）
example_sentence: When the bus broke down, the teacher waved down a passing car for help.
sentence_zh: 當巴士拋錨時，老師攔下一輛經過的汽車求助。

definition_zh: (片) 揮手打發；拒絕
example_sentence: The teacher tried to wave off the student's excuses for being late.
sentence_zh: 老師試圖揮手打發學生遲到的藉口。

definition_zh: (片) 揮手致意；示意前進
example_sentence: The crowd wave on the parade that passed through the town.
sentence_zh: 人群向穿過小鎮的遊行隊伍揮手致意。

definition_zh:
(動) 揮動；揮手
(名) 波浪；波
example_sentence: Students wave goodbye to their families before leaving for school.
sentence_zh: 學生們在離家上學前向家人揮手告別。

definition_zh: (動) 動搖；猶豫
example_sentence: The student's resolve began to waver after the difficult exam.
sentence_zh: 這位學生在困難的考試後，決心開始動搖。

definition_zh: (形) 波浪的；起伏的
example_sentence: Students use a comb to create wavy patterns in their hair.
sentence_zh: 學生們用梳子在頭髮上創造波浪圖案。

definition_zh: (名) 蠟　(動) 打蠟；上蠟
example_sentence: If the floor wax dried too quickly, the janitor would reapply it carefully.
sentence_zh: 如果地板蠟乾得太快，管理員會仔細重新塗抹。

definition_zh: (形) 奇怪的；與眾不同的
example_sentence: If this plan seems way-out, the teacher will explain it again.
sentence_zh: 如果這個計畫聽起來很奇怪，老師會再解釋一次。

definition_zh: (名) 方法；道路
example_sentence: The best way to learn English is through daily practice.
sentence_zh: 學習英文最好的方法是透過每天練習。

definition_zh: (形) 虛弱的；無力的
example_sentence: Feeling weak after the exam, Tom drank some water.
sentence_zh: 考試後感到虛弱，湯姆喝了一些水。

definition_zh: (動) 削弱；變弱
example_sentence: The storm that hit the coast weakened the old bridge.
sentence_zh: 襲擊海岸的暴風雨削弱了那座舊橋。

definition_zh: (名) 弱點；缺點；沉迷
example_sentence: A weakness for social media can reduce study time.
sentence_zh: 對社群媒體的沉迷會減少讀書時間。

definition_zh: (名) 財富；財產
example_sentence: The family's wealth grew steadily through careful investments.
sentence_zh: 這個家庭的財富透過謹慎的投資穩定增長。

definition_zh: (形) 富有的；富裕的
example_sentence: A wealthy businessman donated new computers to the school library.
sentence_zh: 一位富有的商人捐贈了新電腦給學校圖書館。

definition_zh: (片) 戒除；逐漸脫離
example_sentence: The doctor helped the patient wean off painkillers slowly.
sentence_zh: 醫生幫助病人慢慢戒掉止痛藥。

definition_zh: (名) 武器；兵器
example_sentence: If Taiwan had no powerful weapon, its security would be at risk.
sentence_zh: 如果台灣沒有強大的武器，其安全將會受到威脅。

definition_zh: (片) 磨損；侵蝕；消耗
example_sentence: The constant wind and rain wear away the ancient stone walls over time.
sentence_zh: 持續的風雨隨著時間侵蝕了古老的石牆。

definition_zh: (片) 磨損；使疲憊
example_sentence: If students wore down their shoes too quickly, their parents would complain.
sentence_zh: 如果學生把鞋子磨損得太快，他們的父母會抱怨。

definition_zh: (片) 消退；磨損
example_sentence: If the medicine wears off, the pain will return quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果藥效消退，疼痛很快就會回來。

definition_zh: (片) 磨損；耗盡
example_sentence: My old schoolbag started to wear out after three years of use.
sentence_zh: 我的舊書包用了三年後開始磨損。

definition_zh: (動) 穿；戴
example_sentence: Students wear school uniforms to show their pride.
sentence_zh: 學生穿制服以展現他們的驕傲。

definition_zh: (形) 可穿戴的
example_sentence: Smartwatches that are wearable have become popular among students.
sentence_zh: 可穿戴的智慧手錶在學生間變得流行。

definition_zh: (名) 疲倦；厭倦
example_sentence: The long hike up the mountain caused great weariness in the students.
sentence_zh: 漫長的山區徒步旅行讓學生們感到極度疲憊。

definition_zh: (動) 逃避；推卸
example_sentence: The student who tried to weasel out of his homework faced detention.
sentence_zh: 那個試圖逃避作業的學生被罰留校。

definition_zh: (名) 天氣　(動) 平安度過；風化
example_sentence: Weather permitting, the school will hold the sports day outside.
sentence_zh: 如果天氣允許，學校將在戶外舉行運動會。

definition_zh: (動) 編織；編造
example_sentence: The basket that my grandmother weaves is very beautiful.
sentence_zh: 我祖母編織的籃子非常漂亮。

definition_zh: (名) 網；網路
example_sentence: The web of lies that the politician told finally collapsed.
sentence_zh: 那位政治人物編造的謊言網最終崩潰了。

definition_zh: (名) 網站
example_sentence: This website offers many useful resources for learning English.
sentence_zh: 這個網站提供許多學習英語的有用資源。

definition_zh: (動) 結婚；娶；嫁
example_sentence: The famous actress will wed her longtime boyfriend next spring.
sentence_zh: 那位著名女演員將於明年春天與她的長期男友結婚。

definition_zh: (名) 婚禮
example_sentence: Before the wedding, the bride practiced her speech carefully.
sentence_zh: 婚禮前，新娘仔細練習了她的演講。

definition_zh: (名) 楔子；楔形物　(動) 楔入；擠入
example_sentence: Seldom does a small wedge split a large log.
sentence_zh: 很少有一塊小楔子能劈開大木頭。

definition_zh: (名) 星期三
example_sentence: Many students study in the library every Wednesday to prepare for exams.
sentence_zh: 許多學生每週三在圖書館讀書以準備考試。

definition_zh: (形) 小的；極小的　(名) 一點點；一會兒
example_sentence: Having a wee break between classes helps students recharge.
sentence_zh: 在課堂之間休息一小段時間有助於學生恢復精力。

definition_zh: (片) 淘汰；剔除
example_sentence: Not only did the teacher weed out lazy students, but she also motivated them.
sentence_zh: 老師不僅淘汰了懶惰的學生，還激勵了他們。

definition_zh: (動) 除草；排除　(名) 雜草
example_sentence: If students weed out distractions, their focus improves.
sentence_zh: 如果學生排除干擾，他們的專注力就會提升。

definition_zh: (名) 星期；週
example_sentence: This week, our class has a big test on Friday.
sentence_zh: 這個星期，我們班在星期五有一場大考試。

definition_zh: (名) 平日；工作日
example_sentence: The library stays open until nine on every weekday.
sentence_zh: 圖書館每個工作日都開放到晚上九點。

definition_zh: (名) 週末
example_sentence: Finishing all homework before the weekend, the student felt relieved.
sentence_zh: 在週末前完成所有作業，這位學生感到如釋重負。

definition_zh: (形) 每週的；(副) 每週一次
example_sentence: The teacher assigns a weekly quiz to help students review.
sentence_zh: 老師指派每週小考來幫助學生複習。

definition_zh: (動) 哭泣；流淚
example_sentence: The old movie made the students weep for the lost love.
sentence_zh: 那部老電影讓學生們為失去的愛哭泣。

definition_zh: (名) 象鼻蟲；穀象蟲
example_sentence: Farmers use natural methods to control the weevil population in rice fields.
sentence_zh: 農民使用自然方法來控制稻田裡的象鼻蟲數量。

definition_zh: (片) 壓迫；使沮喪
example_sentence: If exam pressure weighs down on students, their sleep quality suffers.
sentence_zh: 如果考試壓力壓在學生身上，他們的睡眠品質就會受影響。

definition_zh: (片) 對…發表意見；參與討論
example_sentence: Many experts weigh in on the environmental impact of plastic bags.
sentence_zh: 許多專家對塑膠袋的環境影響發表意見。

definition_zh: (片) 提出（意見、建議等）
example_sentence: Several experts weighed in with their opinions during the debate.
sentence_zh: 幾位專家在辯論中提出了他們的意見。

definition_zh: (片) 參與討論；發表意見
example_sentence: If the teacher asked for opinions, every student would weigh in with their thoughts.
sentence_zh: 如果老師徵求意見，每個學生都會表達自己的想法。

definition_zh: (片) 使…感到沉重；壓在…心頭
example_sentence: While preparing for the exam, the pressure began to weigh on her.
sentence_zh: 在準備考試的同時，壓力開始讓她感到沉重。

definition_zh: (片) 秤出；量出
example_sentence: The baker who carefully weighs out the flour makes perfect bread.
sentence_zh: 仔細秤量麵粉的麵包師傅能做出完美的麵包。

definition_zh: (片) 權衡；斟酌
example_sentence: Students must carefully weigh up the pros and cons before choosing a major.
sentence_zh: 學生在選擇主修前必須仔細權衡利弊。

definition_zh: (動) 稱重；重達
example_sentence: The package that weighs ten kilograms needs to be shipped today.
sentence_zh: 那個重達十公斤的包裹需要今天寄出。

definition_zh: (名) 重量；重物
example_sentence: The weight of this backpack is too much for a student to carry.
sentence_zh: 這個背包的重量對學生來說太重了，背不動。

definition_zh: (形) 奇怪的；古怪的
example_sentence: Finding a weird rock in the park, the student showed it to the teacher.
sentence_zh: 在公園裡發現一塊奇怪的石頭，那名學生把它拿給老師看。

definition_zh: (名) 歡迎　(動) 歡迎　(形) 受歡迎的
example_sentence: Whenever a new student arrives, the teacher gives a warm welcome.
sentence_zh: 每當有新學生到來，老師都會熱烈歡迎。

definition_zh: (動) 焊接；鍛接
example_sentence: The metal pieces need to be welded together for the project.
sentence_zh: 這些金屬片需要為了這個專案焊接在一起。

definition_zh: (名) 福利；福祉
example_sentence: Many citizens worry about the welfare of stray animals in winter.
sentence_zh: 許多市民擔心冬天流浪動物的福祉。

definition_zh: (動) 湧上；湧現
example_sentence: Seeing the abandoned puppy, tears welled up in her eyes.
sentence_zh: 看到被遺棄的小狗，淚水湧上她的眼眶。

definition_zh: (名) 福祉；健康
example_sentence: Exercising regularly, many students improve their mental well-being.
sentence_zh: 經常運動，許多學生改善了他們的心理健康。

definition_zh: (形) 完善的；發育良好的
example_sentence: Students attend the camp to develop well-developed communication skills.
sentence_zh: 學生參加營隊以培養完善的溝通技巧。

definition_zh: (形) 全熟的；做得好的
example_sentence: The steak that the chef prepared was well-done and flavorful.
sentence_zh: 廚師準備的那塊牛排是全熟且美味的。

definition_zh: (形) 著名的；眾所周知的
example_sentence: This well-known author will visit our school next month.
sentence_zh: 這位知名作家下個月將訪問我們學校。

definition_zh: (形) 好心的；善意的
example_sentence: Having been helped by a well-meaning stranger, the lost student found his way.
sentence_zh: 受到一位好心的陌生人幫助後，迷路的學生找到了路。

definition_zh: (副) 好；充分地　(形) 健康的；良好的　(名) 井；源泉
example_sentence: The students did well on the math test this morning.
sentence_zh: 學生們今天早上的數學考試考得很好。

definition_zh: (形) 有名的；著名的
example_sentence: Although this author is wellknown, few students have read her books.
sentence_zh: 雖然這位作者很有名，但很少有學生讀過她的書。

definition_zh: (形) 富裕的；有錢的
example_sentence: Growing up in a welloff family, Linda never worried about tuition fees.
sentence_zh: 在富裕家庭長大，琳達從不擔心學費。

definition_zh: (名) 西方；西部　(形) 西方的；向西的　(副) 向西地
example_sentence: Seldom does the west wind bring such warm weather in winter.
sentence_zh: 西風很少在冬天帶來如此溫暖的天氣。

definition_zh: (形) 西方的；西式的
example_sentence: Many students study Western history to understand global culture better.
sentence_zh: 許多學生研讀西方歷史，以更了解全球文化。

definition_zh: (名) 西方人；西洋人
example_sentence: When a westerner visits a night market, they often try stinky tofu.
sentence_zh: 當一個西方人參觀夜市時，他們常常會嘗試臭豆腐。

definition_zh: (形) 潮濕的；下雨的　(動) 弄濕
example_sentence: Getting wet in the rain, the students ran quickly to the classroom.
sentence_zh: 在雨中淋濕後，學生們快速跑向教室。

definition_zh: (名) 鯨魚
example_sentence: A whale can stay underwater for a long time.
sentence_zh: 鯨魚可以在水下待很長的時間。

definition_zh: (名) 碼頭；埠頭
example_sentence: The old wharf near the harbor is a popular spot for fishing.
sentence_zh: 港口附近的舊碼頭是受歡迎的釣魚地點。

definition_zh: (片) 如果...怎麼辦；要是...會怎樣
example_sentence: What if the school bus does not arrive on time tomorrow?
sentence_zh: 如果校車明天沒有準時到達怎麼辦？

definition_zh: (片) 而且；更重要的是
example_sentence: Studying regularly is important; what is more, it helps reduce exam stress.
sentence_zh: 定期念書很重要；更重要的是，它有助於減輕考試壓力。

definition_zh: (代) 什麼；(形) 什麼的；(副) 多麼
example_sentence: What do you think about the new school library?
sentence_zh: 你覺得新的學校圖書館怎麼樣？

definition_zh: (代) 無論什麼；任何事物　(形) 任何的；不管怎樣的
example_sentence: If whatever happens during the game, the team will stay calm.
sentence_zh: 如果比賽中發生任何事情，球隊都會保持冷靜。

definition_zh: (副) 絲毫；任何（用於否定句或疑問句，加強語氣）　(代) 無論什麼
example_sentence: The teacher found no reason whatsoever to change the exam date.
sentence_zh: 老師找不到任何理由更改考試日期。

definition_zh: (名) 小麥
example_sentence: Farmers in Taiwan often grow wheat during the cooler winter months.
sentence_zh: 台灣的農民常在較涼爽的冬季月份種植小麥。

definition_zh: (片) 轉身；突然轉向
example_sentence: Wheeling around suddenly, the teacher spotted the student cheating on the test.
sentence_zh: 突然轉過身，老師發現了考試作弊的學生。

definition_zh: (片) 搬出（論點、藉口等）；推出（東西）
example_sentence: Wheeling out old arguments, the politician failed to convince the audience.
sentence_zh: 搬出老舊的論點，那位政治家未能說服聽眾。

definition_zh: (名) 輪子；方向盤
example_sentence: The wheel of the bicycle needs to be fixed.
sentence_zh: 腳踏車的輪子需要修理。

definition_zh: (名) 獨輪車；手推車
example_sentence: After the rain stopped, the gardener used a wheelbarrow to move the soil.
sentence_zh: 雨停之後，園丁用獨輪車搬運土壤。

definition_zh: (名) 輪椅
example_sentence: The new student who uses a wheelchair joins our class today.
sentence_zh: 那位使用輪椅的新同學今天加入我們班。

definition_zh: (片) 當談到；涉及
example_sentence: When it comes to studying for exams, time management is essential.
sentence_zh: 當談到為考試而學習時，時間管理是必要的。

definition_zh: (連) 當...時　(副) 何時
example_sentence: Students study hard when preparing for the CSAT exam.
sentence_zh: 學生在準備學測考試時努力學習。

definition_zh: (連) 每當；無論何時
example_sentence: Whenever the bell rings, students rush to the cafeteria.
sentence_zh: 每當鈴聲響起，學生們就會衝向餐廳。

definition_zh: (副) 在哪裡；到哪裡
example_sentence: Not knowing where to go, the lost student asked a teacher for help.
sentence_zh: 不知道要去哪裡，迷路的學生向老師求助。

definition_zh: (名) 下落；行蹤
example_sentence: If the student knew the whereabouts of the missing book, he would return it.
sentence_zh: 如果那位學生知道那本不見的書的下落，他會歸還它。

definition_zh: (連) 然而；鑑於
example_sentence: Many students prefer online courses, whereas traditional classes offer more interaction.
sentence_zh: 許多學生偏好線上課程，而傳統課堂則提供更多互動。

definition_zh: (副) 藉此；憑藉
example_sentence: The teacher explained a method whereby students can improve their writing skills.
sentence_zh: 老師解釋了一種方法，學生藉此可以提升寫作技巧。

definition_zh: (連) 無論哪裡
example_sentence: Wherever the students go, their backpacks are full of books.
sentence_zh: 無論學生去哪裡，他們的背包都裝滿了書。

definition_zh: (連) 是否；不管
example_sentence: Whether the school will hold the sports day depends on the weather.
sentence_zh: 學校是否舉辦運動會取決於天氣。

definition_zh: (連) 是否
example_sentence: The teacher asked whether the students understood the lesson.
sentence_zh: 老師問學生是否理解了這堂課。

definition_zh: (名) 乳清
example_sentence: A cheese factory produces whey as a byproduct during the process.
sentence_zh: 乳酪工廠在生產過程中產生乳清作為副產品。

definition_zh: (代) 哪一個；哪些　(形) 哪一個；哪些
example_sentence: The book which I borrowed from the library is very interesting.
sentence_zh: 我從圖書館借的那本書非常有趣。

definition_zh: (連) 無論哪個；任何一個
example_sentence: Whichever route the hikers choose, safety must come first.
sentence_zh: 無論登山者選擇哪條路線，安全必須是第一優先。

definition_zh: (名) 一聞；一股氣味　(動) 嗅；聞
example_sentence: The chef took a quick whiff of the soup to check its seasoning.
sentence_zh: 廚師快速聞了一下湯，以檢查其調味。

definition_zh: (片) 虛度；消磨（時間）
example_sentence: If students while away their summer break, they may regret it later.
sentence_zh: 如果學生們虛度暑假，他們之後可能會後悔。

definition_zh: (連) 當...的時候；雖然　(名) 一段時間　(動) 消磨（時間）
example_sentence: Students often listen to music while studying for exams.
sentence_zh: 學生們常常在準備考試時聽音樂。

definition_zh: (連) 當...的時候；與此同時
example_sentence: Students can listen to music whilst studying for exams.
sentence_zh: 學生可以在準備考試的同時聽音樂。

definition_zh: (名) 一時的興致；心血來潮
example_sentence: The decision was based on a sudden whim, not careful planning.
sentence_zh: 這個決定是基於一時的興致，而不是仔細的規劃。

definition_zh: (形) 異想天開的；古怪的
example_sentence: Walking through the art exhibition, students admired the whimsical sculptures.
sentence_zh: 走過藝術展覽，學生們欣賞那些奇思妙想的雕塑。

definition_zh: (名) 哀鳴；抱怨　(動) 哀鳴；抱怨
example_sentence: The dog's constant whine annoyed the neighbors during the night.
sentence_zh: 那隻狗持續的哀鳴在夜裡惹惱了鄰居。

definition_zh: (片) 激起；使…陷入（某種狀態）
example_sentence: The coach's speech whipped the team into a frenzy before the game.
sentence_zh: 教練的演說在比賽前讓隊伍陷入狂熱。

definition_zh: (動) 迅速拿出；突然抽出
example_sentence: The student whipped out his phone to check the exam schedule.
sentence_zh: 那個學生迅速拿出手機查看考試時間表。

definition_zh: (片) 快速完成；匆匆做完
example_sentence: Linda managed to whip through her math homework before dinner.
sentence_zh: 琳達設法在晚餐前快速完成了她的數學作業。

definition_zh: (動) 迅速做；激起
example_sentence: The chef who can whip up a feast quickly is highly respected.
sentence_zh: 那位能迅速準備盛宴的廚師備受尊敬。

definition_zh: (名) 鞭子；打蛋器　(動) 鞭打；攪打
example_sentence: The chef used a metal whip to beat the cream quickly.
sentence_zh: 廚師用金屬打蛋器快速攪打奶油。

definition_zh: (動) 旋轉；急轉
example_sentence: Students often whirl their backpacks to show excitement after class.
sentence_zh: 學生們經常在課後甩動背包來表示興奮。

definition_zh: (片) 迅速帶走；急忙送走
example_sentence: The butler whisked away the teacups before the guests noticed.
sentence_zh: 管家在客人注意到之前迅速收走了茶杯。

definition_zh: (動) 攪拌；拂去
example_sentence: Seldom does a chef whisk the eggs so vigorously for a perfect omelet.
sentence_zh: 廚師很少如此用力攪拌雞蛋來做出完美的蛋捲。

definition_zh: (名) 威士忌
example_sentence: If my grandfather drank whiskey, he would become very talkative.
sentence_zh: 如果我祖父喝威士忌，他會變得非常健談。

definition_zh: (動) 低聲說話；耳語　(名) 低語；耳語
example_sentence: During the test, the students whisper to each other quietly.
sentence_zh: 考試期間，學生們互相低聲說話。

definition_zh: (名) 哨子；哨聲　(動) 吹口哨；鳴笛
example_sentence: The referee's loud whistle signaled the end of the game.
sentence_zh: 裁判響亮的哨聲標誌著比賽的結束。

definition_zh: (名) 吹口哨的人；發出嘯聲的東西
example_sentence: The whistler at the park attracted a small crowd of listeners.
sentence_zh: 公園裡吹口哨的人吸引了一小群聽眾。

definition_zh: (動) 使一片空白；使模糊不清
example_sentence: Seldom does a heavy snow white out the entire campus so quickly.
sentence_zh: 一場大雪很少如此快速地使整個校園一片空白。

definition_zh: (形) 白色的　(名) 白色
example_sentence: If it snows tomorrow, the white ground will look beautiful.
sentence_zh: 如果明天下雪，白色的地面會看起來很美。

definition_zh: (名) 美白劑；增白劑
example_sentence: This whitener makes my teeth look brighter and cleaner.
sentence_zh: 這種美白劑讓我的牙齒看起來更亮更乾淨。

definition_zh: (動) 削；削減；雕刻
example_sentence: The craftsman who whittles wooden figures is admired by many students.
sentence_zh: 那位雕刻木偶的工匠受到許多學生的敬佩。

definition_zh: (動) 迅速移動；快速做　(名) 高手；奇才
example_sentence: The student who whizzes through math tests is a computer whiz.
sentence_zh: 那個迅速完成數學測驗的學生是個電腦高手。

definition_zh: (動) 快速移動；快速做
example_sentence: Students use online forums to whizz through difficult homework problems.
sentence_zh: 學生使用線上論壇快速解決困難的作業問題。

definition_zh: (代) 無論誰；任何人
example_sentence: Whoever finishes the project first will get a prize.
sentence_zh: 任何先完成專案的人都會得到獎品。

definition_zh: (形) 整個的；全部的　(名) 全部；整體
example_sentence: The whole class worked together to finish the project on time.
sentence_zh: 全班同學一起合作，按時完成了這個專題。

definition_zh: (副) 以批發方式　(形) 批發的；大規模的
example_sentence: Buying wholesale saves students money on group gifts.
sentence_zh: 批發購買為學生在團體禮物上省錢。

definition_zh: (形) 有益健康的；健全的
example_sentence: Eating a wholesome breakfast gives students the energy they need for morning classes.
sentence_zh: 吃一頓有益健康的早餐能給學生上午上課所需的精力。

definition_zh: (副) 完全地；全部地
example_sentence: Having wholly dedicated herself to the project, Amy finished it ahead of schedule.
sentence_zh: 完全投入於這個專案後，艾咪提前完成了它。

definition_zh: (代) 誰（受格）
example_sentence: The student whom the teacher praised is my best friend.
sentence_zh: 那位被老師稱讚的學生是我最好的朋友。

definition_zh: (代) 無論誰；任何人（whom 的強調形式，用於動詞或介詞後）
example_sentence: The teacher will help whomever needs assistance with the project.
sentence_zh: 老師會幫助任何需要專題協助的人。

definition_zh: (代) 誰的；哪個人的
example_sentence: If a student whose parents are teachers had more time, he would study harder.
sentence_zh: 如果一個父母是老師的學生有更多時間，他會更努力讀書。

definition_zh: (副) 為什麼；(連) 為什麼
example_sentence: The teacher explained why the experiment failed in class.
sentence_zh: 老師在課堂上解釋了為什麼實驗失敗。

definition_zh: (形) 邪惡的；壞的
example_sentence: The wicked witch cast a spell on the sleeping princess.
sentence_zh: 邪惡的女巫對沉睡的公主施了咒語。

definition_zh: (形) 寬邊的
example_sentence: When hiking in the sun, a wide-brimmed hat offers the best protection.
sentence_zh: 在太陽下健行時，寬邊帽提供最好的保護。

definition_zh: (形) 寬的；廣泛的
example_sentence: The river near our school is wide and clean.
sentence_zh: 我們學校附近的河流又寬又乾淨。

definition_zh: (副) 廣泛地；普遍地
example_sentence: The book that is widely read by students offers great advice.
sentence_zh: 那本被學生廣泛閱讀的書提供了很好的建議。

definition_zh: (動) 加寬；擴大
example_sentence: The gap between the rich and the poor continues to widen every year.
sentence_zh: 貧富之間的差距每年持續擴大。

definition_zh: (形) 廣泛的；普遍的
example_sentence: The widespread use of smartphones has changed how students study.
sentence_zh: 智慧型手機的廣泛使用改變了學生的學習方式。

definition_zh: (名) 寡婦
example_sentence: The widow, raising three children alone, worked two jobs to support her family.
sentence_zh: 那位寡婦獨自撫養三個孩子，做兩份工作來養家。

definition_zh: (形) 喪偶的；寡居的
example_sentence: The widowed teacher still inspires her students with a smile.
sentence_zh: 那位喪偶的老師仍然用微笑激勵她的學生。

definition_zh: (名) 鰥夫
example_sentence: If Mr. Chen were a widower, he would join the community cooking class.
sentence_zh: 如果陳先生是鰥夫，他會參加社區烹飪課。

definition_zh: (名) 寬度；寬廣
example_sentence: The width of this table is too small for our books.
sentence_zh: 這張桌子的寬度對我們的書來說太小了。

definition_zh: (動) 使用（權力）；揮舞
example_sentence: When the mayor wields his power wisely, the city benefits greatly.
sentence_zh: 當市長明智地運用權力時，城市會大大受益。

definition_zh: (名) 妻子
example_sentence: The man whose wife is a teacher works at a hospital.
sentence_zh: 那位妻子是老師的男士在一家醫院工作。

definition_zh: (片) 嚇壞；失控
example_sentence: The news that made everyone wig out was the sudden exam.
sentence_zh: 讓每個人都嚇壞的消息是突然的考試。

definition_zh: (名) 假髮
example_sentence: Having worn a wig for the school play, Tom felt nervous on stage.
sentence_zh: 因為在學校話劇中戴了假髮，湯姆在台上感到緊張。

definition_zh: (片) 逃避；推卸
example_sentence: Tom tried to wiggle out of his homework by pretending to be sick.
sentence_zh: 湯姆試圖假裝生病來逃避作業。

definition_zh: (片) 設法逃脫；逃避（責任或困境）
example_sentence: Having wiggled out of the group project, Sam felt relieved.
sentence_zh: 設法逃脫了小組作業後，Sam感到如釋重負。

definition_zh: (動) 扭動；搖擺
example_sentence: The puppy began to wiggle its tail when the bell rang.
sentence_zh: 小狗開始搖尾巴，這時鈴聲響了。

definition_zh: (形) 野生的；狂野的
example_sentence: The wild dog that lives in the forest is very shy.
sentence_zh: 住在森林裡的那隻野狗非常害羞。

definition_zh: (名) 荒野；荒蕪之地
example_sentence: Hiking through the wilderness, the group found a hidden waterfall.
sentence_zh: 徒步穿越荒野時，這群隊伍發現了一座隱藏的瀑布。

definition_zh: (名) 野火
example_sentence: Because the wildfire spread rapidly, the entire forest was evacuated.
sentence_zh: 由於野火迅速蔓延，整片森林都被疏散了。

definition_zh: (名) 野生動物
example_sentence: Watching wildlife in their natural habitat requires patience and respect.
sentence_zh: 在自然棲息地觀察野生動物需要耐心和尊重。

definition_zh: (副) 瘋狂地；猛烈地
example_sentence: The crowd cheered wildly when the singer appeared on stage.
sentence_zh: 當歌手出現在舞台上時，群眾瘋狂地歡呼。

definition_zh: (助) 將會；(名) 意志；遺囑
example_sentence: If the weather is nice, Tom will go to the park.
sentence_zh: 如果天氣好，湯姆會去公園。

definition_zh: (形) 任性的；固執的
example_sentence: The student's willful refusal to follow instructions caused problems in class.
sentence_zh: 這個學生任性地拒絕遵循指示，在課堂上造成了問題。

definition_zh: (副) 故意地；任性地
example_sentence: The student who willfully ignored the teacher's advice failed the exam.
sentence_zh: 那個故意無視老師建議的學生考試沒過。

definition_zh: (名) 任性；固執
example_sentence: Her willfulness often leads to arguments with her parents.
sentence_zh: 她的任性常導致與父母的爭吵。

definition_zh: (形) 願意的；樂意的
example_sentence: The student is willing to help clean up the park on weekends.
sentence_zh: 這個學生願意在週末幫忙清理公園。

definition_zh: (副) 自願地；樂意地
example_sentence: Seldom would the students willingly join the early morning study group.
sentence_zh: 學生們很少自願加入清晨的讀書會。

definition_zh: (名) 意願；自願
example_sentence: The student's willingness to learn made her teacher proud.
sentence_zh: 這位學生的學習意願讓她的老師感到驕傲。

definition_zh: (名) 柳樹
example_sentence: The willow tree that grows near the school pond provides shade.
sentence_zh: 學校池塘旁那棵柳樹提供了樹蔭。

definition_zh: (名) 意志力；毅力
example_sentence: If a student lacks willpower, studying regularly becomes a real challenge.
sentence_zh: 如果學生缺乏意志力，定期讀書就會變成一個真正的挑戰。

definition_zh: (片) 退縮；膽怯
example_sentence: If David wimped out now, his teammates would lose trust in him.
sentence_zh: 如果大衛現在退縮，他的隊友就會失去對他的信任。

definition_zh: (名) 懦弱的人；膽小鬼
example_sentence: Feeling like a wimp, the student avoided the difficult math competition.
sentence_zh: 覺得自己像個懦夫，那名學生避開了困難的數學競賽。

definition_zh: (片) 贏得第一名
example_sentence: Training every day is necessary to win first place in the competition.
sentence_zh: 每天訓練是必要的，以便在比賽中贏得第一名。

definition_zh: (形) 雙贏的
example_sentence: Students who propose a win-win solution often earn respect from teachers.
sentence_zh: 提出雙贏解決方案的學生通常會獲得老師的尊重。

definition_zh: (動) 贏得；獲勝
example_sentence: The team that won the game received a big trophy.
sentence_zh: 贏得比賽的隊伍收到了一個大獎盃。

definition_zh: (片) 放鬆；減速
example_sentence: Listening to soft music helps students wind down after a long day of studying.
sentence_zh: 聽輕柔的音樂有助於學生在漫長的一天學習後放鬆下來。

definition_zh: (片) 快轉（影音內容）
example_sentence: The movie that made me wind on quickly was too boring.
sentence_zh: 那部讓我快速快轉的電影太無聊了。

definition_zh: (動) 結束；告終　(片) 結束；最終處於
example_sentence: If the team winds up the project early, the manager will praise everyone.
sentence_zh: 如果團隊提早結束專案，經理會表揚每個人。

definition_zh: (名) 風
example_sentence: The wind blew so hard that the students could not open their umbrellas.
sentence_zh: 風吹得太強，學生們打不開他們的雨傘。

definition_zh: (形) 蜿蜒的；曲折的
example_sentence: If the winding road confuses you, use a GPS.
sentence_zh: 如果這條蜿蜒的道路讓你困惑，請使用導航。

definition_zh: (名) 窗戶；窗口
example_sentence: Students opened the window to let in fresh air.
sentence_zh: 學生們打開窗戶讓新鮮空氣進來。

definition_zh: (名) 窗台
example_sentence: The cat slept on the windowsill all afternoon.
sentence_zh: 那隻貓在窗台上睡了一整個下午。

definition_zh: (名) 擋風玻璃
example_sentence: The cracked windshield needs to be replaced before the typhoon arrives.
sentence_zh: 這塊破裂的擋風玻璃需要在颱風來臨前更換。

definition_zh: (名) 結束；收尾
example_sentence: The windup of the project caused a lot of stress for the team.
sentence_zh: 這個專案的結束給團隊帶來了很多壓力。

definition_zh: (形) 颳風的；風大的
example_sentence: The windy weather made it hard to ride a bike.
sentence_zh: 颳風的天氣讓騎腳踏車變得很困難。

definition_zh: (名) 葡萄酒；酒
example_sentence: My grandfather enjoys a glass of red wine with dinner every evening.
sentence_zh: 我祖父每天晚餐時都喜歡喝一杯紅酒。

definition_zh: (名) 翅膀；機翼　(動) 飛翔
example_sentence: Seldom does a broken wing heal without proper care.
sentence_zh: 折斷的翅膀很少能在沒有適當照顧下痊癒。

definition_zh: (名) 翅膀；翼　(動) 飛行；飛翔
example_sentence: The bird's left wing was injured after it hit the window.
sentence_zh: 這隻鳥的左翅在撞到窗戶後受傷了。

definition_zh: (名) 邊鋒；翼鋒
example_sentence: The right winger scored a goal during the soccer match.
sentence_zh: 右翼前鋒在足球比賽中進了一球。

definition_zh: (動) 眨眼；閃爍
example_sentence: The bright light made the baby wink several times.
sentence_zh: 明亮的燈光讓嬰兒眨了好幾次眼睛。

definition_zh: (片) 揭露；找出
example_sentence: The journalist who winked out the truth faced serious threats.
sentence_zh: 那位揭露真相的記者面臨了嚴重的威脅。

definition_zh: (名) 贏家；獲勝者
example_sentence: The student who became the winner practiced every day.
sentence_zh: 成為贏家的那名學生每天練習。

definition_zh: (動) 贏；獲勝　(形) 勝利的；成功的
example_sentence: Winning the science fair boosted her confidence in school.
sentence_zh: 贏得科展增強了她在學校的信心。

definition_zh: (名) 冬天；冬季
example_sentence: Walking to school in winter, the student wore a thick scarf.
sentence_zh: 冬天走路去上學時，那名學生戴著一條厚圍巾。

definition_zh: (片) 消滅；徹底摧毀
example_sentence: The disease that wiped out the ancient civilization remains a mystery.
sentence_zh: 消滅古老文明的那種疾病仍是個謎。

definition_zh: (動) 擦；拭去
example_sentence: If the students wiped the whiteboard, the teacher would be happy.
sentence_zh: 如果學生們擦乾淨白板，老師會很開心。

definition_zh: (名) 金屬線；電線　(動) 用金屬線連接；安裝電線
example_sentence: The wire connecting the computer to the printer is too short.
sentence_zh: 連接電腦和印表機的電線太短了。

definition_zh: (名) 電線；線路
example_sentence: The old wiring in the building caused a short circuit during the storm.
sentence_zh: 大樓內的舊電線在暴風雨中導致了短路。

definition_zh: (形) 瘦而結實的；堅韌的
example_sentence: The wiry little dog escaped from the backyard through a tiny hole.
sentence_zh: 那隻瘦小而結實的小狗從後院的一個小洞逃了出去。

definition_zh: (名) 智慧；明智
example_sentence: The old farmer shared his wisdom with the young students.
sentence_zh: 老農夫與年輕學生分享他的智慧。

definition_zh: (片) 醒悟；識破；明白過來
example_sentence: The student who wised up to the trick avoided the scam.
sentence_zh: 那個識破把戲的學生避免了這場騙局。

definition_zh: (形) 明智的；聰明的

definition_zh: (片) 寫入；記下
example_sentence: Students who write in their journals every day often improve their writing skills.
sentence_zh: 每天寫日記的學生通常能提升寫作技巧。

definition_zh: (動) 取消；註銷　(片) 註銷；報廢
example_sentence: The company decided to write off the damaged equipment as a loss.
sentence_zh: 公司決定將損壞的設備作為損失沖銷。

definition_zh: (片) 寫出；全文寫下
example_sentence: Writing out the entire essay, the student felt a sense of accomplishment.
sentence_zh: 把整篇文章寫出來後，學生感到一種成就感。

definition_zh: (片) 撰寫；詳細記錄
example_sentence: The teacher asked the students to write up their lab reports carefully.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生仔細撰寫他們的實驗報告。

definition_zh: (動) 寫；書寫
example_sentence: Excited about the new topic, the student began to write an essay.
sentence_zh: 對新主題感到興奮，那位學生開始寫一篇作文。

definition_zh: (名) 作家；作者
example_sentence: The young writer finished her first novel last month.
sentence_zh: 那位年輕作家上個月完成了她的第一本小說。

definition_zh: (名) 寫作；書寫　(動) 寫（write的動名詞）
example_sentence: After finishing her homework, the student spent two hours writing a short story.
sentence_zh: 完成作業後，那名學生花了兩小時寫一篇短篇故事。

definition_zh: (動) 寫（write的過去分詞）
example_sentence: The article written by the student won first prize.
sentence_zh: 這篇由學生寫的文章贏得了第一名。

definition_zh: (形) 錯誤的；不對的　(副) 錯誤地　(名) 錯誤；壞事
example_sentence: Having taken the wrong bus, the student arrived at the wrong school.
sentence_zh: 搭錯公車後，那名學生到了錯誤的學校。

definition_zh: (名) 不法行為；壞事
example_sentence: Caught in the act of wrongdoing, the student faced serious consequences.
sentence_zh: 當場被抓到有不法行為時，那名學生面臨了嚴重的後果。

definition_zh: (形) 鍛造的；精心製作的
example_sentence: The wrought iron gate, which was crafted in the 19th century, still stands.
sentence_zh: 這扇鍛鐵大門於19世紀打造，至今依然矗立。

definition_zh: (名) ['ɛksˌre] X光；X光檢查　(動) [ɛks're] 用X光檢查
example_sentence: After the doctor ordered an x-ray, the patient waited nervously in the hallway.
sentence_zh: 醫生安排X光檢查後，病人緊張地在走廊等候。

definition_zh: (動) 影印
example_sentence: The student who xeroxed the handout forgot to collate the pages.
sentence_zh: 那位影印講義的學生忘了整理頁面。

definition_zh: (名) 遊艇；帆船
example_sentence: Sailing a yacht across the ocean requires careful planning and teamwork.
sentence_zh: 駕駛遊艇橫越海洋需要仔細的規劃和團隊合作。

definition_zh: (片) 喋喋不休；嘮叨
example_sentence: The teacher told the students to stop yacking on during the lesson.
sentence_zh: 老師告訴學生們在課堂上停止喋喋不休。

definition_zh: (名) 山藥；番薯
example_sentence: My grandmother uses yam to make a sweet soup for the family.
sentence_zh: 我祖母用山藥為家人煮甜湯。

definition_zh: (片) 喋喋不休；抱怨不停
example_sentence: The teacher warned the students not to yammer on during class.
sentence_zh: 老師警告學生不要在課堂上喋喋不休。

definition_zh: (動) 用力拉；猛拉
example_sentence: When the teacher tried to fix the projector, a student yanked the cord.
sentence_zh: 當老師試著修理投影機時，一名學生用力拉了一下電線。

definition_zh: (名) 院子；庭院
example_sentence: Standing in the yard, the teacher watched the students play basketball.
sentence_zh: 站在院子裡，老師看著學生們打籃球。

definition_zh: (名) 紗線；毛線
example_sentence: My grandmother uses colorful yarn to knit warm scarves every winter.
sentence_zh: 我的祖母每年冬天都用彩色紗線編織溫暖的圍巾。

definition_zh: (名) 哈欠　(動) 打哈欠
example_sentence: The teacher tried to hide a yawn during the long meeting.
sentence_zh: 老師在冗長的會議中試圖掩飾一個哈欠。

definition_zh: (副) 是的；對
example_sentence: Yeah, the math test was really hard this morning.
sentence_zh: 是啊，今天早上的數學考試真的很難。

definition_zh: (名) 年；年份
example_sentence: The year when we graduate is full of exciting changes.
sentence_zh: 我們畢業的那一年充滿了令人興奮的變化。

definition_zh: (名) 一歲大的動物；幼畜
example_sentence: The farmer raised the yearling carefully to prepare it for the winter market.
sentence_zh: 農夫細心飼養這隻一歲大的動物，以準備牠在冬季市場出售。

definition_zh: (形) 每年的；一年一度的　(副) 每年；一年一次地
example_sentence: If the school held a yearly festival, students would enjoy more activities.
sentence_zh: 如果學校舉辦一年一度的節日，學生們會享受更多活動。

definition_zh: (動) 渴望；嚮往
example_sentence: Many students yearn for a break from their heavy study load.
sentence_zh: 許多學生渴望從繁重的課業負擔中休息一下。

definition_zh: (名) 酵母；發酵劑
example_sentence: When the baker added yeast to the dough, the bread rose quickly.
sentence_zh: 當麵包師傅將酵母加入麵團時，麵包很快就膨脹了。

definition_zh: (動) 大喊；叫喊
example_sentence: The coach told the players not to yell during the game.
sentence_zh: 教練告訴球員們在比賽中不要大喊大叫。

definition_zh: (形) 黃色的
example_sentence: The yellow school bus picks up students every morning.
sentence_zh: 黃色的校車每天早上接學生。

definition_zh: (形) 微黃的；泛黃的
example_sentence: Having turned yellowish, the old textbook was still useful.
sentence_zh: 雖然已經泛黃，這本舊課本仍然有用。

definition_zh: (名) 日圓（日本貨幣單位）
example_sentence: The yen the traveler exchanged at the airport was enough for the trip.
sentence_zh: 那位旅客在機場兌換的日圓足夠這趟旅程。

definition_zh: (副) 是；是的　(名) 是；同意
example_sentence: A simple yes or no answer is fine.
sentence_zh: 一個簡單的是或否的回答就可以了。

definition_zh: (名) 昨天　(副) 在昨天
example_sentence: The math test yesterday was easier than the one today.
sentence_zh: 昨天的數學考試比今天的容易。

definition_zh: (副) 還；已經　(連) 然而
example_sentence: If the rain stopped yet, the game would start.
sentence_zh: 如果雨停了，比賽就會開始。

definition_zh: (片) 屈服於；讓步於
example_sentence: The student who refused to yield to peer pressure earned respect.
sentence_zh: 那個拒絕屈服於同儕壓力的學生贏得了尊重。

definition_zh: (動) 讓路；屈服　(名) 產量；收益
example_sentence: The driver had to yield to the ambulance on the highway.
sentence_zh: 駕駛在高速公路上必須讓路給救護車。

definition_zh: (形) 柔韌的；易彎曲的　(動) 屈服；讓步
example_sentence: The yielding branches of the bamboo tree bent easily in the strong wind.
sentence_zh: 竹子樹上柔韌的樹枝在強風中輕易彎曲。

definition_zh: (名) 瑜珈
example_sentence: If students practice yoga regularly, their stress will decrease.
sentence_zh: 如果學生定期練習瑜珈，他們的壓力就會減少。

definition_zh: (名) 優格；酸奶
example_sentence: The yogurt that my mother bought is very fresh.
sentence_zh: 我媽媽買的優格非常新鮮。

definition_zh: (名) 軛；重擔　(動) 結合；連接
example_sentence: The heavy yoke of homework burdened many students before exams.
sentence_zh: 繁重的作業重擔在考試前壓迫著許多學生。

definition_zh: (名) 蛋黃
example_sentence: Using only the egg yolk makes the cake richer in flavor.
sentence_zh: 只用蛋黃會讓蛋糕風味更濃郁。

definition_zh: (形) 年輕的；幼小的
example_sentence: If a young student works hard, good grades will follow.
sentence_zh: 如果一個年輕的學生努力學習，好成績就會隨之而來。

definition_zh: (名) 年輕人；小伙子
example_sentence: The energetic youngster joined the school's basketball team this year.
sentence_zh: 這個精力充沛的年輕人今年加入了學校的籃球隊。

definition_zh: (代) 你自己
example_sentence: If you believed in yourself, you would achieve more in school.
sentence_zh: 如果你相信自己，你在學校就會有更多成就。

definition_zh: (名) 年輕時期；青春
example_sentence: Many people believe that youth is the best time to explore new ideas.
sentence_zh: 很多人相信年輕時期是探索新想法的最佳時機。

definition_zh: (形) 年輕的；有朝氣的
example_sentence: Many students maintain a youthful spirit by staying curious and active.
sentence_zh: 許多學生透過保持好奇和活躍來維持年輕的心靈。

definition_zh: (形) 難吃的；令人噁心的
example_sentence: Finding the cafeteria food yucky, the students complained to the principal.
sentence_zh: 發現餐廳食物很難吃，學生們向校長抱怨。

definition_zh: (形) 好吃的；美味的
example_sentence: Finding the homemade cookies yummy, the students asked for the recipe.
sentence_zh: 學生們覺得自製餅乾很好吃，於是問了食譜。

definition_zh: (名) 咖啡杯套
example_sentence: The waiter placed a zarf on the table for the hot coffee.
sentence_zh: 服務生把一個咖啡杯套放在桌上，用來放熱咖啡。

definition_zh: (名) 熱情；熱忱
example_sentence: When the science fair began, Maria's zeal for renewable energy impressed the judges.
sentence_zh: 當科學展覽開始時，瑪麗亞對可再生能源的熱情給評審留下了深刻印象。

definition_zh: (名) 斑馬
example_sentence: The zoo keeper fed the hungry zebra some fresh grass.
sentence_zh: 動物園管理員餵了那隻飢餓的斑馬一些新鮮的草。

definition_zh: (名) 頂點；巔峰
example_sentence: The athlete reached the zenith of her career after winning the gold medal.
sentence_zh: 這位運動員在贏得金牌後達到了她職業生涯的巔峰。

definition_zh: (片) 集中於；瞄準
example_sentence: Never has the research team zeroed in on such a critical issue.
sentence_zh: 這個研究團隊從未如此精準地鎖定一個關鍵議題。

definition_zh: (片) 歸零；結清
example_sentence: After the project ends, the team will zero out the budget.
sentence_zh: 專案結束後，團隊將把預算歸零。

definition_zh: (名) 零；零點　(動) 歸零；把…調為零
example_sentence: Seldom does the chance to start from zero come again.
sentence_zh: 從零開始的機會很少再來。

definition_zh: (名) 熱情；風味；檸檬/柳橙皮屑
example_sentence: Adding a bit of lemon zest, the chef finished the cake with extra flavor.
sentence_zh: 加了一點檸檬皮屑，主廚用額外的風味完成了蛋糕。

definition_zh: (動) 曲折前進；蜿蜒而行　(名) 鋸齒形；之字形
example_sentence: Zigzagging through the crowded market, the boy lost his mother.
sentence_zh: 在擁擠的市場裡東彎西拐，那個男孩和媽媽走散了。

definition_zh: (名) 極大的數目；無數
example_sentence: This new video game has a zillion different levels to explore.
sentence_zh: 這款新電玩遊戲有數不清的不同關卡可以探索。

definition_zh: (名) 鋅
example_sentence: Zinc is an essential mineral for students' immune systems.
sentence_zh: 鋅是學生免疫系統必需的礦物質。

definition_zh: (片) 快速移動；四處穿梭
example_sentence: If Maria had a scooter, she would zip around the campus quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪麗亞有一台機車，她會在校園裡快速穿梭。

definition_zh: (片) 快速經過；飛逝
example_sentence: Time seems to zip by during the final exams.
sentence_zh: 時間在期末考期間似乎飛逝而過。

definition_zh: (片) 閉嘴；安靜
example_sentence: If the teacher starts talking, students should zip it and listen carefully.
sentence_zh: 如果老師開始講話，學生應該閉嘴並仔細聽。

definition_zh: (片) 拉上拉鍊；拉好拉鍊
example_sentence: The students always zip up their jackets before leaving the classroom.
sentence_zh: 學生們在離開教室前總是會把外套拉鍊拉好。

definition_zh: (名) 拉鍊　(動) 拉上拉鍊
example_sentence: If this zipper broke, my mother would zip my jacket quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果這個拉鍊壞了，我媽媽會很快地拉上我的夾克拉鍊。

definition_zh: (名) 拉鍊
example_sentence: If the zipper on your bag broke, a tailor could fix it quickly.
sentence_zh: 如果你包包上的拉鍊壞了，裁縫師可以快速修好它。

definition_zh: (片) 走神；恍神
example_sentence: During long lectures, many students zone out and miss important points.
sentence_zh: 在冗長的課堂中，許多學生會走神而錯過重點。

definition_zh: (名) 區域；地帶
example_sentence: Students must stay in the quiet zone during the exam.
sentence_zh: 學生在考試期間必須待在安靜區。

definition_zh: (片) 昏睡；睡著
example_sentence: After the long exam, many students zonk out on the sofa.
sentence_zh: 漫長考試後，許多學生在沙發上昏睡過去。

definition_zh: (名) 動物園
example_sentence: The zoo has many animals from different countries.
sentence_zh: 動物園有許多來自不同國家的動物。

definition_zh: (名) 動物園管理員
example_sentence: If a zookeeper forgot to lock the cage, the animals would escape.
sentence_zh: 如果動物園管理員忘記鎖上籠子，動物們就會逃脫。

definition_zh: (片) 放大；仔細觀察
example_sentence: Zooming in on the map, the student found the hidden park.
sentence_zh: 放大地圖後，那名學生找到了隱藏的公園。

definition_zh: (片) 拉近鏡頭；聚焦
example_sentence: The photographer zoomed in to capture the butterfly's wings clearly.
sentence_zh: 攝影師拉近鏡頭，清楚地捕捉蝴蝶的翅膀。

definition_zh: (片) 呼嘯而去；迅速離去
example_sentence: If the bus were late, my friend would zoom off on his scooter.
sentence_zh: 如果公車遲到，我朋友就會騎著他的機車呼嘯而去。

definition_zh: (動) 縮小（畫面或視野）
example_sentence: The photographer asked the students to zoom out for a wider view.
sentence_zh: 攝影師要求學生們縮小畫面以獲得更廣的視野。

definition_zh: (名) 變焦；縮放　(動) 快速移動；變焦
example_sentence: The camera zoom brought the distant mountain into clear view.
sentence_zh: 相機的變焦功能將遠山拉入清晰的視野。

definition_zh: (冠) 一個；一種
example_sentence: A student who studies hard will pass the exam easily.
sentence_zh: 一個用功的學生會輕鬆通過考試。

definition_zh: (名) 上午；午前
example_sentence: The alarm clock is set for 6:30 a.m. every morning.
sentence_zh: 鬧鐘每天早上設定在上午六點三十分。

definition_zh: (動) 是
example_sentence: Although I am tired, I still finish my homework before dinner.
sentence_zh: 雖然我很累，我仍然在晚餐前完成我的作業。

definition_zh: (連) 和；而且
example_sentence: My brother and I like to play basketball after school.
sentence_zh: 我哥哥和我喜歡放學後打籃球。

definition_zh: (副) 任何地方
example_sentence: Students can study anyplace in the library during break time.
sentence_zh: 學生可以在休息時間在圖書館的任何地方學習。

definition_zh: (名) 驚奇；驚訝
example_sentence: Having watched the magic trick, the whole class stared in astonishment.
sentence_zh: 看完魔術表演後，全班同學驚訝地注視著。

definition_zh: (介) 在（某處）
example_sentence: The students at the library were studying for their final exams.
sentence_zh: 在圖書館的學生們正在為期末考試而學習。

definition_zh: (名) 後院
example_sentence: The old tree in the backyard provides shade for the family.
sentence_zh: 後院的老樹為這家人提供了樹蔭。

definition_zh: (動) 是；成為　(助) 被；正在
example_sentence: If a student wants to be successful, he must work hard.
sentence_zh: 如果一個學生想要成功，他必須努力學習。

definition_zh: (形) 金黃色的；金髮的
example_sentence: The blond girl in my class is good at math.
sentence_zh: 我班上那個金髮女孩很擅長數學。

definition_zh: (名) 分手；分裂
example_sentence: After their breakup, Linda focused on her studies and hobbies.
sentence_zh: 分手後，琳達專注於她的學業和興趣。

definition_zh: (名) 計程車
example_sentence: My dad took a cab to the airport this morning.
sentence_zh: 我爸爸今天早上搭計程車去機場。

definition_zh: (名) 咖啡館；咖啡廳
example_sentence: The new café near our school serves great coffee.
sentence_zh: 我們學校附近的新咖啡館提供很棒的咖啡。

definition_zh: (名) 貓
example_sentence: If my cat had wings, it would fly around the room.
sentence_zh: 如果我的貓有翅膀，牠會在房間裡飛來飛去。

definition_zh: (名) 目錄；型錄　(動) 編目；列入目錄
example_sentence: The student used the online catalogue to find a book for her report.
sentence_zh: 那位學生使用線上目錄來找一本報告用的書。

definition_zh: (形) 細胞的；蜂窩式網路的；行動通訊的
example_sentence: If the cellular signal is weak, the video call will fail.
sentence_zh: 如果手機訊號微弱，視訊通話就會失敗。

definition_zh: (名) 女主席；女董事長
example_sentence: The chairwoman announced the new policy after the board meeting ended.
sentence_zh: 主席在董事會會議結束後宣布了新政策。

definition_zh: (名) 漫畫
example_sentence: Reading comics after school is a fun way to relax.
sentence_zh: 放學後看漫畫是一種有趣的放鬆方式。

definition_zh: (名) 祝賀；賀詞
example_sentence: Having received the award, Lisa's family offered their congratulations.
sentence_zh: 在獲獎之後，麗莎的家人表達了他們的祝賀。

definition_zh: (名) 女議員；女國會議員
example_sentence: The congresswoman who visited our school gave a speech about climate change.
sentence_zh: 那位拜訪我們學校的女議員發表了一場關於氣候變遷的演講。

definition_zh: (名) 相關；關聯
example_sentence: If scientists found a correlation between sleep and grades, students would sleep more.
sentence_zh: 如果科學家發現睡眠與成績之間的關聯，學生就會睡更多。

definition_zh: (名) 化妝品
example_sentence: Because her skin is sensitive, Mia avoids using cosmetics with strong chemicals.
sentence_zh: 因為她的皮膚敏感，Mia 避免使用含有強烈化學成分的化妝品。

definition_zh: (名) 標準；準則
example_sentence: The criteria that the teacher used were very strict.
sentence_zh: 老師使用的標準非常嚴格。

definition_zh: (名) 對話；意見交換
example_sentence: A meaningful dialogue between students can help solve school problems.
sentence_zh: 學生之間有意義的對話可以幫助解決學校問題。

definition_zh: (名) 圓盤；光碟
example_sentence: If the disc were scratched, the game would not load.
sentence_zh: 如果光碟被刮傷，遊戲將無法載入。

definition_zh: (名) 沮喪；氣餒
example_sentence: The student's discouragement after failing the test was clear.
sentence_zh: 那名學生考試失敗後的沮喪很明顯。

definition_zh: (動) 做；進行
example_sentence: If the students do their homework, they will learn better.
sentence_zh: 如果學生做作業，他們會學得更好。

definition_zh: (名) 文件；文檔
example_sentence: The doctor uses a doc to check the patient's medical history.
sentence_zh: 醫生用一份文件來查看病人的病歷。

definition_zh: (名) 狗
example_sentence: My neighbor's dog barks loudly every morning at seven.
sentence_zh: 我鄰居的狗每天早上七點大聲吠叫。

definition_zh: (名) 宿舍
example_sentence: Having finished cleaning the dorm, the students decided to order pizza.
sentence_zh: 打掃完宿舍後，學生們決定訂披薩。

definition_zh: (名) 耳機
example_sentence: Using earphones for too long can damage your hearing.
sentence_zh: 長時間使用耳機可能會損害你的聽力。

definition_zh: (名) 耳環；耳飾
example_sentence: Mary bought a pair of silver earrings for her mother.
sentence_zh: 瑪麗為她媽媽買了一對銀耳環。

definition_zh: (名) 電子郵件　(動) 寄電子郵件
example_sentence: The email that my teacher sent contains important homework instructions.
sentence_zh: 我的老師寄的電子郵件包含重要的作業說明。

definition_zh: (名) 增強；改進
example_sentence: Adding more memory is a simple enhancement for a slow computer.
sentence_zh: 為一台速度慢的電腦增加更多記憶體是一種簡單的增強。

definition_zh: (名) 啟蒙；教化
example_sentence: The pursuit of enlightenment requires patience and deep reflection.
sentence_zh: 追求啟蒙需要耐心和深刻的反思。

definition_zh: (名) 豐富；充實；滋養
example_sentence: Reading books on different cultures provides great enrichment for the mind.
sentence_zh: 閱讀不同文化的書籍能為心靈帶來豐富的滋養。

definition_zh: (動) 使平等；均衡
example_sentence: The new law aims to equalize educational opportunities for all students.
sentence_zh: 這項新法律旨在為所有學生平等化教育機會。

definition_zh: (名) 未婚夫
example_sentence: If Linda's fiancé moved abroad, she would consider following him.
sentence_zh: 如果琳達的未婚夫搬到國外，她會考慮跟他去。

definition_zh: (名) 消防員
example_sentence: The brave fireman rushed into the burning house to save a little girl.
sentence_zh: 這位勇敢的消防員衝進燃燒的房子裡去救一個小女孩。

definition_zh: (名) 女消防員
example_sentence: A firewoman helped our family escape the burning building.
sentence_zh: 一位女消防員幫助我們一家人逃出起火的建築物。

definition_zh: (名) 靈活性；彈性
example_sentence: Students who show flexibility in group projects often earn higher grades.
sentence_zh: 在小組專題中展現彈性的學生通常會獲得較高的成績。

definition_zh: (介) 為了；因為　(連) 因為
example_sentence: Students study hard for good grades in the final exam.
sentence_zh: 學生為了期末考試的好成績而努力學習。

definition_zh: (名) 薯條
example_sentence: Ordering a large fries, the student shared them with friends.
sentence_zh: 點了一份大薯條，這位學生和朋友們分享。

definition_zh: (名) 魅力；誘惑力
example_sentence: Seldom does the glamour of old movies fade with time.
sentence_zh: 老電影的魅力很少隨著時間褪色。

definition_zh: (名) 手套
example_sentence: Putting on her warm gloves, the girl went outside to play in the snow.
sentence_zh: 戴上溫暖的手套後，女孩到外面去玩雪。

definition_zh: (動) 去；走
example_sentence: The students go to school by bus every morning.
sentence_zh: 學生們每天早上搭公車去上學。

definition_zh: (名) 再見；告別　(感) 再見
example_sentence: Saying goodbye to a friend is always hard for me.
sentence_zh: 和朋友說再見對我來說總是很難。

definition_zh: (名) 問候；致意
example_sentence: My grandparents always exchange warm greetings during the Lunar New Year.
sentence_zh: 我的祖父母在農曆新年期間總是互相熱情問候。

definition_zh: (名) 海鷗
example_sentence: The hungry gull stole a sandwich from the beachgoer's hand.
sentence_zh: 那隻飢餓的海鷗從海灘遊客手中偷走了一個三明治。

definition_zh: (名) 河馬
example_sentence: The hippo in the zoo is very big and eats many plants.
sentence_zh: 動物園裡的河馬非常大，吃很多植物。

definition_zh: (名) 冰；冰淇淋　(動) 結冰；冷藏
example_sentence: After the ice melted, the cold drink became warm.
sentence_zh: 冰塊融化後，冷飲就變溫了。

definition_zh: (介) 在…內；在…期間　(副) 進入；在家　(形) 流行的；在職的
example_sentence: If the test were in the morning, students would arrive early.
sentence_zh: 如果考試在早上，學生們就會早到。

definition_zh: (名) 判斷；判決
example_sentence: Having exercised poor judgment, the student regretted his decision to skip class.
sentence_zh: 由於判斷失誤，這名學生後悔翹課的決定。

definition_zh: (動) 測量；衡量
example_sentence: The government measures the air quality daily to protect public health.
sentence_zh: 政府每天測量空氣品質以保護公眾健康。

definition_zh: (名) 麥克風
example_sentence: The teacher asked the student to speak into the mike during the presentation.
sentence_zh: 老師要求學生在簡報時對著麥克風說話。

definition_zh: (名) 壟斷；獨佔
example_sentence: The company's monopoly on internet services was unfair.
sentence_zh: 該公司對網路服務的壟斷是不公平的。

definition_zh: (名) 死亡率；必死性
example_sentence: The doctor's research on cancer mortality has saved many lives.
sentence_zh: 這位醫生關於癌症死亡率的研究拯救了許多生命。

definition_zh: (名) 電影；影片
example_sentence: If Maria watched that scary movie, she would have nightmares tonight.
sentence_zh: 如果瑪麗亞看了那部恐怖片，她今晚會做噩夢。

definition_zh: (名) 先生（稱呼）
example_sentence: The student who asked Mr. Wang a question got a clear answer.
sentence_zh: 那個問王老師問題的學生得到了一個清楚的答案。

definition_zh: (名) 太太；夫人
example_sentence: Mrs. Chen asked her students to finish the homework on time.
sentence_zh: 陳太太要求她的學生準時完成作業。

definition_zh: (名) 女士；太太
example_sentence: Never have I seen Ms. Lin so angry about the noise.
sentence_zh: 我從未見過林老師對噪音如此生氣。

definition_zh: (副) 不；不是
example_sentence: The student said nope when the teacher asked for extra homework.
sentence_zh: 當老師要求額外作業時，那名學生說不。

definition_zh: (介) 的；關於；由…組成
example_sentence: If the cost of living were lower, many families would save more money.
sentence_zh: 如果生活成本更低，許多家庭會存更多錢。

definition_zh: (介) 在…之上；關於　(副) 繼續；穿上　(形) 開著的；正在發生的
example_sentence: Having put the backpack on, the student rushed to the classroom.
sentence_zh: 背上背包後，那名學生衝向教室。

definition_zh: (形) 外面的；不在的　(副) 在外；出去　(介) 在…外
example_sentence: The book that the teacher talked about is out of print.
sentence_zh: 老師提到的那本書已經絕版了。

definition_zh: (副) 向外
example_sentence: The tree branches grew outwards, blocking the sunlight from the garden.
sentence_zh: 樹枝向外生長，擋住了花園的陽光。

definition_zh: (動) 無意中聽到；偷聽到
example_sentence: While studying in the library, Jenny happened to overhear a secret conversation.
sentence_zh: 在圖書館讀書時，珍妮無意間偷聽到一段祕密對話。

definition_zh: (副) ……點鐘
example_sentence: Having finished the exam by five o’clock, the student felt relieved.
sentence_zh: 在五點前完成考試後，那名學生感到如釋重負。

definition_zh: (副) 下午
example_sentence: The train arrives at 3:00 p.m. every day to take students home.
sentence_zh: 火車每天下午三點到達，載學生回家。

definition_zh: (名) 父母；家長
example_sentence: Many parents work hard to support their children's education.
sentence_zh: 許多父母努力工作以支持孩子的教育。

definition_zh: (名) 小貨車；搭載；收集
example_sentence: The pickup truck carried many boxes to the new house.
sentence_zh: 那輛小貨車載了許多箱子到新房子。

definition_zh: (形) 極地的；極端的；相反的
example_sentence: The polar regions are experiencing rapid climate change.
sentence_zh: 極地地區正在經歷快速的氣候變化。

definition_zh: (名) 延期；延後
example_sentence: The sudden postponement of the exam upset many students.
sentence_zh: 考試的突然延期讓許多學生感到沮喪。

definition_zh: (名) 心理治療；精神療法
example_sentence: Many students consider psychotherapy a helpful way to reduce stress.
sentence_zh: 許多學生認為心理治療是減輕壓力的有效方法。

definition_zh: (名) 改良；精煉
example_sentence: This software refinement improves the user experience significantly.
sentence_zh: 這項軟體的改良顯著提升了使用者體驗。

definition_zh: (名) 點心；茶點
example_sentence: Serving light refreshments, the student council made the meeting more enjoyable.
sentence_zh: 提供簡單的點心，學生會讓會議更加愉快。

definition_zh: (形) 共和國的；共和政體的　(名) 共和主義者；共和黨員
example_sentence: Many students studied the republican system for their civics exam.
sentence_zh: 許多學生為了公民考試而研究共和制度。

definition_zh: (名) 女銷售員；女推銷員
example_sentence: If a saleswoman gives good service, customers often return.
sentence_zh: 如果女銷售員提供良好的服務，顧客通常會再回來。

definition_zh: (名) 鱗片；秤；規模
example_sentence: The fish scales shone brightly under the kitchen light.
sentence_zh: 魚鱗在廚房燈光下閃閃發亮。

definition_zh: (名) 鞋
example_sentence: My new shoes are comfortable for walking to school.
sentence_zh: 我的新鞋穿起來很舒服，適合走路上學。

definition_zh: (形) 短視的；近視的
example_sentence: Only after the crisis did the company admit its shortsighted policy.
sentence_zh: 直到危機過後，這家公司才承認其短視的政策。

definition_zh: (形) 主權的　(名) 君主；主權國家
example_sentence: A sovereign state has the power to make its own laws without outside interference.
sentence_zh: 一個主權國家有權制定自己的法律，不受外部干預。

definition_zh: (名) 女發言人
example_sentence: The company spokeswoman announced the new policy during the press conference.
sentence_zh: 公司女發言人在記者會上宣布了新政策。

definition_zh: (名) 樓梯；階梯
example_sentence: The old stair creaked loudly as the students walked up.
sentence_zh: 舊樓梯在學生們走上去時大聲作響。

definition_zh: (名) 長襪；襪子
example_sentence: My grandmother wore warm stockings under her dress in winter.
sentence_zh: 我的祖母在冬天時，在裙子裡穿上溫暖的長襪。

definition_zh: (名) 姓氏
example_sentence: After the teacher asked for his surname, the student wrote it down.
sentence_zh: 老師問了他的姓氏後，學生把它寫了下來。

definition_zh: (名) 恐怖主義
example_sentence: Learning about terrorism in class helps students understand global issues.
sentence_zh: 在課堂上學習恐怖主義幫助學生了解全球議題。

definition_zh: (名) 神學；宗教學
example_sentence: Students study theology to understand different religious beliefs.
sentence_zh: 學生研讀神學以了解不同的宗教信仰。

definition_zh: (介) 到；向　(副) 關上；朝向　(助) 不定詞標記
example_sentence: Having finished all the homework, the student went to play basketball.
sentence_zh: 做完所有功課後，那個學生去打籃球。

definition_zh: (介) 朝向；對於
example_sentence: Many students feel nervous towards the end of the semester.
sentence_zh: 許多學生在學期末感到緊張。

definition_zh: (形) 向上的；起床的　(副) 向上；起床　(介) 向上
example_sentence: The student who is up early often finishes his homework.
sentence_zh: 早起的學生常常完成他的作業。

definition_zh: (名) 工資；薪資
example_sentence: If the company raised wages, more workers would apply for jobs.
sentence_zh: 如果公司提高工資，會有更多求職者申請工作。

definition_zh: (名) 威士忌
example_sentence: My father bought a bottle of whisky for his friend's birthday.
sentence_zh: 我父親為朋友的生日買了一瓶威士忌。

definition_zh: (代) 誰；...的人
example_sentence: The student who studies hard often gets good grades.
sentence_zh: 用功讀書的學生通常會得到好成績。

definition_zh: (代) 它
example_sentence: If it rains tomorrow, the school sports day will be postponed.
sentence_zh: 如果明天下雨，學校的運動會就會延期。

definition_zh: (名詞) 滅火器
example_sentence: The teacher showed the students how to use a fire extinguisher safely.
sentence_zh: 老師向學生示範如何安全使用滅火器。
